job.name: Senior Threat Researcher - Windows
job.description:
Hiring for Lean SuperIntelligence — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

ABOUT US

We are a stealth Frontier AI security startup building foundation models for security. Backed by Tier 1 venture capital firms and built by experts in sovereign AI, foundation models, and cybersecurity.

We have built models that already outperform frontier LLMs on cybersecurity benchmarks.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring a Founding Senior Threat Researcher to own Windows threat research, telemetry, detection, vulnerability discovery, and deep technical escalation.

You will reverse engineer malware and EDR behavior, fuzz Windows attack surfaces, develop exploits to prove impact, and build realistic environments used to benchmark autonomous offensive systems. Windows is the center of gravity, with meaningful work across identity, cloud, and containers.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Research Windows tradecraft end to end: process injection, LSASS credential access, token and handle abuse, UAC and privilege escalation, and persistence via services, COM, WMI, scheduled tasks, and registry.
  • Define Windows telemetry strategy across kernel callbacks, ETW and ETW-TI, minifilters, AMSI, and user-mode instrumentation.
  • Reverse engineer malware and offensive tooling to reconstruct behavior, capabilities, and command-and-control protocols.
  • Research EDR evasion and tampering, including driver abuse, BYOVD, ETW or AMSI bypass, callback removal, and PPL abuse; build counter-detections.
  • Build continuous fuzzing against services, RPC/COM, parsers, IOCTL handlers, and drivers using WinAFL, honggfuzz, TTD-assisted approaches, or custom harnesses.
  • Triage crashes to root cause and develop proof-of-impact exploits against CFG/XFG, CET, ACG, ASLR/KASLR, SMEP, VBS, HVCI, and other modern mitigations.
  • Audit Windows-facing open-source and third-party code, drive fixes, and support responsible disclosure.
  • Build intentionally vulnerable Windows labs and multi-stage kill chains for AI training and evaluation.
  • Ship detections with documented data sources, evasion boundaries, tests, and measured false-positive rates.
  • Follow endpoint compromise into Active Directory, Entra ID, Azure, and Windows container attack paths; support incidents and purple exercises.
  • Cover Windows containers and Docker on Windows hosts, including image abuse and container-escape classes; publish rigorous internal research and external work where appropriate.

QUALIFICATIONS

Project Engineer - Research and Development at Epiroc Mining India Private Ltd, Bengaluru We are seeking a dedicated and skilled Project Engineer to join our Corporate Units in the Research and Development department. This pivotal role within a technical company involves supporting the sourcing organisation by delivering reliable back-end sourcing and operational support. The successful candidate will enable cost-effective procurement, uphold supplier performance excellence, ensure data accuracy, maintain compliance, and support business continuity. Collaborating closely with suppliers and cross-functional stakeholders, the Project Engineer will enhance operational efficiency, contribute to KPI achievement, and support regionalization and sustainable sourcing initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders to implement sourcing strategies and support business decisions effectively.
  • Provide support to sourcing engineers and commodity teams in executing sourcing projects and managing operational activities to meet organizational goals.
  • Maintain and update sourcing master data, supplier records, contracts, and essential sourcing documentation to ensure accuracy and compliance.
  • Coordinate supplier onboarding, qualification processes, and verify compliance documentation as part of supplier management best practices.
  • Contribute to localisation, regionalisation, and supplier development programs to strengthen the supply chain.
  • Assist in the preparation and analysis of RFQs (Request for Quotations), quotations, and sourcing decision-making processes.
  • Manage sourcing-related data across ERP, SAP, PLM, and other business systems, safeguarding data integrity and governance adherence.
  • Maintain and support BOM (Bill of Materials), supplier part mapping, catalogues, and sourcing databases, driving data cleansing and standardization initiatives to improve efficiency.
  • Generate, analyze, and distribute sourcing KPIs, cost savings reports, spend analyses, and supplier performance dashboards to inform management and guide strategic decisions.
  • Monitor supplier delivery performance, lead times, and related operational metrics, addressing issues proactively.
  • Provide insightful management reports and support data-driven decision-making processes across the sourcing organization.
  • Analyze sourcing trends and proactively recommend process improvements to foster continuous advancement of sourcing functions.
  • Engage actively in continuous improvement efforts in line with Epiroc's Purchasing policy, promoting best practices and innovation.

Who are V? As a global leader in ship management and marine services, we add value to a vessel’s operations. Operating around the clock and around the world, V. gives every client the quality and efficiency they need in every sector. Covering crew management and recruitment, quality ship management and technical services, together with supporting management and commercial services, V. has an unrivalled industry knowledge with performance assured. Overall Purpose of The Job The Associate Emission Analyst is a supervised delivery role within Njord's Compliance team, positioned as a structured development step between the Assistant Emission Analyst and the Emission Analyst. This role supports the delivery of one compliance product for a designated vessel set under the guidance of the Senior Emission Analyst, while actively building the domain knowledge, data skills, and regulatory literacy required to progress to independent delivery. The role is expected to take ownership of defined, repeatable compliance tasks and develop the capability to manage a full product portfolio at the Emission Analyst level over time.

  • Escalate data issues and regulatory queries to the Senior Emission Analyst promptly and clearly, with sufficient context for resolution.

What can I expect in return? V. Group can offer you a market leading salary and benefits package, in addition to significant opportunities for career growth and personal development. job.name: Product Manager, Input Zone
job.description:
About our Team:- DSM Product is the product management team within Data Source Management (DSM, led by Adrian Scotney), part of Data Operations (led by Kanwar Singh). It is led by the Head of Product Management and owns product management for how publisher content enters the Input Zone, Elsevier’s governed gateway for academic publisher content. This includes technical onboarding, ingestion development, publisher rights data (Salesforce) and the Platform Intelligence reporting that supports content providers.

The team is organised around three areas: Platform Intelligence (PLINT), Salesforce/SCM, and the Content Acquisition Liaisons functions that cover ingestion development and technical onboarding.

About the Role:- The Product Manager, Input Zone will own the technical onboarding and ingestion-development activities for the Content Acquisition Liaisons group and lead execution of related workstreams. They will own the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow, represent this area within the PM team, and have a solid understanding of content providers and publishers. They will represent their technical needs to the delivery team, prioritise and communicate production issues affecting ingestion or onboarding, and support and participate in demos to key stakeholders at programme milestones.

Responsibilities:- Customer Focus

  • Interacts with content providers, publishers, and internal engineering teams during technical onboarding and represents their requirements.
  • Anticipates onboarding and ingestion needs (for example, journal processing moving to the DPOP-601 workflow and the Scopus transition off the legacy OpsBank workflow) and prioritises them for the group.
  • Acts as a named Onboarding Technical Liaison, fielding technical questions from content providers and publishers during negotiation so engineering capacity stays focused on implementation.
  • Focuses on meeting onboarding timelines without compromising the completeness or quality of ingested content.

Data-Driven Decision-Making & Analysis

  • Autonomously analyses onboarding, delivery, and completeness-checking data from multiple sources (content providers, engineering, Governance reporting).
  • Compares and evaluates ingestion and onboarding options, and makes recommendations that consider business implications.
  • Uses AI tools responsibly to accelerate analysis, and validates the results before acting on them.

Onboarding & Content Acquisition Lifecycle

job.name: Technical Consultant - ERP
job.description:
Job Description The Technical Consultant - ERP is responsible for the analysis, design, configuration, implementation, and ongoing support of the company’s on-premise SAP HR/Payroll environment. This role will serve as a subject matter expert for SAP HR/Payroll configuration and processing. This role will collaborate with business stakeholders, IT teams, vendors, and other technology partners to define solutions that meet business requirements and organizational objectives.

The SAP HR/Payroll Architect will also provide technical guidance, knowledge transfer, and mentoring to other team members while ensuring solutions are aligned with established development, change management, security, and support processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement and/or support on-premise SAP HR/Payroll ECC 6 EHP8 in a manufacturing environment.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for SAP Payroll with experience in Personnel Administration, Organizational Management, and Benefits configuration.
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into effective SAP HR/Payroll designs and configuration solutions.
  • Develop alternative solutions, evaluate options, and present recommendations to business stakeholders and IT management.
  • Configure, test, implement, and support SAP HR/Payroll changes within a formal System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and change management methodology.
  • Provide ongoing production support, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and resolution of complex SAP HR/Payroll issues.
  • Implement, maintain, support, and troubleshoot the Rsite Tax Engine , including coordination with Rimini Street and the application, testing, and validation of tax updates and releases.
  • Manage the impact of Rsite Tax Engine updates on SAP Payroll, including payroll configuration, tax calculations, testing, regression testing, and production implementation.
  • Partner with Rimini Street and other vendors to investigate and resolve tax engine, payroll, and integration-related issues.
  • Support payroll tax compliance activities by ensuring applicable federal, state, and local tax updates are appropriately tested and implemented in the Rsite Tax Engine/SAP Payroll environment.
  • Understand and manage integration touchpoints between SAP HR/Payroll, Rsite Tax Engine, SuccessFactors, Kronos Workforce Management, and other downstream or upstream applications.
  • Implement and support SaaS solutions and their integrations with SAP HR/Payroll.
  • Manage, prioritize, and complete support requests for a large and complex organization.
  • Estimate and plan work effort for projects, enhancements, upgrades, tax updates, and production support activities.
  • Independently perform technical, configuration, testing, documentation, and process-related activities.
  • Develop and maintain appropriate system documentation, configuration documentation, test scripts, and support procedures.
  • Work collaboratively across HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, and external vendor teams

job.name: Security Engineer, Leo Security
job.description:
Description Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband network connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

We are a specialized security team that sits inside a global satellite communications business. Our job is to make sure security lessons become permanent: when a security event happens, we find the root cause, close the immediate gap, and build the mechanism that keeps it closed. We watch across the whole environment, spot the trends others are too busy to chase, and turn them into initiatives that measurably reduce risk.

We work shoulder to shoulder with the builder teams designing, launching, and operating the product, and we partner closely with incident response, detection, and enterprise security functions. Over the coming years our focus is shifting further upstream: getting ahead of incidents through proactive posture improvement, hunting for gaps before they are exploited, and investing in automation so security scales with the business rather than against it. If you want your work to protect customers of a system being built at a scale few companies attempt, you will find that purpose here.

Export Control Requirement

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national.

Key job responsibilities

You will analyze the security events observed across Amazon Leo, separating each one into the immediate fixes it demands and the longer-term, systemic trends it reveals across the organization.

You will prioritize this work by the severity and business impact of the threat to Leo, concentrating your effort on the most serious security issues and making sound risk-based trade-offs to deliver against them on time.

You will drive immediate fixes to closure by identifying the right team or individual to own each task, and by creating the mechanisms needed to ensure security outcomes are prioritized and tracked to completion across teams with competing priorities.

You will lead time-boxed Find and Fix missions to investigate and clarify emerging security trends, turning early and ambiguous signals into a validated understanding of the underlying problem.

You will own security initiatives end-to-end that resolve the root cause of systemic trends, favoring centralized, secure-by-default controls that measurably and durably reduce risk across the organization.

A day in the life

Role In this highly dynamic role, you will decide where your time investments deliver the most security value, balancing proactive posture-improvement work against reactive support when security events arise. Teams across the business will reach out for guidance on a wide variety of security problems, and you can anticipate questions like:

"What's the right way to handle authentication tokens in service-to-service communications?"

job.name: Security Systems Engineer
job.description:
About Fluidstack We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply! How We Operate

  • Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.
  • Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.
  • Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.
  • Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.
  • Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

The Security Team

Examples of key problems the team is working on

  • You're securing the frontier of AI. The model weights training on our infrastructure are the most valuable and most targeted artifacts in technology, and we're standing up the compute to hold them faster than anyone ever has. A breach isn't a leak, it's the frontier walking out the door.

job.name: Senior Industry Research Analyst
job.description:
Job Requirements About the Role The Senior Industry Research Analyst will support the Wholesale Banking Risk function by delivering deep, sector-agnostic insights across high-exposure industries in the bank’s portfolio. This role involves conducting in-depth research, identifying early warning indicators, and publishing high-quality reports that inform strategic decisions. The analyst will also contribute to regulatory submissions and policy presentations, while staying abreast of market trends and competitor benchmarks. The position is based in Mumbai.

Key Responsibilities Primary Responsibilities

  • Develop in-house expertise through incisive analysis of high-exposure industries and sectors in the bank’s portfolio.
  • Conduct sector-agnostic assessments covering demand-supply dynamics, cost structures, competitiveness, and regulatory frameworks.
  • Identify sectors under stress or recovery using early warning indicators, industry benchmarks, and peer reviews.
  • Provide medium-term outlooks on key parameters for high-exposure sectors.
  • Perform portfolio analysis to evaluate financial performance trends of companies within specific industries.
  • Develop industry-specific financial and operational metrics to support credit evaluation.
  • Present research findings and reports to senior management and other stakeholders.
  • Publish reports covering sector trends, auto sales data, commodity prices, industry health, and more.
  • Take ownership of regulatory submissions, including reports on stressed and correlated sectors.
  • Optionally participate in credit risk assessments for Financial Institution clients.

Secondary Responsibilities

  • Stay updated with market intelligence through peer networking and industry publications.
  • Recommend improvements to processes and policies to enhance operational efficiency and service quality.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to leverage synergies across the Wholesale Banking business.

What We Are Looking For Education Graduation: Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Economics, Finance, Business, Statistics)

Post-graduation: MBA, CA

Experience Minimum 4yrs in BFSI

Skills And Attributes

  • Excellent research and analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex industry data
  • Strong understanding of macroeconomic and sectoral trends
  • Experience in preparing regulatory submissions and board-level presentations
  • Effective communication and presentation skills
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively across teams
  • Proficiency in data visualization and reporting tools

Key Success Metrics

  • Timely publication and presentation of high-quality reports, including:
  • Industry-related trackers (e.g., corporate performance, share pledges, auto sales)
  • Policy and board presentations (e.g., stressed sectors, correlated sectors)
  • RBI submissions and economic/industry surveys

job.name: BUSINESS GROWTH & MANAGEMENT COORDINATOR
job.description:

Position: BUSINESS GROWTH & MANAGEMENT COORDINATOR

Company: Asukara Nature Private Limited

Brand: Burgerwala®

📍 Location: Delhi NCR

💰 Salary: ₹30,000 – ₹40,000 Per Month + Company Insurance

💼 Experience: 3–5 Years Preferred

ABOUT THE ROLE

Asukara Nature Private Limited is looking for a smart, proactive and result-oriented professional to work directly with the Founder/Management.

The primary responsibility of this role is to support business growth, improve interdepartmental coordination, analyse business performance, maintain accurate management reports and ensure that all teams work towards common organisational goals.

The selected candidate will act as a coordination link between Management, Operations, Marketing and Accounts.

This is a management coordination and business growth role, not a replacement for or supervisory position over any existing department head.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Business Growth & Development

\* Work closely with the Founder/Management to identify business growth opportunities.

\* Analyse overall business performance and suggest innovative growth strategies.

\* Coordinate with the Operations Head to understand outlet-wise performance, challenges and improvement opportunities.

\* Analyse sales, profitability, customer retention and business expansion opportunities.

\* Bring creative ideas to improve revenue, efficiency and overall business performance.

2. Interdepartmental Coordination

\* Maintain regular communication with Operations, Marketing and Accounts Teams.

\* Organise regular departmental and management review meetings.

\* Ensure proper communication between all departments.

\* Track important decisions, action points and pending tasks.

\* Help departments work together towards common business objectives.

3. Business Reports & Data Analysis

\* Collect, review and verify reports submitted by different departments.

\* Ensure accuracy and consistency of business data.

\* Analyse outlet-wise sales, expenses, marketing performance and financial reports.

\* Share verified reports and observations with the Founder/Management and respective departments.

\* Maintain centralised business records, trackers and performance dashboards.

4. Management Support & Follow-ups

\* Follow up on tasks and decisions assigned by the Founder/Management.

\* Coordinate with department heads to ensure timely execution.

\* Identify gaps in departmental reporting and communication.

\* Prepare weekly and monthly management review reports.

\* Highlight important business issues and suggest practical solutions.

5. Company Policies & Process Coordination

\* Coordinate with all departments to ensure company policies, rules and SOPs are followed.

\* Maintain proper documentation of company processes.

\* Highlight policy deviations and report them to Management.

\* Support the development of better systems and working processes.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

job.name: Principal Consultant - Transportation and Infrastructure advisory
job.description:
Job Description At WSP, we are driven by a shared purpose: to create positive, long-lasting impacts on the world around us. As a global leader in strategic advisory services, we are proud to have been named #1 Advisor by Deal Value in 2024 by Infranews. Our Investment and Transaction Advisory team plays a leading role in shaping transport infrastructure investment and delivery, combining technical expertise with commercial insight to support capital allocation, project development, and transaction execution.

We are seeking an experienced Principal Consultant to join our growing advisory team, with a focus on technical and commercial due diligence and strategic advisory in transportation and infrastructure (T&I).

This is a senior role to work as part of the wider advisory team across end-to-end transaction cycles, including origination support, due diligence, investment decision-making, and post-deal strategic advisory - across a diverse portfolio of assets such as:

  • Roads (toll roads, highways, expressways)
  • Rail and metro systems
  • Airports and aviation infrastructure
  • Ports, terminals, and logistics platforms
  • Urban mobility (bus systems, EV infrastructure, intermodal hubs)

This is a unique opportunity to work across a diverse portfolio of infrastructure asset classes, including transport technologies and energy infrastructure , while also providing exposure to a broader range of infrastructure sectors, including energy, transport and social infrastructure, across high-profile investment transactions and strategic advisory mandates.

Responsibilities

  • Supporting the delivery of technical due diligence assignments for investors, lenders, and developers across transportation infrastructure assets
  • Overseeing assessments covering:
  • Asset condition, operations, and lifecycle performance
  • Demand forecasts, traffic/revenue assumptions, and capacity utilisation
  • Capex requirements (expansion, lifecycle, rehabilitation)
  • O&M strategies, contracts, and performance benchmarking
  • Providing strategic advisory across:
  • PPP/PFI concessions and contract structures
  • Investment cases, business plans, and valuation inputs
  • Risk identification, mitigation strategies, and sensitivity analysis
  • Providing technical and commercial input into bids and pursuits, shaping competitive proposals through robust asset and demand insights to strengthen proposals.
  • Supporting cross-sector infrastructure assignments, leveraging WSP’s broader capabilities in digital, energy interface, and sustainability.
  • Participating in international engagements, including site visits and stakeholder meetings where required.

job.name: master data management
job.description:
I am responsible for managing and maintaining Master Data in SAP, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and proper data governance across business operations. My key responsibilities include creating, updating, and maintaining vendor master data, including vendor codes and related information. I also handle material code creation, extension, and maintenance, along with managing Sales and Distribution (SD) data. Additionally, I am responsible for creating customer SAP IDs, extending customer master records, and maintaining accurate Sales and Distribution information.

I actively work on Data Governance to ensure that all master data follows company policies, standards, and procedures. I also perform regular and periodic validation of master data to maintain data accuracy, consistency, and reliability while identifying and correcting discrepancies.

Apart from Master Data Management, I am involved in preparing and analysing various operational reports, including NPS (Net Promoter Score), outlet-wise performance reports, and guest feedback reports. These reports help monitor customer satisfaction, evaluate outlet performance, and identify areas for improvement. I coordinate data collection, verification, and reporting to ensure timely and accurate information. My overall focus is on maintaining high-quality data, improving reporting processes, and supporting effective business decision-making through accurate data management and analysis.

job.name: Ecommerce Specialist
job.description:
We're Hiring: E-Commerce Specialist

Company: Indian Sports Gear (ISG)

Location: Dwarka, New Delhi, India

Employment Type: Full-time

Work Mode: On-site

Experience Required: 1–2 Years

About Indian Sports Gear

Indian Sports Gear (ISG) is a tactical apparel and equipment brand focused on providing high-quality, functional and durable products. Our product range includes tactical clothing, jackets, apparel and accessories designed with an emphasis on quality, comfort and performance.

We aim to build a strong presence in the tactical and outdoor gear market through quality products, customer satisfaction and a growing e-commerce presence.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented E-Commerce Specialist with 1–2 years of hands-on experience in managing multiple online marketplaces.

The ideal candidate must have a good understanding of marketplace operations, product catalogue management, inventory coordination, order processing and online sales management.

The candidate will be responsible for managing our e-commerce operations across multiple platforms and ensuring smooth business operations while contributing to online sales growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage day-to-day operations across multiple e-commerce marketplaces.
  • Handle marketplace accounts such as Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho and other relevant platforms.
  • Create, manage and optimize product listings, titles, descriptions, images and specifications.
  • Manage product catalogues, pricing, inventory and stock availability across platforms.
  • Monitor orders, dispatches, returns, cancellations and order fulfilment.
  • Coordinate with warehouse and logistics teams to ensure timely deliveries.
  • Monitor marketplace performance, sales reports and product analytics.
  • Identify opportunities to improve product visibility, rankings and conversion rates.
  • Handle marketplace account health, listing issues and operational challenges.
  • Conduct competitor analysis and monitor pricing trends.
  • Maintain accurate product information across all selling platforms.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 1–2 years of experience in e-commerce operations or marketplace management.
  • Practical knowledge of multiple e-commerce marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho and others.
  • Experience in product listing, catalogue management and inventory management.
  • Understanding of marketplace dashboards, seller panels and account operations.
  • Good knowledge of MS Excel and Google Sheets.
  • Strong analytical, organizational and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple marketplace operations independently.
  • Good communication and coordination skills.

Who Should Apply?

We are looking for someone with practical experience managing multiple marketplace seller accounts, who takes ownership of responsibilities and understands the fundamentals of online selling.

Atlys is changing that.

About This Role As a Senior Security Engineer at Kontakt.io, you'll protect the platform hospitals rely on to run their operations: devices and gateways on hospital floors, cloud services on AWS, and the AI tools our engineers use every day. You're an engineer first. You'll pen test our most critical services, write the fixes and the tooling yourself, and build your own roadmap from what you find. We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.

Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.

Role Overview

The Detection Operations team is responsible for protecting Coupang's global attack surface across web, network, email, and endpoint security. We operate and manage a broad range of security technologies, including enterprise security appliances, endpoint protection platforms, and cloud-based SaaS security services.

Our mission is to detect, investigate, and mitigate cyber threats before they impact the business. By combining proactive threat detection, rapid response, and in-depth root cause analysis, we help minimize security risks while continuously improving our overall security posture and preventing future incidents.

Why Join Detection Operations?

At Coupang, security operates at massive scale. As a member of the Detection Operations team, you will have the opportunity to work across multiple security domains, including:

  • Web Security
  • Network Security
  • Email Security
  • Endpoint Security

Rather than being confined to a single technology or security domain, you will gain hands-on experience with a diverse set of security solutions and services that protect one of the largest e-commerce and technology platforms in the world.

You will work closely with experienced security engineers and subject matter experts across multiple disciplines, providing unique opportunities to expand both your technical depth and breadth. Team members are encouraged to take ownership, drive improvements, and contribute directly to strengthening Coupang's security capabilities.

job.name: System Verification Engineer
job.description:
Job Title: System Verification Engineer Job Description As a System Verification Engineer, you validate complete optical networking systems composed of multiple interconnected network elements. This is a system-level role that combines hardware, software, firmware, and network behavior, ensuring that complex optical transport solutions operate reliably end-to-end. You design and execute both automated and manual tests, simulate real-world customer scenarios and fault conditions, and play a key role in advancing cutting-edge optical networking technologies that underpin modern digital infrastructure.

Responsibilities

  • Validate entire optical networking systems, including multiple interconnected network elements, to ensure end-to-end functionality and performance.
  • Build comprehensive system-level test plans that cover normal operation, upgrades, corner cases, and fault scenarios.
  • Create detailed test cases directly from system and customer requirements, ensuring full requirements validation.
  • Execute a mix of automation and manual testing, with approximately 4050% of the work focused on Python-based test automation and the remainder on manual testing involving physical hardware and optical equipment.
  • Verify end-to-end system functionality across hardware, software, firmware, and optical transport components.
  • Perform software upgrade testing to confirm that new software releases integrate correctly and maintain system stability.
  • Perform firmware upgrade testing to ensure compatibility and robust operation after firmware changes.
  • Simulate failures and perform fault injection to validate system behavior under adverse and corner-case conditions.

5. Improve testing intelligence: Leverage AI agents to identify coverage gaps, generate meaningful test scenarios, and prioritize testing based on product changes and risk.

6. Design QA for scale: Build workflows that support growing product complexity and engineering velocity without requiring proportional increases in QA staffing.

8. Raise the engineering bar: Mentor engineers, establish testing standards, and drive a culture where quality is owned across the engineering organization.

1. Staff-level engineering expertise with deep experience in Quality Engineering, Software Development in Test (SDET), or Test Automation Architecture.

Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

We seek an experienced Staff Software Engineer in Test to join our Okta Secures AI Team.

The Okta Secures AI Team is building the future of digital identity management. The way companies are using agents and allowing them access is undergoing a fundamental shift, enabling teams to move fast while staying secure. Our North Star is clear: To get AI right, you have to get identity right. We are not just managing identities; we are building the industry's first Identity Security Fabric for the agentic era. As organizations rapidly deploy AI, these non-human entities are acting with access to critical tools, often bypassing traditional perimeters and creating a 'Shadow AI' crisis. Our mission is to move identity from a reactive gatekeeper to a unified control plane, transforming AI risk into business ROI.

We are tackling this by implementing a comprehensive four-pillar maturity model: Discover, Onboard, Protect, and Govern. We are driving innovation by defining the standards for Agent Identity—including pioneer work with the AI Agent Tool Registry and support for protocols like MCP and IPSI

In this role, you'll be working with a team of highly skilled and talented engineers responsible for allowing enterprises to scale AI safely, ensuring every access decision—whether made by a human or an automated agent—is authenticated, authorized, and audited at scale. As part of the team, you’ll ensure projects are completed with the highest quality and reliability using automation at every level for fast, robust, secure releases.

job.name: Platform Engineer – Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance
job.description:
Job Title: Platform Engineer – Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance GCL: D3 Introduction To Role Do you want to build the clear routes that ensure secure delivery becomes the standard across a global enterprise? Can you turn sophisticated security and compliance controls into simple, reusable developer experiences that teams love to adopt?

In this role, you will develop the outspoken pipelines, infrastructure modules, and automation that power efficient, secure software delivery at scale. Your work will reduce friction for engineering teams, embed security-by-design from the start, and accelerate the delivery of technology that underpins life-changing science for patients worldwide.

You will partner closely with engineering, security, architecture, and operations to shape enterprise-grade platform capabilities—hands-on and end-to-end. Expect to start by shipping high-impact, reusable assets and evolve into guiding standards and adoption across hundreds of engineers, always balancing deep technical difficulty with practical, outcome-focused delivery.

Accountabilities

  • Golden Paths & Shared GitHub Actions: Design, build, and version enterprise-grade shared GitHub Actions (Composite Actions and Reusable Workflows) and standardized delivery templates to create secure, automated "Golden Paths" across product teams.
  • Reusable Infrastructure-as-Code: Build and maintain secure, modular Terraform modules and IaC assets, versioned and documented for broad reuse and easy consumption.
  • Embedded DevSecOps Controls: Integrate SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM generation, and supply chain protections into default delivery workflows, shifting security left through automation and policy-as-code guardrails.
  • Secure CI/CD Patterns: Create scalable, resilient CI/CD patterns aligned to enterprise standards, applying least privilege and reducing configuration risk to strengthen operational reliability.
  • Automation and Internal Tooling: Develop automation services and developer tooling in Python or Golang that enable self-service onboarding, secure defaults, and consistent quality checks.
  • Multi-Environment Architecture: Chip in to solutions spanning cloud, serverless, containerized, compute, and hybrid environments, producing reference architectures, diagrams, and implementation guidance that accelerate adoption.
  • Testing and Quality Engineering: Define and execute testing strategies for infrastructure code and automation (unit, integration, and environment validation) to ensure repeatable, high-quality delivery.
  • Adoption and Continuous Improvement: Partner with product and platform consumers to drive adoption, capture feedback, and iterate on patterns and assets to enhance developer experience and business value.
  • AI-Enabled Engineering: Apply AI tools and techniques where appropriate to improve development speed, quality, secure design, and innovation, sharing learning and elevating team practices.

Technical Skills, Coding, And Automation

job.name: SAP Order Management Solution Architect
job.description:
Role: SAP Order Management Solution Architect Location: Pune (Hybrid)

Life Unlimited. At Smith+Nephew, we design and manufacture technology that takes the limits off living.

Smith & Nephew (S+N) is a large multinational Medical Technology organization with an extensive Enterprise Applications ecosystem to run end-to-end business operations. ERPs form the core of this ecosystem and are tightly integrated with best-in-class systems such as Salesforce, Windchill, Movemedical, Maestro, Ariba, Workday and many more. At S+N, SAP serves as our primary and strategic ERP platform, running 80% of our operations and revenue.

We are seeking an SAP Order Management Solution Architect to design and deliver SAP solutions and customizations aligned with business requirements, while supporting and preparing for our strategic transition to SAP S/4HANA. Therefore, this role is both strategic and pivotal, playing a key part in enabling Smith & Nephew's digital transformation and continued growth over the coming years.

What will you be doing?

  • The Order Management Solution Architect is responsible for partnering with Business Process Owners to design and deliver Order to Cash solutions that meet business needs.
  • This role requires strong SAP OM/SD expertise, a solid understanding of complex multinational business processes, and experience delivering large-scale global SAP implementations.
  • The ideal candidate combines strong solution architecture capabilities with the ability to drive business value through standardized, scalable, and efficient processes.
  • Define enterprise integration architecture aligned with SAP roadmap (SAP ECC, S/4HANA, SAP BTP etc.).
  • Collaborate with business, functional, and technical stakeholders and translate business requirements into integration architecture designs.
  • Lead system integration architecture across SAP and third-party applications.
  • Design end-to-end integration solutions using: SAP PI/PO (Process Integration/Orchestration) SAP BTP Integration Suite (CPI, API Management, Open Connectors).
  • Ensure integration scalability, high availability, and performance optimization.
  • Implement security protocols (OAuth, SAML, certificates, encryption).
  • Provide guidance during implementation and production support.
  • Troubleshoot complex integration issues and Lead root-cause analysis and performance tuning.
  • Participates in SAP related projects (releases and/or rollouts) and conducts requirement gathering, fit/gap analysis, design and build activities.
  • Focus on continuous improvement, keeping up with industry and proactively advising the business of new capabilities that can help them support the company’s growth and strategy.

job.name: Databricks Solution Architect (End-to-End Platform)
job.description:
Databricks Solution Architect (End-to-End Platform)

Location: Hyderabad(hybrid)

Duration: Long term/ Full Time

Excellent Salary and Benefits

Experience: 8-14 years

We are looking for an experienced Databricks Solution Architect to lead end-to-end platform strategy, migration execution, and architectural governance for large-scale enterprise data modernization.

In this role, you will define our target-state architecture, establish technical standards, and guide engineering teams through migrating mission-critical workloads from legacy platforms like Teradata and Alteryx onto Azure Databricks.

What You Will Do

  • Define Target Architecture & Strategy: Design end-to-end Azure Databricks Lakehouse architectures, establish engineering standards, and craft pragmatic migration roadmaps for enterprise-scale modernization.
  • Lead Legacy Migrations: Architect and oversee migrations from Teradata and Alteryx to Databricks, managing SQL compatibility, workflow dependencies, and downstream BI impacts.
  • Drive Platform Excellence & FinOps: Implement robust CI/CD pipelines using Databricks Asset Bundles, alongside proactive monitoring, performance tuning, and cost governance frameworks.
  • Enable Next-Gen Data & AI Capabilities: Architect solutions leveraging Unity Catalog, Medallion Architecture, Lakeflow, Databricks SQL, and emerging capabilities like Lakebase, Databricks Apps, and Databricks Genie.
  • Bridge Data Engineering & BI: Ensure seamless integration and semantic model alignment across enterprise BI platforms (Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos).

What You Bring

  • Enterprise Modernization Track Record: Proven experience architecting and delivering at least one large-scale enterprise Databricks migration or modernization project.
  • Deep Databricks Expertise: Strong mastery of Azure Databricks Lakehouse architecture, Medallion Architecture, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and enterprise data governance.
  • Modern Databricks Stack: Hands-on knowledge of Databricks SQL, SQL Warehouses, Lakeflow Jobs, and Declarative Pipelines, plus architectural familiarity with Lakebase, Databricks Apps, and Databricks Genie .
  • DevOps & Governance: Practical experience with Databricks CI/CD, Asset Bundles, workload monitoring, query/cluster performance optimization, and cost governance.
  • Legacy & ETL Migration: Strong understanding of Teradata architecture (migration patterns, SQL compatibility, dependency analysis) and Alteryx architecture (workflow dependencies and Databricks integration).
  • Azure Cloud Foundations: Solid grasp of Azure data and security services, including ADLS Gen2, Key Vault, networking fundamentals, and enterprise security best practices.
  • BI Architecture Experience: Past hands-on experience and architectural understanding of semantic models and reporting dependencies in at least one or two major BI tools ( Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos ).

Read the full description

job.name: Staff FullStack Engineer, Secures AI
job.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Okta Secures AI Team

The Okta Secures AI Team is building the future of digital identity management. The way companies are using agents and allowing them access is undergoing a fundamental shift, enabling teams to move fast while staying secure.

Our North Star is clear: To get AI right, you have to get identity right. We are not just managing identities; we are building the industry's first Identity Security Fabric for the agentic era. As organizations rapidly deploy AI, these non-human entities are acting with access to critical tools, often bypassing traditional perimeters and creating a 'Shadow AI' crisis. Our mission is to move identity from a reactive gatekeeper to a unified control plane, transforming AI risk into business ROI.

We are tackling this by implementing a comprehensive four-pillar maturity model: Discover, Onboard, Protect, and Govern. We are driving innovation by defining the standards for Agent Identity—including pioneer work with the AI Agent Tool Registry and support for protocols like MCP and IPSIE. You will be helping us build the infrastructure that allows enterprises to scale AI safely, ensuring every access decision—whether made by a human or an automated agent—is authenticated, authorized, and audited at scale.

We are a diverse team of engineers, product managers, and designers who are bringing Okta’s expertise in identity to define the future of Agent Identity management, focusing on enablement while staying secure.

The Staff FullStack Engineer Opportunity

As a Staff Fullstack Engineer on the Okta Secures AI team, your mission is to build the industry's first Identity Security Fabric for the agentic era. You are the architect of our unified control plane, ensuring that we operationalize our North Star: "To get AI right, you have to get identity right."

You will lead the technical implementation of our four-pillar maturity model—Discover, Onboard, Protect, and Govern—to provide enterprise-grade visibility and governance for both human and non-human identities. By architecting solutions that move beyond reactive perimeter security, you will empower organizations to prevent "Shadow AI" and transform AI risk into business ROI.

Read the full description

job.name: Staff Software Engineer, Backend (Resilience)
job.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

We are seeking a seasoned Staff Engineer to help drive our Resilience Engineering team. This role is critical in ensuring the safety and reliability of our production systems through proactive validation techniques, including production load testing and chaos engineering.

What You’ll Do Leadership & Strategy

  • Define and drive the vision for resilience engineering at Affirm, with a focus on production load testing and chaos engineering as first-class engineering practices.
  • Tech lead and mentor a team of engineers building platforms and tooling for safe production experimentation.
  • Partner with infrastructure, product, and security leadership to embed resilience validation into the software development lifecycle.
  • Establish best practices for safely testing system limits and failure scenarios in production.

Systems & Operations

  • Own the design and evolution of platforms that enable safe, controlled production load testing and fault injection.
  • Ensure strong safeguards are in place, including isolation boundaries, approval workflows, and automated rollback mechanisms to protect real users.
  • Build systems that provide end-to-end observability, traceability, and auditability for all resilience experiments.
  • Drive reliability improvements by systematically identifying weaknesses through load testing and chaos experiments.
  • Establish monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices tailored to proactive resilience validation.

Collaboration & Enablement

  • Work closely with engineering teams to design and execute production load tests and chaos experiments safely.
  • Partner with infrastructure teams to build guardrails around tests and experimentations.
  • Enable teams to adopt resilience practices by providing reusable tooling, frameworks, and standardized workflows.
  • Identify systemic weaknesses and lead cross-functional efforts to improve reliability and fault tolerance.
  • Evangelize a culture of “test failure before failure tests you” across the organization.

What We Look For

job.name: Senior Systems Engineer (Azure & Hybrid Infrastructure)
job.description:
Job Title: Senior Systems Engineer (Azure & Hybrid Infrastructure)

Location: Canada

Work Arrangement: Remote

Employment Type: Contract

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Systems Engineer to build, manage and optimize enterprise Azure and hybrid Microsoft infrastructure. This is a hands-on engineering role focused approximately 60% on Azure platform engineering and operations and 40% on Windows Server, Active Directory and hybrid Microsoft infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy and manage Azure infrastructure, including virtual machines, storage, subscriptions and resource groups.
  • Lead Azure infrastructure builds, migrations, backup, recovery and disaster recovery initiatives.
  • Manage Azure governance, RBAC, Azure Policy, monitoring and cost optimization.
  • Administer Azure DevOps services and infrastructure deployment pipelines.
  • Automate infrastructure operations using PowerShell and Azure automation.
  • Manage and troubleshoot Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS and core infrastructure services.
  • Support Microsoft Entra ID, hybrid identity, Entra Connect and Microsoft 365 administration.
  • Maintain PKI, certificate management, server hardening, patching and recovery standards.
  • Collaborate with Infrastructure, Network, Security and Architecture teams to deliver infrastructure improvements.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in Systems Engineering, IT Infrastructure or Cloud Infrastructure.
  • Strong hands-on experience engineering and managing production Azure environments.
  • Experience with Azure VMs, storage, RBAC, monitoring, backup and recovery.
  • Experience with Azure infrastructure migrations and Azure DevOps administration.
  • Strong PowerShell scripting and automation skills.
  • Strong Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy and DNS expertise.
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, hybrid identity and Microsoft 365 administration.
  • Working knowledge of PKI, certificates, server security and disaster recovery.

Nice to Have

  • Azure Migrate, Azure Site Recovery, Azure Arc and Update Manager.
  • Defender for Servers and Azure Policy.
  • Terraform, Bicep or Infrastructure as Code.
  • VMware, Hyper-V, Citrix or enterprise backup platforms.
  • Microsoft Azure certifications.

The Role We're looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our Device Management team.

This is an engineering role first: you'll design and build test automation frameworks, tooling, and infrastructure that let the whole team ship confidently at speed. You'll write real code, against our Rust/Node.js APIs, our React front end, and our AWS serverless infrastructure, to make the system testable, simulate device behavior at scale, and catch problems before they reach customers. You'll work as a peer to developers, contributing to architecture discussions, code reviews, and design decisions, with quality and testability as your lens.

You'll have significant latitude to shape how the team approaches testing, from framework design to CI/CD integration to how we simulate thousands of IoT devices and video streams in a repeatable, automated way.

What You’ll Do Automation Framework & Tooling Development

  • Design, build, and maintain automated test frameworks and libraries spanning REST APIs, UI (React), security, and end-to-end/integration layers.

  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines, optimizing for fast, reliable feedback on every build and deployment.
  • Evaluate and introduce new tools, frameworks, and approaches to keep test infrastructure scalable as the platform and team grow.

Engineering Collaboration & Architecture

Redwood empowers organizations to intelligently automate and orchestrate mission-critical business and IT processes across complex ERP, hybrid cloud, data and emerging agentic AI systems. Through its SaaS-first automation fabric—with AI embedded across the automation lifecycle—Redwood accelerates the path to autonomous operations. job.name: Operations Engineer, MetalDev
job.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

About The Role CoreWeave's MetalDev team is seeking an Operations Engineer to support the services and automation used during data center bring-ups and in production. Reporting to the Engineering Manager, this hands-on role is designed for an engineer who can handle routine production issues with growing independence while developing deeper expertise in service reliability, observability, and hardware lifecycle management.

You will support the Redfish-based services and tools used to initialize, reboot, monitor, and recover infrastructure at scale. You will independently triage routine alerts and support requests, contribute to incident response and root-cause analysis, improve dashboards and runbooks, and deliver small automation or reliability changes with guidance on complex or high-risk work.

You will work with NVIDIA GPU servers, BMCs, DPUs, Cooling Distribution Units, NVLink switches, power shelves, and custom hardware while collaborating with Fleet Operations, Hardware Engineering, Service Engineering, and hardware and firmware vendors. Approximately 80% of the role focuses on production operations, troubleshooting, and incident response. The remaining 20% focuses on improving monitoring, documentation, operational processes, remediation capabilities, and automation.

Key Responsibilities Production Support and Troubleshooting

  • Monitor team-owned services and fleet health, identify unhealthy devices, and coordinate remediation using established tools and procedures.
  • Independently troubleshoot routine initialization, reboot, provisioning, and service-health issues, escalating complex or high-risk problems appropriately.
  • Investigate problems across applications, Linux systems, networks, BMCs, servers, DPUs, power equipment, and cooling infrastructure using logs, metrics, and diagnostic data.
  • Perform and validate approved remediation, ensuring services and devices return to a healthy state.
  • Participate in incident response, maintain clear operational communications, and contribute to root-cause analysis and follow-up actions.
  • Participate in the team's on-call rotation after completing onboarding and a readiness review.

Observability and Reliability

The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. job.name: Senior Infrastructure Architect – High-Performance Compute (GPU/CPU) - top hedge fund
job.description:
Location: New York City, NY

Industry: Hedge Fund / Investment Management

Employment Type: Permanent, Full-Time

Seniority: Senior / Principal Architect / SVP

A leading global hedge fund is seeking an experienced Infrastructure Architect at SVP level to design, build and scale its next-generation high-performance computing infrastructure.

This is a highly technical and strategically important position, supporting a sophisticated investment environment where large-scale compute capabilities are critical to quantitative research, financial modelling, machine learning, AI and investment strategies.

The successful candidate will take ownership of infrastructure architecture across large-scale GPU and CPU environments, ensuring the organisation can efficiently scale its compute capacity while maintaining exceptional performance, reliability and operational efficiency.

This opportunity will suit an architect with deep expertise in High-Performance Computing (HPC), distributed infrastructure, GPU clusters, large-scale CPU environments and infrastructure automation .

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure Architecture & Strategy

  • Lead the architecture and design of large-scale compute infrastructure supporting quantitative research, AI/ML workloads and investment analytics.
  • Develop scalable infrastructure solutions capable of supporting thousands of CPU cores and large GPU clusters.
  • Define the technical roadmap for compute infrastructure, balancing performance, scalability, reliability and cost.
  • Design hybrid infrastructure architectures spanning on-premises data centres, colocation facilities and public cloud environments.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend infrastructure improvements to support future computational requirements.
  • Establish architectural standards and best practices for compute infrastructure.

GPU & CPU Infrastructure

  • Architect and scale high-performance GPU environments supporting machine learning, deep learning and complex computational workloads.
  • Design and optimise CPU compute clusters supporting large-scale parallel processing and quantitative research.
  • Evaluate and integrate NVIDIA GPU technologies, including advanced GPU architectures and high-speed interconnects.
  • Develop strategies for efficient GPU allocation, resource scheduling and workload optimisation.
  • Ensure compute infrastructure supports demanding performance, latency and throughput requirements.
  • Identify and eliminate infrastructure bottlenecks affecting compute-intensive applications.

High-Performance Computing & Distributed Systems

job.name: Principal AI Application Engineer - FDE Intelligent Operations
job.description:
Job Description About the Role This role is part of Intelligent Operations team: "We support and guardrail AI forward deployed engineering engagements across SAP industries, ensuring quality, security and lasting impact." What You’ll Build You’re building Intelligent Operations from the ground up. This capability doesn’t exist at scale yet — you’ll define how it works.

Handover model: Take care of what “production-ready” looks like when an FDE engagement transitions from Value Delivery to Value Operation. You own the handover framework — what needs to be in place before your team takes over.

Run-team operations: Build the monitoring, alerting, and incident response capability for deployed AI solutions. Ensure contractual SLA commitments are met — not by heroics, but by design.

AI quality in production: Drift detection, performance benchmarking, guardrails validation, retraining triggers. The solutions we deploy use LLMs and agents — production quality assurance looks fundamentally different here than in classical software.

Operational governance: Establish best practices for production security, data boundaries, and compliance across customer engagements. Work with other engineers to ensure the enterprise bar holds post-deployment and establish self-healing capabilities.

Scalable operations: What works for one customer engagement needs to work for fifty. You’ll design the operational model to scale — tooling, automation, partner integration — so that every new go-live doesn’t require reinventing the wheel.

You’ll work closely with the Knowledge & IP team to capture operational learnings and feed them back into the delivery lifecycle, so the next collaboration starts stronger.

Where you belong T&O is the engineering backbone of CIS Forward Deployed Engineering. Our mission: ensure quality, security, and lasting impact across AI engagements for SAP’s industry customers.

You’ll sit in the Intelligent Operations pillar — the part of T&O that owns what happens after go-live. Deployed solutions stay healthy and improve. That’s the mandate.

This is a leadership role without a management title. You’ll mentor engineers, set operational standards, and build the technical capabilities of a team that’s being assembled now. You’ll work globally, across FDE squads and hubs, with external delivery partners, and directly with customers when production demands it.

If you’ve spent your career at the intersection of SRE, AI systems, and enterprise operations — and you want to build something new rather than maintain something existing — this is the role.

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement

job.name: Technical Product Manager - AI Infra Resilience
job.description:
GPU clusters fail. Workloads crash at 3am, AI teams file tickets pointing at hardware, hardware teams point back at software, and the actual cause stays unknown until someone with deep enough context digs through DCGM metrics, XID history, and NCCL traces. That forensics work shouldn't fall to a human on-call every time. We're building the platform that automates it, and we need a PM who has been that on-call engineer.

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own workload failure attribution: how a GPU cluster figures out whether a failed job was caused by hardware, system software, or application code, and how that verdict gets surfaced to operators, schedulers, and the open source developer surface built on top of it. You will own the roadmap and work directly with the engineering and operations communities who deploy and extend this platform. This role is part of NVIDIA's DSX Platform, NVIDIA's open, modular infrastructure software for designing, operating, and optimizing AI factories at scale. No prior product management title required. If you are a deeply technical product manager, architect, SRE, or infra engineer who has lived the GPU cluster failure-triage problem, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Drive the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for workload failure attribution, in close collaboration with engineering on architecture and prioritization.
  • Identify gaps in how customers and partners triage GPU cluster failures at scale and define new attribution capabilities to close them, including how an NCCL timeout gets attributed to hardware, system software, or application, and which signals belong in a public API vs. an entitled runtime extension.
  • Work directly with cloud partners and cluster operators to translate their operational triage requirements into platform capabilities.
  • Drive community engagement strategy for the open source attribution project, including contribution models, ecosystem partnerships, and developer adoption.

What We Need To See

  • 12+ years total experience.
  • 5+ years in product management, solutions architecture, software engineering, or site reliability engineering on technical infrastructure products. Technical depth on GPU or AI infra is required.
  • Familiarity with GPU failure modes: XID codes, ECC correctable and uncorrectable errors, DCGM metrics, NVLink and PCIe health signals.
  • Technical understanding of why AI workloads fail: GPU hardware failure modes, distributed training failure patterns (NCCL timeouts, framework errors, hardware vs. system software vs. application fault distinction), and the telemetry systems (DCGM, sysfs, dmesg) that surface these signals.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with senior technical customers and translate operational requirements into product decisions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

Read the full description

The problems we work on are challenging, and solving them takes deep domain expertise, rigorous analysis, and a willingness to dig into the details.

At SentiLink, you'll work alongside smart, highly collaborative colleagues who respect each other's time and judgment, take ownership, and follow through on their commitments. Together, we do truly meaningful work protecting the identities of innocent consumers and flagging the fraudsters attempting to exploit them.

We're well capitalized and growing quickly. We already serve 13 of the top 15 U.S. banks, we're expanding into new markets, and we're backed by Craft Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, NYCA, and Max Levchin. We've been named to the Forbes Fintech 50 and as a 2026 FICO Industry Vanguard Decision Award Winner. We were also the first company to go live with the electronic Consent Based Social Security Number Verification (eCBSV) service, and we've testified before the U.S. Congress on the future of identity.

We want SentiLink to be the best place you've ever worked. We offer generous benefits and support a range of working arrangements, from fully remote to in-office. We are a digital-first company with strong collaboration across the U.S. and India, and we meet in person regularly to build relationships. We have offices in Austin, San Francisco, New York City, Seattle (Bellevue), Los Angeles, and Chicago in the U.S., and in Gurugram (Delhi) and Bengaluru in India.

Role SentiLink's Information Security team protects our systems, data, and customers while enabling the business to move quickly and securely. We operate a modern, AWS-based environment and support security and compliance programs including FedRAMP, SOC 2, and PCI DSS.

We're looking for a Senior Cloud Security Engineer to own and improve the technical security implementation of SentiLink's AWS GovCloud environment. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building, maintaining, and operating security controls—not a compliance or audit-management position.

You'll work across AWS infrastructure, Kubernetes, identity and access management, security tooling, vulnerability management, and monitoring. You will partner closely with Infrastructure, Security Engineering, IT, and our Security & Risk team to turn security and FedRAMP requirements into effective, maintainable implementations. You should be comfortable independently identifying gaps, designing pragmatic solutions, and following through on implementation and ongoing operation.

This is an individual contributor role with meaningful technical ownership and no people-management responsibilities.

job.name: Senior/Staff Embedded Linux Software Engineer
job.description:
About The Job Job Title: Embedded Linux Software Engineer — Firmware Team Location: On-Site (San Leandro, CA)

Job Type: Full-Time

About SirenOpt At SirenOpt®, we are building the manufacturing intelligence layer for advanced materials. We help manufacturers visualize, understand, and control the material behavior that determines yield, performance, and safety across energy, aerospace, automotive, electronics, and semiconductor applications.

We are working on this problem because advanced materials are becoming more critical and more complex, but the tools used to manufacture them have not kept pace. Manufacturers still lack real-time visibility into the small variations that shape quality on the line. We care because those invisible variations cause scrap, waste energy and materials, create higher costs, inconsistent product performance, and introduce avoidable safety risks.

We developed PlasmaSens™, our manufacturing intelligence platform, to close that visibility gap and to lay the foundation for truly autonomous manufacturing.

We are uniquely suited to solve this problem because our expertise and our platform connect material science, plasma physics, machine learning, and manufacturing in one system. The same core technology works in-line, at-line, and off-line, and across form factors ranging from electrodes and wafers to 3D components. That flexibility lets us meet manufacturers where they are and carry insight from the lab into mass production.

We have deployed multiple PlasmaSens products with customers and collaborators across the United States, Japan, Germany, and Taiwan. We pair that real-world experience with support from leading US, European, and Japanese venture investors, the National Science Foundation, the California Energy Commission, and the Department of Energy. Our combination of differentiated technology, manufacturing experience, and global scientific and industry partnerships gives us the foundation to solve material variability at scale.

Role Overview SirenOpt is seeking an Embedded Linux Software Engineer to join a small, high-impact firmware team building the embedded software stack for a commercial bench-top scientific instrument. The platform is an AMD/Xilinx FPGA SoC (Zynq / UltraScale+) running PetaLinux, with a mix of userspace applications, device drivers, and real-time control interfacing with custom programmable logic.

You’ll work alongside an embedded systems architect who owns the Linux application layer, peripheral subsystems, protocol design, and hardware integration. Your core mandate is threefold: share the Linux application workload, own test automation infrastructure, and establish CI/build reliability. You’ll write production code and the tooling that proves it works.

job.name: Embedded Software Test Engineer
job.description:
About Us Array Labs builds advanced radar systems to help humanity understand and respond to changes across the physical world.

We're launching a coordinated fleet of radar satellites to create a high-resolution 3D map of the Earth, updated in real time, enabling faster, smarter decision-making for government and commercial organizations supporting disaster response, infrastructure resilience, and mission-critical geopolitical intelligence.

We design and build our satellites end-to-end, producing the world's most advanced earth observation satellites. Our fleet will deliver unprecedented levels of accuracy, coverage, and responsiveness to power critical insights precisely where they're needed most.

About The Job We are looking for a Software Test Engineer to own the validation of our complex radar payload. In this role, you will bridge the gap between hardware and software, writing the code that proves our system works. You will develop specialized firmware to exercise our FPGAs, RF front-ends, and antenna arrays, while simultaneously building high-level Python automation to orchestrate test campaigns. You will work in a hands-on lab environment, pushing our hardware to its limits to ensure it survives and performs in the extreme conditions of space.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement automated test frameworks in Python to characterize the performance of radar, RF, and antenna subsystems.
  • Write firmware in C/C++ to stimulate hardware interfaces, inject test patterns into FPGAs, and control RF transceivers during validation.
  • Develop Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) test setups that integrate flight software, ground station commands, and simulated environmental data.
  • Automate the control of laboratory test equipment (Signal Generators, Spectrum Analyzers, Network Analyzers, Oscilloscopes) to capture and analyze system performance data.
  • Collaborate with FPGA and RF engineers to define test requirements and debug complex hardware-software integration issues.
  • Analyze test data to identify trends, performance regressions, and potential hardware failures before they reach orbit.
  • Maintain and upgrade continuous integration (CI) pipelines that run automated tests on physical hardware targets.

Job Overview We are seeking an experienced Senior or Staff Embedded Test Engineer with 10+ years of experience specializing in Internet of Things (IoT) ecosystems. In this role, you will validate the end-to-end connectivity, functionality, security, and reliability of our smart devices, bridging the gap between physical hardware, edge firmware, and cloud platforms. You will design automated edge-tocloud test setups, simulate necessary test environments, and ensure flawless wireless communication under real-world conditions.

Key Responsibilities IoT Test Strategy & Network Simulation

Edge-to-Cloud Validation: Design test strategies covering the entire IoT data path from physical sensors to cloud databases and user applications.

Network Simulation: Set up test benches to simulate varying network conditions, packet loss, high latency, and intermittent connectivity.

Scale & Stress Testing: Conduct fleet-scale simulation to evaluate how cloud infrastructure handles concurrent data bursts from thousands of edge nodes.

Automation & CI/CD

Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL): Build and maintain automated HIL test rigs for continuous testing of connected products.

API Testing: Automate verification of cloud APIs.

DevOps Integration: Embed automated hardware connectivity tests directly into GitLab CI/CD delivery pipelines.

Wireless, Protocol, & Power Verification

RF & Wireless Testing: Validate wireless performance across protocols like BLE, Wi-Fi, LoRaWAN, and Cellular.

Protocol Analysis: Intercept and analyze network traffic using Wireshark to verify MQTT, CoAP, HTTP, and Protobuf payloads.

Power Profiling: Measure microampere battery consumption during active transmission, sleep states, and deep sleep modes to verify battery-life targets.

IoT Security & Resilience

Security Auditing: Conduct vulnerability testing, including firmware reverse engineering resistance, secure boot verification, and certificate rotation.

Encryption Validation: Ensure all data-at-rest and data-in-transit utilizes appropriate TLS, AES, or ECC encryption standards.

OTA Update Validation: Rigorously test Over-the-Air (OTA) firmware update mechanisms against power interruptions, corrupted payloads, and rollbacks.

Technical Skills IoT Protocols Advanced knowledge of messaging protocols (MQTT, CoAP, HTTPS) and wireless stacks (Wi-Fi, BLE, NB-IoT).
