job.name: Software Engineer, Ads Tooling
job.description:
Responsibilities The ads system at TikTok operates on a massive scale and serves millions of advertisers, clients and influencers across the world. The quality of the ads system depends heavily on the underlying infrastructure that handles massive data. The USDS Ads team empowers TikTok's global monetization by efficiently delivering ads and content on TikTok.

Tooling is what makes changing that system fast — and safe. Ads correctness cannot be asserted by comparing an expected string to an actual one: ranking outputs are probabilistic, behavior is driven as much by configuration as by code, and a silent regression in a prediction pipeline costs revenue long before it triggers an alert. Off-the-shelf test frameworks don't cover this, so we build our own. You will build the platforms and tooling that let every engineer on the team validate their changes — automated validation across ads pipelines, and continuous system-health monitoring that protects business metrics. Just as importantly, you'll go looking for the manual, repetitive, and error-prone workflows our engineers live with today, and replace them with automation.

You'll join a team that invests in your growth — with mentorship from senior engineers, ownership of real surfaces from early on, and a clear path toward technical leadership.

Responsibilities:
- Build and own the internal tooling and platforms that power ads system validation — test frameworks, environment and data provisioning, assertion libraries, and self-service harnesses that let engineers validate changes without hand-rolling infrastructure each time.
- Identify inefficient engineering workflows and automate them away. Audit how the team actually works today — manual verification steps, repeated debugging rituals, slow feedback loops, high-toil release procedures — quantify the cost, and build the tooling that eliminates it.
- Build quality infrastructure for ads systems, including training/serving consistency checks, prediction-service invariant and fallback validation.
- Build automated system-health monitoring that surfaces regressions in business and quality metrics, routes findings to the owning engineer with enough context to act, and shortens time-to-detection.
- Integrate tooling into CI/CD as release gates, so validation runs by default rather than by remembering to run it.
- Treat internal engineers as your users — measure adoption, gather feedback, and iterate on developer experience rather than shipping tools and walking away.
- Bring in new ideas and tooling, including applying LLM and agent-based approaches to test generation, failure triage, and coverage analysis.

Read the full description

job.name: Automotive Wireless Validation Engineer
job.description:
On-Site role

Job Description:

We are seeking a highly skilled and creative Wireless Validation Engineer to join our team in Foster City.

In this role, you will design, document, and execute comprehensive unit and system-level test plans for both core hardware and connected devices.

You will focus on critical wireless technologies, such as 4G-LTE, 5G-NR, Wi-Fi, and GNSS, alongside Ethernet and other vehicle network protocols, partnering with design teams and external vendors to satisfy performance, reliability, and regulatory standards.

What You'll Do:

Protocol & System Validation: Design, specify, and execute comprehensive validation test plans across unit and system levels to analyze end-to-end performance and protocol compliance for key wireless technologies (4G-LTE, 5G-NR NSA/SA, Wi-Fi 6/6E, GNSS) and high-speed Automotive Ethernet. Deeply collaborate with internal system architects, chipset vendors, and network module suppliers to characterize RF performance, evaluate Quality of Service (QoS) parameters, perform throughput benchmarking, and systematically root-cause protocol-level failure modes.

Test Infrastructure Development: Develop and maintain automated validation frameworks using SCPI commands, Python, or specialized APIs on leading cellular and wireless network simulators (e.g., Keysight, Rohde & Schwarz) to execute repeatable test scenarios, simulate complex real-world channel conditions, and accelerate regression testing.

Failure Mode Analysis: Conduct in-depth failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA) for any anomalies or failed test cases identified during validation. Utilize advanced log collection methodologies and post-processing diagnostic software to analyze PHY, MAC, and higher-layer protocol logs, identifying specific root causes across hardware, firmware, and software interfaces.

Field Issue Reproduction & Vendor Management: Replicate intermittent or complex field-reported issues within controlled lab environments using network simulator and signal playback tools. Partner closely with external silicon, module, and software suppliers to drive defect reporting, track bug fixes, review firmware patches, and verify resolutions in subsequent test iterations.

Documentation & Compliance: Author, review, and maintain comprehensive engineering documentation, including master test plans, test reports, architecture reviews, and data analysis presentations.

What You Bring:

Education: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field.

Experience: At least 8 years of hands-on embedded system experience, including 6+ years specializing in wireless system testing and validation.

Technical Expertise:

Hands-on experience configuring, programming, and developing test cases for wireless test platforms (e.g., Keysight, Rohde & Schwarz), alongside testing and troubleshooting Automotive Ethernet systems.

As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. About The Role We are seeking a Staff Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to lead System-Level and Infrastructure Testing locally in our San Jose lab. What You'll Do

  • Profile OS-level resource usage (CPU, memory leaks, I/O bottlenecks, network latency) and run hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) or local service-level automated suites
  • Maintain the physical/virtual San Jose lab environment, building automated orchestration tools to reset, patch, and reconfigure test rigs deterministically

What You'll Bring

  • 8+ years in system-level SDET, platform engineering, or embedded/infrastructure software testing
  • Advanced programming skills in C++, Python, or Go with strong Linux internals, networking protocols (TCP/IP, sockets), and IPC knowledge
  • Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes, container runtimes, and local cloud emulation (AWS/Azure)
  • Experience in managing physical or virtual lab testbeds, edge hardware topologies, or local hardware-software integration loops

job.name: Staff Software Test and Automation Engineer
job.description:
About Mainspring

Mainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel-flexible, low-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power. The company began commercial shipments of its Mainspring Linear Generators in 2020 and today has hundreds of megawatts in advanced development and field operations for leading Fortune 500 companies, data centers, and utilities. Mainspring also partners with global energy leaders including AEP, NextEra Energy Resources, Schneider Electric, and more.

The core values that ground our work, guide our decisions, and connect us together:

  • Pragmatic Optimism
  • Excellence without Ego
  • Proactive Collaboration

Job Overview

Mainspring Energy has fundamentally redefined onsite power generation. Our breakthrough product—the Mainspring Linear Generator (LGen)—is a completely new category of energy technology. Distinct from an engine, turbine, or fuel cell, the LGen directly converts straight-line motion into electricity using a low-temperature, non-combustion thermochemical reaction.

With only two moving parts per core, a frictionless air-bearing system, and zero-flame chemical conversions, we deliver over 46% net AC electrical efficiency. More importantly, it is the world’s only commercially available technology capable of real-time fuel-switching under load, seamlessly transitioning between natural gas, biogas/RNG, propane, hydrogen, and ammonia.

Behind this mechanical simplicity lies an incredibly complex software abstraction layer. To achieve dynamic load-following, sub-millisecond grid synchronization, and real-time thermochemical adaptive fuel mixing, our proprietary controls manage thousands of high-frequency variables simultaneously.

As a Senior Staff Software Test & Automation Engineer, you will architect the core validation and automation frameworks that ensure this distributed energy asset operates with 100% safety and utility-scale reliability. You will own the strategy for testing the intersection of real-time embedded software, predictive control loops, and multi-fuel dynamics.

Responsibilities As a principal driver of our Software Test team, you will:

  • Architect Automation & Test Infrastructure: Design, scale, and maintain custom hardware test beds alongside robust, reusable test automation frameworks, software tools, and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines
  • System Validation & Integration: Develop comprehensive test plans, test cases, technical test approaches, and traceability matrices to validate complex hardware/software integrations and resolve system-level bottlenecks
  • Root Cause & Failure Analysis: Lead deep-dive failure analysis, debug and diagnose issues found during testing, and champion risk mitigation strategies to ensure test stability and environmental reliability

job.name: Manufacturing Test Infrastructure Engineer

In this role, you will drive the design and development of major infrastructure and platform components such as databases, REST APIs, containerization, CI/CD pipelines, and tester orchestration. You will also collaborate closely across the manufacturing, hardware, and software teams.

In This Role, You Will

  • Design and implement server infrastructure to support manufacturing test activities
  • Develop applications to support manufacturing processes and common code libraries for test engineers
  • Design and build dashboards for manufacturing data, including metrics such as throughput and tester utilization

Qualifications

  • BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field; MS preferred
  • 6+ years of industry experience with software development focused on on-prem or cloud infrastructure
  • Exposure to software technologies used in manufacturing systems, such as MRP, MES, MQTT, SCADA systems, and IoT devices
  • Experience with cloud deployment and infrastructure technologies, such as Kubernetes, Terraform, and AWS
  • Deep background in Python programming (scripting, web services, tool development, and test frameworks). Working knowledge of Pytest required.
  • Experience building dashboards and alerting systems for monitoring systems to monitor infrastructure health

$183,000 - $220,000 a year

Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. job.name: Hardware Test Automation Engineer
job.description:
About Sesame Sesame believes in a future where computers are lifelike - with the ability to see, hear, and collaborate with us in ways that feel natural and human. With this vision, we're designing a new kind of computer, focused on making voice agents part of our daily lives. Our team brings together founders from Oculus and Ubiquity6, alongside proven leaders from Meta, Google, and Apple, with deep expertise spanning hardware and software. Join us in shaping a future where computers truly come alive.

About The Role Sesame is building a wearable AI hardware device that brings our voice companion into the physical world. We're standing up our hardware quality function from the ground up, and we're looking for our first dedicated Hardware Test Automation Engineer to build the automation backbone for the program. You'll design and own an automated test rig, a rack of devices wired into our CI/CD pipeline that, on every firmware change, builds, flashes, runs the test suite, and generates reports automatically. You'll establish nightly stability runs, weekly stress runs, and long-duration audio sessions, and you'll build the live performance and stress dashboard that becomes the team's shared source of truth for quality. Your metrics will gate releases and back the performance story we tell investors and customers.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role at the firmware/wireless/hardware boundary, on a small team that moves fast. You'll partner closely with the firmware team and our hands-on platform tester, and you'll have visibility and authority across both the firmware and the testbed so the two are built to cooperate.

Initial focus (first ~60 days):

  • Stand up an automated test framework driven from a programmable Bluetooth central (Android, iOS, or a Pi-based rig, whatever fits), firmware-first then integration-first; even if early runs are short, get the foundation in place before it scales.
  • Establish nightly (sanity/stability) and weekly (stress) automated runs, with extended weekend runs for long-duration audio sessions (e.g., 5-hour and 18-hour using synthetic data).
  • Begin a live performance/stress dashboard: A2DP/throughput, BT link duration, BT latency, battery life, firmware crash counts, and regression flags.

Description Annapurna Labs, an AWS organization with development centers in the U.S. and Israel, builds custom silicon and software for AWS customers. Our team combines cloud-scale innovation with world-class expertise across silicon engineering, hardware design, verification, software, and operations to tackle technical challenges that have never been seen before.

You'll dive deep into new technology hardware components and scaling technologies that power our Machine Learning boards and servers at scale, ensuring every component of our hardware and software comes together into products our customers rely on.

As a Senior Validation Engineer on our Machine Learning Acceleration team, you'll lead and own critical validation aspects across the entire product development lifecycle—from early design validation through emulation, silicon bring-up, post-silicon validation, and ongoing support of production systems deployed in AWS data centers. You'll collaborate deeply with architecture, RTL design, design verification, firmware, and software teams to ensure our next-generation AI/ML accelerators meet the highest standards of quality and performance. This role requires bridging multiple domains and broad scope of impact—from low-level hardware interfaces to high-level ML workloads—to deliver exceptional results.

We Are Looking For Candidates With

job.name: Data Quality Engineer
job.description:
About the job

Delart is home to a team of world-class engineers and project leaders dedicated to developing the next generation of advanced networking technologies, consumer devices, and innovative technology solutions. Trusted by some of the world’s leading technology companies, we deliver highly scalable, mission-critical solutions that power both consumer and business applications globally. Since our founding in 2017, we have been at the forefront of designing cutting-edge networking, telecommunications, and consumer products, while driving end-to-end project execution and creating transformative technology applications.

Overview

Join our team as a Data Quality Engineer, where you'll be the guardian of benchmark data integrity supporting continuous large-scale device testing operations. This hands-on role combines advanced data analysis, Python-based test automation, and operational ownership, ensuring the health, reliability, and actionable insights of benchmark datasets used by product engineering teams.

Responsibilities

  • Define and implement data-quality checks, acceptance criteria, and validation plans grounded in benchmarking requirements and product-team expectations.
  • Run daily operational reviews of 50+ devices under continuous test automation—investigating anomalies, debugging automation issues, and addressing lab-environment variances.

  • Develop, deploy, and maintain automated data-quality checks, alerting systems, and interactive dashboards to track data integrity, device health, and operational trends.
  • Generate, review, and communicate clear analytical reports on benchmarking outputs, highlighting quality risks and actionable findings for stakeholders.
  • Build and support Python-based automation and operational tooling for continuous benchmarking and data validation across multiple device form factors, collaborating directly with scenario and platform developers.
  • Conduct in-depth investigations and monthly analytics to diagnose the root cause of anomalous data, distinguishing genuine device performance from automation artifacts.
  • Review video capture logs from test runs to validate outcomes and troubleshoot scenario failures.
  • Methodically debug data discrepancies, triaging systematically across lab configuration, application settings, wireless conditions, and device defects, and escalate issues to the proper owners.
  • Operate and monitor CI/CD-driven test environments, ensuring stability and rapidly resolving operational failures.
  • Document validation protocols, triage guides, and reporting workflows to facilitate operation at scale.
  • Collaborate closely with lab operations, networking, and product teams to address environment and device issues, and help establish robust data-quality standards and practices.

job.name: Senior Analyst, Fraud Strategy
job.description:
Who We Are At Momentum Financial Services Group, we help people move forward by reimagining how money works for those who need it most. With more than 40 years of experience, we're the team behind Money Mart—Canada's largest non-bank branch network and a leader in financial solutions for underserved communities.

From short-term loans to money transfers and prepaid cards, we power the products, technology, and operations that connect over a million customers a year to the money they need, when they need it.

At MFSG, we come together across teams and departments to create something bigger than ourselves: solutions that remove barriers and give people access to money they might not get anywhere else. Whether you're solving problems, building systems, or shaping strategy, your work fuels real support for real people.

We've Got You Covered

  • Compensation Philosophy: Our strategy is simple—we aim to match the market. We regularly review industry standards to ensure our total rewards package is competitive and fair. This commitment helps us attract and retain talented individuals who share our purpose.
  • Discretionary Annual Bonus: Enjoy the opportunity for a discretionary bonus based on individual performance and company success.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Our benefits include health and dental plans with 100% of the premiums covered. We also offer an Employee Assistance Program to support your mental well-being and provide resources for personal challenges.
  • Retirement Plans: Plan for your future with our robust retirement savings options, ensuring you're set for the long haul.
  • Hybrid Work Environment: Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work model, allowing you to balance remote work with in-office. When you're at our corporate head office, enjoy a relaxed and collaborative environment featuring breakout rooms for brainstorming and unwinding, plus a variety of snacks to keep you energized throughout the day.
  • Perks and Rewards: Enjoy reimbursement for tuition assistance and professional development, discounts through Perkopolis and participate in our rewards and recognition programs to celebrate your contributions.

Please note: The salary range for this position is between C$ 95,000 - C$ 115,000. The Job: Senior Analyst, Fraud Strategy As a Senior Analyst, Fraud Strategy you will be accountable for the daily fraud prevention activities at Momentum that ensure applicable fraud rules, processes and reporting are in place to fend off fraudulent loans. This involves assessing different types of fraud-related risks for all our consumer lending products across North America, adopting industry-leading solutions, developing/deploying fraud prevention strategies and tracking strategy performance for continuous improvement on loan and credit card origination fraud avoidance.

job.name: Senior Analyst, BP&A
job.description:
Prima Living, a proud member of the Primacorp group of companies, is leading the next generation of senior living in Canada. We are growing a network of vibrant, people first communities focused on compassion, connection, cultural inclusivity, and operational excellence.

Reports To: President, Prima Living

Location: New Westminster, BC or Mississauga, ON

Compensation: $80,000–$90,000

Schedule: Full-Time | Onsite

About The Role Prima Living is a fast-growing, multi-province retirement living organization. We are seeking a Senior Analyst, Business Planning & Analysis (BP&A) to serve as a finance business partner to our communities and a strategic partner to the President.

This is a senior individual-contributor role that combines portfolio financial planning, performance analysis and the delivery of high-priority strategic initiatives. You will turn financial and operational data into clear insight and recommendations for the President and Chairman, and play a key role as we grow through acquisition and development.

What You'll Do Financial Planning & Business Partnering Co-lead the annual operating budget process and prepare rolling forecasts for all communities.

Partner with General Managers and Regional Directors on monthly results, variance analysis, labour, occupancy and pricing performance.

Build financial models, business cases and scenario analyses to support decisions.

Support capital planning, ROI analysis and the financial integration of new acquisitions.

Executive Reporting & Analysis Prepare monthly reporting packages, community scorecards and dashboards for the President and Chairman.

Consolidate and validate financial and operational data from multiple sources, ensuring accuracy before any findings are presented.

Identify risks, trends and opportunities, and deliver clear, evidence-based recommendations.

Maintain organized supporting calculations, working files and documentation for review and reference.

Strategic Projects Drive priority initiatives for the President, tracking timelines, deliverables, budgets and follow-ups.

Conduct business analysis, operational assessments and research to support executive decisions.

Coordinate across internal teams, consultants, vendors and external partners to keep initiatives on schedule.

Prepare executive briefings, decision memos and presentations.

Systems & Continuous Improvement Maintain and enhance reporting in Yardi, Excel and Power BI.

Automate recurring reporting and improve data quality.

Use AI-enabled tools to improve efficiency while validating results.

  • Responsibilities may evolve based on business needs and may extend beyond the core financial planning and analysis functions of the role.

What You Bring Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Commerce, Economics or Data Analytics.

MBA (required).

job.name: Supply Chain Analyst
job.description:
Sporting Life Group is a proudly Canadian family of retail banners, Sporting Life, Golf Town, and Team Town Sports, united by a shared passion for sport and active living.

From individual pursuits to team sports, we offer the best equipment, expert services, and experiences to help Canadians play, move, and live well.

Why Work Here?

  • Access to our benefits package, with the choice of different levels of health, dental, and vision coverage to suit you.
  • Employee discounts at Golf Town, Sporting Life, and Team Town Sports that are shareable with friends and family.
  • Team-first culture that celebrates an active, sports lifestyle.
  • Fun, fast-paced hybrid environment where your passion for sport and style belongs.
  • Vendor Pro Deals and expert product training to fuel your knowledge and performance.
  • A salary range of $60,000-$65,000 (dependent on experience), bonus, and opportunities to grow your career in the sports lifestyle.

What You’ll Do; The Supply Chain Analyst will support the Supply Chain and Finance teams and will provide key analytics and insights to support decision-making in the areas of shipping, warehousing, and inventory management. Reporting directly to the Director of Supply Chain, this role will support all 3 banners within Sporting Life Group. The role will manage the GL coding of all Supply Chain invoices as well as tracking and providing analysis of the costs. The SC Analyst will also support the creation of budgets, forecasts, long-term plans, KPI’s, and variance analysis for month end, quarter end and year end.

  • Build and ownership of the logistics financial tracking for all 3 banners (Golf Town, Sporting Life and Team Town Sports).
  • Effectively manage the coding of all Supply Chain invoices and month end accruals.
  • Build effective partnerships with the Supply Chain team and partners, understanding the key drivers of the Supply Chain.
  • Support the Supply Chain team to track, evaluate, gather and present data for warehousing, distribution and freight performance and opportunities.
  • Ownership and improvement of the forecast and budget models and variance analysis.
  • Work closely with the financial reporting team to ensure operating plans of the Supply Chain department are incorporated into overall financial plans.
  • Use critical thinking to assist in the development of new processes, systems and models to support the budgeting and forecasting activities of the department.
  • Cross train on all department functions and support where necessary.
  • Other analytics, reporting, data evaluation, tool development as required.

What You’ll Bring;

At CAAT, we’re passionate about what we do. And it shows!

Here, you’ll find a cultural spark in everything we do – from the way we partner with members and employers, to the way we work, collaborate, and grow. It doesn’t just feel different at CAAT. job.description:
Overview

GGA Partners is an international management consulting firm and trusted advisor to many of the world’s leading private clubs, golf courses, resorts, and residential communities. We are dedicated to helping owners, asset managers, and non-profit clubs achieve their goals and objectives and maximize performance.

We are looking for an Associate to join our team with a strong background in business, strategy, or a related field. The ideal candidate should be dynamic, thrive in a fast-paced environment, demonstrate a passion for solving complex strategic challenges, and have a proven track record of excellence.

Key Responsibilities

As an Associate your responsibilities will range from analyzing operations to hands-on client engagement across multiple industry sectors. You will be an integral part of our team, working directly with the key stakeholders of private clubs, golf courses, leisure assets, resorts, and residential communities.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Compilation and insightful analysis of market, financial, and operational data.
  • Creation and maintenance of financial models across multiple different operating, capital, and ownership structures.
  • Delivery and management of multiple client projects, providing opportunities to influence strategic and operational change.
  • Uncovering industry trends through data collection, calculation, and analysis.
  • Developing and presenting compelling and professional client deliverables in collaboration with senior team members.
  • Cultivating strong client relationships, while juggling multiple deliverables and deadlines.

Qualifications and Skills

  • 0 – 2 years of experience with an accounting, financial services, or consulting firm, including co-op terms or internship placements.
  • University degree in business/finance, economics, mathematics, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated analytics skills and an ability to analyze complex problems.
  • Experience analyzing and presenting complex data in a concise manner.
  • Strong technical proficiency, including Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, and Excel).
  • A keen attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
  • Excellent interpersonal and verbal and written communication skills.
  • Exceptional organizational skills.
  • An interest, passion, or experience in golf, private clubs, residential real estate, or resort businesses.
  • Positive attitude, exceptional work ethic, and ability to thrive in a dynamic team environment.
  • An intellectually curious mind and commitment to excellence.
  • Proven leadership skills with desire to take ownership over work product.
  • Responsibly leverage AI in support of research and deliverable production.

job.name: Pricing Manager
job.description:
Hybrid: Markham, Ontario

Job Description About Us Pet Valu is Canada’s leading pet specialty retailer, dedicated to strengthening the bond between dedicated pet lovers and their pets. With 50 years of animal care expertise, we operate over 800 stores across Canada under several banners, including Pet Valu, Bosley’s, Total Pet, Paulmac's Pet, Tisol & Chico. Guided by our mission to deliver products, care, expertise, and memorable moments, Pet Valu is a place where people build meaningful careers while making a positive impact on pets and communities. This is a temporary full-time position with an anticipated end date of October 2027.

Job Summary The Pricing Manager is responsible for supporting the development, execution, and continuous improvement of pricing strategies that drive sales, profitability, and customer value. Working closely with merchandising and category teams, this role analyzes pricing opportunities, maintains pricing governance, monitors competitive positioning, and delivers data-driven insights to support business decisions. The Pricing Manager combines strong analytical skills with sound business judgment to help optimize pricing performance and contribute to strategic pricing initiatives.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Support the development and execution of pricing strategies by collaborating with merchandising and category teams to align pricing decisions with business objectives.
  • Manage the markdown process for discontinued products by identifying the most cost-effective markdown strategies to optimize inventory exit while maximizing margin recovery. Partner with category teams to communicate markdown recommendations and support execution, while coordinating with cross-functional teams to ensure timely and accurate implementation.
  • Model and analyze price optimization scenarios using the pricing tool to maximize sales and profitability, while supporting adoption and effective use of pricing capabilities across merchandising teams.
  • Analyze the impact of pricing decisions and develop reporting and performance metrics to measure pricing effectiveness.
  • Monitor market trends, competitive pricing, and price positioning, providing analytical insights and recommendations to improve pricing performance and customer value perception.
  • Maintain pricing strategies, configurations, business rules, and governance within the pricing tool to ensure accuracy and consistency.
  • Support pricing initiatives by providing data analysis, documenting business requirements, assisting with implementation activities, and contributing to continuous process improvements.
  • Build and maintain pricing logic within the web-scrape price collection process and analyze competitive pricing to identify opportunities and actionable recommendations.
  • Continuously evaluate internal pricing performance and competitive trends to recommend refinements that improve pricing outcomes.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams

  • Work-life harmony with access to an award-winning holistic wellness program,

  • Pay-for-performance and best-in-class recognition programs, and

Join our growing team where everyone belongs!

through ZenaDrone to innovate and enhance customer inspection, monitoring, safety,

security, compliance, and surveying processes.

This position in on site 5 days a week and is not offer hybrid or remote

Position Summary

The Pricing Analyst will play a key role in developing and maintaining pricing strategies across multiple business units and service lines.

As ZenaTech continues integrating newly acquired companies, this role will help establish standardized pricing models based on current costs, market conditions, and profitability targets. Working closely with Finance, Operations, Business Development, and Executive Leadership, the Pricing Analyst will provide data-driven recommendations that improve margins, support growth objectives, and strengthen competitive positioning.]

Key Responsibilities

Pricing Analysis & Strategy

  • Analyze pricing performance across service lines, regions, customer segments, and business units.
  • Assess realized pricing against actual cost-to-serve and profitability targets.
  • Identify pricing inconsistencies, margin leakage, and revenue optimization opportunities.
  • Develop standardized pricing frameworks and rate cards based on current operating costs and market conditions.
  • Evaluate the financial impact of proposed pricing changes and repricing initiatives.

Bid Support & Margin Analysis

  • Support strategic bids, proposals, and large customer opportunities through pricing analysis and margin modeling.
  • Develop financial models to assess risk, profitability, and competitive positioning.
  • Partner with Sales and Business Development teams to establish bid pricing strategies.
  • Conduct win/loss analysis to evaluate pricing effectiveness and identify areas for improvement.
  • Provide recommendations that balance competitiveness with profitability objectives.

Market & Competitive Intelligence

  • Monitor market trends, competitor pricing, and industry developments.
  • Conduct competitive pricing analysis where market information is available.
  • Support leadership with recommendations based on market conditions and customer behavior.
  • Identify emerging pricing opportunities within new markets and acquired businesses.

Reporting & Business Insights

  • Build and maintain pricing dashboards, reports, and analytical tools.
  • Present findings and recommendations to commercial leadership and executive stakeholders.
  • Track profitability trends and pricing performance over time.
  • Support forecasting, budgeting, and commercial planning activities through pricing insights.

Requirements

job.name: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Frontier Research
job.description:
Company Overview Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.

The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models.

*Operating Principles* Deepgram is a research company that productizes as fast as possible. Four Operating Principles shape how we think, decide, and work together:

  • Compress before you communicate. You think it through first, then lead with the bottom line.
  • Resist entropy. You question what already exists before adding more process or tools.
  • Solve the category. You fix recurring problems at the source, not one case at a time.
  • Work at the frontier. You go after problems no one has solved yet.

We look for people who already work this way, and these principles shape how we grow and evaluate our team.

*AI-First by Default* We build AI that millions of people talk to, and we run the company the same way. AI is how we centralize work here, and is core to how we operate.

That means more than using the tools. We expect you to:

  • Build, not just use. Design your own workflows and agents, and use AI to remove whole categories of work instead of doing the same work faster.
  • Own the output. AI can speed up the work. It doesn’t make anyone less accountable for it. You understand, verify, and stand behind everything you share, including what an agent produces for you.
  • Spend the time you get back at the frontier. The capacity AI creates goes toward problems no one has solved yet.
  • Keep pace. Models and tools change every month, and so will your work. You adopt what’s new quickly and drop what no longer earns its place.

We judge AI by what it helps you deliver and whether you stand behind the result, not by how often you use it. In interviews, expect to walk us through a workflow you built and where you drew the line between AI and your own judgment.

Read the full description

Woven by Toyota is enabling Toyota’s once-in-a-century transformation into a mobility company. TEAM Our Cloud and Data Engineering organization is working on accelerating autonomous driving by providing access to petabytes of data collected from our large fleet of autonomous and non-autonomous vehicles. Efficient, fast and cost-effective access to data at large scale is key to tackle the hardest problems in Automated Driving, from developing the Machine Learning (ML) models for perception and prediction of human driving patterns, to increasing the sophistication of our validation and simulation by identifying rare and interesting real-world driving situations. The Lakehouse ingestion platform developed by the Data Acquisition Engineering team is a fundamental building block for developing and testing modern Automated Driving products that will impact millions of customers.

The primary goal of our Lakehouse system and Fleetnik mobile app is to seamlessly ingest, enrich, and monitor fleet vehicle data as it flows into the cloud. A key goal for this role is delivering data-collection edge filtering infrastructure that supports data validation and scenario detection. Our pipelines are based on industry standard frameworks deployed to AWS. We engineer large-scale data acquisition pipelines that process hundreds of terabytes daily from numerous global ingestion sites. Our data acquisition products leverage industry-standard frameworks deployed on AWS, utilizing Java, Golang, Python, and JavaScript. We believe strongly in automation and testing to ensure delivery of robust and correct systems. We are a distributed team, working in Japan, the UK and the US.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? The Data Acquisition team is looking for engineers who are passionate about and enable the next generation of automotive software development. The right candidate will have excellent communication skills, solid coding skills, broad knowledge of software engineering in areas such as Data Infrastructure and Warehouses, Data Ingestion, Distributed Databases, Compute Frameworks, Stream Processing, Observability and Build Infrastructure.

job.name: Senior Director, Engineering (AI Voice Agents)
job.description:
About Birdeye Inc. Birdeye builds AI coworkers for multi-location brands. Jay for marketing, Myna for operations, and Robin for customer experience orchestrate AI agents to win AI visibility, book appointments, and drive consistent CX at every location. They run on BirdAI, the Agent OS built on 13 years of multi-location data infrastructure and 3,000+ integrations. BirdAI consolidates every signal, reasons with industry, brand and location context, and acts autonomously or with a human in the loop.

Birdeye is trusted by the world's largest multi-location brands across healthcare, dental, restaurants, financial services, auto, retail, and property management. G2 ranks Birdeye #1 in Enterprise Multi-Location Marketing Platforms and named it to the 2026 Best Agentic AI Products list. Learn more at birdeye.com.

About The Role Every day, local businesses miss a large share of their inbound calls — and in appointment-driven industries, every missed call is a lost patient, a lost repair job, a lost service visit. Front desks are understaffed, phones ring after hours, and customers who don’t get through simply call the next provider. Birdeye’s AI Voice Agents group exists to fix this: AI agents that answer every call naturally, book and reschedule appointments directly into the systems businesses already run on, and give owners complete visibility into every conversation and outcome.

As Senior Director of Engineering, you will lead this group end to end: the real-time voice agent platform, a CRM/PMS integrations and data-sync layer handling business-contact data at massive scale, and the conversation dashboard where customers see every call, booking, and insight. You inherit an existing engineering team — the mandate combines 0-to-1 product urgency with the leadership challenge of aligning that team around one architecture, raising the delivery bar, and shipping GA products across four verticals.

The role is based in India, leading Birdeye’s India-based Voice Agents engineering team with direct exposure to US product leadership and customers. You will report to senior R&D leadership and partner daily with Product, Design, and the partnerships team driving CRM/EHR/FSM/DMS alliances. You lead from the front: deeply technical, close to the code where it matters — architecture decisions, critical-path reviews, and agent-quality evals.

job.description:

We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. job.name: Principal Engineer, Core Infrastructure
job.description:
Job Description As part of the TSO/AOCI organization, our mission is to build Kilt, the platform on which OCI services are built, deployed, and operated across every region. We are investing in core platform capabilities that let service teams focus on their product rather than on the undifferentiated work of running it at scale, and we are doing it with a small group of engineers concentrated on high-leverage, low-level systems.

Within Kilt, the Observability & Supervision team owns how the platform sees itself and reacts. We build the systems that collect metrics and logs from every host and service, evaluate that signal against what healthy is supposed to look like, escalate to the right owner with the right context, and increasingly act on their own, whether that means scaling capacity, triggering recovery, or adjusting behavior based on the live state of upstream dependencies. This is real-time distributed systems work with strict latency budgets, where a decision has to be both fast and correct under partial information, because a wrong action taken across a fleet is worse than no action at all.

For this role, we are looking for engineers with a passion for understanding how systems fail, not only how they work. You should be comfortable designing distributed control loops, reasoning about performance and correctness at scale, and owning a component from design through production operation. You should value simplicity, be direct in technical discussion, and be excited by problems where the answer is not yet known.

We are a small, growing team with broad ownership and real autonomy. You will work with motivated, diverse people who care about doing things well, and you will have the support to do your best work in a workplace where you belong.Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team The Production Engineering team is a newly formed organization within Anduril's Software Platform, dedicated to the reliability, performance, and scalability of the cloud infrastructure behind Lattice, Anduril's autonomous command and control platform. Our work helps keep mission-critical systems available in demanding operational environments.

Our team operates at the intersection of software engineering and systems reliability. We run on-call and incident management tooling, build observability and automation, and create the playbooks that help teams detect and recover from production issues. We partner with engineering teams across Anduril as a force multiplier: we provide the platform and operational support, while product teams retain ownership of their services.

About The Role We are seeking a Site Reliability Engineer 2 who is passionate about building resilient, highly available systems that scale to meet the demands of the core systems powering Lattice. You will work closely with platform engineers, product developers, and field operations to proactively identify reliability risks, respond to incidents, and help owning teams improve the operational excellence of our software platform. This is a hands-on role on a growing team, with opportunities to build shared tooling and processes that make reliability improvements easier to deliver. If you thrive on solving hard problems and want your work to have a direct impact on national security, this is the role for you.

job.name: Principal Software Engineer – SRE, Incident Response & Operational Excellence
job.description:
Overview Intuit is the global financial technology platform that powers prosperity for the people and communities we serve. Our public-facing products — TurboTax, Credit Karma, QuickBooks, and Mailchimp — serve approximately 100 million customers who depend on us at the moments that matter most: filing a return before the deadline, running payroll, checking their credit, or sending a campaign. When something breaks, minutes matter, and how quickly and how well we recover is a direct expression of our customer promise.

We are hiring Principal Software Engineers to serve as Technical Duty Officers (TDOs) — the leaders who take command of Intuit’s most critical incidents. During our most critical incidents you hold ultimate authority on decisions and enforcement of our incident principles, partnering with the Business Unit Driver and the Incident Operations Center (IOC) to direct recovery, actions, and communications on the bridge. Reporting to the Director of Cloud Engineering & Operations, this is a dedicated, full-time role: when you are not on the bridge, your mandate is to make the next incident shorter, rarer, and better understood — partnering across every business unit on effective observability, clarity of customer workflows and their real-time impact signals, high-quality runbooks, and validated escalation and notification readiness.

This role is equal parts operator, engineer, and leader. You bring the calm, decisive command presence to lead senior leaders through high-stakes ambiguity, the deep systems intuition to cut to the most likely fault and the fastest safe path to recovery, and the engineering skills to implement the improvements you identify rather than hand them off. As a Principal engineer, you will not just execute this work manually but direct, orchestrate, and govern AI agents to accelerate detection, triage, impact assessment, and post-incident learning, accountable for the quality and reliability of everything you and those agents produce.

Responsibilities

job.name: Senior / Staff Site Reliability Engineer
job.description:
*About Radar* Radar is the global leader in geolocation, with geofencing SDKs, maps APIs, and AI-enabled solutions for marketing, fraud, and operations teams.

Why is Radar the best place to work?

  • We're trusted by some of the world's best companies, from high-growth startups to the Fortune 500.
  • We have incredible scale: We're processing over 1 billion API calls per day from hundreds of millions of devices.
  • We're well-resourced, and we've raised $85.5M from world-class investors, including Accel and Insight Partners.
  • We have a high-performance culture, with ambitious and entrepreneurial teammates in every role.
  • We recently moved into an amazing new office in Flatiron, Manhattan, NYC.
  • We were recently named a top 10 best place to work in NYC by Crain's.

Despite our growth and scale, we're still just getting started. That's where you come in.

*About The Role* We're looking for Site Reliability Engineers to work on our production infrastructure. Radar is a high-throughput, data intensive application handling 1 billion+ API calls per day. Over the past year, Radar has been used from over 100M devices worldwide. We run a multi-availability zone architecture and a major initiative is to enhance our deployment to be multi-region.

*The Stack:* We use Terraform to manage our infrastructure.

We deploy everything to AWS via EKS.

We use MongoDB deployed to Atlas.

We do CI and deployments via CircleCI.

We monitor production with CloudWatch, grafana, Pingdom and PagerDuty.

DNS is managed by CloudFlare.

Most engineers are in the on-call rotation.

Our main server languages are TypeScript and Rust.

Our data pipelines are written in Airflow and Scala Spark.

We sponsor OpenStreetMaps, MapLibre and OpenAddresses.

*How We Use AI:*

  • Engineers choose what AI tools they use, Claude being the most popular.
  • We're actively building Claude skills - for example we've taught it how to debug HorizonDB, our geospatial database.
  • All code changes are reviewed by an Engineer knowledgeable in that area. Claude and Copilot also review all PRs.
  • There is a range of how much engineers use AI. Most use it daily if not weekly.
  • We are excited about what AI can do, but we also recognize the risks and don't compromise our coding standards.

*How We Work:* Most of our engineering team are former technical co-founders or former Radar interns from schools like Waterloo and CMU. Most engineers at Radar fit one of two molds, technically: either Staff level expertise in one stack, or Multi-Stack at any level. We say Multi-Stack because "Full-Stack" has the connotation of "Frontend and Backend", but Radar Engineers might also work on Mobile or Data engineering. Not that you need to be an expert in all of those, but a desire to learn, jump around to different stacks and get things done is the important part.

Read the full description

job.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

This role is available as a hybrid opportunity 3 days a week in San Jose, CA or Remote reporting to Production Engineering in the Cloud Infrastructure & Operations department. Join Zscaler to be a force multiplier for the reliability of a global platform processing 200+ billion transactions daily across tens of millions of enterprise users.

In this role, you will provide the technical vision and hands-on execution to drive an "automation-first" culture across the company. By maturing our observability and architectural standards, you will directly reduce our Mean Time to Mitigate (MTTM) and shape the scalability of our globally distributed, multi-cloud infrastructure.

What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)

  • Design and implement highly available, scalable infrastructure across AWS, GCP, and bare-metal environments

  • Implement and maintain sophisticated observability (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry), define SLIs/SLOs, and establish error budgets
  • Act as a lead Incident Commander (TDO on-call), develop response playbooks, and conduct deep-dive post-incident analyses
  • Partner with Engineering and partner teams to conduct operability reviews

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You act like an owner with a bias for action and integrity.

job.name: Site Reliability Engineer (Senior or Staff), Atlas
Site Reliability Engineer
job.description:
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) at Equifax is a discipline that combines software and systems engineering for building and running large-scale, distributed, fault-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that internal and external services meet or exceed reliability and performance expectations while adhering to Equifax engineering principles.

SRE is also an engineering approach to building and running production systems – we engineer solutions to operational problems. Our SREs are responsible for overall system operation and we use a breadth of tools and approaches to solve a broad set of problems. Practices such as limiting time spent on operational work, blameless postmortems, proactive identification, and prevention of potential outages.

Our SRE culture of diversity, intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Equifax brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big, and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to build an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn, grow and take pride in our work.

What You’ll Do

  • Work in a DevSecOps environment responsible for the building and running of large-scale, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems.
  • Work closely with development and operations teams to build highly available, cost effective systems with extremely high uptime metrics.
  • Work with cloud operations team to resolve trouble tickets, develop and run scripts, and troubleshoot
  • Create new tools and scripts designed for auto-remediation of incidents and establishing end-to-end monitoring and alerting on all critical aspects
  • Build infrastructure as code (IAC) patterns that meets security and engineering standards using one or more technologies (Terraform, scripting with cloud CLI, and programming with cloud SDK).
  • Participate in a team of first responders in a 24/7, follow the sun operating model for incident and problem management.

What Experience You Need

job.name: Supply Chain Intern
job.description:
What You'll Work On Across B2C, B2B, logistics, warehouse operations, quick commerce, and inventory planning, the intern will contribute to:

  • Operational data analysis: Working with order, inventory, and logistics data to track performance across the supply chain network and surface patterns worth acting on.
  • SLA & TAT tracking: Monitoring turnaround times and service levels across warehouse and logistics flows, and flagging deviations from target.
  • Warehouse operations exposure: Understanding day-to-day floor operations — inbound, outbound, inventory accuracy — across fulfilment and distribution centres.
  • Inventory planning support: Assisting with demand-supply matching, stock allocation, and distribution planning across nodes.
  • Reporting & dashboards: Building and maintaining reports/dashboards on cost, availability, and efficiency metrics that operations teams use to make decisions.
  • Cross-functional coordination: Working with warehouse, logistics, retail replenishment, and planning teams to help resolve day-to-day operational issues.

Operational Excellence - What We Expect This internship isn't just about executing tasks — it comes with a standing expectation to bring an operational excellence mindset to everything you touch:

  • Continuous improvement: Don't just complete a task as given — look for ways to make the underlying process faster, cheaper, or less error-prone, and flag it.
  • Root-cause orientation: When a number looks off or a process breaks, dig into why it happened rather than just reporting that it happened.
  • Process discipline: Document what you find and what you fix clearly enough that someone else could pick it up — improvements should be repeatable, not one-off.
  • Metric ownership: Be comfortable owning a metric end-to-end — tracking it, explaining its movement, and proposing what would move it in the right direction.

Who We're Looking For We're looking for a B.Tech graduate or a final year student who thinks in numbers and structure first, and who genuinely wants to understand how physical supply chains work — not just analyze them from a spreadsheet.

  • Analytical strength: Comfortable with data — able to slice, structure, and interpret numbers, spot patterns, and question them before presenting.
  • Logical, first-principles thinking: Can break down an ambiguous operational problem into its component parts without needing to be told how.
  • Genuine interest in supply chain operations: Curious about how B2C and B2B flows, logistics networks, warehouses, quick commerce, and inventory planning actually function end-to-end.
  • Ownership: Takes a task from raw data to a finished, presentable output without needing constant hand-holding.
  • Communication: Can explain a number, a chart, or a finding clearly to someone who doesn't have the analytical background.

job.name: IT Manager
job.description:
JELD-WEN is currently seeking a IT Manager to join our growing team.

External Job Description We're looking for an experienced software developer to build and maintain the applications, integration and automation that keep our Woodbridge plant running. You'll connect plant systems and manufacturing equipment to our AS400 ERP and cloud services, automate manual work, and turn plant data into reporting that leadership can act on. You'll work onsite, close to the production floor, so you can see the problems you're solving first-hand. You'll also be the plant's technology lead. A small Site-Support team handles day-to-day user support, and you'll oversee that work and step in on major incidents. Expect roughly 70% of your time on development and automation and 30% on site technology leadership.

What you'll do:

Software development and integration (about 70%):

  • Design, build and maintain plant applications, integrations and automation, mainly in Progress 4GL, C#/.NET and SQL.
  • Integrate plant systems and manufacturing equipment with our AS400 ERP and cloud services.
  • Build and maintain applications that let manufacturing machines and components communicate with each other and with central systems.
  • Write scripts and small tools that remove manual work, improve data quality and cut repetitive support tickets.
  • Automate device provisioning, patching, reporting and routine maintenance tasks.
  • Use Git for version control and set up CI/CD pipelines so changes are tested, traceable and easy to roll back.
  • Plan and lead testing, deployment and rollback for every application change, scheduled around production.
  • Build queries, dashboards and reports that give plant leadership clear data on KPIs and downtime.
  • Document what you build in SOPs and runbooks, and share reusable components and standards with Plant Technology teams at other sites.

Site technology leadership (about 30%):

  • Oversee the plant's Site-Support team, who handle day-to-day user support, ServiceNow tickets and SLAs.
  • Act as the main technology contact between plant management and central IT, and lead the response to major incidents.
  • Make sure critical systems have tested backups, documented recovery steps, UPS protection, and tracked end-of-life hardware and software.
  • Keep user access in Active Directory and Okta secure through periodic access reviews.
  • Coordinate plant technology projects such as network and Wi-Fi upgrades, scanner replacements and site rollouts.
  • Take part in Production Gemba Walks and SQDCI meetings, and turn what you see into automation opportunities.
  • Mentor plant staff and the Site-Support team on new tools and better ways of working.

Notre réussite repose sur des bases claires : la collaboration, la force du collectif et le respect entrepreneurial . Ici, chaque talent contribue à des projets concrets et à fort impact, dans un environnement où l’expertise et l’initiative sont reconnues.

Description Du Poste Localisations possibles : Boucherville ou Québec

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) Développeur(euse) QA spécialisé(e) en automatisation des tests. Sous la supervision du directeur développement et administration TI, il aura comme principaux mandats d’automatiser les tests, de valider les intégrations API et SFTP, de gérer les pipelines de tests et de suivre les défauts jusqu’à leur correction.

Le(la) Développeur(euse) QA veille à la qualité de nos plateformes critiques : le site web .NET, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O), Salesforce et la suite Manhattan (WMS, TMS, OMS). Pour ce faire, il ou elle conçoit et maintient des suites de tests automatisés qui permettent des livraisons fréquentes, fiables et sécurisées. Ce poste requiert une solide expertise technique et une grande rigueur. Il demande aussi de travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de développement, de configuration et d’analyse fonctionnelle.

Responsabilités Automatisation des tests

  • Concevoir, développer et maintenir les suites de tests automatisés du site .NET (tests unitaires, d’intégration et de bout en bout).
  • Automatiser les tests fonctionnels et de régression de D365 F&O (finance, achats, inventaire, ventes) et des flux associés.
  • Automatiser les tests fonctionnels et de régression de Salesforce (ventes, service, configurations et intégrations avec les autres systèmes).
  • Mettre en place et maintenir les tests des modules Manhattan WMS, TMS et OMS, dont la validation des flux de commandes, d’expéditions et de transport.

Intégrations et données

  • Valider les intégrations API (REST/SOAP) : contrats, schémas JSON/XML, codes de réponse, gestion des erreurs, performance et sécurité de base.
  • Tester les échanges SFTP : dépôt et récupération de fichiers, formats (CSV, XML, EDI), conventions de nommage, traitements par lots, reprise sur erreur et rapprochement des données.
  • Créer et gérer des jeux de données de test, des environnements isolés et des mécanismes de simulation (mocks, stubs, services virtuels).

Intégration continue et fiabilité des suites

Working within a Windows Enterprise and Microsoft Azure ecosystem, you will handle new feature development, complex system integrations, production support, and smooth operational transitions.

Responsibilities

Enterprise Integrations:

Database Engineering:

Operational Readiness & Support:

  • Lead operational acceptance activities to ensure seamless transitions to production; provide ongoing production support, resolve incidents, and coordinate application/database server upgrades.

Quality & Documentation:

  • Conduct thorough code reviews, load testing, performance tuning, and maintain clear technical documentation.

Our client is a globally recognized financial services organization that advises corporations, institutions, and investors on strategic and capital markets transactions. Technology is a core differentiator for the business, with continued investment in modern engineering practices, cloud transformation, data-driven solutions, and AI-enabled innovation.

Description

This is a highly technical individual contributor role with a strong emphasis on software engineering and cloud development.

Core Focus Areas:

  • C# / .NET Engineering (50%)

Profile

10+ years of software engineering experience.

Expert-level C# and .NET development experience.

Strong Azure engineering experience with a proven ability to build and deploy cloud-native applications.

Hands-on experience with REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and enterprise application integration.

Strong understanding of Azure architecture, security, DevOps, CI/CD, and cloud engineering practices.

Experience with SQL Server and enterprise data platforms.

Exposure to AI, machine learning, Copilot technologies, Azure OpenAI, intelligent search, or automation initiatives is highly desirable.

Experience within investment banking, capital markets, financial services, or other highly regulated environments is preferred.

Strong communication skills and ability to engage directly with business stakeholders.

Job Title: Java AWS Developer

Location: Albany,NY

Job Description

Mandatory Qualifications

1. Level III- More than seven (7) years of experience working on complex projects with 2 or more years in a leadership role as a Developer.
2. 7+ years of professional Java development experience with strong proficiency in Java 21 (records, sealed classes, pattern matching, virtual threads). One to three years of experience designing and building microservices architectures — service decomposition, API gateway patterns, service discovery, and distributed configuration; deploying and operating microservices on AWS (EC2, ECS/EKS, RDS, S3, SQS, Lambda).
3. Seven years of experience with Spring Boot and the Spring ecosystem (Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Cloud); Spring Batch for large-scale batch processing; solid understanding of Hibernate/JPA for ORM and database interaction; experience with PostgreSQL or similar relational databases; building and consuming RESTful APIs with proper versioning and contract-first design; experience with inter-service communication patterns (REST, messaging queues, event-driven).

Desirable Qualifications

4. More than 7 years of experience with DevOps principles and experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins.
5. 2+ years of experience working in a federal or state government setting (Health and Human Services, especially in Integrated Eligibility System programs such as PA, TA, SNAP, HEAP, Fair Hearings, Child Support, etc. preferred).
6. More than 7 years of experience with relational databases (e.g., Oracle, PostgreSQL) and SQL, as well as experience with NoSQL databases.

job.name: Appian Solution Architect - Senior Associate
job.description:
The Opportunity

As a Appian Solution Architect - Senior Associate, you will design and implement Appian-based process solutions within our Advisory practice, helping clients digitize and improve how work flows across their organizations. In this role, you will use business process modeling to understand current workflows and identify opportunities for automation through business process management and low-code tools. You will translate business needs into platform architecture and integration approaches that support efficient data flow, secure connectivity, and scalable technology foundations. Working with clients and multidisciplinary teams, you will connect process goals with technical design and implementation.

As a Senior Associate, you will guide assigned technical workstreams while building meaningful client relationships and learning how each client’s business context is changing. You will apply critical thinking when requirements are unclear, ask questions, evaluate options using available methods and technology resources, and use feedback to refine your approach. As a technical lead, you will review junior colleagues’ work, offer practical coaching, and respond to differing perspectives while keeping the team’s broader objectives in view. You will anticipate client and team needs, uphold professional and technical standards, and take ownership of the quality of your contributions as you develop your leadership and technical skills.

Responsibilities

  • Designing Appian solution architectures that translate client process requirements into low-code applications, enterprise integrations, and cloud deployment plans
  • Modeling current and future business processes to identify automation opportunities and define workflows, data flows, and implementation priorities
  • Leading Appian BPM implementation workstreams, including process orchestration and system integrations that support secure connectivity and efficient information exchange
  • Assessing cloud hosting options across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform, with attention to infrastructure design, access protocols, and network security
  • Analyzing process data using Celonis or SAP Signavio to inform workflow improvements and identify opportunities to connect Appian with robotic process automation tools
  • Coordinating technical delivery through Scrum practices, tracking dependencies and implementation issues in Jira, and working with client teams on deployment plans
  • Troubleshooting platform, integration, and network issues, using IT service management processes to document findings and recommend changes
  • Reviewing junior team members’ technical deliverables, guiding implementation decisions, and explaining architecture tradeoffs to clients while incorporating feedback into solution documentation

What You Must Have

  • At least a Bachelor's degree
  • At least 3 years of experience

What Sets You Apart

Role Summary Job Description Summary

We are seeking a Data Analyst to join the Analytics Architecture team within McAfee’s Analytics Platform & Enablement organization. In this role you will build, validate, and maintain the analytical logic behind McAfee’s most critical consumer business metrics — retention rate, trial conversion, bookings, subscriber counts, and marketing effectiveness. You will work directly in Databricks writing SQL and Python to transform raw data into certified KPIs that drive decisions at the VP and C-level.

This is a hands-on, high-output role. You will own end-to-end analysis cycles: receiving business questions from leadership, translating them into data logic, validating results against source-of-truth systems, and delivering findings that directly influence how McAfee measures and optimizes its subscription business. You will partner closely with Data Engineering, Finance, Marketing, and Product teams on a daily basis.

This position reports to the Senior Manager of Analytics Architecture and works alongside 2–3 peer analysts who collectively own the analytical foundations for McAfee’s consumer business.

This is a Hybrid Position located in either Waterloo or Toronto, Canada. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to either location. You will be required to be onsite on an as-needed basis; when not working onsite, you will work from your home office.

Position Details About The Role

  • Build and validate the data logic behind core business KPIs — translating business definitions into certified analytical models across multiple dimensions.
  • Perform end-to-end data reconciliation — validating analytical datasets against finance and operational source-of-truth systems, investigating discrepancies, and ensuring accuracy of reported metrics.
  • Conduct customer lifecycle analysis — defining and measuring customer populations, segmenting behavior across acquisition, engagement, and renewal stages, and identifying drivers of key business outcomes.
  • Build waterfall and funnel analyses — decomposing aggregate metric movements into contributing factors, quantifying the impact of each, and presenting findings to leadership in a clear and actionable format.
  • Build and maintain data models and transformation logic — working in Databricks to create, migrate, and backfill analytical tables, validate data transformations, and ensure consistency between raw and curated data layers.
  • Produce and maintain automated dashboards and reports — building executive-facing visualizations that track business performance across multiple data sources with automated refresh pipelines.
  • Conduct root cause analysis on metric anomalies — investigating unexpected movements in KPIs, tracing issues through multiple data layers, and producing actionable findings for business stakeholders.
  • Analyze digital customer journeys and web funnels across acquisition, engagement, trial, purchase, and renew

Job Summary: We are seeking a skilled Citrix Xen Hypervisor Administrator to manage and support our virtualization infrastructure. Key Responsibilities:

  • Install, configure, and maintain Citrix XenServer/Xen Hypervisor environments.

Working Conditions:

job.name: R&D Software Staff Engineer – RF/Microwave Test Automation
job.description:
R&D Software Staff Engineer – RF/Microwave Test Automation

Overview:

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~15,000 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.

Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

Bring software and advanced hardware together to help launch Keysight’s next generation of RF and microwave technology. As an R&D Software Engineer, you’ll architect, develop, and validate software that controls precision instruments and automates the testing of complex microcircuits and modules. Working closely with electrical test engineers, you’ll turn measurement and calibration requirements into reliable software that supports products from early prototypes through manufacturing release.

This Expert-level individual contributor role combines software architecture and development with hands-on problem-solving in the lab. You’ll take technical ownership of complex test software, develop instrument drivers, resolve interactions between software and hardware, and improve the maintainability and performance of test systems. Collaborating with R&D and manufacturing teams in the U.S. and worldwide, you’ll help establish accurate, repeatable testing for the microcircuits behind Keysight’s measurement products. The position is fully onsite in Santa Rosa, California.

Responsibilities:

Provide software architecture and technical leadership for the implementation, integration, and validation of automated tests for RF and microwave microcircuits and modules. Partner with electrical test engineers, designers, and manufacturing teams to influence product testability and deliver reliable test software from early development through production. This role supports the hybrid microcircuits used across Keysight’s signal analyzers, signal sources, and electronic measurement products, working in an environment that values technical competence, teamwork, and integrity.
