job.name: Architect - IOS Applications
job.description:
About CleanHarbors Clean Harbors Inc. (www.cleanharbors.com) is a NYSE listed US based $6.5 billion company. Clean Harbors was founded in 1980 near Boston by Mr. Alan S. McKim .

Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 25,000 employees and has over 750 service locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300,000 customers, the Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events in North America of the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in New York, the 2015 avian flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy, and the oil pipeline breaks that affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical releases into the environment.

Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Center (GCC) to serve our parent company. We take pride in serving some of the most tech savvy business stakeholders at Clean Harbors. The GCC employees form part of our globally integrated teams that provide cutting-edge IT solutions and production support across platforms. Our shared services teams work seamlessly with their global counterparts in providing critical 24x7 support in various functions including Finance, HR, Procurement, IT and Operations. Our aggressive growth plans open significant career advancement opportunities for our employees.

Job Title: Technical Architect – Mobile Applications Experience: 12 years Location: Hyderabad, Hybrid (3 days from office) Working Hours: 12:00 PM 9:00 PM Overview Clean Harbors is seeking a Mobile Architect to lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and high-performance mobile solutions. This role is pivotal in modernizing our enterprise architecture and aligning mobile platforms with Clean Harbors’ digital transformation goals.

job.name: Operation Engineer
job.description:
Job Description KONE is a global leader in the elevator and escalator industry, making people’s journeys safe, convenient, and reliable with smart and sustainable People Flow®. In a world where cities are constantly evolving and more and more people choose to live in them, we at KONE stand with one clear aim: to shape the future of cities. We make urban life more vibrant and livable. And we do it by enabling safe, sustainable, and effortless people flow for all. We help cities leave a positive mark on the planet - for the next century and beyond. We shape the future of cities.

KONE Technology and Innovation Unit (KTI) is where the magic happens at KONE. It's where we combine the physical world – escalators and elevators – with smart and connected digital systems. We are changing and improving the way billions of people move within buildings every day. We are on a mission to expand and develop new digital solutions that are based on emerging technologies.

KONE R&D brings together top talent from different disciplines into an industry-leading product and technology organization. We thrive in solving complex customer challenges, connecting legacy with the latest technologies across hardware and software engineering. In fact, roughly half of our R&D roles are in software. Agile ways of working mean that we are better able to meet our customers’ rapidly evolving needs for speed and innovation, in a global environment.

R&D unit in KTI is responsible for developing digital services at KONE. It’s the development engine for our Digital Services such as KONE 24/7 Connected Services, Office Flow and Partnership Ecosystem. Our common goal at KONE is to keep the end users safe and people flow uninterrupted. KONE moves 2 billion people every day and that means our services can really make cities better places to live

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Operations Engineer to join our Solution Operations team. This role focuses on ensuring system stability, driving operational excellence, and supporting end-to-end incident management across multiple platforms. The ideal candidate will combine strong operational expertise with hands-on technical skills in DevOps, cloud platforms, and automation.

Key Responsibilities Operations & Incident Management

  • Manage and contribute to end-to-end incident lifecycle, ensuring timely resolution within defined SLAs and KPIs.
  • Perform advanced troubleshooting across multiple technologies and environments (global and local).
  • Lead and/or support problem management and root cause analysis (RCA) initiatives.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Product Owners, Developers, Business, and Support teams) for issue resolution.
  • Provide hands-on operational support and coordinate with stakeholders during critical incidents.

DevOps & Automation

job.name: Senior Data Scientist
job.description:
Apply AI and machine learning in manufacturing Are you interested in applying AI and machine learning to real-world manufacturing challenges? Join our innovation team as a Data Scientist and contribute to improving factory operations, product quality, and predictive maintenance. This role offers the opportunity to work within a global organisation advancing Industry 4.0 while transforming complex industrial data into meaningful insights. Could this be your next professional step?

Transform industrial data into actionable insights As a Data Scientist, you will work with cross-functional teams to analyse manufacturing data and develop solutions that improve operational performance. You will contribute to initiatives such as predictive maintenance, demand forecasting, and process optimisation using AI and statistical techniques. This role involves collaboration across engineering, IT, and business teams to deliver practical outcomes from data.

Your Responsibility Will Be To

  • Analyse large-scale manufacturing datasets to identify patterns and anomalies
  • Build machine learning models for predictive maintenance and defect detection
  • Develop solutions for process optimisation and demand forecasting
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to implement data-driven initiatives
  • Communicate insights to both technical and non-technical audiences

Curious and collaborative professional with a structured approach You are a detail-oriented individual who enjoys working with data to solve practical challenges. You communicate clearly and work effectively with different stakeholders. You approach tasks with curiosity and are motivated by continuous learning. You value teamwork and contribute positively to a collaborative environment while managing shifting priorities.

You Also Have

  • Master’s or PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or related field
  • Experience applying data science in manufacturing or industrial environments
  • Proficiency in Python, R, SQL, and machine learning libraries (scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch)
  • Experience with data visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure Fabric

Contribute to smarter manufacturing and greener future NKT is committed to developing a diverse organization and culture where people of diverse backgrounds can grow and are inspired to do their best. We are committed to establishing gender diversity at NKT and encouraging all interested candidates to apply – even if you don’t tick all the boxes described. We believe that a diverse organization enables long-term performance, and that an inclusive and welcoming culture creates a better work environment.

job.name: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
job.description:
Job Title - Senior Quality Assurance Engineer – ExamDeveloper

Summary

As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer, you are a highly skilled individual contributor recognized as a technical authority for quality within your area. You lead quality engineering strategy and execution for one or more product squads, combining hands-on testing and automation with release-quality accountability and technical guidance for other quality engineers.

You design advanced test strategies that anticipate complex system interactions, integration risks, and failure modes, and you establish an automation-first approach with complete, visible coverage. You are frequently consulted on the most challenging defects, complex integrations, performance and reliability concerns, and critical release decisions. You lead through expertise rather than formal authority — mentoring quality engineers, improving practices, and helping teams make sound quality and release decisions. You partner closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Product Architects, Dev Leads, DevOps, security, accessibility, and vendor teams to protect candidate experience, delivery reliability, and product quality.

The Product

ExamDeveloper is a web-based exam development platform that allows customers to write, review, and manage questions on their exams. Customers rely on ExamDeveloper to support the full workflow around item writing, collaborative review, scoring, and test management for certification and professional assessment programs.

ExamDeveloper is a leading web-based tool for creating tests that certify test-takers in the professional skills they require. The Senior Quality Assurance Engineer plays a critical role in protecting workflow accuracy, automation reliability, delivery confidence, and product quality as the platform continues to support complex exam-development workflows.

Key responsibilities

Quality strategy and test design

  • Lead test strategy and coverage planning for assigned squad initiatives, releases, and platform changes.
  • Design advanced test approaches spanning functional, regression, integration, negative, accessibility, and API coverage.
  • Define quality gates and test readiness criteria for stories, defects, releases, and production-impacting changes.
  • Ensure stories and defects include clear testing evidence, including test cases executed, edge cases considered, environment details, data notes, and traceability where appropriate.
  • Use metrics, defect trends, and production signals to continuously improve the test strategy.

Hands-on testing and automation

  • Contribute directly to hands-on testing for high-risk, complex, cross-team, or automation-critical work.
  • Create, improve, and review automated tests across UI, API, integration, and regression coverage.
  • Review regression results, identify failure patterns, and drive resolution of flaky, missing, or outdated tests.

As Amazon has rapidly grown and diversified, the opportunity for applying machine learning has exploded. These include product bundle recommendations for millions of products, safeguarding financial transactions across by building the risk models, improving catalog quality via extracting product attribute values from structured/unstructured data for millions of products, enhancing address quality by powering customer suggestions

We are developing state-of-the-art machine learning solutions to accelerate the Amazon India growth story. Amazon India is an exciting place to be at for a machine learning practitioner. We have the eagerness of a fresh startup to absorb machine learning solutions, and the scale of a mature firm to help support their development at the same time. As part of the India Machine Learning team, you will get to work alongside brilliant minds motivated to solve real-world machine learning problems that make a difference to millions of our customers. We encourage thought leadership and blue ocean thinking in ML.

Use machine learning and analytical techniques to create scalable solutions for business problems

Analyze and extract relevant information from large amounts of Amazon’s historical business data to help automate and optimize key processes

Design, develop, evaluate and deploy, innovative and highly scalable ML models

Work closely with software engineering teams to drive real-time model implementations

Work closely with business partners to identify problems and propose machine learning solutions

Establish scalable, efficient, automated processes for large scale data analyses, model development, model validation and model maintenance

job.name: Director, Software Engineering
job.description:
About Team Traffic Foundation builds the platforms that direct, protect and accelerate digital traffic for Walmart customers and associates. Our systems operate globally across content delivery networks, edge computing, traffic management and application delivery.

The CDN Platforms and Static Asset Optimization teams move digital experiences closer to customers through multi CDN delivery, edge computing and content optimization. Their work improves how web experiences, images, video and other static content are delivered while reducing origin demand and infrastructure cost.

The teams also build shared capabilities for high demand events and partner with application teams to improve Site Speed. Common observability and resiliency mechanisms help Walmart prepare for traffic growth, holiday events and provider or regional failures.

What will you do

Lead the multi CDN strategy; Define how Walmart uses multiple CDN providers to improve performance, availability and capacity while preserving provider choice and commercial flexibility. Establish the strategy for traffic placement, provider qualification, automated failover and recovery.

Shape edge compute interoperability; Create a consistent way to build, test and operate capabilities across runtimes such as Akamai EdgeWorkers, Cloudflare Workers and Fastly Compute. Use common contracts and selectively adopt standards such as WinterTC, WebAssembly and WASI where they offer practical interoperability.

Set the direction for Static Asset Optimization; Lead the platforms that optimize and deliver images, video and other static content. Improve customer performance and content quality while reducing bandwidth, origin demand and infrastructure cost.

Lead platforms for high demand experiences; Set the direction for capabilities that manage exceptional demand, protect constrained inventory and prevent dependent systems from being overwhelmed. Evolve Draw and Queuing as shared platforms that can support major events across markets and business units.

Make Site Speed a shared engineering outcome; Establish clear measures based on real customer experience. Partner with application teams to identify and prioritize improvements across content delivery, caching and edge execution.

Build observability across the delivery path; Create a consistent view of traffic and experience health from the customer edge through origin systems. Help teams detect degradation early, isolate the responsible layer and understand customer impact.

Own platform resiliency and readiness; Define standards for capacity planning, fault isolation, rollback, automated recovery and disaster recovery testing. Ensure the platforms are ready for holiday traffic, sudden demand and provider, regional or origin failures.

With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Tenstorrent is hiring a Senior Identity Management Engineer to architect, build, and run the identity, secrets, and privileged access systems that secure our global workforce, engineering infrastructure, cloud services, and autonomous AI agents. As part of the Operations Security (OpSec) team, you will replace static credentials, over-scoped tokens, and manual ticket queues with automated, self-service paths, partnering with IT, DevInfra, Cloud, and Software Engineering. This role is remote, based out of the United States or Canada.

job.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Affirm's engineering team is building a large-scale, highly-available, and global infrastructure that is shared across multiple financial products. Ensuring that our infrastructure is accessible to all engineers is critical to the success of the business. We pride ourselves on our culture across engineering of engaging in thorough technical design review, operational excellence, and capable incident response and analysis.

The Compute Platform team owns the EKS foundation that Affirm's products run on, from cluster provisioning and lifecycle through the safety standards that keep thousands of workloads reliable at scale. Affirm operates 90+ EKS clusters across environments and regions, and this team is responsible for making that fleet standardized, automated, observable, and self-healing, while establishing and enforcing the workload configuration standards that protect availability. Our mission is to provide a secure, reliable, and scalable Kubernetes platform that lets infrastructure and application teams deploy and operate with confidence and minimal operational friction.

What You’ll Do As a member of the Compute Platform organization, you will collaborate with other teams - including Product, Infrastructure, Traffic, Cost & Capacity Engineering to:

  • Architect and evolve Affirm's EKS platform, driving strategy across cluster lifecycle, node management, and shared cluster components
  • Lead the technical direction for cluster provisioning, upgrades, and teardown through standardized IaC (Terraform, Spacelift) and self-service workflows
  • Own the reliability of core shared components across the fleet (Karpenter, CoreDNS, VPC CNI, Kube Proxy, Metrics Server, etc) and the CI/CD pipeline that ships them consistently
  • Define and enforce EKS workload safety standards covering resource configuration, workload isolation and blast radius, disruption tolerance (PDBs), Karpenter consolidation strategies, etc
  • Build the enforcement and automation path that moves each standard from research and white-glove onboarding through broad adoption to policy-enforced defaults for new workloads
  • Establish the observability, baseline audits, and reporting needed to identify hot spots and measure risk mitigation over time
  • Partner with cluster-user teams (checkout, batch, ML, analytics, DevProd, etc) to understand workload needs and shape the platform accordingly
  • Drive cost and capacity strategy across node scaling, bin packing, and EC2 instance selection
  • Mentor engineers across the Compute Platform teams and set the bar for operational excellence
  • Participate in the on-call rotation, triage and catalogue runtime K8s issues, and collaborate with SRE on production incidents

What We Look For

job.name: AI Engineer, Design
job.description:
About Nu Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About The Role We're looking for an outstanding AI Engineer with both a passion for design and experience architecting modern AI implementations.

Nu's design and research function is roughly 260 people. Over the past year they have been building their own tooling: something like 100 AI-assisted solutions and 30+ local knowledge repositories, each built inside a business unit to solve that unit's problem. Most of them work. None of them talk to each other.

The Design Center of Excellence exists to turn that kind of local invention into systems the whole function can build on. It has design ops and research ops. It does not have an engineer — which means the CoE can identify a need, specify a tool, and then has no one to build it.

This is that hire: the first engineer in the CoE, and the person who architects the systems that let design at Nu scale. You'll work directly with the designers and researchers who use what you build, and the person who scopes a system is the person who builds it.

What You'll Work On NuBrain — the first priority. A global knowledge system for the design and research function, consolidating the 30+ local repositories that already exist. The hard part is not merging content; it's the context architecture — how retrieval is structured, how token consumption stays sane, and how content reaches people and agents at the moment it's useful.

New tools that enable superlative creative marketing and brand expressions at scale . As Nu scales globally, we are inventing new ways to express our brand in the product and through our marketing. Instead of hiring fleets of marketing designers in every country, we aim to build tools that enable consistent high quality creative expression to be driven centrally.

Canonicalizing what already exists. Roughly 100 AI solutions have been built locally by designers and researchers. Someone needs to understand what they are, decide what becomes standard for the function, and retire the rest before the duplication compounds.

Deciding the shape of the answer. Plugin, MCP server, agent, Claude skill, or a full platform — that call is yours to make and defend. Part of the job is telling the CoE that the tool they asked for should be something else.

What You'll Do

job.name: Senior Software Developer
job.description:
Job Description Some of what you will do: The Staples technology team is seeking a motivated and talented Software Developer to join our backend development team. We are looking for someone passionate about building robust, scalable backend systems and microservices. This role focuses exclusively on server-side development using .NET and C# technologies. You will work in a collaborative environment where you can grow your skills while contributing to mission-critical applications that serve our customers.

Specifically, You Will

  • Develop and maintain backend applications and APIs using .NET and C#.
  • Build and enhance microservices architecture components.
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs and web services.
  • Work with databases to create efficient data access layers.
  • Deploy and monitor applications in Azure cloud environment.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
  • Participate in code reviews and follow development best practices.
  • Contribute to testing strategies including unit and integration testing..

Some Of What You Need

  • Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • Relevant coding bootcamp certification or equivalent practical experience.
  • Microsoft certifications (Azure Fundamentals, C# certifications) are a plus.
  • Strong foundational knowledge of C# and .NET framework (.NET 8+).
  • Understanding various design patterns and best practices.
  • Good knowledge of microservices architecture concepts, Cloud Native services, Containerized Architecture.
  • Expertise in RESTful API design and development.
  • Database knowledge (SQL Server preferred, but open to other RDBMS).
  • Familar understanding of Azure cloud services such as EventHub, Table Storage, Blob Storage.
  • Experience with version control systems (Git).
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile methodology.
  • Experience with Azure services (App Service, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Azure SQL).
  • Knowledge of containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with message queues and event-driven architecture.
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (Azure DevOps).
  • Experience with Entity Framework Core or other ORM tools.
  • Knowledge of design patterns and software architecture principles.
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks (xUnit, NUnit).
  • Understanding of authentication and authorization (OAuth, JWT).
  • Knowledge of caching strategies (Redis, Azure Cache).
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience.
  • 5+ years of experience with .NET Core/.NET 8+ and C# development.
  • Basic experience with SQL databases and writing queries.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure.
  • Understanding of web service development and API integration.
  • Experience with development tools like Visual Studio or VS Code.
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies is a plus.

Read the full description

job.name: Senior Manager – Insurance Software Development
job.description:
Job Description Lead engineers and application specialists in delivering secure, scalable, and reliable technology for Underwriting and Insurance Illustration initiatives. The role combines strategic leadership, integration expertise, and hands-on engineering oversight.

What is the opportunity?

  • Leadership: Develop and coach onsite, offshore, and contractor teams. Manage resourcing and foster a high-performance culture.
  • Delivery and Architecture: Set technical direction aligned with IT strategy. Drive Agile and DevOps delivery using APIs, data center, and cloud platforms. Deliver on time, within budget, and in line with regulatory requirements.
  • Operations and Governance: Own production stability and service excellence. Enforce standards for CI/CD, testing, and security. Ensure ITIL alignment, audit readiness, and oversight of penetration, performance, and disaster recovery testing.
  • Stakeholder and Vendor Management: Act as primary contact for business leaders and vendors. Manage contracts, budgets, and vendor performance. Communicate technical concepts clearly and manage risks and dependencies.

What you need to succeed – Must Have’s:

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent professional experience
  • 3+ years in financial services or insurance
  • 10+ years of engineering experience delivering production or distributed systems at scale
  • 2–4+ years leading engineers, balancing hands-on technical and people leadership
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub, Jenkins, Azure DevOps), cloud or container platforms (e.g., OpenShift), and automated testing
  • Strong knowledge of Git, SQL, and enterprise security (SSO, SSL/TLS, encryption, role-based access)
  • Experience with Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery methodologies
  • Experience embedding AI coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude) into regulated development workflows

Nice-to-Have's:

  • Contractor and vendor management experience
  • Insurance or financial services experience beyond the minimum

  • Previous experience with Sapiens' UWPro and AppPro, Novinsoft Illustrations, or RGA Aura

What's in it for you? We are committed to fostering excellence through innovative thinking, continuous growth, and collaborative partnership to deliver trusted solutions that help our clients and communities succeed. We prioritize supporting one another, realizing our potential, contributing meaningfully to our communities, and achieving shared success.

job.name: Software Development Engineer III, Retail Ad Service
job.description:
Description Are you ready to tackle complex technical challenges that impact millions of customers worldwide? We are looking for a Software Development Engineer III to join our team at Amazon, where you will lead the design, development, and delivery of software systems that operate at massive scale. In this role, you will own your team's architectural direction, drive engineering best practices, and deliver solutions that balance performance, security, and long-term maintainability. You will work across the full software lifecycle — from defining product strategy to coding, testing, deployment, and operations — while collaborating with engineers and stakeholders across multiple teams. If you are a self-starter who thrives on solving problems with unclear technology paths and enjoys mentoring others along the way, this is the role for you.

Key job responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end design, implementation, and delivery of software systems spanning multiple features, ensuring solutions are well-architected, extensible, and secure.
  • Own your team's architectural direction by evaluating trade-offs across scalability, maintainability, and performance, and guide future technology choices that align with business goals.
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and cross-functional partners to define requirements, resolve conflicting constraints, and deliver incremental, high-quality releases.
  • Coach and mentor multiple engineers on your team and across related teams, driving adoption of engineering best practices in code quality, system design, and operational excellence.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify existing systems and proactively apply new approaches, technologies, or design patterns that benefit your team and partner teams.

A day in the life

You will start your day reviewing operational metrics and system health before diving into design discussions or code reviews with your team. You might spend the morning pairing with a teammate on a tricky architectural problem, then shift to writing a technical design document that will align stakeholders across multiple teams. Afternoons could include mentoring a colleague, prototyping a new approach to reduce system complexity, or collaborating with product partners to refine upcoming priorities. You will regularly evaluate generative AI tools and techniques to augment your team's productivity.

Read the full description

job.name: Engineering Manager - Infrastructure
job.description:
BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.

This role will require being full-time onsite at our Toronto or New York City office to support collaborative team dynamics and innovative problem-solving. You will participate in an on-call rotation covering 8:00am–4:00pm ET. This is a player-coach role: you'll lead a small team of infrastructure engineers while staying hands-on in the engineering work itself. You'll be an extra set of hands on your team's projects, take on smaller initiatives yourself so the team can stay focused on roadmap work, and help build, shape, and execute our infrastructure roadmap. Expect to spend roughly 60% of your time on hands-on engineering and 40% on leading the team. What You'll Do Lead the team

  • Lead and develop a small team of talented infrastructure engineers through regular 1:1s, coaching, feedback, and career development
  • Help shape a team culture of open communication, craftsmanship, and ownership
  • Take direct responsibility for the quality and delivery of the team's work
  • Participate in hiring and growing the team
  • Protect the team's focus by triaging incoming requests and unplanned work, so engineers can stay on roadmap priorities

Stay hands-on

  • Be an extra set of hands on your team's projects: pair on hard problems, unblock work, review designs and code, and pick up pieces of larger efforts when it helps the team move faster
  • Own and deliver smaller infrastructure initiatives end to end
  • Participate in the team's on-call rotation (8:00am–4:00pm ET), act as a technical leader during production incidents, and drive postmortems and follow-up work
  • Champion Infrastructure as Code, automation, and engineering best practices, leading by example

Shape the roadmap

  • Partner with the Head of Infrastructure to build, shape, and execute the infrastructure roadmap
  • Translate long-term goals into concrete, shippable milestones, and plan, estimate, and make tradeoffs with your team
  • Own and be accountable for KPIs covering the reliability, resiliency, and uptime of critical services
  • Collaborate with engineering, security, and product teams to identify infrastructure requirements, risks, and opportunities, including cloud cost optimization
  • Facilitate thorough documentation and knowledge sharing

Join Capital One in Canada as we build the products that enable our millions of international Card customers. This team will specifically be working on the development of customer management capabilities for international Card users, including transitioning from an account-centric to a customer-centric decision-making model.

As a Distinguished Engineer at Capital One, you will be a part of a community of technical experts working to define the future of banking in the cloud.

job.name: Senior Staff Software Developer, Developer Infrastructure
job.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Developer Infrastructure org is the engine behind Robinhood's entire engineering organization — a collection of tightly integrated teams whose collective mission is to make every engineer at Robinhood faster, more reliable, and exponentially more productive. The org spans four major teams: DevX (Developer Experience), TestX (Test Infrastructure), Backend Platform, and Mobile Platform. DevX owns Robinhood's monorepo and Bazel-based build infrastructure — the critical layer between a developer writing code and that code being ready to ship — along with the company's full CI/CD pipeline and remote build execution cluster. TestX owns the infrastructure behind Robinhood's entire test experience: the integration test environments, and personal development environments that serve as miniature simulations of the full Robinhood system, giving engineers a safe, isolated space to test their code end-to-end before it ever touches production. Backend Platform and Mobile Platform own the core language runtimes, libraries, IDEs, and developer toolchains across Python, Go, TypeScript, Swift, and Android. Together, these teams share a single north star: leveraging AI and agentic systems to fundamentally transform Robinhood's software development lifecycle — making every engineer dramatically more productive and the entire org a force multiplier for the business.

job.name: SBT Content Software Engineer II
job.description:
Summary Guidewire’s development team is looking for a smart, proactive, and results-oriented Software Engineer II to build elegant solutions for the property & casualty insurance industry’s complex business domain and make our industry-leading products even better. The team is looking for an enthusiastic engineer who is passionate about building high-quality software with a great team and improving the customer experience for millions of people who use our products every day.

The team you will be joining sits within Guidewire’s Product Development and Operations (PDO) organization, which builds and runs the cloud platform that powers the world’s most trusted P&C insurance software. The team focuses on SBT Content and insurance content transformation for U.S. Commercial insurers, which requires large-scale data volumes, heavy server load, and complex business logic. You will work in a highly collaborative and agile environment with a team of Software Engineers, and you will contribute to the design and implementation of high-performance software solutions that align with our product goals and technical best practices.

As part of PDO’s shift toward AI-driven development, you will use AI-native coding approaches and AI-assisted tools (such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot) to build, refactor, and extend our services quickly and safely while maintaining high engineering standards, tests, and observability. Your work will support PDO’s mission to embed GenAI across our products, improve operational excellence, and deliver secure, reliable, and scalable cloud services at scale.

Our teams are lean, empowered, and collaborative. You must be a self-starter and able to perform with minimal supervision while working alongside intelligent colleagues who’ve checked their egos at the door in a team environment, communicating effectively with everyone.

Job Description Successful software engineers at Guidewire typically have:

  • A desire to work collaboratively in an empowered, small, cross-functional team
  • Experience working in an agile and fast-paced development environment (e.g. TDD, BDD, Agile, pair programming, etc.)
  • A passion for code quality demonstrated by thorough testing
  • A desire to be hands-on in designing and writing code
  • A demonstrated ability to embrace AI and apply it to their role, alongside data-driven insights, to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement
  • Curiosity and internal motivation to constantly improve
  • Ability to learn quickly in a dynamic environment
  • Excellent communication skills, comfort level to speak their mind and defend ideas based on merit, yet humility and hunger to learn from others

At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI—empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.

job.name: Engineer II, Systems Reliability Engineering
job.description:
Introduction As an Engineer II, Systems Reliability Engineering, you will lead day-to-day production support and operations for enterprise job scheduling and workload automation platforms. You will serve as the senior technical authority for scheduling support in India, partnering with application, infrastructure, and business teams to ensure batch jobs run reliably and downstream processes are completed on time. Reporting to the Operations Lead, Foundations / Job Scheduling (LATAM), you will drive operational excellence, knowledge management, mentoring, and continuous improvement across the scheduling environment.

About The Job

  • Provide end-to-end production support for HCL Workload Automation, GSCI, Velocity, and related workload automation services, including incident triage, root cause analysis, and issue resolution.
  • Lead incident response, post-incident reviews, and problem management activities for failed, delayed, or stalled batch processes while coordinating with upstream and downstream application teams.
  • Drive knowledge management through the creation and maintenance of operational playbooks, support documentation, runbooks, and standard operating procedures.
  • Provide day-to-day technical leadership and mentoring to India-based scheduling engineers while supporting capability development and operational maturity.
  • Partner with application, infrastructure, and business teams to manage scheduling calendars, dependencies, change windows, reliability improvements, and ITSM process maturity.

About You

  • 4+ years of experience in IT production support, application operations, infrastructure operations, batch processing, or Site Reliability Engineering, including leadership or supervisory experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting enterprise workload automation and job scheduling platforms such as HCL Workload Automation, TWS, Control-M, or similar technologies.
  • Strong understanding of job dependency mapping, scheduling calendars, cross-application workload orchestration, and upstream and downstream impact analysis.
  • Knowledge of ITSM practices, incident and problem management, observability tools, and the ability to communicate technical issues and business impacts effectively.

LOCATION Bengaluru, India

FULL TIME/PART TIME Full time

Current LS&Co Employees, apply via your Workday account.

Apex Systems is looking for a hands-on DevOps Lead to take ownership of a growing Azure environment. This individual will strengthen DevOps processes, drive Infrastructure as Code, improve CI/CD, optimize cloud costs, and bring greater structure and scalability to the infrastructure function.

job.name: Staff Platform Site Reliability Engineer
job.description:
At Index Exchange, we’re reinventing how digital advertising works—at scale. As a global advertising supply-side platform, we empower the world’s leading media owners and marketers to thrive in a programmatic, privacy-first ecosystem.

We’re a proud industry pioneer with over 20 years of experience accelerating the ad technology evolution. Our proprietary tech is trusted by some of the world’s largest brands and media owners and plays a crucial role in keeping the internet open, accessible, and largely free.

We process more than 800 billion real-time auctions every day (in comparison, Google processes 14 billion searches per day) with ultra-low latency. Our platform is vertically integrated from servers to networks and runs primarily on our own metal and cloud infrastructure. This end-to-end infrastructure is designed to provide both stability and agility, enabling us to adapt quickly as the market evolves.

At the core of it all is our engineering-first culture. Our engineers tackle internet-scale problems across tight-knit, global teams. From moving petabytes of data and optimizing with AI to making real-time infrastructure decisions, Indexers have the agency and influence to shape the future of advertising. We move fast, build thoughtfully, and stay grounded in our core values.

The Role

Cloud Platform Engineering builds the platform that makes all of this possible. We architect and deliver the foundational infrastructure—Kubernetes clusters, deployment pipelines, infrastructure-as-code frameworks, container platforms, storage systems—and the software layer on top of it: standard libraries, internal SDKs, platform APIs, and the interfaces that every engineering team at Index Exchange builds on top of. Platform engineering here is software engineering. We don't operate day-to-day; our operational counterpart, Systems Engineering, carries that load. We stay focused on what moves the needle: designing and building systems at scale.

As a Staff Platform Engineer, you will own architectural decisions, deliver large-scale infrastructure projects, and shape the technical direction of a platform that processes more real-time transactions than almost any system on earth.

The vision: We build, scale, and maintain Index Cloud —a multi-tenant, globally distributed compute platform that serves both our exchange workloads and the workloads of every partner in our ecosystem. This is not incremental improvement. It's building a platform-as-a-product at internet scale.

What You'll Work On

job.name: Software Engineer, Strategic Projects
job.description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic! About Tailscale Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About The Role Join our Strategic Projects team, reporting to the team's Engineering Manager and ultimately into our co-founder and Chief Strategy Officer. This team exists to show developers and organizations why Tailscale should be their default connectivity substrate, both for internal infrastructure and for embedding into customer-facing products. Aperture, our identity-aware LLM gateway, is one such initiative.

This is an AI-native team. We use coding agents heavily as a force multiplier and expect every engineer to be a power user. Our customers demand a high bar on code quality, security, and operational rigour, and we treat that as a reason to use every tool available, including LLMs and coding agents, to ship fast without compromising it.

We move fast from idea to prototype, and we're growing the side of the team that's energized by the path from prototype to dependable product. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with product-minded engineers from the moment an idea takes shape, shaping how it's built so it holds up later, and co-owning the work of making it production-grade: stable, observable, maintainable, and ready for real customer load. You're the kind of engineer who finds the long tail of development genuinely satisfying, the edge cases, the failure modes, the tests and runbooks, the details that turn a sharp demo into something customers can rely on.

You'll work directly with reference customers on integrations and own the production bar on prototypes that graduate into Tailscale's product surface area, ensuring the security, review, and operational practices that wrap around agent-generated code actually hold in production.

Tailscale is fully remote, this team operates with significant ambiguity, and the shipping cadence is fast. Comfort working asynchronously and collaborating with highly technical customers is essential.

BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Shape the roadmap

job.name: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Backend (Compute Platform)
job.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Affirm's engineering team is building a large-scale, highly-available, and global infrastructure that is shared across multiple financial products. Ensuring that our infrastructure is accessible to all engineers is critical to the success of the business. We pride ourselves on our culture across engineering of engaging in thorough technical design review, operational excellence, and capable incident response and analysis.

The Compute Platform team owns the EKS foundation that Affirm's products run on, from cluster provisioning and lifecycle through the safety standards that keep thousands of workloads reliable at scale. Affirm operates 90+ EKS clusters across environments and regions, and this team is responsible for making that fleet standardized, automated, observable, and self-healing, while establishing and enforcing the workload configuration standards that protect availability. Our mission is to provide a secure, reliable, and scalable Kubernetes platform that lets infrastructure and application teams deploy and operate with confidence and minimal operational friction.

What You’ll Do As a member of the Compute Platform organization, you will collaborate with other teams - including Product, Infrastructure, Traffic, Cost & Capacity Engineering to:

  • Architect and evolve Affirm's EKS platform, driving strategy across cluster lifecycle, node management, and shared cluster components
  • Lead the technical direction for cluster provisioning, upgrades, and teardown through standardized IaC (Terraform, Spacelift) and self-service workflows
  • Own the reliability of core shared components across the fleet (Karpenter, CoreDNS, VPC CNI, Kube Proxy, Metrics Server, etc) and the CI/CD pipeline that ships them consistently
  • Define and enforce EKS workload safety standards covering resource configuration, workload isolation and blast radius, disruption tolerance (PDBs), Karpenter consolidation strategies, etc
  • Build the enforcement and automation path that moves each standard from research and white-glove onboarding through broad adoption to policy-enforced defaults for new workloads
  • Establish the observability, baseline audits, and reporting needed to identify hot spots and measure risk mitigation over time
  • Partner with cluster-user teams (checkout, batch, ML, analytics, DevProd, etc) to understand workload needs and shape the platform accordingly
  • Drive cost and capacity strategy across node scaling, bin packing, and EC2 instance selection
  • Mentor engineers across the Compute Platform teams and set the bar for operational excellence
  • Participate in the on-call rotation, triage and catalogue runtime K8s issues, and collaborate with SRE on production incidents

What We Look For

Read the full description

About Wind River Wind River is a global leader in delivering software for mission-critical intelligent systems. For more than four decades, the company has been an innovator and pioneer, powering billions of systems that require the highest levels of security, safety, and reliability.

Wind River helps customers across automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, and telecommunications industries solve complex technology challenges on their journey toward the new intelligent machine economy. The company’s software powers generation after generation of the safest, most secure systems in the world. Examples include playing a key role in NASA space missions such as Artemis I, the James Webb Space Telescope, and multiple Mars rovers. We’ve achieved recent 5G milestones including the world’s first successful 5G data session with Verizon and building one of the largest Open RAN networks in the world with Vodafone.

The company has received industry recognition for its technology innovation and leadership, and for its workplace culture, including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a “Top Workplace” for ten consecutive years. If you want to be part of a unique culture where the lived experience is based on our cultural attributes of growth mindset, customer-focus, and diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging, come join us and help advance the future software defined world.

About The Opportunity Within the Wind River Cloud team, we work with large-scale projects like Kubernetes, Docker, OpenStack and fast-paced Open-Source technologies that are in high demand from our customers. Wind River Cloud has adopted these technologies into the core of our product, which is driving us to find experienced and high-performing individuals that can learn and contribute to these container and virtualization solutions. In addition, Wind River Cloud team is a leading contributor to the Open Source StarlingX cloud native project, to manage and maintain the critical infrastructure for highly distributed Edge solutions, including 5G, Autonomous Vehicles, Industrial Automation and Augmented Reality. Wind River contributes and builds upon the work within StarlingX to ensure it meets the demands of these critical applications.

The right candidate will possess proven software engineering skills. You are expected to be versatile and able to thrive in a dynamic environment. You are comfortable managing competing priorities and can bring order to ambiguous scenarios. Maturity, impeccable judgment, and the ability to influence and lead are essential to success in this role.

job.description:
*Location:* Ottawa, ON (on-site)

*Employment type:* Full-time

*Salary range:* $100,000 – $140,000 CAD per year

*Vacancy disclosure:* This posting is for an existing vacancy.

*About Q-Block Computing:* Q-Block Computing builds quantum systems that operate in the real world. The company develops quantum timing, quantum-secure communications, and quantum computing platforms engineered for the performance, reliability, and environmental resilience that mission-critical applications demand — systems designed to be deployed, maintained, and trusted by operators who cannot afford ambiguity about whether the technology works.

The long-term vision is deeper than any single platform. Q-Block is pursuing a mission to decode Nature's foundational model — to build instruments of sufficient precision and coherence that they become tools for understanding the physical universe at its most fundamental level. Commercialization and science reinforce each other by design.

*About this role:* The Platform & Infrastructure Engineer will design, build, and maintain the distributed computing and networking backbone that ties Q-Block's control hardware into coherent, observable, manageable systems. The work spans embedded Linux platforms on ARM compute modules, tiered network architectures that carry real-time control traffic, and the web-based management layer that makes the whole thing operable at scale.

The successful candidate is an engineer who moves fluently across at least two of three worlds — embedded Linux, networking, and full-stack applications — and has the judgment to make each one serve the others. This is a role for someone who reaches for Yocto, a managed switch, and a frontend framework in the same week and does not treat any of them as someone else's problem. The role reports into the Technical Lead and offers real ownership of the platform that every other system depends on.

The Structured Record Storage group owns the shared data persistence layer for AEC: automated database fleet management, streaming to warehousing for analytics and ML, and the developer abstractions that decouple service logic from storage technology. We manage the entire database fleet (Postgres and DynamoDB, all production regions), own schema lifecycle from migration through regional deployment, and emit semantic events into Kafka so downstream teams never build raw reconstruction apps. SRS is a platform-grade function. We define the storage standards, enforce them, and build the tooling that makes compliance automatic instead of manual.

Position Overview Autodesk Construction Solutions is looking for a senior technical contributor who brings deep expertise in cloud data infrastructure and uses it to shape how the division manages structured storage. This role sets technical direction across the SRS platform, from database fleet operations to the API abstractions and event contracts that sit on top, and leads high-impact initiatives end-to-end. You'll operate with significant autonomy, influence architecture decisions across teams, and raise the technical bar for how engineering teams build on shared storage infrastructure.

job.description:
About The Team The Code Scalability team owns build systems and continuous integration across DoorDash. When a shared dependency changes or more teams contribute to a monorepo, the cost of building software can grow for everyone. We tackle that challenge with Bazel, Buildkite, and infrastructure that keeps everyday development efficient. Our work gives teams a dependable path from a code change to a completed build, with fewer delays and less infrastructure troubleshooting.

About The Role As a Senior Software Engineer on Code Scalability, you will solve the engineering problems behind building software at DoorDash’s scale. A change deep in a monorepo can trigger work across many projects; your job is to make that work efficient, predictable, and easy to investigate when something goes wrong. Projects span Bazel configuration and tooling, Buildkite orchestration, build execution and caching, and the services that support them. You will identify where improvements matter most, make the technical decisions, and work with teams across DoorDash to put those changes into practice.

The impact of this role extends to every team that depends on our platform. Shorter queues give engineers more time to iterate, dependable pipelines prevent interruptions, and useful diagnostics help them get back to their work. You will measure progress through those outcomes, alongside the cost and maintainability of the infrastructure you own.

You’re Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will…

  • Evolve build and CI workflows for large monorepos, keeping feedback fast and changes manageable as dependencies, code volume, and the number of contributing teams grow.
  • Develop Bazel rules, toolchains, and integrations that keep builds reproducible and make shared build infrastructure easier for teams to adopt across large monorepos.
  • Improve Buildkite pipeline throughput and reliability by reducing queue times, addressing build bottlenecks, and making better use of CI compute capacity.
  • Reduce redundant build work through dependency analysis, incremental builds, caching, and parallel execution, balancing developer feedback speed with infrastructure cost.
  • Build developer tools that explain build failures and help engineers reproduce CI behavior locally, making troubleshooting faster and reducing support overhead.
  • Rethink what a build and CI platform can do with AI: move beyond reporting failures toward intelligent diagnosis, PR triage, automated recovery, and guidance that helps developers move forward.
  • Instrument and operate build and CI infrastructure. Use metrics and developer feedback to track latency, reliability, and resource usage, then address recurring infrastructure problems.
  • Lead platform improvements from design through rollout, partner with engineering teams on migrations, and mentor teammates through technical decisions and code reviews.

We’re Excited About You Because…

Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Skan AI

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

ROLE SUMMARY

The DevOps Engineer designs, builds, and maintains the CI/CD pipelines, deployment tooling, and infrastructure automation that power Skan's customer delivery operations. Working within the Customer Ops team, this role is the engineering engine behind deployment velocity — ensuring that customer environments are provisioned, upgraded, and maintained reliably, securely, and at pace.

This role sits at the intersection of software engineering and infrastructure operations. The DevOps Engineer is responsible for making deployment a repeatable, automated, and quality-assured activity — eliminating manual overhead, enforcing DevSecOps standards, and giving the wider Customer Ops and Systems Engineering teams the tooling they need to operate efficiently at scale.

As Skan's enterprise customer base grows, so does the complexity of managing deployments across cloud-hosted, customer-hosted, and hybrid environments. job.name: Lead Systems Engineer, Secrets and Vault Engineering
job.description:
Job Purpose The Lead Systems Engineer joins our Secrets and Vault Engineering team within Identity and Access Management. The team is responsible for the platforms and services that protect secrets, certificates, encryption keys, and machine identity across the enterprise — a foundational layer that nearly every application at ICE depends on.

This is a hands-on engineering role with a strong design and architecture component. The ideal candidate has built or operated a HashiCorp Vault platform in production, writes clean automation code in Python and Ansible, and is comfortable working at the intersection of cryptography, identity, and platform engineering. You will help shape how the next generation of our secrets and machine-identity services are built, including emerging areas such as workload identity for AI and agentic workloads, policy-as-code, and proactive non-human identity governance.

We are looking for someone who can move fluidly between writing the code, designing the system, and explaining the trade-offs to stakeholders. You should be the kind of engineer who pushes back on a design when there's a better way, and who can mentor others through the why, not just the how.

What You'll Gain This role offers direct, hands-on exposure to areas that few enterprise engineering teams are working on in earnest today:

  • Post-quantum cryptography (PQC). You'll be part of the team thinking through how an enterprise cryptography platform evolves to meet PQC readiness, including algorithm migration strategies, key lifecycle implications, and the operational realities of running hybrid classical/post-quantum systems at scale.
  • Agentic and AI workload identity. As AI agents and machine-driven workflows become first-class citizens in the enterprise, the question of how they authenticate, what they're allowed to do, and how that's governed is largely unsolved. You'll help build that foundation from the ground up — workload identity, dynamic credentials, policy enforcement, and proactive anomaly detection for non-human identities.
  • A platform being designed, not just operated. The team is actively shaping its next-generation architecture rather than maintaining a legacy stack. You'll have meaningful influence on design decisions and the chance to shape patterns the rest of the organization will adopt.

Responsibilities

job.name: Software Engineer, Platform
job.description:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About The Role We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our Platform team. You will build the observability systems that give Vercel visibility into how we build, ship, and operate our systems. Core Platform owns Vercel’s reliability, resilience, and engineering velocity. We’re looking for engineers to create observability for everything from cost attribution to deployment velocity, alongside the logs, metrics, and traces necessary to optimize how Vercel builds its systems. This is a role with a wide breadth where we quickly develop critical systems and improve the entire Vercel code base. You will report to Eric Larson, Engineering Manager, Platform and will be located onsite, hybrid, or remote.

If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday, even if the role is listed as remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

What you'll do

  • Design and build high-scale, internal observability systems (metrics, logs, and traces) that give engineering and the business visibility into Vercel's own infrastructure.
  • Build cost attribution and chargeback tooling so spend can be accurately mapped to the parts of the business driving it, reducing reliance on third-party tools like Datadog.
  • Partner with Backend and Platform teams to instrument services for compliance, auditing, and record-keeping requirements.
  • Evaluate, integrate, and help operate observability infrastructure across our existing vendors and the CNCF ecosystem.
  • Ship pragmatic, high-leverage visibility quickly that drives improvement in how we build, deploy, and operate our systems.
  • Work closely with Backend and Platform engineers to scale observability infrastructure to the throughput and cardinality of Vercel's full production traffic.

What you need

  • Proficient in TypeScript, with backend/infrastructure experience.
  • Hands-on experience with Go, Rust, or Zig in production systems.
  • Experience with distributed computing systems at scale.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, including object storage.
  • Familiarity with observability tooling and concepts (Datadog, Grafana, New Relic, Splunk, or CNCF-based stacks such as Prometheus-compatible backends).

Bonus if you

  • Have contributed to or worked closely with CNCF observability projects.
  • Built, scaled, and improved internal developer platforms.

job.name: Senior Product Builder - Hub
job.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About The Role Camunda Hub is where enterprises run Camunda at scale. From Hub they manage their clusters and tenants, decide who can do what, and roll changes out across the whole organization. We’re looking for a Senior Product Builder to own the backend and architecture that let Hub manage a whole fleet of clusters. Your first focus will be the mechanism that sends access, secret, tenant and licence changes out to every connected cluster and brings deployments, health and audit records back. From there, you’ll shape Hub’s foundations: its event model, the service boundaries and data model other teams build on, and how Hub behaves when things fail or get upgraded. The platform is your product. Your users are platform administrators, Centres of Excellence and the builders across Camunda who depend on what you create. You’ll join a new two-person pod in our remote-first team. You’ll have real ownership as the person who makes the call, and you’ll build AI-first, from written specs through to production. Our customers run mission-critical processes on Camunda, so your work will matter to them every day.

What You Will Do

Culture at Scribd, Inc. We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.

We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location.

So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.

This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.

About The Team And Role

  • Core Infrastructure builds and operates the foundations of Scribd, Inc.: the paved roads of cloud infrastructure, networking, databases, and observability that let every product team move fast with confidence. Over the past two years, our charter has grown, and today we own the Content Library, the unified storage and governance platform for all content across Scribd®, Slideshare®, Everand™, and Fable.
  • The Content Library is one of the more interesting storage problems you'll find anywhere. Nearly twenty years of accumulated content, hundreds of billions of objects in S3, served to hundreds of millions of people every month. It provides transactional storage, dataset transforms with full lineage tracking, low-latency online reads, and the governance layer (access control, trust, deletion propagation) for our most valuable asset: the content that powers our products and our inference-driven features.
  • The core of the platform is written in Rust and built on the excellent Rust data ecosystem (Apache Arrow, Parquet, and DataFusion), with a Python "userland" that teams across the company contribute to directly. If you want a taste of the work, read about Content Crush on our tech blog: https://tech.scribd.com/blog/2026/content-crush.html

job.name: Platform Engineer
job.description:
About Fluidstack We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply! How We Operate

  • Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.
  • Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.
  • Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.
  • Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.
  • Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

job.description:
About Crosby Crosby is built on a simple conviction: a great legal system is the watermark of a great society — and the best legal work comes from combining human expertise with the right technology, not replacing one with the other.

Crosby is the first AI-native law firm, helping ambitious companies like Cursor, Ramp, and Cognition sign commercial contracts faster.

Legal work is both art and science, and we're mapping the frontier between the two — codifying what can be systematized, amplifying human judgment where it matters most. That's why the right way to bring AI into law isn't to sell software and walk away. It's to own the outcome together: higher-quality work, delivered faster. We build proprietary tools and human-in-the-loop workflows that change what's possible for corporate legal teams.

Crosby was founded by Ryan (Stanford Law, Cooley, startup GC) and John (Penn, first 15 engineers at Ramp). Help us transform one of society's most important industries.

About The Role As an Infrastructure Engineer at Crosby, you'll play a critical role in building and scaling the systems that power our platform. You’ll be responsible for designing and maintaining reliable, scalable infrastructure across compute, storage, and deployment systems.

You’ll work closely with backend, AI, and product engineers to ensure our systems are performant, observable, and easy to operate. This role is for someone who cares deeply about reliability and developer velocity — building infrastructure that enables teams to ship quickly and confidently.

What You'll Do

  • Build and scale infrastructure: Design and maintain cloud infrastructure across compute, storage, and networking.
  • Own deployment systems: Develop and improve CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows to enable fast, reliable releases.
  • Ensure reliability and performance: Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability systems to maintain high uptime and performance.
  • Support AI and data workloads: Optimize infrastructure for ML/AI systems, including batch processing, inference workloads, and data pipelines.
  • Improve developer velocity: Build tooling and systems that make it easier for engineers to build, test, and deploy software.
  • Collaborate across teams: Partner with engineering teams to ensure infrastructure supports product and system requirements.

job.description:
Our Mission Reflection is a research lab making intelligence open and accessible for everyone to use, customize, and build on. We build open models that let anyone control their intelligence and help shape the future of AI. Our mission: make intelligence open and accessible to all.

About The Role Reflection's Platform Foundations team builds and operates the foundational layer every engineering team depends on — cloud and multi-cloud infrastructure, networking primitives, security guardrails, and developer tooling. The team defines the opinionated golden paths that make the safe, scalable, cost-predictable path also the easiest one to follow, so engineers can ship quickly without reinventing the foundation each time.

As Platform Foundations Lead, you'll provide front-line leadership of the team that builds this layer. You'll build, mentor, and grow a team of infrastructure engineers, guide the technical and architectural decisions across cloud, networking, security, and developer infrastructure, and work closely with every engineering team that builds on top of you. You'll stay close enough to the stack to make targeted contributions as an individual contributor and to maintain a deep understanding of the team's technical work. Managing cloud and infrastructure vendors and the important deals that come with them is a core part of the job.

What You'll Do

  • Build, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of infrastructure and platform engineers. Coach and support your reports in understanding, and pursuing, their professional growth.
  • Provide front-line leadership of engineering efforts to build the foundational platform — multi-cloud design, networking, identity and security, and developer infrastructure — and the golden paths and secure defaults that make the safe path the easy path.
  • Stay hands-on: become familiar with the team's technical stack enough to make targeted contributions as an individual contributor.
  • Manage day-to-day execution: prioritize the team's work and manage projects in a highly dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Guide technical and architectural decisions, emphasizing scalability, robustness, security, and cost predictability — networking primitives (routing, DNS, load balancing, BGP), large-scale Kubernetes, IAM and policy-as-code, CI/CD and build systems, and observability.
  • Work closely with our research and engineering teams, and manage the cloud and infrastructure vendor relationships and deals the platform depends on.
  • Raise the bar for technical judgment, prioritization, communication, and execution in a fast-moving environment.

Responsibilities The Global Engineering team builds and operates the global content delivery and multimedia infrastructure behind ByteDance's products, supporting service quality, user experience, and cost efficiency. We run a hybrid platform that combines commercial CDN vendors with ByteDance's own edge network across a large number of points of presence worldwide, supporting edge services including traffic acceleration, CDN caching, and gaming.

We also build video transmission networks, multimedia processing platforms, and the data foundation and analysis capabilities behind them, improving product operations while reducing cost and increasing efficiency.

You will work where user experience, platform stability, and cost efficiency move together, on infrastructure that carries media for businesses worldwide.

ByteDance's Global CDN team is responsible for building and operating a global multi-cloud CDN platform, providing highly available, high-performance, and cost-efficient content delivery capabilities for large-scale products such as TikTok.

The platform combines ByteDance's self-built CDN infrastructure with commercial CDN providers across multiple regions worldwide, ensuring reliable and consistent content delivery for diverse business needs and global markets. The team owns the onboarding, integration, and ongoing management of CDN solutions and related resources, including commercial CDNs, self-built CDN infrastructure, and origin services. Its responsibilities span the entire CDN lifecycle, from solution design and architectural evolution to reliability engineering, performance optimization, and cost governance.

Operating in a large-scale, distributed, and complex global environment, we continuously evolve CDN solutions to support the content delivery needs of different business scenarios, while improving platform reliability, performance, cost efficiency, and operational efficiency. Engineers on this team participate in architecture design, software development, and production operations, gaining deep hands-on experience in large-scale distributed systems, global traffic management, and multi-cloud infrastructure.
