job.name: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
job.description:
Learning Commons aims to scale proven teaching and learning practices to benefit every learner by building AI infrastructure that better connects the way students learn to the tools they learn with.

The Team

At Learning Commons, we operate at the intersection of technology, research, and philanthropy. We pair product development with grantmaking to scale proven teaching and learning practices for the benefit of every learner. We aim to bring learning science into the tools educators and students use every day.

Our work is grounded in a deep belief: when technology reflects the realities of classrooms and the science of how students learn, it can meaningfully strengthen teaching and unlock new possibilities for students. The rise of generative AI offers us a once-in-a-generation opportunity to dramatically accelerate the translation of research insights into practical, classroom-ready tools; tools that honor teachers’ expertise, adapt to students’ needs, and make effective learning practices easier to access, implement, and sustain.

In today’s fragmented edtech landscape, school districts are often left piecing together products that don’t always align with curricula or instructional needs. While AI holds enormous potential to support teachers and students, it can only deliver on that promise when grounded in research, high-quality educational data, and expert evaluation. That’s why we’re building open, public-purpose infrastructure — datasets, rubrics, and resources — that help raise the standard for educational tools and create more consistent, impactful learning experiences for all students and teachers.

Learning Commons is building shared infrastructure for education that enables organizations to better connect, understand, evaluate, and improve learning experiences. Our products—including our Knowledge Graph, Evaluators, Agent Skills, and future AI-powered offerings—help partners unlock value from educational data, content, and learning experiences at scale.

We work closely with EdTech companies and other ecosystem partners to bring these capabilities into real-world products and workflows while continuously learning from deployments to improve our platform.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you will help partners build and launch new learning experiences with Learning Commons products while shaping the platform’s evolution.

You will collaborate with partner product managers, engineers, and decision makers to turn early ideas into production integrations of our Knowledge Graph, Evaluators, Agent Skills, and future products. Engagements will range from technical advising to collaborative development and embedded engineering.

This role combines hands-on engineering, product discovery, and developer education. You will navigate ambiguity, build solutions, and share what you learn through practical content and teaching—all at the intersection of AI, data, and learning science.

job.name: Director AI Governance
job.description:
We are seeking a senior professional who can establish, lead and drive enterprise-wide AI governance initiatives, ensuring responsible and secure adoption of Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, AI Agents and Large Language Models (LLMs).

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in AI governance frameworks, risk management, regulatory compliance, data privacy and responsible AI practices, with the ability to translate evolving regulatory requirements into practical organizational policies and controls.

Required Technical Skills & Expertise:

  • Strong experience in Enterprise AI Governance or Responsible AI Leadership.
  • Good working knowledge of ISO/IEC 42001:2023, NIST AI RMF 1.0 and EU AI Act .
  • Familiarity with ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27701, ISO/IEC 27017, ISO/IEC 27018, IEC 62304 and IEC 82304.
  • Familiarity with FDA AI/ML guidance and regulatory requirements for AI in healthcare.
  • Understanding of AI risk management, model governance, AI assurance and contractual AI controls.
  • Knowledge of data privacy, data provenance and responsible AI practices in healthcare.
  • Familiarity with AI inventory/model governance tools, GRC platforms, Vanta or equivalent solutions.
  • Experience in organizational change management, stakeholder engagement and AI governance training.

job.description:
Summary Position Summary Data Protection - Product Compliance - Senior Consultant Deloitte's Regulatory, Risk & Forensic practice helps clients turn evolving regulatory and risk requirements into practical action. Our Product Compliance practice supports technology, media, and telecommunications organizations in embedding compliance across the product lifecycle, from strategy and design through launch, monitoring, and incident response, including for artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled and agentic products. Join a team that combines data, AI, emerging technology, and industry insight to help clients navigate complexity and create value.

Work you'll do As a Security Engineer III on the Data and Digital Trust team, you will be responsible for:

  • Support product compliance program design and transformation, including operating models, product lifecycle processes, governance, compliance-by-design, automation, testing, and issue remediation.
  • Translate regulatory developments affecting software, digital platforms, and AI-enabled products into product requirements, risk taxonomies, control architectures, and policies.
  • Assess product processes, data flows, and controls, including identity, access, data use, and third-party dependencies, to support risk assessments and compliance-by-design practices.
  • Execute control testing, launch-readiness reviews, red-teaming, release regression testing, key risk and control indicator monitoring, incident exercises, and evidence management for requests for information (RFIs) and audits.
  • Support AI and agentic product compliance, data, identity, and access governance, age assurance, youth-by-design, and third-party risk; manage workstreams and contribute to client deliverables, proposals, and thought leadership.

The team Deloitte's Data and Digital Trust practice helps clients use data responsibly while safeguarding privacy, security, and digital trust. We advise, implement, and operate solutions across privacy governance and compliance, data protection and compliance, digital trust and online protection, risk and controls enablement, and technology implementation. Our teams help organizations respond to changing regulations, consumer expectations, and technology developments while advancing sustainable digital transformation.

job.name: Senior Specialist IT - AI Agent & Automation
job.description:
What You’ll Do Eaton is seeking a hands-on AI Agent & Automation Lead to join the AI Enablement, Literacy & Adoption team within AI & Data Governance, part of Eaton's AI & Data Management organization, based in Pune, India. This is primarily an new engineering role, with front-line enablement and training coordination as a secondary focus. The Lead will design, build and run the agents, workflow automations and standard services that let Eaton's AI adoption program scale.

The role has a dual focus. First, it owns day-to-day AI adoption service delivery: license provisioning, reclaim, transfers, waitlist and consumption credit management for enterprise AI assistants, one intake for leadership and business requests, adoption and consumption reporting, and in-region (IST) office hours and training operations. Second, it owns and delivers the enablement teams automation roadmap, so manual effort goes down measurably every quarter. The Lead will also be the first owner of the enterprise skills and agents library, collecting, reviewing, tagging and publishing reusable skills, prompts and agents into Eaton's AI governance technologies every sprint, and will coach employees, AI Ambassadors and AI focal points on agent development.

Essential Responsibilities Include Run - AI adoption service delivery

  • Own day-to-day AI adoption operations for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Cowork and other enterprise AI assistants, including license provisioning, reclaim, transfers, waitlist and consumption credit-tier management, so routine licensing and service operations no longer depend on leadership, the specialists or front-line training coordination.
  • Run the ServiceNow request service end to end (catalog, approval routing to managers, AI focal points and Finance, fulfillment, notifications and status) and make it the single front door, so requests stop arriving by email, chat and direct message.
  • Build and run one intake, triage and prioritization process for leadership and business requests, with clear service levels, escalation paths and reporting. Point requesters to existing skills, agents and assets before anything new is built.

Copilot effectiveness - agents and automation

  • Design, build, test, deploy and support agents and workflow automations that answer and fulfill requests arriving through Teams, email and ServiceNow, using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility and Azure AI Foundry.
  • Build and tune support agents grounded in help articles, policies and training content, so most routine questions about AI tools are answered without a person and the rest hand off cleanly to second-line support.
  • Build agents and automations for the team's own operations, such as status reporting generated from Jira, meeting preparation and recaps, and release-note drafts from vendor product roadmaps.

job.name: Senior Emulation Engineer
job.description:
About Axiado Corporation Axiado is redefining how AI infrastructure gets secured and managed. Founded in 2019, we’re a fast-growing, well-funded team of over 180 people worldwide, building the Trusted Control/Compute Unit (TCU), a new class of semiconductor that integrates hardware security, real-time platform management, and AI-driven optimization. Our TCU-based Platform Efficiency Controller is shipping hardware that makes AI servers measurably more efficient, more secure, and more reliable, and we’re extending that foundation into a hardware-anchored management fabric that scales from a single board to the whole fleet.

Backed by strong funding and validated by commercial programs with Tier 1 industry leaders, Axiado has earned recognition through numerous industry awards, including the 2026 AI in Cybersecurity Innovation Award from TMCnet, a Diamond award for Zero Trust Solution of the Year at the 2026 Pinnacle Awards, and Gold at the 2026 Cybersecurity Excellence Awards for AI Security Solution, as well as being a finalist for the Start-Up to Watch Award from the Global Semiconductor Alliance. We’re small enough that every person’s work visibly shapes the company, and we look for people who want to build, not just execute. Every employee holds equity, meaning your work directly builds your stake in the company’s future, not just a paycheck. If you want to help define what comes next, let’s talk.

Job Description The Senior Emulation Engineer position is your opportunity to join one of the industry’s leading companies in platform security management and ransomware detection for cloud datacenters, 5G infrastructure and disaggregated compute ecosystems. We are looking for an emulation engineer to run and debug system-level workloads on Synopsys ZeBu emulation platforms and to own the integration and bring-up of transactors (XTORs) that connect the emulated SoC to real and virtual interfaces. Your focus is what happens once the design is running: getting the interfaces alive, executing firmware, OS, and use-case validation, triaging failures, and finding issues before silicon. This role is critical for validating the interoperability of our design with commercial AI servers, and for bridging the gap between hardware and software, as well as supporting SW development.

Key Responsibilities *Runtime validation*

job.name: Principal Software Engineer, Debug Tools
job.description:
Description Invent the future with us. Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute.

As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications.

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we’d love to have you apply!

About The Role As a core member of the Ampere Debug Tools team, you will be responsible for the architecture, design, and development of Debug Tools solutions for the next generation of Ampere products. This role is distinguished by deep technical ownership, architecture leadership, and cross-team influence.

The Debug Tools Team is part of the Ampere Software Team. Our mission is to develop a comprehensive debug strategy and roadmap for internal debug capabilities, as well as to develop and deploy debug solutions for all internal and external Ampere SoC users.

  • Internal users include Debug Tools software users from the Virtual Platform, Emulation, Platform, Design Validation (DV), Post-Silicon Validation, Design For Test (DFT), Firmware, Operating System, Software, Performance, and Application Engineering teams.
  • External users include partners, ODMs, OEMs, datacenter, edge and embedded customers.
  • Debug solutions include Arm Development Studio, TRACE32 PowerView, and OpenOCD debuggers, Arm Self-Hosted Trace for Linux, and utilities for invasive debug, bus trace, instruction trace, array dump, and scan dump. This role will be for the lead of the Arm Development Studio implementation.

What You’ll Achieve

  • Architect, design, develop, and deploy software-based Debug Tools for custom 64-bit Armv9 SoC and other processors.
  • Invent new debug tools and techniques for future products and technologies.
  • Influence the architecture and design team decisions with knowledge of internal and external debug tools on Ampere SoCs.
  • Contribute to software architecture and design documents, application notes, and other software product documentation.
  • Develop tooling for advanced debugging techniques, such as instruction trace, bus trace, array dump, scan dump, and ATE bootstrapping.
  • Develop open source JTAG and self-hosted trace and debugger software for internal and external use in debugging Ampere microprocessors.
  • Develop Arm Development Studio, TRACE32, and OpenOCD utilities for internal and external use in debugging Ampere microprocessors.
  • Perform pre-silicon bring-up of debug software on software simulators and hardware emulation platforms.
  • Collaborate with hardware design, architecture, post-silicon validation, and platform AE teams, as necessary, to resolve critical customer issues.

About You

job.name: New Grad - Engineering
job.description:
Join the Sleep Fitness Movement At Eight Sleep, we’re on a mission to fuel human potential through optimal sleep. As the world’s first sleep fitness company, we’re redefining what it means to be well-rested and building the most advanced hardware, software, and AI technology to make it possible. Our products power peak mental, physical, and emotional performance by transforming every night of sleep into a personalized, data-driven recovery experience. We are trusted by high performers, professional athletes, and health-conscious consumers in over 30 countries worldwide. Recognized as one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies in 2019, 2022, and 2023, and twice named to TIME's “Best Inventions of the Year.” We operate like a high-performance team: fast, focused, and motivated by impact. We don’t just ship; we iterate, refine, and obsess over the details that help our members sleep better and wake up stronger.

Every role at Eight Sleep is a chance to create cutting-edge technology, collaborate with world-class talent, and help shape a future where sleep isn’t passive - it’s a powerful tool for living better. If you’re tired of the ordinary and driven to build at the edge of what’s possible, this is your moment. Join us and lead the movement that’s transforming how the world sleeps and what we’re all capable of when we wake up.

High Standards. No Apologies. We operate with intensity because our mission demands it. At Eight Sleep, we bring the same mindset as the world’s top performers: focused, relentless, and always pushing to be in the top 1% of our craft. Think Kobe Bryant’s mamba mentality, applied to bold ideas, next-gen tech, and flawless execution. This isn’t a 9-to-5. Our team is deeply committed, often putting in 60+ hours a week –not because we’re told to, but because we’re invested. We’re here to build fast, push limits, and deliver without compromise. If you thrive under pressure and want to do the most meaningful work of your career, you’ll feel right at home. If you’re looking for something easier –this isn’t it.

The Opportunity

This is a general application for new graduates with an engineering background who want to start their career at Eight Sleep. We don't always have the perfect role posted at the perfect moment - but we're always looking for exceptional people. If you believe you belong on this team, don't wait for the right opening to appear: tell us who you are, what you've built, and where you can make an impact.

We hire new grad engineers across our hardware and software stack: software engineering (mobile, backend, web), firmware and embedded systems, hardware, and data and machine learning. In your application, tell us which area excites you most, or make the case for something we haven’t thought of.

job.name: Software Engineer II, Full Stack (Card Pre-Swipe Experience)
job.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

We build the experiences that connect a customer's intent to buy with the flexibility of Affirm Card. From making financing options easier to understand to creating intuitive checkout journeys, we turn complex financial capabilities into simple, trustworthy experiences. Our roadmap includes evolving Default Terms, supporting additional cards, and strengthening the mobile experiences customers rely on when deciding how to pay.

Our work sits at the intersection of mobile, backend systems, and product innovation. We partner closely with Product, Design, and engineering teams across Affirm to introduce new capabilities while protecting the reliability of our checkout-critical surfaces.

As a full-stack Software Engineer II, you'll help bring these experiences to life through customer-facing features and the services behind them. We're looking for a curious, collaborative engineer who cares about the complete customer journey and enjoys turning challenging problems into thoughtful solutions. Together, we'll make Affirm Card easier to use and help customers make financial decisions with greater confidence.

What You'll Do

  • With the support of your team's tech lead and manager, you will break down larger projects into individual tasks, deliver them in multiple phases, and collaborate with others to ensure timely delivery of your work.
  • You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.
  • You will support the operations and availability of your team's artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting "keep the lights on" & on-call efforts.
  • You will contribute to a sense of community on your team by engaging in growth and development activities such as participation in the interview process.

What We Look For

job.name: Software Engineer II, Fullstack (Ads Platform)
job.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Our Marketplace is continually evolving to deliver a deeply personalized shopping experience that seamlessly links consumers with merchant partners. By leveraging machine learning alongside rich consumer and merchant data, we aim to simplify and streamline the customer journey around everyday and major purchases with tailored brands, products, deals, and offers. In tandem, we are advancing our Ads Platform which is a key technology that empowers merchant partners to strategically deploy their budgets and reach targeted consumers for maximum incremental impact.

What You'll Do

  • With the support of your team’s tech lead and manager, you will break down larger projects into individual tasks, deliver them in multiple phases, and collaborate with others to ensure timely delivery of your work.
  • You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.
  • You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
  • You will contribute to a sense of community on your team by engaging in growth and development activities such as participation in the interview process.

What We Look For

  • You have a total of 1.5+ years of experience as a software engineer.
  • You have experience shipping web apps using declarative UI frameworks like React.
  • You have experience designing, developing and launching APIs at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.
  • You have mastered taking a simple problem or business scenario into a solution that interacts with multiple software components, and executing on it by writing clear, easily understood, well tested and extensible code.
  • You are comfortable navigating a large code base, debugging others' code, and providing feedback to other engineers through code reviews.
  • Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Base Pay Grade - L

Equity Grade - 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Power Platform & AI Solutions Specialist Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG) is one of the world’s largest travel retailers and corporate travel managers. The company, which is headquartered in Brisbane, Australia has company-owned leisure and corporate travel business in 23 countries, spanning Australia, New Zealand, the Americas, Europe, the United Kingdom, South Africa, the United Arab Emirates and Asia. This role offers the opportunity to lead the design, orchestration, validation, and optimization of AI-generated applications and automations while ensuring quality, security, governance, and business alignment. job.name: Senior Software Developer, Compliance and Multi-Region
job.description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 15,000 customers , including McDonalds, Michaels, Cintas, Redimix, and U.S. LBM, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 16 million managed assets and 92 million completed work orders. In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions , the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours. We are seeking a Senior Software Developer to drive the technical delivery of MaintainX’s compliance and multi-region deployments, including both single-tenant and multi-tenant environments , starting with our FedRAMP-focused AWS GovCloud environment. This role is highly hands-on and combines application development, infrastructure work, and cross-team collaboration to ensure our regulated and regional deployments stay aligned with our commercial SaaS architecture while meeting strict compliance, security, and operational requirements.

This role is well suited for a senior developer who enjoys tackling complex, ambiguous technical problems and translating them into clear, practical solutions that teams can adopt without needing deep domain context.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and implement shift-left practices and tooling that support reliable release cycles in high-compliance and multi-region environments.
  • Own and evolve core technical components that support compliance and regional deployments, including provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management.
  • Design, develop, and review application features across the stack, with proficiency in TypeScript and React Native, ensuring they deploy cleanly and consistently across regions.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and Atmos to manage AWS GovCloud and other regional environments.
  • Ensure architectural consistency between regulated, regional, and commercial environments, helping minimize drift while respecting compliance and locality constraints.
  • Lead technical execution for complex initiatives, collaborating with engineering, security, compliance, and product stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize services across infrastructure and application layers in distributed, multi-region systems.
  • Contribute to documentation and technical standards that support operational clarity, repeatability, and audit readiness.

About You

job.name: Senior Full Stack Engineer, App Runtime
job.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

About The Role The App Runtime team is building a platform that lets every Snowflake user go from an idea to a live, deployed web application (Node.js first) in minutes. We own the end-to-end experience of building and running apps, from Cortex AI-assisted development to deployment in a secure, scalable infrastructure. Apps built on the platform inherit Snowflake's security, governance, lineage, and access controls by default. See Deploy Faster with Snowflake Apps.

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you will drive initiatives that span our product areas and tech stack. It’s a high-impact role - you will work on an early-stage, public-preview product. Your work will directly shape the product experience developers rely on. This role requires a unique combination of deep hands-on expertise with web frameworks, great UX design instincts, customer obsession and collaboration with backend teams.

Responsibilities

  • Build the AI-assisted, agentic development experiences that power App Runtime, spanning the full tech stack - React, Go, Python, and Java
  • Stay deeply hands-on by authoring technical and design specs that consider the system holistically (frontend and backend) and implementing critical code
  • Partner directly with customers, i.e. developers building Snowflake Apps, translating their needs into features and improvements
  • Raise the bar for quality, reliability and performance through code review; mentor engineers
  • Coordinate closely with sister teams such as Cortex AI, Container Platform or Security

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. Master’s or higher is preferred but not a requirement
  • 5+ years of experience including significant experience in frontend or full-stack software development, with a demonstrated track record of designing, shipping and operating high-scale systems
  • Deep understanding of modern web application architecture (e.g. React, NextJS), good API design patterns, security, performance and scale; proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, ideally also in Go, Python and/or Java

Nous sommes aussi déterminés à faire progresser la réconciliation avec les peuples autochtones et à soutenir l’inclusion véritable de la voix et des priorités des Premières Nations, des Inuits et des Métis. Bien que ce poste hybride exige une certaine présence au bureau, une entente de télétravail peut être envisagée pour les candidats des Premières Nations dans les réserves ou les candidats autochtones qui résident à plus de 125 km d’un bureau de la SCHL.

Apprenez-en plus sur notre engagement envers la diversité et l’inclusion.

job.name: Frontier Deployed Engineer Intern (AI Agents & Automation)
job.description:
About the role

We are looking for a Frontier Deployed Engineer Intern to join our Automation CoE and work hand in hand with our Frontier Deployed Engineers (FDEs). This is an internal, team-facing role: the FDEs own the relationship with the business, and you help them design, build, test and run the AI agents and automations they deliver.

You will work with frontier AI tools (Claude, Microsoft Copilot Studio, agentic frameworks), Python, APIs and MCP servers, and the Microsoft Power Platform. You will take on well-scoped build tasks, speed up prototyping, keep deployed solutions healthy, and help turn one-off builds into reusable components the whole team can use.

Key responsibilities

Build alongside the FDEs

  • Take on scoped build tasks from FDE engagements: agent components, flows, scripts and integrations.
  • Rapidly prototype AI agents and automations using Claude, Copilot Studio, Power Automate Cloud Flows and Power Automate Desktop.
  • Write Python scripts and lightweight services that connect systems through APIs, MCP servers and Microsoft 365 / Graph.
  • Draft and refine prompts, tool definitions and guardrails for agents.

Test, evaluate and harden

  • Build test cases and evaluation sets to check agent output quality, accuracy and edge cases.
  • Validate solutions against the requirements the FDEs gathered, and flag gaps before release.
  • Help move prototypes to production following CoE standards for security, governance and version control (Git).

Run and support deployed solutions

  • Monitor deployed agents and bots, triage failures, and fix issues or escalate to the right FDE.
  • Pull usage and performance data (run counts, error rates, time saved) so FDEs can report impact.

Strengthen the FDE toolkit

  • Turn repeated builds into reusable templates, connectors, MCP servers and code snippets.
  • Write and maintain technical documentation, SOPs and runbooks for the team.
  • Research new AI tools and techniques and share short findings or demos with the team.

Qualifications

Required

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Information Technology or a related technical field.
  • Hands-on coding ability in Python (preferred) or JavaScript/TypeScript, C# or Java, shown through projects, coursework or prior internships.
  • Has built something with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, OpenAI/Anthropic APIs), even a side project or hackathon entry.
  • Comfortable working with APIs and data formats such as JSON.
  • Clear communicator and strong technical writer who can keep teammates updated on progress and blockers.
  • Team player who takes direction well, asks good questions and follows through on assigned tasks.
  • Self-directed and quick to learn; can pick up a scoped task and deliver it with limited hand-holding.

Preferred

job.name: Software Developer - Games
job.description:
Job Description On behalf of our client, Affinity is looking for a Senior Software Developer – Games who will lead the development of high-performance gaming applications with a strong focus on low-level systems programming in C++. This role requires extensive experience in the game development industry, ideally with large-scale titles from studios such as Take-Two or EA. The developer will be responsible for designing and optimizing rendering pipelines using modern graphics APIs, including Vulkan, OpenGL, DirectX, or Metal, to deliver cutting-edge visuals and seamless gameplay experiences. In addition to technical expertise, this role involves collaborating closely with designers, artists, and other engineers to create scalable, efficient, and visually compelling game systems.

Responsibilities

  • Designing and implementing game features and systems, with a focus on high-quality graphics and performance optimization.
  • Developing and maintaining system architecture, ensuring seamless integration of graphics technologies.
  • Mentoring and guiding the team.
  • Documenting the software architecture according to our standards.
  • Analyzing, documenting and developing specific modules of the platform.
  • Working closely with the product owner and development team for project planning and delivery.
  • Suggest new tools to improve our architecture.
  • Support the team during project delivery and operations.
  • Assisting with on-call rotation when needed

Qualifications

  • In-depth experience in game development
  • Expertise in graphics APIs like OpenGL, DirectX, Vulkan, or Metal for developing cutting[1]edge rendering pipelines
  • Experience with real-time rendering
  • Experience working with Linux kernel
  • Experience with GPU drivers (Nvidia, AMD)
  • 8+ years of development experience with Javascript/Typescript
  • Experience with C++
  • Strong understanding of the principles of scalable application design;
  • Experience working with React + hooks, nodejs and redux frameworks and libs
  • Proficient in Front-End web development (React, CSS, HTML);
  • Experience using MySQL and understanding database architecture;
  • Strong database administration skills (MongoDB, MySQL);
  • At least 2 years of experience with container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)

About You

  • You are curious and ready to challenge established ideas;
  • You have the ability to work in areas outside of your usual comfort zone and get things done quickly;
  • You have the ability to collaborate, communicate, learn and ship code, while working in a fast-paced and multi-cultural environment;
  • You have at least 8 years of problem solving & software engineering experience;
  • Comfortable working in startup environment

job.name: Data & Analytics Specialist (Markets & Banking)
job.description:
Take a central role The Bank of Canada has a vision to be a leading central bank—dynamic, engaged and trusted—committed to a better Canada. No other employer in the country offers you the unique opportunity to work at the very center of Canada’s economy, in an organization with significant impact on the economic and financial well-being of all Canadians. You will be challenged, energized and motivated to excel in our environment.

Building on the principles that have always guided us – excellence, integrity and respect – we strive to be forward-looking and innovative, to welcome people with diverse perspectives and talents, and to earn trust by living up to our commitments and by clearly explaining the intent of our policies and actions.

With our defined-benefit pension plan, benefits, and high flexibility for work life balance - find out more about why we are annually ranked as one of Canada's top employers: Working Here - Bank of Canada

Find out more about the next steps in our Recruitment process .

What You Will Do We are seeking a data specialist to design, develop and maintain analytical solutions within the Markets and Banking Department (MBD), as part of the Financial Markets Data Analytics (FMDA) division.

FMDA brings together expertise in financial data modelling, advanced analytics, data science and quantitative methods to strengthen how the department leverages data-driven intelligence in support of policy analysis, research and operations. In this role, you will work as part of the technical team to design, build, and implement data solutions that enable more insightful and efficient decision making.

FMDA works with a wide range of data assets, including data from commercial providers, regulatory agencies, and internally generated operations data. The team designs and automates data pipelines, curates and transforms data, and develops statistical and machine learning models. In addition, FMDA provides reusable tools, templates and best practices that enable other teams to efficiently monitor, analyze and report on their data. The division also offers specialized financial modelling expertise in support of the Bank’s fiscal agent responsibilities and domestic market operations. Solutions are user-focused and developed using agile principles in close collaboration with financial market specialists as well as digital and technology partners.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer, Fullstack (App Experience)
job.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Marketplace and App Experience domain is the main pillar of our core consumer strategy, driving the user journey across all of our frontend surfaces: Mobile and Web. The teams span across multiple products and areas to engage and provide value to our customers, starting with the Home hub in the app or website, which expands into the various product offers and journeys a user can embark on with Affirm. This role will be at the forefront of our front-end facing cross-team projects, working closely with other teams and engineers across our mobile and web technologies, while also evolving and collaborating with every product experience team at Affirm.

What You'll Do

  • With the support of your team’s tech lead and manager, you will break down larger projects into individual tasks, deliver them in multiple phases, and collaborate with others to ensure timely delivery of your work.
  • You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.
  • You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
  • You will contribute to a sense of community on your team by engaging in growth and development activities such as participation in the interview process.

What We Look For

  • You have a total of 4+ years of experience as a software engineer.
  • You have experience shipping web apps using declarative UI frameworks like React or Vue
  • You have experience shipping mobile apps using native or cross-platform languages like React Native
  • You have experience designing, developing and launching APIs at scale using languages like Kotlin or Python.
  • You have mastered taking a simple problem or business scenario into a solution that interacts with multiple software components, and executing on it by writing clear, easily understood, well tested and extensible code.
  • You are comfortable navigating a large code base, debugging others' code, and providing feedback to other engineers through code reviews.
  • Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Base Pay Grade - N

Equity Grade - 6

Read the full description

job.name: Senior Mobile Developer
job.description:
Senior Mobile Developer [$50 - $100/hour] Scope of Work

  • Create realistic, interesting, and extremely challenging mobile coding tasks for frontier AI models using your preferred repositories
  • Design problems that require strong mobile engineering skills, such as tracking down subtle bugs, building non-trivial features, handling application state and lifecycle, or improving performance
  • Develop tasks relevant to your expertise: cross-platform applications using TypeScript, JavaScript, or Dart; iOS applications using Swift; or Android applications using Kotlin
  • For each task, define the problem, build a reproducible environment, and write deterministic verifiers that accept correct solutions across different valid implementations while rejecting incorrect, incomplete, or hard-coded approaches
  • Provide a reference solution showing how the task can be solved

Preferred Qualifications

  • Significant hands-on expertise in at least one of the following mobile development tracks:
  • Cross-platform: TypeScript or JavaScript with React Native, or Dart with Flutter
  • iOS: Swift with SwiftUI or UIKit
  • Android: Kotlin with Jetpack Compose or the Android View system
  • Deep understanding of mobile application architecture, state management, asynchronous programming, and application lifecycle
  • Proven ability to debug complex mobile applications, resolve bugs, and deliver effective performance improvements

Compensation Structure Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert s experience and workflow. Minimum weekly submission requirements apply and will be communicated during onboarding.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer
job.description:
Clarity is redefining how private companies and their shareholders access liquidity. Through its institutional-grade platform, Clarity brings together buyers, sellers, and issuers to facilitate secondary transactions in venture-backed, pre-IPO companies, introducing efficiency, transparency, and standardization to an otherwise opaque asset class.

Recognized as one of Canada's fastest-growing companies and backed by leading U.S. investors, Clarity is profitable, well-capitalized, and building a high-performance team to meet growing demand and pursue new market opportunities.

Interested in learning more about life at Clarity? Check out our careers page to see how you can grow with us!

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer , you will be a hands-on contributor to the frontend and backend apps powering our platform. You will learn Elixir on the job from your colleagues and technical leaders. You will collaborate with technical leaders and the founding team to deliver new features to our application. You will work closely with your colleagues to refactor and improve the codebase; create a beautiful, functional, and delightful user experience; and build an excellent and supportive engineering culture.

Please note: Clarity does not use Ruby or Ruby on Rails. We do not have Ruby code in production now nor plan to do so in the future. This job is open to Ruby developers who have a desire to learn and work in Elixir and Phoenix. We will teach you both on the job and expect you to invest in self-learning to grow your skills. In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Include

  • Hands-on develop features across both frontend and backend, shipping React/TypeScript code from day one.
  • Build customer-facing products across the entire stack, from the data model to the UI.
  • Learn and work in Elixir, applying your experience picking up new programming languages.
  • Work proactively and self-sufficiently, learning on the job in a fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborate closely with a small team, including directly with the founders, to build both the product and the company.
  • Adapt quickly to a fast-moving environment and shifting priorities.

Required Experience

  • Substantial expertise building interfaces with React and working in Typescript.
  • Strong experience building backend API services using Ruby and Ruby on Rails.
  • Have a philosophy in writing automated backend tests.
  • Translating design mockups (e.g. Figma) into frontend implementation.
  • Working closely with product designers on feedback for UI/UX changes.

Preferred Experience

  • Understanding of the ins and outs of data modeling and software architecture for developing performant and maintainable code.
  • Experience building or working with GraphQL APIs.
  • Working closely with product managers on understanding use cases, prioritizing features, and scoping work.
  • Exposure to Elixir or other functional languages.

Compensation, Benefits & Perks

job.name: Flight Centre Travel Group - Power Platform & AI Solutions Specialist - Toronto, ON
job.description:
Power Platform & AI Solutions Specialist Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG) is one of the world’s largest travel retailers and corporate travel managers. The company, which is headquartered in Brisbane, Australia has company-owned leisure and corporate travel business in 23 countries, spanning Australia, New Zealand, the Americas, Europe, the United Kingdom, South Africa, the United Arab Emirates and Asia. FCTG also operates a global corporate travel management network, which extends to more than 90 countries through company-owned businesses and independent licensees. The company opened its first leisure travel shop in Sydney, Australia in 1982 and listed on the Australian Securities Exchange in 1995. Our purpose is to “open up the world for those who want to see”. Every day, we give people all around the world the opportunity to experience something really amazing – travel!

To learn more about Flight Centre Travel Group please click HERE

About The Opportunity Join our Digital Workplace team and help drive digital transformation across Flight Centre Travel Group through innovative automation, business applications, and AI-enabled solutions. In this impactful role, you'll partner with Business Analysts and stakeholders to transform business challenges into scalable solutions using Microsoft Power Platform technologies and emerging AI-assisted development capabilities.

This role offers the opportunity to lead the design, orchestration, validation, and optimization of AI-generated applications and automations while ensuring quality, security, governance, and business alignment. If you are passionate about low-code development, AI innovation, integrations, and delivering business value faster, this is an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

job.name: Software Engineer 3
job.description:
MongoDB’s Application Modernization Platform (AMP) helps organizations modernize legacy applications and move their workloads and associated data from relational databases to MongoDB. Our customers need a dependable way to bring analysis, transformation, testing, and migration capabilities into their modernization workflows.

The Agentic Integrations team builds the interfaces that let AMP capabilities be discovered, invoked, and orchestrated from AI agents and development environments. We expose product services through consistent, well-specified tool and API surfaces, keep authentication and execution context correct across every boundary, and make each integration observable and safe to operate. Our work is what makes AMP usable from the assistants and coding agents our customers already run.

We are looking for a Software Engineer 3 to build and operate these integrations. You will design tool and API surfaces for AMP services, implement them end to end, and work with product and platform engineers so that they behave predictably when a model calls them. Your impact will be measured by how reliably agents and developers can invoke AMP capabilities, and by how much integration work your components remove for other teams.

This role will be based remotely in the United States.

What you will do

  • Design and implement agent and developer facing integrations for AMP services, including tool definitions, API clients, and the adapters between them
  • Define clear input and output contracts for each integration, including validation, error semantics, and behavior when a call is malformed or only partially succeeds
  • Propagate authentication, authorization, and tenant context across integration boundaries so that agent-invoked calls carry no more privilege than the user they act for
  • Build the instrumentation needed to observe agent-driven traffic, including structured logs, traces, latency and failure metrics, and actionable diagnostics
  • Write production-quality code and the unit, integration, and end-to-end tests that demonstrate correctness, including tests for nondeterministic model behavior
  • Diagnose failures that span service, tool, and model boundaries, and drive them to root cause
  • Contribute integrations to shared SDKs, command-line tools, and agent frameworks used by other teams
  • Collaborate with product managers, platform engineers, and partner teams on scoped initiatives, and break work into incremental deliverables
  • Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and technical discussions that raise the quality of the team’s work
  • Interview candidates and mentor engineers and interns

job.description:

You will guide the modernization of a business-critical operations platform, replacing database-centered logic with independent Go services. Responsibilities What You Will Do In all of your duties, you will have a relentless, obsessive, yet disciplined approach to manage all details to perfection and deliver desired results.

  • Investigate legacy behavior module by module, compare old and new results, and guide cutovers only after the replacement has demonstrated behavioral parity.
  • Design resilient, long-running processes that support retries, compensation, and rollback when work fails or changes course.
  • Build production Go services, including APIs, data models, tests, and deployment components.
  • Establish shared standards for service contracts, testing, observability, and security; lead architecture and code reviews and document significant decisions.
  • Evaluate architectural tradeoffs across performance, reliability, security, and cost, and assess emerging technologies against business and engineering needs.
  • Mentor senior engineers and technical leads in system design and engineering judgment, including colleagues moving from the existing .NET system.
  • Partner with product, infrastructure, security, and business stakeholders to develop practical technical solutions.
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues in both legacy and new systems, identify root causes, and implement lasting improvements.

This role offers the opportunity to deepen your expertise in large-scale platform migration while broadening your influence on architecture, engineering standards, and the technical judgment of other engineers.

job.name: Technical Product Owner/Scrum Master
job.description:
About the role

This is not a meetings-only Scrum Master role. We want someone who owns the quality of what goes into a sprint, not just the sprint's cadence.

Leap Metrics is hiring a Technical Product Owner / Scrum Master in Hyderabad to drive delivery of Sevida, our healthcare analytics and care management platform. You will run Scrum for a full-stack engineering team and turn business and clinical requirements into JIRA epics and stories that engineers can build from.

If a vague ticket bothers you, if you instinctively add detail, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and data fields before a story reaches sprint planning, and if you can hold your own in a technical discussion with developers, we would like to talk to you.

Do you:

  • enjoy working closely with engineers on how things get built, not just when?
  • want to be part of a fast-moving, growing healthcare technology team?
  • want your work to directly improve care for tens of thousands of patients?

Who we are

Leap Metrics was founded to improve health outcomes, lower the cost of care, and improve regulatory compliance. Our platform, Sevida, stands for "in the service of human lives," and our team uses technology to serve populations with chronic healthcare needs.

We are experienced technologists, developers, designers, client advocates and entrepreneurs. Leap Metrics is headquartered in the Dallas/Fort Worth Metroplex, with an engineering team in Hyderabad. Learn more at leapmetrics.io.

Why work with us

  • Meaningful mission: we help providers focus on care.
  • Real ownership: what you write in JIRA becomes what ships to patients and care teams.
  • Modern stack: React, Node.js, REST/GraphQL APIs, cloud delivery and CI/CD.
  • Culture: a collaborative, supportive startup team at an exciting stage of growth.

What you will do

Product ownership and backlog quality (about half the role)

  • Turn customer, clinical, and business requirements into well-formed JIRA epics and user stories.
  • Enrich every story before it reaches sprint planning: clear acceptance criteria, business rules, edge cases, data fields, UI notes or wireframes, API and integration details, and test scenarios.
  • Understand the technical design well enough to ask the right questions, spot gaps, and capture dependencies and technical notes in the ticket.
  • Own backlog grooming and refinement with the product manager; keep the top of the backlog "ready" at least one sprint ahead.
  • Partner with engineering leads to break large features into small, testable increments.
  • Review completed work against the acceptance criteria and sign off that it meets the requirement.
  • Keep Confluence documentation current so the team has one source of truth.

Overview Amazon is seeking a Senior Risk Manager to join the Finance Operations Risk, Governance and Experience (FORGE) team within Finance Operations (FinOps) Controllership. This is a strategic, high ownership risk leadership role that strengthens Amazons risk and control environment across complex, global Finance Operations processes, with a primary focus on Accounts Receivable (AR) and Payroll.

You will operate at the intersection of risk management, internal audit, controllership, process transformation, technology, and business operations. You will assess processes end to end, identify emerging and material risks, evaluate control effectiveness, and partner with senior stakeholders to design and implement sustainable solutions.

This role is built for someone who thrives in ambiguity. The risks are not always obvious, ownership often spans multiple organizations, and the right answer frequently requires connecting data, processes, systems, policies, and controls across the company. You will not just identify problems. You will architect solutions, influence stakeholders, and drive measurable risk reduction.

Key Job Responsibilities Lead the scoping, planning, and execution of complex audits, inspections, and risk assessments across Finance Operations, with particular focus on Accounts Receivable and Payroll.

Conduct end to end assessments spanning process design, policy, organization structure, systems, technology, regulatory requirements, and internal controls.

Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of controls, identify control gaps, and quantify the potential impact of identified risks.

Identify emerging and material risks across Finance Operations and develop data driven recommendations to mitigate them.

Own the full lifecycle of high impact, cross functional risk and governance programs from problem definition through implementation, measurement, and closure.

Define program objectives, success criteria, and risk reduction metrics, and establish mechanisms to measure the effectiveness of remediation.

Partner with Finance, Controllership, Operations, Technology, Compliance, and Internal Audit to prioritize risks and drive sustainable remediation.

Influence senior stakeholders to adopt scalable, automated, and sustainable controls rather than manual or recurring interventions.

Evaluate policy and process exceptions, determine the associated risk, and recommend appropriate mitigation.

Perform deep dives into complex processes and data to identify root causes, systemic risks, control weaknesses, and process improvement opportunities.

  • Coordinate project execution activities, monitor project progress against established plans, and proactively identify and address issues to keep projects on track (on Time, within budget, adhering to high quality standards, meeting customer expectations).
  • Facilitate communication and collaboration among project stakeholders, including team members, sponsors, and end-users, to ensure alignment, manage expectations, and address concerns.
  • Establish quality standards and metrics for project deliverables, conduct quality assurance reviews, and implement quality control measures to ensure project outputs meet defined criteria.
  • Identify potential changes to project scope, schedule, or requirements, assess their impact, and develop change management plans to address and implement approved changes effectively.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation, including status reports, and issue logs, and generate regular project reports to stakeholders to provide transparency and ensure accountability.
  • Provide service support, triage incoming issues, and escalate complex or critical issues to appropriate teams for prompt resolution, ensuring timely response and resolution of user-reported problems.

Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Electrical / Electronics Engineering, Business Administration or related discipline.

Experience: Relevant work experience in application support and/or project management based on the following number of years:

Associate: Prior experience not required

Standard I: Two (2) years

Standard II: Three (3) years

Senior I: Four (4) years

Senior II: Five (5) years

Role Overview

We're seeking a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to serve as a technical leader and front-end architecture anchor across our web applications. You'll drive delivery for a core product while helping define standards, architectures, and best practices across the broader front-end ecosystem.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer I
job.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

What You'll Do Braze’s product is the control center for thousands of the world’s most sophisticated marketing teams. The Frontend Infrastructure & Experience (FIX) team builds the platform foundations that every product engineer relies on and owns key parts of the end-user experience.

The team makes it easy for engineers across Braze to build polished, accessible, and consistent UIs. FIX owns our design system and component library, internationalization stack, code generation and scaffolding tooling, and the navigation and routing layer of the product. The team also owns key customer-facing experiences including our data tables and our rich text, drag-and-drop, and code editors.

As a Senior Engineer on FIX, you will build high-impact frontend infrastructure and product experiences used across Braze. You will lead important projects from design through rollout, raise the quality bar through technical judgment and code review, and help other engineers move faster by making the product easier to build, test, and maintain.

In this role you will:

  • Design and build foundational frontend systems, components, tools, and patterns used by engineers across Braze
  • Lead large projects end-to-end, including technical design, implementation, testing, rollout, and operational follow-through
  • Improve the developer experience of working in a large TypeScript and React codebase through better abstractions, tooling, documentation, and examples
  • Build customer-facing product experiences that are polished, accessible, performant, and consistent with Braze’s product standards
  • Partner with product engineers, designers, and infrastructure teams to solve cross-cutting frontend problems
  • Mentor other engineers through code review, pairing, technical guidance, and clear communication

job.name: Frontend Software Engineer, ChatGPT Space
job.description:
About The Team The ChatGPT Space team is building a shared workspace where people and AI agents turn ideas into polished, editable work. Space brings teammates, ChatGPT, and dots together around shared knowledge and projects, with creation experiences spanning Pages, Sheets, Slides, and new kinds of artifacts.

We want work to keep improving beyond the first draft, using shared context and collaboration to stay current as projects evolve. We work across product, design, and research, partnering closely with model training teams to shape how frontier models create and edit artifacts. We ship quickly, learn from real usage, and hold a high bar for craft, correctness, and speed.

About The Role We’re hiring a Frontend Software Engineer to build a top-tier collaboration experience and help shape how people work with AI. This is a craft-heavy role: you’ll partner closely with design to prototype, iterate, and polish new interaction models, then turn them into reliable, high-performance product experiences.

You’ll help define what great looks like for collaboration between people and agents: how shared context is represented, how contributions and changes are made understandable, and how users stay oriented and in control as work moves between teammates and AI.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and ship polished, high-performance UI for Space and its collaborative workflows.
  • Partner tightly with design to turn prototypes into production-quality experiences, from layout and typography to motion and interaction details.
  • Develop intuitive interfaces for creating and editing shared content, organizing project context, and reviewing contributions from teammates and AI as work evolves.
  • Own frontend architecture decisions across component systems, state management, navigation, and rendering performance.
  • Improve quality and reliability through testing, instrumentation, accessibility, and thoughtful UX for loading, errors, and concurrent changes.
  • Collaborate with research, platform, and backend partners to bring model capabilities into cohesive creation, editing, and collaboration experiences.

You Might Thrive Here If You

  • Have strong experience with modern frontend stacks such as React and TypeScript, and a high bar for UI craft.
  • Love design engineering: sweating the details while keeping velocity.
  • Have built rich, interactive product experiences and care deeply about performance, responsiveness, and usability.
  • Enjoy exploring ambiguous problems and iterating rapidly with design and product.
  • Think in end-to-end workflows and can make complex interactions feel clear and intuitive.
  • Have experience with collaborative applications, rich-text editors, real-time interfaces, or AI-powered products (nice-to-have).

job.description:
HelloGov AI is a fast-growing gov-tech company transforming how people navigate government services through artificial intelligence. We simplify complex processes, including passports, travel visas, vehicle registrations, and business formations, making them faster, easier, and less stressful through our trusted technology platform. We are looking for a talented Front-End Software Engineer to join our on-site engineering team in Miami.

As a Front-End Software Engineer, you will play a key role in building intuitive, visually polished, AI-enhanced user interfaces across our website, checkout flows, and admin and client portals. You will collaborate closely with the Engineering Lead, Back-End Engineering, Product, and UI/UX Designers to translate design specifications and product requirements into responsive, user-friendly experiences. You will also develop scalable, reusable components that maintain visual consistency and support AI-driven interactions across our products.

The role requires expertise in Next.js, React, TypeScript, and modern UI frameworks, along with strong attention to detail and an understanding of UI/UX principles. You should be comfortable implementing designs, refining layouts and interactions, building modular front-end architectures, and developing dynamic interfaces with conditional logic for document workflows. If you enjoy collaborating with designers and engineers to bring high-quality digital experiences to life, we would love to meet you.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional front-end development experience.
  • Strong experience with Next.js, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Experience building and deploying production web applications.
  • Experience translating Figma designs into functional, responsive interfaces.
  • Understanding of UI/UX principles, visual consistency, accessibility, and responsive design.
  • Experience building reusable components and working with design systems.
  • Experience integrating REST and GraphQL APIs.
  • Familiarity with Auth0 or OAuth authentication.
  • Experience with GitHub and modern development workflows.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including working closely with UI/UX Designers and cross-functional teams.
  • Fluent in English, written and verbal.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Available to work on-site in our Brickell, Miami office Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM-6:00 PM.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Node.js or NestJS.

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

You'll also have the opportunity to work across the Grafana Frontend team and partner with other squads within the Grafana department to drive innovation and solve complex engineering challenges.

The squad: DataViz

We build and evolve the Grafana Visualizations. We want to give our users the ability to visualize their data in a way that’s easy to set up and understand, so they can pull out interesting and valuable insights.

job.name: Staff Software Engineer, Frontend (Decisions Orchestration)
job.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Decisions Orchestration owns key moments in Affirm’s checkout flow, from the screens shoppers see to the behind-the-scenes downstream orchestration and state management that power them.

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer, Frontend, to set the technical direction for this space. You’ll lead the design of the next generation of Affirm’s checkout experience and raise the bar for frontend engineering across our core checkout flows. Your goal will be to make checkout fast, clear, and reliable.

What You'll Do

  • You will be responsible for setting technical strategy for your team on a year-long time scale, and help your team tie it together with critical, business-impacting projects.
  • You will collaborate across teams in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics to ensure technical sustainability, risks and trade-offs are well understood and managed.
  • You will act as a force-multiplier for your team through your definition and advocacy of technical solutions and operational processes.
  • You take ownership of your team’s operations and availability by ensuring you have the right monitoring, triage rotations, playbooks, policies, testing and alerting in place to support “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
  • You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.
  • You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.

What We Look For

  • You have 8+ years of experience of developing and architecting web applications using declarative UI frameworks like React or Vue.
  • You are proficient in working with Javascript/Typescript.
  • You have experience delivering major features, system components or deprecating existing functionality in a system through the definition of a technical and execution plan. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
  • You thrive in ambiguity, and are comfortable moving from low level language idioms all the way to the architecture of large systems to understand how they work.
  • Your growth and impact trajectory demonstrates that you have mastered gathering and iterating on feedback from your engineering and cross-functional peers.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Base Pay Grade - P

Equity Grade - USA 13

job.name: Staff Frontend Software Engineer, AI Product: Observe by Snowflake
job.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Observe by Snowflake is an AI-powered observability platform built on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud and engineered for scale. We ingest and store logs, metrics, traces, and events on an open, scalable data lakehouse, using open formats like Apache Iceberg, at dramatically lower cost. A dynamic Context Graph and AI SRE provide rich context and automated workflows so teams can move from detection to root cause of production issue and resolution 10x faster.

Leading engineering teams at companies like Capital One, Topgolf, and Dialpad rely on Observe to troubleshoot hundreds of terabytes of telemetry daily while maintaining reliability at enterprise scale. As part of Snowflake, Observe combines startup-style ownership and velocity with the global reach, operational excellence, and ecosystem of one of the world's leading data platforms.

This is a rare opportunity to define the future of AI-native observability. We are hiring a Staff Frontend Software Engineer on the AI Products team, the team responsible for the most transformative, customer-facing AI capabilities at Observe. You won't just ship features here; you'll set the technical direction for how AI agents, real-time integrations, and developer tooling come together to fundamentally change how engineers operate production systems. If you want to work at the frontier of agentic AI, in a product that ships to real customers solving real problems every day, this is the role.

job.name: Front-End Developer
job.description:
ADP is hiring Front-End Developer. Role Overview We are seeking a collaborative, detail-oriented, and technically strong Front-End Developer to support front-end execution across our web platform as part of our Global Digital Experience Development team. This role will contribute to the development and maintenance of front-end experiences across www.adp.com and our portfolio of global marketing sites, helping ensure high-quality implementation from design through launch.

This role will work closely with UX/UI designers, engineers, product partners, business stakeholders, and content operations to help translate requirements and designs into polished, responsive, accessible front-end experiences. job.name: Web Engineer
job.description:
About Baseten Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE We're hiring our first in-house Web Engineer to own baseten.co, our most important marketing asset. You'll own the codebase end to end: how it's built, how fast it ships, how it's secured, and how we learn from it through tracking and experimentation. You'll partner closely with the design team and all core marketing functions including product, analytics, ops, brand, etc.

This is a founding role. The website is critical to how Baseten shows up in the market, and we want it to be unmistakably ours, not another generic B2B site. You'll be the person who makes that real in code, and you'll lay the foundation for a web team we plan to grow.

Responsibilities

  • Own the website codebase. Lead the architecture, code quality, and deployment of baseten.co on Next.js and React. Set the standards future engineers and agency partners build to.
  • Ship with marketing. Turn launches, campaigns, and new pages into production code quickly, working directly with marketers and designers as a strategy partner rather than through tickets alone.
  • AI strategy. How do we incorporate AI into the site while keeping a quality bar / no AI slop? How do end users leverage AI to quickly spin up pages? You’ll own the strategy for how this gets done.
  • Own website security. Be the in-house owner for site security: work with our security team on findings, patch vulnerabilities, manage dependencies and third-party scripts, and fix issues fast instead of waiting on an agency.
  • Keep the site fast and up. Own performance, uptime, monitoring, and incident response. When something breaks, you're the one who knows how to fix it.
  • Build our experimentation engine. Set up and run the tooling behind conversion rate optimization, so we can test pages, flows, and messaging to learn quickly.
  • Own tracking and tag management. Own Google Tag Manager and other cookie based / JS implementations with the plan to migrate to server-side tracking. We are looking for individuals who have done this transition before.
  • Bring design to life. Partner with Design to build a unique stand out website while also holding certain performance benchmarks.
  • Direct agency partners. Scope work for our web agencies, review their code, and make sure it meets our bar.
  • Lay the foundation for the team. Document how the site works, and help hire and onboard the engineers who join you.

Requirements
