job.description:
About us

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries

The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work.

NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.

About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, UI at NinjaOne, you will design and build the front-end experiences behind our Network Management System (NMS). NMS gives IT teams visibility into the health and performance of their networks and helps them find the root cause of problems quickly. You will deliver new features and improve existing functionality for customers who manage millions of endpoints and servers.

The NMS team is growing to accelerate new feature development. You will take work from initial design through deployment and production support, and you will be accountable for how it performs once customers are using it.

This role will collaborate closely with Java backend engineers and C++ agent engineers, as well as colleagues in Berlin and Brazil.

Location - We are flexible on remote working from home, if you are located in the USA and reside in one of the following states - CA , CO , CT , FL , GA , \*IL , KS , MA , MD , ME , NJ , NC , NY , OH , OR , TN , TX , VA , and WA . We have physical offices in Austin, TX and Tampa, FL, if you prefer a hybrid option.

\*Onsite interviews may be required for this role.

What You’ll be Doing

  • Build new features. Design and deliver large UI features for a network monitoring product used by customers managing millions of endpoints
  • Own it from idea to production. Take a problem from the first conversation through design, development, deployment and ongoing support. You'll decide what to measure, how you'll know something is wrong, and what you'll do about it
  • Set the contracts. Define and document the API contracts between server, UI and agent so each team can build in parallel and everything ships together
  • Shape the front end. Make sound calls on component design, state management and data fetching. Balance technical debt, performance and scalability against what the business needs, and handle asynchronous, polled data, long-running jobs and offline delegates gracefully
  • Test end to end. Write automated tests alongside your React and TypeScript code, including Playwright end-to-end tests built with page object models
  • Git-based PR workflow and CI/CD
  • Keep the product secure. Fix security vulnerabilities (CVEs) and keep our code healthy.
  • Work across time zones. Partner with engineers in Berlin and Brazil

job.name: Data Quality Officer
job.description:
About The Role As a Data Quality Officer for HR & Reference Data , you will be the key enabler in maximizing the value and trustworthiness of our most critical enterprise domains: our workforce information and core reference datasets. You will act as a proactive partner, collaborating closely with business and technical teams. A critical part of your role is bridging perspectives—from HR business partners to IT architects—into clear, actionable data analysis. Your mission is to resolve data issues and nurture a proactive prevention mindset across the organization. You will translate HR processes and Reference Data requirements into formal data quality policies, rules, and governance standards. By storylining data health metrics and serving as a data provocateur when needed, you will drive the continuous improvement of our core data foundation. *Key Responsibilities*

  • Domain-Specific Insight Generation & Profiling:

+ Perform deep-dive root cause analysis on HR datasets (e.g., employee lifecycle, payroll interfaces, org structures) and Reference Data (e.g., enterprise code tables, locations, job classifications, cost centers) to isolate systemic, process, or integration issues.
+ Conduct thorough data profiling on critical master and reference datasets to detect anomalies, cross-system discrepancies, orphan records, and data drift.
+ Document findings and quantify the business impact of poor data quality on operational HR, compliance, reporting, and downstream integrations.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration & Standard Setting:

+ Work closely with HR Data Stewards, Data Governance, and IT to define, document, and enforce clear data quality rules and reference data standards.
+ Translate HR business rules and Reference Data governance policies into precise technical specifications for automated validation and monitoring tools.
+ Act as the primary liaison between business domain owners and technical teams, ensuring alignment on data lineage and data definitions.

  • Monitoring, Reporting & Governance:

+ Maintain domain-specific Data Quality Dashboards (e.g., tracking HR data completeness, reference data synchronization) for clear visibility across business units.
+ Track and report HR and Reference Data quality KPIs to leadership, driving transparency and accountability.
+ Support reference data management processes, ensuring code values, mappings, and taxonomies remain synchronized across target applications.

  • Remediation & Prevention:

+ Collaborate with IT and HR Tech teams to define requirements for data cleansing, automated enrichment, and exception management.
+ Support business teams at the point of data entry/creation to improve source data quality and minimize manual workarounds.

*Your Profile*

job.name: Business Scientist, Operations
job.description:
Job Title:

Business Scientist, Operations

Reports to:

VP Operations

Vacancy Status: This posting is for an existing vacancy.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Business Scientist, Operations turns Wyse’s operational data into faster, more accurate ways of working — for Wyse and for our clients. This newly created role will find and act on efficiencies from installation through to billing: shortening timelines (for example, taking water reno installations from five days to one), raising first-bill accuracy, and reducing the delays and irritants our clients and customers experience today. The role will also lead ideation and discovery of new ways to use operational data, opening new avenues of value for Wyse and its clients — a strategic mandate co-building the future of submetering operations with emerging AI technologies.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Ideation, Business Discovery & Opportunity Development

  • Map operational processes end to end — from installation and meter activation through billing and support — to identify where data, automation or AI can remove delay, rework and error.
  • Discover new ways to use operational data that improve Wyse’s efficiency and create value for clients.
  • Prioritize opportunities based on business value, feasibility, and client and customer impact.
  • Build working prototypes quickly, put them in front of real users and advance them into production.
  • Turn operational data into new services, product features and client offerings.

Operational Efficiency & Process Improvement

  • Analyze operational data — installation schedules, work orders, meter reads, billing exceptions and service tickets — to find the root causes of delay, rework and cost.
  • Shorten installation-to-billing timelines — e.g., water reno installations from five days to one.
  • Improve first-bill accuracy, reducing re-bills, adjustments and escalations.
  • Reduce recurring irritants for clients and customers — repeat visits, missed reads, billing delays.
  • Establish baselines and KPIs for core operational workflows, and track improvement against them.
  • Design and run pilots to test process changes, measuring results before scaling them.

Client Efficiency & Solutions

  • Participate in client meetings to understand business objectives and operational pain points.
  • Find efficiencies for clients — faster installation, quicker first bills and fewer service disruptions.
  • Support sales, account management and the Client Success Team with analytical expertise.
  • Present findings and recommendations, translating complex analyses into executive-level insights.
  • Help shape new client offerings based on what operational data reveals.
  • Co-lead revenue growth on the client side while lifting the effectiveness and quality of work inside Wyse.

AI & Product Development

  • Build proof-of-concept AI applications using LLMs and automation tools.
  • Automate repetitive operational tasks such as scheduling, data validation and billing exceptions.

AI Disclosure: As part of the application process, Artificial Intelligence will be used in the hiring process for this role Work Arrangement: This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to the office three days per week, at minimum.

The Role The Data Engineering organization at General Motors is building a unified Vehicle Data Platform that moves data and configuration between vehicle ECUs and the cloud. Our team is the only team within General Motors that delivers software on every compute module the company has. Our software is delivered as libraries, apps, and services on Android, Linux, and QNX and covers four areas. The control plane retrieves configuration from the cloud and applies it across the vehicle's ECUs. The data plane collects, processes, and forwards data from vehicle systems to cloud storage. The SDK lets application teams use the platform. The unified logging infrastructure manages logs across the vehicle software stack.

We are looking for a Senior Software Developer to own features and components across these areas. You will take work from design through release and field support, write and review code, and mentor junior engineers. You will work with application, platform, cloud, cybersecurity, and privacy teams to deliver software on production ECUs with limited CPU, memory, storage, and bandwidth.

job.name: Principal, Senior, Distinguished Engineer, AWS Foundational Data & Storage Services, AWS Foundational Data & Storage Services
job.description:
Description We are hiring Principal, Senior, and Distinguished Engineers to join AWS Foundational Data & Storage Services.

AWS Foundational Data & Storage Services is redefining how the world stores, serves, and reasons over data in the age of AI. Our vision is to make every byte of enterprise data instantly durable, infinitely scalable, and intelligent by default — so that organizations of any size can turn their data into insight and action. We pair decades of hard-won operational experience with relentless curiosity to build the foundational services the rest of the cloud is built on: object storage (Amazon S3), block storage (Amazon EBS), archival storage (Amazon S3 Glacier), analytics and database engines (Amazon Redshift, EMR, SageMaker), and the ultra-high-performance caching layers that make generative AI and analytics fast and trustworthy at enterprise scale. We're hiring Principal and Senior Principal Engineers across the org to own technical direction for some of our hardest problems: building a new cache product purpose-built for GenAI and analytics — delivering ultra-low-latency, ultra-high-throughput access to S3 data at exponential scale; setting architecture for S3 storage at the exabyte tier; and driving the engineering direction of SageMaker, Redshift, EMR, and AWS Database Services. These are deep, high-ownership systems roles — some remote-eligible, others anchored to hubs like Seattle, Irvine, and Berlin — for engineers who have led org-wide technical strategy and want to see it run in production. If you want to build systems that operate at planet scale — where durability, availability, latency, and failure-mode ownership are first-class concerns measured in eleven nines — this is the team.

What You'll Do

This is a rare chance to own and ship the foundational services the rest of the cloud is built on — not features on top of a platform, but the storage, data, and caching layers that everything else depends on, operating at a scale no one else in the industry touches. You'll architect systems that store and serve exabytes of the world's most critical data, where a single design decision ripples across hundreds of millions of customers and millions of applications.

The problems here are unlike anywhere else. How do you deliver eleven nines of durability while adding net-new capabilities to a service that already stores hundreds of trillions of objects? How do you build a new cache product that serves S3 data at ultra-low latency and ultra-high throughput for GenAI and analytics workloads growing exponentially? How do you evolve block, object, and archival storage — and the analytics and database engines on top of them — without ever compromising the durability, availability, and latency guarantees customers have bet their businesses on? These are deep systems challenges solved in production, at a scale where the usual playbooks break down. You help write the new ones.

job.name: Staff FullStack Engineer, Secures AI
job.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Okta Secures AI Team

The Okta Secures AI Team is building the future of digital identity management. The way companies are using agents and allowing them access is undergoing a fundamental shift, enabling teams to move fast while staying secure.

Our North Star is clear: To get AI right, you have to get identity right. We are not just managing identities; we are building the industry's first Identity Security Fabric for the agentic era. As organizations rapidly deploy AI, these non-human entities are acting with access to critical tools, often bypassing traditional perimeters and creating a 'Shadow AI' crisis. Our mission is to move identity from a reactive gatekeeper to a unified control plane, transforming AI risk into business ROI.

We are tackling this by implementing a comprehensive four-pillar maturity model: Discover, Onboard, Protect, and Govern. We are driving innovation by defining the standards for Agent Identity—including pioneer work with the AI Agent Tool Registry and support for protocols like MCP and IPSIE. You will be helping us build the infrastructure that allows enterprises to scale AI safely, ensuring every access decision—whether made by a human or an automated agent—is authenticated, authorized, and audited at scale.

We are a diverse team of engineers, product managers, and designers who are bringing Okta’s expertise in identity to define the future of Agent Identity management, focusing on enablement while staying secure.

The Staff FullStack Engineer Opportunity

As a Staff Fullstack Engineer on the Okta Secures AI team, your mission is to build the industry's first Identity Security Fabric for the agentic era. You are the architect of our unified control plane, ensuring that we operationalize our North Star: "To get AI right, you have to get identity right."

You will lead the technical implementation of our four-pillar maturity model—Discover, Onboard, Protect, and Govern—to provide enterprise-grade visibility and governance for both human and non-human identities. By architecting solutions that move beyond reactive perimeter security, you will empower organizations to prevent "Shadow AI" and transform AI risk into business ROI.

job.name: Assistant General Manager - Infra and IT - SCO
job.description:
Job Description Key responsibilities

Linux Administration

  • Install, configure, administer, patch, upgrade and troubleshoot RHEL and Oracle Linux servers.
  • Manage Linux systems across physical, VMware and cloud environments, including users/groups, sudo, SSH, systemd, cron, DNS, NTP and network configuration.
  • Administer file systems, LVM, NFS, SAN/NAS connectivity and multipathing; troubleshoot CPU, memory, disk I/O, kernel and network issues.
  • Perform OS hardening, vulnerability remediation, package/repository management using YUM/DNF and capacity planning.
  • Develop Bash/Shell automation for health checks, operational tasks and reporting.

Oracle Database Administration

  • Install, configure, administer, patch, upgrade and troubleshoot Oracle databases, including supported enterprise versions such as 12c/19c and later.
  • Manage instances, schemas, users, roles, privileges, tablespaces, listeners, initialization parameters and database storage.
  • Monitor and tune SQL performance using AWR, ASH, ADDM, Explain Plan, SQL Trace, wait events, SGA/PGA and session analysis.
  • Manage RMAN backup, restore and recovery, database cloning/refresh, migrations and point-in-time recovery.
  • Configure and support Data Guard, replication, DR architectures, ASM and RAC environments where applicable.
  • Plan and execute Oracle Release Updates/security patching and troubleshoot archive log, corruption, storage and recovery issues.

PostgreSQL Database Administration

  • Install, configure, administer, patch, upgrade and troubleshoot PostgreSQL databases and clusters.
  • Manage roles, privileges, schemas, tablespaces, extensions and configuration files including postgresql.conf and pg\_hba.conf.
  • Tune queries, connections, memory, locks, transactions, indexes, checkpoints, autovacuum and database/storage growth.
  • Manage pg\_dump/pg\_restore, pg\_basebackup, WAL archiving and Point-in-Time Recovery.
  • Configure and support streaming replication and HA solutions such as Patroni, repmgr or equivalent where implemented.
  • Perform major/minor upgrades, migrations, refreshes and troubleshoot replication lag, deadlocks, blocking and table/index bloat.

Microsoft SQL Server Administration

  • Install, configure, administer, patch, upgrade and troubleshoot Microsoft SQL Server databases.
  • Manage databases, logins/users, permissions, database files, TempDB, SQL Agent jobs and maintenance activities.
  • Configure and support Always On Availability Groups, Failover Cluster Instances, log shipping and replication where applicable.
  • Manage full, differential and transaction-log backups and point-in-time recovery.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot blocking, deadlocks, CPU/memory pressure, disk latency, waits and long-running queries.
  • Perform query tuning, index/statistics management, SQL Server cumulative updates and integration with Active Directory authentication.

Backup, Recovery & Disaster Recovery

job.name: Full Stack Tech Lead - Senior
job.description:
Mill is a waste prevention technology company reimagining what it means to eliminate waste, starting with food. We build smart systems and infrastructure for homes, businesses, and municipalities that transform food scraps from landfill-bound waste into valuable resources, including chicken feed. Tens of thousands of Mill’s residential food recyclers are already helping households divert millions of pounds of food scraps every year, paving the way for our upcoming launch of Mill Commercial—the industry’s first end-to-end solution for managing, understanding, and preventing food waste in commercial environments (e.g. grocery, restaurants, food services). At Mill, we are passionate about building easy-to-use, beautifully designed technologies that keep food in the food system and out of landfills.

Job Summary We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Full Stack Tech Lead to join our engineering team. This is an individual contributor technical leadership role reporting to the Director of Software Engineering. You will drive the technical direction of your project area, write high-quality code across the stack, and act as the primary technical partner to product management, while mentoring engineers around you.

We've moved away from a frontend/backend split at Mill: every engineer here works full stack, typically leaning toward one side based on strength and interest, and teams are organized around projects rather than layers of the stack. You'll likely anchor on a given project for a sustained stretch — enough to build real depth and avoid constant context-switching — with real opportunities to rotate onto new projects and parts of the codebase over time.

AI-assisted development is core to how we build software, not a peripheral tool. We expect fluency with tools like Claude Code as part of your daily workflow, and as a senior level engineer, a role in raising the bar for how the team uses them.

Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership

  • Lead the technical design and execution of full-stack web applications, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technical standards
  • Architect and implement scalable, secure, and efficient full-stack solutions
  • Evaluate and select technologies, frameworks, and tools — including AI-assisted development tooling — to improve team productivity and code quality
  • Own estimates and technical delivery plans for your project area, and surface risks early

Development and Implementation

  • Craft elegant, documented, and sustainable code spanning our full web stack, remaining ready to provide support for our native mobile environment when required
  • Develop and optimize APIs, databases, and user interfaces
  • Use AI-assisted development tools fluently as a standard part of how you write, review, and ship code

Team Collaboration & Product Partnership

About The Role And Team Being a Staff Scientist at Uber means solving the complex, global-scale puzzle of how millions of people and things move in the real world. You aren't just an individual contributor; you are a technical multiplier operating at the high-stakes intersection of digital systems and physical movement. Whether you are architecting next-generation marketplace mechanisms or defining the experimentation guardrails for a whole product area, you will be working where performance and scale can’t be separated.

This is a high-impact leadership role that requires navigating extreme ambiguity and making smart decisions with imperfect information. You won't just build models; you will set the scientific strategy for entire organizations, mentoring the next generation of scientists and influencing executive-level roadmaps. If you are a pragmatist who thrives on solving "unsolvable" problems and taking full ownership of outcomes in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment—this is where you’ll make your mark.

What You’ll Do

  • Translate strategically important, unstructured problems into rigorous experiments and productionized solutions that move the needle for Uber’s global business.
  • Lead the architecture and design of next-generation algorithms, role-modeling coding best practices and promoting the adoption of key frameworks across the organization.
  • Set the science strategy and experimentation standards across multiple teams, ensuring scientific rigor and driving organization-wide adoption of best practices.
  • Act as a technical multiplier , identifying opportunities for better performance, efficiency, and reduction of technical debt in software, models, and processes.
  • Influence executive-level roadmaps by presenting complex technical findings and long-term strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Own the technical trajectory of critical product areas, ensuring solutions are designed to be extensible, modular, and observable while balancing short-term needs and long-term productivity.

What You'll Need

  • Ph.D., M.S., or B.S. degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, Economics, or other quantitative fields.
  • M.S. degree/B.S. degree, along with a minimum of 8+ years of industry experience required.
  • Deep expertise in statistical inference and experimental design (e.g., A/B, switchbacks, cluster-randomized trials).
  • Proficiency in SQL and Python to work efficiently with large-scale datasets and distributed tools (e.g., Spark, Hive, Presto).

job.description:
Who We Are At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.

The Role Key Responsibilities Frontend Engineering & Delivery

  • Architect, build, and scale modern frontend interfaces using React or Angular designed to handle dynamic generative UI elements and real-time streaming outputs.
  • Optimize application performance, reliable data flows, state management, authentication, and highly responsive rendering speeds.

Agentic AI Development Practices

  • Apply agentic AI development practices-using AI coding agents (such as GitHub Copilot) throughout the development lifecycle-to accelerate frontend design, coding, testing, and code review.
  • Build frontend components that consume and render outputs from Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and multi-agent backend systems, including structured and unstructured data results delivered via streaming responses.
  • Collaborate with backend and AI engineering teams to ensure frontend resilience when consuming LLM-powered APIs, gracefully handling latency, streaming, and error states in the UI.

Customer Engagement & Solution Integrity

  • Partner directly with subject matter experts to understand business challenges, helping to translate complex requirements into high-quality, fit-for-purpose technical architectures.
  • Take part in end-to-end technical delivery from scoping and prototyping to production deployment, prioritizing sustainable, long-term outcomes over temporary fixes.
  • Bridge engineering rigor with business value, communicating technical trade-offs and solution impact confidently to both technical teams and executive stakeholders.

Field Intelligence & Platform Contribution

  • Systematically capture deployment learnings, document best practices, and share insights to continuously enhance Kyndryl's core AI platforms and frameworks.

We're looking for a *Senior Software Engineer This role is Hybrid, Hyderabad Office Senior Software Engineer* Our Services Engineering team designs and builds technical solutions that solve real business challenges for our customers and help them get more value from their technology investments. The core work spans data and platform migration, system integrations and custom solution development: moving learning, talent and HR data from legacy or third-party systems, connecting systems across the customer's technology ecosystem, and building extensions, automations and tools tailored to each customer's needs. Building on this engineering foundation, our engagements are steadily extending into technical consulting and AI-enabled solutions as customers modernise how their people learn and work.

Working with project teams, internal stakeholders and customer contacts, you build a clear understanding of data, systems and processes, then design, build and deliver technical solutions, migrations and integrations that run in production. As the practice evolves, you help shape how consulting and AI development become part of the value we deliver.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you own migrations and customer engagements end to end, lead solution design decisions, and mentor other engineers on the team.

*How The Role Is Evolving* Migration and implementation work gives you deep knowledge of the Cornerstone platform, customer data and the business processes behind them. That knowledge is exactly what customers need when they look for advice on improving their learning programmes and adopting AI.

As customers adopt AI, our engagements are naturally moving from migrating and integrating data to advising on how to use it and building AI agents and automations around it. You grow with this shift at the pace our customers set, bringing your migration and platform expertise into broader consulting and AI work over time.

Key Responsibilities Solution building, migration and implementation

  • Plan and lead migrations of learning, talent and HR data from legacy or third-party systems onto the Cornerstone platform, covering scoping, data mapping, transformation, validation and cutover.

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You’ll Be Doing... Type of Work: Highly technical, code-driven, and execution-focused. The daily focus is on accelerating the pre-sales cycle by building automated demo labs, scripting repetitive sales engineering tasks (like BOM generation and RFP parsing), and showcasing network automation capabilities to enterprise customers.

Expected Volumes: High volume of scripting, API integration, and lab management. You will maintain internal code repositories, write Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates, manage automated demonstration portals, and execute high-speed Proof of Concepts (PoCs) concurrently.

Risk & Criticality: Moderate commercial risk. You are the technical automation engine for the team. While senior architects design the overarching telecom solutions, your code directly dictates how fast and effectively those solutions can be demonstrated and quoted. Broken scripts or failed API calls during a live demo can derail customer confidence and stall the sales cycle.

What We’re Looking For...

  • Pre-Sales Workflow Automation: Write scripts to eliminate manual pre-sales bottlenecks. Automate the generation of Bill of Materials (BOMs) by querying CPQ APIs, automate network diagramming, and use data parsing to accelerate RFP/RFI responses.

job.name: Senior Engineering Manager- TDP Insights and Data Resiliency
job.description:
Overview Working at Atlassian Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

To help our teams work together effectively, this role requires you to be located in India. You will work closely with engineering teams in India and Australia and coordinate strategy, priorities, and execution with leadership in the United States.

Atlassian’s Trusted Data Platform (TDP) provides secure, reliable, and scalable data capabilities used by Atlassian product and platform teams. It helps those teams manage persistent customer data while meeting complex enterprise requirements, including data residency, encryption, regulatory compliance, backup and recovery, and operation across multiple cloud environments.

TDP Insights provides the intelligence layer for the Trusted Data Platform. It helps teams understand where data lives, how it moves, what it costs, how reliably it operates, and how customers use TDP services. By transforming high-volume platform telemetry into actionable insights, it supports better decisions about reliability, capacity, cost, compliance, recovery readiness, and developer experience.

Atlassian Data Resiliency (ADR) strengthens end-to-end recovery across TDP. It provides common backup and restore capabilities, recovery assurance, RPO and RTO evidence, validation, restore exercises, and consistent resiliency standards across TDP data platforms.

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the TDP Insights and ADR engineering team. This leader will be accountable for the team’s people, strategy, execution, and operational outcomes. They will partner with senior engineers, product and program leaders, storage and streaming teams, infrastructure teams, security specialists, and Atlassian product organizations to improve how Atlassian understands, protects, and recovers its data.

Success in this role means building a strong engineering organization, delivering trusted platform insights and recovery capabilities, and translating complex customer, reliability, and infrastructure requirements into a clear and executable roadmap.

Responsibilities Team and organizational leadership

job.name: Senior ServiceNow Developer
job.description:
At OneSpan, we specialize in digital identity and anti-fraud solutions that create exceptional and secure experiences.

OneSpan is establishing its first internal ServiceNow development capability in India as part of a growing global Business Systems organization. This is an opportunity to become one of the foundational members of a new team and play a key role in the future direction of our ServiceNow platform supporting Customer Support, Professional Services, Revenue Operations, and IT.

Unlike many enterprise development roles, this position requires a highly independent and self-motivated individual who can work effectively with limited day-to-day oversight. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, a Business Analyst in Canada, and a shared Business Analyst in India while partnering with teams across North America, Europe, and India.

This is a hands-on role with an expected focus of approximately 70% ServiceNow development and support, 20% solution design and platform architecture, and 10% requirements analysis and stakeholder collaboration. The ideal candidate is comfortable working from enhancement requests, support tickets, project initiatives, and high-level business requirements that may not always be fully documented. You will be expected to evaluate needs, recommend scalable solutions, develop and test those solutions, maintain technical documentation, and support production issues in a highly customized ServiceNow environment.

What You'll Do ServiceNow Development & Platform Support (Approximately 70%)

  • Design, develop, configure, test, deploy, and support scalable solutions on the ServiceNow platform.
  • Build and maintain Flow Designer automations, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Script Includes, UI Actions, Catalog Items, Notifications, and custom applications.
  • Deliver enhancements supporting Customer Service Management (CSM), Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM/PPM), ITSM, Service Catalog, Customer Portal, and related business processes.
  • Develop and support integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise systems, particularly Salesforce and Jira.
  • Build integrations using REST APIs, IntegrationHub, web services, and other appropriate integration technologies.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, defects, integration failures, access requests, and platform incidents.
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement long-term solutions that improve platform stability and maintainability.
  • Support platform upgrades, patching, release activities, and regression testing.
  • Balance enhancement work, project delivery, support requests, operational tickets, and platform improvement initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline business processes through automation, workflow optimization, and AI-driven capabilities.
  • Communicate clear design, plans and status of work with ServiceNow team and Business Stakeholders via our Jira ticketing system.

job.name: Senior Terraform Developer
job.description:
Senior Terraform / IaC Engineer — Azure Landing Zone Practice Cloud & Infrastructure, Avanade India

Location Bengaluru/NCR, India (Hybrid)

Experience 6–10 years overall in cloud infrastructure and platform engineering, with deep hands-on Terraform experience building Azure landing zones and provisioning Azure services as code

Role Summary Avanade India’s Cloud & Infrastructure practice is looking for a Senior Terraform / Infrastructure as Code Engineer to build enterprise Azure platforms for our clients. This is a deeply hands-on subject-matter-expert role — the person in it writes the Terraform that provisions the landing zone, and is measured on the quality and reusability of the code they produce.

You will work within the platform team on the landing zone build and on the Azure services that sit inside it, taking the target-state design and turning it into tested, reusable, parameterised Terraform that runs through automated pipelines. The role suits an engineer who wants to stay hands-on, set the standard for how infrastructure code is written, and be the go-to person on Terraform for the engagement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build Azure landing zones using Terraform — management groups, subscriptions, policy assignments, networking, identity and the core platform services that sit within them.
  • Write, structure and maintain reusable Terraform modules rather than one-off configurations — variables, locals, dynamic blocks, outputs and clean module interfaces.
  • Provision and configure Azure services as code: networking, Key Vault, storage, Log Analytics, compute, backup, private endpoints and policy assignments.
  • Parameterise a single codebase to deploy consistently across multiple environments and regions.
  • Design and manage Terraform state at scale — remote backends, state segmentation, locking and provider configuration.
  • Test and validate infrastructure code — terraform validate and plan, tflint, and a security scanner such as Checkov or tfsec, wired into the development workflow.

job.description:
Une carrière à titre de scientifique principal(e) des données, développement de modèles et production du risque au sein de l’équipe Analytique du risque de crédit à la Banque Nationale, c’est agir à titre d’expert(e) de contenu pratique en modélisation du risque de crédit et en analytique du capital économique (CE). Ce rôle vous permet d’avoir un impact positif sur l’organisation grâce à votre expertise en modélisation quantitative, mesure du risque, estimation du capital économique, intelligence artificielle et analyse avancée des données.

Votre rôle

  • Développer et améliorer les processus de capital économique (CE) du crédit et de l’ICAAP afin de soutenir le lancement de nouveaux produits, l’intégration de nouveaux portefeuilles, la migration de données ainsi que les exigences de production de rapports internes et externes.
  • Développer et améliorer les modèles de CE, d’ICAAP et de risque de concentration.
  • Moderniser les processus de production de rapports liés au CE, à l’ICAAP et à d’autres fonctions de gestion des risques grâce à une utilisation efficace des outils d’intelligence artificielle, afin d’accroître l’efficacité, l’automatisation et les capacités analytiques.
  • Gérer et exécuter les processus de production et de divulgation du CE et de l’ICAAP pour soutenir les activités mensuelles et trimestrielles de mesure du risque.
  • Réaliser des analyses approfondies des résultats en capital, déterminer les principaux facteurs expliquant les variations et préparer des présentations claires et pertinentes à l’intention de la haute direction, des partenaires internes et des organismes de réglementation.
  • Soutenir le développement, l’implantation et la rétrovalidation (back-testing) de modèles dans d’autres domaines du risque de crédit, notamment l’IFRS 9 et les tests de résistance.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes Finances, TI, Affaires, Développement des modèles AIRB, Validation des modèles et Audit interne afin de soutenir les initiatives de développement de modèles et les projets analytiques.

Votre équipe

L’équipe de Gestion des risques regroupe des spécialistes hautement qualifiés qui collaborent afin de renforcer les pratiques de gestion des risques et les capacités analytiques de la Banque.

Au sein du groupe Analytique du risque de crédit, composé de 26 collègues, vous ferez partie d’une équipe spécialisée en capital économique et relèverez du ou de la directeur(trice) principal(e), Analytique du risque de crédit. Basée à Richmond Hill, en Ontario, l’équipe est responsable du développement et de l’implantation de modèles ainsi que de la production de rapports liés au capital, à l’IFRS 9 et aux tests de résistance. L’équipe se distingue par sa solide expertise quantitative, son approche collaborative et son engagement envers l’amélioration continue des méthodologies de mesure du risque.

You will build scalable evaluation infrastructure that enables research and product teams to compare large language models (LLMs), measure quality, cost, and latency, and make informed decisions about model selection and development.

You will own the engineering approach from early prototypes through reliable, maintainable tools, collaborating closely with research scientists, engineering teams, and product partners while helping shape technical direction and engineering delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead technical delivery and engineering planning: Partner with program and research leaders to define priorities, break projects into delivery stages, estimate effort and cost, recommend staffing and required skills, identify dependencies, and adapt plans to available resources.
  • Design and build scalable evaluation infrastructure: Extend existing shared tools and services, design new components where needed, and develop production-quality Python software, APIs, and reusable evaluation frameworks. Deliver useful initial versions, validate them with users, and improve them through iterative development.
  • Turn research methods into working software: Collaborate with scientists to build automated evaluation pipelines connecting model APIs, test datasets, and agreed scoring methods. Implement reliable workflows for comparing LLMs and other AI models using evaluation datasets relevant to products and customer needs.
  • Ensure reliable, reproducible model comparisons: Maintain repeatable experiments, separate evaluation data from model development, and make results traceable to evaluation inputs and methods. Measure model quality, operating cost, and latency to support product teams in validating model performance.
  • Build practical tools for researchers and product teams: Develop clear user interfaces, documentation, evaluation reports, and diagnostic capabilities. Enable scientists and product teams to run evaluations, understand failures, interpret results, and extend tools without depending on the original developer.
  • Own production reliability, performance, and responsible data use: Integrate automated testing, deployment, and monitoring from the beginning. Address performance, scalability, and operating costs, establish service maintenance and support ownership, and work with data specialists to implement access controls, permitted-use rules, and retention requirements.
  • Collaborate, mentor, and guide engineering decisions: Partner with foundational research, data engineering, platform engineering, and product teams to align interfaces, responsibilities, and delivery plans. Resolve technical dependencies, mentor engineers, communicate trade-offs and delivery risks, and recommend changes to scope or technical approach when necessa

Company Description

AXIOMIS Technologies is a technology-driven company focused on building intelligent, secure, and scalable digital solutions for businesses and organizations. Our work spans software engineering, artificial intelligence, machine learning, cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, and data engineering.

We build modern web applications, cloud-native platforms, AI-powered systems, and digital products designed to solve real-world problems.   • Support improvements in analytics workflows, reporting systems, and data processes.

job.description:
About The Role We're building the next generation of AI‑powered platforms for tax and accounting professionals, and we’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can architect high‑performance backend systems that bring real‑world AI capabilities to life. If you thrive in fast‑moving environments, enjoy tackling complex distributed‑systems challenges, and want your work to directly enable intelligent, production‑grade features, this role is for you.

As a Senior Software Engineer – AI, you will design, implement, and optimize backend services that fuel AI‑native experiences across our Materia‑driven product ecosystem. You’ll be responsible for shaping the architecture, scalability, and reliability of systems that coordinate LLM interactions, serve high‑traffic APIs, and manage large‑scale content processing.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build backend services using Python, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL to support real‑time AI interactions and large‑scale data flows.
  • Shape the architectural foundation of our AI platform by defining service boundaries, system interfaces, and scalable design patterns.
  • Develop high‑performance APIs and microservices that power AI agents, orchestration engines, and content pipelines, ensuring smooth operation under heavy load.
  • Integrate backend systems with modern LLM providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) and implement reliable orchestration, routing, and execution safeguards.
  • Productionize AI capabilities with robust error handling, guardrails, telemetry, and deep observability for performance and reliability.
  • Lead core engineering decisions—driving architecture reviews, mentoring teammates, and promoting best practices in testing, resiliency, and maintainability.
  • Strengthen CI/CD pipelines and DevOps automation to support fast, stable, cloud‑native development workflows.
  • Collaborate closely with ML engineers, product managers, and designers to turn early AI concepts into scalable backend solutions.
  • Deliver backend systems that transform ambitious AI ideas into production‑ready experiences used by thousands of professionals.

Required About You

  • Minimum 4+ years building backend systems, APIs, and microservices.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and AWS cloud services.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, architecture, and data modeling.
  • Experience with AI‑driven systems or agent‑based architectures.
  • Proven ability to deliver production‑ready, highly reliable systems.
  • Excellent debugging skills and strong cross‑functional communication.
  • Comfortable operating in fast‑paced, iterative environments.

Preferred

  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for integrating AI technologies into real applications.
  • Familiarity with embeddings, vector search, or RAG retrieval patterns.
  • Strong opinions on testing, automation, and operational robustness.
  • Experience with modern LLM APIs or orchestration frameworks.

Webisoft is a Montreal-based development studio building custom software, AI and Web3 solutions for clients around the world. We're looking for a Full Stack Engineer to join our growing team. You'll work closely with developers, designers and product managers to ship modern, high-performance applications, from client platforms to our own AI products and core blockchain infrastructure.

We're an AI-first engineering team. Our developers use AI tools every day to design, build, review and debug faster without compromising on quality. If that's already how you work, and you want to apply it to complex problems in AI and Web3, you'll fit right in.

This is a remote-first position. We'd ideally like to see you at our downtown Montreal office a few days a week, but the schedule is flexible.

Must-haves

  • Solid full stack experience with React (frontend) and Python (backend, e.g., FastAPI, Django or Flask).
  • Strong understanding of web application architecture, RESTful APIs and modern development best practices.
  • Daily use of AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) as a core part of how you write, refactor, test and debug code, not just occasional autocomplete.
  • Good judgment about AI-generated code: you know when to trust it, how to review it, and how to keep a codebase clean and maintainable.
  • Comfortable with Git and agile workflows.
  • Familiarity with relational and/or NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MongoDB).

  • Self-motivated, with a strong work ethic and attention to detail.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Based in the Montreal area and able to come into our downtown office a few days a week (flexible).

job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Python + AI Engineer with 8+ years of software engineering experience and strong expertise in building scalable Python applications and AI-driven solutions. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, RAG, APIs, cloud platforms, and enterprise application development . The engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, integrating, and operationalizing AI solutions while ensuring scalability, security, observability, reliability, and maintainability.

In this role, you will

  • Design and develop scalable enterprise applications and backend services using Python.
  • Build Generative AI and LLM-based applications, including conversational AI, intelligent assistants, summarization, knowledge retrieval, and workflow automation.
  • Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using embeddings, vector databases, and enterprise knowledge sources.
  • Develop AI agents and Agentic AI workflows capable of reasoning, tool invocation, orchestration, and multi-step task execution.
  • Integrate LLMs from platforms such as Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source model ecosystems.
  • Build reusable AI services and APIs using FastAPI, Flask, or similar Python frameworks.
  • Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, function/tool calling, context management, and AI guardrails.
  • Establish evaluation approaches for measuring response quality, groundedness, relevance, hallucination risk, latency, and cost.
  • Develop integrations with relational databases, NoSQL databases, vector stores, APIs, and enterprise platforms.
  • Design asynchronous and event-driven processing using technologies such as Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or equivalent platforms.
  • Containerize and deploy applications using Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native services.
  • Implement unit testing, integration testing, automated quality controls, logging, monitoring, and observability.

Work Model We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants in Canada. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

Note: The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

What You Need To Have To Be Considered

job.name: Software Engineer 3
job.description:
MongoDB’s Application Modernization Platform (AMP) helps organizations modernize legacy applications and move their workloads and associated data from relational databases to MongoDB. Our customers need a dependable way to bring analysis, transformation, testing, and migration capabilities into their modernization workflows.

The Agentic Integrations team builds the interfaces that let AMP capabilities be discovered, invoked, and orchestrated from AI agents and development environments. We expose product services through consistent, well-specified tool and API surfaces, keep authentication and execution context correct across every boundary, and make each integration observable and safe to operate. Our work is what makes AMP usable from the assistants and coding agents our customers already run.

We are looking for a Software Engineer 3 to build and operate these integrations. You will design tool and API surfaces for AMP services, implement them end to end, and work with product and platform engineers so that they behave predictably when a model calls them. Your impact will be measured by how reliably agents and developers can invoke AMP capabilities, and by how much integration work your components remove for other teams.

This role will be based remotely in Canada.

What you will do

  • Design and implement agent and developer facing integrations for AMP services, including tool definitions, API clients, and the adapters between them
  • Define clear input and output contracts for each integration, including validation, error semantics, and behavior when a call is malformed or only partially succeeds
  • Propagate authentication, authorization, and tenant context across integration boundaries so that agent-invoked calls carry no more privilege than the user they act for
  • Build the instrumentation needed to observe agent-driven traffic, including structured logs, traces, latency and failure metrics, and actionable diagnostics
  • Write production-quality code and the unit, integration, and end-to-end tests that demonstrate correctness, including tests for nondeterministic model behavior
  • Diagnose failures that span service, tool, and model boundaries, and drive them to root cause
  • Contribute integrations to shared SDKs, command-line tools, and agent frameworks used by other teams
  • Collaborate with product managers, platform engineers, and partner teams on scoped initiatives, and break work into incremental deliverables
  • Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and technical discussions that raise the quality of the team’s work
  • Interview candidates and mentor engineers and interns

What you bring

job.description:
Your work days are brighter here. We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

About The Team Agent Factory is where Workday’s next chapter gets built. We’re forming small, senior, cross-functional AI teams that bring together product leaders, machine learning engineers, and full-stack builders to create intelligent agents used by millions of people every day. This is production-grade AI—deeply embedded into Workday’s platform—not research experiments or maintenance work. Teams own problems end to end, collaborate tightly across disciplines, and use the right tools to solve real customer challenges at global scale. You’ll work at the intersection of AI, platform architecture, and human workflows, with the autonomy to shape how agents reason, act, and scale responsibly. High trust, high expectations, and real impact. Engineering, but brighter.

About The Role As a Full Stack Software Engineer in Agent Factory, you’ll help build the user-facing and platform experiences that bring Workday’s AI agents to life. Working within a small, cross-functional pod, you’ll design and ship full stack solutions—from intuitive front-end experiences to resilient backend services that integrate AI-driven capabilities deeply into HR and Finance workflows. This role is about turning powerful technology into products people actually use: scalable, reliable systems that simplify complex business processes for customers around the world. You’ll collaborate closely with machine learning engineers, product managers, and platform teams, owning features end to end and seeing your work run in production. If you enjoy building real products, solving meaningful problems, and working with people who care about quality and craft, you’ll feel right at home here.

job.name: Software Engineer I, Backend (Streaming Infra)
job.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

The Streaming team at Affirm is responsible for all things data and drives the strategy for event driven architecture, stream processing, data exploration, discovery and validation. We leverage existing open source technologies like Kafka, Flink, Spark and also build our own as needed. As a member of our team you would spend time identifying and executing on new use cases of data infrastructure, designing and scaling our existing infrastructure and working closely with other teams to promote the optimal use of data at the company.

What You'll Do

  • With the support of your team, you will work on tasks that contribute to the team's projects and goals.
  • You will work collaboratively and proactively with your team and stakeholders, bringing them along for your work and helping to create visibility and dialog regarding the risks and trade-offs related to your work.
  • You will strike the right balance of speed and quality in your work, ensuring that we hit our business goals while protecting our systems from downtime.
  • You will contribute to a sense of community on your team by engaging in growth and development activities.

What We Look For

  • You have previous work or internship experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale and are experienced using one of Python or Kotlin.
  • You are familiar with the building blocks of distributed systems, and the technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes.
  • You have mastered taking a simple problem or business scenario into a solution that interacts with multiple software components, and executing on it by writing clear, easily understood, well tested and extensible code.
  • You are comfortable navigating a large code base, debugging others' code, and providing feedback to other engineers through code reviews.
  • Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
  • Experience building and owning large-scale stream processing systems, such as Kafka, SNS is a plus.

Base Pay Grade - J

Equity Grade - 4

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer, Web3 Backend
job.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

As a Senior Software Engineer , you’ll architect, build, and scale the backend services, infrastructure, and data systems that support Robinhood’s next-generation crypto, web3, and wallet offerings. You’ll provide technical leadership to deliver a best-in-class trading experience for cryptocurrencies and tokenized assets—including perpetual futures—to customers worldwide, solving complex distributed systems and correctness challenges in an environment where the systems you build move real customer assets continuously around the clock.

The Robinhood Wallet team’s mission is to democratize access to financial services worldwide by leveraging DeFi protocols and Robinhood Chain. The team builds non-custodial consumer products, self-custody experiences, and seamless cross-chain trading capabilities.

The Tokenization team’s mission is to bring both public and private equity to be tradable 24/7 on decentralized exchanges (DEXs) across the Robinhood Chain. Equity markets have been closed nights and weekends for a century; the team builds the connective tissue between traditional market infrastructure and on-chain systems—issuance, custody, and settlement—to change that.

The Robinhood Chain team designs and scales the underlying decentralized infrastructure across Robinhood. The team continuously improves Robinhood Chain to provide a best-in-class decentralized platform for trading real-world assets, builds specialized smart contracts, and provides infrastructure services for other Robinhood teams that rely on DeFi.

This role is based in our Toronto office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What You’ll Do

The Role

We’re hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to work directly with the world’s leading AI labs and enterprises as a technical research and implementation partner. This role sits at the intersection of applied AI, ML infrastructure, data intelligence, and partner-facing product development.

You’ll help strategic partners define research directions, structure and curate high-quality data, implement ML and evaluation pipelines, and build the agentic systems that extend multi-turn agents and workflows in production. You should be comfortable moving between ambiguous research questions, technical architecture, hands-on engineering, and partner-facing execution.

What You’ll Work On

1. Work directly with leading AI labs and enterprise partners to define research goals, technical requirements, and project direction.

2. Build large-scale data intelligence systems for collecting, organizing, evaluating, and improving training and evaluation data.

3. Implement ML pipelines for data curation, model training, evaluation, experimentation, and continuous improvement.

4. Design data taxonomies, labeling systems, and quality frameworks that improve dataset structure, model performance, and research outcomes.

5. Develop LLM applications, including multi-agent systems, tool-using agents, RAG workflows, evaluation harnesses, and human-in-the-loop systems.

6. Partner with research and engineering teams to translate ambiguous AI problems into scoped technical projects and production systems.

7. Develop infrastructure for model inference, experimentation, evaluation, and deployment across frontier AI platforms.

8. Build systems that help partners move from one-off AI experiments to reliable, repeatable, multi-turn agent workflows.

9. Own systems across the full lifecycle, including discovery, architecture, implementation, deployment, reliability, iteration, and partner success.

What We're Looking For

1. Able to operate independently in ambiguous, partner-facing settings with strong technical and product ownership.

2. Strong Python engineer with experience building and shipping production systems end to end.

3. Experience working with LLMs, agentic systems, multi-turn workflows, tool use, RAG, or AI automation.

4. Built or maintained data pipelines, ML infrastructure, evaluation systems, or research workflows.

5. Strong understanding of data quality, taxonomy design, labeling workflows, and dataset curation for AI systems.

6. Comfortable working directly with technical partners, researchers, founders, and enterprise stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

2. Experience building systems for multi-turn agents, agent evaluation, workflow automation, or human-in-the-loop AI.

job.name: Detector Integration Engineer
job.description:
The National Synchrotron Light Source-II (NSLS-II) at Brookhaven National Laboratory is a U.S. Department of Energy Office of Science User Facility, operating about 30 state-of-the-art X-ray beamlines (https://www.bnl.gov/nsls2/). The Data Science and Systems Integration (DSSI) Division of NSLS-II innovates, integrates, and supports critical hardware for experimental stations and develops and stewards' essential software for applications for data acquisition and analysis. DSSI focuses its research and development in data science and advanced instrumentation and operation of the critical underlying controls and data infrastructure within NSLS-II. Learn more about DSSI at https://www.bnl.gov/nsls2/datascience/.

Position Description This role resides in the Detectors group of DSSI, specifically in the Detector Integrations Team. The role will focus on the deployment, maintenance, and support of state-of-the-art detector systems in use at beamlines at NSLS-II. The role will involve the development of new low level detector drivers as well as the modification of existing drivers to add new features as needed by beamlines. It will also involve the development of higher-level orchestration code that leverages installed detectors for scientific data collection, including using high speed and precision fly scanning techniques, and the overall maintenance and development of any detector-adjacent infrastructure and tooling. The applicant will also be responsible for the deployment of all of these developed components along with the physical detector hardware and server/network infrastructure at beamlines, followed by supporting the solutions in collaboration with beamline staff and coworkers throughout DSSI. The role will involve working extensively with the EPICS control system and area Detector framework, along with the bluesky ecosystem for experimental orchestration. This role will support both operations of current NSLS-II beamlines and the development of the next generation of beamlines from the earliest stages of development.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Work on a team to provide full stack (networking, controls, orchestration) detector integrations for NSLS-II beamlines.
  • Operations support for beamlines leveraging solutions developed and deployed by the team.
  • Engagement with open-source communities (EPICS, area Detector, Bluesky, Scientific Python).

Required Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

About Pivotal Health Pivotal Health is the leading technology platform that helps healthcare providers get paid fairly in an increasingly complex reimbursement landscape.

Today, many providers face persistent underpayment from health insurance companies, despite delivering high-quality care. While processes like IDR (Independent Dispute Resolution) were designed to promote fairness, they’re often administrative-heavy, time-consuming, and difficult to navigate without the right tools.

Pivotal Health combines software, data, and service into a seamlessly integrated, AI-driven platform that simplifies these complex reimbursement workflows. We help providers efficiently dispute underpaid claims, reduce administrative burden, and recover the reimbursement they’re entitled to; without adding more work to already stretched teams.

Our full-service IDR solution is just the starting point. We’re building solutions that enable providers to operate with clarity, control, and confidence across the reimbursement journey.

About The Role We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join Pivotal's Case Execution team. This team owns critical parts of the case execution workflow, including eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These systems sit at the operational core of how Pivotal delivers outcomes for providers.

This is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys solving complex, workflow-driven backend problems and working through data-heavy decision logic. The most technically demanding areas for this team are eligibility and batching, and the right person is energized by that kind of work rather than looking to avoid it.

What You'll Do

  • Build and improve core case execution systems: Own backend development across eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These are the systems that determine how cases move through Pivotal's platform and reach resolution.
  • Tackle complex, data-driven backend problems: Work through the decision logic and data-heavy workflows that make eligibility and batching hard, understanding not just how individual systems work, but how they interact across the broader platform.
  • Contribute to workflow orchestration: Build and improve the systems that coordinate how cases are staged, routed, and executed end to end, with a clear eye toward correctness and reliability.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with the Integrations team, Case Strategy team, and other engineering and product partners to ensure systems are well-connected and aligned with how the broader platform operates.
  • Contribute to front-end and admin workflows where needed: The role is primarily backend-focused, but you'll contribute to internal-facing UI and ops tooling where the product requires it.

Who You Are

job.name: Senior / Staff Software Engineer — AI / ML
job.description:
About Snorkel Snorkel AI is the frontier AI data lab, helping teams build the data and environments behind high-performing frontier and agentic AI. We combine technology with research-driven AI data development to create datasets, benchmarks, evals, and custom solutions for real-world AI systems. Founded out of the Stanford AI Lab in 2019, Snorkel works with leading AI labs and enterprises to move from better data to better outcomes.

Excited to help us redefine how AI is built? Apply to be the newest Snorkeler!

In September 2026 we raised a $350 million Series E at a $3.5 billion valuation , and we are scaling our engineering and research teams to meet demand.

The role

Frontier AI data is expensive to make and hard to measure. Every task we deliver is tested against the strongest models, often through many long-running agent rollouts. Your job is to make that process faster, cheaper, and more rigorous with ML and AI

You will be one of the early members of ML & Research Engineering at Snorkel. You will study how frontier-grade data is generated and evaluated, form hypotheses, validate them against real production data, and ship the winners at scale. You will shape the discipline's direction, its standards, and the team that grows around it.

What you'll work on

  • Efficient agentic evals. Cut the cost of long-horizon agent evaluation with adaptive sampling, statistically grounded early stopping, model cascades, caching, and cheap-first gating.
  • AI model routing. Route every eval and judge call to the cheapest model that clears the quality bar, with fallback, monitoring, and cost attribution.
  • Fine-tuned small models. Fine-tune and serve open-weight models (LoRA and other parameter-efficient methods) where they match frontier quality, and know when they don't.
  • Predictive difficulty. Build models that estimate how hard a task is for frontier systems before running a single rollout.
  • Measurement for AI data. Build golden datasets, quantify the accuracy and calibration of LLM-as-judge systems, and make quality reproducible across projects.
  • Research to production. Turn research prototypes into reusable, configurable components that forward deployed engineers and researchers use on every project.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years building production ML or software systems, with end-to-end ownership from prototype to production
  • Hands-on experience running LLM or ML workloads in production, and comfort reasoning about non-deterministic systems
  • Deep grounding in statistics and experimentation: experiment design, hypothesis testing, sampling, and confidence intervals
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals, including testing, code review, and system design
  • Experience designing evaluations and interpreting results rigorously
  • A habit of finding high-impact problems before they are assigned, and clear communication with researchers, engineers, and business partners

Nice to have

We are WisdomAI. We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity. WisdomAI builds AI-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context.

We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here.

Role We are looking for exceptional ML/NLP engineers to join our team. We are working on fundamental problems in LLM based code-generation, document understanding, context synthesis and LLM based agents. Our team consists of experts from companies like Glean, Apple, Rubrik, Google and Meta.

What You Will Do

  • Build workflows/agentic pipelines for complex analytical workloads.
  • Design evaluation framework and carry out evaluations of our query processing engine.
  • Work closely with customers and founders to define the product and engineering roadmap.
  • Shape up the engineering culture and tech stack for the company.

You have

  • Strong analytical skills and proven ability to work with hard NLP problems.
  • Background in search/retrieval, LLMs, and evaluation pipelines is plus.
  • Experience working in startup/fast paced teams is highly desirable.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field.

Our CRAFT CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.

C — Customer trust. Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.

R — Relentless on outcomes. We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.

A — Authenticity. We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together.

F — First principles, grounded in reality. We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real-world results decide.

T — Transparency. We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong.

job.name: Senior Perception Learning Engineer
job.description:
Apptronik is a human-centered robotics company developing AI-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond.

We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better.

JOB SUMMARY The Senior Perception Learning Engineer is a key, hands-on role. You will build the learned perception that lets Apollo see and understand people, objects, and its work area at customer sites. You will design, train, and deploy deep learning models for detection, tracking, segmentation, depth, and 3D scene understanding. These models give navigation, manipulation, safety, and human-robot interaction the data that they need. The main focus of this role is to move models from research to fast, reliable use on the robot's onboard compute. As a senior member of the team, you will also mentor engineers and raise the team's engineering standards.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES or KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Design, train, and optimize deep learning models for object detection, tracking, segmentation, pose estimation, and 3D scene understanding on humanoid robots.
  • Build perception for safety near people. Detect and track people reliably in all site conditions, and work with the safety team on test evidence for these models.
  • Develop multi-sensor fusion for cameras, depth sensors, and other sensors. Give the robot a real-time model of the space around it, for example obstacles and free space.
  • Build scalable data pipelines, training infrastructure, and evaluation tools. Use data from the field to retrain and improve the models.
  • Deploy models on edge hardware within strict latency, accuracy, compute, and thermal limits. Use profiling, quantization, and regression tests to keep them there.
  • Use synthetic data from simulation frameworks such as Isaac Sim together with real-world data to improve model generalization and robustness.
  • Work closely with the autonomy, navigation, controls, reinforcement learning, and platform teams. Define clear perception interfaces that meet real-time needs.

SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS
