The people who succeed here are fast learners who join discovery conversations on Monday and help ship what was scoped on Thursday.

On this track, your focus is data, retrieval, and model behavior : you help make agents trustworthy by getting the data, context, and evaluation right.

We work with regulated industries and Fortune 500 clients who have AI mandates, real constraints, and low tolerance for demos that don’t hold up.

How We Approach The Work FDEs are trusted to help shape the solution, not only deliver it. Every engagement calls for sound judgment, which you will develop over time:

  • Reframes the request. Treats “we need an agent for X” as a hypothesis, not a spec.
  • Decomposes the problem. Outcome → process → decisions → data → systems → actors → constraints — before choosing technology.
  • Helps choose the intervention. Remove, simplify, traditional software, automation, LLM, RAG, agent, or multi-agent — and learns to defend why. Starts to recognize when the answer is a SQL query, not a vector database.
  • Contributes to architecture decisions. Learns to document trade-offs (ADRs), set success metrics, and raise concerns about scope that won’t deliver value.

The ideal candidate possesses a strong foundation in production machine learning, deep experience with cloud-native GenAI architectures (specifically on AWS), and a proven track record of working with sensitive healthcare data. You thrive in a high-impact, collaborative environment where you will design and deploy scalable AI-driven solutions that automate complex billing workflows, detect fraud, extract insight from unstructured claims, and power our next generation of AI products.

This role is eligible for a hybrid or remote work arrangement. Candidates located near the company office may be expected to work onsite up to 2 days per week. job.name: Agentic AI Engineer — Healthcare AI
job.description:
Three hundred fifty million Americans rely on a healthcare system whose decision-making has become slow, costly, and adversarial - care delayed by prior authorization and paperwork, claims that misfire, clinical decisions made without the right information at the right moment, and patients who struggle to navigate or afford the care they need. Deloitte has a new AI-first effort, backed by $1B in committed investment, building the reasoning models and agentic systems to rebuild how that system decides - across payers, providers, and life sciences, and for the patients they serve - so that care is faster, fairer, and far less wasteful. This is not AI applied at the margins. It is a ground-up rebuild of the decision-making machinery behind American healthcare, at national scale.

This is an early, well-funded build. You will own agent systems end to end - from architecture through production - and your work ships into live clinical and operational settings within your first months, not into a lab.

As an Agentic AI Engineer, you will design, build, and operationalize the LLM- and SLM-powered systems behind real healthcare decisioning - the reasoning, orchestration, retrieval, memory, and control layers that let intelligent agents operate reliably across the hardest decisions in the industry: clinical reasoning, prior authorization and claims integrity, care navigation, and the operational workflows that run across payers, providers, and life sciences. This is not a prompt-only role. We are looking for builders who think deeply about system behavior, grounding, and reliability where a wrong action has real consequences for patients and the clinicians who serve them.

You do not need a healthcare background. We pair every engineer with clinical and domain experts and teach you the domain - you bring the agentic engineering depth.

We hire on demonstrated depth, not years - the level you join at is determined through our interview process, based on the depth and judgment you demonstrate, not your years in a title.

Recruiting for this role ends on 1/29/2027.

Work you'll do

Agent architecture & orchestration

  • Design and implement agentic systems capable of multi-step reasoning, planning, tool use, and workflow execution against complex, regulated operational processes.
  • Build stateful workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain - including branching, retries, self-correction, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and reusable orchestration patterns.
  • Engineer for long-horizon reliability - multi-step task completion, recovery from compounding errors, planning under uncertainty, and robust tool use when individual steps fail.
  • Build the reasoning behind regulated decisions - policy- and criteria-grounded outputs, structured proposer/critic/judge-style review, and auditable rationales for high-stakes decisions across the industry, from clinical review and prior authorization to claims integrity and care management.

Read the full description

Summary Position Summary As a Senior Consultant – Qlik Engineer in the Analytics/Reporting team, you will combine deep hands-on Qlik expertise with leadership and delivery ownership. You will design, develop, enhance, and maintain scalable QlikView / Qlik Sense dashboards and analytical applications that support business decision-making, while leading initiatives and projects with minimal guidance. The role requires strong capability in dashboard development, Qlik data modeling, scripting, reload optimization, security implementation, production support, critical thinking, team leadership, project management, and stakeholder communication. You will guide team members, coordinate across business and technical teams, manage delivery priorities and risks, and provide clear progress reporting to stakeholders. Experience with Qlik Cloud and building dashboards using mashups is preferred; exposure to or knowledge of Qlik Answers and Qlik Predict will be an added advantage as the team expands its AI-enabled and advanced analytics capabilities within the Qlik ecosystem.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead Qlik initiatives and projects from requirements through deployment and support, working with minimal guidance and taking ownership of scope, priorities, timelines, risks, dependencies, and outcomes.

  • Gather and critically analyze business requirements and translate them into data models, KPIs, visualizations, measures, dimensions, and user-friendly reporting solutions.

Arise Tech Global is a technology and talent solutions company helping organizations build high-performing teams across enterprise technology, infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, and digital transformation.

job.name: Applied Scientist, International Seller Services
job.description:
Description Are you fascinated by the power of Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Large Language Models (LLM) to transform the way we interact with technology? Are you passionate about applying advanced machine learning techniques to solve complex challenges in the e-commerce space? If so, Amazon's International Seller Services team has an exciting opportunity for you as an Applied Scientist.

At Amazon, we strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they want to buy online. Our International Seller Services team plays a pivotal role in expanding the reach of our marketplace to sellers worldwide, ensuring customers have access to a vast selection of products.

As an Applied Scientist, you will join a talented and collaborative team that is dedicated to driving innovation and delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and sellers. You will be part of a global team that is focused on acquiring new merchants from around the world to sell on Amazon’s global marketplaces around the world. The position is based in Seattle but will interact with global leaders and teams in Europe, Japan, China, Australia, and other regions.

Join us at the Central Science Team of Amazon's International Seller Services and become part of a global team that is redefining the future of e-commerce. With access to vast amounts of data, emerging technology, and a diverse community of talented individuals, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the way sellers engage with our platform and customers worldwide. Together, we will drive innovation, solve complex problems, and shape the future of e-commerce.

Please visit https://www.amazon.science for more information

Key job responsibilities

Apply your expertise in LLM models to design, develop, and implement scalable machine learning solutions that address complex language-related challenges in the international seller services domain.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including software engineers, data scientists, and product managers, to define project requirements, establish success metrics, and deliver high-quality solutions.

Conduct thorough data analysis to gain insights, identify patterns, and drive actionable recommendations that enhance seller performance and customer experiences across various international marketplaces.

Continuously explore and evaluate state-of-the-art NLP techniques and methodologies to improve the accuracy and efficiency of language-related systems.

Communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, providing clear explanations and guidance on proposed solutions and their potential impact.

job.name: Workforce Management Lead
job.description:
Company Description Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed. Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere. Job Description More about our mission and what we offer .

The WFM Team Lead – Scheduling & Intraday leads the end-to-end tactical execution layer of Workforce Management, integrating schedule optimisation, weekly workforce steering, real-time operational control, and incident response under a single, cohesive leadership structure.

This role ensures that approved capacity strategies are translated into structurally sound, compliant schedules (0–30 day horizon), proactively adjusted through weekly tactical steering, and actively protected through disciplined intraday performance management.

Beyond operational oversight, the role operates as the Workforce Command Center lead — providing governance, decision control, and service protection during both stable and volatile operating conditions. It ensures workforce decisions are data-informed, risk-quantified, and aligned to service, productivity, and cost objectives.

As part of the WFM Centre of Excellence (CoE), the role is accountable for embedding standardised workforce governance, decision frameworks, incident protocols, and execution discipline across Scheduling and Intraday functions. It drives the transition from reactive workforce administration to structured, analytics-driven workforce control at scale.

This position closes the loop between Forecast → Capacity → Schedule → Intraday → Continuous Improvement, ensuring execution learnings systematically improve tactical and structural planning quality.

Key Responsibilities

job.name: Biostatistical Programming Manager
job.description:
HOW MIGHT YOU DEFY IMAGINATION? If you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. At Amgen, our shared mission—to serve patients—drives all that we do. It is key to our becoming one of the world’s leading biotechnology companies. We are global collaborators who achieve together—researching, manufacturing, and delivering ever-better products that reach over 10 million patients worldwide. It’s time for a career you can be proud of. Join us.

Biostatistical Programming Manager What You Will Do Let’s do this. Let’s change the world.

Amgen is expanding its Global Statistical Programming (GSP) capabilities, with Amgen India (AIN) playing a key role in supporting integrated delivery across regions. As a Biostatistical Programming Manager, you will serve as the Study Lead Programmer (SLP) for one or more studies and lead a team of statistical programmers to support all statistical programming activities within a study. You may also support regulatory submissions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead one, or more than one, study/project end to end and assume all the responsibilities of Study Lead Programmer
  • Set the programming strategy for the studies and projects and ensure timelines, quality, and compliance of all deliverables
  • Lead and manage specific programming tasks (e.g., all programming related activities of an integrated analysis that involves multiple studies for regulatory submissions) assigned to the team
  • Participate in establishing the programming scope for a deliverable with the statisticians and the study team
  • Participate in establishing detailed timelines that will ensure timely delivery of programming deliverables for a study or project
  • Create and maintain programming related specifications (e.g., SDTM and ADaM) for the studies/projects
  • Represent GSP at the Clinical Study Team (CST)
  • Attend meetings for, and provide programming input into, cross-functional study start-up activities, including but not limited to CRF development, database specifications review, database development, IVRS specification review, data quality check specifications
  • Initiate cross-functional team meetings as necessary
  • Perform significant hands-on statistical programming, particularly for those most challenging deliverables
  • Manage individual programmer work assignments to ensure timely, high-quality deliverables

job.name: Senior Data Engineer
job.description:
About Snaphomz

Snaphomz is an AI-powered real estate platform helping buyers, sellers, and agents navigate the home buying and selling journey in the US. We bring together property search, market insights, personalized recommendations, and transaction workflows to help people make informed decisions.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Data Engineer to own the pipelines and data infrastructure behind our platform. You will integrate property listings and third-party data, build reliable datasets, and make accurate, timely information available to our product, analytics, and AI systems.

This is a hands-on role with responsibility for architecture, implementation, production reliability, and mentoring.

What you’ll do

  • Design, build, and maintain batch and near-real-time pipelines for property listings, market data, user activity, and transaction workflows.
  • Integrate MLS feeds, real estate APIs, and other external sources, handling incremental updates, schema changes, rate limits, retries, and backfills.
  • Build consistent data models across properties, listings, agents, users, and transactions.
  • Implement validation, deduplication, address normalization, entity matching, and data reconciliation.
  • Track listing changes and maintain reliable historical records, including price changes, status updates, and removed listings.
  • Develop curated datasets for conversational property search, recommendations, affordability tools, and analytics.
  • Improve database performance, pipeline efficiency, and infrastructure costs.
  • Establish monitoring and alerts for pipeline failures, stale data, missing records, and unexpected volume changes.
  • Apply source-specific access, retention, and display requirements throughout the data lifecycle.
  • Work with backend engineers, data scientists, and product teams to define data contracts and deliver production-ready solutions.
  • Maintain documentation, deployment workflows, and incident runbooks; mentor other engineers.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience building and operating production data pipelines.
  • Strong Python and SQL skills, including query optimization and processing large datasets.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling, ETL/ELT, incremental ingestion, change data capture, and orchestration.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS data infrastructure, including S3 and relevant compute, messaging, or database services.
  • Strong experience with PostgreSQL and familiarity with document databases such as MongoDB.
  • Experience with an orchestration framework such as Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect.
  • Ability to design pipelines that recover safely from failures without duplicating or losing data.
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated data quality checks, and production monitoring.
  • Clear communication, sound engineering judgment, and ownership from design through ongoing support.

Nice to have

P-1403

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems - from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business.

Ingesting data into the Lakehouse is a strategic area of investment for Databricks and a key enabler for Data and AI workflows. Lakeflow Connect is looking to solve this problem by providing ready-to-use, point-and-click connectors for a wide variety of sources, including enterprise applications (like Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, SharePoint), databases (e.g., SQL Server), cloud storage, message queues, and local files.

In addition to being an important part of Lakeflow and Data Engineering, Connect is also a key platform capability. Every surface in Databricks (Dashboards, Notebooks, SQL, AI) requires ingestion capabilities and the lead for this role will need to work closely with other products to embed Connect into these surfaces.

We are looking for engineers with experience in core Database internals to join our Lakeflow Connect team. A key part of Connect is to extract data from OLTP systems while imposing minimal load on production systems. To do this efficiently we are building systems that use techniques such as incremental data capture, log parsing, etc. We are looking for engineers who continue to be hands on and are looking to make a large impact on an important problem for the company.

The Impact You Will Have

  • Solve real business needs at large scale by applying your software engineering.
  • Deliver a highly scalable, available, and fault-tolerant engine processing hundreds of TB of data daily across thousands of customers
  • Low level systems debugging, performance measurement & optimization on large production clusters.

job.description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

Position Summary Build Distributed Systems at Global Scale — Join Harness Feature Management & Experimentation (FME) Last year, the Harness FME platform evaluated 4 trillion feature flags . For most people, that’s just an impressive number. For a scale-minded builder and engineering leader, it represents one of the most demanding challenges in distributed systems.

To Power This Scale, We’ve Built

  • Massive global concurrency supporting millions of real-time decisions.
  • Millisecond-level latency through a globally distributed feature flag delivery network.
  • Tier-one enterprise reliability trusted by the world’s most sophisticated companies.

About The Role

  • Design and develop scalable backend services using Java/Golang
  • Architect and maintain distributed microservices-based systems.
  • Build reliable APIs and internal platform services using REST(gorilla.mux, alice.chains) and gRPC.
  • Optimize system performance across compute, memory, storage, and networking layers.
  • Work with PostgreSQL, Redis, S3, and AWS cloud infrastructure.
  • Deploy and manage cloud-native applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Troubleshoot complex production and infrastructure-level issues.
  • Drive engineering best practices, code quality, and system reliability.
  • Mentor engineers and contribute to technical leadership across teams.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to deliver scalable and resilient solutions.

SPIRE Lab (https://spire.ee.iisc.ac.in/), Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bengaluru · Full-time at IISc · 5+ years of experience

About Social Listening

SPIRE Lab at IISc is hiring a senior individual contributor to build the AI, data and evaluation backbone of a two-year, Gates Foundation-funded research programme in rural Bihar.

The programme asks a simple question: can voice AI help a state government genuinely listen to rural women? Women in self-help groups (Didis) have views on livelihoods, nutrition and local services, but little of it reaches decision makers in a usable form.

In partnership with the Bihar Rural Livelihoods Promotion Society (BRLPS / JEEViKA), we will build and field-test a voice AI system that lets SHG women and field cadres ask questions, share feedback and raise grievances over basic and shared phones, in Hindi, Bhojpuri and Magahi. A sense-making layer turns those calls into structured insights JEEViKA can act on. Alongside it, we will build an open evaluation sandbox that tests how voice AI actually performs in the field, with rural accents and real phone lines, rather than only in the lab. The baseline solution, evaluation framework and technical guidelines are intended to be published so other programmes can reuse them.

A field implementation partner will run the voice platform and field operations under IISc's technical oversight. This role owns the AI, data and evaluation work on the IISc side.

Gender-intentional design runs through the work.

About the team

You will work inside SPIRE Lab as a senior individual contributor. You set technical direction through the quality of your work, not by managing a team.

You will sit with speech and AI researchers at IISc, work closely with the Head of Program and a Program Manager who owns operations and partner coordination, and collaborate with government, civil society and research partners on field operations, data governance and evaluation.

About IISc / SPIRE Lab

The Signal Processing, Interpretation and REpresentation Laboratory (SPIRE Lab) is part of the Department of Electrical Engineering at the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bengaluru. Founded in May 2015 and directed by Dr. Prasanta Kumar Ghosh, the lab works on signal processing, speech processing, representation learning and machine learning, with a focus on human-centred signals such as speech and audio.

The lab publishes widely, works with government, industry and civil society partners, and is releasing public datasets for Indian accents and languages. It is also a pioneer of speech datasets for Indian languages, having began work on datasets in 2020, followed by founding Project Vaani in collaboration with Google Deepmind in 2023. It actively works on speech datasets, model development and model evaluations, apart from smaller projects focussed on atypical speech.

This role is an IISc position within SPIRE Lab.

job.name: Senior Staff AI Scientist / Engineer – Oncology Foundation Models & Agentic Platforms
job.description:
Passionate about precision medicine and advancing the healthcare industry? Recent advancements in underlying technology have finally made it possible for AI to impact clinical care in a meaningful way. Tempus' proprietary platform connects an entire ecosystem of real-world evidence to deliver real-time, actionable insights to physicians, providing critical information about the right treatments for the right patients, at the right time.

We are seeking an exceptional AI Scientist/Engineer to bridge two cutting-edge domains in medical AI: Oncology Foundation Models and Agentic Systems . In this role, you will design and train domain-specific foundation models on complex, multimodal cancer datasets (genomics, histopathology, longitudinal EHRs, and clinical imaging) while simultaneously building agentic workflows that orchestrate these models.

By integrating foundation models with agentic frameworks, you will help create intelligent clinical tools capable of dynamic reasoning, multi-step evidence synthesis, and complex decision support in oncology.

Core Responsibilities

  • Oncology Foundation Model Development
  • Design, train, and fine-tune large-scale multimodal foundation models specialized in oncology (e.g., integrating spatial transcriptomics, whole-slide images, and clinical histories).
  • Implement pre-training strategies tailored to bio-medical domains, including self-supervised learning (SSL), contrastive learning, and masked token prediction.
  • Evaluate model robustness, generalization, and domain shift across diverse patient cohorts, tumor types, and sequencing platforms.
  • Agentic Platform Engineering
  • Architect scalable agentic frameworks (e.g., tool-use, multi-agent communication, autonomous planning, and retrieval-augmented generation) tailored for clinical workflows.
  • Design safety guards, reasoning trace verification, and human-in-the-loop interventions for AI agents operating in high-stakes medical settings.
  • Integrate agentic systems with external biological knowledge bases, literature databases (PubMed, clinical trials), and EHR interfaces.
  • Connecting Models & Agents (The Synergy)
  • Expose specialized oncology foundation models as core tools/capabilities within the agentic platform, enabling agents to dynamically invoke multi-omic analysis tools.
  • Develop agent-driven workflows that use foundation models to summarize complex patient trajectories, propose biomarker-driven treatment hypotheses, or query trial eligibility.
  • Optimize end-to-end latency, reasoning chains, and output interpretability for clinical and scientific research end-users.

About Edra Edra is solving one of the hardest problems in enterprise AI: AI models are generic but company processes are specific. We build AI agents that learn how processes actually run, and then run their operations.

We're a Series A startup, backed by Sequoia and other leading VC firms, led by Co-Founders who created and led Forward Deployed AI Engineering at Palantir, and we're growing our team in New York and London. We're a deeply technical team of engineers, AI researchers, and strategists with a high bar for talent and a shared belief that exceptional people are the foundation of everything great we'll build.

The Role We're building a learning system that teaches AI agents how enterprises actually work. Our system starts from what a customer already has: knowledge base articles, support conversations, tickets, system logs, and agent traces. From that evidence it reverse-engineers how the business actually runs and writes the process down as instructions a person can inspect and an agent can execute, with confidence scoring to know when to automate and when to seek human input.

We're looking for AI Research Engineers who have built complex, production LLM-based systems. Whether you've scaled LLM workflows handling millions of requests, built multi-agent systems in production, or designed evaluation frameworks for enterprise deployments, we want people who bring intensity and self-direction to their craft. You'll work on our agentic learning environment: the loops that turn human corrections and agent outcomes into better knowledge and instructions over time. The job combines applied research with ownership of production systems. You find a failure, form a hypothesis, run the experiment, and ship the fix into real customer workflows.

You'll spend most of your time advancing our core context-learning library and the harness that powers our agents across every customer. The work spans continuous learning, context engineering, agent orchestration, and evaluation. You'll contribute to our knowledge benchmarks and to the self-improving capabilities of the harness.

What You'll Do

  • Build and extend our core context-learning library, turning customer-informed problems into reusable platform capabilities.
  • Design and implement LLM-powered systems and agentic workflows from concept to production.
  • Build agentic features for knowledge management: agents that can edit, update, and maintain large knowledge bases autonomously.
  • Build continuous learning loops that use human corrections and production outcomes to find knowledge gaps, detect changed procedures, and improve prompts and instructions.
  • Build reliability and confidence systems: evaluation frameworks, confidence scoring, and logic for when to automate and when to escalate to a human.
  • Architect async, scalable systems that handle complex AI orchestration.
  • Contribute to the direction of our AI strategy and product capabilities.

job.name: Senior / Staff Software Engineer — AI / ML
job.description:
About Snorkel Snorkel AI is the frontier AI data lab, helping teams build the data and environments behind high-performing frontier and agentic AI. We combine technology with research-driven AI data development to create datasets, benchmarks, evals, and custom solutions for real-world AI systems. Founded out of the Stanford AI Lab in 2019, Snorkel works with leading AI labs and enterprises to move from better data to better outcomes.

Excited to help us redefine how AI is built? Apply to be the newest Snorkeler!

In September 2026 we raised a $350 million Series E at a $3.5 billion valuation , and we are scaling our engineering and research teams to meet demand.

The role

Frontier AI data is expensive to make and hard to measure. Every task we deliver is tested against the strongest models, often through many long-running agent rollouts. Your job is to make that process faster, cheaper, and more rigorous with ML and AI

You will be one of the early members of ML & Research Engineering at Snorkel. You will study how frontier-grade data is generated and evaluated, form hypotheses, validate them against real production data, and ship the winners at scale. You will shape the discipline's direction, its standards, and the team that grows around it.

What you'll work on

  • Efficient agentic evals. Cut the cost of long-horizon agent evaluation with adaptive sampling, statistically grounded early stopping, model cascades, caching, and cheap-first gating.
  • AI model routing. Route every eval and judge call to the cheapest model that clears the quality bar, with fallback, monitoring, and cost attribution.
  • Fine-tuned small models. Fine-tune and serve open-weight models (LoRA and other parameter-efficient methods) where they match frontier quality, and know when they don't.
  • Predictive difficulty. Build models that estimate how hard a task is for frontier systems before running a single rollout.
  • Measurement for AI data. Build golden datasets, quantify the accuracy and calibration of LLM-as-judge systems, and make quality reproducible across projects.
  • Research to production. Turn research prototypes into reusable, configurable components that forward deployed engineers and researchers use on every project.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years building production ML or software systems, with end-to-end ownership from prototype to production
  • Hands-on experience running LLM or ML workloads in production, and comfort reasoning about non-deterministic systems
  • Deep grounding in statistics and experimentation: experiment design, hypothesis testing, sampling, and confidence intervals
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals, including testing, code review, and system design
  • Experience designing evaluations and interpreting results rigorously
  • A habit of finding high-impact problems before they are assigned, and clear communication with researchers, engineers, and business partners

Nice to have

As a GenAI Python Systems Engineer – Senior Manager, you will design and deliver Python-based generative AI systems for clients within our Advisory practice, helping move AI solutions from experimentation into production. In this role, you will shape AI and machine learning systems that turn data into actionable insights and support intelligent automation. Working with data and cloud engineering teams, you will apply retrieval, model evaluation, tool orchestration, and monitoring practices to build systems that can be tested, observed, and refined after launch. This work connects technical design with practical changes in how clients operate.

As a Senior Manager, you will lead complex engineering engagements and serve as a strategic advisor to senior client stakeholders, translating technical choices into clear business implications. You will draw on your influence and specialist skills to challenge assumptions, incorporate client feedback, and guide decisions through uncertain delivery issues, recognizing when to act and when to escalate. By coaching diverse teams through candid conversations and thoughtful delegation, you will develop their capabilities while improving engineering processes and maintaining operational excellence. You will model professional standards and sound judgment as teams bring AI systems into use.

Responsibilities

  • Leading client-facing generative AI engineering projects from solution architecture through production deployment, aligning Python-based systems with business processes, data requirements, and measurable automation outcomes
  • Designing AI and machine learning pipelines that transform complex data into actionable insights, using Python and scikit-learn to build and refine models
  • Developing natural language processing applications with hybrid retrieval, reranking, structured memory, context compaction, and prompt caching to improve the relevance of model responses
  • Directing agentic system design across tool orchestration, permissioning, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, guardrails, and tracing to support controlled automation in client environments
  • Guiding model adaptation and evaluation using supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, benchmarks, calibrated model-based scoring, and human review to assess performance against use cases
  • Selecting and integrating generative AI platforms and Model Context Protocol interfaces based on cloud footprint, governance needs, workload fit, and portability requirements
  • Establishing LLMOps and AgentOps practices for testing, monitoring, and iterative improvement after launch, addressing system performance and implementation issues across client deployments
  • Translating technical findings into recommendations and delivery roadmaps for client stakeholders, incorporating their feedback into architecture decisions and coordinating implementation across engineering teams

What You Must Have

job.name: Job Posting Title MS Engineer VC Support- L1
job.description:
Make an impact with NTT DATA Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

Your day at NTT DATA As a Collaboration Managed Services Engineer (L1) at NTT DATA, you will be the go-to person for ensuring our clients' Collaboration, Contact Centre and Voice systems stay up and running. Your main focus will be on providing first-line support by monitoring private and public cloud infrastructure, identifying problems early, and resolving technical incidents efficiently. You'll play a crucial role in ensuring we meet our service level agreements and deliver an excellent client experience.

Throughout the day you’ll be monitoring client infrastructure for any issues and proactively addressing them before they escalate. If incidents occur, you'll investigate and get to the root cause swiftly to restore services. Your tasks will also include executing approved maintenance activities like patching and configuration changes and providing telephonic or chat support to clients when needed.

Your role doesn't stop at issue resolution; you'll also be identifying opportunities to optimize work processes and reduce incidents. Whether it's updating existing knowledge articles, creating new ones, or finding ways to automate routine tasks, you'll actively contribute to enhancing service delivery. Your ability to adapt to changing circumstances and keep a positive outlook will be key to your success.

Effective communication is essential in this role. You'll collaborate across different cultures and social groups, plan activities comprehensively, and ensure smooth handovers during shift changes. Your commitment to placing clients at the forefront of all interactions will help create a positive client experience throughout their journey with us.

To thrive in this role, you need to have:

  • Basic troubleshooting skills and knowledge in network, voice, collaboration, and contact centre services.
  • The ability to triage client cases effectively, ensuring that severity and impact is accurate as well as key information is documented in the case.
  • Active listening techniques to confirm understanding and gather relevant information.
  • Strong communication skills, able to work across different cultures and social groups.
  • Flexibility and adaptability in changing circumstances.
  • Positive outlook and resilience under pressure.
  • Commitment to creating a positive client experience by understanding their requirements and keeping them clearly updated on progress of their case.
  • Willingness to put in extra hours when necessary.
  • Diploma, bachelor's degree, or relevant qualification in Information Technology or Computing (or equivalent experience).
  • Relevant partner Certifications are also desirable.

job.description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You’ll Be Doing... Type of Work: Highly technical, code-driven, and execution-focused. The daily focus is on accelerating the pre-sales cycle by building automated demo labs, scripting repetitive sales engineering tasks (like BOM generation and RFP parsing), and showcasing network automation capabilities to enterprise customers.

Expected Volumes: High volume of scripting, API integration, and lab management. You will maintain internal code repositories, write Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates, manage automated demonstration portals, and execute high-speed Proof of Concepts (PoCs) concurrently.

Risk & Criticality: Moderate commercial risk. You are the technical automation engine for the team. While senior architects design the overarching telecom solutions, your code directly dictates how fast and effectively those solutions can be demonstrated and quoted. Broken scripts or failed API calls during a live demo can derail customer confidence and stall the sales cycle.

What We’re Looking For...

  • Pre-Sales Workflow Automation: Write scripts to eliminate manual pre-sales bottlenecks. Automate the generation of Bill of Materials (BOMs) by querying CPQ APIs, automate network diagramming, and use data parsing to accelerate RFP/RFI responses.
  • Zero-Touch Provisioning (ZTP) Demonstrations: Build and maintain the scripts used in live customer pitches. You will help senior architects show (not just tell) customers how easily our telecom network can be provisioned and managed via APIs.
  • API & Systems Integration: Serve as the team's API expert. Connect disparate pre-sales tools (e.g., Salesforce, CPQ, vendor portals, and internal lab hypervisors) to create a seamless, automated workflow for the Solutions Architecture team.
  • NetDevOps Handoff: Revolutionize the pre-sales-to-delivery handoff. Instead of handing over Word documents, package your successful solution design as Git repositories, JSON payloads, and Ansible playbooks for the Implementation team to deploy instantly.
  • Foundational Network Support: Understand the basics of the telecom and networking equipment you are automating (IP addressing, routing basics, firewalls) just enough to successfully write the code that provisions them.

You’ll Need To Have

job.name: Powertrain Calibration Engineer
job.description:
The Calibration Engineer is responsible for developing the optimal engine calibration to meet drivability metrics along with ensuring optimal emissions and fuel economy. The engineer is responsible for the calibration maturity and development of sub features resulting in an overall optimal propulsion system. This spans the entirety of the lifecycle of development through conceptual phase, strategy development, calibration execution to subsystem and vehicle level validation including robustness evaluations. The responsibilities will be carried out across all different types of propulsion system concepts and will include varying levels of electrification. The work will coincide with a team of calibration engineers and functions to deliver system level functional objectives mainly related to emissions compliance.

The engineer will plan and coordinate daily activities of propulsion dynos and vehicle related testing which may include collaboration with technicians and laboratory support engineers. In addition, test plans and timelines will be developed and executed with reports generated to communicate status of the program to larger development and management teams.

*Basic Qualifications:*

  • Bachelor of Science in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science or equivalent technical degree from an ABET accredited University
  • 5+ years of experience in propulsion system development in software, calibration, and/or hardware
  • Motivated individual and available to travel (4 to 5 overnight trips a year)
  • Basic knowledge of internal combustion engine, including combustion, fueling, aftertreatment
  • Strong written/verbal communication and ability to document test results
  • Ability to collect and summarize data, analyze and present findings in a technical setting

*Preferred Qualifications:*

  • Experience and overall knowledge of internal combustion and/or electrified powertrain principals
  • Data acquisition experience collecting and processing data
  • Strong understanding of emissions-related testing and development processes.
  • Experience with calibration/data-analysis tools such as ETAS INCA, CAN tools, MATLAB/Simulink
  • Familiarity with structured calibration-release processes, including calibration maturity, validation, DVP&R, calibration guides

Job Description The Lead Specialist, Standards and Strategic Initiatives works with center and functional teams to understand how work is performed today, remove unnecessary steps, improve flow, and establish practical standards that can be used consistently across the network.

The position also helps turn new Supply Chain initiatives into clear, repeatable ways of working. Working across Continuous Improvement, operations, training, technology, project teams, and functional owners, the Lead Specialist supports initiatives from early design through rollout and sustainment while ensuring processes are documented, scalable, and supported by clear ownership and measures.

What You’ll Do Supply Chain Center Process Playbook

  • Build and maintain a practical playbook for Supply Chain Center processes.
  • Document current processes through direct observation, center input, process mapping, and review of existing standards.
  • Analyze process steps, handoffs, controls, and variation to identify opportunities to simplify work, reduce waste, and improve flow.
  • Partner with operators, center leaders, subject matter experts, and functional owners to design improved future-state processes.
  • Standardize the strongest proven methods across centers while accounting for valid operational, regulatory, and facility differences.
  • Create the supporting standard work, process maps, job aids, measures, ownership, and review cadence needed to sustain each process.
  • Use center feedback and performance results to refine the playbook as equipment, systems, and business needs change.

Strategic Initiative Support

  • Partner with initiative owners to understand the business need, scope, expected outcomes, and impact on Supply Chain.
  • Coordinate the operational work required to move new initiatives from design through pilot, rollout, and sustainment.
  • Build and maintain implementation plans that identify milestones, decisions, risks, dependencies, and owners.
  • Bring the right partners together to resolve gaps in process, training, systems, labor, communication, or center readiness.
  • Support pilots and early launches, capture lessons learned, and apply improvements before broader deployment.

Standards Development and Integration

  • Translate new initiatives into clear standards, standard work, process maps, job aids, readiness tools, and operating routines.
  • Work with subject matter experts and standards owners to draft, review, approve, and publish process documentation.
  • Confirm that new processes align with existing Supply Chain standards and do not create unnecessary variation or duplicate work.
  • Coordinate updates across SOPs, Leader Standard Work, training materials, and enterprise knowledge platforms.
  • Establish ownership and review expectations so standards remain accurate after implementation.

Job Description Senior AI Transformation Consultant, Professional Services Focus: AI Transformation Services for CoCounsel and Thomson Reuters solutions Giving a legal, tax, or trade team access to AI is the easy part. The real work is changing how the work gets done — and proving it made a difference.

As a Senior AI Transformation Consultant, you will lead that work hands on: finding the workflows worth changing, designing how they should run with AI, getting people to genuinely use them, and measuring what it delivers - with CoCounsel Legal and CoCounsel for Tax and Trade at the center. You’ll work embedded with client teams, alongside Sales, our AI engineers, enablement specialists, and product teams, from the first client conversation through rollout and measured value.

Key Responsibilities In this opportunity as Senior AI Transformation Consultant, Professional Services, you will:

  • Independently lead defined transformation engagements or bounded workstreams across the lifecycle, managing plans, workstreams, and client communication.
  • Conduct targeted discovery through interviews, workshops, surveys, usage information, and operational measures; synthesize clear diagnoses, priority workflows, and next-step decisions.
  • Map current and future-state workflows and develop practical, scoped plans for targeted changes, activation, adoption, risks, dependencies, and success measures.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a skilled and competent Drone Hardware Security Specialist to ensure the robust security of our unmanned aerial systems (UAS) and associated infrastructure. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying vulnerabilities in drone hardware, software, and communication protocols by performing real-world cyberattacks and proposing effective mitigation strategies.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Perform comprehensive vulnerability assessments and penetration testing on drone hardware, firmware, software, and ground control systems.
  • Identify Vulnerabilities by using ethical hacking techniques to discover weaknesses, including those related to physical tampering, unauthorized access, communication interception (RF analysis), and data exfiltration.
  • Assess the security of wireless communication links (e.g., proprietary RF, Wi-Fi, Cellular) between UAV to UAV, UAV to GCS and UAV to RC to prevent jamming, interception, or unauthorized control.
  • Evaluate the physical components of drones for vulnerabilities, focusing on tamper-proofing, secure boot mechanisms, and data storage security on onboard systems.
  • Collaborate with the drone team to design and implement robust security architectures and recommend hardware enhancements to address identified flaws.
  • Ensure Compliance by verifying that drone operations and systems adhere to relevant industry standards, government regulations, and safety protocols. Also, stay current with the latest hacking methodologies related to UAVs.

job.name: Windows System Administrator
job.description:
Windows Administrator Immediate Joining with Experience 2–4 Years

The candidate will be responsible for day-to-day IT infrastructure operations, endpoint management, security administration, and end-user technical support at the Noida office.

The scope of work includes:

1. Windows Administration: Installation, configuration, troubleshooting, patch management, and maintenance of Windows 10/11 laptops and desktops.

2. Microsoft 365 Administration: User account creation, license assignment, mailbox support, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Outlook troubleshooting.

3. Microsoft Entra ID: User and group management, device joining, access permissions, MFA, and account lifecycle management.

4. Endpoint Management: Laptop provisioning, imaging, deployment, MDM enrollment, configuration profiles, and compliance monitoring through SureMDM.

5. Endpoint Security: Deployment, monitoring, and troubleshooting of Seqrite EPP/EDR and endpoint security policies.

6. Data Loss Prevention: Administration and monitoring of Safetica DLP policies to prevent unauthorized data transfers and information leakage.

7. Network & Connectivity Support: Troubleshooting LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, DNS, DHCP, printers, and internet connectivity.

8. IT Asset Management: Hardware inventory, asset allocation, tracking, warranty management, and employee onboarding/offboarding.

9. Linux & macOS Support: Basic installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and user support for Linux and macOS systems.

10. Backup & Recovery: End-user data backup, restoration, and recovery support.

11. IT Compliance & Documentation: Maintaining IT SOPs, asset registers, security compliance records, audit evidence, and technical documentation.

12. Vendor Coordination: Coordinating with hardware, software, and IT service providers for support, renewals, and warranty claims.

Overall Expectation: The candidate should independently handle daily IT operations, ensure endpoint security and compliance, resolve employee IT issues, and maintain a stable and secure IT environment.

job.name: Software Engineering, Team Manager
job.description:
Job Title - Software Engineering, Team Manager

Description - Lead engineering teams that support critical assessment services, with two opportunities across Vue Testing Services and Test Delivery in India. You will combine people leadership, delivery oversight, technical judgement and responsible AI adoption to strengthen team performance and customer outcomes. Also known in the market as: Engineering Manager; Software Development Manager; Technology Manager; Software Engineering People Manager.

About the Role

Pearson is hiring two Software Engineering Team Managers in India through one recruitment campaign. The roles share a common leadership profile but support different product areas: Vue Testing Services (VTS) and Test Delivery.

VTS supports services around a candidate’s assessment journey, including registration, payment and score reporting. Test Delivery powers the delivery of assessments in test centres and online, in a high-volume environment where quality, reliability and operational readiness matter.

In either opportunity, you will lead through clarity, coaching, accountability and partnership. You will translate priorities into achievable plans, strengthen engineering and delivery practices, develop people, manage risk and help teams adopt AI-assisted development responsibly. This is a management role with minimal hands-on coding expected.

What You’ll Do

  • Hire, onboard, coach, develop and retain engineers and technical professionals.
  • Set clear goals, feedback rhythms, development plans and team operating practices.
  • Translate product and department priorities into achievable team plans, capacity choices and ownership.
  • Track sprint and release progress, dependencies, blockers, defects, quality and immediate delivery risks.
  • Partner with Product, Architecture, Quality Engineering, DevOps, Security, Operations and business stakeholders.
  • Maintain strong standards for design, testing, automation, security, observability, documentation and operational readiness.
  • Use engineering, delivery, quality and team signals to identify patterns and drive improvement.
  • Guide deliberate adoption of AI-assisted development, testing, review and documentation while protecting quality and security.

What We’re Looking For

  • A hands-on technical foundation in software engineering, quality engineering, architecture, technology solutions or a closely related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience leading, coaching or managing technical professionals and building effective teams.
  • Experience delivering software products, platforms or technology services in Agile or similarly iterative environments.
  • Evidence of leading meaningful change, making sound decisions and improving delivery or team effectiveness.
  • Working knowledge of modern software delivery, cloud, DevOps, CI/CD, automation, security, reliability, observability and operational readiness.

Read the full description

job.description:
Introduction A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities As a Data Engineer specializing in Data Platforms on AWS, you will advise on, develop, and maintain data engineering solutions on the AWS Cloud ecosystem. You will design, build, and operate batch and real-time data pipelines using various AWS services.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Design and Develop Data Pipelines: Design, build, and operate batch and real-time data pipelines using AWS services such as AWS EMR, AWS Glue, Glue Catalog, and Kinesis, ensuring seamless integration and operation of data engineering solutions.
  • Create Data Layers: Create data layers on AWS RedShift, Aurora, and DynamoDB, and migrate data using AWS DMS.

  • Develop Batch and Real-time Pipelines: Develop batch and real-time data pipelines for Data Warehouse and Datalake, utilizing AWS Kinesis and Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka.
  • Utilize Open Source Technologies: Utilize open source technologies like Apache Airflow and dbt, Spark / Python or Spark / Scala on AWS Platform to support data engineering solutions.

Preferred Education Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Exposure to AWS Toolset: Experience working with AWS services such as AWS EMR, AWS Glue, Glue Catalog, and Kinesis to design, build, and operate batch and real-time data pipelines.
  • Data Pipeline Development: Exposure to developing batch and real-time data pipelines for Data Warehouse and Datalake, utilizing AWS Kinesis and Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka.
  • Data Layer Creation: Experience working with AWS RedShift, Aurora, and DynamoDB to create data layers and migrate data using AWS DMS.
  • Open Source Technologies: Exposure to utilizing open source technologies like Apache Airflow and dbt, Spark / Python or Spark / Scala on AWS Platform to support data engineering solutions.
  • Data Service Management: Experience scheduling and managing data services on the AWS Platform, ensuring efficient operation of data engineering solutions.

job.description:
Job Description Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast paced and challenging area? This is a unique opportunity for you to work in our team to partner with the business to provide a comprehensive view.

As an Executive Director in model risk governance and review within International Consumer Banking, you will serve as the review lead and be accountable for independent model reviews and model governance. You will be accountable to the International Consumer Banking Model Risk Officer for these independent reviews and governance activities. You will also serve as the Consumer and Community Banking and International Consumer Banking India lead, accountable to the line of business head. You will work with senior business, model development, and risk partners.

Job Responsibilities

  • Lead as review lead for International Consumer Banking and be accountable for the quality, consistency, and timeliness of independent model reviews.
  • Set review priorities, allocate reviews, and approve review findings and conclusions covering conceptual soundness, assumptions, inputs, testing, and implementation; personally lead the most complex or high-risk reviews.
  • Discuss findings and required actions with model owners and senior stakeholders, and resolve differences on review conclusions.
  • Oversee the review of proposed enhancements to existing models and extensions of model scope, and provide approvals as required.
  • Oversee the assessment of risks from advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning models, including generative artificial intelligence and agentic artificial intelligence, and ensure required model review and governance processes are followed.
  • Oversee model risk lifecycle activities, including model inventory accuracy, ongoing performance monitoring, annual status assessments, and model change control; ensure these activities are completed accurately and on time.
  • Maintain robust model risk controls for International Consumer Banking models and serve as the primary point of contact; proactively identify and escalate issues to ensure resolutions are sound and timely.
  • Serve as the Consumer and Community Banking and International Consumer Banking India lead, accountable to the line of business head.
  • Prioritize training and career development for team members; coach and mentor staff at all levels, set clear expectations, and give regular feedback.
  • Contribute to model risk governance and review priorities and initiatives.
  • Stay informed about changes in consumer banking, artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques (including generative artificial intelligence and agentic artificial intelligence), products, markets, models, risk practices, and industry standards; use this knowledge to guide review priorities and identify emerging risks.

job.name: QA & Release Engineer Lead
job.description:
Role summary

The QA & Release Engineer Lead owns quality engineering and release governance across web, API, data, AI, integration and cloud-platform workstreams. You will define a risk-based test strategy, build the automation architecture, and run the release controls that make production outcomes predictable, secure and auditable.

You will coordinate teams, environments, defects, dependencies and approvals from sprint planning through post-release validation, acting as the single point of accountability for go/no-go decisions.

Duties and responsibilities

Quality strategy and governance

  • Define the quality strategy, quality gates, entry and exit criteria, and release policy for each engagement.
  • Apply risk-based prioritisation so test effort tracks business and compliance impact.
  • Maintain auditable test evidence that satisfies enterprise and public-sector assurance requirements.

Testing leadership

  • Lead functional, integration, regression, performance, security and resilience testing.
  • Define approaches for testing data pipelines and AI-enabled features, including model evaluation and non-deterministic outputs.

Automation

  • Establish UI, API, contract and pipeline automation frameworks.
  • Embed automated quality gates in CI/CD pipelines.

Environments and releases

  • Plan environments, test data, deployment checks and rollback validation.
  • Chair defect triage and release-readiness reviews; own the go/no-go recommendation.
  • Run post-release validation and feed lessons back into the strategy.

People and reporting

  • Track and report quality metrics to delivery leads and client stakeholders.
  • Mentor QA engineers and raise automation capability across the team.

Skills and abilities

  • Quality-engineering and release-management leadership on enterprise platforms.
  • Automation leadership across UI, API, integration and performance testing.
  • CI/CD quality gates, environment management and deployment governance.
  • Hands-on experience testing cloud-native, data-pipeline and AI-enabled solutions.
  • Working knowledge of model evaluation and non-deterministic testing techniques.
  • Strong risk management, metrics, audit-evidence and stakeholder-management skills.

Qualifications and background

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a directly relevant discipline.
  • 8+ years of directly relevant professional experience.
  • Demonstrated delivery in complex enterprise or public-sector environments.
  • Relevant professional or technology certifications preferred (for example ISTQB Advanced/Test Manager, Azure or AWS, ITIL).

Preferred tools and soft skills

Tools

  • GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot or equivalent enterprise-approved AI tools for coding, testing, documentation and analysis, with mandatory human validation.

EY GDS | PRINCIPAL DATA SCIENTIST Oil & Gas | Senior Manager Job Title Principal Data Scientist – Senior Manager Experience Level 15+ Years Job Description At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. Role Details Key responsibilities include :

Scientific formulation and advanced modelling

  • Formulate operational problems as predictive, diagnostic, causal, or prescriptive tasks, defining targets, objective functions, constraints, decision variables, acceptance criteria, and evaluation methods.
  • Assess data sufficiency, measurement quality, sampling bias, confounding, identifiability, and operating coverage to determine whether available evidence supports the intended outcome.
  • Select statistical, machine learning, simulation, or hybrid approaches suited to noisy measurements, heterogeneous assets, sparse labels, rare events, censored histories, and distribution shifts.
  • Apply probabilistic or hierarchical modelling, uncertainty quantification, survival analysis, semi-supervised learning, transfer learning, or domain adaptation where appropriate.
  • Develop methods for multivariate forecasting, state estimation, change detection, degradation modelling, and industrial time-series analysis while distinguishing process dynamics from measurement artefacts.
  • Combine learned models with engineering equations, mass and energy balances, simulation outputs, or physical constraints, evaluating accuracy, plausibility, extrapolation behaviour, and uncertainty propagation.
  • Connect predictions with constrained optimization, assessing feasibility, sensitivity, robustness, and decision quality under uncertainty; design experiments or causal analyses when observational evidence is insufficient.

  • We are looking for a hands-on Ecommerce Executive to scale our presence across marketplaces, quick commerce platforms, and our D2C website.

Marketplace Operations

Quick Commerce Operations

Customer Feedback & Experience Funnel

  • Build a structured customer feedback loop across marketplace and D2C orders

Platform Partnerships

  • Work closely with marketplace and quick commerce account managers

Data & Performance

  • Track and publish dashboards covering sales, availability, stock health, cancellations, and returns

What Success Looks Like

  • High product availability across marketplaces and quick commerce platforms

  • Strong customer experience and feedback loop across D2C and marketplace channels

We are looking for a result-oriented SEO Executive who can improve our online visibility, drive organic traffic, and strengthen our search presence across traditional search engines and AI-powered search platforms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic search rankings and website visibility.
  • Perform keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.
  • Manage on-page SEO, including meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, and content optimization.
  • Work on technical SEO, including website audits, indexing, crawlability, sitemap optimization, and Core Web Vitals.
  • Optimize website content for SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization).
  • Identify opportunities to improve visibility in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, and other AI-powered search platforms.
  • Monitor website performance using Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and other SEO tools.
  • Conduct backlink analysis and implement ethical link-building strategies.
  • Coordinate with content writers and developers to implement SEO recommendations.
  • Track keyword rankings, organic traffic, conversions, and prepare regular performance reports.

AI Tools & Technology Requirements

  • Hands-on experience with ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or similar AI tools for keyword research, content optimization, SEO analysis, and content planning.
  • Ability to use AI tools effectively for SEO research, content briefs, competitor analysis, and workflow automation.
  • Familiarity with SEO tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, Ubersuggest, Screaming Frog, or similar platforms.
  • Knowledge of AI-driven search trends, AEO, GEO, and LLM optimization is an advantage.

Required Skills

  • 1–2 years of practical experience in SEO.
  • Good understanding of on-page, off-page, and technical SEO.
  • Strong English writing, reading, and comprehension skills.
  • Ability to write, edit, and optimize website content in grammatically correct English.
  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to research independently and stay updated with SEO trends.
  • Good communication and coordination skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, IT, Communications, or a related field.
  • Experience working on international and B2B websites will be an advantage.
  • Basic understanding of HTML, WordPress, and website architecture.

Ensure complete statutory compliance under GST, Income Tax, and the Companies Act through rigorous reconciliations, internal audit, and timely filings. Transaction Coding

Bank Reconciliation

GST Reconciliation & Returns

Inventory Accounting & Valuation

Fixed Asset Management

Variance Analysis

Cost Control and Savings operational efficiency.

Team Leadership and Development

Training & Knowledge Sharing

SOP Development & Implementation

Cash Credit & Banking Compliance

Posting Annual Journals

Annual Accounts Finalization

Tax Filings & Regulatory Compliance

Process Improvement & ERP Usage

job.name: Cataloging & Inventory Executive (from Manufacturing)
job.description:
Position: Cataloging & Inventory Executive

Location: Kolkata

Salary: Up to ₹40,000 per month

Experience: 3–5 years in Inventory Management, Cataloging, Master Data Management, or Warehouse Operations

Industry Background: Proven experience in industries with massive SKU counts (e.g., Apparel, Jewelry, Footwear, or Seasonal Gifting)

Key Responsibilities

  • Inventory Management: Oversee inventory levels, ensuring accuracy and timeliness in stock counts and cataloging.
  • Cataloging: Maintain and update product catalogs, ensuring all SKUs are accurately represented and categorized.
  • Master Data Management: Manage and maintain the integrity of master data related to products and inventory within ERP systems.
  • Operational Support: Collaborate with warehouse staff to streamline operations and resolve any discrepancies in stock levels.
  • Reporting: Generate and analyze inventory reports, identifying trends and providing insights to improve inventory management processes.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets: Proficient in VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, and conditional formatting.
  • ERP Systems: Strong hands-on experience with ERP systems such as Tally ERP 9 / Prime or similar inventory modules.
  • Barcoding Systems: Familiarity with barcoding systems for efficient inventory tracking.
  • Basic Photography & PDF Creation: Ability to take product photos and create PDFs for cataloging purposes.

Communication Skills

  • Fluency in Hindi and English: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to liaise effectively with corporate teams and warehouse staff.

Problem-Solving Abilities

  • Analytical Skills: High analytical capability with a keen eye for spotting stock mismatches or catalog errors before they escalate into business problems.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (preferred).
  • Proven track record in inventory management within the manufacturing industry.

Summary Position Summary Do you have a passion to support Deloitte Tax in helping global clients transform their Global Trade solution? Are you a team player with a practical, business-oriented mindset? Do you enjoy working in an ever-changing global environment with fast-moving markets and evolving business models? If the answer to all the above is “Yes,” come join us in the International Tax group.

We are a recognized leader in solving some of the complex business problems for our clients, differentiated by our ability to execute on the insights we provide. Our multi-disciplinary competencies allow us to address CXO issues from several angles.

Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (“USI Tax”) commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all of the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines have obtained support through USI Tax practice. USI Tax offers you opportunities to learn U.S. taxation, a sought-after career option.

Deloitte Tax is leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace by offering a broad range of fully integrated tax services and add greater impact to their clients by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
