job.name: Cost Control Specialist
job.region: Kolkata metropolitan area, West Bengal, India
job.description:
Company Description

Dream Pillar Construction delivers a broad range of construction services, including villa and bungalow building, renovation, interior design, painting, electrical, plumbing, and civil works across Kolkata and West Bengal. The company emphasizes high-quality workmanship and transparent pricing, aiming to build trust with clients at every project stage. Projects are managed with a strong focus on timely delivery and adherence to agreed budgets and specifications. Dream Pillar Construction is committed to customer satisfaction, creating functional and aesthetically pleasing spaces tailored to client needs.

Role Description

This is a full-time, on-site Cost Control Specialist role based in the Kolkata metropolitan area. The Cost Control Specialist will monitor project budgets, track expenditures, and compare actual costs against estimates to identify variances and potential risks. Daily responsibilities include preparing cost reports, maintaining cost records, and collaborating with project managers, site engineers, and procurement teams to ensure accurate forecasting and efficient resource allocation. The role involves analyzing financial data, reviewing supplier and subcontractor invoices, and supporting the development of cost-saving measures without compromising quality or safety. The Cost Control Specialist will also assist in preparing periodic financial summaries and recommendations for senior leadership to support decision-making.

Qualifications

  • Candidates should possess strong Cost Control and Cost Management skills to plan, monitor, and optimize project budgets.
  • Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills and Cost Reporting capabilities to interpret data, identify trends, and produce clear, actionable reports.
  • Candidates should possess knowledge of Cost Accounting principles to track project expenses, allocate costs correctly, and support financial compliance.
  • Candidates should have proficiency with spreadsheet and project management tools, such as MS Excel and scheduling software.
  • Candidates should demonstrate attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional project teams.
  • Candidates should have a bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, engineering, construction management, or a related field; relevant professional certifications are an advantage.
  • Prior experience in construction, infrastructure, or related industries, particularly in cost control or project accounting, is highly beneficial.

Send your CV

career@dreampillarconstruction.com

job.name: Category Manager
job.description:
Who we are

Sumosave Retail is building the modern “Ration Ke Dukaan” for middle India. These are value-first grocery stores, offline first, for the hundreds of millions of households that big retail has mostly ignored. We’re growing fast across East and North India, and we’re building the team that will shape how middle India buys its everyday essentials and more.

The role

We’re hiring a small group of exceptional early-career managers and training them to become Category Managers. You’ll own a real food and grocery category, with real numbers, and report directly to [the Category Head / founding team]. From early on, you’ll:

  • Own your category’s P&L. You decide what goes on the shelf, at what price, and with what promotion.
  • Sit across the table from vendors, from national FMCG brands to regional suppliers, and negotiate terms that keep our prices low and our margins healthy.
  • Read the data to find where demand is going in Tier 2 and Tier 3 markets before competitors do.
  • Launch new products, private labels and promotions, and see the results in store sales within weeks.
  • Work hand in hand with supply chain, store operations and marketing to keep the right products in stock, at the right stores, every day.

Why this is worth your time

  • Accelerated growth: a clear path to full Category Manager ownership in [12–18 months], with structured mentoring from leadership.
  • Real ownership: your decisions show up in the sales numbers, and you’ll know they were yours.
  • Top-of-market pay: compensation benchmarked against the best offers for your batch [+ performance bonus / ESOPs, if applicable].
  • Mission: build a business that makes daily life cheaper and better for middle India.
  • Proximity: work directly with founders and senior leaders, not through layers.

Who we’re looking for

  • An MBA/PGDM from a premier business school, with 1–2 years of post-qualification experience
  • Sharp with numbers. You enjoy a spreadsheet and you’re comfortable drawing a conclusion from messy data.
  • Commercially instinctive. You like a good negotiation and you always want to know what moves the needle.
  • Someone who acts on their own and keeps going, who does well in a fast-moving startup and doesn’t need a playbook.
  • Experience in FMCG, retail, e-commerce, consulting or a similar field is a plus, but not required. How you think matters more than your background.

Location: Kolkata (on-site, with market visits across East and North India)

If you’d rather build something than wait your turn, we’d like to hear from you.

  • Write to careers@sumosave.in with “Category Fast-Track” in the subject line

job.name: SEO - OFF Page Analyst
job.region: Kolkata metropolitan area, West Bengal, India
job.description:
Job Title: SEO Off-Page Analyst

Company: Shree Ji Steel Private Limited

Location: Sector V, Salt Lake, Kolkata (On-site)

Salary: ₹15,000 – ₹22,000 per month

Experience Required: 1–2 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time | Permanent

Qualification: Graduate or Master's Degree in Digital Marketing, Marketing, or a related field preferred.

About Shree Ji Steel

Shree Ji Steel Private Limited is a growing organization in the iron and steel industry, engaged in the manufacturing, trading, and export of high-quality steel products. We are committed to delivering quality products, maintaining customer satisfaction, and building long-term business relationships while strengthening our digital presence.

We are looking for a skilled and result-oriented SEO Off-Page Analyst who can improve our website authority, build quality backlinks, enhance keyword rankings, and strengthen our organic search presence.

Job Summary

The SEO Off-Page Analyst will be responsible for implementing off-page SEO strategies, identifying backlink opportunities, conducting competitor research, managing business listings, and executing link-building campaigns.

The candidate should have practical knowledge of backlink building, guest posting, website outreach, directory submissions, backlink audits, and SEO performance tracking.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan and execute off-page SEO strategies to improve website authority and organic rankings.
  • Build high-quality backlinks through guest posting, blog submissions, business directories, and relevant industry websites.
  • Identify and research websites for link-building opportunities.
  • Conduct competitor backlink analysis and identify potential backlink sources.
  • Manage business listings, local citations, and directory submissions.
  • Perform email outreach to website owners, bloggers, publishers, and industry-related platforms.
  • Maintain a database of backlink opportunities, submitted links, and approved backlinks.
  • Analyse existing backlinks and identify broken, spammy, or low-quality links.
  • Monitor Domain Authority (DA), Domain Rating (DR), referring domains, and backlink growth.
  • Identify link-building gaps and opportunities to improve competitor positioning.
  • Coordinate with the content team for guest posts, article submissions, and link-building content.
  • Monitor keyword rankings and off-page SEO performance.
  • Prepare weekly and monthly SEO reports.
  • Follow ethical, white-hat SEO practices and Google's search guidelines.

Required Skills and Qualifications

job.name: Credit Risk Management and Analytics Senior Associate
Assistant Manager-Regulated
job.description:
Job Description: Job Description At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.

We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.

Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Process Overview\* Global Payment Services (GPS) team is a shared service team which caters APAC region performing multiple reporting & analytical activities, along with process enhancement and improve productivity. GPS business leverages the Tableau platform and Excel (VBA Macros) to design, visualize and distribute data analysis for business managers globally. The team activity includes reporting on client account balances, revenues, margins, Fund transfer pricing changes, Over Draft tracking and other relevant information for decision making at the senior management level as well as for Treasury Sales Offices (TSOs) and sales people. Accuracy and timely delivery are paramount to the team’s success and associated with multiple business partner’s gives access to many aspects of the GPS organization, which provides opportunities to learn and grow the scope of services. Additionally, team also creates interactive dashboards via Tableau for Regional, Sales and Internal team providing a bird’s eye view.

job.name: Reporting and BI Analyst
job.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.

Your Role

job.name: Trade Data Analyst – Digital Trade Solutions
job.description:
As we create a colorful, capable and cleaner world through chemistry, we invite you to join our team to harness the power of chemistry to shape markets, redefine industries and improve lives for billions of people around the world.

Chemours is seeking a Trade Data Analyst – Digital Trade Solutions to join our Global Trade Compliance team within the Trade Center of Excellence. This role will support the continued modernization of Chemours’ global trade compliance program by transforming trade, shipment, and ERP data into actionable insights, repeatable controls, and digitally enabled decision support. The Trade Data Analyst will operate at the intersection of trade compliance, business analytics, and technology enablement. Working closely with Global Trade, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, IT, and business teams, this role will help translate complex regulatory, operational, and landed-cost data into practical tools, metrics, and recommendations that support compliant and optimized global trade activity. The successful candidate will be a practical problem solver with strong analytical skills, sound trade compliance judgment, and the ability to build scalable data solutions in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. This role will help strengthen Chemours’ ability to identify risk, measure program performance, evaluate duty-optimization opportunities, and provide leadership with clear, reliable, and audit-ready insights. The responsibilities of the position include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Support data quality initiatives related to HTS, ECCN, country of origin, invoice value, Bill of Material breakdowns, Incoterms, other key trade compliance fields.
  • Serve as a key user and internal subject-matter resource for digital trade tools supporting value-chain mapping, landed-cost modeling, origin intelligence, duty optimization, and trade-flow monitoring.
  • Design and maintain trade compliance metrics, scorecards, and dashboards that track program effectiveness, value delivery, landed-cost impact, duty savings, and emerging risk indicators.
  • Identify and support opportunities to streamline, automate, and modernize trade compliance reporting and analytics using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python, RPA, or other scalable digital solutions.
  • Support origin, free trade agreement, and bill-of-materials analyses by identifying data requirements, modeling qualification scenarios, and flagging areas where additional validation is needed.
  • Monitor trade-flow, tariff, and trade remedy data to help identify potential transshipment, origin, circumvention, and landed-cost risks affecting Chemours products and markets

About OnVUE

OnVUE is Pearson’s online proctored test delivery platform, supporting the secure, reliable, and scalable delivery of assessments for Pearson’s certification and professional testing business. The platform enables candidates to test remotely while maintaining exam integrity through identity verification, monitoring, secure delivery workflows, and operational controls. The OnVUE environment includes modern and legacy systems, with ongoing focus on platform modernization, service resilience, API-first integration, cloud-native delivery, candidate and proctor experience, and improved developer and operational practices.

Role summary

As a Lead Specialist, Solution Architect, you are a recognized subject-matter expert who provides technical leadership for sophisticated, high-impact solution work. You independently translate business needs, stakeholder constraints, and technical requirements into secure, scalable, viable, and maintainable architectural models and guide solution delivery from inception through implementation.

You maintain technical consistency within the assigned scope, balance advanced solution design with hands-on support for complex delivery challenges, and resolve day-to-day integration and build issues. You influence through depth of knowledge, sound judgment, clear communication, and the ability to steer architecture discussions toward practical outcomes. You mentor engineers, junior architects, and peers, establish trusted technical patterns within your domain, ensure conformance to established frameworks, and escalate decisions that materially exceed the assigned scope to senior experts.

Solution architecture and technical leadership

  • Provide technical leadership for high-impact projects, major features, product changes, services, domains, or business capabilities.
  • Maintain technical consistency within the assigned product, service, project, domain, or broader solution footprint.
  • Evaluate and communicate tradeoffs involving scalability, security, resilience, maintainability, integration, delivery risk, operational needs, and business value.

Implementation and delivery guidance

job.description:
About the Role : We are looking for a detail-oriented Quality Assurance Executive who will monitor operational quality, maintain accurate records, and prepare MIS reports. Job Description

Position: Senior Education Assessment & Psychometrics Specialist

Organisation: Sambandh Health Foundation

Duration: 36 Months

Positions: 1

Role Overview

Lead the design and technical implementation of learning assessments, psychometric validation, sampling methodologies, and evaluation frameworks for a large-scale education programme.

Key Responsibilities

1. Assessment Design: Develop competency-based reading, numeracy, and learning assessment tools aligned with defined learning outcomes.
2. Psychometric Validation: Conduct pilot testing, item analysis, reliability and validity assessments to ensure robust measurement instruments.
3. Test Equating: Establish methodologies to ensure comparability of learning outcomes across baseline, midline, and endline assessment rounds.
4. Sampling & Survey Design: Develop statistically representative sampling frameworks for large-scale education assessments.
5. Data Analysis: Analyse assessment datasets using statistical methods and generate evidence-based insights.
6. Evaluation: Develop monitoring indicators, assessment frameworks, and evaluation methodologies to measure programme outcomes.

  • Postgraduate degree in Statistics, Economics, Education, Public Policy, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 8 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Demonstrated expertise in educational measurement, psychometrics, and learning assessment design.
  • Hands-on experience in sampling methodologies, test validation, reliability testing, and statistical analysis.
  • Proficiency in STATA, SPSS, R, or Python.
  • Experience in adolescent learning assessments or education system evaluations preferred.

job.name: Sea pricing and Operations
job.description:
Company Description Pax Freight Express Pvt. Ltd. is a leading international logistics and freight forwarding company based in India, with key operations in New Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore, Kolkata, Gujarat, and Chennai, and active global reach. With over 25 years of collective professional experience, the company specializes in air and ocean export/import, customs clearance, and comprehensive logistics solutions. Pax Freight Express offers services including hazardous cargo handling, live pet moving, international packing and moving, documentation, warehousing, project handling, and consignment insurance. The team focuses on clear communication between clients, overseas associates, and their customers, aiming to be a single resource provider for all logistics needs while “delivering peace of mind.”
Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Sea Pricing and Operations role based in Delhi, India. The role involves developing and maintaining competitive sea freight pricing by coordinating with carriers, agents, and internal teams to obtain rates and prepare quotations for clients. Daily tasks include managing sea freight operations such as booking shipments, monitoring schedules, tracking consignments, and ensuring accurate documentation for export and import shipments. The position requires close collaboration with sales and customer service teams to support client needs, resolve operational issues, and ensure timely deliveries. The Sea Pricing and Operations professional will also analyze market trends, optimize cost structures, and contribute to process improvements to enhance efficiency and service quality.
Qualifications

  • Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to interpret freight rates, cost structures, and market trends, and support data-driven decision-making.
  • Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills to coordinate effectively with customers, carriers, agents, and internal stakeholders.
  • Candidates should possess Sales and customer relationship capabilities to support rate negotiations, prepare competitive quotations, and help retain and grow client accounts.
  • Candidates should possess Operations Management skills to oversee booking, documentation, scheduling, and end-to-end sea freight handling.
  • Candidates should possess Project Management abilities to manage complex shipments, multi-leg movements, and special cargo requirements within agreed timelines.
  • Relevant experience in international logistics, sea freight, or freight forwarding is highly beneficial.
  • Knowledge of customs procedures, INCOTERMS, and international trade regulations is preferred.
  • Proficiency in MS Office and logistics-related software or TMS systems is an advantage.
  • A diploma or degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business, or a related field is desirable.
  • Ability to work accurately under time pressure, with strong attention to detail and a focus on service quality.

job.name: Retail Merchandiser
job.description:
Role Purpose

The Retail Merchandiser supports commercial execution and inventory health across AMPM’s retail stores and online platform. Working closely with the merchandising and retail teams, this role ensures products are allocated, tracked, and replenished efficiently so design vision translates into smooth in-store and online availability.

It is a hands-on, execution-focused role, ideal for someone early in their merchandising career who wants to build a strong foundation in retail math, inventory management, and cross-functional coordination within a premium fashion brand.

Key Responsibilities:

A. Inventory Support & Stock Management

  • Monitor stock levels: Track stock levels across 4 retail stores and online, flagging shortages or excess.
  • Support sell-through tracking: Track weekly and monthly sell-through and highlight fast- and slow-moving SKUs to leadership.
  • Assist with slow-moving stock: Support markdown and liquidation execution for slow-moving inventory, as directed by leadership.
  • Handle allocation & replenishment: Execute day-to-day store-wise product allocation and replenishment based on guidance from senior merchandisers.
  • Coordinate with the warehouse: Coordinate with the warehouse team to ensure smooth stock flow, accurate counts, and timely dispatch.

B. Reporting & Data Support

  • Generate weekly reports: Prepare weekly performance reports identifying fast/slow-moving SKUs and visual merchandising gaps.
  • Maintain performance dashboards: Keep dashboards updated so business targets and stock positions remain visible to the team.
  • Support forecasting inputs: Compile sell-through and stock data to support leadership in forecasting and planning decisions.

C. Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Design: Coordinate with the design team to relay stock and sell-through feedback from the field.
  • Production: Track the TNA calendar and delivery timelines, flagging any risk of stock delays.
  • Retail Operations & Marketing: Work with store teams and marketing to execute merchandising plans and support product launches.

D. Systems & Data Discipline

  • Maintain reporting templates: Maintain and follow standardized reporting templates used by the merchandising team.
  • Follow SOPs: Follow established SOPs for allocation, replenishment, and reporting, and suggest improvements where useful.
  • Data accuracy: Ensure all daily merchandising actions are backed by accurate, up-to-date data.

Job Purpose:

Responsible for end-to-end DevOps operations, automation, and infrastructure delivery across AWS cloud environments. The candidate will play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining scalable, secure, and reliable platform solutions using Infrastructure as Code and modern DevOps practices.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Review, design, and implement cloud infrastructure solutions in AWS aligned with microservices-based architecture and organizational standards.
  • Implement and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and Terragrunt for consistent, repeatable infrastructure deployment.
  • Manage containerized applications using Kubernetes and Docker, ensuring reliability, scalability, and observability.

  • Work closely with application and platform teams to integrate build and deployment automation for microservices and backend systems.

Secondary Responsibilities:

  • Ensure all deployments follow automated testing, version control, and rollback strategies.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, and DevOps tooling.
  • Review and optimize Terraform/Terragrunt modules for reusability and consistency.
  • Collaborate with development teams to integrate DevOps best practices early in the SDLC.
  • Perform capacity planning, backup/recovery setup, and environment health monitoring.
  • Support container image management and artifact repositories (e.g., Artifactory, ECR).

Technical Responsibilities:

  • Manage AWS resources such as EC2, ECS/EKS, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC, and CloudFront.
  • Implement GitOps-based workflows and manage infrastructure state effectively.
  • Maintain Kubernetes clusters including deployment, upgrades, RBAC, and networking.
  • Automate routine operational tasks using Python, Bash, or shell scripting.
  • Implement end-to-end observability with metrics, logs, and traces to ensure application health.
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure, container orchestration, and CI/CD issues across multiple environments (Dev, QA, Prod).

About Depthfirst We believe software is the foundation of modern civilization—yet vulnerabilities threaten its integrity, security, and resilience. We are on a mission to solve security.

depthfirst is building intelligence to detect and remediate critical software vulnerabilities. We train and scale security AI agents to discover zero-day vulnerabilities across large customer codebases and popular open-source software.

Our founding team brings deep expertise in data, infrastructure, security, and AI, with technical leaders from DeepMind, Databricks, Square, and Faire. We are looking for thoughtful, driven people excited to work at the intersection of AI, security, and infrastructure.

About This Role depthfirst is hiring a GTM Engineer to build the technical systems behind how we go to market.

You will work across engineering, sales, marketing, and customer success to turn fragmented data and manual processes into reliable software, automation, and infrastructure. This could mean connecting product usage to Salesforce, building a lead-routing system, automating campaign operations, creating an account-health application, identifying account signals, or establishing the data foundation we will need as we scale.

This is not a reporting-only analytics role. We are looking for a builder who is comfortable writing code, working with APIs and data, and using AI agents to ship quickly. You should also be able to understand the underlying business problem and own what you build from initial design through ongoing operation.

You will have significant autonomy to decide when to write software, use an automation platform, or introduce a new tool—and the responsibility to build systems that are maintainable, reliable, and extensible.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build integrations and data pipelines connecting Salesforce, product data, marketing platforms, sales tools, and other internal systems
  • Design the GTM data foundation we need as we scale, including data models, Salesforce architecture, APIs, pipelines, and a data warehouse
  • Automate operational workflows such as campaign ingestion, lead routing, enrichment, attribution, follow-up tracking, and CRM updates
  • Build lightweight internal and customer-facing applications, including enablement, account-health, and product-analytics tools
  • Replace brittle, manual workflows with maintainable and testable systems that can be extended as the business evolves
  • Make GTM data trustworthy and accessible, giving sales, marketing, customer success, and leadership a reliable view of performance
  • Work directly with GTM teams to identify bottlenecks, translate loosely defined needs into technical solutions, and prioritize what to build
  • Own the systems you create, including their accuracy, reliability, documentation, and ongoing improvement

  • Lead cross-functional security projects (e.g., cloud security improvements, network segmentation plans, identity security enhancements) from planning through execution, coordinating with stakeholders across departments to deliver results.

FDA Office and Location: A research opportunity is available immediately with the Food and Drug Administration (FDA), Center for Drug Evaluation and Research (CDER), National Center for Toxicological Research (NCTR), located in Jefferson, Arkansas.

The Center for Drug Evaluation and Research (CDER) performs an essential public health task by making sure that safe and effective drugs are available to improve the health of people in the United States. As part of the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), CDER regulates over-the-counter and prescription drugs, including biological therapeutics and generic drugs. These efforts cover more than just medicines.

Research Project: This project develops a database and web-based application to support regulatory review knowledge management. This internal-facing, web-based application allows FDA staff to automate the capture of review notes, meeting minutes, and reports during pharmacology/toxicology review for query and management. FDA’s GenAI tool’s capabilities will be explored and leveraged to empower the web application.

Learning Objectives: You will join a team of data scientists, AI scientists, and regulatory informatics developers through this learning opportunity. You will receive mentorship by experts in the field, which is a unique opportunity for new data scientists. You will have learning opportunities that include:

  • Development an understanding of regulatory knowledge management approaches;
  • Database development;
  • Full-stack web-based application development;
  • Leveraging of GenAI technologies to support problem-solving and feature development in a web-based application.

Mentor: The mentors for this opportunity are Jaehyun Kim (Jaehyun.kim@fda.hhs.gov), and Shraddha Thakkar (shraddha.thakkar@fda.hhs.gov). If you have questions about the nature of the research, please contact the mentors.

Data Analytics and Systems Engineer - TBD
job.description:
Job Responsibilities The mission of the South Carolina Department of Education (SCDE) is to serve students, support teachers, empower parents, and engage the community so that every student graduates prepared to reach their full potential. About The Role SCDE is seeking a data engineer to support Education Scholarship Trust Fund (ESTF) modernization and the agency’s education data systems. The primary responsibility is to build reliable pipelines that connect governed source files, including vendor assessment files, the Ed-Fi API, and a Snowflake/dbt longitudinal data warehouse.

The engineer will use Earthmover, an open-source Python package, to transform vendor and other CSV files into Ed-Fi API-compliant JSON, and Lightbeam to validate and send those records to the API. The role includes writing, testing, and maintaining reusable assessment bundles that bring vendor assessment results into the statewide data system. Reports, dashboards, and visualizations are a required secondary responsibility once the pipeline is established.

This position requires familiarity with interoperable data ecosystems, a strong interest in connecting systems, and the ability to work with urgency. A working, tested, and documented end-to-end product is expected within eight months of starting.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain data pipelines. Transform governed CSV and other tabular files into Ed-Fi-compliant JSON using Earthmover, and validate and publish records through Lightbeam.
  • Analyze vendor assessment files. Study each vendor’s file layout and data dictionary, decide which fields are required or optional, and build an anonymized sample file for testing. Meet with vendors and program offices to understand assessments and file changes.
  • Model assessments in Ed-Fi. Decide how a vendor’s tests, sub-tests, scores, performance levels, grade levels, and subjects map to Ed-Fi resources and descriptors (Assessment, ObjectiveAssessment, StudentAssessment, StudentObjectiveAssessment). Present the mapping for review under Ed-Fi assessment governance practices.
  • Write assessment bundles. Start from the template bundle and build the full package: seed files for reference data such as descriptors and objective assessments; the earthmover.yaml configuration (sources, transformations such as joins, date conversion and derived IDs, and destinations); and the JSON templates that produce each Ed-Fi record. Use SQL, Jinja, and Python (and dbt where appropriate) to make transformations repeatable.
  • Match students correctly. Configure and test student ID crosswalking against the Ed-Fi roster, review unmatched-student reports, and work with districts and vendors to resolve ID problems.
  • Run, test, and send the data. Run each bundle on sample and production-sized files, reconcile record counts, and spot-check values against the source file. Use Lightbeam to send records to the Ed-Fi API in dependency order (assessments first, student results last),

Role Title: Senior Mobile Software Engineer

Role Type: Contractor (~15 hrs a week)

Location: Remote

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

As an expert, you will create Reinforcement Learning Environments that test an AI model’s ability to solve complex mobile software engineering problems related to fixing code, creating features, refactoring code, and optimizing performance. You will be tasked with creating a reproducible environment and a golden reference solution for each problem.

Scope of Work

  • Create realistic, interesting, and extremely challenging mobile coding tasks for frontier AI models using your preferred repositories.

  • For each task, define the problem, build a reproducible environment, and write deterministic verifiers that accept correct solutions across different valid implementations while rejecting incorrect, incomplete, or hard-coded approaches.
  • Provide a reference solution showing how the task can be solved.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Significant hands-on expertise in at least one of the following mobile development tracks:
  • Cross-platform:TypeScript or JavaScript with React Native, or Dart with Flutter.
  • iOS:Swift with SwiftUI or UIKit.
  • Android:Kotlin with Jetpack Compose or the Android View system.
  • Deep understanding of mobile application architecture, state management, asynchronous programming, and application lifecycle.
  • Proven ability to debug complex mobile applications, resolve bugs, and deliver effective performance improvements.

Compensation Structure Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. job.name: Fullstack Software Engineer (Remote)
job.description:
• Role Title : Fullstack Software Engineer (Remote)
  • Role Type : Full-time
  • Location : Remote

The Role

This is an AI-native fullstack engineering role building micro1's human data platforms. You'll own features end-to-end, from backend services and data pipelines to the frontends our experts use every day.

The role sits between traditional fullstack and research engineering. Coding agents are your primary development workflow, and you'll work closely with research engineers, operations, and product to turn requirements into reliable production systems.

What You'll Own

1. Design and ship fullstack features across backend APIs, data pipelines, and React frontends.

2. Own client-facing data delivery and platform infrastructure, including exports, access control, and reliability.

3. Scope work around outcomes, direct coding agents—often in parallel—review changes at the architecture level, and iterate until shipped.

4. Build and maintain services in Python (FastAPI) and TypeScript.

5. Contribute to data modeling, schema design, and query performance across relational and document databases.

6. Partner with research engineering, operations, and product to translate platform needs into production-ready systems.

7. Improve the frameworks, checks, and evals that make agent-driven development faster without sacrificing quality.

8. Troubleshoot production issues and build resilient, observable systems.

What We're Looking For

1. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

2. 0–5 years of software engineering experience, or strong shipped projects as a recent graduate.

3. Strong fundamentals in Python and TypeScript, with experience building CRUD applications using frameworks such as FastAPI/Flask and React.

4. Working knowledge of databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or SQLite and core data modeling principles.

5. Experience deploying services on a major cloud platform (GCP, AWS, or Azure).

6. Coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex are your default development workflow, and you can clearly explain how you use them.

7. Ability to turn outcomes into plans, direct agents, verify results, and identify architectural issues agents may miss.

8. Understanding of agent loops, MCP, tool/data integrations, permissions, and security.

9. Familiarity with context management, RAG, and evals for testing agent workflows.

Preferred

1. Exposure to RL concepts or environments, including tasks, actions, and rewards.

2. Experience with coding data pipelines or task-authoring platforms.

3. Familiarity with CI/CD, deployment pipelines, and DevOps fundamentals.

4. Experience contributing to team projects, open-source software, or startups.

job.description:
About Valiance

Valiance Solutions is a deep-tech AI company that builds and deploys cutting-edge solutions in Generative AI, Computer Vision, and Cloud for enterprises and public sector organizations. Our work spans product innovation, solution engineering, and real-world deployment at scale.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a hands-on AI Product Manager to lead development across our portfolio of AI-powered products. You’ll work closely with engineering, design, and customers to deliver impactful features, continuously refine the product, and ensure we ship high-quality releases. If you're someone who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and takes full ownership, we’d love to talk.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and ship new features across our Gen AI and Computer Vision product portfolio
  • Improve existing features based on product metrics, customer feedback, and internal QA
  • Track and optimize product performance and user experience using clearly defined metrics
  • Create clear functional specifications and UI mockups for engineering and design teams
  • Collaborate with engineering to plan and execute on feature delivery timelines
  • Work directly with customers to gather feedback, run pilots, and refine product capabilities
  • Actively participate in QA cycles and drive high-quality product releases
  • Communicate product vision and priorities across stakeholders
  • Use AI tools in your workflow to boost productivity, ideation, and delivery

What We’re Looking For

  • 3–5 years of total experience, with at least 2+ years managing AI-powered products
  • Proven experience in shipping features with cross-functional engineering, QA, and design teams
  • You understand how the code works—even if you don’t write it anymore
  • Prior hands-on coding experience is preferred (Python, cloud, or AI tooling)
  • Strong customer orientation—you're energized by conversations that help improve the product
  • Experience working on enterprise-grade platforms or B2B SaaS products
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and turning it into a clear product roadmap
  • Excellent planning, execution, and stakeholder management skills
  • Bias for action and accountability in driving outcomes
  • Open to travel for on-site customer visits and deployment reviews
  • Passion for AI and an “AI-first” mindset in how you work and build

Why Valiance?

Join us to build the future of enterprise AI. At Valiance, you’ll work at the intersection of innovation and impact—shaping products that solve real-world problems using cutting-edge AI.

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Description Amazon Quick is an agentic AI work companion that helps business users find answers, get insights from their data, and automate their work across web, desktop, and mobile. It brings AI agents, enterprise knowledge, and everyday business tools together in one place, so people can go from question to action without switching contexts. Quick is one of Amazon's most strategic products, it is live with enterprise customers, and it is growing fast.

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer who is excited to build generative AI products that customers use every day. You will design and ship features end to end, working across customer-facing experiences, distributed services, and the cloud infrastructure behind them. Experience with generative AI is a plus, but strong engineering fundamentals and a desire to learn quickly matter most.

Why You Will Love This Role

  • Build, not maintain: Quick is in customers' hands, but many of the hardest problems in agentic AI are still being solved, and you will help solve them.
  • Broad scope: You will work across the stack and see your features through from design to production.
  • Enterprise scale with startup speed: We ship frequently to customers with high expectations for availability, performance, and security.
  • Growth: You will work alongside experienced engineers, applied scientists, and product leaders, with mentorship and room to take on more ownership as you grow.

Key job responsibilities

  • Design, build, test, and deploy features for Amazon Quick, from customer-facing experiences to the backend services and infrastructure behind them.
  • Build highly available, scalable, and secure distributed systems on AWS.
  • Work with product managers, designers, applied scientists, and other engineers to turn customer needs into working software.
  • Own the quality and operational health of what you build, including testing, monitoring, and on-call.
  • Use generative AI tools in your daily work, and help improve the quality and reliability of AI-powered features.
  • Participate in code and design reviews, and mentor other engineers.

You will work with a variety of languages and technologies, such as Python, TypeScript, and Java, on AWS.

About The Team Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
  • 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
  • Experience programming with at least one software programming language

job.description:
San Francisco, CA

  • New York, NY
  • London, UK | On-site | Full Time | Direct Hire | Mid to Senior Level | ASAP Start

MaxIT Consulting – Max Corporate Group is looking for a Founding Product Engineer to join a seed-stage consumer AI company that has become one of the fastest-growing consumer AI products of the year.

The company builds a personal AI assistant that people use inside the messaging apps they already have. It does not just answer questions: it carries tasks out for the user, from bookings and purchases to email, calls and content, and nothing irreversible happens without the user's approval.

The team is still very small, so every engineer owns whole products and has a direct impact on what millions of users experience.

THE CHALLENGE

You will build what people actually touch: the conversation itself across messaging apps and group chats, the moments where the assistant asks before it spends money or sends something on the user's behalf, onboarding, payments and the web surfaces around them.

On a team this size you take a product from the first sketch to production and to the numbers after launch, working side by side with the agent and infrastructure engineers so that new capabilities ship as product, not as demos.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own user-facing features end to end, from idea to production to the next iteration, across messaging and the web.
  • Design the moments of trust: approvals, receipts, confirmations and recovery when a task goes wrong.
  • Build onboarding, subscriptions and billing as the product moves from waitlist to paid.
  • Work closely with agent and infrastructure engineers so new capabilities reach users as polished product.
  • Read conversations, talk to users and turn what you learn into what ships that week.

What We Are Looking For

  • At least 3 years of software engineering experience, with a record of shipping polished consumer products end to end, ideally as an early engineer or a founder.
  • Strong full-stack skills in TypeScript and a modern web stack, and the judgment to choose the simplest thing that works.
  • Experience building on large language models (LLMs) in a product people use every day.
  • Real product taste: you notice latency, wording and edge cases, and fix them without being asked.
  • Speed: you ship in days, measure and ship again.
  • Based in, or willing to relocate at your own cost to, San Francisco, New York or London, to work on-site.
  • Fluent English, as you will work daily with the founders and users.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience at a fast-growing consumer or AI-first product company.
  • Experience with messaging platforms, payments or subscription billing (not required).

A particular framework, prior messaging experience or a degree are not required.

POSITION DETAILS

Work arrangement: On-site

The Opportunity insitro is a physical AI company dedicated to unlocking causal human biology and accelerating the delivery of better medicines to patients. Our unique Virtual Human™ platform identifies novel, high-impact genetic intervention points, which our TherML™ platform translates into therapeutics—whether small molecules, biologics, or oligos. With multiple programs in metabolic disease and neuroscience advancing toward the clinic, and our first IND submission slated for the second half of this year, we are at a pivotal inflection point.

As a Senior/ Staff Software Engineer on our Imaging Software team, you will define and expand our data and ML infrastructure across the full data lifecycle — from data generation, high-throughput ML pipelines, to analysis results. You'll build the platform features that make novel in vitro screening modalities and ML-derived phenotypes integral to our discovery workflows, partnering with lab scientists, ML scientists, and our automation teams to turn research prototypes into validated screening workflows that reliably process terabytes of biological data per day. This is a chance to set the technical direction for how imaging, automation, machine learning, and agentic analysis converge in drug discovery.

Based in South San Francisco, this position reports directly to the Director of Imaging, Cellular Machine Learning and offers an in-person hybrid schedule of three days per week .

  • Architectural Ownership: Own complex, end-to-end projects, making thoughtful architectural trade-offs, and delivering incrementally with long-term maintainability in mind.

Scalability & Data Integrity

Headquartered in Silicon Valley with operations in the United States and Europe, Plus was named by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Partners including TRATON GROUP’s Scania, MAN, and International brands, Hyundai Motor Company, Iveco Group, Bosch, and DSV are working with Plus to accelerate the deployment of next-generation autonomous trucks. In this role, you will own critical parts of the path that makes this data reliable and useful—from high-throughput recording on the vehicle to transfer, validation, cataloging, and efficient access for replay, analytics, and machine learning. We are open to candidates at either the Software Engineer or Senior Software Engineer level. Level will be determined by experience, technical depth, scope of ownership, and demonstrated impact. *Responsibilities:*

  • Design and evolve high-throughput C++ systems that continuously record vehicle sensor and runtime data, selectively capture events, and collect system telemetry while operating safely under CPU, memory, disk, and network constraints
  • Build reliable Python data-plane services and libraries for vehicle-data transfer, ingestion, validation, domain-specific format conversion, metadata extraction, cataloging, and storage lifecycle management
  • Evolve versioned vehicle-data formats and their C++ and Python APIs, including indexing, serialization, compression, schema evolution, and backward compatibility

job.name: Senior Software Engineer, Mapping
job.description:
About Pyka Pyka is America’s leading manufacturer of dual-use, heavy-lift autonomous aircraft. We build aircraft that perform critical missions where conventional aircraft are too costly, dangerous, or impractical to operate.

Our approach is different from most. We focus on putting autonomous technologies to work in industries where they can deliver immediate value, starting with the most dangerous and demanding jobs.

Through real-world commercial operations, we are continuously advancing the safety, reliability, and capabilities of our autonomous flight platform while building products that can be manufactured and deployed at scale.

We design, develop, and manufacture our aircraft and the proprietary technologies that power them in the United States. Our vertically integrated technology stack includes flight control software, avionics, high-power-density batteries, hybrid and electric propulsion systems, and custom carbon-fiber composite airframes.

Whether advancing our commercial agricultural aircraft or developing our next-generation multi-mission platform for defense and humanitarian operations, your work at Pyka will directly shape the future of autonomous aviation.

You’ll join a team designing, building, testing, and deploying aircraft that are flying real missions for real customers and pushing the boundaries of autonomous flight.

Role Overview

Pyka is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to own the mapping system, from processing sensor data to delivering validated maps to the aircraft. Our aircraft use terrain and feature maps built from lidar and other sensor data to plan missions that closely follow terrain. These maps complement onboard perception to support safe operation at low altitudes, making their accuracy and reliability critical to mission success. You will own the algorithms, infrastructure, and operational tooling that ensure the aircraft have the right maps for each mission.

The role combines improving how we build maps with improving how we manage them. You will develop algorithms that turn sensor data into useful terrain and feature representations, establish how we validate those maps, and build toward a fully automated pipeline that continuously incorporates new data, validates map changes, and deploys updated maps to the aircraft. You will work closely with perception engineers and flight operations to understand where the current process breaks down, reduce manual work and opportunities for error, and build the tooling needed to scale mapping without compromising safety.

Senior Software Engineer - ExamDeveloper

Summary

As a Senior Software Engineer, you are a highly skilled individual contributor and a technical authority within your area. You lead the design, implementation, optimization, and support of complex software components, services, and platforms that enable key business capabilities and customer experiences.

Working with significant independence, you evaluate technical options, guide design decisions, identify risks, and build scalable, maintainable, resilient solutions. You are frequently consulted on architecture reviews, performance optimization, operational stability, and complex problem resolution. You lead through expertise rather than formal authority — mentoring engineers, improving practices, and helping teams make sound technical and release decisions. You partner closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Product Architects, Quality Engineering, and DevOps to deliver secure, reliable, and highly scalable solutions.

About ExamDeveloper

ExamDeveloper is a web-based exam development platform that allows our customers to write, review, and manage questions for their exams (https://www.pearsonvue.com/us/en/test-owners/develop.html). ExamDeveloper is a leading web-based tool for creating tests that certify test-takers in the professional skills they need. Customers rely on ExamDeveloper to support their full workflow around question writing, collaborative review, scoring, and test management.

Choose the pathway that fits your experience

We have opportunities for strong senior individual contributors and for engineers ready to combine hands-on development with squad leadership. You do not need to decide which pathway fits before applying. We will explore your experience and interests during the recruitment process.

Senior Software Engineer

You will own complex technical work from design through delivery and operational readiness. You will contribute to architecture and technical decisions, improve engineering quality, troubleshoot critical issues, mentor colleagues and help modernise the platform.

Senior Software Engineer, Squad Lead

You will remain hands-on while taking responsibility for the day-to-day technical delivery and results of a squad. You will guide engineers, coordinate work, remove obstacles, influence technical direction and work closely with business and functional leaders. This is technical and delivery leadership, not formal HR people management.

Technical leadership (through expertise)

job.name: Full Stack Agent Platform Developer
job.description:
Join our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work You'll Do As a Center Delivery Senior Consultant, Software Engineering Solutions on the Engineering as a Service team, you will:

  • Build agents against a layered SDK contract (shared types/tools, composable tools, thin agent shell, FastAPI + React surface)
  • Keep business logic in composable skills rather than shells or routers
  • Integrate LLMs through a multi-provider abstraction (Anthropic/Bedrock/OpenAI/Azure, extending to Vertex/OCI) behind a single sanitization + audit boundary so no raw client data leaves the worker
  • Implement durable service boundaries (async persistence, object-storage artifacts, and a tamper-evident hash-chain audit trail per run)
  • Enforce tenant isolation via Postgres RLS scoped sessions and author Alembic migrations (enum/DDL idempotency, RLS policies)
  • Wire agents into an event-driven orchestrator with human-in-the-loop (HITL) approval gates, exposing progress via async tasks (Celery/Redis) and WebSocket
  • Ship behind mechanical architecture linting and CI, contributing new invariant checks

A successful candidate would possess:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Engineering as a Service offering provides end-to-end design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We help transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering mindset. job.name: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (AI Platform)
job.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Affirm's engineering team is building a large-scale, fault-tolerant, and global infrastructure that is shared across multiple financial products, merchants, and vendors. Ensuring that our infrastructure is transparently available to all engineers is critical to the success of the business. We pride ourselves on our culture across engineering of writing blameless postmortems as well as writing detailed tech specs and gathering feedback before large changes to systems.

The AI Platform team owns Affirm's paved path for building, running, evaluating, and governing AI systems. Our customers are not only Affirm users, but also every engineer and a growing set of production workloads at Affirm. As a team, we are responsible for building and exposing simple, governed interfaces to models, tools, and agents, with identity, cost attribution, reliability, and security built in. Examples of components we own include the LLM Gateway that fronts every approved model (Claude, ChatGPT, and open-weight models across AWS Bedrock and other providers), the MCP Gateway that mediates and audits tool calls, the Agent Runtime that gives agentic workloads bounded execution, and the evals and observability layer that tells teams whether an AI change is better, cheaper, or safe to ship. We are early: the gateway is in daily use across engineering, the first production agent is live, and the next year takes us from developer productivity to production inference and agents.

What You'll Do

  • Plan, execute, and own technical decisions and projects within the AI Platform team, from design through launch and on-call.
  • Design and build the gateway, runtime, and evaluation services that take AI workloads at Affirm from pilot to production, securely scaling across millions of users and their transactions.
  • Make AI spend attributable and governable: build the identity, quota, routing, caching, and failover controls that let teams adopt new models and tools without re-solving the same platform problems.
  • Partner with security, infrastructure, and product engineering teams to set the guardrails for agentic workloads and the on-behalf-of identity model for tool access.
  • Create and monitor metrics for your team's systems, and own the operational health of what you ship: monitoring, alerting, runbooks, and on-call.
  • Set and improve code review and design standards, and advocate for them beyond your team through writing and tech talks.
  • Use AI tools and agentic workflows every day as a multiplier for your own code, design review, and operations, and push the team on what a small AI-native team can deliver.
  • Educate, mentor, and grow engineers in the team, and drive best practices around design, coding, and testing.

What We Look For

job.name: Backend Engineer
job.description:
Meet Domaine, a global digital commerce and transformation partner for ambitious and beloved brands. We are the world’s largest independent Shopify partner. We are also a growing team of strategists, designers, engineers and specialists who help brands decide where to invest, build what comes next, and run it at scale across platforms, channels and AI. As pioneers and not just participants in our industry, we are inspired to write, break, and re-write the rules for a new generation of commerce.

The Backend Engineer sits in our Engineering team and builds the integrations, apps and middleware that connect Shopify to the systems our clients run on. It contributes to new implementations and ongoing retainers, delivering high-quality code efficiently. It works alongside a Technical Lead and senior engineers who review the work and set the technical approach, and grows toward owning larger parts of our builds.

This role is open to candidates outside North America, in locations where Domaine can legally employ, who can work U.S. Eastern Time hours.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain backend services, integrations and APIs, including large project components, in PHP/Laravel or JS/Node.
  • Break work down into clear, actionable tasks and deliver it on time to a high standard.
  • Work with the Shopify Admin and Storefront APIs, webhooks and Shopify apps, and with clients' third-party systems such as ERP, OMS, PIM and POS.
  • Write clear software documentation and test steps, and use AI to check your build against ticket scope and acceptance criteria before QA, so your work passes first time.
  • Own the security of what you build: spot risks in your own work and propose how to fix them.
  • Take part in peer code reviews, give and take feedback well, and help teammates when they're stuck.
  • Manage your own work week to week with your Technical Lead, and flag blockers and gaps early.

What You Bring

  • Intermediate or better skills in at least two major languages or frameworks; PHP/Laravel or JS/Node is required.
  • A strong understanding of Shopify app development, APIs and tooling.
  • Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred), queues and HTTP APIs; AWS is a plus.
  • At least one mid-market ecommerce project shipped, ideally in an agency or client-services setting.
  • A good grasp of the software development lifecycle, Git-based workflows and a ticketing system such as Jira.
  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, and clear writing. You can explain a complicated system to teammates and get them on board.
  • Comfort with the unknown: you fill gaps on projects, justify your decisions, and are open to feedback.
  • Responsible, hands-on use of AI coding tools. You review and validate every AI output, never ship work you don't understand, and own all AI-assisted work you deliver.

Nice to have: experience with data migrations, order management or product data integrations; Shopify Functions or app extensions; React.

job.name: Staff Software Engineer, Backend (Grader)
job.description:
About Owner Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants.

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.

Product philosophy Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.

Our vision We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.

But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.

Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.

In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.

Our traction Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com website.

More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees.

Our team Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.

We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth.

Where we work Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location!

Why we're looking for you Owner is the leading all-in-one platform for independent restaurants. Operators use Owner to run their online ordering, websites, menus, marketing, and customer experience. Tens of thousands of restaurants depend on us every day to run their business.

Grader is Owner's free restaurant health report. A restaurant owner submits their URL and gets a clear view of where they're losing money online: website performance, Google presence, menu quality, and more. It's one of the most visible products we build and one of the fastest-growing, with significant scale growth ahead and new AI-powered scoring capabilities launching on top of it. The backend powering all of this needs to be fast, resilient, and built to scale.

job.description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 15,000 customers , including McDonalds, Michaels, Cintas, Redimix, and U.S. LBM, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 16 million managed assets and 92 million completed work orders. In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions , the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours. MaintainX is the world's leading AI-powered maintenance and asset management platform, serving 13,000+ customers including Duracell, Shell, Cintas, and Brenntag. We raised $150M in Series D funding led by Bessemer Venture Partners and Bain Capital Ventures, bringing our total funding to $254M. We were named to the Forbes 2025 Cloud 100, the definitive ranking of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world.

We're growing fast and hiring the Engineering talent to match.

The team and the mission You'd be joining our Backend team within the Platform Engineering division. We're a group with an unusual mandate inside MaintainX: we treat our internal developer platform as a real product, with internal customers (150+ developers), adoption metrics, and a roadmap shaped by what product teams actually need. We are not an ops team.

The platform we're building today exists to answer one question: how do we keep MaintainX engineers shipping fast as the org grows from where we are now to 2-3x the size? Today, spinning up a new backend service, getting it to production, and operating it involves too many manual steps, too much tribal knowledge, and too many decisions each team makes in isolation. We want golden paths that make the right thing the easy thing.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain backend foundations and tooling powering our internal developer platform.
  • Bring AI native and add on workflows into your daily work and into the platform.
  • Raise engineering excellence standards.
  • Lead to the consolidation and evolution of platform primitives: developer portal, local development, domain-service templates and scaffolders, graphQL, event-driven, openAPI golden paths and CI/CD workflows.

job.name: Senior Manager, QA, AI-First, ProWMS
job.description:
Role at a glance

  • Position: Senior Manager, QA, AI-First, ProWMS (1 position, Gurugram or Panchkula)
  • Grade: Senior Manager (SD3)
  • Reports to: AVP Technology or VP Engineering
  • Location: Gurugram: Enkay Tower, Plot B & B1, A Wing, 3rd Floor, Udyog Vihar Phase V, Gurugram, Haryana 122016. Panchkula: Third Floor, HSIIDC Technology Park, Plot No. 12-A, Sector 22, Panchkula, Haryana 134116 (Chandigarh tri-city). Work from office
  • Compensation: INR 15 to 20 Lakhs CTC
  • Employment: Full-Time, Permanent
  • Experience: 5 to 10 years in software QA, preferably on a warehouse management system or other supply chain software
  • Growth path: Senior Manager (SD3) > Director (SD3) > Senior Director (SD3)

The mandate

Prozo builds and runs its own technology: ProWMS for warehouse management, ProOMS for orders, ProShip for shipping and courier allocation, and Control Tower for network-wide visibility. The platform handles about 56,000 orders a day across 44 warehouse sites, with peaks above 23,000 API requests a minute. The team releases daily and builds AI-first with Claude.

Prozo is building an AI-first QA team, with one QA owner for each core product. This role owns quality for ProWMS, Prozo's warehouse management system, which runs inbound, putaway, inventory, picking, packing, returns and billing capture across the network. With daily releases, QA starts at the requirement stage, sits with warehouse operations, and uses AI to test faster and wider than a manual-only team can.

Key responsibility areas

1. ProWMS Test Design and Execution

  • Design and run test cases for inbound, QC, putaway, inventory, cycle counts, allocation, picking, packing, returns, VAS and billing capture.
  • Test handheld flows on Android devices and ring scanners as warehouse staff use them.

2. Integrations

  • Test ProWMS integrations with ProOMS, ProShip, marketplaces, client ERPs such as SAP, and ClearTax e-invoicing.
  • Check data accuracy across system boundaries, including inventory sync and order status updates.

3. AI-First QA and Automation

  • Use Claude and other AI tools to generate test cases, test data and exploratory test plans.
  • Build regression automation with Playwright, Selenium, Cypress or Postman and grow automated coverage release by release.

4. Release Quality

  • Own regression testing and release sign-off for ProWMS on the daily release cadence.
  • Log defects with clear steps, severity and evidence, and track recurring issues to their root cause.

5. Business-Embedded Testing

  • Join requirement discussions with business and engineering teams so testing covers business logic as well as screens.
  • Spend time on the warehouse floor to learn the edge cases that occur in live operations.

Key performance indicators

  • Defects found in production against defects found before release.
  • Share of ProWMS regression tests automated.
  • Release sign-offs completed on schedule.

Read the full description

Overall purpose of role To lead the Global Resilience Operations function and establish India as a strategic capability hub for resilience governance, reporting, data, analytics and operational execution.

The role will transform how resilience information is generated, governed and used across Barclays, providing senior management, Boards and regulators with clear and transparent insight into resilience risks, recovery capability and areas requiring investment or remediation.

The role will also provide strategic leadership for resilience in India, ensuring that regional growth, location strategy and operational concentration are supported by effective resilience planning, governance, testing and recovery capability. *Key Accountabilities*

  • Build and lead a high-performing Global Resilience Operations function, establishing India as a centre of excellence for resilience operations, analytics and automation to support the global resilience strategy, while developing organisational capability, talent and a culture of innovation, accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Provide strategic leadership for resilience in India, ensuring Barclays' growing concentration of operations, technology, colleagues and third-party services is supported by robust resilience, recovery and crisis preparedness capabilities while establishing India as a global resilience capability hub.
  • Working in collaboration with the central team,
  • provide trusted insight to Boards, Executive Committees and regulators by delivering integrated reporting and data analytics on resilience risk, recovery capability, vulnerabilities and investment priorities.
  • drive the transformation of resilience data, technology and automation capabilities by establishing scalable, AI-enabled solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, decision-making and control effectiveness.

*Accountabilities Global Resilience Operations*

With a presence in markets around the world, we are committed to helping our clients navigate an evolving financial landscape and build better financial futures.

Our Enterprise Resilience programs, including Business Continuity Management, Operational Resilience, and Disaster Recovery support the firm's ability to prepare for, respond to, and recover from operational disruptions, helping ensure continuity of critical services for our clients across the globe.

We foster a collaborative environment where employees are encouraged to learn, grow, and contribute to meaningful work.

The Enterprise Resilience Associate will support the firm's Enterprise Resilience team through application development and configuration, system administration, data quality oversight, reporting, and stakeholder coordination, with a primary focus on the BCM Planning System (Fusion Risk Management, built on the Salesforce platform).

This role is well suited for an early-career professional with a foundation in object-oriented programming who is interested in developing technical expertise in Salesforce and enterprise resilience systems.

The role provides an opportunity to gain hands-on experience across application development, configuration, integration, data management, and technical support, while learning from senior team members and contributing to the firm's continuity and operational resilience capabilities.

Application Development & System Support

  • Assist with the development and enhancement of Salesforce-based functionality using Apex, SOQL, Flows, and other platform capabilities, with guidance from senior team members.

Data Quality & Reporting

job.name: Profisee MDM (3-5 Years)
job.description:
Master Data Management (MDM) Consultant – Profisee (3–5 Years Experience)

About The Role We are seeking a skilled Master Data Management (MDM) Consultant with 3–5 years of experience to design, configure, and support enterprise-grade Master Data Management (MDM) solutions using Profisee . In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional business and technical teams to improve data quality , data governance , and data consistency across critical enterprise systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Configure Profisee data models, including entities, attributes, hierarchies, workflows, and business rules, to align with business requirements.
  • Develop and optimize match-and-merge logic, deduplication algorithms, and survivorship rules to produce accurate, trusted golden records.
  • Implement data validation, standardization, and quality controls to ensure compliance with data governance policies and regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).
  • Build and maintain integrations between Profisee and source systems, data warehouses (e.g., SQL Server, Snowflake), and downstream applications using ETL/ELT tools (e.g., SSIS, Informatica) and REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Perform source data profiling, design robust source-to-target mappings, and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for audit and knowledge transfer.
  • Troubleshoot complex data and integration issues, diagnose root causes, and support platform performance tuning and ongoing maintenance.
  • Partner with business stakeholders, data stewards, and engineering teams to translate functional requirements into scalable, high-performing MDM solutions.
  • Support MDM adoption initiatives, including user training, change management, and documentation of best practices.
  • Collaborate on MDM strategy and roadmap to align with enterprise data architecture and digital transformation goals.

Requirements

  • 3–5 years of experience implementing Master Data Management (MDM) solutions, with hands-on expertise in Profisee (preferred) or similar MDM platforms (e.g., Informatica MDM, IBM InfoSphere).
  • Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, data stewardship, and master data management best practices (e.g., DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Proficiency with ETL/ELT tools (e.g., SSIS, Informatica) and integration technologies (REST/SOAP APIs).
  • Experience working with data warehouses such as Microsoft SQL Server, Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, or Azure Synapse.
  • Familiarity with data modeling (logical/physical), metadata management, and data lineage concepts.
  • Experience with cloud-based MDM deployments (e.g., Profisee on Azure/AWS/GCP) is a plus.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work in agile and hybrid environments.
  • Professional certifications (e.g., CDMP, Profisee certifications, DAMA-DMBOK) are highly desirable.

Read the full description

job.description:
TTEC Digital seeks a Senior Frontend Engineer (React + Chrome Extension) to join our team. This role is a full-time and fully remote opportunity!

The work: We’re an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools — automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation — for the world’s biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that’s been obsessed with customer experience since 1982.

This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point.
