  • Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly — new tools, new models, new priorities — without drama.
  • Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread.
  • AI-native. You work with AI on all levels — you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity.
  • Distributed-systems literate. High-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands.
  • Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them.
  • You consider yourself exceptional — and you like winning. So do we.

What You Will Do: The role:

  • Build the Agent UI shell, the Chrome extension, the slide-out / pill workspace, the Control UI, and the per-module panels
  • This is the product wedge — what an evaluator demos in 5 minutes and decides "yes."
  • Real-time UI over live voice, desktop, and AI event streams, in a startup environment: 1-week sprints, Friday demos, fail fast and move forward.

What you'll own:

NextBillion.ai is an enterprise mapping, routing, and location-technology company that became part of Velocitor Solutions in 2025. job.name: Software Engineer
job.description:
About Us Mintive helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools.

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. Our gateway product scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

We are AI-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co-founded Coursera.

*The Job* You will own features end to end, from conception to production, across our gateway infrastructure, enterprise deployments, and agentic systems. The work leans backend and infra, but nothing is off limits: when the product needs a better UI you build it, and when a connector breaks during a security review you fix it.

Claude and Codex are your primary working environment, and you use a fleet of agents to move faster than a team this size has any right to. Agents write much of the code and review PRs, so your real job is the judgment they cannot make: shaping the problem, making architecture, product, and UX calls, hardening enterprise paths, designing connectors, protecting security-sensitive surfaces, and catching generated code that is quietly wrong. Roles are blurred and we ship within hours, and you will learn directly from the founders and from customers.

Read the full description

You thrive in small and collaborative multidisciplinary teams, and love learning something new and surprising every day. You strive for the shared success of improving the health of our oceans and planet by shipping a cohesive, performant and impactful product.

You’re a full-stack engineer with experience developing frontend and backend elements of modern web applications. Our tech stack includes React on the frontend with backend APIs written using Typescript, Express, and Postgres. This role will be working onsite at our Pier 28 office at least 3 days per week and reporting to our Senior Engineering Manager.

Recent Team Stories

We had a particular user account with rapidly increasing numbers of deployed hydrophones, reporting data more and more frequently, with many users concurrently opening the dashboard that displays complex visualizations of this real-time streaming dynamic data, so that the load on the backend system was compounding exponentially. We’re proud of some intense, fun, and successful performance testing work we did, with solutions that spanned React component data invalidation, multiple layers of caching, database index optimization, and remotely configurable thresholds on the hardware systems.

We're currently automating some processes for configuring and updating a wide range of remote hardware devices in order to make it easier for users to manage their systems safely without contacting support. One part of the challenge is documenting the giant unwritten decision tree that has only ever been performed by our very smart and deeply knowledgeable colleagues. job.name: Backend Engineer
job.description:
About Hotplate Hotplate exists to enable anyone to start and scale a local food business without a brick and mortar.

The traditional brick and mortar restaurant model is broken: it requires six figures in upfront capital and comes with high operating costs. Within their first year, 2/3 of all restaurants and bakeries close.

The next wave of food entrepreneurship is emerging. These chefs and bakers run businesses from home, commissary kitchens, or mobile pop-ups. They generate hype and buzz on Instagram and run almost entirely on pre-orders. The result is 50-80% profit margins, over 10x the traditional 5% margin of a brick and mortar.

But today’s e-commerce tools weren’t built for this way of selling food. Without Hotplate, chefs and bakers hack together DMs, Google Forms, Square, and Shopify. They spend more time managing logistics than growing their business.

We've supported 7,000 businesses generating $100M+ in sales, many of whom are the top pop ups in the country recognized by the New York Times, James Beard, Infatuation, Eater, etc., and we're just getting started.

By building the foundational tool for this new model, we have the opportunity to fundamentally change the food industry for the better: increasing the diversity and accessibility of food by making it possible for anyone to start a food business.

*The role* As a backend and infrastructure engineer at Hotplate, you'll own the systems that thousands of chefs and bakers run their businesses on, and that their customers buy from. When a popular chef opens a drop, customers arrive at once and compete for limited items, and every order has to be right: the inventory, the payment and the pickup.

Some of the problems you'll work on:

  • Make high demand drops fast and reliable. Keep inventory accurate and checkout responsive when customers arrive at once and compete for limited items.
  • Build the backend foundation for our consumer app. Design the APIs, data models, and services behind discovery, feeds, and every other customer facing surface to get people relevant results and make interactions fast and data rich to drive ordering.
  • Make critical workflows dependable. Build reliable systems for notifications, background jobs, and third party integrations.
  • Keep Hotplate getting faster and more stable. Find bottlenecks, improve observability, and own production issues through lasting fixes.

You'll work directly with the founders, ship features alongside the rest of the team, and make decisions about how our backend evolves. This is a hands on role with broad ownership and a direct connection between your work and the experience of chefs and their customers.

This role is based in San Francisco, and we are 5 days a week in-person. We move fast.

job.name: Software Engineer
job.description:
About Us Mintive helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools.

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. Our gateway product scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

We are AI-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co-founded Coursera.

*The Job* You will own features end to end, from conception to production, across our gateway infrastructure, enterprise deployments, and agentic systems. The work leans backend and infra, but nothing is off limits: when the product needs a better UI you build it, and when a connector breaks during a security review you fix it.

Claude and Codex are your primary working environment, and you use a fleet of agents to move faster than a team this size has any right to. Agents write much of the code and review PRs, so your real job is the judgment they cannot make: shaping the problem, making architecture, product, and UX calls, hardening enterprise paths, designing connectors, protecting security-sensitive surfaces, and catching generated code that is quietly wrong. Roles are blurred and we ship within hours, and you will learn directly from the founders and from customers.

job.name: Technical Lead
job.description:
About Lila Games:

Lila Games strives to build a world-class engineering team (eventually) that can compete with the best in the world. We are a long way from that ambition, but we hope to find others to help us build this team from Bangalore, India. Built in India, published to the world.

More information about Lila: https://tr.ee/7DD-CnUfci

Why This Role Exists:

We are a multi-game studio, and our biggest constraint is how fast we can ship new games. We need a Tech Lead who helps us ship new games faster, both by working directly on the games and by building the shared systems and tooling that multiple projects reuse.

This is a full-stack, full-lifecycle role. The work spans backend and frontend, in Unity, Godot, or whatever a project uses. You should be comfortable picking up new tech stacks fast. You will not be boxed into one engine or one game.

What You Will Own:

  • Build shared foundations and systems: Design the systems and tooling that multiple projects reuse, so new games start from a stronger base instead of rebuilding the same things each time.
  • Build for liveops operability from day one: Every feature you ship should be operable without engineering involvement after launch. Designers should be able to adjust weapon balance, drop rates, event timing, and economy levers through config or dashboards, not by filing engineering tickets. Think about who operates what you build, not just whether it works on launch day.
  • Design scalable features: Architect features that hold up as a game grows in players and content, and that work across projects rather than being rebuilt each time.
  • Build testable systems, not just tested systems: Pure logic (economy calculations, matchmaking, config parsing, anything that does not touch the engine) should be unit tested. Gameplay systems should be designed so their logic can be validated without running the full game. You do not need TDD dogma everywhere, but you must know what to test, what not to test, and how to architect so testing is possible.
  • Own features end to end across projects: Take features from scoping to shipped, across backend and frontend, often on more than one game at a time. Translate requirements into well-scoped engineering tasks with realistic estimates, in collaboration with product and design.
  • Lead and mentor the engineering team in Bangalore: Most engineers have not received structured technical feedback. Code review is your primary mentorship tool: specific, technical, and instructive. Your goal is to raise the floor of every engineer around you.

Working With AI:

You should be comfortable building with AI agents as part of your normal workflow:

job.name: Content Marketer, Data
job.description:
Clarity is redefining how private companies and their shareholders access liquidity. Through its institutional-grade platform, Clarity brings together buyers, sellers, and issuers to facilitate secondary transactions in venture-backed, pre-IPO companies, introducing efficiency, transparency, and standardization to an otherwise opaque asset class.

Recognized as one of Canada's fastest-growing companies and backed by leading U.S. investors, Clarity is profitable, well-capitalized, and building a high-performance team to meet growing demand and pursue new market opportunities.

Interested in learning more about life at Clarity? Check out our careers page to see how you can grow with us!

As a Content Marketer, Data at Clarity, you'll help define a new category of investing. Companies are staying private longer and reaching a scale once reserved for the public markets. That changes what a well-balanced investment portfolio looks like, and we want you to build the research that shows investors how. Put simply, you'll help shape a new era in equity investing.

Clarity has transacted more than $6B in private company stock since launching in 2023. Your work will explain how the private markets have performed and how investors can use those insights to shape their portfolios going forward. Using Clarity's proprietary data and third-party research, you'll produce data and write insights for company reports, sector reports, market intelligence, and a monthly newsletter. You'll also own two of these content types from the first data pull to the final published copy, with real autonomy and room to grow as our marketing team scales.

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Would Include

  • Owning our Liquidity Thesis series: researching, writing, and updating in-depth reports on the pre-IPO companies investors watch most closely.
  • Turning Clarity's trading data into market intelligence on trading activity, liquidity, market depth, investor participation, and price movement.
  • Building the data and the story behind our annual and quarterly reports on the largest private U.S. companies, including the ones that make the jump to the public markets.
  • Synthesizing third-party research on how institutions, family offices, advisors, and ultra-high-net-worth investors approach private markets.
  • Researching and writing a monthly investor newsletter.

job.name: Data Coordinator Clinical Trials - BC Cancer - Vancouver
job.description:
Data Coordinator, Clinical Trials BC Cancer

Vancouver, BC

The Data Coordinator, Clinical Trials (DCCT) receives direction from Principal Investigators and Director, Business & Strategic Initiatives, Cancer Care, or designates.

The DCCT functions as a member of the collaborative, interdisciplinary Clinical Trials Team responsible for planning and implementing clinical trials. The DCCT participates in the coordination of clinical trials from the protocol review and approval stage through to activation, trial closure and follow-up.The DCCT has principal responsibility for clinical trials data management, including designing data capture tools, capturing and recording clinical trials data, monitoring and promoting the quality and integrity of data, and preparing summary reports. Data management is performed in accordance with trial protocol, procedures, guidelines and professional standards of practice.

What You’ll Do- Perform the data management aspects of clinical trials, in collaboration with other members of the Clinical Trials and Health Care Team, by performing duties such as:

  • Organizing and maintaining study files and documentation
  • Preparing reports and regulatory documents as required, distribution to external individuals and/or groups.
  • Providing input into the development of clinical trial budgets.
  • Ensuring that follow-up tests are completed and deficiencies report.
  • Organizing and conducting study start-up and termination procedures with outside agencies in accordance with Federal Guidelines adapted by each sponsor.
  • Correlating, organizing, calculating trials data for reports, audits, studies, and other client needs according to established criteria.Completing study case report forms and other documents within the required timeframes.
  • Retrieving or requesting data by identifying selection parameters for retrieval.
  • Obtaining information from the patient, chart, family, or other health care professional as required.
  • Utilizing coding systems and resources as required to code and input data as pertaining to Clinical Trials.
  • Capture clinical trials data, as specified in the protocol and in collaboration as required with the Clinical Trials Team, by performing duties such as:
  • Design and develop clinical trial data collection tools, in collaboration with the Clinical Trials Team, by performing duties such as designing forms, tables, and data definitions.
  • Plan and prepare for external audits in collaboration with other members of the Clinical Trials Team; meets with monitors as required.
  • Participates in the evaluation, planning, and implementation of clinical trial protocols by performing duties such as:

+ Reviewing protocols and providing input on resource impact issues related to data management.
+ Reviewing protocols and commenting on form design and data management requirements.
+ Providing input into the development of clinical trial budgets.

Department: Supply Chain Excellence

Capability Area: Business Process

Location: North Vancouver

Your Opportunity at ARC’TERYX:
As Manager, Business Process, you own the design, improvement, and governance of supply chain planning processes across the organization. You are the person who turns operational complexity into clear, scalable workflows, facilitating workshops, diagnosing root causes, and driving adoption of process changes across functions. You bring structured thinking and cross-functional influence and are ready to raise the bar on how the organization plans and executes. It's a role with real ownership, visible impact, and the opportunity to shape how a world-class supply chain operates at scale.

This role is based out of our North Vancouver office and is open to hybrid remote work. Candidates must be eligible to work in Canada.

Meet Your Future Team:

The Business Process team is responsible for defining, standardizing, and continuously improving enterprise processes to enable efficient, scalable, and cross-functional operations. The team partners closely with business functions, Technology, and Data & Analytics to ensure processes are aligned to business strategy, supported by systems and data, and consistently executed. Through governance, design, and change enablement, the team drives operational excellence and sustained business value.

If you were in the Manager, Business Process role now, here are some of the core activities you would be doing:

  • Facilitating process design workshops to map current and future-state workflows across supply chain planning functions
  • Conducting root-cause analysis to identify process gaps, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities
  • Leading the implementation of process changes, establishing clarity on roles and responsibilities, and driving consistent adoption across functions
  • Monitoring process performance metrics and escalating risks or deviations to the appropriate stakeholders

Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:

  • Developing standard operating procedures and process documentation that serve as the foundation for training and onboarding across planning teams
  • Creating process playbooks and reference materials that enable planning teams to drive continuous improvement independently
  • Identifying and prioritizing a pipeline of process improvement opportunities, translating them into structured initiatives with measurable outcomes
  • Partnering with business functions, Technology and Data & Analytics to operationalize processes within systems and ensuring data is effectively leveraged to support decision-making

Are you our next Manager, Business Process?

  • You have a bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, or a related field
  • You have 5-8+ years of experience in business process, process improvement, or a relevant supply chain or operations role

job.description:
Marketing Statement A career at TransLink and our family of companies means working with people with a wide range of skills and perspectives, all teaming up towards a common goal: preserving and enhancing the region's world-envied quality of life. Together, we connect the region and enhance its livability by providing a sustainable transit and transportation network, embraced by our communities and people.

At TransLink we are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of the communities in which we live. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and accessible workplace, recognizing the unique value and skills every individual brings.

Looking for a great place to work where your contributions are valued and you can make a difference in a vibrant city? At TransLink, one of BC’s Top Employers, you'll help make Metro Vancouver a better place to live, built on transportation excellence. Put your future in motion!

Responsibilities PRIMARY PURPOSE

Facilitates the process and organizational change for a business unit by defining needs and recommending technology solutions that deliver value to stakeholders through the discipline of Business Analysis. Ensures stakeholder requirements and solution options are conveyed in terms of impact, risk, cost and alignment to corporate priorities and objectives. Provides expertise to ensure appropriate technology is utilized to meet the business need.

Key Accountabilities Aligns business requirements with the technology products and services currently provided by BTS, and also to recognize when a request is for something new, that we haven’t done before and there is no internal knowledge or expertise.

Collaborates with business representatives to understand the business need and understand their processes and how technology could enable improvements and meet business objectives. Determines requirements of the business need and identify the value, impact, and risks to be addressed, and estimates the investment and effort needed to achieve the desired result.

Develops business cases to support funding requests that validate the business need and clarify the alignment to strategic objectives and priorities. Document all requirements, research, findings and agreements, succinctly and clearly, without technical jargon and unnecessary complexity.

Researches and maintains currency on technology products within the market place, as well as, maintains a deep understanding of the inventory of products available internally, in order to assess and identify the solution options that would satisfy the business needs.

job.name: eCOA Coordinator
job.description:
Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

Job Overview

The eCOA Coordinator is a specialized clinical data management role requiring advanced knowledge and expertise in
electronic Clinical Outcome Assessment (eCOA) systems, processes, and clinical trial requirements.
This position serves as a subject matter expert (SME) for eCOA activities across assigned clinical projects, ensuring alignment
with sponsor requirements, regulatory standards, and industry best practices. Provides eCOA-specific support to study teams
within Data Sciences, working under the direction of the eCOA Manager. Collaborates cross-functionally to maintain system
integrity, support study timelines, and contribute to the successful delivery of project milestones. Supports departmental
initiatives and company-wide strategic objectives through continuous process improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee questionnaire translation workflows, linguistic validation, and review of translated materials to ensure compliance with sponsor requirements and industry standards. Prepare and maintain essential eCOA documentation including user guides and test scripts.
  • Develop and execute comprehensive UAT scripts to test eCOA system functionality, including questionnaire logic, visit schedules, branching logic, and data capture features. Document testing results and report issues for resolution.
  • Generate and review report outputs for accuracy, and support the creation and delivery of data transfers according to study requirements.
  • Perform administrative tasks including document distribution, report preparation, and internal communications. Support meeting coordination and attend as backup when needed.
  • Troubleshoot and triage eCOA-related issues, escalating to the eCOA Manager when necessary to ensure timely resolution and maintain system integrity.
  • Maintain approved study documentation in the electronic Trial Master File, ensuring study records are complete, accurate, and properly stored throughout the trial lifecycle.

job.name: Project Scheduler
job.description:
Job Details

12 months contract- possibility of extension

Hybrid- Surrey BC

  • 1-2 days per week surrey office
  • Q2 next year – work out of Delta office 3 days per week

Rate: 60-67/hr

JOB DESCRIPTION

We're looking for an experienced Scheduler to join an owner-side project controls team supporting a program of five projects in the engineering and natural gas space. The program covers the full engineering lifecycle: engineering, procurement, construction, permitting and commissioning.

In this new role, you'll build and maintain the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) and give leadership one reliable view of progress, the critical path, milestones and forecast completion. You'll work closely with project teams and several contractors to check progress, spot schedule pressure early and support mitigation and recovery planning.

What you'll do

Build and maintain the IMS across five projects, and roll them up into a program-level view.

Run the regular update cycle by gathering contractor and project team updates and adding actuals, forecasts and approved changes.

Review and challenge contractor baselines and updates. Check them for logic, constraints, open ends, lags, float, calendars and coding.

Confirm reported progress, remaining durations and forecast dates.

Monitor critical and near-critical paths, key milestones, and internal, external and cross-project dependencies.

Analyze performance and variance against the approved baseline, and track trends.

Assess the schedule impact of changes, and review time-impact and extension-of-time submissions.

Flag emerging delays and support recovery and mitigation plans.

Prepare schedule reporting, commentary and dashboard inputs for project and program leadership.

Keep baseline and schedule-basis records for assurance and claims prevention.

Key deliverables

Integrated Master Schedule (IMS)

Regular schedule updates

Critical and near-critical path analysis

Major milestone report

Variance analysis, trend analysis and schedule forecast

Change impact assessments

Recovery and mitigation analysis

Monthly schedule explanations and dashboard inputs

What success looks like

The IMS and baseline are accurate and trusted.

Contractor schedules pass quality checks.

Delays are flagged early, with mitigation plans in place.

Monthly reports and dashboards are clear and on time.

Records are complete enough to protect the project in disputes or claims.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

5+ years of hands-on project scheduling across the full lifecycle on large, multi-contractor capital projects, ideally on the owner side

Building and maintaining an Integrated Master Schedule (IMS)

Reviewing and challenging contractor schedules, including quality checks on logic, constraints, open ends, lags, float, calendars and coding

Critical and near-critical path analysis, plus variance and trend analysis against the baseline

job.description:
Job Details

12 months contract- possibility of extension

Hybrid- Surrey BC

  • 1-2 days per week surrey office
  • Q2 next year – work out of Delta office 3 days per week

Rate:70-77/hr

JOB DESCRIPTION

We're looking for an experienced Project Controls Lead to be the senior integrating role on an owner-side projects controls team in the utility sector.

You'll lead project controls across several assigned projects, bringing cost, schedule, forecasting, change, risk and performance reporting together into one clear view of project performance. You'll make sure project information is accurate, timely, controlled and aligned with project governance requirements. You'll lead and coach the Schedulers, Cost Controllers and Project Control Analysts, report to the Manager, and support Project Managers and program leadership with decision-ready analysis.

What you'll do

Lead and coordinate project controls across assigned projects, setting priorities and deliverables for the controls team.

Combine cost, schedule, change, risk, forecast, and progress information into one view of project performance.

Run monthly forecast reviews with Project Managers and challenge key assumptions and emerging cost or schedule pressures.

Review cost and schedule performance against approved budgets, baselines and key milestones.

Oversee change control and make sure approved changes are reflected in project controls information.

Review and challenge contractor cost reports, schedules, forecasts, progress claims, change submissions and recovery plans.

Manage weekly look-aheads and track progress from contractors and internal department leads.

Lead the monthly project controls report, Monthly Executive Report (MER), dashboards and variance explanations.

Keep the issues and actions log current and escalate significant risks and issues to the Manager.

Develop and maintain the Project Controls Execution Plan and the integrated controls calendar.

Lead baseline reviews and run quality checks before anything goes to management.

Monitor contractor compliance with owner reporting requirements and coordinate readiness for assurance reviews.

Give technical direction to controls specialists and coach them.

Key deliverables

Integrated monthly project controls report

Monthly Executive Report (MER)

Consolidated cost and schedule performance analysis

Monthly forecast review

Variance and trend explanations

Critical path and milestone summary

Change and performance summary

Who We Are Applied Materials is a global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. We design, build and service cutting-edge equipment that helps our customers manufacture display and semiconductor chips – the brains of devices we use every day. As the foundation of the global electronics industry, Applied enables the exciting technologies that literally connect our world – like AI and IoT. If you want to push the boundaries of materials science and engineering to create next generation technology, join us to deliver material innovation that changes the world.

What We Offer Salary:

$108,000.00 - $148,500.00

Location:

Austin,TX

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

The JOLT Program Management Office & Operations Product Development team drives technology, business processes, and strategic innovation supporting Applied Materials Global Operations. The rapid growth in semiconductor markets across the world presents unprecedented challenges and opportunities in manufacturing, supply chain and logistics.The Supply Chain Planning Analyst supports integrated demand, supply, capacity, and inventory planning within a complex semiconductor equipment manufacturing environment. The role translates business requirements into planning insight, identifies supply–demand risk, facilitates cross-functional alignment, and drives planning decisions through structured analysis and scenario evaluation.

Key Responsibilities Supply Planning & Integrated Planning

  • Support supply response planning across multiple product families and planning horizons.
  • Analyze material, capacity, inventory, and supplier constraints.
  • Identify supply–demand gaps and develop mitigation recommendations.
  • Develop constrained and unconstrained supply scenarios.
  • Participate in monthly and quarterly planning cycles, including S&OP / IBP reviews.
  • Ensure planning assumptions, risks, and opportunities are clearly documented.

Planning Analytics & Decision Support

job.name: Associate Planner, Accessories
job.description:
Tecovas was founded with the simple goal of making the world's best western boots, apparel and leather goods - and selling them at a fair price. We are a brand revolutionizing a category and welcoming first-time boot buyers and western enthusiasts alike.

Tecovas is looking for an Associate Planner to support forecasting, inventory management and reporting for our Accessories category. Reporting directly to the Planning Manager, you will own the weekly data, forecasts and reports that keep our Accessories business running across channels. This is a hands-on role for someone early in their planning career, where you'll learn how plans get built and grow toward owning a category of your own.

This role is based in Austin, TX. Candidates must live in or be willing to relocate to Austin, TX.

What you'll do:

  • Track weekly sales and inventory for each accessories product, and flag items at risk of selling out or carrying too much stock.
  • In partnership with the sourcing team, follow incoming purchase orders against plan and let partners know about delays or changes.
  • Communicate regularly with Merchandising to keep product, launch timing, and pricing information up to date in planning trackers and systems
  • Update weekly sales, receipt and markdown forecasts with the Planner.
  • Help build seasonal plans by pulling historical data and building item-level forecasts that support sales, inventory and margin goals.
  • Support new product launches with performance data on similar items, colors, sizes and price points.
  • Track promotion and markdown results against last year and plan, and prepare item-level analysis to guide future markdown decisions.
  • Own weekly business reporting for the category, calling out key trends and keeping recurring reports accurate.
  • Support the monthly by channel open-to-buy update, our plan for how much inventory to buy, and end-of-season reviews of product and price performance.
  • Build and maintain Excel tools, AI-powered dashboards using tools like Claude, and one-off analyses to help the team plan more efficiently and make informed decisions

Experience we're looking for:

  • 1-3 years of experience in planning, allocation, buying, inventory management or business analysis
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups and working with large data sets. Experience with AI tools is a plus
  • Working knowledge of retail math, such as sell-through, weeks of supply, inventory turn and margin
  • Familiarity with planning, inventory or reporting systems
  • Bonus points for experience in apparel, footwear or accessories

job.name: Consultant, Strategy & Operations, AI & Automation Solutions
job.description:
About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Partnering across Client Services, Product, and Technology, AI & Automation Solutions helps simplify client interactions, modernize service delivery, and accelerate the adoption of scalable digital capabilities. job.name: Sr. Business Analyst (Starlink Platform Integrity)
job.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. BUSINESS ANALYST (STARLINK PLATFORM INTEGRITY) At SpaceX, we are committed to ensuring the service remains a force for good and sustains trust worldwide: both connecting the unconnected and executing thorough processes to detect and prevent misuse by illicit operators. We are looking for an experienced Sr. Business Analyst, known internally as Sr. Customer Integrity & Threat Detection Analyst to detect, disrupt, and investigate potential misuse of the service—including proactively combating and deterring illicit operators. This person must strike the careful balance of safeguarding customer information and privacy while applying enforcement measures and executing with an even-handed approach, avoiding overreach and disproportionate collateral impacts.

Responsibilities

  • Proactively identify and assess platform integrity and abuse risks
  • Develop technical detection and mitigation strategies
  • React to investigate potential issues such as scams, fraud, and illicit goods/activities
  • Partner with cross-functional teams and deepen our relationships with them
  • Conduct periodic reviews to support legal and compliance obligations
  • Execute with consideration for customer privacy, targeting activities of indisputable harm and avoiding overreach

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree and 4+ years of professional experience in global affairs, intelligence, or investigations; OR 6+ years of professional experience in global affairs, intelligence, or investigations in lieu of a degree
  • 4+ years of experience with data querying languages (e.g., SQL), scripting languages (e.g., Python), geospatial tools (e.g., ArcGIS), and/or statistical software (e.g., R)
  • 4+ years of experience investigating, mitigating, or dealing with illicit operators (e.g., fraud, abuse, cybersecurity, or other illicit activities)

Preferred Skills And Experience

  • Strong analytical research and communication skills, including excellent written and oral communication skills
  • International professional exposure (e.g., working abroad or on global initiatives/businesses)
  • Experience in cybersecurity operations, threat detection, or vulnerability assessment in high-stakes environments
  • Experience with research and intelligence analytic techniques, including open-source intelligence (OSINT) data techniques
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment in a fast-paced, high-tech environment
  • Highly organized with a strong attention to detail
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and deadlines
  • Familiarity with U.S. and international economic sanctions and export control laws and regulations

job.name: Asset Management - Associate
job.description:
A well-established real estate investment firm is seeking an Asset Management Associate to join its team in Austin, Texas. The firm has a strong presence across the commercial real estate sector, with a particular focus on office assets.

This individual will work closely with the asset management team, supporting the execution of business plans, monitoring property performance, and identifying opportunities to enhance asset value across the portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the asset management of a portfolio of commercial real estate assets, primarily focused on office properties.
  • Monitor property-level financial and operational performance, including budgets, leasing activity, occupancy, and cash flow.
  • Assist with the development and execution of asset-level business plans and investment strategies.
  • Analyze leasing activity, market conditions, rental trends, and property valuations.
  • Work closely with property management teams, leasing brokers, and other external partners.
  • Prepare financial reporting, investment analyses, and performance updates for senior management and investors.
  • Identify opportunities to improve asset performance, maximize returns, and mitigate investment risks.
  • Support hold/sell analyses, valuations, and other strategic asset management initiatives.

Candidate Requirements

  • 2–5 years of relevant experience in commercial real estate asset management.
  • Previous exposure to office assets is strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of commercial real estate fundamentals, financial analysis, and property-level performance.
  • Experience with financial modeling, budgeting, and investment analysis.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Real Estate, Economics, or a related field.
  • Ideally graduated between 2021 and 2023, depending on professional experience.
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

This is an excellent opportunity for a real estate professional to join an established investment platform and gain meaningful exposure to office asset management and portfolio-level investment strategies.

job.name: Compensation Manager, Customer
job.description:
The Compensation team serves as a strategic advisor to business leaders, managers, and employees across MDB. We use data and insights to drive value and build the tools, models, and frameworks that support sound compensation decisions. This role sits within Compensation and partners closely with the Customer organization —and with Recruiting, Finance, Sales Operations, Legal, and HR.

The Difference You Will Make

We are looking for a Compensation Partner to serve as the dedicated partner for the Customer organization. This role will support VP and Director-level leaders, and their HRBP partners as the primary day-to-day compensation resource.

The ideal candidate will be a trusted business partner and builder of compensation programs, tools, and frameworks. They will bring deep experience supporting Customer organizations, a strong understanding of various incentive plans, and the ability to partner effectively with Operations and other teams that design them. This person must be comfortable operating autonomously, influencing senior stakeholders, and navigating a fast-moving environment.

A Typical Day

  • Serve as the dedicated compensation partner for the Customer organization, supporting leaders and People Partners across Customer Success, Professional Services, Technical Services and Strategic Partners teams
  • Provide data-informed guidance on new-hire offers, internal equity, leveling, promotions, retention actions, and out-of-cycle requests
  • Build a strong understanding of incentive plans and partner with the teams that design them to assess effectiveness and support informed compensation decisions
  • Own Partners compensation-cycle execution end-to-end, including market benchmarking, budget modeling, manager enablement, and leadership rollups
  • Lead competitive intelligence for Customer roles, researching compensation trends, pay practices, incentive structures, and talent movement in the evolving technology and AI landscape
  • Supplement survey data with recruiting signals, offer data, sales talent trends, and other real-time market sources
  • Partner with Recruiting and People Partners on market insights and competitive positioning for hires at all levels
  • Analyze compensation programs using data, business results, and stakeholder feedback; recommend improvements that support growth, retention, and pay-for-performance principles
  • Lead strategic projects such as incentive-plan governance, job architecture, or compensation-planning tool implementation
  • Develop manager enablement materials and training on compensation philosophy and decision-making

job.name: C3 Presents - Financial Analyst
job.description:
Job Summary WHO ARE WE? Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide. Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

C3 Presents creates music festival experiences for millions of fans across the globe, setting the new standard each year for events that are as memorable as they are spectacular, including Austin City Limits Music Festival in Texas, Lollapalooza in Chicago (and seven other countries), and Bonnaroo in Manchester, Tennessee.

WHO ARE YOU? Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

THE JOB The Financial Analyst supports financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and operational analysis across C3 Presents' festivals, events, and business operations. This role partners with Finance, Accounting, Sponsorship, Legal, Operations, and other business teams to provide accurate financial reporting, insightful analysis, and decision support.

The Financial Analyst is responsible for maintaining financial models, preparing forecasts and reports, analyzing business performance, and supporting budgeting processes. This position plays an important role in ensuring the accuracy of financial information while identifying trends, risks, and opportunities that support sound business decisions.

What This Role Will Do Financial Planning & Analysis

  • Assist with the preparation of monthly forecasts, annual operating budgets, long-range planning, and Capital Expenditure Requests (CERs).

  • Maintain financial models, forecasting schedules, dashboards, and management reporting.
  • Monitor forecast accuracy and recommend improvements to planning assumptions.
  • Analyze revenue and expense activity to identify trends and investigate reporting discrepancies.
  • Maintain financial tracking schedules and supporting business reports.

Process Improvement

job.name: CRO Strategist
job.description:
About Decentralized Masters Decentralized Masters is an investment education and research company. We went from two co-founders to 160+ people and 4,500+ paying members in four years, bootstrapped and profitable. Our business is built on continuity: high-ticket and low-ticket programmes that are membership-based, with payment plans, renewals, upsells and a paid newsletter. We have never taken outside capital. Our growth is still heavily direct-response: paid media on Facebook, YouTube and Google feeds the webinars, calls and offers that fund everything we do.

Our vision is to become the gold standard in investment education and research.

The Role You own conversion performance across the acquisition funnel, from first ad click to booked call. You find where prospects drop off, form hypotheses, run disciplined experiments, and ship the winners. Your work turns the same traffic into more registrations, more booked calls, and more cash.

What You'll Do

  • Audit the full funnel (ads, landing pages, registration and application pages, VSL/webinar pages, booking flows, confirmation and reminder sequences) and prioritize opportunities by expected revenue impact
  • Build and maintain a CRO roadmap with clear hypotheses, success metrics, and ICE/PIE-style prioritization
  • Design, launch, and analyze A/B and multivariate tests on copy, layout, offer framing, forms, and page speed
  • Write test briefs and collaborate with design, copy, and dev to ship variants quickly
  • Analyze funnel data in HubSpot, GA4, and ad platforms to find drop-off points and segment-level insights (source, device, audience, creative)
  • Use heatmaps, session recordings, and user surveys to turn qualitative behavior into testable ideas
  • Partner with the Ad Creative Strategist so ad messaging and landing page messaging stay aligned
  • Work with the sales team (setters and closers) to connect front-end changes to lead quality, show rate, and close rate, not just top-of-funnel conversion
  • Document every test, result, and learning in a shared experiment log
  • Report weekly on test velocity, wins, and revenue impact to the Director of Acquisition

Requirements What You Bring

job.name: Principal Supply Demand Planner – Spares & FRUs - Supply Chain Operations
job.description:
Archer is collaborating with Oracle to connect them with exceptional professionals for this role. Description The Principal Supply Demand Planner owns end-to-end supply and demand planning for service spares, Field Replaceable Units (FRUs), and New Product Introductions (NPIs). The role ensures service readiness, supply continuity, and optimal inventory across the product lifecycle.

This senior individual contributor operates with a high degree of autonomy and partners across Service, Engineering, NPI, Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics, Repair, Finance, and Product teams to manage risk, optimize inventory, and support customer service commitments.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities Analytics & Business Management

  • Develop dashboards and planning models for supply, demand, and inventory..
  • Track service levels, shortages, forecast performance, and inventory health..
  • Perform root-cause analysis on planning and service gaps..
  • Compare NPI assumptions to actual field performance..
  • Develop supply-demand scenarios for business and financial planning..
  • Drive improvements in planning tools, data, and processes..

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the planning subject matter expert for spares, FRUs, and NPI..
  • Lead supply-demand and launch-readiness reviews..
  • Communicate risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to leadership..
  • Influence cross-functional decisions without direct authority..
  • Drive resolution of complex supply-chain issues..

NPI & Launch Planning

  • Own spares and FRU planning for new product introductions..

Demand Planning

  • Own demand forecasts for assigned spares and FRU portfolios..

job.name: Senior Value Consultant
job.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

Our primary goal is to help pre-sales and post-sale teams to incorporate value into every single deal. Our work contributes directly to Braze’s two most important focus areas; closing new business and reducing churn.

The team focuses on 3 key areas:

  • Pre-Sale Support: Helping AEs and account teams develop business cases & value-based narratives to quantify the impact Braze can have on our prospects business
  • Scaling our Offering: We scale our offering through AI, e.g. NotebookLM and Claude Skills that help AEs automate data requests and business case development. We also assist with value-related enablement sessions
  • Post-Sale Value communication: Assisting CS communicate the value Braze has delivered at different points of the contract lifecycle, e.g. QBRs with the goal of increasing the likelihood of upsells and mitigating churn

What You'll Do

  • Help articulate value to customers during the entire contract lifecycle (pre-sales & post-sales), consulting with prospects, partners, and existing clients to build compelling ROI analyses and business cases
  • Develop solutions to help scale our offering to the organization through AI and by managing internal enablement tools for Sales and Customer Success

job.name: Demand Planner
job.description:

The company’s disruptive and innovative products compete in the Functional Beverage and Active Nutrition segments, under three consumer-loved brands: C4® (one of the fastest-growing energy drink brands in the United States and the #1 selling global pre-workout brand), XTEND® (the #1 post-workout recovery brand in the United States), and Cellucor® (an award-winning sports nutrition brand created in 2002).

job.name: Compensation Analyst Snr
job.description:
Job Summary Are you a seasoned compensation professional who enjoys digging into data, evaluating jobs, and translating complex information into meaningful recommendations? Do you have a knack for comparing roles, researching market trends, and helping organizations build fair, consistent, and competitive compensation programs?

job.name: Product Engineer
job.description:
Job Title: Product Engineer, Gaming

Location: Bangalore, India (Full-Time In-Office)

About:

We are dedicated to creating unique and exceptional gaming experiences. Our studio is a place where data-driven strategy meets deep engineering ownership , and where engineers don’t just build features , they shape product outcomes.

We are looking for high-IQ, product-minded engineers who can think from first principles, move fast, and take end-to-end ownership of systems that directly impact player experience, retention, and monetization.

The Role:

You’ll be the person who collapses the gap between idea and evidence .

From the first whiteboard discussion to the first playtest to the first feature shipped, you own that arc end-to-end. You’ll work closely with Product, Design, Art and Engineering to turn hypotheses → prototypes → production systems .

This is not a pure coding role. It’s not a pure product role.

It’s for someone who is operates credibly in both

What You'll Do:

  • Ideation & Concept Testing : Rapidly prototype game ideas in days, define clear hypotheses, instrument for signal, and decide fast—iterate or kill.
  • Prototyping & 0→1 Ownership : Own prototype lifecycle end-to-end (scope → build → playtest → decision) with a focus on speed and learning.
  • Feature Development & System Ownership : Take validated ideas to production, ensuring clean execution, minimal drift, and strong launch readiness.
  • Core Game Systems : Build scalable, config-driven systems (progression, economy, live ops, FTUE) optimized for fast iteration.
  • Experimentation & Data : Ship features with instrumentation, run experiments, and iterate based on real player behavior and metrics.
  • Product Thinking : Evaluate what to build (and what not to) using data, player insight, and first-principles thinking.

What You'll Bring:

Must-Haves:

  • Strong engineering background (CS fundamentals, system design, debugging); ability to quickly pick up new tools and technologies
  • Strong product instincts, you’ve built or shipped something and learned from its success/failure
  • High IQ with the ability to address significant problems from first principles and in a well-structured way.
  • Massive attention to detail, ensuring you don’t miss any minor issues.
  • Outstanding communication, collaboration, and leadership skills, with the ability to inspire teams and influence stakeholders at all levels.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience in mobile F2P product roles; shipped or operated a live-service title.
  • Proven track record of taking a prototype → live feature within a professional games studio environment.
  • Hands-on A/B testing, UA creative iteration, and basic ad monetization mechanics.
  • Experience with game engines like Unity or similar interactive systems

job.name: Senior Mobile Application Developer (iOS & Apple TV)
job.description:
Hiring for BRAHMA AI — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

Brahma AI builds enterprise technology for content creation, management and distribution. This role focuses on native Apple applications, bringing reliable mobile and television experiences to complex media and enterprise workflows.

About the Role

As a Senior Mobile Application Developer, you will design, develop and maintain production applications for iOS, iPadOS and Apple TV (tvOS). This is a full-time, hands-on engineering role for someone with 5+ years of mobile development experience who has delivered both native iOS and native tvOS applications. You will independently own features, work with existing complex codebases and troubleshoot production issues.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain native iOS and tvOS applications using Swift, UIKit and SwiftUI, with reusable components and maintainable MVC/MVVM architectures.
  • Implement Apple TV navigation, Focus Engine behaviour, Siri Remote interactions and TV-specific application lifecycle handling.
  • Develop media playback using AVPlayer, AVKit and AVFoundation, including playback controls, subtitles and multiple audio tracks.
  • Integrate REST APIs, JSON, third-party SDKs, local storage, caching, push notifications and deep links.
  • Work on streaming reliability, secure media delivery and device communication, including authentication, pairing and real-time integrations.
  • Diagnose crashes, memory leaks, concurrency issues, buffering and playback failures using Xcode, Instruments, logs and profiling tools.
  • Own testing, TestFlight distribution, provisioning and App Store releases for the modules you deliver.
  • Collaborate with Product, QA, UI/UX and Backend teams, review code and contribute to architecture and release planning.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of mobile application development experience, with strong professional native iOS development using Swift.
  • Actual hands-on native Apple TV/tvOS development experience; theoretical familiarity or cross-platform-only experience is not sufficient.
  • Practical experience using AVPlayer, AVKit or AVFoundation to deliver production media playback.
  • Strong UIKit/SwiftUI knowledge, REST API integration experience and working knowledge of Objective-C.
  • Sound understanding of memory management, multithreading, concurrency, application lifecycle, local persistence and caching.
  • Experience maintaining released applications, debugging complex production issues and improving performance and stability.
  • Ability to independently translate requirements into maintainable code, own modules and work effectively in existing codebases.
  • Experience with Xcode, Instruments, TestFlight, provisioning profiles and App Store deployment.

job.description:

We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain, and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Data-driven decision-making is at the core of Amazon’s culture and people who are exceptionally talented at analyzing large sets of data to build insights are critical. Your work will directly impact the decisions and strategy of the entire AWS Infrastructure Services org and our customers. You will be gathering customer needs and insights, mining large and diverse data sets from across AWS Infrastructure, building visualizations and tools for our business partners, generating insights to help senior leaders make critical business decisions. Job Title: Senior AI Product Manager

Location: Vancouver, BC (Remote)

Duration: FTE/Perm

A reasonable, good faith estimate of the minimum and maximum for this position is CAD$150K/year to CAD$180K/year with benefits

Job Description:

ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking a Senior AI Product Manager to lead the charge in building the next generation of intelligent Procure-to-Pay automation. This is a pivotal opportunity to define and execute our AI vision, transforming how thousands of companies manage their spending by harnessing one of the most unique and comprehensive datasets in the industry.

You will be responsible for turning cutting-edge AI concepts into tangible customer value, creating features that deliver unprecedented efficiency by reasoning over multimodal data (e.g. invoices, PDFs, emails, and user queries). You will join a world-class, cross-functional team of engineers, data scientists, and designers dedicated to shipping impactful, AI-powered products.

WHAT YOU'LL BE WORKING ON

  • Define the AI Product Vision & Strategy: You will own the AI product roadmap. You'll identify the most impactful opportunities for intelligence, from intake automation to complex compound AI systems, including the orchestration of multiple specialized agents, to manage the entire procurement lifecycle.
  • Lead the Data-for-AI Strategy: You will determine how we leverage our most valuable asset, our proprietary data, to build a defensible competitive advantage. This includes identifying and structuring data for use with foundation models and ensuring the quality and integrity that fuel our AI experiences.
  • Drive Product Discovery & Validation: You will immerse in customer workflows to uncover their most challenging problems. You will lead rapid, feedback-driven prototyping cycles with emerging technologies (LLMs, RAG) to validate new use cases and de-risk our technical investments.
  • Own the End-to-End Product Lifecycle: You will guide AI features from initial concept through to launch and iteration. You will define success metrics that connect model performance to user value, and partner with Engineering to ensure our features are scalable, reliable, and responsible.
  • Gather Customer Feedback: Establish ongoing feedback mechanisms with customers to monitor AI behavior in order to continuously fine-tune performance and user trust.
  • Drive Go-to-Market & Adoption: You will partner closely with our Go-to-Market teams (Sales, Marketing, Customer Success) to articulate the value of our AI solutions, drive market adoption, and solidify our position as a leader in intelligent procurement.
  • Nice to have: Experience as a product manager on an AI enablement team, fostering adoption of AI capabilities across diverse product areas and teams with varying levels of AI maturity.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

job.name: Lead Product Manager, Agent Factory
job.description:
About Juniper Square Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time. About Your Role We’re looking for a Lead Product Manager to build our agent factory. You’ll start by turning how fund administration gets done today into automated workflows, where agents, code and people each take the steps they do best, and then quickly extend the factory more broadly into Private Markets.

About 60% of your time goes to the agent factory, starting with core fund administration workflows such as capital calls and fund onboarding. The other 40% goes to partnering with the product executive team on AI strategy and long-term vision, and shaping how we bring agentic solutions to market. You will also play a role in building our internal R&D factory where agents help us design, code, test and deploy our own software.

The work is early and the problems are hard, and engineering will look to you to make the call on ambiguous tradeoffs. AI fluency is a baseline expectation: you should prototype with agents, build your own automations, and use AI to move 10x faster than a traditional PM.

Who You Are

You are a technically excellent leader who thrives on ownership and building from the ground up.

  • You have outstanding problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and drive initiatives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

job.name: Senior / Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Fraud
job.description:
About Radar Radar is the global leader in geolocation, with geofencing SDKs, maps APIs, and AI-enabled solutions for marketing, fraud, and operations teams.

Why is Radar the best place to work?

  • We're trusted by some of the world's best companies, from high-growth startups to the Fortune 500.
  • We have incredible scale: We're processing over 1 billion API calls per day from hundreds of millions of devices.
  • We're well-resourced, and we've raised $85.5M from world-class investors, including Accel and Insight Partners.
  • We have a high-performance culture, with ambitious and entrepreneurial teammates in every role.
  • We recently moved into an amazing new office in Flatiron, Manhattan, NYC.
  • We were recently named a top 10 best place to work in NYC by Crain's.

Despite our growth and scale, we're still just getting started. That's where you come in.

About The Role We're looking for a Senior/Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Fraud to build machine learning-based anti-fraud systems into core Radar products. The ideal engineer for this role is someone who has built ML-based fraud detection models, leveraged in a risk based rules engine. The perfect candidate will see themselves as a generalist who has built real ML systems and is ultimately motivated by driving impact to products and customers by building end-to-end features that leverage machine learning to prevent fraud.

How We Work Most of our engineering team are former technical co-founders or former Radar interns from schools like Waterloo and CMU. Most engineers at Radar fit one of two molds, technically: either Staff level expertise in one stack, or "Multi-Stack" at any level. We say "Multi-Stack" because "Full-Stack" has the connotation of "Frontend and Backend", but Radar Engineers might also work on Mobile or Data engineering. Not that you need to be an expert in all of those, but a desire to learn, jump around to different stacks, and get things done is the important part.

We care a lot about shipping fast and talking to customers. We're committed to our product vision of full-stack location infrastructure, but we also know that customer feedback is a treasure map to gold. Even though Slack is the brain of our company, working together in-person in our NYC HQ is the fastest way for us to get things done. We meet on Mondays to plan out work for the week in small groups and use Linear for planning.

To us, a week is a long time, and we expect to ship big things every week.

The Stack We have systems that leverage LightGBM and random forests using scikit and Rust and we need to build out new systems impacting additional products.

The server is a TypeScript Node.js app and a Geospatial Rust database we built called HorizonDB. We use MongoDB, S3/Athena, Redis, Airflow and everything is deployed to AWS.

Most engineers are in the on-call rotation.

job.name: Staff Security Engineer, Enterprise AI
job.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The InfoSec team protects Affirm’s systems and data from evolving threats. We manage security risk, monitor vulnerabilities, and enforce protective controls across the company. The team leads incident response, compliance, identity and access management, and employee training. Our goal is to ensure that security is built into every system and decision at Affirm. We maintain a secure, trustworthy environment so the business can operate and grow with confidence.

In this role, you'll build and run Affirm's end-to-end security review process for enterprise AI/LLM systems evaluating architecture, prioritizing AI-specific risks, and designing the controls and guardrails that let Affirm adopt AI safely, partnering across Security, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, IT, and Engineering to make it scalable and repeatable.

What You’ll Do

  • You will lead and continuously improve Affirm's enterprise AI security review process evaluating the architecture, data flows, permissions, and design of internal AI tools, agentic/MCP-based systems, and AI features — and embed security requirements into the design phase.
  • You will threat model AI/LLM-based systems and their data flows for risks such as prompt injection, insecure output handling, excessive agency, tool-permission abuse, data poisoning, and sensitive-data exposure, and drive remediation.
  • You will review source code, system prompts, agent configurations, and tool/permission manifests (e.g., MCP definitions), and help tool owners build security-focused test cases and red-team/eval scenarios to verify requirements before launch.
  • You will design and build security guardrails and tooling for AI systems permission boundaries, authn/authz for agentic tools and MCP servers, data-handling controls, logging/monitoring, and policy-as-code (Python, IaC) — to enforce and automate AI security.
  • You will evaluate the AI capabilities of third-party SaaS vendors (e.g., Notion, Slack, Google Workspace) as part of vendor and SaaS security reviews and drive risk-based adoption decisions.
  • You will identify emerging classes of AI/agentic security vulnerabilities, develop mitigations before they become incidents, and contribute to AI-specific incident response playbooks as a senior escalation point.
  • You will lead cross-functional AI security initiatives to closure, advise technical and executive stakeholders as an internal point of expertise, and stay current on the AI security landscape (OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS) to translate new research into practical controls.

What We Look For

Your domain knowledge — whether in detection engineering, threat intelligence and adversary analysis, cloud security, adversary simulation, mobile and platform security, forensic investigation, or emerging areas like AI/ML security — becomes the foundation for capabilities no existing AI system can replicate.This role is for security practitioners who want to operate at the intersection of deep security expertise and frontier AI — not just using AI as a tool, but shaping what it becomes.

  • Build security products, tools, and capabilities — prototyping AI-driven solutions to real-world security challenges at Meta's scale

  • Identify where AI models lack security reasoning capability and directly contribute to improving them through expert-generated signals, evaluation, and feedback

  • Collaborate with model researchers to translate security expertise into training signal — decomposing hard problems into structured challenges that teach models to reason like security experts
