job.name: Applied Scientist, Selling Partner Support Engagement
job.description:
Description Amazon's Selling Partner Support handles tens of millions of contacts annually worldwide. Our science team is transforming this experience by building AI agents that autonomously resolve seller issues, learn from every interaction, and continuously improve with minimal human intervention. These agents reason and adapt — from understanding the seller's context and selecting the right solution, to routing contacts optimally and automating resolution end-to-end. We do this in deep partnership with multiple engineering and product teams.

We are looking for an Applied Scientist who is excited to work on reinforcement learning, agentic architectures, and large-scale production systems. You will be directly connected to the problems sellers face every day, translating real customer pain into science solutions that operate at massive scale. You will frame ambiguous business challenges as tractable machine learning problems and ship systems that measurably improve millions of seller interactions.

Key job responsibilities

  • Build evaluation frameworks that measure agent quality across dimensions such as helpfulness, correctness, and safety.
  • Own research and development of reinforcement-learning based agent improvement systems, from problem formulation through production deployment and impact measurement.
  • Design approaches to preference learning, reward modeling, and policy optimization for conversational agents operating over real-world tools and APIs.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to deploy models into production systems serving sellers worldwide.
  • Contribute to the team's scientific impact through peer review, mentorship, and publications at peer-reviewed venues.

A day in the life

You read the latest research papers and implement new techniques by building rapid prototypes using AI-assisted coding tools, then take what works from prototype to production. You collaborate closely with product managers and engineering teams to translate seller pain points into deployed science solutions. You work with senior scientists to propose experiments and make the case for what to build next. You also stay connected to the seller experience by understanding the real problems sellers face so your models solve what actually matters.

About The Team Our team is a growing group of scientists building the AI that powers Amazon's seller support experience. We operate across capabilities such as agentic systems, knowledge retrieval, and content automation, each owning distinct problem spaces but sharing evaluation infrastructure and research insights. We work backwards from business problems, deeply understanding the domain and defining success metrics and guardrails. This lets us run parallel experiments, compare approaches rigorously, and ship the best models to production. We publish at both internal and external venues and actively invest in research that compounds over multiple product cycles.

job.name: Applied Scientist - Agentic AI, Amazon Fulfillment Technology
job.description:
Description As an Applied Scientist in Amazon Fullfilment Technology, you will lead the development of agentic systems to assist with operational decision making and orchestration. You will work building full agentic systems leveraging multi-agent orchestration, tool use, memory, and action execution. You will train LLMs using a combination of rejection sampling approaches, SFT, continual post-training, and Reinforcement Learning (RL).

These systems are deployed to Amazon buildings, and you will also work on rigorous offline and online evaluations.

Your work will leverage the latest LLMs to develop capabilities for agentic reasoning, coding and analytics. You will also lead research projects to tackle unsolved problems, mentor interns, and author academic papers to summarize your findings for external publication.

Key job responsibilities

  • Generating training and preference data for specific use cases (reasoning trajectories, tool traces)
  • Reward modeling and policy optimization for LLMs: DPO, IPO, RLHF/RLAIF with PPO/GRPO, rejection sampling.
  • Supervised fine-tuning on step-by-step trajectories and tool-use traces
  • Verbal Reinforcement Learning and Continual Learning
  • RL for LLMs, Offline RL and off-policy evaluation
  • Agentic memory/state management; episodic and semantic memory; vector search; grounding with RAG.
  • Evaluation: developing decision quality metrics, scaling LLM-based evaluations.

About The Team Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) powers Amazon's global fulfillment network. We invent and deliver software, hardware, and data science solutions that orchestrate processes, robots, machines, and people. We harmonize the physical and virtual world so Amazon customers can get what they want, when they want it. Learn more about AFT: https://tinyurl.com/AFTOverview

  • 3+ years of building models for business application experience
  • PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience

  • Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

job.name: Data Scientist-Vibration Analytics
job.description:
About us

TrackBeat provides a wireless, end-to-end condition monitoring system that continuously tracks machine health to prevent unplanned failures and extend equipment life. Its rugged sensors combine vibration, temperature, and magnetometer technologies to detect issues such as imbalance, misalignment, bearing wear, friction, overload, and electrical stress well before breakdowns occur. Sensor data is sent wirelessly to an industrial receiver and then to the cloud, where machine-learning models learn each machine’s unique signature and identify meaningful changes. Clear alerts, health trends, and insights are delivered to dashboards and integrated with existing CMMS/EAM systems, enabling maintenance teams to plan downtime and scale monitoring from a few critical assets to entire sites. TrackBeat is based in Ontario, Canada, and focuses on monitoring a wide range of industrial equipment, including rotating, pumping, pressing, conveying, and drive systems.

Position Summary

We are looking for a Data Scientist with a specialization in vibration analysis to lead the analytics behind machine health assessment for industrial rotating equipment, such as motors, pumps, fans, gearboxes and compressors.

You will turn vibration and related sensor data into clear, reliable judgements: whether a machine is healthy, what fault is developing, how severe it is, and what maintenance should do about it. The role sits where mechanical engineering, signal processing and machine learning meet, and it has a direct, visible impact on our clients' operations.

This is a high-ownership role in a small team. You will shape our analytics practice from the ground up and work closely with the founders and engineering leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Analytics and modelling

  • Analyse vibration, temperature and related sensor data from industrial rotating machinery
  • Design, build and validate anomaly-detection models that reliably separate normal from abnormal machine behaviour
  • Develop fault-classification models for common failure modes, including imbalance, misalignment, mechanical looseness and rolling-element bearing defects
  • Estimate fault severity and progression, and support remaining-useful-life estimates where the data allows
  • Combine physics-based diagnostic rules with statistical and machine-learning methods to produce explainable results

Data and validation

  • Define and maintain data-quality standards, labelling processes and curated training and validation datasets
  • Make sure models generalize across different machine types, operating speeds, loads and installation conditions
  • Design experiments and field validation studies, and measure model performance (accuracy, false-alarm rate, detection lead time)
  • Validate analytical findings against observed machine condition, working with field and maintenance personnel

Collaboration and communication

Job Posting Title: Research Engineering/ Scientist Associate V, Hildebrand Department of Petroleum and Geosystems Engineering

Hiring Department: Hildebrand Department of Petroleum and Geosystems Engineering

Position Open To: All Applicants

Weekly Scheduled Hours: 40

FLSA Status: Exempt from FLSA

Earliest Start Date: Immediately

Position Duration: Expected to Continue

Location: UT MAIN CAMPUS

Job Details: General Notes

As a top-10 engineering school with the No. 1 program in Texas, the Cockrell School of Engineering at The University of Texas at Austin (UT Austin) has been a global leader in technology innovation and engineering education for over a century. With 11 undergraduate and 13 graduate programs, over 20 research centers and a faculty community that boasts one of the highest number of National Academy of Engineering members among U.S. universities, Texas Engineering has launched some of the nation’s most accomplished leaders and pioneered world-changing solutions in virtually every industry, from space exploration to energy to health care. Situated in the heart of Austin — named “America’s Coolest City” by Expedia and “The Best Place to Live in the U.S.” by U.S. News and World Report — the Cockrell School embodies the city’s innovative spirit. Major companies with Austin campuses, such as Dell, National Instruments, Apple, IBM, Samsung, Google and many others, continue to recruit Cockrell School students at a remarkable rate, launching thousands of successful careers and developing Texas Engineers into industry leaders.

Purpose

Advance computational methods and research software for quantitative formation evaluation, emphasizing multidimensional borehole electromagnetic modeling and resistivity inversion. Develop reliable, efficient tools that translate research advances into practical subsurface interpretation workflows and support consortium research and technology transfer.

Responsibilities

job.name: Senior / Staff Sim-to-Real Engineer
job.description:
Apptronik is a human-centered robotics company developing AI-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond.

We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better.

JOB SUMMARY We are looking for an experienced and autonomous Senior/Staff Sim-to-Real Engineer to bridge the gap between simulation and physical hardware for our advanced tendon-driven robotic hands.

Simulating tendon-driven mechanisms is notoriously difficult due to complex routing, friction, elasticity, and non-linear transmission dynamics. In this role, you will be responsible for creating elegant, highly accurate abstractions of these complex mechanisms for our simulators, and proving they work through rigorous empirical testing and system identification.

You will play a critical role in our control pipeline, ensuring that Reinforcement Learning (RL) policies trained in simulation successfully transfer to physical hardware. As a senior member of the team, you will have the autonomy to define our system identification roadmap, establish testing protocols, and drive the sim-to-real engineering culture.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES or KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Tendon Mechanism Abstraction: Develop and implement simple, computationally efficient, and highly accurate physical abstractions for complex tendon-driven mechanisms in simulation.
  • System Identification & Validation: Design and execute empirical testing protocols to identify system parameters and prove that your simulation abstractions accurately reflect physical reality.
  • Actuator Characterization: Perform rigorous system ID and control tuning on low friction robotic actuators to ensure high-fidelity torque and effort mapping.
  • Rigid Multi-Body Calibration: Drive the kinematic calibration, inertial parameter identification, and effort production verification across our multi-body hand systems.
  • Sim-to-Real Pipeline Ownership: Collaborate closely with the RL and Controls teams to ensure the dynamics engine and domain randomization strategies perfectly support zero-shot or few-shot transfer of control policies onto physical hardware.
  • Technical Leadership: Operate autonomously to identify bottlenecks in the sim-to-real pipeline, propose solutions, and lead the technical execution from concept to deployed hardware.

SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS

  • Apply methods through methods like distillation (and other techniques) to make efficient image and video understanding models, that are ready for production and can run at the scale of billions of daily ad impressions.
  • Calibrate automated image and video judges against human annotations, using preference learning and active learning to raise agreement with expert reviewers.
  • Run experiments, analyze the results, and turn findings into production improvements together with engineering and product partners. Share results in design reviews, documents and research publications.

About The Team The Creative X team within Amazon Advertising is on a mission to democratize access to high-quality ad creatives for advertisers worldwide. job.name: Research Scientist / Engineer – Reinforcement Learning Infrastructure
job.description:
You'll build the systems that make reinforcement learning work at frontier scale — coupling policy optimization with large fleets of inference workers, agentic environments, and the reward and verification systems that turn model behavior into learning signal. RL is how Luma's models go from capable to useful.

RL at scale is a full-loop systems problem: training, rollout generation, environment execution, and reward computation running concurrently across thousands of GPUs, all needing to stay fast, stable, and correct together. It fits someone who has lived this — post-trained LLMs with RL, built environments and verifiers, and debugged asynchronous rollout pipelines at scale. If you haven't operated RL at real scale, this will be deep water.

What You'll Own

  • Design, build, and scale distributed RL post-training systems, orchestrating trainer, rollout, environment, and reward workloads across thousands of GPUs.
  • Build high-throughput rollout generation, integrating inference engines (vLLM, SGLang), weight synchronization, and asynchronous/off-policy schemes.
  • Design RL environments for agentic, multi-step tasks — sandboxed code execution, tool use, computer use, multimodal interaction — reproducible and scalable to millions of episodes.
  • Build reward infrastructure: verifiable/programmatic rewards, reward-model serving, LLM-as-judge pipelines, and defenses against reward hacking.
  • Develop the evaluation, monitoring, and debugging tooling that keeps large RL runs stable.
  • Advance training efficiency and stability, and turn new post-training ideas into production runs with researchers.

First 90 Days One way the first 90 could unfold.

  • Days 1–30 — Immerse & Diagnose: Learn the current RL stack and where throughput, stability, or correctness break.
  • Days 30–60 — Ship & Validate: Improve a piece of the loop (rollout throughput, reward infra, or an environment) and prove it on a real run.
  • Days 60–90 — Scale & Systemize: Harden the full loop across thousands of GPUs and asynchronous architectures.

What You Bring

  • Hands-on experience post-training LLMs with RL (PPO/GRPO-family, RLHF, RLVR) at meaningful scale.
  • Extensive distributed PyTorch training and parallelism (FSDP, Tensor/Pipeline/Expert Parallel) for foundation models.
  • Experience building RL environments, reward functions, verifiers, or evaluation harnesses for LLM agents, including sandboxed execution and multi-turn tool use.
  • Deep familiarity with RL post-training frameworks (veRL, OpenRLHF, TRL, Ray orchestration) and rollout inference engines (vLLM, SGLang).
  • Strong understanding of GPU clusters, networking, and communication libraries (NCCL, MPI) under mixed training and inference workloads.

Nice to Have

Who You Are: Are you interested in researching cutting-edge developments in AI applied to climate modeling? Do you have a passion for applying technology to do good in the world? If so, an Ai2 research internship in the Climate Modeling team may be the perfect opportunity. We will be offering 12-week internships during summer 2027.   • Duration: 12 weeks
  • Start Date: Flexible
  • Candidates: A PhD student with a strong research background

Please apply by January 4, 2027, at 11:00pm Pacific Time to be considered for our Spring/Summer 2027 internships.

Who We Are: Ai2’s Climate Modeling team (Ai2CM) has developed ACE, the world’s leading AI-based global atmosphere emulator for climate applications. ACE can be trained to replicate weather variability and climate change at 100 km horizontal resolution using historical observations or outputs from any physics-based climate model. It runs hundreds of times faster on a single GPU than such a model running on a supercomputer. For climate-planning applications, we have implemented diffusion-based super-resolution for downscaling ACE simulations to kilometer-scale local detail. We also recently began a collaboration with Google Research to advance NeuralGCM, a hybrid AI-physics model, for climate projection applications.

Your Next Challenge: At Ai2, you will be working with world-class AI researchers and software engineers. We perform team-based, ambitious research, with a mandate to strive for big breakthroughs, not just incremental progress, in an exciting and interactive workplace.

Interns will develop and apply novel AI methodologies for projects such as: (1) account for the effects of disparate radiative forcing agents including aerosols within ACE; (2) improve representation of land processes or the stratosphere in ACE; (3) improve the generalization capabilities of NeuralGCM’s column-wise learned physics.

You will work closely with a technical mentor on project design, coding and testing. Your technical mentor will discuss project details with you before your start date.

Over the course of your time at Ai2, you will build your resume and leave an impact on Ai2 and the world. job.name: Senior Software Engineer - Planning
job.description:
About Overland AI Founded in 2022 and headquartered in Seattle, Washington, Overland AI is transforming land operations for modern defense. The company leverages over a decade of advanced research in robotics and machine learning, as well as a field-test forward ethos, to deliver combined capabilities for unit commanders. Our OverDrive autonomy stack enables ground vehicles to navigate and operate off-road in any terrain without GPS or direct operator control. Our intuitive OverWatch C2 interface provides commanders with precise coordination capabilities essential for mission success.

Overland AI has secured funding from prominent defense tech investors including 8VC and Point 72, and built trusted partnerships with DARPA, the U.S. Army, Marine Corps, and Special Operations Command. Backed by eight-figure contracts across the Department of Defense, we are strengthening national security by iterating closely with end users engaged in tactical operations.

Role Summary We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to design and implement navigation planning algorithms for unmanned ground vehicles operating in complex off-road and on-road terrain using local sensing. These systems must perform at speed in punishing conditions. You will need to balance fidelity and optimality against computational cost and robustness, and decide when to trust prior information and when to trust what the vehicle sees.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with both classical and learned approaches to planning under uncertainty and knows how to combine them. They also understand both the value and the failure modes of prior maps and far-field data. This position reports to the Principal Software Engineer.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement planning algorithms for autonomous ground vehicles in unstructured off-road and structured on-road environments.
  • Bridge learned and classical methods: decide where learned components (costing, prediction, policy) add value, and where classical guarantees and interpretability must win.

job.name: Post-Doctoral Research Fellow
job.description:
Overview Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center is an independent, nonprofit organization providing adult cancer treatment and groundbreaking research focused on cancer and infectious diseases. Based in Seattle, Fred Hutch is the only National Cancer Institute-designated cancer center in Washington.

With a track record of global leadership in bone marrow transplantation, HIV/AIDS prevention, immunotherapy and COVID-19 vaccines, Fred Hutch has earned a reputation as one of the world’s leading cancer, infectious disease and biomedical research centers. Fred Hutch operates eight clinical care sites that provide medical oncology, infusion, radiation, proton therapy and related services, and network affiliations with hospitals in five states. Together, our fully integrated research and clinical care teams seek to discover new cures to the world’s deadliest diseases and make life beyond cancer a reality.

At Fred Hutch we value collaboration, compassion, determination, excellence, innovation, integrity and respect. Our mission is directly tied to the humanity, dignity and inherent value of each employee, patient, community member and supporter. Our commitment to learning across our differences and similarities make us stronger. We seek employees who bring different and innovative ways of seeing the world and solving problems.

The Kuznets-Speck Lab at Fred Hutch Cancer Center is seeking a highly motivated Post Doctoral Research Fellow to develop new statistical and machine-learning methods for understanding and predicting biological function from high-dimensional ‘omics data.

Our research lies at the intersection of biostatistics, genomics, artificial intelligence, and statistical physics . We develop generative and interpretable computational frameworks for studying how cells respond to perturbations, identifying causal and predictive gene programs, reconstructing regulatory interactions, and modeling cellular state transitions. A major focus is on combining modern generative models with ideas from stochastic processes, nonequilibrium statistical physics, optimal transport, and dynamical systems to address problems in cancer biology and single-cell genomics. The Fellow will have substantial freedom to develop independent research directions within this broad program.

Mentorship and Environment The Fellow will be mentored by Assistant Professor Ben Kuznets-Speck in the Public Health Sciences Division at Fred Hutch Cancer Center. The lab will provide an interdisciplinary environment spanning statistics, machine learning, genomics, and cancer biology.

Postdoctoral Fellows will receive mentorship in research, scientific communication, grant writing, and career development, with substantial protected time for methodological research and opportunities to build collaborations with computational, experimental, and clinical groups across Fred Hutch.

We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

The Team Join the next science revolution at AWS Life Sciences Applied AI Solutions where you'll work alongside world-class scientists to build AI that transforms how therapeutics are discovered, developed, and brought to patients.

We're out to revolutionize how medicines are discovered, developed, and brought to patients powered by a new generation of AI. Our team tackles some of the hardest open problems at the intersection of frontier AI and life sciences. We apply biological foundation models large language models and agentic reasoning systems to life sciences problems then put them into the hands of customers as applications and managed services they can fine-tune tailor and deploy on their own data. The science challenges are deep: how do you design agentic systems that reason correctly over complex biological regulatory and clinical logic? How do you enable customers to tailor foundation models to their proprietary data and get better outputs with less effort? How do you adapt models to reason faithfully in high-stakes scientific and regulatory domains?

Today we're focused on two areas. In clinical trials we're building AI that automates and optimizes regulatory and clinical development workflows. In drug design our products (including Amazon Bio Discovery) accelerate discovery by giving bench scientists AI-guided protein engineering and antibody design capabilities. We combine frontier research with production-scale delivery to put breakthrough science into the hands of customers solving humanity's hardest problems.

We value scientific rigor encourage publication and support conference participation. If you want to do research that ships this is the team.

The Role We are seeking an Applied Scientist to build the models and methods behind our life sciences AI products with a primary focus on clinical trial operations and agentic reasoning. You will design train and evaluate systems that reason over complex clinical and operational logic and ship them into products customers use directly. You will work closely with senior and principal scientists on well-scoped research problems own your results end to end and see your work reach production.

The Data Integration Analyst is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, completeness, integrity, and timely processing of electronic client data received from our clients and business partners. Working closely with Client Administration, Operations, Information Technology, and other business stakeholders, the Data Integration Analyst will identify and resolve data issues, support ongoing process improvements, and contribute to data-driven business initiatives. The successful candidate will combine strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a passion for data quality, process automation, and continuous improvement.

Role and Responsibilities:

Data Management & Quality Assurance

· Manage the intake, validation, transformation, and loading of client insurance and reinsurance data into internal systems.

· Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and analyze requirements for data integration projects.

· Review and reconcile control reports, exception reports, and validate results to ensure data accuracy and completeness before committing data to production systems.

· Investigate, analyze, and resolve data quality issues, discrepancies, and exceptions in a timely manner.

· Collaborate with internal peers and clients to follow up on missing, incomplete, or inaccurate data submissions.

· Develop and maintain data quality standards, validation rules, and quality control procedures.

Data Analysis & Reporting

· Analyze operational and client data to identify trends, anomalies, risks, and improvement opportunities.

job.description:
Requisition ID: 279960

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

We are looking for a Data Analyst / Data Architect with strong Transfer Agency (TA) experience. You will design, model and govern the data behind unitholder recordkeeping, fund transactions, distributions and dealer relationships. You will work between Operations, Distribution, Finance, Compliance and Technology to turn TA data from outsourced and in-house platforms into trusted, well-documented data products. These products support reporting, analytics, regulatory obligations and the move to the cloud.

The role is both hands-on and architectural. You will write SQL and analyze source data, and you will also define target-state data models, integration patterns and data quality controls for the TA domain.

Is this role right for you? In this role you will: Transfer Agency Data Analysis

  • Analyze TA data across the full unitholder lifecycle: account setup, KYC/AML, purchases, redemptions, switches, transfers, systematic plans (PAC/SWP), distributions and reinvestments, fees, trailers and commissions.
  • Profile and reconcile data from TA platforms (e.g., IFDS/SS&C, FundSERV order flows, dealer and intermediary files) against fund accounting, custody and general ledger records.
  • Investigate breaks and data issues, find root causes and work with Operations and vendors to fix them for good.
  • Turn business questions from Distribution, Sales, Finance and Compliance into clear data requirements, mappings and analytical outputs.

Data Architecture & Modelling

  • Design and maintain conceptual, logical and physical data models for the TA domain, including investor/account, dealer/advisor, fund/series/class, transaction, holdings/positions, distributions, and fee/trailer entities.
  • Define the target-state architecture for TA data on the enterprise cloud platform (e.g., Azure, Databricks, Snowflake), including ingestion, curated layers (bronze/silver/gold or equivalent) and consumption patterns.
  • Set integration standards for batch file feeds, APIs and event-driven flows between the TA, fund accounting, CRM (e.g., Salesforce), data warehouse and reporting tools.
  • Build source-to-target mappings, data lineage and transformation logic that engineers can implement and auditors can follow.

Data Governance & Quality

  • Own TA business definitions, metric dictionaries and critical data elements (e.g., AUM by dealer, net sales, gross sales, redemptions, unitholder counts).
  • Design and monitor data quality rules, reconciliation controls and exception workflows.
  • Help classify and protect sensitive investor data (PII), in line with privacy, records retention and information security standards.
  • Work with Data Governance on metadata, data catalog entries, ownership and stewardship.

job.name: Software Development Engineer III - Advertising, MADS
job.description:
Description Amazon Advertising's Measurement and Data Science (MADS) organization delivers campaign measurement and reporting across the advertising business and serves as the scientific center of excellence for measurement algorithm development. Within MADS, the Programmatic Reporting (PREP) team builds the interfaces and engines that turn measurement data into consistent, accurate, and efficient reporting for advertisers and partners — through programmatic interfaces rather than dashboards. Other companies' systems talk to ours to measure and grow their Amazon advertising investment.

We operate at scale. Billions of ad impressions, clicks, and conversion events are processed and summarized every day across petabyte-scale data with millions of transactions per second. Delivering this reliably requires invention ahead of common technologies and event-driven architectures built on AWS.

This SDE II role spans two of our three tier-1 reporting surfaces and the engines behind them:

  • Reporting API — the pull surface: an asynchronous API for occasional, experimental, and analytical queries, and the back end to the Unified Report Builder.
  • Amazon Marketing Stream — the push surface for recurring, high-volume reporting data.
  • The processing engines — including the Offline Engine (Iceberg + Spark on EMR) that computes the data those surfaces deliver.

The work is high-ownership and collaborative: you will partner with senior and principal engineers on architecture, and with product managers and technical account managers to translate customer pain points into features. You will also help deliver Unified Reporting as Amazon's single programmatic reporting solution and shift high-volume, recurring consumption from repeated API polling toward Amazon Marketing Stream.

Amazon is investing heavily in a world-class advertising business, and this team is at the forefront of that growth. We are highly motivated, collaborative, and direct, with a strong bias for action and a broad mandate to experiment. We start with the customer and work backwards in everything we do. If you want to build the next generation of large-scale reporting systems on modern data and AWS technologies, we would like to hear from you.

job.name: Data Engineering Manager
job.description:
Relay is a digital banking platform that gives self-made business owners the tools and know-how to be great with money—bringing clarity, confidence, and control to every dollar earned, so they can turn hard work into lasting success. We do this by replacing financial guesswork with real visibility, transforming cash flow from a constant source of stress into a clear signal owners can use to run stronger, more resilient businesses.

Relay's data engineering team has tripled in size, from 4 to 12, and is now splitting into two teams. Analytics Data Engineering works close to the business, building the models, pipelines and dashboards that teams use to run the company. Data Platform , the team you'll lead, owns the foundation underneath: infrastructure, cost, real-time data, observability, and the AI capabilities the rest of Relay builds on.

The team's north star is platform health . That means a fast, reliable, cost-efficient platform with strong observability, and partners across the company who can do their work without waiting on us.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Lead and grow a senior team of data engineers. With an experienced team in place, your role is to provide direction, challenge thinking, and help the team make decisions and move work forward.
  • Own Snowflake cost. In your first 90 days, you’ll develop and execute a plan to reduce Snowflake costs month over month, working closely with the team to identify and deliver savings.
  • Get data into stakeholders' hands faster. You'll define and drive Relay's approach to real-time data and platform enablement, including streaming (Kafka) and a Snowflake MCP server that opens our data to AI tooling.
  • Make platform health visible. Build observability so the team finds a problem before a stakeholder does.
  • Translate platform work into business outcomes. You’ll help the team prioritize upgrades, migrations and refactors by linking technical investments to business value, whether that’s driving revenue, improving efficiency or reducing risk.
  • Balance speed against technical debt, in both directions. Sometimes you'll persuade the team to ship with some debt because the business value is there. Sometimes you'll persuade the business to give the team more time. You'll know which is which.
  • Run the team's operating rhythm. That includes standups, sprint and roadmap planning, architectural decisions, code review, and the requests that come in from across Relay.

Who You Are

job.name: Palantir Developer
job.description:
Position Description

CGI is looking for a Palantir Foundry & Ontology Developer with strong, hands-on experience designing and delivering production-grade data solutions and ontology-driven applications on the Palantir Foundry platform.

The role will work closely with business, data, architecture, security, and delivery teams to translate operational needs into governed data pipelines, reusable ontology models, analytics, workflows, and user-facing applications. The successful candidate will combine practical engineering expertise with strong problem-solving, testing, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills.

This is a hybrid role and requires attendance at our downtown Toronto office and/or a client office a minimum of 3 days per week. This requirement may change at any time.

Your future duties and responsibilities

  • Foundry Solution Development: Design, build, test, deploy, and support end-to-end solutions using Palantir Foundry services and development tools.
  • Data Engineering: Ingest, clean, transform, integrate, and curate data from multiple sources into reliable Foundry datasets and reusable data products.
  • Pipeline Development: Build and maintain data pipelines using Pipeline Builder and code repositories, including branching, pull requests, testing, build management, scheduling, and operational monitoring.
  • Ontology Design: Translate business concepts and operating processes into scalable ontology designs, including object types, properties, link types, backing datasets, object sets, and relationships.
  • Ontology Implementation: Configure, enhance, and troubleshoot ontology-backed data pipelines while managing additive and destructive changes safely.
  • Operational Workflows: Implement governed writeback, Actions, function-backed Actions, submission criteria, and security controls to support business workflows.
  • Application Development: Develop ontology-aware applications and common operating views in Workshop using variables, object tables, filters, charts, maps, metric cards, object views, overlays, and multi-page navigation.
  • Functions Development: Develop, unit test, publish, and integrate TypeScript functions for custom aggregations, derived columns, ontology edits, and application behavior.
  • Analytics and Visualization: Create analyses and dashboards using Contour, Quiver, Object Explorer, Foundry Map, and time-series capabilities where appropriate to the use case.
  • Data Lineage and Operations: Use Data Lineage to trace dependencies, assess downstream impact, visualize flows, manage builds and schedules, and support production troubleshooting.
  • Quality Engineering: Apply coding standards, peer review, automated testing, version control, maintainable design, performance optimization, and defect-prevention practices.
  • Security and Governance: Implement Foundry access controls, action security, data-handling standards, and auditable development practices in partnership with security and governance

job.name: Staff Software Engineering - Vehicle Data Platform
job.description:
Job Description Vacancy Status: This posting is for an existing vacancy within the organization and is open to new applications.

AI Disclosure: As part of the application process, Artificial Intelligence will be used in the hiring process for this role Work Arrangement: This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to the office three days per week, at minimum.

The Role

The Data Engineering organization at General Motors is building a unified Vehicle Data Platform that moves data and configuration between vehicle ECUs and the cloud. Our team is the only team within General Motors that delivers software on every compute module the company has. Our software is delivered as libraries, apps, and services on Android, Linux, and QNX and covers four areas. The control plane retrieves configuration from the cloud and applies it across the vehicle's ECUs. The data plane collects, processes, and forwards data from vehicle systems to cloud storage. The SDK lets application teams use the platform. The unified logging infrastructure manages logs across the vehicle software stack.

We are looking for a Staff Software Developer to set technical direction and lead the work that spans these areas. You will make architecture decisions with the team, lead initiatives across organizations, and mentor senior and junior engineers. You will work with application, platform, cloud, cybersecurity, and privacy teams to deliver software on production ECUs with limited CPU, memory, storage, and bandwidth.

What You'll Do (Responsibilities)

job.description:
Who We Are Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

What We Offer Salary:

$128,000.00 - $176,000.00

Location:

Austin,TX

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

About The Role Applied Materials is seeking a Forecast Operations Manager to help build and scale a world-class forecasting capability across a complex global supply chain. This role will serve as the bridge between forecasting systems and supplier execution, ensuring forecast signals are understood, adopted, and translated into actionable plans throughout the supply ecosystem.

The successful candidate will work cross-functionally with Supply Chain, Planning, Procurement, Supplier Management, Data & Analytics, and Business Unit teams to improve forecast effectiveness, drive supplier engagement, and enhance supply chain responsiveness.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and improve forecast signal quality and performance tracking.
  • Partner with forecasting, planning, and analytics teams to continuously improve forecast accuracy, usability, and adoption.
  • Drive supplier engagement to ensure forecast signals are understood and effectively utilized.
  • Establish and manage feedback mechanisms with suppliers to identify gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities.
  • Analyze supplier execution performance and forecast consumption trends.
  • Ensure forecast signals are properly translated into supplier planning and MRP processes.
  • Consolidate supplier feedback, execution insights, and operational risks into actionable recommendations.
  • Develop dashboards, metrics, and executive-level reporting on forecast effectiveness.
  • Influence stakeholders across multiple functions and business units to drive forecast adoption and process improvements.
  • Support strategic supply planning initiatives and long-range capacity planning activities.

job.name: Finance Data, Analytics & AI - Experienced Associate
job.description:
The Opportunity

As a Finance Data, Analytics & AI - Experienced Associate, you will help clients turn financial data into actionable insights within our Advisory practice. In this client-facing role, you will contribute to finance technology projects that connect planning, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting with data analytics and AI. You will support the design and implementation of applications such as OneStream, Anaplan, and Tagetik, helping clients improve financial modeling, close and consolidation processes, and visibility into performance. Through analysis and data visualization, you will help finance teams understand trends, make informed decisions, and identify ways to streamline processes.

As an Associate, you will develop your technical skills while contributing reliable work across client engagements with different needs and priorities. You will take ownership of your assignments, ask questions when requirements are unclear, and use feedback to refine your approach. By listening to clients and colleagues and respecting different perspectives, you will build relationships and contribute to an inclusive team. As you explore digital and AI tools, you will assess their outputs with human judgment, apply professional standards and independence requirements, and deepen your understanding of how your work supports broader business goals.

Responsibilities

  • Supporting client teams in configuring OneStream, Anaplan, and Tagetik applications for financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, consolidation, and management reporting
  • Gathering financial and operational data from multiple sources, checking data quality, and identifying patterns that inform business decisions
  • Building financial models that connect budget assumptions, expense trends, and operational measures to support forecasts and resource allocation
  • Developing dashboards with data visualization software to communicate financial results, process measures, and emerging trends to client stakeholders
  • Contributing to close, consolidation, and reporting workflows by connecting data across financial management applications and documenting repeatable processes
  • Reviewing financial statements and performance data to identify cost reduction opportunities and potential improvements to planning and reporting processes
  • Testing application performance and reviewing AI-assisted analysis with human judgment, documenting limitations and raising questions about unclear outputs or assumptions
  • Collaborating with colleagues and client contacts through active listening and constructive feedback while taking ownership of assigned tasks and developing technical skills

What You Must Have

  • At least a Bachelor's degree
  • At least 1 year of experience

What Sets You Apart

job.description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the Product Team The Product Team creates high-quality end-to-end experiences for travelers, partners, and Expedia Group. Our customer-first mindset focuses on developing products that encourage loyalty and repeat business from our travelers and partners. We partner closely with teams across Expedia Group to achieve growth and results for our customers and company.

We connect Travelers to new experiences, through trusted relationships. We use the power of Expedia Group brands to empower strategic partners to nurture and grow the existing relationship with their audience. Strategic Partnerships and Affiliates breadth of solutions which include cashback, travel offers, loyalty exchange, co-branded sites, Affiliate APIs and EG’s Affiliate Program, bring a partners’ audience onto EG sites, thereby increasing EG’s traffic and exposure.

Through a conversational travel assistant, Layla helps travelers move from inspiration to a complete, bookable itinerary — flights, hotels, activities, and the day-by-day detail — in minutes. As part of Expedia Group, the team combines Layla’s planning and personalization capabilities with Expedia Group’s global supply, first-party traveler insights, marketplace scale, and booking technology.

The team is small and senior by design and operates with startup pace: you own a surface, ship it, and see the impact on real travelers within weeks — with decisions driven by data and AI tooling used in practice every day.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will help steer Layla off its numbers — defining trusted metrics, running product analytics and experiments, and turning traveler behavior into clear insights that shape what the team builds next.

job.name: Sr. Global Operations Engineer (Starlink)
job.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

Sr. GLOBAL OPERATIONS ENGINEER (STARLINK) Starlink is leveraging SpaceX’s experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy the world’s most advanced broadband internet system and largest satellite constellation. The Starlink Growth team combines deep analysis, business strategy, and operational excellence to drive customer retention, improve lifetime value, and scale the business.

As a Sr. Operations Engineer, you will own high-impact initiatives from end to end. You will identify complex problems, build scalable solutions, influence cross-functional leadership, and translate data into strategic decisions that directly affect Starlink’s growth, profitability, and operational effectiveness.

Responsibilities

  • Take extreme ownership of process improvement: ruthlessly apply first-principles methodologies to eliminate waste, scale self-service, accelerate resolution, and simplify complex processes
  • Identify systemic engineering and operational defects with bias for action; rapidly determine root causes and drive comprehensive solutions at scale—both immediate fixes and permanent preventative systems that remove recurring requirements
  • Design and own lean data frameworks that surface only the signals that matter across the customer journey and internal operations (logistics, finance, etc.), enabling fast decisions
  • Partner with leadership and cross-functional teams to prioritize, aggressively de-scope requests, allocate resources, and kill non-essential work so high-impact solutions stick
  • Own complex projects end-to-end with bias for action: set aggressive timelines, remove blockers, influence stakeholders, drive tight feedback loops, and deliver results without waiting for perfect conditions
  • Lead design reviews and rollouts with design, engineering, logistics, and operations teams—challenge scope, strip unnecessary requirements, run lean betas, and create only the enablement materials that actually move the needle
  • Establish living knowledge systems with extreme ownership: codify essential best practices, continuously prune outdated documentation, and ensure systems stay simple and scalable

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, mathematics, computer science, or STEM field
  • 5+ years of experience in an operations, process improvement, manufacturing, and/or consulting environment
  • 3+ years of experience with, Excel, SQL, and Python

job.name: Head of US Applied Engineering
job.description:
Habitat Energy is a fast growing technology company focussed on the physical and financial optimization of energy storage and renewable generation assets globally through complex models and trading. By maximizing the returns from these assets we aim to drive investment in renewable energy and accelerate the transition to a low carbon world. Our rapidly growing team of 130+ people in Austin, TX, Oxford, UK, and Melbourne, Australia brings together exceptionally talented and passionate people in the domains of energy trading, data science, software engineering and renewable energy management.

We have a vacancy for a Head of Applied Engineering to join our US team based in Austin, TX. This role will be a code-contributing leader for the existing Applied Engineering team. This role will build strong relationships working alongside Analytics, DataOps, and other non/less-technical teams in the company, manage a team of advanced engineers, and lead in the planning and design of the team's work.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Implementing robust, scalable, and efficient Python code that transforms optimization or machine learning prototypes into production-grade solutions, and maintain/improve productionized models
  • Developing clean, maintainable, well-documented code that adheres to best practices. Mentoring and support in the continued improvement of coding practices within the Data Science team
  • Contributing to the design, development, implementation, and continuous improvement of our data engineering tools, workflows, processes, and platforms. This includes enhancing the architectural foundations and integrating new data management technologies
  • Participating in development and maintenance of backtesting and model tuning frameworks
  • Continuously enhancing data quality across multiple dimensions such as accuracy, availability, performance, and accessibility to ensure a clear understanding of data within the company
  • Managing a team of engineers
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements

  • 5+ years of Python experience
  • 3+ years of working with data scientist/ML researchers to develop tooling, collaborate on backtesting frameworks, build data pipelines, build/maintain orchestration workflows or productionize code
  • 2+ years of demonstrable people management/team leadership
  • 2+ years working in energy markets, power trading, or relevant adjacent fields
  • BA/BSc degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or related technical field

Preferred skills and experience:

  • Data engineering experience collecting, curating, managing and monitoring large time series data
  • Experience with monitoring frameworks (Prometheus)
  • Machine learning experience especially time-series forecasting & generative ML problems
  • Optimization experience especially linear programming / mixed-integer programming

job.description:
Compensation Range $150,000.00 - $200,000.00 Annual Salary

Job Description Summary We are seeking a Senior Solution Architect to design, build, and evolve Swinerton’s enterprise data and AI platform, ensuring it is technically strong, AI‑ready, and tightly aligned to business outcomes. This role combines hands‑on implementation with strategic foresight - guiding the selection and integration of data, AI/ML, and agent platforms to create scalable, trusted foundations that support future growth and innovation.

Job Description Essential Responsibilities: Enterprise Data & AI Architecture Design & Decision ‑ Making: Define, review, and refine data and AI architecture designs to support analytics, AI/ML, and agent‑based use cases. Participate in architecture discussions and decisions to ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, and business priorities.

AI/ML and Agent Platform Design & Enablement: Design and review platform components supporting AI/ML and agent‑based solutions, including model management, feature stores, vector and graph databases, metadata management, and orchestration frameworks. Guide weekly technical decisions related to platform scalability, reuse, and integration.

Solution Design Collaboration & Reviews: Work with business partners, data engineers, data scientists, and analysts to translate requirements into architectural blueprints and implementation plans. Participate regularly in design sessions, solution reviews, and tradeoff discussions to ensure secure and scalable outcomes.

AI ‑ Ready Data Architecture Enablement: Collaborate with engineering and BTech teams to ensure data is discoverable, trusted, and structured to support AI and analytics use cases. Review approaches for metadata, governance integration, unstructured data handling, and orchestration patterns.

job.name: Sr Analyst, Revenue Operations
job.description:
The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary: This job will collaborate internally and use best practices to influence the quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of processes and programs. You will work independently to determine appropriate actions and consider alternative solutions. Your role will involve managing sales data, preparing reports, and ensuring smooth communication between the sales team and clients.

Job Description: Essential Responsibilities:

  • Analyze sales data to recommend process improvements.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to enhance operational efficiency.
  • Prepare detailed reports for management review.
  • Handle complex customer inquiries and provide solutions.
  • Mentor junior analysts and guide their professional growth.

job.name: Data Architect
job.description:
Position: Data Architect

Duration: 12 months to start, project up to 2 years

Work Location: Austin, TX

Hybrid: M & F remote, Tuesday-Thursday onsite

Pay: $85-90/HR

This position is eligible to enroll in medical, dental, vision after 60 days. In addition, this position is eligible to enroll in a 401(k) after 90 days.

We’re hiring a hands-on Data Architect to lead the data strategy, architecture, and migration for a large-scale ERP transformation. This role is critical to successfully transitioning from our on-premise ERP to a new SaaS-based ERP platform, ensuring data integrity, governance, and long-term scalability. You’ll operate at the intersection of business, technology, and institutional data—designing a future-state architecture while guiding complex data conversion and integration efforts.

Key Responsibilities

Data Strategy & Architecture

  • Define and own the enterprise data architecture aligned to SaaS-based ERP capabilities and constraints
  • Design conceptual, logical, and physical data models across student, finance, HR, and advancement domains
  • Establish data standards, naming conventions, and architecture principles for the program
  • Document user stories, journeys, process models, and create data models to support them.
  • Ensuring data architecture supports strategic initiatives, such as accelerating AI readiness or improving operational efficiency

Data Migration & Conversion

  • Lead end-to-end migration strategy from on-prem ERP to SaaS-based ERP, including:
  • Data profiling, cleansing, and enrichment
  • Data mapping and transformation rules
  • Migration waves and cutover planning
  • Oversee validation, reconciliation, and audit processes to ensure accuracy and completeness
  • Establishing standards for data security, data lineage, and data management to ensure accuracy and compliance.

Data Governance & Quality

  • Define and document data governance framework (ownership, stewardship, controls, roles)
  • Define and monitor data quality KPIs and remediation processes
  • Partner with functional leaders to align on data definitions and business rules
  • Define and establish data lifecycles
  • Define and establish archival and accessibility of cold data.
  • Establish data management and access roles

Integrations & Ecosystem

  • Architect integrations between SaaS-based ERP and other enterprise systems (CRM, LMS, reporting, identity management, etc.)
  • Define API, middleware, and data flow patterns with the data integration team.
  • Ensure scalability, security, and performance across the data ecosystem

Analytics & Reporting Enablement

  • Design data structures to support reporting, analytics, AI and regulatory/compliance needs
  • Partner with BI teams to enable modern reporting platforms and data access strategies
  • Create subject area data models and catalogs

Leadership & Delivery

job.name: Corporate Entity Data Coordinator
job.description:
We are always seeking talented, motivated, growth-minded, and creative individuals. Our firm is committed to providing employee support and advancement, while embracing inclusion and innovation as keys to a stronger future.

We invite you to explore the position below and to submit your application to join our team!

The Corporate Entity Data Coordinator researches corporate ownership and maintains accurate, complete, and consistent entity information across the firm’s financial, intake, and related administrative systems. The coordinator evaluates parent-subsidiary and global ultimate owner relationships, assesses corporate changes, and resolves data discrepancies. Working with Financial Systems and Solutions, Intake & Conflicts Services (ICS), Firm Intelligence, Billing, and Collections, the analyst supports reliable entity data and consistent data-management practices.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Maintain corporate ownership hierarchies, including parent-subsidiary and global ultimate owner relationships, across the firm’s financial and other administrative systems.
  • Create, update, link, consolidate, or recommend corrections to entity records based on documented research and established data standards.
  • Research corporate ownership and entity relationships using authoritative public records, corporate filings, company websites, commercial research tools, and reputable news sources.
  • Conduct recurring quality-control reviews of client, matter, and entity records to identify duplicates, incomplete relationships, naming inconsistencies, outdated ownership information, and other data-quality issues. Document research findings, sources, decisions, and unresolved exceptions.
  • Review mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, reorganizations, name changes, dissolutions, and other corporate events to determine necessary updates to firm records.
  • Partner with Intake & Conflicts Services, Billing, Collections, Firm Intelligence, and other stakeholders to reconcile corporate relationship data, resolve discrepancies, and maintain consistent entity information across systems.
  • Respond to research and data-maintenance requests in a timely manner, communicate status and findings clearly, and escalate complex or high-risk questions when appropriate.
  • Assist in developing and maintaining procedures, decision rules, naming conventions, and data standards for corporate entity research and maintenance.
  • Support targeted data-cleanup projects, reporting, audits, system conversions, integrations, and other data-governance initiatives involving client and corporate entity information.
  • Maintain the confidentiality of firm and client information and follow applicable information security, records management, and data handling requirements.

Required Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

job.description:
Your opportunity

At Schwab, you’re empowered to make an impact on your career. Here, innovative thought meets creative problem solving, helping us “challenge the status quo” and transform the finance industry together. We believe in the importance of in-office collaboration and fully intend for the selected candidate for this role to work on site in the specified location(s).

Schwab Technology Services enables the future of how clients manage their money by delivering innovative, reliable technology products that support our mission to democratize access to investing and financial planning.

As a Senior Product Manager (Data Platforms), you will define and lead the strategy, operating model, roadmap, and adoption of enterprise data platforms. You will initiate cross-functional programs, design scalable product and governance practices, and align business, analytics, architecture, governance, and engineering leaders around measurable platform outcomes. This individual contributor role is ideal for a product leader who can shape direction, influence enterprise decisions, and translate strategy into coordinated execution.

Key Responsibilities Platform vision & roadmap: Define and own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap (with clear success metrics) for one or more enterprise-scale data platforms. Ensure the roadmap aligns with business priorities and delivers measurable value.

Roles & Responsibilities:

1. Ansible Automation:

Design and maintain enterprise-grade playbooks, roles, and collections. Combine Ansible with Terraform for seamless post-provisioning configuration.

2. AWS Cloud Automation:

Architect serverless and event-driven automation using Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, SNS/SQS, S3 triggers, and Systems Manager. Build scalable, cross-account automation across AWS Organizations with proper IAM boundaries. Align all implementations with CIS, NIST, and AWS Well-Architected standards.

3. Kubernetes & Helm:

Develop and own custom Helm charts for multi-environment Kubernetes deployments. Manage the full Helm lifecycle including upgrades, rollbacks, and canary releases. Drive GitOps adoption using ArgoCD or Flux. Automate namespace management, RBAC, secrets, and network policies.

4. Infrastructure as Code & CI/CD:

Build reusable, versioned Terraform modules covering AWS networking, IAM, EKS, ECS, RDS, and security controls. Implement CI/CD pipelines for IaC using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps - with automated testing, linting, drift detection, and policy enforcement baked in.

5. Security & Compliance Automation:

Automate CIS benchmark enforcement, vulnerability remediation, and infrastructure hardening. Integrate with CyberArk, AWS Secrets Manager, and SSM Parameter Store. Implement policy-as-code using OPA, Gatekeeper, or Conftest. Automate certificate lifecycle management end to end.

6. Observability & Auto-Remediation:

Connect automation workflows to New Relic and LogicMonitor for telemetry-driven triggers. Build self-healing routines that detect, diagnose, and resolve incidents automatically. Convert operational runbooks into fully automated diagnostic workflows to cut MTTR significantly.

7. ITSM Integration:

Integrate automation into SymphonyAI-driven ticketing, approval flows, CMDB updates, and change management processes. Build operational runbooks that map directly to ITSM workflows.

Ideal Candidate:

  • Strong Automation Architect Profile with cloud-based automation strategy and framework architecture.
  • Mandatory (Experience 1) - Must have 8+ years of total experience with the last 6 years focused continuously on hands-on automation, including automation strategy and framework architecture.

The role acts as a technical lead and escalation point, working closely with SOC Analysts, Threat Detection, Security Engineering, and platform teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead engineering and optimization of Splunk-based SIEM alerting and monitoring.
  • Design, develop, and tune correlation rules and detections to reduce false positives.
  • Own alert lifecycle management including creation, tuning, validation, and retirement.
  • Design and implement alert enrichment using IAM, CMDB, vulnerability, and threat intelligence sources.
  • Ensure alerts are enriched with user, asset, privilege, and business context.
  • Engineer and maintain Splunk data ingestion, normalization, and CIM compliance.
  • Support onboarding of log sources across endpoint, network, cloud, and identity platforms.
  • Develop detection use cases mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Act as L3 escalation for complex SIEM and detection issues.
  • Maintain SOPs, runbooks, and SIEM documentation.
  • Mentor SIEM engineers and provide technical guidance.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 6–10 years of experience in SIEM or security engineering roles.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with Splunk Enterprise / Splunk ES.
  • Proven experience in SIEM alert development, tuning, and enrichment.
  • Strong understanding of security telemetry across endpoint, network, cloud, and IAM.
  • Proficiency in SPL (Search Processing Language).
  • Experience with MITRE ATT&CK and SOC workflows.
  • Experience integrating SIEM with IAM, CMDB, vulnerability, and threat intel platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in regulated environments such as healthcare or financial services.
  • Exposure to SOAR platforms and automated response workflows.
  • Scripting experience using Python or PowerShell.
  • Relevant security or Splunk certifications.

job.description:
Hiring for Zurich Insurance — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

Zurich Insurance Group is one of the world's largest multi-line insurers, serving customers in more than 200 countries and territories. In 2026 Zurich opened its Global Capability Centre in Hyderabad as a zero-legacy, AI-first technology hub. Its Security Platform Services team is building an in-house network security engineering capability there, taking over firewall operations for Zurich's global estate.

About the Role

As a Level 2 Palo Alto Firewall Engineer you're the technical escalation point for Zurich's global firewall service. You resolve complex incidents, deliver higher-risk changes and upgrades through Panorama, and turn repeat operational work into automated, API-first workflows. You also mentor Level 1 engineers in Hyderabad.

This is a hybrid role from Hyderabad. Candidates who can join immediately or within 15 days are preferred.

What you'll do

  • Engineer, administer and improve Palo Alto firewall platforms and Panorama across a complex global estate
  • Own advanced diagnosis of firewall, routing, NAT, App-ID, DNS, VPN and connectivity issues, including during major incidents
  • Assess and deliver non-standard and higher-risk changes with design review, testing and rollback plans
  • Lead root-cause analysis for recurring or high-impact incidents and put fixes in place
  • Plan and carry out PAN-OS upgrades, patching and lifecycle work
  • Drive rule recertification, policy optimisation, object clean-up and vulnerability remediation
  • Automate repeat tasks with Python, PAN-OS APIs, Ansible or Terraform, with proper governance

What you bring

  • 4–5 years in network security engineering, with hands-on Palo Alto Networks firewalls in an enterprise environment
  • Hands-on Panorama administration; Strata Cloud Manager exposure is a plus
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, NAT, App-ID, security policy, DNS, and site-to-site and remote-access VPN
  • You have troubleshot complex issues using logs, packet captures and traffic analysis
  • You have delivered production changes and PAN-OS upgrades under ITIL change and problem management
  • Practical scripting or automation with Python, REST APIs, Ansible or Terraform

Nice to have

  • PCNSE, CCNP Security or a similar certification
  • Azure or AWS network security and hybrid connectivity; Prisma Access
  • Infrastructure-as-Code and Git-based workflows
  • Using AI tools for policy analysis, drift detection and troubleshooting

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. job.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is looking for a Software Engineer to join our Data Platform team , which owns and develops the core analytical platform across Samsara. This team builds and maintains the infrastructure that powers Samsara’s data lake, distributed compute platform, and the systems that move data from our production data stores into our lakehouse.

As a Software Engineer on Data Platform, you will design, build, and operate reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure for ingesting, processing, cataloging, and accessing petabytes of data. You will work on the foundational systems that enable engineers, data scientists, analysts, and product teams across Samsara to build customer-facing features, train models, develop operational insights, and support the company’s long-term AI and analytics roadmap.

This is a specialized software engineering role focused on data infrastructure. You will work on systems such as Spark and Databricks infrastructure, Delta Lake on S3, data replication from primary data stores such as RDS and DynamoDB, orchestration and metadata services, internal data libraries, and infrastructure tooling across the big data ecosystem.

This role is not an analytics or business data engineering role. If your experience is primarily focused on SQL modeling, BI dashboards, ETL tools, or building business-facing data marts, this role is likely not the right fit. The ideal candidate is a software engineer with deep experience building and operating production data platforms, distributed systems, or large-scale ingestion infrastructure.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Canada. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

job.description:
• Role Title: Staff Data Engineer (Remote)
  • Role Type: Full-time
  • Location : Remote

The Role

This is a Staff-level, hands-on engineering role for someone who has built data infrastructure from zero to production and knows how to turn fragmented operational data into reliable, accessible, and actionable systems.

You'll own the architecture and implementation of our data warehouse, ingestion pipelines, transformations, and product analytics foundations.

We're building an AI-native organization where both humans and autonomous agents need access to trustworthy, well-structured data. You'll design the systems that make this possible, enabling self-service analytics, automated decision-making, and increasingly intelligent workflows across the company.

What You'll Do

1. Build our data platform from zero: Architect and implement our internal data warehouse, ingestion infrastructure, ETL/ELT pipelines, and core data models.

2. Create agent-ready data foundations: Design reliable, well-documented datasets and interfaces that AI agents can safely discover, query, and use.

3. Turn messy data into trusted systems: Transform fragmented operational and product data into consistent, high-quality sources of truth.

4. Enable self-service analytics: Build the infrastructure that allows engineering, product, and business teams to answer questions independently without relying on manual data requests.

5. Own product analytics infrastructure: Establish the event tracking, instrumentation, data models, and reporting foundations needed to understand product usage and performance.

6. Automate data operations: Leverage AI coding agents and intelligent automation to accelerate pipeline development, data validation, documentation, monitoring, and troubleshooting.

7. Build for reliability and scale: Establish data quality standards, observability, governance, and scalable architectural patterns from the beginning.

8. Raise the engineering bar: Mentor engineers, establish strong data engineering practices, and lead architectural decisions through hands-on execution.

What We're Looking For

1. Staff-level engineering expertise with extensive hands-on experience building and operating production data platforms.

2. Proven greenfield experience: You've personally led the design and implementation of a data platform from scratch, rather than exclusively maintaining or extending existing infrastructure.

3. Deep understanding of data warehouses, ETL/ELT architectures, data modeling, orchestration, and distributed data processing.

4. Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with the software engineering fundamentals needed to build reliable data infrastructure.

5. Experience with modern data technologies such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, dbt, Airflow, Dagster, or equivalent tools.

6. Strong understanding of data quality, lineage, observability, access controls, and production data reliability.
