job.name: Vehicle Performance Engineer
job.description:
About Portal Portal Space Systems is on a mission to expand humanity’s freedom of movement in space. We’re building the spacecraft that makes that mission possible. From our Bothell, WA headquarters, we design vehicles with the maneuverability, resilience, and adaptability needed for the next era of orbital operations. Every system we build is in service of a simple idea: space should be more accessible, responsive, and capable. Joining Portal means stepping into a team that believes in bold engineering, fast iteration, and the power of small groups to change what’s possible. If you want your work to directly shape the future of in-space mobility, join us.

Position Summary

The Vehicle Performance Engineer creates the integrated, quantitative view of spacecraft health and mission performance used by engineering leadership, program managers, and executives. This systems and data-integration role connects analysis results, engineering budgets, test data, and flight telemetry across disciplines; resolves data definitions and interfaces; and develops intuitive performance dashboards and graphical tools. Subsystem owners remain responsible for the technical correctness of their source data. The Vehicle Performance Engineer owns consolidation, traceability, visualization, trend identification, and high-level cross-disciplinary performance assessments.

Responsibilities

  • Define the data architecture, interfaces, update cadence, and governance needed to create a reliable integrated view of spacecraft performance.
  • Integrate mass, power, energy, thermal, propulsion, delta-V, GNC, specific impulse, test telemetry, and other mission-performance datasets.
  • Develop and maintain spacecraft performance dashboards and graphical user interfaces using Python-based tools, Grafana, or comparable technologies.
  • Determine where automated or live data pipelines provide value and where controlled periodic imports are more appropriate.
  • Work with subsystem owners to establish authoritative sources, common definitions, units, assumptions, metadata, and configuration traceability.
  • Consolidate subsystem budgets and margins without replacing the technical ownership of the contributing disciplines.
  • Identify missing, stale, inconsistent, or conflicting data and drive resolution with the appropriate owners.
  • Create leadership-level indicators that communicate vehicle health, margin trends, readiness, and mission capability for spacecraft on the ground and in orbit.
  • Perform high-level cross-disciplinary trade studies, sensitivity analyses, and “what-if” assessments using controlled source data.
  • Compare predictions with test and flight results and highlight performance changes, emerging risks, or margin erosion.
  • Build reusable data-processing, validation, visualization, and reporting tools.
  • Provide integrated performance products for design reviews, test campaigns, qualification or acceptance reviews, flight readiness, and on-orbit operations.

  • Receive 2-for-1 matching gifts for your charitable contributions and the opportunity to secure annual grants for the organizations you love
  • Access on-demand professional development resources that allow you to hone existing skills and learn new ones

“I can succeed as a Machine Learning Engineer at Capital Group” We are looking for someone who can take a vague question from an investment professional, find a real answer in messy data, prove the answer holds, and build the thing that delivers it.

You will join the AI Insights team. We build the insight layer on top of Capital Group’s investment data: multi-agent systems that answer investment questions with citations, the evaluation methods that tell us whether those answers are any good, agents that take on expert analyst workflows end-to-end, and the extraction work that turns unstructured research, calls, and filings into reusable insight. Some problems here are better served by a conventional supervised model, and part of the job is knowing which is which.

Our work reaches across the investment organization, from research analysts to governance specialists to the teams behind portfolio and order management. Each partner brings its own data, its own workflow, and its own idea of what a good answer looks like. You go deep with one rather than skim, and you end up learning parts of the business most engineers never see.

Job Description About the Role We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to develop data-driven forecasting and analytics solutions for networking hardware and data center infrastructure planning.

This role sits at the intersection of data science, demand forecasting, planning, and cloud infrastructure. You will work with large and complex datasets to understand demand drivers, develop forecasting models, improve the quality of the demand signal, and provide analytical insights that support hardware procurement, capacity planning, and data center build decisions.

The role is highly hands-on. You will work closely with Demand Planning, Networking Engineering, Data Center Planning, Supply Chain, Product, and Finance teams to turn business and engineering questions into analytical models and actionable insights.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain demand forecasting models for networking hardware and data center infrastructure across short- and long-term planning horizons.
  • Analyze historical demand, deployment trends, data center build plans, engineering inputs, product roadmaps, and other signals to identify key demand drivers.
  • Develop time-series, statistical, machine learning, and other forecasting approaches appropriate for different products and planning scenarios.
  • Measure and improve forecast accuracy, bias, stability, and confidence across products and planning horizons.
  • Build analytical models to evaluate base, upside, downside, and what-if scenarios and quantify their impact on hardware demand.
  • Partner with demand planners to translate analytical outputs into practical planning recommendations and improve forecasting processes.
  • Develop models that connect data center builds, deployment plans, network capacity, product requirements, BOMs, and SKU-level demand.
  • Investigate anomalies and changes in the demand signal, including unexpected demand shifts, duplicate signals, missing data, and inconsistent planning assumptions.
  • Build scalable datasets and analytical pipelines using SQL and Python to support forecasting and planning workflows.
  • Develop reusable analytical frameworks, dashboards, and tools that improve visibility into demand trends, forecast performance, and planning risks.
  • Work with Data Engineering and other technical teams to improve data quality, data availability, and the reliability of planning data.
  • Automate recurring analysis, forecasting, reconciliation, and reporting processes.
  • Apply machine learning, optimization, simulation, and AI/ML techniques where they provide meaningful improvements to planning or decision-making.
  • Communicate analytical findings clearly to planners, engineers, business partners, and senior leadership.
  • Work independently on ambiguous problems, define the appropriate analytical approach, and drive projects from problem definition through implementation and adoption.
  • Contribute to the development of modern, scalable data science and forecasting

Lead and grow the team

Drive the strategy

Partner broadly

job.name: Senior Software Engineer, Developer Experience
job.description:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

About the role

More and more of our engineering work now runs through autonomous agents, and those agents can only be as effective as the tools, context, and codebase around them. As a Developer Experience Engineer, you'll build the tooling and agent workflows that let humans and agents change our largest monorepos quickly and safely.

You'll own the interfaces engineers use to observe, steer, and give context to the agents working on our code. You'll also build the guardrails that keep complexity in check as those agents take on bigger changes. Large-scale work like framework upgrades, language migrations, and dependency health is still part of the job, but you'll do it by building and steering agents rather than making the changes by hand. This is a high-leverage role. Every improvement you ship multiplies across the whole engineering organization.

What you’ll do

  • Build and ship the tools engineers and their agents use every day, such as CLIs, desktop integrations, and interfaces for observing, unblocking, and steering autonomous agents, and own their adoption, distribution, and support
  • Design and evolve agentic loops (the plan, act, verify, and iterate cycles) and the harnesses, skills, and context that let agents do real engineering work reliably
  • Build agent workflows that drive large-scale changes across the codebase, including framework upgrades, language migrations, and dependency updates, with minimal disruption to product teams
  • Build the guardrails, tests, and automation that make large, agent-authored changes safe to land, and track the leading indicators of growing complexity
  • Find friction in the development workflow for both humans and agents, and fix the root causes
  • Partner with builders inside and outside of engineering to understand their pain points, and measure the adoption and impact of what you ship
  • Set technical direction and mentor other engineers on agent design, tooling, and codebase health

What we’re looking for

We care more about what you've done than about which specific technologies you used to do it.

job.name: Senior Systems Engineer
job.description:
About us

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries

The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work.

NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Systems Engineer to join the Datacenter Engineering team within our Platform Engineering organization. Reporting to the Datacenter Engineering Manager, you will help build and run the systems foundation of our North Central Austin colocation environment, moving it from a manual, loosely documented set-up to a stable, automated, enterprise-grade operation.

This is a hands-on technical role. You will work across both Linux and Windows every day: building and patching servers, supporting VMware, cleaning up Active Directory and DNS, and helping put in place the standards and automation that make the environment reproducible and maintainable.

You must live in the greater Austin area and be able to work onsite in our datacenter 2–3 days a week.

We hire the best software engineers, but experience in our stack can’t hurt: NinjaOne is built on Java, Kotlin, C++, Golang and Postgres; supporting millions of user endpoints and running as a scalable cloud service in AWS. Knowing large-scale datastore bottlenecks, asynchronous application design and client-server architecture will help you.

What You’ll be Doing

  • Systems Administration: Build, configure, patch, and maintain Linux and Windows servers in a physical and virtualized datacenter environment.
  • Automation and Modernization: Help move us from manual processes to infrastructure-as-code, using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, and Puppet, golden images, PXE provisioning, and automated deployment pipelines.
  • Core Services: Support Active Directory cleanup and governance, DNS and DHCP standards, and monitoring (including SNMP) across the environment.
  • Virtualization: Administer our Virtualization environment (~50 ESXi hosts, vCenter), support the current storage migration, and help evaluate and adopt alternative hypervisors.
  • Physical Datacenter Operations: Help maintain standards in an 8-rack colocation cage, including cabling, rack layout, power, and hardware lifecycle. Leave everything better than you found it.
  • Reliability and Documentation: Troubleshoot and resolve incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and keep runbooks and documentation current.
  • Collaboration: Work with the network team, SRE, corporate IT, and production engineering to understand requirements and deliver reliable, well-documented infrastructure.
  • Other duties as needed.

About You

Experience limited to monitoring, alert triage, incident coordination, compliance, or assessment activities without direct responsibility for implementing technical changes may not provide sufficient background for this role.

This role is not a primary SOC, detection, or application security pipeline ownership role, but partners closely with those teams to drive remediation outcomes.

The ideal candidate enjoys solving complex technical problems, has experience operating and securing enterprise technology environments, and communicates effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Prozo builds and runs its own technology: ProWMS for warehouse management, ProOMS for orders, ProShip for shipping and courier allocation, and Control Tower for network-wide visibility. job.name: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, Amazon Interactive Video Service (IVS)
job.description:
Description Amazon Interactive Video Service (Amazon IVS) is AWS's fully managed live streaming service, built on the same battle-tested technology that powers Twitch and trusted by thousands of enterprises across gaming, social, live commerce, sports, and entertainment.

Our mission: enable developers to build communities around live video. We handle everything from ingest to processing to delivery at global scale, so developers can focus on creating interactive, engaging live experiences for their audiences. Whether you're streaming to tens of millions of concurrent viewers or just getting started, Amazon IVS removes the complexity so developers can move fast.

Amazon IVS is building the future of live video for AWS. The IVS Data Infrastructure team is the backbone of that future, empowering internal teams and IVS customers with the data they need to make key operational and business decisions.

We operate petabyte-scale data infrastructure for collecting, processing, and warehousing IVS data. We support streaming and batch pipelines to facilitate analytics, reporting, and ML workloads. We offer analytics tools and data products designed to make it easy for our customers to extract the insights they need from their data.

As a member of the team, you will partner with Product and Data Science stakeholders to understand your customers' needs and deliver robust, scalable solutions. You will work with an enthusiastic team of engineers to bring data-driven clarity to IVS and its customers.

Key job responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable data infrastructure in native AWS
  • Build and optimize data pipelines (batch and streaming) to support analytics, reporting, and ML workloads
  • Ensure data quality, reliability, and observability through monitoring, logging, and automated alerting
  • Work closely with product and analytics teams to understand requirements and deliver high-performance solutions
  • Champion best practices for security, compliance, and governance in data infrastructure
  • Identify opportunities to optimize performance and cost of data platforms
  • Stay current with emerging tools, frameworks, and cloud services in the data infrastructure ecosystem

A day in the life

Your primary focus will be empowering customers to succeed with their data by ensuring they can:

  • Gather and access data at scale – Enable seamless data collection and retrieval that grows with their needs
  • Extract meaningful insights – Provide the right tools and capabilities to uncover the answers they're seeking
  • Trust their data – Maintain confidence in the completeness, accuracy, and reliability of their information

Achieving these goals requires close collaboration and strong partnerships with Product and Data Science teams to deliver solutions that truly meet customer needs.

Basic Qualifications

job.description:
About Patelco Credit Union Patelco Credit Union is a not-for-profit credit union with a purpose to build financial health and wellbeing for our members. Since 1936, Patelco has grown from $500 in assets to over $9 billion in assets and is the 7th largest credit union in California with branches throughout Northern California.

We are here for our members throughout all their stages of life. Meeting them with the products and services to help them plan purposefully for their futures and to secure our life-long partnership as their trusted financial advocate. As one team, we are all committed to delivering service, empowering financial literacy, creating products, and providing new technology for our members.

We believe that work should be rewarding, challenging, and enjoyable. We’re dedicated to creating a positive and supportive culture where our team members can thrive. job.name: Data Platform Engineer
job.description:
About TypeSafe We’re building prod, not god. TypeSafe is an AI lab pushing frontier model intelligence in a new direction, starting with System One Models. We combine the reasoning of LLMs with the reliability of code, for truly trustworthy AI. Our first model, Jev, launched in September 2026.

While others chase leaderboards, we’re rebuilding the LLM stack from first principles to make models smarter and also dependable enough to run in production. We’re a small, fast team backed by a $870M Series A led by a16z. Made in SF, with love. Come join the frontier.

About The Role You’ll build and own the data infrastructure and internal tooling that support our engineering, analytics, and business teams. You’ll work across ingestion, storage, transformations, and access controls, helping make our data reliable and easy to use.

Responsibilities Include

  • Build and maintain data pipelines, infrastructure, and internal tools
  • Support data transformations, analytical models, and BI workflows
  • Manage data access and permissioning
  • Improve reliability, performance, and data quality
  • Work with teams across the company to understand and support their data needs

We expect that you

  • Have experience in data engineering, infrastructure, or backend systems
  • Are familiar with Kafka, ClickHouse, a data orchestrator such as Dagster or Airflow, and similar technologies
  • Are comfortable with SQL, data transformations, and permissioning
  • Understand how data infrastructure supports BI and analytics
  • Take ownership, collaborate well, and adapt to changing requirements
  • Are excited about our mission and working on a small team

We are hoping that you

  • Have built and operated large-scale, production data systems
  • Have experience building internal tools and supporting analytics
  • Have worked on a team with strong engineering standards
  • Are familiar with AI and its practical applications

Life at TypeSafe

We’re a small, flat, close-knit team working to make intelligence dependable enough to become part of everyday software. We work fully in person from our San Francisco office near Embarcadero station. We love what we do and care deeply about the work.

We strive for excellence and craftsmanship and won’t stop until we get there. When the team wins, we all win, and we enjoy collaborating and inspiring each other to grow—as a team and as individuals.

We value emotional honesty, kindness, and bringing your whole self to work. We build machines; we don’t try to be machines.

We want TypeSafe to be the place where you do the most impactful work of your career and help define our future as a company.

We provide

  • 100% covered health insurance
  • Daily lunch and dinner
  • Visa sponsorships
  • 401K plans

job.name: Partner 16, Data Engineer - Global Partnerships
job.description:
Founded in Silicon Valley in 2009 by Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz, Andreessen Horowitz (aka a16z) is a venture capital firm that backs bold entrepreneurs building the future through technology. We are stage agnostic. We invest in seed to venture to growth-stage technology companies, across AI, bio + healthcare, consumer, enterprise, fintech, frontier, games, and companies building toward American dynamism. a16z has $100B+ under management across multiple funds.

We’ve established a team that is defined by respect for the entrepreneur and the company-building process; we know what it’s like to be in the founder’s shoes. We’ve invested in companies like Anduril, Airbnb, Coinbase, Cursor, Databricks, Deel, Figma, GitHub, Roblox, SpaceX, and Stripe. Our team is at the forefront of new technology, helping founders and their companies impact and change the world.

The Role The Global Partnerships team is dedicated to crafting an outstanding client experience for our trusted Limited Partners (“LPs”). The Global Partnerships Data Engineer owns and advances critical data infrastructure, systems, and automation that support the global partnerships activities of Andreessen Horowitz. This role operates with significant independence, leads complex cross-functional initiatives, and serves as a technical and strategic thought partner across Global Partnerships and adjacent teams. We’re looking for a data leader who can translate ambiguous business needs into scalable systems, reliable pipelines, and practical insights.

We are open to candidates based in the San Francisco Bay Area.

To join our team, you should be excited to: Own and advance the Global Partnerships data ecosystem

  • Lead ownership of critical systems, including the Global Partnerships core datasets and data pipelines. Serve as a technical and strategic thought partner to Global Partnerships and adjacent teams on data practices, automation, and scalable process design
  • Design and maintain scalable data infrastructure and reliable pipelines that connect Global Partnerships systems and reduce manual work and error rates
  • Uphold the highest standards of data precision and monitor and rectify discrepancies across different platforms
  • Evaluate and implement tools and integrations to improve visibility, connectivity, and decision-making

Champion AI adoption across Global Partnerships

  • Identify, pilot, and scale AI tools and agentic workflows that remove manual work and give the team leverage, then drive team-wide adoption through training, documentation, and change management
  • Lead automation, process development, and operational scale. Enhance processes through automation to achieve data accuracy, reliability, and speed
  • Act as the team's AI thought partner, staying current on emerging tools and translating them into concrete, high-leverage improvements to LP-facing and internal processes

job.name: Software Development Engineer
job.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to join our team. This is a Hybrid role for Santa Clara, CA, reporting to the Sr Manager, Software Development Engineering in the Engineering department. As an engineer on the Data & APIs team, you will build large-scale data pipelines and real-time streaming systems that process Zscaler's security telemetry at scale, along with the APIs that expose it to internal and external consumers. You will own features end-to-end across the streaming pipeline and API surface—writing production code, contributing to distributed-systems design, and operating what you build.

What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)

  • Build and maintain backend services and APIs (REST/gRPC) that expose Zscaler's security data to internal teams and customers, writing production-quality code across the request path
  • Contribute to large-scale streaming and batch data pipelines (Kafka, Spark/Flink) and the storage layer (SQL, NoSQL, columnar) that feed those APIs — writing processing logic, tuning performance, and helping triangulate bottlenecks in production
  • Participate in design discussions, write and review design docs for features you own, and contribute to AI/ML enabled anomaly-detection and signal-correlation logic over streaming telemetry.
  • Instrument, monitor, and operate the services you build — including on-call rotation, incident response, and continuous improvement of reliability and performance
  • Spot pain points and friction in the existing system (bugs, slow queries, flaky tests, manual toil) and propose or ship improvements; partner with senior engineers, Product, and consuming teams to clarify requirements and deliver features — fluently using modern AI coding, review, and agentic tools across the SDLC

Who You Are (Success Profile)

job.description:
Data Engineer – Databricks & Manufacturing Data

Location: Foster City – ONSITE ROLES

Duration: 12+ months with possibility of longer term extensions

Pay Rate: $70/hr - $76/hr dependent on experience

W-2 only; NO C2C, 1099, or H-1B sponsorship.

Zoox is seeking a Data Engineer to build and maintain pipelines and data models for its Manufacturing Operations lakehouse. You’ll bring data from manufacturing systems including SAP MES, SAP HANA, on-prem databases, and test systems into Databricks to support trusted KPIs, dashboards, and AI use cases.

What you’ll do

Build batch and streaming pipelines in Databricks and Delta Lake.

Develop incremental dbt models and trusted manufacturing data layers.

Support data quality, performance, monitoring, and CI/CD.

Partner with data, manufacturing, analytics, and platform teams.

What you’ll bring

6+ years of data engineering experience.

job.name: Forward Deployed Engineer
job.description:
About Us Higharc is a VC-backed startup that is changing how new homes are designed and built. Join a founding team who’ve shipped products for Autodesk, Electronic Arts, Nike, and Apple. We have raised over $175M with support from top-notch venture capital firms and more than 18 strategic investors: industry leaders in construction, building products manufacturing, and distribution.

Higharc is seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer to join as one of the founding roles on our new Forward Deployed team. You'll work embedded alongside a large production homebuilder to turn plans into actionable data.

What You'll Do

A homebuilder's plan library is the product data behind its entire business — and at enterprise scale, that data is almost entirely unstructured. Plans live as drawing sets scattered across semi-autonomous divisions, renamed and re-numbered as they move. Nobody can say with confidence which plans are duplicates, how many versions of a given home exist, or what actually varies between them.

Higharc converts those catalogs into structured, queryable plan data, and builds the analysis on top of it: searchable plan libraries with agent-enabled natural-language search, geometric similarity scoring that surfaces plans which have forked under different names, structured mapping of what varies across a library, and classification that makes consolidation decisions possible. You'll build what gets shipped in the field.

This role is for someone who wants to build against real, messy data in front of the customer, not two abstractions removed from it.

NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. job.name: Senior Data Engineer, Product
job.description:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role

As a Data Engineer, you will handle everything from data architecture and modeling to data pipeline tooling and dashboarding. You will enable a range of other engineering and business teams to make impactful business decisions by laying the foundation of our large and unique datasets that span across multiple products. This role will support the product data engineering team.

The Product Data Engineering Team at Block builds and maintains the curated data foundation that powers all of Block's product lines — Cash App, Square, Afterpay, and Tidal. We transform raw event streams, transactional systems, and operational data into governed, tested, and reliable analytical assets across domains including banking, lending, commerce, investing, checkout, and AI assistants. We partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, and Applied AI teams to deliver the metrics, experimentation frameworks, and ML-ready datasets that enable Block's products to grow, improve, and serve customers at scale.

You Will

  • Lead the creation and optimization of data models across eventing, customer-level, and process-level data, leveraging AI-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery.
  • Take shared or independent technical ownership of critical data pipelines across Block — including foundational customer datasets, money transfer and movement pipelines, and the data infrastructure powering Block's experimentation platform.
  • Build monitoring to assess data quality and lineage and further, build AI agents for false positive reduction and automated resolution.
  • Participate in on-call rotation, monitor daily execution, diagnose and log issues, and fix business critical pipelines to ensure SLAs are met with internal stakeholders. Automate this process through AI agents to focus human effort on highest priority tasks.
  • Work with non-technical partners and product teams to understand their needs, translate business requirements into applicable data requirements, and develop automated end-to-end solutions.

job.name: Data Engineer, Central InfraOps Analytics Team
job.description:
Description As a Data Engineer you will enable data-driven decision making within the Amazon Web Services Data Center Infrastructure Operations organization. The Infrastructure Operations Team is responsible for planning, implementing, monitoring and continuously improving the global Amazon Data Center infrastructure. The team supports all aspects of the Data Center based organizations, including but not limited to : Safety, Security, maintenance, operations, logistics, engineering and equipment management.

Key job responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain ETL pipelines to ingest data into the data warehouse and data lake

Create and optimize logical data models that drive physical design for the Infrastructure Operations organization

Implement data quality measures and ongoing monitoring to ensure data integrity

Build scalable, efficient, and maintainable data solutions that support business intelligence needs

Optimize data storage and query performance across various data platforms

Develop automated processes to replace manual data operations

Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand data and reporting requirements

Translate business questions into data solutions that drive decision-making

Mentor and develop peers in data engineering best practices

Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and team planning

Improve self-service access to data for business users

Enhance code quality and dependency management

Automate manual processes to increase efficiency

Identify and resolve root causes of complex data problems

A day in the life

At AWS, the Data Engineer fully embraces the "You Build It, You Own It" philosophy, taking complete ownership of data solutions from conception through deployment and ongoing maintenance. You design architectures, implement pipelines, and remain responsible for their health and evolution as business needs change.

Each day begins with reviewing pipeline alerts and data quality metrics, followed by a 15-30 minute team stand-up to align on priorities and discuss blockers. You'll spend time monitoring infrastructure, reviewing logs for ETL pipeline health and data lake performance, then dedicate time to address stakeholder queries and prioritizing incoming requests via email, Slack and intake forms. The majority of your time is spent developing and maintaining ETL pipelines that ingest infrastructure operational data from global data centers, which includes writing code, debugging issues, optimizing queries, and implementing quality checks. The role requires frequent context switching between developing new data models, supporting existing infrastructure, and consulting on data utilization.

Read the full description

job.name: Data Engineer I
job.description:
Description Are you passionate about building data pipelines and turning raw information into actionable insights? Do you enjoy designing solutions that help teams make smarter, faster decisions? As a Data Engineer I at Amazon, you will build and maintain data solutions that power critical business decisions across the organization. You will work with large-scale datasets, design efficient data models, and create automated pipelines that process millions of data points. This is an opportunity to grow your technical skills while collaborating with analysts, data scientists, and engineers who rely on your work to unlock the value hidden in data. If you are curious, resourceful, and energized by solving real problems with data, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain data pipelines and ETL workflows that ingest, transform, and persist data from multiple sources at scale.
  • Create and optimize physical data models, applying best practices in schema design, partitioning, indexing, and query performance tuning to ensure reliable and efficient data access.
  • Write secure, testable, and well-documented code using scripting and query languages such as SQL, Python, or Scala to automate data processing and support analytical workloads.
  • Collaborate with business analysts, data scientists, and engineering partners to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions that meet business needs.
  • Monitor data pipelines for operational issues, troubleshoot root causes, and resolve defects to maintain data integrity and system reliability.

A day in the life

You will start your day reviewing pipeline health dashboards and addressing any data quality alerts. From there, you might refine a data model to support a new reporting requirement, write and test ETL code, or pair with a teammate to review a schema change. Expect regular conversations with analysts and data scientists who depend on your pipelines, helping you stay connected to the business impact of your work. You will also participate in design discussions and code reviews, continuously sharpening your skills in a collaborative engineering environment.

About The Team Amazon's Global Logistics (GL) Exports team supports Amazon's vision of offering customers worldwide cross-border product selection at competitive prices. We build the data infrastructure and analytics that power smart, data-driven decisions for customers, sellers, and vendors navigating international trade and logistics. Our work directly shapes Amazon's ability to scale globally and deliver innovative e-commerce solutions.

job.name: Data Engineer (Chicago-Based - Onsite/Hybrid)
job.description:
Description Position at HNI Corporation HNI Corporation is a global family of brands for the workplace and home dedicated to enhancing the spaces where we live, work, and gather. We pride ourselves on fostering an environment where we make a positive impact on others; upholding our beliefs in integrity, inclusion and belonging.

Position Summary The Data Engineer is an early-career technology professional responsible for developing, maintaining, and supporting the data pipelines and data structures that enable analytics, reporting, and data-driven decision-making across HNI Corporation.

Working as part of the Data Engineering and Decision Sciences organization, this position helps move data from enterprise applications and other source systems into HNI’s cloud-based data environment, where it can be organized, transformed, and made available to Business Intelligence, analytics, and other data consumers.

The Data Engineer I performs hands-on development using SQL, Python, ETL/ELT technologies, and cloud data platforms , with an emphasis on Microsoft Azure and Snowflake. The role works within established data architecture, engineering standards, security requirements, and development practices while gradually building the technical depth necessary to design increasingly complex data solutions.

This position is appropriate for someone with foundational professional experience in data engineering, database development, business intelligence, software development, or a related technical discipline who is ready to expand their experience working with enterprise-scale data. Success requires strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, attention to data quality, curiosity about how data is created and used, and a willingness to learn new technologies and engineering practices.

Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate has already moved beyond learning SQL and programming solely in an academic environment and has begun applying those skills to real business data and production technology environments . They may currently be a junior Data Engineer, BI Developer, Database Developer, Analytics Engineer, Data Analyst with strong technical skills, or Software Developer whose work has increasingly focused on data.

They do not need to arrive as an expert in Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, data architecture, or large-scale cloud engineering. More important is a strong foundation in SQL, logical problem solving, data manipulation, and basic programming , combined with enough professional experience to understand concepts such as source systems, production data, testing, version control, documentation, and downstream dependencies.

Read the full description

job.name: Data Engineer
job.description:
MANTECH seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented Data Engineer to join our team in Doral, FL. Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

  • Designing, constructing, testing, and maintaining scalable data architectures and processing systems.
  • Developing and optimizing automated ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, and load enterprise data sources.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional technical teams, data scientists, and analysts to define data interoperability standards.
  • Conducting performance tuning, data validation, and troubleshooting across complex database environments.
  • Maintaining data baselines, configuration management controls, and comprehensive technical documentation.
  • Recommending and implementing process improvements to enhance system reliability, data quality, and scalability.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field with 3+ years of experience in data engineering.

+ OR a master’s degree and 1+ or more years of relevant experience
+ OR an associate’s degree and 5+ or more years of relevant experience
+ OR a high school diploma and 7+ or more years of relevant experience

  • Proven experience building and managing scalable data pipelines, data warehouses, and relational databases. Strong proficiency in writing complex SQL queries and programming languages such as Python, Scala, or Java.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms, database engineering, and automated workflow orchestration tools. Experience creating, maintaining, and communicating complex technical documentation and data architectures.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Relevant industry certifications such as AWS Certified Data Engineer, Azure Data Engineer Associate, or Databricks Certified Data Engineer.
  • Prior experience supporting U.S. Military Command operations or Department of Defense enterprise data environments.
  • Familiarity with real-time streaming architectures, data governance frameworks, and containerization technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate across multi-disciplinary technical teams to drive data platform improvements.

Clearance Requirements

  • Must hold a current/active secret security clearance.

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50%.
  • Needs to occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc.
  • Frequently communicates with co-workers, management, and customers, which may involve delivering presentations. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.

job.name: Data Engineer
job.description:
Join a strong community where all we do is care-for the children and families we serve every day, as well as for our dedicated team members. Our people are our best asset. We listen and we know what you're looking for:

  • You want benefits. We support you with a minimum 50% childcare discount, immediate access to benefits, innovative health programs, 401(k) company match, and much more.
  • You want balance. We offer flexible schedules that work for you, no nights or weekends, the ability to bring your children to work with you, and paid time off.
  • You want opportunity. We invest in your future with ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, credential assistance, and our unique Master Teacher Program.
  • You want recognition. We provide a positive, fun workplace where employees are appreciated.

The Data Engineer is a member of the Data & Analytics team responsible for building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines on Microsoft Fabric and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The role moves data from source systems through a medallion (raw-to-curated) architecture, delivering trusted, well-documented data for Power BI reporting, analytics, and data science. The Data Engineer helps ensure pipeline reliability, performance, cost efficiency, and governance, and uses AI-assisted development tools to work more efficiently.

Essential Functions:

  • Design, build, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines that move data to and from source systems, including reusable, metadata-driven ingestion frameworks.
  • Build and maintain lakehouse and warehouse data structures using a medallion (raw-to-curated) architecture, and develop the transformation logic that moves data through each layer.
  • Build and support near-real-time and streaming data flows for analytics and operational use.
  • Integrate data across cloud platforms while maintaining a consistent design and a single source of truth.
  • Deliver curated, well-documented datasets for reporting and self-service analytics.
  • Use AI coding assistants daily to accelerate development, debugging, testing, and documentation, reviewing and validating all generated output.
  • Monitor pipelines for failures, data quality, and performance issues, resolving them to root cause, and optimize platform cost and performance.
  • Apply security, access controls, and governance practices in line with company data governance requirements.
  • Apply version control, code review, testing, and CI/CD practices, and document data flows, lineage, and design decisions for maintainability and handoff.
  • Own moderately complex projects from requirements through production as part of the team, contribute to design reviews, and participate in code reviews and knowledge sharing.

Supervisory Responsibilities: No

job.name: Data Engineer
job.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking a Data Engineer to join our Data team, comprising both Data Scientists, Data Analysts, and Data Engineers. Our team is at the forefront of enhancing data analysis efficiency and effectiveness. Our data engineers develop and maintain data pipelines integral to our analytics data model.

As a Data Engineer, your primary responsibility will be designing and maintaining data pipelines, primarily utilizing SparkSQL and Pyspark, within our central data lake. These pipelines are crucial for ingesting and transforming source data from our IOT devices and software products into our core data model, facilitating statistical analysis, model training, and dashboard creation.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
  • You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
  • You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we’re all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win – together.

job.name: Data Engineer
job.description:
Join Atlas Air Worldwide. Move the World with Us! At Atlas Air Worldwide, we’re not just an airline, we’re a global engine powering cargo, passenger, and leasing operations across more than 70 countries. As a leader in outsourced aviation logistics, we’re built on a foundation of safety , service excellence , integrity , innovation , teamwork , and responsibility . With over 30 years of history, a modern all-Boeing fleet, and nearly 5,000 teammates collaborating across operations, technical, and corporate functions, we’re driven by purpose.

If you're ready to grow, innovate, and help us deliver excellence every single day, you belong here. Position Summary: Atlas Air is seeking a Data Engineer to join our Data Platform and Engineering team. This is an early-career individual contributor role for an engineer who can deliver well-defined data solutions with guidance, build strong engineering fundamentals, and grow ownership over increasingly complex work.

As we continue to build our data environment on Databricks, you will help build and operate reliable data pipelines, transformations, and data models. You will work within established architecture and standards, partner with more experienced engineers, and author production-quality code that supports analytics, data science, AI/ML, and operational decision-making.

Major Accountabilities Data Pipeline Development

  • Build, test, deploy, and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines for structured and semi-structured data sources using established patterns and frameworks.
  • Develop data transformations that convert source data into accurate, documented, and reusable datasets.
  • Implement data models and data products based on defined business requirements and technical designs.
  • Use Databricks, Spark, orchestration tools, and cloud services to complete scoped engineering work with support from senior team members.
  • Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to improve code quality, maintainability, and performance.

Data Quality & Operations

  • Create automated tests, validation checks, logging, and monitoring the pipelines and datasets you develop.
  • Investigate data quality, reliability, and performance issues; resolve routine issues independently and escalate broader problems appropriately.
  • Produce clear technical documentation, including data definitions, lineage, runbooks, and support notes.
  • Participate in the team's on-call and incident response practices, with appropriate guidance and escalation support.
  • Follow established security, privacy, governance, and access control requirements.

Collaboration & Growth

job.name: Data Engineer II, Veritas, Security Tools Foundation
job.description:
Description Amazon Security (AmSec) is looking for a Data Engineer II to join a team of highly skilled individuals working on our initiatives in resource and application discovery within Amazon security. Our product, Veritas, is a foundational service within Amazon security that provides data for security initiatives like security reviews, threat modeling and detection, access control and incident response.

You will be part of a AmSec organization that spans over ten countries worldwide, catering to a wide variety of customer use cases, including security intelligence, application security, incident response, security operations, risk and compliance, acquisitions and subsidiaries, and external partner security.

You will work closely with a diverse range of roles, such as Software Development Engineers, Data Scientist, Data Engineers, Technical Program Managers, Product managers and our Security Engineer customers, to build high quality datasets for security investigations, application modeling, and more.

You’ll primarily work with AWS services such as EMR, Glue, Athena, Redshift, S3, SNS, SQS, Apache Airflow, along with some internal tools.

You’ll also be part of our transformation journey to build data objects by leveraging AI. Our data lake contains over 500 datasets from various sources, with some handling daily volumes exceeding PBs.

As Data Engineer, you will be gathering and understanding data requirements, partnering with software engineers, and collaborating across roles and teams to create the necessary data infrastructure and high quality pipelines to drive our team's initiatives. We have high-visibility data ingestion goals in a fast-paced, operational environment. The ideal candidate should enjoy the challenge of operating complex and mission-critical systems under ambiguity.

Key job responsibilities

  • Develop and influence the teams’ data strategy and data storage roadmap through working closely with partners
  • Lead designs for data governance strategy, define data schema and develop tools to enable more efficient data sharing with customers which adhere to highly confidential data handling guidelines.
  • Continually improve the data quality and operations, via automation and building full CI/CD data pipelines
  • Recognize and adopt best practices in data integrity, data model, testing, analysis, validation, and documentation.
  • Build end-to-end data pipelines to ingest and transform data from different types of data sources and systems
  • Utilize AI/LLM to automate manual and redundant data engineering task
  • Evaluate and implement various big-data technologies and solutions (e.g. Redshift, Iceberg, Hive/EMR, Spark, SNS, SQS) to optimize processing of extremely large datasets
  • Understand and analyze business processes, logical data models and relational database implementations
  • Write high performing and optimized SQL queries

job.name: Senior Data Engineer, Product
job.description:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role

As a Data Engineer, you will handle everything from data architecture and modeling to data pipeline tooling and dashboarding. You will enable a range of other engineering and business teams to make impactful business decisions by laying the foundation of our large and unique datasets that span across multiple products. This role will support the product data engineering team.

The Product Data Engineering Team at Block builds and maintains the curated data foundation that powers all of Block's product lines — Cash App, Square, Afterpay, and Tidal. We transform raw event streams, transactional systems, and operational data into governed, tested, and reliable analytical assets across domains including banking, lending, commerce, investing, checkout, and AI assistants. We partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, and Applied AI teams to deliver the metrics, experimentation frameworks, and ML-ready datasets that enable Block's products to grow, improve, and serve customers at scale.

You Will

  • Lead the creation and optimization of data models across eventing, customer-level, and process-level data, leveraging AI-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery.
  • Take shared or independent technical ownership of critical data pipelines across Block — including foundational customer datasets, money transfer and movement pipelines, and the data infrastructure powering Block's experimentation platform.
  • Build monitoring to assess data quality and lineage and further, build AI agents for false positive reduction and automated resolution.
  • Participate in on-call rotation, monitor daily execution, diagnose and log issues, and fix business critical pipelines to ensure SLAs are met with internal stakeholders. Automate this process through AI agents to focus human effort on highest priority tasks.
  • Work with non-technical partners and product teams to understand their needs, translate business requirements into applicable data requirements, and develop automated end-to-end solutions.

You Have

job.name: Senior Data Engineer - ETL/ELT (Remote - NC, AZ, TX, FL)
job.description:
Overview This is a remote role that may only be hired in the following location(s): North Carolina, Arizona, Texas, Florida

We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer with strong hands-on experience building and operating modern data pipelines in a cloud-based data platform. This role is focused on implementing, enhancing, and supporting data pipelines and platform capabilities under established architectural patterns.

Senior Data Engineers are expected to be daily hands-on contributors who can independently deliver complex pipeline components, partner effectively with Leads, and mentor junior engineers while continuing to grow toward platform ownership and technical leadership.

In addition to modernization and delivery responsibilities, this role is expected to identify opportunities to accelerate engineering outcomes through automation, reusable frameworks, metadata-driven development, and emerging AI-enabled engineering capabilities. Engineers in this role will help drive improvements in both platform modernization and delivery lifecycle efficiency.

Responsibilities & Qualifications Duties & Responsibilities: Data Pipeline Development

  • Design and build data pipelines using established Medallion Architecture patterns (Bronze, Silver, Gold).
  • Implement batch and CDC-based ingestion pipelines from databases, files, and APIs.
  • Support pipeline reliability, scalability, performance, and cost optimization.

Data Ingestion & Integration

  • Develop and support ingestion pipelines using Qlik Replicate for snapshot and CDC patterns.
  • Implement ingestion processes for structured and semi-structured data.
  • Build and extend Python-based pipeline components following existing frameworks.

Transformation, Modeling & Testing

  • Develop dbt models using SQL and Jinja templating.
  • Implement and maintain automated tests for data quality, freshness, and schema validation.
  • Participate in CI/CD-based deployments of dbt transformations.

Snowflake Development & Governance

  • Implement Snowflake ingestion patterns using Snowpipe and Tasks.
  • Apply and support RBAC, dynamic masking, and tag-based access controls.
  • Develop stored procedures and support governed data access patterns.

Cloud Development

  • Develop and operate data workloads using AWS services such as S3, Lambda, ECS Fargate, Glue, DynamoDB, and IAM, or equivalent Azure services.
  • Collaborate with senior engineers on deployment pipelines, automation, and environment promotion.

Modernization

  • Demonstrated experience reducing manual engineering effort through automation, framework development, reusable components, intelligent tooling, metadata-driven approaches, or other engineering acceleration techniques
  • Experience implementing automated testing, validation, reconciliation, documentation, monitoring, or operational support capabilities within enterprise data platforms.

Operational Excellence

What's Not Eligible

Good to Know

Description Amazon Leo is building a global e-commerce experience for Internet Service Provider (ISP) customers, and we need a Software Development Engineer II. You will build the backend-for-frontend layer, the service that sits directly behind the customer-facing surfaces and orchestrates over the many backend systems that make satellite internet work: ordering, payments, billing, equipment and network provisioning, and support.

The job is to shape what the frontend needs, route and orchestrate requests across those systems, translate between them, and compose their responses into reliable operations the customer experience can depend on. The core of the work is integration: calling many APIs, handling partial failures gracefully, mapping between different service models, and keeping latency and reliability high across a lot of moving parts. Much of this is built zero-to-one and expanding into new countries, so you will move from ambiguous problems to working products. You will own the full development lifecycle and work closely with frontend, product, and partner service teams.

Export Control Requirement Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities

  • Design and build backend gateway APIs in Java that route and orchestrate requests across many downstream services, from concept through deployment and operation.
  • Integrate with ordering, payments, billing, equipment and network provisioning, and support services: calling their APIs, translating between their models, and composing their responses.
  • Handle the realities of a distributed system: partial failures, retries, timeouts, error translation, and keeping latency and reliability high across many dependencies.
  • Work with product managers, frontend engineers, and partner service teams, and help the platform expand into new countries.
  • Use agentic development workflows and generative AI tools to deliver faster, and improve the system with AWS native services.
  • Review code, give feedback, and coach teammates on service integration patterns and well-tested code.
  • Document your team's software and train new team members on how it is built, tested, and operated.

About The Team We build the e-commerce experience for a global ISP customer base at Amazon Leo. Our team owns the backend-for-frontend layer: the single API the customer-facing app talks to, and the orchestration behind it that connects to the systems provisioning and running satellite internet. We work hand in hand with the frontend team, shaping our APIs around what their experiences need. We are scaling the team and investing in AI-based development and operational workflows.

The Emerging Markets Outbound Tech team plans which packages will be dispatched, and which by alternate methods such as bikes, vans, or stores to pick them up. Our systems make the best decisions on how each package in our network is delivered, complying with traffic limitations (no trucks in a zone), size restrictions, and grouping packages together for efficiency. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer who loves solving hard problems in a collaborative environment, has high standards for quality and maintainability, and is looking to grow into a space where they can have high impact on customers. You will work with other engineers on our team and in adjacent teams, as well as with research scientists, senior engineers, and product managers, to develop software to automatically create the best package plans, which are used all over the globe, multiple times, every day.

Key job responsibilities

An SDE on the Emerging Markets Outbound Tech team collaborates both within the team and with SDEs on adjacent teams, with TPMs and PM-Ts, to deliver scalable software (used in ECCF region including India and Midlle East) that allocates packages and provides planning assets related to cycles, channels, and multi-hop planning to downstream systems. SDEs also mentor intern/apprentice and junior engineers, improve the performance, maintainability, and availability of existing software, and respond quickly to high severity events. Engineers on this team work closely with Science, Tech SMEs, Program and Product managers across the Last Mile organization, as well as business PMs to resolve any production issues and support expansion and feature launches.

A day in the life

SDEs design, implement, and operate our running software. Daily activities may include attending daily team scrum meetings, estimation of future tasks, design discussions and reviews, as well as coding and reviewing other code reviews and performing deployment and monitoring duties. SDEs are also responsible for learning necessary and ancillary skills (both hard and soft) as well as mentoring others and being mentored. All engineers are also expected to participate (after suitable onboarding) in a weeklong oncall shift, during which they must be available if called 24/7 during the shift.

You will join a start-up team and work closely with Sr. Engineers and principal engineers and Sr. Principal Engineers and application teams.

Engineers within AWS Identity need to be creative, responsible, and curious while working with others to move quickly in turning code into customer solutions. You’re excited about rolling up your sleeves, implementing ideas, and learning from those around you. You relish the opportunity to dig into challenging operational issues, fix them permanently while taking the learning back as you design the next iteration.

This specific position within AWS IAM Identity Center where you design and build services that enables customers manage their workforce and individual identities and manage their access to AWS applications and SaaS offerings.

Key job responsibilities

In this role, you will collaborate with talented engineers to build innovative services used by millions of users worldwide. Our team operates at the intersection of security and user experience, enhancing both for AWS customers. You will work on core platforms that power AWS IAM Identity Center, leveraging the latest technologies to solve complex problems.

About The Team AWS IAM Identity Center (IdC) helps customers securely create or connect workforce identities and manage their access centrally across AWS accounts and applications. IdC simplifies the administrative complexity of federating and managing permissions separately for each AWS account, allows customers to set up AWS applications from a single interface, and to assign access to their cloud applications from a single place. IdC offers additional identity federation functionality to provide a uniform identity platform for a large set of internal AWS Data, ML & Business applications such as QuickSight, Sagemaker, RedShift and IoT.

job.name: GTM Engineer
job.description:
About the role: Nscale's GTM organization is being built right now — and the revenue infrastructure underneath it does not exist yet. The commercial source of truth, the account intelligence, the data layer behind pipeline and forecasting, and every automation on top will be designed, built and shipped by this role, from a blank page. This is a hands-on builder role that combines revenue operations judgment with GTM engineering: you decide what the highest-leverage system is, then you build it.

Nscale sells the infrastructure that the agentic era runs on, and we intend to run our GTM the same way. The agentic workflows for research, enrichment, signal routing and competitive intelligence that this team will run on are yours to architect, build and ship from the ground up. You are not improving someone else's system; you are creating the one every future hire inherits.

What You'll Own The commercial source of truth

  • Implement and structure the CRM from the ground up: account and opportunity data models, pipeline stages, required fields, routing, process hygiene and reporting — one trusted record for every deal and every tranche of capacity
  • Architect and build the GTM stack from scratch with integrations and automations that eliminate manual work before it ever becomes habit
  • Own field governance and data integrity with Revenue Enablement — the standard is enforced in the system, not in reminders

The data layer and reporting

  • Create the data layer the GTM operating rhythm will run on — pipeline health, deal velocity, forecast accuracy, ASP by SKU, utilization, capacity sold-forward. None of this data exists today; you define it, instrument it and make it trustworthy
  • Build the first reporting these forums will ever run on — the weekly pipeline review, the capacity allocation forum and the WPR are being stood up in parallel with this role
  • Build executive dashboards that make funnel performance, pipeline coverage and launch adoption legible at a glance

AI-native workflows and automation

  • Build and ship the first agentic and automated workflows for research, enrichment, account intelligence, signal capture and routing — removing repetitive work while preserving human judgment on strategic accounts
  • Build the internal tools, dashboards and agents that become this team's core infrastructure — a competitive intelligence hub and rep-facing agents are on the blueprint; you build the first versions
  • Build the automation behind deal capture and commercial document assembly from zero, as deal desk standardizes its structures

Ecosystem and signal mining

  • Mine Nscale's unique data — the Ray and Anyscale ecosystem, open-source community activity, platform usage telemetry — to identify high-value prospects, warm paths and expansion signals before competitors see them
  • Turn usage and adoption signals into sales triggers: who is scaling, who is about to hit capacity, who went quiet

job.name: Software Development Engineer, Seller Economics & Fees
job.description:
Description Are you an SDE II who thrives on end-to-end ownership, gets energized by problems where correctness actually matters, and wants to work on systems that are actively being reimagined and not just maintained? This role might be for you.

On Fee Tech, you will own systems that 2+MM sellers depend on daily to understand, predict, and act on their economics. The work is genuinely end-to-end: you design, build, ship, and operate. Our systems process ~68.5B transactions and used across 23 countries. The engineering model is changing fast: we are rebuilding how fee policy is expressed, deployed, and validated using AI agents, formal verification (SMT), and self-improving RL loops.

You will work alongside senior and principal engineers, product managers, applied scientists, and ML engineers across the full fee lifecycle — from the Fee Calculation Engine through ML-based item classification to seller-facing AI surfaces and the agentic infrastructure beneath them. If you are the kind of engineer who wants to see the direct impact of what you ship, you will see it here.

Key job responsibilities

  • Design and implement software solutions for major features and improvements, balancing technical constraints with customer needs while ensuring scalability, performance, and security.
  • Contribute across the full software development lifecycle including product definition, system design, coding, testing, deployment, and operational support, delivering incrementally and with high quality.
  • Identify root causes of operational issues and implement permanent fixes, continuously improving your team's systems and technical processes to reduce support costs and increase reliability.
  • Mentor and coach fellow engineers through code reviews and knowledge sharing, actively training new team members on system architecture, operations, and design decisions.
  • Evaluate new technologies and approaches to solve problems using optimal data structures and algorithms, making thoughtful recommendations for adoption while keeping solutions as simple as possible.
  • Operate AI-native engineering practices: use AI-assisted coding, multi-agent workflows, and agentic code review tools as your default mode of software delivery.

A day in the life

You start your morning reviewing a pull request from a teammate, offering feedback that strengthens both the code and the engineer behind it. After a quick standup, you dive into designing a new feature, sketching out how it fits into the broader system architecture. In the afternoon, you might pair with a colleague to debug a tricky production issue, then document your findings so the team can learn from it. Throughout it all, you collaborate closely with product partners to ensure what you build truly serves the customer.

job.name: Senior Developer Relations Manager - Dynamo AI Inference
job.description:
We are seeking a Senior Developer Relations Manager to build the developer ecosystem around NVIDIA Dynamo, our open-source framework for distributed AI inference. In this senior individual contributor role, you will help developers deploy and operate inference systems, build practical technical resources, and represent developer needs both in the community and inside NVIDIA!

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build the ecosystem with vLLM, SGLang, Mooncake, llm-d, and other inference projects through joint demos, integration guides, upstream contributions, and community programs that bring developers and maintainers together.
  • Develop runnable demos, sample code, technical documentation, and videos that explain Dynamo’s modular ecosystem and demonstrate its data center performance value.
  • Represent the developer community inside NVIDIA: turn feedback into concrete engineering and product requirements, influence priorities, and communicate progress back to developers.
  • Advocate externally through technical talks, live demos, workshops, and office hours. Help developers troubleshoot real deployments and contribute to projects; track repeat participation, contributor growth, and issues resolved.

What We Need To See

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years of overall technology industry experience, including 4+ years in AI/ML infrastructure, model serving, or distributed systems. Experience leading developer or partner programs across engineering, product, sales, marketing, and legal.
  • A background in AI inference with practical experience deploying and managing model-serving systems: configuring deployments, monitoring latency and throughput, scaling capacity, and troubleshooting reliability or performance issues. Familiarity with inference engines such as vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM, distributed serving stacks such as Dynamo or llm-d, and deploying and operating inference workloads on Kubernetes.
  • Experience working with open-source maintainers through issues, pull requests, and design discussions, and translating developer feedback into technical priorities.
  • A portfolio of technical guides, working demos, talks, or workshops you personally delivered that helped developers solve real problems. Ability to explain inference architecture and performance tradeoffs to audiences from engineers to executives.

job.name: Sr. AI Architect Finance - (Hybrid- Seattle, WA)
job.description:
Job Description Nordstrom Finance is looking for a Principal AI Architect who can both design and personally build the AI-driven reporting infrastructure that moves the organization toward an "autopilot" model of financial reporting — where routine reporting, reconciliation, variance analysis, and narrative generation are increasingly automated by well-governed AI agents and pipelines, freeing Finance teams to focus on judgment and decision-making. This is a hands-on architecture and engineering role, not a strategy-only position: you're expected to design the system and write the code, prompts, agent orchestration, and data pipelines that bring it to life, while also setting the technical vision and standards other engineers build against.

  • This role is Hybrid and will require you to be in office in downtown Seattle, WA 4 days per week.

A Day in the Life AI Architecture & Engineering

  • Architect and build the end-to-end AI infrastructure for automated financial reporting — agent orchestration, data pipelines, model integration, and human-in-the-loop review workflows.
  • Design for reliability and auditability: Finance reporting requires traceability, reproducibility, and controls, not just a working demo.
  • Personally prototype and ship production-grade AI agents/pipelines (e.g., using LLM APIs, retrieval systems, and workflow orchestration tools) rather than only producing designs for others to implement.

Finance & Data Domain Partnership

  • Partner closely with Finance leaders, FP&A, Controllership, and Accounting to understand current reporting workflows, controls, and pain points before automating them.
  • Work with Data Platform, Data Governance, and Security teams to ensure financial data used in AI pipelines meets Nordstrom's classification, access, and audit requirements.
  • Define what "autopilot" reporting should and shouldn't automate — identifying where human review and sign-off must remain in the loop.

Technical Leadership & Standards

  • Set architecture standards and best practices for applied AI within Finance Technology, and mentor engineers building against them.
  • Evaluate and select the AI/ML tooling, models, and platforms (build vs. buy) that best fit Nordstrom's Finance use cases and existing tech stack.
  • Act as the primary technical expert and thought leader on applied AI for Finance, staying current on the fast-moving AI landscape and translating relevant advances into roadmap decisions.

Governance, Risk & Change Management

  • Build in guardrails against model error, hallucination, and drift in a domain where reporting accuracy has real financial and compliance consequences.
  • Partner with Risk, Internal Audit, and Compliance as needed to ensure AI-generated reporting meets internal control and regulatory expectations.
  • Help Finance teams build trust in AI-assisted reporting through transparent design, clear documentation, and phased rollout.

You Own This If You Have...
