job.name: Financial Research Analyst
job.description:
Company Description

Money Purse Finserv is part of one of the largest Telugu financial education platforms, with a community of over 2 million subscribers on YouTube. The organization is focused on delivering free, practical, and easy-to-understand personal finance content in Telugu, covering topics such as financial planning, investments, daily financial news, stock research, loans, and insurance. Money Purse Finserv aims to build a financially aware and empowered community through expert insights, management interviews, and comprehensive educational resources. job.name: Profisee MDM (3-5 Years)
job.description:
Master Data Management (MDM) Consultant – Profisee (3–5 Years Experience)

About The Role We are seeking a skilled Master Data Management (MDM) Consultant with 3–5 years of experience to design, configure, and support enterprise-grade Master Data Management (MDM) solutions using Profisee . In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional business and technical teams to improve data quality , data governance , and data consistency across critical enterprise systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Configure Profisee data models, including entities, attributes, hierarchies, workflows, and business rules, to align with business requirements.
  • Develop and optimize match-and-merge logic, deduplication algorithms, and survivorship rules to produce accurate, trusted golden records.
  • Implement data validation, standardization, and quality controls to ensure compliance with data governance policies and regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).
  • Build and maintain integrations between Profisee and source systems, data warehouses (e.g., SQL Server, Snowflake), and downstream applications using ETL/ELT tools (e.g., SSIS, Informatica) and REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Perform source data profiling, design robust source-to-target mappings, and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for audit and knowledge transfer.
  • Troubleshoot complex data and integration issues, diagnose root causes, and support platform performance tuning and ongoing maintenance.
  • Partner with business stakeholders, data stewards, and engineering teams to translate functional requirements into scalable, high-performing MDM solutions.
  • Support MDM adoption initiatives, including user training, change management, and documentation of best practices.
  • Collaborate on MDM strategy and roadmap to align with enterprise data architecture and digital transformation goals.

Requirements

  • 3–5 years of experience implementing Master Data Management (MDM) solutions, with hands-on expertise in Profisee (preferred) or similar MDM platforms (e.g., Informatica MDM, IBM InfoSphere).
  • Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, data stewardship, and master data management best practices (e.g., DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Proficiency with ETL/ELT tools (e.g., SSIS, Informatica) and integration technologies (REST/SOAP APIs).
  • Experience working with data warehouses such as Microsoft SQL Server, Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, or Azure Synapse.
  • Familiarity with data modeling (logical/physical), metadata management, and data lineage concepts.
  • Experience with cloud-based MDM deployments (e.g., Profisee on Azure/AWS/GCP) is a plus.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work in agile and hybrid environments.
  • Professional certifications (e.g., CDMP, Profisee certifications, DAMA-DMBOK) are highly desirable.

At SentiLink, you'll work alongside smart, highly collaborative colleagues who respect each other's time and judgment, take ownership, and follow through on their commitments. Together, we do truly meaningful work protecting the identities of innocent consumers and flagging the fraudsters attempting to exploit them.

We're well capitalized and growing quickly. We already serve 13 of the top 15 U.S. banks, we're expanding into new markets, and we're backed by Craft Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, NYCA, and Max Levchin. We've been named to the Forbes Fintech 50 and as a 2026 FICO Industry Vanguard Decision Award Winner. We were also the first company to go live with the electronic Consent Based Social Security Number Verification (eCBSV) service, and we've testified before the U.S. Congress on the future of identity.

We want SentiLink to be the best place you've ever worked. We offer generous benefits and support a range of working arrangements, from fully remote to in-office. We are a digital-first company with strong collaboration across the U.S. and India, and we meet in person regularly to build relationships. We have offices in Austin, San Francisco, New York City, Seattle (Bellevue), Los Angeles, and Chicago in the U.S., and in Gurugram (Delhi) and Bengaluru in India.

Role SentiLink's Information Security team protects our systems, data, and customers while enabling the business to move quickly and securely. As software development accelerates across the company, we're investing in engineers who can both build security capabilities and improve the security of the products we deliver to customers.

We're looking for a Senior InfoSec Product Engineer who combines strong software engineering skills with a security mindset. You'll build and operate custom security applications, automation, and integrations; investigate vulnerabilities in our applications and cloud infrastructure; and help engineering teams develop, test, and deliver more secure software.

This role spans software development and hands-on product security. You'll work closely with other product security engineers and the broader Engineering and Infrastructure teams to uncover difficult security problems, develop practical solutions, and drive them through implementation. We're looking for someone who is curious about how systems fail, can navigate complex codebases and architectures, and has the technical range to move between building security tooling and validating the security of customer-facing products.

job.name: Application Security Engineer
job.description:
Application Security (AppSec) Engineer

Location: U.S. Remote

Salary: $160K-$175K (depending on experience)

Our client is a remote-first software company. Their software runs inside large enterprises, and they’re hiring their first dedicated Application Security (AppSec) Engineer to own the program.

The opportunity

You’ll start by streamlining how the company handles incoming vulnerabilities so engineers can get back to building. Then you’ll go on offense: testing the product the way an attacker would, finding problems before anyone else does, and shrinking the attack surface. You’ll have real freedom to bring in new tools and shape the approach, and you’ll work closely with the principal architect and engineering leaders.

What you’ll do

  • Own incoming vulnerabilities (a few a week): assess exploitability, drive patches, and help support teams respond to customers
  • Own and improve internal scanning and CI/CD security controls
  • Build a low-friction, repeatable process that makes security second nature for developers
  • Design and run an internal penetration testing program
  • Run secure code reviews and threat models, mostly in Java
  • Strengthen the software supply chain (SBOMs, dependency management, artifact verification)

What you bring

  • Strong Java skills: you can read code, find the flaws, and explain the fix
  • About 4 to 5 years in application security, product security, or security-focused software engineering
  • Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, SCA, and container scanning in CI/CD
  • Familiarity with Docker, cloud security basics, and software supply chain security
  • Excellent communication and high energy. You’ll build relationships quickly on a fully remote team.
  • Real passion for security, including on your own time

Bonus: offensive security or fuzzing experience, AI-assisted code review, open-source or CVE work, certifications (nice, not required)

Benefits

  • Fully remote
  • Meaningful equity
  • Medical, dental, and vision
  • 401(k) match
  • Generous PTO and holidays
  • Room to grow and shape the program

You will move fluidly across platforms and vendors rather than anchoring to a single stack, advising clients on the art of the possible, designing composable, future-ready architectures, and leading implementation across MarTech, AdTech, and AI-enabled solutions.

This role suits a technologist who treats the pace of change in this space as the appealing part of the job: someone who stays current on emerging platforms and AI capabilities, pilots new tools ahead of the market, and brings that point of view to clients and internal teams alike.

Recruiting for this role ends on February 19, 2027

Work you'll do As a MarTech Multi-Solution Architect, you will be responsible for:

  • Architecting end-to-end solutions across the marketing technology landscape (e.g., Adobe Experience Platform/AEP, Real-Time CDP, Journey Optimizer, Customer Journey Analytics, Target; Salesforce Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Agentforce; and comparable platforms) to enable unified customer profiles, journey orchestration, and omnichannel personalization
  • Bridging MarTech and AdTech ecosystems by integrating CDPs with ad servers, DSPs/SSPs, identity resolution, and measurement/attribution platforms to enable addressable, privacy-safe advertising and cross-channel activation
  • Architecting and maintaining identity resolution (IDR) and identity graph solutions, including identity matching logic, resolution accuracy, and data collection strategies that feed a unified, enterprise-wide view of the customer
  • Embedding AI and agentic capabilities into client marketing and advertising ecosystems, including generative content and personalization, AI assistants/copilots, and next-best-action or agent orchestration, and continuously evaluating emerging tools as the landscape evolves
  • Advising clients on future-state architecture design, feasibility, level of effort, cost, and the art of the possible, across composable, API-first MarTech and AdTech stacks
  • Leading technical pre-sales and solutioning (hunter/farmer cycles), translating business and marketing goals into technical designs, estimates, and phased implementation roadmaps
  • Leading integration and solution delivery across multiple platforms, third-party systems, and client stakeholder groups during technical design and implementation
  • Building and leading high-performing, cross-functional, geographically distributed teams of architects, engineers, and analysts, and establishing reusable frameworks, accelerators, and playbooks
  • Evaluating and recommending composable architecture approaches that enable clients to assemble modular, best-of-breed MarTech/AdTech capabilities rath

job.name: Staff Data Engineer
job.description:
Saronic Technologies is a leader in revolutionizing autonomy at sea, dedicated to developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance maritime operations through autonomous and intelligent platforms.

Job Overview We are seeking a Staff Data Engineer to join Internal Business Tools (IBT) which builds custom applications, analytics, and digital solutions for Saronic's internal operations. You will architect and build our enterprise data platform on Databricks.

You will own the medallion architecture across Saronic's business units and critical domains. That data feeds both the internal tools our team builds and the analytics business teams run themselves. You will understand what the data means and how sensitive it is, and design pipelines and access controls around that.

You will also be the key technical consultant to the business-led analyst teams building on the platform. You will be embedded with the business teams you support, working alongside them and their leaders so the platform reflects how they actually work. This role suits a hands-on engineer who enjoys setting technical direction as much as writing code, on a platform that is still taking shape.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and own our Databricks lakehouse: medallion layers, catalog layout, environments, and cost.
  • Build batch, CDC, and streaming ingestion from ERP, other enterprise systems, and internally built software, with traceable, replayable loads.
  • Design conformed data models and shared business definitions that serve our internal tools, analytics, and BI.
  • Create reusable pipeline patterns and standards that domain teams adopt as they onboard.
  • Own data quality, lineage, and documentation, with data contracts for published datasets. Quarantine bad records rather than silently dropping them.
  • Apply classification, retention, and access controls in Unity Catalog, including for export-controlled, CUI, HR, and financial data.
  • Consult for business-led analyst teams: set ownership boundaries and onboarding paths, review their work, and help them self-serve safely.
  • Embed with business teams and their leaders to learn their workflows and data needs first-hand, and turn what you learn into platform priorities.
  • Run the platform like production software: CI/CD, infrastructure as code, dev/test/prod promotion, and incident response.
  • Be a technical voice on the shared data platform roadmap and help make documented build-versus-buy decisions.
  • Mentor engineers and analysts, and help grow the data engineering function.

job.name: Remote Software Engineer
job.description:
About Us:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in software engineering, logical reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Ideal Background:

This role is ideal for engineers who have built production systems at companies like Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, Meta, or similar high-scale engineering organizations. We especially welcome graduates from top computer science programs such as Stanford, MIT, Carnegie Mellon, UC Berkeley, Georgia Tech, and comparable institutions — though exceptional experience and skill always take precedence over pedigree.

Project Overview:

As a Software Engineering evaluator, you will create cutting-edge datasets for training, benchmarking, and advancing large language models, collaborating closely with researchers. This includes curating code examples, providing precise solutions, and making corrections — with a primary focus on Python across backend services, data pipelines, and ML infrastructure, alongside JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C++, Java, Rust, and Go. You will evaluate and refine AI-generated code for efficiency, scalability, and reliability, and work with cross-functional teams to enhance enterprise-level AI-driven coding solutions.

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

  • Work on AI model training initiatives by curating code examples, building solutions, and correcting code — primarily in Python, with additional work in JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C++, Java, Rust, and Go.
  • Evaluate and refine AI-generated code to ensure that it is efficient, scalable, and reliable.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance AI-driven coding solutions against industry performance benchmarks.
  • Build agents and automated verification tools in Python that can verify the quality of code and identify error patterns.
  • Hypothesize on steps in the software engineering cycle (prototyping, architecture design, API design, production implementation, launch, experiments, monitoring, operational maintenance) and evaluate model capabilities on them.
  • Design verification mechanisms that can automatically verify a solution to a software engineering task.

About InMarket Since 2010, InMarket has been the leader in 360-degree consumer intelligence and real-time activation for thousands of today’s top brands. About The Role As a Product Builder at InMarket, you will design and build internal AI-powered software that simplifies, automates, and scales workflows across the entire organization. You'll work close to the business, embedding with teams across operations, data, product, and engineering to turn messy, manual processes into clean, reliable systems.

You'll start by securing quick wins on well-scoped internal problems, then progress toward larger-scale, higher-impact initiatives leading AI deployment for a key area of the business.

At InMarket, AI is the default way of working, and we care less about where you come from than about what you've built with it. Strong candidates come from a software engineering background or from a business domain (finance, marketing, operations), where they've rebuilt a real workflow around AI.

This role is a great fit if you're looking at AI transformation and figuring out how it actually drives business value, playing with the latest tools, building things for fun, and are hungry to show what you can do at the highest levels of a fast-growing company.

job.name: Sr. Engineering Manager
job.description:
Care.com is a consumer tech company with heart. We’re on a mission to solve a human challenge we all face: finding great care for the ones we love. We’re moms and dads and pet parents. We have parents and grandparents so we understand that everyone, at some point in their lives, could use a helping hand. Our culture and our products reflect that.

Job Description We are seeking a Senior Engineering Manager to lead our Pricing and Subscription team, a group of nine engineers responsible for the company’s core revenue-generating experiences, including rate cards, upsell, and checkout. In this role, you will partner closely with Product Management to review requirements and shape the roadmap, and you will drive a strong culture of experimentation through extensive A/B testing. This is a hands-on leadership position: you will be expected to remain technically engaged, reviewing technical designs and code changes to uphold engineering quality across the team.

What You Will Do

  • Lead a team of 9 engineers (including backend, frontend and QA) responsible for pricing, packaging, promotions and subscriptions experiences across our web and mobile products.
  • Partner with Product, Finance, Marketing, and Data to translate business priorities into the technical roadmap
  • Share progress and results with leadership, and help guide trade-off decisions by clearly explaining the risks, options, and expected return on engineering investment.
  • Stay hands-on: review code and designs, help debug production issues.
  • Build and run an experimentation practice that includes A/B testing, feature flags, clear success metrics and guardrails, so the team can ship pricing changes quickly and read the results with confidence.
  • Design and maintain the services that hold pricing rules, plans, discounts and promotions, and make sure they stay accurate, auditable and consistent with billing and payments systems.
  • Work with architects to break up legacy platform components and move core pricing capabilities to an event-driven architecture.
  • Champion engineering best practices across the domain, including observability, testing, performance, scalability and security.
  • Recruit, mentor and develop engineers, and build a team culture of ownership, collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Oversee on-call practices, SLAs and incident management to keep the platform resilient and available.

job.name: Appian Solution Architect - Senior Associate
job.description:
The Opportunity

As a Appian Solution Architect - Senior Associate, you will design and implement Appian-based process solutions within our Advisory practice, helping clients digitize and improve how work flows across their organizations. In this role, you will use business process modeling to understand current workflows and identify opportunities for automation through business process management and low-code tools. You will translate business needs into platform architecture and integration approaches that support efficient data flow, secure connectivity, and scalable technology foundations. Working with clients and multidisciplinary teams, you will connect process goals with technical design and implementation.

As a Senior Associate, you will guide assigned technical workstreams while building meaningful client relationships and learning how each client’s business context is changing. job.name: Consultant, Data Engineering
job.description:
SUMMARY Build the data foundation that grounds AI agents on facts they can trust. You turn raw, messy, multi-source data - structured feeds and unstructured content alike - into canonical, provenance-tagged, SLA-fresh Gold data that the Knowledge & Intelligence layer serves. Working with business leaders and internal customers, you set the design standards and assurance processes that keep the pipeline compatible, operable, and traceable end to end. This is hands-on data engineering where correctness and lineage aren't nice-to-haves - they're the product. You develop fundamentally new approaches to pull meaning out of data, and every record you land answers the question "where did this come from, and can we trust it?"

What You'll Own

  • + The medallion pipeline. Take landed data through Bronze → Silver → Gold - conforming structured sources and extracted content to Gold within its freshness SLA, with traceable lineage at every hop.
  • + Entity resolution. Own the resolve gate that turns many sources into one canonical identity - the join everything downstream depends on.
  • + Model-based extraction lanes. Build the NLP- and LLM-assisted lanes that pull structure out of unstructured content across many content types - HTML, PDF, DAM assets, and more - tagged as evidence, not fact.
  • Provenance and trust. Tag provenance and trust tier on every record. Quarantine what fails the gate with its reason attached, rather than silently dropping it.
  • + Performance at scale. Keep high-volume data in the lakehouse - and the served layer - lean and fast.

Why This Role?

  • + You own the layer everything else is built on. If the grounded facts are right, every agent that reads them is more trustworthy; if they're wrong, nothing downstream can save it - so this is where the leverage really is.
  • + Genuinely hard, genuinely new work: production-grade extraction from unstructured content, resolution at scale, and lineage you can defend - not another ETL backlog.
  • + A pod where provenance and trust are first-class engineering concerns, with the mandate to build the gates that enforce them.

Essential Requirements:

* + Lakehouse platforms - Databricks, IOMETE, or similar.
* + In-depth Spark - massive-volume data processing and fine-tuning.
+ PySpark, Java, and Python.
+ Table formats - in-depth knowledge of Iceberg, Delta Lake, or similar.
+ Advanced querying on RDBMS - complex data retrieval across Teradata, Oracle, SingleStore, and SQL Server.
+ Deep understanding of data integrity and consistency.
+ Workflow frameworks - Airflow, AWS Step Functions, or similar.
+ Chunking, embeddings, and vector databases.
+ S3-compatible storage.
+ MongoDB - nice to have.

Compensation Dell is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range for this position is USD $187,850 - USD $243,100

job.name: Workday Analyst (Functional)
job.description:
At MiniMed, you can begin a lifelong career of exploration and innovation, while helping make a difference in the lives of people living with diabetes around the globe. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation for a more connected, compassionate world.

About The Role A Day in the Life

Our Global Diabetes Capability Center in Pune is expanding to serve more people living with diabetes globally. Our state-of-the-art facility is dedicated to transforming diabetes management through innovative solutions and Technologies that reduce the burden of living with diabetes.

This position is an exciting opportunity to work with Minimed’s Diabetes business. Medtronic has announced its intention to separate the Diabetes division to promote future growth and innovation within the business and reallocate investments and resources across Medtronic, subject to applicable information and consultation requirements. This separation provides our team with a bold opportunity to unleash our potential, enabling us to operate with greater speed and agility. As a separate entity, we anticipate leveraging increased investments to drive meaningful innovation and enhance our impact on patient care.

#BetterDaysStartNow

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.

  • Configure and maintain Workday modules and business processes to meet business and operational needs, including organization management, eligibility rules, approval routing, calculated fields, templates, and plan setup as applicable.

  • Provide ongoing administration and support for Workday, respond to HR helpdesk requests, troubleshoot issues, and perform root-cause analysis.
  • Deliver user guidance and training to support adoption and effective use of Workday.
  • Develop and maintain reports and analytics to support HR operations, workforce insights, and informed decision-making.
  • Coordinate testing and project activities, manage competing priorities, and communicate progress and issues to stakeholders.
  • Support Workday functional domain leads and work effectively across cross-functional and virtual teams.

+ 3+ years of experience in HR systems administration or a related HR technology role, preferably supporting Workday.
+ Knowledge of Workday reporting, data management, and data analysis.
+ Strong communication, problem-solving, organization, and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to explain technical topics to nontechnical audiences.

job.description:
Location Name: Pune Corporate Office - PTP

Job Purpose Support management accounting and financial planning activities by preparing and reviewing business P&Ls, delivering flash and month-end reporting, coordinating AOP and reforecast cycles, aligning financials with business stakeholders, and identifying revenue or expense booking corrections and savings opportunities.

Duties And Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

Flash Reporting

  • Prepare P&L for flash reporting.
  • Prepare and consolidate the flash report.

Month-End Closing

  • Review trial balance (TB).
  • Finalize and provide inputs for monthly P&L for assigned line items and areas.
  • Perform segment-level break-up and provide inputs for the financials of assigned segments.
  • Prepare business statements and analytical schedules, such as AR Walk.

Business Alignment and Review Meetings

  • Review monthly P&Ls of assigned businesses and prepare need-based analysis.
  • Resolve queries and align P&Ls with business teams.
  • Attend review meetings and prepare minutes and follow-up points.

Annual Operating Plan (AOP)

  • Prepare the AOP model and tracker.
  • Update the model using inputs from businesses and functions.
  • Finalize assigned P&L line items and provide AOP inputs.
  • Review assigned business P&Ls, raise queries, and incorporate corrected inputs.
  • Align AOP P&Ls with business stakeholders.
  • Attend review meetings and update the model based on management directions.

Reforecasting

  • Prepare the reforecast model and tracker.
  • Update the model using inputs from businesses and functions.
  • Review assigned business P&Ls, raise queries, and incorporate corrections.
  • Align reforecast P&Ls with business stakeholders.
  • Attend review meetings and implement directed changes.
  • Prepare the reforecast deck for management submission.

Monthly Finance Deck

  • Review the monthly finance deck and coordinate required corrections.

Savings and Process Corrections

  • Analyse revenue line items for appropriate charging and booking, including revenue assurance.
  • Identify incorrect charging and coordinate corrective actions.
  • Drive corrections in the booking process.
  • Identify expense-booking issues and ensure necessary corrections.

Other Accountabilities

  • Break business-segment P&Ls into sub-segments as required.
  • Provide historical break-up of specific P&L line items based on business requirements.
  • Support other finance and management accounting activities as required.

job.name: Profisee MDM (3-5 Years)
job.description:
Master Data Management (MDM) Consultant – Profisee (3–5 Years Experience)

About The Role We are seeking a skilled Master Data Management (MDM) Consultant with 3–5 years of experience to design, configure, and support enterprise-grade Master Data Management (MDM) solutions using Profisee . In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional business and technical teams to improve data quality , data governance , and data consistency across critical enterprise systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Configure Profisee data models, including entities, attributes, hierarchies, workflows, and business rules, to align with business requirements.
  • Develop and optimize match-and-merge logic, deduplication algorithms, and survivorship rules to produce accurate, trusted golden records.
  • Implement data validation, standardization, and quality controls to ensure compliance with data governance policies and regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).
  • Build and maintain integrations between Profisee and source systems, data warehouses (e.g., SQL Server, Snowflake), and downstream applications using ETL/ELT tools (e.g., SSIS, Informatica) and REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Perform source data profiling, design robust source-to-target mappings, and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for audit and knowledge transfer.
  • Troubleshoot complex data and integration issues, diagnose root causes, and support platform performance tuning and ongoing maintenance.
  • Partner with business stakeholders, data stewards, and engineering teams to translate functional requirements into scalable, high-performing MDM solutions.
  • Support MDM adoption initiatives, including user training, change management, and documentation of best practices.
  • Collaborate on MDM strategy and roadmap to align with enterprise data architecture and digital transformation goals.

Requirements

  • 3–5 years of experience implementing Master Data Management (MDM) solutions, with hands-on expertise in Profisee (preferred) or similar MDM platforms (e.g., Informatica MDM, IBM InfoSphere).
  • Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, data stewardship, and master data management best practices (e.g., DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Proficiency with ETL/ELT tools (e.g., SSIS, Informatica) and integration technologies (REST/SOAP APIs).
  • Experience working with data warehouses such as Microsoft SQL Server, Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, or Azure Synapse.
  • Familiarity with data modeling (logical/physical), metadata management, and data lineage concepts.
  • Experience with cloud-based MDM deployments (e.g., Profisee on Azure/AWS/GCP) is a plus.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work in agile and hybrid environments.
  • Professional certifications (e.g., CDMP, Profisee certifications, DAMA-DMBOK) are highly desirable.

Read the full description

job.name: Profisee MDM (3-5 Years)
job.description:
Master Data Management (MDM) Consultant – Profisee (3–5 Years Experience)

About The Role We are seeking a skilled Master Data Management (MDM) Consultant with 3–5 years of experience to design, configure, and support enterprise-grade Master Data Management (MDM) solutions using Profisee . In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional business and technical teams to improve data quality , data governance , and data consistency across critical enterprise systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Configure Profisee data models, including entities, attributes, hierarchies, workflows, and business rules, to align with business requirements.
  • Develop and optimize match-and-merge logic, deduplication algorithms, and survivorship rules to produce accurate, trusted golden records.
  • Implement data validation, standardization, and quality controls to ensure compliance with data governance policies and regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).
  • Build and maintain integrations between Profisee and source systems, data warehouses (e.g., SQL Server, Snowflake), and downstream applications using ETL/ELT tools (e.g., SSIS, Informatica) and REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Perform source data profiling, design robust source-to-target mappings, and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for audit and knowledge transfer.
  • Troubleshoot complex data and integration issues, diagnose root causes, and support platform performance tuning and ongoing maintenance.
  • Partner with business stakeholders, data stewards, and engineering teams to translate functional requirements into scalable, high-performing MDM solutions.
  • Support MDM adoption initiatives, including user training, change management, and documentation of best practices.
  • Collaborate on MDM strategy and roadmap to align with enterprise data architecture and digital transformation goals.

Requirements

  • 3–5 years of experience implementing Master Data Management (MDM) solutions, with hands-on expertise in Profisee (preferred) or similar MDM platforms (e.g., Informatica MDM, IBM InfoSphere).
  • Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, data stewardship, and master data management best practices (e.g., DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Proficiency with ETL/ELT tools (e.g., SSIS, Informatica) and integration technologies (REST/SOAP APIs).
  • Experience working with data warehouses such as Microsoft SQL Server, Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, or Azure Synapse.
  • Familiarity with data modeling (logical/physical), metadata management, and data lineage concepts.
  • Experience with cloud-based MDM deployments (e.g., Profisee on Azure/AWS/GCP) is a plus.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work in agile and hybrid environments.
  • Professional certifications (e.g., CDMP, Profisee certifications, DAMA-DMBOK) are highly desirable.

Read the full description

job.name: Profisee MDM (3-5 Years)
job.description:
Master Data Management (MDM) Consultant – Profisee (3–5 Years Experience)

About The Role We are seeking a skilled Master Data Management (MDM) Consultant with 3–5 years of experience to design, configure, and support enterprise-grade Master Data Management (MDM) solutions using Profisee . In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional business and technical teams to improve data quality , data governance , and data consistency across critical enterprise systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Configure Profisee data models, including entities, attributes, hierarchies, workflows, and business rules, to align with business requirements.
  • Develop and optimize match-and-merge logic, deduplication algorithms, and survivorship rules to produce accurate, trusted golden records.
  • Implement data validation, standardization, and quality controls to ensure compliance with data governance policies and regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).
  • Build and maintain integrations between Profisee and source systems, data warehouses (e.g., SQL Server, Snowflake), and downstream applications using ETL/ELT tools (e.g., SSIS, Informatica) and REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Perform source data profiling, design robust source-to-target mappings, and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for audit and knowledge transfer.
  • Troubleshoot complex data and integration issues, diagnose root causes, and support platform performance tuning and ongoing maintenance.
  • Partner with business stakeholders, data stewards, and engineering teams to translate functional requirements into scalable, high-performing MDM solutions.
  • Support MDM adoption initiatives, including user training, change management, and documentation of best practices.
  • Collaborate on MDM strategy and roadmap to align with enterprise data architecture and digital transformation goals.

Requirements

  • 3–5 years of experience implementing Master Data Management (MDM) solutions, with hands-on expertise in Profisee (preferred) or similar MDM platforms (e.g., Informatica MDM, IBM InfoSphere).
  • Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, data stewardship, and master data management best practices (e.g., DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Proficiency with ETL/ELT tools (e.g., SSIS, Informatica) and integration technologies (REST/SOAP APIs).
  • Experience working with data warehouses such as Microsoft SQL Server, Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, or Azure Synapse.
  • Familiarity with data modeling (logical/physical), metadata management, and data lineage concepts.
  • Experience with cloud-based MDM deployments (e.g., Profisee on Azure/AWS/GCP) is a plus.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work in agile and hybrid environments.
  • Professional certifications (e.g., CDMP, Profisee certifications, DAMA-DMBOK) are highly desirable.

job.description:
Job Title: Lead Data Engineer

Experience: 8–12 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Department: Data Engineering

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Lead Data Engineer with strong expertise in Python programming, Databricks, Data Modelling, T-SQL and Data Architecture.

The ideal candidate will have extensive hands-on experience designing, developing and managing production-grade Python applications, scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and modern Lakehouse platforms.

This role requires a strong Python-first engineering approach, combined with deep knowledge of Databricks, Spark, data warehousing and data architecture.   • Collaborate with Data Architects and business stakeholders on data architecture, orchestration and ETL/ELT strategies.
  • Mentor Data Engineers and Senior Data Engineers through technical guidance, design reviews and code reviews.

job.description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and visionary Senior Generative AI Architect with 12+ years of experience in AI/ML, including hands-on work with LLMs (Large Language Models) and Generative AI solutions . In this strategic technical leadership role, you will be responsible for designing and overseeing the development of advanced GenAI platforms and solutions that transform business operations and customer experiences.

As the GenAI Architect, you will work closely with data scientists, ML engineers, product teams, and stakeholders to conceptualize, prototype, and scale generative AI use cases across the organization or client engagements.

Key Responsibilities

GenAI Solution Architecture & Design

· Lead the design and development of scalable GenAI solutions leveraging LLMs , diffusion models , and multimodal architectures .

· Architect end-to-end pipelines involving prompt engineering , vector databases , retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) , and LLM fine-tuning .

· Select and integrate foundational models (e.g., GPT, Claude, LLaMA, Mistral ) based on business needs and technical constraints.

Technical Strategy & Leadership

· Define GenAI architecture blueprints, best practices, and reusable components for rapid development and experimentation.

· Stay current on the rapidly evolving GenAI landscape and assess emerging tools, APIs, and frameworks.

Collaboration & Delivery

· Work with product owners, business leaders, and data teams to identify high-impact GenAI use cases across domains like customer support, content generation, document understanding, and code generation.

· Support PoCs, pilots, and production deployments of GenAI models in secure, compliant environments.

· Collaborate with MLOps and cloud teams to enable continuous delivery, monitoring, and governance of GenAI systems.

Required Qualifications & Experience

· Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science , Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related technical field . PhD is a plus.

· Experience: 12–15 years in AI/ML and software engineering, with 3+ years focused on Generative AI and LLM-based architectures .

Core Skills

· Deep expertise in machine learning , natural language processing (NLP) , and deep learning architecture .

· Hands-on experience with LLMs, transformers, fine-tuning techniques (LoRA, PEFT) , and prompt engineering .

About the Team

We are expanding our AI Engineering organization at ZF and are hiring Senior Solution Architects.

Our team builds enterprise-grade AI platforms and solutions across Agentic AI, Generative AI for the software development lifecycle, systems engineering, automated testing, MLOps, computer vision, and engineering data intelligence.

  • Architecture leadership: You'll set the reference architecture, platform patterns and guardrails that multiple engineering teams build on.
  • Strategic decisions: You'll lead decisions on what to build versus buy, which models to use, and whether to customize models through fine-tuning, weighing quality, cost, scalability and vendor independence.
  • Cutting-edge technology: You'll design multi-agent systems on leading frameworks and cloud platforms, such as LangGraph, AWS Bedrock and Azure AI Foundry.
  • Visibility and influence: You'll be the trusted technical authority for business leaders, security teams and enterprise architecture boards.

Your Profile as Solution Architect: AI/ML (m/f/d)

Project Role : Custom Software Engineer

Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.

Must have skills : Machine Learning (ML)

Good to have skills : NA

Minimum 7.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary:

As a Custom Software Engineer, your day involves creating tailored software solutions by designing, coding, and improving various components within systems or applications. You engage in collaborative environments that emphasize agile methodologies and modern frameworks to ensure the delivery of scalable and efficient software. Your work is focused on meeting unique business requirements through innovative and high-quality software development practices, contributing to the overall success of projects and client satisfaction.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
  • Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
  • Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and deliver effective software solutions.
  • Continuously update knowledge on emerging technologies and industry trends to enhance software development processes.
  • Assist junior team members by sharing knowledge and providing guidance to support their professional growth.
  • Ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices to maintain software quality and reliability.

Professional & Technical Skills:

  • Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Machine Learning (ML).
  • Strong understanding of machine learning algorithms and their practical applications.
  • Experience with data preprocessing techniques to prepare datasets for model training and evaluation.
  • Ability to implement and optimize machine learning models for performance and accuracy.
  • Familiarity with software development lifecycle and agile methodologies in the context of machine learning projects.
  • Competence in programming languages commonly used in machine learning such as Python or R.

Additional Information:

  • The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Machine Learning (ML).
  • This position is based at our Hyderabad office.
  • A 15 years full time education is required.

job.name: Solutions Architect, Frontier AI Quality
job.description:
Description The Solutions Architect is APAJ's technical lead for automated quality judgment. The role partners with Quality Specialists, QOMs, Science and Engineering to move workflows from sampled batch inspection to trustworthy unit-level judgment, and acts as a Technical Bar Raiser for judge builders.

Key job responsibilities

  • Turn workflow requirements and conventions into judge designs, deterministic checks and transformation logic, and review difficult designs.
  • Streamline existing judge measurement and onboarding mechanisms — including precision measurement, judge onboarding decisions and the handoff to DCE — so they run consistently and at scale.
  • Provide technical input to RED certification and data-classification work for critical-data workflows.
  • Develop and assess judge-builder candidates; contribute reusable components, runbooks and lessons to the network.

Basic Qualifications

  • 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
  • 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
  • 5+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
  • Experience using a current programming language, such as Python, to build scripts, prototypes or reusable components
  • Experience with large language models, prompt design or automated evaluation

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
  • Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective
  • Experience building or evaluating ML- or LLM-based quality or evaluation systems in production
  • Experience interpreting precision, recall, calibration, agreement or error-analysis results
  • Experience with data annotation, labelling or content-quality workflows
  • Familiarity with data-classification, access-control or security review requirements

job.name: Senior Solution Architect (AI / LLM solutions)
job.description:
Job description:

About the Team

We are expanding our AI Engineering organization at ZF and are hiring Senior Solution Architects. Our team builds enterprise-grade AI platforms and solutions across Agentic AI, Generative AI for the software development lifecycle, systems engineering, automated testing, MLOps, computer vision, and engineering data intelligence. Our work includes developing AI agents for requirements engineering, code development, test generation, and traceability. We also address complex automotive engineering challenges, including virtual sensors, lateral and longitudinal control, perception engineering, object detection and tracking, digital twins, condition monitoring, and intelligent validation.

What you can look forward to as Solution Architect: AI / LLM solutions (m/f/d)

  • End-to-end ownership: You'll own the technical architecture of enterprise Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, from framing the business problem through to secure, observable and cost-efficient production systems.
  • Real-world impact: You'll turn LLM capabilities into reliable, auditable solutions that hold up against complex enterprise data, strict security and compliance requirements, tight latency and cost budgets, and unpredictable model behavior. This role goes well beyond proof of concept.
  • Architecture leadership: You'll set the reference architecture, platform patterns and guardrails that multiple engineering teams build on.
  • Strategic decisions: You'll lead decisions on what to build versus buy, which models to use, and whether to customize models through fine-tuning, weighing quality, cost, scalability and vendor independence.
  • Cutting-edge technology: You'll design multi-agent systems on leading frameworks and cloud platforms, such as LangGraph, AWS Bedrock and Azure AI Foundry.
  • Visibility and influence: You'll be the trusted technical authority for business leaders, security teams and enterprise architecture boards.

Your Profile as Solution Architect: AI / LLM solutions (m/f/d)

job.name: DEVELOPER L4
job.description:
Job description:

Job Description

Role Purpose

The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters

͏

Do

1. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software

  • Develop software solutions by studying information needs, studying systems flow, data usage and work processes
  • Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
  • Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
  • Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
  • Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
  • Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
  • Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities

͏

2. Perform coding and ensure optimal software/ module development

  • Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, software development and proposed software
  • Develop and automate processes for software validation by setting up and designing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases
  • Modifying software to fix errors, adapt it to new hardware, improve its performance, or upgrade interfaces.
  • Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system
  • Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
  • Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
  • Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns
  • Compile timely, comprehensive and accurate documentation and reports as requested
  • Coordinating with the team on daily project status and progress and documenting it
  • Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned stakeholders

͏

3. Status Reporting and Customer Focus on an ongoing basis with respect to project and its execution

job.name: AI Native Software Engineer
job.description:
Project Role : AI Native Software Engineer

Project Role Description : Design and deliver software solutions using AI as a core part of the engineering lifecycle. Apply AI-native practices to translate specifications into architecture, code, and technical artifacts while ensuring quality, compliance, and specification integrity.

Must have skills : Microsoft Agentic AI Architecture

Good to have skills : Python (Programming Language), Agentic Design, Agentic Orchestration

Minimum 12 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary:

Lead the end-to-end enterprise AI and Agentic AI architecture, translating the existing application and integration landscape into a scalable, production-grade AI architecture and driving it from design through approval and engineering execution. This builds on the existing client requirement. This role needs the Architect to be cloud agnostic and not just on Azure rather should be able to pick up across cloud and lead the Enterprise AI and Agentic AI Architecture.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Strong Enterprise AI / Agentic AI architecture experience, with ability to define target architecture, reusable patterns, standards and guardrails across enterprise platforms. Required active participation and contribution in team discussions.
  • Deep expertise in Context Engineering, including how enterprise/domain knowledge, architecture, code, APIs, standards and delivery context are curated and dynamically supplied to agents - Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into effective application configurations.
  • Internal AI-native engineering guidance explicitly positions context engineering as managing context, rules, memory, skills and architectural constraints around the model.
  • Strong understanding of Agent Memory Management, including short/long-term memory, state, persistence, context-window optimization, knowledge retrieval and appropriate separation of context versus persistent memory.
  • Architect AI Harness patterns around agents, covering context, tools/APIs, execution loops, state, guardrails, recovery, observability, security and human approval. Accenture's internal harness material positions the harness as the operating layer governing how agents execute reliably at enterprise scale.

job.name: Sr. Product Security Engineer (Starlink)
job.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. PRODUCT SECURITY ENGINEER (STARLINK) At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe.

Skills As a Security Software Engineer you will influence the security of software across our product lines. We are looking for people with a track record of shipping reliable software and who have a broad understanding of the security design of today’s Internet, including the cryptographic primitives involved. You see the big picture, prioritize accordingly, and are comfortable with working at different levels of abstraction. Ideally, you have notable skills in one or more of the following:

  • Software engineering
  • Applied cryptography
  • Network security
  • Operating system security
  • Secure/Authenticated boot
  • Incident response and adversary detection
  • Vulnerability research

Being flexible, communicating clearly, and establishing and maintaining productive working relationships with other engineering teams are paramount to success. If you are passionate about building quality products, love the challenges of outsmarting adversaries, and want to make an impact on an inter-planetary scale, then you will fit right in.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build security infrastructure for Starlink, including cryptographic services and other security-critical services
  • Develop security features for Starlink systems, including our router, dish, gateways, and satellites
  • Design security into factory processes and provide network services in support of this
  • Maintain existing production systems and improve security posture via both direct implementation and recommendations to other teams
  • Build prototypes and help identify, design, and test security improvements
  • Further our mission of providing secure and reliable Internet to underserved communities

Basic Qualifications

job.name: Summer 2027 Software Engineering Internship
job.description:
T-Mobile is synonymous with innovation–and you could be part of the team that disrupted an entire industry! We reinvented customer service, brought real 5G to the nation, and now we’re shaping the future of technology in wireless and beyond. Our work is as exciting as it is rewarding, so consider the career opportunity below as your invitation to grow with us, make big things happen with us, above all, #BEYOU with us. Together, we won’t stop!

Get hands-on experience, training—and a leg up on a bright future.

T-Mobile didn’t become a leader by following the playbook. We got here by breaking it. We’re a disruptor that now plays on a higher tier, and we’re still raising the bar for millions of customers nationwide. If you want to work somewhere that sets the standard instead of matching it, this is your place.

This is an 11-week paid learning experience where you’ll do real work, not busywork. You’ll build relationships with other interns and leaders across the company, and you’ll be paired with mentors who will challenge you to grow skills that matter. We’ll give you hands-on projects with real stakes, and we expect your creativity and sharp ideas to make an immediate impact. You’ll work alongside T-Mobile employees who have your back and who still believe the best ideas can come from anyone.

What It’s Like T-Mobile High-Speed Internet is redefining what it means to be an ISP. We’re bringing a better choice to urban areas and reaching communities that have been overlooked. Our team of architects, data engineers, and software engineers is small enough that you’ll be seen and big enough that your work will matter. We move fast, work in an agile environment, and build and run the back-end and reporting data operations behind customer acquisition and analysis. In a typical week you’ll join stand-ups, pair with your mentor, work on production pipelines, and share what you’re learning with the team.

What You’ll Do As a Software Engineer Intern, you’ll define and engineer data and software solutions that serve the larger business. You’ll work on real production pipelines that other systems and teams depend on. Your goal is to make them more performant, scalable, and reliable, which helps T-Mobile stay ahead in a competitive market. You’ll have mentorship and support the whole way.

Key Responsibilities

  • Get up to speed quickly on your assigned codebase, product area, or system, then deliver production-ready code
  • Complete tasks effectively, with minimal revisions needed
  • Analyze problem statements, propose the best solutions, and weigh trade-offs and edge cases
  • Communicate clearly and efficiently with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Collaborate in an agile environment to ship high-quality software
  • Improve the performance, scalability, and reliability of data pipelines

job.name: Android Developer
job.description:
seeking an experienced C++/Android Engineer to support telemetry, crash reporting, and diagnostic capabilities for next-generation wearable devices.

This is a highly hands-on engineering role spanning device software, AOSP/Android, telemetry and crash diagnostics, testing, backend integration, and production operations. The ideal candidate is comfortable troubleshooting complex problems across the stack and independently driving issues from investigation through resolution.

What You'll Do

\* Support telemetry, crash reporting, and bug reporting services across wearable devices.

\* Participate in on-call production support, triaging alerts, crashes, event-loss issues, upload failures, and data regressions.

\* Develop and maintain production-quality C++ components and services running on Android/AOSP-based devices.

\* Build and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end automated tests using gtest/gmock and device test frameworks.

\* Debug complex issues across device, companion application, and backend systems.

\* Enable telemetry and diagnostic capabilities on new wearable hardware platforms.

\* Analyze telemetry, crash, and operational data using SQL, dashboards, metrics, and alerts.

\* Develop automation and diagnostic tooling using Python and shell scripting.

\* Improve reliability through defensive programming, concurrency improvements, logging, and diagnostic tooling.

\* Maintain code across release branches and support platform upgrades, build changes, and production releases.

Required Qualifications

\* 10+ years of professional software development experience, with strong hands-on expertise in modern C++ (C++17 or later) on Linux or Android.

\* Strong experience with AOSP or embedded Android, including:

o Android.bp / Soong

o Native Android services

o AIDL / Binder

o adb and device debugging

o System properties and basic SELinux concepts

\* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills for device and production issues.

\* Experience with gtest/gmock, automated testing, mocking, and diagnosing flaky tests.

\* Solid understanding of multithreading, concurrency, mutexes, IPC, and shared state.

\* Proficiency with Python and shell scripting for automation and tooling.

\* Working knowledge of SQL, including joins, aggregations, and analysis of large datasets.

\* Experience with Git, code reviews, release branches, branch synchronization, and cherry-picks.

\* Ability to independently own technical problems end-to-end and communicate progress proactively.

\* Ability to work PST business hours and participate in on-call rotations.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable:

\* Telemetry, logging, or analytics pipelines, including event schemas, sampling, batching, serialization/protobuf, and upload workflows.

\* Android/Linux crash reporting and diagnostics, including tombstones, minidumps, symbolication, bug reports, and log collection.

job.name: People Analytics AI Engineer
job.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

job.name: Senior InfoSec Product Engineer
job.description:
SentiLink helps institutions and protects customers by accurately resolving identities and flagging fraud risk. Each day, we verify more than 3 million identities, flagging 150k+ fraud attempts in the process. The problems we work on are challenging, and solving them takes deep domain expertise, rigorous analysis, and a willingness to dig into the details.

At SentiLink, you'll work alongside smart, highly collaborative colleagues who respect each other's time and judgment, take ownership, and follow through on their commitments. Together, we do truly meaningful work protecting the identities of innocent consumers and flagging the fraudsters attempting to exploit them.

We're well capitalized and growing quickly. We already serve 13 of the top 15 U.S. banks, we're expanding into new markets, and we're backed by Craft Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, NYCA, and Max Levchin. We've been named to the Forbes Fintech 50 and as a 2026 FICO Industry Vanguard Decision Award Winner. We were also the first company to go live with the electronic Consent Based Social Security Number Verification (eCBSV) service, and we've testified before the U.S. Congress on the future of identity.

We want SentiLink to be the best place you've ever worked. We offer generous benefits and support a range of working arrangements, from fully remote to in-office. We are a digital-first company with strong collaboration across the U.S. and India, and we meet in person regularly to build relationships. We have offices in Austin, San Francisco, New York City, Seattle (Bellevue), Los Angeles, and Chicago in the U.S., and in Gurugram (Delhi) and Bengaluru in India.

Role SentiLink's Information Security team protects our systems, data, and customers while enabling the business to move quickly and securely. As software development accelerates across the company, we're investing in engineers who can both build security capabilities and improve the security of the products we deliver to customers.

We're looking for a Senior InfoSec Product Engineer who combines strong software engineering skills with a security mindset. You'll build and operate custom security applications, automation, and integrations; investigate vulnerabilities in our applications and cloud infrastructure; and help engineering teams develop, test, and deliver more secure software.

This role spans software development and hands-on product security. You'll work closely with other product security engineers and the broader Engineering and Infrastructure teams to uncover difficult security problems, develop practical solutions, and drive them through implementation. We're looking for someone who is curious about how systems fail, can navigate complex codebases and architectures, and has the technical range to move between building security tooling and validating the security of customer-facing products.

Location: Redmond WA - ONSITE

Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced C++/Android Engineer to support telemetry, crash reporting, and diagnostic capabilities for next-generation wearable devices.

This is a highly hands-on engineering role spanning device software, AOSP/Android, telemetry and crash diagnostics, testing, backend integration, and production operations. The ideal candidate is comfortable troubleshooting complex problems across the stack and independently driving issues from investigation through resolution.

What You'll Do

  • Support telemetry, crash reporting, and bug reporting services across wearable devices.

  • Develop and maintain production-quality C++ components and services running on Android/AOSP-based devices.

  • Debug complex issues across device, companion application, and backend systems.
  • Enable telemetry and diagnostic capabilities on new wearable hardware platforms.

Required Qualifications

o Android.bp / Soong

o Native Android services

o AIDL / Binder

o adb and device debugging

o System properties and basic SELinux concepts

  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills for device and production issues.
  • Experience with gtest/gmock, automated testing, mocking, and diagnosing flaky tests.
  • Solid understanding of multithreading, concurrency, mutexes, IPC, and shared state.
  • Proficiency with Python and shell scripting for automation and tooling.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, including joins, aggregations, and analysis of large datasets.
  • Experience with Git, code reviews, release branches, branch synchronization, and cherry-picks.
  • Ability to independently own technical problems end-to-end and communicate progress proactively.

job.name: Software Development Engineer II, FleetWatch Team
job.description:
Description AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain, and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

DC BRIDGE builds the software platforms that support Amazon's data center engineering operations worldwide. Our systems directly impact the reliability and efficiency of the physical infrastructure that powers AWS and Amazon's global services.

Every AWS data center depends on its electrical and mechanical infrastructure, the power and cooling systems that keep it within operational limits. The FleetWatch team within DC BRIDGE builds the platform that monitors all of it, ingesting trillions of metrics a month. We expose metric data in real time to the operator tools that depend on it, evaluate alarms in-stream to determine actions when metrics breach thresholds, and persist telemetry to a datalake for analytics and long-term monitoring across the fleet.

As an SDE2 you'll own features from design through code, test, deployment, and operation, with autonomy. Our customers are the controls engineers and operations teams who run Amazon's data centers. You'll work directly with controls engineers to improve the alarm configuration experience on the one hand, and with operations teams to refine the alarm output experience on the other. The problems span stream processing at fleet scale, alarm quality and noise reduction, and extending monitoring to new regions and new generations of data center infrastructure. Telemetry volume grows every month, so efficiency is a feature: we simplify systems and drive down the cost of processing each metric even as the fleet expands.

Tech stack: Java (primary for service code), with Kotlin (stream processing), TypeScript (CDK infrastructure), and Python (Lambda functions, data processing, monitoring). AWS services include Kinesis, Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, S3, Fargate, CloudWatch, Athena, and Step Functions.

job.description:
Principal Azure Platform & Cloud Operations Architect (AKS / Networking / Automation)

Mode of Work: Hybrid

Reports to: Director, Cloud Operations

What’s the opportunity?

Our client is looking for a hands-on Principal Azure Platform & Cloud Operations Architect to assess and improve how we run critical production systems on Azure. You will evaluate their current Cloud Operations processes and platform architecture, identify automation and improvement opportunities, implement stronger operational patterns, and act as the escalation SME when the team hits technical roadblocks—especially across AKS, networking, and deployments.

What will you do?

Assess and Improve Cloud Operations Processes: Review current operational workflows (provisioning, deployments, incident response, change management) and implement process corrections, automation opportunities, and operational guardrails to reduce manual effort and improve reliability.

Own AKS Platform Architecture and Operations: Lead the design and operational maturity of Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) environments, including cluster topology, node pools, upgrades, scaling, resiliency patterns, ingress/egress, workload identity, secrets, and runtime security.

Lead Azure Networking Architecture and Troubleshooting: Provide deep expertise in Azure networking and connectivity patterns (VNET design, routing/UDRs, NSGs, DNS, private endpoints, firewalls, load balancers, gateways, and secure egress/ingress) and troubleshoot complex network and performance issues impacting production systems.

Deliver Hands-on Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Design and implement IaC using Terraform with reusable modules, clear lifecycle management, environment consistency, and safe change practices.

Advance GitOps and Deployment Standardization: Strengthen deployment maturity using Argo CD and Helm, improving repeatability, release confidence, environment promotion, and rollback strategies.

Improve CI/CD and Release Automation: Enhance CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps / Jenkins / GitHub Actions) to implement quality gates, validation, security scanning, and automated delivery patterns to production.

Implement Observability and Operational Readiness: Improve monitoring, logging, alerting, and dashboards using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights to create actionable signals and reduce noise; promote production readiness practices (runbooks, readiness reviews, operational checklists).

Provide L3/L4 Escalation and Incident Leadership: Act as the technical escalation point for high-severity incidents, guiding triage and recovery, leading root cause analysis, and ensuring corrective/preventive actions are implemented through automation and platform improvements.

What's In It for You

  • Play a key role in bringing an innovative, first-of-its-kind consumer product to market.
  • Gain exposure to cross-functional technology initiatives spanning eCommerce, retail, and third-party integrations.
  • Enjoy a collaborative environment where your expertise, initiative, and ability to navigate ambiguity will make a meaningful impact.

Your Responsibilities

  • You'll lead coordination across technology teams, vendors, and third-party partners, managing timelines, dependencies, risks, and deliverables.
  • You'll partner closely with business project leadership, providing clear progress updates and facilitating key decisions.
  • You'll translate business needs into actionable requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and Jira tickets.
  • You'll support data integration mapping, system documentation, and process flows across technology platforms.
  • You'll contribute to the booking system RFP process, including requirements gathering, vendor evaluation, and selection.
  • You'll coordinate eCommerce and retail technology changes while supporting QA, UAT, cutover, and go-live readiness.

Skills and Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Business Systems Analysis, Project Management, or Technical Program Management within Agile technology environments.
  • Proven ability to coordinate complex, multi-vendor technology initiatives while managing risks, dependencies, and leadership reporting.
  • Strong requirements documentation, user story development, and Jira experience.
  • Hands-on experience with data integration mapping, data models, APIs, and vendor RFP processes.
  • Solid understanding of eCommerce, retail technology, and omnichannel environments.
  • Excellent communication, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills, with confidence navigating ambiguity.
  • Degree or diploma in business, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience. BA/PM certification and outdoor, apparel, or retail industry experience are assets.

job.description:
ServiceNow Technical Lead

Workplace type: Vancouver, BC

Fulltime – Onsite

Requirement: Immediate

Technical Lead – ServiceNow

10-15 Years

Roles and Responsibilities:

The person will be responsible for leading ServiceNow technical delivery and application management for the BC Hydro Technology tower, with expert-level hands-on ownership across ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, SecOps and related platform capabilities. The role requires strong technical leadership, platform configuration and customization expertise, integration delivery, CMDB/Discovery support, release governance, production issue resolution and coordination with architects, customer stakeholders, offshore teams and vendor support.

Key Accountabilities:

  • Lead day-to-day technical delivery and support for ServiceNow ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, SecOps and related platform capabilities for the BC Hydro account.
  • Translate business requirements, incidents, service requests, problem records and change requests into technical tasks, solution designs and delivery plans.

  • Lead technical implementation for ITOM capabilities such as Discovery, Service Mapping, event integrations, service health and operational visibility as applicable.
  • Support CMDB governance and data quality by working on CI classes, relationships, reconciliation, identification rules, data certification and integrations with upstream/downstream systems.

  • Design, develop and review ServiceNow configurations, scripts, Flow Designer flows, workflows, business rules, script includes, client scripts, UI policies, ACLs and scheduled jobs.
  • Lead integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, MID Server, event sources, monitoring/security tools and enterprise application interfaces.
  • Guide developers and administrators on platform best practices, code/configuration quality, peer reviews, testing, deployment and operational documentation.
  • Troubleshoot platform, integration, workflow, CMDB, Discovery, service mapping, performance and access/security issues, and drive root cause analysis and permanent fixes.
  • Participate in release planning, change implementation, upgrade validation, Automated Test Framework execution and post-production support.
  • Prepare and maintain technical design documents, SOPs, runbooks, deployment guides, release notes, knowledge articles and support handover documents.

Experience required:

Good communication skills with ability to work with customer stakeholders, solution architects, service owners, technical leads, developers and support teams.
