job.name: Lead Principal Data Systems Software Engineer
job.description:
Job Description The Distributed Database team is responsible for a globally distributed, elastic, cloud-native relational database . This database combines the best of NoSQL and NewSQL technologies with the enterprise capabilities of Oracle RDBMS.

Our projects span all layers of the database kernel, such as parallel query execution, transaction management, replication, etc., and external components, such as client-side drivers, intelligent query routers, and load balancers. We are also responsible for supporting emerging technologies in the distributed database, such as Vector and Text Search, Microservices, Machine Learning, Blockchain, and Graphs.

We are looking for motivated and talented system engineers who want to make significant contributions to highly visible and strategic projects by solving challenging problems in distributed computing, high availability, and extreme scalability. Join our team of exceptional engineers in building a transformative database solution that is reshaping how enterprises handle data at a global scale.

As a member of the software engineering division, you will take an active role in the definition and evolution of standard practices and procedures. You will be responsible for defining and developing software for tasks associated with the developing, designing and debugging of software applications or operating systems.

Work is non-routine and very complex, involving the application of advanced technical/business skills in area of specialization. Leading contributor individually and as a team member, providing direction and mentoring to others. BS or MS degree or equivalent experience relevant to functional area. 10 years of software engineering or related experience.

Career Level - IC5

Responsibilities Experience and/or interest in database internals, distributed systems, replication technologies , load balancing algorithms, and design trade-offs among consistency, availability, and performance in distributed systems is required, as are the following skills:

  • Expert-level proficiency in C programming
  • Fluency in SQL; PL/SQL
  • Solid background in relational database and operating system concepts
  • Expert-level in query processing and distributed query processing.
  • Good understanding of concurrent programming concepts
  • Strong software engineering and debugging skills
  • Track record of delivering high-quality software under time constraints
  • Strong collaboration skills, particularly in geographically distributed team

About Us Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

job.description:
About Signify Through bold discovery and cutting-edge innovation, we lead an industry that is vital for the future of our planet: lighting. Through our leadership in connected lighting and the Internet of Things, we're breaking new ground in data analytics, AI, and smart solutions for homes, offices, cities, and beyond.

At Signify, you can shape tomorrow by building on our incredible 125+ year legacy while working toward even bolder sustainability goals. Our culture of continuous learning, creativity, and commitment to diversity and inclusion empowers you to grow your skills and career.

Join us, and together, we’ll transform our industry, making a lasting difference for brighter lives and a better world.

Job Summary More about the role The Lead Software Quality Engineer, an Individual Contributor, is a Functional Quality Expert responsible for driving company-wide adoption of the IoT Software Quality Framework across the connected lighting ecosystem, including edge devices (luminaires, drivers, controllers), platforms, gateways, cloud, mobile applications, and security layers.

This is not an operational Quality Assurance role. The position focuses on enabling and influencing global BU Stakeholders (e.g. R&D teams, Architecture teams, Test Teams, Product Management teams and Field teams) to embed reconfigurable, scalable, secure, and reliable software quality practices into engineering execution.

The ideal candidate must have prior hands-on experience within IoT software engineering (embedded + cloud-connected systems) and must understand system-level integration challenges such as device-cloud communication, OTA updates, interoperability, performance, and cybersecurity risks.

Key Areas of Responsibility IoT Software Quality Framework Deploymen

  • Drive the implementation of the defined Software Quality Framework across

+ Firmware (MCUs, RTOS-based systems)., Gateway / edge computing platforms., Cloud services & APIs.Mobile applications (iOS/Android).'Device-cloud connectivity layers.

  • Ensure system-level traceability across hardware–firmware–cloud–app interactions.
  • Institutionalize risk-based engineering practices for distributed Connected Lighting Architectures.

Engineering-Embedded Quality Enablement

  • Partner with device, cloud, and mobile R&D teams to embed “Built-in Quality.”
  • Translate governance standards into practical guidance aligned to Agile / SAFe / DevOps.

Proactive Measures

  • As defined in Company IoT SW Quality Framework.
  • Enable cross-layer dashboards for leadership visibility.
  • Drive early risk detection through data analytics and release readiness reviews.

Reactive Quality & Closed-Loop Learning

  • Support institutionalizing of Root Cause Analysis, Corrective Actions and Closed Loop Preventions (Field failures., Interoperability breakdowns, safety and Security incidents)

Cross-BU & System-Level Alignment

job.name: Software Engineer (PLC) -Control System Engineering
job.description:
Job Requirements At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.

This position involves developing PLC and HMI control systems for semiconductor gas/chemical delivery equipment. Responsibilities include designing control logic, system integration, commissioning, and troubleshooting. The role involves designing control architectures based on customer requirements and leading the improvement of equipment stability and performance, as well as the standardization of automation.

As a Senior Engineer, Lead the software programming, system design, and technical direction for chemical and specialty gas delivery equipment used in semiconductors.

Proficient in PLC, HMI, C/C++, Java, and other PC-based languages at an expert level. Hold a technical vision for the assigned product areas in chemical equipment and translate complex requirements into scalable, high-performance, manufacturable solutions. Through cross-team collaboration, they contribute to engineering standardization and reliability and demonstrate technical leadership in both systems engineering and PLC software development.

Key Responsibilities

PLC Software Development

  • Understand PLC Software Development
  • Develop and maintain PLC software based on IEC 61131-3 standards.
  • Design, program, test, and validate PLC logic for semiconductor gas and chemical delivery systems.
  • Support Omron, Siemens, and LS PLC platforms.
  • Develop reusable software modules and engineering standards

HMI & System Integration

  • Configure and maintain HMI systems (Pro-face, MXon/M2I).
  • Implement alarms, diagnostics, state monitoring, and data logging functions.
  • Integrate PLC, HMI, instruments, motion devices, and network systems.

System Engineering

  • Analyze customer and product requirements and translate them into software and control system architecture.
  • Define software-hardware interfaces and control philosophies.
  • Support system design reviews and risk assessments.

Troubleshooting & RCA

  • Investigate field issues and implement corrective actions.
  • Lead root cause analysis (RCA) activities.
  • Optimize system performance, reliability, and maintainability.

Manufacturing & Customer Support

  • Support manufacturing, FAT, SAT, commissioning, and startup activities.
  • Provide technical support during customer escalations.
  • Develop manufacturing packages and technical documentation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

job.name: Test Automation BDD , Robot Framework
job.description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

Job Description Test Automation Engineer (BDD & Robot Framework) Location :- Bangalore

Experience :- 2+ Years

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a place where you'll be empowered to shape your career, supported by a collaborative global community, and inspired to reimagine what's possible. Join us in delivering high-quality software solutions through modern test automation practices and innovative quality engineering approaches.

Your Role As a Test Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining automated testing solutions using Robot Framework and Python. You will work closely with development and QA teams to ensure product quality through scalable automation frameworks and efficient testing practices.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Robot Framework.
  • Design and implement BDD (Behavior Driven Development) test automation frameworks.
  • Develop automation utilities and test solutions using Python.
  • Execute, monitor, and troubleshoot automated test suites in Linux environments.
  • Manage and maintain source code using Git and collaborate through code reviews.
  • Analyze test results, identify defects, and work with development teams for resolution.
  • Participate in continuous improvement of automation frameworks, standards, and processes.
  • Support CI/CD integration and automated test execution pipelines.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure high-quality software delivery.

Your Profile

  • 2+ years of experience in Test Automation.
  • Hands-on experience with Robot Framework.
  • Strong understanding and practical experience in BDD methodologies.
  • Minimum 1+ year of experience in Python programming.
  • Good working knowledge of Linux environments and shell operations.
  • Experience using Git for version control.

job.name: QA
job.description:
We’re Hiring: QA Test Engineer

Location: Bangalore(WFO)

Experience: 3+ Years

About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and highly motivated QA Test Engineer to join our team and ensure the quality and performance of our web-based payment gateway application. The ideal candidate will have solid experience in manual and automated testing, especially in the fintech or payments domain, and will play a critical role in validating security, functionality, and compliance of our transaction systems.

Key Responsibilities

· Develop and execute detailed test plans, test cases, and test scripts for web-based payment systems.

· Perform functional, regression, integration, UI, API, and end-to-end testing of payment gateway features.

· Test core modules including transaction processing, authentication, encryption, payment methods

(Credit/Debit, UPI, Wallets, etc.), and refunds.

· Ensure compliance with standards such as PCI-DSS, ISO 8583, and EMV where applicable.

· Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and raise quality issues.

· Identify, log, track, and manage defects in defect tracking tools (e.g., JIRA).

· Build and maintain automated test suites using tools like Selenium, Postman, TestNG, RestAssured, etc.

· Validate integration with third-party payment processors and banks.

· Perform load testing and performance testing using tools like JMeter or LoadRunner.

· Ensure browser compatibility and mobile responsiveness testing.

Basic Qualifications & Skills

· 3+ years of experience in web application QA testing, with at least 1-2 years in payment gateways, fintech, or banking domain.

· Strong understanding of payment flow, transaction lifecycle, and settlement processes.

· Hands-on experience with API testing (REST/SOAP) and tools like Postman, SoapUI, etc.

· Proficiency in Selenium WebDriver, Java/Python, and frameworks like TestNG or Cucumber.

· Experience with SQL for database validation.

· Familiarity with security testing practices and standards relevant to payment systems.

· Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies, tools, and processes.

· Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

· Good communication skills and the ability to work in agile/scrum environments.

Preferred Qualifications

· Master’s degree in a related field.

· Experience in high-volume transaction systems with low-latency requirements.

· Knowledge of emerging payment technologies like blockchain, UPI, and real-time payments.

· Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

· Familiarity with tools like Kubernetes, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines.

job.name: Software Engineer II
job.description:
Hiring for Lapmaster Wolters — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

Lapmaster Wolters is a global leader in high-precision machine tools and surface processing systems, with a heritage of over 200 years. Its machines lap, polish and fine-grind surfaces for manufacturers in more than 20 industries. The company has 600+ employees, 40,000+ m² of production space and revenue above €250 million.

Lapmaster Wolters is now expanding into advanced semiconductor packaging, one of the fastest-growing segments in chips, driven by chiplet architectures, heterogeneous integration and next-generation compute. The Bengaluru software team builds the software behind this new equipment line.

About the Role

As a Software Engineer II in Software Engineering – Semiconductor Equipment, you'll write the software that drives high-precision semiconductor machines. You'll work where software meets hardware, building control interfaces, operator GUIs and automated system controls that meet semiconductor-industry standards. The role is full-time and on-site in Bengaluru.

What you'll do

  • Design, develop, test and integrate software for semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
  • Build C#/C++ DLL interfaces that let customers control the equipment programmatically.
  • Build operator interfaces for the equipment in C# (WinForms/WPF) and C++.
  • Implement hardware control modules over serial interfaces and TCP/IP.
  • Develop and maintain automated system controls for equipment operations.
  • Run system testing, debugging and performance optimisation.
  • Support customers and field teams after deployment, debugging issues on live equipment.

What you bring

  • 3–6 years of professional software development in C# / .NET.
  • Hands-on C# and C++, with strong OOP, design patterns, data structures and algorithms.
  • GUI development with C# .NET (WinForms and WPF).
  • Has built software that talks to hardware (instruments, machines, PLCs or embedded devices) over serial or TCP/IP.
  • Solid multithreading and concurrent programming.
  • Strong debugging and root-cause analysis on complex systems.
  • Familiarity with PLC programming concepts and industrial automation.
  • Version control with GitHub or Azure DevOps.
  • Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field, and clear written and spoken English.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of SEMI software standards (SECS/GEM, GEM300) and equipment cybersecurity.
  • Experience in regulated or high-precision domains such as semiconductor, healthcare/medical devices or aerospace.

Originally posted on: 3 Nov 2026

job.name: Omnichannel Orchestration Lead
job.description:
Job Description For Omnichannel Orchestration Lead Axtria Inc. About Axtria Axtria is a data analytics, software and consulting company focused on life sciences commercial operations. We combine commercial process knowledge, analytics and cloud technology to help pharmaceutical and biotech companies improve patient outcomes and grow their business. We work with 75+ life sciences companies across the US, Europe and other regions, with 4500+ employees globally.

We are seeking a high energy and innovative leader to join our Omnichannel Centre of Excellence to develop new, specialized capabilities for Axtria, and to accelerate the company’s growth by supporting our clients’ omnichannel marketing strategies.

Role Summary You will lead delivery of omnichannel orchestration programs for leading US and EU pharma and biotech clients from Axtria's India delivery centre. That means sequencing field (personal) and non-personal promotion (NPP) channels into compliant, data-driven HCP and patient journeys. You will work directly with client stakeholders and Axtria's onshore leads, and drive solutioning and pre-sales that grow these accounts. You will also bring practical innovation, including AI-driven decisioning, into how Axtria delivers.

Expect roughly 70% of your time on delivery and 30% on business development. You will lead an India-based team of 10–15 and work across time zones with client brand, sales, analytics and IT teams.

What Will You Do Delivery leadership (~70%)

  • Own end-to-end delivery of orchestration engagements from India: scope, plan, staffing, quality, budget and client outcomes.
  • Lead, hire and develop a team of 10–15 consultants, analysts and data engineers.
  • Act as the main delivery counterpart for client stakeholders and Axtria onshore leads, running a clear cadence across time zones.
  • Design the orchestration approach across field and NPP channels (rep visits, email, web, programmatic, peer-to-peer, HCP platforms) for multiple brands and therapeutic areas.
  • Translate brand strategy into channel sequencing rules, trigger logic and next-best-action (NBA) frameworks that respect HCP and patient preferences, consent and channel fatigue limits.
  • Oversee configuration and validation of rules and decision logic in client CRM, marketing automation and decisioning platforms. Review data and resolve issues that affect recommendations.
  • Write business requirements for machine-learning models and partner with data science teams to build and deploy them.
  • Support client governance forums with analysis and recommendations on priorities, measurement and optimization.
  • Define and track orchestration KPIs (channel mix, engagement lift, frequency, field adoption, test-and-learn results) and turn insights into iterative improvements.
  • Build client compliance requirements in from the start: MLR review, US and EU promotional rules, HIPAA and GDPR, and consent management.

Business development (~30%)

The analyst will be expected to develop hands-on expertise across Workiva reporting, data integration, automation, controls, and workflow capabilities while helping improve the efficiency, accuracy, and governance of reporting processes.

This is primarily an individual contributor role requiring strong analytical, technical, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills.

Key Responsibilities Workiva Solution Development

  • Configure, develop, and maintain reporting solutions within Workiva.
  • Build and maintain Workiva Documents, Spreadsheets, Presentations, and associated reporting structures.
  • Configure links and connected reporting processes to improve consistency and reduce manual intervention.
  • Support the development and maintenance of Workiva Chains and automated workflows.
  • Translate business and reporting requirements into practical Workiva configurations.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize and simplify existing reporting processes.

Data Integration & Automation

  • Support data ingestion and integration between Workiva and upstream/downstream systems.
  • Develop and maintain automated data flows and transformation processes supporting reporting requirements.
  • Investigate data integration or processing failures and coordinate resolution with appropriate teams.
  • Identify manual processes suitable for automation and implement sustainable solutions.
  • Support reconciliation and validation of data between source systems and Workiva.

Regulatory / Statutory Reporting

  • Partner with Regulatory Reporting, Financial Reporting, Finance, and other stakeholders to support reporting deliverables.
  • Understand reporting requirements and translate them into system and data requirements.
  • Support implementation of new reports and changes resulting from regulatory or business requirements.
  • Help ensure appropriate controls, traceability, documentation, and evidence are maintained throughout the reporting process.

Business Analysis & Change Delivery

  • Gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements.
  • Perform impact assessments for reporting, data, and system changes.
  • Work with business and technology teams through design, development, testing, implementation, and post-production support.
  • Develop test scenarios and coordinate or execute UAT.
  • Track defects and issues through resolution.
  • Maintain functional documentation, process flows, requirements, and operating procedures.

job.description:

Position Overview Woolpert is hiring a Senior Data Developer to join us. This is a hands-on technical role responsible for developing, maintaining, and supporting SQL-based data solutions across Woolpert’s business applications. The primary focus of this role is advanced SQL development, data analysis, and troubleshooting. The developer will work with SQL Server and Snowflake and partner with ETL and integration engineers by providing the SQL development, transformation, validation, and data troubleshooting needed to support integration and migration processes. + Design, develop, and maintain complex SQL queries, stored procedures, views, functions, and database objects.

Data Analysis & Troubleshooting

Data Integration & ETL Support

  • Work with ETL and integration engineers to understand data flows, mappings, and transformation requirements.
  • Develop SQL-based transformation and validation logic to support ETL processes and data movement.
  • Apply working knowledge of Azure Data Factory and Snowflake to support data validation and troubleshoot data-related pipeline issues.

Reporting & Data Support

Environmental Conditions Office

Join Us as a Senior CM Analyst I – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation

job.description:
*About Target* As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America’s leading retailers. Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect while striving to make a meaningful and positive impact for our guests, team members, and communities. job.name: Risk Specialist I, AWS Payments and Fraud Prevention
job.description:
Description This role sits within the Payments and Fraud Prevention (P&FP) organization, whose vision is to make AWS the easiest and most trusted cloud to adopt and pay for, anywhere in the world. We deliver this through a reinforcing cycle: expanding customer access to drive adoption and revenue, empowering our internal teams, reinvesting in AI and automation for smarter fraud detection, and protecting the business in a way that enhances customer trust. This role is central to "protect the business" pillar — keeping AWS safe to transact on while minimizing friction for legitimate customers. Help protect millions of AWS customers from fraud and account takeover. As a Risk Specialist on the AWS Fraud Investigations Team, you'll investigate high-impact fraud and compromised accounts across AWS, including GenAI services such as Amazon Bedrock, working alongside AI agents and automation.

The AWS Fraud Investigations Team (FIT) is the human decision layer of AWS's fraud defense. Machine learning models and AI agents resolve most cases automatically. The cases that need human judgment come to for investigative checks. Your decisions protect legitimate customers, stop bad actors and directly reduce fraud losses for AWS.

We are a global, 24×7 follow-the-sun team, and we are evolving into an AI-first investigation model. AI agents gather evidence and recommend actions, and you make the final decision. This is a chance to build deep expertise in cloud security, fraud and AI-assisted investigation while working on some of the fastest-growing services at AWS.

Key job responsibilities

Investigate AWS accounts flagged for a review by system or by internal teams for fraud, abuse or account take overs, and take the right actions.

Work on investigations cases end to end, helping legitimate customers regain access to their accounts

Review requests from AWS Customer Support, Sales and service teams, and respond accurately within SLA

Use AI and investigation tools effectively, and flag continuous improvements.

Identify new fraud patterns and share insights that help improve detection rules, models and procedures

Meet KPIs in a fast-paced, high-volume environment

Work rotating shifts as part of a 24×7 global team

A day in the life

Most of your day is spent investigating cases such as account takeovers, suspected fraud, or a new customer's request to enable an AWS service. You review the evidence, apply the relevant standard operating procedures (SOPs) to investigate. You work with teammates across sites, review complex cases, and share new patterns you've spotted so the team and our systems keep improving.

About The Team FIT is part of AWS Payments & Fraud Prevention, with Risk Specialists in Bangalore, Hyderabad, Berlin and Seattle. We work closely with Fraud Prevention science, engineering and product teams, and with AWS Customer Support.

job.name: AI Engineer
job.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an innovative Senior AI Engineer to lead the architecture, development, and end-to-end delivery of enterprise Generative AI products and intelligent agentic solutions. Combining deep expertise in large language models (LLMs), full-stack development, and cloud-native infrastructure, you will build scalable AI pipelines, Graph/RAG architectures, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. You will act as a technical subject matter expert, partnering with product managers, data scientists, and domain leaders to shape the organization's AI roadmap while maintaining rigorous DevSecOps and governance standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • GenAI Solution Architecture: Design, architect, and build scalable Generative AI applications, including LLM pipelines, Agentic AI workflows, MCP servers, Graph/RAG architectures, and advanced prompt-engineering frameworks.
  • Full-Stack & Cloud Implementation: Lead hands-on engineering of AI products using Python, React/Next.js, and cloud-native AWS services (EKS, Lambda, Fargate, Glue, Athena, Bedrock).
  • Performance & Experimentation: Optimize latency, accuracy, and operational reliability of production AI systems while driving continuous R&D across emerging GenAI models, frameworks, and evaluation toolchains.
  • End-to-End Delivery & Roadmap: Partner with product and data science stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions, managing delivery milestones through Agile (Scrum/Kanban) practices.
  • Governance & Reliability: Monitor production telemetry and incident metrics, enforce DevSecOps security protocols, and ensure enterprise AI governance compliance.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Experience: 6+ years of progressive software or data engineering experience, including at least 1–2 years leading Generative AI or emerging technology initiatives in production.
  • Tech Stack: Strong proficiency in Python (NumPy, Pandas, Boto3), modern frontend frameworks (React, Next.js, TypeScript), GenAI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Amazon Bedrock), foundational LLMs (GPT, Claude, Gemini, LLaMA), Vector/Graph databases (Weaviate, Milvus, PGVector, Neo4J, Neptune), and AWS infrastructure (EKS, Lambda, Fargate, Glue, Athena, Lake Formation).
  • Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of Agentic AI, MCP, Graph/RAG architectures, LLM fine-tuning, automated AI evaluation (Ragas), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Docker), ETL orchestration (Apache Airflow), and DevSecOps best practices.
  • Education & Extras (Preferred): Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; domain familiarity with financial markets, enterprise data systems, and BI platforms (QuickSight, Tableau).

job.name: Forward Deployed Engineer
job.description:
Forward Deployed Engineer - AI Solutions

The Challenge

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Pivotree, you go into a customer's environment and use AI to solve their most pressing business problem, fast . You bring three key skills together: engineering depth to build working AI solutions, product judgment to decide what is worth building, and the strategic instinct to reframe the problem alongside the customer. The unit of work is an outcome, not a deliverable.

You will work inside the real conditions of our clients' businesses: legacy systems, broken pipelines, undocumented APIs and messy data across their digital commerce ecosystem. You will spot the opportunity, run discovery with the customer, and rapidly build a working, AI-powered proof of concept. You then hand a refined architecture to our delivery team, who build the production application ready to be managed and supported. Through this process you become a trusted advisor to uncover future opportunities.

Forward Engineering is not a services arm. The patterns you solve in the field flow back into our core capabilities, so each engagement makes the next one faster.

What You Will Do

  • Embed with customers, on-site or in their environment, to understand their operations, data and constraints, and identify where AI can deliver measurable business impact.
  • Lead discovery and working sessions with stakeholders from delivery teams to C-level, and reframe the stated challenges into problems worth solving.
  • Decide what to build and why: define scope from the business need, state the outcome and the measure of success, and own it end to end.
  • Build and ship working AI solutions against real systems: agents, LLM-powered workflows, retrieval over customer data, and integrations with whatever systems exist (commerce platforms, OMS, PIM, ERP, data platforms).
  • Deliver a proof of concept within days to weeks that de-risks the approach and demonstrates value, with a strong working demo.
  • Design the target architecture behind the proof of concept, covering functional and non-functional requirements so it hands off cleanly to production delivery and our managed services team.
  • Document requirements, deployment patterns and reusable playbooks, and feed recurring patterns back into our Centre of Excellence.
  • Build trusted-advisor relationships with customer leaders, and identify follow-on opportunities for AI across their digital commerce landscape.
  • Support pre-sales by shaping AI solutions, estimating scope and effort, and showing prospects a working demonstration rather than a slide.
  • Mentor engineers and architects in AI-assisted development, context engineering and agentic delivery practices.
  • Work with project managers and delivery leads on planning, risk and change management, including adoption of new ways of working by the customer's IT, business and end users.

Your Qualifications

Total Experience: 12+ Years

Specialist Experience: 5+ Years in VMware vSphere Kubernetes Service (VKS) and VMware Tanzu Architecture

Location: Mumbai / Bangalore

Travel: Yes – Willingness to travel is mandatory.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced TKG – Tanzu Kubernetes Grid Architect with strong expertise in VMware vSphere Kubernetes Service (VKS), VMware Tanzu and enterprise Kubernetes architecture.

The candidate will lead the transformation of traditional IT infrastructure into modern, containerised application environments. This role requires extensive experience in enterprise infrastructure, virtualization, cloud-native platforms and Kubernetes, along with at least 5 years of hands-on architecture and deployment experience in VMware Tanzu and VKS environments.

The architect will be responsible for customer-facing discussions, technical discovery, architecture design, HLD/LLD documentation and guiding engineering teams through platform implementation, deployment and operationalisation.

Key Responsibilities

1. Customer Engagement & Requirement Analysis

  • Lead technical discovery sessions and architecture workshops with clients, DevOps teams and enterprise architects.
  • Understand business requirements and translate them into scalable, secure Kubernetes solutions.
  • Present architecture recommendations and technical strategies to senior stakeholders.

  • Prepare operational runbooks, migration strategies and implementation roadmaps.
  • Design vSphere with Tanzu, Supervisor Clusters and Tanzu Kubernetes Grid (TKG) environments.

3. Platform Deployment & Architecture

  • Design and oversee VMware vSphere Kubernetes Service (VKS) and Tanzu platform implementations.
  • Architect Tanzu Control Planes, NSX Advanced Load Balancer (Avi) and vSAN Cloud Native Storage (CNS) integrations.
  • Lead Kubernetes platform deployment, configuration and lifecycle management.

4. DevOps & Ecosystem Integration

  • Integrate CI/CD pipelines and container registries such as Harbor.
  • Implement monitoring and logging solutions using Prometheus, Grafana and Fluent Bit.
  • Support service mesh integration and cloud-native platform automation.

5. Technical Leadership & Governance

  • Lead and mentor technical deployment and engineering teams.
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance for implementation, troubleshooting and Day-2 operations.
  • Define platform governance, operational standards and lifecycle management practices.

6. Security & Compliance

  • Define Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), vSphere Namespaces and Kubernetes network policies.
  • Ensure enterprise security, governance and compliance requirements are addressed across Kubernetes environments.

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: –Assist in diagnosing and debugging issues in system components to support ongoing operation, under supervision.

Founding Full-Stack Engineer (NYC – Hybrid)

Location: New York City, NY

Our hiring partner is a pioneering cybersecurity startup that recently secured Series A funding, and are on a mission is to eliminate systemic risks in critical infrastructure—from energy grids to space systems—by transforming how software is hardened at scale. Today’s software supply chains produce uniform binaries, creating a single point of failure for entire fleets. We break this vulnerability by engineering intelligent variability directly into the compilation process. Our technology disrupts attacker economics and massively increases exploitation costs, ensuring resilience for large-scale deployments.

To achieve this, we orchestrate thousands of parallel compiler runs across distributed systems. We’re now building our greenfield backend platform from scratch—scaling build orchestration, secure artifact distribution, and performance analytics. Join us at ground zero to architect the future of resilient software.

  • Expose infrastructure pipelines (build orchestration, artifact distribution) via UI/APIs.
  • Ship end-to-end features across the stack, from dashboards to access controls.

Required Expertise

  • 3+ years as a full-stack engineer shipping production systems.
  • Frontend mastery: React, Next.js, TypeScript.
  • Backend fluency: Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST/GraphQL API design.
  • Core understanding: Web architecture, auth (OAuth/SAML), CI/CD, and testing.

Nice-to-Haves

job.description:
• Role Title : Senior Mobile Engineer (Remote)
  • Role Type : Contractor (~15 hrs a week)
  • Location : Remote

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

As an expert, you will create Reinforcement Learning Environments that test an AI model’s ability to solve complex mobile software engineering problems related to fixing code, creating features, refactoring code, and optimizing performance. You will be tasked with creating a reproducible environment and a golden reference solution for each problem.

Scope of Work

1. Create realistic, interesting, and extremely challenging mobile coding tasks for frontier AI models using your preferred repositories.

2. Design problems that require strong mobile engineering skills, such as tracking down subtle bugs, building non-trivial features, handling application state and lifecycle, or improving performance.

3. Develop tasks relevant to your expertise: cross-platform applications using TypeScript, JavaScript, or Dart; iOS applications using Swift; or Android applications using Kotlin.

4. For each task, define the problem, build a reproducible environment, and write deterministic verifiers that accept correct solutions across different valid implementations while rejecting incorrect, incomplete, or hard-coded approaches.

5. Provide a reference solution showing how the task can be solved.

Preferred Qualifications

1. Significant hands-on expertise in at least one of the following mobile development tracks:

2. Cross-platform: TypeScript or JavaScript with React Native, or Dart with Flutter.

3. iOS: Swift with SwiftUI or UIKit.

4. Android: Kotlin with Jetpack Compose or the Android View system.

5. Deep understanding of mobile application architecture, state management, asynchronous programming, and application lifecycle.

6. Proven ability to debug complex mobile applications, resolve bugs, and deliver effective performance improvements.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum weekly submission requirements apply and will be communicated during onboarding.

Start Timeline & Availability

1. We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

What You’ll Do

1. Create realistic, interesting, and extremely challenging mobile coding tasks for frontier AI models using your preferred repositories.

2. Design problems that require strong mobile engineering skills, such as tracking down subtle bugs, building non-trivial features, handling application state and lifecycle, or improving performance.

job.description:
About Us Ever wondered what powers the products people rely on every day? Chances are, we've helped build it.

Our software and development tools help build products for cars, hospitals, factories, homes, and industries worldwide. We help engineers solve complex challenges and create technology people can depend on.

Rooted in Nordic values and trusted by innovators worldwide, we combine deep technical expertise with a culture of curiosity, craftsmanship, and collaboration. With decades of engineering experience and a shared passion for technical excellence, we're helping shape the future of software and embedded development.

We take pride in building tools for people who build the world around us.

About The Role Qt for MCUs is on a mission to bring Qt’s industry-leading UI framework to the most resource-constrained microcontrollers on the market — enabling rich, responsive user experiences on devices where every byte of Flash and every millisecond of CPU time matters. Our team works directly with the world’s leading silicon vendors and embedded product companies to make that vision a reality.

As a Solutions Engineer — MCU, you are the technical heart of our customer engagements. You will port Qt for MCUs to new silicon platforms, design display adaptation layers, solve complex hardware-software integration challenges, and serve as the go-to subject matter expert for MCU-related opportunities across sales, pre-sales, and product engineering.

This role is located in Bengaluru, India.

What You’ll Do

  • Port Qt for MCUs to new microcontroller platforms — from BSP bring-up and HAL integration through to display adaptation, framebuffer management, and validated performance on target hardware
  • Design and optimise display and graphics pipelines for memory-constrained MCUs, including DMA-driven transfers, partial rendering, and asset optimisation using the Qt for MCUs toolchain
  • Act as the primary technical SME for customer engagements, proof-of-concept projects, and evaluations — delivering workshops, demos, and training to engineering teams worldwide
  • Debug complex issues spanning hardware, firmware, BSP, and UI stack layers using JTAG/SWD debuggers, logic analysers, and oscilloscopes; provide root-cause analysis and drive resolution with product engineering
  • Author application notes, porting guides, and best-practice documentation; support the sales team with technical proposals and RFP responses for Qt for MCUs solutions
  • Collaborate closely with silicon vendors (Infineon, Renesas, NXP, STMicroelectronics) and internal engineering teams to bridge cutting-edge Qt technology with real-world MCU constraints

What You Bring To The Table

job.name: Custom Software Engineer
job.description:
Project Role : Custom Software Engineer

Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.

Must have skills : Automotive ECU Software

Good to have skills : AUTOSAR

Minimum 7.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required Educational Qualification : A Bachelors or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering Computer Science Electronics Automotive Engineering or related discipline is required

Summary:

As a Custom Software Engineer, you will be responsible for developing software applications and platform services for Automotive High-Performance Computing (HPC) systems based on Adaptive AUTOSAR architecture. Your typical day will involve collaborating with system architects, platform teams, and requirements engineers to develop scalable and high-performance software solutions for Software Defined Vehicles (SDVs). You will participate in software design, coding, integration, debugging, testing, and deployment activities while ensuring compliance with automotive quality, safety, and cybersecurity standards. The role requires strong expertise in modern C++, Linux/QNX, service-oriented communication, and automotive middleware technologies.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain Adaptive AUTOSAR applications and services running on Linux/QNX-based HPC platforms.
  • Design, implement, and integrate software components using Modern C++ (C++14/17/20) following industry coding standards.
  • Develop Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) applications leveraging Adaptive AUTOSAR communication frameworks.
  • Analyze, debug, and resolve software defects across distributed automotive ECU environments.
  • Collaborate with System Architects, Platform Teams, and Requirements Engineers to define and implement software solutions.
  • Develop and integrate communication services using SOME/IP, Ethernet, TCP/IP, UDP, DDS, and MQTT protocols.
  • Perform software integration, validation, and troubleshooting activities on target automotive platforms.
  • Create and enhance unit, integration, and automated test frameworks to ensure software robustness and reliability.
  • Develop CI/CD-based software build and deployment pipelines.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and technical discussions.
  • Monitor and improve software quality metrics including code coverage, static analysis, and defect density.
  • Support software lifecycle activities in compliance with ASPICE, Functional Safety, and Cybersecurity requirements.
  • Identify performance bottlenecks and optimize software for resource-efficient execution on HPC platforms.
  • Maintain software documentation, design specifications, and technical artifacts.
  • Comply with clean coding standards and best engineering practices.

job.name: Staff Software Engineer - Computer Vision
job.description:
About Us Array Labs is building a new way to understand the physical world.

Today, most geospatial systems are built around flat imagery, incomplete elevation models, slow refresh cycles, or narrow-area surveys. The world increasingly needs something better: accurate, frequently updated 3D information about the places, infrastructure, terrain, and activity that shape human decisions.

Array is building that system. We are developing a coordinated fleet of radar satellites designed to create high-resolution 3D data products of the Earth at unprecedented scale, speed, and reliability. Our technology is built to work across wide areas, through clouds, day and night, and to support both commercial and government customers operating in environments where timely physical-world understanding matters.

We design and build our satellites, radar payloads, sensing systems, and data products end-to-end. Our goal is to make 3D geospatial intelligence dramatically more accessible, useful, and operationally relevant for customers in mapping, infrastructure, disaster response, defense, intelligence, energy, telecommunications, mining, and other industries that depend on understanding the changing Earth.

About The Job As a Staff Software Engineer for Computer Vision, you will develop and deploy across all of Array's 3D processing capabilities, including our photogrammetry and radar reconstruction pipelines. The work spans computer vision algorithms and production engineering: you should be equally comfortable reading a paper about unfamiliar algorithms, and shipping new capabilities as production-quality software. The position will work closely with 3D reconstruction scientists, radar algorithms engineers, and product engineers.

Responsibilities

  • Productionize and continuously improve Array's photogrammetry and radar image formation pipelines using industry best practices
  • Step into individual pipeline stages — bundle adjustment, dense matching, point cloud generation, geometric refinement, geo-referencing — to improve accuracy, robustness, and throughput
  • Develop and optimize database schemas and storage solutions for managing large-scale 3D geospatial data
  • Contribute to broader software engineering efforts across the company, including data infrastructure, analytics, and systems to deliver our satellite data to customers

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a substantial portion focused on computer vision
  • Strong proficiency in Python and C++, experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerization technologies (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Strong foundation in geometric computer vision, spanning camera modeling, epipolar geometry, and multi-view reconstruction pipelines (stereo, SfM, MVS, bundle adjustment)
  • Excellent communicator, with the ability to make high-quality technical decisions in a startup environment

job.name: Engineering Manager, Mobile Platform
job.description:
Who We Are Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. What You'll Do

job.name: Residency Internship Program - Engineering
job.description:
As the Software Engineering Resident, you are an AI-Native Engineer on Method's internal product team. The people who will use the product are your customers. You sit with them, understand the problem, and build the answer in front of them, working with AI agents that write much of the code while you own what ships.

You will work alongside the Product Management and Design Residents from the first conversation, not at the end of a hand-off. Together you shape the problem, write the specifications, and turn them into a working, shippable product.

This residency is practical. The tools will change between now and when you start, and again before you finish. The residency teaches what does not change: framing a problem, directing AI to solve it, knowing when the output is wrong, and being able to explain every line you ship.

Today, our internal product is built with React, TypeScript and REST APIs , using AI coding agents. Expect that to have moved on by the time you join.

The Engineering Resident role comprises three primary learning areas:

  • Build with agents: Break problems into specifications an AI agent can act on, direct the agent, and review, test and take ownership of what comes back.
  • Build in front of the customer: Prototype quickly with the people who have the problem, show working software early, and turn their reaction into the next iteration.
  • Keep the work trustworthy: Learn what may and may not be shared with which AI tool, keep a clear record of what the AI produced and who reviewed it, and never ship code you cannot explain.

We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on inference . Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.

Job Summary Join our team and take the lead in illuminating the performance landscape of our cutting-edge ML accelerator. We are seeking a highly skilled engineer to design and develop a sophisticated performance analysis tool, tailored specifically for our hardware. You will be instrumental in creating the essential tooling that enables our ML engineers and customers to understand workload behavior, identify performance bottlenecks, and unlock the full potential of our hardware, accelerating the most demanding ML applications in the world. This is a unique opportunity to shape performance analysis for novel hardware from the ground up.

During Your Internship, You May

  • Build components of our performance analysis and profiling infrastructure.
  • Collect and analyze performance data from our custom ML accelerators, including hardware counters, execution traces, and memory behavior.
  • Develop tooling to trace host-side runtime activity, system behavior, and accelerator execution.
  • Help correlate performance events across CPUs, accelerators, storage, networking, and distributed workloads.
  • Build analysis and visualization tools that help engineers identify performance bottlenecks and optimize models.
  • Work alongside hardware, compiler, firmware, and inference engineers to understand performance challenges and develop tools that improve developer productivity.

Representative projects

  • Implement the data collection framework for hardware performance counters on a custom PCIe-based accelerator.
  • Develop a user-space service for low-overhead tracing of accelerator activity.
  • Design and build a correlated timeline view visualizing CPU API calls, driver submissions, PCIe transfers, and accelerator execution units.
  • Create an analysis pass to detect and quantify memory access inefficiencies or PCIe bandwidth saturation while transacting on a PCIe-attached accelerator.

job.name: Software Engineer, Intern - Labs (Summer 2027)
job.description:
About Labs DoorDash Labs is an independent team within DoorDash. We're hiring software engineer interns to work at the intersection of software engineering and robotics to solve key business problems with elegant technical solutions. If you have a passion for applying robotics solutions to a service loved by millions of people, then we want to talk to you!

About The Teams We are hiring Software Engineer interns across our Perception, Autonomy Platform, and DoorDash Air Cloud (Foundry) team. Please review the team descriptions below to learn about each. Selected candidates will be notified of which team is interested in pursuing their candidacy.

Perception: The Perception team helps Dot understand the world through vision foundation models and VLMs, supported by lidar and radar for safety. We tackle rare scenarios, adverse weather, and advances in reinforcement learning and end-to-end driving to make deliveries faster and smoother. We're seeking exceptional engineers in machine learning, computer vision, and state estimation to turn cutting-edge research into profitable autonomous delivery.

Autonomy Platform: The Autonomy Platform team is responsible for the software foundation that Dot runs on. We build a wide variety of software frameworks for ensuring the robot operates reliably at an ever-increasing scale. This includes everything from designing the robot's operating system, building petabyte-scale data processing pipelines in the cloud, and optimizing nanosecond-level compute of bleeding-edge AI models. We are systems-oriented thinkers and hands-on builders who are excited to advance the state of the art in autonomy.

Doordash Air Cloud (Foundry): The Air Cloud team, also known as Foundry, builds the cloud software that powers autonomous delivery across DoorDash—from the moment an order is placed and deemed eligible for drone or robot delivery, through merchant handoff, to flight management.

Autonomy Planning: Our team builds the planner that powers real-time driving decisions for DoorDash’s autonomous delivery robots. We combine prediction and planning in a unified architecture using deep reinforcement learning, large-scale simulation, and fleet data to tackle novel driving scenarios and long-tail edge cases. We’re looking for engineers excited to turn advances in machine learning into robust driving behavior on real robots.

About The Role We believe interns are essential to our mission of attracting and retaining top talent. During our 12-week Software Engineer internship, interns are completely immersed in their teams and will have the opportunity to develop, maintain, and ship products. As an intern, you will directly impact our business by collaborating with your team to solve real problems for our customers.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer – Maps Infrastructure

Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions About The Role Applied Intuition is looking for senior software engineers with passion and expertise in owning and maintaining HD maps infrastructure for autonomous vehicles.

At Applied we treat maps not as a static dataset, but as a single integrated, self-healing data flywheel powering Physical AI. Fleets of vehicles collect ground truth from multimodal sensors which feed ingestion pipelines, dynamic change detection algorithms, machine learning models, and real-time onboard localization and map fusion —closing the loop between field data collection and instantaneous autonomy stack updates.

In this full time role on the Maps team, you will solve challenges at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems, continuous data pipelines, and spatial visualization. You’ll be involved in whole life cycle of HD maps from gathering and codifying map requirements, supporting map visualization and editing, enabling large scale simulations, and publishing maps to AV fleets across multiple vehicle types worldwide – from long-haul L4 commercial trucks to L2++ personal cars, to heavy mining rigs, and tactical defense platforms. Our mission is to add intelligence to 1 billion machines.

job.name: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Job Description Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:

–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.

–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.

–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.

–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).

–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.

–Design performance and load testing.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:

–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.

–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.

–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.

–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:

–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.

–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..

JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Description & Skill Requirement:

Job Description

We're looking for a hands-on iOS Solution Architect / Technical Lead to own the architecture and delivery of large-scale, customer-facing native iOS applications. This is an onsite role in Philadelphia, PA, and you'll stay close to the code while guiding engineering teams and engaging directly with customer architects and product stakeholders.

Core Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end iOS solution architecture and technical design, from requirements through production.
  • Translate business and product requirements into scalable mobile architecture, including patterns, components, APIs, and data flows.
  • Stay hands-on through design reviews, code reviews, PoCs, debugging, and complex problem resolution.
  • Architect integrations with REST APIs, backend and cloud services, authentication, analytics, notifications, and connected-device services.
  • Establish coding standards, reusable components, and engineering best practices.
  • Drive performance, scalability, security, reliability, observability, and maintainability.
  • Troubleshoot complex application, API, network, concurrency, memory, and production issues.
  • Lead technical discussions with customer architects, product owners, and cross-functional teams, and maintain architectural consistency with the Android team.
  • Mentor developers and provide technical leadership across onsite and offshore teams, and support CI/CD, release engineering, and App Store deployment.

Required Qualifications

  • 8-12+ years of software or mobile engineering experience, including 5+ years of strong native iOS development.
  • Expert-level Swift programming, with strong hands-on experience in SwiftUI and UIKit.
  • Deep understanding of iOS frameworks, application lifecycle, and Apple platform architecture.

job.name: Senior Software Developer
job.description:
Cronometer is the most accurate, comprehensive nutrition tracking app on the market. We empower people to make informed decisions about their health and wellness with data they can trust. With over 19 million users and growing fast, we're passionate about building world-class tools that support better health outcomes.

We are looking for a Senior Software Developer. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining our web and mobile applications. This requires both excellent server-side programming skills (Java, SQL, AWS) as well as great front-end UI development skills (HTML/CSS, Javascript, iOS, Android).

We want to find a great fit with someone who wants to live our mountain lifestyle, has a passion for our mission to empower people in making informed decisions on their health & wellness, and can demonstrate the skills and talent we’ll need to take our products to the next level. We value in-person collaboration, therefore we are looking for someone willing and able to relocate to Revelstoke, British Columbia.

What you'll be doing

  • Designing, building and maintaining reliable full stack features across our web and mobile platforms
  • Developing scalable server-side systems using Java and SQL
  • Maintaining and extending our existing frontend built with GWT and HTML/CSS/JS
  • Contributing to architectural decisions and best practices as we modernize our platform
  • Participating in peer code reviews and mentoring junior developers
  • Collaborating cross-functionally with QA, Product and Design teams to deliver robust, user-friendly features
  • Supporting deployments and cloud infrastructure in AWS

What you bring to the table

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a software developer
  • Strong SQL skills and high proficiency in at least one modern backend programming language, with experience designing scalable backend systems
  • Solid fronted development skills (GWT, Javascript, HTML/CSS)
  • Experience with AWS Services (EC2, RDS, S3, etc.) and CI/CD pipelines
  • Proven ability to deliver production-ready code with attention to performance, maintainability and observability
  • Comfortable working with version control (Git), pull requests, and team based workflows
  • An ability to lead projects independently and work with a high degree of autonomy while staying aligned with team goals
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate in a distributed team environment
  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice to haves

  • Experience with GWT (Google Web Toolkit) in a production environment
  • Familiarity with React.Js for modern web development
  • Experience with Python and mobile development frameworks like Flutter
  • Interest or background in nutrition, fitness, or health tech
  • Exposure to machine learning or data science concepts

Nous sommes à la recherche d’une développeuse ou d’un développeur d’expérience à l’aise avec la programmation mobile (Android et iOS) et d’arrière-plan (back-end) requise pour créer une application complète. Vous participerez ainsi au développement et à la conception d’applications destinées aux propriétaires de nos véhicules.

Vous devrez chercher loin pour réussir à trouver une scène de développement numérique comme celle de Montréal. Une entreprise multinationale canadienne connaissant une croissance sans précédent et ne ménageant aucun effort pour réaliser sa transformation numérique, BRP demeure fidèle à ses racines.

En tant que développeur d’applications à pile complète (full-stack) relevant directement de l’architecte numérique principal, vous ferez partie de l’équipe d’innovation de la connectivité qui améliore constamment les applications destinées aux clients de BRP et vous participerez directement aux initiatives de produits numériques de BRP.

L’équipe numérique de BRP est répartie dans deux bureaux dans la province de Québec, l’un à Montréal, l’autre à Sherbrooke. Nos espaces sont entièrement conçus pour stimuler l’innovation, la co-création, la collaboration avec les différentes équipes (CRM, numérique et ingénierie de produits) et pour s’amuser au travail!

VOUS AUREZ L'OCCASION DE :

  • Participer au développement et à la maintenance de l’application mobile et de son système d’arrière-plan, dont toute interface à d’autres systèmes (p. ex. applications iOS et Android, API de matériels pour véhicules).
  • Collaborer avec les propriétaires de produits et l’équipe de l’expérience utilisateur (XU) pour améliorer constamment l’expérience.
  • Rédiger un test automatisé pour garantir la qualité du code et de l’application.
  • Participer à tous les aspects du cycle de vie des produits, dont la découverte, la planification, le développement, la livraison et le soutien à la production.

VOUS VOUS ÉPANOUIREZ DANS CE RÔLE SI VOUS AVEZ LES COMPÉTENCES ET QUALITÉS SUIVANTES :

  • Excellente connaissance du développement Android (Kotlin) ou iOS (Swift) et de structures natives hybrides (Kotlin Multiplateform).
  • Expérience des protocoles Bluetooth et WiFi
  • Familiarité avec les technologies de bases de données telles que MySQL, MariaDB et MongoDB.
  • Connaissance des structures JavaScript telles que Angular, React et Vue.
  • Excellente connaissance des protocoles API (Rest et GraphQL).
  • Connaissance des services infonuagiques Azure.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication (en français ou en anglais): Capacité à communiquer avec des parties prenantes internes et externes à l'extérieur du Québec ou unilingue anglophone sur une base quotidienne.
  • Une expérience dans un environnement d’entreprise est un atout.
  • Une expérience de travail avec un fournisseur de développement est un atout.

At Fujitsu, we are driven by our purpose to make the world more sustainable by building trust in society through innovation.

We have been a pioneer in technology and innovation for over 80 years, and we are committed to using our expertise to help businesses and organizations transform for the digital age. We believe that digital transformation is essential to creating a more sustainable future. That's why we are working with our customers to develop solutions that can help them reduce their environmental impact, improve their efficiency, and create a more equitable society.

We are committed to contributing to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). These goals are a blueprint for a better future for all, and we believe that technology can play a vital role in achieving them.

If you share our passion for making a meaningful impact on the world, we invite you to join our global family of 130,000 employees spanning more than 50 countries. We are a diverse workforce, and we offer a wide range of opportunities for you to grow and develop your career.

Together, we can create a more sustainable future for all.

Fujitsu Canada has an exciting opportunity for an experienced Design Engineer to join our dynamic digital transformation team.

The Design Engineer is a hands-on role that owns the user experience of a product from research through shipped interface. The role combines user research, interaction and visual design, front-end engineering, and AI-assisted delivery so that what is designed is what gets built.

The role replaces the traditional hand-off between a UX designer and a front-end developer. The Design Engineer works directly in the codebase and the design system, produces working prototypes and production-quality UI, and validates decisions with real users through usability testing and heuristic evaluation.

The Design Engineer makea sure product features are desirable, usable, feasible and consistent, and that human-centred design principles are met in the delivered product rather than only in the design file.

The developer will interact with both internal and external stakeholders and will not have access to customer data. The first week includes TD onboarding and knowledge transfer. This position offers significant opportunity to network and grow within the organization, with many new initiatives underway on a high-usage application.

Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in 2-week sprint cycles, including ceremony meetings and timely completion of assigned action tickets

The agency and no-nonsense of a seed startup: you write product specs, make product and design decisions, and build in an almost-no-meeting culture. While also the product-market fit and scale of a growth-stage startup: 100,000+ weekly active users who depend on your software and eagerly await your next feature.

You’ve probably seen this role posted before, and it’s because we’re always expanding the team (we’re on track to double Engineering this year). Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. job.name: Residency Internship Program - Engineering
job.description:
As the Software Engineering Resident, you are an AI-Native Engineer on Method's internal product team. The people who will use the product are your customers. You sit with them, understand the problem, and build the answer in front of them, working with AI agents that write much of the code while you own what ships.

You will work alongside the Product Management and Design Residents from the first conversation, not at the end of a hand-off. Together you shape the problem, write the specifications, and turn them into a working, shippable product.

This residency is practical. The tools will change between now and when you start, and again before you finish. The residency teaches what does not change: framing a problem, directing AI to solve it, knowing when the output is wrong, and being able to explain every line you ship.

Today, our internal product is built with React, TypeScript and REST APIs , using AI coding agents. Expect that to have moved on by the time you join.

The Engineering Resident role comprises three primary learning areas:

  • Build with agents: Break problems into specifications an AI agent can act on, direct the agent, and review, test and take ownership of what comes back.
  • Build in front of the customer: Prototype quickly with the people who have the problem, show working software early, and turn their reaction into the next iteration.
  • Keep the work trustworthy: Learn what may and may not be shared with which AI tool, keep a clear record of what the AI produced and who reviewed it, and never ship code you cannot explain.

Key Responsibilities (Learning & Contribution):

job.description:
*🚀 Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!* Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.

As a remote co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.

We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.

*💻 Role* The Whatnot Design System (WDS) Is How One Product Ships Coherently Across IOS, Android, And Web. We're In The Middle Of WDS 2.0 — a Ground-up Evolution Of Our Tokens, Components, And The Pipeline That Connects Figma To Production Code On All Three Platforms. As a Design Systems Engineer, You Will

  • Build and evolve Whatnot Design System components across iOS (Swift/SwiftUI), Android (Kotlin/Compose), and web (React/TypeScript), so that every team ships consistent, accessible, high-craft UI — measured by component adoption, migration velocity, and reduction of one-off UI in the product.
  • Own and extend our design token architecture — base, semantic, and component tokens — and the automated pipeline that syncs them from Figma through our token repository into each platform's codebase, so a change made once lands everywhere without breaking changes.
  • Partner daily with product designers as a true collaborator: reviewing specs and redlines, pressure-testing component APIs and naming, flagging gaps between Figma and code, and building the tooling (Figma plugins, code connect, component playgrounds, snapshot galleries) that keeps design and engineering in lockstep.
  • Raise the bar on quality and leverage: accessibility by default, dark mode, RTL, haptics, snapshot and visual regression testing, component telemetry, and AI-assisted workflows that turn a Figma component into a first-draft implementation.

Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team Stripe Terminal helps our users extend their online presence to the physical world. The Terminal team’s mission is to make it as easy for businesses to accept in-person payments as the Stripe API has made it to accept online payments. Whether a user is building a superb retail experience, extending their website to a pop-up store, or enabling mobile point-of-sale payments at their next event, Terminal gives them the building blocks to do it.

Almost every Terminal experience starts with a developer building the integration. The Developer Experiences team owns that work: the SDKs, APIs, integration primitives, documentation, and example apps that developers—and, increasingly, AI agents—use to build on Terminal. In this role, you’ll own how developers and agents integrate in-person payments with Stripe, from making their first test charge to running their integrations at scale in production.

What you’ll do

You’ll own the roadmap and execution for Terminal’s developer-facing surface: the client SDKs (JavaScript, iOS, Android, React Native, .NET, and Java), the integration primitives developers depend on, and the documentation and example apps that help them make their first successful charge. You’ll work with engineering to ship capabilities that make Terminal faster to integrate and more reliable to run while supporting newer patterns such as server-driven integration and agent-built integrations.
