Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd®, Slideshare®, Everand™, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise.

Culture at Scribd, Inc. We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.

We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location.

So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.

This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.

About The Team And Role

  • Core Infrastructure builds and operates the foundations of Scribd, Inc.: the paved roads of cloud infrastructure, networking, databases, and observability that let every product team move fast with confidence. Over the past two years, our charter has grown, and today we own the Content Library, the unified storage and governance platform for all content across Scribd®, Slideshare®, Everand™, and Fable.
  • The Content Library is one of the more interesting storage problems you'll find anywhere. Nearly twenty years of accumulated content, hundreds of billions of objects in S3, served to hundreds of millions of people every month. It provides transactional storage, dataset transforms with full lineage tracking, low-latency online reads, and the governance layer (access control, trust, deletion propagation) for our most valuable asset: the content that powers our products and our inference-driven features.
  • The core of the platform is written in Rust and built on the excellent Rust data ecosystem (Apache Arrow, Parquet, and DataFusion), with a Python "userland" that teams across the company contribute to directly. If you want a taste of the work, read about Content Crush on our tech blog: https://tech.scribd.com/blog/2026/content-crush.html

job.name: Software Engineer
job.description:
What should happen when an AI provider hits a rate limit? How do you switch providers without breaking the developer’s workflow? These are the kinds of problems you’ll work on at Cheaper Inference.

We’re hiring a hands-on software engineer to help lead development of OmniRoute, our open-source AI gateway. OmniRoute gives developers one API endpoint for multiple AI providers and lets them route requests based on cost, availability, and performance. You’ll write code, help shape technical decisions, and own improvements from design through release.

OmniRoute website: https://www.omniroute.online/

GitHub: https://github.com/cheaper-inference/OmniRoute

What you’ll do

  • Build and maintain AI provider integrations and improve request routing, automatic fallback, and streaming reliability.
  • Lead features from design through release, weighing technical trade-offs and following up on user feedback.
  • Investigate provider failures and regressions, then improve the tests, logging, and documentation that make them easier to catch and diagnose.
  • Review pull requests, triage issues, and discuss technical decisions with English- and Portuguese-speaking contributors.

What you’ll bring

  • At least 2 years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Fluency in spoken Portuguese and English , with the ability to discuss designs, explain trade-offs, and troubleshoot in both languages.
  • Experience building and debugging backend services or API integrations.
  • The ability to take ownership of a feature, write maintainable code and tests, and communicate clearly in code reviews.

Experience with TypeScript and Node.js, open-source collaboration, or AI provider APIs is a plus.

How to apply

Send us your résumé and a short note about a feature or integration you owned. Tell us what you built, one technical trade-off you made, and what happened after it shipped. Links to public work are welcome.

Base salary

  • CAD $105,000–$130,000 per year, depending on relevant experience.

job.description:
Introduction At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world’s leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM’s product and technology landscape. Here, you’ll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world.

Your Role And Responsibilities We’re not just building better tech. We’re rewriting how data moves and what the world can do with it. With Confluent, data doesn’t sit still. Our platform puts information in motion, streaming in near real-time so companies can react faster, build smarter, and deliver experiences as dynamic as the world around them.

It takes a certain kind of person to join this team. Those who ask hard questions, give honest feedback, and show up for each other. No egos, no solo acts. Just smart, curious humans pushing toward something bigger, together.

Senior Software Engineers II at Confluent take ownership of critical backend systems that underpin our data streaming platform. You’ll lead the design and delivery of large-scale, distributed services that must be secure, highly available, and easy to operate across regions and clouds.

The team owns a highly available, scalable metadata store — the source of truth that services across Confluent Cloud build on. It serves low-latency read and write APIs, and streams data in real time. The platform is a foundational backbone of a broader effort to re-architect Confluent Cloud and replacing bespoke, per-team datastores with a single self-serve platform.

Responsibilities

  • Build and evolve the metadata platform — the read, write, and streaming APIs
  • Solve hard distributed-systems problems — availability, consistency, sharding, scaling
  • Design, build, and operate resilient, scalable systems across a stack spanning multiple clouds and services
  • Independently drive projects — spot high-impact gap

Preferred Education Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

job.name: Technical Lead (Python)
job.description:
Remarcable is the intelligent procurement and material operations platform transforming how trade contractors (electrical, plumbing, HVAC) and suppliers work together. Processing over $1B in monthly purchase volume, our platform unifies procurement, inventory, prefabrication, tool management, and delivery. We connect live field operations, back offices, and suppliers through real time data sync, visual catalogs, side by side distributor pricing, AI discrepancy detection, and 180+ supplier and ERP integrations.

Your first 90 days

job.name: Lead Engineer - Payments Platform
job.description:
About The Role For a small business, getting paid isn’t an abstract technical problem. It affects whether they can pay their people, buy supplies and take on their next opportunity. We connect money movement with financial context to help small businesses manage cash flow with greater confidence.

Payments is one of Xero’s biggest areas of investment and growth. As a Lead Engineer on Payments Platform, you’ll join early-stage initiatives and make foundational architectural decisions for capabilities that power money movement across Xero and enable new product lines globally. Your work can span shared platform capabilities and customer-facing payment products, including global bill payments.

You’ll stay hands-on in production code and proofs of concept while setting the technical direction other engineers and teams build on. It’s an opportunity to shape both the technology and the engineering practices of a growing team, with a direct connection to the problems small businesses face every day

The Technical Challenges

  • A shared payments platform: Build orchestration, risk and fraud, and multi-provider capabilities that work across products and markets, helping teams launch new payment products faster without rebuilding the same foundations.
  • Global bill payments: Make a complex financial process feel simple for small businesses while keeping it accurate, secure and connected to the accounting record.
  • High throughput at scale: Design reliable, secure distributed services that remain dependable under real-world production constraints.
  • Customer impact alongside architectural progress: Selectively rebuild and enhance existing systems, delivering value quickly while moving toward a coherent long-term architecture.
  • AI capabilities customers can trust: Apply AI to challenging product problems while protecting customer trust, and bring the same discipline to how we evaluate and operate those capabilities.

Impact

  • First 6 months: You understand the payments platform, its consumers and the customer problems it enables teams to solve. You’ve shipped production code and aligned the team on the architecture and roadmap for at least one core capability, such as onboarding, orchestration, risk and fraud, or multi-provider support. Through mentorship, technical reviews and practical improvements, you’ve helped elevate the team’s engineering capability.
  • First 12 months: Your architectural decisions are operating in production and helping new payment products launch faster. You’ve helped establish engineering standards and clear ownership for the Vancouver Payments team, and your work is reaching small businesses through faster, safer ways to pay and get paid.

job.name: Sr Backend Engineer, Falcon NG-SIEM, Global Serverless Platform (Hybrid)
job.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

*About The Role:* CrowdStrike is seeking an experienced Engineer III for the NG-SIEM (next generation security information and event management) Global Serverless Platform team in the US. The Global Serverless Platform team is responsible for building and operating the global- and region-level automation that will automatically manage the industry’s largest event data store and search system.

Our goals are to scale to 100s of PB of data ingress per day, while maintaining best-in-class ingest, search, and detection SLAs, as well as a best-in-class cost structure.

The team that you will be a part of owns the regional control plane layer, as well as account provisioning systems and region-level integrations with the rest of the Falcon platform.

You will be joining a distributed team of highly collaborative engineers who share a strong passion for the product. In this role you will get a chance to work on hard engineering problems that do not have well-defined solutions. You will become one of the go-to experts of the NG SIEM control plane, and will have a broad understanding of the entire NG SIEM data plane fleet.

The team’s vision is to build a zero-touch, highly refined, self-service model of a data plane. Teams in NG SIEM have a great amount of autonomy, and own a part of the NG SIEM experience, from ideation and development to deployment and feedback. This includes ensuring high quality of the features they deliver, by writing automated tests, and performing manual tests. Moreover, we do not just throw over features to our operations teams, but we constantly observe and monitor new features in production.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer, Product Security
job.description:
SentiLink helps institutions and protects customers by accurately resolving identities and flagging fraud risk. Each day, we verify more than 3 million identities, flagging 150k+ fraud attempts in the process. The problems we work on are challenging, and solving them takes deep domain expertise, rigorous analysis, and a willingness to dig into the details.

At SentiLink, you'll work alongside smart, highly collaborative colleagues who respect each other's time and judgment, take ownership, and follow through on their commitments. Together, we do truly meaningful work protecting the identities of innocent consumers and flagging the fraudsters attempting to exploit them.

We're well capitalized and growing quickly. We already serve 13 of the top 15 U.S. banks, we're expanding into new markets, and we're backed by Craft Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, NYCA, and Max Levchin. We've been named to the Forbes Fintech 50 and as a 2026 FICO Industry Vanguard Decision Award Winner. We were also the first company to go live with the electronic Consent Based Social Security Number Verification (eCBSV) service, and we've testified before the U.S. Congress on the future of identity.

We want SentiLink to be the best place you've ever worked. We offer generous benefits and support a range of working arrangements, from fully remote to in-office. We are a digital-first company with strong collaboration across the U.S. and India, and we meet in person regularly to build relationships. We have offices in Austin, San Francisco, New York City, Seattle (Bellevue), Los Angeles, and Chicago in the U.S., and in Gurugram (Delhi) and Bengaluru in India.

Role SentiLink's Information Security team protects our systems, data, and customers while enabling the business to move quickly and securely. As software development accelerates across the company, we're investing in engineers who can both build security capabilities and improve the security of the products we deliver to customers.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Product Security who combines strong software engineering skills with a security mindset. You'll build and operate custom security applications, automation, and integrations; investigate vulnerabilities in our applications and cloud infrastructure; and help engineering teams develop, test, and deliver more secure software.

This role spans software development and hands-on product security. You'll work closely with other product security engineers and the broader Engineering and Infrastructure teams to uncover difficult security problems, develop practical solutions, and drive them through implementation. We're looking for someone who is curious about how systems fail, can navigate complex codebases and architectures, and has the technical range to move between building security tooling and validating the security of customer-facing products.

Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. job.name: Full-Stack Developer - Core
job.description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 15,000 customers , including McDonalds, Michaels, Cintas, Redimix, and U.S. LBM, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 16 million managed assets and 92 million completed work orders. In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions , the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours. About The Team Core is the heart of the MaintainX CMMS: the work orders, planning and scheduling, inventory and parts, reporting, and asset hierarchy that frontline teams touch every day. It is also where some of our newest investment is happening, including two newly formed teams building a Work Execution Platform and a rebuilt Technician Experience from scratch. If you want to work close to what customers use daily, and have a chance at green-field ownership, this is the place.

Teams You Might Join

  • Planners: Planner and scheduler workflows, plus Operating Hours.
  • Inventory Management / Parts: Spare parts, purchase orders, forecasting and vendors.
  • Home / Reporting: The Overview screen, plus shared and scheduled reports.
  • Work Execution Platform: The work order primitives the product runs on: recurrence, assignment, calendar, procedures, automations and permits.
  • Technician Experience: GPS check-in, field UX and offline state for technicians in the field.
  • Enterprise Data Management: Global, multi-site platform capabilities, templates, asset hierarchy and location, and dynamic asset forms.

What You'll Work On

  • Build and improve the workflows customers use every day, from scheduling and parts management to reporting.
  • Solve hard product problems: dense, data-heavy interfaces, large datasets, offline behaviour and multi-site scale.
  • On our newly formed teams, shape architecture and engineering practices from the ground up.
  • Make complex workflows feel simple on desktop and mobile.

The Role

  • Ship features end to end, from planning through production.
  • Partner directly with Product Managers and Designers to shape your team's roadmap, not just execute against it.
  • Own a feature area or system's long-term health: reliability, performance, and the parts of the codebase nobody notices until they break.
  • Review code and mentor other developers on your team.
  • Raise the bar on tooling, testing, and delivery practices.

job.name: Software Engineer I, Fullstack (Disputes Platform)
job.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Our team owns the refund experience for Affirm customers. We build the customer-facing features, backend services and data foundations that make refunds clear, fast and reliable. Refunds touch a large share of our customers, so the work has a direct, visible impact on their trust in Affirm. We're a growing team with a full roadmap, which means we can invest consistently in this area.

We're collaborative and ownership-minded. Engineers own their work from design through on-call, raise risks early, and share what they learn. We care about clear written communication and constructive code review, and we work closely with partner teams across the company.

What You'll Do

  • With the support of your team, you will work on tasks that contribute to the team's projects and goals.
  • You will work collaboratively and proactively with your team and stakeholders, bringing them along for your work and helping to create visibility and dialog regarding the risks and trade-offs related to your work.
  • You will strike the right balance of speed and quality in your work, ensuring that we hit our business goals while protecting our systems from downtime.
  • You will contribute to a sense of community on your team by engaging in growth and development activities.

What We Look For

  • You have previous work or internship experience shipping web apps using declarative UI frameworks like React or Vue.
  • You have previous work or internship designing, developing and launching APIs at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.
  • You have mastered taking a simple problem or business scenario into a solution that interacts with multiple software components, and executing on it by writing clear, easily understood, well tested and extensible code.
  • You are comfortable navigating a large code base, debugging others' code, and providing feedback to other engineers through code reviews.
  • Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Base Pay Grade - J

Equity Grade - 4

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

job.name: Software Engineer, Product (Fullstack)
job.description:
About Badge More people now use Apple and Google Wallet than TikTok or Instagram. At Badge, we believe mobile wallets are the next big customer engagement channel, and we make it easy for enterprise brands and platforms to build in and monetize experiences in Apple and Google Wallets. From loyalty cards to stored value cards, memberships, IDs, and tickets, Badge helps brands drive retention, reactivation, and revenue by turning wallets into a powerful marketing channel.

The Badge platform consists of a no-code UI for marketers, flexible APIs for developers, and an embed/SDK for platform partners, enabling companies to create dynamic wallet experiences with in-wallet push notifications, location-based notifications, offers, coupons, tap-to-redeem, and more.

We are a fast-growing team backed by leading investors, including QED and Infinity, and trusted by top-tier retailers, grocers, and partner institutions including Shift4, Carrefour, Hoka, and Yale University. We value sharp thinking, fast execution, and a deep understanding of what drives customer behavior in a mobile-first world.

Position Overview

Join Badge as a Product Engineer and become an architect of experiences that thousands of users interact with daily. You'll be responsible for the entire customer journey—from easy to use interfaces to rock-solid APIs—ensuring every touchpoint exceeds expectations and drives meaningful business outcomes.

This role is perfect for a full-stack engineer who thrives on ownership, loves collaborating across disciplines, and gets energized by seeing their code directly impact customer success and product growth.

Core Responsibilities

  • Build and optimize APIs that power seamless interactions between frontend and backend systems
  • Work within our modern tech stack: React/TypeScript frontend with Node.js, Express, Prisma, and PostgreSQL backend
  • Work with other engineers to deliver new features and iterate on existing ones
  • Partner closely with product managers to translate user needs into technical solutions that drive business metrics
  • Collaborate with designers to bring mockups to life while advocating for technical feasibility and user experience best practices
  • Write clean, maintainable code that scales with our growing user base and feature complexity
  • Implement robust testing strategies and monitoring to ensure reliability and performance
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and technical strategy as we scale our platform

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

  • You have 4+ years of experience in frontend and backend development
  • You have mastered TypeScript and have experience with React
  • You are excited to work across the stack to deliver features
  • You work well with designers and product managers to come up with optimal solutions
  • You are clear and concise in explaining your thought process and in enumerating the tradeoffs made in your work
  • You have strong problem-solving and analytical skills

job.description:
About Onyx. Onyx is building a social trading platform for what happens next. We started in sports and grew to more than one million users. Now, through Onyx Predictions, users can trade on the outcomes of real-world events. We’ve also launched Pack Rips for trading cards, with crypto perpetuals up next.

Onyx Predictions is a CFTC-registered introducing broker and NFA member. Our exclusive clearing agreement with Payward Services Derivatives gives us the infrastructure to expand into new markets. Payward, the parent company of Kraken, also led our $20 million Series A at a $220 million valuation, less than a year after we came out of beta.

We’re a small team building in New York, with people from Jane Street, DraftKings, Robinhood, xAI, SIG, HRT, and Harvard. You’ll build for an audience that’s already here and help take new products from idea to launch.

The Role.

We’re hiring a Full Stack Engineer to build the trading experience on Onyx and the systems behind it. You’ll work across our React web app, React Native mobile app, and Node.js backend, using TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and AWS. You’ll work directly with product, design, trading, and operations to decide what to build, ship it, and keep it running in production. That could mean building a live trading screen, making sure balances stay accurate through order execution and settlement, or integrating a new exchange.

What You’ll Own

  • Build and ship customer-facing trading features across web and mobile, along with tools for our internal teams.
  • Build backend services for markets, orders, execution, positions, balances, and settlement.
  • Design APIs and real-time systems, and keep data consistent across concurrent operations in PostgreSQL.
  • Integrate with exchanges, liquidity providers, payment systems, and financial partners.
  • Run the systems you ship in AWS and improve their performance, observability, and ability to recover from failures.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Strong TypeScript, React, and Node.js skills, with experience shipping and maintaining full-stack applications in production.
  • Production experience with PostgreSQL and AWS, plus a solid understanding of transactions, concurrency, and data consistency.

Nice To Have

About ExamDeveloper

ExamDeveloper is a web-based exam development platform that allows our customers to write, review, and manage questions for their exams (https://www.pearsonvue.com/us/en/test-owners/develop.html). ExamDeveloper is a leading web-based tool for creating tests that certify test-takers in the professional skills they need. Customers rely on ExamDeveloper to support their full workflow around question writing, collaborative review, scoring, and test management.

Summary

As a Senior Software Engineer, you are a highly skilled individual contributor and a technical authority within your area. You lead the design, implementation, optimization, and support of complex software components, services, and platforms that enable key business capabilities and customer experiences.

Working with significant independence, you evaluate technical options, guide design decisions, identify risks, and build scalable, maintainable, resilient solutions. You are frequently consulted on architecture reviews, performance optimization, operational stability, and complex problem resolution. You lead through expertise rather than formal authority — mentoring engineers, improving practices, and helping teams make sound technical and release decisions. You partner closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Product Architects, Quality Engineering, and DevOps to deliver secure, reliable, and highly scalable solutions.

Key responsibilities

Technical leadership (through expertise)

  • Lead design and implementation for complex software components, services, and platforms.
  • Drive technical decision-making for major features and engineering initiatives.
  • Influence software architecture, design patterns, and engineering standards within your domain.
  • Lead technical design sessions and contribute to architectural discussions with Product Architects.
  • Mentor and coach engineers through design reviews, code reviews, pairing, and technical guidance.
  • Participate in interviews to help assess and hire engineering talent.
  • Communicate technical direction, tradeoffs, and risks clearly to stakeholders outside your immediate team.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer
job.description:
About Onyx. Onyx is building a social trading platform for what happens next. We started in sports and grew to more than one million users. Now, through Onyx Predictions, users can trade on the outcomes of real-world events. We’ve also launched Pack Rips for trading cards, with crypto perpetuals up next.

Onyx Predictions is a CFTC-registered introducing broker and NFA member. Our exclusive clearing agreement with Payward Services Derivatives gives us the infrastructure to expand into new markets. Payward, the parent company of Kraken, also led our $20 million Series A at a $220 million valuation, less than a year after we came out of beta.

We’re a small team building in New York, with people from Jane Street, DraftKings, Robinhood, xAI, SIG, HRT, and Harvard. You’ll build for an audience that’s already here and help take new products from idea to launch.

The Role.

We’re hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build the trading experience on Onyx and the systems behind it. You’ll lead projects across our React web app, React Native mobile app, and Node.js backend, using TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and AWS. You’ll work directly with product, design, trading, and operations to define the problem, make the architectural calls, and ship. That could mean building a live trading experience, integrating a new exchange, or designing services that keep orders, positions, and balances consistent through execution and settlement. You’ll write production code and help other engineers make better technical decisions through design reviews, feedback, and mentorship.

What You’ll Own

  • Lead the design and delivery of trading features across web and mobile, from the first technical decisions through launch.
  • Build backend services for markets, orders, execution, positions, balances, and settlement.
  • Design APIs and real-time systems that keep data consistent across concurrent operations in PostgreSQL.
  • Integrate with exchanges, liquidity providers, payment systems, and financial partners.
  • Operate the services and infrastructure you build in AWS. Improve performance and observability, investigate difficult production issues, and fix the underlying causes.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production systems.
  • Strong TypeScript and Node.js skills, with experience building customer-facing applications in React.
  • Production experience with PostgreSQL and AWS, plus a solid understanding of relational data modeling, transactions, concurrency, and data consistency.
  • Experience building real-time, event-driven, or distributed systems.
  • The ability to lead cross-functional projects with open-ended requirements, explain technical trade-offs clearly, and ship quickly while keeping the systems reliable.

Our partner is an AI-native HR and payroll platform built for founders and startups, with a sweet spot of companies up to about 250 employees. job.name: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Rentals)
job.description:
What is Bilt? Bilt is the membership for where you live.

What started as a way to reward people on their largest expense has turned into an ecosystem connecting our members, property managers and local merchants.

Travel, dining, fitness, everyday spend. We are building systems across payments, credit, loyalty, and commerce all at once.

We run lean and move quickly. Every person here has a real impact on what gets built and how fast it happens.

This role comes with real ownership and high expectations. If you prefer clearly defined lanes and structure, this will feel uncomfortable. If you want to build quickly, have a real say in what gets built, and work on products used by millions, you will likely do your best work here.

What's the role? The Rentals team builds the property platform connecting residents, property managers, and the systems they rely on across millions of users and billions of dollars worth of transactions each month. Our work spans rent payments, property-management integrations, home search and applications, resident experiences, and building access.

The work combines visible product development with demanding systems engineering: keeping data accurate across third-party platforms, making workflows recover safely from failures, and scaling systems that people depend on to manage their homes. You’ll work directly with product, account managers, and property partners, turn real operational problems into software, and own what you ship in production.

You don’t need to arrive knowing every part of our stack but we value engineers who can navigate ambiguity, make sound trade-offs, and learn unfamiliar systems.

In This Role You Will

  • Own projects from customer problem to production, working directly with product, sales, account managers, and property partners.
  • Build reliable rent-payment workflows that handle retries, partial failures, and reconciliation across external systems.
  • Integrate new property-management platforms and keep property, resident, lease, and ledger data accurate as those systems change.
  • Ship complete products across property-manager tools and resident web/mobile experiences, from home search and applications to building access.
  • Scale ingestion and distributed workflows while improving correctness, observability, and recovery—not just throughput.
  • Build AI-assisted engineering tools that shorten the path from a customer problem to a safely shipped fix.

job.description:
About Solace Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.

We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly.

Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way.

You'll be challenged daily, expected to move fast, learn faster, and take ownership of your work like a seasoned engineer.

You'll join a spectacularly talented team who will push you to grow, but you'll also be expected to think independently, ask the right questions, and own your work from design through deployment. You will commit code daily. You will make mistakes. You will learn from them and get better every single day. If you're the kind of person who wants to be thrown into the deep end and come out stronger, keep reading.

You are scrappy, resourceful, and eager to prove yourself. You don't need all the answers—you need the drive to find them. You're not afraid of ambiguity or hard problems; in fact, they excite you. We are looking for an experienced Senior Quantitative Researcher with extensive hands-on experience in Forex algorithmic trading, quantitative strategy development, historical backtesting, optimisation and trading signal generation.

  • Support and Resistance Trading.
  • Price Action and Candlestick Pattern Analysis.
  • Fibonacci Retracement and Extension.
  • Multi-Timeframe Analysis.
  • Volatility-Based Trading.

B. Historical Backtesting & Strategy Validation

job.description:
Job Description You will work as part of international, multidisciplinary teams providing robust, impartial and influential advice across the policy lifecycle, from policy development and appraisal through implementation, monitoring, evaluation and review. The role combines economic analysis, quantitative modelling, research and clear communication to help public- and private-sector clients understand the economic, environmental and social implications of policy and investment decisions.

  • Prepare clear, concise and defensible reports, policy briefs, presentations, models and other client deliverables in English.
  • Work collaboratively with specialists across environmental science, engineering, climate, natural capital, infrastructure, finance and other disciplines on global projects.
  • Contribute to project management, quality assurance, commercial delivery and adherence to agreed scope, budget and programme.
  • Support proposals, capability development and knowledge sharing; take a active role in client relationships, opportunity development and technical leadership.

Sector And Thematic Experience Experience across multiple sectors or policy areas would be useful. We do not expect candidates to cover every area; applications are welcomed from economists who bring strong depth in one or more fields and an ability to apply their economics skills across unfamiliar topics.

job.name: Senior Information Security Analyst
job.description:
At Rocket India, security isn't a checkbox — it's a cornerstone of everything we build. Our Security Operations Center stands guard 24/7, ensuring that the technology powering millions of homeownership dreams stays resilient against evolving threats. As a Senior Information Security Analyst, you won't just respond to incidents — you'll shape how we detect, investigate, and neutralize them. You'll mentor the next generation of analysts, drive measurable improvements in detection quality, and serve as the calm, decisive voice when the pressure is highest. If you're ready to lead from the front lines and leave the SOC stronger than you found it, we want to talk.

About The Role You'll operate as a senior technical leader within the SOC — owning complex investigations, driving high-severity incidents to resolution, and elevating the capability of the entire team. Here's what that looks like:

  • Lead end-to-end investigation of complex, multi-vector security incidents across endpoint, identity, email, network, and cloud telemetry, including P1 and P2 events
  • Serve as the incident commander or primary investigator on high-severity incidents, coordinating cross-functional response efforts with ThreatOps, SecOps Engineering, IT, and application teams
  • Reconstruct detailed attack timelines and determine blast radius by correlating diverse telemetry sources, producing executive-ready incident summaries

job.description:
Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Databricks)

Location: Noida / Gurugram, hybrid (may move to office-based as the team grows)

Experience: 5 to 8 years overall, including 4+ years building and running ML models in production

Notice period: Immediate joiners only (can join within 15 days). Candidates currently serving notice are welcome to apply.

About Inferova Technologies

Inferova Technologies builds and deploys production-grade AI systems for enterprises.

The role

This is a client-facing role. You will work directly with an enterprise client's business and technical teams, and be the ML owner they rely on.

You will own models end to end: problem framing, feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring and retraining. Building a good model is half the job. Keeping it accurate in production, and keeping the client confident in it, is the other half.

Databricks on Azure is the centre of this role.

What you'll own

  • Work with client stakeholders to understand the business problem, agree success metrics and translate them into an ML approach.
  • Develop, train and tune ML models on Databricks using Python and PySpark.
  • Build feature pipelines on Delta Lake, with experiment tracking and model versioning in MLflow and Unity Catalog.
  • Deploy models for batch and real-time inference.
  • Build monitoring for data drift, concept drift, prediction drift and data quality, with thresholds, alerts and dashboards.
  • Define retraining triggers and automate retraining, validation and rollback.
  • Set up CI/CD for ML using Git and Azure DevOps, with reproducible runs and reliable promotion across environments.
  • Diagnose production issues to root cause, and present results, model behaviour and trade-offs to client teams in regular reviews.

What you'll bring

  • 5 to 8 years of experience, with 4+ years in hands-on ML model development and production deployment.
  • 3+ years of hands-on Databricks experience on Azure: Workflows, Delta Lake and MLflow, with exposure to Unity Catalog.
  • Experience with ADF and Azure DevOps.
  • Strong Python, PySpark and SQL.
  • Solid ML fundamentals: feature engineering, model selection, evaluation, tuning, handling imbalance and leakage.
  • Practical model monitoring experience: drift detection (PSI, KS test, feature distribution checks), performance decay and alerting.
  • Working knowledge of MLOps: CI/CD, Git, Docker, model registry and reproducibility.
  • Experience working directly with clients or business stakeholders, and the communication skills to explain model behaviour, risks and trade-offs to a non-technical audience.

Good to have

  • Databricks certification (ML Professional or Data Engineer).
  • Databricks Model Serving, Lakehouse Monitoring or Feature Store experience.
  • AWS experience.
  • Consulting or services background with enterprise clients.
  • A story of a model you rescued in production, backed by numbers.

job.name: Michigan Psychoneuroimmunology Lab Manager
job.description:
How to Apply

A detailed cover letter is required for consideration when applying for this position and should be uploaded via the UM Careers website as the first page(s) of a single, electronic document of application materials that also includes your CV or resume. The cover letter should address your specific interest in the position and outline your skills and experience that directly relate to the duties described below.

Job Summary The Michigan Psychoneuroimmunology (PNI) Lab , directed by Dr. Annelise Madison in the Department of Psychology, is seeking a Lab Manager (Research Technician Senior). Our lab studies how mental health and immune function shape one another, and how these mind body links affect people living with immune-related disorders such as cancer. We study both healthy and clinical populations using psychosocial stressors and immune stimuli, psychosocial interviews and surveys, blood draws, longitudinal designs, and wearable devices and mobile technology.

Supported by several recent awards, including a Brain & Behavior Research Foundation Young Investigator Grant, a Rogel Discovery Award, and an Eisenberg Family Depression Center Impact Grant, current projects include studying inflammation and depression in cancer patients receiving CAR-T cell immunotherapy; using wearables and mobile technology to track psychological stress in real time, including among patients awaiting biopsy results; and examining how people respond to uncertainty, social threat, and psychological challenges in interactive environments.

The PNI lab has existed for three years, and as such, has developed protocols to run efficiently pertaining to studies' recruitment, onboarding, data collection, and data analysis, as well as operations in the wet lab, and manuals for how the PNI Lab conducts itself on a day to day basis. Lab values include teamwork, initiative, excellence, and integrity, and we have a positive and energetic lab culture comprised of about 10 undergraduate research assistants and four graduate students. We are committed to a welcoming, inclusive, and collaborative lab culture where members support one another's growth and success. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply, including those historically underrepresented in psychological science.

The Lab Manager will recruit, train, and manage research assistants; coordinate study setup and operations (recruitment, onboarding, data collection, data management, visit scheduling and staffing); oversee protocol development for study execution; prepare and manage IRB submissions; oversee day-to-day lab operations;

For more information about the Michigan PNI Lab please visit: Michigan Psychoneuroimmunology Lab.

For immediate consideration call Jimmy Tunney at 517-657-8054.

  • The ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues across different areas of the business.

job.name: IT Sourcing Consultant 2 – Medicaid MES/MMIS
job.description:
IT Sourcing Consultant 2 Medicaid MES/MMIS

Work Location: Lansing, Michigan Area

Work Arrangement: Hybrid Monday and Tuesday are mandatory in-office days

Assignment Duration: Projected through April 30, 2027, with possible extension based on business needs

Education: Bachelor's Degree Required

Experience Required: 10+ Years of IT Sourcing Consulting Experience

Candidate Location: Local candidates preferred within 150 miles of Lansing, Michigan.

Job Overview The IT Sourcing Consultant 2 will lead the development and execution of complex IT sourcing strategies and provide consulting support to address business and technology challenges.

The role focuses on Medicaid Enterprise Systems (MES) and Medicaid Management Information Systems (MMIS), including market research, vendor analysis, cost evaluation, and sourcing strategy development.

The consultant will support a Medicaid MMIS procurement project by conducting a comprehensive Analysis of Alternatives (AoA) and Cost Benefit Analysis (CBA). This includes evaluating potential procurement approaches, total cost of ownership, implementation timelines, business impacts, vendor capabilities, and industry trends across other states.

The selected consultant must translate research and market findings into clear recommendations, decision matrices, risk assessments, and executive-level presentations for stakeholder and CMS review.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and execution of complex IT sourcing strategies for assigned projects.
  • Consult with business owners and stakeholders to identify IT business challenges and develop sourcing approaches.
  • Conduct market research and develop sourcing scopes, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Research and evaluate vendor capabilities, pricing models, implementation approaches, and performance across multiple states.
  • Gather industry benchmarks and information on other states' Medicaid MMIS operational and procurement investments.
  • Evaluate Medicaid Enterprise Systems, MMIS platforms, major vendors, modernization initiatives, and current market trends.
  • Develop Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and Cost Benefit Analysis (CBA) for proposed MMIS alternatives.
  • Support CMS-required Analysis of Alternatives (AoA) and cost-benefit documentation.
  • Evaluate procurement alternatives, including full system replacement, partial replacement, and Maintenance and Operations (M&O) takeover.
  • Assess potential timelines, costs, business impacts, and market conditions for each alternative.
  • Proactively manage customer expectations through timely communication with stakeholders and senior management.
  • Prepare recommendations, decision matrices, risk assessments, and executive-level briefing materials.
  • Conduct post-project lessons-learned reviews to support knowledge transfer and customer satisfaction.

Project Background

THE JOB The role of Pricing Specialist manages a portfolio of events and is responsible for implementing a pricing strategy commensurate with client goals for inventory of premium tickets. This includes market research to develop a unique plan for each client, and management of clients with updates and price adjustments throughout an event’s sales cycle. This position requires client-facing interaction to help build the client relationship. This position will research market trends and work within various technology platforms to make price adjustments and report on sales. In addition, this role will be responsible for recommending front-end and back-end enhancements to improve the efficiency and display of tickets and ensure our offering is cutting edge and delivering maximum value to Artists and promoters. job.description:
How to Apply

A cover letter is required for consideration for this position and should be attached as the first page of your resume. The cover letter should address your specific interest in the position and outline skills and experience that directly relate to this position.

Job Summary The Business Process Consultant Intermediate is a member of the OAS Project Management Office (PMO) and reports to the Administrative Director, Operations, Ancillary Services and Safety. This is a versatile role. The consultant is assigned to one or more OAS departments and leads process improvement and rollout, project management, and data and reporting work. Process Improvement and Implementation (35%)

Project Coordination (25%)

  • Monitor the quality, accuracy and integrity of departmental data and records.

Department and PMO Support (15%)

  • Design and maintain operational processes and tools for assigned departments, such as scheduling, tracking and audit programs.
  • Maintain departmental SharePoint sites and information repositories, and support committees through agendas, minutes and action tracking.
  • Support department-specific program activities as assigned, which may include regulatory documentation, exercises and time-sensitive operational events.

We are wholly committed to the conservation of the environment while also sustainably developing and manufacturing a comprehensive line of acoustical fiberglass insulation for residential, commercial, industrial, marine, OEM and metal building applications, using post-consumer recycled materials.

Analyze processes and product data provided by Process Technicians, Production Superintendents, and others. Identify and support the direction of process improvements while maintaining parameters that are currently in place.

What You'll Do

  • Perform technical analyses of manufacturing and process data related to curing, sizing, facing, and packaging

  • Identify recommendations to enhance manufacturing capabilities through new ideas and/or methods
  • Participate in projects and/or assist project sub-teams involved in process and product optimization, innovation, cost reduction, or other related business activities
  • Under the supervision of the Manager, Process Engineering, execute projects to fulfill department goals and objectives in the areas of cost reduction, productivity gains, process flow, capacity increases, scrap reduction, and process and product enhancements
  • Maintain process set points and control for curing, sizing, facing, and packaging
  • Participate in activities with other Process Engineers and Corporate functions
  • Review all new product requests and approve them based on plant capabilities
  • Maintain all data pertinent to the process, including KIMS requirements and upkeep of records

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Chemical, or Ceramic Engineering or a related field

job.name: Lead Continuous Improvement Specialist, Standards and Strategic Initiatives
job.description:
Domino’s Pizza, which began in 1960 as a single store location in Ypsilanti, MI, has had a lot to celebrate lately: we’re a reshaped, reenergized brand of honesty, transparency and accountability – not to mention, great food! In the rise to becoming a true technology leader, the brand is now consistently one of the top five companies in online transactions and 65% of our sales in the U.S. are taken through digital channels. The brand continues to ‘deliver the dream’ to local business owners, 90% of which started as delivery drivers and pizza makers in our stores. That’s just the tip of the iceberg…or as we might say, one “slice” of the pie! If this sounds like a brand you’d like to be a part of, consider joining our team!

Job Description The Lead Specialist, Standards and Strategic Initiatives works with center and functional teams to understand how work is performed today, remove unnecessary steps, improve flow, and establish practical standards that can be used consistently across the network.

The position also helps turn new Supply Chain initiatives into clear, repeatable ways of working. Working across Continuous Improvement, operations, training, technology, project teams, and functional owners, the Lead Specialist supports initiatives from early design through rollout and sustainment while ensuring processes are documented, scalable, and supported by clear ownership and measures.

What You’ll Do Supply Chain Center Process Playbook

  • Build and maintain a practical playbook for Supply Chain Center processes.
  • Document current processes through direct observation, center input, process mapping, and review of existing standards.
  • Analyze process steps, handoffs, controls, and variation to identify opportunities to simplify work, reduce waste, and improve flow.
  • Partner with operators, center leaders, subject matter experts, and functional owners to design improved future-state processes.
  • Standardize the strongest proven methods across centers while accounting for valid operational, regulatory, and facility differences.
  • Create the supporting standard work, process maps, job aids, measures, ownership, and review cadence needed to sustain each process.
  • Use center feedback and performance results to refine the playbook as equipment, systems, and business needs change.

Strategic Initiative Support

  • Partner with initiative owners to understand the business need, scope, expected outcomes, and impact on Supply Chain.
  • Coordinate the operational work required to move new initiatives from design through pilot, rollout, and sustainment.
  • Build and maintain implementation plans that identify milestones, decisions, risks, dependencies, and owners.
  • Bring the right partners together to resolve gaps in process, training, systems, labor, communication, or center readiness.
  • Support pilots and early launches, capture lessons learned, and apply improvements before broader deployment.

job.name: Staff / Principal Offensive Security Engineer
job.description:
Hiring for Lean SuperIntelligence — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

LSI (Lean SuperIntelligence) is a security AI lab building self-improving cybersecurity LLMs. LSI-Offense-1 finds, exploits and validates vulnerabilities; LSI-Defense-1 detects, investigates and responds to attacks. The two train against each other inside LSI Cyber World Models, realistic instrumented enterprise environments where every outcome is verified, and they run on-prem or air-gapped inside the enterprise that owns them.

LSI is founded by the team behind India's first sovereign LLM and AI labs at Alexa, Uber AI and Salesforce Research, with elite security researchers, and is backed by Accel, Fusion Fund, SVQ, Inventus Capital and Dreamit Ventures, plus angels who led AI and security at OpenAI, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne and Zscaler.

About the Role

You are the attacker in LSI's self-play loop. You will turn what elite pentesters, red teamers and vulnerability researchers do into the environments, tasks, rewards and evaluations that make LSI's offense model find, prove and fix real vulnerabilities at machine scale.

This is not a consulting or corporate red-team seat. Your targets are the models: you decide which attack paths are worth teaching, design the labs they learn in, judge whether a finding is real, and own how offensive capability is measured. Level (Staff or Principal) is set by scope and track record.

What you'll do

  • Set the technical direction and evaluation strategy for how the offense model finds, exploits, validates and remediates vulnerabilities.
  • Build realistic, instrumented labs and ranges: vulnerable apps, cloud and Kubernetes estates, CI/CD pipelines, enterprise Active Directory networks and agentic / MCP-based systems.
  • Design multi-stage kill chains mapped to MITRE ATT&CK that emulate real threat-actor tradecraft, not toy CTFs.
  • Turn tradecraft into training signal: tools, harnesses, task curricula, reward functions and expert trajectories, and define what a proven finding means (working PoC, reachable sink, verified patch).
  • Triage model output, separate real vulnerabilities from noise, and extend contamination-resistant offensive benchmarks (CyberGym-style reproduction, AIxCC-style find-and-fix, network ranges).
  • Generate adversary-simulation campaigns that train the defense model, run design-partner pilots and coordinate responsible disclosure.

What you bring

job.name: Kafka Administrator
job.description:
Location: Hyderabad

Experience: 5–7 Years

Openings: 1

About The Role We are looking for an experienced Kafka Administrator with 5–7 years of experience in managing, monitoring, and optimizing enterprise Apache Kafka environments. The candidate should have strong hands-on expertise in Kafka cluster administration, broker management, security, performance tuning, and production support. The role involves maintaining highly available Kafka environments and collaborating with development teams to ensure reliable data streaming operations.

Job Description The Kafka Administrator will be responsible for administering Kafka clusters across development, UAT, and production environments, ensuring platform stability, performance, and availability.

The role involves managing Kafka infrastructure, implementing security configurations, monitoring cluster performance, troubleshooting production issues, and supporting Kafka Connect integrations. The candidate will also contribute to automation, disaster recovery, capacity planning, and operational improvements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, administer, and maintain Apache Kafka clusters across multiple environments.
  • Manage Kafka brokers, topics, partitions, replicas, consumer groups, and offsets.
  • Monitor cluster health, consumer lag, throughput, disk utilization, and replication status.
  • Perform Kafka upgrades, patching, capacity planning, scaling, and performance tuning.
  • Troubleshoot broker failures, under-replicated partitions, connectivity issues, partition imbalance, and network latency.
  • Configure Kafka security using SSL/TLS, SASL, ACLs, and authentication and authorization mechanisms.
  • Support Kafka Connect, troubleshoot connector issues, and collaborate with development teams on producer and consumer application problems.
  • Implement monitoring and automation using Prometheus, Grafana, Confluent Control Center, Splunk, Shell scripting, Python, or Ansible.
  • Participate in production incident management, root cause analysis, disaster recovery, and high-availability support.
  • Maintain operational documentation, SOPs, deployment procedures, and troubleshooting guides.

Required Skills

  • Apache Kafka Administration
  • Kafka cluster, broker, topic, partition, and replication management.
  • Kafka security: SSL/TLS, SASL, and ACLs.
  • Kafka Connect and consumer group management.
  • Kafka monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
  • Production support and incident management.
  • Monitoring tools: Prometheus, Grafana, Confluent Control Center, or Splunk.
  • Shell scripting, Python, or Ansible automation.
  • High availability and disaster recovery concepts.

Mandatory Skills

  • Kafka

job.name: DEVELOPER L4
job.description:
Job description:

Job Description

Role Purpose

The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters

͏

Do

1. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software

  • Develop software solutions by studying information needs, studying systems flow, data usage and work processes
  • Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
  • Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
  • Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
  • Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
  • Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
  • Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities

͏

2. Perform coding and ensure optimal software/ module development

  • Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, software development and proposed software
  • Develop and automate processes for software validation by setting up and designing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases
  • Modifying software to fix errors, adapt it to new hardware, improve its performance, or upgrade interfaces.
  • Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system
  • Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
  • Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
  • Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns
  • Compile timely, comprehensive and accurate documentation and reports as requested
  • Coordinating with the team on daily project status and progress and documenting it
  • Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned stakeholders

͏

3. Status Reporting and Customer Focus on an ongoing basis with respect to project and its execution

Read the full description

job.description:
Project Role : Application Support Engineer

Project Role Description : Act as software detectives, provide a dynamic service identifying and solving issues within multiple components of critical business systems.

Must have skills : Cloud Data Integration

Good to have skills : DevOps, Apache Kafka, Google Cloud Platform Architecture

Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary:

As an Application Support Engineer, a typical day involves acting as a software detective by proactively monitoring and diagnosing issues across various components of essential business systems. This role requires a dynamic approach to identifying problems, analyzing system behaviors, and ensuring smooth operation of critical applications. The position demands continuous engagement with multiple teams to maintain system stability and support business continuity through effective troubleshooting and resolution strategies.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Design, build, configure, and support production workflows using Google Cloud Composer and Apache Airflow.

Help with debugging DAGs, operators, integrations, and workflow.

Implement and manage infrastructure using Terraform, following enterprise standards for reusable modules, configuration management, security, and environment promotion.

Configure, administer, maintain, and troubleshoot API gateways, with emphasis on Google Apigee.

Support Confluent Cloud and Kafka-based integration capabilities, including configuration, connectivity, monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational readiness.

Plan and execute installation, configuration, upgrades, patching, and lifecycle management for integration products and services running on Google Cloud Platform.

Configure, manage, troubleshoot, and optimize integration platforms such as MuleSoft, API gateways, message brokers, EDI solutions, and related technologies.

Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for owned solutions using GitHub Actions and related DevOps practices.

Implement monitoring dashboards, alerting, logging, tracing, and other observability capabilities across owned services and workflows.

Design and implement disaster-recovery, backup, recovery, and business-continuity strategies for owned technology stacks.

Identify and automate manual processes, improve data delivery, and increase scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency.

Translate strategy and architecture into secure, highly available technical implementations aligned with enterprise standards and best practices.

Collaborate with product, application, data engineering, analytics, and support teams to understand requirements and deliver effective platform solutions.

Participate in incident response, root-cause analysis, problem management, and continuous improvement activities.

job.description:
Bring more to life. Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

Within Danaher the work our Life Science businesses do saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact. And at Pall Corporation, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

We have over 21,000 associates across more than 10 life sciences businesses. These businesses empower our customers to develop diverse and impactful innovations — from investigating the causes of disease, creating therapies and vaccines, protecting fluid filtration on airplanes, testing food and water, to advancing pharmaceuticals and biopharmaceuticals.

As a global leader in high-tech filtration, separation, and purification, Pall Corporation thrives on helping our customers solve their toughest challenges. Our products serve diverse, global customer needs across a wide range of applications to advance health, safety and environmentally responsible technologies. From airplane engines to hydraulic systems, scotch to smartphones, OLED screens to paper—everyday Pall is there, helping protect critical operating assets, improve product quality, minimize emissions and waste, and safeguard health. For the exponentially curious, Pall is a place where you can thrive and amplify your impact on the world. Find what drives you on a team with a more than 75-year history of discovery, determination, and innovation.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Compliance Auditing & Monitoring Analyst role supports the execution and continuous improvement of Life Sciences compliance monitoring programs, with a focus on Anti-Bribery and Anti-Corruption (ABAC) and Healthcare Compliance (HCC). The role helps evaluate key compliance controls, conduct monitoring and testing activities, support third-party and channel partner reviews, document observations, and track remediation efforts to strengthen the effectiveness of the compliance program.

This position reports to the Sr. Manager, Compliance Monitoring and Data Analytics and is part of the Compliance team located in India and will be fully remote.

job.name: AVP - Equities - P&L Production - APAC
job.description:
Job Title: AVP - Equities - P&L Production - APAC

Department : P&L and Valuations

About Business line/Function: Global Market Operations also known as COE (Center of Excellence) is further divided into multiple departments i.e. Listed Derivatives Transaction Processing, Securities Transaction Processing, Prime and US Markets Transaction Processing, FXMM & OTCD Transaction Processing, Transversal Lifecycle Support, Collateral & TFLM and Valuations & Transversal Services.

Within Valuations & Transversal Services, Valuation Controls (VC) is a global function whose main missions are articulated around second level control hubs in Europe, Asia and the Americas.

The P&L production chain encompasses the processes of production, control and reporting of Economic P&L. By economic P&L, we refer to both Official P&L and P&L Explain; and when we only refer to P&L Explain, we refer to both P&L Explain Step Revaluation (P&L SRE) and P&L Explain Risk Based (P&L RBE) owned by P&L Control.

Position Purpose

  • Provide a daily Economic, Step Reval and Risk Based PNL to each desk and to the Bank’s management.
  • Ensure that the PNL is calculated from the reference positions and that these positions are real and checked.
  • Escalate any unusual P&L to the desk and management that may indicate a wrong position or transaction in the FO system.
  • Run all the required controls on key elements of the PNL
  • Document all exceptional PNL moves and adjustments for Management.

Responsibilities Direct Responsibilities

  • Produce accurate daily analysis of P&Ls to Trading desks and bank management. This includes the 3 different P&L analysis required by the internal Valuation Policy and Regulators:
  • Economic P&L (cash + PV) for Management and Accounting P&L reconciliation (performed by Finance)
  • Step Reval P&L for VaR back-testing feeds and contribution to Regulatory ratios (used in the Dodd Franck and French Banking Law ratio calculations)
  • Risk based P&L to validate the FO risk and models.
  • Responsible for daily and monthly controls on key elements (positions, market data, adjustments, reserves) and liaise with internal departments in case of issues.
  • Perform FO/MO reconciliations between Trading P&L estimations at T and Official MO P&L at T+ 1 and both explain and investigate P&L breaks to FO if any.
  • Adjust the P&L if necessary to secure correct P&L reporting and document each
  • Monitor daily Funding and fees.
  • Interact daily with traders to explain the results of their P&Ls and seek their daily sign-off.
  • Report, Comment and Validate the P&Ls into the Official Reporting tool
  • Monitor and reconcile monthly R-IM and V&RC reserves during EOM process.
  • Active follow up on updating documentation.
  • Organize a monthly meeting with trading to go through all P&L issues during the last month.
  • Escalate issues to management on the fly and via Orus.
  • Confirm PV to dependent team/business.

Contributing Responsibilities

About Central Square Foundation Established in 2012, Central Square Foundation (CSF) is a non-profit organisation dedicated to enhancing the learning outcomes of all school-going children across India through system-led reforms. As a catalytic enabler, our initiatives span innovation and policy to practice and focus on learning impact at scale across 14 states.

At the heart of our mission is our strategic focus on Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN) , which drives our collaborative efforts with 11 state governments to design and execute statewide FLN missions. We are deeply committed to Early Childhood Education (ECE) reforms, recognising the critical role it plays in laying a strong groundwork for children's learning journey, thereby augmenting FLN outcomes. Additionally, we prioritise EdTech integration, aiming to deploy digital solutions for in-class and at-home learning and establish evidence-based practices while also tapping into the potential of artificial intelligence (AI) to augment learning outcomes. We also work for School Governance , extending our system-level approach to children in both private and government schools, to strengthen the country's education landscape and High Potential Students to support India's bright young minds from underprivileged backgrounds in becoming future innovators, researchers and leaders.

Learn more about CSF on the website ( http://www.centralsquarefoundation.org ) About The Policy And Communications Team (PAC) At CSF, PAC's role is to build salience around CSF's key thematic areas and strengthen the organisation's position as a thought-leader in India's school education sector. The PAC team operates horizontally, closely collaborating with various program teams at CSF.

job.description:
Role: Associate Product Manager Location: Gurgaon About The Function MMT Growth & Commons Function at MakeMyTrip is responsible for building common product experiences for our users such as Homepage, Cross-sell products, Loyalty program, Login & Onboarding, Wallet, Offers, and so on. This team focuses on growth — be it new user acquisition, activating never-transacted customers, retention, etc. As a horizontal product team in the organization, the team works with all other business units very closely to deliver seamless and scalable user experiences.

About The Role The Associate Product Manager role in the Growth & Commons team at MakeMyTrip is a high impact, strategic position at the core of our platform experience. This role is central to shaping critical, high-traffic user journeys—from the Homepage and Login to Wallets, Offers, and our Loyalty Program—touchpoints that influence the experience of every MakeMyTrip user.

This role plays a pivotal part in driving MakeMyTrip’s growth charter, with direct influence on key levers such as new user acquisition, user activation, retention, and cross-sell effectiveness. As a part of a mature, scaled platform serving millions over 25+ years, this role requires a nuanced balance of creative product thinking, user empathy, and data rigor.

Operating at the intersection of user experience, platform design, and business growth, the position offers the opportunity to reimagine foundational user flows in online travel. It demands strong ownership, cross-functional influence, and a mindset tuned toward long-term impact and platform scalability.

What Will You Be Doing

  • Own the Product Lifecycle: Drive end-to-end product development—from discovery and conceptualization to launch and ongoing enhancements.
  • Define the Roadmap: Shape and manage the product roadmap aligned with business goals and user needs.
  • Build Cross-Functional Alignment: Work closely with engineering, design, marketing, and other stakeholders to translate product vision into executable plans.
  • Drive Continuous Improvement: Analyze product performance post-launch, gather feedback, and iterate to enhance user experience and business impact.
  • Identify Growth Opportunities: Conduct market research and competitive analysis to uncover emerging trends and whitespace opportunities.
  • Translate Ideas into Action: Develop detailed product requirements, including user stories, wireframes, and specifications.
  • Validate with Users: Support user testing and feedback loops to ensure the product resonates with real-world use cases.
  • Measure Success: Define and track key product metrics (KPIs) to evaluate performance and guide future decisions.
  • Stay Ahead of the Curve: Keep abreast of industry trends, best practices, and evolving technologies to inform product strategy.

job.name: Specialist - Aviation Strategic Advisory
job.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Your impact

The Specialist - Aviation Strategic Advisory will lead the development and delivery of strategic advisory services for airports, governments, investors, airport operators, and infrastructure developers. The role will support clients in making informed decisions on airport development, expansion, investment, commercialization, privatization, airport city development, and long-term aviation growth strategies.

The position will work closely with Jacobs' Aviation Planning, Infrastructure, Urban Development/Cities, and Solution Center teams to provide integrated solutions across the airport development lifecycle while supporting the growth of Jacobs' Aviation Advisory business.

Key Responsibilities Strategic Advisory

  • Lead aviation strategy, airport development, and business planning assignments.
  • Advise clients on airport growth, capacity expansion, and long-term development strategies.
  • Develop airport city, aerotropolis, and land development strategies.
  • Support aviation policy, market assessment, and infrastructure planning studies.
  • Provide strategic recommendations to airport operators, governments, and investors.

Commercial & Investment Advisory

  • Support airport privatization, PPP, concession, and transaction advisory assignments.
  • Develop business cases, investment assessments, and growth strategies.
  • Evaluate commercial opportunities, land monetization, and non-aeronautical revenue initiatives.
  • Conduct strategic due diligence and investment attractiveness assessments.

Market & Economic Analysis

  • Lead aviation market studies, traffic forecasts, catchment assessments, and benchmarking exercises.
  • Assess airport competitiveness, connectivity, and economic impact.
  • Support scenario planning and long-term demand assessments.

Client Engagement & Business Development

  • Develop and maintain relationships with key aviation stakeholders.
  • Support proposal preparation, pursuits, and client presentations.
  • Identify and develop new aviation advisory opportunities.
  • Represent Jacobs at client workshops, industry forums, and strategic engagements.

Project Leadership

  • Manage multidisciplinary project teams and advisory assignments.
  • Ensure quality, commercial performance, and timely delivery of projects.
  • Mentor and support the development of junior team members.

Key Clients

  • Airport Operators and Developers
  • Government and Civil Aviation Authorities
  • Infrastructure Funds and Investors

  • Airlines and Aviation Stakeholders
  • Multilateral Agencies and Financial Institutions
