job.description:
About The Role Grade Level (for internal use): 09

The Team Our analyst teams in London, Dallas, Gurgaon, and Singapore serve over 300 institutional investors, covering notable names in start-up, growth, mature, and distressed markets across the globe. Since inception in 2014, the Private Equity business has been among the fastest-growing areas within the firm. The team values collaboration, expertise, and innovation, and is looking for a driven valuations analyst to support its future product growth.

Responsibilities And Impact

  • Perform valuations on a wide range of illiquid investments across industries and geographies using accepted and relevant approaches and theory.
  • Present analyses and conclusions, including written reports, and handle valuation queries from clients.
  • Contribute to the design and enhancement of financial models used to perform valuations.
  • Work with management to build and maintain client relationships.
  • Attend relevant industry events to broaden knowledge and experience within the alternative asset industry.
  • Engage in research to value early-stage private companies, unicorns, and illiquid debt portfolios.

What We’re Looking For Basic Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years’ experience working in a valuations role.
  • Qualified accountant or CFA charter holder (or in process of obtaining qualification) preferred.
  • Solid experience constructing and reviewing valuation models and other financial models including DCF, comparable company/bond, and other intangible asset models.
  • Experience managing delivery of valuations and provision of responses to price challenges.
  • Knowledge of software packages including MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

Key Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively within a global team.
  • Strong client relationship management skills.

Additional Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the alternative asset industry (private equity, hedge funds, asset managers, banks).
  • Exposure to technology projects to enhance valuation product quality and depth.

Our team of experts delivers unrivaled insights and leading data and technology solutions, partnering with customers to expand their perspective, operate with confidence, and make decisions with conviction.

job.description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our Career Consulting team at Mercer, a business of Marsh . This role will be based in Gurgaon. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.

Associate - Compensation Consulting Role of Associate in the Career (Rewards) Consulting Practice. The role is responsible for leading the projects and delivery of rewards benchmarking and design related engagements for clients in an identified industry or set of industries. The growth and POV creation for the industry will be an important responsibility of this role as well as generation of revenue through new and existing clients. Developing strong working relationships with key people in the client organizations and advising them on Rewards and Benefits; Providing ongoing support to clients in data interpretation; Review survey data and reports and provide sign-offs; Proactively engage with key clients (existing and prospective) to identify opportunities and form long-term sustainable relationships with them and partnering with internal stakeholders like Survey Operations with the objective of delivering world class rewards consulting and products to our clients.

We will count on you to:

  • As an industry/segment leader, you will drive Mercer’s footprint in the attached industry, create content and share POV with clients, thereby establishing yourself as a go-to-person for the said industry, its construct, roles and rewards focus areas.
  • Actively engage in business development by independently engaging with key people in prospective clients and identifying opportunities for building a long- term, sustainable relationship;
  • Achieve greater footptint in the industry by increasing number of paid participants in Industry Total Remuneration survey (as applicable) over previous year; Win projects with new clients; Win new clients for participating in the survey of the assigned industry
  • Develop a deep understanding of rewards trends in specific industries; Establish self as a go-to person for rewards in the specific industry; Form a point of view on rewards practices to provide appropriate consulting advice to clients
  • Proactively identify opportunities to win repeat business or multi-year contracts from existing clients; Establish a regular channel of communication with existing clients; Host networking events for clients and share Mercer researches in relevant areas
  • Deliver revenue budget basis the industry numbers & by product category, along with a team of industry aligned consultants.
  • Monitor revenue and sales pipeline versus budgets on a regular basis for the assigned industry; Raise invoices and analyze data on collections and sales pipeline and guide Consultants accordingly
  • Build & manage client base through retention of annuity clients as well as new client acquisition
  • Ensure successful delivery of projects thorough effective project management & service delivery
  • Build market

job.name: Senior Project Consultant - Business Consulting PI - TMT - CNS - BC - FINANCE - New Delhi
Senior Officer - Costing
job.description:
Main Purpose of Job: Perform Costing activities for several company codes within Nestlé in the Market including sanity checks and production of timely, accurate and relevant cost data and analysis.

First level support to customers: Monitor common mailbox for customer requests, and contribute to the issues resolution and questions related answering to the assigned focus area on a daily basis, during PEC & TP activities

Maintain Costing Master Data (Cost Center, Material Master Data and Assessments)

Perform Costing related and Pre-PEC Health Checks

Peform activities for actual cost calculation during monthly PEC

Perform all necessary health checks and reconciliation to ensure quality of data provided with agreed timelines

Execution of Budget and DF activities, ensuring accurate information

Perform monthly/quarterly reports

Monitor the application of service level agreement (SLAs) and indicators of services (KPIs); analyse and share periodic reports

Participate to the design of process flow at CCC level and identify continuous improvement and internal control points

Perform Ad Hoc projects in regard to costing function (ex. new plants)

Perform Ad Hoc cost analysis for the needs of businesses/functional controllers

Participate in the implementation of new costing functionalities, tools and solutions (ex. PCM)

We are Nestlé, the largest food and beverage company. We are 308,000 employees strong driven by the purpose of enhancing the quality of life and contributing to a healthier future. Our values are rooted in respect: respect for ourselves, respect for others, respect for diversity and respect for our future. With more than CHF 91.4 billion sales in 2018, we have an expansive presence with 413 factories in more than 85 countries. We believe our people are our most important asset, so we'll offer you a dynamic inclusive international working environment with many opportunities across different businesses, functions and geographies, working with diverse teams and cultures. Want to learn more? Visit us at www.nestle.com.

Nestlé is committed to the accessibility of its recruitment process. If you require an adaptation during the recruitment process, please talk to your recruiter so we can support you effectively. All information will be treated confidentially.

Nestlé is committed to providing equal opportunities without any discrimination on the grounds of age, color, disability, origin, nationality, religion, race, gender, or sexual orientation. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity at our company. For any reasonable accommodation in the recruitment process for persons with disabilities, kindly reach out to your recruiter. Reasonable accommodation includes any appropriate modifications to ensure that persons with disabilities are provided an equal platform in the recruitment process.

job.name: Senior Project Consultant - Business Consulting PI - TMT - CNS - BC - FINANCE - New Delhi
job.description:
Requisition Id: 1750632

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it’s your career and ‘It’s yours to build’ which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.

The opportunity : Senior Project Consultant-TMT-Business Consulting PI-CNS - BC - FINANCE - New Delhi

TMT : Industry convergence offers TMT (Technology, Media & Entertainment, and Telecommunications) organizations the chance to evolve and transform, but it also presents challenges around competitiveness and delivering agile corporate strategies for growth. Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now.

We help TMT companies create compelling employee and customer experiences, retaining skills and talent while achieving enterprise-wide operational excellence. We help them protect their data, brand and reputation. We also enable the pursuit of M&A strategies that systematically create value, reduce risk and transform TMT companies into powerhouses that will lead the technology revolution of the future – building a better working world for all.

CNS - BC - FINANCE : EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.

Business Consulting works with clients to reimagine or transform their business purpose and model; create growth; manage cost and efficiency; respond to market pressures and regulation; and resolve operational challenges. The scope of this team encompasses innovation, strategy and purpose, through deep functional experience in business transformation, finance, supply chain and operations, providing support for the complex and large-scale program and portfolio management.

It has multiple fields of play such as:

Finance Consulting - helps assess and transform our clients' finance function to improve performance and effectiveness. We help organizations implement service and cost improvement initiatives, and embed a performance management process and culture that unites the business around its core objectives.

Read the full description

job.name: Senior Staff Engineer (JD Edwards EnterpriseOne CNC Administrator)
job.description:
Company Description 👋🏼We're Nagarro. We are a Digital Product Engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. We work at a scale — across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world (18500+ experts across 39 countries, to be exact). Our work culture is dynamic and non-hierarchical. We are looking for great new colleagues. That is where you come in!

Requirements Job Description

  • Experience : 7.5+ years
  • Strong hands-on experience in JD Edwards EnterpriseOne administration and technical support.
  • In-depth knowledge of Configurable Network Computing (CNC) architecture and administration.
  • Experience administering and maintaining JDE EnterpriseOne environments across Development, QA, UAT and Production.
  • Hands-on experience installing, configuring and supporting JDE Enterprise Servers, Deployment Servers, HTML Servers, AIS Servers, Security Servers and Batch Servers.
  • Strong knowledge of JDE Application Interface Services (AIS), Orchestrator and Business Services (BSSV).
  • Experience managing JDE Tools Releases, upgrades, Electronic Software Updates (ESUs), Application Software Updates (ASUs) and application package deployments.
  • Hands-on experience in building and maintaining JDE path codes, environments, packages and object deployments.
  • Strong understanding of JDE security administration, user roles, menu filtering and access controls.
  • Experience in system monitoring, performance tuning, resource utilization and infrastructure optimization.
  • Experience in server migrations, platform upgrades, environment cloning and infrastructure maintenance.
  • Knowledge of disaster recovery, backup management and business continuity processes.
  • Strong troubleshooting experience across JAS Servers, Enterprise Servers, Security Servers, Workflow, UBEs and kernel processes.
  • Experience in JDE kernel configuration, administration and performance tuning.
  • Knowledge of JDE interoperability, integrations, middleware connectivity and external system interfaces.
  • Experience supporting Orchestrator implementations and integrations with external systems and APIs.
  • Experience managing code migrations, object promotions, package builds and software distribution.
  • Working knowledge of database connectivity and administration involving Oracle, SQL Server or DB2.
  • Strong understanding of production support, incident management, change management and release management processes.
  • Ability to maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams and operational procedures.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication and stakeholder coordination skills.

job.name: Sr DB Engineer - SQL
job.description:
About Clean Harbors Clean Harbors Inc. (www.cleanharbors.com) is a NYSE listed US based $6.5 billion company. Clean Harbors was founded in 1980 near Boston by Mr. Alan S. McKim .

Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 25,000 employees and has over 750 service locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300,000 customers, the Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events in North America of the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in New York, the 2015 avian flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy, and the oil pipeline breaks that affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical releases into the environment.

Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Center (GCC) to serve our parent company. We take pride in serving some of the most tech savvy business stakeholders at Clean Harbors. The GCC employees form part of our globally integrated teams that provide cutting-edge IT solutions and production support across platforms. Our shared services teams work seamlessly with their global counterparts in providing critical 24x7 support in various functions including Finance, HR, Procurement, IT and Operations. Our aggressive growth plans open significant career advancement opportunities for our employees.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain MS SQL databases.
  • Optimize database performance through indexing, query optimization, and other techniques.
  • Handle database archiving and data retention policies.
  • Monitor database performance and troubleshoot issues.
  • Implement and maintain database security measures.
  • Collaborate with development teams to design and implement database solutions.
  • Perform database migrations and upgrades.
  • Develop and maintain documentation for database systems and processes.
  • Provide support for database-related issues and incidents.
  • Stay updated with the latest database technologies and best practices.

Required Skills

  • Strong knowledge in writing and optimizing stored procedures (SPs).
  • Expertise in creating and managing database schemas.
  • Proficiency in SQL and T-SQL.
  • Strong knowledge of database performance optimization techniques.
  • Experience with database archiving and data retention.
  • Familiarity with database security best practices.
  • Experience with SSIS (SQL Server Integration Services) jobs.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

job.name: Manager, Salesforce Development
job.description:
Business Systems | ECI Solutions Hyderabad | On-site

Job Title Manager, Salesforce Development

Location Hyderabad, India — On-site

Work Model On-site, 5 days per week

Department Business Systems / Enterprise Applications (Internal IT)

Reports To Chief Information Officer

Direct Reports 3–6 Salesforce developers and admins (India-based)

Employment Type Full-time, permanent

Experience 9–14 years total; 6+ years hands-on Salesforce development; 2+ years leading a development team

Working Hours India business hours with 2–3 hours of overlap with US Central Time

About Eci Solutions ECI Solutions builds cloud-based business management and ERP software for small and mid-sized companies in manufacturing, distribution, building and construction, and field service. Our Business Systems organisation runs the Salesforce platform that our global sales, revenue and customer support teams depend on every day — a single connected org that sits at the centre of our quote-to-cash and customer-support operations and integrates with our ERP, billing, CPQ, data, and telephony systems.

THE ROLE We are hiring a hands-on Manager, Salesforce Development to run ECI’s Salesforce engineering team in India. This is a player-coach role: roughly 50–60% of your time is spent designing and writing code, and the remainder is spent leading people, setting technical standards, reviewing work, and partnering with stakeholders in the US and Europe.

You will own the technical quality of everything the team ships across Service Cloud and Sales/Revenue Cloud, including the integrations that connect Salesforce to our ERP, billing, and support systems, and the Agentforce and Data Cloud capabilities we are rolling out across service and revenue operations.

This role suits an engineer who is still energised by solving hard platform problems but has grown past wanting to be the only person who can solve them.

Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership

  • Own the technical design of Salesforce solutions across Service Cloud, Sales Cloud and Revenue Cloud, balancing declarative configuration against custom code and documenting the reasoning behind each choice.
  • Set and enforce coding standards, design patterns, naming conventions, test-coverage expectations, and a definition of done for the team.
  • Run code reviews as a teaching exercise, not a gate — raise the team’s ceiling, not just the pull request’s.
  • Guard against technical debt: governor limit risk, hard-coded IDs, uncontrolled triggers, duplicated automation, and sprawling unmanaged Flows.
  • Partner with architects and the US platform team on org strategy, release planning, and Salesforce release readiness (three major releases per year).

Hands-on Delivery

job.name: Applied AI Specialist-Cloud FullStack
job.description:
Introduction A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities As an Applied AI Specialist: Cloud FullStack, you will design, build, and evolve cloud-native and hybrid applications that translate client requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready solutions. This role involves collaborating with digital workers and intelligent agents to deliver solutions, applying an AI-First mindset and following established methodologies.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Solution Design: Designing and building cloud-native and hybrid applications that meet client requirements and are scalable, secure, and production-ready.
  • Application Development: Applying an AI-First mindset to automate scaffolding, dependency management, API definition, and validation, as well as database design and validation.
  • Pipeline Operation: Designing and operating CI/CD and GitOps pipelines with IaC and DevSecOps controls to ensure production readiness and cutover quality.
  • Quality Engineering: Performing unit, module, and functional testing using testing agents and synthetic data to ensure quality and reliability.
  • Incident Resolution: Analyzing logs and stack traces using AI agents to triage and resolve incidents and defects across different phases.

Preferred Education Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Cloud Application Development: Exposure to designing and building cloud-native and hybrid applications that meet client requirements and are scalable, secure, and production-ready.
  • AI-First Mindset: Experience applying AI-First mindset to automate scaffolding, dependency management, API definition, and validation, as well as database design and validation.
  • CI/CD Pipeline Operation: Exposure to designing and operating CI/CD and GitOps pipelines with IaC and DevSecOps controls to ensure production readiness and cutover quality.
  • Quality Assurance: Experience performing unit, module, and functional testing using testing agents and synthetic data to ensure quality and reliability.
  • Hyperscaler Platforms: Exposure to hyperscalers such as AWS, Azure, and Red Hat OpenShift, and deployment models to architect resilient and cost-optimized full-stack and integration patterns.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

job.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

Service line - Position Title: TechOps\_SAP\_ABAP\_Senior\_1,2 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

About Global Delivery Services Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. job.name: Lead Specialist, Solution Architect
job.description:
Job Description - Lead Specialist, Solution Architect

Role: Solution Architect

Division: Pearson Qualifications - Consumer Services

Location: Bangalore or Chennai, India (Hybrid)

About Pearson

Pearson's mission is to "add life to a lifetime of learning." With more than 20,000 employees worldwide, we deliver high-quality, digital-first educational experiences that empower learners and educators. Our teams are passionate about creating accessible, sustainable solutions that drive real-world impact.

About Pearson Qualifications - Consumer Services

Consumer Services creates and operates digital products that help teachers teach and learners build the knowledge, confidence and skills needed to succeed in their qualifications. Our services bring together curriculum-aligned content, learning activities, practice assessment, progress insight and supporting administration for schools, teachers and learners.

The portfolio includes modern cloud-based products alongside established applications that are being simplified, consolidated or retired over time. The architecture role is focused on evolving a coherent consumer product ecosystem, improving integration and operational quality, and supporting the controlled migration of users and capabilities to strategic platforms. This remit is distinct from systems used to administer and deliver qualifications, examinations, marking and certification.

Role Summary

As a Solution Architect, you will shape and oversee solutions across Pearson Qualifications Consumer Services. You will work primarily with modern digital teaching and learning products in the UK Secondary Education market (K-12) and Post-16 Education, while also supporting the safe evolution, integration and retirement of applications across the wider consumer portfolio.

You will translate content, product and business needs into secure, scalable and supportable solution designs, working closely with content, product, engineering, user experience, data, security, service management, and external partners. The role requires strong architecture judgement across customer-facing web applications, APIs, event-driven integration, data, identity, cloud infrastructure and operational readiness.

You will balance strategic direction with pragmatic delivery, assessing reuse before new build, documenting trade-offs, estimating cost and effort, and ensuring functional and non-functional requirements are addressed. Clear communication, constructive challenge and the ability to guide delivery teams through change are essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Solution Architecture Design: Lead end-to-end architecture for consumer-facing digital products and supporting services. Define application, integration, data and deployment views that meet functional and non-functional requirements, sometimes including sovereign data requirements in a highly regulated industry.

Role Summary We are looking for a hands-on Oracle Fusion Cloud technical resource who can design, build, test, and deploy extensions on the Fusion platform.

The primary focus is extensibility (UI, logic, process, and security) with minor customizations in the Supply Chain Management (SCM) space.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical skills with working functional knowledge of SCM processes, and can translate business requirements into maintainable, upgrade-safe extensions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze requirements and design upgrade-safe extensions and minor customizations for Oracle Fusion Cloud, primarily in SCM.
  • Build and maintain extensions using Application Composer, Page Composer, Visual Builder Studio, and related Fusion tooling.
  • Develop Groovy scripts, object functions, triggers, validations, and workflows for custom logic.
  • Configure and extend flexfields (descriptive, extensible, and key), custom objects, and custom fields.
  • Create and modify BI Publisher reports, templates, and data models for business outputs.
  • Build and manage ESS jobs, scheduled processes, and approval rules.
  • Develop integrations and data loads using REST and SOAP APIs, FBDI, HDL, and file-based patterns.
  • Manage the extension lifecycle: sandboxes, configuration sets, change migration across environments (DEV, TEST, UAT, PROD), and quarterly release regression testing.
  • Configure security for extensions: roles, privileges, and data access.
  • Work with SCM functional consultants and business users to validate requirements, test, and support go-live.
  • Prepare technical design documents, unit test evidence, and deployment and support documentation.
  • Support production issues related to extensions and customizations (L2/L3), following ITIL-aligned processes.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience developing extensions on Oracle Fusion Cloud applications.
  • Working knowledge of SCM modules and processes, and the ability to implement minor SCM customizations.
  • Strong understanding of Fusion extensibility principles: what can be done through configuration, what requires an extension, and how to stay upgrade-safe.
  • Experience with quarterly Oracle release cycles and regression impact on extensions.
  • Solid SQL skills and understanding of the Fusion data model.
  • Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills.

Quality and validation (30–40%)

Risk Consulting – AI Governance – Manager The opportunity: your next adventure awaits

Are you a technology savvy risk professional passionate about Responsible AI and eager to help organizations embed trust, ethics, and governance into their AI journeys? EY Risk Consulting is expanding its AI Governance and Responsible AI practice, and we are looking for a manager who can bridge AI technology, risk management, and governance to create meaningful impact for our clients.

In this client facing role, you will work with global organizations to operationalize Responsible AI, design and assess AI governance frameworks, evaluate AI/ML risks at a use case level, and test the effectiveness of controls. You will help clients move from high level AI principles to real, on the ground implementation, backed by robust risk assessments, root cause analysis, and actionable recommendations.

The role As a Manager within Risk Consulting – AI Governance, you will lead complex engagements at the intersection of risk management, AI/ML, and Responsible AI. You will advise clients on how AI principles (fairness, transparency, accountability, safety, robustness, privacy) are embedded across the AI lifecycle and how governance, controls, and assurance mechanisms are established and tested.

This role is ideal for professionals who either:

  • Bring strong Risk Management experience with Responsible AI, OR
  • Have hands on AI/ML experience with Responsible AI operationalization, including root cause analysis and solutioning.

Your Key Responsibilities Client Advisory & Delivery

  • Lead and deliver AI Governance and Responsible AI engagements, ensuring high quality outcomes within timelines and budgets.
  • Advise clients on embedding Responsible AI principles across the AI lifecycle—from ideation and design to deployment and monitoring.
  • Design, assess, and implement AI governance frameworks, policies, standards, and operating models.
  • Perform AI use case–level risk assessments, identifying ethical, regulatory, operational, model, data, and technology risks.
  • Define risk and control matrices (RCMs) for AI/ML systems aligned to leading frameworks and regulations.
  • Test the design and operating effectiveness of AI controls, including governance, model risk, data, security, and monitoring controls.

The TVM team performs security assessments, vulnerability research, guides and advises mitigation strategies, and coordinates the response to zero-day and other urgent vulnerabilities. We ensure the security of the software and hardware that runs our cloud and non-cloud infrastructure and strive for continuous improvement. As a team, we defend our customers and ensure Oracle meets or exceeds all applicable security and regulatory requirements in all markets.

Values our foundation and how we deliver excellence. We strive for equity, inclusion, and respect for all. We are committed to the greater good in our products and our actions. We are constantly learning and taking opportunities to grow our careers and ourselves. We challenge each other to stretch beyond our past to build our future. You can learn more about us by visiting https://cloud.oracle.com/cloud-infrastructure .

job.name: Chief Technology Officer, Healthcare AI
job.description:
Hiring for Moative — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

Moative is an AI company that partners with mid-market businesses in asset-heavy, regulated industries to co-build industry-specific agentic and machine-learning solutions, then scales them across the industry through revenue-share and equity-linked models. The founders have built and sold two companies, one of them in AI, and the 20+ person team of AI/ML engineers, data scientists and mathematicians comes from IITs, IISc, CERN, UZH and IBM Research. Its healthcare business builds AI agents that run revenue-cycle and administrative work for US healthcare practices.

About the Role

As CTO for Moative's healthcare business, you'll lead technology for an AI management services organisation (AI MSO) for US healthcare practices. It combines operational expertise, data infrastructure and AI to manage and improve revenue-cycle and administrative workflows, automating tasks progressively with clear controls and human accountability. You'll own technology strategy, platform architecture and the engineering organisation, and stay hands-on in architecture, prototypes, code reviews and hard production problems. The role is based in Chennai (Bengaluru is possible), hybrid with 3 days a week in person with the founders and the healthcare AI pod.

What you'll do

  • Own technology strategy, platform architecture and engineering standards for the healthcare AI MSO
  • Work with founders, practice owners and billing leaders to assess workflows, set baselines and prioritise by business value and feasibility
  • Design solutions across EHRs, practice-management systems, clearinghouses and payer portals, covering payer-portal agents, voice payer follow-up, denial management and payment posting
  • Define the practice data architecture: claims, remittances, EOBs and denial codes as validated, traceable data, with isolation between practices and de-identified analytics
  • Set healthcare privacy, security and compliance controls, plus production evaluation, monitoring, escalation and release criteria
  • Make build-versus-buy, vendor and model decisions, and own engineering and infrastructure budgets
  • Hire and develop engineers, data scientists and technical leads, and represent Moative's technology to practice owners, partners and investors

job.name: Software Engineer 2 - ADEX
job.description:
About The Role Enterprises of all sizes trust Abnormal's AI-native security products to stop cybercrime and protect critical communications, identities, and infrastructure in the cloud. Our products are data- and systems-intensive , operating at high scale and low latency across multiple clouds and regions.

As a Software Engineer II on the ADEX Team , you are a highly capable detection feature owner: you take a detection problem, come up with an idea, design a technical approach, and drive it end-to-end, from design and implementation through launch, operation, and continuous improvement. You will work with a world-class group of engineers, product managers, and data scientists to build and operate detection that is reliable, scalable, and AI-native by default .

This role focuses on impersonation detection , including brand, lookalike-domain, VIP and employee impersonation. It is ideal for an engineer who has already shipped meaningful production systems, wants more ownership and impact, and is excited to use AI to build detection that was not possible before.

About The Team The Advanced Detection of EXtended threats (ADEX) is an attack-detection team inside Abnormal's Detection org. We own several of the highest-visibility detection surfaces at the company, spanning attachment-based attacks, fraud, and impersonation. We work the way an analyst would: we study the attacks that get through, understand the underlying pattern, and translate it into system-level detection enhancements that generalize beyond the individual attack.

We are also one of the most AI-forward teams at Abnormal. We build and operate LLM-based detection agents and treat internal AI tooling as a first-class deliverable. Every engineer here writes detection logic and builds AI agents. Impersonation is one of the most damaging and visible classes of attack we defend against, where even simple attacks that slip through erode customer trust, so this is a surface we hold to a very high bar.

job.name: AI Inference Engineer
job.description:
Hiring for FlexAI — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

FlexAI is building a high-performance, cloud-agnostic AI compute platform for training and inference. Its Token Factory serves 20+ open models through one OpenAI-compatible API, from serverless to dedicated endpoints and private cloud, running across NVIDIA, AMD and emerging AI accelerators. The company is led by the team that deployed the Aurora supercomputer and managed 50,000+ GPUs at Intel, is headquartered in Paris, and is growing its Bengaluru engineering centre as inference demand scales.

About the Role

As an AI Inference Engineer you'll design, build and optimise the serving stack that runs large language and multimodal models in production on heterogeneous hardware. It's a hands-on role at the intersection of model architecture, hardware and production serving: you'll own critical parts of an inference runtime built on vLLM, SGLang and PyTorch, help set direction on performance, and work with engineering, research and product to deliver fast, reliable and cost-efficient tokens to customers.

What you'll do

  • Own the serving stack for LLMs and multimodal models: engine configuration, tensor/expert/data parallelism and deployment across NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.
  • Bring new open-weight models to production quickly and correctly: chat templates, tool-calling and reasoning parsers, structured outputs, quantized checkpoints.
  • Profile and optimise throughput, time to first token, inter-token latency and cost per token, from kernels to the request path.
  • Apply and evaluate FP8/FP4 quantization, speculative decoding, KV-cache reuse and offloading, prefix caching and prefill/decode disaggregation.
  • Maintain and contribute patches to vLLM and SGLang, and upstream fixes where it makes sense.
  • Run inference on Kubernetes across clusters and clouds with autoscaling, zero-downtime rollouts and graceful failure handling.
  • Build observability, benchmarking, load-testing, evaluation and model-release tooling that catches silent quality regressions before customers do.

What you bring

  • 2+ years building performance-critical systems software in Python and C++.
  • Hands-on experience serving LLMs in production with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM or similar engines.
  • A deep understanding of transformer inference: attention and the KV cache, batching and scheduling, and when a workload is memory-bandwidth bound versus compute bound.
  • Experience profiling GPU workloads (Nsight, rocprof, PyTorch profiler) and turning findings into measured improvements.
  • Familiarity with distributed inference: tensor and expert parallelism, NCCL/RCCL, high-speed interconnects.
  • Comfort with Kubernetes, containers and running production services.
  • A habit of measuring before and after every change, and of verifying correctness, not only speed.

Nice to have

  • Partner with business controllers and global stakeholders to convert requirements into MVPs, functional testing, UAT, rollout, and ongoing enhancements across 2–3 month project cycles.
  • Support Power BI as the reporting and visualization front-end, including datasets, dashboards, calculations, and validation of outputs against source systems.
  • Work through Jira/ticket-based delivery while communicating clearly with teams across India, Germany, Czech Republic, China, and external partners.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • 3–5 years of data engineering, analytics engineering, or BI engineering experience; no freshers/newcomers for this role.
  • Strong hands-on Snowflake experience is the top priority, including data modeling, transformations, warehouse concepts, and performance optimization.
  • Advanced SQL and practical ETL/ELT or data-pipeline experience, ideally around business, finance, controlling, operations, or manufacturing data.
  • SAP S/4HANA exposure is a strong advantage but trainable; candidates with strong Snowflake/data-engineering fundamentals should still be considered if SAP depth is emerging.
  • Power BI experience is helpful for front-end visualization, but should not outweigh Snowflake/data-engineering strength.
  • Computer Science or Information Systems background preferred; Snowflake Cortex, AI/ML on Snowflake, or chatbot-over-business-data exposure is a bonus signal.

Role Impact

This role will help PULS replace and localize data-engineering capability that previously sat in Munich. The hire will turn SAP and business data into trusted Snowflake data products and Power BI outputs, enabling controllers and global business teams to make faster, more confident decisions.

What We Offer

  • Work with a global industrial technology leader building India capabilities across analytics, manufacturing, sourcing, and operations.
  • Collaborate with international stakeholders on practical, business-critical data products rather than isolated dashboard work.
  • Gain exposure to emerging Snowflake AI/Cortex use cases, including chatbot-style interaction with SAP/business data.

EisnerAmper is seeking a detail-oriented Sales Pipeline Data Analyst to support CRM data quality and pipeline management across its Advisory Services Group and Outsourced Services Group.

The candidate will be responsible for auditing, cleaning, maintaining, and validating sales pipeline data within NetSuite CRM and other approved CRM platforms.

The role involves identifying duplicate, incomplete, inaccurate, stale, and misclassified opportunity records, coordinating with business development professionals and practice leadership to resolve discrepancies, and ensuring reliable pipeline reporting, forecasting, and KPI tracking.

Sales Pipeline Management

Reporting & Analytics

job.name: Research Consultant, Mobility - India Program
job.description:
Job Description RMI is seeking analytically strong and highly motivated Research Consultants to support our work accelerating India's transition to clean mobility. The role offers an opportunity to work at the intersection of policy, technology, markets, and implementation, collaborating with governments and industry stakeholders to address some of India's most important mobility-transition challenges.

Our staff represents a variety of skill sets, and we welcome candidates with diverse educational and work backgrounds.

Organisation Overview RMI, founded as Rocky Mountain Institute in 1982, is an independent, nonpartisan nonprofit working to accelerate the global clean energy transition through market-driven solutions. Active in over 50 countries, RMI collaborates with governments, businesses, funders, communities, and other partners to scale clean energy solutions and advance a prosperous, resilient, and sustainable future.

Since 2016, RMI’s India Program has been working with the public and private sectors to build confidence and further commitment toward India’s clean energy and mobility targets. The Program’s mission is to accelerate India’s transition to a clean, prosperous, and inclusive energy future. RMI's India work spans national and state-level policy support, technical assistance, market engagement, and implementation projects across clean energy and mobility.

Position Overview The Research Consultant will support RMI's electric mobility work in India, spanning EV policy and implementation, charging infrastructure, public transport electrification, zero emission trucks, battery circularity market development, and state- and city-level technical assistance. The role will primarily involve data collection, quantitative analysis, and policy research, along with assistance on stakeholder engagement and project activities.

As a Research Consultant, you will be a detail-oriented and curious researcher who brings rigour to data gathering, analysis, and synthesis on crucial issues in the mobility sector. Working closely with team members, you will strengthen the evidence base behind our research and the solutions we develop for our government and industry partners, while building your expertise in the sector.

You will be an individual contributor and work closely with colleagues on projects under the guidance of more senior staff. You will build familiarity with the content area of your specific programme within the organisation and support the team with research and analysis on that topic.

What You Will Contribute To Over the course of the engagement, the research consultant will help build the data, research, and analytical foundation that underpins RMI’s electric mobility work in India, including datasets and trackers, background research, and analytical inputs that inform policy recommendations, publications, and technical assistance for governments and market actors.

job.name: Solution Architect, VP
job.description:
Join us as a Solution Architect

  • We’ll look to you to create the solution architecture definition for your assigned change projects, in addition to supporting the delivery of business outcomes that benefit both customers and colleagues
  • You'll be working closely with stakeholders to contribute to the design and implementation of digital solutions, validating alignment with the bank’s strategic target architecture and roadmap
  • If you’re ready for a new challenge and want to make a far-reaching impact through your work, this could be the opportunity you’re looking for
  • We're offering this role at vice president level

What you'll do

As a Solution Architect, you’ll be architecting customer centric, high performance, secure and robust end to end digital products, solutions, and services that deliver business value while aligning to the bank’s strategic target architectures and roadmaps.

You’ll be supporting the growth of architecting capability, contributing to the development of architecture skills across the team by sharing knowledge, best practices, lessons learned, and mentoring others.

As Well As This, You’ll Be

  • Supporting the realisation of the enterprise and solution architecture, working as part of development teams throughout the engineering development lifecycle
  • Providing technical guidance, resolving architectural impediments, and championing the adoption of architecture patterns and practices
  • Collaborating with programme stakeholders to help define the minimum viable solution architectures, while following the bank’s architecture method and frameworks
  • Supporting the selection and integration of technologies using the bank’s approved technology catalogues and patterns, with a focus on practical and immediate application
  • Adopting a DevOps mindset by working as part of development teams to embed architecture guidance in CI/CD pipelines

job.description:
Hiring for PULS Group — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

PULS is a German manufacturer of industrial DIN-rail power supplies, used by automation OEMs worldwide. Headquartered in Munich with about 1,700 people globally, PULS is building an India-based IT and AI team that works directly with its Munich Software Development department. The team is relaunching the global PULS website as an AI-ready platform for 21 country sites in 7 languages and runs a growing portfolio of in-house AI solutions on Azure.

About the Role

You will own the cloud infrastructure, CI/CD and operations behind the new global PULS website and the company's AI and agent infrastructure. The goal is a reproducible, highly available and secure Azure platform for 21 country sites, with committed uptime targets, defined RPO/RTO and restores that are actually tested. You will work closely with the Cybersecurity Engineer, the web developers and the AI team, GDPR-compliant with EU data residency. Coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex are part of the everyday toolkit, including for infrastructure code.

What you'll do

  • Build Azure infrastructure as code (Bicep for Azure-native workloads, Terraform where multi-cloud is needed), container setups on Azure Container Apps or AKS, and dev/stage/prod environments with preview deployments
  • Design high availability with replication and failover, committed uptime targets and defined RPO/RTO with regularly tested restores
  • Run load balancing, CDN (Azure Front Door) and caching for 21 country sites, including the China setup
  • Build CI/CD on GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps with OIDC instead of stored secrets, rollback, and automated quality gates: tests, SAST/DAST, IaC scans (Checkov, Defender for Cloud) and Core Web Vitals checks
  • Set up logging, metrics, alerting and dashboards (Azure Monitor, Application Insights or OpenTelemetry), including integration sync status and cloud cost control
  • Harden and patch, manage secrets in Azure Key Vault, run WAF/DDoS protection and backups, and operate managed PostgreSQL/MySQL with replication and safe migrations
  • Run Claude Code and Codex headless in pipelines with sandboxes and permissions, and deploy MCP servers and the runtime for AI search and the chatbot with the AI team

What you bring

job.name: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Job Description Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:

–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.

–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.

–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.

–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).

–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.

–Design performance and load testing.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:

–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.

–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.

–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.

–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:

–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.

–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..

job.name: Staff Quality Assurance Engineer
job.description:
About Us:

Versa Networks, Inc. is a vendor of a unified Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) platform. Versa's goal is to provide unprecedented business advantages through a software-based approach that allows for unmatched agility, cost savings and flexibility. We have created a platform that is feature-rich, scalable and easy to use for both enterprise and service provider use cases.

Job Summary:

VMS is a core component of Versa's SASE security platform. It collects user identity, authentication, device posture, IoT, UEBA and threat intelligence data and distributes it, per tenant, to Versa enforcement points for Zero Trust, identity-based firewall, micro-segmentation and SSE policies. Data sources include SCIM, passive and active authentication, RADIUS and threat intelligence feeds. We are looking for a Staff QA Engineer to lead the testing of VMS, covering functional correctness, tenant isolation, high availability, upgrades and performance.

Educational Qualification:

B.E./B.Tech. or higher degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics and Communication or equivalent.

Professional Qualification:

8–12 years of experience in software quality engineering and test automation, including at least 3 years testing networking, security or distributed systems products.

Job Responsibilities:

Quality strategy

  • Define the test strategy, test plans and release-readiness criteria for VMS.
  • Provide the quality status for each release, with test results and defect data.
  • Mentor SDETs and review their test designs and automation code.
  • Work with developers to add unit and contract tests to every change, and add quality gates to the CI/CD pipeline.

Functional and security testing

  • Test that identity, posture and threat intelligence records are delivered correctly to enforcement points, including adds, updates, deletes and revocations.
  • Measure how long it takes for a change, such as a user logout or a new threat feed entry, to take effect.
  • Test tenant isolation, so that data for one tenant is never sent to or changed by another.
  • Test behavior when a data source or downstream consumer is unavailable, including data aging and recovery.

Test automation

  • Build integration and end-to-end test frameworks for the publish/subscribe path across record types, services and tenants.
  • Build contract and schema-evolution tests for the gRPC/Protobuf interface to keep backward compatibility with deployed clients.
  • Build simulators for upstream data sources (SCIM, RADIUS, authentication events, threat feeds and posture data) to test at scale.

Platform, high availability and performance

job.description:
Job Summary We are looking for a GenAI Developer – Snowflake with 4–6 years of experience in Data/ML Engineering or Software Development, including 1–2 years of hands-on GenAI/LLM experience. The candidate will design and develop production-ready GenAI solutions using Snowflake Cortex AI, Cortex Search, Cortex Analyst, Python and RAG frameworks.

The role involves building chatbots, copilots, document Q&A and summarisation solutions; implementing RAG pipelines; prompt engineering; LLM evaluation; and integrating AI solutions through APIs and Streamlit. Strong knowledge of Python, Snowflake, embeddings, vector/hybrid search and AI security/governance is required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Gen AI Solution Development
  • Design and build GenAI applications on Snowflake Cortex AI, including chatbots, copilots, summarisation tools and document Q&A.
  • Use Cortex AI Functions (AISQL) such as AI\_COMPLETE, AI\_CLASSIFY, AI\_EXTRACT, AI\_SENTIMENT, AI\_FILTER, AI\_AGG and AI\_EMBED to enrich and analyse structured and unstructured data at scale.
  • Build RAG pipelines with Cortex Search, covering document parsing (AI\_PARSE\_DOCUMENT), chunking strategy, embeddings, hybrid search and re-ranking.
  • Develop natural-language-to-SQL experiences with Cortex Analyst, including authoring and tuning semantic models and semantic views.
  • Build and configure Cortex Agents and Snowflake Intelligence agents that orchestrate across Cortex Search, Cortex Analyst and custom tools.
  • Integrate Cortex capabilities into applications through the Cortex REST API, Python SDK and Streamlit in Snowflake.

Data Engineering and Pipelines

  • Work with data engineers on data models, data quality and incremental refresh of AI outputs.

Quality, Cost and Governance

  • Write and version prompts, and choose the right model (for example Claude, Llama, Mistral, OpenAI or Snowflake Arctic) for accuracy, latency and cost.
  • Set up evaluation for LLM outputs, including groundedness, relevance, hallucination checks and regression test sets, using tools such as Snowflake AI Observability or TruLens.
  • Apply Cortex AI Guardrails, PII redaction (AI\_REDACT), role-based access control, masking policies and row access policies so that AI applications respect data security.
  • Monitor credit consumption and query performance, and tune warehouses, batch sizes and model choice to keep costs predictable.

Delivery and Collaboration

  • Translate business problems into GenAI use cases with clear success metrics.
  • Run proofs of concept, then harden them into production releases with CI/CD, documentation and runbooks.
  • Present solutions and results to technical and business stakeholders.
  • Mentor junior developers and share reusable patterns across the team.

This role is focused on creating the scientific foundations that enable new monetization scenarios to scale with high quality, operational efficiency, and rapid iteration across evolving product surfaces.   • Influence senior leaders across product, engineering and partner science organizations on scientific direction, architecture, long-range capability building, and prioritization of major investments.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 6+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research)

+ OR Master's Degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 4+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research)
+ OR Doctorate in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 3+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research)
+ OR equivalent experience
+ Deep expertise in one or more of the following areas: retrieval, relevance, recommender systems, large-scale machine learning, trust and safety

job.name: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Job Description Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:

–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.

–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.

–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.

–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).

–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.

–Design performance and load testing.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:

–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.

–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.

–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.

–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:

–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.

–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..

job.name: Head of Infrastructure & Platform Engineering
job.description:
KocharTech is a 25-year-old technology group behind Knowmax, Maxicus, IGZY, and Devicemax. Every product we ship runs on one shared platform. We are looking for a hands-on leader to own it.

THE ROLE

You will own platform engineering across cloud and on-premises for every business in the group, including the security of the infrastructure. That covers SRE, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, databases, VAPT and compliance support, on-prem delivery and a 24x7 Tech Desk, with a team of about 10 engineers that you will grow.

This is not a pure people management role. You will architect, make build-versus-buy calls, step into production incidents and set technical direction, while hiring the team that runs these functions day to day.

THE ESTATE

  • Mostly OCI, with selected services on Azure, GCP and AWS
  • Our own cloud, customer-owned cloud accounts, and on-prem installs inside customer datacenters
  • Customers across multiple geographies. Some deployments are run by regional implementation partners, but the standards and the outcome stay with you.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • Infrastructure and cloud: OCI tenancy and IAM governance, provisioning, consistent standards across clouds, cost management and rightsizing, and reference architectures for customer cloud deployments
  • Reliability: uptime and performance SLAs, observability, on-call health, capacity planning, BCP and DR testing
  • DevOps and release: CI/CD end to end, registries, config management, and rollback and cutover for cloud and on-prem releases
  • Databases: high availability across relational, caching and search engines, including replication, failover, backup, restore and tuning
  • Security and compliance: platform-side support for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and HIPAA, VAPT cycles from planning to remediation, patching, vulnerability management and access governance
  • On-prem and customer-hosted delivery: sizing, installs and upgrades held to the same bar as cloud, including partner-led deployments
  • Tech Desk: the standard for 24x7 incident response, escalation and runbooks
  • People: org design, the headcount case, the hiring bar, and an intern bench as a cost-efficient way to scale

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 10+ years in infrastructure and platform engineering, including 3 to 4 years as a lead or head owning multiple functions, not a single silo
  • You have scaled a team through growth: hiring, onboarding, promoting into leadership, and knowing when to hire versus automate
  • Deep hands-on OCI, or strong AWS, GCP or Azure experience with the ability to ramp on OCI quickly
  • Commercial judgment on infrastructure spend, and build-versus-buy calls you can defend on cost and risk
  • Running databases in HA production setups. The HA and DR principles matter more than specific tools.
  • Hands-on CI/CD ownership (Jenkins, GitLab CI or equivalent) and a modern observability stack (Prometheus and Grafana, Datadog or equivalent)

Monitoring & Reliability

job.description:
Description Have you ever wondered how Amazon delivers millions of customer orders with exceptional speed and reliability? Behind every fast and on-time delivery is a complex network of software, infrastructure, robotics, and operational processes engineered to work seamlessly at scale.

Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) builds the software and infrastructure that power Amazon's world-class fulfillment centers. Our systems integrate with warehouse automation, machines, and human associates to orchestrate critical fulfillment processes across a global network. These technologies enable the movement of millions of inventory units and support billions of transactions, ensuring that customers receive the products they want, when they expect them.

About The Mansort Team The Mansort team owns the manual sortation layer of Amazon's fulfillment network. Our systems determine where packages should be routed after packing and before reaching the outbound dock, enabling accurate and efficient movement of shipments through fulfillment centers.

We build and operate software responsible for sort plan generation, chute and destination assignment, and scan-and-sort workflows used by warehouse associates. Our systems operate on the fulfillment center floor across hundreds of buildings worldwide, where reliability, performance, and correctness directly influence operational efficiency and customer delivery promises.

Mansort operates in a technically demanding environment characterized by high transaction volumes, stringent low-latency requirements, and the need for continuous availability despite connectivity disruptions or upstream dependency failures. Correctness is equally critical: every sortation decision must accurately direct a package to its intended destination to prevent operational errors and missed transportation cutoffs.

Manual sortation complements Amazon's automated sortation capabilities by providing the flexibility and scalability needed to handle peak demand, support new geographies and fulfillment center formats, and accommodate diverse operational requirements that cannot always be addressed through fixed automation.

As Amazon continues to expand its global fulfillment network and introduce new supply chain capabilities, delivery models, and customer experiences, the Mansort team has an opportunity to solve challenging engineering problems, modernize existing systems, and build scalable, resilient solutions that support the future of fulfillment operations.

Key job responsibilities

Design and develop scalable systems by owning the architecture, design, implementation, testing, and deployment of distributed software systems operating in live fulfillment center environments.

Build high-throughput, low-latency services that meet stringent performance, scalability, and availability requirements.

job.name: Staff Network Reliability Engineer
job.description:
The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo. Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.

Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.

At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.

When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.

This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works SUMMARY: HOW YOU WILL IMPACT SKYLO As a Staff Network Reliability Engineer, Core Operations, in the Global Product Support & Customer Success organization, you are the 5G Core domain authority within Skylo’s production NTN network. Where the Incident Manager coordinates the bridge, you own the technical outcome. You are the escalation target for every Core-domain Sev 1–2 event — the engineer who diagnoses AMF registration failures, SMF session establishment drops, UPF forwarding anomalies, IMS SIP/Diameter failures, and IMSI provisioning breakdowns at a protocol level, and delivers a resolution or a definitive root cause.

On a network where every subscriber is roaming over satellite, Core NF health is the difference between a connected device and a dark one. You own that health — 24×7. You define the KPIs, write and own the runbooks, set the diagnostic standards the entire team operates against, and continuously surface toil and failure patterns as engineering requirements. You are not a first responder; you are the last technical stop before a Core problem becomes an engineering escalation.

At Staff NRE level you are also a force multiplier: mentoring Senior NREs in Core domain depth, contributing to the automation backlog with operational requirements, and partnering with Product Engineering to ensure new Core releases meet operational readiness standards before they reach production.

Key Responsibilities Core Network Operations & Health Ownership

This enables customers to safeguard their existing SAP ERP investment, while benefiting from a new level of flexibility – tailoring the software to meet their specific needs, retaining company-specific configurations and customizations of their SAP ERP system, and accessing the latest capabilities that give their company a competitive advantage.

Under RISE with SAP, SAP allows customers to run their SAP S/4 HANA and other SAP applications in a managed private cloud environment either in SAP’s own datacentres, IaaS Hyperscalers, SAP Premium Suppliers or in customers’ own existing datacentres. SAP has established strategic partnerships with the major cloud infrastructure providers, including Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), to offer customers maximum choice for their SAP private cloud deployment.

Within the Customer Services & Delivery (CS&D) Board area, the mission of the Enterprise Cloud Services (ECS) Delivery organization is to run and operate SAP’s private cloud offering.

job.name: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Job Description Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:

–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.

–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.

–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.

–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).

–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.

–Design performance and load testing.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:

–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.

–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.

–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.

–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:

–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.

–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..

Database Infrastructure Maintenance

Hiring for BRAHMA AI — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

BRAHMA AI is an enterprise AI content creation platform. Its products help media, sports and enterprise brands create, edit and distribute video and multimodal content at scale using generative AI. The team is growing its AI engineering group in Bengaluru to build the agentic systems behind its next generation of content workflows.

You'll design, build and scale AI agents and GenAI applications in production: agentic systems powered by LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation and multimodal models that turn text, images and video into finished content. You'll take recent research and make it into reliable, observable production systems.

  • Work with platform, data and product teams to ship and run these systems reliably

What you bring

  • 3+ years in AI/ML engineering, with hands-on work on LLMs or generative AI
  • Have shipped an ML, computer vision or LLM feature that runs in a real product
  • Strong Python, plus experience with microservices or API-based systems
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, vector search and RAG architectures
  • A good grasp of prompt engineering, model evaluation and context optimisation
  • Experience with AWS, Azure or GCP and containerised deployments
  • Exposure to fine-tuning, LoRA or custom embeddings

Nice to have

  • Experience with video, sports or media AI products (highlights, clipping, video analytics)
  • Multimodal AI across text, image, audio and video
  • Built or contributed to agent SDKs or AI developer platforms
  • Optimising inference latency and cost for production models
  • Familiarity with hallucination control and AI safety practices

Concentrix is a technology-enabled global business services company specializing in customer engagement and improving business performance. We partner with ambitious, progressive executives around the world to future-proof their business and stay ahead of the competition and customer expectations

Role And Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including the Red-Team Team Lead, Project Manager, and QA analysts to resolve challenges constructively.

Key Skills & Knowledge

  • Core Technical Competencies: AI Red Teaming, Adversarial AI, Prompt Injection, Jailbreak Testing, Responsible AI, AI Governance, AI Safety.
  • Core Methodology Competencies: LLM Evaluation, Model Evaluation, RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback), Human Feedback, Prompt Engineering, GenAI Testing, AI QA.
  • Strong analytical, skeptical, and troubleshooting capability across LLM/RAG safety environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in US-English for structured reporting.
  • High attention to detail and structured problem-solving approach to isolate false positives and verify citations.
  • Demonstrated ability to build original, bounded attack hypotheses and execute multi-turn context escalation scenarios.
