job.name: Software Development Engineer
job.description:
Description Amazon Customer Service supports customers around the world through one of the world’s largest and most diverse customer service workforces. As AI fundamentally changes how customer service work is performed, it also creates an opportunity to reinvent how associates learn, develop their capabilities, receive coaching, and continuously improve.

The Associate Development team is building the next generation of learning, coaching and performance experiences for Amazon Customer Service Associates. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to help build these systems from the ground up.

This is a highly greenfield opportunity. Rather than digitizing traditional training and coaching processes, we are rethinking how associate development should work in an AI-native world. What does an associate need to learn before doing a job? What can they learn through experience? What should AI provide in the flow of work? How can we understand an associate’s evolving capabilities and use that understanding to personalize development? How can generative AI help provide timely, relevant and effective coaching at the scale of a global workforce?

Imagine systems that continuously learn from an associate’s experience and outcomes, identify where they would benefit from development, and deliver personalized learning or AI-powered coaching. The outcomes of those interventions can then become new evidence about the associate, creating a closed loop that gets smarter over time.

As an SDE on this team, you will help define and build the technical foundations that make this possible. You will work on problems spanning generative AI, personalization, intelligent recommendations, learning and coaching systems, experimentation, data and distributed systems. You will have the opportunity to influence architecture at an early stage rather than inherit a predetermined technical solution.

You will partner closely with Product, Science, UX and engineering teams across Amazon to turn ambiguous customer problems into scalable technical solutions. The systems you build have the potential to shape how Customer Service Associates around the world develop and succeed at work.

This is an opportunity for an engineer who enjoys zero-to-one problems, emerging AI technologies, large-scale systems and building products with direct human impact.

Key job responsibilities

Senior Data Scientist, Research

Location: Remote (India); US and UY candidates considered

Department: Data Science / R&D

Reports to: Principal AI Scientist

﻿How to Apply: To be considered for this role, send your application to recruiting@vizit.com. We only consider applications sent to this address.

About Vizit

Vizit is the leader in Visual AI for ecommerce. Our patented Audience Lens™ technology and proprietary Vizit Score help brands predict, measure, and improve the effectiveness of their product imagery and visual content for specific shopper audiences—without relying on surveys.

Vizit's platform combines real-time content scoring, competitive insights, and optimization recommendations to help brands create higher-performing digital-shelf experiences. Vizit is trusted by many of the world's leading consumer brands, including Procter & Gamble, Unilever, Nestlé, L'Oréal, and Mars, and is backed by a $25 million Series B led by Industry Ventures, with participation from Infinity Ventures, Brand Foundry, and others.

Role Overview

Vizit is looking for a Senior Data Scientist, Research to build the models that score product imagery and the benchmarks those scores are measured against.

In this role, you will own research, training, and validation for our computer vision and vision-language scoring models. You will take that work into production with Engineering and work directly with the Principal AI Scientist. Your work shapes the scores customers use to choose and improve their product imagery.

This role suits someone who combines deep learning research with the discipline to ship. You should be comfortable owning an entire modeling area on your own over time.

What You'll Do

  • Research, design, and train computer vision and vision-language models that score product imagery, from single images to full product galleries.
  • Build interpretable scoring models so every score can be explained to a customer.
  • Build and maintain the benchmarks our scores are measured against.
  • Train on noisy real-world commerce data and extend models to new categories and retailers with little prior data.
  • Own model validation, and measure real-world impact with causal methods where the question calls for it.
  • Package, deploy, and monitor your models in production with Engineering.
  • Explain technical tradeoffs to Product, Engineering, and leadership so they can make scoring decisions.
  • Question results that look too good, and hold every model to a rigorous evaluation standard.
  • File patents and publish research that protects and extends Vizit's IP.

What You'll Bring

job.name: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
job.description:
About the role

AI Crew Solutions (AICS) is hiring a Machine Learning Engineer to own the full lifecycle of our predictive models. You’ll build data pipelines, develop and evaluate models, deploy them on live data, and report on how they perform. You’ll also be responsible for keeping the services behind those models running in production.

Responsibilities

  • Build and improve predictive models for regression and classification, including neural networks, that run continuously on live data.
  • Operate the production services behind those models, including monitoring, incident response, and safe rollouts and rollbacks.
  • Design pipelines that combine real-time and historical data from multiple internal and external sources.
  • Evaluate models through back testing, live comparisons, drift monitoring, and metrics tied to business outcomes.
  • Keep cloud computing costs within budget.
  • Write code that is tested, documented, and easy to review.

Required qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience building and operating production ML systems, including on-call ownership.
  • Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience using pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, and either XGBoost or LightGBM.
  • Deep experience with regression, including regularized models, tree ensembles, quantile regression, and prediction intervals.
  • Hands-on experience building neural networks in PyTorch or TensorFlow for tabular and sequence data.
  • Experience with time-series modeling and forecasting, including preventing data leakage, building point-in-time features, and designing fair evaluations.
  • Hands-on experience operating services on AWS and Linux, including troubleshooting from logs.
  • Experience with Git and CI/CD, including automated testing and deployment.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to translate model results into decisions.

Nice to have

  • Experience with real-time or streaming data, such as Kafka, JMS, or AMQP feeds.
  • Experience with probability calibration and designing thresholds or alerts.
  • Experience working in regulated environments or with sensitive data.
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and practices, including experiment tracking, model registries, and containers. Examples include MLflow and Docker.
  • Knowledge of airlines, aviation, or crew scheduling.

job.name: Postdoctoral Scholar-Fixed Term
job.description:
Position Summary

The Wheat Breeding and Genetics program in the Department of Plant, Soil and Microbial Sciences at Michigan State University (MSU) seeks a highly motivated Postdoctoral Research Scholar to conduct research focused on improving nitrogen use efficiency (NUE) in wheat production systems. The successful candidate will contribute to an interdisciplinary research program integrating field-based agronomic experimentation, proximal sensing technologies, uncrewed aircraft systems (UAS) remote sensing, quantitative genetics, genomic and phenomic prediction, statistical modeling, and machine learning to characterize crop responses to nitrogen availability and develop predictive approaches for nitrogen management.

The research will emphasize the collection and integration of proximal sensing measurements, UAS-based multispectral and hyperspectral imagery, and field-based measurements of crop growth, nitrogen status, and grain yield. The successful candidate will develop and evaluate statistical, genomic, phenomic, and machine learning models to identify spectral indicators of crop nitrogen status and predict agronomic traits associated with nitrogen uptake, utilization, and use efficiency.

The research will compare genomic prediction based on molecular marker data, phenomic prediction based on sensor-derived traits, and integrated genomic-phenomic models to predict genetic merit and support selection for improved nitrogen use efficiency in wheat.

This position provides opportunities to conduct independent research, collaborate with faculty and graduate students, publish findings in peer-reviewed journals, and contribute to innovative approaches for improving nitrogen management and wheat productivity.

The successful candidate will have opportunities to develop expertise at the intersection of crop physiology, quantitative agronomy, proximal sensing, UAS-based remote sensing, and predictive modeling. Research activities will contribute to improved understanding of the physiological and genetic factors influencing nitrogen use efficiency in wheat and the development of data-driven approaches for nitrogen management.

The position will provide opportunities for professional development through interdisciplinary collaboration, scientific publication, conference participation, mentoring, and involvement in competitive research proposals.

Job Duties Field Research and Sensor Data Collection

job.name: Junior Forward Deployed AI Engineer - AI/ML & Data Track - Remote - USA
job.description:
About FullStack FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence.

We’re Most Proud Of

  • Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas.
  • Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies.
  • Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users.
  • Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor.
  • Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average.

The Position Forward Deployed Engineers sit inside the client’s problem, not next to it. You embed with an enterprise team, help find the work that actually warrants AI, learn to architect the system, build it, and stay long enough to help make it survive contact with production.

This is a three-way role: consultant, operator, engineer. You will grow into pressure-testing a business case with a COO or VP of Engineering while learning to diagnose why retrieval quality collapsed after a data refresh. The people who succeed here are fast learners who join discovery conversations on Monday and help ship what was scoped on Thursday.

On this track, your focus is data, retrieval, and model behavior : you help make agents trustworthy by getting the data, context, and evaluation right.

We work with regulated industries and Fortune 500 clients who have AI mandates, real constraints, and low tolerance for demos that don’t hold up.

How We Approach The Work FDEs are trusted to help shape the solution, not only deliver it. Every engagement calls for sound judgment, which you will develop over time:

  • Reframes the request. Treats “we need an agent for X” as a hypothesis, not a spec.
  • Decomposes the problem. Outcome → process → decisions → data → systems → actors → constraints — before choosing technology.
  • Helps choose the intervention. Remove, simplify, traditional software, automation, LLM, RAG, agent, or multi-agent — and learns to defend why. Starts to recognize when the answer is a SQL query, not a vector database.
  • Contributes to architecture decisions. Learns to document trade-offs (ADRs), set success metrics, and raise concerns about scope that won’t deliver value.

Read the full description

job.name: Principal Engineer - Confluent
job.description:
Introduction At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world’s leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You’ll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM’s product and technology landscape. Here, you’ll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world.

Your Role And Responsibilities About the job We’re not just building better tech. We’re rewriting how data moves and what the world can do with it. With Confluent, data doesn’t sit still. Our platform puts information in motion, streaming in near real-time so companies can react faster, build smarter, and deliver experiences as dynamic as the world around them.

It takes a certain kind of person to join this team. Those who ask hard questions, give honest feedback, and show up for each other. No egos, no solo acts. Just smart, curious humans pushing toward something bigger, together.

One Confluent. One Team. One Data Streaming Platform.

About The Role We are building Kafka Connect charter which is core for scalable and reliable streaming data between Apache Kafka® and other data systems. It makes it simple to quickly define connectors that move large data sets in and out of Kafka. Kafka Connect can ingest entire databases or collect metrics from all your application servers into Kafka topics, making the data available for stream processing with low latency. An export connector can deliver data from Kafka topics into secondary indexes like Elasticsearch, or into batch systems–such as Hadoop for offline analysis.

We are looking for a Principal Engineer to lead the technical vision, architecture, execution, and operations of core engineering teams that build Confluent's industry-leading Kafka Connectors.. As an IC leader of this product line, you will be responsible for guiding the world-class Connect team in driving innovation and outpacing competitors.

What You Will Do

job.name: Cloud Security Engineer
job.description:
Cloud Security Engineer

📍 Ahmedabad, Gujarat (Hybrid) · Full-time · UK-facing hours

Join the engineering team behind a UK private healthcare platform built on Google Cloud.

Script Assist runs the prescribing infrastructure that private clinics, pharmacies and patients across the UK depend on, and more than 500,000 prescriptions have gone through our platform. It all runs on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). As we grow, we’re adding a Cloud Security Engineer to work on the controls and guardrails across our GCP environment.

You might be a Cloud Security Engineer, GCP Security Engineer or DevSecOps Engineer today. What matters is that you’ve configured IAM and security on Google Cloud yourself, and you enjoy proving your controls work.

🏥 About Script Assist

We’re a UK healthcare technology company that has spent seven years building the software behind modern private medicine. Our multi-tenant SaaS platform handles prescribing for clinics, clinicians, pharmacies and patients. It’s a regulated market, and security is built into how we work.

🔐 What you’ll work on

  • IAM governance across our Google Cloud organisation and projects, built on least privilege
  • Service account security , covering non-human identities, keys and impersonation rights
  • Privileged access to production that is approved, time-limited and tested to expire
  • Organisation-wide guardrails such as Organization Policy constraints and VPC Service Controls
  • Posture management , working through cloud security findings with the engineers who own each system
  • Control testing and evidence , showing that access restrictions and other controls work as intended
  • Security as code , automating configuration and repeatable checks

🚀 Why you’ll enjoy it

  • You’ll grow with the team. We’re expanding cloud engineering and DevOps, and you’ll help shape how infrastructure security scales with them.
  • Your work matters. You’ll protect patient data and prescriptions for customers who hold us to high standards.
  • You’ll keep learning. You’ll work across identity, network and data controls on Google Cloud, in a field that moves fast.

✅ What you’ll bring

  • 3+ years in cloud security, DevSecOps or cloud engineering with a security focus
  • At least 2 years of hands-on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) experience, including IAM and security configuration you’ve made yourself
  • A solid grip on Identity and Access Management (IAM), least privilege and privileged access management
  • Terraform or another Infrastructure as Code tool, plus scripting in Python, Bash or gcloud
  • You live in Gujarat and can work hybrid from Ahmedabad

⭐ Bonus points

job.name: Senior Mobile Software Engineer, Android
job.description:
Location Qualifications : Pune

Position Overview As Senior Android Developer , you will build and evolve the native Android app that Showpad's field sellers rely on every day to find content, learn, and engage with buyers, often on the road and with patchy connectivity. You'll work in a mature, modular codebase, helping to move it towards a cleaner, more testable architecture while continuing to ship new features.

You'll operate with a high degree of ownership, collaborate closely with product, design and backend peers, and help raise the technical bar of the mobile team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Android Engineering: Design, build and maintain features in Kotlin (with some legacy Java) across a multi-module Gradle project, placing new code in dedicated feature modules rather than the historical core module.
  • Architecture Evolution: Drive the gradual migration from MVP-style Presenter/UseCase screens to Hilt-injected ViewModels built on Coroutines and Flow (StateFlow/SharedFlow), keeping each migration a small, reviewable change.
  • Networking & Data: Build resilient API integrations with Retrofit, using consistent result handling and cancellation-safe coroutines, and moving away from deprecated networking libraries.
  • Offline & Sync: Build and maintain offline content availability, background sync (WorkManager) and local storage (Room, encrypted files).
  • UI Development: Build and maintain screens using XML layouts and ViewBinding, delivering accessible, responsive experiences across phones and tablets. Knowledge of Jetpack Compose may be beneficial as we develop the application.
  • Integrations & Content: Work on features that connect to Salesforce, SAML login, web content in WebViews with JavaScript bridges (ShowpadJS)and Chrome Custom Tabs, and in-app document and PDF viewing.
  • Quality & Testing: Write and maintain unit tests (JUnit 4, Mockito, Robole ctric) and instrumentation tests, and contribute to the automated test pipeline.
  • Build, Release & Observability: Contribute to GitLab CI pipelines and release builds (build types, R8 minification, signing, a dedicated China build), and use crash reporting and product analytics (Crashlytics, Pendo, Segment) to find and fix real-world issues.
  • Security & Compliance: Apply secure-by-default practices to credential handling, data storage and network traffic, in line with GDPR and SOC 2 expectations.
  • Collaboration & Growth: Participate actively in design and code reviews, contribute to team documentation, module maps and conventions, and mentor fellow engineers.

job.name: Senior System Software Engineer, DRIVE OS - Linux and QNX
job.description:
NVIDIA's Deep Learning GPUs have ignited modern AI — the next era of computing — with the GPU acting as the brain of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Today, we are increasingly known as “the AI computing company”. We are growing our company and the team with the smartest people in the world.

We are looking for extraordinary Software Engineers to develop and productize NVIDIA's DRIVE OS software. As a member of NVIDIA's Solution Engineering team, you will adapt DRIVE OS solutions to various car platforms equipped with different sensors. We are looking for a Senior System Software Engineer with strong experience in Linux/QNX/Android operating system, Device Drivers development, virtualization, ARM architecture.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Architecture, development, and enhancement of native/para-virtualized Linux/QNX device drivers
  • Developing/Designing/Debugging Android HALs
  • Solve complex system issues on Linux/Android/QNX OS
  • Lead the architecture discussions for SW components and interface with customers to support DRIVE software solutions.
  • Continuously evolve and support requirements gathering process and traceability flow.
  • Actively coordinate with cross-functional engineering teams to meet customer's requirements and to drive complex issues to closure.
  • Participate in architectural explorations which include feasibility studies, safety evaluations and data analysis.

What We Need To See

  • BS/MS or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of overall experience and preferably with 2+ years of automotive industry experience.
  • Strong understanding of QNX/Linux/Android operating system and hands-on experience with QNX/Linux device driver development
  • Strong C/C++ programming and debugging skills
  • In-depth understanding of ARM processor architecture fundamentals
  • Background in embedded software development and deep knowledge of product development lifecycle.
  • Effective written and verbal communication regardless of audience or issue complexity.
  • Android Automotive/Android HAL development experience

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

  • Extensive device driver development experience

job.name: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
job.description:
About Techdome Techdome is a product engineering company that builds and runs production-grade platforms for clients in FinTech, Healthcare, E-commerce, SaaS, Logistics, and EdTech. The industries change, but the standard doesn’t: every system we ship is secure, reliable, and ready to scale.

The Role Shipping a feature is the easy part. The real test is what comes after: does the system hold when traffic doubles overnight, how quickly does it recover when something breaks, and is the client’s product still thriving a year later?

We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer (4+ years of experience) to build products with React, Next.js, Node.js (TypeScript), Express, and PostgreSQL, deployed on Azure, and to stay accountable for them long after launch. What You’ll Own Building products that last

Keeping production healthy

  • Lead the response when incidents hit, restore service fast, and follow through with root-cause analysis so problems stay fixed.

Raising the bar for the team

  • Run constructive code reviews and champion readable, tested, maintainable code.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and lift the team’s overall skill.
  • Work as one team with product, design, QA, and DevOps.

Understanding the client

  • Learn each client’s users, goals, and constraints quickly, and turn them into the right technical solutions.

What You Bring Must have

job.description:
Function Barco is looking for a Data Engineer to join its global Data & BI team. You will build and support enterprise data solutions that bring together SAP and non-SAP data and make it available for reporting, analytics and operational use. The role combines hands-on data engineering in Microsoft Fabric with a solid understanding of SAP BW. Position: Staff AI Engineer, Open-Source GenAI (R&D with Production Ownership) Location: Noida

Department: AI/ML

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 6 - 8+ years

About Gigaforce Gigaforce is a California-based InsurTech company delivering a next-generation, SaaS-based claims platform built for the Property and Casualty industry. We combine AI-powered models with deep domain expertise to streamline and accelerate subrogation and claims processing for insurers, recovery vendors, and other ecosystem participants, turning a traditionally fragmented claims lifecycle into an intelligent, end-to-end digital experience.

Our AI products focus on subrogation, claims recovery, workflow automation, and decision support, including claim scoring, liability analysis, document preparation, demand generation, and agentic claims workflows. We build on open-source technology and run our own models, so our engineers work close to the model, not just behind an API.

Gigaforce was a finalist at InsurtechNY, was twice named a Top 50 company by the TiE Silicon Valley community, and was selected for the global accelerator program at Plug and Play Tech Center in Sunnyvale, California. Our platform is built with Java, Kotlin, Angular, Node.js, and a modern AI stack.

We are driven by curiosity, excellence, and inclusion. Our employees enjoy comprehensive medical benefits, equity participation, and generous paid time off. We are an equal opportunity employer and are proud to foster a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace.

Role Overview We are looking for a Staff AI Engineer to lead the research and production hardening of open-source GenAI systems for insurance claims and subrogation. You will work directly with the AI Lead, who sets the overall architecture, and turn it into a concrete technical plan: which models to use, how to serve and evaluate them, and how to make multi-agent and document-intelligence workflows reliable enough for customers.

This is a hands-on role. You will run experiments on open models, fine-tune them where prompting is not enough, and own the path from prototype to production, while mentoring mid-level engineers who implement components alongside you. Much of our data is documents and text (claim files, adjuster notes, legal correspondence, scanned records), so retrieval, extraction, and document understanding sit at the center of the work.

PULS is a German manufacturer of industrial DIN-rail power supplies, used by automation OEMs worldwide. Summary Position Summary Oracle Fusion Tax – Tax Technology Services Consultant I Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn and support U.S. and other countries (such as the Netherlands, United Kingdom etc.) taxation practice, a popular career option.

At Deloitte , we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and add greater impact to clients by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.

Work you’ll do We are looking for dynamic professionals that are looking to broaden their careers in Tax and Oracle. As you build your career with us in Oracle within our Tax ERP team, you will be helping our clients to design, develop and implement systems architecture that best meets their business needs, in the rapidly changing tax and legal landscape.

You will be working alongside an experienced and growing team, to support our clients in ensuring that they have the right data, business processes and systems set-up for the future. You would be required to coordinate with the UK engagement leaders and clients to implement ERP Tax solutions in Oracle.

To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best Oracle design for Tax for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group.

Your Team Within Tax Technology Consulting sits our NSE USI Tax ERP team who specialize in implementing tax requirements within finance transformation programmes or system remediation programmes. We are a fast-growing team with a super-growth ambition. We undertake Oracle Cloud implementations in ERP, and these need a combination of Tax knowledge and Oracle solution design capabilities. Tax in Finance Transformations is a key differentiator for our practice globally.

As a Tax-focused Oracle Consultant, you will be part of the tax workstream on our engagements. You will have plenty of opportunities to work on large-scale projects as part of complex business transformations. You will work with a wide range of colleagues and clients around the world, exposing you to cutting edge tax technology work in a strategic, commercial, and business context. Microsoft’s Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging & real-time analytics, and business intelligence. The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. Our mission is to build the data platform for the age of AI, powering a new class of data-first applications and driving a data culture.

Within Azure Data, the big data analytics team provides a range of products that enable data engineers and data scientists to extract intelligence from all data – structured, semi-structured, and unstructured. We build the Data Engineering, Data Science, and Data Integration pillars of Microsoft Fabric.

Our team is part of Azure Data, building reliable, large-scale distributed systems for data engineering. We develop Fabric Materialized Lake Views, which automatically refresh analytical data in Microsoft Fabric so customers can query up-to-date results without manual pipelines. We also maintain Azure HDInsight in production, the PaaS platform running open-source Hadoop, Spark, HBase, and Kafka. You will get hands-on experience with both.

As a Software Engineer II, you will design and ship features for our Fabric-based SaaS platform with minimal supervision. You will write high-quality code, debug complex distributed systems, and work closely with Spark and Spark-based extension frameworks. You will own features through the full lifecycle: requirements, design, implementation, deployment, and production support. You will also maintain HDInsight components in production. This role will deepen your expertise in distributed systems, cloud platform engineering, and large-scale data infrastructure.

Successful candidates will have strong experience in one or more of these areas: designing and coding cloud-scale SaaS products; building data lakes or data engineering tools; working with big data technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, or HBase; enterprise software development in C#, Scala, Java, or Python; and working with the Azure stack (Storage, Compute, Networking, Fabric, Purview, Synapse, AKS, DevOps, Data Factory, Power BI).

Description Google Cloud

Experience Required 7-10 Years We are building a central Data Engineering team responsible for ingesting data from enterprise source systems and engineering applications — including Oracle, CRM platforms, and internal engineering tools — loading it into our data platform and delivering foundational data products that serve Group Practices across the firm. We're looking for a senior engineer who combines an architecture mindset with deep hands-on experience — someone who can design scalable systems and personally build and ship them into production. You will own pipelines end-to-end, from whiteboard to running code, on Google Cloud.

What You'll Do

ARCHITECTURE & DESIGN

Architect end-to-end data platform solutions: from source system connectivity through ingestion, storage, transformation, and data product delivery — making deliberate decisions on scalability, cost, and maintainability.

Use LLMs: to classify, summarize, and transform unstructured text and documents into structured, queryable data products.

Build and maintain Common Information Model (CIM) semantic layers: aligning ingested data with business-domain meaning across Group Practices.

Design and manage Google Cloud Storage buckets: lifecycle policies, folder structure, access controls, and cost optimization.

Configure and enforce Google Cloud IAM: service accounts, role bindings, workload identity, and least-privilege policies across all platform resources.

Write observability into every pipeline: logging, alerting, data quality checks, and SLA monitoring from day one.

job.name: Staff, Data Engineer
job.description:
Job Purpose :

  • Enterprise AI (EAI) builds the data foundations that GSK's AI systems depend on. In our operating model, digital workers do the hands-on data engineering. They generate pipelines, test and deploy them, monitor them in production and remediate failures. Our engineers design the system those digital workers operate in.
  • At the centre of that system is a governed context layer. It makes data, meaning, permissions and history retrievable at the moment they are needed, and sits above our data platforms and beneath every experience and agent built on them.
  • The Staff Data Engineer is accountable for implementing and evolving the governed context layer that humans and digital workers use across EAI, and is EAI's internal authority on data architecture for AI.

Responsibilities:

  • Implement and evolve the governed context layer as a product: one layer across enterprise knowledge, structured data, business vocabulary and modelled ontologies, queried by humans and digital workers at run time.
  • Build the capabilities the layer depends on: reliable cataloguing across structured and unstructured data, AI-assisted metadata enrichment, context design for each use case, secure agent access over standard protocols such as MCP, and routing across sources.
  • Make certified meaning machine-readable so that every number a digital worker returns resolves to one governed definition, with clear ownership and lineage.
  • Define the architecture standards and shared frameworks that digital workers use to generate, test, deploy and monitor pipelines, reducing the integration cost of each new AI initiative.
  • Set the operating model for agent-generated engineering work: what digital workers do autonomously, what requires human approval, how quality is evaluated and how incidents escalate. Lead the incidents digital workers cannot resolve, from detection to permanent resolution.

Required skills:

  • 10+ years in data engineering, including substantial time defining data architecture for production AI or ML systems at significant scale or complexity.
  • Deep, hands-on experience building AI-grade data infrastructure: feature stores, vector databases, retrieval architectures, streaming data flows and evaluation datasets.
  • Experience building context, metadata or semantic infrastructure that AI systems consume, such as catalogues, business glossaries, knowledge graphs or ontologies, exposed to agents over protocols such as MCP.
  • Experience designing and operating AI agents or LLM-powered systems inside data workflows, including evaluation, guardrails and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • A track record of defining data quality, lineage and governance standards for AI pipelines, including privacy, consent, PII handling and auditability, adopted across multiple data domains.
  • Expert command of cloud data platforms and infrastructure as code, and a record of setting engineering standards that others adopted

job.name: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Job Description Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:

–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.

–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.

–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.

–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).

–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.

–Design performance and load testing.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:

–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.

–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.

–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.

–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:

–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.

–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..

About Amgen Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.

About The Role We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Forecasting to join the Forecasting team within the AI & Data organization. This role will design, build, deploy, and maintain scalable machine learning systems that power forecasting capabilities and uncertainty-aware decision support across the company.

This senior member of the team will work cross-functionally to translate advanced forecasting methods into reliable, production-grade solutions that support critical business processes and help Amgen deliver on its “every patient, every time” mandate. The role is particularly well suited to a strong engineer who is excited about building robust ML infrastructure, productionizing state-of-the-art forecasting models, and enabling decision-support solutions that inform multi-horizon planning and business decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable machine learning systems and forecasting pipelines to support demand forecasting across near-, medium-, and long-term planning horizons.
  • Productionize advanced statistical, Bayesian, and machine learning forecasting models, including training, validation, deployment, and lifecycle management.
  • Build and optimize data pipelines, feature engineering workflows, and batch and real-time inference systems using large, complex datasets.
  • Own the end-to-end ML engineering lifecycle, including solution design, prototyping, model integration, testing, deployment, monitoring, observability, and continuous improvement.
  • Develop robust MLOps capabilities, including model versioning, CI/CD, automated retraining, performance monitoring, drift detection, and rollback strategies.
  • Partner closely with data scientists and business stakeholders to operationalize forecasting, simulation, and scenario-analysis capabilities that support strategic decision-making.
  • Establish and promote software engineering best practices, including code quality, documentation, reproducibility, and system reliability.
  • Research and evaluate emerging tools, platforms, and methodologies in machine learning engineering, forecasting, and AI for potential application to business problems.

Basic Qualifications

EY GDS – Data and Analytics (D&A) – Senior - Data Engineering As part of our EY-GDS D&A (Data and Analytics) team, we help our clients solve complex business challenges with the help of data and technology. We dive deep into data to extract the greatest value and discover opportunities in sectors like Banking, Insurance, Manufacturing, Government Healthcare, Retail, Manufacturing and Auto, Supply Chain, and Finance.

The opportunity We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in AWS, Databricks, Python, and SQL to design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data solutions for analytical and operational use cases.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • 4+ years of experience in Data Engineering or related data roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS cloud services and cloud-based data engineering.

  • 2+ years of strong Python experience for data processing, automation, and ETL/ELT pipelines.
  • Expert-level SQL skills across relational and cloud-based data platforms.
  • Strong understanding of data warehousing, data integration, data quality, and batch/real-time data processing.
  • Experience across the software development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and production support.
  • Ability to build reliable data solutions with appropriate consideration for data integrity, security, availability, and usability.

job.name: Expert IT Cyber Defense Analyst - 8990
job.description:
Veradigm Life

Veradigm is here to transform health, insightfully. Veradigm delivers a unique combination of point-of-care clinical and financial solutions, a commitment to open interoperability, a large and diverse healthcare provider footprint, along with industry proven expert insights. We are dedicated to simplifying the complicated healthcare system with next-generation technology and solutions, transforming healthcare from the point-of-patient care to everyday life.

For more information, please explore Veradigm.com.

Expert IT Cyber Defense Analyst - 8990 – Full Time What Will Your Job Look Like The Expert IT Cyber Defense Analyst is a senior technical role responsible for advanced threat detection, security monitoring, incident investigation, and response across enterprise environments. This position acts as a technical authority within the Security Operations Center (SOC), driving high-impact investigations, optimizing detections, mentoring analysts, and strengthening the organization’s overall cyber defense posture. The analyst collaborates closely with Incident Response, Cloud Security, Infrastructure, and Threat Intelligence teams to ensure rapid mitigation and continuous improvement of cyber defenses.

An Ideal Candidate Will Have

  • Perform continuous monitoring of network, endpoint, identity, cloud, and application telemetry using SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, Firewall, AAD, and vulnerability management platforms.
  • Identify sophisticated threats by correlating multi-source telemetry, detecting anomalies, and recognizing attacker TTPs.
  • Enhance SIEM and EDR detection logic by creating and tuning correlation rules, behavioral analytics, watchlists, and automated alert workflows to reduce false positives and improve detection fidelity.
  • Lead high-severity incidents and complex investigations involving malware, privilege misuse, lateral movement, ransomware indicators, persistence mechanisms, and potential data exfiltration.
  • Conduct in-depth forensic analysis of endpoints, logs, cloud audit trails, and network flows to determine root cause, scope, and business impact.
  • Collaborate with the Incident Response (IR) team to drive containment, eradication, and recovery efforts with minimal operational disruption.
  • Perform proactive threat hunting aligned with the latest threat intelligence, emerging TTPs, vulnerabilities, and adversary campaigns.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for Tier 1 and Tier 2 analysts, providing guidance on triage decisions, investigation handling, and escalation criteria.
  • Review and audit alerts handled by junior analysts to ensure accuracy, completeness, and adherence to SOC processes.
  • Contribute to SOC capability uplift through training, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Develop, refine, and maintain SOPs, incident response playbooks, and detection runbooks to support consistent and repeatable operations.
  • Assess business impact of ongoing or emerging threats

job.name: Junior Consultant – Vulnerability Assessment, Penetration Testing & Red Teaming
job.description:
Location: Clearwater Pune, WFO

Experience: 1–3 years

Employment Type: Full-time

Department: Cybersecurity / Information Security

Reporting To: Senior Consultant / Team Lead

About The Role Clearwater is looking for a Junior Consultant – Vulnerability Assessment, Penetration Testing (VAPT) & Red Teaming to join our consulting services team.

The role will support the delivery of vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, application and infrastructure security assessments, and red team engagements for clients across different technology environments. The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in cybersecurity, networking, operating systems and common security testing methodologies, along with a willingness to continuously learn and develop offensive security skills.

Key Responsibilities

Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing

  • Assist in conducting vulnerability assessments and penetration tests across:

+ Web applications and APIs
+ Mobile applications
+ Network and infrastructure environments
+ Cloud environments
+ Internal and external networks
+ Wireless environments, where applicable

  • Perform reconnaissance, enumeration, vulnerability identification and validation.
  • Identify and safely validate security weaknesses using manual and automated techniques.
  • Assist with exploitation and post-exploitation activities under approved engagement scopes.
  • Conduct security testing in accordance with established methodologies such as OWASP, PTES and NIST, as applicable.
  • Analyse scan results and distinguish genuine vulnerabilities from false positives.

Red Teaming

  • Support red team and adversary simulation engagements under the guidance of senior team members.
  • Assist with reconnaissance, attack-path identification, initial access, privilege escalation, lateral movement and other approved activities.
  • Develop an understanding of adversary tactics, techniques and procedures (TTPs), aligned with frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and regulatory compliance requirements such as HIPAA, HITRUST, PCI DSS, SOC2, CMMC.
  • Assist in evaluating security controls, detection capabilities and potential attack paths.
  • Document technical findings with clear evidence and reproduction steps.
  • Prepare professional vulnerability assessment, penetration testing and red team reports.
  • Provide risk ratings, business impact and remediation recommendations for identified vulnerabilities.
  • Maintain accurate POC, testing notes, evidence and supporting documentation.
  • Participate in client discussions and technical walkthroughs
  • Stay current with emerging vulnerabilities, exploits, attack techniques and cybersecurity trends.
  • Research new tools, techniques and methodologies relevant to offensive security.
  • Build and maintain practical skills through labs, CTFs and security research.
  • Contribute to internal knowledge bases, testing methodologies and reusable security-testing resources.

Read the full description

job.name: Senior Penetration Tester
job.description:
Ready to take your career global? Global Payments Inc. is a leading worldwide provider of payment technology services that deliver innovative solutions driven by customer needs globally. Our technologies, partnerships, and employee expertise enable us to provide a broad range of products and services that allow our customers to accept all payment types across a variety of distribution channels in many markets around the world.

What You’ll Own

  • Creates, coordinates and plans engagements with internal customers with medium oversight from senior team members. Has plans validated and approved by an assigned senior team member and executes according to plan with limited oversight. Ability to identify and exploit more complex scenarios as well as employing stealth and evasion techniques. Be able to accurately answer questions about compliance, regulatory and policy standards.
  • Independently gather requirements in order to create appropriate engagement documentation and schedules. Can begin to document engagement plans for how an engagement is executed by other team members (under guidance of senior member of the team). Gathers and proposes final report findings with preliminary analysis and severity assignments.

Ability to professionally communicate both verbally and in written form. Ability to evaluate proposed remediation actions and recommend alternate actions under moderate supervision.
  • Understand more complex architecture and design concepts of applications, hardware and networks and how they impact the security posture of the enterprise. Apply corporate and security ethics in every aspect of day to day activities.

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • Relevant Experience or Degree in: with a concentration in security, networking or development / computer science
  • Typically Minimum 4 Years Relevant Exp
  • Ethical Hacking/Penetration Testing, software development, cyber forensics or threat hunting. Additional 4 years related experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) or GIAC Penetration Tester (GPEN) or equivalent certification
  • Skills / Knowledge - Having wide-ranging experience, uses professional concepts and company objectives to resolve complex issues in creative and effective ways. Some barriers to entry exist at this level (e.g., dept./peer review).

job.name: Security Analyst II
job.description:
About The Opportunity Netrix Global team is looking for an experienced Security Analyst II to join our growing security team. In this role, you will be responsible for defending client environments and internal infrastructure against evolving cyber threats. You will operate within a global 24/7 SOC environment , playing a key role in detection, investigation, and incident response, while also contributing to threat hunting, process optimization, and security automation initiatives .

This role is ideal for someone with strong technical curiosity, a proactive security mindset, and a passion for improving enterprise security at scale. If you thrive in fast-paced environments and value continuous learning, we’d like to hear from you.

How You Will Make An Impact

  • Act as a senior member of the Security Operations Center (SOC), independently managing and resolving security incidents end-to-end.
  • Lead incident investigations, perform root cause analysis, and drive lessons learned and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Collaborate with global security teams to develop and improve processes, tooling, and operational best practices.
  • Perform in-depth analysis of complex security logs, SIEM alerts, and correlated data to identify, assess, and remediate threats.
  • Maintain and enhance existing security tools, including creating and refining SIEM use cases and detection logic based on evolving threat intelligence.
  • Proactively identify risks, potential security gaps, and opportunities to strengthen the organization’s security posture.
  • Contribute to 24/7 SOC operations, ensuring effective monitoring, detection, and response coverage.
  • Mentor junior analysts and foster a collaborative, high-performing team culture.

What You Will Bring To The Table

  • 4+ years of experience in Information Security or related cybersecurity roles.
  • Hands-on experience working in a SOC environment, with strong exposure to SIEM, endpoint, and network security technologies.
  • 2+ years of experience working with cloud environments and cloud-native security tools.
  • Experience with SOAR platforms and scripting (Python, PowerShell, Bash, etc.) is a strong plus.
  • Working knowledge of Linux systems, including syslog analysis from the command line.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security principles, including access control, data protection, threat detection, and compliance monitoring.
  • Proven ability to conduct root cause analysis and implement effective risk mitigation strategies.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders across multiple time zones.
  • High attention to detail, strong ownership mindset, and commitment to continuous improvement.
  • Ability to remain calm under pressure and manage incidents in a structured, methodical manner.

job.name: VP, Incident Response & Advanced Threat Defense
job.description:
Why Mizuho

At Mizuho, we provide the stability of an international industry leader with the career trajectory of a growing business. Our steady, strategic growth gives our people at all levels rewarding degrees of responsibility and richer work experience than a boutique firm or an established giant could offer alone

It’s the local expertise of our employees that makes our global network so powerful. By collaborating with colleagues and clients who have the same ambition and drive, you can amplify your sphere of influence and base of knowledge as part of one of the largest and growing banks in the world.

Serve as a hands-on technical leader for incident response coordination and advanced threat defense across the global SOC. Personally lead complex threat investigations and hypothesis-driven hunting, guide containment decisions and integrate threat intelligence with specialist external DFIR support.

Key responsibilities:

  • Lead, manage and develop technical teams responsible for 24x7 global incident response and advanced threat defense, ensuring operational readiness, technical excellence and effective coordination across regions.
  • Lead complex security incident investigations, including technical triage, scoping, containment planning, evidence preservation and recovery coordination.
  • Serve as an escalation leader for high-severity incidents and support clear incident command, decision logs and stakeholder updates.
  • Define and exercise incident response playbooks, readiness procedures, evidence-handling practices and post-incident reviews.
  • Manage engagement with external DFIR specialists for deep forensics, malware reverse engineering and other capabilities not maintained internally.
  • Lead hypothesis-driven threat hunting across endpoint, identity, network and cloud telemetry, aligned to relevant attacker techniques.
  • Drive threat-led defense through intelligence-informed hunting hypotheses, adversary TTP analysis and validation of detection gaps; translate findings into actionable detection use cases and coverage priorities for the separate Detection Engineering team.
  • Translate threat intelligence on actors, campaigns, indicators and tactics into operational priorities and actionable investigation leads.
  • Work with Detection Engineering to translate hunting discoveries and investigation gaps into validated detection requirements.
  • Coordinate with monitoring teams, technology owners, cyber risk and business stakeholders to drive timely response and lessons learned.

job.name: Cloud Engineer - Windows Administrator
job.description:
About The Opportunity Netrix Global is seeking a Cloud Engineer responsible for managing Netrix and its customers' IT infrastructure (on-prem/hosted and cloud environments). The Cloud Engineer reports to the TOC/NOC Manager under Managed Services and serves as an escalation point for the TOC/NOC, Service Desk, and Systems Team.

The ideal candidate will have 5-7 years of hands-on experience and advanced skills in administering, managing, monitoring, and troubleshooting Windows/Linux Server environments, as well as Virtualization (Hyper-V and VMware), and familiarity with Backup Technologies.

job.description:
Job Description The Oracle Threat and Vulnerability Management (TVM) team proactively identifies, assesses, prioritizes, and relentlessly drives the remediation of security weaknesses and vulnerabilities at scale across the total enterprise. The TVM team performs security assessments, vulnerability research, guides and advises mitigation strategies, and coordinates the response to zero-day and other urgent vulnerabilities. We ensure the security of the software and hardware that runs our cloud and non-cloud infrastructure and strive for continuous improvement. As a team, we defend our customers and ensure Oracle meets or exceeds all applicable security and regulatory requirements in all markets.

Values our foundation and how we deliver excellence. We strive for equity, inclusion, and respect for all. We are committed to the greater good in our products and our actions. We are constantly learning and taking opportunities to grow our careers and ourselves. We challenge each other to stretch beyond our past to build our future. You can learn more about us by visiting https://cloud.oracle.com/cloud-infrastructure .

Are you interested in building large-scale distributed security systems and tools for the cloud? Do you enjoy all aspects of security, from end user devices and traditional information technology (IT), to hyperscale cloud and multicloud services, to hardware and operational technology (OT)? A security-focused leader can have significant technical and business impact. This is a unique opportunity to work with smart people to solve complex and industry-wide problems in distributed systems, security, and multi-tenant Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS) at massive scale. The biggest challenges for the team is the dynamic and fast growth of the business, driving us to improve our systems, tools, and automation to scale to our security expertise several orders of magnitude greater than what we can support today. We understand that software is living and needs investment. The challenge is making the right tradeoffs, communicating those decisions effectively, and crisp execution. Come shape the future of one of the largest cloud services on earth with us!

Our ideal candidate is a hardworking security practitioner, with interest in working in new domains and learning about new verticals every day. They should be fascinated with solving complex problems at the scale of a distributed multi-tenant service infrastructure.

This role is for a self-motivated individual interested and capable of managing multiple facets of security, comfortable working as part of a global team and also independently as part of a larger security strategy.

Must have skills : Automotive ECU Software

Good to have skills : AUTOSAR

Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required Educational Qualification : A Bachelors or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering Computer Science Electronics Automotive Engineering or related discipline is required

Summary:

As a Custom Software Engineer, you will be responsible for developing software applications and platform services for Automotive High-Performance Computing (HPC) systems based on Adaptive AUTOSAR architecture. Your typical day will involve collaborating with system architects, platform teams, and requirements engineers to develop scalable and high-performance software solutions for Software Defined Vehicles (SDVs). You will participate in software design, coding, integration, debugging, testing, and deployment activities while ensuring compliance with automotive quality, safety, and cybersecurity standards. The role requires strong expertise in modern C++, Linux/QNX, service-oriented communication, and automotive middleware technologies.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain Adaptive AUTOSAR applications and services running on Linux/QNX-based HPC platforms.
  • Design, implement, and integrate software components using Modern C++ (C++14/17/20) following industry coding standards.
  • Develop Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) applications leveraging Adaptive AUTOSAR communication frameworks.
  • Analyze, debug, and resolve software defects across distributed automotive ECU environments.
  • Collaborate with System Architects, Platform Teams, and Requirements Engineers to define and implement software solutions.
  • Develop and integrate communication services using SOME/IP, Ethernet, TCP/IP, UDP, DDS, and MQTT protocols.
  • Perform software integration, validation, and troubleshooting activities on target automotive platforms.
  • Create and enhance unit, integration, and automated test frameworks to ensure software robustness and reliability.
  • Develop CI/CD-based software build and deployment pipelines.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and technical discussions.
  • Monitor and improve software quality metrics including code coverage, static analysis, and defect density.
  • Support software lifecycle activities in compliance with ASPICE, Functional Safety, and Cybersecurity requirements.
  • Identify performance bottlenecks and optimize software for resource-efficient execution on HPC platforms.
  • Maintain software documentation, design specifications, and technical artifacts.

job.description:
Job Description Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:

–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.

–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.

–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.

–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).

–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.

–Design performance and load testing.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:

–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.

–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.

–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.

–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:

–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.

–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..

job.name: Senior Software Engineer - Gen AI
job.description:
Role Title

Gen AI Engineer (FDE) — Mid-Level

Location

About The Role You've shipped real software. You've sat in a room with stakeholders and pushed back on a bad idea. You've built something with LLMs that ran in production and learned, the hard way, what doesn't make it past the demo. Now you want to do more of that, faster, with bigger problems and better tools.

As a mid-level FDE at Firstsource, you'll be embedded with a named client, own a problem end-to-end, and partner with junior FDEs and our internal AI platform team to build solutions that operate — not just impress. You'll be expected to think about extensibility on day one and ship working prototypes by day five.

What You'll Own

  • End-to-end delivery of Gen AI solutions inside a client engagement — from discovery to production
  • Architecture decisions on document pipelines, agent systems, RAG infrastructure, copilots, and operational AI
  • Hardening LLM features: evals, prompt versioning, cost & latency optimisation, observability, guardrails
  • Stakeholder management — translating client problems into technical scope, and technical realities back into business language
  • Mentoring 0–2 year FDEs on the engagement, reviewing their code, and accelerating their ramp
  • Contributing patterns and platform components back to Firstsource's reusable AI stack

What We're Looking For

  • 2–5 years of engineering experience with at least one product/major feature shipped to real users (can speak to scale, edge cases, what broke)
  • Strong Python + one of TypeScript, Go, or Java; comfortable across the stack when needed
  • Production Gen AI experience — you've built and deployed an LLM-powered feature, not just a demo. You understand cost, latency, prompt versioning, and have set up evals
  • Solid system design — distributed systems concepts, vector DBs (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector), cloud (AWS / Azure / GCP)
  • Direct experience with stakeholders, PMs, or clients — not buried inside a pure backend pod
  • At least one "0 to 1" project you owned end-to-end
  • Fluent with Gen AI pair programming (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf) — uses them as a force multiplier, reviews output critically

Stretch / Strongly Preferred

  • Built or contributed to internal tooling/platforms used by other engineers
  • Vertical domain depth — BFSI, healthcare, telecom, retail, or insurance
  • Eval frameworks experience (Braintrust, LangSmith, internal eval pipelines)
  • Experience with MCP servers, agent frameworks, multi-agent orchestration
  • Have broken production at least once on an architectural choice — and can articulate the lesson

job.description:
About The Role We are looking for a Microsoft SQL Server subject matter expert to act as the senior technical authority for our SQL Server estate. You will combine deep, hands-on SQL Server DBA expertise with strong experience of running SQL Server in both Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS), and a genuine drive to standardise and automate. The role is accountable for the health, performance, security and resilience of our SQL Server databases, whether hosted on-premises or in the cloud, and for raising the standard of how the Data Services Team builds and operates them.

You will lead by example: solving the hardest technical problems, replacing repetitive manual effort with reliable automation, and mentoring less senior DBAs. You will work closely with the Data Services Manager, and with application, infrastructure and security teams.

Key Responsibilities

SQL Server Administration & Architecture

  • Design, implement and maintain SQL Server environments (2019 and 2022) on-premises, covering capacity planning, schema design, filegroup and storage management, and tempdb configuration.
  • Manage Always On Availability Groups, Failover Cluster Instances (WSFC), log shipping and replication to meet defined availability targets.
  • Administer SQL Server Management Studio, Azure Data Studio, SQL Server Agent and related monitoring tooling.
  • Maintain documented instance configuration baselines and define and enforce standards for naming, collation, partitioning and object management.

Microsoft Azure

  • Own the build, operation and optimisation of SQL Server on Azure, including Azure SQL Managed Instance, Azure SQL Database and SQL Server on Azure VMs.
  • Use Query Performance Insight, SQL Insights in Azure Monitor and automatic tuning recommendations to analyse real-time and historical performance.
  • Manage Azure SQL auto-failover groups, automated backups and long-term retention, with identity and access through Microsoft Entra ID and Azure RBAC, and keys and secrets in Azure Key Vault.
  • Configure and review private endpoints, VNet rules and firewall settings in line with security standards.

Amazon Web Services (AWS)

  • Own the build, operation and optimisation of SQL Server on AWS, including Amazon RDS for SQL Server, RDS Custom and SQL Server on EC2, with Multi-AZ deployments and read replicas.
  • Use Amazon CloudWatch, RDS Performance Insights and Enhanced Monitoring to analyse real-time and historical performance.
  • Manage RDS automated backups, snapshots and AWS Backup plans, native backup and restore to Amazon S3, and platform maintenance windows.
  • Apply AWS IAM, AWS KMS, AWS Secrets Manager, VPC subnet groups and security groups in line with security standards.

job.description:
About The Opportunity Netrix Global is looking for a skilled Business Analyst, Service Desk Reporting & Analytics owns reporting and analytics for the Netrix Global Service Desk. This role transforms ServiceNow and contact center data into accurate, automated Power BI reporting that supports customer service reviews, SLA governance, and internal operational and financial decision-making. Working directly with customers and alongside Service Delivery Managers, Technical Account Managers, Lead Technical Architects, and service desk leadership, the Business Analyst ensures that the performance story Netrix tells its customers is timely, consistent, and backed by trusted data.

How You Will Make An Impact Customer Service Desk Reporting

  • Produce, automate, and deliver monthly customer service reports and Netrix template service review presentations, enabling Service Delivery Managers to share them with customers during the first week of each month.
  • Report SLA attainment by priority for response and resolution, including tickets opened and closed, backlog, mean time to resolve, reopened rates, escalations, and major incident activity.
  • Report customer experience results, including CSAT, NPS, survey response rates, and voice-of-customer themes.
  • Report contact center performance metrics, including average speed of answer, average handle time, abandonment rate, first contact resolution, and channel mix across phone, email, portal, and chat.
  • Configure customer-specific views that reflect SLA targets, priority matrices, and scope defined in each customer’s statement of work.
  • Incorporate customer outages, changes, and environmental factors into SLA commentary to ensure performance results are explained accurately.
  • Develop trend analysis, identify top contact drivers, and provide improvement recommendations to support quarterly and executive business reviews.

Internal Operational and Financial Reporting

  • Maintain daily operational reporting, including open and aging ticket reports, daily and month-to-date SLA status, and queue health.
  • Provide volume and demand analytics by hour, day, and channel to support workforce management and staffing decisions across global follow-the-sun delivery centers.
  • Deliver team and queue-level KPI reporting that supports service desk leadership, Quality Assurance, and Training.
  • Produce internal financial reporting by customer, including revenue, cost of goods sold, and gross margin, while ensuring internal-only data is never included in customer-facing deliverables.
  • Build leadership dashboards and executive summaries for service desk and Managed Services leadership reviews
  • Establish reporting baselines and dashboards for new customers during service desk onboarding, transition, and hypercare.

Report Migration, Automation, and Modernization

This is the “one set of numbers” used by sales leadership, finance business partners and area teams worldwide.

  • Ingestion and transformation in Azure Databricks and ADLS.

We are evolving our semantic layer and using AI assistants and agents in our engineering work. You will help shape both.

Key Responsibilities

Build and own the data layer

  • Design, build and run scalable data pipelines in Azure Databricks (SQL/PySpark) on ADLS, orchestrated with Azure Data Factory, integrating multiple ERP and operational source systems.
  • Design, maintain and optimize Azure Analysis Services models and Power BI / Fabric semantic models, moving business logic upstream into the data platform where it improves performance and maintainability.

Keep it reliable

job.description:
Introduction At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world’s leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM’s product and technology landscape. Here, you’ll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world.

Your Role And Responsibilities About the job We’re not just building better tech. We’re rewriting how data moves and what the world can do with it. With Confluent, data doesn’t sit still. Our platform puts information in motion, streaming in near real-time so companies can react faster, build smarter, and deliver experiences as dynamic as the world around them.

It takes a certain kind of person to join this team. Those who ask hard questions, give honest feedback, and show up for each other. No egos, no solo acts. Just smart, curious humans pushing toward something bigger, together.

One Confluent. One Team. One Data Streaming Platform.

About The Role We are building Kafka Connect charter which is core for scalable and reliable streaming data between Apache Kafka® and other data systems. It makes it simple to quickly define connectors that move large data sets in and out of Kafka. Kafka Connect can ingest entire databases or collect metrics from all your application servers into Kafka topics, making the data available for stream processing with low latency. An export connector can deliver data from Kafka topics into secondary indexes like Elasticsearch, or into batch systems–such as Hadoop for offline analysis.

We are looking for a Principal Engineer to lead the technical vision, architecture, execution, and operations of core engineering teams that build Confluent's industry-leading Kafka Connectors.. As an IC leader of this product line, you will be responsible for guiding the world-class Connect team in driving innovation and outpacing competitors.
