Introduction A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities As an Application Developer: Google Cloud FullStack, you will design and develop cloud-native solutions using microservices-based modular designs and API-driven microservices. You will work in an Agile environment, focusing on continuous release and improvement cycles, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and resilient applications.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Develop Rich UI Applications: Design and develop rich UI applications based on Single Page Applications (SPA) or microfrontends using frameworks such as ReactJS or Angular.
  • Develop Scalable Backend Microservices: Develop scalable and resilient backend microservices based on 12-factor principles, bounded context of the business domain, and expose functionality via API and event interfaces using frameworks such as Springboot.
  • Develop Data Models: Design and develop data models using modern SQL and No-SQL modeling techniques, and implement data storage solutions using databases such as DB2, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB.
  • Implement Event-Driven Architectures: Develop event-driven applications using Kafka, Zookeeper, and other event-driven technologies, and implement cloud-native CI/CD pipelines for change release.
  • Manage Cloud Services: Run and manage services on IBM Cloud, including PaaS, databases, event-driven services, observability, DevSecOps, storage, and networking.

Preferred Education Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

job.name: Global Learning Technology & AI Specialist (11-12-month Fixed-term/Remote)
job.description:
About Generation At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives. We are a global nonprofit organization that supports adults to achieve economic mobility through employment. Generation trains and places adult learners of all ages into careers that are otherwise inaccessible, working in partnership with governments, employers, and other system actors. We also conduct original research and share data insights on high-priority global workforce transition topics to inform decision-making by workforce system stakeholders. Launched in 2015, Generation comprises a global hub (Generation You Employed, or GYE) and a network of in-country affiliates. To date, the network has 150,000+ graduates and 23,000+ employers across 50 professions and 17 countries.

When learners join Generation, 91% are unemployed, of which nearly half are long-term unemployed. Three months after completing our program, graduates have a 78% job placement rate, rising to 88% within six months. Of our employed graduates, 79% are hired by repeat employers who have previously hired Generation graduates, and 89% are in jobs directly related to the profession for which we have trained them. Employed graduates immediately earn an average of 3-4X their previous earnings. Two to five years after graduation, 77% of our alumni from upper-middle income countries continue to meet their daily financial needs and 63% can save for the future. To date, Generation’s global graduates have earned more than $1.9 billion in wages. Generation graduates typically have a secondary school background, 52% are female, 28% have dependents, and the majority identify with underrepresented communities in their country.

Position Overview The Learning Technology & AI Specialist provides hands-on technical expertise across Generation's AI-enabled learning ecosystem. The role is responsible for developing prototypes, building integrations, implementing automations, enhancing AI-enabled learning tools, and supporting the technical delivery of new learning technology solutions.

Working within the Online Team and reporting to the Learning Technology & AI Innovation Lead, the role supports the development and scaling of AI-enabled learning experiences while also dedicating approximately 50% of capacity to Product Team initiatives focused on accelerating curriculum development through AI, automation, and technology-enabled workflows.

Location:

This role is remote, with preference given to candidates based in India.

Generation is an equal opportunity employer and actively encourages applications from people of all backgrounds. Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities Prototype Development & Technical Experimentation

job.name: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Job Description Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:

–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.

–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.

–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.

–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).

–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.

–Design performance and load testing.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:

–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.

–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.

–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.

–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:

–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.

–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..

We are looking for someone who will own the architecture and health of the Linux side of Developer Compute — the fleet of AWS WorkSpaces, WSL, and Linux config that thousands of engineers build on every day. You'll set the standard for how the team ships Ansible changes through peer review, do the deep OS-internals work that keeps the fleet healthy, and act as the final technical authority when a problem survives first-line and self-service troubleshooting. This is a hands-on senior Unix engineering role: you diagnose from strace and journalctl, design the fix at the platform level, and make sure it's codified so the same problem doesn't recur across the fleet.

The Role at a Glance

  • Architect and own the Linux compute platform — the design decisions behind AWS WorkSpaces, WSL, and the broader Linux fleet that thousands of engineers build on daily.

  • Act as the final technical authority on hard Unix/identity/infrastructure problems — the ones that survive first-line and self-service troubleshooting.

job.name: INFORMATION SECURITY CONSULTANT II
job.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role Lumen is expanding its AI Defense capability and is seeking a hands-on security engineer to help implement, operate, and improve the technologies and processes protecting enterprise AI use, applications, and agents.

This position is part of a four-person, India-based AI Defense team within Investigations & Innovation. The Senior Information Security Engineer will independently perform security engineering, investigations, detection development, threat hunting, platform operations, automation, and control validation within established priorities and delegated authority.

You will investigate suspicious activity, configure security platforms, develop and tune detections, validate protective controls, and maintain repeatable operational procedures. Initial platforms identified for the program include Palo Alto Networks Prisma AIRS and CrowdStrike Guardian.

You will collaborate with the AI Defense technical lead, contribute to peer reviews and operational improvements, and escalate complex or consequential decisions to AI Defense leadership. The team will coordinate with the Cyber Incident Response Team through established incident response procedures.

The Main Responsibilities Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot approved AI security platforms, applications, telemetry sources, and integrations.

Monitor platform health, security coverage, and telemetry completeness, identifying and documenting operational gaps.

Investigate security alerts related to employee AI usage, AI applications, and agents, including misuse, policy violations, and suspicious activities.

Investigate prompt injection, sensitive-data exposure, unauthorized access, and misuse of AI agent tools, identities, and permissions.

Analyze and correlate AI platform, endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and application logs to identify affected assets and assess potential impact.

Conduct targeted threat hunting based on emerging threats, suspicious activities, and identified security gaps.

Implement, test, tune, and document security detections, including false-positive analysis and technical limitations.

job.name: AI Security Software Engineer (AppSec & AI-Assisted Development) (Teradyne, India)
job.description:
Overview Teradyne Information Security is building an in-house capability to design, build and operate its own security applications using AI-assisted development. The Security Software Engineer owns those applications end to end: architecture, delivery, bug resolution, new features and the full application security lifecycle. The first major platform in scope is the Cyber Incident Response Platform, with further security applications to follow.

Applications built with AI coding tools can be delivered quickly, but speed is only valuable if the result is secure, tested, maintainable and trusted by the teams who depend on it. This role is accountable for that outcome. The engineer is expected to treat AI-generated code as untrusted input, applying engineering discipline and application security rigor to everything that ships, and to set the standard for how Information Security builds software with AI.

The platforms in this role will hold some of the most sensitive data in the company, including incident details, investigation evidence and security telemetry. They must therefore meet a higher security bar than a typical internal tool.

This role reports into the Information Security team led by the Deputy CISO and works closely with Security Operations and Incident Response, Product Security, Enterprise Architecture and IT. It suits a hands-on engineer who combines software development skills with genuine application security depth, and who has a background or strong interest in cyber security or product security.

*Responsibilities Building and Owning Security Applications*

  • Application Delivery — Design, build and deliver security applications using AI-assisted development, beginning with the Cyber Incident Response Platform. Translate requirements from Incident Response, Security Operations and Product Security into working, maintainable software.
  • End-to-End Ownership — Own each application across its lifecycle, including architecture, roadmap, backlog, releases, documentation and eventual retirement. Act as the accountable owner and technical point of contact for the platforms you build.
  • Maintenance and Support — Triage and resolve bugs, respond to production issues, and design and deliver new features and enhancements. Keep the applications reliable, performant and aligned to agreed service levels.
  • Integration — Build and maintain secure integrations with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, ticketing, identity and data platforms using least-privilege service identities and well-governed APIs.
  • Quality Engineering — Establish automated testing, code review, CI/CD and observability so that AI-generated code is verified rather than trusted, and so that changes can be released with confidence.

*Owning the Application Security Lifecycle*

job.name: Senior Software Engineer, Distributed Data Systems (IN)
job.description:
About Onehouse Onehouse is a mission-driven company dedicated to freeing data from data platform lock-in. We deliver the industry’s most interoperable data lakehouse through a cloud-native managed service built on Apache Hudi. Onehouse enables organizations to ingest data at scale with minute-level freshness, centrally store it, and make available to any downstream query engine and use case (from traditional analytics to real-time AI / ML).

We are a team of self-driven, inspired, and seasoned builders that have created large-scale data systems and globally distributed platforms that sit at the heart of some of the largest enterprises out there including Uber, Snowflake, AWS, Linkedin, Confluent and many more. Riding off a fresh $35M Series B backed by Craft, Greylock and Addition Ventures, we're now at $68M total funding and looking for rising talent to grow with us and become future leaders of the team. Come help us build the world's best fully managed and self-optimizing data lake platform!

The Community You Will Join When you join Onehouse, you're joining a team of passionate professionals tackling the deeply technical challenges of building a 2-sided engineering product. Our engineering team serves as the bridge between the worlds of open source and enterprise: contributing directly to and growing Apache Hudi (already used at scale by global enterprises like Uber, Amazon, ByteDance etc) and concurrently defining a new industry category - the transactional data lake. The Data Infrastructure team is the grounding heartbeat to all of this. We live and breathe databases, building cornerstone infrastructure by working under Hudi's hood to solving incredibly complex optimization and systems problems.

The Impact You Will Drive:- As a foundational member of the Data Infrastructure team, you will productionize the next generation of our data tech stack by building the software and data features that actually process all of the data we ingest.
Accelerate our open source enterprise flywheel by working on the guts of Apache Hudi's transactional engine and optimizing it for diverse Onehouse customer workloads.- Act as a SME to deepen our teams' expertise on database internals, query engines, storage and/or stream processing.

job.name: QA Automation Engineer
job.description:
Job Description Role Overview: We are looking for a strong, hands-on, highly motivated QA Automation Engineer to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of the Service Layer (SL-QTC) platform supporting Quote-to-Cash (QTC), customer lifecycle, and enterprise integration workloads.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining automation frameworks and quality engineering practices for a cloud-native, event-driven platform built on AWS, Kafka/MSK, APIs, databases, and distributed microservices. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Architecture, and DevOps teams to ensure robust test coverage, early defect detection, and high-quality releases.

The ideal candidate combines strong automation expertise with experience testing distributed systems, event-driven architectures, cloud-native applications, APIs, and complex enterprise integrations.

Key responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for APIs, microservices, event-driven workflows, and cloud-native applications.
  • Develop automated functional, integration, regression, end-to-end, and data validation test suites for Service Layer integrations and Quote-to-Cash business processes.
  • Validate Kafka/MSK event flows, message transformations, canonical data models, database transactions, and downstream system integrations.
  • Implement automated API testing, contract testing, service virtualization, and integration testing across enterprise applications and services.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and collaborate with Engineering and DevOps teams to enable continuous quality and shift-left testing practices.
  • Perform non-functional testing including performance, reliability, resiliency, and scalability testing of distributed systems.
  • Develop automated data validation and reconciliation testing across PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, DynamoDB, and other platform data stores.

You will investigate deviations and risks, quantify their impact, follow agreed actions through to results and flag what is coming next. Working in Global Operational Planning, you will help keep the global supply plan balanced, which supports the people who rely on Novo’s treatments.

What You’ll Bring

  • A Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, Business or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in supply chain or planning.
  • Experience preparing and presenting management insights that combine performance out-comes, root-cause analysis, business impact, actions and recommendations.
  • Experience facilitating cross-functional validation of data, conclusions, ownership and action status before management reporting.

  • Experience with tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx and SQL.
  • The ability to translate complex datasets into executive-ready business narratives.

What You’ll Do You will be the person who brings clarity to complex planning data, so leaders can see what changed, what is being done and where they need to step in.

  • Prepare and present structured insights for management and board-level forums, following a consistent storyline: what changed, the analysis and drivers, impact or risk, actions taken, open actions with owners and timelines, and the decision or support needed.
  • Investigate deviations, trends and emerging risks using operational data. Quantify impact where the data allows, and separate facts from assumptions and data limitations.
  • Capture agreed actions, follow up with the people responsible, monitor progress and report the latest status and effectiveness in each update.
  • Reconcile data across source reports, validate conclusions with stakeholders and run balance checks before insights reach management.
  • Look ahead using trends, scenarios and leading indicators to spot risks and opportunities, and recommend preventive or corrective actions.
  • Manage operational KPIs on a regular schedule, contribute to weekly and monthly insights reports, prepare and cleanse data with tools such as Alteryx and SQL, and answer ad-hoc data questions with clear, actionable findings.

As an Associate in Deposits & Liquidity Performance Analytics, you support the Liquidity & Account Solutions business within Treasury Services. job.name: Software QA Lead
job.description:
Hiring for Cotecna Inspection — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About Company

Cotecna is a global provider of testing, inspection and certification services. Its digital products support customer portals, field inspection, laboratories, compliance records, certificates, document workflows and operational teams across high-stakes global supply chains. The company is strengthening the quality-engineering foundations behind these applications.

Job Roles & Responsibilities

  • Own the automation strategy while remaining hands-on with framework design, test development, debugging and execution across Cotecna’s digital products.
  • Build and evolve maintainable automation frameworks for web and API journeys; framework choice is flexible when the architecture and ownership evidence are strong.
  • Integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines and establish reliable quality gates, reporting, triage and release-readiness criteria.
  • Lead and mentor QA engineers, define standards and review practices, and improve coverage, speed, maintainability and production quality.
  • Partner with product, engineering and business stakeholders on risk-based testing, defect prevention, go/no-go decisions and post-release improvement.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Six to ten years of QA or quality-engineering experience, including at least five years of recent hands-on automation and continued coding or framework work.
  • Demonstrable ownership of an automation framework built from scratch or substantially architected; scripting only inside somebody else’s framework is insufficient.
  • Hands-on web automation using Playwright, Selenium, Cypress or an equivalent, plus API automation using Rest Assured, Postman, Karate or an equivalent.
  • Personal ownership of integrating automated suites into Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps or a comparable delivery pipeline.
  • Evidence of leading or owning QA for a team, including mentoring, standards and release or production-readiness decisions; quantified team size is preferred.
  • Mobile automation, performance or security-aware testing, cloud or containers, and regulated or document-heavy systems are useful differentiators.

Hiring Process

1. Internal HM Review
2. Flexiple Interview

Hiring for BRAHMA AI — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

BRAHMA AI builds an enterprise AI content platform for media, entertainment and brand content teams. Its BRAHMA AI Core (BAIC) platform grew out of the CLEAR media asset management system and helps organisations ingest, manage, search and localise large libraries of video and media, while BRAHMA AI Studio adds generative AI for content creation. The engineering team in Bengaluru is modernising the core platform and adding AI capabilities across it, and this hire strengthens that work.

About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineer (Backend) at BRAHMA AI in Bengaluru, you'll design and build the services behind the BAIC platform: microservices in Go, Python and .NET, the data stores and search that power media workflows, and the React micro-frontends on top of them.   • Design, build and maintain scalable backend microservices for the BAIC platform in Go, Python and .NET.

  • Deploy to AWS and Azure and keep CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps fast and reliable.
  • Pay down technical debt, modernise legacy platform services, review code and contribute to architecture and documentation.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering.

  • Experience building an enterprise SaaS or media-tech product, in an agile team.

Nice to have

  • Exposure to integrating AI/ML models into product workflows.
  • Experience modernising legacy services into cloud-native microservices.

job.name: Builder QA II
job.description:
Job Description You are an engineer who specialises in proving things work. The distinction between “dev” and “QA” work is not one we maintain: you read the application code, you write production-grade Python, and you build agents. The difference is what you point them at.

  • Core DNA
  • AI-Native Workflow. You use AI to accelerate everything you do as a default, not an experiment. You have opinions about which tools earn their place.
  • Agentic Implementation. You build, debug and deploy autonomous agents — LLM-driven test generation, Playwright browser-use agents, self-healing locator strategies — against complex ERP screens and workflows.
  • Legacy-to-Modern Bridge. Some of what you’ll test is a modern web rewrite. Some is a desktop application older than your career. Both are puzzles.
  • Evidence Over Confidence. A generated test that has never been executed is not a test. You know your own false-positive and flake rates rather than claiming there aren’t any.
  • What You Own

The ticket-to-test pipeline. An agent that reads a requirement or defect, understands the affected area, and produces a real test — grounded in the actual application, not in what the model imagines the application looks like. Hallucinated locators are the failure mode that kills these systems; preventing them is your problem.

Execution and stabilization. Generation is the easy half. Your pipeline isn’t done when a test file exists or a ticket gets created — it’s done when the test has run against a real build, passed repeatedly, and earned its place in the suite. Flake is the enemy, because a suite nobody trusts is worse than no suite.

Coverage that means something. You can tell the difference between a suite that covers the code and a suite that covers the risk. You use mutation testing and real defect history rather than counting tests, and you argue for the edge cases that actually bite: fiscal calendars, multi-currency, partial shipments, period-end adjustments.

  • Where You Might Lean In
  • Test Generation & Grounding — the retrieval and context problem. How does an agent know what the screen really contains, what the business rule really is, and what changed in this release?
  • Adversarial & Red-Team — you build agents whose job is to break things. Programmatic prompt optimization (DSPy), fuzzing business logic, hunting the input nobody thought of.
  • Test Infrastructure & Agent-Ops — the factory the test agents run in: parallel execution, environment and data management, tracing, and the observability to know why a run went sideways.
  • Legacy Surface Automation — desktop and thick-client applications where modern tooling doesn’t reach and the automation has to be built rather than installed.

What You’ll Actually Do

job.name: Testing and Validation Engineer
job.description:
We are building next generation of motors and control systems for applications in robotics, electric vehicles, automation, and industrial motion. Our focus is on creating precision linear motion systems for applications across industrial, defense, robotics and aerospace. We are looking for a Test & Validation Engineer to own how our actuator firmware and actuators are proven before they ship, from bench characterization to formal qualification and acceptance testing.

Responsibilities

  • Write test plans, procedures and pass/fail criteria for actuator design verification, qualification (QT) and acceptance (AT)
  • Verify actuator firmware: control loops, position and force control, homing, end-stop and stall handling, fault and safe-state behaviour, and CAN/UART/SPI interfaces
  • Build bench and hardware-in-the-loop setups that inject faults (overcurrent, encoder loss, supply dips, bus errors) and run regression tests on every firmware release
  • Characterise actuators: force vs current, speed vs load, accuracy, repeatability, step response, efficiency, thermal rise, endurance and life
  • Operate and improve our load and endurance rigs (1 to 20 kN class) and automate them in Python
  • Calibrate and maintain instrumentation: load cells, linear encoders, current probes, DAQ
  • Run root-cause analysis on failures and produce clear QT/AT reports with requirement-to-test traceability.

Qualifications

  • B.E./B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics or similar
  • 2 to 5 years in test, validation or firmware work on motor-driven or electromechanical products
  • Working embedded C: you can trace a control loop and tell a firmware bug from a hardware or mechanical fault
  • Motor control fundamentals: PWM, current sensing, PI loops, encoder or Hall feedback; BLDC, stepper or PMSM exposure
  • Hands-on CAN, UART and SPI, including logging and decoding bus traffic
  • Python for test automation, data logging and reporting
  • Bench skills: oscilloscope, logic analyser, power supply, electronic load, safe handling of up to 48 V DC systems

Why Quintrans

  • Real actuators from week one, close to the design and firmware team
  • Ownership of the test function, with your reports feeding customer and certification submissions
  • Hands-on learning across electromechanical and linear motor drives including defence/aerospace qualification practice

Job Description - SAP BTP Developer Position Title SAP BTP Developer

Location Onsite / Remote / Hybrid based on project requirements

Employment Type Contract / Full-Time

Travel This position may require travel up to 80% based on project phase, deployment needs, design workshops, testing, cutover, and hypercare. Preferred location: East Coast or Midwest.

Role Overview

This role is aligned to a large global SAP S/4HANA transformation program delivered using SAP Activate, a Greenfield+ implementation approach, SAP S/4HANA RISE PCE, Fit-to-Standard principles, and a Clean Core delivery model. The role is expected to support formal design, build, test, deploy, cutover, hypercare, and knowledge transfer activities across a multi-wave enterprise implementation. The position requires strong documentation discipline, close collaboration with functional and technical workstreams, and the ability to operate within structured governance, change control, validation, and deliverable approval processes.

The SAP BTP Developer will design, build, test, deploy, and support SAP Business Technology Platform-based applications, services, workflows, APIs, and extensions for a global SAP S/4HANA transformation program. The role will focus on side-by-side extensibility and clean-core aligned solutions that complement SAP S/4HANA without modifying the core. The developer will collaborate with SAP S/4HANA technical developers, Fiori developers, integration developers, solution architects, functional teams, security teams, and testing teams to deliver secure, scalable, and reusable BTP solutions. The candidate must understand how SAP BTP fits into the broader extensibility strategy across Key User Extensibility, Developer Extensibility, RAP-based services, and side-by-side extensions.

job.name: AI Workflow Automation Engineer
job.description:
How to Apply

Apply through LinkedIn Easy Apply, then login to https://candidate.recruitbots.ai/?utm\_source=awae-a-o-b. More detailed instructions on onboarding.

Company : RecruitBots AI

Location : Onsite · Bengaluru

Experience : 1–3 years

Type : Full-time

Salary : ₹6–12 LPA

About the role

We are looking for an AI Workflow Automation Engineer with 1–3 years of experience to design, build, and maintain automated workflows that combine LLMs, APIs, and business tools.

You will work with operations, product, and recruiting teams to replace repetitive manual work with reliable AI-driven automations, working from our Bengaluru office.

Responsibilities

Design and build end-to-end automated workflows using n8n, Make, Zapier, or custom code.

Integrate LLMs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini into workflows for classification, extraction, summarisation, and content generation.

Connect CRMs, email, Slack, Google Workspace, and ATS tools through REST APIs, webhooks, and databases.

Build AI agents that handle multi-step tasks such as candidate screening, outreach, and scheduling.

Write Python or JavaScript for custom logic, data transformation, and integrations.

Add error handling, retries, logging, and alerts so workflows run reliably in production.

Work with teams to find manual processes worth automating and measure the time saved.

Monitor the cost, latency, and output quality of AI steps, and improve prompts and logic.

Document workflows and train teammates to use and maintain them.

Track new automation and agent tools, and apply them where they add value.

Required Skills

1–3 years of experience in automation, software development, or AI integration.

Hands-on experience with at least one workflow tool such as n8n, Make, or Zapier.

Working knowledge of Python or JavaScript.

Experience calling LLM APIs and writing prompts that return structured output.

Understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, and authentication (API keys, OAuth).

Basic knowledge of SQL or NoSQL databases.

Familiarity with Git and basic debugging practices.

Strong problem-solving skills and clear communication.

Good to Have

Experience building AI agents with LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar tools.

Familiarity with RAG and vector databases.

Experience automating CRM, HR-tech, or recruiting workflows.

Basic knowledge of Docker and cloud deployment.

A portfolio or GitHub showing working automations.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field is preferred.

Strong practical projects and working automations may be considered in place of a directly related degree.

What We're Looking For

People who enjoy finding manual work and turning it into reliable automation.

Practical builders who test, measure, and improve what they ship.

Comfort working with non-technical teams and explaining solutions simply.

Curiosity about AI agents and a willingness to keep learning.

job.name: Engineer Intern
job.description:
About Us:-

TransformNXT is an emerging technology startup building AI-powered talent acquisition, talent intelligence and workforce transformation solutions.

We are looking for enthusiastic technology interns for 3 to 6 months internships who are passionate about software development, Artificial Intelligence and building intelligent systems.

Role Summary:-

As an AI & Agentic Systems Engineering Intern, you will work on developing backend applications, integrating AI models, building intelligent agents and creating automated workflows.

You will get hands-on exposure to modern AI technologies and contribute to real-world product development.

Key Responsibilities:-

  • Develop backend applications using Python and Node.js .
  • Build APIs and backend services using FastAPI and REST APIs .
  • Work with SQL, NoSQL and vector databases.
  • Explore and integrate LLMs, SLMs and open-source AI models.
  • Develop AI agents and agent-based architectures for business and operational automation.
  • Work with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and API integrations.
  • Build skills and context layers for AI agents.
  • Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), embeddings and semantic search.
  • Experiment with agent orchestration, memory and tool calling.
  • Explore and integrate AI voice models and conversational AI technologies.

What we are looking for ?

  • Students or recent graduates in Computer Science, IT, AI/ML or related disciplines.
  • Strong knowledge in Python and/or JavaScript.
  • Understanding of backend development, APIs and databases.
  • Strong interest in AI, LLMs and agentic architectures.
  • Good problem-solving skills and a hands-on learning attitude.
  • Willingness to experiment, research and work in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Previous internship or project experience with AI Voice Models, Voice AI, Speech-to-Text (STT), Text-to-Speech (TTS), voice agents or conversational AI is highly preferred.
  • Prior exposure to FastAPI, MCP, RAG, vector databases and open-source AI models will be an added advantage.

What you will gain?

  • Hands-on experience building real-world AI-powered applications.
  • Exposure to agentic AI, LLM integration and modern backend architectures.
  • Opportunity to work on live TransformNxt products.
  • Practical experience with AI voice technologies and emerging engineering practices.

TransformNxt is an early-stage technology startup. We are looking for genuinely interested candidates who are eager to learn, experiment, take ownership and build technology from the ground up.

This is not a conventional internship involving only theoretical learning or repetitive assignments. You will be expected to contribute to actual product development and engineering challenges.

Internship Duration: 3–6 Months

To Apply: Share your updated resume and GitHub profile (if available), along with details of any technical, AI or voice AI projects you have worked on.

The role requires attention to detail and good understanding of coding, design, development of applications and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) methodologies. Our interns will get an opportunity to work with State Street Technology Services at Hyderabad and Bangalore office locations.

Why this role is important to us Our technology function is vital to State Street and is the key enabler for our business to deliver data and insights to our clients. We’re driving the company’s digital transformation and expanding business capabilities using industry best practices and advanced technologies such as cloud, artificial intelligence, and robotics process automation. We offer a collaborative environment where technology skills and innovation are valued in a global organization. We’re looking for top technical talent to join our team and deliver creative technology solutions that help us become an end-to-end, next-generation financial services company.

Join us if you want to grow your technical skills, solve real problems, and make your mark on our industry.

job.name: Senior Developer, Agentic AI
job.description:
Overview ABOUT JAGGAER Jaggaer is a global provider of AI-powered procurement software for complex sourcing, supply and spend. job.name: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Job Description Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:

–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.

–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.

–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.

–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).

–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.

–Design performance and load testing.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:

–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.

–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.

–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.

–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:

–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.

–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..

Hiring for BRAHMA AI — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

BRAHMA AI builds an enterprise AI content platform for media, entertainment and brand content teams. Its BRAHMA AI Core (BAIC) platform grew out of the CLEAR media asset management system and helps organisations ingest, manage, search and localise large libraries of video and media, while BRAHMA AI Studio adds generative AI for content creation. The engineering team in Bengaluru is modernising the core platform and adding AI capabilities across it, and this hire strengthens that work.

About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineer (Mobility) at BRAHMA AI in Bengaluru, you'll build services and APIs for the BAIC platform in Go, Python and .NET, including the APIs that mobile and client apps rely on, along with React micro-frontends. This is a full-time, on-site role working directly with BRAHMA AI.

What you'll do

  • Design and build backend services and APIs for the BAIC platform in Go, Python and .NET, including APIs consumed by mobile and client apps.
  • Keep those APIs fast, versioned and reliable for clients on varied networks and devices.
  • Build React micro-frontends on top of the services you deliver.
  • Model data in PostgreSQL and MongoDB and build search with Elasticsearch or OpenSearch.
  • Deploy on AWS and Azure with CI/CD in Jenkins, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
  • Review code, contribute to architecture and documentation, and help modernise the platform.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering.
  • Strong production backend development in at least one of Go, Python or .NET (C#/ASP.NET). Strength in one is enough; willingness to work across the others is expected.
  • Hands-on React experience, ideally with microservices and micro-frontend architectures.
  • Working knowledge of PostgreSQL/SQL and MongoDB, and of a search engine such as Elasticsearch or OpenSearch.
  • Has deployed and run services on AWS or Azure, with CI/CD in Jenkins, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience building an enterprise SaaS or media-tech product, in an agile team.
  • Has built backends or APIs that serve mobile apps, or worked on a mobility product, at production scale.

Nice to have

  • Experience with media asset management, OTT, video or content platforms.
  • Exposure to integrating AI/ML models into product workflows.
  • React Native or mobile client experience.

From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

Job Description Build hands-on Gen AI prototypes, pilots and reusable components for AI roadmap. Implement AI solutions for knowledge-base query, requirements generation, design support, trace/RCA, test strategy, test case generation, test execution support, deployment/MOP and stakeholder interaction analysis. Develop RAG pipelines over requirements specifications and design documents, test plans, tickets, KB articles, deployment records, application and system logs and traces. Build document-processing pipelines including parsing, metadata extraction, chunking, embedding generation, vector indexing and retrieval logic. Create prompts, structured outputs and reusable skill files for requirements, acceptance criteria, design summaries, test cases, RCA summaries and stakeholder summaries. Build n8n workflows for AI automation, including document ingestion, knowledge refresh, ticket summarisation, requirement extraction, trace processing, test generation, approvals and metrics capture. Use Claude Code to support code understanding, code generation, refactoring, unit-test generation, documentation and engineering productivity within the OSP delivery context. Implement evaluation mechanisms to track output quality, retrieval accuracy, hallucination risk, human review effort, time saved, adoption and AI output acceptance rate. Work closely with SMEs, developers, testers, deployment teams and use-case owners to validate AI outputs and improve solution quality. Document reusable assets, demos, workflows, lessons learned and implementation patterns in the AI KM repository and AI Engineering Playbook. Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

job.name: Physical AI Engineer
job.description:
Role Overview Develop and deploy robotic systems using digital twins, simulation-driven development, and modern robotics software frameworks. The primary focus is building digital twins of humanoid and industrial robotic systems using NVIDIA Isaac Lab, Isaac Sim, and Omniverse, developing simulation-to-real workflows, integrating robots through ROS2, and deploying solutions on physical robotic platforms.

How You’ll Make an Impact (key responsibilities of role)

  • Build and maintain digital twins of humanoid robots, manipulators, mobile robots, workcells, and industrial environments.
  • Develop simulation environments using NVIDIA Isaac Lab, Isaac Sim, and Omniverse.
  • Model robot kinematics, dynamics, sensors, and environment interactions.
  • Develop and maintain Sim2Real workflows and support virtual commissioning.
  • Develop robotics applications using Python, C++, and ROS2.
  • Integrate robot APIs, SDKs, middleware, and enterprise systems.
  • Interface with commercial and research robot platforms using vendor SDKs.
  • Integrate cameras, LiDAR’s, IMUs, force-torque sensors, and other robotic sensors.
  • Deploy, test, debug, and validate robotic solutions on physical hardware.
  • Develop and execute Vision-Language-Action (VLA) pipelines for robotic task execution.
  • Support teleoperation workflows for data collection, robot control, and task demonstration.
  • Generate synthetic datasets from simulation environments for robotics development and validation.

What You Bring (required Qualification And Skill Sets)

  • Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, AI, or related field.
  • Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Isaac Lab, Isaac Sim, Omniverse, and ROS2.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and C++.
  • Strong understanding of robot kinematics, dynamics, manipulation, navigation, motion planning, and control systems.
  • Experience integrating robot SDKs, APIs, cameras, LiDAR’s, IMUs, and force sensors.
  • Familiarity with Linux-based robotics development environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with humanoid robots, mobile manipulators, or industrial robotic platforms.
  • Experience with teleoperation systems and remote robot control.
  • Experience with synthetic data generation workflows.
  • Familiarity with Vision-Language-Action frameworks and robotics foundation models.
  • Knowledge of industrial automation and manufacturing environments.

Key Attributes

  • Hands-on engineering mindset and strong problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and willingness to support others across the team.
  • Ability to work in cross-functional teams.
  • Passion for robotics, digital twins, simulation, and humanoid systems.
  • Strong ownership, accountability, and communication skills.

job.description:
Responsibilities Program Leadership & Technical Roadmap

  • Lead the STF, MTF and LTF forecasting programs end-to-end, covering intra-day, day-ahead, term-ahead (up to six months) and annual horizons in line with CERC regulations.
  • Define technical roadmaps, KPIs and accuracy targets (RMSE, MAE, CUF deviation) for each horizon, and plan resources across the team.
  • Guide and mentor meteorologists, AI/ML engineers and data engineers, and review model design and performance.

Weather Modelling, NWP & Data Assimilation

  • Direct the development of in-house mesoscale weather models on the WRF framework, including set-up and tuning on HPC clusters.
  • Lead variational and ensemble data assimilation experiments using real-time ground-based and satellite observations.
  • Oversee ingestion and post-processing of ECMWF, GFS, NCMRWF and ERA5 reanalysis data, with ML-based bias correction.
  • Evaluate AI-native weather models (e.g., GraphCast, FourCastNet, Aurora, NeuralGCM) for MTF and LTF use.

AI/ML Forecasting Models

  • Drive ML-based multi-model super-ensembles and adaptive best-model selection to improve medium-range skill.
  • Oversee 15-minute resolution wind and solar power forecasting frameworks for term-ahead and Round-the-Clock (RTC) market support.
  • Lead improvement of long-term wind and solar models for regions such as Khavda to sharpen CUF predictions and annual energy planning.
  • Ensure model explainability (SHAP) and continuous benchmarking against existing state-of-the-art models.

Data Engineering, MLOps & Platform Delivery

  • Own end-to-end pipelines that ingest weather station, SCADA and satellite data, run QA/QC and deliver production-ready datasets.
  • Ensure models move from prototype to production through Docker, CI/CD, model versioning and monitoring on cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure).
  • Oversee onboarding of new wind and solar assets into the forecasting ecosystem and the IEP portal.
  • Sponsor forecasting AI agents and dashboards (Streamlit/Dash) for forecast delivery and situational awareness.

Partnerships, Budget & Stakeholder Management

  • Manage PoC collaborations with external partners, including data sharing via APIs and forecast evaluation.
  • Partner with Scheduling, Commercial, Business Development and ENOC teams to turn forecasts into DSM and revenue gains.
  • Collaborate with academic institutions and research bodies to bring new methods into operations.
  • Develop and manage program budgets (CAPEX & OPEX), including HPC, cloud and data costs, and coordinate with vendors and procurement.
  • Report program performance, accuracy and business impact to senior leadership.

  • Monitor weather in real time using high-resolution satellite imagery and live data, and revise forecasts quickly during volatile weather.
  • Detect short-term weather anomalies and explain their impact on generation to the scheduling team.

Data Engineering & Model Development

MTF & LTF Support

Validation & Reporting

  • Validate forecasts using RMSE, MAE, variance and anomaly correlation coefficient (ACC) against observations.
  • Track forecast error degradation across lead times and support DSM root cause analysis.
  • Document methods and prepare periodic accuracy reports.

Qualifications

  • M.Tech in Atmospheric Science or M.Sc in Physical Oceanography/Meteorology or a related field.
  • 1+ years of experience in operational energy forecasting or atmospheric research.
  • Hands-on experience processing large meteorological datasets in Python.

job.name: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Job Description Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:

–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.

–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.

–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.

–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).

–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.

–Design performance and load testing.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:

–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.

–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.

–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.

–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:

–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.

–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..

You will coordinate timely responses and vulnerability disclosures, connect engineering, product, compliance, and security teams, and help ensure products meet relevant standards and regulatory requirements. This role provides broad visibility across global teams and direct influence on product security, customer trust, and business risk decisions. How You’ll Make An Impact

  • undefined
  • Lead product vulnerability management from identification and triage through remediation, verification, and closure.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with proven experience coordinating across global technical and business teams.

*The Opportunity: Build the future of Wealth* In a fintech world obsessed with gamification and speculative betting, Endowus stands apart. We aren't here to build another trading app; we are building the financial infrastructure to help people achieve long-term life goals - retirement, education, and financial freedom.

*Headquartered in Singapore, we are the largest independent digital wealth platform in Asia* . However, we are not a one-trick robo-advisor. We are a full-suite wealth platform spanning public equities, fixed income, private markets, and hedge funds. We provide clients with customized exposure—global, regional, or sectoral—across all their wealth (from liquid cash to pension savings) and for all their needs (from short-term cash management to long-term retirement planning).

Just six years after launch, we manage over US$10 Billion (:₹90,000 Crore) in assets for more than a quarter-million clients across Singapore and Hong Kong. We are a Series B company backed by global giants (Lightspeed, Illuminate, Prosus, EDBI, UBS), with ambitions to cover the entire region.

*This is not an 'offshore' support role. Our India team is a core product hub* , operating on parity with our Singapore HQ. Engineers here drive end-to-end ownership of platform innovation. You won't just be testing code; you will be engineering the safety nets that allow us to move fast without breaking trust.

*The Role: Engineering Confidence* Most companies treat QA as a final checkpoint. We treat it as an engineering discipline.

Our clients trust us with their life savings. "Move fast and break things" is not an option here. What we need is "Move fast and prove it's safe."

Here's what you can look forward to in this role.

  • Engineer the Safety Net: You will build and maintain scalable automation scripts that cover the entire stack - from Backend APIs (Scala/Akka) to Web (React) and Mobile (Flutter). You ensure our regression tests are reliable and fast.
  • Shift Quality Left: You will collaborate with Product Managers and Developers before a line of code is written. You will review requirements for testability and ensure edge cases are caught during the design phase.
  • Pragmatic Quality: While automation is our north star, we value thoughtful test planning and the human eye. You are willing to roll up your sleeves and perform manual exploratory testing because you know when to automate and when to test/investigate manually.
  • Drive CI/CD Velocity: You will integrate your tests into our CI/CD pipelines. You ensure that our feedback loops are fast so developers can fix issues immediately.
  • Guardian of the Client Experience: You will look beyond functional correctness. You will simulate real-world client behaviors to catch usability friction, performance lags, and data inconsistencies that automated checks might miss.

job.name: AI Integration Engineer
job.description:
AI Integration Engineer (AI Engineer)

Company: AJEMS

Job location: Pune, Maharashtra (work from office)

Type: Full-time ·

Experience: 2 to 5 years

About AJEMS

  • AJEMS is an enterprise platform where businesses build their own apps, forms and workflows without code, then get answers from that data. Brain Behind Business.
  • AJEN is the AI assistant inside the product. Users ask questions in plain language and get reports, insights and answers from their own workspace.
  • Connectors bring data in from Tally, Google Sheets, Excel, Meta Lead Ads and more, so everything sits in one place.

The role

You own how AI works inside AJEMS: AJEN, the AI layer behind it, and how outside AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT connect to a customer's workspace. It runs on real customer data, so getting security right matters as much as getting answers right.

What you will do

  • Build and improve AJEN: chat over a customer's apps, forms and records, plus AI insights, reports and template generation
  • Design tool calling so the model queries live workspace data instead of guessing
  • Extend the AJEMS MCP server so Claude, ChatGPT and other AI clients can read and write workspace data securely
  • Build an AI gateway: model routing, PII filtering, logging, cost and rate limits, so switching model providers is a config change
  • Test and run open-source models (Qwen, Llama, DeepSeek) through hosted APIs and on our own GPU servers
  • Enforce strict tenant isolation: the AI only ever sees data from the tenant asking
  • Move all AI features to a secure backend service
  • Build evals and test sets that measure answer accuracy, hallucination and latency
  • Use AI inside connectors for field mapping, data cleaning and schema detection when importing Excel, Sheets or Tally data
  • Work closely with the React and backend developers and the QA team

Must have

  • 2+ years building backend software, with at least 1 year shipping LLM features to real users
  • Strong Python, working knowledge of Node.js or TypeScript
  • Hands-on with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic or open-source), tool calling and structured JSON output
  • RAG basics: embeddings, a vector store (pgvector, Qdrant or similar), chunking and retrieval tuning
  • REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, API keys, JWT and webhooks
  • Comfortable with PostgreSQL and SQL, including safe text-to-SQL or query building
  • A security mindset: prompt injection, data leakage and PII handling
  • Uses AI coding tools daily and can explain every line shipped

Good to have

  • Built an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server or client
  • Self-hosted models with Ollama or vLLM, quantisation, GPU setup
  • Multi-tenant data models
  • Django and React
  • Agent frameworks (LangGraph or similar), and knowing when not to use one
  • Docker, Kubernetes, AWS
  • APIs for Tally, Zoho, Google Workspace or Meta

Why join

  • Build the AI layer of a product that launched in November 2026

job.name: Senior Integration Health Engineer
job.description:
Our Mission You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.

We’re here to give power to the patient.

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting . We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

About The Role We are seeking a detail-oriented Senior Integration Health Engineer to ensure the stability, performance, and reliability of our system integrations. This role focuses on monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimizing integrations between various applications, platforms, and third-party services. The ideal candidate will proactively identify potential issues, resolve system errors, and work closely with development and operations teams to maintain seamless data flow and system connectivity. They will build and maintain secure Claude Code and Glean tooling that improves integration triage, troubleshooting, documentation, and QA while applying evidence-based verification, human review, and measurable quality controls. In addition to technical responsibilities, this role also includes leadership in process improvement, training, and communication across teams and stakeholders.

job.name: Machine Learning Engineer, Fraud (Crypto & Debit Card)
job.description:
The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary: This job will support the development and implementation of machine learning models that detect and prevent fraud across our Crypto and Debit Card portfolios. You will work alongside senior ML engineers, data scientists, software engineers, and fraud strategy teams to build and improve AI/ML solutions that protect customers and reduce losses. Your role will involve preparing data, building features, training and evaluating models, and helping deploy and monitor them in production. This is a great opportunity to grow your ML engineering skills on real-time systems that make high-impact decisions.

job.name: Transmission Safety Validation & Verification Engineer
job.description:
Job Description The Role: Our team is seeking a Transmission Safety Validation & Verification Engineer for the Transmission Diagnostics Calibration organization. The Transmission Safety Validation & Verification Engineer performs tests to ensure the transmission system meets system safety requirements. They work closely with the diagnostic calibrators, transmission calibrators and system safety engineers. Our Safety Validation Engineers are engaged in transmission programs from the early stages of product development, through validation, product launch and after sales service. Creative engineers with a passion for embedded controls systems and vehicular safety are encouraged to apply.

What You’ll do:

  • Execute system level testing to gain Development Vehicle Usage Level (DVUL) approval for each calibration milestone, ensuring safety compliance
  • Analyze data and document results in engineering reports; investigate and address any test non-conformities
  • Identify and recommend test procedure enhancements, readily share lessons learned and follow-up with the appropriate documentation
  • Provide technical expertise and guidance to our global counterparts
  • Work with algorithm and system safety engineers to support development of new functions, issue analysis, test plans and procedures as required
  • Actively engage at the appropriate Technical Review Board meetings
  • Support safety, vehicle development, durability and warranty analysis and problem resolution
  • Develop and execute automated test scripts for hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) simulations to ensure accurate vehicle and software performance.
  • Conduct standard transmission diagnostic testing to evaluate and validate vehicle systems with HIL Simulation.
  • Develop tools to automate the processing and organization of collected data to reduce the time spent on manual data reviews.
  • Generate clear and concise reports summarizing collected HIL results and present findings to relevant stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to simulate vehicle issues and gather critical data for analysis.
  • Provide technical support and guidance to team members in troubleshooting and resolving hardware and software issues.

job.description:
The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary: This job will lead the design, development, and implementation of advanced machine learning models and algorithms to detect and prevent fraud across our Crypto and Debit Card portfolios. job.name: Senior Android Developer
job.description:
SOTI is committed to providing its employees with endless possibilities; learning new things, working with the latest technologies and making a difference in the world.

Job Title: Senior Software Developer, Android

Location: Mississauga, Ontario, Canada

Work Model: Hybrid

Who We Are

At SOTI, we are committed to delivering best-in-class mobile and IoT solutions. We are looking for unconventional thinkers who appreciate the art of creating great software.

To us, being visionary is more important than doing things the way they’ve always been done.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for a Senior Software Developer with strong Android expertise to join the XSight development team. XSight provides analytics and monitoring capabilities that help customers understand the health, performance and behaviour of their device fleets. The product collects telemetry from devices and processes that data through backend services for storage, analysis and visualization.

This role has a strong focus on the Android side of that pipeline, from collecting device information and telemetry through reliably transmitting and ingesting that data. You will also work with C# and .NET backend services, particularly around receiving, validating and interpreting data reported by devices.

While you will primarily specialize in Android and device-to-server functionality, you should understand the broader system and be comfortable collaborating with developers specializing in backend processing, databases and web technologies. You should be able to consider how decisions made on the device affect data storage, processing, APIs and ultimately the analytics presented to customers.

As a senior developer, you will be expected to take ownership of complex features and technical problems with minimal direction, contribute to technical and architectural decisions, investigate issues spanning multiple components, and mentor other developers. You should be comfortable questioning assumptions, digging deeply into unfamiliar problems and balancing technically ideal solutions with the realities of a large, mature product.

What’s in It for You?

The People - From our humble origins in our founder’s basement to our industry-leading position today, SOTI has worked hard to foster a company culture that emphasizes personal growth, continuous innovation and fun.

The Growth - Our environment encourages new ideas, fresh perspectives and the ability to take them over the goal line. SOTI is a fast-paced environment with a global reach that encourages you to make your mark and be part of something big.

The Technology - You will work on complex engineering problems as part of highly collaborative teams. You will have the opportunity to work across Android devices, backend services and a large-scale analytics product, while working alongside SOTI's technology and device partners.

What You’ll Do

We are seeking a visionary and hands-on Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)/Quality Engineering Architect to define, champion, and drive the global quality engineering strategy across multi-tier, high-throughput trading platforms.

In this role, you will lead the technical vision for automated quality gates, design scalable test automation frameworks from scratch, integrate cutting-edge AI-driven testing tooling, and establish robust in-sprint automation and performance engineering practices across global distributed teams.   • Enterprise Test Architecture: Design, build, and maintain next-generation, cloud-native test automation frameworks from scratch using Core Java, BDD/TDD principles, and modern architectural design patterns.
  • In-Sprint Automation Acceleration: Spearhead shift-left quality practices, enabling engineering squads to achieve true in-sprint test automation for UI, microservices, and distributed streaming/messaging pipelines.
  • AI & Intelligent Testing Integration: Evaluate, integrate, and scale AI/ML-assisted testing solutions (e.g., generative AI for synthetic test data generation, predictive quality gates, self-healing test automation, and intelligent test impact analysis).
  • Multi-Tier & Service-Level Automation: Architect robust API and microservice testing frameworks (REST, gRPC, WebSockets, Kafka/messaging queues) using Rest Assured, Mocking frameworks, and contract testing (Pact).
  • Data Architecture & Validation: Architect comprehensive data validation frameworks capable of validating complex financial data pipelines, data consistency, and transactional integrity across relational (Oracle/PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB) databases.

2. Performance Engineering & Non-Functional Architecture

  • End-to-End Performance Strategy: Formulate and execute non-functional testing strategies encompassing load, stress, spike, endurance, and latency benchmarking using JMeter, Gatling, or distributed cloud performance engines.
  • Observability & Bottleneck Identification: Analyze system bottlenecks across CPU, memory, database query execution, network latency, and JVM performance to provide actionable optimization recommendations to core engineering teams.

This role requires excellent analytical skills and attention to detail when it comes to hard engineering problems that force you to cut through ambiguity and establish creative solutions.

Our vision is to build advertiser trust in Amazon 1P Audio Video measurement space and drive adoption of our measurement in ways that help us grow Amazon’s Ad businesses.
