job.name: Software Engineer, Frontend
job.description:
About Outtake Outtake exists to empower and facilitate trust for a digital-first world. Today, impersonation, fraud, AI-driven scams, and identity abuse spread faster than any security team can respond to. So we built something different: an agentic AI platform that proactively detects, monitors, and takes down impersonators, automating protection in hours, not weeks.

Built by ex-Palantir, ex-CTO/founders, and ex-Notion engineers, Outtake is designed for clarity, autonomy, and velocity. Our goal is ambitious: become the trust layer of the modern internet. And we intend to do it with a lean, dense, exceptionally talented team.

Outtake is backed by top-tier investors and operators who believe in our mission and our model. With strong financial footing and a long runway, we prioritize creating an environment where people can do the best work of their careers.

The Role

We’re looking for a Frontend Engineer to define how customers experience Outtake. At a high level, this person will build the FE Software Factory that enables the rest of the team (humans and agents) to ship beautiful, reliable, and consistent user experiences seamlessly.

Our product turns a noisy, messy, fast-moving threat landscape into clarity: surfaced risks, evidence, workflows, decisions, and automated action. The frontend is where that complexity becomes legible. It is where customers understand what is happening, trust the system’s recommendations, and take action with confidence.

This role is for someone who cares deeply about craft, speed, and product judgment. You should be excited to work close to the customer, translate ambiguous workflows into simple interfaces, and build software that feels fast, intelligent, and obvious.

We are early, so this is not a narrow UI implementation role. You will shape product direction, design interaction patterns, make architectural decisions, and set the quality bar for the frontend as the company scales.

What You’ll Do

  • Build the agentic coding harness that allows non-frontend devs to ship polished, reliable, and consistent UI
  • Refine and maintain our design system and design language
  • Own the core componentry and abstractions that enforce consistency across our workflows, while accelerating other devs and coding agents building new workflows
  • Own our UI testing framework and ensure we're shipping reliably
  • Maintain a high quality bar for FE code by providing thoughtful reviews and coaching backend-leaning devs
  • Build the agentic UI/UX (chat interfaces, generative UI, or similar) that define how our customers experience the effectiveness of our security agents
  • Flex as a Product Engineer and build end-to-end products alongside as necessary or desired

job.name: Software Engineer, Robot Interfaces
job.description:
Physical Intelligence is bringing general-purpose AI into the physical world. We are a group of engineers, scientists, roboticists, and company builders developing foundation models and learning algorithms to power the robots of today and the physically-actuated devices of the future.

As a Fullstack Software Engineer, you will build internal products that help Pi's research and operations teams move faster. You will work closely with operators, roboticists, researchers, and other engineers to turn physical workflows into reliable software.

The Team Fullstack builds the internal software the rest of Pi runs on. Our users span the path from research intent to physical execution: researchers designing experiments and requesting data, Research Ops working across task design, environments, prototyping, and instructions, and Production Ops running collection, evals, and deployments across our lab, warehouse, and real-world sites.

In This Role You Will

  • Own the human-robot interfaces: The software people use to run, monitor, and debug robots, from setup and calibration through live operation and review. Someone lives in this for an entire shift, and small friction compounds fast.
  • Design for the whole shift, not just the episode: Time on a robot is a fraction of the day. The rest is preparation, troubleshooting, handoffs, and feedback, spread today across several tools and several people. The goal is not to expose every tool, but to build one surface that tells someone what deserves their attention now and notices when they're stuck.
  • Design for safety: Make state unambiguous, make failure obvious, and make the safe action the easy one. Assume the network drops mid-episode or a camera dies, and design so the system degrades predictably rather than surprisingly.
  • Own the realtime edge: Video, robot state, and control at latency budgets tight enough that teleoperation feels direct, plus the controllers, headsets, pedals, and sensors people drive with.
  • Draw the line between device and cloud: Decide what has to stay local because it is safety-critical or latency-sensitive, and what belongs in a control plane that owns identity, state, and coordination across sites.
  • Ship into the physical world: On-prem and on-device deployment, versioning and rollout across lab, warehouse, and partner sites, and enough observability to know what is running where.
  • Make the work measurable: Instrument these interfaces well enough that we can see where the operation loses time, then test changes against it.
  • Act as your own PM: Gather requirements, prioritize, define success metrics, ship, and drive adoption. That starts by standing in the room and watching a shift.

What We Hope You'll Bring

job.name: Member of Technical Staff, Developer Experience
job.description:
About Us Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

The Role Every developer who tries Fireworks has a first five minutes. They land on the site, sign up, grab an API key, pick a model, and make their first call. If it works, they build. If it fails, they leave, usually for good.

Developer Experience drives that journey and everything after it: the path from first visit, to first successful API call, to a team running production workloads and growing on Fireworks across inference, fine-tuning, and the rest of the platform.

We're looking for a product-minded engineer to join as one of the first engineers on Developer Experience, and own the surfaces that make that path real: signup and onboarding, the developer console, quickstarts, the API and model playground, model choice and defaults, error messages, pricing, billing and usage, and lifecycle messaging.

You'll work directly with external customers, from solo developers to enterprise engineering teams. You'll get on calls, watch them build, and turn what you learn into products that customers and developers actually use. You'll also look across the whole platform, from inference and fine-tuning to the console and billing, for the places where a new 0-to-1 product can unblock users and drive exponential growth.

This is a high-autonomy IC role on a small team. There's an early roadmap, but the market moves every week, so you'll help find the problems as much as solve them. You'll own features end to end: from watching where developers get stuck, to designing the fix, to shipping it, to seeing whether it worked. If you're the kind of engineer who ships fast, cares how a product feels, and doesn't wait to be told what to build, this role has enormous leverage and nothing standing between you and impact.

What You'll Do

job.name: Staff Frontend UX Platform Engineer
job.description:
About Plenful Plenful is on a mission to transform healthcare operations from the inside out. Fresh off our $50M Series B and backed by Notable Capital, Bessemer Venture Partners, TQ Ventures, Susa/Kivu Ventures, and other leading investors, we’re building the category-defining AI automation platform that healthcare teams rely on to operate smarter, faster, and more efficiently. Our technology empowers healthcare operators across hospital and health systems, pharmacies and payors to eliminate manual work, reduce administrative burden, and improve compliance, all while unlocking critical revenue to fund programs for their in-need patient populations.

Built by healthcare operators for healthcare operators, Plenful is driven by a deep understanding of the challenges facing today’s care teams. We’re passionate about equipping healthcare workers with world-class tools that deliver real, measurable impact, and we’re proud to serve 100+ leading health systems, pharmacies, and healthcare organizations across the country. If you’re excited to help shape the future of healthcare, we’d love to meet you. Apply now to join our growing team.

Plenful is hiring a Staff Frontend UX Platform Engineer to shape the foundations of our product experience. You’ll build the shared tools, patterns, and architecture that help product teams deliver consistent, accessible, and performant interfaces. This is a hands-on staff role for someone who can set technical direction, solve complex problems, and make other engineers more effective.

What you’ll do

  • Lead the architecture and evolution of our frontend UX platform, including shared components, design system foundations, and developer tooling.
  • Build product experiences and reusable infrastructure with TypeScript, and React.
  • Work across the stack with Python and FastAPI to design and integrate APIs that support excellent user experiences.
  • Establish practical standards for accessibility, performance, testing, and frontend maintainability.
  • Partner with design, product, and engineering teams to turn complex workflows into intuitive interfaces.
  • Mentor engineers, review technical designs, and drive improvements across teams.

What you’ll bring

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial experience building frontend applications at scale.
  • Strong, hands-on knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, React,
  • A track record of leading frontend architecture or platform work across multiple teams.
  • Sound judgment about when to create shared abstractions and how to keep them useful as a product grows.
  • Experience collaborating closely with designers and product partners on user-facing work.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to lead through both code and technical guidance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with Python and FastAPI.
  • Experience working at a health-tech startup
  • Familiarity with FHIR, HL7

job.name: Software Engineer, Web Platform
job.description:
Archer is collaborating with Sierra to connect them with exceptional professionals for this role. About Us Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Sierra was co-founded by Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor who first met while working together at Google over 20 years ago. Bret currently serves as Chairman of the Board of Open AI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook. Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs.

What You’ll Do You'll build the agent harness and web platform that let marketers and AI agents create and update sierra.ai. Your users are marketers, designers, and AI agents, and the website is your product.

  • Build the agent harness for our website. Design the agent harness, tools, and guardrails that let marketers ask for changes in plain language, and let agents draft, update, and publish pages safely.
  • Build the system that builds pages. Create the React components, content models (we use Sanity), and previews that marketers and agents use to put together new pages without filing an engineering ticket.
  • Take Sierra global. Build international localization into the platform as Sierra expands into new regions.
  • Build the tools we can't buy. Create custom analytics and insight tools that show how visitors use the site, so the team can ask an AI agent what's working.
  • Put agents to work on growth. Build agents that help run search and paid campaigns, and work out how Sierra shows up when people ask AI tools for answers.
  • Ship the pages everyone sees. Launch pages, site refreshes, and interactive product stories that show how Sierra works.
  • Be part of Engineering. You'll sit on our engineering team, not in an agency or a marketing silo, and pick up product work from time to time.

What You'll Bring

job.name: Staff Software Engineer, React Native
job.description:
About VSCO For years, we've helped photographers create their work. Now we're building what comes next.

VSCO exists for photographers. Not as a side feature, not as an afterthought, but as the whole point. We build the connected system photographers rely on, and we've spent over a decade earning the trust of a global creative community that takes the craft seriously.

Photography is at an inflection point. AI is reshaping what's possible for creative work, and that's where our mission shines. VSCO is building the full photographer's workflow: from creating and editing your work, to delivering it to clients, to running your business. All of it built thoughtfully, with photographers leading the way. We believe the future of photography tools creates more space for creativity, handling the busy work so photographers can focus on the craft.

If you care about craft, community, and what technology can unlock for creative people, this is the work. We're a mission-driven and focused company where your work ships quickly, is meaningful, and reaches tens of millions of people worldwide. You'll have a real say in what we build and how we build it. We hire people who don't wait to be asked, naturally connect the dots, care about the quality of what they ship, and believe the best outcomes come from building together.

About The Role If you are passionate about React Native development and excited to join a dynamic team of creators, we encourage you to apply for this position and help us empower creators worldwide. At VSCO, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented individuals who share your passion for innovation and creativity. We're building an ecosystem of end-to-end tools for photographers, enhancing our existing product while creating entirely new tools and services. This is a crucial role for someone who will help define and drive that vision forward, shaping the way our users create, connect and earn. Join us in shaping the future of mobile, desktop and web technology and making a meaningful impact on the global creative community.

As a Staff Engineer, you are first and foremost a technologist. You'll be in the trenches with the team in terms of writing code, solving hard problems, and staying current with the latest technologies. But your impact goes beyond individual contributions. You'll act as a technical leader who guides the team through complex challenges, champions best practices, and anticipates what's coming around the corner so the team can stay ahead. You think about scalability, long-term maintainability, and future features — even while the rest of the team is focused on shipping today's work. You'll mentor engineers, raise the bar on quality, and enable others' success.

The Day to Day

job.name: Software Engineer- Maps Rendering
job.description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions Applied Intuition is looking for map rendering engineers with passion and expertise in owning and maintaining web rendering and editing tools geared towards HD maps for autonomous vehicles.

At Applied we treat maps not as a static dataset, but as a single integrated, self-healing data flywheel powering Physical AI. Fleets of vehicles collect ground truth from multimodal sensors which feed ingestion pipelines, dynamic change detection algorithms, machine learning models, and real-time onboard localization and map fusion —closing the loop between field data collection and instantaneous autonomy stack updates.

All of this map data needs to be visualized and edited performantly. In this full time role on the Maps team, you’ll help us build out map visualization tools that operate at every part of the process of developing an autonomy stack. You will operate across verticals - from long-haul L4 commercial trucks to L2++ personal cars, to heavy mining rigs, and tactical defense platforms - and context - real operations and simulations - to visualize standard and high definition map data, LiDAR point clouds, detailed 3D models and more.

Read the full description

job.name: Software Engineer
job.description:
Full Stack Engineer (React & Node)

About the Company

A rapidly scaling SaaS startup revolutionizing operations for one of the largest yet underserved service industries globally. Backed by top-tier venture firms, our platform empowers businesses to streamline workflows, improve profitability, and deliver exceptional customer experiences. Join a team of ex-FAANG engineers and industry experts building mission-critical tools used in thousands of daily operations.

The Role

As a Full Stack Engineer, you’ll architect and deliver high-impact features across our web and mobile platforms, directly shaping the product roadmap for a solution already trusted by enterprise clients. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve complex challenges in an industry ripe for digital transformation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ship end-to-end solutions using React (TypeScript) for frontend and Ruby on Rails for backend systems, ensuring seamless integration between web and mobile apps.
  • Optimize performance, scalability, and security across PostgreSQL databases, RESTful APIs, and AWS cloud infrastructure.
  • Lead code reviews and architectural decisions while managing technical debt in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Partner with product managers and customer success teams to translate non-technical user needs into elegant technical solutions.
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks to maintain rapid, reliable deployment cycles.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and contribute to on-call rotations for mission-critical systems.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of full-stack development experience with React and/or Ruby on Rails in production environments.
  • Expertise in modern JavaScript/TypeScript, REST API design, and relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred).
  • Proven track record of shipping high-quality B2B SaaS products for non-technical users.
  • Strong grasp of cloud platforms (AWS), containerization (Docker), and infrastructure-as-code principles.
  • BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent hands-on engineering experience.
  • Must be based in the SF Bay Area and comfortable with a hybrid work model (2-3 days in-office).

Bonus Skills

  • Experience with React Native for cross-platform mobile development.
  • Familiarity with facility management, logistics, or field-service software.
  • Background in early-stage startups with <50 employees.

Why Join?

  • Up to $300,000 base salary + equity in a high-growth venture-backed startup.
  • Hybrid flexibility with modern offices in SF/South Bay + remote work options.
  • Top-tier health benefits (medical/dental/vision) and 401(k) matching.
  • Unlimited PTO, quarterly team offsites, and $3k/year learning stipend.
  • Hybrid (San Francisco Bay Area) - Full-Time

How to Apply

Submit your resume to https://underdog.io/candidates/apply

No visa sponsorship available. U.S. authorization required.

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

job.name: Staff Software Engineer, Enrollment & Onboarding
job.description:
The Opportunity

Enrollment and Onboarding is the front door to Hinge Health. Every member's care starts here: registering, answering the clinical questionnaire that determines eligibility and program fit, getting accepted, and then calibrating their first exercise therapy so day one feels made for them. The pod owns that whole path, on web and in our React Native app, for every program we offer, from chronic and acute musculoskeletal (MSK) pain to pelvic health and migraine.

This stretch is where members decide whether Hinge Health is for them. Small improvements in how quickly and confidently someone gets from sign-up to their first session compound into large gains in how many people actually start care.

As the Staff Software Engineer on this pod, you'll be the technical lead for a team of six engineers, working full-stack across NestJS services, a GraphQL backend-for-frontend (BFF), React web, and React Native. The system is a clinical intake pipeline and a server-driven mobile experience at the same time, and you'll set its architecture. Day to day you'll partner with Product, Design, Data Science, and User Research to turn what we learn about members into a better first week.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Own the enrollment and onboarding architecture: Set technical direction for the services and clients that take a member from registration through questionnaire, acceptance, and baseline calibration. Keep it coherent as programs, surfaces, and clinical rules multiply.
  • Build durable, observable member workflows: Design the multi-step, long-running orchestration behind enrollment on Temporal, with the idempotency, retry, and failure semantics a clinical intake flow demands.
  • Ship native, server-driven experiences: Lead the mobile and web experience for clinical questionnaires and calibration. Render data-driven survey and layout definitions in React Native and React so clinical and product teams can change content without an app release.
  • Turn intake signals into a personalized start: Connect what we learn about a member during enrollment to their first exercise therapy session, working with Data Science and partner teams so onboarding feels calibrated to the person.
  • Move the funnel: Instrument and experiment on the enrollment and onboarding funnel with Product, Design, and User Research. You'll be measured on accepted members who reach their first session.
  • Retire legacy safely: Lead migrations off legacy systems while they stay in production, and hold the line on quality, testing, observability, and protected health information (PHI) handling across the pod's repositories.
  • Lead through influence: Mentor the team's senior and mid-level engineers and raise the bar through design and code review. Represent the pod technically with partner teams across accounts, mobile platform, care, and data.
  • Participate in the team’s weekly on-call rotation, helping ensure the reliability and timely support of the systems we build.

Read the full description

job.name: Member of Technical Staff, Forward Deployed
job.description:
Profound is the fastest-growing AI marketing platform, used by 15% of the Fortune 500 including Comcast, Estée Lauder, and Walmart, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. It is where marketing teams do the work: research, briefs, content, campaigns, reporting, all in one place, alongside agents that carry the load with them.

Built on 2B+ real user prompts and growing, Profound’s data shows you what people ask AI and what the models say back. Profound's AI Marketer joins that data with deep context about our customers to find the opportunities worth acting on, and then puts agents to work: automating reporting, drafting content, auditing pages for readability, running competitive research. It measures what works and gets better every day.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Profound, you will be the technical bridge between our engineering team and our Fortune 500 clients. You will combine deep engineering expertise with exceptional communication skills to ensure our most strategic customers successfully integrate and maximize value from our platform.

You will write production code, architect custom integrations, and solve complex technical challenges while sitting in client meetings, presenting to CTOs, and translating between engineering and executive stakeholders. This is not a support role. You are a full-stack engineer who loves working directly with customers.

*What you’ll do*

  • Design and build custom integrations connecting Profound’s platform to enterprise systems
  • Write production-quality code in TypeScript, Python, and Next.js for client-specific features
  • Architect solutions that handle enterprise-scale data volumes and security requirements
  • Debug complex issues spanning client infrastructure and Profound systems
  • Optimize performance for clients processing millions of daily queries
  • Lead technical discussions with client engineering teams and C-suite executives
  • Join client calls to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions
  • Present technical architectures and implementation plans to diverse audiences
  • Build trusted relationships with technical champions at Fortune 500 companies
  • Conduct technical workshops and training sessions for client teams
  • Identify patterns in client needs and partner with Product to build scalable solutions
  • Contribute to core product development based on field insights
  • Build reusable components and libraries for common integration patterns
  • Document technical solutions and create implementation guides
  • Influence the product roadmap with direct customer feedback
  • Lead enterprise proofs of concept that unlock multi-million dollar contracts
  • Design data pipelines integrating with client business intelligence tools and data warehouses
  • Build custom dashboards and reporting solutions for executive stakeholders
  • Develop automation workflows connecting AI insights to business processes

job.name: Senior Automation Tester
job.description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

Job Description

Role: Senior QA Test Engineer

Location: Bengaluru, India

Department: Eurofins IT Solutions – ELN

Experience: 5–8+ Years

Eurofins IT Solutions, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

With 36 facilities worldwide, Eurofins BioPharma Product Testing (BPT) is the largest network of bio/pharmaceutical GMP product testing laboratories providing comprehensive laboratory services for the world's largest pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, and medical device companies.

BPT is enabled by global engineering teams working on next-generation applications and Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS). As Senior Automation Engineer, you will be a crucial part of our delivery team, ensuring the product features are completely automated and reducing the idea to live time to Business. As a technology leader, BPT wants to give you the opportunity not just to accept new challenges and opportunities but to impress with your ingenuity, focus, attention to detail and collaboration with a global team of professionals.

This role reports to a Manager.

job.name: AI Researcher: Entity Resolution & Knowledge Graphs
job.description:
The hardest problem in our system isn't retrieval. It's deciding when two mentions are the same person.

A full name in one document. An abbreviation in another. A transliteration in a third script. An honorific. A description with no name at all. Everything above this depends on getting it right. Getting it wrong produces something worse than an error: a confident, well-sourced picture of a person who doesn't exist.

We're hiring one person to own it.

Why this work

India has been caught by surprise before. Not because the warning didn't exist, but because it existed somewhere in the system and nobody put it together in time. People died because of that gap. We're closing it.

We're building the intelligence system that helps India see the next attack coming before it happens, and helps it win the next war before the first shot is fired. Not with better sensors; India already collects enough. With the ability to actually use what it collects, at the speed the threat moves.

This doesn't get built by a foreign company, and it doesn't get built for a demo. It gets built by people who decided this mattered enough to build it here, for real, before it's needed. If we do this right, the payoff is a warning that gets acted on in time, and a war that's already won in preparation before it's fought at all.

What you'd work on

  • Identity across scripts: A name in Devanagari, Roman and a third script has no canonical form. Edit distance assumes a shared alphabet. Phonetic methods were built around English. Multilingual embeddings will cheerfully merge two distinct people who share a name component, the exact failure that ends you. What replaces the standard toolkit is open.
  • Decisions under asymmetric cost: A wrong merge is far more expensive than a missed one, and most of the published literature optimises a metric that assumes the two costs are equal. You'd set thresholds against that asymmetry with very few labels.
  • Extraction from data that resists it: Mixed-language reports, OCR'd handwriting, no standard format. Turning that into entities you'd stake an assessment on, with hallucination detection you actually trust, is its own problem.
  • A graph that corrects itself: It grows with every document and will make mistakes. A merge made today gets revisited tomorrow, and everything built on a bad one has to be findable when it's undone. Full provenance, no quiet corruption.
  • Finding what nobody asked for: Structural patterns across unrelated entities, anomalies against learned baselines, signals surfaced before anyone poses the question. Not RAG, not search. Very little exists to copy.

Why it's hard

At this scale all-pairs comparison is out, and standard candidate generation assumes comparable surface forms, the exact assumption that breaks first here. Rare-event base rates are punishing, which makes overall accuracy meaningless and puts all the weight on the top of a ranked list.

Who this is for

job.name: Solution Architect - AWS Integration & API Gateway
job.description:
Job Description We are seeking a Solution Architect to design and lead a central email gateway. It will sit between the client's commerce platform, its middleware (enterprise service bus) and a new email service provider, and will carry all business-critical transactional email, such as order, shipping, refund and account notifications. The gateway offers two integration models:

  • a pass-through API for systems that are ready to use the new provider directly
  • a backward-compatible API that mimics the legacy provider, so existing systems only need to change an endpoint

The Architect will own the AWS target architecture, the versioned API contracts, a configuration-driven mapping model, and the resilience design needed to make sure no email is lost or sent twice. The role leads a small cross-functional team on a short build window, drives technical decisions with the client's architects, and owns cutover readiness and early-life support.

Responsibilities Architecture & Design

  • Own the AWS target architecture across edge, API Gateway, private networking, load-balancing and ECS Fargate integration, containerized compute, eventing, audit and data flows
  • Define versioned OpenAPI contracts for the pass-through and backward-compatible APIs
  • Design a configuration-driven mapping engine for campaign, field and error-code translation
  • Design resilience patterns: timeouts, retries with backoff, circuit breaker, idempotency and dead-letter queue (DLQ) handling
  • Design the Security & Observability Framework

Technical Leadership

  • Lead discovery and capture existing integration contracts from live traffic
  • Set engineering standards and review all code, including AI-generated code
  • Guide developers, DevOps and QA on design, testability and performance
  • Establish AI-assisted application-building workflows using AI approved

Stakeholder & Delivery

  • Present options and recommendations to the client's architecture and platform teams
  • Coordinate the ecommerce, middleware and email provider teams through integration and SIT
  • Own cutover planning, go/no-go criteria and early-life support

Security & Compliance

  • Ensure OAuth2 machine-to-machine authentication, encryption, least-privilege IAM and PII masking
  • Align audit retention and the data purge approach with GDPR/CCPA requirements

Qualifications Required Skills & Competencies

job.name: Core Infrastructure Engineer 2
job.description:
Job Description Implements and optimizes components within existing distributed systems under the guidance of senior engineers. Applies foundational scalability principles, conducts performance and load testing, and configures retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts to improve resilience to network variability. Delivers scoped features, develops fault-injection tests, and assists with data replication and synchronization.

Builds telemetry and alerts, maintains operational runbooks, and participates in on-call rotations with support. Uses automation and infrastructure-as-code scripts to troubleshoot issues. Follows established change management, security, and compliance procedures, including encryption, access controls, and remediation plans, and escalates complex issues appropriately.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: –Assist in the implementation of components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling under the guidance of senior engineers.

–Optimize code segments and/or systems for large-scale data processing with oversight from senior engineers.

–Implement scalability requirements for assigned components.

–Learn about the use of data plane platforms for large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.

–Execute performance and load testing, with guidance.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: –Collaborate with the team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by learning about redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.

–Learn about recovery oriented computing principles and assist in applying them to component designs.

–Configure and test retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability, with guidance

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: –Implement testing and alarming configurations to detect issues/failures.

–Support efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures, under guidance.

–Help build dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: –Implement functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.

–Implement test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness, under guidance.

–Help implement basic data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: –Assist in diagnosing and debugging issues in system components to support ongoing operation, under supervision.

–Follow protocols to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.

job.name: Lead AI Specialist (Finance Operations)
job.description:
Organization Overview Company Description QAD is a leading provider of ERP solutions purpose-built for manufacturing industries — automotive, life sciences, food & beverage, high tech, and industrial. Serving thousands of global manufacturers, QAD's Adaptive Manufacturing Cloud helps companies operate with greater precision, agility, and intelligence.

Enterprise software is entering a third era. The first gave manufacturers a System of Record — ERP that answered 'what do we have and what did we commit to?' The second gave them Data Infrastructure — the ability to move, analyse, and query that data at scale. The third era is domain-specific intelligence: AI agents that can act autonomously on manufacturing data, but only if that data has been given the context, relationships, and governed rules that allow an agent to reason correctly.

Job Description This position will lead the technical design, deployment, and operational management of QAD's Finance AI agents. The role bridges finance operations, data engineering, and AI systems to build secure, high-performing, and auditable agent-assisted workflows that optimize finance processes.

Core Responsibilities

* Data Foundation & Semantic Layer
* Define and own the context tables (business glossary, entity definitions, metric hierarchies) that ground AI agents in QAD's financial reality.
* Build and maintain the semantic layer — the translation between raw Google Cloud BigQuery datasets and the financial concepts agents reason over
* Partner with the data engineering team and other functions on dbt model governance and Fivetran pipeline integrity
* Agent Architecture & Process Design
* Determine the build methodology for process agents — frameworks, orchestration patterns, tool use conventions, handoff protocols between agents
* Sequence the agent build roadmap.
* Design the human-in-the-loop thresholds — when an agent escalates vs. executes autonomously
* Own the technical architecture decisions: LLM selection, retrieval strategy, memory design, context window management
* Agent Operations & Lifecycle Management
* Run the agent registry — versioning, deployment, deprecation, and change control for all live agents
* Manage agent performance over time: drift detection, accuracy degradation, prompt updates as business rules change
* Own the incident response protocol when an agent produces an incorrect output or takes an unintended action
* Coordinate agent updates when underlying data schemas, business logic, or finance policies change
* Visibility & Monitoring Platform
* Build or procure a Finance AI Control Center — a dashboard giving real-time visibility into which agents are running, what they've done, error rates, and escalation queues
* Define and track agent KPIs: task completion rate, exception rate, cycle time vs. manual baseline, cost per transaction
* Create an audit log for every agent action — who initiated it, what data was touched, what output was produced
*

As a Structured Data Engineer (AI Search), you will make ecommerce product data accurate, complete and machine-readable for AI search and AI shopping. Your work will ensure that AI systems can access reliable product, pricing, availability and delivery information, supporting product discoverability and ecommerce performance.

You will be fully embedded in an AEO/GEO programme and engineering team, working closely with the AEO/GEO Lead, engineering and platform teams, paid search, trading and product content teams.

This mid-to-senior-level role focuses on improving structured data quality, maintaining reliable product information at catalogue scale and enabling AI-powered product discovery and shopping.

  • Build automated validation and monitoring to identify broken, missing or contradictory structured markup
  • Own and maintain product feed pipelines into Google Merchant Center and Microsoft Merchant Center, collaborating with the paid search team
  • Prepare product feeds and integrations for emerging AI shopping platforms and agentic commerce protocols
  • Maintain near real-time consistency of pricing, availability and delivery information across the website, structured markup and product feeds where required

  • Ensure price matching, delivery options and customer review information are consistently structured across relevant platforms
  • Collaborate with PIM, catalogue and trading teams to resolve product data quality issues at source
  • Ensure important content and structured markup are available in server-rendered HTML and accessible to AI crawlers

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

About the Role

As a Structured Data Engineer (AI Search), you will make ecommerce product data accurate, complete and machine-readable for AI search and AI shopping. Your work will ensure that AI systems can access reliable product, pricing, availability and delivery information, supporting product discoverability and ecommerce performance.

You will be fully embedded in an AEO/GEO programme and engineering team, working closely with the AEO/GEO Lead, engineering and platform teams, paid search, trading and product content teams.

This mid-to-senior-level role focuses on improving structured data quality, maintaining reliable product information at catalogue scale and enabling AI-powered product discovery and shopping.

Responsibilities

  • Implement and maintain template-level JSON-LD across product, category, content and brand pages, including Product, ProductGroup, Offer, AggregateRating, Review, OfferShippingDetails, MerchantReturnPolicy and Organization
  • Generate structured markup directly from source systems to maintain accuracy as prices, stock levels and reviews change
  • Build automated validation and monitoring to identify broken, missing or contradictory structured markup
  • Own and maintain product feed pipelines into Google Merchant Center and Microsoft Merchant Center, collaborating with the paid search team
  • Prepare product feeds and integrations for emerging AI shopping platforms and agentic commerce protocols
  • Maintain near real-time consistency of pricing, availability and delivery information across the website, structured markup and product feeds where required
  • Identify and resolve gaps in product attributes, including specifications, energy ratings, dimensions and compatibility information
  • Ensure price matching, delivery options and customer review information are consistently structured across relevant platforms
  • Collaborate with PIM, catalogue and trading teams to resolve product data quality issues at source
  • Ensure important content and structured markup are available in server-rendered HTML and accessible to AI crawlers
  • Support log file analysis and crawler access rules alongside the AEO/GEO Lead

If you enjoy solving complex systems problems, thinking about graph patterns and distributed architectures, and shipping tools that have organization-wide impact, this role will give you that opportunity.

Key job responsibilities

  • Design and build scalability testing frameworks and tools that help Prime Video services validate their readiness to support millions of concurrent viewers safely and without customer impact.
  • Identify and resolve scalability blockers across services by analyzing system dependencies, load characteristics, and failure modes, then implementing permanent fixes at the root cause.
  • Collaborate with service teams across Prime Video to help them understand scalability challenges and adopt the frameworks your team builds, coaching them on best practices along the way.
  • Contribute across the full software development lifecycle — from working backwards on requirements through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations — while maintaining high code quality and clear documentation.
  • Evaluate new approaches and technologies for scale-readiness tooling, recommending adoption where appropriate and keeping your solutions straightforward rather than over-engineered.

A day in the life

You will spend much of your time working independently — diving deep into system architectures, profiling service behavior under load, and writing code for the tools and frameworks that power Prime Video's scale-readiness program. On other days, you will partner with service teams to walk through their scalability challenges, propose solutions, and help them integrate your tooling. As an individual contributor, you will balance heads-down engineering with collaborative problem-solving sessions, gaining broad exposure to the systems and patterns that keep Prime Video running at scale.

This role will focus on platform reliability, automation, developer experience, infrastructure scalability, security, and operational excellence. You will be responsible for building cloud-native platform capabilities, implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC), enhancing CI/CD processes, driving platform observability, and enabling modern developer platforms through tools such as Backstage.

job.description:
Recruitment Fraud Alert We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.

What To Know

  • Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.
  • We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.
  • Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com

About Commvault Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) delivers continuous recovery for the AI era. We help organizations stay ready for constant disruption by returning critical data, applications, identities, and AI systems to a clean, trusted state. Our purpose-built recovery solutions span cloud-native and hybrid environments, leveraging AI to enable resilience at enterprise scale.

Senior Engineer – Identity Resilience The Opportunity We have an outstanding career opportunity for a Senior Engineer – Identity Resilience at Bangalore and Hyderabad locations.

As a Senior Engineer on the Identity Resilience team, you will develop and enhance products that help enterprises monitor, protect, and recover their identity environments. You will build solutions across leading identity platforms including Microsoft Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, AWS IAM, and Google .

You’ll work on challenging engineering problems around identity change monitoring, auditing, protection, and recovery while building highly scalable, reliable, and secure cloud-native software.

job.description:
Summary:

A dedicated Level 2 application support team of two engineers, along with project management oversight, will be provided for the calendar year 2027, with potential continuation. The team is fully offshore and provides coverage across two weekday shift windows. Services include L2 (and escalated L3) incident and defect resolution, monitoring of batch jobs and ETL/API interfaces, incident, problem and change management, supplier enablement support, AI-assisted support, and status reporting.

  • ServiceNow (ITSM) and Git.

job.name: Senior Processor Verification Engineer
job.description:
Introduction At IBM Infrastructure & Technology, we design and operate the systems that keep the world running. From high-resiliency mainframes and hybrid cloud platforms to networking, automation, and site reliability. Our teams ensure the performance, security, and scalability that clients and industries depend on every day. Working in Infrastructure & Technology means tackling complex challenges with curiosity and collaboration. You'll work with diverse technologies and colleagues worldwide to deliver resilient, future-ready solutions that power innovation. With continuous learning, career growth, and a supportive culture, IBM provides the opportunities to build expertise and shape the infrastructure that drives progress.

Your Role And Responsibilities We are seeking a highly motivated Processor Simulation Engineer to join our processor architecture and modeling team. The candidate will contribute to the development, execution, validation, and analysis of processor simulation models used for architectural exploration, performance evaluation, and product development.

The role involves working closely with architects, performance engineers, design teams, and infrastructure teams to develop and maintain simulation environments, automate regression execution, analyze simulation results, and improve modeling accuracy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, configure, and maintain processor simulation and modeling environments.
  • Execute simulation workloads and regression suites to validate architectural and functional behavior.
  • Analyze simulation results and identify performance bottlenecks, functional issues, and modeling inaccuracies.
  • Debug simulation failures and collaborate with architecture, firmware, and hardware teams to resolve issues.
  • Create and maintain automation scripts for simulation execution, monitoring, and reporting.
  • Support simulator version migrations, model updates, and release validation activities.
  • Build tools and workflows that improve simulation efficiency, scalability, and usability.
  • Participate in model correlation, benchmarking, and performance characterization activities.
  • Document simulation methodologies, debugging procedures, and best practices.
  • Collaborate with global development teams in planning and executing simulation milestones.

Preferred Education Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Strong programming experience in:

+ C/C++
+ Python
+ Shell scripting (Bash/Ksh)

  • Solid understanding of:

+ Computer Architecture
+ Operating Systems

job.name: Associate Principal, Trust and Safety, Shopping
job.description:
Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7 years of experience in data analytics, Trust & Safety, policy, cybersecurity, or related fields.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in roles related to business analysis, statistical analysis or Machine Learning.
  • Experience in process/project management, with the ability to navigate and influence cross-team stakeholders.
  • Ability to solve large unstructured business problems, preferably in fraud investigations and risk management space.
  • Excellent process/project management, prioritisation, multitasking, analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to process a high amount of data to drive business strategies and decisions.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate with multiple cross-regional and cross-functional stakeholders.

About The Job Trust & Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know-how, excellent problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big-picture thinker and strategic team-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed - with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.

In this role, you will work hard to earn the users’ trust every day. Gaining and retaining this trust is critically important to Google’s success. job.name: Data Analytics Engineer I
job.description:
Job Purpose Design and deliver data transformation pipelines, semantic models, and BI solutions that enable reliable, self-service analytics across the organization. The role bridges data engineering and business intelligence, owning the analytical data layer from source transformation through to governed, business-ready reporting assets.

Key Result Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain modular, well-tested ELT pipelines using tools such as dbt, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent orchestration frameworks.
  • Build and maintain the semantic/analytical data layer in Snowflake or Microsoft Fabric, including fact and dimension tables, conformed metrics, and reusable dbt models.
  • Develop production-grade Power BI reports and dashboards, including well-structured data models, DAX measures, and row-level security configurations.
  • Define and implement data quality rules, testing frameworks, and monitoring to ensure accuracy and consistency of analytics outputs.

Key Result Responsibilities-Continued

  • Collaborate with data analysts, business stakeholders, and data engineers to translate reporting requirements into robust, governed data assets.
  • Apply and enforce dimensional modelling principles (star schema, slowly changing dimensions) to support efficient BI consumption.
  • Work within Azure and Snowflake environments to manage datasets, optimize query performance, and control data access.
  • Maintain clear documentation for all pipelines, semantic models, metric definitions, and report logic.
  • Participate actively in code reviews and contribute to improving team standards for analytics engineering.

Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages)

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Analytics, Statistics, or a related field.
  • Fluent in English Language.
  • ITIL Certification is an advantage but not mandatory.
  • Strong SQL skills and solid working knowledge of Python for data transformation tasks.
  • Working knowledge of dbt for transformation layer development, including tests, documentation, and lineage.
  • Hands-on experience with Power BI: data modelling, DAX, report design, and workspace governance.
  • Demonstrable experience delivering Power BI solutions in a professional setting.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric or Azure Data Factory for pipeline orchestration and data movement.
  • Solid understanding of dimensional modelling (star/snowflake schema, SCD types).
  • Understanding of BI governance principles: semantic model management, certified datasets, and access control in Power BI.

Work Experience

  • With 2–4 years of hands-on experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI development.
  • Experience with Snowflake or Azure Synapse Analytics for data warehousing and query optimization.
  • Experience with Git-based version control and collaborative development workflows.

About Vanguard Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.

Vanguard India Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.

Role Summary Lead a team of engineers and technical leads responsible for architecting, developing, and supporting enterprise technology solutions across multiple platforms. This role provides senior-level technical leadership, drives modern engineering practices, oversees secure API integrations, and ensures alignment between technology architecture, business priorities, and user needs. The incumbent champions innovation, software quality, documentation standards, and the adoption of emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop high-performing engineering teams by setting clear expectations, fostering career growth, and driving accountability for results.
  • Provide strategic technical leadership and architectural direction for complex, enterprise-scale software and platform solutions.
  • Drive the design, development, implementation, testing, deployment, and support of secure, scalable, and resilient technology solutions.
  • Review and approve technical designs, architectural recommendations, and engineering deliverables to ensure alignment with enterprise standards and business objectives.
  • Partner with business, product, UX, infrastructure, and security teams to deliver technology solutions that enhance user experience and operational efficiency.
  • Lead resolution of complex technical challenges through root-cause analysis, risk mitigation, and proactive problem prevention.
  • Establish and maintain engineering best practices, technical standards, governance processes, and software documentation frameworks.
  • Guide the adoption of modern software engineering methodologies, development tools, automation, and cloud-native technologies.
  • Drive API strategy and integration architecture to support secure and seamless data exchange across enterprise systems and applications.
  • Ensure solutions comply with information security, privacy, risk, and regulatory requirements.
  • Mentor engineers and technical leaders, fostering continuous learning and technical excellence across the organization.
  • Contribute to strategic technology roadmaps, architecture evolution, and long-term investment planning.
  • Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity, software quality, development efficiency

job.name: Full-Stack Software Engineer (Frontend, Backend & Cloud) – Applied & Agentic AI Systems
job.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Job Description We are looking for a highly skilled, deeply hands-on Full-Stack Software Engineer who will cover frontend UI, backend architecture, cloud deployment, and DevOps engineering all under one hat. Since our team already includes dedicated AI Engineers and Data Engineers, your primary mission is to be the foundational software engineering anchor: building the robust, scalable, and secure user interfaces, infrastructure, integrations, and server-side logic that allows our AI solutions to thrive in a production environment.

Description Of The Area At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. As part of our strategic initiatives, we are enabling high-value AI solutions spanning advanced agentic frameworks, Generative AI applications, and classical Machine Learning. The Applied AI Engineering Team is tasked with building these innovative AI applications end-to-end to solve complex business challenges in healthcare.

In the 2026 tech landscape, the lines between traditional disciplines have blurred. We operate in small agile teams (e.g., ~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before (through agentic SDLC).

Job Responsibilities Frontend Architecture & Generative UI: Develop highly scalable, reusable UI components using expert-level TypeScript and modern frameworks (React/Next.js or Angular 16+). Shift from static layouts to flexible, dynamic interfaces that gracefully handle unpredictable data and real-time LLM streams.

Core Backend Engineering & API Design: Design and build highly scalable, reusable backend services and APIs (using Python) that serve as the backbone for multi-agent workflows and GenAI applications. Build, host, and secure Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and standard APIs to standardize data exchange.

Cloud Architecture & DevOps Excellence: Design, implement, and manage secure and scalable cloud infrastructure (primarily AWS) tailored for diverse AI workloads. Apply Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) practices using Terraform. Build, maintain, and optimize fully automated CI/CD pipelines and manage application containerization (Docker).

Agentic SDLC & Engineering Excellence: Leverage AI coding assistants and autonomous agents (e.g., Claude Code, Ona) daily to accelerate full-stack development cycles. Conduct rigorous code reviews for both human-written and AI-generated code.

job.name: Data Architect
job.description:
About Onit We're redefining the future of legal operations through the power of AI. Our cutting-edge platform streamlines enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management and contract lifecycle processes, transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated solutions.

We’re a team of innovators using AI at the core to help legal departments become faster, smarter, and more strategic. As we continue to grow and expand the capabilities of our new AI-centric platform, we’re looking for bold thinkers and builders who are excited to shape the next chapter of legal tech.

If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we’d love to meet you.

*Position Summary* The Data Architect owns the technical foundation of a new data-intensive benchmarking and analytics capability embedded in Onit's enterprise legal operations platform. This is a hands-on, engineering-focused architecture role at the start of a multi-phase programme, and the work is front-loaded: within the first quarter, the Data Architect will select the data platform, design the canonical data model that several product surfaces depend on, define the service contracts, and set the performance and multi-tenant data-isolation guarantees the team builds against. Working closely with the Lead Engineer, Lead Designer, Product Management, and Data Engineering, this role stays in the code, the query plans, and the review conversations rather than handing designs over a wall.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architecture Ownership: Own the end-to-end architecture for a data-intensive analytics capability embedded in an existing enterprise product.
  • Data Platform Selection: Evaluate and select the data platform for large-scale analytical queries, with a documented cost and performance basis for the decision.
  • Canonical Data Model: Design a canonical data model that multiple source systems feed and multiple product surfaces consume, ensuring figures reconcile consistently across every surface.
  • Service Contracts & APIs: Define and publish service contracts and API specifications using a contract-first approach.
  • Non-Functional Requirements: Set and defend latency targets, refresh cadence, and availability requirements, and make them measurable rather than aspirational.
  • Multi-Tenant Data Isolation: Design tenant data isolation so that it is enforced structurally, not by convention.
  • Architecture Decisions & Reviews: Write architecture decision records that explain trade-offs honestly, including what would change the decision, and review designs and code across the team.
  • Cross-Functional Translation: Translate technical constraints into terms Product and Design can act on, and translate their requirements back into architecture.

job.name: Senior Specialist - AMS F&T - M&S Mobility
job.description:
What You’ll Do Eaton announced, on June 11, 2026, the intent to combine its Mobility Group (including both the Vehicle and eMobility segments) with a new company. We expect to complete this process by the end of the first half of 2027. The compensation and benefits that will initially be offered for this position are based on Eaton's plans, programs and practices. If you are offered and accept this position and are actively employed by the Mobility Group when the transaction closes, the new company will provide further details to employees concerning compensation and benefits at that time.

The primary function of the role is to provide technical leadership in development and use of advanced simulation and modeling techniques in plasma physics of electrical arc and gas breakdown. The person would be expected to work with Product groups to ensure deployment of arc modeling and simulations capabilities to drive competitive advantage for Eaton. In addition, Incumbent is also expected to closely partner with product development and marketing teams to help in demonstrating value proposition to OEMs during pursuit programs towards new business wins. The person would also be responsible to help retain, document and review advanced modeling methodologies for flow & thermal analysis.

Job Responsibilities Would Include

  • Develop and implement new arc simulation models (physical and numerical) to enhance Eaton’s simulation capabilities, including new (potentially publishable or patentable) approaches to plasma physics.
  • Work with Arc Modeling and Simulations CoE Leaders to improve on technology development related to Plasma Physics and relevant product development.
  • Constantly update and mature technologies based on Flow, Thermal & Emag (FT&E) TRM set for the team in line with business product roadmap and product strategies.
  • Work with the stakeholders to secure DP synergy & business infra funding to improve on technology development.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with global stakeholders, technical community and academia. Leverage internal and external partnerships for continuous advancements of the capability.
  • Meet stakeholder expectations on R / D / E portfolio with tighter engagement on project / program and analysis first deployment.
  • Constantly strive towards percolating Arc Modeling expertise into new sites / businesses to get more meaningful engagement.
  • Participate in organization initiatives / discussion to add value by leading initiatives and handle technical expert in Plasma Physics responsibility effectively.
  • Compliment rest of the technologies in M&S to create seamless execution of the projects across the technologies."

Qualifications Masters degree/PhD in Mechanical

Relevant experience in Simulation domain - 15+ years with Masters degree / 10+ years with PhD. Experience of working with multinational engineering organization

job.name: Structured Data Engineer - AI Search (Remote, Full-Time) [HR226]
job.description:
About Smart Working

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being.

Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

About the Role

As a Structured Data Engineer (AI Search), you will make ecommerce product data accurate, complete and machine-readable for AI search and AI shopping. Your work will ensure that AI systems can access reliable product, pricing, availability and delivery information, supporting product discoverability and ecommerce performance.

You will be fully embedded in an AEO/GEO programme and engineering team, working closely with the AEO/GEO Lead, engineering and platform teams, paid search, trading and product content teams.

This mid-to-senior-level role focuses on improving structured data quality, maintaining reliable product information at catalogue scale and enabling AI-powered product discovery and shopping.

Responsibilities

  • Implement and maintain template-level JSON-LD across product, category, content and brand pages, including Product, ProductGroup, Offer, AggregateRating, Review, OfferShippingDetails, MerchantReturnPolicy and Organization
  • Generate structured markup directly from source systems to maintain accuracy as prices, stock levels and reviews change
  • Build automated validation and monitoring to identify broken, missing or contradictory structured markup
  • Own and maintain product feed pipelines into Google Merchant Center and Microsoft Merchant Center, collaborating with the paid search team
  • Prepare product feeds and integrations for emerging AI shopping platforms and agentic commerce protocols
  • Maintain near real-time consistency of pricing, availability and delivery information across the website, structured markup and product feeds where required
  • Identify and resolve gaps in product attributes, including specifications, energy ratings, dimensions and compatibility information
  • Ensure price matching, delivery options and customer review information are consistently structured across relevant platforms
  • Collaborate with PIM, catalogue and trading teams to resolve product data quality issues at source
  • Ensure important content and structured markup are available in server-rendered HTML and accessible to AI crawlers
  • Support log file analysis and crawler access rules alongside the AEO/GEO Lead

job.name: Product Owner SharePoint Online
job.description:
What you will do

About The Role We are looking for a Product Owner SharePoint Online to take end-to-end responsibility for SharePoint Online at tesa. In this role you own the platform in every sense: you develop, keep it running for our users day to day, you shape how it and you make sure it stays secure, governed and easy to work with. We are looking for a developper and not a simple SharePoint administrator. The position sits in our IT organisation and combines hands-on development and operational work with solution design and consulting for the business.

A large part of your time is spent close to our colleagues worldwide. You handle incidents and service requests, you lead the migration of legacy file servers into SharePoint Online, and you design the document management structures that our departments rely on. Alongside this operational ownership you work on demands and projects, and you build automation and low-code solutions with Power Apps and Power Automate where they create real value. You collaborate closely with our Modern Workplace team as well as with business stakeholders in Germany and at our international sites.

  • Process incidents and service requests in our ticket system, including analysis, resolution, documentation and communication with the requester
  • Lead migrations from file servers and legacy platforms to SharePoint Online, from assessment and structure design through to cutover and adoption
  • Design and implement document management solutions on SharePoint Online, including site and library structures, metadata, versioning, retention and access concepts
  • Work on demands and projects together with business departments, from requirement clarification and solution design to implementation and handover
  • Build and maintain low-code solutions with Power Apps, Power Automate flows and SharePoint Lists to digitise and automate business processes
  • Support tickets and topics in the wider Microsoft 365 environment, for example Teams, OneDrive and related collaboration services
  • Integrate SharePoint with other Microsoft 365 services and evaluate new capabilities such as Microsoft Copilot for our collaboration landscape
  • Provide user training, documentation and expert guidance to drive adoption and effective use of SharePoint
  • Monitor platform health, run regular audits and continuously improve stability, security and user experience

Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Skan AI

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist who loves to get their hands dirty. This is a deeply hands-on role; you will build and own AI/ML models and data pipelines, work directly with large and messy real-world datasets, and be the go-to person when something breaks or doesn't make sense.

What You'll Do

Hands-On Modelling & Algorithm Development

  • Build, train, evaluate, and improve ML models that power core Skan.ai features including but not limited to task detection, workflow segmentation, behavioral pattern recognition, process discovery, and variant analysis.
  • Own the full modelling lifecycle: data exploration, feature engineering, model selection, hyperparameter tuning and validation.
  • Run disciplined experiments: define clear hypotheses, design evaluation frameworks, and present findings with statistical rigour.
  • Explore and apply techniques from deep learning, NLP, time-series analysis, and unsupervised learning to real process intelligence problems.
  • Write clean, well-tested, production-ready Python code that your teammates can maintain and build on.

Data Pipelines & Large-Scale Data

  • Design and build reliable data pipelines that handle high volumes of multimodal enterprise data such as screen telemetry, event logs, clickstreams, and structured process data.
  • Own data quality at every step: define validation checks, detect drift, monitor pipeline health, and fix issues proactively.
