Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Skan AI

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist who loves to get their hands dirty. This is a deeply hands-on role; you will build and own ML models and data pipelines, work directly with large and messy real-world datasets, and be the go-to person when something breaks or doesn't make sense. You will also play a key guiding role for junior data scientists and analysts on the team, helping them grow through close collaboration, code reviews, and day-to-day technical direction.

You are not a manager, but you are a multiplier. The best candidate is someone who writes excellent code in the morning, helps a junior teammate unblock an issue in the afternoon, and debugs a tricky customer data problem before EOD, and finds all three equally satisfying.

What You'll Do

Hands-On Modelling & Algorithm Development

  • Build, train, evaluate, and improve ML models that power core Skan.ai features including but not limited to task detection, workflow segmentation, behavioral pattern recognition, process discovery, and variant analysis.
  • Own the full modelling lifecycle: data exploration, feature engineering, model selection, hyperparameter tuning and validation.
  • Run disciplined experiments: define clear hypotheses, design evaluation frameworks, and present findings with statistical rigour.
  • Explore and apply techniques from deep learning, NLP, time-series analysis, and unsupervised learning to real process intelligence problems.

ANSR is hiring for one of its clients.

About ANSR MedTech:

Who We Are:

ANSR MedTech Capability Center is a new global innovation hub being established in India for a Fortune 100 Fastest-Growing Company in the MedTech sector. Built in partnership with ANSR, the center draws on ANSR’s proven experience in establishing and scaling high-performance Global Capability Centers (GCCs) for leading global enterprises.

ANSR MedTech center brings together world-class engineering, product, and technology talent to build next-generation healthcare platforms and solutions that power global operations.

Our Vision:

To build a next-generation MedTech capability center that powers global healthcare innovation. We envision:

  • High-impact innovation hubs shaping global product and technology roadmaps
  • Centers that go beyond support functions to drive core engineering and platform development
  • Sustainable, scalable ecosystems that nurture world-class MedTech talent
  • Capability centers that directly influence patient outcomes worldwide

At its core, the ANSR MedTech Capability Center is about enabling innovation that touches lives at scale.

About IACTO:

At ANSR MedTech, the Insights & Analytics (I&A) Center of Excellence is built as a single, integrated analytics organization with two closely partnered focus areas: Growth aligned analytics and CTO aligned analytics.

Both work together to ensure analytics drives real outcomes at enterprise scale.

Growth Aligned Insights & Analytics:

  • Growth aligned I&A teams focus on turning data into decisions.
  • They work closely with business leaders to understand context, analyze data, and deliver insights that directly inform commercial, product, and operational actions.
  • These roles are best suited for people who enjoy:
  • Working close to the business and stakeholders
  • Translating complex data into clear insights and recommendations
  • Driving measurable impact through analytics

CTO Aligned Insights & Analytics:

  • CTO aligned I&A teams focus on building and operating the data and AI foundation that enables analytics at scale.
  • They design, build, and maintain platforms, pipelines, models, and governance that ensure analytics is secure, reliable, and repeatable.
  • These roles are best suited for people who enjoy:
  • Building scalable data platforms and AI capabilities
  • Engineering high quality, production ready data solutions
  • Establishing standards, reliability, and long term sustainability

How the Teams Work Together:

  • Growth defines what insights matter and how they are used
  • CTO enables how those insights are delivered at scale
  • Teams operate as one connected analytics organization, with clear ownership and shared outcomes
  • This model allows ANSR MedTech to deliver fast, meaningful insights while building a strong, enterprise grade analytics foundation for long term growth.

job.name: Applied AI Researcher : Energy Intelligence Platform(Phd)
job.description:
Voltanova is building an AI-powered Energy Intelligence Platform to optimize how energy is generated, stored, purchased, and consumed across industrial energy systems.

We are looking for an ML Researcher to develop intelligent models combining:

Weather + Renewable Generation + Electricity Demand + Tariffs + Grid + Storage + Industrial Processes

What you’ll work on

  • Build advanced time-series forecasting models for energy demand, renewable generation, prices, and weather.
  • Develop AI-driven optimization and decision-making for energy storage and industrial energy systems.
  • Research Transformers, probabilistic forecasting, reinforcement learning, and physics-informed ML .
  • Build models that move from prediction → optimization → autonomous energy decisions .
  • Work closely with our energy and thermal engineering teams to incorporate real-world physical constraints.

What we’re looking for

  • Strong ML, statistics, and mathematical foundations.
  • Strong Python and experience with PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX .
  • Experience with time-series forecasting, optimization, or reinforcement learning.
  • Prior experience in energy, power systems, climate, industrial systems, or storage is a strong advantage.
  • Strong research mindset and ability to independently solve complex problems.

This is an opportunity to build the AI brain that manages the future of industrial energy.

job.name: Lead Data Scientist
job.description:
Job Title

Lead Data Scientist

Job Description Job title: Lead Data Scientist Your Role The Lead Data Scientist architects, builds, and runs production-grade Machine Learning and Generative AI systems—owning the full lifecycle from model development to scalable cloud deployment and ongoing performance monitoring . In addition, the role partners with commercial stakeholders translate market/customer data into decision-ready insights and AI-enabled analytics solutions that drive measurable outcomes Operating with a builder and translator mindset , the individual rapidly develops MVP analytics solutions , leverages AI to accelerate insight generation , and ensures strong product engineering fundamentals, data quality , and governance . The role plays a critical part in establishing a single source of truth for performance management across markets and channels while elevating analytics maturity from descriptive reporting to predictive and insight-led decision making .

Key Responsibilities

  • ML & Deep Learning Model Development
  • Design, train, and optimize ML models for prediction, classification, ranking, time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, NLP, and recommendation use cases.
  • Build robust experimentation workflows (train/validation strategy, ablations, error analysis) and improve model quality through iterative tuning.
  • Ensure reproducibility and maintainability through clean code practices, versioning, and automated testing.
  • GenAI Engineering (LLMs, RAG / MCP / fine-tuning, Agents)
  • Build enterprise-grade LLM applications using RAG (retrieval-augmented generation), MCP, and fine-tuning approaches: chunking strategies, embedding generation, hybrid retrieval, reranking, prompt templates, and citation/attribution patterns.
  • Develop LLM applications with tool use/function calling patterns and agentic workflows where appropriate.
  • Implement systematic evaluation: curated eval sets, prompt regression tests, hallucination checks, retrieval quality metrics, and automated quality gates.
  • ML & LLM Operations: Productionization, Deployment & Monitoring
  • Deploy and operate real-time and batch inference solutions on Azure using managed endpoints and/or containerized serving.
  • Build CI/CD for ML systems: automated packaging, container builds, model validation tests, staged rollouts, and rollback strategies.
  • Establish lifecycle management: model registry/versioning, lineage, promotion workflows, and release governance.
  • Implement observability: latency, throughput, cost, drift signals, data quality checks, alerts, and performance degradation monitoring.
  • Pipeline Orchestration & Automation (Train → Deploy)
  • Build standardized ML pipelines for training, evaluation, and deployment using orchestration tools (cloud-native pipelines and/or platform tools).
  • Automate dataset/versio

job.name: Senior Data Engineer
job.description:
Job Logistics Summary Position: Senior Data Engineer

Type: Full-time

Location: Hybrid, Bangalore, India

Reports to: CTO

Who We Are SellCord is the largest Walmart-exclusive agency dedicated to helping sellers maximize their success on the Walmart platform. Our mission is to empower businesses with the tools, insights, and support they need to thrive in a competitive e-commerce landscape.

About The Role We’re rebuilding our data platform on Snowflake. The foundation is in place, but most of the design decisions are still open. We need one engineer to own it: how data comes in, how it’s modeled, how metrics are defined, and how the rest of the company gets answers from it. You won’t inherit someone else’s architecture and maintain it. You’ll build it, and people will use it the same week.

What You’ll Own The architecture. Every layer of the warehouse, from raw landing through cleaned data, business models, and the semantic layer on top.

Ingestion. Pipelines from APIs, file feeds, and application databases. Some sources are large, some are messy, and the schemas change without warning.

The models. Dimensional models and shared dimensions that reporting, analytics, and AI tools all build on.

The definitions. One agreed meaning for each key metric, so a dashboard, a client report, and an AI assistant all give the same number.

Reliability. Tests, CI/CD, monitoring, and alerts. If a number is wrong, you hear about it before a client does.

Performance and cost. Fast queries, sensible compute, predictable spend.

The standards. You review data work from other engineers and set how it’s done here.

What The First Six Months Look Like Month 1: Learn the sources and the business. Ship your first pipeline and model to production.

Month 3: The core models are live and documented. Teams are building on them instead of writing one-off queries.

Month 6: The semantic layer is the default source for reporting and AI tools. Legacy workloads are moving over on a plan you wrote.

You’ll Do Well Here If You have 5+ years in data engineering and have owned production pipelines, not just contributed to them.

You’ve designed a warehouse from raw data to business metrics at least once and can explain what you’d do differently.

Your SQL is excellent and your Python is solid.

You’ve run Snowflake and dbt (or close equivalents) in production.

You’ve used an orchestration tool and have opinions about it.

You can sit with a non-technical person, hear “I need a report,” and come back with a precise definition.

You write things down without being asked.

You use AI tools to move faster and check their work.

Bonus Points Semantic layer tools (dbt Semantic Layer, Cube, Snowflake semantic views)

Postgres depth

Experience making reports in BI tools like Power BI or Metabase

Retail, e-commerce, or advertising data

We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Job Title Development Manager (Hybrid)

Job Description Role summary Kaplan International Pathways is a leading provider of global education, centered around our students. Technology is at the heart of what we do, and delivery discipline matters because we operate across multiple platforms, partners, and time zones.

We are seeking a strategic and technical Development Manager to join our Application Engineering and Architecture Team. This role is unique: you will own the "production line" of our software delivery. While we have multiple distributed development teams shipping code, we need to eliminate friction and ensure seamless integration.

You will not just be managing people; you will be the architect of our flow. You will coordinate teams to optimise cadence, professionalise our release capability, and ensure that our delivery ordering prevents technical debt. You will be the guardian of our platform's integrity and the driver of our engineering velocity.

As the Development Manager you will work intimately with the QA Manager, Solution Architects, Partners, and the Portfolio Delivery Team. Your mission is to streamline our development cycle through lightweight governance, automation, and artificial intelligence.

Detailed Responsibilities Release Management:

  • Enforce the Operational Readiness Review (ORR). You have the authority to say, "No Go."
  • Ensure that before code goes live, Service Level Objectives (SLOs) are met, telemetry is active and run books are updated.
  • Coordinate release schedules across concurrent, distributed development teams to prevent environment contention and deployment collisions.
  • Act as the conductor of the "Release Train," ensuring it runs on time, in the correct order, and that inter-team dependencies are resolved before deployment day.
  • Partner with the QA Manager to enforce the Release-Confidence (RC) Score as a hard gate in your pipelines, preventing low-quality code from blocking the flow for other high-performing teams

Pipeline Governance & Policy-as-Code

  • Own the definition and evolution of our CI/CD pipeline standards.
  • Drive the implementation of "Policy-as-Code" and automated quality gates to catch issues early (Shift Left), ensuring that no non-compliant build ever reaches production.
  • Work with Solution Architects to define and operationalise "Green Lane" patterns, our automated, low-friction paths for low-risk changes.
  • Move us away from heavy manual governance for standard changes, enabling high-trust teams to bypass red tape and increasing our overall DORA metrics/velocity.

Operational Excellence & Incident Command

  • Act as the primary Incident Commander for major deployment failures or outages.
  • Lead the Root Cause Analysis (RCA) process, ensuring we don't just fix the bug, but systematically prevent the recurrence of the failure scenario.

Ensure that no unauthorized software or corporate agents (e.g., CrowdStrike, ServiceNow, ClearPass, Windows Domain utilities) are installed or active on endpoints installed on the VLAN behind the Jump Host.
  • Service Availability: Ensure the high availability, performance, patch status, and storage capacity of jump servers acting as gateways to the core RDL networks.
  • Export Control Compliance & Interactive Gates

Additionally, you'll handle client escalations with professionalism and assist in disaster recovery functions and tests when necessary.

Working within our diverse and inclusive environment, you'll help drive the optimization of efforts by working with automation teams and supporting L1 Engineers. Your responsibility also extends to contributing to various projects, ensuring that all changes are approved, and maintaining a positive outlook even in high-pressure situations.

job.name: Senior Storage Engineer
job.description:
About Us At apexanalytix, we’re lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we’ve been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure-to-pay solutions to the world. We’re the perfect balance of established company and start-up. You will find a unique home here.

And you’ll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you’ll be helping build that reputation.

Read more about apexanalytix - https://www.apexanalytix.com/about/

Most storage jobs are console administration: provision a LUN, hand it over, close the ticket. This one is not. We build, own and operate our own private cloud on our own hardware, and storage runs the whole way from the enterprise arrays through Ceph to the persistent volume a container actually mounts. You would own that path end to end, and you would own the thing most organisations only claim to have, which is a restore that has been proven rather than assumed.

What you would own

  • Kubernetes-native storage. Rook and Ceph, the CSI layer, StorageClasses, and how a persistent volume claim becomes real capacity. This is the centre of the role, not an adjunct to it.
  • Provable backup and restore. Not just that backups ran, but that a restore has been performed, timed and witnessed. You would own the evidence, and the schedule that keeps it current.
  • The enterprise arrays. Pure Storage and NetApp, including snapshots, replication, provisioning, capacity planning and performance work.
  • Disaster recovery. Designing the tests, running them, and fixing what they expose. RPO and RTO you can defend with a number rather than an intention.
  • The storage standard. Documentation, monitoring, alerting on failure rather than on absence of success, and the capacity roadmap.

What the first year looks like

  • Establish provable backup and restore across every tenant and platform system, with independently witnessed evidence. This is a stated company priority, and it would be yours.
  • Bring Ceph and the Kubernetes storage layer under the same operational standard as the arrays.
  • Run at least one full DR exercise end to end and close what it uncovers.
  • Remove the single points of knowledge, so no part of the storage estate depends on one person being reachable.

What we need you to have done

job.name: Programme Coordinator- Research, Advocacy and Partnerships, Ahmedabad
job.description:
About the job Programme Coordinator- Research, Advocacy and Partnerships, Ahmedabad **Role: Programme Coordinator- Research, Advocacy and Partnerships, Ahmedabad Experience: 3+ years **Salary band: upto 7.5 LPA

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_* About The Role* Help turn workers’ experiences into evidence, partnerships and action.

We are seeking a thoughtful, resourceful professional who can connect field realities with research and public advocacy. Based in Ahmedabad, you will work with migrant and informal workers, programme teams, and external partners to strengthen access to rights, social protection, decent housing, and safer working conditions.

*The Opportunity* This role offers the opportunity to shape an evidence-informed advocacy agenda grounded in workers’ lives. You will identify recurring problems through field engagement, develop focused research, and translate findings into practical recommendations and sustained dialogue with government, employers, and civil society. The work will include labour rights, occupational safety and health, social security, worker housing, and emerging concerns such as heat stress.

*Your Responsibilities*

  • Research and Evidence: Identify research questions with field teams and workers; undertake focused studies, interviews, and policy reviews; analyse programme and case data; and develop concise research notes, policy briefs, and worker case studies. Use appropriate methods, informed consent, and confidentiality safeguards.
  • Advocacy and Policy Engagement: Develop achievable advocacy priorities and action plans from field evidence. Prepare submissions and recommendations, track policy developments, and follow up on institutional commitments and barriers affecting workers.
  • Government and Employer Engagement: Build constructive working relationships with labour and social-protection authorities, health services, municipal institutions, and employers. Use these relationships to address gaps in workers’ access to services, safety, and grievance resolution.
  • Partnerships and Collective Action: Develop purposeful collaborations with worker groups, trade unions, civil society organisations, researchers, and academic institutions. Convene dialogues and joint initiatives with clear objectives and follow-through.
  • Communication and Representation: Communicate findings clearly for different audiences and represent the organization in relevant consultations and networks. Work with communications colleagues to bring worker perspectives into public discussion responsibly.
  • Field Connections and Organisational Learning: Maintain regular contact with workers and field teams in Ahmedabad and relevant Gujarat locations. Support colleagues to integrate research and advocacy into programme work, document learning, and report on progress and outcomes.

job.name: Supply Chain Manager
job.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Supply Chain Manager to own the complete supply chain function: procurement, vendor development, stores, inventory and logistics. The role ensures materials are available on time for uninterrupted production, at optimum cost and inventory levels.

Key Responsibilities

1. Procurement

  • Manage end-to-end procurement for production, R&D and operational needs.
  • Source electronic components, mechanical parts, raw materials and consumables.
  • Raise Purchase Orders against approved Purchase Requisitions and follow up for timely delivery.
  • Keep all purchases within approved budgets and company policy.

2. Vendor Management & Cost Optimisation

  • Identify, evaluate and develop new vendors; maintain strong relationships with existing ones.
  • Compare quotations and negotiate price, payment terms, credit periods and delivery conditions.
  • Develop alternate vendors for critical and long-lead-time materials to reduce supply risk.
  • Review vendor performance (price, quality, delivery, service) periodically.
  • Track market price trends and achieve annual cost-reduction targets.

3. Inventory & Material Planning

  • Plan materials based on production schedules and project forecasts, in coordination with Production and Planning teams.
  • Set minimum, maximum and reorder levels for critical materials.
  • Avoid overstocking and shortages; act on slow-moving, non-moving and dead stock.
  • Track pending orders to ensure timely availability.

4. Stores Management

  • Oversee material inward, storage, issuance and stock control.
  • Ensure GRN documentation and coordinate with QA/QC for incoming inspection.
  • Maintain accurate stock records with timely ERP updates; follow FIFO/FEFO.
  • Conduct periodic physical stock verification and reconciliation.
  • Ensure proper labelling, traceability, housekeeping and efficient use of storage space.

5. Logistics

  • Manage inbound and outbound logistics (transport, courier, freight).
  • Ensure timely movement of materials between vendors, stores and production.
  • Monitor logistics cost and delivery performance; resolve transport issues.

6. Documentation, Compliance & Reporting

  • Maintain procurement records: PRs, quotations, comparative statements, POs and vendor data.
  • Coordinate with Finance for invoices, payments and reconciliation.
  • Ensure GST and purchase documentation compliance.
  • Prepare monthly supply chain MIS covering inventory value, turnover, supplier performance, cost savings and logistics cost.

7. Team & Process Development

  • Lead and develop the procurement and stores team; define roles and accountability.
  • Create and implement SOPs for procurement, stores and inventory.
  • Improve coordination with Production, QA, QC and Finance.
  • Identify risks and process gaps; implement corrective and preventive actions.

Required Skills

job.name: Digital Construction Engineer (DCE)
job.description:
About VisiLean

VisiLean is an award-winning, cloud-based Construction Management Software company founded in Helsinki, Finland, in 2015. With offices in Finland, the UK, and Ahmedabad, we support clients globally on some of the world's largest construction projects.

Our platform helps the Architecture, Engineering and Construction (AEC) industry improve project planning, execution and monitoring through digital construction solutions, integrating project schedules and BIM models for real-time project tracking.

About the Role

We are looking for an enthusiastic and technically capable Digital Construction Engineer (DCE) to join our growing Customer Support & Engineering team in Ahmedabad.

In this role, you will work closely with international clients and internal teams to support the implementation and deployment of VisiLean across construction projects. The position combines practical construction knowledge, project planning expertise and digital engineering, with opportunities to contribute to product development and digital construction practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical and back-end support for VisiLean implementation across projects.
  • Assist clients in adopting digital engineering and construction solutions.
  • Support project setup, including project plan and BIM model imports, system configuration and schedule updates.
  • Assist with BIM model linking and project data management.
  • Develop user guides, reference manuals and workflow documentation.
  • Deliver VisiLean training on web and mobile applications.
  • Support drone flights and/or 360° camera-based site capture.
  • Develop feature specifications and coordinate with the technical team.
  • Assist implementation consultants with training and technical support.
  • Develop and share best practices, workflows, processes and tools.
  • Provide on-site support to projects across India, including travel to project locations.

What We Are Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Civil Engineering or a specialisation relevant to Construction Project Management.
  • Relevant practical experience in construction projects, preferably across multiple locations and cultural settings.
  • Knowledge and expertise in construction scheduling tools such as Primavera P6, MS Project, Asta or Vico.
  • Familiarity with Business Analytics tools such as Power BI.
  • Excellent command of the English language.
  • Knowledge of BIM tools and their integration with project management systems would be an advantage.
  • Drone Pilot Licence would be an added advantage.

Why Join VisiLean?

  • Work with an international team supporting major construction projects globally.
  • Gain exposure to digital construction, project controls and BIM integration.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of innovative construction technology solutions.
  • Work closely with clients and industry professionals across different markets.

Interested?

job.name: Planning Lead
job.description:
• Position Summary

The Project Planning & Controls Lead is responsible for providing planning leadership, schedule governance, and delivery assurance for data center construction and infrastructure projects delivered under a Project Management Consultancy (PMC) model.

Acting as the client’s planning and controls representative, the role ensures that integrated master schedules, progress reporting, and forecasting frameworks are robust, accurate, and aligned with delivery objectives. The position works closely with Project Managers, Project Directors, contractors, consultants, and client stakeholders to provide clear, data-driven insights that support timely decision-making and delivery certainty across one or multiple mission-critical data center projects.

  • Key Responsibilities

Planning & Controls Leadership

  • Lead planning and controls activities across the full project lifecycle, including design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover.
  • Develop, maintain, and govern integrated master schedules and detailed project programs in alignment with PMC and client standards.
  • Establish planning principles, schedule structures, coding, and reporting frameworks across the project portfolio.
  • Act as the central authority for schedule integrity, logic, and baseline management.

Schedule Development & Governance

  • Review, validate, and integrate contractor and consultant schedules into a coordinated master program.
  • Ensure alignment of design, procurement, construction, and commissioning activities across all workstreams.
  • Define and manage key milestones, critical paths, and interface dependencies.
  • Support phasing strategies, fast-track delivery, and concurrent construction models common to data center projects.

Progress Monitoring, Analysis & Reporting

  • Implement consistent progress measurement methodologies across all disciplines and contractors.
  • Track progress against baselines, identify variances, and provide forward-looking forecasts.
  • Prepare high-quality schedule reports, dashboards, and executive summaries for client and project leadership.
  • Highlight risks to milestones and critical paths, with clear mitigation and recovery options.

Risk, Change & Recovery Planning

  • Support identification of schedule-related risks and development of mitigation strategies.
  • Perform schedule impact assessments for changes, delays, and scope adjustments.
  • Support recovery planning, acceleration strategies, and what-if scenario analysis.
  • Contribute to risk registers and delivery assurance reviews from a planning perspective.

Delay Analysis, Claims Review & Forensic Support

job.name: Specialist, Cybersecurity
job.description:
If you’re passionate about being part of a dynamic organization that enables a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales to drive innovation and adopt new technologies that deliver business results, then Nationwide’s Technology team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

Insider Threat Response Analyst

Position Overview We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically proficient Insider Threat Response Analyst to join our cybersecurity team. This role is responsible for detecting, investigating, and responding to potential insider threats across enterprise environments. The ideal candidate will have strong scripting, data analysis, and incident response capabilities, along with a deep understanding of operating systems, cloud platforms, and forensic processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead investigations into potential insider threats, including data exfiltration, sabotage, compliance violations and unauthorized access.
  • Monitor and analyze user activity across endpoints, networks, and cloud environments to detect anomalous behavior.
  • Develop and execute scripts using Python or PowerShell to automate threat detection and data parsing.
  • Perform database querying and analysis to identify unauthorized access or data exfiltration.
  • Utilize SIEM solutions and write SPL and XQL queries to correlate events and generate actionable insights.
  • Conduct analysis on Windows, Linux, and macOS systems to support investigations.
  • Investigate incidents involving insider threats, including digital evidence collection and preservation.
  • Collaborate with incident response teams to ensure timely containment and remediation.

job.name: CFD/Meshing Engineer, AI Integration
job.description:
Job Title: CFD/Meshing Engineer, AI Integration

Location: Gurugram | Bengaluru| Hyderabad | Pune (On-site)

Type: Full-Time

Experience: 5+ years

About the Role

We are looking for a CFD Engineer who can bridge simulation workflows with AI-driven automation. This role sits at the intersection of aerodynamics, CAD/geometry, and applied AI, building tools that automate meshing, simulation setup, and geometry validation, while working closely with CAD and ML teams to make the aircraft design pipeline end-to-end automated.

What You'll Do

● Set up, run, and post-process full-aircraft CFD simulations (external aerodynamics).

● Build and maintain automated CFD pipelines: geometry import, cleanup checks, meshing, solver setup, and results extraction.

● Integrate AI/ML models into the CFD workflow (e.g., surrogate models, automated mesh-quality classification, geometry-defect detection, parameter optimization loops).

● Work directly with the CAD/geometry team to flag and resolve geometry issues before they cause meshing or solver failures.

● Design and prototype AI-assisted tools that reduce manual intervention in the meshing-to-simulation cycle.

● Collaborate with software/ML engineers to productionize CFD automation scripts and internal tooling.

● Document workflows and templates so they generalize across a wide range of aircraft configurations.

Required Skills

● Strong hands-on CFD experience: setup, meshing, solving, and post-processing for external aerodynamics.

● Working knowledge of CAD/geometry, able to read, clean up, and troubleshoot geometry issues (not just consume finished CAD).

● Python scripting for automation; comfort building pipelines that chain CAD to meshing to solver to post-processing.

● Practical exposure to applying AI/ML in an engineering context (e.g., using ML models for prediction, classification, or optimization within a simulation workflow); does not need to be a research-level ML background, but must be comfortable integrating models into pipelines.

● Understanding of mesh-quality metrics and common failure modes in CFD setups.

● Ability to work cross-functionally with CAD, ML/software, and aerodynamics teams.

Preferred Skills

● Experience with STAR-CCM+, ANSYS Fluent, OpenFOAM, or SU2.

● Exposure to OpenVSP or other parametric aircraft geometry tools.

● Experience with surrogate modeling or ML-based optimization for engineering simulations. Familiarity with containerized/cloud CFD workflows.

● Prior work in an aerospace or aircraft design environment.

Required Tools/Software

● CFD: STAR-CCM+ / ANSYS Fluent / OpenFOAM

● Geometry: OpenVSP, Siemens NX / Parasolid or Open CASCADE

● Scripting/AI: Python (PyTorch/TensorFlow/scikit-learn as applicable)

job.description:
Job Description: Sr. Manager – B2C

Company: Sastasundar Healthbuddy Ltd

Function: B2C Business (Retail Pharmacy, Omni-channel & Digital Health)

Reports to: CRO/Business Head

Location: Rajarhat with East India coverage

Role Purpose

Own the end-to-end B2C P&L for Healthbuddy’s retail pharmacy and omnichannel business. Drive store network expansion, acquisition, customer growth, retention, and profitability across offline and online channels.

Key Responsibilities

  • P&L ownership: Deliver top-line, EBITDA, and cash-flow targets for the B2C vertical; own annual business plan and budgets.
  • Network expansion: Lead rollout of company-owned and franchise stores, including data-led location selection, pilots and scale-up with clear unit economics.
  • Omni-channel growth: Integrate stores, app and web to increase daily orders, average ticket size and repeat purchase.
  • Customer retention: Build and scale loyalty and health-card/subscription programmes; improve NPS, brand score and customer lifetime value.
  • Category and margin: Expand OTC, private label and adjacent categories; grow ad income and in-store space monetisation.
  • Supply chain and inventory: Partner with supply chain on availability, lead times, stockouts and inventory days; strengthen vendor and supplier terms.
  • Operations and compliance: Drive store operational excellence, SOPs, productivity and cost control; ensure licence and regulatory compliance across stores.
  • Franchise management: Onboard, support and govern franchisees to hit performance and brand standards.
  • Team leadership: Build and mentor high-performing regional, store and category teams; set KPIs and review rhythms.
  • Analytics: Use market segmentation, catchment and performance data to guide decisions.

Key KPIs

  • Revenue growth and EBITDA vs. budget
  • Store additions and store-level breakeven timelines
  • Daily orders and average ticket size
  • Retention, repeat rate and subscription penetration
  • Private label/OTC share of sales
  • Inventory days, fill rate and stockouts
  • NPS and compliance score

Experience

  • 15+ years in retail, pharmacy retail, or e-commerce, with at least 5 years in senior P&L leadership roles.
  • Proven record of scaling pharmacy or health retail networks (100+ stores) across multiple cities.
  • Hands-on exposure to franchise models and omnichannel or digital health.

Skills

  • Business planning and strategy; P&L and cost management
  • Sales and channel development; business expansion
  • Category, merchandising and private label management
  • Supply chain, inventory and vendor development
  • Data analytics and location intelligence
  • Team building and stakeholder management

Education

  • MBA/PGDM or equivalent in retail or business management (PhD or retail specialisation is a plus)

What We Offer

job.region: Kolkata metropolitan area, West Bengal, India
job.description:
Company Description iKure Techsoft Pvt. Ltd. is a health-tech enterprise focused on delivering last-mile primary healthcare services to underserved rural communities across India. The organization combines a patent-pending technology platform, Wireless Health Incident Monitoring System (WHIMS), with a hub-and-spoke model supported by trained community health workers, clinics, and medical teams. Using smartphone-based diagnostics, bio-medical devices, and data analytics, iKure enables remote monitoring, disease prevention, and holistic interventions that address sanitation, hygiene, and nutrition. iKure collaborates with leading research institutes, NGOs, and healthcare partners, including the University of Michigan, Deshpande Foundation, TATA Trust, and PRADAN, to expand its reach. The company aims to serve millions of customers in multiple states, creating healthier communities and closing critical gaps in rural healthcare access.
Role Description The Executive Associate – Founder’s Office (Finance & Administration) is a full-time, on-site role based in the Kolkata metropolitan area, providing direct support to the founder on strategic, financial, and administrative initiatives. This role involves preparing and analyzing financial reports, budgets, and forecasts, as well as tracking key operational metrics and project costs. The Executive Associate will coordinate cross-functional activities, manage executive calendars, organize meetings, and follow up on action items to ensure timely execution. Daily responsibilities include drafting presentations and documentation for stakeholders, supporting investor and partner communications, and assisting with policy development and compliance across finance and administration. The role also requires conducting research, generating insights for decision-making, and helping streamline processes to enable efficient scaling of iKure’s healthcare model.
Qualifications

  • Strong financial analysis and reporting abilities, including budgeting, forecasting, and monitoring of KPIs and project costs.
  • Experience in administration and operations, with skills in planning, coordination, documentation, and process improvement.
  • Proficient written and verbal communication skills for preparing presentations, reports, and stakeholder correspondence.
  • Comfort with technology and data, including working with spreadsheets, dashboards, and basic analytics tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain attention to detail, and work effectively in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Management, or a related field.
  • Prior experience in a founder’s office, consulting, finance, or social enterprise setting is an advantage.
  • Interest in public health, rural development, or impact-based organizations, and willingness to engage with on-ground teams and partners.

job.name: Staff Software Engineer
job.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

About Okta

Okta is an enterprise grade identity management service, built from the ground up in the cloud and delivered with an unwavering focus on customer success. With Okta you can manage access across any application, person, or device. Whether the people are employees, partners, or customers, or the applications are in the cloud, on premises, or on a mobile device, Okta helps you become more secure, make people more productive, and maintain compliance.

The Okta service provides directory services, single sign-on, strong authentication, provisioning, workflow, and built in reporting. It runs in the cloud on a secure, reliable, extensively audited platform and integrates deeply with on premises applications, directories, and identity management systems.

About the Team

The Data Platform team is responsible for the foundational data services, systems, and data products for Okta that benefit our users. Today, the Data Platform team solves challenges and enables:

  • Streaming analytics
  • Interactive end-user reporting
  • Data and ML platform for Okta to scale
  • Telemetry of our products and data

Our elite team is fast, creative and flexible. We encourage ownership. We expect great things from our engineers and reward them with stimulating new projects, new technologies and the chance to have significant equity in a company. Okta is about to change the cloud computing landscape forever.

About the Position

This is an opportunity for experienced Software Engineers to join our fast growing Data Platform organization that is passionate about scaling high volume, low-latency, distributed data-platform services & data products. In this role, you will get to work with engineers throughout the organization to build foundational infrastructure that allows Okta to scale for years to come. As a member of the Data Platform team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and deploying the systems that power our data analytics and ML. Our analytics infrastructure stack sits on top of many modern technologies, including Kinesis, Flink, ElasticSearch, and Snowflake.

job.name: Associate Engineer - Connectivity
job.description:
Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career.

  • Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience
  • Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence
  • Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment

What You’ll Be Part Of The Android Bluetooth Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, integrating, and optimizing Bluetooth connectivity solutions for Android-based platforms. The role requires strong expertise in Android application and framework development, Bluetooth Classic and BLE protocols, and hands-on experience with Bluetooth profile implementation and debugging. The engineer will work closely with platform, middleware, and application teams to ensure seamless communication between Android devices and external peripherals while delivering high-performance and reliable wireless connectivity solutions.

How You’ll Make An Impact

  • Design, develop, and maintain Bluetooth communication features and frameworks for Android applications using Java and Kotlin.
  • Develop, integrate, and optimize Bluetooth Classic and BLE profiles, including proprietary and standard implementations.
  • Work with Android Bluetooth stack components (Fluoride/Gabeldorsche) and Android Framework layers (android, Bluetooth).
  • Debug and resolve complex Bluetooth connectivity issues such as pairing failures, reconnection issues, throughput bottlenecks, latency concerns, and power consumption challenges.
  • Analyze protocol-level communication using Bluetooth packet analysers and logs.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including platform, middleware and hardware teams to deliver robust connectivity solutions.

Security Architecture & Strategy

About Us

About the role

Gazeo is an AI SEO platform that helps brands get found on Google and in AI answers from ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews. We're hiring a hands-on full-stack lead to own the product end to end: what we build, how it's built, and how it runs for customers.

job.name: Data Engineer-Data Integration
job.description:
Introduction A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities As a Data Engineer specializing in Data Integration, you will design and build solutions to transfer data from operational and external environments to the business intelligence environment. You will utilize specialized tools to create and implement Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) processes, ensuring the seamless flow of data throughout the business intelligence solution's lifecycle.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Ensure Seamless Data Flow: Ensure the smooth flow of data throughout the business intelligence solution's lifecycle by creating and implementing effective ETL processes.

Preferred Education Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Exposure to Data Integration Tools: Familiarity with tools such as Informatica, Ab Initio software, and DataStage (formerly Ascential) - IBM's WebSphere Data Integration Suite.
  • ETL Process Implementation: Experience working with Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) processes to ensure the seamless flow of data throughout the business intelligence solution's lifecycle.
  • Data Solution Design: Exposure to designing solutions to transfer data from operational and external environments to the business intelligence environment.

  • Data Flow Management: Exposure to ensuring the smooth flow of data throughout the business intelligence solution's lifecycle.

job.name: Specialist, External Data Acquisition and Delivery
job.description:
Build Our Future Together Regeneron is founded on the belief that the right idea, combined with the right team, can lead to significant transformations. Our growing global network is dedicated to inventing, developing, and commercializing medicines that change lives for those with serious diseases. In doing so, we are pioneering innovative approaches to science, manufacturing, and commercialization, as well as redefining our understanding of health.

We are seeking a Specialist, External Data Acquisition and Delivery to join our Clinical Data Management team. In this role, you will manage non-Case Report Form data across assigned studies or Clinical Development Units while collaborating with external data vendors, CRO partners, Clinical Data Management and cross-functional stakeholders. This position offers the opportunity to support data integrity, improve external data delivery and strengthen compliant study execution.

When & Where Hyderabad (hybrid)

  • Manage end-to-end non-Case Report Form data delivery.

  • Support data structure issue resolution and change requests.

This Role Requires

job.name: Software Engineer – Senior Executive
job.description:
Job Title: Software Engineer- Senior Executive

Experience: 2-4 years

Location: Delhi

About MARS Cosmetics:

MARS Cosmetics is an affordable, trend-forward Indian colour cosmetics brand with a strong e-commerce and retail presence. We are scaling fast across functions, and we need a hiring engine that keeps pace.

About the Role:

MARS is a fast-growing Indian D2C beauty brand. Our in-house tech team builds external-facing products for customers and partners, as well as the internal platforms, integrations and AI-driven automations that run the business.

You will own features end-to-end, work directly with business teams, and see your work used in production within weeks.

What You’ll Work On:

  • External-facing web products and portals for customers, influencers and business partners, such as an influencer collaboration portal.
  • Internal platforms, dashboards and workflow tools used by teams across operations, finance, sales, marketing and supply chain.
  • Integrations with ERP, CRM, e-commerce, messaging and other third-party systems.
  • Data pipelines and automations that replace manual processes.
  • AI-enabled features and workflows across both external products and internal tools.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own features end-to-end: requirements, design, build, deploy and iterate.
  • Build backend and frontend: Backend services and APIs in Node.js / NestJS + TypeScript.
  • Frontends in React / Next.js.
  • Python for scripts and data pipelines.
  • Integrate third-party APIs reliably: webhooks, OAuth, rate limits, retries and idempotency.
  • Work with data: design PostgreSQL schemas and queries, and use Redis for caching and background jobs.
  • Embed LLMs into business workflows (RAG, tool-calling), with attention to accuracy and cost.
  • Deploy and operate on the cloud (AWS / Azure): maintain CI/CD, logging, role-based access and security hygiene.
  • Build secure, scalable and user-friendly systems for both external users and internal teams.
  • Collaborate: work directly with business stakeholders and contribute to code reviews.

Must-Have

  • Experience: 2–4 years of hands-on backend or full-stack development, with features shipped to production.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer
job.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About The Team The Semantic Layer team owns the systems that turn dbt models into trusted, reusable business metrics. At the heart of this is MetricFlow — the open-source semantic engine that powers the dbt Semantic Layer. MetricFlow lets data teams define metrics once in code and consume them consistently across BI tools, notebooks, AI agents, and downstream applications.

This team is the steward of MetricFlow as an open-source project: shipping releases, reviewing community contributions, evolving the query compiler, and ensuring it integrates cleanly with the broader dbt ecosystem. You'll work at the intersection of language design, query compilation, and distributed data execution — solving problems that directly shape how thousands of organizations measure their business.

job.name: Software Engineer - Battery & Conventional Propulsion HIL Engineer-Lead the Future of Electric Mobility
job.description:
Job Description Hybrid: This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to Milford, MI, 3-4 days per week, at minimum.

The Role General Motors is undergoing a major transformation, both in how we operate and in how we will influence the future of transportation in the EV realm. Our Software Services team is on the forefront of this work, emboldening our culture by seeking out determined, innovative individuals who will join our team to help move us forward and achieve our mission.

We are currently seeking experienced and motivated candidates for the roles of Battery & Propulsion HIL Engineer. The HIL Engineer role is responsible for creating hardware in the loop environments to enable development, verification and validation of embedded controllers and calibrations for battery, electrification, engine, and powertrain. This position designs and maintains models using dSpace Simulink and Simscape tools. Simulation allows GM to move the integration and validation tasks earlier in the development cycle. It enables us to release new product and features quicker and to improve our competitiveness in the market. In addition, the position requires designing the harness, layout, the ECUs, and power for our HIL bench.

You will be a GM Entrepreneur that is responsible to deliver finished products on time, meet goals, tailor our processes to be more efficient. You will utilize Agile principles, Scrum ART direction with stories written for tasks. These methods support Lean Manufacturing principles and DFSS knowledge to improve exponentially in what you accomplish and raise the quality in what you contribute to GM.

What You'll Do

  • Work closely with software development, calibration, and validation stakeholders to identify solutions to customer needs.
  • Create and maintain simulation models (such as plant, sensors and actuators, serial data communication, and controller models) for creating test environments.
  • Design HIL benches, including harness design, power requirements, and integration of key ECMs. Understanding of ISO SPI, CAN tools, and INCA.
  • Understand and apply Agile principles that support DFSS tools and methodologies. Incorporate Lean Manufacturing principles and thinking into daily processes as a HIL Engineer.
  • Partner closely with test environment users to root-cause issues, address unexpected test results, and resolve issues encountered during test execution.
  • Plan, communicate, and coordinate test environment strategy and model/hardware rollouts to support applications and features requested by the user community.
  • Support HIL benches and automated tools.
  • Work closely with sources of models and equipment to ensure common models and other simulation assets are shared across test environment domains and architectures.

job.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The LS-SWIFT division delivers high-throughput patterned wafer inspection systems that support advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to provide industry-leading defect detection with optimal cost of ownership across a wide range of applications. LS systems enable precise, cost-effective inspection for cutting-edge process nodes, while SWIFT systems offer comprehensive macro inspection of all wafer surfaces—capabilities that are especially critical for advanced packaging, as well as logic, memory, and automotive applications.

What You'll Do In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and optimize image processing and computer vision algorithms for semiconductor inspection applications.
  • Evaluate and productize machine learning and deep learning approaches where they provide measurable value.
  • Prototype new concepts using Python and other analytical tools, and implement production-quality solutions in C++.
  • Drive feature development from requirements definition through implementation, validation, release, and customer deployment.
  • Perform root-cause analysis for field issues and develop robust corrective actions.
  • Document algorithm design, experimental results, and technical recommendations.

+ Image Processing

+ Machine and Deep Learning fundamentals

+ Pattern Recognition
+ Optimization techniques

  • Proficiency in:

+ C++

job.name: Cyber Operate - Security Controls Engineer Manager
job.description:
The Security Controls Engineer designs, engineers, and automates the security controls that protect a large banking client's cloud and hybrid environments. The role standardizes controls across AWS and GCP, maintains the control library against NIST, ISO, and CIS frameworks, and turns control evidence into continuous, automated assurance. It also performs risk assessments, identifies compensating controls for non-compliant items, and provides technical leadership to architecture and project teams. The role works with cybersecurity, technology risk, internal audit, and engineering teams, and applies AI to control mapping and evidence review under human accountability.

Recruiting for this role ends on 01/31/2027.

Work you'll do As a Lead Managed Services Engineer II on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for:

  • Design and standardize information security controls across Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environments; maintain a control library mapped to the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), NIST Special Publication (SP) 800-53, and Center for Internet Security (CIS) Controls.
  • Build and maintain automated control monitoring and evidence collection using Python, PowerShell, Terraform, and Open Policy Agent (OPA) policy-as-code; integrate results with ServiceNow Integrated Risk Management (IRM), Archer, or OneTrust.
  • Assess AWS and GCP security architectures using the AWS Well-Architected Framework and Google Cloud Security Command Center; identify, assess, and mitigate risks and define compensating controls for non-compliant items.
  • Perform automated and manual security testing of applications and infrastructure; validate results, analyze source code, analyze root cause and impact, and guide corrective actions.
  • Provide timely technical evidence for internal audit and regulatory requests; collaborate with cybersecurity, technology risk, and engineering stakeholders to influence secure solution delivery.
  • Apply generative artificial intelligence (GenAI), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and prompt engineering for control mapping and evidence review in alignment with the NIST Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework and Federal Reserve Supervisory Letter SR 11-7 expectations, while retaining human accountability for final control conclusions.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor

job.name: Bioinformatics AI
job.description:
Bioinformatician (AI & Agentic Pipelines)

We are hiring a Bioinformatician who builds the pipelines, and the AI agents that run them, for every NGS analysis module at NGB Diagnostics.

Company: NGB Diagnostics Private Limited · Location: Noida, India · Type: Full-time · Experience: 3–8 years (flexible for the right profile)

About NGB Diagnostics

NGB Diagnostics (ngbdx.com) is a Noida-based genomics and bioinformatics company. We run NGS projects on in-house Illumina, PacBio and Oxford Nanopore platforms for research institutes, hospitals and biotech companies across India. We hold NABL, ISO 15189 and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certifications, and we are moving from research services toward clinical NGS products.

The role

You will own our analysis stack end to end. Today each module is built separately. Your job is to turn them into standardised, containerised, reproducible pipelines, and then put AI agents on top that can run QC, choose parameters, flag problems and draft the client report with minimal manual effort.

Modules in scope:

  • RNA-seq: QC, alignment or pseudo-alignment, quantification, differential expression, pathway analysis, fusions
  • DNA-seq (WGS / WES / panels): alignment, variant calling, annotation, filtering, CNV/SV
  • miRNA-seq: adapter and UMI handling, isomiR and novel miRNA detection, target prediction
  • De novo assembly: short-read, PacBio HiFi and ONT long-read assembly, polishing, scaffolding, annotation
  • Others as we grow: metagenomics and 16S, SNP arrays, single-cell

What you will do

  • Design, build and maintain production pipelines in Nextflow (DSL2) or Snakemake, with Docker/Singularity containers and versioned releases
  • Build agentic workflows using LLMs and tool-calling frameworks that launch pipelines, read QC metrics, troubleshoot failed runs and assemble draft reports for review
  • Automate the path from raw FASTQ/BAM to a client-ready HTML/PDF report with figures, tables and methods text
  • Validate each pipeline against benchmark and simulated datasets, and write SOPs and design documents
  • Set up and optimise runs on our HPC/server and cloud environments, including cost and runtime tuning
  • Support the sales and project teams with technical scoping, tender technical bids and client queries
  • Keep client data secure and follow our ISO 27001 practices

What we are looking for

job.name: National Public Health Data Analyst, India Country Program, Asia, Middle East, and Europe Region
job.description:
PATH current employees - please log in and apply Here PATH is a global nonprofit advancing health innovations for the people who need them most. With 50 years of experience, a global team of experts, and trusted partnerships spanning 70+ countries, PATH turns breakthroughs into better health for millions every single year.

The Expand ELEVATE (Engaging Local Experts in Validating and Analyzing TB-data to End TB) is a CDC (Centers for Diseases Control and Prevention) supported, and PATH implemented project under the guidance of the CTD (Central Tuberculosis Division). The project aims to build sustainable data analytics capacity among health program staff and promote data-driven decision-making within TB and public health programs to support TB elimination activities at local level. The project has been in implementation since July 2021 across eleven states of India (Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Himachal Pradesh, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Mizoram, Odisha, Rajasthan, Sikkim and West Bengal) and it set to expand to new geographies.

Each intervention state is supported by a Public Health Data Analyst (PHDA) who provides technical assistance to NTEP (National Tuberculosis Elimination Program) teams in data analysis and its use for programmatic actions. The project promotes the Data Champion approach, wherein the programme staff are equipped with required analytic skills to independently assess programme performance, identify gaps in the tuberculosis care cascade and facilitate evidence-based programme actions.

PATH is hiring a National Public Health Data Analyst (NPHDA) to provide technical and analytical support to the Expand ELEVATE project at the national level.

The NPHDA, under the overall supervision of Deputy Director-TB, PATH and direct supervision of the Senior Program Manager, PATH and in coordination with the concerned officials at CTD, will provide technical leadership in project data management, analysis, project performance tracking, team capacity strengthening in data analytics, documentation and reporting.

The incumbent will be responsible for developing and maintaining robust data management systems for the project, including designing data collection tools, establishing data quality control mechanisms, and tracking project output and outcome indicators. The position will also undertake periodic analysis of programme and project data to generate actionable insights and support the programme management team in data-driven planning, decision-making and course correction.

Over the first 6–12 months, with structured mentoring, you will grow into production troubleshooting and performance tuning, and from there into production SQL support.

This is not a BI/ETL/DW role and not an SSIS package-development role.

Key Responsibilities

SQL Development (primary focus)

  • Write, debug and maintain T-SQL stored procedures, functions and views for critical business workflows.
  • Deliver new database logic and enhancements with the engineering team.
  • Refactor existing procedures for better performance and maintainability.
  • Test database changes and release them through the team’s change process.
  • Perform controlled, documented production data fixes.
  • Investigate slow procedures using execution plans, with guidance from senior engineers.

Growth Path: Performance Tuning & Production Support (from about month 6, with mentoring)

  • Shadow, then handle, live production issues (blocking, deadlocks, high CPU, slow queries) as US-hours support is phased in.
  • Use Query Store to find top resource-consuming queries, detect plan regressions and force plans.
  • Use DMVs to analyze waits, blocking, query stats, index usage and memory/CPU pressure. Examples: sys.dm \_exec\_requests, sys.dm \_os\_wait\_stats, sys.dm \_exec\_query\_stats.
  • Read execution plans, fix parameter sniffing, and improve indexing and statistics.
  • Document root causes and prevention steps for each incident.

Requirements

  • 4–6 years of hands-on T-SQL experience on transactional (OLTP) application databases.
  • Strong T-SQL skills: stored procedures, transactions, error handling, CTEs, temp tables and window functions; set-based logic in preference to cursors. You must be able to write new logic, not just review it.
  • Solid indexing fundamentals (clustered, non-clustered, covering indexes) and the ability to read a basic execution plan (scan vs seek, key lookup).
  • Has optimized at least one slow query or procedure and can explain what they found and what they changed.
  • Working understanding of transactions and locking basics (isolation levels, blocking).
  • Clear written and spoken English.
  • Eagerness to learn production troubleshooting and willingness to move to US-hours support after the ramp-up period.

Preferred

Within AFT, the Labor Insights team builds and operates the platform that tracks on associate labor performance across Amazon's entire global warehouse network. Labor Insights' suite of 18+ services supports ~1 million associates and 70,000+ daily portal users across 9,800+ facilities and 10 business lines — ingesting over 19 billion labor events annually to produce the real-time productivity reports that warehouse managers rely on to run their operations every day. As a Software Development Engineer on the Labor Insights team, you will build the next generation of Amazon's labor management platform — designing systems that ingest billions of labor events from warehouse floor tools and time clock systems, aggregate them through multi-stage pipelines, and serve real-time productivity reports to operations managers across the globe. You will contribute to a wide range of projects — from event processing pipelines and aggregation engines to reporting APIs, modern React-based portals, and AI-powered configuration tools. You will be involved in all aspects of the software development cycle including scoping, design, implementation, testing, and delivery. A commitment to teamwork, hustle, and strong communication skills are absolute requirements. Creating reliable, scalable, and high-performance services requires exceptional technical expertise. job.name: Cloud Security Specialist
job.description:
What You’ll Be Doing As a key member of the Exposure Management team, you will own the security posture of our hybrid and multi-cloud environment (Azure, AWS, GCP). The role combines hands-on vulnerability management using enterprise vulnerability management (VM) tools with cloud posture and exposure management capabilities delivered through a cloud-native application protection platform (CNAPP). You will be the first responder when emerging threats appear. You will automate workflows from detection through remediation, prioritize by risk, and work closely with Cloud, DevOps, Infrastructure and Application teams to make sure findings get fixed and not just reported.

During a Typical Day, You’ll

  • Run end-to-end vulnerability management using enterprise VM tools across on-premises, cloud and hybrid assets. This includes scan configuration, coverage validation, asset tagging, risk assessment and false-positive tuning.
  • Oversee cloud security posture through CNAPP capabilities. Triage issues, toxic combinations and attack paths across cloud workloads, containers and serverless functions.
  • Drive exposure management by bringing vulnerability, misconfiguration, identity and internet-exposure data into a single risk-ranked view. Prioritization is based on exploitability (CISA KEV, EPSS, threat intelligence) and business criticality, not CVSS alone.
  • Lead emerging threat response for critical and zero-day vulnerabilities. You will assess exposure within hours, build targeted vulnerability queries and CNAPP searches, issue advisories, and coordinate emergency remediation with asset owners until findings are closed.
  • Identify misconfigurations and vulnerabilities and govern their remediation, tracking ownership, SLAs and exceptions through the ticketing workflow.
  • Build security controls, guardrails and automation for cloud platforms. Use Python and PowerShell with APIs from VM and CNAPP tools to automate reporting, ticket creation, enrichment and fix validation.
  • Track and report KPIs for cloud posture and vulnerability management, including SLA compliance, mean time to remediate, scan coverage and risk trend. Reports go to both operational and leadership audiences.
  • Identify and assess cloud-related risks through continuous monitoring and threat modeling, and govern their mitigation.
  • Verify adherence to frameworks such as SOC 2, FedRAMP, ISO 27001, NIST, PCI DSS, HIPAA and CIS Benchmarks, and confirm that security controls are implemented and working as designed.
  • Manage CSPM, CWPP and CNAPP tooling, integrate it into operational workflows, and maintain connector health and coverage.
  • Collaborate with cloud providers, tool vendors, internal teams and external auditors.

What You Bring To The Role

You will design scalable, secure, production-grade AI platforms leveraging agentic frameworks, LLMs, and cloud-native services.   • Define GenAI reference architectures; evaluate and select LLMs, embedding models, vector databases, and orchestration frameworks based on performance, compliance, and cost.
  • Embed security, privacy, and Responsible AI governance from inception — covering PII handling, data access controls, and content guardrails.
  • Build scalable backend APIs using Python (FastAPI, asyncio) with REST/JSON-RPC interfaces and resilience patterns (Redis, RabbitMQ); guide teams on MLOps/LLMOps standards including deployment, monitoring, retraining, and drift handling.
  • Define LLM evaluation strategies, implement observability/tracing (Arize, LangSmith), and design memory strategies with retention and replay safety for long-running assistants.
  • Containerize and deploy services via Docker and Kubernetes; govern CI/CD pipelines with automated testing, security scanning, and IaC (Terraform or equivalent).

job.name: Module Lead – Oracle PL/SQL | Experience - 4 to 8 years | CTC - 14 to 18 Lakhs | Noida Location | Domain Banking & Financial Services
job.description:
We're hiring a Module Lead to own the design, build, and performance of Oracle-based backend components that power core banking and financial-services applications. You'll write and tune production PL/SQL — packages, procedures, triggers, and bulk-processing jobs — that move real money and real transactions, and you'll lead 3–4 engineers through the full delivery cycle from requirement breakdown to go-live support. This is a hands-on technical role: expect to be in execution plans and AWR reports as often as you're in design reviews.

WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING

▪

Solution design: translating functional requirements from Business Analysts into a technical design — data model impact, package/procedure boundaries, and rollback strategy — before any code gets written.

▪

Core development: developing and maintaining PL/SQL packages, stored procedures, functions, and triggers for transaction processing, batch settlement, and end-of-day (EOD) jobs.

▪

Performance tuning: reading execution plans, fixing bad joins and missing indexes, and using AWR/ADDM output to bring long-running batch jobs back inside their SLA window.

▪

Quality gates: writing and reviewing unit tests (utPLSQL or equivalent), enforcing coding standards in code reviews, and signing off before promotion to UAT/production.

▪

Deployment & support: planning cutover windows, running data migration/reconciliation scripts, and providing L2/L3 support immediately after go-live.

▪

Team leadership: owning day-to-day technical direction for 3–4 engineers — splitting work into a realistic WBS, unblocking them on schema or logic issues, and reviewing their code before yours.

▪

  • Client interface: sitting in client calls to explain technical trade-offs in plain language, and giving realistic effort estimates before commitments are made upstream.
