Hiring for GOPA Consulting Group — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

GOPA Tech is the engineering arm of the GOPA group, a German consulting firm with 60 years of work on public-sector and development projects. Its engineers and consultants advise power utilities, governments and international funders such as the EU, World Bank, KfW and EBRD across energy, transport, water and urban development. The Power Systems team covers generation, transmission lines, grids and substations through studies, design, supervision and advice, including SCADA, smart grids and cyber security. GOPA Tech is adding an OT cybersecurity expert to its energy advisory projects.

About the Role

This is a freelance / contract advisory role working from GOPA Tech's office in Baner, Pune. You won't run one company's security operations day to day. You'll go into power utilities, assess how exposed their operational technology (SCADA, ICS, substations) and business systems are to cyber threats, recommend fixes, help plan their digital upgrades and train their staff. The projects are typically funded by international development banks and the EU, with clients in Europe and its neighbourhood.

What you'll do

  • Assess power utilities' cybersecurity against the EU NIS2 Directive and IEC 62443, and write up gaps, risks and priorities
  • Review OT environments (SCADA, EMS/DMS, substation automation, ICS networks) and recommend segmentation, controls and security roadmaps
  • Assess the digitalisation level of energy utilities and help shape digitalisation strategies
  • Advise on OT modernisation and on business platforms such as ERP, billing, CRM and MIS/BI reporting, including integrations, data flows and requirements specifications
  • Run training, workshops and knowledge transfer for utility staff
  • Work alongside GOPA's power systems engineers and the client's project teams, on site where needed

What you bring

  • 5+ years in ICT, digital transformation or cybersecurity in the energy sector
  • Hands-on OT / ICS / SCADA cybersecurity work for power utilities, grid operators or power plants, including IEC 62443
  • Experience assessing organisations against the NIS2 Directive (gap analysis, readiness or compliance assessment)
  • A professional security certification such as GICSP, CISSP or an ISA/IEC 62443 certificate
  • Consulting or advisory delivery: assessments, audits, strategies or roadmaps you have written for a client
  • A degree in IT, Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical Engineering, Cybersecurity or a related field

job.name: Director, Quality Engineering and Automation
job.description:
Organization Overview Company Description QAD is a leading provider of ERP solutions purpose-built for manufacturing industries — automotive, life sciences, food & beverage, high tech, and industrial. Serving thousands of global manufacturers, QAD's Adaptive Manufacturing Cloud helps companies operate with greater precision, agility, and intelligence.

Enterprise software is entering a third era. The first gave manufacturers a System of Record — ERP that answered 'what do we have and what did we commit to?' The second gave them Data Infrastructure — the ability to move, analyse, and query that data at scale. The third era is domain-specific intelligence: AI agents that can act autonomously on manufacturing data, but only if that data has been given the context, relationships, and governed rules that allow an agent to reason correctly.

Job Description This director changes how QAD builds and proves quality in Adaptive ERP. The goal is continuous, automated evidence that every release, patch, and update works in environments that look like customers' own, not a QA stage at the end. This leader owns quality standards, regression automation, and release gates, and has the authority to stop a release that does not meet them. We are not looking for a QA manager. We need a leader who will reshape how the organization thinks about quality.

Responsibilities

  • Build and lead the central Quality Engineering organization: strategy, staffing, capability, and results.
  • Define quality standards and evidence-based release gates covering installation, configuration, upgrades, patches, integrations, and end-to-end business flows.
  • Hold the authority to block a release that fails those gates.
  • Lead regression automation: one framework, a suite covering the defined test surface, and a measurable coverage ramp, integrated into development and deployment pipelines.
  • Qualify releases in customer-representative environments and configurations.
  • Apply AI across the quality lifecycle, including test generation, maintenance, and defect analysis.
  • Make quality visible with data: coverage, escaped defects, regression results, and release readiness.
  • Own the quality assessment against agreed release gates and escalate unmet criteria through the release decision process.

Qualifications Required

  • Senior quality engineering leadership on large enterprise SaaS products, including organizational and process transformation. ERP experience is not required.
  • Expertise in automation architecture, continuous testing, CI/CD, branch strategy, and risk-based qualification.
  • Practical experience applying AI to testing or software engineering, with evidence it worked.
  • Data-driven judgment and the confidence to push back on senior leaders, including the SVP, when quality standards are not met.

Preferred

job.name: Senior Firmware Design Engineer
job.description:
Job Type: Full-Time

Interview Type: Video or In Person

Duration: Long Term

Experience: 7-10 Years

Work Preference: Onsite

Work Location: Pune, MH

Domain- Fire & Safety

About Job Role

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Firmware Design Engineer with 7-10 years of experience to develop, enhance, migrate, sustain, and release embedded firmware for fire and life-safety portfolio. The role supports new product development, product extensions, platform modernisation, value engineering, component obsolescence, compliance, and field or production support. The engineer will own assigned firmware work packages, define maintainable architectures, develop reusable platform software and product features, and ensure deterministic behaviour on target hardware. Assignments may include microcontroller or toolchain migration, protocol development, diagnostics, hardware integration, verification, and issue resolution across multiple product families.

Key Responsibilities

Firmware Architecture and Product Development

  • Own firmware work packages for new products, product enhancements, redesigns, sustenance, and value-engineering initiatives.
  • Analyses system and software requirements, hardware interfaces, existing code, field behavior, regulatory constraints, and manufacturing needs before defining the implementation approach.
  • Define and implement modular architectures covering startup, BSP, HAL, drivers, protocols, application logic, diagnostics, configuration, and production-test support.
  • Develop production embedded software in C for bare-metal or RTOS-based systems, with appropriate use of interrupts, timers, state machines, memory, and communication peripherals.
  • Plan and execute microcontroller, compiler, IDE, or hardware-platform migrations when required, including build, linker, startup, timing, peripheral, and compatibility changes.
  • Create reusable software components and controlled product configurations that reduce duplication and simplify maintenance across product families.

Qualifications

  • 7-10 years of hands-on embedded firmware-development experience, including responsibility for implementation, integration, debugging, verification, and production release.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Telecommunication, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related discipline.
  • Strong Embedded C skills and practical experience with bare-metal or RTOS-based systems, interrupts, timers, state machines, memory constraints, and deterministic real-time behaviour.
  • Demonstrated experience designing or maintaining modular BSP, HAL, driver, protocol, application, diagnostic, or boot and update layers for production embedded products.
  • Experience migrating firmware between microcontroller families, compilers, IDEs, or hardware revisions and resolving architecture, linker, startup, timing, and peripheral differences.

job.name: ServiceNow - Senior Application Developer
job.description:
Your Mission:

Take end-to-end ownership of our ServiceNow platform customization and ongoing improvement, with a strong focus on ITSM and ITOM. You will partner closely with IT and HR stakeholders to deliver scalable, upgrade-safe solutions that align with ServiceNow best practices—knowing when to configure vs. customize, and having the confidence and communication skills to push back when a request would create unnecessary technical debt. As a senior member of the team, you will shape how we build on ServiceNow: establishing maintainable patterns, improving automation, ensuring data quality in the CMDB, and integrating ServiceNow with other enterprise services via REST/APIs. You will help keep the platform clean, secure, and operationally reliable across environments.

What You’ll Do

Core Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain ServiceNow solutions across ITSM and ITOM using configuration-first, upgrade safe patterns.
  • Build and improve workflows and automations (Flow Designer, approvals, routing, fulfillment, notifications) with a focus on reliability and reuse.
  • Own and evolve ITOM capabilities (e.g., Discovery, Service Mapping, Event/Operations integrations) and improve the quality and usefulness of operational data.
  • Advise on best practices for CMDB health and data model discipline (e.g., CSDM-aligned thinking, CI relationships, lifecycle hygiene) in collaboration with platform/process owners.
  • Operate a safe delivery lifecycle across Dev/Test/Prod: versioning, controlled transports, documentation, and release readiness.
  • Apply security-by-design (roles, ACLs, least privilege) and contribute to ongoing platform hygiene and governance.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across UI, scripting, integrations, performance, and data integrity; resolve quickly and implement preventive fixes.

Strategic Responsibilities

  • Set and enforce development standards (scoped apps, reusable components, documentation expectations, and “don’t customize what the platform already does well”).
  • Help shape the ServiceNow roadmap with IT and HR: prioritize work, reduce technical debt.
  • Improve integration and automation maturity (API design, error handling, monitoring, retry patterns, and runbooks).
  • Support platform governance (instance health checks, release readiness, structured upgrade planning/testing).
  • Coach stakeholders and peers to raise platform literacy and reduce “snowflake” requests through clear guidance and tradeoff communication.

What You Bring

About the role

We build three software products used by customers in Australia, and we are taking them global: Portal 360 (practice management for accountants, bookkeepers and advisory firms), Community 360 (community management and engagement for associations, clubs, schools and government) and eSign 360 (e-signature for everyone). The next stage is serving customers in many countries, in many currencies and languages, with the reliability and security that regulated industries expect.

As a Developer you will build across all three products, end to end. You will ship features, make the platforms faster and more dependable, and help us open new markets. Integrations with the tools our customers already use are a big part of that growth, but this is a full-stack engineering role, not a single-feature one.

The outcomes we want from this role

  • Portal 360, Community 360 and eSign 360 running reliably for customers in new regions, with the performance, data residency and compliance each market needs.
  • Products ready for the world: multi-currency, multi-language, time zones, local tax and regulatory requirements, and local payment methods.
  • A growing library of integrations (accounting, file storage, messaging, payments, government services and e-signature) that put our products inside our customers' daily tools and bring in new customers.
  • A public API, webhooks and documentation that let partners and customers build on our products.
  • Faster, safer releases, with automated testing, monitoring and clean deployments that let a small team move quickly as we scale.
  • Mobile apps (iOS and Android) that match the quality of the web products.

About The Role We're hiring a Revenue Operations Manager to own HubSpot and turn it into the single source of truth for our go-to-market teams. You'll design how leads move from Marketing to Sales to Customer Success, keep the data clean, and build the reporting leadership uses to run the business.

This is a hands-on role reporting to the Senior VP of Sales. You'll work daily with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, and you'll have the authority to set standards and the responsibility to make them stick.

  • CRM ownership and governance: Own HubSpot end to end, including naming conventions, user permissions, and change control for properties and workflows

  • Documentation: Maintain the CRM design document, covering the property dictionary, workflow map, pipeline definitions, and integration overview
  • Reporting and forecasting: Build dashboards for pipeline, conversion, revenue, and forecast accuracy that leadership trusts and uses
  • Tech stack management: Evaluate, integrate, and manage the tools connected to HubSpot, and keep data flowing cleanly between them
  • Team enablement: Train Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success on correct HubSpot use, and act on their feedback
  • Cross-team alignment: Drive shared definitions, such as qualified lead and closed deal, and service-level agreements (SLAs) between teams

Requirements What you bring

  • 4+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Marketing Operations, ideally in B2B SaaS

job.name: CS Data Foundations and Operations Data Analyst and Architect
job.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

CS Data Foundations and Operations Data Analyst and Architect

Location: Pune, India.

The Position

Large organisations generate and rely on vast amounts of data across their operations. The quality and trustworthiness of that data directly determines whether regulatory and management reports are credible, whether they can be independently assured, and whether the operational, strategic, and financial decisions based on them are sound. Data Foundations is the discipline that makes data trustworthy by defining what data means, how it should be collected and validated, who is accountable for its quality, and how disputes about its interpretation are resolved. To support this, the Global Data and Digital Solutions (GDDS) function is responsible for establishing and operating these critical data foundations across Corporate Strategy, Sustainability & Sites (CS).

As the Data Analyst and Architect, you will be the senior technical voice in the newly formed Data Foundations and Operations team in charge of transforming Roche's extensive site data and business processes into a clear, highly automated, readily usable, and trusted organizational asset. This is a deliberately hands-on senior role: you will decide how the data should be structured, and then go into the source systems yourself to establish whether the design holds. You will bring a strong technical background, excellent communication skills, and a passion for wrangling data to collaborate closely with Business Process teams, Digital Solutions, and Data experts. As the team grows you will set the technical direction for the analysts working alongside you. Together, you will ensure our investments in Data Foundations support a strategic approach, deliver actionable insights, and provide measurable business value. Ultimately, your work will directly fuel high-impact decisions that enhance sustainability outcomes and elevate overall business performance.

The Opportunity

In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. job.description:
ABOUT XPLORETEQ

Xploreteq is a Pune-based technology and cybersecurity company working with organisations across cybersecurity, AI governance, data protection and DPDP readiness — through advisory, implementation and managed services. We are ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified, serve 50+ enterprise customers across financial services, healthcare, technology, manufacturing and services, and partner with leading platforms including Netskope, CrowdStrike, Menlo Security, Proofpoint, Okta, Varonis and Forcepoint. As we scale our team across sales, delivery and operations, we're looking for people who want to build a specialist practice rather than join a generalist IT shop.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking a client-facing Professional Services Engineer to lead the technical implementation, architecture and integration of edge security solutions for our enterprise clients. Working from a System Integrator perspective, you will assess client environments, design the deployment architecture, and execute migrations onto modern Zero-Trust platforms — bridging legacy infrastructure (on-prem proxies, MPLS) and cloud-native SASE/SSE.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Assessment & Design

  • Lead technical discovery workshops to map legacy architecture, application portfolios and traffic flows.
  • Author High-Level and Low-Level Design documentation covering traffic steering, proxy chaining, SSL decryption policy and fallback mechanisms.
  • Help clients plan prerequisites — allowlists, firewall exceptions, certificate authority provisioning, IdP sync.

SASE/SSE Implementation

  • Build, configure and validate tenants covering Secure Web Gateway, CASB and ZTNA.
  • Implement DLP policies aligned to client regulatory requirements (PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, DPDP) with custom detection rules.
  • Configure traffic steering and client deployment via MDM/GPO, including bypass and smart-steering rules.
  • Deploy Remote Browser Isolation and content-sanitisation (CDR) controls where in scope.

Integration & Go-Live

  • Integrate platforms with client Identity Providers (Azure AD/Entra ID, Okta) for provisioning and group-based policy.
  • Configure log/event forwarding into the client's SIEM (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, etc.).
  • Design and execute UAT test matrices; provide post-go-live hypercare support; run technical training and handover sessions for the client's internal operations team.

REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3–6 years as a Cyber Security Engineer, Consultant or Professional Services engineer, ideally within a System Integrator or MSP.
  • Hands-on deployment experience with at least one SASE/SSE platform (Netskope preferred) or isolation platform (Menlo Security); familiarity with a second (Zscaler, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Forcepoint) is a strong plus.
  • Working knowledge of proxy configuration (PAC files, explicit vs. transparent), GRE/IPsec tunnelling, TLS/SSL inspection and routing fundamentals.

Summary Professional Services at Guidewire partners with P&C insurers worldwide to design, implement, and optimize mission-critical solutions on the Guidewire platform, with a strong focus on cloud and AI-enabled delivery. You’ll join a collaborative, global team that values curiosity, transparency, and continuous improvement, working closely with customers and internal stakeholders.

As a Performance Test Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring that Guidewire-based projects/ solutions meet defined performance, scalability, and stability goals. You will design and execute performance tests, analyze results to identify bottlenecks and areas for optimization, and collaborate closely with functional QA, developers, and architects to help deliver high-quality, reliable solutions for our P&C insurance customers.

Job Description What you’ll do

  • Take end-to-end ownership of performance testing for assigned projects, from requirement analysis through sign-off.
  • Work with architects, functional QA, business analysts, and developers to understand business flows, volumes, SLAs, and peak load expectations.
  • Design performance test approach and scenarios, including workload models, test data strategy, and environment pre-requisites.
  • Develop, maintain, and execute performance test scripts using tools such as JMeter (or equivalent).
  • Execute different types of performance tests (load, stress, endurance/soak, spike, scalability) and capture key metrics.
  • Monitor application, database, and infrastructure during test runs, and consolidate findings into clear, actionable reports.
  • Analyze test results to identify hotspots and potential risks; provide recommendations for tuning and retest as needed.
  • Collaborate with development and DevOps/cloud teams to validate fixes and configuration changes.
  • Maintain all performance test artefacts: test plans, scripts, datasets, execution logs, and result summaries.
  • Share performance testing best practices with functional QA and junior team members; support knowledge sharing within the QA practice.

What You’ll Bring

  • 4-6 years of overall software QA experience, with at least 3 years focused on performance testing of web or enterprise applications.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one performance testing tool (e.g., JMeter, Gatling; LoadRunner or similar is a plus).
  • Good understanding of performance test types and key concepts: response time, throughput, concurrency, error rates, capacity, and SLAs.
  • Ability to interpret and correlate performance metrics across:

+ Application / JVM (threads, heap, GC, response times, throughput)
+ Database (slow queries, indexing, connection pooling)
+ Infrastructure (CPU, memory, network, disk I/O)

job.description:
About Allica Bank Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description The Modelling team sits within the Credit Portfolio Management (CPM) function and is at the heart of building the measurement and decisioning models behind Allica’s lending products. The team builds and owns the bank’s IFRS9 model estate (including PD, LGD, SICR and economic response models), the statistical and machine learning models and credit policy rules used for automated underwriting, and the credit-linked GenAI solutions used to automate processes.

Role Description This role will be part of the team building, implementing, monitoring and optimising two sets of models: the IFRS9 impairment models that measure our credit risk and support accurate reporting to auditors and investors, and the decisioning models and policy rules behind automated lending, which are critical to delivering fast, consistent and well-controlled credit decisions and a better customer journey as the bank grows.

The role requires the technical ability and practical mindset to take models and decisioning changes from initial problem definition through data identification, cleansing and analysis to model development, implementation and ongoing monitoring. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between structured model development and fast-paced ad-hoc analysis, working closely with Finance, Credit Risk, Underwriting, Collections, Product, Data, Engineering, Capital Markets and Model Risk colleagues. They will communicate complex concepts clearly to stakeholders with different levels of technical expertise and work with third-party suppliers where required. We are looking for a hands-on modeller who can turn data into reliable, scalable solutions, and help make data a key strength for the bank.

Principal Accountabilities

About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

job.name: Business Analyst I, CMT
job.description:
Description Amazon.com operates in a virtual, global e-commerce environment without boundaries, and operates a diverse set of businesses worldwide, including Retail, third party marketplaces, e-commerce platforms, web services for developers. Amazon’s global price perception is how the population perceives Amazon’s pricing compared to other retailers. Elements that make up customer price perception include the perceived; (1) competitiveness of the retailers pricing (i.e. who has the perceived lowest prices), (2) clarity of price information on the site, (3) the price vs quality of the products offered (i.e. the value), (4) the price the customer expects to pay for the product at a given retailer, and (5) how Amazon messages pricing in press and advertising.

CMT Central Analytics team is responsible for the metrics and programs that define customer price perception today. The team is responsible for driving new initiatives to deepen our understanding and measurement of price perception, as well as delivering projects that will improve Amazon’s price perception overtime. We protect Amazon Customers and influence projects to improve price perception and price satisfaction.

Opportunity Do you want to be part of the team that ensures Amazon keeps its “best price” promise across millions of products worldwide? Does the challenge of driving decisions in a dynamic environment excite you? Do you love solving complex business problems using technology? Are you seeking an environment where you can drive innovation? Are you a passionate self-starter? If the answer to the above questions is a resounding “YES”, read on!

The ideal candidate is a motivated self-starter that can work in a fast paced, ambiguous environment with limited supervision. You must be a fast learner who can quickly absorb the nuances of Amazon's varied pricing programs and processes.

Amazon is one of the world’s most trusted companies. Help us keep it that way.

Description The Amazon Delivery and Shopping Experience Product Team is looking for a talented Sr. Business Intelligence Engineer who develop solutions to optimize customer experience by disproportionately improving discoverability and speed. As part of Amazon’s DEX product team, we have the opportunity to be at the forefront of DEX product thought leadership - working on some of the most difficult Customer Experience problems while partnering with research scientists, software developers, and business leaders. With the focus on driving real impact on Amazon's long-term profitability, we build new analysis from ground up, proposing new concepts and technology to meet business needs. We need strong BIEs who enjoy and excel at diving into data, analyzing root causes, defining long-term solutions and driving their implementation with stakeholders.

This position requires superior analytical thinkers, able to quickly approach large ambiguous problems and apply your technical and engineering expertise to rapidly prototype and deliver solutions. This skill also requires you to work across a variety of teams, including software tech teams, operations, finance, category, search, and inventory platform (software) teams. Successful candidates must thrive in fast-paced environments which encourage collaborative and creative problem solving, be able to measure and estimate risks, constructively critique peer research, extract and manipulate data across various data marts, and align research focuses on Amazon’s strategic needs.

We are NOT a reporting team and we are not looking for reporting analysts. We are looking for people with a flair for recognizing trends and patterns while correlating it to the business problem at hand. If you have an uncanny ability to decipher the exact policy/mechanism/solution to address the challenge and ability to influence people using hard data (and some tact) then we are looking for you!

Key job responsibilities

As a Sr. BIE in the team, you will work closely with program managers, software developers, research scientists, and product managers to analyze massive data sets, identify areas to improve, define metrics to measure and monitor programs, and most importantly work with different stakeholders to drive improvements over time. You will also work closely with internal business teams to extract or mine information from our existing systems to create new analysis, and expose data from our group to wider teams in intuitive ways. As a BIE embedded in the product team you have the opportunity to participate and shape product development as well as leverage your technical skills. This position provides opportunities to influence high visibility/high impact areas in the organization.

A day in the life

job.name: Category- Travel
job.description:
About the role :

Own how much Scapia earns on every travel booking, and grow it. This is one of the

most important levers in the travel business and a critical, high-ownership role. The role

has two halves: growing gross take rate (add-ons, supply–demand matching, new

products and fees), and setting and running pricing and discount strategy so we stay

competitive without giving away growth or margin.

This role will work closely with Product, Supply, Finance and other category members.

What you will own :

● Net take rate across cohorts, routes and segments. Run the weekly and monthly

rhythm around it with cross-functional teams, across strategy, launches, margin

and attach rates.

● Benchmarking: keep a clear, current view of where we stand on price and on

earnings after coupons and fees, against competitors and across partners. Turn

that view into actions.

● Problem finding and solving: spot leaks and missed opportunities early, by

cohort, route or search segment. Size each one, pick the fix, and drive it to

launch with the relevant teams.

● Revenue: a) own attach rates and earnings from add-ons and VAS ; b) match

supply to demand and work with Supply on better commercial terms, so the right

partner,and terms reach the right demand; c) launch new products and fee

formats for extended revenue.

● Pricing and discounting: a) set where and how much we discount, by cohort,

segment and competitor position; b) run it day to day, test changes, and make

sure every rupee of discount earns its return; c) balance growth and margin with

the Category leads.

● Targets and strategy: plan and deliver the monthly targets. Build the short and

medium term plan: which levers to pull, in what order, and the expected impact.

Partner with Finance on goals and tracking.

P&L Management: Develop and implement short-term and long-term topline

and bottom-line strategies, including driving the margin improvement, and

category growth.

● Pricing& Ops : Build and execute strategy, manage catalog operations, and

develop pricing, discounting, and offer policies to deliver customer value

through intelligent and targeted promotions.

What we're looking for

● 4–8 years in category management, revenue or yield management, pricing,

strategy or consulting, ideally at a consumer internet, travel or fintech company.

● An MBA or B.Tech from a top-tier institute (IIM, ISB, IIT, BITS or equivalent).

● High ownership. You are comfortable with ambiguity, and you push ideas across

teams until they ship.

● Strong analytical skills. You can size an opportunity from scratch, are

comfortable in data platforms/ SQL/ Excel, and make data-backed decisions.

● User-first judgement: you keep the user experience at the centre of any product,

fee or pricing decision.

● Clear communication with senior leadership and external partners.

Good to have

● Experience in B2C business, revenue management, or selling add-on and

insurance products.

job.description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist

Why HSBC

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

The Opportunity

As a Release and Environment Management Specialist you’ll manage application releases, production changes, deployment activity and environment stability across enterprise platforms. This role sits at the point where change meets operational resilience - ensuring deployments are controlled, evidenced and safe and that environments remain stable before and after change. You’ll own delivery from planning through implementation, validation and handover while partnering closely with application, infrastructure and support teams. Day to day success is measured through high-quality change documentation, controlled deployments and clear stakeholder communication. You’ll also play a key role in reducing deployment failures, build issues and repeat incidents through strong troubleshooting and practical preventative actions. The work requires disciplined change management and the technical depth to execute deployments and site switching with care.

What you'll be doing

  • Own release and environment delivery from planning through implementation, validation, closure and handover
  • Create and manage change orders with 100% quality assurance against approved change requirements
  • Execute code and configuration deployments across relevant environments including retrofit activities after fixes and emergency change
  • Perform site switching using F5 load-balancing technology including pre-change checks and post-change validation
  • Resolve deployment and release issues using fix-forward approaches in line with approved change, release, security and operational procedures
  • Manage Git repositories including branch management, code promotion, merge coordination and repository hygiene
  • Investigate build and pipeline issues affecting release workflows including Jenkins troubleshooting and log analysis

job.name: Staff Software Engineer
job.description:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.

Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon.

Itron Resiliency Solutions is a global, diverse team of builders and innovators who tackle previously impossible challenges for our customers. If you have a desire to challenge yourself, solve impactful problems, and work with a passionate and talented team, this is the place.

About The Role We're hiring a Staff Software Engineer in Bengaluru to build and run production services. You'll own features end to end — from understanding the problem to shipping, monitoring and fixing what you built — with growing independence and support from senior engineers.

Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. You'll work closely with senior engineers, your Engineering Manager, Product and Customer Support.

What you'll own in your first year

  • Own: Own features and services end to end with speed and quality — build, test, release, monitor, fix.
  • Well-scoped problems, then bigger ones. Start with clearly defined work and grow into breaking down ambiguous problems yourself.
  • Design. Write design notes for your features and get them reviewed; contribute to larger designs led by senior engineers.
  • Quality. Write tests, add observability, and take part in on-call so issues are caught before customers see them.
  • Customers. Understand who uses what you build, and learn from support issues what to fix next.
  • Code reviews. Give and receive thoughtful reviews, and help onboard engineers who join after you.

What you must bring

These are the bar. We can't teach them on the job.

  • Experience: 1–4 years building production software. We level on demonstrated scope, not years alone.
  • You've shipped code that runs in production. Features or services you built, released and supported — not only coursework or prototypes.
  • You are strong at problem solving. You can take an unfamiliar, feature-sized problem, reason through it, and land on a simple, correct solution.
  • You work independently toward a clear goal. Given a clear goal, you figure out the steps, unblock yourself, and ask for help at the right moments.

We care how you engineer more than which language you did it in.

job.name: Software Engineering Lead
job.description:
About Airbound Our mission is to make a world where everyone has access to delivery. Where goods move as freely as information moves today. This is possible. Today the cost of moving on a scooter is ₹2/km. That’s the cost of moving a 150kg mass from point A to B. We’re bringing that mass down to less than 5kgs, concurrently bringing the cost down to 10 paise/km. This is how we make deliveries a reality. This is how we create a world where we’re doing billions of deliveries per day.

The tech is not there. The current cost of drone delivery is ₹100/km. We need to completely redefine the way things are done here. We’re building the world’s most efficient aircraft from the ground-up, and scaling that up to beyond anything the aerospace sector has ever seen. This cannot be an iterative process. We have to tear down all conventions and build everything up from scratch.

To do this, we need nothing less than the best engineers. The ones who care about building something fundamentally different, who are deeply curious about understanding the fundamentals of everything they’re working on, who are dreamers that believe in the impossible.

About Flight Systems The hardware on the drone is only half of what keeps it up in the air. The rest is the software both on the craft and on our ground station. Our unique dual motor thrust vectored tailsitter with blended wing body design has to fly in almost all weather-including heavy winds and light rains autonomously. We're targeting 1000s of flights per day across all locations, requiring us to rethink everything from firmware, controls, state estimation to even ground control and fleet management software. We've achieved an industry-leading payload-to-weight ratio of ~2kg drone for 1kg payload and we're pushing this even further. Every gram matters when you're revolutionizing logistics. This is where cutting-edge aerospace engineering meets software scalability meets real-world impact. If you get excited about solving problems that span multiple disciplines that don't have textbook solutions, this is your playground.

About The Role We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Engineer to join our team dedicated to developing a suite of sophisticated, web-based platforms for UAV operations. This role is central to building the software that powers our entire ecosystem, including our next-generation Ground Control Station (GCS), fleet management dashboards, data analysis tools, and simulation interfaces. This position is integral to our core mission, contributing directly to the safety and efficiency of our real-world autonomous operations.

Key Responsibilities

job.name: NPI & Test Automation Engineer
job.description:
JD – NPI & Test Automation Engineer (Electronics / Power Systems)

Role summary

The engineer owns NPI support, hardware validation and automated test system development for telecom power products, EV DC chargers and Li-ion battery packs. The role bridges R&D and production: it turns new designs into tested, production-ready products and builds the test setups that cut test time and improve repeatability on the line.

Key responsibilities

Automated test systems (ATS) and Test Jigs

  • Study schematics, rack architecture and engineering documents to define test and validation requirements.
  • Prepare wiring diagrams and design universal ATS setups that cover multiple product or rack variants.
  • Integrate and commission test hardware: PLCs (e.g. Siemens S7-200 Smart), relay cards, contactors, programmable DC loads (e.g. Chroma), rectifiers/SMRs and power supplies.
  • Assemble, wire and verify test setups, then validate them against manual testing before release to production.
  • Develop Python applications for functional test cases, real-time monitoring, data logging and Excel/report generation.
  • Design and maintain burn-in, life-cycle and regenerative test setups for batteries and SMRs.
  • Design simple PCBs for jigs and fixtures (cell simulators, pre-charge test, CAN splitters).

New Product Introduction (NPI)

  • Take part in Cross-Functional Team (CFT) reviews of design documents, specifications and customer requirements.
  • Find design, assembly and testing issues at prototype stage and drive corrective actions with R&D.
  • Review prototype builds, test reports and engineering documents before production release.
  • Prepare assembly and test documents (SOPs, work instructions) for manual and automated testing.

Production support and validation

  • Support testing and troubleshooting of telecom power systems, EV DC fast chargers and Li-ion battery packs / BMS.
  • Lead root-cause analysis of assembly and functional failures with Production, Quality and R&D.
  • Suggest and implement improvements that raise test coverage, throughput and first-pass yield.

Required skills

Area

What we need

Programming

Python, including hands-on test or monitoring tools; PyQt/PySide (GUI), Pandas and Matplotlib preferred

Communication protocols

CAN plus at least two of RS485, RS232, UART, SPI, I2C, Modbus

Automation hardware

PLC programming (Siemens preferred), relay/contactor logic, Arduino or similar controllers

Test equipment

Programmable DC loads, power supplies, rectifiers/SMRs, DMMs, oscilloscopes, data loggers

Electronics & power

Power electronics basics, SMPS/rectifiers, battery packs and BMS, PCB-level troubleshooting

Documentation

Wiring diagrams, test procedures, test reports, SOPs and work instructions

Tools

Git/GitLab, Excel; a PCB tool such as EasyEDA or Altium is a plus

Preferred experience

job.name: Data Scientist - Senior
job.description:
Job Summary Solves complex analytical problems using quantitative approaches through a combination of analytical, mathematical and technical skills. Researches, designs, implements and validates complex algorithms to analyze diverse sources of data to achieve targeted outcomes by leveraging complex statistical and predictive modeling concepts.

Key Responsibilities Participates in projects to support key objectives and business goals through the use of data science methodology. Leverages data science methodology to solve complex business problems. Creates multiple algorithms using complex statistical methodologies through the use of statistical programming languages and tools. Partners with domain experts to verify model capabilities. Partners with Solution Architect to enable appropriate data flow/data model, development using appropriate tools/technology, rapid prototyping and informs the design of analytical products. Partners with less experienced employees on data science tools and methodologies. Clearly articulates results, methodologies and learnings to stakeholder and peer group. Continuous development and advancement of the team through knowledge sharing and collaboration.

Competencies Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Tech savvy - Anticipating and adopting innovations in business-building digital and technology applications.

Data Mining - Extracts insights from data by identifying relationships and patterns through use of a suite of data exploration and data visualization techniques to understand the underlying structure of the data and enable sound conclusions upon model building.

About This Opportunity

Not every incident manager is an Incident Commander. We're looking for someone who knows the difference. At KIBO, we operate a sophisticated, enterprise-grade SaaS commerce platform supporting global brands and mission-critical business operations.When something goes wrong, we need someone exceptional taking command. We're looking for a technically strong, decisive Senior Major Incident Manager who understands modern SaaS environments, earns the respect of experienced engineers, and can confidently lead a Severity 1 (Sev1) incident from initial alert through resolution.

This is a high-ownership role where your technical judgment, leadership, communication, and ability to make decisions under pressure directly affect our customers. You won't be the engineer writing the fix. You'll be the person responsible for making sure the right engineers are engaged, the right decisions are made, and the incident is resolved as efficiently as possible.

We have high expectations for this position. We're looking for proven experience, not just certifications or familiarity with incident management terminology.

About KIBO

KIBO is a global SaaS technology company delivering modern, composable digital commerce solutions for B2B, B2C, and D2C organizations. Our platform brings together enterprise eCommerce, Order Management, and Subscriptions, helping businesses simplify complex operations and deliver exceptional customer experiences. Trusted by brands including Ace Hardware, Zwilling, Jelly Belly, Nivel, and Honey Birdette, KIBO powers sophisticated commerce environments where reliability, performance, and scalability matter.

Our technology is built around modern MACH architecture:

  • Microservices-based: Independently deployable services supporting scalability and flexibility.
  • API-first: Modern integration capabilities connecting complex enterprise ecosystems.
  • Cloud-native SaaS: Modern cloud infrastructure designed for enterprise-scale operations.
  • Headless: Flexible architecture separating customer experiences from back-end commerce capabilities.

KIBO is MACH Alliance Certified and was recognized as a Leader in The Forrester Wave™: Order Management Systems, Q1 2025. We're also at the forefront of embracing AI and intelligent automation, continually exploring how emerging technologies can improve engineering productivity, operational efficiency, and the experiences we deliver to our customers. Our global team of Kibonauts works in a remote-friendly environment that values technical excellence, accountability, innovation, continuous learning, and customer obsession.

Pico fuels the global capital markets community by providing exceptional market data services and customized managed infrastructure solutions. As financial industry experts at the center of markets and technology, we help our clients efficiently scale their business and quickly access markets. From infrastructure to connectivity, we support our clients through the full trading lifecycle. We are a global company headquartered in New York, with offices in Chicago, London, Singapore, Hong Kong and Tokyo.

Purpose of the role

Pico’s Level 1 Support Team provide critical front-line support across all aspects of Pico’s infrastructure. Working as a global team, the Level 1 Support team are responsible for the pro-active monitoring of Pico’s infrastructure, performing initial triage of alerts and inbound support requests, and the creation and assignment of support cases into the Level 2 operational support teams.   • Act as a primary technical authority within the Pico Level 1 Team and lead real-time incident triage across network, platform and connectivity domains.

job.description:
Branch Overview

Branch is a leading AI-powered lending fintech with 50M+ downloads across India and Africa. We use alternative data and machine learning to expand financial access for millions of people traditionally excluded from the formal financial system. Founded by the former CEO of Kiva.org and backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Visa, and the IFC, Branch combines mission-driven impact with world-class technology and scale.

In India, Branch operates as a regulated digital lending institution and Middle Layer NBFC, building trusted and accessible financial products for millions of customers across the country. Our 250+ member India team is growing rapidly and works across technology, data science, risk, product, and operations to solve high-impact problems at scale.

Certified as a Great Place to Work in 2025, Branch offers the opportunity to build meaningful careers while shaping the future of inclusive fintech in one of the world’s fastest-growing digital economies.

Job Overview

The Senior Associate – Fraud Risk will play a key role in building and strengthening our fraud prevention function by focusing on external fraud signals, emerging market threats, evolving customer scam behaviours and drive improvements in fraud prevention and detection. This role reports to the Lead, Fraud Risk Operations.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor emerging fraud trends, scam typologies, and external fraud intelligence across the lending ecosystem.
  • Conduct complex fraud investigations, identify root causes, fraud patterns, and control gaps across the personal loan lifecycle.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to strengthen fraud prevention, detection, and monitoring controls.
  • Manage SCNs, Reasoned Orders, customer responses, and fraud case resolutions.
  • Support RBI regulatory reporting, including FMRs and FUAs, ensuring accurate and timely submissions.
  • Liaise with law enforcement agencies, partner banks and financial institutions for fraud reporting and information sharing.
  • Prepare fraud risk dashboards, management reports, investigation records and regulatory documentation.
  • Maintain fraud repositories, investigation records and reporting documentation.

Required

  • 3-6 years of experience in fraud risk management, fraud investigations or anti-fraud operations, preferably in NBFC, bank, fintech, or payments ecosystem.
  • Strong understanding of fraud detection, investigation methodologies and fraud prevention controls, including identity fraud, loan stacking, mule networks, and digital scam patterns.
  • Experience in regulatory fraud reporting, including FMRs and FUAs.
  • Working knowledge of SQL queries and data analysis preferable.
  • Strong problem solving, communication, presentation skills, ability to write clear trend reports and notes.
  • Ability to manage complex investigations, collaborate across teams and drive process improvements.

job.name: Application Engineer - III
job.description:
About Vanguard Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.

Vanguard India Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.

Role Summary

  • Designs and builds the integration layers between Dynamics/Dataverse, front-end channels, and AI agents. Exposes CRM capabilities through secure APIs and MCP-compatible tools, enabling event-driven applications and agentic AI to safely reason over and act on CRM data.

Responsibilites

  • Build REST/GraphQL APIs and middleware that decouple Dynamics from consuming apps and agents
  • Implement event-driven patterns to publish CRM state changes to downstream systems
  • Expose CRM and platform capabilities via MCP servers for AI tool access
  • Enable LLM/agent workflows to query, summarise, and trigger CRM processes
  • Enforce secure, delegated access using modern identity and authorization patterns
  • Understanding of Dynamics runtime (Dataverse schema, security, plugins and workflows)
  • Production support, release and change management
  • Write and deploy CI/CD pipelines

Qualifications And Skills

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in software development, system integration, database design, and back-end architecture.
  • Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in relevant fields such as Computer Science, or a Master’s degree/Diploma in Computer Science.
  • Java, .NET & Python backend engineering and API design
  • API gateways and integration platforms (e.g. Azure API Management)
  • Event-driven architecture (Kafka-style patterns; Service Bus / Event Grid equivalents)
  • Identity & security: Entra ID, OAuth/OIDC, delegated access
  • Agent integration using Semantic Kernel / LangChain, prompt design, and RAG patterns
  • Co-Pilot Studio integrations.
  • AWS Cloud skills (lambda, ECS, glue, s3, IAM, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS)
  • GitHub & GitHub Actions

Location This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.

Our mission Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.

job.name: Technical Lead – Visual C++ & SQL Server
job.description:
Navtech is a premier IT software and services provider. Our mission is to increase public cloud adoption and build cloud-first solutions that become trendsetting platforms of the future.

We have been recognized as the Best Cloud Service Provider by GoodFirms for delivering quality services and results. We strive to innovate and push technology and service boundaries to provide best-in-class technology solutions to our clients globally.

We are a fast-growing company serving clients across the United States, UK and Europe. You will work with a team of talented developers, quality engineers and product managers who are passionate about building impactful technology solutions.

About the role You will lead the team taking over a large rights and licensing rules engine that has been inproduction for many years. It is written in Visual C++ on Windows Server, with heavybusiness logic in SQL Server. You will shadow the client's current technical lead, then ownthe architecture, code quality and release decisions for the system.

Responsibilities

  • Lead knowledge transfer from the client's engineers and turn it into architecturedocuments, runbooks and code walkthroughs.
  • Own technical design, code reviews and production releases for the rules engine.
  • Lead a pod of 3 senior C++ developers and 1 Rails developer.
  • Diagnose and resolve production issues, including performance problems in SQLServer.
  • Plan the modernisation of legacy components (including MS Access dependencies)without disrupting live operations.
  • Act as the main technical contact for the client's engineering leadership in the US andCyprus.

Must have

  • 12+ years in software development, with at least 7 years in C++ on Windows (VisualC++ / MSVC).
  • Deep SQL Server experience: complex stored procedures, query tuning, executionplans, indexing. SQL Server 2016/2017 preferred.
  • Has led a team that took over and maintained a large existing codebase built by otherpeople over many years.
  • Strong debugging skills on Windows: Visual Studio debugger, WinDbg or crash-dumpanalysis.
  • Has led teams of 4 or more engineers.

Nice to have

  • Rules engines, workflow engines or business rules systems.
  • Kafka or other message queues.
  • MS Access, VBA or Ruby on Rails.
  • Rights management, licensing, royalties or contract systems in media, telecom billingor financial services.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer - Automation/Manual QA Engineer
job.description:
Senior Software Engineer (Automation/Manual QA Engineer) Location: Hyderabad What Makes Us, Us Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values – caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

As our new Senior QA Engineer, you will join the Product Division, Transactions product area. It consists of three teams, each with four to seven software engineers across several geographical locations.

This role is pivotal in accelerating delivery cycles while maintaining high product quality.   • Analyze and report bugs with clarity and precision
  • Help maintain product quality
  • Contribute to continuous integration, quality gates, and deployment pipelines

What We Value

  • 3+ years of experience in QA or software engineering with a focus on test automation
  • Proficiency in C# and .NET testing frameworks like SpecFlow
  • Solid understanding of software QA methodologies, tools, and processes
  • Comfortable with manual testing in complex business domains (ideally finance or data-heavy systems)
  • Solid experience testing APIs, services, and data pipelines
  • Solid problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Agile and BDD practices

Additionaly We Value

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help build the next generation of scalable content intelligence, metadata, classification, and data governance capabilities for enterprise unstructured data. Ideal

  • Experience building content intelligence, enterprise search, data classification, data governance, file-processing, or unstructured-data platforms.
  • Experience optimizing systems operating across very large datasets or high-volume processing pipelines.
  • Experience helping establish engineering practices within a new or rapidly scaling product team.
  • Demonstrated use of AI-assisted development workflows with strong validation practices.

job.name: Software Engineer - Lab Automation
job.description:
The Research & Automation Technologies (R&AT) group within Amgen’s Automation, Research Informatics, and AI (ARIA) organization is seeking a highly creative candidate for a Software Engineer position. This person will be responsible for the development and delivery of full-stack solutions that accelerate the discovery and development of Amgen’s life-saving therapeutics. These solutions will require integration with multiple systems across our informatic ecosystem, using a variety of existing and emerging technologies, including source code repository and automated build system management, AWS infrastructure management, device driver development, and data integration. This Software Engineer will play a key role in developing solutions that enable the evolution of our Research labs into highly automated, highly integrated next-generation facilities. Our goal is to develop transformative, automated systems that fundamentally change the way science is executed in our Research labs. To effectively communicate and collaborate with a diverse group of stakeholders, an understanding of biology, chemistry and drug discovery is essential.

Position Responsibilities

  • Full ownership of projects, from client scientist interviews and requirements gathering, to system and functional specification, to development, testing, training, and support.
  • Development of code using .NET (C#, WPF) and Python (desktop applications, web applications, AWS lambda functions, etc.) to: control lab automation instruments; take input from lab information management systems and transform it into automation system-specific instructions; data extraction, transformation, and loading from lab automation instruments to lab information management systems.
  • Solutions will regularly require integration with our Benchling lab information management system via REST APIs, Mosaic compound inventory and management system using REST APIs and/or a direct Oracle database connection, and a variety of other informatic ecosystem services.
  • Close communication and coordination with our engineers to ensure the output (CSV, XML, JSON) of the utilities developed will work with the lab automation systems that will consume them.
  • Continuous outreach, collaboration, and communication with scientists across multiple research organizations and geographies to identify opportunities, ideate solutions, manage expectations, and deliver fit-for-purpose lab informatic systems and integrations.
  • Identify emerging, transformative technologies and develop innovative solutions that improve existing processes or enable novel processes.
  • Identify and establish best practices across the full spectrum of software development tasks, including DevOps, documentation, end-user training, delivery, and support.

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science
  • OR
  • Associate's degree in Computer Science and 5 years of in-industry experience

job.name: Senior Automation QE Engineer
job.description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

The Role This is an opportunity to join our growing Product Quality team as a Senior Automation Software Quality Engineer. In this role, you will be responsible for functional and non functional testing (including performance and automation testing) of the AspenTech Inmation Data Fabric products. You will work closely with front end and back end software developers and Product Management to gather functional requirements, understand system behaviour, and proactively drive quality best practices throughout the product lifecycle.

Your Impact

  • Deliver high‑quality software by designing and executing manual and automated tests, including test environments, installations, upgrades, and configurations, in accordance with technical specifications.
  • Develop, enhance, and maintain test automation frameworks to improve test efficiency, reliability, and coverage.
  • Design and perform unit, integration, end‑to‑end, and performance testing in an iterative, agile development environment.
  • Collaborate and communicate effectively with internal stakeholders to understand project goals and expectations.
  • Drive test automation across API, UI, system, and integration layers using technologies such as MSTest, C#, Lua, PowerShell, Cypress, and Selenium.
  • Maintain and execute performance, scalability, and stress tests.
  • Share knowledge and best practices by participating in code reviews and pair programming.
  • Work effectively both as an individual contributor and as part of a collaborative team in a fast‑paced, evolving environment.

What You'll Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • At least four years of experience as a Software Developer or Software Developer in Test.
  • Strong ability and willingness to design, develop, and enhance test frameworks, not just use existing ones.
  • Advanced knowledge of at least one modern operating system.
  • Fluency in English.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Understanding of cloud deployments; familiarity with different deployment infrastructure and virtualization technologies.
  • Basic knowledge of networking, databases, servers, communication protocols, and information security concepts.
  • A strong willingness and curiosity to learn new technologies and skills.

job.name: SRM Architect
job.description:
Organization Overview Company Description QAD is a leading provider of ERP solutions purpose-built for manufacturing industries — automotive, life sciences, food & beverage, high tech, and industrial. Serving thousands of global manufacturers, QAD's Adaptive Manufacturing Cloud helps companies operate with greater precision, agility, and intelligence.

Enterprise software is entering a third era. The first gave manufacturers a System of Record — ERP that answered 'what do we have and what did we commit to?' The second gave them Data Infrastructure — the ability to move, analyse, and query that data at scale. The third era is domain-specific intelligence: AI agents that can act autonomously on manufacturing data, but only if that data has been given the context, relationships, and governed rules that allow an agent to reason correctly.

Job Description The SRM Architect owns the technical direction of QAD's SaaS products outside the core ERP: Supplier Relationship Management (SRM), Enterprise Quality Management (EQMS), and Demand & Delivery. Development on these products is largely outsourced, so this person is the internal technical authority who sets direction and holds partners to it. Major customer commitments, including a strategic co-investment partnership, depend on this role.

Responsibilities

  • Define the target architecture and a practical modernization roadmap for SRM, EQMS, and Demand & Delivery, with engineering and product leaders.
  • Make and document architecture decisions on application design, AWS deployment, multi-tenancy, integrations, data, security, and performance.
  • Set technical standards for outsourced engineering partners, review their designs and delivered work, and resolve technical risks before they reach customers.
  • Translate customer and commercial commitments into feasible designs, estimates, dependencies, and milestones, and see them through delivery.
  • Build the internal knowledge needed to sustain these products independently of any one partner.

Qualifications Required Skills:

  • Architecture leadership for enterprise SaaS products, across both multi-tenant and single-tenant deployment models.
  • Strong hands-on depth in Java and/or .NET (C#), with the ability to assess designs in both.
  • Strong AWS experience and fluency with modern cloud-native architecture.
  • A record of directing outsourced or partner engineering teams and owning their technical outcomes.
  • High agency: owns outcomes end to end, challenges weak designs, and leads with authority without waiting for direction.

Preferred

  • Experience with supplier management, quality management, or supply chain software.
  • Experience modernizing existing products without disrupting customers.

What Success Looks Like Customer commitments delivered on time, partners held to a clear technical standard, and an architectural roadmap the business can plan against.

Read the full description

job.name: Delivery Operations Team Lead
job.description:
Skill required: Financial Planning & Analysis - Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A)

Designation: Delivery Operations Team Lead

Qualifications: Any Graduation

Years of Experience: 7 to 11 years

About Accenture Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com

What would you do? The primary responsibility of the role is to proactively manage the delivery of Group Management and Statutory Reporting information in line with the agreed service level agreements by acting as a P&L owner. Group Management information will include financial information and scenarios required for S&OP meetings, H1 and FY targets. This will include challenging assumptions and coordination data inputs in all internal reporting systems, running the forecasting process activities, preparation and generation of financial information accurately and performing quality review with key finance senior stakeholders prior to releasing to the customer for approval. Drive independent analysis and provide insightful recommendations to the senior stakeholders. The objective of this role is to enable the Area Finance team to meet their business objectives by consolidating area financials, tracking actuals delivery vs budgets, providing key insights for Finance leadership team, as well as managing monthly dashboards and providing executive summary for Finance leadership team along with insights on key drivers. This role will partner senior stakeholders across various functional teams (Marketing Directors, Commercial Directors, Heads of Finance, Supply Chain Directors, etc) to provide strategic financial guidance on key financial performance in the market. Specific responsibilities include, but not limited to, overseeing financial forecasts, industry value projections, regulatory impacts to the category, price war analysis, etc. The ideal candidate will proactively and collaboratively work across the organization to develop a competitor framework that can effectively be used as a platform to provide insights revenue and resource allocation and drive recommendations on potential course of action. This position requires an excellent knowledge of financials, strategic thinking, analytical expertise, and leadership skills. information

job.description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our Investments team part of our People & Investments team at Marsh. This role will be based in Gurgaon This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office

Director – Investments The Performance Centre of Delivery (CoD) Lead is responsible for leading the global Performance CoD operating model, delivering centralised 24/5 operational support across performance measurement, attribution, ex-post risk, GIPS/FMPS oversight, and exception management processes to enable fund, client and investment performance.

The role is accountable for providing consistent, high-quality and SLA-driven performance services globally. Acting as the operational hub for performance support activities, the CoD Lead ensures issues are proactively managed, resolved efficiently and escalated appropriately to maintain service quality, operational stability and stakeholder confidence.

The CoD Lead drives a service-oriented culture focused on responsiveness, ownership, quality and continuous improvement, ensuring the CoD delivers a scalable and resilient support model across regions, asset classes and analytics disciplines.

The role provides operational oversight of the third-party managed service provider, FactSet, ensuring externally delivered services operate in line with agreed service levels, governance standards, operational controls and stakeholder expectations. The CoD Lead will work closely with vendor teams and internal stakeholders to manage service quality, operational performance, issue escalation, process alignment and continuous improvement across the broader performance operating model.

Working closely with Performance Regional SMEs, the Performance Change Lead and key business stakeholders, the role ensures globally aligned operational practices while supporting the evolving needs of investment teams, clients and the wider organisation.

The role forms part of the global Performance leadership team and reports to the Global Head of Performance

We will count on you for :

  • Global Service Leadership & Operational Delivery

job.name: Financial Planning & Analysis Representa
job.description:
Project Role : Financial Planning & Analysis Representa

Project Role Description : Drive performance, strategic analysis and identification and correction of financial or operational concerns. Provide financial analysis to aid in decisions pertaining to the profitability and financial health of the organization.

Must have skills : AWS Architecture

Good to have skills : NA

Minimum 7.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary In the role of Financial Planning and Analysis Representative, a typical day involves driving performance improvements through strategic analysis and identifying financial or operational issues that may impact the organization. This position requires providing insightful financial analysis to support decision-making processes focused on enhancing profitability and maintaining the financial well-being of the company. The role demands continuous monitoring of financial data, collaborating with various stakeholders to address concerns, and contributing to the overall financial strategy to ensure sustainable growth and operational efficiency.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
  • Responsible for team decisions.
  • Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
  • Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
  • Lead initiatives to improve financial processes and reporting accuracy.
  • Facilitate communication between finance and operational departments to align goals and strategies.
  • Mentor junior team members to support their professional development and enhance team capabilities.

Professional & Technical Skills

  • Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in AWS Architecture.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud infrastructure design and deployment best practices.
  • Experience in designing scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud solutions.
  • Ability to analyze complex financial data and translate it into actionable insights.
  • Familiarity with integrating financial systems and cloud platforms to optimize performance.
  • Skilled in troubleshooting and resolving architectural challenges in cloud environments.

Additional Information

  • The candidate should have minimum 7.5 years of experience in AWS Architecture.
  • This position is based at our DDC5E - SEZ location.
  • A 15 years full time education is required.
