job.name: Associate Analyst - AO Business Strategy & Insight
job.description:
Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.

Description At United, we fly into airports around the entire world. And we need a whole team of people to keep things running in tip-top shape! From the exceptional service at the check-in counter to the departure gate, and even behind the scenes making sure your checked bags arrive with you, our Airport Operations team keeps operations at our airports running smoothly every single day.

Job Overview And Responsibilities The Associate Analyst – AO Business Strategy & Insight is responsible for supporting workforce scheduling, resource planning, employee dependability, and Business Office operations across Network Operations Center (NOC) and Airport Operations (AO). Key responsibilities include workforce planning and modeling, scheduling and payroll audits, employee dependability monitoring, and ensuring compliance with company policies. The position also focuses on identifying operational inefficiencies, developing data-driven tools and automated solutions, and improving processes to optimize resource utilization and operational performance. The role supports additional Business Office initiatives and ad-hoc assignments as needed, contributing to operational efficiency, accuracy, and risk mitigation across NOC/AO.

  • Short- and long-term workforce scheduling, resource planning, staffing analysis, and workforce modeling
  • Employee dependability monitoring, attendance tracking, reconciliation, compliance audits, and exception management
  • Scheduling and payroll audits to ensure data accuracy, policy compliance, and operational consistency
  • Development of data-driven tools, dashboards, automation, and reporting solutions to improve operational efficiency
  • Workforce utilization analysis, process optimization, and identification of efficiency and cost-saving opportunities
  • Cross-functional Business Office support, operational analysis, and ad-hoc projects to address evolving NOC/AO business needs

This position is offered on local terms and conditions. Expatriate assignments and sponsorship for employment visas, even on a time-limited visa status, will not be awarded. This position is for United Airlines Business Services Pvt. Ltd - a wholly owned subsidiary of United Airlines Inc. Qualifications What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

job.name: Data Analyst (Tableau, Power BI, SQL)
job.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together. Primary Responsibilities

  • Collect, clean, and validate data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy and reliability
  • Analyze complex datasets using statistical methods and provide meaningful insights
  • Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and visualizations to communicate findings to stakeholders
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business objectives and deliver data solutions
  • Identify trends, patterns, and opportunities in data that can inform strategic decisions
  • Prepare presentations and documentation of analysis results for both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Assist in the development of data collection processes and improvement of existing systems
  • Ensure the security, integrity, and confidentiality of data
  • Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

Required Qualifications

  • Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience
  • 3+ years of experience in data analysis with bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau or similar
  • Knowledge of statistical programming language such as R/Python
  • Knowledge of Azure Snowflake/ Databricks and GutHub
  • Proficiency in SQL for querying databases
  • Proven solid analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail
  • Proven excellent communication skills; able to present complex information clearly

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

job.name: Associate, Sr. Associate, AM, Manager | Growth Consulting
job.description:
About The Opportunity

  • Foresight is a growth marketing firm built for the fast-moving world of new-age consumer brands. We help D2C brands scale online with clarity, performance, and momentum across channels including D2C websites, traditional marketplaces, and quick commerce. We also support brands that are just getting started or are looking to reinvent themselves with brand strategy, GTM and creative services to translate their vision into a powerful digital-first brand.
  • Founded by Bhanu Nangru and Kriti Agarwal, Foresight is grounded in consumer insights, data-led thinking, sharp execution, and a deep partnership model with founders and growth teams. We work hand-in-hand with founders to drive outcomes, not just outputs. If you’re excited about joining an early-stage team working at the intersection of consumer insights, data, marketing, and strategy, we’d love to hear from you.

Role & Responsibilities

  • Conduct competitive, category, consumer and channel research to generate insights and come up with recommendations to support strategic decision making for our clients.

job.name: Senior Category Associate
job.description:
About Us : We are making natural living a HABIT little by little. We do so by serving 100% natural self care to our consumers. The products are scientifically formulated, guided by ayurvedic principles & modern science. They are prepared fresh everyday in our ayurvedic kitchen, out of whole and raw ingredients such as fresh milk, curd, fruit pulps, flowers, herbs, nut & spices. They are finally tested clinically for efficacy & safety. This offering of Fresh Ayurveda has made a mark in the Indian personal care industry.

Today ~60Lac customers trust us for their personal care needs. The founding team has a strong startup experience, is well funded and backed by tier 1 institutional investors.

About the role

A Senior Category Associate does everything a Category Associate does - stays close to the consumer, keeps the insight engine running, keeps ops tight - and then goes one step further: you own the category's P&L and make the calls. Pricing, mix, promo calendar, launch bets, inventory investment - the decisions are yours, backed by the ground-truth you built.

Why this stays hands-on even once you own the P&L

It would be easy, at this level, to hand the calls and FGDs to someone junior and sit with the dashboard instead. We deliberately don't let that happen. The decisions you're now accountable for - pricing, assortment, what to launch, what to sunset - are only as good as the ground-truth behind them, and that ground-truth comes from talking to consumers directly, not from a report someone else generated.

Secondary data tells you what happened last month. A direct conversation tells you why, early enough to act before it shows up as a dip in the number you own. The Senior Category Associates who make the best calls are the ones who never fully hand over the phone - they just get faster and sharper at turning what they hear into a decision.

job.name: Consultant - Global Employer Services Technology Center (GESTC) - Tier 2 Product Support & Technology Operations Professional
job.description:
Summary Position Summary GESTC is building a modern, event-driven, cloud-native GlobalAdvantage (GA) platform on Amazon Web Services (AWS).

Concretely, the environment you will operate includes:

  • Backend for Frontend (BFF) APIs on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS); Angular micro-frontends in the GA Portal.
  • Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)
  • supported by an Amazon S3 data lake, AWS Glue, and Amazon OpenSearch Service, including the operational dashboards you will use daily.
  • Azure DevOps continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), OpenTelemetry with Application Insights, and ServiceNow for IT service management (ITSM)

Data: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and Oracle as primary relational stores backbone where modules communicate through domain topics.

Integrations: external and client-system integration through Boomi iPaaS and a client API gateway

Workflow: human-in-the-loop processes on Pega bridged to Kafka

Security: AWS Cognito with Amazon Verified Permissions (AVP) policy-based authorization

This role does not require you to build these components. It does require sufficient understanding of how they work together to diagnose issues that cross them, coordinate the right teams, validate fixes, and improve how the platform is run.

This is an experienced position. You will work with Tier 1 support personnel and provide Tier 2 support across the platform, supporting users from both a technical and functional perspective. More than resolving tickets, you will own assigned production issues through diagnosis, resolution, validation, communication, and closure, and continuously improve the reliability and supportability of the platform.

Because the platform is event-driven and multi-layered, a single incident may span a micro-frontend, a .NET API, an Aurora/Oracle query, a Kafka message routed to a dead-letter queue (DLQ), a Boomi HRIS feed, a Pega case, an AVP authorization decision, and a dashboard. With training, you will trace issues across those layers using correlation IDs and telemetry, isolate the failing hop, and coordinate resolution with engineering, product, integration, security, and data teams without needing to build or re-architect the components yourself.

This position requires significant client contact, so you must possess excellent communication, consulting, and probing skills to manage client expectations. Our applications are used by Deloitte's Global Employer Services member firms and clients, so strong client service and the ability to deliver on time in a dynamic team environment are essential. The candidate will receive training on existing as well as next-generation tools.

job.name: RL Environment Engineer
job.description:
About Adzzat

Adzzat is an applied AI research lab. We turn enterprise data and human expertise into training data and evaluations for frontier AI labs.

The role

Design and deliver RL environments built from supplied code and domain data. This is an end-to-end, ML-leaning builder role. It is not a pure backend role or a research-only role.

Location: Mumbai, India

Non-negotiable

You have created an RL environment, or done real hands-on work on one. Show a runnable repo or inspectable artifact and explain what you built. This matters more to us than your degree or your title.

What you'll do

  • Decide which data can become a useful environment and clarify what data a lab needs.
  • Work backwards from existing benchmarks, or design suitable evaluations.
  • Build rewards, graders and verifiers that score agent runs and resist shortcuts and reward hacking.
  • Run agent experiments and measure whether post-training improves performance.
  • Ship containerised, reproducible setups in Docker, in a standard format such as Harbor.

Strong skills

  • ML and RL fundamentals, including gradient descent and how RL environments work
  • Strong recent Python
  • Linux, Docker, deployment and sandboxes
  • Verifier design that resists gaming
  • Training or post-training models is a strong extra signal

Ideal profile

B.Tech in Machine Learning or in AI and Data Science. This is a preference, not a filter.

How to apply

Apply with your resume and a link to a runnable repo or artifact. Add one line on what you built.

We are currently seeking a Systems Integration Advisor to join our team in Chennai, Tamil Nādu (IN-TN), India (IN).

Role Purpose Design and build the SQL Server data foundation for the monitoring solution, converting raw SSAS/ALETL telemetry into traceable, historised, queryable and Power BI-ready information.

About the Role

We are looking for a skilled and enthusiastic DevOps & Cloud Engineer with 2-3 years of hands-on experience in AWS and Kubernetes to join our growing technology team.

The ideal candidate should have practical experience in managing AWS infrastructure, deploying and maintaining Kubernetes clusters (EKS), automating deployments, and building scalable and reliable cloud environments.

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform or Ansible.

  • Implement Kubernetes security practices, including RBAC, Network Policies, and Secrets Management.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 1–2 years of hands-on experience in DevOps or Cloud Engineering.
  • Practical experience with AWS cloud services and networking.
  • Strong understanding of Kubernetes, with hands-on experience in Amazon EKS.
  • Knowledge of Docker and containerization.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
  • Working knowledge of Terraform or Ansible.
  • Good understanding of Linux administration and command-line operations.
  • Basic scripting knowledge in Bash or Python.
  • Familiarity with Git version control.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.

What We Are Looking For

  • A hands-on engineer with a practical understanding of DevOps concepts.
  • Someone who takes ownership of infrastructure and deployment responsibilities.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • An automation-focused mindset.
  • Ability to learn new technologies and work in a fast-paced environment.

﻿

Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to work on real-world AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure.
  • Exposure to cloud-native technologies and automation.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and technical development.
  • Collaborative and performance-driven work environment.

job.name: AWS DevOps Lead
job.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business. About The Role We are seeking a highly experienced AWS DevOps Lead to drive the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and automation strategy. The ideal candidate brings 15+ years of progressive experience in DevOps/Cloud engineering, with proven leadership in managing teams, modernizing legacy systems, and delivering scalable, secure, and highly available AWS-based solutions.

This role requires a hands-on technical leader who can balance strategic architecture decisions with day-to-day operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Core areas of ownership and accountability for this role Leadership & Strategy

  • Lead and mentor a team of DevOps/Cloud/Infrastructure engineers, setting technical direction and best practices.
  • Own the DevOps roadmap, driving automation-first culture across engineering teams.
  • Partner with engineering, security, product, and business stakeholders to align infrastructure strategy with organizational goals.
  • Define and track KPIs/SLAs for deployment frequency, system uptime, MTTR, and release quality.

Cloud Architecture & Infrastructure

  • Architect, implement, and optimize scalable, resilient, and cost-efficient infrastructure on AWS (EC2, S3, VPC, RDS, Lambda, ECS/EKS, ECR, IAM, etc.).
  • Design and enforce Infrastructure as Code (IaC) standards using Terraform / AWS CloudFormation / CDK.
  • Drive multi-account AWS landing zone strategy, networking, and security architecture.
  • Lead cloud cost optimization (FinOps) initiatives and capacity planning.

CI/CD & Automation

  • Design and manage end-to-end CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or AWS CodePipeline.
  • Build and maintain containerization and orchestration workflows (Docker, ECS, EKS/Kubernetes).
  • Automate build, test, deployment, and rollback processes to enable single-click/unattended releases.
  • Champion Infrastructure as Code and Configuration as Code practices across all environments.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts, operational tooling, and platform engineering solutions using Python, Bash, or similar scripting languages.
  • Leverage Python scripting for cloud automation, infrastructure operations, CI/CD integrations, reporting, and operational efficiency improvements.

Monitoring, Security & Compliance

  • Implement robust monitoring, logging, and alerting (CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Datadog).
  • Establish DevSecOps practices — vulnerability scanning, secrets management, IAM least-privilege policies, and compliance guardrails.
  • Lead incident management, root cause analysis, and disaster recovery/business continuity planning.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards (SOC2, HIPAA, GDPR, as applicable).

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration

job.name: Data Engineer-Master Data Management
job.description:
Introduction A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities As a Data Engineer specializing in Master Data Management, you will design, implement, and maintain a unified, accurate, and reliable master data environment that supports business operations, analytics, and decision-making. You will collaborate with stakeholders to identify data gaps and prioritize Master Data Management initiatives.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Develop and Enforce Data Governance Policies: Develop and enforce data governance policies to ensure data quality, security, and compliance. This includes implementing data management best practices and standards across the organization.
  • Implement Master Data Models: Design and implement master data models and data integration processes to ensure seamless data flow and integration across systems.
  • Ensure Data Quality and Security: Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and security of master data entities, identifying and addressing data gaps and inconsistencies.
  • Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work closely with stakeholders to identify business requirements, prioritize Master Data Management initiatives, and ensure organizational adoption and alignment with MDM strategies and policies.
  • Execute Change Management Plans: Develop and execute change management plans to ensure successful implementation and adoption of Master Data Management solutions.

Preferred Education Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

Read the full description

job.name: Data Engineer-Data Platforms-Google
job.description:
Introduction A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities As a Data Engineer specializing in Google's data platforms, you will design, build, and maintain data engineering solutions on Google's Cloud ecosystem. This role requires expertise in utilizing various Google services for batch and real-time data pipelines, data migration, and data layer design.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Design Data Pipelines: Design and develop batch and real-time data pipelines for Data Warehouse and Datalake using Google services such as DataProc, DataFlow, PubSub, BigQuery, and Big Table.
  • Develop Data Engineering Solutions: Utilize Google Cloud Storage, BigTable, BigQuery DataProc with Spark and Hadoop, and Google DataFlow with Apache Beam or Python to build and maintain data engineering solutions.
  • Manage Data Platforms: Schedule and manage the data platform using Google Cloud Scheduler and Cloud Composer (Airflow), ensuring efficient data pipeline operations.
  • Implement Data Migration: Develop and implement data migration solutions using Google services, ensuring seamless data transfer between systems.
  • Optimize Data Layer: Design and optimize the data layer using Google services such as BigQuery, Big Table, and Cloud Spanner, ensuring efficient data storage and retrieval.

Preferred Education Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

job.name: Principal Cybersecurity Expert
job.description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L

Role Overview:

Turing is looking for a Principal Cybersecurity Expert to lead a full-time pod of about 10 cybersecurity experts who label security data and run light investigations for a leading AI lab. You will set how the pod works, settle policy and judgment calls, and be the pod’s main domain voice with the client.

This is a hands-on leadership role for a practitioner who makes clear calls quickly. It is not a research or academic position, and a PhD is not expected.

What does day-to-day look like?

  • Lead 2 to 3 Seniors and 6 to 7 Juniors on cybersecurity labeling and investigation tasks for AI model training and evaluation.
  • Turn client goals into guidelines, rubrics and decision rules the pod applies consistently.
  • Make the final call on ambiguous or policy-sensitive cases and document each decision as reusable guidance.
  • Set the quality bar with Seniors through QC sampling, calibration sessions and feedback to Juniors.
  • Keep investigations scoped by deciding when a case has been looked at enough.
  • Report throughput, quality and recurring issues to the client and internal delivery team, and propose guideline changes.
  • Help onboard and assess new pod members early in the engagement.

Requirements:

  • 8 to 15 years of hands-on cybersecurity experience in areas such as security operations, incident response, threat intelligence, application security, penetration testing or vulnerability research.
  • Experience leading or mentoring analysts or engineers, including setting standards and reviewing their work.
  • Working experience with large language models: using them in security workflows, evaluating their outputs, red-teaming them or contributing to AI training data.
  • Offensive and defensive range deep enough to judge others’ analysis across domains.
  • Sound judgment on security policy, responsible disclosure and dual-use content.
  • Clear written English for writing guidelines others follow.
  • Available full-time for 6 to 12 months, with no competing full-time commitments.

Preferred Qualifications:

job.name: Cybersecurity Analyst, Offensive Security
job.description:
At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.

Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25-year-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.

While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America.

Responsibilities

  • Support authorized penetration testing, purple team, and AI security assessment activities under senior team direction.
  • Perform reconnaissance, vulnerability validation, basic attack-path analysis, and controlled testing within approved rules of engagement.
  • Assist with testing web applications, cloud environments, identity platforms, networks, endpoints, and assigned technologies.
  • Collect and document technical evidence, findings, affected assets, and recommended remediation actions.
  • Support validation of detection use cases and control gaps with Threat Detection and Response partners.
  • Maintain testing tools, scripts, documentation, and awareness of emerging vulnerabilities and offensive security techniques.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information security, related degree, or measurable knowledge from serving in industry/military/government unit.
  • Relevant certifications such as Security+, eJPT, PNPT, CEH, cloud security certifications, or equivalent demonstrated knowledge are preferred.
  • 1-5 years’ professional experience working in cybersecurity or information technology
  • Foundational knowledge of penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, threat modeling, or security testing methodologies.
  • Working knowledge of operating systems, networking, web technologies, cloud platforms, and enterprise identity concepts.
  • Ability to analyze technical issues, validate security findings, and communicate risk clearly to technical audiences.
  • Familiarity with common security tools and scripting languages, such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar.
  • Exposure to application, cloud, network, identity, OT, or AI security is preferred.

job.description:

You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. job.name: ServiceNow Administrator
job.description:
At Verint, we’re helping shape what is next in customer experience. As a leader in CX automation, we are creating a future where people and AI-powered bots work together to help some of the world’s most iconic brands achieve real business outcomes. Powered by our next-generation Verint Open Platform, we are continuing to grow, innovate, and push the boundaries of what is possible with AI.

We are bringing together passionate people with diverse voices, perspectives, and expertise who want to push what is possible, make an impact, and help shape the future of AI-powered customer experience. If you are excited by who we are, where we are going, and what we are building together, we want to hear from you!

About The Role We are looking for a ServiceNow Administrator, Junior Developer to own the day-to-day health, hygiene, and administration of our ServiceNow instances, so that AI workflow capability can be built and deployed on foundations that behave predictably. You will own access and configuration control, run family release upgrades, manage environments and releases, and keep platform performance, data quality, and license position under control. You will work collaboratively to deliver high-quality code and support existing projects while responding to internal requests.

As a ServiceNow Administrator, You Will

  • Administering users, groups, roles and ACLs, and maintaining a defensible access model across instances.
  • Maintaining core platform configuration including assignment rules, notifications, SLAs, service catalogue, and reporting.
  • Supporting the planning and running ServiceNow family release upgrades end to end - skipped-update review, regression testing, remediation planning, and post-upgrade verification.
  • Supporting the management of environments and releases: update set or source control promotion, clone scheduling and clean-up, and pre-production data integrity.
  • Monitoring platform performance and health - scheduled jobs, transaction and log analysis, system diagnostics - and acting before issues reach users.
  • Supporting CMDB and data quality, including discovery data integrity and the accuracy of CI relationships used by workflow and AI capability.
  • Provide support for complex Incidents by performing Root Cause Analysis and implementing effective solutions to resolve technical and security issues within the serviceNow platform. Building and maintaining reports, dashboards, and Performance Analytics content for operational and leadership use.
  • Operating and enforcing change control and maintaining accurate platform documentation and configuration records.
  • Providing second-line platform support to the Workflow Development team and to internal users and resolving issues to root cause.

Requirements You Will Need To Be Successful

job.description:
Job Description Position Summary As an Analyst II for Procurement Intelligence function, you contribute to Kraft Heinz's strategic ambition in shaping procurement-wide cost modelling strategy, providing critical insights to support executive decision-making, and driving financial efficiency. You will provide structure, support, and guidance to the Procurement team to ensure a comprehensive approach is used when there is a need to build our understanding of the market, competitors, and the importance of trends for all categories. You’ll understand our business objectives and strategically research relevant data to help us improve category strategies & approaches to competitive sourcing. You will design summary extract reports and analytics in collaboration with our procurement teams to embed this external knowledge which will help our business partners make informed decisions. This is a data-intensive, insight-driven role that bridges procurement strategy, finance, and external market intelligence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform quantitative and qualitative research into consumers, competitors, and the marketplace
  • Data mine the world wide web leveraging search engines and web analytics to gain insights from articles, publications etc.
  • Conduct in-depth research on industry trends, supplier markets, commodity pricing, and geopolitical factors to understand supply and demand dynamics and cost drivers
  • Analyze data from numerous sources to identify market trends and relevant demographics
  • Evaluate market data using software and statistical techniques
  • Provide analytical support to help develop sourcing strategies, support supplier identification and selection processes
  • Assist category managers and contribute to the development of category and sourcing strategies
  • Deliver supplier intel for strategic sourcing as required on an ongoing basis based on financial performance metrics (KPIs)
  • Apply the end-to-end procurement knowledge to conduct internal and external benchmarking, identify areas of cost improvement and areas of automation
  • Collect and analyze data from various procurement tools like SAP Ariba, Jaggaer, Sievo, SAP MM to ensure accuracy and consistency in data
  • Conduct spend analysis, total cost breakdown and should cost analysis to compare supplier prices and identify savings opportunities
  • Collect, analyze data from various databases including sec filings, Refinitiv, Capital IQ, EMIS, Factiva to ensure accuracy and consistency in data
  • Review and interpret large data sets and organize them into spreadsheets, charts, and graphs
  • Create insightful reports, presentations, and action items based on collected data

The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. You will lead the design and delivery of web applications, data platforms, and supporting infrastructure, working closely with business stakeholders and product managers. You will set the technical direction for the systems your team owns, working with senior engineers and leads to drive architecture, key design decisions, and engineering quality. The team’s technology stack includes Java/Spring, React/TypeScript, SQL Server, and Python. job.name: Machine Vision Engineer
job.description:
Job Description – Vision Engineer

Company Description

Join GoodEnough Energy, where innovation meets sustainability! We are at the forefront of revolutionizing the energy sector through advanced Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS). We are looking for a skilled and motivated Vision Engineer to join our team and contribute to the development and implementation of machine vision solutions for industrial automation and battery manufacturing processes.

Position Details

  • Job Title: Vision Engineer
  • Location: Greater Noida
  • Experience: 1–3 Years
  • Employment Type: Full-time | Work from Office

Job Summary

The Vision Engineer will be responsible for configuring, implementing, and troubleshooting machine vision systems for automated inspection and manufacturing processes. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with industrial cameras, lenses, lighting systems, image processing, and C# programming, along with an understanding of battery manufacturing processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Configure, integrate, and implement machine vision systems for industrial inspection and automation applications.
  • Independently select, configure, and operate industrial cameras, lenses, and lighting sources according to inspection requirements.
  • Perform CCD camera calibration, installation, setup, and troubleshooting.
  • Develop and implement vision applications using C# programming.
  • Work on image processing, image acquisition, and visual inspection solutions.
  • Support machine vision system integration with industrial automation equipment and production lines.
  • Perform vision system debugging, testing, optimization, and performance improvement.
  • Understand and work with battery manufacturing processes, including Cell, Module, and Pack sections.
  • Coordinate with production, automation, and engineering teams to ensure smooth implementation of vision systems.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Science, Automation, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Basic to strong understanding of Machine Vision and Image Processing.
  • Hands-on ability to independently configure and apply industrial cameras, lenses, and lighting systems.
  • Proficiency in C# programming and its integration with machine vision applications.
  • Knowledge of CCD cameras, camera calibration, and image acquisition.
  • Understanding of Industrial Automation and automated visual inspection systems.
  • Familiarity with battery manufacturing processes, particularly Cell, Module, and Pack sections.
  • Practical experience in machine vision debugging and troubleshooting.

Experience Requirements

  • 1–3 years of relevant experience in Machine Vision, Industrial Automation, or Vision System Integration.
  • Hands-on experience in vision system configuration, commissioning, and debugging.
  • Experience in battery manufacturing (Cell, Module, or Pack production lines) will be preferred.

job.name: Mobile Security Engineer (Android / iOS) - RASP, anti-debugging
job.description:
About the Role : We are looking for a Mobile Security Engineer to join a technology team focused on developing advanced security solutions for mobile applications. The role involves researching security threats, analysing vulnerabilities, developing protective mechanisms and strengthening mobile application security across Android and iOS platforms.

Key Responsibilities :

  • Research and develop security solutions for Android and iOS applications.
  • Analyse mobile applications to identify vulnerabilities, attack methods and security gaps.
  • Perform reverse engineering of mobile applications, malware and security tools.
  • Develop and improve mobile application protection mechanisms, including anti-debugging, anti-tampering, anti-hooking and runtime integrity checks.
  • Study and reproduce real-world mobile security attacks to evaluate existing protection mechanisms.
  • Develop and test security techniques using C/C++, Kotlin, Swift or Objective-C.
  • Work with reverse engineering and dynamic analysis tools to identify potential security weaknesses.
  • Contribute to the development and improvement of mobile security SDKs.
  • Understand relevant banking and fintech security regulations and their implications for mobile application security.
  • Participate in technical discussions with enterprise customers and internal engineering teams.
  • Document research findings, security vulnerabilities and defensive solutions.

Experience and Qualification :

  • 5–12 years of experience in application security, mobile security, reverse engineering or penetration testing.
  • Strong understanding of Android and/or iOS application security.
  • Hands-on experience in mobile application reverse engineering.
  • Familiarity with dynamic instrumentation and runtime analysis.
  • Experience with tools such as IDA Pro, Ghidra, JEB or JADX.
  • Exposure to Frida, GDB, LLDB or similar tools.
  • Experience developing or evaluating RASP (Runtime Application Self-Protection) solutions.
  • Ability to analyse compiled code and understand low-level application behaviour.
  • Experience in mobile malware analysis.
  • Knowledge of Android internals or iOS security mechanisms.
  • Experience with native code analysis (C/C++).
  • Understanding of mobile application protection, obfuscation and anti-tampering techniques.
  • Familiarity with Git, CI/CD and Linux/Unix environments.

job.name: Sr Data Engineer
job.description:
The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary: PayPal Marketing Technology team is dedicated to creating a best-in-class platform. We are looking for highly talented, professional, and motivated engineers to join our team. As a Senior Data Engineer on our Marketing Technology Platform, you will be at the forefront of designing and developing scalable data pipelines and data services on GCP (BigQuery, Bigtable) using Python, Kafka, and SQL.

You will take part in all facets of data pipeline development, including design, coding, instrumentation, security, testing, and overseeing production releases, delivering new features, enhancements, and fixes for the data platform that powers MarTech.

job.description:
Role Summary
Join our team as a Senior QA Engineer, where you will play a pivotal role in delivering high-quality software solutions through robust automation and functional testing practices. We are looking for a seasoned professional with strong hands-on experience in API automation frameworks, DB validation and CI/CD integration, complemented by solid functional QA expertise. This position involves designing and maintaining scalable automation frameworks, validating complex workflows, and ensuring comprehensive test coverage across legacy, web and API layers. The ideal candidate will also bring strong domain knowledge of Order-to-Cash processes, invoicing, and tax, enabling effective validation of end-to-end financial workflows and business rules.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Remain fully hands-on with automation scripting, framework development, and test execution.

  • Switch seamlessly between automation and functional testing responsibilities as project needs and situations arise, ensuring flexibility and comprehensive quality coverage

  • Lead the load testing campaign — design the eight to ten scenarios that validate sustained 50K msg/sec ingest, 150K msg/sec peaks, full DBT refresh at billion-row scale, 1,000 concurrent Starburst queries, 5,000 req/sec FHIR API, MDM degradation behaviour, and reprocessing during steady state. job.description:

job.name: Project Director/ Project Manager - Credit Risk Consulting
job.description:
Highlight of the engagement opportunity

  • Nature of role: Full time
  • Number of years of experience expected:
  • Project Manager: 8–13 years, including at least 5 years hands-on in credit risk modelling, credit analytics, credit policy, or regulatory capital.
  • Project Director: 13–20 years, including at least 7 years in the above, with proven ownership of delivery, revenue, and client relationships.
  • Candidates without direct credit risk modelling / analytics experience will not be shortlisted, regardless of general risk consulting pedigree.
  • Areas of past experience preferred / mandatory:
  • Credit risk modelling and scorecards: application, behavioural, collection, and bureau scorecards; credit rating and scoring models; PD / LGD / EAD models; scorecard development lifecycle including data preparation, WOE / IV analysis, logistic regression and machine learning models, cut-off setting, calibration, validation, monitoring, and redevelopment.
  • Credit risk policy and framework: credit policy, underwriting and credit appraisal, delegation of authority, credit monitoring, early warning signals (EWS), restructuring, NPA / IRAC classification, provisioning, and write-off policy.
  • Regulatory capital and Basel: credit RWA computation, Standardised and IRB (F-IRB / A-IRB) approaches, capital adequacy (CRAR), capital conservation buffer, leverage ratio, ICAAP, and stress testing.
  • Portfolio analytics: vintage analysis, roll-rate and migration matrix, delinquency analysis, concentration risk, portfolio ECL, collections and recovery analytics.
  • IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109: impairment model design, staging and SICR logic, ECL computation, macro-economic scenario design, and disclosures.
  • Model risk management: model validation, model governance, model inventory, back-testing, benchmarking, sensitivity and outcome analysis, and ongoing monitoring.
  • Regulatory frameworks: RBI guidelines on credit risk, ECL, IRAC, and provisioning; Basel III / IV; Middle East regulatory context (CBUAE, SAMA, CBB, QCB, CBO, CBK / CMA Kuwait) preferred.
  • Consulting or in-house risk analytics experience with banks, NBFCs, insurers, or corporates.
  • Educational qualification expected: Graduate / Postgraduate
  • Additional qualifications / certifications required: None

job.name: CFD/Meshing Engineer, AI Integration
job.description:
Job Title: CFD/Meshing Engineer, AI Integration

Location: Gurugram | Bengaluru| Hyderabad | Pune (On-site)

Type: Full-Time

Experience: 5+ years

About the Role

We are looking for a CFD Engineer who can bridge simulation workflows with AI-driven automation. This role sits at the intersection of aerodynamics, CAD/geometry, and applied AI, building tools that automate meshing, simulation setup, and geometry validation, while working closely with CAD and ML teams to make the aircraft design pipeline end-to-end automated.

What You'll Do

● Set up, run, and post-process full-aircraft CFD simulations (external aerodynamics).

● Build and maintain automated CFD pipelines: geometry import, cleanup checks, meshing, solver setup, and results extraction.

● Integrate AI/ML models into the CFD workflow (e.g., surrogate models, automated mesh-quality classification, geometry-defect detection, parameter optimization loops).

● Work directly with the CAD/geometry team to flag and resolve geometry issues before they cause meshing or solver failures.

● Design and prototype AI-assisted tools that reduce manual intervention in the meshing-to-simulation cycle.

● Collaborate with software/ML engineers to productionize CFD automation scripts and internal tooling.

● Document workflows and templates so they generalize across a wide range of aircraft configurations.

Required Skills

● Strong hands-on CFD experience: setup, meshing, solving, and post-processing for external aerodynamics.

● Working knowledge of CAD/geometry, able to read, clean up, and troubleshoot geometry issues (not just consume finished CAD).

● Python scripting for automation; comfort building pipelines that chain CAD to meshing to solver to post-processing.

● Practical exposure to applying AI/ML in an engineering context (e.g., using ML models for prediction, classification, or optimization within a simulation workflow); does not need to be a research-level ML background, but must be comfortable integrating models into pipelines.

● Understanding of mesh-quality metrics and common failure modes in CFD setups.

● Ability to work cross-functionally with CAD, ML/software, and aerodynamics teams.

Preferred Skills

● Experience with STAR-CCM+, ANSYS Fluent, OpenFOAM, or SU2.

● Exposure to OpenVSP or other parametric aircraft geometry tools.

● Experience with surrogate modeling or ML-based optimization for engineering simulations. Familiarity with containerized/cloud CFD workflows.

● Prior work in an aerospace or aircraft design environment.

Required Tools/Software

● CFD: STAR-CCM+ / ANSYS Fluent / OpenFOAM

● Geometry: OpenVSP, Siemens NX / Parasolid or Open CASCADE

● Scripting/AI: Python (PyTorch/TensorFlow/scikit-learn as applicable)

RCFS-FS Finance-Private Equity Billing and Fund Accounting - Manager
job.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

About Global Delivery Services Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centres. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support for EY’s growth agenda.

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today, we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, the Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, highly skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

Job Description – Private Equity Billing & Fund Accounting (Manager) The opportunity We are looking to build a dedicated team to support a leading alternative investment and private markets client. The team will support end-to-end Portfolio Company (PC), Joint Venture (JV), and Fund Billing, including invoice processing, expense allocation, reconciliations, and query resolution.

This role will involve working with internal and external stakeholders to ensure accurate and timely billing, strong controls, and effective service delivery, while supporting continuous process improvement and automation.

Key Responsibilities PC, JV & Fund Billing

job.name: Manager-Data Science
job.description:
Job Summary The Manager-Data Science role is pivotal in driving data-driven decision-making within the organization. With a focus on Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning the candidate will leverage Azure services to optimize processes and enhance business outcomes. This hybrid role requires a strategic thinker with a strong technical background aiming to innovate and improve investment banking operations.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and implementation of data science models to solve complex business problems.
  • Oversee the integration of Azure Open AI Service and Azure Machine Learning into existing systems.
  • Provide expert guidance on leveraging Artificial Intelligence to enhance operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for data-driven improvements.
  • Analyze large datasets using Python to extract actionable insights.
  • Develop strategies to optimize investment banking operations through advanced analytics.
  • Ensure the scalability and robustness of machine learning models deployed in production.
  • Monitor and evaluate the performance of data science initiatives to ensure alignment with business goals.
  • Facilitate workshops and training sessions to upskill team members in data science methodologies.
  • Drive innovation by staying updated with the latest trends in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.
  • Implement best practices for data governance and security within the data science framework.
  • Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure seamless integration of data science solutions into business processes.
  • Report on the impact of data science projects on company performance and societal benefits. Qualifications
  • Possess a strong background in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning with hands-on experience in Azure services.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in Python for data analysis and model development.
  • Have a solid understanding of investment banking operations and brokerage services.
  • Exhibit excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think strategically.
  • Show experience in managing data science projects in a hybrid work model.
  • Display effective communication skills to convey complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Hold a degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science Data Science or related disciplines.

job.name: EIC Apprentice
job.description:
Job Title EIC Apprentice

Job Description Summary The Apprenticeship Program is a 6 month to 1 year Program that trains you for your future. The Valuation & Advisory Apprentices shall largely be involved in execution of valuation assignments and coordination with internal/external stakeholders and ensuring timely and quality deliverables.

Job Description About the Role:

  • To conduct the primary field survey and interaction with local brokers etc. and to prepare databases of various real estate asset classes.
  • The candidate will be given research topics. Some of them would be- Luxury real estate overview in India. Major demand drivers, reasons for shift in preferences, profitability and performance of major projects across the country.
  • List of major real estate-based AIFs (Category-II) in India, their performance, market size and its contribution to real estate growth in India.
  • Consumption story of India and its impact on different real estate asset classes
  • India Future: Manufacturing Vs. Services Sector or Both
  • Know-how of how a warehouse system works and an overview of warehouse asset class PAN India
  • Mega Infrastructure projects being planned across India and its impact on real estate
  • Senior Living overview PAN India
  • Retail Industry trends and research paper on existing and upcoming retail mall supply.
  • Maintain database of projects, developers, investors etc

What do we need from you?

  • Under-Graduate in Finance / any other engineering discipline may also apply.
  • Under-Graduate - Marketing / Data Management / Finance may also apply
  • Good written and verbal communication skills
  • Intermediate to advanced excel skills is essential.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to operate in a fast-paced environment.

Why join Cushman & Wakefield? As one of the leading global real estate services firms transforming the way people work, shop and live working at Cushman & Wakefield means you will benefit from;

  • Being part of a growing global company;
  • Career development and a promote from within culture;
  • An organisation committed to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to providing work-life balance for our people in an inclusive, rewarding environment.

We achieve this by providing a flexible and agile work environment by focusing on technology and autonomy to help our people achieve their career ambitions. We focus on career progression and foster a promotion from within culture, leveraging global opportunities to ensure we retain our top talent. We encourage continuous learning and development opportunities to develop personal, professional and technical capabilities, and we reward with a comprehensive employee benefits program.

We're not looking for someone who simply manages technical projects. We're looking for an exceptional architect who can design solutions, write code, lead technical discussions, and deliver results for enterprise customers.

At KIBO, we're building the future of enterprise digital commerce using modern, composable, cloud-native technology.

We're committed to being at the forefront of AI adoption and intelligent automation, embracing emerging technologies to accelerate innovation, improve engineering productivity, and deliver better customer experiences. Our global team of KIBOnauts operates in a remote-friendly environment built on trust, technical excellence, continuous learning, and customer obsession.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

LEAD ENTERPRISE COMMERCE ARCHITECTURE

Position summary:

Centre for Integrative Biology and Systems mEdicine (IBSE), Wadhwani School of Data Science and AI (WSAI), IIT Madras, seeks a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher with strong expertise in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) to establish advanced AI/ML pipelines using multimodal biomedical datasets, including physiological signals, medical images, and videos. job.name: Software Engineer II
job.description:
For nearly 40 years, PDI has helped convenience retailers and petroleum wholesalers adapt to changes in the industry by leveraging the latest technologies. Simplifying the complexity in your world is our main focus. That's why we're delivering an integrated portfolio of global, cloud-based solutions and services to meet our customers needs today and well into the future. From the back office to fuel logistics, and the latest wave of consumer demands and digital commerce, PDI solutions and services are designed to give you a competitive edge. Our deep domain knowledge is backed by our industry-specific software offerings and a people-first approach. Serving the entire supply chain means that we’ve had to solve a wide range of industry challenges and deliver measurable value. To address the increasingly dynamic convenience retail and petroleum wholesale industry, PDI leads the way with converged digital, cloud-optimized, secure, and scalable solutions including ERP, Loyalty, Fuel Pricing, Point-of-Sale and Logistics to create a broader industry ecosystem. The result is unparalleled insights, simplified operations, and higher profitability for your employees and business. We’re dedicated to helping our more than 1,500 customers in over 50 countries, providing solutions and services to over 200,000 sites.

PDI C-Store Essentials is cloud back-office software for convenience store owners and operators. It covers pricebook and promotions, point-of-sale integration, fuel, lottery, daily paperwork, scan data reporting and subscription billing, for single stores, chains and franchise operators.

You will build and maintain features across the Essentials web application, its .NET services and its databases, as part of a team split between India and the United States. The team works AI-first: coding agents are part of how every engineer plans, builds, tests and reviews work, and this role is expected to use them well from day one.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Design, build and ship features across the stack: React and TypeScript on the front end, ASP.NET Core services and APIs on the back end, SQL Server and PostgreSQL underneath
  • Take part in design decisions for new and existing features, raise risks early and ask for help when blocked
  • Work with the Product Owner to clarify requirements, break them into small deliverable pieces and estimate them
  • Write automated tests for your own work (xUnit, Vitest, Playwright) and work with QA engineers on test plans and release stabilization.
  • Troubleshoot and fix development and production issues with urgency, using logs and monitoring to find the root cause.
  • Review teammates' pull requests and respond to review on your own.
  • Keep documentation of what you build current, including the instructions and context that coding agents rely on
  • Give your manager clear status and risk updates so work stays on schedule.

job.name: Senior Python Developer
job.description:
Financial Data Engineer

Job description: A person with strong technical skills who can understand complex financial analyses in Excel and partner effectively with the business to write code in Python that will be used for data and report automation processes.

  • At least 5+ years experience doing data-heavy work in a financial or economic-adjacent field (or equivalent)
  • Can understand a complex Excel financial model, breaking it down into manageable components
  • Can partner closely with the business to specify and understand business requirements, ask clarifying questions, and write down the goals and technical specifications in documentation
  • Prior experience writing complex logic in Python code to transform time series data
  • Can write auditable, well-documented Python code that replicates the logic in an existing Excel model
  • Can write auditable, well-documented Python code for new logic that the business needs to transform data
  • Writes clear and concise code that is readable and replicable by internal client technology resources

Example Projects

Take an existing Excel model that converts gross of fees returns to net of fees returns. Write a Python function that can take any gross of fees return stream (monthly or quarterly) with any start date, the specified fee schedule, and accurately convert it to a net of fees return stream.

A hypothetical portfolio model with various inputs. Inputs are parameters and 10-30 time series with accompanying weights. Write a Python function that can receive inputs for different strategies/allocations and output the final portfolio return stream (both gross of fees and net of fees) along with various portfolio statistics.

job.name: Software Engineer (Java) - Global Research Platform
job.description:
We are seeking a driven Java engineer to join our global research platform team in Mumbai. The team builds and operates the compute and data platform that powers all of IMC's quantitative research: a large-scale Kubernetes-based research cluster, a distributed job scheduling platform used by every trading and research team, and the market-data and dataset services that feed research on it. Mumbai runs one of the platform's regional production deployments, and you'll collaborate closely with platform colleagues in Amsterdam, Chicago and Sydney.

Your Core Responsibilities

  • Design, build and operate the Java backend of our distributed job scheduling platform: the job controller and state machine, scheduling integrations, resource and cost tracking, and the failure-recovery machinery that keeps research workloads running at scale
  • Develop gRPC/protobuf APIs consumed by Python, Java and C++ clients across the firm
  • Build event-driven services on Kafka for job lifecycle tracking, data lineage, and dataset orchestration
  • Work hands-on with Kubernetes at scale: pod scheduling, fair-share queueing, preemption and multi-cluster placement
  • Instrument, monitor and firefight production systems, and drive root-cause analysis of performance bottlenecks
  • Support and consult research users in the India office

Your Skills And Experience

  • 3+ years of professional Java development experience (Java 17+, Maven/Gradle, strong grasp of concurrency and JVM performance)
  • 2+ year of hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Docker (building on the K8s API is a strong plus)
  • Comfortable developing in Python; our client libraries and research users are Python-first, and you'll work on both sides of the API
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems fundamentals: state machines, retries/idempotency, event-driven architectures, consistency trade-offs
  • Experience with workload scheduling or batch/compute orchestration systems (e.g. Kubernetes schedulers, Slurm, YARN, Kueue, Ray, Airflow)
  • Experience with messaging/streaming systems such as Kafka
  • Working knowledge of NoSQL and time-series/SQL databases (e.g. MongoDB, PostgreSQL)
  • Experience with gRPC/protobuf or similar RPC frameworks is a plus
  • Strong Linux fundamentals and scripting (bash, Python)
  • Experience with monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, alerting) and comfort operating what you build
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot across the stack from application code through Kubernetes to network and storage
  • Exposure to object storage (S3) or high-performance data formats (Parquet, Iceberg)

job.name: Senior AI Agent Evaluation Engineer
job.description:
Summary:

The Senior AI Agent Evaluation Engineer is a hands-on technical role responsible for defining, developing, and executing robust evaluation frameworks and test strategies for AI agents built using the Google Agent Development Kit (ADK). This role bridges AI development and reliable deployment, ensuring our agents are safe, ethical, effective, and meet high-quality performance standards. A significant focus of the role is on Responsible AI and Safety Evals, including adversarial testing, red-teaming, bias detection, and toxicity measurement. The engineer will design scalable evaluation pipelines, build synthetic test environments, and work closely with AI/ML Engineers, Researchers, and policy teams to ensure agents are production-ready and compliant with regulatory and ethical standards. The role is 70% Automation and 30% Manual Testing, and sits within the AI team as a key quality authority.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable, repeatable evaluation datasets, metrics, and benchmarks to measure agent performance, robustness, safety, and alignment.
  • Build synthetic testing environments and simulation strategies to stress-test agents under diverse real-world conditions.
  • Develop and execute adversarial testing, jailbreaking, and red-teaming methodologies to identify potential harm, bias, toxicity, and unauthorized behavior in agent responses.
  • Implement and measure adherence to established ethical guidelines, safety policies, and content-filtering mechanisms across all agent deployments.
  • Partner with policy and legal teams to ensure agent evaluations cover regulatory compliance and fairness objectives.
  • Define comprehensive end-to-end QA strategies for functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT) tailored for conversational and goal-oriented AI agents.
  • Develop and maintain detailed test artifacts covering agent features, tool use, memory, and reasoning capabilities.
  • Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects, performance regressions, and alignment failures using Jira, collaborating with AI/ML Engineers and Researchers to analyze root causes and validate fixes.
  • Integrate evaluation pipelines into CI/CD processes to enable continuous quality assurance and fast iteration cycles.
  • Analyze and interpret evaluation results, providing clear, actionable quality and safety reports to stakeholders and development teams, with a specific focus on risk metrics and mitigation recommendations.

Required Skills:

  • Direct experience designing and executing safety evaluations including red-teaming, adversarial testing, jailbreaking, bias detection, and toxicity/harmful content measurement for generative AI models.
  • Proven track record building and running general evaluations for LLM-powered applications, including designing evaluation datasets, metrics, and scoring rubrics.

  • Analyse large current and historical datasets to identify shifts in economist and market expectations, forecast trends, outliers, consensus changes and longer-term developments across major economies.
  • Deliver clear, timely and actionable findings for Reuters news stories, market alerts, graphics and broader economic and financial-market coverage.
  • Use spreadsheets, Python and AI-enabled analytical workflows to improve data processing, automation, quality assurance, survey analysis and presentation of poll results.

job.name: Data Analyst
job.description:
Summary:

This position involves the identification, validation, and migration of Data Quality (DQ) rules from SAP to Databricks. The role requires a strong understanding of SAP data structures and Databricks platforms to ensure data quality and integrity throughout the migration process.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Data Discovery: Identify SAP tables and fields used for existing DQ rules and reports, and locate the corresponding data in Databricks.
  • Data Validation: Validate data across all layers (bronze, silver, etc.) in Databricks for completeness, structure, and availability of required fields.
  • DQ Rule Migration & BUILD: Select and build a set of existing DQ rules in Databricks as part of the PoC.
  • PoC Testing & Reconciliation: Execute the rules in Databricks and compare results with existing DQ results, investigating and resolving differences.
  • End-to-End Rule Migration: Following the PoC, migrate/BUILD the agreed As-Is DQ rules to Databricks, including SQL logic, data mappings, rule outputs, and required transformations.
  • Data & Rule Validation: Perform end-to-end validation of source data, DQ rules, results, and defects in Databricks to ensure the migrated process produces expected outcomes.
  • DQ Reporting: Support the development of DQ outputs, KPIs, and dashboard reporting from Databricks, including validation of report results.
  • Documentation & BAU Handover: Document data mappings, DQ rules, validation results, and migration processes.

Required Skills:

  • Proficiency in SQL & Pyspark/Python.
  • Experience in Data Quality/Data Validation.
  • Experience working with SAP data, preferably master data.
  • Good understanding of SAP tables.
  • Experience with the Databricks platform.
  • Experience in data reconciliation and comparison between different data sources.
  • Ability to translate DQ requirements/rules into technical SQL or Python logic.
  • Experience in DQ rule testing, defect analysis, and troubleshooting.

Education & Qualifications:

No specific educational qualifications are mentioned, but relevant experience and skills in data quality, SAP, and Databricks are essential.

job.name: Senior AI Engineer
job.description:
Build the intelligence layer that powers Finnulate, and the model professionals reach for first

REPORTS TO:

Founding Technology Partner

LOCATION:

Gurgaon / Delhi-NCR

TYPE:

Full-time, core team

GROWTH PATH:

Lead role in 6 to 12 months

ABOUT FINNULATE AI:

Finnulate AI is an AI-powered Compliance Operating System for regulated entities. It turns regulatory circulars into tasks, owners, evidence and a live view of compliance health for leadership and boards. It is built in India, on a foundation of decades of banking and governance experience, and designed to be relevant globally.

ABOUT KIRA:

KIRA is Finnulate’s proprietary regulatory intelligence engine, and first of all the intelligence layer inside the Finnulate platform itself. It reads, interprets and analyses regulation, and is deployable on-premise or in a private cloud for institutions that cannot let data leave their walls. Today it covers four regulatory frameworks and over 15,000 regulations, guidelines and notifications.

Every product capability that touches regulatory text depends on KIRA, so its quality is the platform’s quality. Beyond the platform, KIRA is designed to become the go-to model for legal, secretarial, finance and consulting professionals: reading and interpreting regulations, notifications, statutes and standards, and returning insights and recommended actionables, across frameworks and, over time, across jurisdictions. The next phase is dedicated training, backed by rigorous measurement.

WHAT MATTERS:

The job is to make KIRA the model professionals trust first, and to prove that with measurement, not with demos. Evaluation discipline comes before model ambition.

WHERE KIRA WORKS INSIDE FINNULATE:

AI already runs through the platform. In outline, the usage themes are:

• Behind the scenes: Sorting, structuring and connecting incoming regulatory content at scale, with full traceability.

• Inside the product: Powering the intelligence features that help compliance teams and leadership understand and act on their obligations.

• Beyond the platform: Research, interpretation and insight for legal, secretarial, finance and consulting professionals, as KIRA matures into a standalone offering.

Your task is to make each of these uses measurably better, cheaper to run and safer to trust, with one model strategy behind them rather than many separate point solutions.

THE MANDATE:

KIRA serves the Finnulate platform first and the wider market next. You will own the technical path from KIRA as it is today to KIRA as a trained, measured, continuously improving model. That means the data, the evaluation, the training and the release discipline, and the judgment to know which of these to do next.

Read the full description

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Toast is seeking a Senior Security Engineer to design, implement, and operate enterprise Data Loss Prevention and Secure Access Service Edge capabilities. The role will reduce data exfiltration risk, enable secure access to web, SaaS, private applications, and cloud services, and improve security coverage.

You will be a senior individual contributor and subject matter expert, within the Enterprise Security team and will closely partner with IT, Network Engineering, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and application owners. A Day In The Life (Responsibilities) Data Loss Prevention Engineering

  • Design and operate controls for sensitive data across managed endpoints, email, web and network channels, SaaS and collaboration applications, cloud environments, and data repositories.

  • Translate requirements into precise policies and response actions with documented exceptions.

  • Triage and investigate DLP alerts and incidents, determine root cause and business context, coordinate containment and remediation, and reduce false positives without weakening protection.
  • Integrate DLP with SASE services, SIEM/SOAR platforms, MDM, ticketing systems, data classification, data security posture management, and relevant response workflows.

Senior Full-Stack Developer

As part of a Vista portfolio company, you’ll work in an environment backed by deep expertise, long-term investment, and a strong commitment to building market-leading businesses and meaningful careers.

Underwriters and loss-control consultants use it to survey sites, raise recommendations, and track whether anyone actually did anything about them. It is a real product with real customers and about fifteen years of history. The work is roughly half building new things and half making old things behave.

This engineer will own features end to end. Angular in the browser, .NET on the server, SQL Server and MongoDB underneath, deployed through our own pipeline to customer sandboxes. This is not full stack used as a polite word for front-end work with occasional API calls. They will write the query, the endpoint, the component and the test.

As a Senior Analyst in Full Stack Engineering, you’ll own features end to end across the browser, server, data layers, and tests. You’ll design, develop, enhance, test, troubleshoot, and support software solutions; contribute to technical design decisions; and collaborate with engineering and business partners.

You’ll work with Angular 16, TypeScript, RxJS, Kendo UI for Angular, Angular Material, Bootstrap, and SignalR. The back end includes C# and .NET services, SQL Server, MongoDB, Kafka, xUnit, and Moq. The platform includes a classic ASP.NET Website alongside the modern Angular application. Our delivery environment includes Kubernetes through Rancher Desktop, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, and yuniql database migrations.
