job.name: Business Analyst-COO Office
job.description:
About the role

The COO’s Office works on the company’s most important operating priorities across sales, manufacturing,

supply chain and the business units. This analyst role brings data and analysis to the office’s internal projects, helping leadership see what is happening in the business and why.

The person will work on several projects at once, from pulling and analysing data to building models, dashboards and presentations, alongside senior colleagues across functions.

Key responsibilities

1. Data analysis and business insights

  • Extract, clean and analyze data from SAP/ERP, sales and operations systems using SQL, Python and Excel.
  • Analyse sales, margin, cost and operating data to find trends, root causes, risks and opportunities.
  • Respond to ad hoc analysis requests from the COO’s Office quickly and accurately.

2. Support for internal projects

  • Work on multiple COO’s Office projects at the same time, building fact bases, analytical models and business cases.
  • Gather inputs from sales, plants, supply chain, finance and other functions, and turn them into structured analysis.

3. Business reviews and reporting

  • Prepare the data points and analysis needed for business reviews.
  • Build and maintain Power BI dashboards and automate recurring reports.
  • Keep a reliable, reconciled view of key business metrics.

4. Market research and field insights

  • Research industry trends, category shifts and competitor moves using public sources, filings and earnings calls.

5. Presentations, automation and AI

  • Turn analysis into clear, well-structured presentations for senior leadership.
  • Use Python, automation and AI tools to speed up data work, reporting and analysis.
  • Build reusable templates and a knowledge base for the COO’s Office.

job.name: Senior Snowflake Developer
job.description:
Senior Snowflake Developer – JD

About QualMinds:

We at QualMinds design & develop world-class digital products and custom software for Startups, Scale-ups & Enterprises with our world-class engineering team.

We assemble a great team of frontend, backend, full-stack, QA automation, UI/UX, DevOps, data science, machine learning, and agile experts to help our clients propel their pursuit of digital excellence.

Our engineering community at QualMinds is always passionate about building customer-centric software with the highest quality, performance, security, scalability, and lowest failure rates.

We are looking for an experienced Snowflake Developer / Senior Data Engineer with strong expertise in building scalable data pipelines, optimizing Snowflake environments, and delivering high-quality data solutions. The ideal candidate will have 5–10 years of hands-on experience in data engineering with a deep understanding of Snowflake, SQL, and cloud-based ETL tools.

Key Responsibilities

1. Snowflake Development & Architecture

  • Design and develop scalable Snowflake data models including fact, dimension, and staging layers.
  • Define and implement clustering keys , partition strategies , and effective micro-partition usage for large tables.
  • Optimize Snowflake storage and compute architecture based on business workloads.

2. Data Ingestion & Pipeline Development

  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using: Snowflake SQL, Snowpipe, Azure Data Factory (ADF), Matillion
  • Implement incremental / delta load mechanisms and ensure data freshness.
  • Perform data validation, deduplication, and consistency checks across sources and targets.

3. SQL & Stored Procedure Development

  • Write complex SQL queries , views, and stored procedures using: Snowflake Scripting, JavaScript (for Snowflake stored procedures)
  • Conduct SQL performance tuning and query optimization.

4. Performance Tuning & Optimization

  • Analyze and troubleshoot slow-running queries using Query Profile and Snowflake monitoring tools.
  • Optimize performance through warehouse sizing, caching strategies, micro-partition pruning, and query structure improvements.
  • Ensure efficient resource consumption and cost optimization.

5. Security, Governance & Access Control

  • Implement and maintain RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) .
  • Manage roles, users, privileges, and secure data sharing.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational security standards and best practices.

6. Monitoring, Troubleshooting & Operations

  • Implement robust error handling including logging, retry mechanisms, and alerting.
  • Monitor pipeline performance and proactively identify issues.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams for requirement gathering, solution design, and production support.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Job Description

Product Manager – AI & Enterprise Platforms

Company: Ekshvaku Tech Innovations

Location: Hyderabad / Remote (India)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: 7–12+ years overall, including at least 4 years in Product Management

Domain: AI/ML, Healthcare Technology, Digital Health, Enterprise SaaS

About the Role

Ekshvaku Tech Innovations is looking for an experienced, strategic, proactive and highly client-focused Product Manager – AI & Enterprise Platforms to lead product discovery, strategy, roadmap planning and execution for AI-powered healthcare and enterprise digital solutions.

We are seeking someone who can independently explore product vision, research market opportunities, analyze competitor products, identify feature gaps and recommend innovative capabilities that transform digital applications into competitive, scalable and enterprise-grade platforms.

The ideal candidate must combine strong product management expertise with excellent client relationship management, emotional intelligence, patience, technical understanding and hands-on execution capabilities.

This is not a traditional Product Owner or backlog management position. The successful candidate must be capable of independently shaping product direction, presenting evidence-based recommendations, managing demanding stakeholders and translating approved strategies into actionable product requirements.

The role requires significant ownership of product outcomes while ensuring major product decisions, strategic priorities and investments receive appropriate stakeholder approval.

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Vision, Strategy & Roadmap

  • Independently research and evaluate product vision, market positioning and long-term opportunities.
  • Understand business objectives, customer expectations and market requirements to shape product direction.
  • Assess existing product capabilities and identify gaps, limitations and improvement opportunities.
  • Develop short-term, medium-term and long-term product strategies and roadmaps.
  • Proactively recommend innovative features, integrations, workflows and enhancements.
  • Evaluate product opportunities based on customer value, competitive differentiation, technical feasibility and commercial potential.
  • Prepare product proposals, business cases and roadmap recommendations for stakeholder approval.
  • Define measurable product objectives and success metrics.

2. Market Research, Competitor Analysis & Product Innovation

job.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

The Global Procurement team is an integral engine to Micron’s growth, delivering best-in-class total cost and supply chain resiliency through innovative predictive capabilities, risk analysis, and a focus on sustainability and diversity. Our business goals are directly tied to the value we place on our team members, our greatest asset. We invest in our people through a skills-based learning and development model to create clear career pathways for growth. Join us and discover why Micron’s Global Procurement team is the preferred destination to ignite your talent.

As Senior Manager, Data Excellence & Governance within Global Procurement’s Digital Transformation & AI organization, you will lead the function that makes procurement data trusted, measurable, and ready for AI. You own data governance and quality operations, Global Procurement performance metrics and reporting, and the procurement data strategy — and you lead a multi-region team across Singapore, the United States, India, and Malaysia.

Data readiness is the single largest constraint to unlocking value from AI, automation, and analytics in procurement. A core part of your mandate is to reimagine the data governance and excellence operating model with AI agents embedded — redefining how policies, quality monitoring, lineage, and stewardship operate when agents handle detection, enrichment, routing, and maintenance, and where people focus on exception handling, governance, and continuous improvement. Success is measured by whether prioritized workflows run on trusted, agent-consumable data, and whether the data foundation strengthens itself through automated feedback loops rather than manual clean-up.

This is a people-leadership role. You will develop a team of data governance and analytics professionals, set the standards and stewardship model for procurement data, and partner closely with AI Transformation, Data & Process Automation, Platform Excellence, IT, Security, and Compliance to ensure the data foundation aligns with enterprise platforms, ERP readiness, and enterprise data governance standards.

job.name: Data Engineer - Databricks [T500-30915]
job.description:
About Stolt-Nielsen:

Stolt-Nielsen is a family-founded global leader in bulk-liquid and chemical logistics, transportation, and storage, known for its commitment to safety, service excellence, and innovation. At the Stolt-Nielsen Digital Innovation Centre, we bring this legacy into the future — building smarter systems, driving digital transformation, and shaping what's next for the world of logistics. Here, you’re encouraged to think boldly, challenge convention, and help move today’s products toward tomorrow’s possibilities.

About the company:

We are a trusted, family-founded company and global pioneers with a worldwide reputation for excellence in bulk-liquid and chemical logistics, transportation, and storage. Our passion for innovation drives us to lead the industry forward. Across our logistics, shipping, and seafood businesses, we deliver world-class reliability, flexibility, and expertise – ensuring that complex operations run seamlessly.

About the Role:

We’re looking for an ambidextrous Data Engineer with strong Databricks, Python and SQL skills, who can build the pipelines and also deliver the Power BI reports that sit on top of them.

You’ll design and maintain reliable data pipelines, model trusted data in the Lakehouse, and turn it into intuitive dashboards that business teams use to make decisions. Data Engineers only become more relevant in the age of Generative AI: we are moving to solutions like Databricks Genie that rely on well-modelled and well-described data, so the models you build serve both analytics and AI.

You’ll work closely with analysts, data scientists and stakeholders across the organization, and help raise data literacy through training, shared best practice and the transition to self-service.

At Stolt-Nielsen, we take Digital seriously. We invest in our teams through training and mentoring and give them the tools to work in a modern way (engineering laptops, Cursor licenses). As we build up our engineering practice in the Digital Innovation Centre, there is ample room for you to contribute, take initiative and shape our ways of working and technology landscape.

job.name: Lead Software Engineer - Full Stack
job.description:
ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Lead Software Engineer - Full Stack, you will lead the design, development and delivery of secure, scalable and high-performing enterprise applications across the user interface, application and data layers. A hands-on technical leader who leads solution design and technical delivery across workstreams, guides engineers, influences architecture, drives engineering standards and owns the technical quality and production readiness of full-stack solutions. You will collaborate with product, UX, architecture, DevOps and quality engineering teams, mentor engineers, and drive reliable delivery from design through production support.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Education and Certifications

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related field.
  • Certifications in Java, cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), Kubernetes or software architecture are preferred.

Required Experience

  • 7-10 years of software engineering experience delivering enterprise applications across front-end and backend technologies.
  • At least 2-3 years of experience leading technical delivery, mentoring engineers or owning modules/workstreams.
  • Proven experience designing, developing and supporting cloud-native full-stack applications in production.
  • Experience working with distributed global teams or within a Global Capability Center is an advantage.

Essential Skills

  • Strong expertise in Java 17+, Spring and Spring Boot for distributed microservices.
  • Advanced proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3 and responsive web design.
  • Hands-on expertise in React.js and component-driven architecture; working knowledge of Angular or Vue.js is valuable.
  • Experience with state management, reusable UI components, accessibility (WCAG) and cross-browser compatibility.
  • Deep understanding of microservices architecture, domain-driven design, event-driven design and cloud-native deployments.
  • Experience building and consuming REST APIs and working with Kafka/RabbitMQ, asynchronous patterns and distributed transactions.
  • Proficiency with relational and NoSQL databases, Hibernate/JPA, caching frameworks and data-access optimization.
  • Strong foundation in Git, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, unit/integration testing, observability and production support.
  • Experience with OAuth2, JWT, API security and secure coding practices.
  • Ability to review technical designs, influence architecture decisions and mentor engineers in full-stack delivery.

Desired Skills

  • Experience with React Native, micro frontends or server-side rendering.
  • Exposure to service mesh, API gateways, distributed tracing and resilience frameworks.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and multi-cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with Agile/SAFe, SRE principles and engineering process optimization.
  • Knowledge of front-end and backend observability, performance profiling and automated quality tooling.

job.name: Senior Python Developer
job.description:
Financial Data Engineer

Job description: A person with strong technical skills who can understand complex financial analyses in Excel and partner effectively with the business to write code in Python that will be used for data and report automation processes.

  • At least 5+ years experience doing data-heavy work in a financial or economic-adjacent field (or equivalent)
  • Can understand a complex Excel financial model, breaking it down into manageable components
  • Can partner closely with the business to specify and understand business requirements, ask clarifying questions, and write down the goals and technical specifications in documentation
  • Prior experience writing complex logic in Python code to transform time series data
  • Can write auditable, well-documented Python code that replicates the logic in an existing Excel model
  • Can write auditable, well-documented Python code for new logic that the business needs to transform data
  • Writes clear and concise code that is readable and replicable by internal client technology resources

Example Projects

Take an existing Excel model that converts gross of fees returns to net of fees returns. Write a Python function that can take any gross of fees return stream (monthly or quarterly) with any start date, the specified fee schedule, and accurately convert it to a net of fees return stream.

A hypothetical portfolio model with various inputs. Inputs are parameters and 10-30 time series with accompanying weights. Write a Python function that can receive inputs for different strategies/allocations and output the final portfolio return stream (both gross of fees and net of fees) along with various portfolio statistics.

Business Analyst, AI

So, what’s the role all about?

NiCE is building SPARK, a new internal incubation team that turns great ideas from across CX International into working AI solutions, and then into enterprise-grade tools that roll out to colleagues around the world. Your idea. Our spark.

As Business Analyst in the SPARK team, you will be the bridge between the people who have the ideas and the architects and builders who make them real. You will shape raw ideas into clear, prioritised, buildable use cases, and make sure what we build solves the problem it was meant to solve.

This is a business analysis role with a technical edge. You come from a programming background, so you can read code, query data, test an API, and prototype a quick proof of concept, and you can still run a room full of non-technical stakeholders. You will work closely with the Project Manager, the AI Architects & Builders, and the Change Management & Evangelist.

How will you make an impact?

You will own the front end of the incubation pipeline, from the first conversation about an idea through to accepted, measurable outcomes, working hands-on with business teams, architects, and delivery colleagues across regions.

Discover and Shape Ideas

  • Run discovery sessions, interviews, and workshops with business teams to understand pain points, current processes, and the outcome they want
  • Turn ideas into clear use case briefs covering the problem statement, users, expected value, data needs, risks, and success measures

job.name: Product Designer
job.description:
Love baseball and building great products? Join us to design and ship the software pro hitters use every day.

ABOUT TRAJEKT

Trajekt builds pitching machines that recreate real pitchers. Our machines throw a specific pitcher's pitches, matching velocity, spin and movement, synced with video of that pitcher's delivery. Hitters can face tonight's starter before the game.

We work with MLB and NPB clubs, college programs and training centres, and we build the software players and coaches use alongside the machine. Our team is based in the Toronto area, with an office in Mississauga.

THE ROLE

We're hiring a Product Designer to design and build the software that players and coaches use alongside our machines. You'll take a feature from a rough idea to something shipped in the product, then help show it off when it launches.

Our users are hitters, coaches and analysts working in cages, labs and stadiums, often on a tablet between swings. They need dense pitch data to make sense in a glance. You'll spend roughly 80% of your time designing and building product, and about 20% making launch visuals that our product marketing team takes to social and sales.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build what you design. Ship production front-end code in React and TypeScript, reviewed and merged with our engineering team.
  • Prototype fast so we can test ideas with coaches and players before committing, including internal tools in Retool.
  • Turn pitch data into views a hitter understands in a glance: pitch charts, session summaries, trends over time.
  • Spend time in the cage. Watch real sessions with teams and at our facility, and talk to the people using what you build.
  • Own and grow our design system so every screen feels like one product.
  • Make launch visuals: polished feature screens, screen recordings, short clips and data graphics for our product marketing team to post and sell with.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • A portfolio with shipped product work, not just concepts. Show us the problem, your thinking and what went live.
  • Strong product design skills in Figma, including layout, typography, colour and interaction design.
  • Front-end code that ships: React, TypeScript and modern CSS. You're comfortable using AI coding tools like Cursor to move faster.
  • Experience designing data-heavy interfaces, such as dashboards, analytics tools or stats products.
  • A real love of sports, especially baseball. You know the game well enough to hold your own with a hitting coach.
  • Clear communication and an appetite for feedback. You'll work in a small team where you own a lot.

BONUS POINTS

job.name: SDE 2 Infra
job.description:
About Fam (previously FamPay)

Fam is India’s first payments app for everyone above 11. FamApp helps make online and offline payments through UPI and FamCard. We are on a mission to raise a new, financially aware generation, and drive 250 million+ young users in India to kickstart their financial journey super early in their life.

We’re reimagining how the next generation experiences fintech—going beyond payments to build a lifestyle brand that blends money, identity, and everyday experiences into one seamless, intuitive journey.

Founded in 2019 by IIT Roorkee alumni, Fam is backed by some of the most respected investors around the world like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (Sequoia Capital) India, Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital and the likes of Kunal Shah, Amrish Rao as angel investors.

About the team

The Core Infrastructure team builds the platforms and systems that power everything at Fam, from real-time app experiences to high-volume payments. It operates as a small, high-leverage team with deep ownership. Every service at Fam runs on the platform this team builds, so it cares obsessively about system fundamentals, operational excellence, and mechanical sympathy.

What our systems process

  • 1 Billion+ API requests per day powering :10M daily transactions for 10M+ users at 20,000+ RPS
  • 470+ node Kubernetes cluster (:2,500 vCPUs and :8 TiB RAM) under active orchestration
  • Dynamic, multi-dimensional auto-scaling powered by 195+ HPAs paired with Karpenter
  • 12+ TB of active transactional data (and counting) across our high-throughput database clusters
  • Event Streaming - 400+ topics, and 3,800+ partitions at :46,700 messages/sec

Our Next Chapter

While our core systems already handle massive scale, our next vision as a team is to turn infrastructure into a frictionless platform discipline.

We are building towards a world where internal engineering teams consume platform primitives compute, storage, and event streams via self-serve contracts without waiting on us. We're also laying the groundwork for AI-native platform operations, developing agent plane and agent skills so agents can safely interact & operate infrastructure primitives alongside our team. We look to the CNCF landscape for best-in-class tools our systems, with a long-term commitment to contributing back to open source.

What You'll Do

  • Build and operate compute, storage, and networking at scale that powers FamApp
  • Design platform contracts for other teams: Modules, golden paths, and abstractions with clear inputs, outputs, and guarantees
  • Take medium-to-large infrastructure projects from design to rollout, manage dependencies across engineering teams, and work through ambiguity without waiting to be unblocked
  • Build idempotent, retry-safe automation with its own observability, integrated with CI/CD, ticketing, compliance, and incident workflows

job.name: Senior Python Developer
job.description:
Summary:

We are hiring strong Python developers for a network automation initiative. You will build tools and frameworks that inspect telecom network nodes, perform operational actions on Kubernetes workloads, and monitor network availability and health from Layer 1 through Layer 7. The work reduces manual effort in network operations and gives teams real-time, automated visibility into the network.

Job Responsibilities:

* Design, develop and maintain Python-based automation for network and cloud-native operations.
* Connect to and check the health of network nodes and servers (routers, switches, core and RAN nodes, VMs, bare-metal servers) using SSH, REST, gNMI/NETCONF, SNMP and CLI-based tools.
* Automate Kubernetes operations such as pod lifecycle actions (restart, scale, drain, rollout), log collection, diagnostics and config checks, using the Kubernetes Python client, kubectl and Helm.
* Build monitoring and availability checks across the OSI stack:
+ L1/L2: interface status, link state, optical levels, VLAN and MAC checks
+ L3/L4: IP reachability, routing and BGP/OSPF state, ping/traceroute, port and TCP/UDP checks
+ L5-L7: session health, DNS, TLS/SSL, HTTP/HTTPS and API endpoint availability, application-level service checks
* Integrate with monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Alertmanager) to generate alerts, dashboards and reports.
* Parse and normalize network data (CLI output, JSON, XML, YANG models) using TextFSM, Jinja2, NAPALM, Netmiko or similar.
* Develop CI/CD-ready, testable code with proper logging, error handling and documentation.
* Work with network engineers, SREs and DevOps teams to turn manual runbooks into automated workflows.
* Support troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for network and platform incidents.

Required Skills:

  • Strong Python programming (3.8 ), including asyncio, multithreading, OOP, packaging and unit testing (pytest).
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes: pods, deployments, services, namespaces, CNI and troubleshooting. Experience with the Kubernetes Python client is a plus.
  • AI tools (e.g., Claude) usage experience a big plus.
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals and the OSI model (L1-L7): TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, load balancing, TLS, HTTP.
  • Familiarity with telecom network concepts such as 4G/5G core, RAN, transport, and network functions (CNFs/VNFs).
  • Experience with network automation libraries and protocols: Netmiko, Paramiko, NAPALM, Scrapli, SNMP, NETCONF/RESTCONF, gNMI.
  • Working knowledge of Linux, shell scripting and Git.
  • Experience with REST APIs and integration with monitoring or ticketing systems.

Preferred Skills:

Role: NSX Deployment Architect

Location: Mumbai / Gurgaon / Bengaluru

Experience Level: 10+ years in IT infrastructure, 5+ years hands-on NSX

Role Summary

We are hiring an NSX Deployment Architect to own the design and delivery of VMware NSX and VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) solutions for our clients. You will be the technical bridge between Broadcom architects, customer stakeholders and our implementation team, turning business requirements into proven designs and guiding them through to successful go live.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead discovery workshops with customer stakeholders to capture business, security, and network requirements
  • Produce High-Level and Low-Level Designs (HLD/LLD) for NSX and VCF, including logical topology, routing, micro-segmentation and multi-site architecture.
  • Collaborate with Broadcom architects on design validation, best practices, escalations and product roadmap alignment.
  • Technically guide and mentor the implementation team through build, migration, testing, and handover.
  • Present designs, trade-offs and progress clearly to technical teams and senior client leadership.
  • Own delivery quality: review build documents, as-built reports, test plans and runbooks.
  • Plan and execute migrations from NSX-V, legacy networks, or older VCF versions with minimal disruption.
  • Identify risks early, resolve complex technical issues, and ensure requirements are delivered on time.

Mandatory Experience (Must-Have)

  • NSX design and deployment: at least 3 end-to-end enterprise NSX (NSX-T / NSX 4.x) projects as lead designer, covering Edge clusters, Tier-0/Tier-1 gateways, BGP/OSPF, overlay (Geneve), NAT, load balancing and VPN.
  • NSX security: Distributed Firewall, micro-segmentation, Gateway Firewall and security policy design.
  • VCF design and deployment: hands-on VCF 4.x/5.x delivery, including SDDC Manager, management and VI workload domains, vSAN, lifecycle management and bring-up.
  • Multi-site and scale: NSX Federation, stretched clusters or multi-region designs.
  • Migrations: NSX-V to NSX-T migration or brownfield network integration.
  • Core infrastructure: strong vSphere, data center networking (L2/L3, VLANs, spine-leaf) and physical network integration.

Preferred Skills and Certifications

  • VMware certifications such as VCP-NV, VCAP-NV Design/Deploy, VCP-VCF or VCDX-NV.
  • Exposure to Aria (vRealize) Operations, Aria Operations for Networks, Aria Automation and HCX.
  • Automation with PowerCLI, Python, Terraform or Ansible against NSX and VCF APIs.

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent experience.

About the Role:

This team doesn't treat AI tools as an occasional productivity add-on. Anthropic Claude is a full-time engineering partner on this team — used daily to generate, review, refactor, test, and document code across our .NET backend, React frontend, and Azure cloud infrastructure. Engineers here are expected to think in terms of prompt design, context management, and AI-output validation as a core part of their craft, not a side skill.

We are looking for a Junior Full Stack Developer / BSA who will support CHEC development while also acting as a Business Systems Analyst, bridging business needs, user workflows, and technical implementation. This is a growth role designed to develop you into a full-stack engineer. You will build features under senior guidance, gather and translate requirements, and support validation activities. AI fluency is a core competency on this team - you will use AI coding assistants as daily development and learning tools, building foundational prompt engineering skills alongside your engineering capabilities.

The Custom Hardware and Electronics Configurator (CHEC) team builds and maintains DTNA's proprietary web-based tool that enables Truck Equipment Manufacturers (TEMs), dealers, and internal teams to configure and validate vehicle electrical features. CHEC operates in a safety-relevant, high-complexity domain where usability, correctness, and delivery discipline are critical.

  • Build foundational prompt engineering skills — learn to structure context, constraints, and intent so Claude produces accurate, production-aligned code on the first or second pass

You will build the software that allows customers and Leaser’s AI agent to create, launch, manage, and measure programmatic campaigns. Your ownership includes the platform architecture, backend services, integrations, data pipelines, permissions, financial controls, and production infrastructure.

job.name: Senior AI Frameworks Engineer
job.description:
We are now looking for a Senior AI Frameworks Engineer (C++/Python)! NVIDIA's high-performance computing platforms are powering the AI revolution across many applications and industries. Within our software stack, CUTLASS stands out as a popular open-source ecosystem dedicated to high-performance math primitives. Since 2017, it has provided the community with C++ template abstractions to implement custom GEMM and related computations efficiently on NVIDIA GPUs.

We are building the next frontier of this ecosystem: Pythonic CUTLASS (CUTLASS DSL). This initiative aims to bring "speed-of-light" performance and powerful abstractions of our stack directly into the Python environment. Join the CUTLASS team and help bridge the gap between low-level hardware primitives and high-level developer productivity. If you are passionate about building elegant, high-performance DSLs and want to empower the next generation of AI researchers and engineers with better tools, apply today!

What You'll Be Doing As a core contributor to the CUTLASS project, you will use your expertise in systems programming and API design to create a world-class developer experience for GPU programming and kernel delivery.

  • Design APIs that prioritize user productivity, providing a "native" feel for developers accustomed to modern scientific computing and deep learning frameworks.
  • Develop robust compilation infrastructure—including AST transformations and JIT-friendly execution—to lower Pythonic descriptions into high-performance GPU machine code.
  • Optimize developer experience by creating debugging tools, profiler integrations, and validation methodologies that make writing and using kernels easy.
  • Build production-grade delivery infrastructure for the open-source community, managing everything from package distribution (wheels, conda) to the user-facing documentation and testing.

What We Need To See

  • MS or PhD degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • At least 3+ years of relevant experience.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and C++, specifically regarding the design of Python extensions and foreign function interfaces (FFI).
  • Experience in library or framework development, with a focus on creating intuitive APIs for complex technical systems.
  • Deep understanding of the Python ecosystem’s delivery stack, including building, testing, and distributing high-performance compiled extensions.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

  • Active maintainer status or significant contributions to high-performance open-source libraries, AI frameworks or compiler projects (LLVM/MLIR).
  • Understanding of compiler foundations, such as intermediate representations (IR), lowering passes, or AST manipulation.
  • Experience with GPU Architecture and parallel programming models (CUDA).

The problems we work on are challenging, and solving them takes deep domain expertise, rigorous analysis, and a willingness to dig into the details.

At SentiLink, you'll work alongside smart, highly collaborative colleagues who respect each other's time and judgment, take ownership, and follow through on their commitments. Together, we do truly meaningful work protecting the identities of innocent consumers and flagging the fraudsters attempting to exploit them.

We're well capitalized and growing quickly. We already serve 13 of the top 15 U.S. banks, we're expanding into new markets, and we're backed by Craft Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, NYCA, and Max Levchin. We've been named to the Forbes Fintech 50 and as a 2026 FICO Industry Vanguard Decision Award Winner. We were also the first company to go live with the electronic Consent Based Social Security Number Verification (eCBSV) service, and we've testified before the U.S. Congress on the future of identity.

We want SentiLink to be the best place you've ever worked. We offer generous benefits and support a range of working arrangements, from fully remote to in-office. We are a digital-first company with strong collaboration across the U.S. and India, and we meet in person regularly to build relationships. We have offices in Austin, San Francisco, New York City, Seattle (Bellevue), Los Angeles, and Chicago in the U.S., and in Gurugram (Delhi) and Bengaluru in India.

Role As a Senior Data Scientist at SentiLink, you will build our core products: models that identify fraudsters and also advance our growing suite of products in financial risk. As an experienced researcher you will be relied upon to be technically capable and the definitive owner of your respective domain. You will often work on projects with high visibility and impact that require deep domain understanding, critical thinking and strong technical abilities. You will work with teams across the company to research new types of fraud, develop new products, and provide analysis to drive sales and marketing. This is a full-stack data science role, involving model development, analysis, and writing production code. You should be interested in having end-to-end ownership and a fast-moving environment where deep domain understanding drives development and unusual insights drive our competitive advantage rather than optimization of new machine learning methodologies.

job.name: Consultant, Data Engineering
job.description:
SUMMARY Build the pipelines that bring the outside world into the Knowledge & Intelligence layer - the governed knowledge spine that grounds AI agents on verified, provenance-backed facts. You own how data gets in: the contracts with upstream domain teams, the connectors and change-data-capture that move it, and the landing zone it arrives in. This is hands-on data engineering where everything downstream depends on what you bring in - get the source contracts and ingestion solid and every system that reads this data can trust its inputs.

What You'll Own

  • + Source & publishing contracts. Negotiate schema, freshness SLAs, and change-notice with upstream domain teams - and hold them to it. These contracts are what keep the layer trustworthy.
  • + Connectors & ingestion. Build and operate the connectors and change-data-capture that land upstream sources into the lake, reliably and on their freshness SLA.
  • + The landing zone. Own the raw landing layer - structure, partitioning, and a clean handoff to the medallion pipeline.
  • + Ingestion observability. Know when a source breaks, drifts, or goes stale - before anything downstream does.
  • + Grounding discipline. Nothing lands ungrounded; provenance travels with every record from the moment it arrives.

Why This Role?

  • + You own the front door to the entire layer - every grounded fact starts as something you sourced and landed. Get ingestion right and everything downstream can trust its inputs.
  • + This is a greenfield role - you're standing up the sourcing patterns and the contracts from scratch, not inheriting a maintenance queue.
  • + High leverage on reliability - the freshness and trustworthiness of the whole layer rests on the inputs you bring in.

Essential Requirements:

  • + Senior / staff-level, hands-on depth in data sourcing and ingestion - the core discipline of this role.
  • + Strong Python - your primary language for building and operating pipelines, connectors, and tooling.
  • + A track record of landing diverse upstream sources into a data lake reliably and on their freshness SLA.
  • + Proven experience handling data at high volume, with real attention to cost, partitioning, and performance.
  • + A provenance mindset - "where did this come from" travels with every record you land.
  • + Strong collaboration and stakeholder communication with upstream domain teams.

Tech Stack Ingestion takes whatever shape the source needs - depth in one or two matters more than all of them:

Sources - REST / APIs • Kafka • Teradata • Oracle • SQL Server • MongoDB • Cassandra • S3-compatible storage (ECS)

Move & land - CDC • SQL & DB extract scripts • Airflow • Spark / PySpark • Delta / Iceberg • CSV / JSON / Parquet

Compensation Dell is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range for this position is USD $187,850 - USD $243,100

AI Researcher

Seattle, WA · Onsite · Full Time

About Talus Bio

Talus Bioscience, a venture-backed early-stage biotechnology company, is at the forefront of developing innovative AI models, and using those models to deliver much-needed medicines. Driven by the belief that "nothing is undruggable," we harness cutting-edge proteomics and frontier AI during the initial stages of discovery to unlock previously inaccessible targets in cancer, autoimmunity, and other high burden diseases.

AI Researcher Job Description

Talus Bio is looking for an AI Researcher to join the team full-time in our Seattle office (this is an in-person role). This person will be naturally curious, results-driven, and eager to work in a small preclinical biotech environment.

You will improve Ptarmigan, our structure-free model that predicts which small molecules engage which proteins across the human proteome, and you will build new models for our drug discovery programs and partners. Ptarmigan learns from Talus Bio's own chemoproteomics data: hundreds of millions of compound-protein measurements collected in native human cells, including on transcription factors and other proteins without good structures. We measure success by delivering value beyond in silico metrics: successful models drive early discovery and accelerate the optimization of molecules moving toward the clinic.

You will work closely with our team of multi-disciplinary scientists to choose what models, metrics, and new features maximize our success. You will also work with our Product and Applications Lead to understand what partners need from our models. This role suits a machine learning researcher who has applied models to drug discovery, ideally in a preclinical program, and wants to shape the modeling direction at a small company. We will set the level (AI Researcher or Senior AI Researcher) based on experience.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer - Internal AI Accelerator Squad
job.description:
The role / impact Every team at Xero has work that is slow, manual and error prone and the people doing it are often the ones best placed to make better decisions if they had time. We're building agentic AI workflows/agents that take that toil away, so our people can focus on the work that matters.

The internal AI accelerator squad partners directly with Xero's enterprise and G&A functions, including HR, Legal, Finance, Sales teams. As a Senior Engineer, you will work in a forward deployed way, sitting down with senior business leaders to understand their challenges, then designing, building and delivering agents and workflows that the business can run itself. You will own that work end to end, from the first conversation to a live system with real users.

The Technical Challenges The Squad is early in it's life and the problems are as much about judgement as engineering. Five problems define the work:

  • Agents the business trusts: Build agentic workflows that handle real work, with human review, guardrails and clear escalation, so business teams are comfortable relying on them.
  • Discovery to delivery: Take an ambiguous business pain point, shape it into a problem worth solving, and deliver a working solution quickly, then iterate with the people using it.
  • Production, not prototypes: Design agents that are observable, evaluated and maintainable, with evals, monitoring and cost controls built in from the start.
  • Handover that sticks: Build so the business team can own and run the outcome without you in the loop, and so the next agent is faster to build than the last.
  • Platforms that scale us: Build the golden paths, MCP integrations and reusable skills that let hundreds of Xeros build and ship AI safely, without needing an engineer for every idea.

What We Build

  • Agents in production: triage agents for IT and People support, an onboarding orchestrator that guides every new starter, tax classification, and spend limit approval automation that cut approvals from hours to seconds.
  • Platforms that scale AI across Xero: the Dashboard Accelerator, which takes apps people build in Claude to secure internal hosting in minutes instead of weeks; a governed marketplace for Claude plugins and skills; and support for a growing community of citizen builders.
  • MCP and enterprise integrations: production grade MCP servers that safely connect agents to systems like Workday and Salesforce, plus the patterns and guidance the rest of Xero builds on.
  • Bonus: experience building MCP servers, durable workflows (e.g. Temporal), or agent frameworks such as Pydantic AI or LangGraph.

Tools And Tech You'll get early access to the latest AI tooling (Claude Code, Glean, Gemini, GitHub Copilot and many models through our AI gateway) and the freedom to choose the right tool for the job. Today we build Python, Typescript and .NET; MCP;Temporal; AWS, Kubernetes and Terraform; Snowflake and ddbt; and GitHub Actions.

About Turing

Turing is one of the world’s leading AGI infrastructure companies, working with frontier AI labs to accelerate model development through high-quality training data, evaluations, and engineering talent.

About the Role

We’re looking for experienced, hands-on software engineers to help evaluate and improve AI coding models .

Rather than primarily building production applications, you’ll work with coding agents across real-world repositories and assess the quality of their work. You’ll review generated code and agent behavior, determine whether solutions are technically correct, identify failure modes, and create the evaluation signals and feedback used to improve model performance.

Think of the coding agent as another engineer whose work you’re reviewing: Can it understand the task? Did it choose the right approach? Is the resulting code correct, robust, and maintainable? Can you explain precisely where it succeeded or failed?

What You’ll Do:

  • Evaluate AI-generated code and solutions across real-world software repositories
  • Review agent behavior, tool usage, and code changes for correctness and quality
  • Identify technical errors, weak approaches, and recurring model failure modes
  • Compare model outputs and explain why one solution is better than another
  • Create and refine rubrics and evaluation criteria for coding tasks
  • Produce high-quality evaluation and preference data used to improve coding models
  • Build and maintain pipelines and infrastructure supporting data generation, collection, and evaluation workflows
  • Synthesize findings from data work into clear write-ups, updates, and recommendations for the team
  • Collaborate closely with researchers and engineers to translate qualitative judgment into scalable processes
  • Share clear, actionable findings with AI researchers and engineers

What We’re Looking For:

  • 5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience
  • Strong proficiency in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, or another major production language
  • Experience working in substantial real-world codebases
  • Strong code-review skills and technical judgment
  • Ability to clearly explain why an implementation is correct, incorrect, or could be improved

Experience with LLM evaluation, coding agents, RLHF, preference data, rubric design, or post-training is a plus, but not required.

Palladium Security is a cybersecurity firm built around one idea: security made simple.

Our team works across Canada, the US and India, and every consultant is Google Cloud and Chrome certified.

The role

You will own the technical side of customer engagements from first conversation to production rollout, working alongside Google Cloud's field teams on enterprise accounts. The role is fully remote within Canada, with customers mainly in Eastern and Central time zones and occasional travel for workshops and Google Cloud events.

What you'll do

  • Lead technical discovery, demos and proof-of-value engagements for Chrome Enterprise Premium, Google Security Operations (SIEM/SOAR), Wiz and Google Threat Intelligence
  • Design architectures for secure enterprise browsing, DLP, context-aware access, detection engineering and cloud posture management
  • Scope engagements and write statements of work with clear milestones, deliverables and success criteria
  • Lead hands-on delivery: policy design, identity and endpoint integrations, log ingestion, detection content, and pilot-to-production rollout
  • Act as trusted technical advisor to customer security and IT leadership
  • Build reusable assets: reference architectures, delivery guides and demo environments

What you bring

  • 5+ years in security architecture, pre-sales engineering or security consulting
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of Google SecOps (Chronicle), Chrome Enterprise Premium / BeyondCorp, or Wiz
  • Strong grounding in zero trust, identity (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace), endpoint management and DLP
  • Working knowledge of SIEM/SOAR operations: log pipelines, parsers, detection rules and playbooks
  • Confidence running customer workshops and presenting to both executives and engineers
  • Clear, concise writing for SOWs, design documents and status reports

Nice to have: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer or Security Operations Engineer certification; YARA-L; experience with Wiz, Cameyo or competing enterprise browser and SSE platforms; background at a Google Cloud partner, MSSP or security vendor.

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it.

Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog to learn more about what our team is working on! The Identity and Access Management (IAM) team owns Vanta's authentication and authorization platform. As Vanta's product surface grows in complexity and our customer base expands upmarket, the company looks to IAM team to deliver enterprise features that open new opportunities, and execute at a quality bar that minimizes risk to Vanta and our customers. Our mission is to make correct authentication and authorization the default path for every engineer at Vanta, with clear guardrails, fast onboarding, and predictable performance at scale.

As Vanta expands its agentic capabilities across surfaces like MCP, CLI, and the Vanta Agent, the IAM team is also at the center of a new set of problems: defining what it means for an agent to act as a user's proxy, how an agent acts on its own behalf, enforcing consistent permission checks across every invocation surface, and building an attribution model that makes agent-assisted actions auditable and trustworthy. You'll help design the identity primitives that make autonomous agent behavior safe and governable at scale.

As a Senior Software Engineer , you'll shape the direction of these areas in the IAM pillar, and your technical decisions will create leverage across the engineering organization.

job.name: Major Incident Management
job.description:
Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv. We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title Major Incident Management

Job Description \*

What does a successful Major Incident Manager do at Fiserv? You will lead high-pressure Major Incidents that are (or could) impact IT services, ensuring strong command and control, accurate real-time documentation, and coordinated actions that drive safe and timely service restoration. You will partner with IT Support and Business teams throughout the incident lifecycle, with a focus on P2/P3/P4 Major Incidents.

What You Will Do

  • Provide strong command and control for Major Incidents, with frequent impact assessments and a focus on safe, timely client service restoration.
  • Ensure real-time incident documentation in MIMIC (level-set and workstream tool), including fix attempts, infrastructure details (IP addresses, device names, etc.), and impact assessments (applications affected, clients impacted, impact types/amounts).
  • Lead efforts for P3/P4 Major Incidents and serve as the focal point for MIMIC documentation on P1/P2 Major Incidents alongside a Major Incident Management SRT associate who drives command and control of the incident meeting.
  • Perform thorough Post Incident Reviews (PIRs) for every Major Incident; ensure accurate and detailed incident synopses are provided by root cause owners and restoration teams.
  • Identify opportunities/shortfalls and ensure they are documented as Problem Tasks (pTasks) for follow-up in the formal Problem Review process.
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure consistent communication and coordination throughout the Major Incident lifecycle.
  • Support process improvement and Continual Service Improvement initiatives to streamline Major Incident Management execution.

What You Will Need To Have

  • 10+ years of experience working in a Major Incident Management organization with strong understanding of the Major Incident Management lifecycle.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across multiple levels of the organization.
  • Ability to remain calm, make decisions under pressure, and drive outcomes in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency with MS Office tools (Power BI, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams) and ServiceNow.
  • Proficiency with Command Center technologies and software.

job.name: Technical Product Manager
job.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Technical Product Manager with strong product judgement and the technical depth to partner closely with Engineering. The role turns technical initiatives into clear priorities and product outcomes, then drives them through implementation and validation.

The focus includes platform capabilities, architectural evolution, security and vulnerability remediation, performance and reliability, APIs, integrations, and other work that strengthens the product and reduces operational risk.

Role positioning: This is a Product role, not an Engineering or Solution Architect role. Engineering and Architecture own solution design and implementation. This role defines the problem and outcomes, represents product and customer needs, evaluates impact and priority, clarifies decisions and dependencies, and drives cross-functional closure.

Key Responsibilities 1. Technical Initiatives and Product Improvements

  • Partner with Engineering and Architecture to identify, assess, and shape technical initiatives, platform improvements, technology upgrades, and technical-debt reduction work.
  • Translate engineering proposals into clear product problems, intended outcomes, benefits, risks, and acceptance criteria.
  • Prioritise technical work alongside customer and feature initiatives by considering business impact, customer impact, operational risk, security exposure, regulatory commitments, effort, and long-term platform value.
  • Maintain visibility of technical initiatives through a clear backlog or roadmap, including ownership, dependencies, target releases, decisions, and progress.

2. Architecture and Design Partnership

  • Participate actively in architecture and design reviews for new features, integrations, and major technical changes.
  • Represent product, customer, operational, compliance, and support needs during technical discussions, while respecting Engineering and Architecture ownership of the solution design.
  • Ensure that non-functional requirements are considered early, including security, performance, scalability, availability, resilience, data integrity, maintainability, deployment, upgrade and backward-compatibility needs.
  • Challenge assumptions constructively, understand technical trade-offs, and help teams make decisions that balance short-term delivery with long-term platform health.
  • Capture product-impacting architecture decisions, open questions, dependencies, constraints, and follow-up actions so they remain traceable through delivery.

3. Security and Vulnerability Management

job.name: AI Architect – .NET / Azure / GenAI
job.description:
AI Architect (.Net/Azure)

About RetireAIQ

RetireAIQ is Sagitec's AI-powered retirement planning application. A pension plan member arrives from the plan's portal through a secure one-time link that carries their benefit estimate. The application projects their income, expenses and savings through retirement for each benefit option, and an AI assistant answers their questions from the plan's published documents.

It is a multi-tenant web application built on .NET, C# and JavaScript and hosted on Azure. Its conversational features use Azure OpenAI and retrieval-augmented generation, and it runs in production with live users.

The role

You will be the engineering owner of RetireAIQ: its architecture, its code quality, its Azure environment and its production health. You make the technical decisions, review what ships, and act as the escalation point when something breaks.

Our code is written with AI coding tools. You will direct those tools, review everything they produce, and decide what is safe to release to members of a live pension system. You will lead the engineering team as it grows and work directly with the RetireAIQ product owner in the US.

What you will do

Ownership and review

  • Own the architecture of a multi-tenant .NET application: API, web front end and background services.
  • Review and approve every change before it reaches production, including code produced by AI coding tools.
  • Set the engineering standards, automated tests and release checks that let a small team ship safely.
  • Guide and review the work of other developers on the team.

AI application

  • Build and maintain AI-powered conversational features using Azure OpenAI.
  • Own prompt design and the retrieval pipeline that grounds answers in each agency's plan documents.
  • Maintain the evaluation suite that checks answer accuracy after every prompt, model or knowledge-base change.
  • Decide what belongs in deterministic code and what belongs in the AI layer.

Azure and operations

  • Own the Azure environment end to end: App Services, Azure OpenAI, storage, secrets, networking and identity.
  • Manage CI/CD in Azure DevOps with infrastructure as code, including deployments, rollbacks and production approvals.
  • Monitor application performance, logs and reported defects; prioritize and address issues.
  • Maintain security controls for regulated pension data: encryption, least-privilege access, audit logging and protection against prompt injection.
  • Provision new client environments and track cloud cost as usage grows.
  • Act as the escalation point for production incidents.

Client delivery

  • Support client onboarding and configuration.
  • Support pilot and post-go-live issues as clients are onboarded.
  • Integrate RetireAIQ with client member portals and pension administration systems.
  • Represent engineering on technical calls with client IT teams.

Must-have qualifications

Deliver production‑ready Oracle EBS Financial solutions that integrate with upstream and downstream systems, prioritize data integrity and compliance, and improve system reliability through automation and modern engineering practices.

Core responsibilities

  • Compliance: Ensure solutions meet SOX, audit, tax, and internal security requirements.

Documentation & collaboration: Produce clear technical documentation and work closely with Finance and IT stakeholders; provide technical guidance to peers and junior engineers.

Requirements

  • Soft skills: Strong analytical and problem‑solving abilities; effective collaborator across multiple teams and priorities; clear technical communicator.

job.name: System Integration Engineer
job.description:
Job Description – System Integration Engineer

Location: Chennai (Onsite)

Experience: 5–7 Years

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced System Integration Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Oracle PL/SQL, WSO2, NGINX Reverse Proxy, Oracle APEX/ORDS, and Azure Blob Storage integration.

The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and managing secure end-to-end data integration pipelines connecting Oracle databases, middleware services, cloud storage, and external systems.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in enterprise application integration (EAI), API gateway configuration, REST API integrations, and secure network architecture.

Key Responsibilities

1. Outbound Integration Architecture (Oracle → NGINX/WSO2 → External Systems/Azure)

  • Develop and maintain Oracle PL/SQL packages using UTL\_HTTP to generate JSON payloads from Oracle databases.
  • Configure secure outbound communication through NGINX/WSO2 over HTTPS (Port 443).
  • Implement data synchronization and transactional data transfer pipelines.

2. Third-Party & Azure Blob Storage Integration

  • Configure WSO2 for secure outbound HTTPS communication with third-party APIs and Azure Blob Storage.
  • Implement JSON file uploads (PUT) and downloads (GET) using Azure Blob Storage.
  • Manage secure authentication tokens, connection strings, and file transfer workflows.

3. Inbound Integration Architecture (External Systems → NGINX/WSO2 → APEX/ORDS → Oracle)

  • Develop inbound integration pipelines to receive requests from external systems.
  • Configure secure routing through NGINX/WSO2 to Oracle APEX/ORDS REST endpoints.
  • Implement backend PL/SQL procedures to process incoming requests and update Oracle staging tables.

4. NGINX & WSO2 Administration

  • Configure NGINX for SSL termination, reverse proxy routing, and security headers.
  • Manage WSO2 API Manager and Micro Integrator configurations.
  • Implement request authentication, payload transformation, error handling, and secure API routing.

5. Oracle APEX, ORDS & PL/SQL Development

  • Develop and maintain Oracle PL/SQL packages, procedures, and database integrations.
  • Configure and manage Oracle REST Data Services (ORDS) REST endpoints.
  • Build Oracle APEX dashboards for interface monitoring, exception handling, and manual payload reprocessing.
  • Implement logging, troubleshooting, and error-handling mechanisms.

Required Technical Skills

job.name: SAP TM Technical Consultant
job.description:
Role Title: Senior Specialist- SAP TM(Hyderabad/Pune/Noida/Mumbai/Bangalore)

Experience: 5 –1 2 + years SAP technical experience; 5 + years in SAP TM technical development .

Role Overview

The SAP TM Technical Principal Lead is responsible for leading the technical architecture, development, and integration of SAP Transportation Management within S/4HANA or standalone TM. This role leads technical designs, oversees development teams, ensures adherence to development standards, and supports complex enhancements, performance optimization, and interface enablement.

Job Responsibilities

Technical Solution Design & Development Leadership

  • Lead end-to-end technical architecture and development for SAP TM (Embedded or 9.6).
  • Own WRICEF design (Workflows, Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms) for all TM objects.
  • Perform complex development using:

o ABAP OO / BOPF

o CDS Views / AMDP

o Enhancements & BADIs

o TM-specific PPF actions, charge calculation enhancements, optimizer BAdIs

  • Build and review technical specifications, code review checklists, and reusable frameworks.
  • Lead TM extensibility using SAP BTP, RAP model, and Cloud SDK where applicable.

Integration Responsibilities

  • Design and build TM interfaces using:

o ALE/IDoc frameworks

o CPI Integration Suite

o PI/PO mappings

o SOAP/REST APIs, OData services

  • Ensure seamless integration with EWM, SD/MM, Finance, carrier systems, freight exchanges, and external logistics providers.
  • Develop error-handling, monitoring dashboards, and performance tuning for high-volume transportation data flows.

UI/UX & Fiori Development

  • Lead development of SAP TM Fiori apps (Freight Order, FU, Planning apps, collaboration apps).
  • Develop custom SAPUI5 applications integrated with TM BOPF data.
  • Enhance standard TM Fiori applications with extensions and custom logic.

Data & Migration

  • Lead data conversion for TM master data & transactional data:

o Locations, Resources, Schedules

o Business Partners

o Transportation Zones

o Rate tables & charge profiles

  • Design ETL logic using ABAP, BODS, CPI-DS, or custom frameworks.

Delivery Leadership

  • Lead junior developers and offshore technical teams.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, performance assessments, and quality gates.
  • Support SIT/UAT cycles, defect resolution, cutover preparation, and hypercare.

Skills Set to Possess

  • Strong expertise in ABAP OO, BOPF, CDS, AMDP, and data modeling in S/4HANA.
  • Deep technical knowledge of SAP TM architecture, frameworks, and enhancement points.
  • Strong ALE/IDoc experience and CPI/PI integration concepts.
  • Strong Fiori/UI5, OData, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS, RESTful services.
  • Experience with TM planning logic, charge management frameworks, PPF, and execution BOPF nodes.
  • Experience in RISE with SAP, Cloud ALM, and Git-enabled CTS preferred.
  • Proven ability to lead technical workstreams.

Preferred Qualifications

job.name: Engineering Manager- AI & ML (Navi Mumbai)
job.description:
As an Engineering Manager, AI & ML (Data Collection), you will play a critical role in building

and scaling the company’s Unified AI/ML Data Collection Platform, enabling standardized, reliable, and scalable machine learning capabilities across the organization.

This role will focus on transforming existing AI/ML and LLM-driven data systems into a cohesive platform that supports data pipelines, model lifecycle management, evaluation frameworks, and production deployment.

This position requires deep technical expertise in machine learning systems, ML platform architecture, and MLOps, along with a strong ability to lead and mentor engineering teams.

You will work closely with individual contributors and cross-functional partners to ensure that ML platform capabilities align with broader business objectives and AI/ML strategies. You will be deeply involved in the design, development, and operationalization of platform components, including data ingestion, feature management, model training and evaluation, and scalable inference systems. You will provide strong technical leadership, solve complex system-level challenges, and ensure delivery of high-quality, reliable, and scalable ML solutions.

Your leadership will ensure that AI/ML systems are production-ready, observable, and maintainable, with a strong emphasis on performance, cost-efficiency, and governance. You will leverage your expertise in areas such as large language models (LLMs), retrieval augmented generation (RAG), ML Operations (MLOps), distributed systems, and cloud native architectures. You will oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of ML systems—from development and experimentation to deployment and monitoring—while ensuring alignment with global engineering standards and business priorities.

You will be responsible for mentoring engineers, driving technical excellence, and fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation. Your ability to partner across teams, influence technical direction, and build high-performing teams will be critical to success in this role.

You will lead a multidisciplinary team of ML engineers responsible for building and maintaining the Unified AI/ML Data Collection Platform. The team focuses on developing scalable systems that support data pipelines, model lifecycle management, LLM-based workflows, and evaluation frameworks, enabling downstream teams to build and deploy AI driven data collection solutions.

Primary Job Responsibilities :

  • AI-Powered Data Collection Systems: Lead the design and development of scalable AI-driven data collection and enrichment workflows across structured and unstructured data sources.
  • LLM & Generative AI Workflows: Drive the implementation of LLM-based capabilities including extraction pipelines, RAG systems, prompt orchestration, summarization, classification, and automated validation workflows.

job.name: Principle ServiceNow Architect
job.description:
Ajoni Technologies helps enterprises turn AI ideas into real business solutions. We bring together Agentic AI, data, workflows, architecture and governance to make AI adoption practical, trusted and easier to scale. Our BFSI practice partners with banks and NBFCs to move beyond AI experimentation, designing production-grade Agentic AI and GenAI solutions grounded in real business processes and governed responsibly.

Why Join Us

  • Drive Next-Gen AI Transformations: Lead architect-level implementations at the intersection of ServiceNow, Now Assist, and cutting-edge Enterprise AI agents.
  • High Impact & Zero Red Tape: Work directly with enterprise clients and key decision-makers without navigating heavy corporate bureaucracy.
  • Accelerated Growth: Build and shape the technical foundation of a growing, specialized consulting firm, opening rapid pathways to practice leadership.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Lead or Principal ServiceNow Architect with 10 to 15 years of IT experience who loves working directly with clients and building alongside the development team. In this role, you will act as a technical leader and a collaborative teammate. You will lead initial client workshops to design the solution blueprint and then work closely with our engineers to make sure the project is delivered successfully.

The ideal candidate has strong, practical experience with ServiceNow ITSM and either CSM or HRSD. You should also have the hands-on technical skills to set up ServiceNow Now Assist (GenAI) and build an operational AI Control Tower.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Client Workshops and Discovery: Lead technical meetings with clients, understand their business needs, and figure out how to solve them using native ServiceNow features.
  • Solution Design and Building: Own the technical design while staying close to the actual configuration. You will build complex proofs-of-concept, set up integrations using IntegrationHub, and organize clean CMDB models.
  • Pre-Sales & Technical Scoping: Partner with business development leads during pre-sales discovery to evaluate client requirements, design high-level technical architectures, define integration scope, and estimate technical effort for proposals and Statements of Work (SOWs).
  • Now Assist and AI Control Tower: Set up Now Assist features like incident summarization, GenAI search, and virtual agents. You will also build the AI Control Tower framework using performance analytics so clients can track their AI performance and ROI.
  • Team Collaboration: Act as the technical anchor for the engineering team. You will partner with developers to troubleshoot bugs, fix performance issues, and solve tough coding challenges.
  • Technical Standards: Set clean platform standards focused on configuration over customization so client instances are healthy and easy to upgrade. You will also do friendly peer code reviews to help the team learn.

REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

job.name: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
job.description:
Requirements

  • 3-5 years of full-time software engineering experience, with strong TypeScript/Node.js skills (NestJS preferred).
  • Shipped and owned a conversational, search, or RAG feature used by real users at scale: a customer-facing product, not an internal tool, company knowledge-base bot, or internal RAG.
  • Hands-on production experience with LangChain or LangGraph for building agentic or multi-step LLM workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Langfuse for tracing, evaluations, and regression testing of prompt and model changes.
  • Search relevance experience: built or tuned search with Elasticsearch/OpenSearch and vector search (Qdrant, Pinecone, etc.), and measured relevance rather than eyeballing it.
  • Data-driven approach: comfortable defining success metrics, working with product analytics, and using funnel and conversion data to decide what to build or improve.

Nice to have

  • Built an LLM-as-judge setup or relevance test set that changed a real decision.
  • Experience with geo/places data, entity resolution, or local search.
  • Experience with reranking and rank fusion.
  • Experience with messaging platform APIs (WhatsApp Cloud API, Instagram Graph API).
  • Experience with prompt caching or model routing at scale.
  • Exposure to multimodal understanding (video, images).
  • Exposure to Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Prior experience in a fast-paced, AI-driven startup environment.

Responsibilities

  • Build agentic, multi-step LLM workflows: orchestration, tool calling, memory, and multi-turn conversation state.
  • Own our conversational AI end to end across in-app chat: from product requirement, to production, to iteration based on real user behavior.
  • Own retrieval quality for our hybrid search and RAG systems, grounding every answer in first-party data.
  • Work on query understanding and entity resolution for location-aware search.
  • Make LLM features reliable in production: structured outputs, streaming, fallbacks, and routing across multiple models based on quality, latency, and cost.
  • Build async, event-driven pipelines that hold up under real user traffic.
  • Build the evaluation and observability layer: tracing, eval datasets curated from real user conversations, regression testing for prompt, model, and retrieval changes, and metrics for relevance and groundedness.
  • Optimise cost and latency across LLM workloads.
  • Identify the data a feature needs, design and architect the system around it, and source it from the right teams: product analytics, conversion and growth metrics.
  • Translate requirements and product insights into shipped features, collaborating closely with the founder, engineering, and product.

Job Details

Mumbai, work from office.

Interview Process

  • Initial Screening
  • Technical Interview
  • Founder Discussion

job.name: Head of Research - Benchmarks
job.description:
Title- Head of Research - Benchmarks

Experience- 1- 4 years

Location- Mumbai (5 days, onsite)

Job Role:

Lead research and production of coding-focused benchmarks built around real AI failure cases.

What you'll do

  • Build multiple benchmarks, with a repeatable task-design, validation and review process that keeps quality high.
  • Lead our current benchmarking projects with AI labs.
  • Study agent runs, group the failures and turn them into objectively graded tasks.
  • Define what makes an evaluation useful: correctness, objective grading and difficulty.
  • Guard against answer leakage and gaming, and measure genuine improvement.
  • Guide the researchers who write and review tasks.

Non-negotiable

You have personally worked on building one or more benchmarks. Sole ownership is not required, but your own contribution must be clear, with an artifact or public work we can inspect.

Technical requirements

Must-haves

  • Strong Python for data processing and evaluation pipelines: pandas, JSON/JSONL at scale, scripting and automation.
  • Hands-on experience running LLMs or coding agents against graded tasks through an evaluation harness.
  • Working knowledge of statistics for evaluation: sampling, significance, contamination and train/test separation.
  • Comfort with git-based workflows and code review.
  • Working knowledge of Docker for reproducing agent runs.

Nice-to-haves

  • Familiarity with benchmark frameworks such as Terminal-Bench, SWE-bench, HELM or lm- evaluation-harness.
  • Exposure to RL or post-training evaluation loops.
  • Prompt engineering and agent framework experience (tool use, sandboxes).
  • Contributions to open-source evals or published benchmark work.

Strong skills

Coding-agent evals such as Terminal-Bench and SWE-bench style tasks; experimental judgment

(what a benchmark does and does not measure); reproducible pipelines; quality control across many outputs.

Kamakhya Analytics is a technology-driven research and consulting organisation helping leaders, parties, and institutions decode India’s political and policy landscape. job.name: Shopify Developer

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a hands-on Shopify expert to own the technical health, performance and growth of the Aamra Jewellery online store. You will keep the platform fast, stable and conversion-ready, and turn business needs into smooth, reliable store experiences.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

job.name: Product Security Engineer, North Security
job.description:
Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this role

Enterprises hand Cohere their most sensitive data and put our models inside workflows they can't afford to get wrong. Securing that means working on problems the industry hasn't settled yet, what authorization means when an agent acts on a user's behalf, how to contain tools that consume untrusted input, and whether tenant boundaries hold when a model can be steered by the data it reads. The established playbooks only take you so far.

We're hiring a Senior Product Security Engineer to work these problems alongside the engineers building the products, reviewing architecture and code, threat modeling before implementation, testing what ships, and turning what you learn into defaults other teams inherit. This is a hands-on engineering role, not an advisory one.

What you’ll do

  • Lead security reviews. Review architecture, code, and security-sensitive changes. Identify both individual vulnerabilities and the recurring design patterns behind them.
  • Secure AI-powered products. Evaluate risks such as prompt injection, unsafe tool use, identity and delegation failures, excessive agency, data exposure, tenant isolation, and sandbox escapes.

  • Strengthen engineering capability. Pair with engineers, document practical guidance, and help product teams develop durable security expertise.
