job.name: Senior Security Engineer, AI Security
job.description:
Beacon is looking for a Sr. Security Engineer, AI Security to own the safe use of AI at Beacon and across the companies in our portfolio. You will design and operate the security controls, harden the systems that AI tools and agents connect to, and work closely with engineering on identity, authorization, and network protections for AI agents and other non-human workloads.

Key Responsibilities

  • Give every agent an owner, scoped credentials, least privilege, and approvals where the action calls for it, and track it from creation to offboarding like a user.
  • Own the security requirements for AI integrations (MCP connections, OAuth grants), memory, and retrieval, and set tenant defaults and approved connectors.
  • Keep a live view of AI tools and agents, including AI features that vendors turn on inside tools we already use.
  • Put limits on tool calls, network access, data egress, and resource use.
  • Threat model and adversarially test our internal AI platform and agents, covering prompt injection, data disclosure, unsafe tool use, and unauthorized actions. Turn findings into regression tests and release gates.
  • Define the logs AI systems must produce, build detections for risky grants and sensitive data going into AI tools, lead the AI side of incidents, and join the on-call rotation.
  • Give a quick yes with conditions on new tools, and keep approved patterns and a pre-cleared list so most requests need no review.
  • Add an AI inventory and the same standards to the security baseline for each acquisition.

What We Are Looking For

  • About 5 to 7 years in security engineering, application security, or cloud security.
  • Hands-on experience securing LLM applications, agents, or AI developer tools, including prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency, and insecure tool use.
  • Strong in non-human identity: OAuth, SSO, SCIM, service accounts, and secrets.
  • Writes and ships code, building the tooling instead of stopping at a recommendation.
  • Explains risk clearly to engineers and non-engineers, and can say yes with conditions.
  • Works independently, is comfortable in greenfield work, and is willing to join the on-call rotation.
  • Uses AI in everyday work and has informed judgment about where it is useful.

Nice to have

  • Experience building evaluations or adversarial tests for AI systems.
  • Experience with AI gateways, SSPM, CASB, or DLP tools.
  • Familiarity with the NIST AI Risk Management Framework or ISO 42001.

*Our Values at Beacon Holdings:*

job.name: Senior Security Engineer, Enterprise Security
job.description:
Beacon is looking for a Sr. Security Engineer, Enterprise Security to join our enterprise security team and work alongside its lead. You will build the monitoring and response systems that let a small team cover the corporate environment and cloud infrastructure at Beacon and across the companies in our portfolio, hands-on and engineering first.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build the monitoring. Bring telemetry from endpoints, identity, SaaS, cloud, and email into one place, close coverage gaps, and keep the pipeline healthy as new companies join.
  • Own detection content. Write and tune detections for account takeover, session token theft, malicious OAuth grants, admin abuse, and misuse of legitimate access, and measure and cut the noise.
  • Scale response. Build the playbooks, automation, and case management that let a small team handle incidents across many companies, with incident access set up in advance. Join the on-call rotation.
  • Cut manual alert review with automation and AI-assisted triage.
  • Map attack paths across separate systems, such as a phishing email that leads to a compromised engineering admin account and then a change to a cloud workload that delivers malware, and close the links in the chain that matter most.Report on all of it. Build dashboards and metrics on coverage, detection quality, response time, and security posture, for leadership and for each company.
  • Set the security standards for endpoint, identity, SaaS, and cloud, and verify them. Work with IT and Corporate Engineering, who run those systems, to get gaps fixed, and check that the fixes hold.
  • Manage security configuration as code, with drift detection across SaaS and cloud, so controls are repeatable and auditable.
  • Govern third-party integrations, OAuth grants, and non-human identities, and review new vendors for security risk.
  • Run the security baseline for newly acquired companies and bring them into the monitoring.

What We Are Looking For

  • About 4 to 7 years in enterprise security, detection and response, or security engineering.
  • Has built and run detection content and a telemetry pipeline, and measured detection quality.
  • Has built response playbooks and automation, and taken part in live incident response.
  • Writes production-quality code and automates instead of configuring by hand.
  • Solid understanding of identity: OAuth, SAML, OIDC, session and token lifecycle, and how non-human identities reach cloud access.
  • Solid grasp of cloud and SaaS security, enough to judge risk across more than one environment.
  • Has built dashboards or reporting on security metrics that leadership used.
  • Treats identity, devices, SaaS, and cloud as one system, and hardens the paths between them instead of each tool alone.
  • Collaborative and direct. Gets security work done without owning the platform, working with company leaders and engineers outside your reporting line.
  • Uses AI in everyday work and has informed judgment about where it is useful.

With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time. About Your Role Juniper Square is the system of record for private-capital funds: we move LP capital, hold investor data our customers are legally responsible for, and enforce the boundaries between one fund’s information and another’s. As a Staff Security Operations Engineer, you will be the senior hands-on engineer who builds our Tier 2 detection and response capability and stands up our data loss prevention program. You will report to the Head of Security and work day to day with the Staff Security Engineer who owns our security platform, the Application Security team, GRC, and the CISO. Our stack is modern and already deployed: Google SecOps for SIEM, CrowdStrike for endpoint, Cloudflare Zero Trust, Upwind for cloud posture and runtime, FireCompass for external attack surface, and a managed detection and response provider we are transitioning away from. job.name: Forward Deployed Engineer, AI Trust and Reliability
job.description:
About The Role Hopper powers travel for some of the world's largest banks, airlines and travel companies, and our AI agents act on their customers' behalf by looking up accounts, changing and cancelling bookings, and handling payments and loyalty points. As the Forward Deployed Engineer, AI Trust and Reliability, you make sure that AI is safe, secure and ready for production in every partner deployment. You work in a small forward-deployed team as the person who owns guardrails, adversarial testing, launch readiness and partner security reviews, and you are the bridge between our partners' security, risk and IT teams and Hopper's engineering and security teams.

What would your day-to-day look like

  • Tailor guardrails to each partner's policies, regulations, risk appetite and languages, covering what the AI may do, what it must refuse and when it hands off to a human
  • Design protections for sensitive data and actions, including data masking, identity checks and customer consent before any change to a booking or payment
  • Tune guardrails so they stop real risks without blocking legitimate customers
  • Red-team every deployment before launch and after significant changes, testing for jailbreaks, prompt injection, data leakage, unauthorized actions and social engineering
  • Build and maintain automated adversarial test suites that run continuously, in every language a partner serves
  • Turn findings into fixes with engineering, and into regression tests so they stay fixed
  • Lead partner security questionnaires, architecture reviews and AI or model-risk reviews, and respond to partner penetration-test findings
  • Document how our AI handles data, access and decisions in terms a regulator or auditor would accept
  • Own the go-live checklist for each deployment, covering functional, regression, safety and load testing, sign-off criteria and rollback plans
  • Extend our automated testing across products, so every model, prompt or configuration change is tested before it reaches customers
  • Coordinate user acceptance testing with partners and close out issues before launch
  • Lead the security and privacy side of partner data access for our forward-deployed teams, including data-sharing agreements, IT security reviews and secure access to partner systems, including on-premise ones
  • Define how partner data is handled, stored, separated and deleted across deployments and model training, and make sure it is followed
  • Monitor live deployments for quality, reliability, abuse and safety failures, and set up dashboards and alerting with engineering
  • Lead the response when a safety or security issue occurs, with clear communication to the partner throughout
  • Work closely with Research, Product and our security team, so new models and features ship with security built in
  • Turn each deployment into reusable guardrails, tests and documentation, so the next partner goes faster

job.name: Développeur Système Embarqué Cybersécurité
job.description:
Contexte Notre client mène des projets de recherche et développement (R&D) à forte composante technologique dans les domaines de la défense et des systèmes complexes. Ces initiatives reposent notamment sur les technologies numériques, les systèmes embarqués et l’intelligence artificielle, et nécessitent une expertise pointue dans l’analyse d’architectures complexes et la cybersécurité.

Dans ce contexte, tu rejoindras une équipe multidisciplinaire composée notamment de spécialistes en développement logiciel, cybersécurité et intelligence artificielle. Tu contribueras à l’évaluation de la sécurité de plateformes embarquées et de systèmes de systèmes, dans des environnements techniques complexes où les interactions entre logiciels, matériels et équipements doivent être prises en compte.

Tes Responsabilités

  • Participer à la rétro-ingénierie (reverse engineering) de systèmes logiciels ou matériels embarqués afin d’en comprendre le fonctionnement et d’identifier leurs vulnérabilités potentielles.
  • Réaliser des tests d’intrusion (penetration testing) sur des systèmes et plateformes embarqués afin d’identifier les vulnérabilités et de recommander des mesures correctives.
  • Concevoir, développer et assembler des bancs de test destinés aux activités de cybersécurité.
  • Effectuer des tests permettant de confirmer et de caractériser les vulnérabilités identifiées, notamment au moyen de méthodes observationnelles ou destructives.
  • Développer de nouveaux outils et proposer des techniques de test innovantes afin d’améliorer l’efficacité des tests d’intrusion existants.
  • Développer des outils permettant de communiquer avec les systèmes embarqués ou d’en analyser le comportement.
  • Participer aux activités de rétro-ingénierie au sein d’une équipe multidisciplinaire afin d’identifier les points d’entrée potentiels dans des systèmes complexes.
  • Concevoir, programmer et tester des logiciels pouvant être déployés sur des systèmes embarqués.
  • Développer des méthodes permettant de démontrer l’impact potentiel d’une vulnérabilité de sécurité sur une plateforme testée ainsi que sur les systèmes auxquels elle est connectée.
  • Documenter les activités réalisées et communiquer efficacement les résultats des tests, les vulnérabilités découvertes et les recommandations associées.
  • Contribuer activement au bon déroulement des activités d’une équipe Agile, notamment lors des Sprint Planning, Daily Meetings, Sprint Reviews et Sprint Retrospectives.
  • Réaliser l’ensemble de ces activités conformément aux bonnes pratiques techniques et méthodologiques de l’équipe.

Profil Recherché

his position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Security Operations Engineer based in Canada. In this role, you will own Tier 2 detection engineering, incident response, threat hunting, and the development of a comprehensive data loss prevention (DLP) program. You will strengthen the organization's ability to protect sensitive financial and investor information while improving visibility across endpoints, cloud infrastructure, identity systems, and SaaS applications. Accountabilities

  • Own Tier 2 detection engineering within Google SecOps, developing, testing, and tuning detection rules and correlation logic, reducing false positives, and maintaining a detection catalog mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Develop playbooks, runbooks, escalation criteria, and operational procedures for Tier 1 analysts, while serving as the Tier 2 escalation point for investigations and complex triage decisions until the analyst desk is fully established.
  • Lead the technical transition from managed detection and response services to internal security operations by assessing existing detection coverage, rebuilding or replacing detections in Google SecOps, defining transition criteria, and validating coverage before handover.
  • Design, implement, and maintain a data loss prevention program across Google Workspace, endpoints, SaaS applications, cloud storage, and data shared with AI tools.
  • Classify sensitive information, including investor personally identifiable information, fund financial records, payment instructions, and credentials, and develop DLP policies and response procedures tailored to real business workflows.
  • Automate security operations using Python, REST APIs, alert enrichment, triage and response automation, detections-as-code, version control, and testing.
  • Build and maintain integrations between Google SecOps, CrowdStrike, Cloudflare, Upwind, identity providers such as Okta, and Jira.
  • Lead and continuously improve threat hunting initiatives across endpoint, identity, cloud, and SaaS telemetry, translating investigation findings into durable detection capabilities.
  • Serve as a senior incident responder, leading investigations that involve endpoint and cloud forensics, timeline reconstruction, containment, and post-incident repor

job.description:
About Owner Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants.

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.

Product philosophy Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.

Our vision We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.

But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.

Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.

In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.

job.description:
Role: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer – Voice Role Overview We are looking for a Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to own the reliability, scalability, and performance of our voice infrastructure. This is a highly technical individual contributor role combining deep cloud infrastructure expertise with a specialised focus on real-time voice systems, SIP/VoIP technologies, and media processing pipelines.

You will be responsible for managing and maintaining the cloud infrastructure that powers our voice platform — ensuring carrier-grade availability, low-latency call routing, and seamless integration with downstream systems. The role requires both technical depth and a proactive operational mindset, with ownership of platform stability, automation, security, and cost optimisation across all voice-related services.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and maintain the cloud infrastructure supporting voice services, including SIP trunking, media servers, and real-time communications (RTC) components.
  • Own the availability, reliability, and performance of production voice systems — ensuring low latency, high availability, and minimal packet loss.
  • Lead capacity planning and scaling strategies for voice workloads, including handling traffic spikes and concurrent call volume growth.
  • Manage cloud environments across development, staging, and production with a focus on voice-specific infrastructure (e.g. FreeSWITCH, Kamailio, Asterisk, WebRTC gateways).
  • Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation to provision and manage voice infrastructure.
  • Implement cloud security best practices including IAM, network segmentation, TLS/SRTP enforcement, and secrets management across voice services.
  • Monitor voice infrastructure health using specialised observability tooling — tracking call quality metrics (MOS, jitter, latency, packet loss) alongside standard platform metrics.
  • Identify and resolve voice-specific incidents including call drops, codec negotiation failures, NAT traversal issues, and signalling faults.
  • Optimise cloud infrastructure costs related to voice workloads — including media transcoding, PSTN connectivity, and real-time media relay.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to support the rollout of new voice features and integrations.
  • Improve platform automation and developer tooling to accelerate deployment and reduce operational toil across the voice stack.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer in Test
job.description:
About Rocketlane

Rocketlane is a B2B SaaS platform for client onboarding and project delivery. Our product runs on a set of microservices that power projects, resourcing, time tracking, billing and a customer-facing portal. We're also building Nitro, an AI-native layer where Nitro agents do real delivery work for our customers.

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer in Test who can test both: the core platform, and the GenAI and agentic features we build on top of it.

This is not a "run the regression suite and file tickets" role. You'll own quality for the areas you cover, from functional testing to automation to release sign-off.

What you'll own

  • Functional testing: Understand features end to end, from requirements to edge cases. Write test plans and test cases, and run exploratory testing before every release.
  • UI and end-to-end automation: Build and maintain Playwright suites in TypeScript for critical user journeys. Keep them fast, stable and free of flaky tests.
  • API and microservices testing: Test REST APIs and the contracts between services. Cover authentication, permissions, data validation and error handling.
  • Distributed systems testing: Test asynchronous flows, background jobs and event-driven workflows across services. Check for data consistency, retries, idempotency and behaviour when a downstream service fails or slows down.
  • Performance and reliability: Run load and performance tests on key services and workflows. Find bottlenecks before customers do.
  • GenAI and agentic testing: Test Nitro agents and other GenAI features for accuracy, consistency and safe behaviour. Build eval suites, curate test datasets from real scenarios, and check tool-use accuracy and handoff to humans.
  • CI/CD and release quality: Wire automated suites into CI so every change is checked before it ships. Provide quality sign-off for the areas you cover.
  • Frameworks and documentation: Enhance our existing test frameworks and tools. Document test strategies, test cases and guidelines for the team.

Requirements

Location: Kolkata

Experience: 8–12 years

Organisation: iKure Techsoft Pvt. Ltd.

About iKure

Founded in 2010, iKure is a technology-enabled healthcare enterprise connecting community-based healthcare, digital technology and real-world research. Through its network of community health workers (iCHAs), clinics and proprietary WHIMS platform, iKure has served over 4.5 million patients across 11 Indian states. Today, iKure is evolving into a collaborative healthcare innovation platform, working with global researchers, universities, healthcare companies, innovators, foundations and public institutions to develop, validate and scale healthcare solutions. Our growing portfolio spans primary healthcare, non-communicable diseases, maternal and child health, digital health, implementation research and real-world evidence generation.

Why This Role Matters

As iKure expands its healthcare network, research partnerships and innovation programmes, the opportunity to generate meaningful evidence from real-world healthcare delivery is growing significantly. We seek a senior professional who can bring together research, programme data, strategic analysis and resource mobilisation. This person will lead high-quality research and grant proposals, strengthen monitoring and information systems, generate actionable insights from field data and support collaborations with national and international institutions. The role combines scientific thinking, analytical rigour, strong writing and the ability to translate research opportunities into well-designed, funded programmes.

Key Responsibilities

Research Strategy & Design: Lead research planning, study concepts, methodologies, evidence reviews, implementation research and real-world evidence initiatives across iKure programmes.

Proposal Development & Grant Writing: Identify national and international funding opportunities; independently develop research proposals, concept notes, technical narratives, logical frameworks, budgets and grant applications with relevant teams.

Data Analysis & Insights: Analyse healthcare, programme and operational data to identify trends, gaps, performance patterns and opportunities to improve delivery.

MIS & Performance Dashboards: Strengthen reporting systems, indicator definitions, data quality, dashboards and analytical reporting across programmes and partnerships.

Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning: Develop results frameworks, baselines, indicators, outcome assessments and evidence-generation plans for funded programmes.

Institutional Research Partnerships: Coordinate research collaborations with universities, healthcare companies, foundations, academic institutions and global research partners.

Publications & Knowledge Products: Lead research reports, policy briefs, white papers, case studies, manuscripts and presentations for scientific and non-scientific audiences.

job.name: Lead Engineer, AI Security
job.description:
Job Description Position Summary As the Lead Engineer, AI Security, you will secure the digital fabric enabling our company’s rapid AI transformation. You will focus entirely on discovering, managing, and securing machine identities, service accounts, API keys, and automated tokens.

A primary objective in this role is mapping and restricting data access rights for non-human actors—both independent automated systems and AI agents operating on behalf of human users. You will act as the critical bridge between core identity security operations and our AI enablement initiatives, ensuring that tools like Microsoft Copilot and emerging LLM technologies operate under strict least-privilege principles.

Core Responsibilities

  • NHI Governance & Lifecycle: Discover, inventory, and classify all non-human identities, including Azure/Entra Enterprise Applications, AWS IAM Roles, service accounts, and API keys.
  • Data Rights & Privilege Mapping: Analyze, map, and audit the data rights/permissions held by NHIs to understand what sensitive data they can access, either independently or through inheritance from their human owners.
  • AI & Copilot Guardrails: Partner with the AI Enablement team to define and enforce access controls for Microsoft Copilot and future AI models, ensuring AI agents cannot access or expose restricted corporate data.
  • Least-Privilege Enforcement: Design and implement automated policies to remediate over-privileged service accounts and eliminate "privilege creep" within AWS and Microsoft environments.
  • Blast Radius Reduction: Formulate strategies to untangle complex human-to-machine permission chains, ensuring a compromised human account does not inadvertently grant an AI or machine identity elevated data rights.
  • Monitoring & Incident Response: Establish continuous monitoring for anomalous NHI behavior and integrate machine identity alerts that facilitate the AI Observability and Runtime monitoring requirements of the security operations pipeline.

Required Technical Experience

  • Cloud Identity Infrastructure: Deep, hands-on experience managing identity frameworks in AWS IAM and Azure AD / Entra ID (specifically Workload Identities, App Registrations, and Managed Identities).
  • Data Security & Governance: Proven experience auditing data access paths, file-share permissions, or cloud data store policies (S3, Azure Blob, SharePoint/OneDrive permission structures) and utilizing tools such as Microsoft Purview or Cyera (or equivalent DSPM platforms).
  • AI Security Context: Familiarity with the security implications of AI deployment, data ingestion pipelines, and how tools like Microsoft Copilot inherit user-level permissions.
  • Automation & Scripting: Proficiency in scripting (e.g., Python, PowerShell) or using API-driven tools to automate the discovery and rotation of machine credentials.

Preferred Qualifications

job.name: Senior Security Engineer, Enterprise Security
job.description:
Beacon is looking for a Sr. Security Engineer, Enterprise Security to join our enterprise security team and work alongside its lead. You will build the monitoring and response systems that let a small team cover the corporate environment and cloud infrastructure at Beacon and across the companies in our portfolio, hands-on and engineering first.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build the monitoring. Bring telemetry from endpoints, identity, SaaS, cloud, and email into one place, close coverage gaps, and keep the pipeline healthy as new companies join.
  • Own detection content. Write and tune detections for account takeover, session token theft, malicious OAuth grants, admin abuse, and misuse of legitimate access, and measure and cut the noise.
  • Scale response. Build the playbooks, automation, and case management that let a small team handle incidents across many companies, with incident access set up in advance. Join the on-call rotation.
  • Cut manual alert review with automation and AI-assisted triage.
  • Map attack paths across separate systems, such as a phishing email that leads to a compromised engineering admin account and then a change to a cloud workload that delivers malware, and close the links in the chain that matter most.Report on all of it. Build dashboards and metrics on coverage, detection quality, response time, and security posture, for leadership and for each company.
  • Set the security standards for endpoint, identity, SaaS, and cloud, and verify them. Work with IT and Corporate Engineering, who run those systems, to get gaps fixed, and check that the fixes hold.
  • Manage security configuration as code, with drift detection across SaaS and cloud, so controls are repeatable and auditable.
  • Govern third-party integrations, OAuth grants, and non-human identities, and review new vendors for security risk.
  • Run the security baseline for newly acquired companies and bring them into the monitoring.

What We Are Looking For

  • About 4 to 7 years in enterprise security, detection and response, or security engineering.
  • Has built and run detection content and a telemetry pipeline, and measured detection quality.
  • Has built response playbooks and automation, and taken part in live incident response.
  • Writes production-quality code and automates instead of configuring by hand.
  • Solid understanding of identity: OAuth, SAML, OIDC, session and token lifecycle, and how non-human identities reach cloud access.
  • Solid grasp of cloud and SaaS security, enough to judge risk across more than one environment.
  • Has built dashboards or reporting on security metrics that leadership used.
  • Treats identity, devices, SaaS, and cloud as one system, and hardens the paths between them instead of each tool alone.
  • Collaborative and direct. Gets security work done without owning the platform, working with company leaders and engineers outside your reporting line.
  • Uses AI in everyday work and has informed judgment about where it is useful.

job.name: Technical Support Engineer III

Description Aryaka is a Unified SASE as a Service company, delivering secure, high-performance connectivity for enterprises worldwide through its private core network of global points of presence (PoPs). The platform combines managed SD-WAN (SmartConnect), WAN optimization and application acceleration, a full security service edge (NGFW-SWG, IPS, anti-malware, CASB, next-gen DLP, ZTNA), and unified management and observability (SmartManage) into a single, vendor-managed service. Aryaka's Technical Assistance Center is central to delivering on that promise, providing 24x7 support to enterprise customers running mission-critical traffic across the Aryaka network.

Role Summary The Technical Support Engineer III (TSE-III) is a senior escalation-tier role within the Technical Assistance Center (TAC), responsible for resolving the most complex customer-impacting issues across Aryaka's SD-WAN, Unified SASE, and security service offerings. This person acts as the final escalation point within the TAC, working closely with Network Operations (NOC), Engineering, and Product teams to drive root-cause analysis, permanent fixes, and process improvements. The role requires deep hands-on expertise in enterprise networking and security, strong ownership of customer outcomes, and the ability to lead technical war rooms for high-severity incidents.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and resolve TSE-III-level escalations across SD-WAN, WAN optimization, and Unified SASE security services (NGFW-SWG, IPS, anti-malware, CASB, DLP, ZTNA) that could not be resolved at TSE-I/TSE-II.

  • Perform deep-dive root-cause analysis on complex network, routing, and security issues using packet captures, device logs, and platform telemetry; document findings in RCA reports.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot issues involving ANAP appliances, PoP connectivity, private core routing, BGP/OSPF peering, IPsec/SSL VPN tunnels, QoS, and multi-cloud connectivity (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Mentor and technically upskill TSE-I/TSE-II engineers; author and maintain knowledge base articles, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides.

job.name: Full Stack ai Engineer
job.description:
About the Role

Build AI-powered communication experiences using foundation models and voice AI: speech-to-clear-writing, cross-language communication and feedback on expression. Combine product engineering with prompting, evaluation and reliable AI systems. Prototype fast, learn from real usage, and improve quality, latency and cost on the shared platform. Much is still undefined, so you'll experiment and make calls without set answers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and prototype AI features, build demos/PoCs, iterate on feedback
  • Craft prompts; version prompts and model configs to trace regressions; manage context (chunking, metadata, retrieval)
  • Build hybrid rule-based + AI systems, robust pipelines for non-deterministic output, guardrails, fallbacks and human-in-the-loop workflows
  • Optimise performance and cost for API or hosted models
  • Build eval sets from real conversations, edge cases and production failures; define criteria for correctness, clarity, tone, usefulness, latency and cost; combine automated checks with human review; compare prompts and models over repeated runs
  • Monitor production for drift/regressions; turn failures into eval cases
  • Assess new models, explore fine-tuning/hosting, share learnings

Technical Requirements

Engineering : work across the full stack; quickly model unfamiliar systems (architecture, data flow, failure modes); explain and defend your design choices; review agent-written code as rigorously as your own; avoid needless abstraction and fragile design; open small, focused PRs.

AI : built products where LLMs drive the UX; know model tradeoffs; design prompts/context for consistent output; evaluate systematically and diagnose failures; monitor AI features in production.

Backend : HTTP, DNS, proxies; relational DB design; APIs, queues, cron jobs. Plus: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/GCP/DigitalOcean, WebSockets.

Frontend : strong JS, HTML, CSS fundamentals; JavaScript/TypeScript with React, Vue or Svelte; responsive design.

Strong debugging and root-cause analysis.

How We Work with AI

AI agents write most of our code; engineers direct it and own the result. You must be able to explain the architecture, data flow, failure modes and trade-offs of anything you ship, including behaviour under unusual or malicious input. Test and simplify before a PR – never pass unchecked agent output to reviewers. Prototypes move fast; production must be excellent: edge cases, copy, loading/failure states and performance. Shipping starts the feedback loop. Every team uses AI (designers/PMs prototype; Devin in Slack lets anyone explore and fix code); you'll help improve these shared tools.

Qualities We Love

  • Strong engineering judgment
  • Moves fast and finishes well
  • Cares about craft
  • Relentless about improvement
  • Delivers checked, ready-to-use work
  • Ambitious, eager to grow
  • Contributes beyond assigned tasks
  • Empathetic toward users

Why Join

Zinier’s No-Code Customization field service automation platform empowers field service organizations with the combined power of humans and technology to keep our world up and running.

NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. Today, we are tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing — an era in which our GPUs act as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that understand the world. NVIDIA's Silicon Co-Design group is seeking Execution engineers who will be supporting development and validation of product and engineering platforms for Nvidia GPUs and SOCs. About The Job Department: Technology & Product

Employment Type: Full-time

About TerraTern TerraTern is one of India’s fastest-growing Global Talent Mobility startups, helping individuals navigate international relocation with confidence. We deliver end-to-end visa support, job search guidance, and mobility resources designed for global aspirants. Transparency, precision, and client trust are the foundation of everything we build.

Role Overview We are looking for a Data Analyst who enjoys finding the story hidden in numbers. You will work with our product, tech, sales and marketing teams to turn raw data into clear answers that help us make better decisions. Freshers with good projects and a strong interest in data are welcome to apply.

Eligibility & Requirements

  • 1 to 3 years of experience in data analysis, or a fresher with strong projects, internships or a good portfolio.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Maths, Engineering or a related field.
  • Good SQL skills and comfort with Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Hands-on use of a dashboard tool such as Metabase, Power BI, Tableau or Looker Studio.
  • Basic Python or R for cleaning and analysing data is a plus, not a must.
  • Clear communication, and the ability to explain numbers to people who are not from a data background.
  • Curiosity, attention to detail and a sense of ownership over your work.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with product or marketing analytics, such as funnels, cohorts or A/B tests.
  • Experience working with CRM or lead data.
  • Interest in immigration, education or global careers.

Why Join TerraTern

  • Impactful Work: Your analysis will shape real decisions that help people reach jobs and study options abroad.

  • Entrepreneurial Culture: Share your ideas, test them and own the result.

Java + microservices — senior IC with mentorship responsibility

Company: Valeo Health

Location: Bengaluru — Work from Office (WFO)

About Valeo Health

Valeo Health is a preventive healthcare and wellness platform operating across Saudi Arabia (KSA) and the United Arab Emirates (UAE), offering diagnostics, teleconsultation, AI-driven health insights, supplements, and care programs. We are building AI-first, compliant, and scalable

healthcare platforms that handle sensitive health data while delivering reliable, high-quality customer experiences across geographies.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Backend Developer with deep experience in Java and microservices to build, scale, and operate the backend systems that power Valeo’s healthcare platform across KSA and UAE. You will own services end-to-end — design, build, ship, operate — while mentoring junior engineers and raising the technical bar of the team. This is a senior individual-contributor role focused on technical depth. You will spend most of your time writing code, designing systems, and reviewing your peers’ work. You will not manage people, but you will mentor 2–3 junior engineers, drive technical standards, and be the senior voice in architecture decisions for your area. It is the right role if you want to grow as an engineer rather than into management.

The Mindset We Hire For

These three traits matter more than any specific framework on your CV. If they don’t describe you, this is not the right role.

  • Ownership: You don’t wait for permission. When a service you own breaks, you fix it. When a junior engineer is stuck, you pair with them. When the design is unclear, you write it down.
  • Deliver Results : You measure yourself in services shipped and reliability improved, not PRs merged. You can tell us what you built last quarter, what changed for users or the business because of it, and what you would do differently.
  • Quick to Learn : You taught yourself something significant in the last three months and can describe it without preparation — a new framework, architecture pattern, or operational tool.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Ownership

  • Design, build, and operate Java-based microservices that handle sensitive healthcare data at scale.
  • Own technical design for services in your area — write design docs, lead design reviews, make architecture tradeoffs.
  • Maintain high standards for code quality, testing, observability, and operational excellence.
  • Debug production issues across services; own root-cause analysis and remediation.

job.name: Senior DevOps Engineer
job.description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.

About the Role

As a DevOps Engineer (E3), you will own the multi-cloud infrastructure, large-scale Kubernetes (k8s) deployments, CI/CD pipelines, observability, security posture, and operational reliability that power IRL's data collection, processing, and delivery workflows. This is a dedicated infrastructure and reliability engineering role focused on scaling resilient, secure, and cost-efficient systems across cloud providers—supporting a platform already processing 50+ PB of data and 600K+ hours of video.

You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Security, and Operations teams to standardize infrastructure patterns, accelerate safe deployments and leverage automation. You are someone who thrives in high-scale, fast-moving environments, brings deep ownership to production operations, and solves ambiguous infrastructure challenges from first principles.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Cloud Infrastructure operating production systems at scale.
  • Proven experience managing large Kubernetes (k8s) deployments at scale in production—including multi-cluster operations, node pool autoscaling, cluster upgrades, workload isolation, and hardening (Amazon EKS and Azure AKS strongly preferred).
  • Hands-on experience designing, provisioning, and operating multi-cloud deployments in production across multiple cloud providers (AWS and Azure strongly preferred), including cross-cloud networking, identity, and storage architectures.
  • Strong expertise in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm, or equivalent) and declarative, reproducible environment management.
  • Experience designing, maintaining, and securing CI/CD pipelines, container builds, and automated deployment/rollback workflows (e.g., CircleCI, GitHub Actions).
  • Deep understanding of cloud networking, storage, and distributed systems fundamentals—including VPC design, DNS, load balancing, ingress, object storage lifecycle, and high-throughput data infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with observability and reliability engineering: metrics, structured logging, distributed tracing, alerting, and SLO/SLI management (e.g., Datadog, OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, Prometheus/Grafana).
  • Strong cloud security and compliance foundation, including IAM/RBAC least-privilege, workload/pod identity, KMS and secrets management, network segmentation, secret/vulnerability scanning, and audit logging.

job.name: Video Platform Engineer - E3
job.description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.

About IRL (Instawork Robotics Labs)

Researchers at UC Berkeley have identified a "100,000-year data gap"—the gulf between what trained AI language models and what physical robots actually have to learn from. Closing that gap is the defining infrastructure challenge of the physical AI era. IRL is Instawork's answer to it. We deploy skilled workers into real commercial and residential environments—kitchens, warehouses, hotel floors, and homes—to capture the high-fidelity task data that the world's leading robotics labs use to train their foundation models.

About the Role

Every dataset IRL ships starts as raw video: multi-camera rigs recording a worker palletizing a warehouse order, cooking a meal, or turning over a hotel room. Many hours of synchronized streams per session, plus the telemetry captured alongside them, growing into petabytes.

As a Video Platform Engineer, you'll own the pipeline that turns that raw capture into training-ready data: ingest, transcode, time-synchronization, automate video quality checks, indexing, and delivery to the robotics labs that train on it.

This is a hybrid media-engineering and distributed-systems role. You'll make codec and container decisions. You'll design orchestration that survives a rig failing mid-session. And you'll own the cost per captured hour of processing.

You'll help shape the roadmap by working directly with the data collection teams in the field, and you'll have real say in which of their problems we solve first.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years building and operating production video or media processing systems at scale.
  • Hands-on, production experience with FFmpeg, GStreamer, or an equivalent media framework. You've built a pipeline around it and debugged it under load.
  • Fluency in codecs and containers: H.264/HEVC/AV1, MP4/fMP4, and the practical tradeoffs between them.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, object storage, and observability.
  • Strong programming and problem solving skills.
  • Experience with durable workflow orchestration (Temporal, Conductor, Step Functions, Airflow, or similar).
  • Experience designing cost-efficient architectures for large media or data workloads, and a working understanding of storage tiering, egress, capacity planning, and GPU utilization.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, and production operations.

\\*Preferred\\*

About The Project The project is an enterprise agentic chat assistant built with Salesforce Agentforce. It uses retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to answer user questions from a large library of enterprise documents, cites its sources, and declines when the documents do not support an answer.

The agent also calls tools and APIs to fetch context and complete tasks, and works alongside other agents. We want an engineer who can deliver this on Salesforce and is open to working with the wider agentic AI stack.

The role You will be the hands-on Salesforce AI engineer on a small team of architects and data, integration and platform engineers. You will design and build grounded, retrieval-based agents on Agentforce and Data 360, connect them to non-Salesforce systems, and show the customer that the answers are accurate, cited and safe.

What you will do Build and improve Agentforce agents, including their topics, instructions and actions. Set up Data 360 so the agent can search documents and answer with citations. Connect the agent to other systems through APIs and tools. Test answer quality and work with the wider team to deliver and demo the solution. Must-have skills Hands-on Agentforce delivery (production or an advanced pilot), including agent design, actions and Agent Script or prompt templates. Hands-on Data 360 (formerly Data Cloud) experience, ideally with unstructured data, search indexes and retrievers used to ground agent answers. Solid Salesforce development: Apex, Flow, permission sets, sandboxes and deployment. Working knowledge of RAG: chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, metadata filtering, citations and reducing hallucinations. Clear communication with customer architects and business stakeholders. Good to have These strengthen a profile but are not all required. A strong agentic AI engineer who can show real Agentforce and Data 360 work is a good fit even without every item.

Tech Stack You Needed:

job.name: AI Demo Engineer
job.description:
The Opportunity

Join us as an AI Demo Engineer, a truly ground-floor role where you’ll be instrumental in shaping the future of Scout, our brand-new AI product. You’ll tackle the exciting challenge of building, not just maintaining, dynamic AI-powered demonstrations that empower our Sales Engineers and directly drive deal closures. This is your chance to build a critical function from scratch, defining processes and making a tangible impact on our market approach, bringing real variety and ownership to every project.

What You'll Do

As our first AI Demo Engineer in Bangalore, you will occupy a unique, pivotal position, bridging the gap between traditional Demo Engineering and AI engineering. Your primary focus will be on constructing sophisticated agentic Scout workflows, moving beyond static demo data to craft intelligent, multi-step solutions. You will own the creation of a comprehensive library of reusable standard demo agents, complete with robust data and documentation, serving as the essential foundation for all sales demonstrations. Furthermore, you will design and implement prospect-specific agents tailored to individual deal requirements, directly contributing to successful sales outcomes. A crucial part of your role involves maintaining the main demo template, ensuring it remains current, functional after platform updates, and populated with fresh data and golden records. Beyond building, you will become a diagnostic expert, analyzing prospect usage within Proof-of-Concept (POC) instances, identifying why a solution might not be landing, and expertly tuning agents, data, and configurations to optimize outcomes and secure conversions. You won't inherit a fixed process; instead, you'll help define the operating model for this critical new team function.

The Skills You'll Have

Agentic AI / Scout Configuration

  • You'll build or configure at least one agentic AI workflow, demonstrating proficiency with agents that plan, call tools, and complete multi-step tasks
  • You'll possess hands-on prompt engineering experience, having written and iterated prompts/instructions for LLM-based tools
  • You'll have a basic understanding of MCP (Multi-Cloud Platform) or comparable tool-calling/connector patterns
  • You'll have designed multi-system agentic workflows end-to-end, showcasing your ability to move beyond single-agent/single-tool solutions
  • You'll have built or worked directly with MCP connectors, leveraging your deep technical expertise

Business Translation & Demo Enablement

job.name: AI Engineer
job.description:
About The Job Department : Technology & Product

Employment Type: Full-time

About TerraTern TerraTern is one of India’s fastest-growing Global Talent Mobility startups, helping individuals navigate international relocation with confidence. We deliver end-to-end visa support, job search guidance, and mobility resources designed for global aspirants. Transparency, precision, and client trust are the foundation of everything we build.

Role Overview We are looking for an AI Engineer to build products that use large language models to help people plan their move abroad. You will work with our product and tech teams to take an idea from a rough sketch to a working feature that real users rely on. Freshers with good projects and a strong interest in AI are welcome to apply.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build AI features using LLM APIs, such as chat assistants, document readers and smart search.
  • Set up RAG systems so our AI answers from TerraTern’s own trusted information.
  • Create AI agents and workflows that handle repeat tasks for our users and our team.
  • Connect AI features to our website, apps and internal tools through clean APIs.
  • Test every feature on real questions, and fix wrong or unclear answers before users see them.
  • Watch speed, cost and accuracy after launch, and bring all three in line.
  • Work with product managers and designers so each feature is easy to use and solves a real problem.

Eligibility & Requirements

  • 1 to 3 years of experience building software or AI applications, or a fresher with strong projects, internships or open-source work.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI or a related field.
  • Good Python skills, and comfort with APIs, Git and a database.
  • Hands-on use of at least one LLM API such as OpenAI, Claude or Gemini.
  • Basic understanding of embeddings, vector search and prompt design.
  • Clear communication, and the ability to explain technical ideas in simple words.
  • Curiosity, ownership and a habit of finishing what you start.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, n8n or similar tools.
  • A deployed AI project, even a small personal one.
  • Interest in immigration, education or global careers.

Why Join TerraTern

  • Impactful Work: Build tools that help people reach jobs and study options abroad.
  • Professional Growth: Learn from the team and work on real AI products from day one.
  • Entrepreneurial Culture: Share your ideas, try them out and own the result.
  • Collaborative Environment: Work closely with product, sales and operations in a team that likes to learn together.

job.name: Director, Data Science
job.description:
About Team Catalog Data Science team is part of the broader Catalog organization in Walmart. The team is focused on using the latest research in Generative AI (GenAI), Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), statistics, Deep Learning, Computer Vision and Optimization to implement solutions that ensure Walmart’s product catalog is accurate, complete, and optimized for customer experience. Our team tackles complex data science and ML engineering challenges related to product classification, attribute extraction, trust & safety, and catalog optimization, empowering next-generation retail use cases. We are building the next generation of omni-retail platforms to deliver performance and value at scale.

We partner with our product and engineering teams to drive significant measurable business impact. Advanced AI/ML algorithms/models driven by our team help Walmart to optimize experimentation and insights frameworks, business practices, reduce cost and pass those benefits to our customers. The Data Science and ML Engineering community at Walmart Global Tech is active in most of the Hack events, utilizing the petabytes of data at our disposal, to build some of the coolest ideas. All the work we do at Walmart will eventually benefit our operations & our associates, helping Customers Save Money to Live Better.

What You'll Do

  • As a Director of Data Science, you’ll have the opportunity to be part of leadership team for the Catalog data science team. You will be focused on experimenting and applying machine learning techniques to improve effectiveness of competitive intelligence data. The successful candidate will be able influence algorithm development that will shape our next-gen competitive intelligence. Additionally, the role will entail the following responsibilities:
  • Lead and deliver on Walmart’s strategic priorities, balancing timelines, resourcing, cost, quality and scope, towards customer and business OKRs.

Coaching and developing high-performance team: Lead several teams of data scientists and engineers to ensure business deliverables are met. Train, develop and coach managers and individual contributors on technical and professional skills.

Business Thought Partnership: Provide thought leadership and counsel to stakeholders in exploring possible data solutions to address business questions and business needs. Define problem statement. Translate business requirements into data / analytic strategies, initiatives, and projects, align them to business team’s strategy and objectives. Synthesize data from different sources, provide actionable business insights and / or analytic solution to stakeholders.

job.name: Lead Python Developer
job.description:
Role: Lead Python Developer

Experience: 7–12 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

Role Type: Hands-on Technical Lead

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Lead Python Developer to design, develop, and manage Python-based bots and enterprise automation solutions. The role involves building scalable automation frameworks that integrate with multiple enterprise applications, REST APIs, databases, and external systems.

The candidate will be responsible for owning the complete automation lifecycle, from requirement analysis and technical design to development, integration, testing, deployment, and production support.

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Python development, API and system integration, workflow automation, and production engineering, along with the ability to lead a team technically while remaining hands-on with coding and troubleshooting.

Key Responsibilities

1. BOT & Automation Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation solutions using Python.
  • Build bots to automate complex business processes involving multiple enterprise applications.
  • Develop reusable Python frameworks, libraries, and components rather than relying on standalone scripts.
  • Automate file processing, data transformation, reconciliation, validations, and business workflows.
  • Implement robust exception handling, retries, timeouts, and recovery mechanisms.
  • Ensure idempotency to prevent duplicate business transactions.
  • Implement transaction-level logging, audit trails, and execution tracking.

2. API & System Integration

  • Develop and integrate Python applications with REST APIs, SOAP/Web Services, databases, and enterprise applications.
  • Work with JSON/XML payloads and authentication mechanisms such as OAuth 2.0, JWT, and API Keys.
  • Integrate upstream and downstream applications using APIs, databases, SFTP/file-based interfaces, and messaging systems.
  • Understand and manage end-to-end integration workflows, including data mapping, processing, validation, and reconciliation.
  • Troubleshoot integration issues involving:
  • HTTP errors (400, 401, 403, 404, 429, 500, 502, 504).
  • API timeouts, rate limiting, and authentication failures.
  • Payload and data-mapping errors.
  • Partial or failed downstream processing.
  • Duplicate transactions and network/SSL issues.
  • Retry, recovery, and reconciliation failures.

3. Technical Leadership

Lead Full Stack Engineer

6-8 years | Bangalore (onsite)

About TutorCloud

TutorCloud is an AI-powered education company building for K-12. We believe AI should give teachers more time and a clearer picture of how each student is learning, not just hand out answers.

Our platform connects students, teachers, parents and administrators in one place. Students get an AI personal tutor that adapts to their level. Teachers get productivity tools like a lesson planner and question paper creation, which take over repetitive work so they can focus on teaching. Parents get clear visibility into their child's learning.

Why this team exists: our B2B platform is built. This pod's job is to take that existing product and make it work for individual parents and teachers, launching it directly to them in a new market. You won't be starting from zero, but you won't be maintaining something either. You'll be deciding what to reuse, what to rebuild, and what to design fresh for a very different kind of user.

You'll work from our Bangalore office in a small, focused team where engineers own features end to end and see their work reach real families and classrooms.

The role

You'll be the technical owner of the B2C platform, reporting to the Head of Engineering and working day to day with the B2C Product Manager.

What you'll do

  • Take our B2B product, built for a few thousand users, and prepare it for a far larger consumer market, deciding what to reuse, rebuild or design fresh
  • Make the architecture and system design decisions that let the platform scale reliably
  • Own CI/CD, releases and DevOps on Azure
  • Lead PR reviews and set engineering standards, making sure everything that ships is understood by whoever wrote it, whether or not an AI tool helped
  • Mentor two full stack engineers and a QA engineer in fundamentals and debugging, while staying hands-on in the code
  • Turn product goals into technical plans, instrument product events, and design APIs with a future mobile app in mind

What success looks like

  • 30 days: you understand the B2B codebase and what the B2C platform needs from it
  • 60 days: a release pipeline is in place, code review standards are agreed, and the first B2C features are shipping
  • 4-5 months: the Parent and Teacher products are live, with analytics in place and a platform that can scale

job.name: Ingénieur test logiciel
job.description:
Description De L'entreprise CS Group Canada, filiale de CS Group et membre du groupe Sopra Steria, est un acteur clé en sûreté de fonctionnement et en cybersécurité pour les entreprises développant des technologies embarquées critiques (avionique, conduite autonome, électrification des transports).

Nos clients incluent des équipementiers (OEM) et des fournisseurs de rang 1 dans les secteurs de l’aérospatiale, de l’automobile, de la défense et du ferroviaire, qui recherchent des certifications en sûreté de fonctionnement (ISO 26262, DO-178C, DO-254, ARP-4761, ARP-4754, EN50128) et en cybersécurité (DO-326A, ISO 21434, UN-R155) afin de commercialiser leurs technologies.

Description Du Poste Nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur en test de logiciels soucieux du détail pour rejoindre notre équipe à Montréal. En tant que membre de notre département Verification et Validation logiciel, vous jouerez un rôle important en assurant la fiabilité et la performance de nos applications logicielles embarquées pour les systèmes aéronautiques et spatiaux.

Responsabilitiés :

  • Élaborer et exécuter des plans et des cas d'essai complets pour les applications logicielles intégrées.
  • Effectuer des tests de logiciels conformément aux meilleures pratiques.
  • Assurer la traçabilité entre la conception logicielle et les tests.
  • Rédiger la documentation technique, y compris les rapports d'essai et les résultats des vérifications
  • Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour améliorer la qualité et l'efficacité des logiciels
  • Participer à l'amélioration continue de la performance de l'équipe (qualité, efficacité, respect des délais).
  • Collaborer avec des équipes de développement travaillant en mode sprint. Le TDD est un atout (Test Driven Development).
  • Fournir régulièrement aux chefs de projet des mises à jour sur l'état d'avancement des travaux et des évaluations de la charge de travail.

Qualifications

  • Baccalauréat en génie, en aéronautique, en systèmes et réseaux ou dans un domaine connexe
  • Minimum 5 ans d'expérience en vérification et validation de logiciels de télécommunication, incluant une expérience significative avec Python et Pytest.
  • Connaissance de Jira et Confluence
  • Expérience pertinente relative à la section sol des systèmes de satellite (antenne, terminal utilisateur …), ou system de télécommunication équivalent.
  • Exposition aux outils de QA (CI/CD) et à l’intégration des outils (GitHub/GitLab, runners, checkers)
  • Expérience avec le Cycle de développement logiciel (SDLC)

Informations complémentaires Dans cette annonce, l’emploi du masculin pour désigner des personnes n’a d’autres fins que celle d’alléger le texte.

La connaissance de l’anglais est requise pour assurer les échanges professionnels avec nos clients et partenaires situés à l’extérieur du Québec, ainsi que pour participer aux activités techniques liées aux projets concernés.

Read the full description

Sonatest recherche un.e spécialiste en assurance qualité

Qui sommes-nous?

Sonatest est une entreprise technologique basée à Québec, reconnue à l’échelle mondiale pour ses solutions de tests non destructifs (NDT). Nos produits sont utilisés dans des secteurs critiques comme l’aéronautique, l’énergie et le transport. Dans un marché où plusieurs leaders sont regroupés à Québec, Sonatest se démarque par ses choix technologiques audacieux et son esprit d’innovation.

Notre force ? Une équipe de développement brillante, engagée et agile, où chaque membre a l’occasion de contribuer de façon concrète et significative. Pour en savoir plus : www.sonatest.com.

Tu aimes comprendre le fonctionnement des systèmes, détecter les problèmes et trouver des solutions pour améliorer la qualité des produits?

Tu es passionné.e par la technologie et tu souhaites jouer un rôle concret dans la fiabilité et l'évolution de produits utilisés partout dans le monde?

Au sein de l'équipe de développement, tu contribueras à assurer la qualité et la fiabilité de nos solutions technologiques. job.name: Senior System Software Engineer - AV Platform
job.description:
The Autonomous Vehicles Platform team is looking for a hands-on System Software Engineer. As part of our team, you will work on our Autonomous Driving Platform software, implementing performant and scalable solutions for data collection and autonomous vehicle fleets. Our team is responsible for developing platform and middleware features for self-driving cars. This includes software that interacts with various sensors including Cameras, LIDAR, RADAR, GPS, IMU, Vehicle CAN etc.

We are seeking candidates with interests in inventing, developing, and maintaining application framework and tools on multi-computer and heterogeneous architectures. The role encompasses working with various teams across the stack, from platform and embedded software to cloud infrastructure, underpinned by safety and performance. It extends an opportunity to contribute to the technology that will drive the cars of the future!

What You'll Be Doing

  • Integrating sensors into our AV driving software stack.
  • Develop and improve startup user experience of our AV stack.
  • Work on areas such as sensor abstraction layers, data processing & performance optimization, data serialization, and service frameworks.
  • Collaborate with hardware, platform software, product, safety, performance, algorithms and cloud teams.

What We Need To See

  • BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years of professional experience working on system software.
  • Excellent programming skills in C++, C and Python.
  • Familiarity with source control tools.
  • Solid understanding of Linux, QNX, ROS, and/or real-time operating systems.
  • Experience in developing user-space system software, with a willingness to delve into kernel-space and/or low-level hardware when needed.
  • Knowledge about embedded system programming, threading, mutex, synchronization, communication, and parallel computing to build highly-scalable and efficient applications.
  • Familiarity with hardware architecture for CPU/GPU and memory alongside performance.
  • Prior experience working in the following areas: Autonomous Vehicles, Robotics, Self-Driving-Cars, GPU technology, Embedded Systems, Computer Vision.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

  • Deep understanding of system architecture, CPU/GPU/Memory/Storage, everything related to performance optimization.
  • Experience in Autonomous Vehicle or Robotic System Building.
  • Hands-on experience in embedded development, operating systems and real-time software.

job.name: Test Engineer
job.description:
Job Title: Test Engineer

Overview The Test Engineer is responsible for the design and development of automated test systems within a high-volume manufacturing environment. This role partners with Test Engineering and Product Design teams to develop testing strategies, validate products, and support production launches.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop testing concepts and inspection requirements alongside Design, Controls, and Industrial Engineering teams.
  • Create electrical schematics and test hardware interfaces using EPLAN Electric.
  • Develop software utilizing LabVIEW and NI TestStand.
  • Design diagnostic and performance tests for automotive electronics products, including steering wheel switches, climate control panels, and start/stop buttons.
  • Work with vision systems, force/travel measurement systems, laser marking, and vehicle communication bus technologies.
  • Commission equipment through PLC integration and I/O verification.
  • Perform system setup, software installation, calibration, and communications validation.
  • Support production launches by providing training and technical knowledge transfer.
  • Participate in the design, development, documentation, and implementation of test methods and systems.
  • Assist with additional controls engineering projects as needed.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in automated test equipment, electronic product testing, or automotive electronics manufacturing.
  • Hands-on programming experience with LabVIEW and NI TestStand.
  • Strong background in electronic design and test development.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively in a cross-functional engineering environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with RF and microwave design/test techniques.
  • Knowledge of yield analysis, process controls, and statistical methods (Cp/Cpk).
  • Familiarity with PLCs and controls engineering.

Top Skills

  • LabVIEW
  • Test Engineering
  • Electronic Design

Additional Skills

  • Automated Test Equipment (ATE)

Location: Hyderabad, India

Immediate joiners preferred

POSITION OVERVIEW

Anblicks is seeking a motivated and analytical Data Scientist to develop, validate, and maintain statistical models and analytical solutions that transform complex datasets into actionable business insights. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in applied statistics, Python or R, SQL, machine learning, and exploratory data analysis, with an interest in solving business problems through data-driven methodologies.

In this role, you will work with large and diverse datasets to support predictive modeling, statistical analysis, causal inference, and performance measurement. You will collaborate with Data Engineers, senior Data Scientists, and cross-functional teams to develop reliable analytical workflows, validate data quality, and deliver repeatable, scalable data science solutions. Exposure to marketing analytics, attribution modeling, and privacy-conscious data analysis will be an added advantage.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Primary Responsibilities: Data Science and Measurement Analytics

  • Support the design, development, testing, and validation of statistical and machine learning models for business measurement and analytical use cases.
  • Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA), data preprocessing, feature engineering, and statistical analysis on large, complex datasets.
  • Apply statistical modeling, hypothesis testing, experimental design, and causal inference techniques to identify patterns, measure outcomes, and generate actionable insights.
  • Develop and evaluate models supporting incrementality and lift analysis, multi-touch attribution (MTA), marketing mix modeling (MMM), and rules-based attribution, where applicable.
  • Analyze data from multiple sources, including customer interactions, media exposure, commerce, engagement, and business outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering teams to validate data quality, feature pipelines, data transformations, and model input datasets.
  • Support the integration and validation of new data sources and partner feeds into analytical and modeling workflows.
  • Evaluate model performance using appropriate statistical metrics, validation techniques, and performance benchmarks.
  • Monitor deployed models and analytical workflows, identify data or performance issues, and recommend improvements.
  • Document analytical methodologies, modeling assumptions, experiments, results, and reusable best practices.
  • Translate business requirements into analytical problems and communicate findings, insights, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Secondary Responsibilities: Identity Analytics and Privacy-Aware Data Science

job.name: Serdes Validation Engineer # 26-29039
job.description:
**Duration- 12 Months

Description:**

  • We are seeking a senior-level contractor to lead SoC-level testing and bring-up of copackaged optics (CPO) SerDes interfaces.
  • The role focuses on developing automated Python-based test frameworks, executing lab validation, and collaborating across silicon, firmware, and system teams.
  • Familiarity with UCIe and PCIe is important, along with experience leveraging AI-assisted tools for bring-up and debugging.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own SoC-level validation and bring-up of high-speed SerDes interfaces for copackaged optics, including test planning, execution, and reporting
  • Develop robust automated test suites in Python (e.g., pytest-based frameworks) to exercise SerDes PHY, link training, loopback, PRBS, margining, and stress tests
  • Perform signal integrity and link characterization using lab equipment (oscilloscopes, BERTs, VNAs, protocol analyzers), and analyze eye diagrams, jitter, BER, and equalization settings
  • Validate protocol-level behavior and interoperability for UCIe (die-to-die) and PCIe (preferably Gen5/Gen6), including link bring-up, error handling, and compliance testing
  • Collaborate with firmware and RTL/DFT teams to triage issues across layers (PHY, link, protocol), use JTAG, logic analyzers, and debug tools to isolate defects
  • Contribute to test infrastructure: CI integration, test data capture, dashboards, and automated analysis; improve test coverage and reliability
  • Apply AI-assisted bring-up tools and workflows (LLM-based assistants, log analyzers, pattern detection) to accelerate root cause analysis and test development
  • Generate clear documentation: test plans, procedures, results, and failure analysis; present findings and drive corrective actions

Required Qualifications:

  • Deep knowledge of SerDes/PHY concepts: equalization, CDR, CTLE/DFE, FEC, link training, margining, PRBS patterns, BER measurements
  • Strong Python skills for test automation (pytest/unittest, instrumentation control via SCPI/VISA, data parsing, plotting, and result management)
  • Experience setting up and using lab equipment (oscilloscopes, BERT, protocol analyzers, pattern generators, power supplies) and automating measurements
  • Working knowledge of UCIe (die-to-die) and PCIe protocols (preferably Gen5/Gen6): link training, LTSSM, error counters, compliance tests, and interoperability
  • Demonstrated ability to bring up complex SoCs: reading schematics, using JTAG and boundary scan, handling power sequencing, clocks/resets, and firmware interaction
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools in bring-up/debug contexts (e.g., LLM-based code/log assistants, automated triage/analysis pipelines) and integrating them into workflows
  • Experience testing copackaged optics or closely related optical/electrical high-speed links preferred; comfortable with optical modules, connectors, and SI considerations
  • Excellent problem-solving, documentation, and cross-functional communication skills

job.name: Wireless Validation Engineer
job.description:
Our client is seeking a Wireless Validation Engineer to join their team. As a Wireless Validation Engineer, you will be part of the Engineering team supporting Wireless System Validation and Protocol Compliance. The ideal candidate will have a strong drive to solve complex technical problems, a commitment to precise documentation, and the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering and vendor partners.

Job Title: Wireless Validation Engineer

Location: Foster City, CA

Pay Range: $75-$80/hour + Benefits

What's the Job?

  • Design, specify, and execute comprehensive unit and system-level validation test plans for wireless technologies including 4G-LTE, 5G-NR (NSA/SA), Wi-Fi 6/6E, and GNSS, as well as high-speed Automotive Ethernet.
  • Deeply collaborate with system architects, chipset vendors, and network module suppliers to characterize RF performance, evaluate Quality of Service (QoS) parameters, benchmark throughput, and root-cause protocol-level failure modes.
  • Develop and maintain automated validation frameworks using SCPI commands, Python, and specialized APIs to run repeatable test scenarios on leading cellular and wireless network simulators (e.g., Keysight, Rohde & Schwarz).
  • Perform failure mode analysis (FMEA) for anomalies and failed test cases, using advanced log collection and post-processing tools to identify root causes across PHY, MAC, and higher-layer protocol behavior.
  • Reproduce intermittent or field-reported issues in controlled lab environments using network simulators and signal playback tools, then partner with external suppliers to drive defect reporting, verify firmware patches, and confirm resolutions in subsequent test iterations.

What's Needed?

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field.
  • At least 8 years of hands-on embedded system experience, including 6+ years specializing in wireless system testing and validation.
  • Hands-on experience configuring and developing test cases for wireless test platforms (e.g., Keysight, Rohde & Schwarz), plus experience testing and troubleshooting Automotive Ethernet systems.
  • Experience with regulatory compliance testing and network diagnostic analysis using tools such as Wireshark and Qualcomm QXDM logs, including modem log analysis with QXDM/QCAT or ShannonDM toolsets.
  • Strong protocol validation expertise across LTE and 5G NR (3GPP), including execution of test plans targeting LTE and NR-NSA/NR-SA L1/L2/L3 features (PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC, NAS), and demonstrated success analyzing IMS, VoLTE, and VoNR call flows.
