Integrity: We’re conscientious, intentional, and empathetic. Our words and actions align. That’s our character. Please don’t ask us to play another part, we’re poor actors. Compassionate: If we may borrow a quote from Theodore Roosevelt: “No one cares how much you know until they know how much you care.” Because our team is thoughtful and supportive, caring deeply for each other, our clients, and our work, this comes naturally. Inquisitive: We remain students by failing openly and turning lessons into solutions. Unconventional: For us, life isn’t what happens outside of work. Work happens inside of life and our culture erases the line often dividing the two. Authentic: Made possible only because we embody the values listed above. We’re relaxed and fun yet intensely curious and driven. Team members are placed with thought, care, and precision to ensure that Trust, Truth, and Transparency continue to represent our brand. Because of that, we continue Onward, Upward, and Skyward.

We need an Automation Test Engineer. Are you the kind of person who can’t look at a machine learning model without wanting to test it six different ways (and then automate all six)? Do your friends sigh when you bring up responsible AI? Maybe they’ve stopped asking what you do for work because the last time you went on a 20-minute tangent about bias in training data and flaky CI pipelines for neural nets.

If that sounds familiar, you might be exactly who we’re looking for.

Come join us if you're motivated to learn from others, to learn from mistakes, to be part of a future-looking and growth-oriented team.

Let's go Skyward together.

Pienomial is a next-generation AI technology company. Our flagship platform, Knolens , is a deterministic knowledge graph platform that eliminates hallucination, detects contradictions and provides full claim-level traceability. It is purpose-built for high-stakes domains.

You will combine domain expertise with technical depth to earn the customer's confidence and deliver

solutions rapidly. You will shape the solution, prove its value and own delivery success, from discovery

through proof-of-value and into early deployment.

You must understand:

  • The challenges Life Sciences customers face across the drug lifecycle

job.name: Data Engineer
job.description:
Company : SCRY AI

Location : Multiple Locations

Experience : Data Engineer

Employment Type : Full-time

About Us

SCRY AI is an innovative AI-driven technology company focused on building intelligent, scalable, and high-performance solutions. We work with modern technologies across Software Engineering, AI/ML, and Data to solve real-world business problems and deliver impactful digital products.

Role Overview

We are looking for a skilled Data Engineer with 2–3 years of experience in building scalable data pipelines, backend services, and data processing systems. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Python, SQL, ETL/ELT, API development, and database technologies, with exposure to AI/ML applications, Agentic AI, and cloud or on-premise deployments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines for processing structured and unstructured data.
  • Build data ingestion and transformation workflows using Python, SQL, and relevant data engineering frameworks.
  • Extract, clean, validate, normalize, and transform data from APIs, databases, files, and other sources.
  • Design and optimize database schemas, data models, SQL queries, joins, indexes, and aggregations.
  • Work with relational databases such as PostgreSQL/MySQL and NoSQL databases where required.
  • Develop batch and incremental data processing pipelines with appropriate error handling and recovery mechanisms.
  • Implement data quality checks, validation rules, deduplication, and reconciliation to ensure data accuracy and consistency.
  • Integrate data pipelines and AI applications with SQL/NoSQL databases, APIs, enterprise systems, and customer-specific data sources.
  • Develop Agentic AI and workflow automation solutions using frameworks such as LangChain/LlamaIndex, including tool calling and external system integrations.
  • Build and optimize backend services and APIs to support data processing, AI/ML workflows, and enterprise integrations.
  • Work directly with customers and stakeholders to understand requirements, troubleshoot issues, demonstrate solutions, and translate business needs into technical implementations.

job.name: Member of Technical Staff, Multimodal Foundation Models
job.description:
About Mecka AI Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.

We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.

We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

The role

Every capture tells a story: what someone did, when they did it and whether they completed the task. At Mecka, you’ll build vision-language and video models that turn that footage into useful annotations and catch quality issues across more video than a human team could review.

You’ll own the work from data selection and training through evaluation and production. We’re looking for someone who brings strong research instincts and the engineering skills to make models reliable at scale—and who wants to understand where they fail as much as where they succeed.

What you’ll do

  • Build models that understand the footage. You’ll develop and improve vision-language and video models for egocentric and manipulation footage.
  • Catch problems across what we collect. You’ll build model pipelines that identify capture defects, missing coverage and task errors, then check their performance against human audits.
  • Make models more reliable. You’ll use supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization and reinforcement learning to improve reliability and reasoning.
  • Turn video into useful annotations. You’ll build pipelines for captioning, temporal grounding and video annotation at scale.
  • Take experiments through to production. You’ll run large experiments on distributed GPU infrastructure, analyze the results and turn successful approaches into production systems.

What you’ll bring

  • Hands-on experience with large multimodal models. You’ve trained, fine-tuned or post-trained vision-language or multimodal models.
  • Strong deep learning fundamentals. You’re comfortable building and training models with PyTorch or JAX.
  • Experience running large experiments. You can design an experiment, see it through and draw sound conclusions from the results.
  • Familiarity with distributed training. You know your way around GPU-based development and distributed training infrastructure.
  • Research instincts and engineering discipline. You ask good questions, test your assumptions and build clean systems that hold up beyond the experiment.

Nice to have

Experience in one or more of these areas would be valuable:

  • Footage quality control: Using vision-language and video models to identify defects and gaps in captured data.
  • Video understanding and annotation: Structured captioning, temporal grounding and scene understanding.
  • Training and post-training: Reward modeling, synthetic data, and data curation and filtering for multimodal models.

Read the full description

The Role

Join our research team as a Member of Technical Staff (MTS), Finance Research, where you'll help define the frontier of AI-powered financial reasoning. This role sits at the intersection of large language models, agentic systems, and enterprise finance, with a focus on building rigorous evaluation frameworks that measure, benchmark, and advance AI performance across complex financial workflows.

You will conduct applied research, develop novel methodologies for assessing financial intelligence in AI systems, and partner closely with researchers, engineers, and product teams to shape the next generation of enterprise AI.

What You'll Be Doing

1. Design, own, and evolve evaluation frameworks for AI agents operating in financial domains, including benchmark suites, scoring methodologies, quality rubrics, and research-grade evaluation protocols.

2. Conduct original research on financial reasoning, decision-making, and workflow automation, translating findings into measurable improvements in AI system performance.

3. Develop and curate datasets, test cases, and benchmark environments that capture real-world enterprise finance challenges.

4. Collaborate with AI researchers, machine learning engineers, and product teams to evaluate, validate, and improve finance-focused models and agentic systems.

7. Stay current with advances in AI, machine learning, financial modeling, evaluation science, and agent architectures, incorporating emerging techniques into research initiatives.

8. Help establish research standards and thought leadership for enterprise financial intelligence and AI evaluation.

9. Foster a culture of scientific rigor, experimentation, and collaborative innovation within a distributed research environment.

What We're Looking For

1. Advanced degree in Finance, Economics, Financial Engineering, Quantitative Finance, or a related field (PhD strongly preferred; MBA, CFA, or equivalent expertise also considered).

2. Deep domain expertise in one or more areas of finance, including investment research, capital markets, risk management, corporate finance, accounting, or financial analysis.

3. Demonstrated experience conducting rigorous research, developing analytical methodologies, or building evaluation frameworks in finance or related quantitative disciplines.

job.name: Junior AI Engineer, Speech Models

Annual base salary: CAD $90,000 to $100,000

About the role

ALEBEX AI builds Canadian voice AI infrastructure. We are hiring a Junior AI Engineer to help develop and maintain our real time speech engine. You will work across speech recognition, end of turn detection, and speech synthesis, the components that let a voice agent hear a caller, know when to respond, and speak naturally.

You will work with our engineering team to design experiments, train and evaluate models, and bring improvements into production. The goal is to make voice conversations more accurate, responsive, and reliable.

What you’ll do

  • Develop, train, and evaluate models for speech recognition (STT), end of turn detection, and speech synthesis (TTS).
  • Help run pretraining and post training experiments. Depending on the model and the problem, these may involve supervised fine tuning (SFT), direct preference optimization (DPO), group relative policy optimization (GRPO), or on policy self distillation (OPSD).
  • Prepare and check speech and text datasets for training and evaluation.
  • Build evaluation tools to measure recognition accuracy, voice quality, turn taking, and response latency. Use the results to identify errors and test improvements.
  • Write, test, and maintain Python code for training pipelines and model services. Help improve inference speed and troubleshoot issues that appear in production.
  • Review relevant speech and language model research and test ideas that can improve the product.

What you’ll bring

  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch or a comparable deep learning framework.
  • A solid foundation in machine learning and neural network training, with a project where you trained or adapted a model and evaluated the results.
  • Experience writing, testing, and debugging code, and the ability to explain your experimental choices and findings.
  • A degree in computer science, engineering, statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Relevant coursework, internships, research, and independent projects count.

Nice to have

  • Experience with speech or audio, including speech recognition, speech synthesis, audio processing, speech tokenization, or streaming systems.
  • Exposure to GPU or distributed training, model serving, or inference optimization.
  • Familiarity with one or more of the training methods listed above.
  • A research paper, open source contribution, or project that shows how you approach an applied machine learning problem.

When applying, include a short note about a relevant project, what you contributed, and how you measured the results.

job.name: Member of Technical Staff, Evals & Data Quality
job.description:
About Mecka AI Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.

We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.

We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

The role

When a robotics team trains on Mecka’s data, they need to trust what they’re getting. You’ll define what that trust rests on: the benchmarks, audits and quality standards behind every delivery. You’ll dig into the failures that averages hide, question results that look too good and make the call on whether data is ready to ship.

You’ll work across Computer Vision, annotation, operations and delivery. We’re looking for someone with a machine learning and data science background who enjoys getting to the bottom of a difficult measurement problem, and can turn what they find into a quality bar the whole team can use.

What you’ll do

  • Own the benchmark methodology: which evaluation sets exist, how they are sampled, which metrics apply and how versions are frozen and compared.
  • Write customer quality specifications and audit rubrics, and keep both aligned with what customers actually reject.
  • Run human audits and work with annotation and operations on sampling, agreement, throughput and cost.
  • Build automated checks and graders that reduce manual review costs and are hard to game.
  • Track where recorded hours are lost, report quality results regularly and make the ship or no-ship call on data.

What you need

  • Experience in evaluation, measurement or data quality for machine learning systems, or in data operations at scale.
  • A machine learning and data science background, with strong Python and working knowledge of statistics: sampling, precision and recall, agreement and confidence intervals.
  • Experience designing evaluation protocols and ground-truth pipelines from scratch.
  • The judgment to challenge a research team’s numbers and support that challenge with evidence.
  • An eye for how a metric can be gamed, and the habit of closing those gaps.

Nice to have

  • Benchmarks and metrics: 3D pose, trajectory and reconstruction metrics such as MPJPE and ATE.
  • Audits and data quality: Sampling design, inter-annotator agreement, loss accounting and managing annotators or vendors.
  • Automated checks and graders: Verifiers, learned scoring, active learning and human-in-the-loop evaluation.
  • Data curation and scoring: Quality scoring, filtering and composition of large datasets.

If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply — we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match.

How about working with customers and peers from the disparate range of Amazon's business and science on complex real world problems, backed with high volume data and complex reasoning tasks? Whether you're passionate about building highly scalable and reliable systems or a scientist who likes to solve business problems, Amazon Tax Engine can be the place for you.

We are responsible for the Tax Engine platform, providing the core services that classifies and calculate taxes (sales tax and VAT) for all Amazon sales, physical and digital, globally. We seek to interpret legislative texts and reason with the vast catalogue of Amazon goods, to compute the correct tax amounts to customers when they place their Amazon order. The challenges for our space includes staying on top of the complex and ever-changing global tax legislations as well as evolving taxonomies, classifying goods through NLP/LLM, reasoning with large sets of human rules to impute domain conventions and assessing causal drivers of change for impacts on billions of daily transactions.

As a Senior Applied scientist, you will provide AI leadership to the team that helps increase the accuracy of Tax Engine's tax computation globally. You will work with Large language models, Causal reasoning and other AI/ML areas to build various solutions that help improve accuracy of Amazon’s Tax Engine.

You will guide other Applied Scientist , MLE and SDE in exploring solutions through the application of Scientific techniques. You will evaluate risk areas other undertake new PoC and collaborate with other Amazon organization to create best in class solutions.

You will help us innovate different ways to enhance tax experience for our global customers.

You will need to be entrepreneurial, work in a highly collaborative environment with SDEs, Product managers and businesses. We like to move fast, experiment, iterate and then scale quickly, thoughtfully balancing speed and quality.

Basic Qualifications

  • PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
  • Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc.
  • Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc.

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

job.name: Analyste - Finance
job.description:
Lieu : Montréal, en présentiel

Aperçu du poste

Nous recherchons un analyste motivé et soucieux du détail pour rejoindre notre équipe d'investissement. Le candidat idéal est actuellement inscrit à un programme de premier cycle (ou est diplômé) en finance, statistiques, science des données, mathématiques ou dans un domaine connexe. L'analyste participera à la collecte et à l'analyse de données, élaborera et tiendra à jour des feuilles de calcul et des tableaux de bord, et aidera à préparer des rapports détaillés destinés à la haute direction afin d'éclairer les décisions clés en matière d'investissement et d'affaires. Le poste implique également d'étudier les tendances du marché, les évolutions du secteur et la dynamique concurrentielle pour générer des informations exploitables.

Principales responsabilités

Collecte et intégrité des données

  • Utiliser le terminal Bloomberg (ainsi que des outils tels que Yahoo Finance et Benzinga) pour recueillir des ratios financiers, des mesures comparatives (comps) et d'autres données nécessaires à l'analyse du portefeuille et des investissements.
  • Tenir à jour, actualiser et vérifier les ensembles de données financières afin de garantir leur exactitude, leur exhaustivité et leur intégrité.

Rapports et visualisation

  • Créer des tableaux de bord interactifs dans Excel pour présenter les résultats financiers mensuels et trimestriels.
  • Veiller à ce que les tableaux de bord et les rapports fournissent des informations claires, concises et exploitables aux parties prenantes des secteurs de la finance et de l'investissement.
  • Participer à la préparation de présentations et de documents de synthèse pour la haute direction.

Analyse et recherche

  • Compiler et analyser les tendances historiques du marché et la conjoncture économique actuelle pour appuyer l'analyse du portefeuille.
  • Suivre les évolutions du secteur et le paysage concurrentiel afin d'offrir un éclairage stratégique sur l'environnement des investissements en titres.
  • Examiner et analyser les états financiers (bilans, comptes de résultat et tableaux des flux de trésorerie) pour identifier les points forts et les pistes d'amélioration.
  • Évaluer les indicateurs financiers pour soutenir la planification stratégique et l'optimisation du portefeuille.

Modélisation et risque

  • Élaborer des modèles financiers pour prévoir les performances futures en se basant sur les données historiques et les tendances du marché.
  • Contribuer à l'analyse des risques en identifiant les risques potentiels liés à l'activité et au portefeuille, et en évaluant leur impact.
  • Suivre la performance du portefeuille par rapport aux indices de référence pertinents et signaler les écarts significatifs.

job.name: Data Scientist
job.description:
Confido is the AI infrastructure powering modern CPG — the platform that 200+ brands like OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Dr. Squatch, and Tropicana use to run everything from deductions to production planning. Finance, accounting, sales, and operations, unified in one system for the first time.

We're growing 5x year over year with a small team in New York City; the people who join now will shape the product, the culture, and the company itself.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you.

THE ROLE

CPG brands live and die by their ability to predict what’s coming — how much product will sell, where demand will land, and what a promotion will actually do to the business. At Confido, you’ll build models that help brands forecast sales, price products, and shape promotional strategy. You’ll work with an unusually broad dataset spanning sell-through, inventory, deductions, trade promotions, and supply-chain signals from 200+ brands — much of it messy, real-world data that makes the problems genuinely interesting. The models you build will directly influence decisions behind the products you see on store shelves every day.

As a Data Scientist, you'll turn that data into models and analyses that ship inside the product — not slide decks. You'll work alongside our AI/ML engineering team to move from exploratory analysis to production-grade insight.

What you'll work on

  • Demand and sales forecasting — improving prediction quality across thousands of noisy, real-world retail time series
  • Promotion effectiveness — measuring lift, price elasticity, and cannibalization so brands know which promotions actually pay
  • Data quality and evaluation — building the statistical checks that keep our models honest as messy data flows in

About You

  • 3-5+ years of hands-on data science experience with real-world (not benchmark) data
  • Strong statistical foundations: regression, time-series methods, experiment design, uncertainty quantification
  • Fluent in Python and SQL; comfortable working in a modern data stack (we use Snowflake and dbt)
  • You care whether your analysis is right, not just whether it runs — you validate, sanity-check, and communicate uncertainty
  • You can explain a model to a non-technical brand operator and defend it to an ML engineer

Bonus

  • Experience with retail, CPG, supply chain, or demand-planning data
  • Experience shipping models into production systems (vs. offline analysis only)
  • Familiarity with forecasting at scale (hierarchical forecasting, intermittent demand)

Stack: Python

  • SQL
  • Snowflake
  • dbt
  • AWS

We are an applied science organization building the science behind them. The work sits at the intersection of machine learning research, real world data, and production systems running in industrial environments.

As Principal Applied Scientist, you lead the science on a major capability area inside the pod. You take ambiguous problems through hypothesis, method selection, experimentation, and into models that run in production. job.name: Senior Scientist I, Biostatistics
job.description:
At Alamar, we are passionate about enabling our customers to make scientific discoveries that translate into clinical outcomes and benefit patients. Our team is growing quickly as we develop innovative approaches to measure critical protein biomarkers from liquid samples that can enable the earliest possible detection of disease. We believe the next frontier in biology is enabled by measuring proteins at higher sensitivity in highly multiplexed assays at the push of a button, which is something only Alamar can do. As we build our team, we seek collaborative, driven, intellectually curious people committed to solving complex challenges. Our culture rewards accountability and cross functional teamwork because we believe this enables the kind of breakthrough thinking that will accelerate our mission.

We are seeking a Senior Scientist, Biostatistics to provide statistical and biostatistical expertise within Bioinformatics, supporting product development and scientific programs across the organization. The scientist will partner with product development teams, Field Application Sciences, and external industry and academic collaborators to shape study designs, analyze data, interpret findings, and translate evidence into practical decisions.

The role combines hands-on statistical work with close scientific partnership. You will help teams and collaborators answer meaningful questions with fit-for-purpose study designs and analyses, communicate results clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences, and ensure that scientific evidence informs the development and improvement of our products.

Responsibilities Study Design and Statistical Consultation

  • Partner with Bioinformatics and cross-functional colleagues to frame scientific questions and recommend appropriate study designs and analysis plans
  • Advise on endpoints, controls, sample size, power, inclusion criteria, data collection, and analysis methods for feasibility, performance, and product development studies
  • Review protocols, analysis plans, and study materials for statistical rigor and alignment with intended claims and use cases
  • Help troubleshoot study execution and data quality issues, identifying their implications for analysis and interpretation

Data Analysis and Interpretation

  • Analyze data from assay evaluations, validation studies, field studies, and other product development activities using appropriate statistical and biostatistical methods
  • Apply methods such as regression, generalized linear models, mixed-effects models, survival analysis, diagnostic performance metrics, and resampling or simulation approaches as appropriate to the question
  • Develop reproducible analysis workflows and clear visualizations, reports, and presentations that explain results, uncertainty, limitations, and implications
  • Interpret findings in collaboration with scientific and product teams, distinguishing robust evidence from exploratory signals

job.name: Principal Data & Applied Scientist – Ontologies, Knowledge Graphs & AI Research
job.description:
Job Description Teach AI how business actually works AI agents are starting to take on real business work: releasing blocked invoices, re-planning supply, preparing the financial close. To do it safely, they need more than access to data. They need to know what an order, a supplier and a cost center are, how they connect, which rules and authorizations apply, and what happened the last time someone made a similar decision. When executing mission-critical business processes, an answer or action that is right 90% of the time is not good enough.

SAP systems hold the context for many of the world's largest companies. SAP's knowledge graph for SAP S/4HANA alone is based on 452,000 tables, 80,000 CDS views (semantic data models) and 7.3 million fields. Yet much of the meaning, especially in each company's own extensions, configuration and decision history, is still implicit. A 'customer' in sales, a 'business partner' in finance and an 'account' in CRM can be the same company described three ways, and an agent deciding whether to raise a credit limit has to know that. This is not a data-cleaning problem, it is a knowledge-representation problem. Today that context, the semantic layer agents rely on, is mostly modeled by hand, one company at a time. We think it can be learned, so AI agents can act on business data, not just read it. SAP's Autonomous Enterprise depends on that, and it is what makes the agents people work with in Joule Work, SAP's AI workspace, accurate enough to trust.

As Principal Data Scientist, you will define and lead our research toward that goal and work with product teams to ship the results. This is a research and modeling role, not product analytics.

What You Will Work On

Read the full description

At Bedrock, we're moving AI out of the lab and onto real job sites. Our team includes veterans who helped launch Waymo, scaled Segment to a $3.2B acquisition, and grew Uber Freight to $5B in revenue. We're using it to put more autonomous machines to work, build the field and operations teams behind every deployment, and expand into new machine types and job-site tasks.

This is where algorithms meet steel-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world-class engineers to solve physical-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us.

You will work across the full data science lifecycle (problem framing, analysis, measurement, and communication) while helping establish foundational practices for how data science is applied at Bedrock. What You'll Do

This is not a data-cleaning problem, it is a knowledge-representation problem. Today that context, the semantic layer agents rely on, is mostly modeled by hand, one company at a time. We think it can be learned, so AI agents can act on business data, not just read it. SAP's Autonomous Enterprise depends on that, and it is what makes the agents people work with in Joule Work, SAP’s AI workspace, accurate enough to trust.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you'll own a research thread end to end: from an open question, to a method and a benchmark, to a prototype a product team adopts. This is a research and modeling role, not product analytics.

What You Will Work On

job.name: Senior Data Scientist
job.description:
Confido is the AI infrastructure powering modern CPG — the platform that 200+ brands like OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Dr. Squatch, and Tropicana use to run everything from deductions to production planning. Finance, accounting, sales, and operations, unified in one system for the first time.

We're growing 5x year over year with a small team in New York City; the people who join now will shape the product, the culture, and the company itself.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you.

THE ROLE

CPG brands live and die by their ability to predict what’s coming — how much product will sell, where demand will land, and what a promotion will actually do to the business. At Confido, you’ll build models that help brands forecast sales, price products, and shape promotional strategy. You’ll work with an unusually broad dataset spanning sell-through, inventory, deductions, trade promotions, and supply-chain signals from 200+ brands — much of it messy, real-world data that makes the problems genuinely interesting. The models you build will directly influence decisions behind the products you see on store shelves every day.

As a Data Scientist, you'll turn that data into models and analyses that ship inside the product — not slide decks. You'll work alongside our AI/ML engineering team to move from exploratory analysis to production-grade insight.

What you'll work on

  • Demand and sales forecasting — improving prediction quality across thousands of noisy, real-world retail time series
  • Promotion effectiveness — measuring lift, price elasticity, and cannibalization so brands know which promotions actually pay
  • Data quality and evaluation — building the statistical checks that keep our models honest as messy data flows in

About You

  • 5+ years of hands-on data science experience with real-world (not benchmark) data
  • Strong statistical foundations: regression, time-series methods, experiment design, uncertainty quantification
  • Fluent in Python and SQL; comfortable working in a modern data stack (we use Snowflake and dbt)
  • You care whether your analysis is right, not just whether it runs — you validate, sanity-check, and communicate uncertainty
  • You can explain a model to a non-technical brand operator and defend it to an ML engineer

Bonus

  • Experience with retail, CPG, supply chain, or demand-planning data
  • Experience shipping models into production systems (vs. offline analysis only)
  • Familiarity with forecasting at scale (hierarchical forecasting, intermittent demand)

Stack: Python

  • SQL
  • Snowflake
  • dbt
  • AWS

job.name: Data Scientist
job.description:
Job Description Thomson Reuters Special Services (TRSS) is looking for a Data Scientist to support our Federal Law Enforcement customers. TRSS Data Scientists serve several Federal Law Enforcement agencies by collecting, integrating, resolving, analyzing, modeling, and explaining large data in support of complex investigations. Success in this role requires strong technical depth, the initiative to operate with minimal direction, creativity to develop novel solutions, the ability to work directly with customers, and a mission-focused mindset.

TRSS Data Scientists support the full range of Federal Law Enforcement missions including, but not limited to: Emerging Threat Detection, Money Laundering, Fraud, Force Protection, Human Rights Crimes, Transnational Crime, and more. Outside of contract work, TRSS Data Scientists contribute to internal innovation by participating in research and development (R&D), developing and maintaining shared capabilities, strengthening technical skills, and supporting business development efforts such as proof-of-concept projects and capabilities briefings.

This opportunity is specifically for positions located on US Government customer sites in the Arlington , Merrifield, Fairfax, Crystal City, and DC area. This is not a telework position. We recruit from a broad range of disciplines and experience. If you are passionate about the chance to put your Data Science skills to practice in support of Federal Law Enforcement, then we are looking for you!

Key Responsibilities Data Scientists in this role will support Federal Law Enforcement missions by applying technical expertise to complex investigative and operational challenges. Responsibilities include:

  • Collect, integrate, clean, verify, resolve, and maintain large and complex datasets.
  • Analyze data using statistical methods, graph networks, anomaly detection, spatial analysis, pattern-of-life analysis, sentiment analysis, and related techniques.
  • Develop and apply data models, including risk models, community detection, classification, computer vision, machine learning, and artificial intelligence models.
  • Translate data findings into actionable insights through dashboards, visualizations, briefings, and clear explanations for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Write, edit, customize, and execute Python code to support mission requirements.
  • Use SQL for data extraction, pipelining, exploration, and analysis.
  • Work directly with customers to understand problem statements, define project goals, develop methods, and deliver results within required timeframes.
  • Contribute to internal innovation, research and development, shared capabilities, technical skill development, and business development efforts such as proof-of-concept projects and capabilities briefings.

Required Qualifications

job.description:
Swift is a privately held, mission-driven and employee-focused services and solutions company headquartered in Reston, VA. Our capabilities include Software Development, Engineering & IT, Data Science, Cyber Enablement, Logistics, and Training. Founded in 2019, Swift supports Civilian, Defense, and Intelligence Community customers across the country and around the globe.

We are looking for a Data Scientist to join a robust team in Annapolis Junction and/or Laurel, MD. This role focuses on extracting insights and value from large, complex datasets to support mission needs. The ideal candidate applies a blend of mathematical, statistical, computational, and domain-specific expertise to analyze data, develop models, and communicate clear, actionable findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Responsibilities

  • Apply two or more core data science skill areas, including:

+ Mathematical, computational, and statistical foundations
+ Data processing, management, curation, visualization, and reproducible analytic workflows
+ Data modeling, inference, prediction, and domain-specific analysis

  • Compile, integrate, and manage data from multiple sources using computer scripting, APIs, and analytic tools.

job.name: Sr. Lead Data Scientist
job.description:
At Early Warning, we’ve powered and protected the U.S. financial system for over thirty years with cutting-edge solutions like Zelle®, Paze®, and so much more. As a trusted name in payments, we partner with thousands of institutions to increase access to financial services and protect transactions for hundreds of millions of consumers and small businesses.

Early Warning follows a hybrid work model to allow for a more collaborative working environment.

Candidates responding to this posting must independently possess the eligibility to work in the United States, for any employer, at the date of hire. This position is ineligible for employment Visa sponsorship.

The Sr. Lead Data Scientist is a senior individual contributor and technical leader within the data science organization, responsible for designing, developing, and delivering advanced machine learning and statistical solutions in a complex, high-volume, high-throughput data environment. This role plays a critical leadership function by owning end-to-end modeling initiatives, guiding analytical direction for major business problems, and mentoring data scientists across multiple projects.

This position is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, influence modeling standards and best practices, and partner closely with engineering, product, and business leaders to translate strategic objectives into scalable, production-ready analytics solutions.

Essential Functions Advanced Modeling & Technical Leadership

  • Leads the design, experimentation, and implementation of advanced machine learning, statistical, and optimization models to solve complex, high-impact business problems.
  • Serves as the technical owner for large-scale, business-critical models, including model selection, feature engineering, training strategy, validation, and performance monitoring.
  • Drives development of complex consumer or entity profiles used for both offline model training and real-time scoring.
  • Assesses and ensures long-term performance, stability, scalability, and interpretability of analytically derived models in production environments.
  • Establishes modeling standards, evaluation frameworks, and best practices adopted across the data science team.

Project & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Takes a lead role in the development and delivery of product-prototype and production models, coordinating across multiple data science and engineering contributors.
  • Partners with software engineers and MLOps teams to define statistical components, data requirements, unit testing, acceptance testing, and deployment strategies.
  • Translates ambiguous, high-level business goals into clearly defined analytical problems, roadmaps, and measurable success criteria.
  • Identifies and recommends new modeling, analytics, and data opportunities aligned with business strategy.

Mentorship & Knowledge Sharing

job.description:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture. Team members for this role must be based In San Francisco, Seattle, or New York City. About Superhuman Superhuman is an AI productivity suite that makes AI work for everyone. Over 40 million people rely on our products daily to get work done. A recognized leader in productivity tools, Superhuman is the maker of popular products including Docs, Fathom, Go, GPTZero, Grammarly, and Mail. The newest product, Superhuman Go, builds on Grammarly’s ability to deliver help everywhere people work. It lets anyone build proactive agents that act as teammates across more than 1 million apps and websites, without changing how they work. Learn more at superhuman.com.

The Opportunity

Help shape how millions of people discover and get value from a connected suite of AI-powered products that work where they do.

Superhuman is bringing together products including Grammarly, Mail, Docs, Go, GPTZero, and Fathom. The opportunity is bigger than growing any one product: it’s understanding how people move across the suite, what they need next, and how a more connected experience can create lasting value for users and the business.

As a Growth Data Scientist, you’ll help define how we measure and accelerate that growth. You’ll investigate questions like which product a user is most likely to value next, where people encounter friction across the self-serve journey, and how packaging and monetization can support both adoption and retention. You’ll use experimentation, modeling, and rigorous measurement to turn those questions into decisions.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Finance, and User Research, with visibility into the leaders shaping our growth strategy. Your analysis won’t stop at reporting what happened: you’ll help teams decide what to build, where to invest, and how to know whether it worked.

This role is a chance to bring your multi-product growth experience to an ambitious, evolving portfolio—and help shape how it grows. If you enjoy untangling complex user journeys, connecting product-level insights to portfolio-wide outcomes, and making your work matter in the roadmap, you’ll find meaningful scope in this opportunity.

What you’ll do

Hi, we're Oscar. We're hiring a Senior Data Scientist, Lucie to join our Data team.

Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves—one that behaves like a doctor in the family.

job.description:
Position Description

We are seeking a hands on Data Scientist to join our client's Chief Data Office (CDO) and build predictive, statistical and machine learning solutions that support the organization's AI, GenAI and Agentic AI portfolio. The role centers on classical data science: framing business problems, preparing data, building and validating models, and measuring outcomes.

You will work in an Azure environment using Python, Databricks and Snowflake, partnering with business stakeholders, data engineers and AI engineers to take use cases from idea to evaluated, production ready models.

This position can be based remotely anywhere in the United States. The client's preferred location is Alpharetta, Georgia.

What You'll Do

job.description:
Job Description **Job description

Senior Software Engineer — Customer Files Orchestration CoCounsel Legal is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to help build and operate the Customer Files Orchestration Service** – the system that makes a customer's own documents usable by CoCounsel Legal's agents.

Every file a customer brings to CoCounsel passes through this team: upload, storage, extraction, embedding, and indexing , orchestrated end-to-end. You make millions of customer files available to CoCounsel. Bringing a customer's content together with Thomson Reuters' world-class proprietary content and the latest frontier models – including TR's own custom large language models – is what makes our products highly differentiated and our agent experiences genuinely grounded. This team is a critical part of what makes that combination possible.

It is also, unavoidably, a hard distributed systems problem. Supporting millions of files means real engineering: dedicated workers, fair queuing so one busy customer cannot starve another, durable state, idempotent processing, and honest reasoning about consistency and delivery guarantees across systems this team does not own.

The team owns what it builds, designing, implementing, testing, deploying, scaling, and operating the service end-to-end. As a Senior Software Engineer you own a meaningful part of that service outright. You are eager to ship something you’re proud of and become someone the team trusts.

Key Responsibilities Design & Technical Ownership

  • Own the orchestration service end-to-end – Take an ambiguous problem, shape it into a design, write the ADR, build it, ship it, and operate it. You and the team are accountable for the outcome, not just the pull request.
  • Make and defend the calls that define this domain – Where eventual consistency is safe and where only a strongly-consistent read is correct; at-least-once with idempotent processing versus the real cost of exactly-once; lease and heartbeat models for crash recovery; compare-and-swap state transitions across asynchronous service boundaries.
  • Build the queuing and flow-control machinery – Fair queuing so one busy tenant cannot starve another, rate limiting, backpressure, circuit breaking, dead-letter handling, and autoscaling.
  • Treat our APIs as a product – CoCounsel's file and workspace APIs serve a growing set of consumers beyond orchestration. Versioned contracts, documented behavior, backward compatibility, and deliberate change management are part of the work, not paperwork after it.
  • Design for correctness at scale, not correctness in a test – Anticipate the failure modes that only appear under concurrency and load and build systems where whole classes of bugs cannot occur rather than fixing them one at a time.

Reliability & Operations

job.name: Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Job Summary The Cloud/Infrastructure Engineer will help design, implement, and maintain our organization's cloud and on-premise infrastructure. This role owns day-to-day infrastructure work independently while contributing to broader strategy alongside senior engineers. The ideal candidate has a solid understanding of system stability, monitoring, and performance optimization, and can troubleshoot complex issues and drive practical solutions with limited oversight.

YOUR IMPACT

At Redwood, we strive to automate and optimize our operations and application integrations to support the scale of our business and customer needs. As an observability engineer, you will build and maintain systems that collect, analyze, and visualize data from software applications and infrastructure. You will provide insight into system health and performance, enable proactive problem identification, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of our observability solutions in partnership with other teams.

Responsibilities

* Implement Infrastructure Strategy: Contribute to the design and implement infrastructure initiatives, including data collection pipelines, data processing, and visualization dashboards, with scalability and performance in mind. This includes metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting to provide end-to-end visibility into system behavior.
* System Monitoring and Performance Optimization: Monitor system performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement solutions to optimize efficiency and reliability, including proactive identification of potential issues and preventative measures.
* Incident Response and Troubleshooting: Respond to incidents, troubleshoot complex system issues, and perform root cause analysis to help prevent future occurrences.
* Tooling and Infrastructure: Configure, manage, and maintain observability tooling and infrastructure (log aggregation, metric collection, distributed tracing, alerting), and contribute to tool evaluation and selection. Work with tools such as Prometheus, Datadog, New Relic, VictoriaMetrics, and similar to capture relevant metrics, logs, and traces.
* Alerting and Incident Management: Configure and maintain alerts based on defined thresholds and anomalies, ensuring timely notification of potential issues and supporting rapid incident response.
* Data Analysis and Troubleshooting: Analyze collected data to identify performance bottlenecks, root causes, and trends within complex systems, collaborating with engineering teams to resolve problems.
* Automation and Optimization: Develop and implement automation for monitoring and alerting to improve response times and reduce manual effort. Create automations for repetitive tasks (e.g., RMJ automation for new employees).
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with development, operations, and other teams to apply cloud and infrastructure best practices across the software development lifecycle, ensuring proper instrumentation and data collection.

job.name: AI/ML Architect
job.description:
Qualifications:

  • Software Engineering Architect / Lead with 10+ years of experience in designing and leading AI/ML and RPA solutions.
  • Experienced in driving technical architecture, solution design, automation, and end-to-end software engineering initiatives.
  • Strong leadership in guiding teams, defining scalable solutions, and collaborating with stakeholders to deliver business-focused technology solutions.

Strategy and use-case portfolio

  • Build and own the AI, machine learning and RPA use-case pipeline: source candidate use cases from the business, size value and feasibility, and sequence them honestly.
  • Make and defend build-versus-buy decisions, including where embedded vendor AI — SAP Joule, Manhattan's agentic capabilities, Microsoft Copilot, Shopify's native tooling — is the better answer than a custom build.
  • Say no to use cases that do not survive scrutiny, and document why.

Architecture and delivery

  • Own the reference architecture for machine learning and generative AI at Organization: data access patterns against Snowflake, model hosting, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation, monitoring and MLOps.
  • Own the RPA architecture and platform selection for finance and supply chain back-office automation, with a clear position on where process redesign beats automation of an existing bad process.
  • Deliver the first production use cases personally alongside a small team — this is a hands-on role, not a strategy function.

Governance, risk and data protection

  • Establish Organization's AI governance framework: use-case approval, model risk assessment, human-in-the-loop requirements, bias and fairness testing, and model lifecycle management.
  • Define what corporate, customer and employee data may and may not be used in AI systems, working with Information Security and Legal, under GDPR and CCPA obligations.
  • Ensure no personally identifiable or payment data enters model training, prompting or third-party AI services without explicit approved control.
  • Own the position on third-party AI vendor assessment and data residency.

Leadership and enablement

  • Hire and lead a small team of AI, machine learning and RPA engineers.
  • Act as Organization's internal translator on AI — set realistic expectations with business stakeholders, and counter both overclaiming and reflexive scepticism with evidence.
  • Partner with the Snowflake Lead to ensure the data platform is fit for purpose for AI workloads.

Preferred:

  • Retail, consumer goods or apparel use cases: demand forecasting, assortment planning, inventory optimisation, pricing or customer service automation.
  • Experience with AI capabilities embedded in SAP, Microsoft, Shopify or Manhattan platforms.
  • Experience building an AI function from a standing start.
  • Snowflake or comparable cloud data platform experience as the foundation for ML workloads.

NYAI Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a DevOps Engineer to join our technology team in Pune.

NYAI builds AI-powered legal intelligence and infrastructure designed to make legal workflows more accurate, explainable, and accountable. Our platform combines advanced AI engineering with legal expertise to support research, document workflows, and enterprise-grade AI deployments.

Explore more about us: https://nyai.ai/

Location: Pune

Work Mode: Work from Office | 5 Days a Week

Experience: 5-6Years

Employment Type: Full-time

What You'll Do

  • Own end-to-end infrastructure management across development, staging, and production environments.
  • Design, manage, and optimize cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for efficient and reliable deployments.
  • Ensure infrastructure uptime, reliability, and operational stability.
  • Monitor systems, applications, logs, alerts, and cloud resources proactively.
  • Implement cloud security best practices, including IAM, network security, access controls, and environment hardening.
  • Handle production incidents, downtime management, root cause analysis, and preventive improvements.
  • Build and maintain disaster recovery plans, backup strategies, and business continuity readiness.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning and operational workflows using Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Manage containerized deployments and orchestration platforms.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering teams on releases, troubleshooting, scalability, and performance optimization.
  • Maintain infrastructure documentation, SOPs, and operational standards.

What We're Looking For

  • 5-6 years of experience in DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP cloud platforms.
  • Good understanding of cloud security, IAM policies, VPCs, firewalls, SSL, encryption, and access governance.
  • Experience handling production systems with uptime and reliability ownership.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or similar.
  • Strong expertise in Docker and containerized deployments.
  • Experience with Kubernetes or similar orchestration platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, or similar Infrastructure as Code tools.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog, or CloudWatch.
  • Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills.
  • Understanding of backup management, disaster recovery planning, and failover strategies.
  • Scripting knowledge using Bash, Python, or similar languages.
  • Familiarity with networking fundamentals, DNS, load balancing, and high-availability architecture concepts.

What We Value

job.name: Software Engineer (AI Document Processing)
job.description:
Since 2003, Entrata has evolved from a visionary, student-led startup into a global leader in AI-driven property management technology. Today, we power the industry's most essential operating system, serving owners and residents worldwide through a comprehensive suite of intelligent leasing, payment, and communication tools powered by cutting-edge AI. With a proven track record of sustained growth and a global team of more than 2,200 employees, we offer the rare combination of established stability and high-velocity innovation. Recognized by the Silicon Slopes Hall of Fame and the Utah Business Fast 50, Entrata fosters a culture of radical transparency and entrepreneurial energy. At Entrata, we create an environment where different perspectives are valued and respected. Those perspectives challenge assumptions, strengthen our decisions, and raise the bar as we reshape the global living experience through AI-powered solutions.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to help build Document Ingestion, a platform that processes any documents or images into structured data using LLM Models, OCR, and AWS cloud-based processing.

You’ll work across frontend, backend services, APIs, extraction workflows, evaluations, deployment, and observability.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Design, build, test, deploy, maintain, and support the most accurate Document Ingestion features
  • Develop Python APIs and services using FastAPI and Pydantic
  • Build document ingestion workflows for PDFs, DOCX, and image files
  • Work with AI models, prompts, schemas, structured outputs, and OCR
  • Build asynchronous processing using S3, SQS, DynamoDB, and worker services
  • Create automated tests and extraction-quality evaluations
  • Troubleshoot production issues using logs, metrics, traces, and New Relic
  • Contribute to Docker, Terraform, Helm, and Amazon EKS deployments
  • Demonstrate autonomy and operate with minimal supervision
  • Follow best security practices for authentication, API scopes, tenant isolation, and data documentation

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of experience building complex products
  • Proficiency in the Python programming language
  • Experience with REST APIs, background processing, databases, cloud services, and automated testing
  • Understanding of AI applications, prompt design, structured outputs, tool calling, and response validation
  • Experience with monitoring and troubleshooting production systems
  • Experience using Codex/Cursor AI coding tools
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills
  • Ability to communicate effectively with teams across Entrata
  • Experience with LLM APIs integrations
  • Experience with FastAPI, Pydantic, pytest, PyMuPDF, or AWS Textract
  • Knowledge of AWS services like S3, DynamoDB, and SQS

Preferred Qualifications:

job.description:
À propos du mandat

Odesia est à la recherche d’un(e) Conseiller(ère) DevOps / DevSecOps spécialisé(e) en gestion des secrets et en automatisation des infrastructures pour contribuer à l’évolution, à la sécurité et à la fiabilité de plateformes technologiques complexes.

Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable de l’administration, de la maintenance, de la sécurisation et de l’évolution de la plateforme de gestion des secrets HashiCorp Vault Enterprise, dans des environnements multiclusters, multirégions, sur site (On-Premise) et infonuagiques (Azure).

Vous jouerez un rôle-conseil auprès des équipes technologiques en les accompagnant dans l'intégration et l'utilisation sécuritaire des secrets applicatifs. Vous contribuerez également à l'amélioration continue des pratiques DevOps et DevSecOps, en mettant l'accent sur l'automatisation, l'Infrastructure as Code (IaC), la sécurité et la résilience des plateformes.

Responsabilités principales

Administration et gestion de HashiCorp Vault

  • Administrer, configurer et maintenir HashiCorp Vault Enterprise.
  • Assurer la disponibilité, la performance et la sécurité de la plateforme dans des environnements complexes.
  • Gérer les mécanismes de haute disponibilité (HA), de reprise après sinistre (DR), de sauvegarde et de restauration.
  • Configurer et maintenir les méthodes d'authentification, notamment LDAP, OIDC, TLS et les mécanismes d'authentification machine-to-machine.
  • Administrer les différents Secrets Engines et assurer une gestion sécurisée du cycle de vie des secrets.
  • Surveiller l'état de santé des environnements et intervenir lors d'incidents ou de problèmes de performance.

Automatisation et Infrastructure as Code

  • Automatiser l'administration et la configuration de Vault selon les principes Infrastructure as Code.
  • Développer, maintenir et optimiser les modules Terraform.
  • Concevoir et maintenir des pipelines CI/CD avec Git et GitHub Actions/Workflows.
  • Développer des scripts d'automatisation à l'aide de Bash et d'outils de traitement JSON.
  • Identifier les possibilités d'automatisation afin de simplifier les opérations et d'améliorer l'efficacité des équipes.
  • Participer à l'amélioration continue des processus de déploiement et d'exploitation.

Sécurité et pratiques DevSecOps

  • Appliquer les meilleures pratiques de sécurité liées à la gestion des secrets et des accès.
  • Configurer et maintenir les paramètres de sécurité des environnements technologiques.
  • Contribuer à l'intégration des contrôles de sécurité dans les processus CI/CD.
  • Veiller au respect des bonnes pratiques de développement, d'automatisation et de gestion des configurations.
  • Participer à l'identification des risques et proposer des mesures correctives.

AI DevOps Specialist (AI Enablement & Secure DevOps)

Contract Duration: 1 year + extension

Work Location: North York, ON.

Work Model: Hybrid preferred but open to considering remote

Operational Scope: Support across global Hardware Platform Solutions (HPS) Design Centers and secure testing labs (including the Hardware Platform Solutions (HPS) Innovation Lab and local RDL networks).

Project Objectives & Role Summary:

The AI DevOps Specialist is primarily responsible for the technical deployment, secure enablement, administration, and continuous optimization of the global HPS Artificial Intelligence (AI) sandbox, modeling, and software engineering toolchains.

This specialist will bridge the gap between AI development pipelines, secure networking infrastructure, and cloud platform services. They will take a hands-on lead in configuring foundational AI cloud services (primarily Google Cloud Platform - Vertex AI), managing user-facing web interfaces (LibreChat or Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform), implementing agentic workflow architectures (Flowise AI or Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform), ensuring secure, uninterrupted developer access to AI coding assistants (such as Claude Code, Gemini Code Assist, and Claude Sonnet/Opus models), and establishing robust cloud budget governance.

Core Responsibilities & Scope of Work

1. AI Sandbox Platform Administration & Deployment

● Multi-Phase Sandbox Rollout: Own the deployment and lifecycle management of the HPS AI Sandbox environment across cloud and hybrid infrastructures.

● Front-End User Interfaces: Deploy, configure, and maintain LibreChat (or similar web-based interfaces) to provide HPS engineers with safe, compliant, and localized access to LLMs.

● Agentic Frameworks: Establish and configure Flowise AI or Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for the design and orchestration of agentic AI workflows and LLM-backed applications.

● Model Registry & Endpoints: Administer model deployment, model endpoint configurations, and vector databases within the sandbox environment.

2. GCP & Vertex AI Model Management

● Project Governance: Oversee the HPS-designated GCP AI projects (e.g., gcp-ai-hps), including security permissions, service accounts, and IAM roles.

● Model Enablement & Quota Tuning: Coordinate the provisioning and scale-out of advanced foundational models (including Anthropic Claude 3.5/3.6/3.7 suite [Opus, Sonnet, Haiku] and Google Gemini) in Vertex AI. Actively manage, troubleshoot, and resolve API quota restrictions with cloud providers.

● Local Code Integration: Ensure developer command-line interfaces and local development terminals (such as Claude Code, VS Code, and GitKraken) seamlessly communicate with cloud model endpoints.

3. Secure DevOps & Network Integration (Zscaler & Firewall)

If you're interested sign up to Dex to apply. Dex is an AI recruiter agent that helps you run your job search. Tell Dex your stack, seniority, and what you want to build. We will manage your applications and surface other opportunities that are a fit.

The role Global enterprises are already running mission-critical workloads on this team's AI operating system, which absorbs massive IT complexity across distributed corporate environments. Backed by tier-one venture funds with substantial Series A capital, the company was built by veteran engineers from leading enterprise data platforms. They combine early-stage momentum with immediate, high-stakes customer traction.

You will be the founding Platform Engineer, owning everything beneath the application code with full autonomy over architectural direction. This is not a ticket-clearing operations role or an internal IT gig. Your mission is to stand up the US region from scratch, harden tenant isolation and security boundaries, and bring agent sandboxing and durable execution inside their own perimeter rather than renting external SaaS.

The work

  • Architect and stand up the US cloud footprint from scratch, establishing automated, repeatable multi-region deployments managed entirely via Terraform.
  • Engineer enterprise security guarantees directly into the infrastructure substrate, including customer-managed encryption keys, tenant isolation, and strict network boundaries.
  • Bring durable execution, vector indexing, and agent sandboxes inside proprietary infrastructure to eliminate reliance on brittle third-party providers.
  • Tune and scale the PostgreSQL data layer while creating intuitive, self-serve observability and fast preview environments for product engineers.
  • Design the core AI runtime architecture, including the LLM gateway, model routing, cost controls, and failover mechanisms for flaky external APIs.

What You Bring

  • Proven track record owning cloud infrastructure, networking, and deployment pipelines through rapid scaling at a high-velocity startup or scale-up.
  • Production mastery of infrastructure as code using Terraform alongside deep expertise in tuning and scaling high-throughput PostgreSQL data layers.
  • Demonstrated experience building runtime infrastructure for modern systems, including durable execution, agent sandboxing, or LLM routing and resilience.
  • A pragmatic architectural bias that ships clean, reliable paved paths fast rather than getting bogged down in multi-quarter infrastructure rewrites.
  • Based in the United States and legally authorized to work without sponsorship.

Read the full description

job.name: Cloud Solutions Engineer
job.description:
Become a part of our caring community The Cloud Solutions Engineer supports cloud-based customer experience platforms through the development, integration, testing, and optimization of conversational AI and contact center solutions. This role translates business and technical requirements into secure, scalable solutions and collaborates with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, customer-focused technologies.

The Cloud Solutions Engineer is responsible for developing, configuring, integrating, testing, and supporting cloud solutions utilizing Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Google CX Agent Studio, and related contact center technologies. The role works on moderately complex technical initiatives, resolves platform and application issues, and partners with architects and senior engineers to implement scalable cloud solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, deploy, and support cloud-based conversational AI and contact center solutions.
  • Build and maintain integrations between cloud platforms, APIs, and enterprise applications.
  • Support contact center modernization efforts, including migration and transformation initiatives.
  • Configure and support GCP services, including Cloud Run, BigQuery, IAM, APIs, logging, and monitoring.
  • Develop conversational experiences, authentication services, and workflow orchestration.
  • Troubleshoot application, integration, performance, and production issues.
  • Perform unit, integration, and regression testing to ensure solution quality and reliability.
  • Participate in Agile development activities, including sprint planning and backlog refinement.
  • Apply enterprise standards for security, CI/CD, monitoring, and software development best practices.
  • Maintain technical documentation and support continuous platform improvements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Experience in cloud engineering, systems analysis, or application development.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, APIs, integrations, and application support.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Passion for improving consumer and customer experiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Google CX Agent Studio, conversational AI, or contact center technologies.
  • Experience with cloud-native services, CI/CD pipelines, and enterprise integrations.

job.name: Consulting Principal, Solutions Engineering Lead
job.description:
About Cognizant Consulting Cognizant Consulting is more than Cognizant’s consulting practice. We’re a global community of 5,000+ experts dedicated to helping clients reimagine their business. Blending our deep industry and technology advisory capability, we create innovative business solutions for Fortune 500 clients. And now, we’re looking for our next colleague who’ll join us in shaping the future of business. Could it be you?

About The Role As a Consulting Principal, Solutions Engineering Lead , you will make an impact by designing and delivering enterprise-scale AWS cloud solutions that enable complex application migration, modernization, and platform transformation.

You will be a valued member of the Solutions Engineering team and work collaboratively with AWS architects, Cognizant delivery leadership, and client engineering, platform, and product teams. This role combines hands-on technical delivery with consulting leadership, requiring you to own architectural outcomes while helping client engineering teams build sustainable cloud and DevSecOps capabilities.

In This Role, You Will

  • Architect and deliver enterprise AWS cloud solutions aligned with AWS Well-Architected principles, including landing zones, multi-account architectures, networking, identity and access management, security, and platform engineering for complex financial-services workloads.
  • Lead cloud migration and application modernization initiatives, moving applications from on-premises and legacy cloud environments to AWS, with emphasis on ECS/Fargate, container-based services, serverless architectures, APIs, and cloud-native modernization patterns.
  • Design and build Infrastructure as Code using AWS CDK and TypeScript, including reusable L2/L3 constructs, stack composition, cross-account deployment patterns, AWS Organizations guardrails, and standardized ECS/Fargate service constructs.
  • Engineer secure DevSecOps and CI/CD capabilities, including pipeline design and standardization, automated security and quality gates, IAM policies, AWS Config, CloudTrail, Security Hub, CSPM tooling, and cloud compliance controls.
  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor to client teams, leading discovery sessions, architecture reviews, technical workshops, paired-programming sessions, and structured knowledge transfer to strengthen client capabilities across AWS, CDK/TypeScript, DevSecOps, ECS/Fargate, and cloud-native engineering.

Work model

We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants in the United States. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

Read the full description

job.name: Staff Infrastructure Software Engineer
job.description:
At Carbon, our mission goes beyond 3D printing. We are enabling creators everywhere to make what the world needs, right now. Our company is built on the idea that diverse fields of study must come together to solve intractable problems. We have grand ambitions to create technology that will influence industry around the world. You will be joining a diverse team with a vibrant culture, where team success is as important as celebrating individual contributions.

Help us change the world and we will help you change yours.

Job Description

We are looking for a Staff Infrastructure / DevOps Engineer to join a small, high-trust platform team that owns the foundations everything else at Carbon runs on: our AWS and GCP footprints, the networks that connect our cloud to printers in the field, the Terraform that describes all of it, and the CI/CD pipelines that ship software to production. You will be a core owner of that platform, drive substantial initiatives across it end to end, and raise the engineering bar for how we build and operate cloud infrastructure at Carbon.

You Will

  • Operate & Extend Multi-Cloud Infrastructure: Be a core owner of our AWS and GCP environments that host our Tier-0 services, keeping them resilient, cost-efficient, and secure while extending them to support the next generation of Carbon products.
  • Build the Network Between Cloud and Printer: Design and maintain the networking that connects our cloud services to a global fleet of printers, including VPCs, peering, DNS, load balancing, TLS, and secure edge connectivity. You will make sure a printer in a customer's factory can reach the cloud reliably, no matter where it is.
  • Run Services on Kubernetes with Istio: Be a core owner of the Kubernetes clusters and Istio service mesh that our platform runs on. You will drive substantial improvements to cluster architecture, workload isolation, traffic management, mTLS, and observability, and help application teams run their services on the platform safely and confidently.
  • Own Infrastructure as Code in Terraform: Take end-to-end ownership of substantial Terraform initiatives, from module design through rollout. You will help shape our IaC standards, keep our state and module ecosystem healthy, and make it easy for other engineers to ship infrastructure safely.
  • Ship Software Faster and Safer with CI/CD: Lead major improvements to our Jenkins and GitHub Actions pipelines: faster builds, safer deploys, better feedback loops, and clear paths from a merged PR to production. You will help define what "good" looks like for delivery at Carbon.
  • Own Reliability Alongside the Product Teams: Participate in on-call for the platform, drive incident response and postmortems on the initiatives you own, and turn recurring pain into permanent fixes. You will help other teams adopt strong operational practices for the services they own.
  • Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Work as a senior technical contributor across infrastruc

job.name: Cloud DevOps Engineer
job.description:
About Lumafield:

Lumafield was founded in 2019 to upgrade manufacturing.

We are engineers with deep experience across the product development cycle, from initial ideas to shipping hardware, across industries and specializations, who became frustrated by the cost and complexity of modern manufacturing. So we decided to upgrade it.

Engineers make million-dollar decisions every day, and they need tools that give them the greatest possible insight into their products. By offering unprecedented visibility into products, as well as AI-driven tools that highlight problems and generate quantitative data, Lumafield promises to revolutionize the way complex products are created, manufactured, and used across industries. We started with industrial CT scanning, which for us was the most valuable but underutilized tool in the manufacturing toolbox, enabling us to rapidly inspect essential components non-destructively.

We rebuilt the whole system, from X-ray capture, to computer vision analysis, to web-based collaboration, to the entire business model, making the most advanced manufacturing tech more accessible to every industry. Our company, like our platform, is designed for upgrades. We’re building for greater intelligence, autonomy, and speed. For deeper vision, operational excellence, and powerful insights. And then we'll upgrade it all again.

Lumafield is headquartered in San Francisco, CA. and has an office in Cambridge, MA.

About the role:

As a Cloud DevOps Engineer at Lumafield, you will own the cloud platform that runs Voyager, our CT data platform. A scan is only useful once someone can open it, measure it, and make a decision, and that happens in Voyager, in a web browser. Everything underneath is yours: AWS, the production Kubernetes clusters, Terraform, the pipeline every engineer ships through, observability, and the cloud side of our security and compliance programs.

This is an ownership role, not a ticket queue. Nobody will hand you a backlog; you will be the person who knows what the platform needs, what it costs, and what to fix first. We expect you to grow into a senior engineer here.

You will work in Platform Engineering alongside the backend lead, the software engineers who ship through your pipeline every day, and the team building the on-prem version of Voyager for customers who cannot send scan data to the cloud. You will report to engineering leadership; Platform Engineering is part of the organization our new Head of Software will lead.

This is a hands-on, in-person role based in our San Francisco, CA office.

What you'll do:

  • Own our AWS accounts and regions: architecture, access, onboarding and offboarding, and a bill you can explain by service and environment, then bring down
  • Run the production EKS clusters, and carry Kubernetes version upgrades from plan and rehearsal to completion, with a rollback ready
