job.name: Staff Software Engineer, Platform
job.description:
Backed by leading Silicon Valley investors, Peregrine helps public safety organizations, state and local and governments, federal agencies, and private-sector institutions address society’s challenges with unprecedented speed and accuracy. Our AI-enabled platform turns siloed and disconnected data into operational intelligence — instantly surfacing mission-critical information to empower better, faster decisions that improve outcomes at every touchpoint. Today Peregrine supports hundreds of customers across 30+ states and two countries, serving more than 125 million people — and we’re amplifying our impact as we expand into the enterprise and internationally.

Our Team The Platform team owns the foundation that every product team at Peregrine builds on. Our job is to make Peregrine's infrastructure fast, resilient, secure, and cost-efficient, while making it easy for other engineers to ship safely and quickly on top of it. We work closely with our traffic engineering team to keep routing, load balancing, and capacity running smoothly as we scale.

We believe great infrastructure is invisible when it's working and clearly communicated when it isn't. We hold ourselves to a high bar on reliability and security, and we treat other engineering teams as our customers, investing in tooling, documentation, and self-service paths that reduce their toil.

Role We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our growing Platform team and lead the technical strategy for scaling Peregrine's cloud footprint. You'll drive initiatives that improve performance and reliability, reduce infrastructure cost, strengthen our security posture, and make the platform more developer-friendly, often all at once. We're open to leveling this role up to Principal based on your experience and scope of impact.

This role blends hands-on technical leadership with cross-functional influence. You'll partner with product engineering teams to understand where infrastructure is a bottleneck, and set technical direction that the rest of the team executes against. As the platform scales, you'll also provide technical guidance to our traffic engineering team. You'll also mentor engineers, review designs, and help build a culture of ownership and operational excellence.

Read the full description

job.name: Senior Software Engineer, Cloud Engineering
job.description:
#TeamNextdoor Nextdoor is the essential neighborhood network. Neighbors, public agencies, and businesses use Nextdoor to connect around local information that matters in more than 350,000 neighborhoods across 11 countries. Nextdoor builds innovative technology to foster local community, share important news, and create neighborhood connections at scale. Download the app and join the neighborhood at nextdoor.com .

Meet Your Future Neighbors At Nextdoor, Cloud Engineers are responsible for building, deploying, managing, and securing the underlying cloud-based architecture that powers communities on the Nextdoor platform worldwide. These engineers have designed, built and implemented a globally scalable container and “serverless” based infrastructure that serves billions of requests a day, millions of active users, and hundreds of developers.

We build infrastructure and tooling that is iterable, scalable, and secure. We write everything in code from network infrastructure to server management, database provisioning, and data pipelines. Recently we have focused on scaling up our Kubernetes infrastructure. We created a dedicated management cluster to run ArgoCD, Loki, Prometheus, and Grafana. Additionally, we have created a second Kubernetes cluster for Nextdoor applications to ensure we can scale beyond the limitations of a single cluster. This will ensure Nextdoor’s infrastructure is able to scale for many years to come.

Additionally our team has focused efforts to modernize our Infrastructure as Code (IaC) by leveraging CDK to manage our AWS resources and Pulumi to manage our other core infrastructure systems such as PagerDuty, Datadog, and Sentry.

At Nextdoor, we operate in an AI-first environment and expect every team member to actively use AI tools as part of their workflow. We aren't looking for prompt engineers; we’re looking for people who use tools like Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, and Glean to challenge their own thinking and take full ownership of AI-assisted outputs.

We also offer a warm and inclusive work environment that embraces a hybrid employment model, blending an in office presence and work from home experience for our valued employees. The hiring team will go over these expectations with you if you are being considered for a role near one of our offices in San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago, Dallas, New York, and London.

The Impact You’ll Make You will be responsible for building an efficient and scalable container and serverless computing environment for our product developers. In this team you will work in the ways of reliability engineering, design scalable systems from the ground up, and generally build systems that never page you. You serve all of our engineering teams by providing them with reliable and scalable infrastructure.

job.name: Senior AWS Cloud Engineer
job.description:
About Us Founded in 2015 to develop the world’s first industrially scalable laser metal additive manufacturing solution, VulcanForms is reshaping how the world manufactures critical products. We build and operate advanced digital infrastructure that enables innovation, accelerates growth, and supports sustainability across aerospace, defense, medical, and other essential industries. Through our vertically integrated capabilities, including scalable additive manufacturing and precision machining, we deliver true end-to-end production at scale by combining cutting-edge technology with a foundation of proven industrial craftsmanship. Our team brings deep expertise in manufacturing, materials science, software, automation, and operations, united by a shared commitment to quality, curiosity, and accountability. We foster an inclusive culture where people take ownership, solve meaningful problems, and continuously learn, because we believe diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes.

Job Purpose As a Senior AWS Cloud Engineer, you will contribute to the digital foundation that powers VulcanForms’ manufacturing operations. You will build out, standardize, secure, scale and maintain a hybrid of AWS-hosted and on-premise services that provide mission-critical support across multiple sites. You will support developing the services that provide reliable data migration and processing from the edge to the cloud as well as analytics applications, enabling insights and innovative capabilities to unlock scalable additive manufacturing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the development of cloud infrastructure, ensuring availability and reliability for 24/7 manufacturing operations
  • Build out Infrastructure as Code (IaC) resources to automate environment provisioning, deployment, and service management
  • Scope, deploy, and manage AWS-hosted services spanning data ingestion, data lakes, and data warehousing
  • Implement comprehensive logging, tracing, and monitoring to ensure visibility into system health and performance
  • Partner with teams across the company to deliver services that accelerate their workstreams and enable new ways of working
  • Support and manage the software development lifecycle, deploying custom applications into production, and maintaining best practices

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in AWS in a Cloud, Platform, SRE, or DevOps Engineering.
  • Proven experience managing AWS-native resources in production environments.
  • Strong proficiency in CDK, Terraform, Pulumi, or Ansible to manage infrastructure.
  • Cloud-Native Networking: Solid understanding of service networking, load balancing, and securing edge-to-cloud traffic.
  • Proficiency in Python or Go for building custom operators, service integrations, or platform automation.
  • DevOps Leadership: Experience managing diverse deployment pipelines, supporting constantly raising the bar for software quality and development standards.

job.name: Senior Cloud Engineer
job.description:
Zachary Piper Solutions is seeking a Senior Cloud Engineer to support a company focused on federal modernization, cloud transformation, and mission-critical technology initiatives. This position is on-site in Huntsville, AL. The Senior Cloud Engineer will design, deploy, optimize, and sustain secure cloud infrastructure supporting enterprise applications, data platforms, and DevSecOps operations. This is an opportunity to play a key role in modernizing critical government systems while ensuring scalable, resilient, and secure cloud environments supporting high-impact national missions.

Responsibilities for the Senior Cloud Engineer include:

  • Design, build, and optimize cloud infrastructure supporting enterprise applications, data workloads, and modernization initiatives
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar automation tools

job.name: Head of AI Engineering & Center of Excellence (CoE)
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Head of AI Engineering

& Center of Excellence (CoE)

1. Role Overview

Our company is seeking a senior technology leader to establish and lead its AI Engineering Center of Excellence (CoE), driving the adoption of AI across enterprise engineering, insurance technology platforms, product development, and operational workflows.

The Head of AI Engineering & CoE will define AI engineering strategy, establish reusable AI architectures and frameworks, enable AI-assisted software development, and deliver scalable, secure, measurable AI solutions. The role combines technical leadership, architecture governance, engineering enablement, and people development.

A core objective is to turn individual AI experiments and isolated implementations into reusable enterprise capabilities that support Solartis’s product-platform strategy.

1. Key Responsibilities

A. AI Engineering Strategy and CoE Leadership

Establish the CoE charter, operating model, service offerings, engagement model, and delivery priorities.

Develop an AI engineering roadmap aligned with product strategy, technology priorities, and business objectives.

Identify opportunities to standardize AI capabilities and reduce duplicated implementations.

Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, implementation guidelines, and approved technology frameworks.

Partner with the CTO and engineering leadership to prioritize AI investments based on business value, feasibility, risk, and expected return.

Establish processes to evaluate AI initiatives, productionize successful pilots, and retire ineffective or duplicated solutions.

B. Enterprise AI Architecture and Shared Frameworks

Define scalable architectures for LLMs, SLMs, RAG, vector search, orchestration, and model integration.

Design reusable AI services, APIs, SDKs, libraries, reference implementations, and deployment patterns.

Establish patterns for model selection, prompt management, context engineering, embeddings, document processing, inference, and lifecycle management.

Evaluate AI frameworks, models, infrastructure, and platforms for performance, cost, security, scalability, and maintainability.

Define integration patterns for AI capabilities within existing platforms, services, applications, and development workflows.

Guide build-versus-buy decisions across managed AI services, open-source models, and internally developed capabilities.

C. AI-Assisted Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

Define and implement AI-assisted SDLC practices across requirements analysis, code generation, code understanding, test generation, code review, documentation, debugging, and maintenance.

Establish standards for responsible use of AI coding assistants and developer productivity tools.

Build reusable workflows and accelerators integrated with development environments, repositories, CI/CD pipelines, and quality processes.

job.name: Mechanical Engineering
job.description:
Mechanical Engineering AI Trainer About The Role We partner with the world's leading AI research labs to build smarter, more reliable AI systems — and we need mechanical engineers to make it happen. As a Mechanical Engineering AI Trainer, you'll use your deep technical expertise to challenge, evaluate, and improve how advanced AI models reason through complex engineering problems.

This is a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of engineering and artificial intelligence — contributing directly to the next generation of AI tools used by engineers and researchers worldwide.

  • Organization: Alignerr
  • Type: Hourly Contract
  • Location: Remote
  • Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

  • Design Advanced Engineering Problems — Craft challenging problems across fluid dynamics, thermodynamics, FEA, heat transfer, kinematics, and material science to rigorously test AI performance
  • Author Gold-Standard Solutions — Write precise, step-by-step technical solutions that serve as benchmarks for AI training and evaluation
  • Audit AI Reasoning — Review AI-generated outputs including CAD logic, thermodynamic proofs, and material specifications for technical accuracy, safety, and compliance with engineering standards (ASME, ISO, etc.)
  • Refine Model Thinking — Identify and document logical errors in AI reasoning — such as incorrect force distributions, energy conservation violations, or flawed structural assumptions — and provide structured feedback to improve model quality
  • Document Failure Modes — Systematically capture how and where AI models break down so engineering teams can address weaknesses

Who You Are

  • Advanced Degree — Master's (in progress or completed) or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a closely related discipline
  • Deep Domain Knowledge — Strong foundational expertise in solid mechanics, fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, CAD/CAM, or manufacturing processes
  • Technical Communicator — Able to explain complex physical phenomena and mathematical reasoning clearly and concisely in writing
  • Precision-Oriented — High attention to detail when reviewing derivations, unit conversions, boundary conditions, and physical constraints
  • No AI experience required — Your engineering expertise is what matters

Nice to Have

  • Experience with data annotation, data quality, or technical evaluation workflows
  • Proficiency with engineering software such as SolidWorks, MATLAB, or ANSYS
  • Familiarity with FEA solvers or CFD simulation environments
  • Prior technical writing or peer review experience

Why Join Us

  • Work on cutting-edge AI projects with top research labs around the world
  • Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule, 10–40 hours per week
  • Freelance autonomy with meaningful, intellectually stimulating work
  • Directly influence how AI understands and reasons through engineering challenges
  • Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

job.name: Lean 4 Proof Engineer - Mathematical Formalization
job.description:
Lean 4 Proof Engineer — Mathematical Formalization About The Role What if your deep mathematical training could directly shape how the world's most advanced AI systems reason about formal logic and proof? We're looking for Lean 4 Proof Engineers to translate complex, human-written mathematical arguments into precise, machine-verifiable formalizations — pushing the boundary of what modern proof assistants can express and automate.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role built for mathematicians who live at the intersection of rigorous proof construction and formal verification.

  • Organization: Alignerr
  • Type: Hourly Contract
  • Location: Remote
  • Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

  • Translate informal mathematical proofs into Lean 4 (and related systems) with an emphasis on clarity, structure, and correctness
  • Analyze domain-specific proofs, identifying gaps, hidden assumptions, and formalizable sub-structures
  • Construct formalizations that stress-test the limits of existing proof assistants — especially where automation breaks down
  • Collaborate with AI researchers to design, refine, and evaluate formal verification strategies
  • Develop readable, reproducible proof scripts aligned with best mathematical practices and proof assistant idioms
  • Provide expert guidance on proof decomposition, lemma selection, and structuring techniques for formal models
  • Investigate where automated provers fail and articulate why — complexity, missing lemmas, insufficient libraries, and more
  • Create Lean proofs that surface deeper patterns or generalizations implicit in the original mathematics

Who You Are

  • Hold a Master's degree or higher in Mathematics, Logic, Theoretical Computer Science, or a closely related field
  • Have a strong foundation in rigorous proof writing across areas such as algebra, analysis, topology, logic, or discrete math
  • Have hands-on experience with Lean (Lean 3 or Lean 4), Coq, Isabelle/HOL, Agda, or comparable systems — Lean strongly preferred
  • Are deeply enthusiastic about formal verification, proof assistants, and the future of mechanized mathematics
  • Can translate dense informal arguments into clean, well-structured formal proofs with precision

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with type theory, the Curry-Howard correspondence, and proof automation tools
  • Experience contributing to large-scale formalization projects such as mathlib
  • Exposure to theorem provers where automated reasoning frequently fails or requires extensive manual scaffolding
  • Prior experience with data annotation, evaluation systems, or AI training workflows
  • Strong communication skills for explaining formalization decisions, edge cases, and proof strategies to collaborators

The selected SRE and DevOps professional will be responsible for maintaining highly available production systems, managing cloud infrastructure, improving observability, and supporting reliable deployment and operations practices. job.description:

Experience: 6+ Years

Budget: Up to ₹1,00,000 Per Month (1 LPM)

Location: Pune

Work Mode: Hybrid

Notice Period: Immediate Joiners Only

Employment Type: Contractual Engagement 6 month after contractual duration complete this can be full time role.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled and hands-on Senior Agentic AI Engineer with strong expertise in Python, AWS Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, MCP (Model Context Protocol), and Multi-Agent AI architectures.

The ideal candidate should have proven experience designing, developing, deploying, and supporting enterprise-grade AI Agent solutions in production environments.

This role involves building autonomous and collaborative AI agents, implementing advanced orchestration patterns, developing MCP servers, integrating enterprise systems, and deploying scalable AI applications on AWS.

We are specifically looking for engineers who have delivered real-world production Agentic AI applications and can independently contribute to architecture, development, deployment, and operational support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deploy autonomous and multi-agent AI systems using Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore.
  • Build intelligent AI agents capable of planning, reasoning, decision-making, tool usage, memory management, and workflow orchestration.
  • Implement advanced multi-agent orchestration patterns, including Supervisor Agents, Collaborative Agents, Hierarchical Agents, and Agent Swarms.
  • Develop Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) workflows for approvals, validations, and controlled decision-making.
  • Design, build, and maintain MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and MCP-enabled tools.
  • Implement Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication and enterprise AI integration frameworks.
  • Integrate AI agents with enterprise applications, databases, APIs, SaaS platforms, and business systems.

  • Build scalable backend services and REST APIs using Python and FastAPI.
  • Containerize AI applications using Docker and deploy them on AWS ECS, EKS, Lambda, or AgentCore runtime environments.
  • Implement monitoring, tracing, observability, security, governance, guardrails, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Optimize AI agent performance, reliability, scalability, and production readiness.
  • Collaborate with engineering, architecture, and business teams to deliver enterprise-grade Agentic AI solutions.

Mandatory Technical Skills

1. AWS Bedrock & AgentCore

  • Strong hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock.

2. Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Architecture

job.name: Financial Analyst
job.description:
The Role We're looking for a Financial Analyst to own the systems that carry our financial planning, forecasting, consolidation, and reporting processes. Our finance data should be clean enough and well-presented enough inside our Financial Planning tool, Abacum, that people trust what they see to run the business. When a question is too dense or too multi-dimensional to answer well on the team space, it should live in our data platform tool as a Liveboard — and you should be the person who knows where that line sits and balances data in the best tool for managing the business questions.

This is an individual contributor role on the core corporate finance team, reporting to the Director of Finance – Budget and Cost Management, in a lean team at a fast-growing global AI and Agentic Tools company. You'll manage the finance system operations, support the monthly forecast, track the close cycle, and shadow the team to take on more data systems and analytic projects.

What You'll Do *Systems Design & Enhancement*

  • Serve as the primary system designer for Abacum — maintaining system health, performance, dimensions, hierarchies, and configuration across planning, consolidation, allocation, and reporting.
  • Manage finance applications, data, user access and security, system configuration, and version management to ensure appropriate controls and governance.
  • Design, build, and maintain financial models, workflows, calculation logic, and rules engines in Abacum to support planning, budgeting, forecasting, consolidation, and allocation.
  • Build and maintain ThoughtSpot finance Liveboards, keeping both reliably available for finance users.
  • Identify and share best practices in using AI-first reporting and planning tools.
  • Provide technical support and troubleshooting for finance and cost center users — resolving issues and answering system questions as the finance-side owner.
  • Keep definitions, semantics, and hierarchies aligned across the stack so your systems are the source of truth for financial data and internally consistent.
  • Own the enhancement roadmap — scope new capabilities, configure, test, manage releases, and work the vendor relationship.

*Data Management & Quality*

  • Own the accuracy and integrity of financial data across the stack.
  • Build and maintain validation rules, reconciliation controls, and quality checks between source systems and Abacum and ThoughtSpot data models.
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and drive them to resolution with the relevant teams.
  • Support data migration and transformation work as the stack evolves.
  • Treat data quality as a trust problem rather than a compliance one: numbers should reach the business without caveats attached.

*Business Partnership & Process Improvement*

We're looking for a Data Acquisition Director to lead the strategy and execution of sourcing high-quality datasets that fuel cutting-edge AI systems — from text and language corpora to structured records, multimedia assets, and beyond.

AI is only as good as the data it learns from. In this role, you'll be the person making sure that data is world-class — diverse, representative, ethically sourced, and precisely what our models need to get smarter. This is a strategic leadership role with real autonomy and direct impact on AI development at scale.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. No prior AI experience is strictly required — but you do need a proven track record in data sourcing, vendor management, partnerships, or content acquisition.

  • Organization: Alignerr
  • Type: Hourly Contract
  • Location: Remote

What You'll Do

  • Develop and execute data acquisition strategies to source high-quality, diverse datasets for AI training and evaluation
  • Identify, evaluate, and negotiate with data providers, content partners, and vendors worldwide — with particular strength in sourcing multilingual and Indic-language datasets
  • Define data requirements in close collaboration with AI research and engineering teams
  • Assess data quality, coverage, licensing, and compliance — ensuring all acquisitions meet ethical and legal standards
  • Build and manage a pipeline of data sources across multiple formats, languages, and domains
  • Monitor market trends and emerging data sources to stay ahead of evolving AI training needs

  • Track acquisition metrics, budgets, and timelines — reporting on progress and ROI
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams including legal, engineering, and product to ensure seamless data integration
  • Document sourcing strategies, vendor relationships, and acquisition workflows

Who You Are

  • Experienced in data sourcing, content acquisition, licensing, vendor management, or a related strategic function
  • Strong negotiator with a track record of building productive partnerships and closing deals
  • Analytical and detail-oriented — you can evaluate data quality and fitness-for-purpose with a critical eye
  • Comfortable working across diverse data types: text, audio, images, structured records, and more
  • Excellent communicator who can translate technical data needs into clear sourcing requirements
  • Self-directed and organized — you thrive with autonomy and manage competing priorities with ease

job.name: Mlops Devops Engineer
job.description:
MLOps / DevOps Engineer (Senior)

Experience: 5–9 Years

Engagement Type: Contract

Notice Period: Immediate Joiners Preferred

Location: Bangalore (Open to working from the client's office 3 days a week)

JOB REQUIREMENTPROFILE OVERVIEW

We are seeking a Senior MLOps Engineer to build and maintain the infrastructure that takes machine learning models from experimentation to production. You will design robust CI/CD pipelines for ML workflows, automate model training and deployment, and ensure our AI systems are reliable, observable, and scalable. This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, DevOps, and data science.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, build, and operate end-to-end ML pipelines: from data ingestion and feature engineering to model training, validation, and serving.
  • Implement CI/CD workflows for ML models, including automated testing, versioning, and canary deployments.
  • Manage and optimize model-serving infrastructure (batch and real-time) for latency, throughput, and cost.
  • Build monitoring and alerting systems for data drift, model performance degradation, and infrastructure health.
  • Maintain experiment tracking platforms and model registries to ensure reproducibility and governance.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning using IaC tools (Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation).
  • Collaborate with data scientists to containerize models and standardize training environments.
  • Implement feature stores, data versioning, and lineage tracking for ML data assets.
  • Develop internal tooling and self-service platforms to accelerate the ML development lifecycle.
  • Ensure security, compliance, and access controls across the ML platform.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5–8 years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, or MLOps, with significant focus on ML systems.
  • Strong programming skills in Python; working knowledge of Go, Bash, or similar.
  • Hands-on experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker) and cloud services (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Proficiency with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Argo Workflows, or similar).
  • Experience with ML pipeline frameworks (Kubeflow, Airflow, Prefect, Metaflow, or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with model-serving tools (TorchServe, Triton, TF Serving, Seldon, BentoML, or similar).
  • Solid understanding of monitoring and observability (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or equivalent).
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

GOOD TO HAVE

  • Experience building or managing GPU clusters for training workloads.
  • Familiarity with feature store platforms (Feast, Tecton, or equivalent).
  • Knowledge of data versioning tools (DVC, LakeFS, or similar).
  • Experience with ML experiment tracking tools (MLflow, Weights & Biases, Neptune).
  • Background in cost optimization for cloud-based ML workloads.
  • Exposure to LLM deployment, vector databases, or RAG infrastructure.

job.description:
We are looking for a senior technology leader to drive cloud operations, platform reliability and security for enterprise SaaS products.

Exp :15+

Location : Chennai, Madurai or Coimbatore

Leads : 24×7 Application Monitoring, SRE & AIOps, Cloud Infrastructure & Provisioning, Security Engineering & ISMS

Notice Period: Immediate joiner to 15days

The role

You will have end-to-end accountability of production operations and for meeting customer SLAs on production issues: 24×7 application monitoring, cloud infrastructure, reliability, operational security and security engineering, ISMS, disaster recovery and AIOps. You will lead functional managers across these areas. You will partner with the VP of Engineering, who owns the platform, the deployment tooling and AI-assisted SDLC/PDLC, including secure application design and code remediation. Key Responsibilities

  • Lead cloud infrastructure, SRE, 24×7 production operations and customer SLA management.

  • Strengthen cloud security, vulnerability management, DevSecOps and ISO compliance.
  • Improve automation, observability, operational efficiency and cloud cost optimization.
  • Lead engineering managers and technical teams to deliver secure, reliable and scalable platforms.

Requirements

  • 15+ years of technology experience with strong cloud operations or SRE leadership.
  • Proven ownership of customer-facing SaaS production environments.
  • Experience managing major incidents, customer SLAs and security remediation.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS, Azure, GCP or OCI, Kubernetes and DevSecOps.
  • Experience leading large technical teams and driving operational transformation.

job.name: Data Security & DLP Analyst
job.description:
Data Security & DLP Analyst (AI Training) About The Role Your experience with real-world data leaks, DLP controls, and sensitive information risk is exactly what's needed to make the next generation of AI smarter and safer. At Alignerr, we partner with the world's leading AI research labs to build cutting-edge models — and we need seasoned data security professionals to help us get it right.

This is a unique opportunity to apply your hands-on security expertise to frontier AI development, working remotely and on your own schedule.

  • Organization: Alignerr
  • Type: Hourly Contract
  • Location: Remote
  • Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

  • Analyze realistic data security and DLP scenarios spanning cloud, SaaS, and enterprise environments
  • Classify data sensitivity levels, exposure pathways, and policy violations
  • Evaluate prevention, detection, and incident response strategies for real-world scenarios
  • Generate, label, and validate data security cases used to train and benchmark AI systems
  • Help AI models reason accurately about sensitive information risk, data handling, and regulatory compliance

Who You Are

  • 2+ years of experience in data security, compliance, or security operations
  • Familiar with DLP tools, data classification frameworks, and privacy or regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, CCPA)
  • Practical understanding of how data exposure and insider threats play out in real enterprise environments
  • Able to think critically about security scenarios and communicate findings clearly in writing
  • Comfortable working independently and asynchronously

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud security posture management or SaaS security tools
  • Background in incident response, risk assessment, or data governance
  • Familiarity with AI training or evaluation workflows

Why Join Us

  • Work directly on frontier AI systems with top research labs
  • Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule
  • Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration
  • Put your security expertise to work on problems that genuinely matter
  • Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

job.name: AI Architect
job.description:
AI Architect

Location: Bengaluru, India

Experience: 10 to 15 years (8+ years in AI/ML, 2–4 years in GenAI/LLM systems)

Role: AI Architect (Architecture Ownership)

About Aurigo

Aurigo is an AI-native capital program management platform trusted by over 300 customers managing more than $450 billion in capital programs across North America. With over 40,000 projects delivered, Aurigo helps organisations in transportation, water and utilities, healthcare, higher education, and government plan, build, and manage infrastructure with confidence. Recognised as one of the Top 25 AI Companies of 2024 and a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years, we leverage artificial intelligence to create smarter, more connected outcomes. At Aurigo, we don't just build software — we help shape the future of infrastructure.

Role Overview:

We are hiring an AI Architect to lead the design and evolution of enterprise-grade AI platforms and GenAI systems at scale. This is a high-impact, architecture-first role focused on solving real-world AI problems beyond POCs—owning system design, production maturity, evaluation frameworks, and governance. You will define how AI systems are built, deployed, observed, and scaled across the organization.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Architecture & System Design

  • Define end-to-end architecture for LLM-powered platforms, copilots, and agent-based systems
  • Design scalable RAG architectures (retrieval, grounding, response orchestration)
  • Architect multi-agent systems integrating enterprise tools, APIs, and workflows

2. GenAI Platform & Knowledge Systems

  • Own the design of enterprise knowledge systems powered by LLMs and vector databases
  • Implement advanced retrieval strategies (hybrid search, re-ranking, context optimization)
  • Design memory, context management, and reasoning pipelines for complex workflows
  • Optimize systems for accuracy, latency, reliability, and cost at scale

3. Evaluation, Observability & Governance

  • Define and implement evaluation frameworks for RAG systems, agents, and copilots
  • Establish AI observability including traceability, monitoring, and feedback loops
  • Build guardrails, hallucination mitigation, and responsible AI controls

4. Cloud, MLOps & Production Engineering

  • Architect deployment pipelines on AWS (Bedrock, OpenAI, and equivalent services)
  • Design systems for scale, resilience, and high availability using microservices
  • Ensure production readiness: monitoring, rollback strategies, and cost optimization

5. Technical Leadership & Strategy

  • Act as the AI/GenAI technical authority across engineering teams
  • Mentor engineers and guide teams on best practices, trade-offs, and design choices
  • Drive AI roadmap, platform vision, and enterprise adoption strategy

job.name: AI Outcomes Associate, Digital Programs
job.description:
ThoughtSpot is a Data & AI platform that helps companies turn data into enterprise advantage. We're Gartner MQ leaders with more than 1,000 customers globally and offices in Mountain View, Chicago, London, Bangalore, Sydney, and Tokyo.

The Role The future of Customer Success isn't more headcount, it's smarter systems, better signals, and AI doing the work that shouldn't require a human.

As AI Outcomes Associate - Digital Programs, you'll own how ThoughtSpot delivers value to customers at scale. That means designing the journeys, engineering the automations, and orchestrating the moments including onboarding sequences, adoption nudges, health interventions, expansion triggers and in app journeys. You'll do this by building and scaling AI-powered workflows, intelligent lifecycle programs, and data-driven systems that make the entire Customer Outcomes organization faster and sharper.

This role is for someone who has already crossed the line from AI user to AI builder. You don't wait for a tool to exist, you assemble one. You see a manual process and your first instinct is to engineer it out of existence. You understand that the best digital programs don't feel digital to the customer receiving them, and you use AI to close that gap at scale.

What You'll Do

  • Digital Journey Architecture: Design and own the end-to-end customer journey from post-sale handoff through onboarding, adoption, expansion, and renewal. Map the moments that matter, define what triggers automated touchpoints vs. human intervention, and build AI-augmented programs that execute reliably across a large, segmented portfolio.
  • AI-Powered Lifecycle Programs: Build and iterate on lifecycle campaigns : onboarding sequences, adoption nudges, health-triggered outreach, feature activation plays, renewal readiness programs and leverage AI and automation to make them intelligent - dynamically personalized, contextually timed, and continuously learning from engagement signals.
  • Customer Health Intelligence: Instrument a health scoring model that covers all aspects of a customer relationship, not just login frequency. Build AI-assisted alerting that keeps the team ahead of risk rather than reacting to it
  • Agentic Workflow Development: Go beyond static automations. Build agentic pipelines using tools like LangChain, n8n, CrewAI, or custom LLM integrations that can monitor customer health, draft contextual outreach, recommend next best actions, and flag escalations with minimal manual input. Instrument every workflow for impact and iterate relentlessly.
  • Segmentation & Coverage Design: Define how the digital program segments the customer base - by tier, use case, lifecycle stage and match the right level of AI-led vs. human-led coverage to each. Own the logic that determines when a customer moves between digital and CSM-led engagement.
  • Content & Playbook Development: Build the asset library that powers the digital journey: onboarding guides, adoption playbooks, AI

Read the full description

job.name: Finacle Customization Consultant (Loans)
job.description:
Job Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Finacle Loans – Implementation & Customization Specialist responsible for end-to-end implementation, customization, testing, and deployment of the Finacle Loans module. The ideal candidate will play a critical role in delivering customized Finacle solutions for lending operations, ensuring alignment with business requirements and compliance with regulatory standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement and configure the Finacle Loans module as per business and functional requirements.
  • Perform gap analysis and translate business requirements into technical designs.
  • Develop custom components, ISF scripts, PL/SQL Queries, Stored Procedures, and integration interfaces/APIs.
  • Execute unit, system, integration, and UAT testing for all enhancements and configurations.
  • Manage deployment of customizations and patches across various environments.
  • Write and maintain Unix shell scripts to support deployment automation, batch job management, and system monitoring.
  • Work closely with business analysts, QA testers, and infrastructure teams to ensure smooth delivery.
  • Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve issues during testing, deployment, and post-go-live phases.

Maintain comprehensive documentation for customization, configuration, and deployment , adhering to audit and compliance requirements

Required Skills & Experience

  • Minimum 4+ years of hands-on experience with Finacle Core Banking, specifically in the Loan module.
  • Proficient in Finacle scripting (ISF/SSI), JSP/PCRE, and PL/SQL(Queries, Stored Procedures, Scripts).
  • Strong understanding of loan product parameterization and configuration in Finacle.
  • Experience with EOD/EOM processes, workflows, interest computation, EMI scheduling, and the full loan lifecycle.
  • Working knowledge of Unix/Linux, including shell scripting for automation, log analysis, and deployment tasks.
  • Strong debugging and issue-resolution skills.
  • Experience in test case creation, execution, and defect management.
  • Should be a self-starter capable of delivering results independently, without the need for hand-holding or continuous supervision.
  • Should be willing to work in the Phillippines Shift ( Morning 6.30 AM IST Onwards)

Good To Have

  • Experience with Finacle version 10.x or higher.
  • Exposure to Finacle API/web service integrations with third-party systems.
  • Understanding of regulatory reporting requirements such as NPA classification, CIBIL, etc.
  • Finacle certifications (technical or functional) are an added advantage.

Skills: finacle (customization / 10x environment),scripting (finacle scripting, srv workflows, batch jobs),sql / database,loans (finacle loans module expertise),reporting (mrt, jasper reports),integration (srv workflows, mtt, custom menus),frontend / javascript / jsp (enhancements, optional java knowledge),unix / linux shell scripting

job.name: CENtree Ontology Engineer
job.description:
Job Description: CENtree Ontology Engineer

1. Role Summary

The CENtree Ontology Engineer will design, model, curate, and manage ontologies, taxonomies, and controlled vocabularies in the SciBite CENtree platform. This engineer will lead ontology lifecycle management and integration, enabling precise and interoperable metadata across data assets.

2. Must-Have Technical Skills

2.1 Ontology & Semantic Modeling

  • Deep understanding of ontology concepts (RDF/OWL/SKOS)
  • Model, curate, and extend domain ontologies (life sciences/pharma focus)
  • Map data elements to controlled vocabularies and standards

2.2 CENtree Platform Usage

  • CENtree ontology curation, versioning, and publishing
  • Mapping and linking ontologies with data catalogs
  • Experience creating and managing term relationships, synonyms, and hierarchy

2.3 APIs & Integration

  • CENtree REST APIs for programmatic access and integration
  • Automate ontology publishing and validation workflows

2.4 Data Governance & Quality

  • Assist in defining and enforcing enterprise metadata standards
  • Support governance policies: standardization, stewardship, compliance

3. Key Responsibilities

1. Design, curate, and maintain ontologies and vocabularies in CENtree

2. Align business data assets to enterprise ontologies

3. Manage ontology versioning, releases, and impact analysis

4. Map and integrate ontologies with data catalogs and domain models

5. Work with platform/admin engineers to support high quality metadata flows

6. Develop and deliver ontology documentation and training materials

4. Soft Skills

  • Analytical problem-solving for semantic data challenges
  • Stakeholder collaboration with scientists, stewards, and platform teams
  • Strong written and verbal communication of complex models

5. Additional Details

  • Background in life sciences, pharma, or research data domains strongly preferred
  • Experience with standards such as SNOMED, MeSH, ChEBI, or CDISC is a plus

This is a combined role requiring expertise in both \\*Solution Architecture and .NET Software Development\\*.

During the initial phase, the selected professional will focus on designing the complete technical architecture, database structure, multi-tenancy strategy, security framework, and foundational backend components.

Following the initial architecture phase, the individual will transition primarily into hands-on .NET development and technical leadership, overseeing the engineering team, developing complex backend components, reviewing code, and ensuring successful implementation.

job.name: Machine Vision Engineer
job.description:
Who we are We build dark factories: fully autonomous, zero-defect production systems for electronics & semiconductor manufacturing. Based in Hyderabad , obsessed with tolerances, not corporate fluff.

The gig You own the imaging chain end to end — lens, lighting and sensor through to the algorithm and the app that ships inside the machine. Classical vision first, AI/ML where it actually earns its place. Prove it on real production parts, not curated sample images.

What you’ll do Size the imaging chain — FOV, working distance, µm/pixel, DOF, motion-blur budget · pick sensors, lenses, filters & lighting geometry · set exposure, gain, strobe and triggering to a latency budget · build GenICam/GenTL pipelines sized to cycle time · write algorithms from first principles — sub-pixel edges, pattern matching, blobs & contours · own camera, distortion & hand-eye calibration into robot coordinates · deploy AI/ML where classical falls short · ship a real app with a live-view operator HMI · talk to PLCs, robots & machine I/O · commission it on the floor.

Must haves Bachelor's/Master's in CS, ECE, EE or Mechatronics · 2+ yrs in machine vision, CV, robotics or automation · hands-on optical design — FOV, WD, focal length, magnification, DOF, µm/pixel — and the lens/sensor/lighting to match · algorithms you wrote yourself, not just library calls · calibration, distortion correction & coordinate transforms · strong C++ or C# with working Python · OpenCV and/or Halcon, VisionPro, Matrox or pylon vTools · one AI/ML model actually deployed · vendor SDKs in production apps · Qt/QML, WPF/.NET or PySide · multithreading, profiling, real-time · Git, tests, code reviews.

Nice to haves Telecentric & macro optics, line scan, Scheimpflug · MTF and lens qualification · CoaXPress, 10 GigE, frame grabbers · strobe controllers & encoder-synced acquisition · Halcon, Cognex, Keyence · 2D/3D vision, profilometry, metrology · deep learning for defect & anomaly detection · DataMatrix/OCR with ISO/IEC 15415/15416 grading · CUDA/TensorRT · EtherCAT, OPC UA, PROFINET · gauge R&R, SPC · 24/7 traceability & fault recovery.

tl;dr Can you pick the lens, light the part, write the algorithm and ship the app that runs it 24/7? Come build machines that actually see. No black boxes — except ours.

Partner with product and business-unit teams to build security into the full lifecycle, from concept and architecture through release, production operations, maintenance, and vulnerability response. Provide staff-level technical leadership through security architecture, threat modeling, penetration testing, and reusable engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Security & Secure by Design

  • Set risk-based security direction across product portfolios. Establish reusable architecture patterns, security baselines, risk registers, review checkpoints, and measurable security objectives tailored to each product’s architecture, deployment model, intended use, and applicable regulatory profile.
  • Drive secure-by-design from concept through retirement. Define security requirements and design-review checkpoints; guide implementation; verify controls before release; and support secure deployment, configuration, operations, maintenance, updates, and end-of-support planning.

Security Architecture, Threat Modeling & Penetration Testing

  • Design and review secure architectures for desktop and instrument software, embedded and IoT systems, web applications and APIs, on-premises deployments, and AWS, Azure, or GCP services. Assess trust boundaries and dependencies across identity, network, endpoint, server, instrument connectivity, data flows, and third-party services; recommend controls for authentication, authorization, encryption, segmentation, secure configuration, and resilience.
  • Lead structured threat modeling and attack-surface reviews using methods such as STRIDE, attack trees, misuse cases, data-flow analysis, and trust-boundary mapping. Translate credible threats into prioritized risk scenarios, security requirements, testable controls, and verification plans; track material risks through remediation or documented acceptance.
  • Plan and conduct authorized manual penetration tests across instrument communications, embedded/Linux systems, desktop applications, web and API services, cloud deployments, and software supply-chain interfaces. Validate findings, explain business and product impact, prioritize remediation with engineering teams, and retest fixes.

DevSecOps & Secure Engineering

job.name: Quality Assurance Engineer
job.description:
Job Title: QA ENGINEER & TECHNICAL SUPPORT

Location: Noida, Sector 63 (On-site)

Experience: 2–4 years

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary

We are seeking a versatile and highly skilled individual to join our team as a QA Engineer and Technical Support professional. This role combines technical expertise in software quality assurance, particularly automation testing, with strong client-facing and project coordination abilities. The successful candidate will help ensure the quality of our software applications while serving as a primary contact for clients, managing their needs, and facilitating effective communication between clients and development teams.

Key Responsibilities

Software Quality Assurance and Automation

  • Develop and enforce a robust automated software quality engineering strategy, including practices and processes that ensure consistent application quality.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts and frameworks, collaborating closely with project and business teams to improve system effectiveness and efficiency.
  • Lead and manage project quality through effective quality engineering practices, ensuring deliverables meet agreed timelines, cost expectations, and quality standards.
  • Provide hands-on leadership throughout the QA lifecycle, supporting both manual and automated testing in an Agile environment.
  • Estimate testing effort for low- and medium-complexity applications and maintain a comprehensive test coverage matrix.
  • Define automation test strategies and test plans for different applications, taking business needs and return on investment (ROI) into account.
  • Identify appropriate device coverage for applications.

Client and Technical Support

  • Serve as the first point of contact for customer concerns related to technical issues, advocate for customers, and communicate their needs to internal developers.
  • Respond to and resolve technical inquiries promptly in accordance with established service-level agreement (SLA) guidelines.
  • Stay aware of customer business priorities and key events, providing proactive issue-status updates to relevant stakeholders.
  • Record and document customer issues according to established processes; troubleshoot and qualify cases before escalating them to developers.
  • Troubleshoot implementation problems and investigate complex issues that require in-depth evaluation and problem-solving skills.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to learn new concepts, resolve complex issues, and occasionally lead knowledge-sharing sessions.
  • Reproduce customer-reported issues using available documentation, knowledge bases, community resources, and peer support.

Team Leadership and Collaboration

  • Guide and oversee a small team of 3–6 people throughout the software development life cycle (SDLC), from test-case creation through test closure.

  • SAP BW / BW4HANA, SAP HANA or SAP MDG.
  • AWS / Azure / GCP exposure.

  • GenAI / AI-ML data architecture exposure.

job.description:
• Serve as the functional lead for Workday, overseeing configuration, business processes, and cross-functional design
  • Develop and execute a Workday optimization roadmap focused on usability, process efficiency, and adoption
  • Partner with CoE HR Systems Head, HR leadership and CoEs in the execution of Workday roadmap strategy
  • Establish and manage Workday governance processes for enhancement prioritization and change control
  • Oversee configuration, testing, and deployment of updates across Workday modules (e.g., HCM, Compensation, Talent, Absence, Time Tracking, Recruiting)
  • Identify system pain points, inefficiencies, and process gaps — and lead optimization initiatives to resolve them
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation of system configurations, workflows, and functional designs
  • Ensure that configuration decisions adhere to internal controls, audit standards, and security requirements
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives through regular health checks, release analysis, and stakeholder feedback
  • Evaluate new Workday features released biannually, recommending adoption plans and change impact
  • Partner with process owners to simplify workflows, reduce manual effort, and increase automation through Workday capabilities
  • Champion a “Workday-first” mindset across HR and business functions
  • Perform regular Survey in the organization to get constant feedback on workday Adoption
  • Collaborate with HR, Payroll, Finance, and IT to understand business needs and translate them into scalable Workday solutions
  • Serve as an escalation point for Workday-related issues, providing expert-level functional support and troubleshooting
  • Proven expertise across multiple Workday modules (e.g., Core HCM, Compensation, Absence, Time Tracking, Talent, Recruiting)
  • Experience leading Workday optimization or enhancement projects in a corporate or global environment
  • Strong understanding of HR processes, data governance, and system interdependencies
  • Workday certification(s) in one or more modules (Core HCM, Compensation, Reporting, etc.)
  • Experience with Workday reporting tools (Advanced, Composite, Matrix, or Dashboards)
  • Familiarity with Workday integrations and system architecture
  • Experience in global Workday environments or with Workday release management

job.name: Banking Advisory Associate
job.description:
Skill required: Com.Bkg- Credit UW - Commercial Credit Underwriting

Designation: Banking Advisory Associate

Qualifications: BCom/MCom/Master of Business Administration

Years of Experience: 1 to 3 years

About Accenture Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com

What would you do? We help clients address quality and productivity issues, keep pace with customer expectations, navigate regulatory and operational pressures and ensure business sustainability by transforming their banking operations into an agile, resilient operating model. Com.Bkg- Credit UW stands for Commercial Banking Credit Underwriting. It involves evaluating the creditworthiness of businesses applying for loans or credit. This process includes analyzing financial statements, assessing risk, and determining the terms of the credit. The goal is to ensure that the bank makes sound lending decisions while minimizing risk. Credit underwriters play a crucial role in maintaining the financial health of the bank. The Credit Lending processes includes initial set up of loan, detailed analysis of financials, setting covenants, analyzing the accounts receivable for borrowing base calculation for working capital line of credit, drafting a detailed credit memoranda by a detailed analysis of 5 Cs of Credit - Character, Capacity, Collateral, Capital and Current Market Conditions. Conduct detailed research on the financial history of businesses to determine their creditworthiness. Assess the risk parameters of the loan, borrower, and industry including the Financial performance of the borrower and guarantor, assessing the repayment capacity and recommending the future course of action in approving/declining/counter offer of business loans.

programs, and providing review and guidance on robust controls design adhering to Citi’s Policies,

Standards, and Frameworks. Individuals proactively identify and drive controls enhancements such as

automation, standardization and rationalization including transformation execution activities. Includes first

line activities for identification, measurement (significance and likelihood), and ongoing assessment of key

risks and controls in partnership with relevant process owners to drive management decisions to operate

within the firm’s Risk Appetite.

  • Serve as a primary coordination and reporting point of contact for internal reviews and regulatory examinations across Wealth Lending and Deposits.

job.name: Senior Manager - Commercial Reporting Excellence
job.description:
GCL: E

Introduction To Role Are you ready to industrialise how reporting is delivered—using process excellence, AI and agentic workflows—to absorb growing demand without adding manual effort? This role develops the future of commercial reporting by transforming fragmented processes into a scalable, consistent, and increasingly agent-assisted operating model. It frees teams to focus on high-value interpretation and decision support.

As the enterprise-wide lead for reporting transformation, you will be responsible for the roadmap, set common standards, and build reusable capabilities that improve cycle time, quality and cost-to-serve. You will work horizontally across reporting teams to eliminate unnecessary work, rationalise the portfolio and orchestrate adoption of AI-enabled workflows that are safe, governed and trusted. How would you redesign end-to-end workflows to put human judgement where it adds the most value?

Accountabilities

  • Transformation Roadmap Ownership: Build an end-to-end view of reporting demand, services, workflows, technology, capacity, cost and performance. Lead the cross-portfolio approach to reporting excellence, setting the direction for standardisation, automation and agentification.
  • Process and Workflow Redesign: Challenge established processes, hand-offs and controls before automating. Apply Lean and process-excellence methods to eliminate failure demand and unnecessary activity. Redesign workflows around human and AI-agent delivery and lead a prioritised backlog from discovery through adoption and benefits realisation.
  • Portfolio Optimisation: Maintain visibility of demand, usage, value, cost-to-serve, ownership and lifecycle status. Apply a consistent framework to retain, enhance, consolidate, automate, convert to self-service, AI-enable or retire reporting assets. Lead cross-service solutions that reduce duplication, manual effort, variation and technical debt.
  • AI Enablement and Agentification: Embed AI, generative AI, intelligent automation and agentic workflows into development, production, quality and consumption. Develop reusable capabilities for commentary, quality assurance, anomaly detection, conversational access, documentation, lineage, developer productivity and workflow coordination. Assess opportunities for value, feasibility, scalability, adoption, quality, cost and sustainability, retaining human oversight where it contributes.
  • Standards and Reusable Capabilities: Set enterprise-wide standards for development, user experience, documentation, testing, deployment and lifecycle management. Establish common definitions, metrics, frameworks, templates and technical components to support scalable, automated and self-service delivery. Monitor adoption and challenge exceptions that create avoidable cost, complexity or risk.

Job Description:

Senior Software Developer – AI Platform Engineering (B2B Integration)

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly motivated Senior Software Developer with strong engineering expertise and practical experience in modern AI technologies.

In this role, you will design and develop enterprise-grade services that combine Java-based microservices, cloud-native architectures, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI-driven workflows.

You will work closely with software engineers, architects, product owners, and platform teams to deliver scalable, secure, observable, and maintainable solutions for global enterprise customers.

This position is ideal for developers who enjoy building production-ready systems and applying AI technologies to solve real-world business and integration challenges.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Build scalable microservices and APIs that support AI-enabled platform capabilities.
  • Develop integrations between internal systems, cloud services, and external AI platforms.
  • Implement event-driven architectures using Kafka or similar messaging technologies.
  • Contribute to platform components that support enterprise-scale B2B integration scenarios.

AI Engineering

  • Develop AI-powered application features using Large Language Models (LLMs).
  • Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, semantic search, and knowledge retrieval capabilities.
  • Design prompt orchestration, context management, and AI workflow logic.
  • Integrate AI tools, external services, and agent-based workflows into enterprise applications.
  • Contribute to the implementation of AI governance, guardrails, and responsible AI practices.
  • Evaluate and adopt emerging AI frameworks, technologies, and engineering approaches.

Cloud & DevOps

  • Develop and deploy cloud-native applications on modern cloud platforms.
  • Build and maintain containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and release processes.
  • Support platform scalability, reliability, resilience, and operational excellence.

Engineering Excellence

job.description:
About the Role
We're looking for a hands-on Lead Engineer to design and build corporate systems at Staples. You'll own backend development on Java and Spring Boot, work across UNIX environments and databases, and help shape portal and platform work on WebSphere / HCL DX. You'll guide a small group of engineers and work closely with business and platform teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain corporate applications using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Build and improve RESTful services and backend components with a focus on performance, security and maintainability.
  • Write and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures and data-access layers.
  • Automate operational and deployment tasks using UNIX shell scripting.
  • Lead technical design discussions, code reviews and engineering best practices.
  • Support portal development and enhancements on WebSphere / HCL DX.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, carry out root-cause analysis and drive permanent fixes.
  • Work in Agile teams using Jira, Bitbucket and Confluence for planning, version control and documentation.
  • Mentor junior engineers and support knowledge sharing across the team.
  • Work with architects, QA, DevOps and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality releases on schedule.

Requirements

Primary Skills (Must Have)

  • Strong hands-on experience in Core Java (Java 8+; Java 17 preferred)
  • Solid experience with Spring Boot (Spring MVC, Spring Data / JPA, REST APIs)
  • Good working knowledge of UNIX / Linux and shell scripting
  • Strong SQL skills (Oracle or another RDBMS), including query tuning

Good to Have

  • Microservices architecture and design patterns
  • Apache Tomcat and IBM WebSphere application servers
  • Portal development on WebSphere Portal / HCL DX
  • Groovy and VBScript
  • Microsoft Azure cloud services
  • Kubernetes and containerized deployments
  • Atlassian Suite: Jira, Bitbucket, Confluence

Behavioral Competencies

  • A strong team player who works well across functions
  • Eager to learn and quick to pick up new technologies and tools
  • Takes ownership and shows a problem-solving mindset
  • Clear verbal and written communication
  • Able to guide and support team members

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field
  • 6–10 years of software development experience, including at least 2 years in a technical lead or senior engineer role

job.name: Business Administration (MBA) - AI Content Specialist
job.description:
About The Role What if your MBA — your hard-won expertise in finance, strategy, and operations — could directly shape how AI advises the next generation of business leaders and executives?

We're looking for MBA-qualified professionals to challenge, evaluate, and improve advanced AI models on the toughest questions in business. You'll stress-test AI reasoning across corporate finance, market strategy, supply chain, and organizational behavior — and build the gold-standard solutions that make these models smarter, sharper, and genuinely useful at the executive level.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. No AI background needed — just deep business expertise and a rigorous analytical mind.

  • Organization: Alignerr
  • Type: Hourly Contract
  • Location: Remote
  • Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

  • Design Complex Business Challenges — Craft advanced case studies and quantitative problems spanning DCF valuation, market entry strategy, operations bottlenecks, cap table modeling, and more
  • Author Gold-Standard Solutions — Write rigorous, step-by-step responses — complete with financial statements, strategic frameworks (4Ps, 5Cs, Porter's Five Forces), and executive-level rationales — that serve as training benchmarks for AI models
  • Audit AI Business Reasoning — Evaluate AI-generated business plans, financial forecasts, and case analyses for logical consistency, mathematical accuracy, and adherence to professional standards
  • Refine and Correct AI Thinking — Identify flawed reasoning such as sunk cost errors, miscalculated WACC, or failure to account for macroeconomic variables, and provide structured, actionable feedback

Who You Are

  • Holder of a Master of Business Administration (MBA) from an accredited institution
  • Strong foundational knowledge across at least two core business disciplines: Finance, Marketing, Operations, or Strategic Management
  • Skilled at synthesizing complex data into clear, executive-style recommendations
  • Exceptionally detail-oriented — you catch formula errors, logical inconsistencies, and weak arguments others miss
  • Comfortable working independently and asynchronously on your own schedule
  • No prior AI or tech experience required

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience in management consulting, investment banking, or corporate strategy
  • Background in data annotation, quality assurance, or evaluation systems
  • Proficiency in data-driven decision tools such as Excel financial modeling, Tableau, or SQL
  • Experience writing case studies, executive reports, or business school curriculum

Why Join Us

  • Work directly with industry-leading AI research labs on cutting-edge projects
  • Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
  • Freelance autonomy with meaningful, intellectually stimulating work
  • Apply your MBA expertise to a field that is actively reshaping the global business landscape
  • Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

job.name: BI ERP Technical Project Manager
job.description:
Would you like to lead digital transformation? Would you like to be involved in bringing innovative solutions? Join our dynamic Digital Technology Team We operate at the heart of the digital transformation of our business. Our team is responsible for digitization initiatives, from defining digital strategy to enabling employee success, the Digital Technology team provides world class products and services to our business partners..

Partner with the best We are seeking an experienced BI ERP Technical Project Manager to lead the planning, prioritization, and delivery of Business Intelligence and Data initiatives within our Oracle BI Platform .

In this role, you will serve as the primary liaison between Business stakeholders, Oracle ERP functional teams, Solution Architects, technical delivery teams, and external delivery partners, ensuring that reporting and analytics requirements are translated into scalable, reliable, and business-focused solutions.

This position combines strong project management, stakeholder engagement, vendor management, and technical leadership capabilities. You will be responsible for managing a portfolio of BI initiatives while driving alignment across business priorities, ERP roadmaps, architecture standards, and delivery plans.

Unlike a traditional Project Manager role, this position requires a highly hands-on individual with strong technical acumen. The successful candidate will be expected to work directly with existing BI and ERP solutions, analyzing reports, integrations, database objects, and application code to understand business processes, identify impacts, and support solution design. The ability to perform reverse engineering of existing PL/SQL code, ODI integrations, OBIEE reports, and Oracle ERP data models is essential to uncover business logic, reconstruct requirements, and support modernization, optimization, and rationalization initiatives.

Working closely with Business Process Owners, Oracle ERP teams, Blueprint organizations, and vendor teams, you will drive demand management, project planning, prioritization, delivery governance, stakeholder communication, and execution oversight. The role also carries accountability for managing external partners and system integrators, ensuring delivery quality, adherence to timelines, effective resource utilization, and alignment with business priorities and enterprise standards. You will be expected to build strong relationships across all stakeholders while maintaining clear ownership of delivery outcomes for the Oracle BI platform.

As a BI ERP Technical Project Manager, you will be responsible for Business & Project Leadership

job.name: IoT Integration Deployment Engineer
job.description:
Role Summary

You will be company's engineer in the customer's environment. You will scope each project with the client, design how Envizom fits their infrastructure, deploy and integrate it on their servers or cloud, migrate their existing data, and keep the live system healthy. The role combines solution design, Linux and database work, IoT integrations and direct client communication.

Key Result Areas (KRAs)

1. Architecture & Scoping

  • Run requirement calls with clients and vendors; collect infrastructure, network, security and integration details.
  • Design the application and database layout to fit the customer's local infrastructure, network constraints and security compliance (including data-residency rules).
  • Produce the solution design, server sizing, prerequisite checklist and effort estimate for sign-off.

2. Local Deployment & Setup

  • Install and configure the application stack (Node.js services, Docker), web servers (Nginx) and databases (PostgreSQL, Cassandra) on customer VMs or on-premises hardware.
  • Set up domains, SSL, firewall rules, backups and monitoring, and run go-live checks with the client.

3. Remote Infrastructure Management

  • Access customer environments securely over VPN and SSH to monitor server health, manage CPU, memory and disk, and troubleshoot live infrastructure.
  • Apply upgrades and patches in planned windows, often with restricted access or limited sudo rights.

4. Low-Level VM Automation

  • Write Bash and Python scripts to automate installs, health checks, log collection and backups.
  • Debug network and API blockers inside VMs with terminal tools such as curl, netstat/ss, systemctl, journalctl and tcpdump.

5. Data Migration

  • Plan and execute data transfers and schema updates from legacy systems into the new environment without data loss.
  • Validate migrated data (counts, time ranges, checksums) and keep a tested rollback plan.

6. IoT Device Data Integration

  • Integrate company and third-party devices, gateways and external systems with Envizom using the right protocol for each: MQTT (QoS, TLS, broker setup), Modbus TCP/RTU, HTTP/REST APIs (push and pull), webhooks, FTP/SFTP file drops and raw TCP/UDP sockets; OPC UA where required.
  • Decode device payloads (JSON, CSV, hex/binary, register maps), handle scaling, units, time zones and missing data, and map them to Envizom parameters.
  • Push data on to client systems and regulatory portals on schedule, with retries and delivery checks.

7. Edge Coding, Scripting & Integration

You will coordinate a baseline assessment of current workplace-risk and compliance arrangements across defined operations, then convert findings into structured plans, owned actions, governance reporting and practical implementation.

job.name: Postdoctoral Scholar-Fixed Term
job.description:
Position Summary

Position Summary : An in-person postdoctoral scholar position is available in the Department of Fisheries and Wildlife at Michigan State University (MSU) in East Lansing, Michigan. This position is funded for at least two years. The preferred start date is 4 January 2027, but a later start date may be considered.

This position is part of Evaluating New Approaches to Deer Overabundance and Chronic Wasting Disease Management , a broader four-year project led by Michigan State University (MSU) in partnership with the Michigan Department of Natural Resources (DNR) Wildlife Division and the CWD Research Consortium. The project tests whether coordinated, community-based deer management interventions can increase hunter harvest and change deer population and disease outcomes, using a treatment and control design in townships in the southern Lower Peninsula of Michigan. The project combines assessments of hunter and landowner social and behavioral conditions with ecological outcomes such as deer harvest, density, demographics, and CWD prevalence.

Connection to a multistate project This position contributes to a multistate adaptive management project developed through the Chronic Wasting Disease (CWD) Research Consortium. The project brings together state wildlife agencies, universities, and federal research partners to evaluate coordinated approaches to deer and CWD management across the Midwest. It integrates human dimensions research with monitoring of deer populations and CWD to assess whether agency and landowner partnerships and interventions to increase antlerless harvest can support population and disease management goals. Specifically, human dimensions research examines factors influencing landowner decisions about deer harvest, participation in management activities, and responses to interventions.

job.name: Senior Agentic AI Engineer
job.description:
Senior Agentic AI Engineer

About the Role

Insurance software implementations are among the most complex, document-heavy, and process-intensive programmes in enterprise technology. A single implementation can involve thousands of configuration decisions, hundreds of requirement documents, and years of delivery time. Sapiens is rebuilding how that work gets done — using production-grade AI agents that operate across the full implementation lifecycle, from pre-sales and scoping through to configuration, testing, and go-live.

Work You'll Do

Agent architecture & orchestration

  • Design and implement agentic systems capable of multi-step reasoning, planning, tool use, and workflow execution against complex, document-intensive implementation processes
  • Build stateful workflows using LangGraph or equivalent — including branching, retries, self-correction, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and reusable orchestration patterns
  • Engineer for long-horizon reliability — multi-step task completion, recovery from compounding errors, planning under uncertainty, and robust tool use when individual steps fail
  • Build the reasoning behind high-stakes implementation decisions — criteria-grounded outputs, structured review patterns, and auditable rationales that delivery consultants can act on and defend

Retrieval, grounding & context engineering

  • Develop end-to-end RAG pipelines: ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector and hybrid retrieval, reranking, contextual compression, and grounding strategies
  • Engineer memory and context management — conversational state, persistent memory, retrieval-aware context assembly, and token-efficient context selection
  • Apply MCP-style tool and context interfaces so agents access the right information at the right time across enterprise knowledge repositories, document sources, and structured configuration data

Reliability, evaluation & safety

  • Implement observability and tracing for prompts, tool calls, retrieval quality, agent traces, failures, drift, latency, and production behaviour
  • Apply guardrails, safety controls, and failure-handling to reduce hallucinations in agents whose outputs practitioners act on directly in live client settings
  • Evaluate agents at trajectory and task level — multi-step task success, failure-mode and regression analysis, sandboxed test environments — alongside retrieval and generation quality metrics, automated checks, and human review

Integration & production craft

What you’ll do

Tech environment

The target stack is set, but you will have a real say in final choices.

LayerTechnology

Ingestion

AWS DMS (full load + CDC), scheduled batch loaders, PostHog batch exports

Storage

Amazon S3 + Apache Iceberg, AWS Glue catalog

Governance

AWS Lake Formation, IAM, two AWS regions (London, Ireland)

Transformation

dbt Core on Amazon Athena

Orchestration

Dagster or Amazon MWAA (Airflow)

BI

Amazon Quick Sight with embedded dashboards and tag-based row-level security

Engineering

Terraform, GitHub, CI/CD, Python, SQL

What you’ll bring

  • Around 6–9 years in data engineering, with at least 2–3 years building modern lakehouse or dbt platforms hands-on.
  • Production AWS data experience: S3, DMS, Glue, Lake Formation, and IAM—ideally across more than one region or account.
  • Production experience with Apache Iceberg (or Delta/Hudi): table design, partitioning, compaction, and snapshot expiry.
  • Deep dbt experience: incremental models, snapshots, tests, and keeping a growing project tidy.
  • Excellent SQL and solid Python.
  • Terraform (or similar) and CI/CD for data projects.
  • Hands-on experience with an orchestrator such as Dagster, Airflow, or Prefect.

  • Practical GDPR knowledge: personal data masking, data residency, and least-privilege access.
