  • Organization: Alignerr
  • Type: Hourly Contract
  • Location: Remote
  • Commitment: 20–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and optimize high-performance C++ systems supporting AI data pipelines and evaluation workflows
  • Develop full-stack tooling and backend services for large-scale data annotation, validation, and quality control
  • Improve reliability, performance, and safety across production C++ codebases
  • Identify bottlenecks and edge cases in data and system behavior, and implement scalable, robust fixes
  • Collaborate with data, research, and engineering teams to support model training and evaluation workflows

Who You Are

  • Native or fluent English speaker with clear written and verbal communication skills

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience with data annotation, data quality pipelines, or evaluation systems
  • Familiarity with AI/ML workflows, model training, or benchmarking infrastructure
  • Experience building distributed systems or developer tooling at scale

Why Join Us

  • Work on real production systems supporting some of the world's leading AI research labs
  • Fully remote and flexible — structure your hours around your life
  • Freelance autonomy with the substance of high-impact, technically challenging work
  • Contribute directly to infrastructure that shapes how next-generation AI models are built and evaluated
  • Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as projects grow and expand

job.name: Software Development Engineer II
job.description:
Description Every time a customer taps "Buy Now" on Amazon, the software behind that moment has been validated, released, and proven reliable by our team. We build the validation and release tooling that powers the checkout experience for hundreds of millions of customers placing 23 billion orders per year, and we are looking for a Software Development Engineer to help us make that process faster and more dependable. In this role, you will design and maintain tooling that accelerates how partner teams ship code from first commit to production, catching defects early and ensuring every release meets a high quality bar. You will work across the full software development lifecycle alongside Software Development Engineers, Software Development Managers, and Technical Program Managers from feature and application teams, directly shaping how one of the world's largest e-commerce platforms delivers new capabilities to customers.

Key job responsibilities

  • Design and build validation and release tooling that helps hundreds of partner teams ship code faster while catching defects at the code-review stage, before they reach production.
  • Implement architectural improvements that make core front-end and business logic applications more robust, testable, and easier to maintain over time.
  • Collaborate with Software Development Engineers, Software Development Managers, and Technical Program Managers across feature and application teams to improve the end-to-end software development lifecycle for checkout.
  • Identify root causes of operational issues and deliver permanent fixes, continuously raising the reliability of the validation and release pipeline.
  • Mentor fellow engineers through code reviews and design discussions, sharing knowledge that helps the broader team produce high-quality, well-documented software.

A day in the life

You might start your morning reviewing a design proposal for a new replay-validation capability, then shift into writing code that wires it into the release pipeline. After lunch you could be debugging a tricky validation edge case with a partner team's engineer or reviewing pull requests and coaching a teammate on testing strategies. Throughout the day you will connect with engineers across feature and application teams, ensuring the tooling you build keeps pace with the volume of code changes flowing through the system.

As the Software Development Engineer for the Neuron Foundation Tools Team, you will be responsible for working alongside a team of engineers to develop and maintain high-performance monitoring and observability tools for machine learning applications and AI accelerators. You will work on design, development, and deployment of the Neuron Tools. A day in the life

You will work with the executive leadership and other senior management and technical leaders to define product directions and deliver them to customers. Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work/Life Balance

Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. You will work across PCIe topology, Networking, and critical subsystem diagnostics, Linux drivers, and telemetry pipelines to correlate signals and isolate faults at fleet scale.

Why You Will Love It

Your automation runs at a large scale across servers in the cloud. When you ship, you see failure rates move within days. The team is small enough that your decisions shape the architecture, and large enough that you will always have experts to learn from across hardware, firmware, and software.

The Ideal Candidate

You know the full stack from bare-metal to userland. You debug at the intersection of components, not just within them. You build at cloud scale and care how your systems decisions impact customers. You are an excellent communicator who can drive alignment across hardware, software, and operations teams.

Key job responsibilities

Fleet Health & Predictive Infrastructure

  • Build and own the automation infrastructure for fleet health at a large scale of servers, driving toward zero-touch operations that detect, diagnose, triage, and remediate faults without human intervention
  • Design and develop test frameworks, test coverage strategies, and diagnostic tooling to validate hardware functionality, detect faults, and ensure qualification coverage across the platform lifecycle.
  • Design predictive failure detection using telemetry, sensor data, error trending, and log correlation to identify degrading components before customer impact
  • Develop monitoring dashboards and alerting for real-time fleet health visibility across manufacturing, lab, and production environments
  • Define and track fleet health metrics: failure rates, mean time to detect and resolve issues, first-time fix rate, test dwell time, and predictive accuracy

Debugging & Troubleshooting

job.name: DSX NVCRE Senior Engineer
job.description:
NVIDIA is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our DSX team to build and operate the tooling that verifies AI infrastructure is ready for production. You will work on cluster readiness and certification software, including the open-source Cluster Readiness Engine, that validates GPU clusters across Kubernetes and Slurm, measures real training and inference performance, and produces evidence customers and partners can trust. We partner with the world's most innovative AI companies and cloud providers to make sure their infrastructure performs as designed before their most important workloads land on it.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Shape the Future of Validation. Design and build the systems that turn cluster validation from a manual exercise into repeatable, verifiable software. Your work will directly shape how NVIDIA and its partners qualify new GPU platforms and deployments.
  • Core Development. Design and implement cluster readiness and certification tooling in Go and Python that runs on Kubernetes and Slurm, including controllers, operators, CLIs, and scheduler integrations.
  • Benchmarking & Workloads. Build a catalog of benchmarks and real workloads spanning communication (NCCL), compute, storage, diagnostics, training, inference, reliability, and security, with per-architecture expectations and clear pass/fail criteria.
  • Data Provenance. Develop provenance and evidence pipelines that capture what actually ran, where it ran, and under which configuration, and that produce signed, auditable results.
  • Platform Integration. Bring new GPU platforms, schedulers, and fabrics under test, from first bring-up on a single node through multi-node validation on production clusters.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration.Collaborate with internal platform, networking, and solutions teams and with cloud partners to root-cause performance and correctness gaps found by the tooling, and feed fixes back into platforms and reference architectures.
  • Open Source Contribution. Contribute to the open-source Cluster Readiness Engine and related projects, including design documents, documentation, and reviews.
  • Technical Authorship. Author design documents, runbooks, and operational guides that codify how clusters are validated and how results are interpreted.

What We Need To See

Job Description About the Role: We are seeking a Systems Engineer to own patch management, configuration automation and vulnerability remediation across our Linux server and endpoint fleet. This role uses Puppet/Ansible-based automation for Linux OS patching and configuration enforcement, ensuring systems stay compliant, secure, and up to date with minimal manual intervention.

Key Responsibilities — Linux (Puppet/Ansible)

job.name: Javascript Developer (ai) - internship: 381
job.description:
Backend Developer Intern, Conversational AI (Node.js)

Internship, 3 months (full commitment) | Stipend | Pune | careers

Work from Office

Askyara is the conversational AI engine behind MyNextHire: it holds real-time voice conversations with candidates, follows a hiring process step by step, and has to behave when people interrupt, go silent or say something nobody expected. We are looking for an intern who wants to learn how an engine like that really works, from the inside, on production code. Not a tutorial project. The real thing.

What you need to achieve

In 3 months, know one or two repos of our conversational AI backend well enough to draw every conversation flow in them, reproduce any reported bug within a day, and fix a set number of them in production code, each with a test that stops it coming back.

How the best people get there

  • Read code you did not write and draw the flow it follows, including the paths nobody planned for
  • Reproduce a bug until it fails every time, then cut it down to the smallest case that still breaks
  • Think in states: what the conversation is waiting for, what can interrupt it, and what happens when two things arrive at once
  • Know asynchronous Node.js well enough to say why something hangs, runs twice or answers late
  • Write a bug note and a test that the next engineer can trust without asking you a question

What you can count on

  • A mentor from the team that built the engine, with a review of your work every week
  • Real production code and real conversation logs from your first week
  • A clear list of bugs and flows to start on, so you are never waiting for work
  • The AI coding tools the team uses. You are expected to use them, and to understand everything they write for you
  • A stipend for the 3 months

What you need to be resourceful around

  • A full 3-month commitment is necessary. This does not work alongside classes or another internship
  • Three months is short. Nobody will walk you through the code line by line. You read, you draw, you ask sharp questions
  • Many bugs here do not fail every time. Finding the conditions that make them fail is the job, not a distraction from it
  • The AI model will sometimes reply in ways no one planned for. Your code and your tests have to expect that
  • A full-time offer is not promised. It is earned in these 3 months

Why this is your next move

  • You work on a live conversational AI engine, not a college project: real-time voice, real users, real failures
  • You learn to read and reason about a complex system, the skill that separates engineers who last from those who only write new code
  • You learn it from the people who built it
  • Interns who shine in these 3 months may be offered a full-time role. That is when you start designing and shipping your own conversation flows

If you've spent time in the trenches of AWS, GCP, or Azure and you know what a misconfigured IAM policy or an exposed storage bucket actually means for a business, this role was built for you. Why Join Us

  • Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule

  • Meaningful work that improves how AI understands real-world security

job.description:
We are looking for a technically strong and motivated Security Consultant with hands-on experience in Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) across web applications, mobile applications, APIs, networks, and infrastructure.

The ideal candidate should possess strong knowledge of offensive security techniques, manual penetration testing, vulnerability exploitation, and security assessment methodologies. The candidate must have relevant hands-on VAPT experience and industry-recognized cybersecurity certifications.

Responsibilities

  • 1. Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing :
  •  Perform comprehensive vulnerability assessments and penetration testing across web applications, mobile applications (Android/iOS), APIs, networks, and infrastructure.
  •  Conduct manual and automated penetration testing to identify security weaknesses and exploitable vulnerabilities.
  •  Identify and validate vulnerabilities such as SQL Injection, XSS, IDOR, SSRF, XXE, authentication bypass, privilege escalation, and business logic flaws.
  •  Perform security testing aligned with OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, OWASP MASVS/MSTG, PTES, and NIST guidelines.
  •  Conduct authenticated and unauthenticated vulnerability assessments.
  •  Perform vulnerability exploitation and proof-of-concept validation within authorized testing scope.
  •  Perform revalidation of identified vulnerabilities and verify remediation effectiveness.
  • Web Application & API Security Testing
  •  Perform manual web application penetration testing using Burp Suite and other security assessment tools.
  •  Assess authentication, authorization, session management, input validation, and business logic security controls.
  •  Conduct API security testing for REST and SOAP APIs.
  •  Identify API vulnerabilities, including BOLA/IDOR, broken authentication, excessive data exposure, and security misconfigurations.
  •  Evaluate JWT security, OAuth implementations, API access controls, and rate-limiting mechanisms.
  • Mobile Application Security Testing
  •  Perform Android and iOS application security assessments.
  •  Conduct static and dynamic analysis of mobile applications.
  •  Identify insecure data storage, hardcoded credentials, weak cryptography, insecure communication, and SSL pinning weaknesses.
  •  Perform runtime analysis using Frida, Objection, MobSF, JADX, Apktool, and other relevant tools.
  •  Assess mobile application security controls, including root/jailbreak detection and runtime protections.
  • Network & Infrastructure Security
  •  Conduct internal and external network vulnerability assessments and penetration testing.
  •  Perform network reconnaissance, service enumeration, vulnerability identification, and controlled exploitation.
  •  Assess operating systems, exposed services, and common network security misconfigurations.
  •  Perform basic Windows and Linux privilege escalation testing.

About Leena.ai Leena.ai is an enterprise agentic AI platform automating work across HR, Finance, and Legal functions for global enterprises. We compete — and win — against ServiceNow+Moveworks, Workday Illuminate, and vertical point solutions by offering vendor-agnostic cross-functional orchestration, the broadest connector coverage in the category, and deployment timelines measured in weeks rather than quarters. We are a Series B+ company headquartered in New York, with our largest engineering hub in Gurgaon.

The Role We are hiring a hands-on Tech Lead to own a pod of 4–6 engineers within our Knowledge Management / NLP org, or across adjacent agentic AI platform pods depending on fit. You will design and ship production systems that power enterprise knowledge retrieval, grounding, and agentic reasoning across the Leena.ai platform — the engine behind every customer-facing agent.

This is an IC-heavy leadership role. Expect to spend roughly 60–70% of your time in code, architecture, and design reviews, and 30–40% on mentoring, planning, and cross-functional alignment.

What You’ll Own

  • Knowledge & agent architecture: Architect and ship production RAG, knowledge ingestion, and agentic reasoning pipelines that operate across enterprise systems of record (Workday, ServiceNow, SAP, Confluence, SharePoint, and many more).
  • Evaluation & quality: Build and maintain custom golden datasets and eval harnesses; distinguish retrieval failures from generation failures; set and enforce production accuracy, latency, and cost SLOs.
  • Multi-LLM orchestration: Work across Anthropic, OpenAI, and Gemini model families. Own model selection tradeoffs (capability vs. cost vs. latency), prompt iteration, function-calling/tool-use patterns,and fallback strategies.
  • Technical leadership: Set the engineering bar for the pod — design docs, code reviews, on-call

discipline, incident response, and production quality gates.

  • Platform leverage: Partner with Product and Implementation on reference architectures that compress time-to-value for new enterprise deployments.
  • People growth: Mentor 4–6 engineers; grow at least one to senior-level scope within the year.

Must-Haves

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of shipping production software.
  • Strong production engineering in Python and Node.js. Comfort reading and contributing to a React frontend when the work crosses the boundary.
  • Hands-on experience building LLM-powered production systems with at least one major provider

(Anthropic, OpenAI, or Gemini): RAG pipelines, function-calling / tool-use, prompt and eval iteration loops.

  • Depth in one or more of: information retrieval, NLP, knowledge graphs, semantic search, vector

databases, or chunking / embedding strategies.

  • Production ownership on AWS — observability, cost discipline, and incident response, not just

familiarity.

job.name: Banking Data Functional Analyst
job.description:
Banking Data Functional Analyst (Retail Liabilities & Assets)

Team: Data Engineering / Coding Team | Grade: E4 / D1 | Experience: 6 to 13 years | Education: Postgraduate degree (MBA / MCA / M.Sc. / M.Tech or equivalent)

Role Summary

We are building a cloud data platform for banking and lending products. We are looking for a functional-first data professional who understands how retail banking and lending products actually work and can translate that into data requirements, pipelines and engineered datasets. You will sit with product and business teams, understand their data needs, discover and map source data, and work with engineers and solution architects to build it on the cloud.

This role needs both sides: deep banking product knowledge and strong hands-on data skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work directly with product, business and credit teams to understand how products work and what data they need.
  • Carry out data discovery: identify source systems, tables, fields, data flows and data quality issues across core banking, loan management and related systems.
  • Understand and document how data pipelines are constructed, from source to consumption, and define how data should be engineered for the cloud platform.
  • Perform substantial technical processing of data using SQL: profiling, transformation, reconciliation, cleansing and validation.
  • Prepare concept notes, Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and functional specifications.
  • Create data mapping documents (source to target, with transformation logic and business rules).
  • Perform data cleansing and design and prepare test data and test cases for validation and UAT.
  • Support solution architects in designing data models and solutions for liabilities and asset products.
  • Build or support business MIS and dashboards where required.
  • Partner with engineers in the coding team to clarify logic, resolve data issues and sign off outputs.

Domain Scope

In scope

  • Liability products: current accounts, savings accounts, term deposits
  • Asset products: retail and secured/unsecured loans, home loans, personal loans, credit cards and other lending products
  • Credit lifecycle: origination, underwriting, disbursement, servicing, collections, delinquency and provisioning data

Out of scope – no candidates with this

  • Cash management, transaction banking
  • Treasury and markets products such as derivatives and forwards

Required Skills and Experience

job.description:
Role: Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer About the Company A high-growth fintech platform is scaling two core data initiatives: a credit bureau intelligence engine that turns financial signals into automated underwriting logic, and an embedded health membership product distributed across its large lending base. This role sits at the intersection of credit data, user behavior, and multi-channel campaign analytics to power real-time eligibility engines, customer targeting models, and product-mapping triggers.

Role Overview A hands-on, build-from-scratch position focused on turning raw data into working scripts, decision rules, and evaluation models without reliance on pre-built dashboards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Credit Bureau Data Analysis: Work with raw bureau files (scores, tradeline histories, account classifications, enquiry velocity) to build risk segmentations, scoring rules, and lending eligibility logic.
  • Rule Engine & Tool Development: Build and maintain client-side eligibility and Business Rule Engine (BRE) frameworks by converting partner credit policies into testable code.
  • Campaign & Funnel Analytics: Analyze communication logs (WhatsApp, voice, call center CDR data) to pinpoint high-fit borrower segments, conversion drivers, and funnel drop-offs.
  • Signal-to-Trigger Mapping: Build algorithmic triggers linking credit behavior changes to contextual health and financial protection offerings.
  • Pipelines & Experimentation: Develop repeatable Python and SQL workflows for A/B testing, cohort tracking, and executive performance reviews.
  • Data Hygiene & Structuring: Ingest, clean, and standardize large-scale CRM files, call logs, and bureau extracts for cross-functional product and growth teams.

Candidate Profile

  • Experience: 0–2 years in Data Analytics, Data Science, or a related analytical discipline (internships included).
  • Technical Stack: Strong proficiency in Python (pandas, numpy) and SQL, alongside spreadsheet modeling for rapid analysis.
  • Analytical Skills: Solid grasp of statistics, cohort dynamics, and performance metrics (precision, approval bands, conversion rates).
  • Domain Curiosity: High interest in credit bureau data, digital lending, and fintech/insurtech intersections.
  • Execution: Comfort with unstructured, messy datasets and the ability to articulate technical insights to business stakeholders.
  • Nice-to-Haves: Exposure to classification models, lightweight internal dashboards (HTML/JS), or lending/insurance underwriting logic.

job.name: Product Security Engineer — Connected Devices
job.description:
Why Join us:

Anker Innovations is a global leader in smart charging technologies and a developer of consumer products for the home, car, and mobile life. Founded in 2011, we've brought our products to 100+ countries and regions with more than 140 million users and a revenue of 2000+ million USD in 2022.

Anker Innovations has successfully built Anker, a world-renowned high-end innovative charging brand, and launched intelligent hardware brands such as Eufy, Nebula, and Soundcore to further explore smart charging, smart voice, smart home and other fields.

Today, we have a total of 4000+ employees in 15 offices across North America, Europe, Australia, Asia, LATAM and the Middle East. We are always looking for top talents like you.

For more information, please visit: https://us.anker.com/

Location: Onsite at Bellevue, Washington or San Jose, California

About the Role：

We build connected home and personal devices used in households across the US. Our product security team's scope spans the full attack surface of those products — the devices themselves, the companion mobile apps, and the cloud services behind them.

Responsibilities:

  • Own cryptographic and identity standards used across our product lines, and the trust model connecting device, app, and cloud
  • Build and operate PKI, HSM integration, and manufacturing-line key provisioning
  • Own the OTA client and backend: image signing, rollback protection, A/B update recovery, staged rollout, and fleet update adoption
  • Develop and operate CI security gates, SBOM pipelines, and evidence infrastructure across firmware, mobile, and cloud
  • Implement hardware root of trust, secure boot, encrypted storage, and OS hardening on embedded Linux and RTOS
  • Own wireless and provisioning security: BLE pairing, Wi-Fi onboarding, Matter device attestation (DAC/PAI)
  • Own mobile app security: third-party SDK governance, secure storage, certificate pinning, session and token lifecycle
  • Design and implement cloud authorization models, device authentication, and least-privilege access controls for systems handling customer data
  • Implement technical controls for telemetry data minimization

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years in security engineering, or 7+ in software/embedded/cloud engineering with 3+ focused on security
  • Have owned a security capability end to end — design through maintenance
  • Production coding ability in at least one of C/C++/Rust, Go, Python, Kotlin, or Swift
  • Working knowledge of applied cryptography and its common failure modes
  • Able to explain a security requirement in terms a product team can build against, and hold it under schedule pressure

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Embedded security (TrustZone/TEE/SE, secure boot implementation)
  • PKI and HSM operations (PKCS#11/KMIP)
  • OTA and release infrastructure (TUF/Uptane)
  • DevSecOps and SBOM tooling
  • BLE/Wi-Fi/Matter protocol security
  • iOS and Android app hardening

In this role, you will be the security champion embedded within our platform infrastructure, ensuring that our cloud environments, container orchestration platforms, and developer tooling are secure by design.

You will work closely with platform engineers, DevOps, and enterprise security teams to build secure foundational services, automate compliance guardrails, and foster a strong culture of security across the engineering organization.

  • Identity and Access Management (IAM): Architect secure authentication, authorization, secrets management, and zero-trust networking principles across all platform services.
  • Automation & Guardrails: Build automated security guardrails that empower developers to move fast safely, minimizing friction while maintaining strict compliance standards (e.g., CMMC, NIST 800-171, FIPS 140-3).
  • Vulnerability & Threat Management: Conduct regular security assessments, penetration testing, threat modeling, and container vulnerability scanning; coordinate remediation efforts with platform teams.

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About The Role Millions of people use Notion every day, and we’re growing quickly. The Infrastructure Security team’s mission is to build a secure-by-default foundation across Notion’s technical stacks—architecting systems that make the secure path the easy path. As an IC4 on this team, you’ll own meaningful infrastructure security problems end-to-end: from identifying risk, to designing pragmatic controls, to shipping secure defaults that scale across engineering.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve

  • Proactively enhance the security posture of our AWS accounts and cloud infrastructure.
  • Create secure frameworks for secrets management and authentication/authorization.
  • Design and deploy robust Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions.
  • Provide guidance and education on security and privacy best practices to cross-functional partners.
  • Participate in (and help drive) mitigation strategies during security-related incident response.

Skills You'll Need To Bring

  • Security architecture and expertise: you’ve built and maintained systems to secure cloud architectures, ranging from secrets management to Identity and Access Management solutions.
  • Backend/infrastructure development: you’ve written and shipped production-grade code, and can contribute to the codebase and architecture to raise the bar on secure systems design.
  • Working in production: you can debug systems in production and continuously improve components with minimal disruption.
  • Pragmatic, risk-based prioritization: you model threats, balance trade-offs, and focus security investments where they drive the most business impact.
  • Empathetic communication: you communicate nuanced ideas clearly in writing and in real time; in disagreements, you engage thoughtfully and look for the right compromise.

Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The IDaaS Site Reliability Engineering Team

Okta authenticates, authorizes and provisions millions of users a day. The service is hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS) across multiple availability zones and geographically separated regions. The service is designed for high throughput and 99.999 availability. We're looking for a strong SRE to help us continue to scale the service with great people and reliable, cost-effective, and efficient infrastructure, processes, and tooling.

What you’ll be doing

  • Modernization and automation of our core infrastructure platform and workloads, identifying reliability, performance, and toil gaps and building tools and software to close them.
  • Incident Management: Respond and remediate to production incidents, performing deep-dive troubleshooting, driving rapid response, and implementing permanent preventive solutions.
  • Engineering Standards: Drive high-quality code and operational rigor through design reviews, code reviews, attention to detail, and deep technical expertise.

job.name: Cloud Engineering Team Manager
job.description:
About Us

We are the world’s learning company, with over 24,000 employees operating in 70 countries. We combine world-class educational content and assessment, powered by services and technology, to enable more effective teaching and personalized learning at scale. Within Pearson VUE, our Cloud & Platform Engineering team designs, builds, and operates the cloud foundation that powers secure, high-stakes test delivery for millions of candidates worldwide. We believe that wherever learning flourishes, so do people.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Cloud Engineering Manager to lead our Cloud & Platform Engineering team. In this hands-on and managerial role, you will design, build, and operate the enterprise Azure platform and shared services that our product and delivery teams build on — spanning our assessment delivery, exam development, product lines.

You will use Infrastructure as Code, automation, and platform engineering practices to improve the security, consistency, reliability, and developer experience of our cloud estate, which operates under rigorous security and compliance requirements. This role manages a highly technical, engineering-focused team that combines cloud platform development, automation, security and governance, and site reliability with a focus on automation and AI Ops. You will also participate in an on-call rotation supporting business-critical cloud services.

What You’ll Do

Cloud & Platform Engineering

  • Design, build, and operate shared cloud platform services on Microsoft Azure that product teams consume for provisioning, deployment, and day-to-day operations.
  • Develop reusable platform capabilities, modules, templates, and pipelines — that accelerate secure, self-service cloud adoption.
  • Design and manage enterprise cloud networking and connectivity, including hub-and-spoke topologies, next-generation firewalls, DNS, VPN, peering, and secure administrative access.
  • Build and operate Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters and Helm-based application delivery for shared platform and product workloads.
  • Provision and manage Azure PaaS and data services, including Key Vault, Storage, Azure SQL and MySQL, Cosmos DB, Redis, and Event Hub, with private, secure connectivity.
  • Manage secure ingress and content delivery services, including Application Gateway/WAF, Azure Front Door, API Management, and CDN.
  • Maintain golden VM images and hardened infrastructure baselines.

Infrastructure as Code & Automation

  • Build and maintain Terraform-based provisioning frameworks and shared modules.
  • Develop automation with Ansible, Python, PowerShell, Bash, and cloud-native APIs.
  • Create and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitOps practices, and help modernize tooling (including migrating pipelines from Azure DevOps to GitHub).
  • Drive modernization through an automation-first approach that reduces manual operations.

Security, Governance & Compliance

job.description:
The Opportunity

As a Managed Services - AI Platform Operations / SRE Lead - Manager, you will lead the ongoing operation and improvement of client AI platforms within our Advisory practice. In this client-facing role, you will apply site reliability engineering practices to platform maintenance, automated observability, data pipeline management, and AI model tuning. As a Manager, you will guide and coach teams supporting client engagements, drawing on individual strengths while taking accountability for delivery quality, budgets, and timelines. job.description:
Description Duties Description ITS provides operational support to state agencies on a 24x7x365 basis; some positions may be required to provide this critical service at any time.

Under the direction of a senior IES manager, the Enterprise SRE and Cloud Architect (Project Coordinator) will be assigned to the Integrated Eligibility System (IES) within the Office of Information Technology Services (ITS) and will be the principal technical leader responsible for defining the strategic direction, architectural standards, and operational governance for system reliability, cloud infrastructure, and continuous delivery across enterprise platforms. This role will operate at the intersection of software engineering, infrastructure operations, and cybersecurity, championing a culture of reliability and security-first automation. The incumbent will design resilient hybrid and AWS cloud environments, establish enterprise-wide DevSecOps practices using GitLab, and define the service level standards (SLOs/SLIs) that guarantee high availability, performance, and security compliance for mission-critical public sector applications.

Duties Include But Are Not Limited To The Following

  • Enterprise Cloud & Hybrid Architecture: Design and architect highly resilient, scalable, secure, and cost-optimized infrastructure frameworks across AWS cloud and hybrid-cloud environments, ensuring alignment with the AWS Well-Architected Framework and modern security standards.
  • GitLab DevSecOps Pipeline Engineering: Architect, standardize, and govern enterprise-wide GitLab CI/CD pipelines. Integrate automated security scanning (SAST/DAST), compliance checks, and vulnerability management directly into the software development lifecycle (SDLC) to achieve continuous, secure delivery.
  • SRE Standards & Observability Governance: Define, implement, and govern Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) standards across the organization. Establish robust Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for critical business applications, and design comprehensive observability and alerting frameworks.
  • Automation & Self-Healing Systems: Lead the design and implementation of automated deployment, scaling, configuration management, and self-healing infrastructure systems to minimize manual operational overhead and maximize system uptime.
  • Incident Management & Continuous Improvement: Drive high-severity incident response, lead blameless post-mortem reviews, and conduct root-cause analyses (RCAs) to identify systemic vulnerabilities, translating operational failures into actionable engineering improvements.

job.name: Senior Production Engineer
job.description:
*🚀 Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!* Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.

As a remote co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.

We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.

💻 Role That growth is the reason this role exists. Production Engineers are software engineers who embed with product, platform, and infrastructure teams to find and fix what breaks at scale. We think of them as hunters: engineers who go looking for the anomaly, the bottleneck, the slow degradation nobody has noticed yet, and then own it through to a fix, working with whoever owns the system to make sure it stays fixed.

Live video and real-time commerce run on the same critical path here. Every auction is live and money moves during the show, so system behavior and business outcomes are tightly coupled in a way few platforms experience. Milliseconds are visible to buyers and sellers, and the signals that matter most are often small, concentrated in a specific cohort, and invisible in aggregate. Surfacing them early, and knowing which ones are worth acting on, is the core of this work.

Production Engineers embed with a team and go deep on its systems, while staying accountable for what falls between teams. Some of the most consequential problems at our scale live in the seams, in the interaction between two services that each look healthy on their own, so we expect hunting both inside your area and across it. You'll be joining early, which means broader discovery across the platform before the embedding settles, and real influence over how Production Engineering takes shape here.

What You'll Do

job.name: Sr Staff Software Engineer
job.description:
Company Description It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description About the Role

As a Sr. Staff SRE at Armis, you’ll set the reliability and infrastructure direction for a high-scale, security-first platform. You’ll own uptime, scalability, and security across our microservices, data stores, and cloud environments, and you’ll lead the technical strategy that shapes how we run them. You’ll have the autonomy to evaluate and adopt new technologies, and you’ll raise the bar for reliability across several engineering teams, not just your own.

What You’ll Do

  • Set reliability strategy across multiple teams. Define SLOs, error budgets, and reliability standards for critical services, and drive adoption through technical influence rather than direct authority.
  • Design resilient, multi-region infrastructure. Architect highly available, scalable production systems across cloud environments, and lead design reviews for changes that affect platform-wide stability.
  • Lead observability and alerting. Drive system-wide alerting and monitoring strategy across infrastructure and database layers, and reduce alert noise through better signal design and automated triage.
  • Own large-scale database reliability. Lead DBRE efforts across distributed data stores, including capacity planning, failover design, backup and recovery validation, and performance tuning.
  • Lead incident response and postmortems. Serve as a senior escalation point during incidents, and ensure postmortems produce systemic fixes rather than one-off patches.
  • Build security and compliance into the SDLC. Partner with Security and Compliance to embed FedRAMP, SOC 2, and related controls into infrastructure design, pipelines, and change management.
  • Evaluate and lead POCs. Assess new tools and services for performance, cost, and security posture, and make build-versus-buy recommendations to leadership.
  • Advance Infrastructure as Code. Set standards for Terraform and/or CloudFormation across teams, including module design, policy validation, and review practices.
  • Mentor and raise the bar. Coach senior and mid-level engineers, lead technical design reviews, and contribute to hiring and engineering standards.
  • Document and communicate. Maintain clear runbooks, architecture documentation, and reliability reports for engineering, product, and executive audiences.

Read the full description

job.name: Founding Engineer
job.description:
Founding Engineer (Infrastructure / Product) | AI Security Startup | New York

About the company

AI agents now write code, query sensitive data and call internal tools, and most companies have no visibility into what they’re doing. Our client is building the layer that monitors and controls them. Their open-source tool captures activity from all the major AI coding agents in one standard format. It’s used by thousands of developers and has topped GitHub’s trending charts. Their enterprise platform builds on it with real-time detection, policy enforcement and blocking of risky agent actions. The company recently closed an oversubscribed seed round led by a top-tier fund. The founders are security engineers who spent 7+ years as early engineers at a fast-growing cybersecurity company, building threat detection at scale.

The role

They’re hiring two founding engineers to build the core of the company alongside the founders. You’d be one of the first five people on the team.

  • Founding Engineer, Infrastructure. Own the systems the product runs on: high-throughput data capture, low-latency detection and enforcement, and infrastructure that holds up as customers run thousands of agents.
  • Founding Engineer, Product. Take ambiguous problems end to end, from talking to users to shipping working product across the stack.

What you’ll do

  • Design and build the core data path: capturing, normalising and processing agent activity at high volume and low latency
  • Ship detection and policy enforcement that can block a risky agent action in real time
  • Grow the open-source project in public with thousands of developers using and contributing to it
  • Work directly with security and engineering teams at customers to turn their problems into product
  • Shape the engineering culture, architecture and hiring of a deliberately small team

Who they’re looking for

Both roles

  • 3+ years of industry experience as a software engineer
  • A degree in computer science or a hard engineering discipline, or an exceptional, unusual track record that shows the same depth
  • Early-stage or high-growth startup experience, ideally as a founding or early engineer
  • A habit of owning problems end to end rather than waiting for a spec

Infrastructure

  • A strong background in infrastructure, SRE, DevOps or systems engineering
  • Low-level systems understanding: memory, concurrency, performance
  • Experience building high-throughput, low-latency systems at meaningful scale
  • Bonus: AI infrastructure, developer tooling or trading systems

Product

  • Comfortable across the stack and happy to pick up whatever the product needs
  • A record of turning vague problems into shipped, working product
  • Bonus: experience at an AI-native company

New York, hybrid · Competitive salary + meaningful founding equity

job.description:
Group Overview The TP ICAP Group is a world leading provider of market infrastructure.

Our purpose is to provide clients with access to global financial and commodities markets, improving price discovery, liquidity, and distribution of data, through responsible and innovative solutions.

Through our people and technology, we connect clients to superior liquidity and data solutions.

The Group is home to a stable of premium brands. Collectively, TP ICAP is the largest interdealer broker in the world by revenue, the number one Energy & Commodities broker in the world, the world’s leading provider of OTC data, and an award winning all-to-all trading platform.

This position involves monitoring system health, analysing incidents, coordinating changes and releases. It requires strong troubleshooting skills, an understanding of electronic trading workflows, and the ability to collaborate effectively with a wide range of technical and business teams.

The Support Engineer ensures seamless daily operations, rapid incident response, accurate stakeholder communication, and proactive identification of risks or emerging issues. job.name: Senior Software Engineer in Test
job.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Senior Software Development Engineer in Test — Okta Identity Governance

Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Okta Identity Governance Team

Okta Identity Governance is Okta's Identity Governance and Administration solution, responsible for some of the most critical and visible workflows in enterprise identity: how people request access, how approvers grant it, how entitlements are enforced, and how organizations prove to auditors that only the right people have the right access.

Okta Identity Governance is the leading contributor to Okta's new product bookings, and it runs inside some of the largest enterprises in the world — the kind of accounts where a single tenant carries hundreds of thousands of identities across thousands of applications.

Quality here is a compliance bar, not just a user experience one. When a governance product has a defect, a company can stay over-provisioned on access it believes it revoked, or hand an auditor evidence that isn't true.

The Senior Software Development Engineer in Test Opportunity

As a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test, you'll own quality for medium-sized features on your scrum team, and co-own larger ones, from the first design review through release and into production. You'll turn the team's test strategy into test plans, write the automation, and hold the release bar for features that have to work at enterprise scale — long-running certification campaigns, tenants with millions of entitlements, dozens of third-party connectors, and audit records that must be provably correct.

You'll work alongside developers as an engineer, not a gatekeeper: reviewing designs and code, building the tools that make coverage cheap, and turning every escaped defect into automation that keeps it from coming back.

What You'll Be Doing

job.name: Palo Alto Firewall Engineer, Level 1
job.description:
Hiring for Zurich Insurance — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

Zurich Insurance Group is one of the world's largest multi-line insurers, serving customers in more than 200 countries and territories. In 2026 Zurich opened its Global Capability Centre in Hyderabad as a zero-legacy, AI-first technology hub. Its Security Platform Services team is building an in-house network security engineering capability there, taking over firewall operations for Zurich's global estate.

About the Role

As a Level 1 Palo Alto Firewall Engineer you're the first line of Zurich's global firewall service. You keep the Palo Alto estate healthy, diagnose incidents, and carry out approved changes under strict change control. Along the way you learn automation and AI-assisted operations, so you can grow into a broader engineering role.

This is a hybrid role from Hyderabad. Candidates who can join immediately or within 15 days are preferred.

What you'll do

  • Monitor the health, availability, capacity and alerts of Palo Alto firewalls, Panorama and VPN services
  • Do structured first-line diagnosis of firewall, NAT, DNS, VPN and connectivity incidents using logs and telemetry
  • Make approved standard changes, including security rules, network objects and NAT, within change controls
  • Work through service requests and tickets with clear updates, implementation evidence and validation results
  • Escalate complex or high-risk issues to Level 2 engineers with diagnostics and business impact
  • Support health checks, configuration compliance, rule recertification and audit evidence
  • Keep runbooks and the knowledge base current, and spot repeat work that could be automated

What you bring

  • 1–3 years in network operations, network security or infrastructure support
  • Hands-on experience with Palo Alto Networks firewalls
  • A solid grasp of TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, NAT, segmentation and VPN
  • You have made firewall rule or NAT changes in production and troubleshot traffic from firewall logs
  • You have worked tickets under ITIL incident, change and request processes (e.g. ServiceNow)
  • Clear written communication and careful documentation

Nice to have

  • PCNSA, CCNA or a similar certification
  • Some Python, REST APIs, Ansible or Terraform
  • Exposure to cloud network security on Azure or AWS
  • Using AI tools in day-to-day troubleshooting and documentation

job.name: Systems Administrator
job.description:
About Protecht

At Protecht, we’re a fast growing Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) SaaS company with a bold mission: to revolutionise how organisations understand and manage risk. We’re leading the way in innovation, weaving cutting edge AI into our Protecht.ERM platform and across our entire business.

The Opportunity

Based in Bengaluru, we are seeking a Systems Administrator, who will manage and maintain Protecht's internal IT systems, ensuring a secure, reliable and efficient technology environment.

This is a hands-on role spanning systems administration, identity and access management, endpoint management, technical support, and continuous improvement.

job.name: F5 BIG-IP Consultant – Kubernetes

Position Overview

This is an F5 BIG-IP-focused position requiring strong hands-on experience in BIG-IP administration, configuration, production support and troubleshooting, along with practical Kubernetes exposure.

CI/CD, programming and DevOps automation are not primary requirements for this position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Configure, administer and troubleshoot F5 BIG-IP platforms.

  • Support ASM/Advanced WAF and APM environments where applicable.
  • Diagnose application-connectivity, traffic-flow, SSL-handshake and performance issues.
  • Support the deployment or operation of F5 components in Kubernetes environments.

job.name: Post-Training and Reinforcement Learning Engineer
job.description:
About the company

SustainabilityEconomics.ai is a Singapore- and US-based company with a large development center in Bengaluru. The company is building AI agents that are paid on the results they deliver. The first is Clem.ai, an Energy-Mix Agent that plans, contracts and operates the power supply mix for large electricity consumers such as data centers. Its objective is power that is lower in cost than grid supply, at least as reliable, and carbon-free around the clock.

The company does not pre-train models. It takes open models and post-trains them on narrow energy tasks where a program can verify the result. Solvers, calculators and simulators perform the arithmetic, and the models are trained to use them correctly.

The position

We are looking for a Post-Training and Reinforcement Learning Engineer to join the platform team in Bengaluru. The engineer will help train, evaluate and improve the open models behind Clem.ai.

This is an early-career position reporting to the Post-Training Lead. The engineer will work alongside senior post-training engineers, applied AI engineers and the company’s energy experts. An independent assurance team approves every model release.

Scope of work

  • Prepare, clean and verify training data for tasks such as bill and invoice extraction, contract clause tagging and optimization template completion.
  • Run supervised fine-tuning of open models using low-rank adapters (LoRA) on company GPU infrastructure.
  • Develop reinforcement learning environments and reward functions in which a validator, solver, calculator or simulator scores the model output.
  • Evaluate every model before and after training on the company’s energy-domain benchmark, and report the results accurately.
  • Convert operator corrections and overrides from live operation into new training examples and evaluation cases.
  • Generate and validate synthetic data where real examples are limited.
  • Support the distillation of larger models into smaller, lower-cost models.
  • Maintain reproducible experiments, including configurations, data versions, run logs and written summaries.
  • Use coding agents for first drafts of code, tests and data preparation, and review all output before use.
  • Comply with data governance requirements, including keeping customer data used for per-site tuning within that customer’s sandbox.

Required qualifications

job.name: Advanced Engineer - Product Development
job.description:
Autoliv's primary goal is to Save More Lives. Our products never get a second chance. This is why we can never compromise on quality. We are working to increase vehicle safety by developing seatbelts, airbags and steering wheels and you can be part of our team as ROLE .

About The Role We are looking for an experienced EM - Product Development Advanced Engineer to join our Product Development team and contribute to the design, development, validation, and integration of embedded electronics and software solutions for automotive applications.

This role requires strong expertise in microcontroller-based embedded systems, low-level driver development, hardware-software integration, embedded troubleshooting, proof-of-concept development, and automotive communication protocols. The successful candidate will collaborate with global teams to develop innovative, reliable, and safety-focused automotive products.

Key Responsibilities Embedded Software Development

  • Design and develop embedded software using Embedded C/C++ for automotive applications.
  • Develop software solutions for ARM Cortex, STM32, NXP, and Infineon microcontroller platforms.
  • Design, implement, and validate low-level drivers, including:

+ CAN
+ LIN
+ SPI
+ I2C
+ UART
+ ADC
+ PWM

  • Develop and optimize embedded applications for automotive systems and safety products.

Hardware-Software Integration

  • Perform software-hardware integration and board bring-up activities.
  • Interface and integrate sensors, displays, and motor control systems including:

+ Brushed Motors
+ BLDC Motors
+ Sensor-Based Embedded Systems
+ Display-Based Applications

  • Conduct embedded system debugging, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis.

Innovation & Rapid Prototyping

  • Build Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs) and prototype solutions to demonstrate innovative product ideas.
  • Utilize platforms such as:

+ Arduino
+ Raspberry Pi
+ ESP-Based Controllers

  • Support new product development initiatives through rapid prototyping and concept validation.

Communication & Diagnostics

  • Work extensively with automotive communication protocols and diagnostics.
  • Use CAN development and validation tools including:

+ CANoe
+ CANalyzer

  • Develop and execute basic CAPL scripts for simulation and testing.
  • Troubleshoot communication and system-level integration issues.

System Validation & Testing

  • Perform system-level validation and integration activities.
  • Utilize laboratory tools including:

+ Oscilloscope
+ Logic Analyzer
+ Signal Generator

  • Ensure robust functionality and reliability of embedded systems through structured testing and validation.

Product Development & Cross-Functional Collaboration

job.description:
Project Role : Silicon Firmware & Embedded Engineer

Project Role Description : Write the software that powers and operates a silicon chip. Develop pre-silicon firmware and software with a direct interface to hardware. Integrate and develop C tests/APIs and software build flow. Perform design and code reviews. Test and validate product implementations.

Must have skills : Embedded C++

Good to have skills : NA

Summary:

We are looking for a Lead – Embedded Linux & BMC Firmware Engineering to own technical delivery and people leadership for a team working on server/platform management firmware (BMC, OpenBMC-based stacks) across embedded Linux, system programming, and standards-based management interfaces.

This is a hybrid role: hands-on enough to unblock deep technical issues, and senior enough to own process, planning, and people management for the team.

Roles and responsibility:

  • Product & Technical Ownership
  • Drive architecture, design reviews, and technical decision-making for embedded Linux / BMC firmware components.
  • Own end-to-end debugging of complex system-level issues, including hardware-software interaction (JTAG-level debugging), boot flow, and kernel/userspace boundary problems.

  • Review and guide implementation across core system services: systemd, I2C, GPIO, and Communication-based communication. ( D-Bus,MCTP is a plus)
  • Set technical direction on language/tooling choices — Go and Python-based tooling and automation (Python 3 preferred).

Process Management

  • Own sprint planning, estimation, and delivery predictability for the team using Agile/Scrum practices.
  • Drive code quality, review standards, and release processes own technical risk and escalation management with stakeholders.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams (hardware, QA, product/program management) to align on roadmap, dependencies, and release timelines.

People Management

  • Manage, mentor, and grow a team of embedded/firmware engineers — set goals, conduct performance reviews, and build individual development plans.
  • Drive hiring and onboarding for the team build technical depth and bench strength.
  • Foster a culture of ownership, technical excellence, and continuous learning within the team.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for the team on delivery commitments, escalations, and stakeholder communication.

job.name: Apprentice - Pricing
job.description:
About CleanHarbors Clean Harbors Inc. (www.cleanharbors.com) is a NYSE listed US based $6 billion company. Clean Harbors was

founded in 1980 near Boston by Mr. Alan S. McKim, who today remains the company’s Chairman and CTO.

Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on-site, providing premier environmental, energy and

industrial services. Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 23,000 employees and has over 450 service

locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300,000

customers, the Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events

in North America of the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in

New York, the 2015 avian flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy,

and the oil pipeline breaks that affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical

releases into the environment.

Job Title: Jr. Associate, Associate I, II - Contract Management Analyst Job Location: Hyderabad Shift Timings: 5:00 PM to 2:00 AM IST should be willing to work from office (mandatory) with global working windows. Job Overview The Contract Administration Associate is responsible for working on Contractual Agreements which includes end-to-end

contract life-cycle management, ensuring that pricing and contract terms are correctly reflected accurately across systems. The

role includes creating new contracts, contract updates/maintenance, performing audits, and ensuring correct pricing for bundles,

packages, and templates. The associate also collaborates with cross-functional teams to resolve issues, uphold pricing accuracy,

and ensure compliance with contract standards.

Responsibilities  Ensuring Health and Safety is the number one goal by following policies, processes, and always acting in a safe manner.

 Will be responsible for working on Contract management, Pricing, Item code management and all other queries related to

Contract Management and Master Data Management.

 Conducts audits of newly created contracts, ensuring pricing aligns with contractual terms and making any adjustments.

 Process requests for creating, editing, or rationalizing component codes, packages, bundles, and job type templates

following Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

 Analyze active component codes and confirm that regional pricing has been set up for each.

 Process pricing requests, update Suggested Retail Pricing (SRP) and costs, and identify cost impacts for necessary

adjustments.

 Run SQL queries as per the business requirement and Develop Power BI dashboards.

 Run Monthly reports, validate, audit and report out based on business requirement from onshore partners.

job.name: Computer system validation
job.description:
Company Description Samrudh Pharmaceutical Private Limited Tarapur M.I.D.C. Boisar is a biotechnology-focused pharmaceutical organization located in Thane District, Maharashtra, India. The company operates from Varun Apartment on Palghar Road in Boisar, serving regional and national healthcare markets. It is involved in the development and manufacturing of pharmaceutical products with an emphasis on quality and regulatory compliance. The team works in a collaborative environment that values scientific rigor and process reliability, providing opportunities for growth in computer system validation and related quality functions.

Role Description This is a full-time Computer System Validation role based in Ahmedabad with a hybrid work arrangement, combining on-site responsibilities with some work-from-home flexibility. The role involves planning, executing, and documenting validation activities for computerized systems used in pharmaceutical manufacturing, laboratory operations, and quality management. Daily tasks include preparing and reviewing validation protocols and reports, performing risk assessments, supporting system qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ), and ensuring compliance with relevant regulatory guidelines such as GxP and data integrity requirements. The role also includes collaborating with cross-functional teams (IT, QA, production, and laboratory), managing change control and deviation documentation, participating in audits and inspections, and providing training and guidance on validated systems and procedures.

Qualifications

  • Candidates should possess Programming skills to understand, evaluate, and support validated computerized systems.
  • Candidates should possess Machining or equipment-related skills to interface effectively with automated instruments and production systems.
  • Candidates should possess Teaching or training skills to communicate validation requirements and system usage to colleagues.
  • Strong knowledge of computer system validation principles, GxP regulations, and data integrity guidelines (e.g., 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11).
  • Experience in pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, or a regulated industry, preferably in quality assurance, validation, or IT support for GxP systems.
  • Ability to write clear protocols, reports, and SOPs, with strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Comfort working in a hybrid environment, collaborating effectively on-site and remotely, and managing multiple projects and timelines.

job.name: Principal Cloud Platform Engineer - India
job.description:
All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.

About JumpCloud®

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.

About the Role

We're hiring a Principal Cloud Platform Engineer to join the Cloud Platform organization, which owns JumpCloud's cloud infrastructure, developer experience, and edge and traffic engineering.

This is a hands-on principal role. You'll write production code and you'll run what you build. You'll set the technical direction for the platform that keeps JumpCloud available at 99.99% across regions, and you'll raise the engineering bar for everyone around you. We want someone who is as comfortable designing and shipping a platform service as they are leading a major incident at 2 a.m.

What You'll Be Doing :

  • Set the technical direction and multi-year architecture for JumpCloud's cloud platform across AWS and GCP, covering compute, networking, Kubernetes, data stores, and edge.
  • Write production-grade Go or Python as a regular part of the job: platform services, Kubernetes controllers and operators, internal APIs, CLIs, and automation that removes manual work.
  • Build and evolve our internal developer platform, including golden paths, self-service provisioning, and CI/CD and GitOps pipelines (Argo CD), so product teams can ship safely without filing tickets.
  • Own the design of multi-region architecture, failover automation, and disaster recovery, with RTO and RPO targets we actually test.
  • Operate what you build. Take part in on-call, act as the senior escalation point during major incidents, and turn blameless post-incident reviews into lasting fixes.
  • Define the reliability standards for the platform: SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, production readiness reviews, and capacity planning that hold a 99.99% SLA as we grow.
  • Find and remove scalability bottlenecks across services, databases, queues, and network paths before customers feel them.
  • Shape edge and traffic engineering, including ingress, load balancing, DNS, CDN, WAF, and service mesh.
  • Lead our Infrastructure-as-Code architecture in Terraform across multi-account, multi-region environments, with policy-as-code guardrails for security and compliance.
  • Treat cost as a design input. Partner on FinOps, unit economics, and right-sizing so we scale efficiently.
  • Bring AI-assisted engineering (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) into platform work to speed up tooling, runbooks, and incident triage.

Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)

📍 San Jose, CA: Hybrid (3 days onsite), open to remote for the right candidate

💰 $160,000–$180,000 base + bonus

About the Company

We’re hiring for a fast-growing startup that leads in enterprise Kubernetes management. Its platform powers commercial and federal deployments across the US and EU.

About the Role

As an SRE, you’ll operate and improve production systems end to end. That includes SLOs, incident response, production readiness, observability, automation, disaster recovery and performance optimization. You’ll partner with Platform Engineering, DevOps and product engineering teams to build a declarative, self-healing, Kubernetes-native platform. The focus is on reducing toil, speeding up recovery and preventing repeat incidents.

This is a fast-paced startup environment. You’ll need to be comfortable adapting quickly and handling shifting priorities.

What You’ll Do

Production Reliability

AI-Accelerated Reliability

What You Bring

Introduction At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world's leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You'll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM's product and technology landscape. Here, you'l have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world.

Within IBM Software, the HCP Terraform Foundations group is made up of SREs and Software Engineers who keep HCP Terraform platform reliable, performant, and robust. Within Foundations, Production Engineering proactively improves the architecture, observability, and operational posture of the platform's foundational services and is Terraform's final escalation point when the platform is in trouble.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer II with an SRE background, experience building distributed systems at scale, and a strong interest in release engineering. Your Role And Responsibilities

  • Design and deliver technically deep improvements across Aurora PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, and Puma.

  • Help make database migrations safer and more self-service for application teams.
  • Make production measurable
  • Drive deep observability for foundational services, including SLOs, alerting, and log delivery.
  • Turn production signals into prioritized, systemic fixes.
  • Lead incident response

  • Lead across teams and grow others
  • Lead cross-team initiatives, working closely with other Foundations Engineering teams as well as feature teams.

job.name: Senior Software Developer (.Net)
job.description:
We are seeking a Senior .NET Developer who brings experience in system design and aims to step into an architectural role. Split roughly evenly between hands-on coding and code reviews, your responsibilities will also focus on designing cohesive application structures, data flows, and system integrations.

Your opportunity Our group builds and supports the software that runs the organization's internal operations: custom applications, integrations and data pipelines. As that portfolio grows, we need a senior developer who can deliver hands-on and also help shape our standards and technical direction.

As part of a 12-member team reporting to the Manager, IT Solutions, you will evaluate specifications, construct prototypes, and deliver production-ready code. Over time, the role will expand to include greater architectural responsibility alongside key contributions to core design decisions.

This is a permanent, full-time hybrid role, on-site at least three days a week. Our team is based in London, Ontario, but this position can be based in any of the following Dillon offices: Vancouver, Chatham, Guelph, Hamilton, Kingston, Kitchener, Oakville, Ottawa, Downtown Toronto, North York, Vaughan and Windsor. Responsibilities

  • Software development: Build, maintain and support .NET applications, APIs, integrations and SQL in production.
  • Current-state mapping: In your first 90 days, document our applications, databases, data flows and integrations.
  • Systems integration: Connect on-premise systems with SaaS platforms using REST APIs, scheduled ETL and event-driven patterns where they fit.
  • SaaS data handling: Recommend when to replicate data locally, query it live, or allow read/write, taking licensing, API limits and running costs into account.
  • AI in development: Use AI coding assistants to work faster, and help set team practices for reviewing, testing and securing AI-generated code.
  • AI in our solutions: Identify where AI adds real value in our applications and workflows, and integrate agentic services with attention to data security, accuracy and running cost.
  • Technology recommendations: Evaluate new tools, cloud services and AI, and write clear recommendations covering cost, risk, effort and long-term support.
  • Team mentorship: Support the professional development of junior and intermediate developers through continuous knowledge sharing, collaborative pair programming, rigorous code reviews, and architectural discussions.
  • ERP readiness: Help clean up the data and integration points our upcoming ERP replacement will depend on.
  • Production support: Help investigate complex production issues through to the root cause.

job.name: Junior Software Developer
job.description:
Green Shield Canada (GSC) is revolutionizing the healthcare industry as part of our mission to ensure better health for all!

In 1957, our founder, pharmacist William Wilkinson, witnessed a mother sacrifice her health by forgoing her own medicine to ensure she could afford a prescription for her sick daughter. He knew there had to be a better way! He introduced North America’s first prepaid drug plan, and Green Shield was born as a not-for-profit health benefits provider that re-invested its earnings to support better health for all Canadians.

Today, we follow in the footsteps of our founder as we continue our pursuit of a better way. No longer just a traditional health and dental benefits provider, Green Shield is now the first integrated health services organization in Canada that is both a payer (offering insurance, administering benefits, and paying claims) and a provider (offering medical, mental health, and pharmacy services).

This means we can uniquely offer:

  • Direct access to real time professional health services
  • Convenience to engage our services anywhere, anytime, effortlessly
  • Integration of our services, creating a seamless experience
  • Improved health outcomes via preventative care and treatment, and data driven insights

This evolution also deepens our social mission through both financial support and the direct delivery of services to support local communities and underserved populations across Canada.

THE ROLE IN A NUTSHELL

Our IT professionals focus on delivering innovative custom business applications and services that enable GSC to stand out as a specialist in the health benefits industry. As an employee on our IT team, you will have the opportunity to develop your technical and/or leadership skills, and deliver innovative solutions to our customers. We have big plans, and we need talented and motivated IT specialists to help us get to where we want to go.

This unionized position reports directly to the Manager – IT Delivery Services.

The Junior Software Developer is responsible for writing, developing, testing code, supporting existing applications including fixing defects according to departmental standards and client requirements that are small in size and low complexity.
