job.name: Full Stack /Eval & QA Engineer
job.description:
About Maximizer Maximizer has been building CRM software in Vancouver since 1987. That’s longer than most software companies have existed, and it means we’ve seen how sales and client relationships change, and what stays the same.

Our software helps financial advisors and sales teams keep track of the relationships their business depends on. It’s built in Canada, with Canadian data hosting for customers who want their client data to stay here, and in G2’s Spring 2026 reports, based on real user reviews, Maximizer was named a Leader and High Performer in CRM.

We’re about 50 people, and we like it that way. In a team this size, you know your colleagues, your work is visible, and there’s room to step into new challenges and shape projects that matter. We work in a hybrid model, and we make the most of the time we spend together, from team events to the small moments that make work more fun.

Where we’re headed: Maximizer is becoming an AI platform for financial advisors. IQBoost 2.0, now in early access with advisory firms, gives advisors one place to see their clients and get real work done with AI, in English and French, with Canadian data hosting. We’re a small team rebuilding how we ship software around AI, so what you build here reaches customers quickly. If you want to help build it, we’d like to meet you.

About The Team What we do: We build and ship Maximizer’s products, including IQBoost 2.0, our AI platform for financial advisors.

Who's on it: A mix of engineers who know our platform inside out and newer teammates bringing fresh perspectives.

Current focus: Taking LLM-powered features and agentic workflows from prototype to production, and modernizing legacy code along the way. It’s a time of renewal for the team, with new people, new tools, and new ways of working coming together, and plenty of room for you to help shape what comes next.

How we work together: We work in Agile and Scrum, review each other’s code, and share what we learn about building with AI. We set team and individual goals in Lattice, and use Assembly to recognize great work, so effort doesn’t go unnoticed.

About The Role Why this role exists: We’re expanding what IQBoost 2.0 can do for advisors, and need an engineer who can turn new AI ideas into features they rely on every day.

What success looks like: By 30 days, you know how the platform and its AI layer fit together and you’ve shipped your first change. By 90 days, you’ve shipped your first AI feature to production, with evals in place that show it’s ready. By 180 days, you own a set of AI features or workflows, track their quality, latency, and cost, and set the standard for how the team builds with AI.

job.description:
Description AWS Specialist Technology Team (STT) is seeking a Software Development Engineer to join the Specialist AI Tooling engineering team - the group building AI-native, agentic solutions that are fundamentally transforming how thousands of AWS technical specialists and field team members develop expertise, get matched to customer engagements, and how AWS service teams consume customer feedback at scale. If you want to build production agentic AI systems that impact thousands of users daily - not research prototypes, but real AI agents solving real problems - this is the role for you.

You Will Design, Build, And Operate Core Components Across Four Interconnected Products That Collectively Power The Intelligence Layer Of AWS's Specialist Ecosystem

AWS Learning Agent - A new generative AI-powered, agentic learning system that replaces static training paths with personalized, cross-domain skill development for every builder in the AWS technical field. Powered by a structured skill graph, persistent learner profiles, and the Specialist Knowledge Vault, the Learning Agent delivers adaptive learning journeys via a custom console, in Kiro, Claude, Quick and wherever builders work.

Intelligent Routing Agent - A new AI-driven routing engine that matches 136K+ annual specialist requests to verified domain experts using validated skill profiles rather than manually maintained lists - reducing resolution time (currently 7.72 days) and enabling precision matching at scale.

Technical Field Community (TFC) Hub - The platform powering 46 Technical Field Communities, managing member engagement, competency tracking, learning path orchestration, and community-driven content curation across AWS's specialist network.

Service 360 - A GenAI summarization and prioritization engine that aggregates customer feedback signals (PFRs, SpecReqs, SFDC Opportunity data) into categorized, prioritized service recommendations - automating what was previously a manual closed-loop feedback process to influence the roadmap for AWS public service teams.

This is a high-impact, AI-first engineering role where you will build agentic systems, ship production GenAI features, and solve hard problems at the intersection of knowledge graphs, multi-agent orchestration, LLM-powered personalization, and retrieval-augmented generation - all at AWS scale, using the very AI services AWS builds for its customers.

Key job responsibilities

Design and implement production agentic AI systems using LLMs, knowledge graphs, RAG, and multi-agent orchestration - delivering personalized learning paths and intelligent expert-matching to thousands of field members daily.

Build and optimize GenAI-powered pipelines including summarization, content ranking, skill assessment, and intelligent routing - ensuring low latency, high quality, and cost efficiency at scale.

job.name: Software Development Engineer, Ads AI Core Infrastructure (ACI), Ads AI Core Infrastructure
job.description:
Description At Amazon Ads, we're re-imagining the advertising landscape through advanced generative AI technologies and AI agents, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands online. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle — from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights.

The Ads Agent Fabric team delivers the AI infrastructure platform that accelerates agentic application development from months to weeks. We build the agent-builder SDK with pre-integrated Ads features, developer tools that accelerate the develop, test, and model evaluation lifecycle, and a fully-managed stateful runtime with integrated access to Ads services, data, and foundational models. Our platform solves core production challenges: managing execution state across multi-step reasoning and multi-agent orchestration, enabling resumability through checkpointing and task queues for long-running workflows, and providing memory primitives that enable stateful experiences where agents remember and learn across sessions.

You will build Tier-1 services to handle millions of requests per day, while maintaining response latencies in the milliseconds and meeting strict SLA requirements. You will develop distributed solutions with service-oriented architecture to build high-performance platforms powering the next generation of AI-driven advertising experiences. Our systems and algorithms operate on massive datasets using distributed frameworks. In this role, you will design new and rebuild existing solutions for the fast-growing scale of agentic infrastructure — including stateful runtime services, and pre-built platform components that agent-builder teams rely on to ship production agents.

You will not merely go through the full software development cycle but more importantly drive appropriate technology choices for the business, lead the way for continuous innovation, and shape the future of AI-powered advertising at Amazon.

We are a highly motivated, collaborative, and fun-loving team building at the forefront of AI agent infrastructure. We are entrepreneurial and have a bias for action with a broad mandate to experiment and innovate. This is an opportunity to make a significant impact on the future of AI agents in the Amazon Advertising business.

A successful candidate will have the satisfaction of seeing their work power thousands of AI agents serving millions of advertisers globally, broaden their technical skills across distributed systems and ML infrastructure, and work in an environment that thrives on creativity, experimentation, and product innovation.

Key job responsibilities

job.name: Platform Engineering – Middleware – Data Transport SRE - Assistant Vice President
job.description:
*Who We Are Looking For* The State Street Middleware Data Transport Team supports enterprise Managed File Transfer (MFT) platforms across the Bank.

We are seeking an experienced IBM Sterling Connect:Direct (NDM) Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in engineering, implementation, production support, troubleshooting, upgrades, security, automation, and optimization of enterprise Connect:Direct environments.

This is a hands-on technical engineering role, not a managerial or administration-only position. The candidate must be capable of independently troubleshooting complex production issues across Connect:Direct, operating systems, networks, authentication, certificates, and file-transfer workflows.

Experience with IBM Sterling Connect:Direct 6.x , including recent versions such as 6.3, 6.4 and 6.5 , is highly preferred.

*What You Will Be Responsible For*

  • Install, configure, upgrade, patch, maintain, and troubleshoot IBM Sterling Connect:Direct (NDM) on Linux/UNIX and Windows; z/OS exposure is preferred.
  • Provide Level 3 engineering and production support for business-critical Connect:Direct services and file-transfer workflows.
  • Troubleshoot PNODE/SNODE connectivity, Process failures, Netmap, authentication, permissions, TCP/IP/network, firewall, certificates, Secure+, TLS and performance issues.
  • Develop and troubleshoot Connect:Direct Processes, including COPY, RUN TASK/RUN JOB, symbolic parameters, conditional processing, checkpoint/restart, and Process dependencies.
  • Analyze Connect:Direct statistics, logs, return codes, message IDs, queues and session failures to perform root-cause analysis.
  • Configure and support Netmap, functional authorities, user proxies, Secure+, TLS certificates and cipher configuration.
  • Perform Connect:Direct upgrades, migrations, patching, vulnerability remediation, server refreshes, HA/DR and failover/failback exercises.
  • Work extensively with IBM Sterling Control Center Monitor/Director for node monitoring, alerts, SLA/SLC monitoring, configuration management, audit, inventory, and centralized management.
  • Troubleshoot end-to-end file-transfer issues involving application, Linux/Windows, network, firewall, security, storage, and external partner teams.
  • Integrate Connect:Direct workflows with AutoSys and other enterprise scheduling solutions.
  • Develop automation using Bash/Shell, PowerShell, Python or Ansible for monitoring, health checks and operational activities.
  • Participate in Incident, Problem, Change and Capacity Management and lead technical troubleshooting/RCA for complex production incidents.

*Required Skills*

job.name: Software Development Engineer, AWS OpenSearch Service
job.description:
Description Imagine running search and analytics at any scale without thinking about clusters, capacity, or version upgrades. Where your queries return in milliseconds whether you're indexing a thousand documents or a hundred billion. Where the platform scales, heals, and secures itself so your team can focus on the questions, not the infrastructure.

That's what we build.

Amazon OpenSearch Service is the fully managed and Serverless AWS service that lets customers deploy, operate, and scale OpenSearch for log analytics, full-text search, application monitoring, observability, and AI-powered retrieval. We serve hundreds of thousands of customers running mission-critical workloads across every AWS region, and we are part of the AWS Database and Analytics organization.

Come join the OpenSearch Control Plane team. We are responsible for a service that:

  • Reliably manages a large fleet of cloud-native OpenSearch clusters and collections, freeing customers from sizing, scaling, and patching decisions
  • Guarantees high availability and durability for mission-critical search and observability workloads at the scale of the most demanding internet businesses
  • Orchestrates and automates the complete lifecycle of an OpenSearch cluster or collection — from creation through scale-up, scale-out, upgrade, replication, and fail-over

The OpenSearch control plane is not just any distributed system. It orchestrates a fleet of clusters across every AWS region, detects and recovers from node failures in seconds, and serves workloads that span petabytes of customer data. Most recently, we launched \\*OpenSearch Serverless NextGen\\* — delivering ultra-fast collection provisioning and true scale-to-zero capacity, so customers pay only for what they use and get a working environment in seconds rather than minutes. We are not done; this is one of many investments raising the bar for what customers can expect from a managed search service.

OpenSearch itself is a community-driven, Apache 2.0–licensed open-source search and analytics suite built on Apache Lucene. Since launching in July 2021, the project has delivered multiple major and minor releases advancing core search, vector search, and analytics. Our next phase focuses on transforming OpenSearch into an intelligent retrieval engine — one that meets the evolving needs of customers running search, analytics, and AI-powered workloads across structured, unstructured, and multi-modal data.

We work in Java, Rust, Python, and Go. We contribute upstream to OpenSearch and Apache Lucene. We are customer-obsessed, operate with the entrepreneurial pace of a startup inside one of the world's largest cloud providers, and value strong intuition backed by metrics.

job.name: Software Development Engineer, Trainium Systems
job.description:
Description Have you ever wondered what it takes to build the software systems that turn a rack of AI accelerators from inert silicon into a system a customer can run workloads on? Do you want deep ownership of a service that every one of those systems depends on to boot, run, and stay healthy?

Who are we?

Annapurna Labs is the part of Amazon that designs the custom silicon behind the cloud, including Trainium for AI training, Graviton CPUs, and the AWS Nitro system. Nearly every server in AWS runs hardware we designed. We build the chips, the systems, and the software that power some of the largest AI training and inference workloads in the world.

What do we do?

We build the software that provisions, operates, updates, and monitors the servers behind AWS's largest AI training workloads, built on Trainium, Graviton, and the AWS Nitro system. We give the people who run this hardware a complete way to stand it up, watch its health, deliver new software to it, and diagnose it, all through open, standard interfaces. We own that software from design through the running system.

Why it's high-impact?

The hardware is just silicon until our software makes it provisionable, observable, and serviceable. Every system runs through what we build. The service you own is on the path for all of them, and the people who run this hardware depend on it every day.

What's the challenge?

There are many ambiguous and difficult challenges in our fast-moving space. Our services require deep system and software expertise. You need to have the ability to work within a fast moving and startup-like environment in a large company. You will identify solutions, trying ideas, given space to fail and iterate to produce products that your customers love.

What you will do?

You own a service in the management plane, in provisioning, monitoring, telemetry, software delivery, or diagnostics, depending on where the team needs you. You take it from design to production, you work backward from what the operator needs, and you build on the interfaces the hardware teams expose.

Who would succeed in this role?

An engineer who likes building and operating a service in production and takes it the whole way. You read logs and reason across process and system boundaries, you ship in small verifiable steps, and you turn requirements into a service other people rely on.

Key job responsibilities

  • Own the design and implementation of a large component or service in the management plane, in provisioning, monitoring, telemetry, software delivery, or diagnostics.
  • Make the application-level trade-offs on your component, and seek direction on the calls that reach beyond it.
  • Automate and simplify the team's development, test, and operations work, and mentor peers as you grow.
  • work backward from customer requirements and deliver solutions that are simple.

A day in the life

The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

Payments Platform is at the front door of Coinbase’s financial ecosystem. Our mission is to move old money into crypto and power financial access and payments for the crypto economy globally. As the bridge between the traditional financial world and the crypto economy, we build and operate the fiat on- and off-ramps and payment services that let Coinbase’s customer-facing products deliver reliable, seamless payment processing and connect customer fiat funds into crypto.

We’re seeking a deep technical leader to define the engineering vision for Payments, shape architectural cohesion across our global payment rails and funds-flow systems, drive platform-level reliability and cost efficiency, and lead the next evolution of how fiat moves into and out of Coinbase.

What you’ll be doing (ie. job duties):

  • Define and drive the multi‑quarter technical strategy for Payments, spanning rails, orchestration, and transfers, to support new products, geos, and significant growth in payment volume.
  • Architect and evolve the core Payments platform (rails integrations, routing, and funds-flow services) for high availability, low latency, and cost efficiency at global scale.
  • Lead end‑to‑end design and rollout of large, cross‑team initiatives (e.g., new global rails, decomp/migrations, resiliency programs), breaking high ambiguity into clear milestones and measurable outcomes.
  • Set and enforce technical standards for financial correctness across Payments, including idempotency, reconciliation, failure‑mode handling, and auditability for all money‑movement paths.
  • Partner closely with FinHub, Payments Risk, Regulatory Platform, and Product to design cohesive architectures that balance customer experience, risk controls, compliance, and unit economics.
  • Provide deep technical mentorship to senior/staff engineers across Payments pods, upleveling system design quality, review rigor, and long‑term maintainability.
  • Use data and observability signals (e.g., success rates, latency, cost, incident patterns) to identify structural platform gaps and lead systematic reliability and efficiency improvements.
  • Represent Payments in executive and cross‑org forums, clearly communicating tradeoffs, aligning stakeholders on strategy, and securing buy‑in for high‑impact technical bets.

job.name: Staff Software Engineer
job.description:
StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels.

About the Team

Activations is part of StackAdapt's Data Hub product, our customer data platform. Advertisers bring their first-party data into Data Hub: CRM lists, website and app events, product catalogs and store locations. Activations turn that data into something they can use. We build audiences, keep them in sync with the channels advertisers buy on, and feed products and locations into dynamic creative.

We are a small team of senior and mid-level engineers. We work mostly in Go, on event-driven services that run at large scale, using Kafka, gRPC and TiDB on AWS. Advertisers spend against the audiences we build, and privacy law shapes how we handle their data, so correctness matters as much as speed.

The team runs flat. Senior engineers lead projects from design to launch. You will set the technical standard those project leads work to: how we design, review and ship. You will help every engineer on the team get better at it, mostly by building alongside them.

You will work closely with our Data Hub architect, who sets technical direction across the whole domain and decides designs that cross Data Hub teams. You decide designs inside Activations, and the two of you work together on the ones that cross the line. You also own the technical calls the team makes day to day, and the case for changing direction when what we learn in production says we should.

job.name: Forward Deployed Engineer, AI Trust and Reliability
job.description:
About The Role Hopper powers travel for some of the world's largest banks, airlines and travel companies, and our AI agents act on their customers' behalf by looking up accounts, changing and cancelling bookings, and handling payments and loyalty points. As the Forward Deployed Engineer, AI Trust and Reliability, you make sure that AI is safe, secure and ready for production in every partner deployment. You work in a small forward-deployed team as the person who owns guardrails, adversarial testing, launch readiness and partner security reviews, and you are the bridge between our partners' security, risk and IT teams and Hopper's engineering and security teams.

What would your day-to-day look like

  • Tailor guardrails to each partner's policies, regulations, risk appetite and languages, covering what the AI may do, what it must refuse and when it hands off to a human
  • Design protections for sensitive data and actions, including data masking, identity checks and customer consent before any change to a booking or payment
  • Tune guardrails so they stop real risks without blocking legitimate customers
  • Red-team every deployment before launch and after significant changes, testing for jailbreaks, prompt injection, data leakage, unauthorized actions and social engineering
  • Build and maintain automated adversarial test suites that run continuously, in every language a partner serves
  • Turn findings into fixes with engineering, and into regression tests so they stay fixed
  • Lead partner security questionnaires, architecture reviews and AI or model-risk reviews, and respond to partner penetration-test findings
  • Document how our AI handles data, access and decisions in terms a regulator or auditor would accept
  • Own the go-live checklist for each deployment, covering functional, regression, safety and load testing, sign-off criteria and rollback plans
  • Extend our automated testing across products, so every model, prompt or configuration change is tested before it reaches customers
  • Coordinate user acceptance testing with partners and close out issues before launch
  • Lead the security and privacy side of partner data access for our forward-deployed teams, including data-sharing agreements, IT security reviews and secure access to partner systems, including on-premise ones
  • Define how partner data is handled, stored, separated and deleted across deployments and model training, and make sure it is followed
  • Monitor live deployments for quality, reliability, abuse and safety failures, and set up dashboards and alerting with engineering
  • Lead the response when a safety or security issue occurs, with clear communication to the partner throughout
  • Work closely with Research, Product and our security team, so new models and features ship with security built in
  • Turn each deployment into reusable guardrails, tests and documentation, so the next partner goes faster

job.name: Senior Software Engineer
job.description:
TITLE: Senior Software Engineer

REPORTING TO : CTO

LOCATION : Marina del Rey, CA – OR – Williamsburg, NY (onsite M - F)

Who Is Flip? Flip builds AI voice agents that handle millions of real customer conversations for some of the biggest brands, healthcare providers, and transportation companies in the world. When you call a company and the AI actually solves your problem — tracks the order, processes the return, refills the prescription — that’s us.

We’re a low-ego team. We don’t need the limelight or the stardom — we care about solving really hard problems, fast. And here’s the part worth stopping on: outside the frontier labs, almost nobody is running AI in production at this scale. We are — millions and millions of live phone calls, at a ratio of roughly one engineer for every million calls. We deploy to production three times a day. Very few teams our size serve this volume, and the reason is simple: we hold a very high bar for development.

How We Think From day one, we’ve operated on first principles, and the first principle is the customer. If you have strong conviction that something delivers real business value for your customer, it shouldn’t die in red tape or committee. You ship it — fast and often — because the customer is what actually matters. That’s why there’s a direct line from your keyboard to production here. We didn’t remove the committee to move fast for its own sake; we removed it because conviction plus customer obsession doesn’t need a permission slip.

We reward big swings. Our founders are very forward about this: you’ll test in production, and you’ll always be encouraged to take a swing — whether it lands or not. Missing on a big swing is fine. Not swinging is what gets called out.

Agentic development has changed the way we work — we’re not shy about that. What it hasn’t changed is the necessity of experience, especially at the production level. You can ship faster than ever now; that doesn’t negate experience. Speed without judgment is how you break things millions of people depend on. That’s why we hire senior engineers: builders whose experience makes the new speed safe.

Our view is simple: let builders build. We care a lot less about stack experience or corporate pedigree than most companies — and a lot more about whether you’ve looked past the noise and want to build product you’re genuinely proud of. Tools change monthly now. The instinct to build doesn’t.

We keep the team lean on purpose — a high bar, real support, real resources — because that’s where builders truly express themselves. The most common thing we hear from engineers after joining Flip is some version of “I could never have done this at my last company” .

Deep industry expertise matched with ruthless execution creates wonderful work. That’s the whole formula.

You will work on cluster readiness and certification software, including the open-source Cluster Readiness Engine, that validates GPU clusters across Kubernetes and Slurm, measures real training and inference performance, and produces evidence customers and partners can trust. We partner with the world's most innovative AI companies and cloud providers to make sure their infrastructure performs as designed before their most important workloads land on it.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Shape the Future of Validation. Design and build the systems that turn cluster validation from a manual exercise into repeatable, verifiable software. Your work will directly shape how NVIDIA and its partners qualify new GPU platforms and deployments.
  • Core Development. Design and implement cluster readiness and certification tooling in Go and Python that runs on Kubernetes and Slurm, including controllers, operators, CLIs, and scheduler integrations.
  • Benchmarking & Workloads. Build a catalog of benchmarks and real workloads spanning communication (NCCL), compute, storage, diagnostics, training, inference, reliability, and security, with per-architecture expectations and clear pass/fail criteria.
  • Data Provenance. Develop provenance and evidence pipelines that capture what actually ran, where it ran, and under which configuration, and that produce signed, auditable results.
  • Platform Integration. Bring new GPU platforms, schedulers, and fabrics under test, from first bring-up on a single node through multi-node validation on production clusters.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration.Collaborate with internal platform, networking, and solutions teams and with cloud partners to root-cause performance and correctness gaps found by the tooling, and feed fixes back into platforms and reference architectures.
  • Open Source Contribution. Contribute to the open-source Cluster Readiness Engine and related projects, including design documents, documentation, and reviews.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer - Pacing & Experimentation
job.description:
The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.

Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.

The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.

About The Role Every campaign on our platform has a budget and a flight, and our pacing system decides in real time how to spend it against 20M queries per second. It has to bid the right amount on every impression, at the right rate, so advertisers spend their budget in full and get the most value from it.

Changing a system like that safely is its own engineering problem. An ordinary A/B traffic split breaks down here, because both arms draw on the same campaign budget and one arm's spend distorts the other. We solve this with budget split experiments: each arm gets its own share of the budget, its own pacing calculation and its own spend tracking, all inside one live campaign. This is now how we gain confidence in any change to bidding behavior.

We are looking for a senior engineer to work across both areas: the pacing engine itself, and the experimentation infrastructure that proves changes to it. You will build in the services that compute pacing instructions and apply them at bid time. You will also extend the experiment framework so teams across the company can launch a trustworthy experiment in hours instead of weeks.

We work in a highly collaborative environment with a broad range of technologies, including .NET, Kafka, Kubernetes, Spark and Delta Lake. If you have built experimentation platforms or real-time decisioning systems outside ad tech, such as trading, payments or marketplace pricing, we want to hear from you.

What You Will Do

Get to Know Us Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find, fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers & operators, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. The Core Front-End team operates as a central front-end architecture and enablement group responsible for driving the long-term scalability, consistency, performance, and usability of the NodeZero platform. You will work across multiple product areas and partner closely with Product, Design, Front-End, Back-End, Platform, and Security Engineering teams to define and implement modern user experiences at scale.

As a Staff Engineer, you will lead complex technical initiatives that span multiple teams and systems. You will help define architectural direction, establish engineering standards, improve developer workflows, and guide the evolution of our front-end platform and design system. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy solving ambiguous problems, influencing technical direction beyond their immediate team, and building systems that enable other engineers to move faster.

job.description:
You own and build the interactive frontend architecture and production surfaces where a person asks an AI what's actually true about a purchase: our /shop Verification Checker, our streaming conversational shopping assistant, the SimplyCodes browser extension at checkout, and the pages a shopper lands on from search.

Product.ai is the verification layer for commerce: when a person or an AI agent needs to know what's actually true about a purchase, we answer with proof. SimplyCodes is the first proof at scale, the code verification service, at ~$22M a year in revenue. Profitable. Founder-owned since 2009, bootstrapped, no outside investors, no board. Fewer than twenty operators.

Why This Role Exists

We are shipping several high-leverage consumer surfaces at once: our /shop Verification Checker (where any shopper pastes what an AI, an article, a brand page, or a friend told them to buy, and we grade the claims inside it across five verification states — free to consumers to win trust and habit while AI shopping agents pay per call for verified commerce truth), our conversational shopping assistant that streams verified answers with proof beside them, and the SimplyCodes browser extension and web pages that millions of shoppers use every day.

We need a senior frontend architect and builder who owns the interactive frontend end to end: streaming state machines, motion physics, the /shop Design Record component architecture, responsiveness, perceived performance, and accessibility across every consumer surface. You partner directly with our Founding Designer and the founder to set and raise the consumer design and engineering bar.

This is not "implement the mockup." Our design system is executable law, and its tokens and components in the /shop Design Record are read directly by the coding agents that accelerate our builds. You own the hard interactive components, the state and streaming architecture, and the live production interfaces end to end.

job.description:
A career s a Senior Data Scientist in the Credit Risk Analytics team at National Bank, means you’ll be responsible for the IFRS 9 and stress testing model development and performance monitoring, as well as IFRS 9 reporting and analytics. This role will also need to support other closely related risk functions that includes RWA, Economic Capital and stress testing. With your experience in credit risk modeling , strong analytical skills , and knowledge of IFRS 9 and regulatory requirements , you’ll have a positive impact on NBC’s credit risk management through building advanced models, efficient and robust risk processes and providing insightful analyses to our senior management .

Your role:

  • Develop and recalibrate IFRS 9 and stress testing models for the Bank’s wholesale and retail portfolios. Document the data selection, modeling techniques and implementation.
  • Conduct model backtesting, monitor model performance and propose appropriate model actions when necessary.
  • Keep abreast of up-to-date modeling methodologies, tools and regulatory requirements.
  • Conduct IFRS 9 ECL impact assessment for parameter recalibration, economic scenario change, model updates, data migration and process changes.
  • Work with IFRS 9 production team to implement and test IFRS 9 model changes.
  • Validate the process inputs and outputs for quality control and governance.
  • Collaborate with Model Validation, Model Governance, Audit by preparing supporting materials, addressing questions and concerns, and ensuring IFRS 9 model changes are appropriately documented and understood.
  • Provide in-depth analysis on IFRS 9 results and identify key drivers for ECL movements.
  • Provide support for ad-hoc requests required by IFRS 9 stakeholders and senior management in a precise and efficient manner.
  • Contribute to strategic risk initiatives by using analytical skills to project potential losses and make recommendations to limit risk.
  • Demonstrate insight into internal client's business and develop innovative solutions that create value.

Your team:

As part of the Credit Risk Analytics sector, you’ll be on a team of 24 of colleagues and you’ll report to the Senior Director – Analytics. Our team stands out for expertise in model development, model implementation and risk reporting in IFRS 9, stress testing and capital areas. As some processes are part of the Bank’s month-end or quarter-end reporting to the public or to the regulators, we may work under tight deadline and pressure sometimes.

We offer a wide range of ongoing learning opportunities for your development, including coaching, hands-on learning, training courses and through the collaborating with colleagues who have varied expertise and profiles such as in-depth data analytics, model development, risk programming and presentation to senior management.

The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We're early in the agent lifecycle, which means the work here is hands-on, fast-moving, and genuinely entrepreneurial: you'll often help write the playbook for how Workday deploys a new agent, rather than follow one that already exists. Responsibilities:

· Define the long-term Physical AI research direction and system architecture for humanoid and industrial robotics to guide next generation technology and product strategy.

· Architect, develop, and maintain virtual system world models including articulated hands and arms, sensors, robot dynamics, contact interactions, and environments.

· Own the technical architecture of Physical AI data curation pipelines, spanning simulation, synthetic data generation, real-world collection and teleoperation, multimodal synchronization, schemas, quality checks, dataset versioning, and reproducible training and evaluation.

· Lead imitation-learning, reinforcement-learning, domain-randomization, sim-to-real, and real-to-sim workflows; establish evaluation criteria, analyze failure modes, and resolve complex model and controller issues with limited information.

· Translate research into hardware implementations through algorithm–hardware co-design.

· Define and evaluate system-level performance and resource trade-offs to guide deployment decisions and long-term technical priorities.

· Mentor engineers and researchers across domains.

Qualifications

· Extensive relevant research and engineering experience, including 8 years of related experience with a Ph.D.

· Strong expertise in foundation model training and fine-tuning, vision-language-action models (VLAs), reinforcement learning, and generative and world models targeting Physical AI systems such as humanoids and industrial robotics.

· Strong background in mathematics, physics, and software engineering, with the ability to apply rigorous modeling, analysis, and engineering methods to complex robotic systems.

· Knowledge in Neuromorphic and in-memory computing and modeling will be considered an advantage.

· Knowledge with foundation model development and finetuning for specification to hardware generation (e.g., schematics, RTL) will be considered an advantage.

job.name: Senior Applied AI Researcher
job.description:
Overview: Guidepoint is hiring a Senior Applied AI Researcher for its new Applied AI/ML team in Toronto. You'll build and optimize NLP, LLM and machine learning systems in production, and run the experiments that decide which models and techniques we build on.

You'll work on hard, open problems with real users and a large proprietary knowledge base and take ideas from first experiment to production. This is applied research: we don't train foundation models. We pick the right model and technique for each problem, prove it with evals, and make it faster and cheaper where it counts.

Guidepoint's mission is to make individuals, businesses and the world smarter through personalized knowledge-sharing. Our Toronto Technology Hub is home to Guidepoint's Data, AI and ML teams.

This is a hybrid role based in our Toronto office. What You'll Do:

  • Build, deploy and optimize LLM and NLP systems in production, from RAG and agents to classification and extraction, for quality, latency and cost
  • Fine-tune and adapt open-weight and proprietary models, and combine LLMs with classical ML for scoring and ranking
  • Turn loosely defined problems into testable questions, run experiments and recommend what to build
  • Build evaluation frameworks other teams can reuse, and assess new models as they're released
  • Embed with product teams and own projects end to end, from framing to production
  • Mentor junior engineers and share what you learn

What You Have:

  • 5+ years of hands-on industry experience applying NLP, ML or AI to real products, with multiple production releases (3+ years with a Master's or PhD), and a degree in computer science, ML, statistics or a related field
  • A track record of both shipping and experimenting: systems you built or optimized in production, and experiments that changed what a team built
  • Deep experience building LLM applications: RAG, hybrid search and re-ranking, agents and tool calling, structured outputs
  • Hands-on fine-tuning (for example LoRA or QLoRA) and model optimization such as distillation or small language models, with sound judgement on when each beats better prompting or retrieval
  • Strong evaluation skills: golden and synthetic datasets, metrics, and LLM-as-judge calibrated against human review
  • Solid classical ML: gradient boosting, ranking, feature engineering and drift monitoring
  • Strong Python (PyTorch, Hugging Face, scikit-learn) and production experience on a cloud platform; Azure, Databricks and MLflow are a plus
  • Clear communication and comfort with ambiguity: you can shape a vague request into a question worth answering, and explain the result to any audience
  • Experience in data-sensitive industries such as financial services or market research is a plus

What We Offer: The annual base salary range for this position is 170,000-200,000 CAD . Additionally, this position is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on performance.

job.name: Principal AI Engineer, Trust & Evaluation
job.description:
Who are we? Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary Sets the technical direction for the evaluation and trust capabilities of Equinix's GenAI platform, and designs, develops and deploys them. Builds platform features that let teams evaluate their agents at scale: golden datasets, synthetic test data, scoring with LLM-as-judge, and monitoring of agent quality in production. Designs and tests the trust controls that agents run on, including agent identity, access, guardrails and data boundaries. Leads the investigation of the hardest agent failures and fixes them in the platform. Serves as the hands-on technical lead of the Trust & Evaluation team, and partners with product, platform, security and governance leaders to turn ambiguous problems into robust, secure, observable and performant solutions.

Knowledge and Application Applies expert knowledge of software engineering practice and of LLM and agent concepts (prompting, retrieval, tool and function calling, orchestration, MCP). Has deep expertise in evaluation methods (code-based checks, LLM-as-judge, human review, golden datasets, regression suites) and evaluation statistics (sampling, variance across runs, agreement between reviewers). Has a deep understanding of AI security risks such as prompt injection and data leakage, and of identity concepts such as OAuth, token exchange and per-user access. Sets the standards and practices that the team and other teams follow, and keeps them current with industry research.

Complexity and Problem Solving Works on complex, open-ended problems that span teams, where the right approach is not yet known. Leads the investigation of the hardest agent failures (retrieval, tool call, prompt, model, data or infrastructure) and follows them until they are fixed. Decides which metrics reflect real quality and sets the bar for release. Makes architecture decisions with long-term impact on the platform, and resolves trade-offs among quality, cost, latency and security. Work is reviewed at design and milestone gates for results against long-term goals.

job.name: Applications Development Senior Programmer Analyst – CitiKYC MIS Cognos Reporting
job.description:
Job Description We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced MIS Reporting Developer / Senior Programmer Analyst to join our CitiKYC Reporting Technology team. The ideal candidate will serve as a lead reporting specialist with extensive, proven expertise in developing and managing global enterprise-level reports, semantic models, and distribution frameworks using IBM Cognos Analytics as the primary business intelligence toolset, complemented by strong visualization and dashboarding capabilities.

The candidate must have strong hands-on proficiency in querying, optimizing, and analyzing large datasets primarily hosted on Oracle databases, ensuring high performance, data integrity, and strict adherence to regulatory reporting reliability standards.

Job Background / Context

Know Your Customer (KYC) is an enterprise due diligence process executed when accepting, or periodically renewing, business relationships. This process ensures compliance with global Anti-Money Laundering (AML) regulations, Customer Identification Program Procedures (CIP-P), and other regulatory mandates designed to protect Citi from financial crime risks.

CitiKYC is a unified global platform across Citi's business lines. Its core objective is to reduce KYC complexity through process standardization, automated workflows, and robust regulatory MIS reporting. This team is directly responsible for delivering reporting solutions that monitor KYC record throughput, backlog, SLA management, and compliance risk indicators for senior management and regulatory bodies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Cognos Enterprise Reporting (Primary): Lead the end-to-end design, development, enhancement, and maintenance of operational, regulatory, and management reports using the full IBM Cognos Analytics suite (Report Studio, Query Studio, Dashboard, Event Studio, and Framework Manager / Data Modules).
  • Oracle Data Layer & Query Optimization (Primary DB): Write, fine-tune, and optimize complex Oracle SQL queries, PL/SQL blocks, views, and stored procedures to extract, aggregate, and transform high-volume datasets efficiently.
  • BI Administration & Security: Implement best practices for enterprise BI administration, metadata modeling, role-based access control, object-level security, and scheduled report distribution across Cognos environments.
  • Requirements & Strategy: Collaborate closely with Business Analysts, KYC Operations leads, Compliance Officers, and Data Architects to translate complex business and regulatory requirements into scalable reporting solutions.
  • Maintenance & Performance Tuning: Troubleshoot report failures, resolve data discrepancies, and optimize report execution times and database access paths for peak operational efficiency.
  • Mentorship & Support: Provide technical guidance, code/model reviews, and mentorship to junior developers; deliver training and tier-3 support to end-users on reporting tools.

job.name: Scientifique de données principal Modeles Risque de crédit
job.description:
Une carrière à titre de scientifique de données senior au sein de l’équipe Analytique du risque de crédit à la Banque Nationale, tu seras responsable du développement des modèles IFRS 9 et de tests de résistance, ainsi que du suivi de leur performance. Tu contribueras également à la production de rapports et d’analyses liés à IFRS 9. Ton rôle t’amènera aussi à soutenir d’autres activités étroitement liées à la gestion des risques, notamment les actifs pondérés en fonction des risques (RWA), le capital économique et les tests de résistance.

Grâce à ton expérience en modélisation du risque de crédit, à tes solides compétences analytiques ainsi qu’à ta connaissance d’IFRS 9 et des exigences réglementaires, tu auras un impact positif sur la gestion du risque de crédit de la Banque Nationale. Tu contribueras notamment au développement de modèles avancés, à la mise en place de processus de gestion des risques efficaces et robustes, ainsi qu’à la production d’analyses pertinentes destinées à la haute direction.

Ton rôle :

  • Développer et recalibrer les modèles IFRS 9 et de tests de résistance pour les portefeuilles de crédit de gros et de détail de la Banque, et documenter la sélection des données, les techniques de modélisation et leur mise en œuvre.
  • Effectuer des tests rétrospectifs (backtesting), surveiller la performance des modèles et recommander les ajustements appropriés lorsque nécessaire.
  • Te tenir à jour sur les méthodologies et outils de modélisation ainsi que sur les exigences réglementaires.
  • Réaliser des analyses d’impact sur les pertes de crédit attendues (ECL) selon IFRS 9 lors du recalibrage des paramètres, de changements aux scénarios économiques, de mises à jour des modèles, de migrations de données ou de changements aux processus.
  • Collaborer avec l’équipe responsable de la production IFRS 9 afin de mettre en œuvre et de tester les changements apportés aux modèles IFRS 9.
  • Valider les données d’entrée et les résultats des processus afin d’assurer le contrôle de la qualité et une saine gouvernance.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes de Validation des modèles, de Gouvernance des modèles et d’Audit en préparant la documentation requise, en répondant aux questions et préoccupations et en veillant à ce que les changements apportés aux modèles IFRS 9 soient adéquatement documentés et compris.
  • Fournir des analyses approfondies des résultats IFRS 9 et identifier les principaux facteurs expliquant les variations des pertes de crédit attendues (ECL).
  • Répondre de façon précise et efficace aux demandes ponctuelles des parties prenantes IFRS 9 et de la haute direction.
  • Contribuer aux initiatives stratégiques en matière de risque en utilisant tes compétences analytiques afin de projeter les pertes potentielles et de formuler des recommandations visant à limiter les risques.
  • Démontrer une bonne compréhension des activités des partenaires internes et développer des solutions novatrices qui créent de la valeur.

job.description:
Temporary Full Time

As an Analyst at Canada Life, you’ll build and maintain reliable data pipelines that support analytics reporting, financial reporting, and business applications. You’ll work with stakeholders to understand their data needs and deliver well-tested, well-documented solutions that meet Canada Life’s engineering standards, protocols, and data governance requirements. The Financial Horizons Business Unit owns its own Databricks node, you’ll be doing administrative work required to run it.

What You Will Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-quality data pipelines that deliver accurate, consistent, and timely data.
  • Monitor pipeline performance, troubleshoot failures and data quality issues, and address root causes to prevent recurrence.
  • Develop, test, and document pipeline code. Review peers’ code for correctness, readability, maintainability, and adherence to Canada Life’s standards.
  • Follow data governance requirements when documenting data sources, transformations, lineage, and dependencies, and when testing new or updated pipelines.
  • Collaborate with analytics, finance, and application teams to understand how they use the data and validate that pipeline outputs meet their needs.
  • Conducting and maintaining all work within the data segregation policy for the MGA business.

What You Will Bring

  • Master’s degree in related field of study, or an equivalent combination of bachelor’s degree and extensive related work experience.
  • Experience within the Insurance & Financial Services sector would be an asset.
  • The ability to give constructive code review feedback and write clear technical documentation.
  • Experience building, testing, and maintaining data pipelines and writing maintainable code.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to trace data issues across source systems, transformations, and downstream outputs.
  • Strong experience in working with Databricks, Python, SQL.
  • Nice to Have: Informatica, JIRA, Power BI, Excel, Snowflake, Azure Data Factory, Control M, dbt
  • Ability to work with little to no documentation or instruction.
  • Think outside the box and identify solution to overcome obstacles.
  • Experience working on project teams to analyze business needs.
  • Proven ability to learn and handle multiple priorities in a challenging work environment.

The base salary for this position is between $65,800 - $109,700 annually. This represents base salary only and does not represent other variable compensation components of our total compensation ( i.e. annual bonus, commission etc). If you are selected to move forward in our recruitment process, your recruiter will be able to discuss additional details of our total rewards program with you.

Career opportunities will be open a minimum of 5 business days from the date of posting, closing dates will vary depending on the search activity. All applications received will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

job.name: Applications Development Senior Programmer Analyst – CitiKYC MIS Cognos Reporting
job.description:
Job Description We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced MIS Reporting Developer / Senior Programmer Analyst to join our CitiKYC Reporting Technology team. The ideal candidate will serve as a lead reporting specialist with extensive, proven expertise in developing and managing global enterprise-level reports, semantic models, and distribution frameworks using IBM Cognos Analytics as the primary business intelligence toolset, complemented by strong visualization and dashboarding capabilities.

The candidate must have strong hands-on proficiency in querying, optimizing, and analyzing large datasets primarily hosted on Oracle databases, ensuring high performance, data integrity, and strict adherence to regulatory reporting reliability standards.

Job Background / Context

Know Your Customer (KYC) is an enterprise due diligence process executed when accepting, or periodically renewing, business relationships. This process ensures compliance with global Anti-Money Laundering (AML) regulations, Customer Identification Program Procedures (CIP-P), and other regulatory mandates designed to protect Citi from financial crime risks.

CitiKYC is a unified global platform across Citi's business lines. Its core objective is to reduce KYC complexity through process standardization, automated workflows, and robust regulatory MIS reporting. This team is directly responsible for delivering reporting solutions that monitor KYC record throughput, backlog, SLA management, and compliance risk indicators for senior management and regulatory bodies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Cognos Enterprise Reporting (Primary): Lead the end-to-end design, development, enhancement, and maintenance of operational, regulatory, and management reports using the full IBM Cognos Analytics suite (Report Studio, Query Studio, Dashboard, Event Studio, and Framework Manager / Data Modules).
  • Oracle Data Layer & Query Optimization (Primary DB): Write, fine-tune, and optimize complex Oracle SQL queries, PL/SQL blocks, views, and stored procedures to extract, aggregate, and transform high-volume datasets efficiently.
  • BI Administration & Security: Implement best practices for enterprise BI administration, metadata modeling, role-based access control, object-level security, and scheduled report distribution across Cognos environments.
  • Requirements & Strategy: Collaborate closely with Business Analysts, KYC Operations leads, Compliance Officers, and Data Architects to translate complex business and regulatory requirements into scalable reporting solutions.
  • Maintenance & Performance Tuning: Troubleshoot report failures, resolve data discrepancies, and optimize report execution times and database access paths for peak operational efficiency.
  • Mentorship & Support: Provide technical guidance, code/model reviews, and mentorship to junior developers; deliver training and tier-3 support to end-users on reporting tools.

Read the full description

job.name: Credit Portfolio Analytics - Existing Customer Management - Analyst I
job.description:
The Credit Portfolio Analyst is an entry-level position responsible for participating in a variety of portfolio monitoring activities to identify credit migration in coordination with the Risk Management team. The overall objective of this role is to assist in managing Citi's portfolio exposure to clients and counterparties globally.

Job Responsibilities: Portfolio Monitoring & Risk Analysis

  • Track portfolio performance metrics including delinquency, roll rates, losses, and utilization.
  • Perform trend, vintage, and cohort analysis to identify early risk signals.
  • Support creation and maintenance of risk dashboards and MIS.

Acquisition & New Account Risk

  • Analyze performance of new account vintages by channel, product, and segment.
  • Monitor early delinquency and first-payment default trends.
  • Support evaluation of acquisition strategies to balance growth and risk.
  • Assist in evaluating approval rate vs loss trade-offs.
  • Participate in champion–challenger analysis for policy and strategy updates.
  • Help document policy rationale and analytical findings.

Existing Customer Management (ECM) Responsibilities

  • Monitor existing customer credit risk performance across ECM levers, including CLI, CLD, authorization controls, and line management etc.
  • Perform segmentation, trend, and vintage analysis to identify changes in customer behavior and emerging risk signals.
  • Support analytics for risk-based ECM strategies to balance spend growth, customer experience, and credit losses.
  • Track post-implementation performance of ECM actions and highlight variances versus expectations.
  • Quantify risk–return impact of ECM strategies, including effects on utilization, delinquency, losses, and attrition.
  • Assist in diagnosing portfolio performance changes and segment-level risk drivers.

Stakeholder Communication & Governance

  • Prepare clear, structured presentations for senior analysts and managers.
  • Support documentation for risk governance and audit requirements.
  • Participate in regular risk review forums as an analytical contributor.
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Required Skills & Qualifications: Experience & Education

  • 1-2 years of experience in credit card risk analytics, consumer lending, or financial analytics.
  • Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in business, Statistics, Finance, Economics, or related quantitative fields.

Technical Skills

  • Strong working knowledge of SQL/SAS; exposure to Python preferred.
  • Experience working with large datasets.
  • Experience with Tableau or PowerPoint for visualization and reporting.

job.description:
About Thermo Fisher Scientific

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you'll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join a team that enables our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.

You'll be part of a collaborative culture where curiosity, innovation, and scientific excellence drive everything we do. Together, we push the boundaries of technology to empower scientists in making groundbreaking discoveries.

Position Summary

We are seeking a passionate and experienced Validation Engineer to lead biological and functional validation activities for Thermo Scientific KingFisher automated sample purification instruments and associated software applications.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or related Life Sciences, combined with extensive hands-on experience in nucleic acid extraction, magnetic bead-based purification, and automated laboratory instrumentation.

This role bridges biological applications, instrument functionality, and software validation. The successful candidate will independently design and execute complex validation experiments to evaluate instrument performance, software functionality, and end-to-end sample preparation workflows.

The candidate should demonstrate strong analytical thinking, scientific troubleshooting, technical leadership, and enthusiasm for applying biological expertise in a software-driven product development environment.

Key ResponsibilitiesInstrument and Biological Validation

  • Independently design, plan, and execute moderate to complex biological experiments to validate new features and capabilities of KingFisher automated purification instruments.
  • Develop comprehensive validation strategies and test plans to evaluate instrument performance, functionality, reliability, and scientific accuracy.
  • Perform hands-on validation of automated DNA, RNA, and protein purification workflows using magnetic bead-based separation technologies.
  • Evaluate critical purification performance parameters, including extraction yield, purity, recovery, reproducibility, sample carryover, and cross-contamination.
  • Design and execute experiments using different sample types, extraction protocols, reagent chemistries, and throughput conditions to simulate real-world customer applications.
  • Optimize and troubleshoot biological workflows involving magnetic beads, binding, washing, elution, and sample preparation.
  • Utilize downstream analytical techniques such as PCR, qPCR, fluorometric quantification, and spectrophotometric analysis to assess purified sample quality.

Software and System Validation

job.name: QA Analyst Enterprise Applications
job.description:
The group you’ll be a part of The Global Information Systems Group is dedicated to the success of Lam through providing best-in-class and innovative information system solutions and services. Together, we support users globally with data, information, and systems to achieve their business objectives.

The impact you’ll make Role Overview

The QA Analyst Enterprise Applications is a fully hands-on performance testing role responsible for planning, scripting, executing, analyzing, and reporting performance tests for complex enterprise applications. The role requires deep, current expertise in OpenText LoadRunner, particularly Web HTTP/HTML, SAP, and TruClient 2.0 protocols, together with strong knowledge of C-based scripting, correlation, parameterization, custom requests, and performance diagnostics.

The analyst will work directly with product owners, development teams, functional teams, infrastructure and platform teams, database administrators, application support teams, and business stakeholders to translate non-functional requirements into realistic workload models and actionable performance evidence. The role requires agility in moving scripts across environments, maintaining scripts through frequent application and environment upgrades, and meeting demanding

What You’ll Do Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end performance testing lifecycle: requirements, NFR validation, strategy, workload modelling, scripting, execution, monitoring, analysis, defect mgt, reporting.
  • Develop, debug, maintain LoadRunner VuGen scripts (Web HTTP/HTML, SAP, TruClient 2.0); independently resolve correlation, session, authentication, replay issues.
  • Build stable, maintainable scripts using HTTP/HTTPS functions, C, parameterization, correlation, validations, error handling, reusable libraries.
  • Design realistic load, stress, endurance, volume, scalability, spike, capacity scenarios in LoadRunner Controller/ Enterprise Engg/ Performance Center.
  • Adapt scripts to changes in environments, endpoints, certificates, authentication, applications, applying modular design, naming standards, version control.
  • Gather business volumes, concurrency, transaction mix, response-time targets; translate them into workload models,acceptance criteria.
  • Monitor client- and server-side metrics,correlate user experience with application, web/API, database, middleware, infrastructure behavior
  • Analyze results, logs, percentiles, throughput, errors, and resource utilization to identify bottlenecks recommend improvements
  • Partner with product owners and technical teams on scope, environment readiness, dependencies, risks, timelines; escalate blockers
  • Document test plans, scripts, results, defects, findings, residual risks in approved platforms; support defect triage, tuning, retesting, release-readiness reviews.

Role Requirements Performance Testing & LoadRunner

job.name: Senior Performance Test Specialist
job.description:
Esko | Veralto Corporation Location: Bangalore, India | Hybrid

Reports To: Senior Team Leader

Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Senior Performance Test Specialist to independently design realistic workload simulations and own performance, scalability, stability, and capacity testing for WebCenter Enterprise, a Java/J2EE web application. The role requires strong hands-on expertise in JMeter and complementary performance-testing tools, test scripting, workload modelling, statistical analysis of results, and evidence-based root-cause analysis across application, JVM, database, search, and infrastructure layers. You will partner with development and infrastructure colleagues to translate findings into prioritized recommendations and verified improvements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design realistic load, stress, spike, endurance, scalability, and capacity simulations based on user behaviour, transaction flows, concurrency, data volumes, pacing, and production-like workload distributions.
  • Develop and maintain reusable JMeter frameworks and scripts for web applications and APIs, including correlation, parameterization, dynamic test data, assertions, distributed execution, and automated result collection. Use LoadRunner, Gatling, k6, or other tools where appropriate.
  • Define workload models, baselines, SLAs, and acceptance criteria with stakeholders.
  • Analyze response-time distributions and percentiles, throughput, errors, variability, saturation points, and resource trends; distinguish repeatable patterns from noise, outliers, and environmental variation.
  • Diagnose Java/JVM issues using JFR, heap and thread dumps, GC logs, Eclipse MAT, jcmd, and related tools, including memory leaks, OOM errors, high CPU, thread contention, and connection-pool bottlenecks.
  • Analyze and tune performance across JBoss/WildFly, Tomcat, SQL Server, REST APIs, and OpenSearch/Elasticsearch in collaboration with development and infrastructure teams.
  • Correlate transaction timings, logs, traces, diagnostics, database behaviour, and cloud/infrastructure metrics to identify and quantify root causes.
  • Form and test hypotheses, recommend prioritized improvements, and rerun controlled tests to verify benefits and prevent regressions.
  • Integrate repeatable performance checks into CI/CD pipelines and maintain controlled environments, baselines, and versioned test assets.
  • Plan investigations independently, estimate effort, manage dependencies and risks, validate test-environment and load-generator constraints, and document reproducible findings.
  • Use approved AI tools where appropriate for scripting, diagnostics, and reporting; validate outputs and protect proprietary and customer data.

Required Skills

Key Responsibilities & Requirements

job.description:
Functional Job Title : Finance CoE-Treasury Asset Liability Management, Associate Vice President

Reports to : Finance COE Manager, AVP

Department/ Division : Finance CoE, Global Treasury, Asset Liability Management (ALM) Team

Basic Purpose Of Job The Asset Liability Management (ALM) team within Global Treasury is responsible for optimizing the company’s balance sheet while maximizing net interest revenue (NIR) within our risk appetite and regulatory constraints. Key functions within ALM include balance sheet and NIR forecasting and interest rate risk (IRR) management which are supported by groups focused on data analytics, balance sheet modeling and senior management and Board reporting. ALM is also responsible for coordinating the company’s deposit pricing strategy, return on capital and funds transfer pricing methodologies and balance sheet strategy. ALM works closely with other functions across Global Treasury, Finance, Risk Management and Business Units.

This role sits at the intersection of Asset Liability Management, quantitative risk, technology, and business intelligence. This is a Senior Analyst contributor role within Treasury responsible for driving the end-to-end modernization of the ALM operating model — migrating manual, spreadsheet-intensive processes onto a cloud-powered, BI-driven platform anchored by QRM as the central calculation engine.

The role accelerates a transformation programme already underway. Immediate priorities include productionalising the Treasury Management Dashboard, executing the QRM Publish to MR integration to create a governed time-series dataset on cloud, and deploying Power BI on structured QRM outputs. Longer-term, the role will extend the ALM modernization model beyond ALM. The successful candidate will combine deep ALM domain expertise with hands-on QRM experience, Power BI or Tableau capability, and cloud data architecture knowledge.

Responsibilities & Tasks Include QRM Modernization & Integration

  • Lead the migration of complex Excel-based ALM calculations into QRM, including NII simulation, EVE sensitivity, gap analysis, and liquidity stress testing.
  • Own the implementation of the QRM Publish to MR functionality — designing the data flow from QRM outputs back to input transactional data to create a structured, governed time-series dataset on cloud.
  • Explore and deploy QRM's attribution walk modules for NII and EVE, enabling waterfall analysis from base to target positions for senior management reporting.
  • Manage the end-to-end QRM environment including scenario libraries, behavioural model inputs, repricing terms, and rate assumptions — ensuring all inputs are sourced from the single unified data layer.

Cloud & Data Architecture

Job Description We are currently seeking a Fraud Analyst to join our team. This is a hybrid role with an option to work from our Collaboration Centers in Langley, Vancouver, Kelowna, Penticton, Duncan, Victoria, or Toronto. Under direction from the Team Lead, Fraud Detection & Analytics, supports the organization’s fraud prevention and detection capabilities through fraud monitoring, data analysis and reporting, risk and control improvement, and cross-functional collaboration. The Fraud Analyst reviews and escalates fraud alerts, supports the testing and refinement of detection rules and thresholds, and develops reporting and actionable insights to inform fraud prevention activities. Documents decisions and completes activities within established procedures, service standards, risk tolerances, and delegated authority.

Develops recurring and ad hoc reports, dashboards, metrics, and analytical insights related to fraud trends, losses, alert activity, false-positive rates, detection outcomes, and member impact. Provides evidence-based recommendations to strengthen fraud prevention and operational controls.

Maintains documentation relating to fraud rules, testing, reporting definitions, analytical methods, procedures, and change decisions. job.description:
ANALYSTE BI ET GOUVERNANCE DES DONNÉES

Lieu : Laval, Québec (présentiel)

Rejoignez notre équipe en tant qu'Analyste BI et Gouvernance des données et contribuez à transformer les données en informations stratégiques permettant d'améliorer la performance de l'organisation.

Ce poste offre l'opportunité de travailler avec des technologies modernes telles que Power BI, Microsoft Azure et les plateformes de gestion de données, tout en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes d'affaires afin de développer des indicateurs de performance, améliorer la qualité des données et favoriser une culture décisionnelle basée sur les faits.

LE POSTE EN QUELQUES LIGNES

Au sein de l'équipe de gestion des données et de Business Intelligence, vous contribuerez à la valorisation des données de l'entreprise en transformant l'information disponible en analyses, indicateurs et tableaux de bord permettant de soutenir la prise de décision.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les différents secteurs d'affaires afin de comprendre leurs besoins, développer des solutions analytiques pertinentes et promouvoir les meilleures pratiques en matière de qualité et de gouvernance des données.

Ce rôle représente une excellente opportunité de développer une expertise en Business Intelligence, en analytique de données et en gouvernance tout en acquérant une compréhension approfondie des processus opérationnels de l'entreprise.

PLUS SPÉCIFIQUEMENT, VOUS AUREZ À :

  • Collaborer avec les utilisateurs d'affaires afin de comprendre leurs besoins en matière d'information, d'analytique et de performance.
  • Participer à la conception, au développement et à l'amélioration de tableaux de bord et rapports Power BI.
  • Développer et maintenir des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) permettant de soutenir la prise de décision.
  • Réaliser des analyses de données permettant d'identifier des tendances, opportunités d'amélioration et enjeux opérationnels.
  • Participer à la collecte, au nettoyage, à la validation et à l'amélioration de la qualité des données.
  • Développer et maintenir des requêtes SQL servant à l'extraction, l'analyse et la transformation des données.
  • Contribuer à la documentation des données, indicateurs, règles d'affaires et processus analytiques.
  • Participer aux initiatives de gouvernance des données en favorisant l'adoption de standards, définitions communes et meilleures pratiques.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes TI et d'affaires afin d'assurer une compréhension commune des données et de leur utilisation.
  • Soutenir les utilisateurs dans l'interprétation des rapports, tableaux de bord et indicateurs de performance.
  • Participer à l'évolution des capacités analytiques de l'entreprise en utilisant les outils et technologies disponibles au sein de l'écosystème Microsoft, incluant Azure.
  • Assurer une vigie des meilleures pratiques en Business Intelligence, gestion des données et analytique.
