job.name: Sr. Software Development Manager, Search Relevance, Amazon Search
job.description:
Description Amazon Search is rebuilding relevance for an agentic world, where customers and AI shopping agents rely on Search to find the right product. We are looking for a Senior Software Development Manager to lead a manager-of-managers organization in Bangalore covering Vertical Search, Buy-It-Again in Search, and Relevance Measurement. You will be Search's primary partner to Amazon's vertical businesses: Music, Books, Amazon Business, Grocery and Amazon Health Services. With their leaders, you will jointly set the search strategy for each vertical. You will own how Search meets category-specific needs for these businesses, how customers find products they buy again, and how Amazon measures search relevance worldwide. You will be a core leader in moving Search Relevance to an agentic-native stack.

Key job responsibilities

  • Lead, coach and grow a manager-of-managers organization of SDMs, SDEs, Applied Scientists and MLEs. Hire and develop senior engineers and future managers.
  • Set the strategy and multi-year roadmap across Vertical Search, Buy-It-Again in Search and Relevance Measurement, and decide how investment is split between category features, repeat-purchase experiences and measurement.
  • Own vertical search relevance for Amazon Business, Grocery and Everyday Essentials, Books, Music, Amazon Health Services and other strategic categories, and turn business-unit needs into reusable search capabilities.
  • Set the search strategy jointly with the leadership of each vertical business. Each vertical has its own customers, catalog, constraints and business goals. You will reconcile those priorities with a shared search stack that serves all of them.
  • Influence vertical partners' product roadmaps so that their launches work well in Search from day one, and secure commitments on the dependencies Search needs from them.
  • When vertical and Search priorities conflict, frame and lead the leadership debates needed to resolve them, for example category-specific ranking versus a shared relevance backbone. Write the narratives that drive those decisions at Director and VP level.
  • Build Buy-It-Again experiences across Search, from matching through ranking to Autocomplete.
  • Own the relevance measurement platform: LLM-based relevance metrics, weblab assessments, longitudinal Page 0 metrics, and regression detection and attribution. Keep it serving every Search Relevance team and business partner, not only the teams in this org.
  • Drive the agentic-native transition for Search Relevance. Redesign systems, metrics and evaluation so they serve agentic shopping surfaces as well as traditional search results.
  • Replace human-labeling and rule-based processes with LLM judges and learned models, while keeping the metrics trustworthy enough to gate launches and support WBR and QBR reporting.
  • Set a high bar for architecture, operational excellence and on-call health on services that run at Amazon Search scale under strict latency budgets.

job.description:
Project Role : Custom Software Engineering Lead

Project Role Description : Own the technical direction and architecture of custom software solutions, leading teams through design and delivery. Set development standards and ensure code quality, scalability, and performance aligned to business objectives.

Must have skills : Edge Computing

Good to have skills : NA

Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary:

We are seeking a Senior Developer or Technical Lead to design, build, and deploy end-to-end Edge AI solutions for industrial clients. The ideal candidate will own the full software stack — from AI inference pipelines on edge devices to data flow, workload orchestration, and cloud integration. You will transform AI use cases into production-grade, scalable solutions that run reliably across distributed remote sites, while guiding the team on architecture, reviewing code, and driving DevOps and MLOps best practices.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and deploy end-to-end Edge AI solutions for industrial clients.

Own the full software stack: AI inference pipelines, data flow, workload orchestration, and cloud integration.

Turn AI use cases into production-grade, scalable solutions running reliably across distributed remote sites.

Lead the team on design decisions, conduct code and architecture reviews, and drive DevOps and MLOps practices.

Collaborate with client architects, data science teams, and operations teams to deliver solutions on time.

Communicate clearly with stakeholders and maintain thorough technical documentation.

Deploy, monitor, and manage workloads remotely across multiple edge sites.

Evaluate technologies and recommend the appropriate architecture for each use case.

Technical Responsibilities

Build containerized Edge AI workloads in Python using inference frameworks such as NVIDIA Triton, Intel OpenVINO Model Server (OVMS), and TensorFlow.

Develop real-time edge data pipelines using video analytics tools including NVIDIA DeepStream, GStreamer, and OpenCV.

Perform model optimization using ONNX, TensorRT, OpenVINO IR, and quantization techniques.

Implement messaging and data streaming solutions with MQTT and/or Kafka.

Containerize workloads with Docker and orchestrate them on lightweight Kubernetes clusters (K3s, RKE2, or Kubernetes).

Connect edge deployments securely to Azure IoT Hub / IoT Edge or AWS IoT Core / Greengrass.

Deploy and manage edge workloads remotely using Rancher or Azure Arc across multiple sites.

Apply strong Linux fundamentals and advanced debugging skills in production environments.

Additional Skills Nice to Have

Hands-on experience with edge hardware such as NVIDIA Jetson or Intel edge platforms.

Edge stream processing with eKuiper and edge storage with SeaweedFS or MinIO.

job.name: Senior Sql Database Administrator
job.description:
Job Description: Senior SQL DBA

Company Profile:

We are a product and services company focussed on the financial services domain. Our clients are the world's major fintech players. We are looking for intelligent, talented and motivated individuals who are up for a challenge and believe in our vision. We are an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and inclusion and encourage all qualified individuals to apply.

We're looking for exceptional Full Stack Developers who are passionate about technology and coding.

Core Enterprise Administration (multi-TB scale)

  • Database architecture for VLDBs (very large databases) — partitioning strategies, filegroup design,

data compression (row/page/columnstore)

  • Storage engine internals: tempdb configuration, I/O subsystem tuning, storage tiering for 10-40TB+

databases

  • Backup/recovery at scale: differential/log backup strategies, backup compression, striped backups,

Instant File Initialization, point-in-time recovery for huge DBs

  • Index management: online index rebuilds, resumable index operations, maintenance windows for large

tables

  • Capacity planning and storage forecasting for continued growth

High Availability / Disaster Recovery

  • Always On Availability Groups: multi-replica design, synchronous/asynchronous commit modes,

automatic/manual failover, read-scale replicas

  • Distributed Availability Groups (cross-region/cross-cluster DR)
  • Windows Server Failover Clustering (WSFC) integration and quorum configuration
  • Log shipping and database mirroring (legacy, still seen in hybrid environments)
  • Backup/restore testing and DR runbook validation
  • RTO/RPO planning and SLA management

Enterprise Edition Features

  • Table/index partitioning and partition switching for large fact tables
  • Data compression (ROW, PAGE, columnstore compression)
  • Transparent Data Encryption (TDE)
  • Online operations (index rebuild, schema changes without downtime)
  • Resource Governor for workload isolation
  • In-Memory OLTP (memory-optimized tables) where applicable
  • Query Store for plan regression tracking at scale

Performance Tuning

  • Query plan analysis, execution plan reading, and plan cache management
  • Wait statistics analysis (sys.dm\_os\_wait\_stats, sys.dm\_exec\_requests)
  • Index tuning: missing index DMVs, index fragmentation, covering indexes, filtered indexes
  • Statistics management (auto-update thresholds, manual stats maintenance on large tables)
  • TempDB contention troubleshooting (PFS/GAM/SGAM latches)
  • Parameter sniffing mitigation, plan forcing, query hints
  • Extended Events / Profiler-replacement tracing
  • Server-level tuning: max memory, MAXDOP, cost threshold for parallelism, NUMA considerations Monitoring & Automation
  • Proactive monitoring tooling (native DMVs, third-party APM like SolarWinds/Redgate/SentryOne, or

Azure Monitor)

  • PowerShell/dbatools scripting for repeatable admin tasks across many instances

Read the full description

job.name: Software Development Engineer II, AWS IoT Fleet Management
job.description:
Description AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

AWS IoT is building the infrastructure to deliver AI from the cloud to the physical world. Our Physical AI team is developing services that provision, deploy, monitor, and secure AI software across every processor inside autonomous machines including robots, vehicles, drones, agricultural equipment, and industrial workcells operating in environments with limited or no cloud connectivity.

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II to own and drive the design and delivery of core subsystems in our edge-first fleet management platform for Physical AI. You will design and build systems that operate reliably without cloud connectivity handling offline provisioning state reconciliation on reconnect staged fleet-wide rollouts atomic rollback across multi-processor machines and secure over-the-air (OTA) delivery of AI models and software to heterogeneous processor topologies. Your systems must be correct when disconnected consistent when reconnected and resilient when partially connected. You will also develop cloud-side services that orchestrate, monitor, and coordinate with fleets of edge devices ensuring seamless interaction between cloud control planes and disconnected or intermittently connected hardware. You will write high-performance code working across the hardware-software boundary to debug issues that span operating systems, runtimes, networks, and physical devices. You will independently own substantial subsystems end to end from writing the design document through implementation testing and production operation.

You will also mentor junior engineers raise the bar on design quality and help shape the technical direction of the platform. This is an opportunity to build foundational infrastructure for a new category of AWS services delivering intelligence to the physical world at scale.

job.name: Senior Systems Engineer II - Platform Engineering
job.description:
SurveyMonkey is the world’s most popular platform for surveys and forms, built for business—loved by users. We combine powerful capabilities with intuitive design, effectively serving every use case, from customer experience to employee engagement, market research to payment and registration forms. With built-in research expertise and AI-powered technology, it’s like having a team of expert researchers at your fingertips.

Trusted by millions—from startups to Fortune 500 companies—SurveyMonkey helps teams gather insights and information that inspire better decisions, create experiences people love, and drive business growth. Discover how at surveymonkey.com.

What We’re Looking For SurveyMonkey's Platform Engineering team builds the platforms, shared services, and tooling that every engineering team depends on. We're looking for a Senior Systems Engineer to own major parts of our web platform and quality platform: the services, shared libraries, test infrastructure, and delivery tooling that let product teams build and ship with confidence.

What You’ll Be Working On Web platform

  • Own a major web platform capability end to end, such as the web application framework, shared frontend libraries, or the federated GraphQL layer
  • Design and evolve service templates that let teams launch new web services and GraphQL subgraphs with CI/CD, observability, and security built in
  • Lead upgrades and modernization of shared libraries and frontend tooling across product teams

Quality platform

Across both

  • Measure platform and quality health, such as build and release time, flake rate, adoption, and escaped defects
  • Participate in an on-call rotation

We’d love to hear from people with

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time in web platform, frontend infrastructure, or test infrastructure
  • Deep expertise in either web platform or test infrastructure, and working knowledge of the other
  • Expert TypeScript and Node.js; strong Python

job.name: Senior Manager, Core Infrastructure Engineering
job.description:
Job Description Manages team delivering scalable distributed systems and components on a 2–4 quarter horizon. Standardizes engineering practices and scalability requirements across teams; oversees optimization for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and ensures effective use of distributed state tools and data plane platforms. Guides teams to design fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems, set SLO‑aligned durability/availability targets, and implement resiliency mechanisms (load‑shedding, throttling, rate‑limiting). Provides oversight for KPIs, telemetry, and moderately complex dashboards; directs design of functional/correctness requirements, fault‑injection tests, and replication/synchronization strategies. Ensures proactive incident management, operational readiness, and on‑call coverage; drives encryption/access control practices, remediation plans, and compliance documentation. Oversees development and maintenance of automation/IaC and partners with teams on change‑management plans enabling safe patching, updates, and rollbacks.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities System Design & Architecture – System Scalability:

  • Manages the development and implementation of scalable distributed systems and components across multiple teams, including the effective use of distributed state management tools.
  • Oversees code and/or system optimization efforts for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements within and across teams to support hyper-scale systems.
  • Guides teams to define scalability requirements for owned components and ensures design and implementation requirements are met.
  • Manages the use of data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  • Ensures team accurately designs performance and load testing.

System Design & Architecture – System Reliability Design:

  • Manages the strategy for building fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by guiding the implementation of redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  • Develops design strategies for systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
  • Leads implementation and optimization initiatives across teams for approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
  • Guides teams to design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.

job.name: Software Development Manager, AWS IoT Fleet Management
job.description:
Description AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset. AWS IoT is building the infrastructure to deliver AI from the cloud to the physical world. The Physical AI team develops services that provision, deploy, monitor, and secure AI software across processors inside autonomous machines including robots, vehicles, drones, agricultural equipment, and industrial workcells operating in environments with limited or no cloud connectivity. We are looking for a Software Development Manager to build and lead the team behind edge-first fleet management for Physical AI. Your team owns software that runs on embedded processors inside autonomous machines and the cloud control plane that orchestrates them coordinating deployments across hierarchical heterogeneous processor topologies that often operate entirely offline. You will lead engineers writing production C++ and Rust for local artifact caching cryptographic verification peer discovery over link-local networks and coordinated over-the-air updates across nested processor hierarchies and you will own the cloud services that track fleet state when the fleet is not reachable. Physical AI is a new business for AWS so you will define the platform while you build it hire the team that builds it and decide what the team does not build. This is a rare chance to lead where cloud services meet physical machines shipping software that keeps autonomous systems running safely in the real world. The Physical AI team within AWS IoT is focused on delivering intelligence to every processor inside autonomous machines at scale. We build the services that provision, deploy, and secure AI software across robots, vehicles, drones, and industrial equipment worldwide. Our work sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and embedded systems and we partner closely with other AWS IoT teams to push what is possible in disconnected resource-constrained environments. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where every engineer's voice matters and new ideas are welcomed.

Key job responsibilities

Must have skills : Edge Computing

Good to have skills : NA

Summary : We are seeking a Senior Developer or Technical Lead to design, build, and deploy end-to-end Edge AI solutions for industrial clients. The ideal candidate will own the full software stack — from AI inference pipelines on edge devices to data flow, workload orchestration, and cloud integration. You will transform AI use cases into production-grade, scalable solutions that run reliably across distributed remote sites, while guiding the team on architecture, reviewing code, and driving DevOps and MLOps best practices.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and deploy end-to-end Edge AI solutions for industrial clients.

Own the full software stack: AI inference pipelines, data flow, workload orchestration, and cloud integration.

Turn AI use cases into production-grade, scalable solutions running reliably across distributed remote sites.

Lead the team on design decisions, conduct code and architecture reviews, and drive DevOps and MLOps practices.

Collaborate with client architects, data science teams, and operations teams to deliver solutions on time.

Communicate clearly with stakeholders and maintain thorough technical documentation.

Deploy, monitor, and manage workloads remotely across multiple edge sites.

Evaluate technologies and recommend the appropriate architecture for each use case.

Technical Responsibilities

Build containerized Edge AI workloads in Python using inference frameworks such as NVIDIA Triton, Intel OpenVINO Model Server (OVMS), and TensorFlow.

Develop real-time edge data pipelines using video analytics tools including NVIDIA DeepStream, GStreamer, and OpenCV.

Perform model optimization using ONNX, TensorRT, OpenVINO IR, and quantization techniques.

Implement messaging and data streaming solutions with MQTT and/or Kafka.

Containerize workloads with Docker and orchestrate them on lightweight Kubernetes clusters (K3s, RKE2, or Kubernetes).

Connect edge deployments securely to Azure IoT Hub / IoT Edge or AWS IoT Core / Greengrass.

Deploy and manage edge workloads remotely using Rancher or Azure Arc across multiple sites.

Apply strong Linux fundamentals and advanced debugging skills in production environments.

Additional Skills Nice to Have

Hands-on experience with edge hardware such as NVIDIA Jetson or Intel edge platforms.

Edge stream processing with eKuiper and edge storage with SeaweedFS or MinIO.

About This Role Associate, IT Data Analytics (PFS) Company Description HPS Investment Partners, a part of BlackRock, is a leading global, credit-focused alternative investment manager that seeks to provide creative capital solutions and generate attractive risk-adjusted returns for our clients. We manage various strategies across the capital structure, including privately negotiated senior debt; privately negotiated junior capital solutions in debt, preferred and equity formats; liquid credit including syndicated leveraged loans, collateralized loan obligations and high yield bonds; asset-based finance and real estate. The scale and breadth of our platform offers the flexibility to invest in companies large and small, through standard or customized solutions. At our core, we share a common thread of intellectual rigor and discipline that enables us to create value for our clients.

HPS was established in 2007 as a unit of Highbridge Capital Management, LLC (“HCM”), a subsidiary of JPMorgan Asset Management (“JPMAM”). On March 31, 2016, the senior executives of HPS acquired HPS and its subsidiaries from JPMAM and HCM (the “Transaction”.[i] Following the Transaction, JPMAM retained a passive minority investment in HPS, which was subsequently redeemed in April 2022. In June 2018, affiliates of Dyal Capital Partners made a passive minority investment in HPS. In February 2022, an affiliate of The Guardian Life Insurance Company of America made a passive minority investment in HPS, which was subsequently increased in August 2024. On July 1, 2025, BlackRock acquired the business and assets of HPS, with 100% of consideration paid in BlackRock equity (the “HPS/BlackRock Transaction”).

The HPS/BlackRock Transaction brings together BlackRock’s corporate and asset owner relationships with HPS’s diversified origination and capital flexibility. BlackRock and HPS have formed a new private financing solutions business unit (“PFS”) led by Scott Kapnick, Scot French, and Michael Patterson, creating an integrated franchise with approximately $370 billion in client assets, including $205 billion of private credit assets.[ii] This combined platform, which has more than 590 investment professionals and approximately 1,300 employees globally,[iii] offers broad capabilities across senior and junior credit solutions, asset-based finance, real estate, CLOs and GP-LP solutions. As part of the HPS/BlackRock Transaction, Scott Kapnick, Scot French, and Michael Patterson have joined BlackRock’s Global Executive Committee, and Scott Kapnick has been appointed as an observer to the BlackRock Board

NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

We are seeking an exceptiona l Senior Revenue and Pricing Finance Analyst to join our Sales Finance Revenue Analytics team, based in our Santa Clara office. As part of the Product FP&A team, you will support critical activities and data products related to revenue, pricing, and rebates. This is a unique opportunity requiring proven experience with financial concepts, business processes, and data analysis.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Develop and maintain data models for pricing and rebate analysis, consolidating and curating data from multiple systems into a single source of truth.
  • Collaborate with multi-functional teams to find opportunities for process optimization, automation, and standardization.
  • Prepare revenue analysis and reporting, maintaining the highest standards of data integrity, quality, and compliance with relevant regulations.
  • Evolve reporting processes from ad-hoc analyses and prototypes to production-ready, systematized workflows.
  • Develop a thorough understanding of our business and processes to inform our data strategy.

What We Need To See

  • 5+ years of experience in Finance, FP&A, or a similar function (e.g. Business Operations) supporting top line revenue.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Economics, Business Analytics, Data Science, or Engineering. MBA or equivalent experience is a plus.
  • Experience and proficiency with Excel, SQL, ETL development, BI Tools (e.g. Tableau or PowerBI), and Data Platforms (e.g. Databricks or Snowflake).
  • Advanced financial modeling and reconciliation skills, with the ability to move fluidly between detailed analysis and big-picture storytelling.
  • Highly motivated self-starter with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment, managing multiple priorities and functional areas.
  • Demonstrable ability to communicate effectively to audiences across a wide spectrum of seniority and technical acumen.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

job.name: Quality Analyst
job.description:
Summary SUMMARY: Facilitates ongoing measurement, data optimization, reporting, and information dissemination with a focus on data integrity, integration, standardization, analysis, and visualization; collaborates with multi-disciplinary teams and assist in the development of data management and analysis plans, monitors reporting requirements establishes guiding metrics and benchmarks for performance improvement initiatives and system-wide clinical priorities; provides clinical stakeholders data driven insights and will works closely with clinical stakeholders to produce reports to inform decision making.

DUTIES & ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS: NOTE:The following are the duties performed by employees in this classification, however, employees may perform other related duties at an equivalent level. Not all duties listed are necessarily performed by each individual in the classification.

  • Monitors the healthcare environment, identify emerging industry trends and evolving public policy/regulation and best practices.
  • Identifies and tracks clinical and operational opportunities and assist stakeholders with program planning and decision making around the use of data.
  • Supports public reporting and payment incentives programs; maintains data capture infrastructure; disseminates and educates programmatic changes to clinical and operational leadership; serves as primary contact for 3rd party vendors involved in program submissions (i.e. Patient Experience, Core Measure Submission).
  • Leverages descriptive statistics, correlations, and regression analysis to drive data driven insights.
  • Works with clinical and operational leaders to construct measurement and analytic plans for improvement initiatives and organizational goal setting; clearly defines and seeks consensus on metric definitions; assists in setting realistic and achievable targets based on evidence and national benchmarks.
  • Develops key clinical quality indicators and measurement strategies, including analyzing and interpreting technical measurement specifications, collaborating with clinical and technical stakeholders and validating results.
  • Creates queries, standard reports, dashboards and recommendations for new solutions and analyze existing reports and interfaces, traces metrics to data sources and defines the logic used to create the metrics.
  • Designs, interprets and presents data in formats such as data visualizations, dashboards, and reports; consolidates information from databases, business intelligence tools and other applicable software and presents actionable findings to operational and clinical leaders.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

job.name: Early Career Analyst, AI Planning & Category Operations
job.description:
Associate Analyst, AI Planning & Category Operations – Americas

Are you ready to combine your passion for design with a meaningful and multifaceted career in the cycling industry? At Specialized, our teammates are encouraged to explore roles across a variety of functions throughout their careers. We value curiosity, a desire to try new things, and an eagerness to learn about all aspects of the business. Join us in making the world a better place through the power of bicycles and build your dream career at the same time! As a Specialized Early Career Associate Analyst, AI Planning & Category Operation, you won’t be watching from the sidelines. You’ll step into meaningful work, bring a fresh perspective, and help shape the future of Specialized and how we show up for riders around the world. Bring your curiosity. Bring your ideas. Bring the courage to challenge what’s been done before. You’ll work alongside people who are constantly pushing what’s possible, learn from experienced leaders, and have the opportunity to leave your mark on a brand built around riders.

If you’re ready to learn fast, think differently, and help write the next chapter of Specialized , come ride with us.

Are you excited about AI and how it can change the way a business works? Do you love digging into data, finding a better way to do things, and seeing your ideas put into action? If you answered "yes," we want to hear from you!

The Associate Analyst, AI Planning & Category Operations is an entry-level role on our Americas Operations team, supporting the Planning and Category teams across North America and Latin America. You'll use AI tools — from generative AI assistants to forecasting and analytics tools — to help the team plan inventory, understand product and category performance, and spend less time on manual work.

Working alongside experienced planners, category managers, and analysts, you'll prepare data and reports, automate repetitive tasks, map and improve processes, and help teammates get the most out of AI. This is a hands-on learning role: you'll build a strong foundation in planning, category management, and operations while growing your skills in analytics, AI, and process improvement.

How You'll Make a Difference

Planning & Category Support – 35%

  • Support demand and supply planning by gathering, cleaning, and analyzing sales, inventory, and forecast data across Americas markets.
  • Prepare recurring reports and dashboards on sell-through, inventory health, product performance, and category trends.
  • Help the Category team with assortment, product line reviews, and SKU-level analysis.
  • Track key planning and category metrics and flag risks, gaps, and opportunities to the team.

AI Tools & Automation – 30%

job.name: Critical Care Clinical Outcomes/APACHE Analyst
job.description:
Summary SUMMARY: The Critical Care Outcomes/APACHE coordinator will coordinate all activities related to the APACHE Critical Care System. The Coordinator maintains the systems and its interfaces by incorporating interdisciplinary collaboration between the APACHE system, accompanying personnel, the medical staff, nursing staff, Quality Management and Administration. The Coordinator will access data and maintain data integrity to facilitate an accurate reflection of clinical patient outcomes. The databases will be utilized to help analyze the quality of care and provide a tool for continuous Quality Improvement that will influence care for all disciplines and education of staff. Performs related duties as required.

DUTIES & ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS: NOTE: The following are the duties performed by employees in this classification. However, employees may perform other related duties at an equivalent level. Not all duties listed are necessarily performed by each individual in the classification.

  • Acts as primary contact person and facilitates communication with the vendor to ensure timely resolution of APACHE program problems.
  • Provides analysis and interpretation of outcomes data.
  • Assist management team members in ICU, SDU, Telemetry and Medical Surgical Units with development and implementation of activities to improve patient care, based on outcomes data.
  • Assist with use of APACHE data in research activities or for special projects.
  • Assumes primary responsibility for the operations and management of the APACHE critical care outcomes system and other critical related quality data sources.
  • Assure flawless data, conducting validations studies to proactively identify and correct any inconsistencies.
  • Assure integration of APACHE data into day to day operations of the critical care unit.
  • Brainstorms with medical and nurse leaders to develop process improvements based on trends.
  • Collaborates with the medical directors and nurse leaders on solutions for improvement; notes trends and communicates to appropriate parties.
  • Coordinates the dissemination, interpretation and presentation of report data.
  • Generates and distribute reports to designated medical and hospital staff members for use in quality improvement activities. -
  • Provide education to staff members and physicians, as needed, to ensure understanding and optimal use of the data to direct patient care and operations activities.
  • Act as liaison with the quality department with respect to high acuity patient care outcomes.

Minimum Qualifications Education: Bachelor's degree or 4 years of directly related experience in Critical care experience.

Minimum Experience: Previous experience with APACHE clinical outcomes systems required.

Minimum Experience: Extensive experience with computer based programs such as Excel and Business Objects.

Minimum Experience: Demonstrated experience in quality, statistical analysis and report writing.

job.name: Sr. Fraud Risk Strategies Analyst
job.description:
At Early Warning, we’ve powered and protected the U.S. financial system for over thirty years with cutting-edge solutions like Zelle®, Paze®, and so much more. As a trusted name in payments, we partner with thousands of institutions to increase access to financial services and protect transactions for hundreds of millions of consumers and small businesses.

Early Warning follows a hybrid work model to allow for a more collaborative working environment.

Candidates responding to this posting must independently possess the eligibility to work in the United States, for any employer, at the date of hire. This position is ineligible for employment Visa sponsorship.

Overall Purpose This role is accountable to analyze, create and deploy the rules and scores from both internally and externally develop fraud risk models and applications with the associated outcomes as it applies to decisions rendered to optimize the balance of risk, expense and experience while using the payment network in a variety of operating environments. This work must be done directly or in partnership with financial institutions in decisioning fraud risk.

Essential Functions

  • Assess, recommend and modify the application of scores and rules to deliver the optimal balance of risk, expense and experience for clients, consumers and partners in the network.
  • Implement the fraud detection strategies for the network.
  • Create and apply of data driven insights for constant monitoring of effectiveness, efficiency and opportunities in the application of scores, rules and logic in the execution of managing fraud risk.
  • Create appropriate communications to internal and external stakeholders regarding emerging risks, observed trends and related opportunities.
  • Perform the analysis of fraud events for the purpose of identifying and consistently categorizing the root cause of fraud events observed or attempted in the network.
  • Support the company’s commitment to protect the integrity and confidentiality of systems and data.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education/experience required.
  • Typically a minimum 5 years of fraud risk management experience.
  • SQL/SAS/Python/R competencies or comparable data analytics skills
  • Proven track record of converting concepts to analysis to cases for change
  • Exceptional executive presence, written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience with digital banking, payments and/or payment networks
  • Experience with financial institutions in the area of fraud risk management

The above job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position. Incumbents will follow instructions and perform other related duties as assigned by their supervisor.

job.description:
About Abridge Founded in 2018, Abridge is the first AI-native clinician intelligence platform organized around the patient, built for clinicians, and designed to help health systems coordinate the clinical, financial, and evidence-based decisions for every moment of care. Powered by purpose-built AI for healthcare, Abridge connects patients, providers, payers, and life sciences companies. This year, the platform will support more than 100 million patient-clinician conversations across more than 300 of the largest and most complex health systems in the U.S. With deep workflow integration, the Abridge clinician intelligence platform has been validated to support encounters in 28+ languages across specialties and care settings.

Abridge is setting the industry standard for the responsible deployment of Al across health systems with continual and transparent Al evaluation. Clinical decision support references and cites gold-standard sources of evidence, and features like Linked Evidence map AI-generated documentation to source data, helping clinicians quickly trust and verify the output.

Abridge was awarded Best in KLAS for Ambient AI in 2025 and 2026, in addition to other accolades, including TIME Best Inventions of 2024 and 2025, CNBC Disruptor 2025, and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2025.

We are a growing team of practicing clinicians, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to transform healthcare. We have offices located in San Francisco, New York, and Pittsburgh.

The Role Our generative AI-powered products are revolutionizing the practice of medicine, and we’re looking for a highly motivated Senior Data Scientist to join our growing US-based Data Science team. Your work will be instrumental in driving product strategy, directly influencing how healthcare professionals engage with patient data. You’ll work across Abridge’s full product portfolio, partnering with product, engineering, science, commercial and finance teams to drive decisions with data.

job.name: AI Full-Stack Developer, Maintenance & Enhancements
job.description:
Hiring for PULS Group — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

PULS is a German manufacturer of industrial DIN-rail power supplies, used by automation OEMs worldwide. Headquartered in Munich with about 1,700 people globally, PULS is building an India-based IT and AI team that works directly with its Munich Software Development department. The team is relaunching the global PULS website as an AI-ready platform for 21 country sites in 7 languages and runs a growing portfolio of in-house AI solutions on Azure.

About the Role

PULS runs live AI solutions used every day by Purchasing, Finance, Logistics, R&D and Sales: chat agents integrated with SAP, scheduled Azure jobs, document pipelines, workflow apps and dashboards. You will keep them reliable and keep improving them. That means resolving incidents at the root cause, shipping change requests in regular maintenance releases, and keeping everything monitored and documented. You will work from India with core hours overlapping the Munich morning (about 13:00–18:00 IST), with no night shifts and no solo on-call, alongside the AI team, DevOps and Cybersecurity. Onboarding is in Munich, with one or two visits a year after that.

What you'll do

  • Own the incident and change-request queue for all live AI solutions: reproduce on the test stage, separate bugs from change requests and agree weekly priorities with the AI Team Lead
  • Fix root causes across the stack: TypeScript/React frontend, Node.js or Python (FastAPI) backend, scheduled jobs, SAP OData integration, PDF and mailbox automation, and write the test that proves each fix
  • Ship enhancements in maintenance releases (new SAP fields, document layouts, extended agent skills) and turn larger requests into specifications for the project team
  • Use Claude Code and Codex to draft fixes and tests, then review, verify on the preview stage and merge
  • Catch rising error rates, silently failed jobs and token-cost drift with KQL in Log Analytics; release prompt, skill and model updates on Azure OpenAI only after regression cases and an LLM-as-judge review pass
  • Run Azure Container Apps and jobs across preview, pilot and production with DevOps: Bicep, rollbacks, Key Vault secrets, Entra app registrations and Teams app updates
  • Take over solutions built by business teams and keep runbooks and documentation current

What you bring

job.name: Chief Technology Officer, Healthcare AI
job.description:
Hiring for Moative — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

Moative is an AI company that partners with mid-market businesses in asset-heavy, regulated industries to co-build industry-specific agentic and machine-learning solutions, then scales them across the industry through revenue-share and equity-linked models. The founders have built and sold two companies, one of them in AI, and the 20+ person team of AI/ML engineers, data scientists and mathematicians comes from IITs, IISc, CERN, UZH and IBM Research. Its healthcare business builds AI agents that run revenue-cycle and administrative work for US healthcare practices.

About the Role

As CTO for Moative's healthcare business, you'll lead technology for an AI management services organisation (AI MSO) for US healthcare practices. It combines operational expertise, data infrastructure and AI to manage and improve revenue-cycle and administrative workflows, automating tasks progressively with clear controls and human accountability. You'll own technology strategy, platform architecture and the engineering organisation, and stay hands-on in architecture, prototypes, code reviews and hard production problems. The role is based in Chennai (Bengaluru is possible), hybrid with 3 days a week in person with the founders and the healthcare AI pod.

What you'll do

  • Own technology strategy, platform architecture and engineering standards for the healthcare AI MSO
  • Work with founders, practice owners and billing leaders to assess workflows, set baselines and prioritise by business value and feasibility
  • Design solutions across EHRs, practice-management systems, clearinghouses and payer portals, covering payer-portal agents, voice payer follow-up, denial management and payment posting
  • Define the practice data architecture: claims, remittances, EOBs and denial codes as validated, traceable data, with isolation between practices and de-identified analytics
  • Set healthcare privacy, security and compliance controls, plus production evaluation, monitoring, escalation and release criteria
  • Make build-versus-buy, vendor and model decisions, and own engineering and infrastructure budgets
  • Hire and develop engineers, data scientists and technical leads, and represent Moative's technology to practice owners, partners and investors

What you bring

job.name: AI DevOps Engineer – Platform & Infrastructure
job.description:
Hiring for PULS Group — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

PULS is a German manufacturer of industrial DIN-rail power supplies, used by automation OEMs worldwide. Headquartered in Munich with about 1,700 people globally, PULS is building an India-based IT and AI team that works directly with its Munich Software Development department. The team is relaunching the global PULS website as an AI-ready platform for 21 country sites in 7 languages and runs a growing portfolio of in-house AI solutions on Azure.

About the Role

You will own the cloud infrastructure, CI/CD and operations behind the new global PULS website and the company's AI and agent infrastructure. The goal is a reproducible, highly available and secure Azure platform for 21 country sites, with committed uptime targets, defined RPO/RTO and restores that are actually tested. You will work closely with the Cybersecurity Engineer, the web developers and the AI team, GDPR-compliant with EU data residency. Coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex are part of the everyday toolkit, including for infrastructure code.

What you'll do

  • Build Azure infrastructure as code (Bicep for Azure-native workloads, Terraform where multi-cloud is needed), container setups on Azure Container Apps or AKS, and dev/stage/prod environments with preview deployments
  • Design high availability with replication and failover, committed uptime targets and defined RPO/RTO with regularly tested restores
  • Run load balancing, CDN (Azure Front Door) and caching for 21 country sites, including the China setup
  • Build CI/CD on GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps with OIDC instead of stored secrets, rollback, and automated quality gates: tests, SAST/DAST, IaC scans (Checkov, Defender for Cloud) and Core Web Vitals checks
  • Set up logging, metrics, alerting and dashboards (Azure Monitor, Application Insights or OpenTelemetry), including integration sync status and cloud cost control
  • Harden and patch, manage secrets in Azure Key Vault, run WAF/DDoS protection and backups, and operate managed PostgreSQL/MySQL with replication and safe migrations
  • Run Claude Code and Codex headless in pipelines with sandboxes and permissions, and deploy MCP servers and the runtime for AI search and the chatbot with the AI team

job.name: AI Engineer
job.description:
Hiring for J&F — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About Company

J&F is building an AI product that generates construction drawings from a 3D building model, beginning with data centres. A human detailer approves the drawings. The CTO and product design are in place; hires build and operate the product.

Job Roles & Responsibilities

  • AI career from the start; backend-to-AI switchers excluded.
  • Production-deployed AI work with ownership of technical decisions.
  • Build multi-agent workflows extracting geometry, drawing rules and conventions from 3D building models.

Ideal Candidate Profile

job.name: Senior, Full Stack Engineer -Knowledge Hub & Data Lead GSC (2 year-fixed term contract)
job.description:
This is a 2 years fixed term contract About The Role GSK’s Enterprise AI team builds AI solutions that prove value fast and scale to production. The Forward Deployed Engineer is the engineer GSK sends in to find out whether an AI idea will work — embedded with business unit teams, proving ideas through PoCs, PoVs, and MVPs at a days-to-weeks cadence, then handing the proven solution off to the Sr. Solutions Engineer for scale-up. The pattern is proven by AI-native companies — Anthropic, Palantir, OpenAI — and this role brings that model to GSK.

This senior engineer role embeds directly with business unit teams — product owners, engineering leads, and the wider BU — to understand the problem and execute. Most prototyping work is AI-augmented: AI coding assistants and multi-agent workflows handle the bulk of routine coding, freeing the FDE to focus on framing, judgement, and validation. The role works directly inside the customer’s business and emerges with working software and a defensible value hypothesis — not slideware. The FDE does not carry use cases through to long-term operations — clean handoff to the Sr. Solutions Engineer is part of the role.

CMC (Chemistry, Manufacturing and Controls) is the GSK function that turns a validated molecule into a reliably manufactured, quality-assured medicine; its mission is to get safe, effective, consistently manufactured medicines to patients, faster. To support GSK's ambition to double new product introductions, the CMC Acceleration program is composed of three engines: the Development Engine, which fosters molecule and process development (R&D); the Tech Transfer Engine, which expedites the path from R&D to market (GSC); and the Data & Automation Engine (across CMC), which provides the foundational knowledge system feedback loop and agentification of the full CMC process.

This role will build and scale the GSC knowledge hub and the feedback loop across the CMC process, including all the required data for all engines. It will pull data from equipment and manufacturing leveraging ontology building and domain matching so that GSC knowledge is structured, searchable and reusable by agents and by the teams redesigning internal platforms for faster molecule development. You will also serve as the official CMC GSC Data lead for and specific design and data mapping that would be required. You bring deep, hands-on AI/engineering expertise and the judgement to turn ambiguous technical problems into shipped, production-grade systems, while mentoring the engineers around you.

Key Responsibilities PoC (Proof of Concept) / PoV (Proof of Value) / MVP (Minimum Viable Product) Delivery

job.name: Applications Development Senior Programmer Analyst – CitiKYC MIS Cognos Reporting
job.description:
Job Description We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced MIS Reporting Developer / Senior Programmer Analyst to join our CitiKYC Reporting Technology team. The ideal candidate will serve as a lead reporting specialist with extensive, proven expertise in developing and managing global enterprise-level reports, semantic models, and distribution frameworks using IBM Cognos Analytics as the primary business intelligence toolset, complemented by strong visualization and dashboarding capabilities.

The candidate must have strong hands-on proficiency in querying, optimizing, and analyzing large datasets primarily hosted on Oracle databases, ensuring high performance, data integrity, and strict adherence to regulatory reporting reliability standards.

Job Background / Context

Know Your Customer (KYC) is an enterprise due diligence process executed when accepting, or periodically renewing, business relationships. This process ensures compliance with global Anti-Money Laundering (AML) regulations, Customer Identification Program Procedures (CIP-P), and other regulatory mandates designed to protect Citi from financial crime risks.

CitiKYC is a unified global platform across Citi's business lines. Its core objective is to reduce KYC complexity through process standardization, automated workflows, and robust regulatory MIS reporting. This team is directly responsible for delivering reporting solutions that monitor KYC record throughput, backlog, SLA management, and compliance risk indicators for senior management and regulatory bodies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Cognos Enterprise Reporting (Primary): Lead the end-to-end design, development, enhancement, and maintenance of operational, regulatory, and management reports using the full IBM Cognos Analytics suite (Report Studio, Query Studio, Dashboard, Event Studio, and Framework Manager / Data Modules).
  • Oracle Data Layer & Query Optimization (Primary DB): Write, fine-tune, and optimize complex Oracle SQL queries, PL/SQL blocks, views, and stored procedures to extract, aggregate, and transform high-volume datasets efficiently.
  • BI Administration & Security: Implement best practices for enterprise BI administration, metadata modeling, role-based access control, object-level security, and scheduled report distribution across Cognos environments.
  • Requirements & Strategy: Collaborate closely with Business Analysts, KYC Operations leads, Compliance Officers, and Data Architects to translate complex business and regulatory requirements into scalable reporting solutions.
  • Maintenance & Performance Tuning: Troubleshoot report failures, resolve data discrepancies, and optimize report execution times and database access paths for peak operational efficiency.
  • Mentorship & Support: Provide technical guidance, code/model reviews, and mentorship to junior developers; deliver training and tier-3 support to end-users on reporting tools.

job.name: Data Scientist- Husky( India ), Guindy, Chennai
IDP Education - Data Modeler - Metadata Management
Exceptional Internship - AI Engineer, Decision Engine (Fast-Track to FT Role)
job.description:
🧠 Ship at the frontier of AI

Unloq is a 🚀 UK AI startup building the next big Decision Intelligence Platform for Enterprise. We’re VC-backed, an Anthropic partner, a Databricks Connected Partner, and AWS, NVIDIA, Microsoft. Our platform is live with some important customers.

We’re hiring one intern for this incredibly lucrative seat, for an exceptional engineer who wants real responsibility from week one and the chance to grow into a founding engineer. You’ll do the same job as our AI Decision Engine Engineers, on the same engine, held to the same standard, and we’ll fast-track you to get there.

Internships like this very rarely come up: a small team, big open problems, and a direct path from intern to a FT AI engineer with EQUITY for the person who earns it.

🎯 The Role

You’ll join our platform team and own the quality loop on our decision engine: proving each new client’s answers against ground truth before they go live, and making sure no change makes them worse. You’ll report to our Founding Lead Engineer for the decision engine and work day to day with our founding leads. Most of your week is learning, solving problems, reviewing code, experiments and eval runs. The rest is code review, benchmark reviews and pairing.

  • Building and verifying each new client’s golden set: real questions and the correct SQL, checked against ground truth before go-live
  • Running every change through the benchmark, and turning every thumbs down into a test, so nothing gets worse
  • Making text-to-SQL repeatable, so a re-run gives the same SQL and scores only move when the code does
  • Shipping across the engine, from document search and the Semantic Layer to how answers are shown, holding back any chart or table we can’t verify

🗓️ Your Fast Track

  • Week one: get set up, learn the engine, start training.
  • First 30 days: pair with our founding engineers on the benchmark and golden sets, and learn how we evaluate text-to-SQL.
  • Days 30 to 90: take a new client’s golden set to go-live yourself, and turn their thumbs downs into tests.
  • After 90 days: you own a part of the engine. Do that well and we’ll talk about a full-time founding engineer role.

💰 What We’ll Invest in You

  • Highly Competitive Stipend
  • Mentoring from the top. Regular time with our CTO, who has taken startups from $0 to $20m+ revenue, and with our founding engineers.
  • The whole business, end to end. Sit in on client go-lives, product decisions and leadership reviews, so you see how a company is built from client calls to roadmap.
  • A voice in the industry. Speaker coaching, and a slot to present your work at our client and community events.
  • Your network. Introductions to our leadership team, investors, partners and enterprise clients.

👤 Who Is This For?

We’re setting the bar extremely high, and we’ll only fill this seat with someone exceptional.

Read the full description

job.description:

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization:

  • Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design:

  • Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture.
  • Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices.
  • Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture.

job.name: Core Infrastructure Engineer 2
job.description:
Job Description Implements and optimizes components within existing distributed systems under the guidance of senior engineers. Applies foundational scalability principles, conducts performance and load testing, and configures retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts to improve resilience to network variability. Delivers scoped features, develops fault-injection tests, and assists with data replication and synchronization.

Builds telemetry and alerts, maintains operational runbooks, and participates in on-call rotations with support. Uses automation and infrastructure-as-code scripts to troubleshoot issues. Follows established change management, security, and compliance procedures, including encryption, access controls, and remediation plans, and escalates complex issues appropriately.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: –Assist in the implementation of components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling under the guidance of senior engineers.

–Optimize code segments and/or systems for large-scale data processing with oversight from senior engineers.

–Implement scalability requirements for assigned components.

–Learn about the use of data plane platforms for large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.

–Execute performance and load testing, with guidance.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: –Collaborate with the team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by learning about redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.

–Learn about recovery oriented computing principles and assist in applying them to component designs.

–Configure and test retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability, with guidance

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: –Implement testing and alarming configurations to detect issues/failures.

–Support efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures, under guidance.

–Help build dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: –Implement functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.

–Implement test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness, under guidance.

–Help implement basic data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: –Assist in diagnosing and debugging issues in system components to support ongoing operation, under supervision.

–Follow protocols to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.

job.description:
At Aristocrat, we are on a mission to bring happiness to life through the power of play! We are a global leader in gaming content and technology. Our culture is dynamic and inclusive, encouraging innovation and creativity.   • Experience with change-control or data-governance processes.
  • Experience in gaming, equipment leasing, field service, or similar asset-intensive industries is preferred but not required.
  • Strong written English and ability to work with stakeholders in US time zones.

Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

Innovation

Business Intelligence

  • Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)

Basic Qualifications:

  • At least 1 year of experience working with at least one scripting language
  • At least 1 year of experience utilizing business intelligence visualization tool
  • At least 1 year of experience querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms

job.description:
About SiTime SiTime is the Precision Timing company.

Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience and scalability. For decades, quartz devices, non-silicon technology, have kept systems in sync, but they struggle in harsher, more demanding environments. MEMS-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT.

Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. With more than 4 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit: www.sitime.com .

This role will work extensively with Snowflake, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and SQL, using governed data from systems such as Salesforce, Oracle, Jira, PLM, TPD, and other enterprise platforms. The analyst will build reports, dashboards, semantic models, and analytical solutions supporting areas including Sales, Finance, Business Units, HR, Engineering, and Digital Marketing. As SiTime expands its enterprise data platform and AI capabilities through 2026 and 2027, this role will also help establish reusable metrics, improve data quality, identify trends and opportunities, and enable responsible AI-driven analytics.

We value diverse experiences, perspectives, and career paths, and welcome candidates who are excited to contribute to our mission.

Translate business requirements into clear metrics, visualizations, and insights that support decision-making across Sales, Finance, Business Units, HR, Engineering, Digital Marketing, and other functions.

Validate and reconcile data across systems including Salesforce, Oracle, Jira, PLM, TPD, and other enterprise sources while helping establish consistent business definitions and trusted KPIs.

Support SiTime’s continued expansion of governed self-service analytics, reusable semantic models, new enterprise data products, and AI-driven insights.

Is it surprising to hear that a financial institution of 1.5 million members and over $30 billion in managed assets say that success comes from focusing on people, not profits?

Our “people helping people” philosophy has guided us since 1935, driving our deep commitment to serving our members, communities, and each other. When you join our team, you become part of a purpose-driven organization where your work makes a real difference.

While we’re proud of our history, we’re even more excited about our future. With business and technology transformation on the horizon, there’s never been a better time to be part of BECU.

  • 4% annual contribution to your 401(k) by BECU
  • Medical, Dental and Vision (family contributions as well)

  • BECU Cares volunteer time off + donation match

To join our dynamic team, we require candidates to be residents of WA, OR, ID, AZ, TX, GA, or SC. If you’re located in Washington state and within a reasonable driving distance from Tukwila, we are requesting that you come into our HQ on Tuesdays & Wednesdays. For those candidates that live outside the commute distance of TFC and in any of our approved remote work locations, this role will be remote. Remote or onsite, we are committed to ensuring you are fully engaged and included in our collaborative environment.

IMPACT YOU’LL MAKE As a Sr Data Analyst at BECU, you'll do more than analyze data—you'll turn complex information into meaningful insights that shape business decisions, uncover opportunities, and drive measurable results. Your ability to connect analytical expertise with business strategy will help teams solve challenging problems, improve operational efficiency, and make smarter, more informed decisions that ultimately benefit our members.

  • Write complex, performant SQL against warehouse data (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift) to answer questions about user behavior, revenue, and operational efficiency
  • Partner with analytics engineers to model data in dbt - defining metrics, dimensions, and documentation in a shared semantic layer
  • Run deep-dive analyses on retention, funnel conversion, and unit economics using Python or R, and present findings to non-technical stakeholders
  • Define and instrument KPIs alongside product managers, ensuring event tracking and source data support the analyses the business needs
  • Audit and improve data quality across reporting surfaces - building anomaly checks and resolving discrepancies between systems of record
  • Support A/B test design and analysis, including power calculations, experiment readouts, and guardrail metric monitoring

What We Are Looking For

  • 3–6 years of experience in business analytics, data analysis, or a closely related role at a product-driven technology company
  • Expert-level SQL - window functions, CTEs, query optimization - with hands-on experience in a modern cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift)
  • Working proficiency in Python or R for analysis, including pandas, statistical testing, and data visualization libraries
  • Experience building and maintaining BI dashboards in Looker, Tableau, or Power BI, with a strong sense of what makes metrics trustworthy
  • Track record of partnering directly with stakeholders - translating ambiguous business questions into rigorous, defensible analyses
  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (statistics, economics, computer science, engineering) or equivalent practical experience
  • Bonus: Experience with dbt, experimentation platforms (e.g., Statsig, Amplitude, Optimizely), or light data engineering skills in Airflow or Spark

job.name: Sr. Software Engineer - Cloud Security
job.description:
Onwards Together!

Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters.

Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave™ for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running.

Our Team's Vision Our Engineering team is driven by a culture that thrives on visionary leadership, autonomy, and ownership, creating a dynamic synergy that drives us forward in the ever-evolving landscape of cybersecurity.

When you join our team, you become part of the leader in Zero Trust Segmentation. You'll work with a cutting-edge technology stack that spans operating systems, distributed applications, and immersive UI/visualization tools.

We're shaping the future of cybersecurity. And together, we will continue to build world-class products—led by people with different perspectives, backgrounds, and a commitment to innovation in a time when the world faces its greatest cybersecurity threats in history.

Your Impact

  • You will primarily write code in Go and work with data pipeline using SQL or other types of interfaces. We leverage Kubernetes for service infrastructure platform. We welcome people with backgrounds in other languages and technology stacks along with a desire to learn.
  • Own critical features and subsystems and own the entire software development lifecycle, from clarifying requirements to ensuring their successful deployment and usage by customers.
  • Own operational aspects of the system, being on the front lines and experiencing first-hand the challenges of operating such a system, will make you understand how to write better more supportable software, like no other experience.
  • Own code quality, as we do early developer testing and functional/integration testing to ensure we build robust and resilient products.
  • Partner with Product Management to review, refine requirement that exceed our customers’ expectations.

job.description:
Role :: Go/Golang Senior Engineer/ Lead

Location :: Dallas, TX/ Bloomington, IL / Remote

Type :: Fulltime

Job Description

Role - Go Senior Engineer

Location - Bloomington, Illinois; Dallas, Texas

Experience Required - 5+ years

Job Summary

Develop and support high-performance backend services and microservices using Go. This role focuses on secure REST and gRPC APIs, cloud-native deployment, CI/CD automation, infrastructure as code, observability, and production support across the software development lifecycle.

Must Have Technical/Functional Skills

  • 5+ years of overall software engineering experience, with strong backend-development expertise.
  • 2+ years of hands-on Go/Golang development, preferably building enterprise-grade backend services.
  • Strong knowledge of goroutines, channels, concurrency, interfaces, error handling, context management, dependency management, and performance optimization.
  • Experience using AI agents to accelerate development and testing.
  • Experience developing REST and/or gRPC microservices.
  • Strong knowledge of JSON, HTTP/HTTPS, authentication and authorization, OAuth 2.0/JWT, error handling, and API versioning.
  • Experience building containerized applications with Docker and deploying them using Kubernetes.
  • Experience with AWS services such as EKS/ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudWatch, IAM, and Secrets Manager.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or equivalent tooling.
  • Experience with logging, monitoring, distributed tracing, metrics, alerting, and production observability.
  • Preferred: Experience with auto insurance and auto policy administration systems.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain high-performance backend services and microservices using Go.
  • Develop secure and scalable REST and gRPC APIs for enterprise applications.
  • Create reusable frameworks, common service components, libraries, and engineering accelerators.
  • Containerize Go applications with Docker and deploy and manage services in Kubernetes-based cloud environments.
  • Build and enhance end-to-end CI/CD pipelines covering build, code-quality chec ks, automated testing, security scanning, artifact management, deployment, verification, and rollback.
  • Implement infrastructure as code for repeatable and automated cloud provisioning.
  • Contribute to development, testing, or test-automation activities based on product-team needs.
  • Implement production-grade logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, alerting, and observability.
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement permanent corrective measures.
  • Participate in production support, incident management, defect resolution, performance tuning, and continuous service improvement.
  • Collaborate with product teams, DevOps/SRE engineers, QA engineers, and business stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle

job.name: Senior Software Engineer -RDB/SPO
job.description:
The Basics As a Tanium Senior Software Engineer, you will be tasked with building and maintaining best-of-breed products as part of a small and nimble development team. Tanium focuses on a strong customer engagement model and feedback process to ensure our products are designed the right way from the beginning. When new products ideas are identified, our software engineers are responsible for designing, developing, testing, and deploying the products from the ground up, while continuously iterating with product management and customers for feedback and input.

This position follows the Company’s hybrid schedule which currently requires employees to work in the office at one of the following locations a minimum of three days per week: Addison, TX; Bellevue, WA; Durham, NC; Emeryville, CA. What You’ll Do

  • Building and maintaining Tanium's products alongside a highly agile development team
  • Focusing on a strong customer engagement model and feedback process to ensure our products are designed the right way from the beginning
  • Designing, developing and testing new product ideas from the ground up while working with product management for feedback and input

We’re looking for someone with

  • Education

+ Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
+ CS Degree preferred

  • Experience

+ Must be eligible for U.S. federal contract work; ability to obtain Canadian Reliability status (Protected B) is a plus, but not required
+ 5+ years industry experience, 7+ preferred
+ Experience building large cloud-based data services
+ Knowledge of at least one of Golang (preferred), C++, or Rust
+ Experience with PostgreSQL
+ Experience with API design and development
+ Experience with Azure or AWS Database Services
+ Experience with cloud object storage, such as AWS S3 or Azure Blob Storage
+ Experience designing memory-efficient streaming and multipart data-transfer systems
+ Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Pulumi) and container orchestration (Kubernetes)
+ Experience with modern software engineering development and automation tools like git and CI/CD pipelines

Other

  • Demonstrates excellent judgment for balancing between rapid development, long-term code maintainability and supportability
  • Believes in the power of and the need for writing automated tests as part of development
  • Experienced debugger who can put out fires under pressure when things go wrong in production environments and address the root causes of those fires for the future
  • Has knowledge of a variety of modern backend software frameworks and the versatility to learn new tools and languages

job.name: Senior Developer, Device Trust
job.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing. About 1Password At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work. If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future. We are seeking a Senior Backend Developer to join our Device Trust team, building the services that help organizations verify whether an employee’s device meets security requirements before granting access to work applications. You’ll work on a security-critical service in the login path, owning backend development alongside observability, safe delivery, incident response, and long-term resilience. Your work will help make access to the tools people rely on simpler and safer.

How We’re Using AI Today Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What We're Looking For
