job.name: Software Development Engineer III, FAI Asset Creation Technology (FACT)
job.description:
Description Are you passionate about building software that makes a meaningful difference for millions of customers? As a Software Development Engineer II at Amazon, you will own and deliver features across the full software development lifecycle—from understanding customer needs through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations. You will tackle complex technical problems, bring clarity to ambiguous challenges, and craft solutions that are simple, maintainable, and built to scale. This is a role where your engineering contributions have direct, visible impact on the products and experiences our customers rely on every day. If you are a curious, self-motivated engineer who thrives on collaboration and continuous learning, we would love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities

  • Design and implement software solutions that address customer needs, working across the full development lifecycle including scoping, coding, testing, deployment, and ongoing operations.
  • Write high-quality, well-documented, and maintainable code while actively participating in code reviews to provide meaningful feedback and mentor fellow engineers on your team.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners including product managers, stakeholders, and peer engineers to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.
  • Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues, driving permanent fixes and continuously improving your team's operational processes and software reliability.
  • Evaluate emerging tools and approaches—including generative AI capabilities—to recommend and adopt improvements that enhance productivity and solution quality.

A day in the life

Your morning might start with a design discussion where you sketch out the architecture for a new feature, weighing tradeoffs around scalability and maintainability with your teammates. After lunch, you could be deep in code, building and testing a component that will ship incrementally to customers. Between focused coding sessions, you review pull requests from peers, share constructive feedback, and help onboard a new team member by walking them through how your services operate and fit into the broader system.

About The Team Our team is committed to building reliable, customer-focused software that operates at Amazon scale. We value collaboration, technical rigor, and an inclusive environment where every engineer's perspective is heard. Whether you are refactoring existing systems or launching new capabilities, you will be part of a group that invests in long-term quality and encourages continuous growth. We are excited about the road ahead and looking for engineers who want to help shape what comes next.

Basic Qualifications

Job Description Oracle Database Patch Delivery Team is responsible for delivering software patches and updates across multiple products, components, releases, and platforms. The team also develops automation solutions to streamline patch creation, testing, and delivery, investigates failures in automated systems, and builds AI-driven tools to improve engineering efficiency.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, package, test, and deliver software patches and updates across multiple products, releases, and platforms.
  • Design and implement automation solutions for software patch creation, validation, testing, and delivery.
  • Investigate failures in automated build and patching systems, identify root causes, and implement fixes.
  • Build and maintain Jenkins CI/CD pipelines and supporting automation scripts.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues across Linux, Unix and Windows environments.
  • Collaborate with Development, Testing, and Release Management teams to resolve issues and improve delivery processes.
  • Document technical solutions, automation workflows, and operational procedures.

  • Develop and maintain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using internal documentation and knowledge sources.
  • Integrate databases, documents, APIs, and internal systems into AI and automation workflows.
  • Develop techniques to evaluate the accuracy and effectiveness of LLM-based solutions.

About Us Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. job.name: Principal Agentic AI Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Let’s be unstoppable together! Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives. We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work. Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at www.circana.com.

Role Overview Design, build and govern the shared Agentic AI, scripting and automation architecture used across Infrastructure and Service Delivery.

The role will establish reusable frameworks, APIs, automation libraries, AI agents, orchestration patterns, security guardrails and integration standards so that infrastructure teams build once and reuse many times, rather than creating isolated technology-specific scripts . Job Responsibilities Agentic AI Architecture:

  • Define the enterprise Agentic AI architecture for Infrastructure, Security and Corporate Systems Operations.
  • Build reusable agent frameworks and orchestration.
  • Establish agents capable of observing, reasoning, acting and validating.
  • Design RAG and operational knowledge systems using SOPs, runbooks, CMDB information and technical documentation.
  • Develop agent memory/context strategies.
  • Build human-in-the-loop controls for sensitive actions.

Automation Engineering:

  • Python
  • PowerShell
  • Ansible
  • Terraform
  • REST APIs
  • Infrastructure APIs/SDKs
  • Git
  • CI/CD pipelines

SurveyMonkey is the world’s most popular platform for surveys and forms, built for business—loved by users. We combine powerful capabilities with intuitive design, effectively serving every use case, from customer experience to employee engagement, market research to payment and registration forms. With built-in research expertise and AI-powered technology, it’s like having a team of expert researchers at your fingertips.

job.name: Integration Engineer - SAP, EWM & Shop-floor Systems (L2/L3)
job.description:
12 of the top 15 pharma generic companies in the world trust Leucine to manufacture the drugs that reach millions of patients every day.

Pharma manufacturing is one of the last large industries still running on paper, Excel, and tribal knowledge. A single missed step in a batch record can mean a recall, a regulatory warning, or a drug that should never have left the plant.

Leucine is the AI platform replacing all of it. Series A, backed by top-tier global investors, 60+ pharma enterprises in production, and the team that's going to define this category.

About The Role We are looking for an Integration Engineer to join our platform team and own the integration layer between Leucine applications and the systems around them on a pharma shop floor — SAP ERP and SAP EWM at the enterprise and warehouse level, weighing balances, floor scales and label printers at the point of work, and PLCs, SCADA, historians, LIMS and QMS across the L2/L3 layer.

You will work directly on customer-facing integration projects — understanding customer data schemas, configuring and testing integrations with our applications, and building and maintaining our Reify (edge/IoT) and SAP integration pipelines.

This is a hands-on role on production systems used by real pharmaceutical manufacturers, with direct exposure to customer SAP, automation, IT/OT and QA teams.

Key Responsibilities SAP & ERP Integration (L4 ↔ L3)

  • Design, configure and support integrations between Leucine MES and SAP (S/4HANA / ECC) — process order download, BOM/recipe and material master sync, goods issue/receipt order confirmations, batch characteristics, and QM inspection lots / usage decisions
  • Build interfaces over REST/OData, IDoc, BAPI/RFC and middleware (SAP PI/PO, CPI/BTP), with idempotency, retries, error queues and reconciliation
  • Monitor SAP interfaces, investigate data-flow issues and drive configuration changes to resolution
  • Configure ontology Action-Effects so MES events (e.g., batch rejected, material dispensed) trigger the correct outbound postings to SAP

Warehouse Management (SAP EWM / WMS)

  • Integrate staging to production supply areas, dispensing requests, warehouse tasks, handling units and return-to-stock flows.
  • Enforce material status (quarantine / released / expired) and FEFO at point of use, and keep ERP-EWM-MES inventory reconciled

Weighing Balances, Scales & Printers.

  • Integrate analytical/precision balances and floor scales (e.g., Mettler Toledo, Sartorius) via MT-SICS, serial/TCP-IP, OPC UA or vendor middleware — automatic weight capture, tare/gross/net logic, tolerance checks and calibration-status interlocks
  • Integrate industrial label printers (e.g., Zebra, Honeywell, SATO) and barcode / 2D DataMatrix / RFID scanners; build dynamic label templates (ZPL, BarTender, NiceLabel/Loftware) with reprint governance

L2 & L3 Systems / Reify Edge Platform

As a Senior Associate in Operations Automation within the Commercial and Investment Bank, you design, build, deploy, and operate production-grade AI assistants that automate high-volume knowledge work. job.description:
Summary Own the design and delivery of incentive compensation solutions for assigned US brands. Translate brand strategy into motivating, compliant and operationally practical plans, supported by rigorous analytics, clear communication and disciplined execution.

About The Role Key responsibilities

  • IC design across the brand lifecycle
  • Lead end-to-end design from business problem and design principles through simulation, recommendation, approval, implementation readiness and post-launch monitoring.
  • Pre-launch: build design hypotheses with limited history; define success measures, scenario assumptions and adaptable options for uncertain uptake, access and territory potential.
  • Launch: balance adoption, patient-impact measures, controllability, differentiation and simplicity; establish frequent monitoring and clear triggers for adjustment.
  • Mature brands: assess effectiveness, refine measures and weights, manage lifecycle changes, reduce unintended behavior and simplify plans where complexity no longer adds value.
  • Evaluate measures, weights, eligibility, thresholds, goals, pay curves, caps, gates, modifiers, contests and awards; document rationale, trade-offs and implementation requirements.
  • IC analytics and decision support
  • Perform simulations, sensitivity tests and scenario analyses covering payout distribution, performance differentiation, affordability, volatility, fairness and behavioral risk.
  • Lead health checks using goal attainment, payout dispersion, pay-for-performance alignment, outliers, geographic bias, stability and representative-level impact.
  • Convert findings into recommendations, root causes and quantified alternatives; validate source data, business rules, assumptions and version control with data partners.
  • Stakeholder engagement and communication

job.name: Senior Systems Engineer, Virtualization
job.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

What You'll Do HAVOCK builds the software stack that bridges AI workloads and bare metal. We own the operating system, virtualization, runtime, and hardware interfaces that allow thousands of GPU servers to securely execute customer workloads at hyperscale.

This team focuses on the execution layer beneath Kubernetes. We build the systems that provide strong workload isolation, efficient GPU sharing, and high-performance execution across containers and lightweight virtual machines. Our work spans Linux, KVM, container runtimes, GPU drivers, and Kubernetes, ensuring customers can safely run demanding AI workloads on shared infrastructure without sacrificing performance.

About The Role As a Senior Software Engineer on HAVOCK's Runtime & Virtualization team, you'll design and build the execution environment that powers CoreWeave's AI platform. This is fundamentally a Linux systems engineering role where you'll work across the Linux kernel, KVM/QEMU, container runtimes, GPU drivers, and Kubernetes to solve problems that don't have off-the-shelf solutions.

You'll develop secure sandboxed runtimes for GPU workloads, extend virtualization technologies to support new hardware capabilities, optimize the interaction between Linux, hypervisors, and NVIDIA GPUs, and build the tooling that helps engineers understand what's happening across the entire software stack.

The work spans multiple abstraction layers. One day you might be debugging a kernel memory-management issue affecting VFIO device passthrough; the next you might be improving container startup latency, extending KubeVirt to support new GPU workflows, or building eBPF tooling to diagnose production networking and scheduling problems. We value engineers who enjoy understanding how systems behave from the hardware up rather than treating infrastructure as a black box.

Some Of What You'll Work On

Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Software Engineer Opportunity

The team that built Jeeva AI is building Digital Workers, a new suite of autonomous agents for identity operations and security inside Okta. The team works directly with Todd McKinnon, Okta's co-founder and CEO, with the opportunity to bring this product to Okta's 20,000+ customers. You will help shape the product with the ownership and pace of a startup and the resources of a public company.

You will build the backend and AWS platform that keep these workers running around the clock. The team owns services, connectors, workflow execution, data and production reliability. You will write Python services and infrastructure code that let workers make approved changes and preserve evidence.

About You

Reliable builder: You design for failure and prove that recovery works.

Hands-on engineer: You write production services and improve the tools engineers use every day.

Strong owner: You follow changes through deployment, monitoring and production support.

What you will be doing

  • Build Python FastAPI services, data models and reusable connectors for Okta, AWS, ServiceNow and enterprise applications.
  • Implement durable execution with Step Functions, SQS and EventBridge. Handle approval waits, rate limits, duplicate events and safe retries.
  • Manage PostgreSQL schemas, indexes, query performance and pgvector retrieval. Enforce tenant isolation across APIs, storage and credentials.

  • Create reliable usage records and reconciliation. Prevent retries, duplicate findings and incomplete work from being counted as new outcomes.
  • Build deployment pipelines, infrastructure as code, observability and safe release controls across development, staging and production.

CI/CD and deployments

job.name: Senior Software Engineer - ClickHouse Private (Remote)
job.description:
About The Role ClickHouse Private brings ClickHouse Cloud capabilities to Kubernetes environments controlled by customers, from managed Kubernetes in their AWS, GCP or Azure accounts to clusters running on other infrastructure they provide. Today, much of our work focuses on adapting Cloud technology so it can be deployed, upgraded and supported in these environments, including regulated and disconnected deployments.

Our plans also include building software and platform capabilities specifically for ClickHouse Private, such as tools and interfaces for managing ClickHouse clusters. We will reuse Cloud components where they fit and build our own implementations where customer-controlled environments require a different approach. Depending on the deployment model, these components may run in ClickHouse-managed infrastructure, in customer environments, or across both.

You will join a small product engineering team with broad ownership and real architectural influence. The role combines hands-on software development with deep Kubernetes and infrastructure knowledge, from designing production services to making them reliable to deploy, upgrade and support.

What will you do?

  • Design and build backend services and platform capabilities for ClickHouse Private, combining reusable Cloud components with purpose-built implementations.
  • Adapt and integrate existing ClickHouse Cloud components for Kubernetes-based deployments in customer-controlled cloud and self-hosted environments.
  • Build and maintain what customers actually install: Helm charts, Kubernetes operators, and deployment tooling.
  • Make installation and upgrades boring: build preflight validation, deterministic tooling, health diagnostics, and safe recovery paths.
  • Build release automation: assemble tested sets of components, define supported upgrade paths, and make failures diagnosable.
  • Adapt deployments for regulated and network-restricted environments.
  • Work alongside support engineers on customer deployments and troubleshoot problems in customer-controlled environments.
  • Turn recurring customer requirements and deployment constraints into reusable product capabilities rather than one-off solutions.
  • Write the documentation and runbooks customers and our support teams rely on.

About You

Read the full description

job.name: Senior Platform Engineer
job.description:
OUR MISSION We exist to create a more connected, compassionate, and confident experience for people with cancer and those who care for them. We make it easier to get answers, access high-quality care quickly, and feel supported throughout treatment and beyond.

Today, Thyme Care is a market-leading value-based oncology care enabler, partnering with national and regional health plans, providers, and employers to deliver better outcomes and lower costs for thousands of people across the country. Our model combines high-touch human support with powerful technology and AI to bring together everyone involved in a person’s cancer journey: caregivers, oncologists, health plans, and employers.

As a tech-native organization, we believe technology should strengthen the human connection at the center of care. Through data science, automation, and AI, we simplify complexity, improve collaboration, and help care teams focus on what matters most: supporting people through cancer.

Looking ahead, our vision is bold: to become a household name in cancer care, where every person diagnosed asks for Thyme Care by name. If you’re inspired to make cancer care more human and to help reimagine what’s possible, we’d love to meet you. Together, we can build a future where every person with cancer feels truly cared for, in every moment that matters.

What You’ll Do As a Platform Engineer at Thyme Care, you will join a team focused on building the infrastructure, developer tooling, and workflows that help drive high-quality interventions for our members with cancer. You’ll partner closely with other engineering teams to improve the internal platform, reduce operational friction, and support feature development. This role is well suited for a senior engineer who enjoys owning ambiguous platform problems from discovery through delivery.

  • Lead medium-to-large platform/architectural initiatives end-to-end, from early discovery and technical design through rollout and adoption.
  • Design and implement developer experience tooling that uses AI Agents as well as traditional automation.
  • Own and evolve our AWS platform (including EKS, RDS, Bedrock) using Terraform and other infrastructure-as-code tools.
  • Build and maintain internal Python libraries and Kubernetes tooling that abstract away infrastructure complexity, letting other engineers self-serve deployments with minimal platform help.
  • Improve our CI/CD pipelines by building and maintaining reusable workflows, optimizing performance, and enhancing our deployment and rollback capabilities.
  • Partner with engineers across the organization to improve developer experience through better tooling, clearer workflows, and team enablement.
  • Participate in our on-call rotation, improving our observability, triaging incidents, and handling support requests from our engineering and data teams.

job.name: Senior DevOps Engineer
job.description:
About Adelphi Adelphi's Vision is to build the biggest AI Deployment company for National Security, which requires talent that is extremely good at problem solving, gets excited about National Security challenges, and thrives in software factories. We're executing a Mission that (1) Identifies the core bottlenecks in Warfighting, Intelligence and the Enterprise, (2) Assigns top talent with backgrounds in systems and machine learning engineering, and (3) Finds repeatability in solution development to target similar offices across the DoW/IC. The business has 10x'd in under two years and has built trust with the senior most leaders at the Department of War and Intelligence Community.

About The Role As Senior DevOps Engineer on our DevSecOps team, you will own the platform that carries our Customers' AI applications into accredited DoD environments and keeps them there. Today that platform hosts a handful of applications; it is built to host many, and you will be the person who makes adding the next one a routine, reviewed change rather than a project. The platform is a GovCloud EKS cluster defined entirely as code: Terraform for the infrastructure, Helm charts and Argo CD for everything the cluster runs, Istio and Kyverno as the security and admission boundary, Keycloak for identity, and CloudWatch and Grafana for observability. Around it sit the CI pipelines, automated test suites, and the tooling that turns the running environment into NIST 800-53 evidence. You will make technical direction and architectural decisions for this platform and write a large share of its code. Expect the split to be roughly 70/30 platform engineering (Terraform, Helm, Argo CD, Kubernetes, AWS) to security and compliance engineering (hardening, evidence, ATO support). The right candidate has built and operated production Kubernetes in government or regulated environments and can be productive in this codebase within weeks, not months. We are an AI-native engineering team. We expect every engineer to leverage LLMs and AI tooling as a core part of how you design, build, ship, and debug infrastructure as an integral, daily extension of your workflow.

Location

DC/McLean, with 2-3 days per week in office.

Compensation Competitive pay within the 75th-90th percentile with equity.

Clearance Requirement

An active U.S. Government Secret clearance is not required. Candidates must be U.S. citizens and be eligible to maintain and upgrade clearances as the role requires. A current CompTIA Security+ certification is required. Candidates need to be excited to work for the Defense and Intel Communities, and to apply AI to real applications for Government.

Is this you?

We are an AI-native engineering team. We expect every engineer to leverage LLMs and AI tooling as a core part of how they design, build, ship, and operate the platform that turns frontier-model capability into mission outcomes.

job.name: Software Engineer, Runtimes
job.description:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About the Role:

Vercel started as the home for frontends. The Languages and Runtimes team is making it the home for the rest of the application: APIs, background workers, AI agents, and the services that connect them. This past year we took Python on Vercel to general availability, launched Vercel Services so frontends and backends deploy together as one project, and, alongside our Compute team, helped bring always-on background workers to the platform.

Our work spans the path from source code to a running process: tooling that understands an application’s structure, packages its dependencies, and runs it on Vercel, plus language runtimes, SDKs, private service-to-service communication, and production observability. Much of it is making existing applications run efficiently without asking developers to rework them, whether that means taming large dependency sets, cutting cold starts, precompiling Python bytecode at build time, or serving a framework’s static assets straight from the CDN.

Next, we’re bringing first-class support to Go and Rust, from builds and packaging to runtime integration and SDKs, and improving observability so developers can see how their services connect and where requests spend their time. You’ll work across these layers, following problems from a developer’s application down to how it builds and executes.

What You Will Do:

  • Build and maintain backend services and infrastructure using Python and Rust.
  • Improve serverless Python execution, including dependency management, runtime behavior, startup performance, and resource efficiency.
  • Design distributed systems that support reliable deployment and execution of customer applications and AI workloads.
  • Develop cloud infrastructure and deployment automation using Infrastructure as Code.
  • Investigate performance bottlenecks and production issues across services, runtimes, and infrastructure.
  • Partner with engineering and product teams to turn developer needs into reliable platform capabilities.
  • Own the services you ship, including monitoring, incident response, and participation in an on-call rotation.

About You:

Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

The Cloud Foundations team owns and operates the foundational infrastructure that powers GitHub’s internal compute platform across Azure and our global data centers. Our responsibilities span the VM platform, compute provisioning and lifecycle management, OS and container base images, fleet-wide configuration, host inventory, and infrastructure-as-code tooling. Our mission is to provide reliable, secure, and low-toil foundations that enable engineering teams to build and operate services without managing the complexity of the underlying infrastructure.

As a Software Engineer III, you’ll help build and improve the systems that create, configure, secure, maintain, and retire GitHub’s compute resources. Your work may include VM provisioning workflows, image pipelines, configuration management, safe fleet maintenance, service discovery, and Terraform-based automation. You’ll strengthen the reliability and recovery capabilities of critical infrastructure while helping modernize legacy systems and evolve our Azure platform.

You’ll collaborate with a distributed team in an environment that values asynchronous work and clear written communication. Working with partners across engineering and security, you’ll deliver well-scoped projects, improve operational visibility, reduce manual work, and help teams adopt safe, consistent infrastructure practices. You’ll also contribute to operating the services we own, using production experience to guide lasting engineering improvements.

This role offers the opportunity to solve infrastructure problems at GitHub’s scale, take ownership of meaningful platform improvements, and help shape the foundations that GitHub’s engineering teams rely on every day.

job.name: MLOps Engineer
job.description:
About The Role The role owns the infrastructure and tooling that takes ML models from notebooks to production — CI/CD pipelines for models, scalable training infrastructure, low-latency serving stacks, and the observability layer that catches failures before they become incidents.

The team sits at the intersection of data science and platform engineering, enabling ML practitioners to ship faster while keeping production systems reliable, reproducible, and cost-efficient.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines using Kubeflow, Airflow, or MLflow — from data ingestion through training, validation, and deployment
  • Design CI/CD workflows for model versioning, automated testing, and progressive rollout (canary, blue-green) using GitHub Actions or GitLab CI
  • Operate and optimize model serving infrastructure on Kubernetes, including GPU utilization, autoscaling, and inference optimization (Triton, TorchServe, or vLLM)
  • Implement monitoring and alerting for data drift, model degradation, and system health using Prometheus, Grafana, and Evidently
  • Manage feature stores and training data pipelines, ensuring reproducibility across experiments and production environments
  • Partner with data scientists to productionize models, providing tooling, documentation, and paved-path deployment patterns
  • Drive cost and performance optimization across cloud ML workloads on AWS or GCP

What We Are Looking For

  • 3–6 years of experience in MLOps, ML engineering, or platform/SRE roles supporting ML systems in production
  • Strong proficiency with Python and containerization tooling (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm)
  • Hands-on experience with an ML orchestration stack: MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, or Vertex AI Pipelines
  • Deep familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including IaC with Terraform
  • Experience building observability for ML systems: drift detection, latency monitoring, automated retraining triggers
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

job.name: Full-Stack Software Engineer (Remote, EST hours)
job.description:
Hi! I'm Emma, co-founder at JuniGo.

I'm looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our product and tech team. Below is some context on why we're hiring, what you'll own, and the things you probably want to know before you apply.

BACKGROUND & WHY WE ARE HIRING

JuniGo helps small and medium businesses in Africa pay their suppliers in Asia and around the world, and we are starting our footprint in Nigeria.

The region was not a random choice. Nigerian businesses move real goods at real scale: China alone shipped nearly $25 billion worth of goods to Nigeria in 2025. Yet the businesses behind that trade are badly underserved. Slow, expensive payment infrastructure and little access to funding hold them back. We're building the financial infrastructure emerging markets deserve.

And it's working. We launched in January 2026 and have grown 200x since. In October alone, we processed US$26.6 million in total payment volume (TPV).

We're growing fast, and there's more worth building than we have people to build it. Our tech team today is 3 engineers, all based in Asia. For us this means:

  • Partner integrations are queuing up. We have several new partner integrations in the pipeline, and each one is waiting its turn.
  • We're leaving good opportunities on the table. We've found some really good opportunities in the market, but we don't have the people to go after them.
  • Our engineers are spread too thin. They switch between too many workstreams at once, which slows everything down.
  • Nobody covers the other half of the day. When customers and partners need something during North American hours, there's no engineer online.

That's where you come in. I'm looking for a full-stack engineer who can own features from start to finish, and who can be our engineering presence on EST time.

SCOPE OF THE ROLE & SOME EXAMPLES

You'll own features end to end: from a rough idea to code running in production, across the backend, web, and our iOS and Android apps.

Example 1: Owning a feature from idea to launch

You won't always get a polished design file or a detailed spec. Sometimes it's a rough wireframe. Sometimes it's a few lines of high-level requirements. You'll:

  • Work out what the customer actually needs, and fill in the gaps with your own judgement
  • Design the API, build the backend, and build the screens on web and mobile
  • Make sensible product and UX calls when there's no detailed design, and check the important ones with me
  • Figure things out step by step, without waiting for every detail to be spelled out
  • Ship it, watch how it's used, and keep improving it

Example 2: Connecting JuniGo to new partners

job.name: Electron Software Engineer (Remote)
job.description:
• Role Title : Electron Software Engineer (Remote)
  • Role Type : Full-time
  • Loc ation : Remote

The Role

We’re building high-fidelity productivity infrastructure for a globally distributed workforce—software that operates quietly, reliably, and intelligently in the background. As a Software Engineer focused on desktop systems, you’ll help design and scale a cross-platform time intelligence application (MacOS + Windows) used daily by thousands of professionals.

What You’ll Work On

1. Architect and evolve a cross-platform desktop agent using Electron.js, optimized for performance and minimal resource footprint.

2. Build real-time timekeeping systems with precise event tracking and background execution.

3. Design and implement system-level signal collection (keyboard, mouse, app usage) with strong privacy and efficiency guarantees.

4. Develop offline-first data pipelines with reliable background sync and conflict resolution.

5. Integrate with distributed backend services and internal APIs to enable analytics and reporting.

6. Continuously improve runtime performance, memory efficiency, and fault tolerance.

7. Collaborate with product, design, and backend teams to ship features that directly impact user productivity.

What We're Looking For

1. 3+ years building production-grade desktop applications with Electron.js.

2. Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js.

3. Experience designing cross-platform systems (MacOS + Windows) with consistent behavior.

4. Hands-on work with real-time tracking, event streams, or activity monitoring systems.

5. Familiarity with OS-level APIs for capturing user/system interactions.

6. Deep understanding of performance optimization in desktop environments.

7. Strong debugging skills and ability to reason about edge cases in distributed/offline systems.

Preferred

1. Experience building productivity, monitoring, or telemetry-driven applications.

2. Knowledge of native OS integrations (permissions, background processes, system hooks).

3. Understanding of security and privacy considerations in user activity tracking.

4. Familiarity with auto-update systems and release management in Electron.

Compensation & Benefits Notice

The national pay range for this full-time position is base salary of $130,000 –$160,000 USD. All employees are eligible for equity compensation, and employees may also receive performance-based bonuses, dependent on role and subject to company policies. provides a comprehensive benefits package, including up to 100% reimbursement for health-insurance premiums, paid time off, a 401(K) plan with a company match, and additional benefits designed to support a high-performing, remote-first workforce.

Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. Description & Requirements Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

You will develop scalable backend services while also contributing to intuitive, performant user interfaces. You will also collaborate across design, product, and engineering teams to deliver high-quality, API-driven features that power our web applications and report to the Director of Engineering.

If you enjoy creating reliable backend systems, integrating data from multiple sources, and delivering full-stack experiences, we'd love to hear from you.

Backend-Focused Development

CMS & Content Delivery

Quality Assurance & Collaboration

  • Collaborate with designers, product managers, and other engineers to deliver end-to-end features.
  • Contribute to Agile ceremonies and maintain across teams.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer II, Multiple Teams
job.description:
Relay is a digital banking platform that gives self-made business owners the tools and know-how to be great with money—bringing clarity, confidence, and control to every dollar earned, so they can turn hard work into lasting success. We do this by replacing financial guesswork with real visibility, transforming cash flow from a constant source of stress into a clear signal owners can use to run stronger, more resilient businesses.

Our Engineering team is at the heart of building banking products that help millions of small businesses succeed. We're on a journey to reinvent banking, and we're looking for Senior Software Engineer II to help set the technical direction for how we get there. You'll take on our highest-risk, most ambiguous work, spot the problems that matter before anyone assigns them, and bring teams together around solutions that move the business forward.

This is a unique opportunity to shape architecture across interconnected systems, raise the engineering bar beyond your own team, and grow the next generation of technical leaders at Relay. If you're excited about building best-in-class fintech products and multiplying your impact through others, this is the role for you.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Technical Direction: Lead architecture and the highest-risk work across interconnected systems, and set practical standards for quality, reliability, security, and maintainability
  • Cross-Team Delivery: Own ambiguous, cross-team initiatives from problem definition through measurable outcomes by setting priorities, resolving dependencies, and keeping execution moving
  • Product Judgment: Find important problems before they're assigned, and tie technical decisions to customer needs, business priorities, cost, and risk
  • Cross-Team Influence: Align teams with different priorities using context, evidence, and sound judgment rather than formal authority
  • Organizational Improvement: Create practices, tooling, documentation, and guardrails that improve delivery and operational effectiveness across Engineering
  • Developing Others: Coach engineers and delegate meaningful ownership so you create more technical leaders instead of becoming a bottleneck

Who You Are

  • You have led architecture for complex, interconnected systems and owned the highest-risk technical decisions
  • You have driven cross-team initiatives from an ambiguous problem to measurable results
  • You connect technical trade-offs to customer impact, business priorities, cost, and risk
  • You influence without authority, aligning teams and stakeholders through context and evidence
  • You have created standards, tooling, or processes that improved how teams beyond your own deliver and operate
  • You grow engineers by coaching and delegating real ownership, and you measure your success by the leaders you develop
  • You thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments and are comfortable navigating ambiguity and change

It's a Bonus (but Not Required) If You

job.name: Senior Software Engineer, Lifecycle
job.description:
About Life360 Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 107.7 million monthly active users (MAU), as of September 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com.

Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above. We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team The Lifecycle team at Life360 owns the moments that decide whether a new member sticks. From the first app open through account creation, permissions, and the first seven days of habit-building, we shape the experience that gets families set up and on the map. Beyond onboarding, we run rapid, full-funnel experimentation, from store impression through activation, engagement, and reactivation, across in-app, push, and email. We own the experimentation platform and standards, so we can test anywhere in the product and scale what works. Our mission is to turn curiosity into connection, and connection into a habit that families rely on.

We are a product-minded, AI-Native engineering team. That means AI isn’t just a tool we use — it’s how we work. We’ve redesigned our team workflows around AI, treating it as a first-class collaborator at every stage: ideation, coding, testing, review, and iteration. We ship faster and go deeper because of it, and we’re looking for someone who wants to help define what that looks like at scale.

Read the full description

job.description:
The opportunity From the business unit level help product and application teams implement secure, efficient identity and access controls across the business. As an internal consultant, you will connect central identity and access management teams with product and application teams, turning policies, standards, and proven practices into workable solutions. You will review architectures and implementations, guide teams through complex cross-organizational dependencies, and identify risks and gaps that need resolution. This role offers broad influence across Grid Integration and the opportunity to improve how identities, authentication, authorization, and access lifecycles are managed across a diverse application portfolio.

How You’ll Make An Impact

  • Act as the primary identity and access management advisor for product and application teams across business units.
  • Guide teams in implementing identity lifecycle, authentication, and authorization controls so access is granted, reviewed, and removed appropriately.
  • Translate central policies, standards, and guidance into practical requirements, implementation instructions, and reference architectures.
  • Review identity and access management architectures, designs, and implementations; document recommendations and identify deviations for resolution.
  • Develop risk-based review criteria using access privileges, data sensitivity, external exposure, and integration complexity to determine assessment and escalation needs.
  • Identify gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities, then recommend updates to identity and access management guidance and practices

Your background

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.
  • Extensive experience with identity and access management across diverse product and application portfolios, including architecture and implementation reviews.
  • Strong knowledge of federation, authentication, authorization, and directory technologies, including SAML, OpenID Connect, OAuth, and LDAP.
  • Proven ability to translate central identity and access management policies into workable solutions and coordinate across organizational boundaries.
  • Experience with cloud-based identity and access management solutions and hybrid environments; knowledge of related compliance requirements is preferred.
  • Excellent communication and consulting skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders, build consensus, lead work, and mentor others.

Job Purpose / Brief Of Job Role Serve as a technical expert supporting our underwriting teams and clients on risk assessment, incident response and other advisory services with the aim of enhancing the quality, resilience and scalability of our cyber business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct cyber risk assessments of individual commercial risks and translate technical findings into actionable underwriting recommendations.
  • Identify, evaluate and benchmark the effectiveness of security controls against evolving threats, attack vectors and mitigation strategies.
  • Continuously enhance our cyber risk assessment methodologies, frameworks and questionnaires.
  • Provide analytical support on cyber coverage language and its alignment with current threat trends, loss scenarios and portfolio exposures.

job.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. job.name: Product Engineering Lead
job.description:
Join the team bringing autonomy to the built world

At Bedrock, we're moving AI out of the lab and onto real job sites. Our team includes veterans who helped launch Waymo, scaled Segment to a $3.2B acquisition, and grew Uber Freight to $5B in revenue. We retrofit the heavy equipment contractors already own, starting with excavators, so experienced crews can safely take on more projects and deliver more of the critical infrastructure our society needs.

In August 2026, Bedrock-equipped excavators began doing fully autonomous, paid work on live commercial job sites. We've more than doubled our customer base since 2025, and our machines now work with contractors across the South, Midwest, and Mid-Atlantic

In October 2026, we raised a $600M Series C co-led by CapitalG and Emergence Capital, bringing our total funding to nearly $1B. We're using it to put more autonomous machines to work, build the field and operations teams behind every deployment, and expand into new machine types and job-site tasks.

This is where algorithms meet steel-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world-class engineers to solve physical-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us.

About The Role Autonomy in the real world is never fully hands-off. Our machines work alongside expert operators who support them from anywhere, and the tools those operators use are a core part of the product. As a tech lead you'll be the bridge between the people supporting our fleet and the engineers building it. You'll architect, build, and own the software that connects people to our machines when it matters most.

You'll spend real time with the people using these tools, in the operations center and on job sites, and partner with our product team to shape the vision and requirements. From there, you'll own the technical design and implementation, leading the build with frontend, backend, and autonomy engineers, and scale it as the fleet grows. This is where great product engineering meets steel-toed boots.

Also, you get to drive 100,000 lb excavators.

What You'll Do

In August 2026, Bedrock-equipped excavators began doing fully autonomous, paid work on live commercial job sites. We've more than doubled our customer base since 2025, and our machines now work with contractors across the South, Midwest, and Mid-Atlantic

In October 2026, we raised a $600M Series C co-led by CapitalG and Emergence Capital, bringing our total funding to nearly $1B. We're using it to put more autonomous machines to work, build the field and operations teams behind every deployment, and expand into new machine types and job-site tasks.

This is where algorithms meet steel-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world-class engineers to solve physical-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us.

The Mission At Bedrock, we aren’t just building robots; we are redefining how the world moves earth. We are looking for a Senior level Robotics Application Engineer who thrives at the intersection of heavy machinery, cutting-edge autonomy, and real-world grit.

What You’ll Do In this role, you won't be stuck behind a desk. You’ll be the bridge between our advanced R&D lab and the rugged reality of a construction site. Your job is to take our autonomous excavators and make them perform - turning lines of code into moved dirt and satisfied customers. As a "Full-Stack" Robotics Engineer, you will own the success of our deployments through:

  • Data-Driven Evaluation: Run evaluations on site data to predict autonomous performance and validate release readiness before the buckets start digging.
  • Real-Time Problem Solving: Debug complex issues across the entire stack—from hydraulic sensors and compute hardware to high-level behavior. Employ a breadth of technical knowledge to dig into both onboard and offboard code to keep the mission moving.
  • Technical Strategy: Collaborate closely with Partnerships to identify new customer sites that align with our product roadmap and provide technical feedback to our engineering team to influence the next generation of Bedrock systems.
  • Customer Partnership: Translate "robot-speak" into value. You will lead discussions on site progression, explain how the system integrates into our customers’ work, and how to maximize its performance on a job site.

Robotics Product Engineer

Location: San Francisco, CA (Onsite – 5 Days/Week)

Compensation: $225,000–$275,000 Base + Equity

Industry: Robotics, Artificial Intelligence, AI Infrastructure

About the Opportunity

Shields Group Search is partnering with an innovative, early-stage AI infrastructure startup in San Francisco to hire a Robotics Product Engineer .

The company is building the infrastructure layer that enables developers and robotics teams to integrate, deploy, and run cutting-edge AI world models in real-world applications.

While research labs are developing increasingly sophisticated world models, getting these models to operate efficiently in production remains a significant technical challenge. The company is solving this problem by building the inference infrastructure, SDKs, and deployment capabilities that allow developers to integrate world models into their products without having to build the underlying infrastructure themselves.

Rather than focusing primarily on training foundation models from scratch, the engineering team works at the intersection of AI inference, cloud infrastructure, real-time systems, and applied research , collaborating with research labs to make emerging models usable in production.

Its technical team brings experience building sophisticated, low-latency, real-time systems at major technology organizations, applying that expertise to the emerging world-model ecosystem.

The company operates with a highly technical, talent-dense, flat engineering structure, where individual contributors have significant autonomy and ownership over what they build.

About the Role

We're seeking a Robotics Product Engineer to help bridge the gap between cutting-edge robotics research and real-world deployment.

Robotics teams want to run the newest AI models on physical robots. This engineer will build the products, integrations, and infrastructure that make that possible.

The role has two primary areas of focus:

1. Customer-Facing Product Engineering

Work directly with robotics customers to understand their challenges, investigate technical failures, identify bottlenecks, and translate real-world feedback into meaningful product improvements, new features, and platform capabilities.

2. Research-to-Production Engineering

Collaborate closely with the company's growing robotics research team to take new research, models, and algorithms and get them running reliably on physical robotic systems.

This is a highly hands-on, individual contributor position with significant end-to-end ownership, spanning frontend development, backend engineering, APIs, infrastructure, robotic systems, and physical hardware testing.

The company has physical robots in its San Francisco office, and this engineer will be directly involved in testing and validating software on those systems until a dedicated test engineer joins the team.

Exodigo engineers the underground without digging. Our platform combines multi-sensor fusion and AI to produce complete, accurate 3D maps of buried utilities, foundations, and geotechnical conditions, which utilities, transportation agencies, and engineering firms use to plan, design, and build with confidence. Behind every map is a team of civil engineers, BIM modelers, and mapping specialists who turn raw subsurface data into engineering-grade deliverables.

You will work alongside our Mapping, Delivery, and Engineering Services teams, learn how a project moves from field scan through interpretation to Civil 3D and OpenRoads models and client-ready utility maps, and find where AI can take on the repetitive work so our engineers can focus on engineering judgment.

This is a hands-on, builder role. You will scope the problem, build the solution, ship it into live projects, and stay with it until it becomes part of how the team works. You will be the bridge between engineers who know the underground deeply and the AI agents that can amplify them: you can discuss utility quality levels, model QA/QC, and client CAD standards in the morning, and write a new integration for an AI agent in the afternoon. The Role

As a Staff iOS Engineer on Bitcoin, you will own the technical direction and delivery of a critical area of our iOS product experience with bitcoin and stablecoin. This is a hands-on role: you’ll prototype new ideas, make architectural decisions, write production code, and lead work through launch and ongoing improvement.

The work extends beyond the client. You’ll align product requirements with backend capabilities, resolve dependencies with partner teams, and make tradeoffs across customer experience, delivery speed, security, and reliability. You’ll personally tackle the hardest design and implementation problems while helping other engineers contribute effectively.

Your impact will come from shipping valuable products and making the next release better: fewer recurring problems, clearer interfaces, stronger testing, and practices the team can use independently.

You Will

Build and evolve the iOS product

  • Build products in iOS related to bitcoin, stablecoin and non custodial wallets.
  • Work across interfaces in Cash App, Square and Bitkey.
  • Own complex features end to end, including client architecture, service integration, testing, rollout, and post-launch improvements.
  • Work with product and design to shape customer journeys, prototype new interactions, and turn open questions into delivery plans.
  • Build prototypes, reference implementations, and critical paths that prove a direction before broader adoption.
  • Contribute bitcoin and stablecoin technology to open source when it creates value for the broader community.
  • Influence the technical direction within the product area, making explicit tradeoffs and sequencing dependencies with adjacent teams.
  • Improve architecture and shared components where they make product development faster, safer, or more consistent.
  • Build automated testing, observability, and safe rollout practices into delivery, with security, privacy, and compliance safeguards appropriate to the risks.

Lead as an AI-fluent engineer

  • Integrate AI-assisted development tools into daily workflows to drive leverage across bitcoin engineering.
  • Evaluate emerging tools and practices, building durable, AI-powered capabilities where they add clear value.
  • Verify AI-assisted outputs and ensure high standards for software quality, security, and reliability.
  • Contribute to codebases beyond your iOS specialty.

Read the full description

About Us Orkes is the operating system for AI agents and workflows, providing the battle-tested infrastructure required to move AI from simple conversation to real-world action. Built on the open-source Conductor engine, our platform empowers developers to orchestrate complex business processes at scale, handling billions of workflows without worrying about failure or visibility. We enable enterprises to seamlessly bridge the gap between LLM-driven reasoning and deterministic execution, creating reliable pathways for AI to drive actual business value.

The Opportunity As a Senior Frontend Engineer (Fullstack-capable) at Orkes, you will work at the frontier of agentic workflow development, defining how enterprises build, manage, and visualize the future of AI integrated work. You will own the architecture across our Conductor workflow builder—the canvas where developers create and link complex agentic workflows—as well as the mission-critical control plane tools used by SREs, Customer Success teams, and our enterprise clients to manage and monitor their clusters at scale. This is a unique opportunity to build high-performance, intuitive UI infrastructure to power scalable, observable business engines.

Must-haves

job.name: Full-Stack Mobile AI Engineer, InZone
job.description:
We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters.

Shape the Future of Manufacturing with ATP At Ford, we aren’t just building vehicles — we are redefining how the world moves. Within the Advanced Industrial Technology and Platforms (ATP) organization, we are the architects of Ford’s next industrial revolution.

Our mission is clear: we build and scale industrial platforms, technologies, and capabilities that unlock Ford Firsts to drive sustained competitive advantage in manufacturing. Driven by our vision to "build once, scale everywhere," we bridge the gap between cutting-edge technology and global physical deployment.

Our guiding mantra is simple yet relentless: Scale what matters, win what's next.

If you are a high-tech builder, thinker, or innovator who thrives at the intersection of software, hardware, and massive scale, ATP is where you belong. Join us, and write the next chapter of industrial history.

In this position... A plant supervisor today juggles several systems and side channels to run a shift. We are replacing that with InZone, the mobile app supervisors use to run a shift, which puts production status, issues, parts, and team chat in one place. It is built on the Living Canvas, a live view of a plant zone across safety, quality, maintenance, and production that shows supervisors what needs attention next.

You will build InZone end to end, from the iPhone and iPad app to the services behind it.

You will work on a small, hands-on Engineering team that ships often, and you will also...

  • Build InZone features supervisors use every shift.
  • Build the services that connect InZone to plant systems and AI recommendations.
  • Ride along with supervisors and turn what you see into the next release.

What You'll Do... Build the App

  • Build features in the native iOS app (Swift, SwiftUI) and the web views behind it.
  • Design for the plant floor: noise, gloves, poor connectivity, and shift hand-offs.
  • Build issue, escalation, alert, and team chat flows.

Build the Services Behind It

  • Build APIs and services that connect InZone to plant systems for production, maintenance, and quality, and to Microsoft Teams.
  • Show recommendations from ATP's AI agents with their sources and confidence.
  • Handle identity, permissions, and privacy for plant users.

Ship and Support

  • Write tests, release through CI/CD, and monitor crashes and performance.
  • Fix issues fast and learn from how the app is really used.

job.description:
Role :- React Native Developer With AI Experience

Location :- - Remote (Unites states)

Job Description :-

About The Role

1. Technical depth: Practical coding and debugging skills beyond textbook answers.
2. Firsthand experience: Specific examples of personal contributions, implementation decisions, and outcomes.
3. Clear communication: Direct, substantive answers supported by concrete details.
4. Team fit: Collaboration, responsiveness to feedback, and contribution to team dynamics.
5. Effective AI use: Strong independent coding skills alongside thoughtful use and validation of AI-generated output.
6. The team is currently working on Loyalty and Adyen payment integration, so relevant experience in these areas would be beneficial.

We are hiring a Senior React Native Developer to build and scale a high-performance mobile commerce app used by real customers at production scale. You will work in a modern TypeScript monorepo, ship native iOS features, and collaborate closely with product, design, and backend teams to deliver polished shopping experiences.

What You’ll Build

  • A React Native app with TypeScript and modern architecture patterns.
  • Native-integrated mobile experiences for iOS and Android.
  • Reliable commerce flows including onboarding, navigation, checkout-related components, and localization.
  • Instrumented and observable features using mobile analytics and monitoring tooling.

Tech Environment

  • React Native CLI workflow, with Expo modules where useful.
  • TypeScript, React 19, React Navigation 7, MobX, React Hook Form, Zod.
  • Native integrations and platform modules across iOS/Android.
  • Testing and quality tooling with Jest, Testing Library, ESLint, Knip.
  • Monorepo and package management with pnpm.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain production-grade React Native features.
  • Own app performance, stability, and release quality across iOS and Android.
  • Integrate and maintain native modules and third-party SDKs.
  • Write clean, testable TypeScript with strong code review standards.
  • Partner with backend and platform teams on API contracts and mobile architecture.
  • Improve developer productivity through tooling, build reliability, and CI discipline.
  • Support observability, debugging, and incident response for mobile production issues.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years in React Native.
  • Strong TypeScript and JavaScript fundamentals.
  • Proven experience shipping React Native apps to App Store and Google Play.
  • Solid understanding of iOS and Android platform behavior and native dependency management.
  • Experience with state management and form validation patterns in mobile apps.
  • Experience writing unit/integration tests for React Native code.
  • Comfortable in monorepo environments and collaborative Git workflows.

Staff Mobile Engineer

Location: 100% Remote - U.S.

Employment Type: Full-Time

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Staff Mobile Engineer to provide technical leadership for a modern, customer-facing mobile platform. This is a highly influential engineering role focused on shaping the long-term architecture of React Native and native iOS applications while remaining hands-on with complex, business-critical development.

You'll drive mobile engineering strategy, solve challenging technical problems, establish engineering standards, and mentor other engineers while partnering closely with Product, Design, Backend, Platform, and Security teams.

job.name: Software Engineer
job.description:
Truelio is looking for an experienced Software Engineer to join our Software Services team. This is a hands-on development role for someone who is comfortable taking ownership of software, not simply completing assigned tickets.

You will work across mobile applications, backend services, databases, integrations, and internal systems that support both our clients and our own operations. Our client-facing software is increasingly centered around mobile applications, with React Native playing an important role in our technology stack. Just as important are the APIs, databases, integrations, background processes, and operational systems behind those applications.

We are looking for someone who can understand how a system works, diagnose problems when it does not, and take responsibility for getting it working correctly.

  • We are looking for applicants in the Metro Atlanta area; this is a hybrid role with flexibility between in person and remote

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, maintain, and support production software used by our clients and internal teams.
  • Develop and maintain React Native applications for iOS and Android.
  • Build and support backend applications and APIs using C# and .NET.
  • Work extensively with SQL Server, including writing and troubleshooting queries, stored procedures, data integrations, and database-driven processes.
  • Investigate production issues across applications, services, databases, and third-party integrations.
  • Own problems through resolution rather than simply handing them off when they cross a technical boundary.
  • Maintain and improve existing systems while also contributing to new application development.
  • Build and support integrations with external APIs, services, and client systems.
  • Work with our account and project management teams to deliver day-to-day deliverables for our clients.
  • Review code and work collaboratively with other engineers to improve reliability and maintainability.
  • Identify recurring problems, technical debt, and practical opportunities to simplify or improve our systems.
  • Write appropriate automated tests and help improve development and deployment processes.
  • Communicate clearly about technical problems, tradeoffs, progress, and risks.

4+ years of professional software development experience.

  • Strong experience with C# and .NET.
  • Strong working knowledge of SQL Server and relational database concepts.
  • Experience building or maintaining backend APIs, services, integrations, or background processes.
  • Experience with React Native, React, or another modern JavaScript/TypeScript application framework.
  • Solid understanding of HTTP APIs, authentication, application architecture, and distributed application fundamentals.
  • Experience using Git and working in a collaborative development environment.
  • Ability to troubleshoot systems you did not originally build.

job.description:
Impact In this hands-on technical leadership role, you'll help shape the architecture behind Shipt's core Member App and the mobile systems that support it. You'll work across teams to build performant, reliable, config-driven mobile experiences that can move quickly without creating unnecessary client complexity.

Day to day, you'll use React Native, GraphQL, TanStack, config-driven UI patterns, and AI-assisted development tools to solve complex mobile architecture problems, establish shared systems, and improve critical parts of the customer experience like startup speed, navigation, rendering, and network behavior.

Your work will directly impact the business by improving app reliability, product flexibility, delivery velocity, and delivery quality, helping drive customer conversion, trust, and habituation at high-scale e-commerce depth.

*What You’ll Need to Be Successful Deep Mobile Experience* - 8+ years of software engineering experience, including deep production experience building and scaling React Native applications. Kotlin Multiplatform, native iOS, or Android experience is a plus.

Principal-Level Technical Leadership - A proven track record of setting architectural direction, creating alignment across teams, mentoring peers, and raising the engineering bar as an independent technical leader.

Modern Mobile Architecture - Hands-on experience designing mobile architectures and shared systems across GraphQL, TanStack, async workflows, caching, routing, and client data patterns.

Config-Driven UI - Experience designing config-driven UI systems that balance product flexibility, development velocity, client complexity, performance, and maintainability.

Performance And Production Ownership - Strong experience improving mobile performance and reliability through CI/CD, automated testing, Real User Monitoring, observability, incident response, and tools like Datadog or similar platforms.

AI-Assisted Development - Experience using tools like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar assistants to improve team velocity, quality, documentation, and delivery consistency.

Helpful Experience - Backend API or platform experience with Go, Node.js, or similar server-side frameworks. High-scale commerce, marketplace, or grocery experience is also a plus.

As a Mobile Senior developer, you will collaborate closely with development teams, contributing to the architectural design and scalability planning of critical components. Your primary focus will be on delivering and supporting IoT device solutions through cloud technologies within a multi-tiered, high-throughput infrastructure. Note: This is an individual contributor position.

The above hiring range represents the University's good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting. Position Summary

The AlQuraishi Lab in the Departments of Systems Biology and Computer Science at Columbia University is seeking a Machine Learning Scientist with a focus on deep learning models for biomolecular systems and drug discovery. Projects span development and training of new neural network architectures, design of active learning experiments in conjunction with experimental collaborators, derivation of scaling laws for biomolecular systems, and other topics. All projects involve interactions with team members in the AlQuraishi lab as well as academic and industry partners in three major consortia: OpenFold, AISB (AI Structural Biology Network), and OpenBind.

Responsibilities

  • Design and train state-of-the-art neural network architectures for biomolecular systems, including prediction of protein-ligand, protein-protein, and antibody-antigen structures and affinities, and protein conformational ensembles.
  • Design active learning algorithms and experiments to steer large-scale data acquisition campaigns focused on improving biomolecular models.
  • Devise experiments to understand scaling behavior of biomolecular models.
  • Curate and prepare datasets, and develop dataset processing algorithms, for in-acquisition and proprietary datasets, including in federated training settings.
  • Develop new ideas, write code, run experiments, analyze data, and prepare reports.
  • Be an active member of one or more highly collaborative teams.
  • Stay current with the ultrafast-paced nature of biomolecular machine learning.
  • Maintain and enhance external visibility through publishing papers, writing open-source code, and engaging with the scientific community.

Minimum Qualifications

  • M.S. in computer science / machine learning, computational biology, or related quantitative fields plus five years of related experience, or equivalent combination of education/experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ph.D. in computer science / machine learning, computational biology, or related quantitative fields.
  • Extensive machine learning experience, including design, training, and deployment of complex neural architectures.
  • Extensive programming experience in Python.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.

Other Requirements

job.name: Forward Deployed AI Engineer, Travel Intelligence
job.description:
About The Role Hopper powers travel for some of the world’s largest banks, airlines and travel companies, and our Research team builds travel-specialized models. As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer you take that work into a partner’s environment and make it theirs: building the evaluation with their team, preparing their data, training and evaluating the model, and putting it into production where it delivers measurable results. You work in a small forward-deployed team as the person who leads model training on site, across servicing, loyalty, commerce and more, and you are the bridge between our partners and Research.

What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like

  • Work with a partner’s data and business teams to turn their real tasks into a frozen, held-out benchmark across their priority use cases
  • Define what success means for each task, covering task completion, policy adherence, cost and response time, and build the automated graders with human spot checks
  • Establish baselines so results can be compared fairly
  • Prepare training data inside the partner’s environment through extraction, redaction, deduplication, labelling and train/test splits, using only the data the agreed tasks need
  • Run post-training in partnership with Research, applying modern fine-tuning methods to partner use cases
  • Run training on the partner’s cloud and GPUs, or in an environment they approve, under their security and access rules
  • Design experiments that show partners clearly what drives the results
  • Take models from evaluation into production based on evidence, then monitor quality, latency and cost once they are live
  • Use production results to keep improving the model
  • Present results, method and trade-offs to partner data and technology leaders, and defend them
  • Work closely with Research, feeding back what you learn in the field
  • Turn each deployment into reusable tooling so the next partner goes faster
  • Uphold strict data handling, privacy and security standards in every partner environment, and support partner model-risk, security and compliance reviews with clear documentation of data, training and evaluation
