job.name: Sr Systems Engineer
job.description:
About The Role We are hiring a Systems Engineer to be the technical lead for NETGEAR Enterprise networking opportunities with IT customers and channel partners in North India. You will design and win switching and WiFi solutions, built on NETGEAR managed switches, access points and Insight cloud management.

You will work alongside sales, partners and product teams. You turn customer requirements into secure, scalable network designs, prove them through demos and proofs of concept, and support customers through deployment.

Key responsibilities

  • Solution design: Gather requirements and design LAN and wireless networks for campus, branch and SMB environments, including topology, VLAN, routing, PoE and RF plans.
  • Presales leadership: Lead technical discovery, solution presentations, live demos and proofs of concept with customers and partners.
  • Bids and documentation: Prepare bills of materials, high-level and low-level designs, and responses to RFPs and RFQs, including compliance statements.
  • Wireless design: Run predictive and on-site WiFi surveys, capacity planning and post-deployment validation.
  • Deployment support: Guide partners through installation, configuration, migration and troubleshooting; escalate complex issues to engineering and TAC.
  • Partner enablement: Train system integrators and distributors through workshops, technical sessions and certification support.
  • Competitive positioning: Position NETGEAR against competitors and others with clear technical differentiators.
  • Security integration: Build network security best practices into every design, such as segmentation, NAC, 802.1X and secure management.
  • Voice of the customer: Feed market and customer requirements back to product management to shape the roadmap.
  • Opportunity management: Keep technical engagements and opportunity records up to date in Salesforce.

Mandatory skills

Switching

  • Deep hands-on knowledge of Layer 2 and Layer 3 switching: VLANs, 802.1Q trunking, STP/RSTP/MSTP, LACP, stacking and MLAG
  • Routing protocols such as static, OSPF and BGP, plus VRRP, inter-VLAN routing and ACLs
  • QoS, multicast (IGMP snooping, PIM) and PoE/PoE++ power budgeting
  • Campus design across access, distribution and core layers, including 10G to 100G uplinks
  • Configuring and troubleshooting switches through CLI and web or cloud management

WiFi

  • Strong knowledge of 802.11ac, 802.11ax (WiFi 6/6E) and 802.11be (WiFi 7)
  • RF fundamentals: channel planning, power, interference, roaming (802.11k/v/r) and high-density design
  • WiFi site surveys with tools such as Ekahau or Hamina (predictive, active and passive)
  • Wireless security: WPA2/WPA3-Enterprise, 802.1X/RADIUS, guest access and captive portals
  • Cloud-managed and controller-based WLAN architectures

Presales

  • Proven track record in presales or solution architecture for enterprise or IT customers
  • Strong presentation, whiteboarding and technical writing skills

job.name: Technical Architect
job.description:
• Executive Summary & Role Purpose

The Technical Architect – Banking as a Service (BaaS) will serve as the technical authority and architectural designer for our next-generation BaaS and Embedded Finance platform. In this role, you will define the end-to-end architecture enabling third-party fintechs, enterprise platforms, and digital ecosystems to consume core banking services—such as digital accounts, payments, card issuing, lending, and compliance services—via secure, highly scalable, and developer-friendly APIs.

You will bridge the gap between high-level business strategy and deep technical execution, designing resilient multi-tenant architectures, modernizing integration with core banking ledgers, and ensuring rigorous security, operational resilience, and regulatory compliance.

  • Key Responsibilities & Scope of Work

Architectural Strategy & Solution Design

  • Platform Architecture: Architect, design, and govern enterprise-grade, multi-tenant BaaS platforms capable of handling ultra-low latency, high-throughput financial transactions with 99.999% availability.
  • API-First & Ecosystem Design: Drive comprehensive API lifecycle standards (OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, RESTful, GraphQL, gRPC), establishing developer portal architectures, SDK generation, sandboxes, and webhook event-distribution systems.
  • Domain-Driven Design (DDD): Decompose complex banking domains (Accounts, Ledgering, Clearing, Payments, FX, Cards, Lending) into decoupled, bounded-context microservices and event-driven choreographies.
  • Modern Integration Patterns: Design integration layers between modern cloud-native service fabrics and mission-critical legacy core banking platforms, payment gateways, and clearing networks (FedNow, RTP, ACH, SEPA, SWIFT / ISO 20022).

Security, Governance & Regulatory Compliance

  • Regulatory & Compliance by Design: Ensure all architectural patterns strictly comply with local regulations, sanctions screening and regional financial authority guidelines.
  • Auditing & Immutability: Design comprehensive audit logging, data lineage, idempotency mechanisms, and non-repudiation systems across all customer- and partner-facing touchpoints.

Scalability, Resilience & Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)

  • High Availability & Disaster Recovery: Architect multi-region, active-active cloud deployments with zero-data-loss recovery point objectives (RPO=0) and near-zero recovery time objectives (RTO~0).
  • Distributed Data Patterns: Formulate data architectures incorporating Event Sourcing, CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation), distributed caching, and transactional outbox patterns.
  • Observability & SRE: Define standards for distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry), APM monitoring, distributed rate limiting, circuit breakers, and automated canary deployments.

Technical Leadership & Partner Enablement

You will lead data and modelling on site as part of a small forward-deployed team, acting as the bridge between partners and Research.   • Design, train and evaluate production ML models for a high-volume commercial use case, choosing the right approach and being clear about the trade-offs.
  • Build the evaluation and measurement that show whether the models are good enough, and where they aren't.
  • Build low-latency, high-throughput services that serve the models in production.
  • Design how the system decides what to answer and how, and how it improves from real usage.
  • Own reliability, cost and performance once the system is live.

job.name: Forward Deployed Engineer
job.description:
Invoke is a consulting and innovation firm focused on delivering Intelligent Automation solutions that solve real operational challenges. We partner with organizations across industries to design and implement scalable RPA and AI-driven workflows that improve efficiency, accuracy, and reliability.

Our teams work hands-on with clients to automate complex processes across a range of systems, from modern applications to legacy environments. Whether it’s streamlining high-volume workflows or improving data quality and consistency, our goal is to build automation and AI solutions that are practical, maintainable, and impactful.

This is a deliberately hybrid role. You’ll lead the hands-on development of a reusable intelligent automation platform designed to be configured and deployed across multiple client engagements, then take that platform into the field and own its integration with real client environments. You’ll move between building new capabilities into the platform and applying them to specific client needs.

We’re looking for someone with deep engineering expertise who is equally comfortable building products and working directly with clients. You should be able to lead technical conversations, understand how solutions apply to real business problems, and help client teams successfully adopt what you build through hands-on training and onboarding.

Roles/Responsibilities

  • Lead the build of our intelligent automation platform, combining deterministic workflow orchestration, RPA, agentic AI workflows, RAG-based retrieval, and OCR/document extraction into systems that run reliably in production.
  • Build and maintain integrations into client systems, from modern APIs, enterprise platforms like SAP Concur, Oracle Fusion, Netsuite, to legacy desktop applications.
  • Own technical delivery on client implementations, sit with client teams to map their actual processes onto the platform, and act as tech lead, making the calls.
  • Act as a consultant on the ground: train client teams, run workshops, and help them build the internal skills to run and extend what's been implemented.

Qualifications

  • 3+ Years of experience in a hybrid technical and client-facing role: you've built things, then been the one implementing, explaining, or troubleshooting them directly with clients.
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs and AI agents: prompt engineering, tool/function calling, multi-step agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, and structured outputs.
  • 5+ Years of strong, full-stack software engineering experience: comfortable across the frontend (React) and backend (Python, PostgreSQL)
  • Experience managing projects, scoping work, sequencing delivery, and keeping a client engagement on track end to end.
  • A strong communicator, comfortable leading workshops, presenting technical decisions, and training non-technical stakeholders.

job.description:
This is a core backend software engineering role (70% SWE / 30% Data) within our Mapping organization. You will focus primarily on building high-throughput services, distributed system architecture, and APIs, while leveraging large-scale spatial data to power Lyft's routing and mapping products. Note: This position focuses on backend service architecture and platform scalability rather than traditional ETL, BI, or data modeling pipelines. At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

As a Senior Software Engineer, Data on the Mapping team, you will collaborate with our world-class team of engineers, product managers, and scientists to grow and improve the quality of recommended routes and accuracy of our travel time estimations. You will lead the architecture and long-term technical direction of our offline experimentation tooling and route simulation services — the systems that let Lyft test routing changes safely before they reach production. You'll also build scalable data pipelines for experimentation, analytics, and machine learning models, along with the data governance and observability systems that keep them trustworthy. Your work will enable integration with partner teams and allow stakeholders across Engineering, Data Science, and Product to make data-informed decisions that directly impact Lyft’s growth and profitability.

Our technology stack is based on the latest technologies such as AWS, Databricks, Kubernetes and Airflow. You will work with incredibly passionate and talented colleagues from software engineering, machine learning and data science on projects that directly impact millions of riders and drivers.

Responsibilities

  • Own core data pipelines end-to-end, building deep subject matter expertise in the systems you manage and defining/managing SLAs for pipelines, services, and datasets to ensure reliability at scale
  • Serve as the technical owner and architectural lead for our offline experimentation platform and route simulation services, setting technical direction, evaluating trade-offs, and ensuring the systems scale with Lyft's routing and mapping ambitions

  • Architecture Modernization: Support new architectural visions (such as headless commerce and decoupled frontends) and actively help migrate legacy or custom components into modern architectural patterns.

Skills & Abilities

  • Core Technical Stack: Proven project experience utilizing React, Java, Spring Boot, Node.js , alongside REST API development .

job.name: Junior Fullstack Engineer
job.description:
Small businesses represent 99.9% of all companies, yet they're still forced to choose between clunky, outdated enterprise phone systems or their personal phones. This multi-billion dollar market has been overlooked for decades, left to cobble together solutions that slow them down instead of helping them grow.

Quo is changing that. We bring calls, texts, and customer information together into one easy-to-use, AI-powered platform. We're not just building a phone system. We're setting a new standard for how businesses connect with their customers.

Driven by our values, we move fast, build with determination, and obsess over delivering value to the businesses that have been underserved for far too long.

Today, Quo is trusted by more than 120,000 companies and rated #1 in customer satisfaction on G2. We're backed by Y Combinator, Tiger Global, Craft Ventures, Slow Ventures, and other top-tier investors. It's safe to say we're onto something big.

About The Role We're looking for a Junior Fullstack Engineer who is building their foundation and wants to grow quickly alongside experienced teammates. You'll work in one of two engineering squads, Gateway or Connect, shipping real features across our React web app and Node backend that small businesses rely on every day. You'll have a dedicated mentor, well-scoped work, and plenty of room to learn how a world-class production SaaS platform is built, run, and scaled.

Gateway owns the front door to Quo: how businesses sign up, choose a plan, pay, verify their business for compliance, and bring their existing phone numbers with them. You'll work on everything from the sign-up, plan, and checkout experiences customers see to the systems behind them, like billing and subscriptions, pricing and trials, taxes, account and trust verification, and number porting.

Connect makes Quo part of the rest of a small business's tech stack. You'll help build and maintain integrations with tools like HubSpot and Salesforce, including the in-app experiences customers use to connect and manage them, and contribute to Quo's public API and webhooks, which let customers send messages, sync contacts, and log calls and messages in the other apps they use every day.

Some Of The Things You’ll Do

Our vehicles do more than just drive themselves - they provide value to communities, bridge public transit gaps and move people where they need to go safely, easily and with a lot more fun. We're building the world's best autonomy system to reimagine transit by minimizing congestion, expanding access and encouraging better land use in order to foster more green, vibrant and livable spaces. Since our founding in 2017, we've given more than 500,000 autonomous rides to real people around the globe. And we're just getting started. We're hiring people who share our passion for building the future, today, solving real-world problems and seeing the impact of their work. Join us.

Job Summary This Manager will be responsible for leading the vision, strategy, and technical roadmap for ML Engineering functions at May Mobility. This position plays a key role in advancing May's core autonomy software stack, applying Autonomy Models to ML challenges across the organization, and charting the path for the supporting ML Platform and Operations infrastructure to maintain velocity.

This position reports to the Director of Autonomy Modeling and is responsible for providing world class leadership to our Autonomy Engineering, Software and Data Engineers, in order to propel their professional success as they develop industry-leading technology advancements.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Oversee day-to-day development, training, evaluation and deployment of ML models across edge and cloud/on-prem targets.
  • Maintain technical roadmaps for accelerating ML performance and operations across the organization
  • Collaborate with other Autonomy teams, Safety teams, and Advanced Engineering teams to deploy robust, generalizable models for autonomous vehicles
  • Track and trend the performance and development of ML models across the organization
  • Support site/field integration, performance evaluation, system verification, and product launch/deployment in US and global sites
  • Support and calibrate the performance of 5+ Engineers across a wide range of ML-related specialties

Skills and Abilities Success in this role typically requires the following competencies:

  • Ability to direct the architecture and maintenance of training, data, evaluation and optimization/release pipelines at enterprise scale.
  • Mastery of the process for training and deploying Perception and/or Planning models for Robotics and/or Physical AI applications.
  • Demonstrable success in directing groups of 3+ Engineers in cross-functional, physical and ML-related projects.

job.name: Forward Deployed Engineer
job.description:
About This Role We’re looking for a Forward-Deployed Engineer to solve technical problems for our customers and build the software they need to succeed with depthfirst. You’ll work directly with enterprise engineering and security teams to understand their needs and own delivery from initial discovery through production.

Your work will span building customer-facing features, developing integrations, and helping customers deploy and operate depthfirst in their environments. Depending on the problem, you might extend a product capability, build an API integration, debug an application issue, or work through a complex deployment constraint. You’ll implement solutions yourself and turn recurring customer needs into lasting improvements across our product and platform.

We welcome engineers with different strengths. You might be a backend or full-stack engineer who wants to work more closely with customers, or an infrastructure engineer with deep experience in cloud systems, Kubernetes, and networking. You don’t need to arrive with expertise in every area. We’re looking for engineers who take ownership, learn unfamiliar systems, and ship solutions.

You’re excited about this role because you will…

  • Build and ship customer-facing features, APIs, and integrations that solve real customer problems.
  • Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, identify technical blockers, and define practical solutions.
  • Own delivery from discovery and technical design through implementation, testing, rollout, and iteration.
  • Help customers integrate, deploy, and operate depthfirst within their existing systems and technical constraints.
  • Investigate problems across application code, integrations, and infrastructure, and implement fixes.
  • Turn solutions developed for individual customers into reusable product capabilities, tooling, and automation.
  • Communicate technical tradeoffs and progress clearly, keeping customer and internal teams aligned.

Qualifications

  • A strong engineering background in at least one of the following:

+ Backend or full-stack software engineering: experience designing, building, and shipping production applications, services, APIs, or integrations.
+ Infrastructure or platform engineering: deep hands-on experience deploying and debugging production systems across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and networking, with experience developing software and tooling.

job.name: Forward Deployed Engineer
job.description:
About Savvy Wealth Wealth management is a $545 billion industry that still runs on manual work. 75% of advisors offer no digital communication beyond email, and most still build financial plans by hand in Excel. Savvy is reinventing what it looks like to be a financial advisor. Founder Ritik Malhotra saw the fragmentation firsthand after seeking out his own advisor, and started Savvy to give independent advisors a modern, AI-native home.

Savvy is a registered investment advisor (RIA), and we partner with experienced financial advisors who want to grow without running the back office themselves. Advisors bring their book and join Savvy, running under their own brand (or ours), and Savvy earns a percentage of the assets they manage. In return, they get a true business-in-a-box: a proprietary tech platform and client portal, an in-house marketing team that helps them grow, a world-class investment management team, and a dedicated client services team that runs day-to-day operations and support. Advisors at Savvy service up to 50% more households and save 19 hours a week.

AI runs through everything we do. On the product side, Savvy Intelligence (released April 2026) is the only AI built for wealth managers that can see a client's complete financial picture. Internally, everyone at Savvy uses Claude and is encouraged to experiment with it, backed by a dedicated AI enablement team and a RevOps org building agents in-house.

The trajectory is steep and it's still early. We're a Series C company with 170+ people, $200M raised, and $100M ARR in sight this year. Inc. ranked us the No. 1 fastest-growing financial services company in America in 2026. Come build the next stage with us!

Recognition We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for our culture and our growth:

  • Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2026)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces in New York™ (2026)
  • Great Place to Work Certified™

The Role Savvy's Forward Deployed Engineers sit between our core platform and the external firms who run their business on top of it. Rather than pulling advisors into Savvy, you'll embed with the client: understanding their existing tech stack, operations, and workflows, then building and customizing the integrations that bring Savvy's software directly into their environment. The best FDEs here move quickly between discovery, scrappy prototyping, and production-quality code, and bring what they learn back to the core product so the next deployment goes faster than the last.

job.name: Forward Deployed Engineer
job.description:
Exodigo is the leading underground mapping solution for non-intrusive discovery. Our platforms combine multi-sensor fusion, 3D imaging, and AI technologies to create complete, accurate underground maps that enable confident decision-making for customers across the built world. We transform the project lifecycle for our customers, who include key community stakeholders in the utilities, transportation and government sectors.

*We are experiencing sky-rocketing growth and closed a historically large $96M Series B round in July of 2025* .

Job description:

Exodigo engineers the underground without digging. Our platform combines multi-sensor fusion and AI to produce complete, accurate 3D maps of buried utilities, foundations, and geotechnical conditions, which utilities, transportation agencies, and engineering firms use to plan, design, and build with confidence. Behind every map is a team of civil engineers, BIM modelers, and mapping specialists who turn raw subsurface data into engineering-grade deliverables.

We are looking for an AI BIM Engineer to help that team move faster, stay consistent, and scale with our growth. You will work alongside our Mapping, Delivery, and Engineering Services teams, learn how a project moves from field scan through interpretation to Civil 3D and OpenRoads models and client-ready utility maps, and find where AI can take on the repetitive work so our engineers can focus on engineering judgment.

This is a hands-on, builder role. You will scope the problem, build the solution, ship it into live projects, and stay with it until it becomes part of how the team works. You will be the bridge between engineers who know the underground deeply and the AI agents that can amplify them: you can discuss utility quality levels, model QA/QC, and client CAD standards in the morning, and write a new integration for an AI agent in the afternoon. What you learn on our projects will shape the AI capabilities we give every team.

What You'll Do Embed with engineering teams

  • Work side by side with highway, structures, water, and site development teams to understand their design processes, tools, standards, and pain points.
  • Lead discovery sessions with engineers and project leads, and translate what you hear into clearly scoped, prioritized opportunities for AI and automation.
  • Own delivery end to end: from first conversation and rapid prototype through to a stable tool in daily production use.
  • Coach engineers on using AI effectively and safely in their work, through hands-on sessions, office hours, and one-on-one support.

Hiring for Lean SuperIntelligence — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

ABOUT US

Lean SuperIntelligence (LSI) is an AI lab building self-improving cybersecurity foundation models for enterprises. LSI publicly announced LSI-Offense-1 and LSI-Defense-1 on October 9, 2026, alongside the closing of its initial pre-seed financing.

LSI-Offense-1 discovers, exploits and validates vulnerabilities; LSI-Defense-1 detects, investigates and responds to threats. The models improve through an offense-defense feedback loop inside LSI Cyber World Models, simulated enterprise environments that turn attack and defense outcomes into training signals.

Founded by Chandra Khatri, LSI brings together foundation-model builders and security researchers. Your work days are brighter here. We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. job.name: Machine Learning Engineer: Perception Analytics
job.description:
Join the team bringing autonomy to the built world

At Bedrock, we're moving AI out of the lab and onto real job sites. Our team includes veterans who helped launch Waymo, scaled Segment to a $3.2B acquisition, and grew Uber Freight to $5B in revenue. We retrofit the heavy equipment contractors already own, starting with excavators, so experienced crews can safely take on more projects and deliver more of the critical infrastructure our society needs.

In August 2026, Bedrock-equipped excavators began doing fully autonomous, paid work on live commercial job sites. We've more than doubled our customer base since 2025, and our machines now work with contractors across the South, Midwest, and Mid-Atlantic

In October 2026, we raised a $600M Series C co-led by CapitalG and Emergence Capital, bringing our total funding to nearly $1B. We're using it to put more autonomous machines to work, build the field and operations teams behind every deployment, and expand into new machine types and job-site tasks.

This is where algorithms meet steel-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world-class engineers to solve physical-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us.

Machine Learning Engineer: Perception Analytics

We are looking for a perception engineer to build features for our customers' analytics. This isn’t just a data science job. This is developing fundamental perception features to drive customer-facing platforms. What are the real-world challenges in measuring dig productivity from lidar/camera data? Can we modify existing perception systems to provide useful metrics for job sites? How do you measure safety over an entire site given perception systems? How do you re-identify the same objects across dozens of camera views on a site several city blocks wide, through dust and changing light?

What You’ll Do

  • Extend, modify and adapt existing perception signals for analytics needs
  • Work with customers to define and scope what is possible with advanced perception systems on-site
  • Deploy models and analytics directly to fleets of machines

What We're Looking For

  • MSc or advanced degree in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field
  • 4+ years of professional experience shipping perception systems to production (ideally on robotic or other embedded platforms), with strong hands-on experience in a modeling framework (e.g. PyTorch)
  • Proficient in Python and comfortable reading and writing at least one systems language (e.g. C++, Rust)
  • Hands-on experience incorporating raw sensor data (camera, lidar, IMU) into learned pipelines
  • Solid grounding in 3D geometry, sensor calibration (intrinsics/extrinsics), coordinate transforms, and camera/image re-projection algorithms
  • Strong data analysis skills across statistical characterization of sensor data, corner-case and anomaly discovery, and evaluation design

job.name: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Homefeed & Search Quality
job.description:
About Pinterest Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Pinterest helps Pinners discover and do what they love. Most of that discovery happens on three surfaces: Homefeed, Search and Related Pins. The Home & Search Quality team decides what hundreds of millions of people see every month on those surfaces. We build the retrieval, ranking and blending systems that make each one personal, relevant and worth coming back to.

We're looking for a Tech Lead for ranking and blending who can drive engineering work across teams and turn state-of-the-art machine learning into better experiences for Pinners. You'll work on large-scale, low-latency systems and models that directly move Pinner engagement and business metrics.

What Will You Do

  • Set the technical direction for ranking and blending on Homefeed, Search and Related Pins, and move the three surfaces toward shared models and shared wins.
  • Build and adapt large foundation models (transformer-based user and content models) into ranking models for each surface.
  • Optimize for long-term value: rank and blend for what brings Pinners back, not only for the next click, while keeping results relevant and high quality.
  • Develop signals for relevance, quality and intent (for example, LLM- and VLM-based embeddings) that are reused across the stack.
  • Make the final ranking stage learned and adaptive, replacing hand-tuned rules and weights.
  • Partner with retrieval, foundation-model, infrastructure and product teams so improvements land across the full stack, from candidate generation to the final page.
  • Mentor and tech-lead a team of 7-10 engineers.

What We Are Looking For

job.name: Member of Technical Staff - Applied AI
job.description:
Who We Are Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress.

Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We’re changing that.

Atoms builds Physical AI— real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive.

This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don’t just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale.

We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life.

If you want to work on hard problems with real-world impact, join us.

About The Role As a Member of Technical Staff focused on Applied AI, you will help shape how advanced machine learning capabilities are developed, adapted, and deployed across Atoms' physical AI systems.

You will work at the intersection of AI research and real-world engineering, translating advances in foundation models, multimodal learning, perception, and embodied intelligence into systems capable of operating in complex, dynamic physical environments.

This is not simply a role focused on integrating existing models or optimizing established machine learning pipelines. You will have the opportunity to develop novel approaches, influence model architectures, and solve challenging problems where existing methods may not be sufficient.

You will work closely with researchers, machine learning engineers, robotics specialists, and autonomy teams to bridge the gap between emerging AI capabilities and their application to intelligent machines.

This is a deeply technical, hands-on individual contributor role with significant influence over Atoms' AI architecture and technical direction.

job.name: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Shield
job.description:
WHAT IS BOX? Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including AstraZeneca, JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.

By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It’s the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

WHY BOX NEEDS YOU Box Shield is an add-on security control that helps you protect the flow of information and reduce content-centric risks with precision — without slowing down work. It allows classification-based security controls to automatically prevent data loss, and AI-powered, context-aware alerts to detect potential data theft and malicious content. Box Shield enables secure hybrid work from anywhere, anytime, and any device with native tools that help secure content at scale.

The Shield team is looking for ML engineers with a passion for building out enterprise security features that are able to handle complex use-cases in a robust and easy-to-use way. Shield’s mission is to protect the flow of an enterprise’s information while delivering frictionless user experience so that Box is the tool of choice for secure Cloud Content Management. Shield helps customers keep their content secure by detecting malicious software in their content, potentially compromised accounts, and anomalous behavior so that Administrators have the right information to act before a problem occurs. As an engineer on our team, you will join a diverse, fast-paced, mainly backend/core team that works together to build new capabilities that help Box’s customers protect their Box content. Security being a horizontal product, you will work across teams to design and implement capabilities that power high-demand use-cases in a future-proof way.

job.name: Applied AI Engineer, Codex Core Agent
job.description:
About The Team The Codex Core Agent team builds the kernel of Codex. We own making the agent better, accelerating research, and making those improvements real in production for our users.

That means working across the systems that make Codex actually function as an agent in the real world: the production performance envelope around tokens, latency, reliability, cost, and capacity; the core execution loop and interfaces that turn models into useful behavior; the shared infrastructure that enables other teams to build on Codex; and the feedback loops that turn real-world usage into better models and better agent behavior over time.

About The Role We’re looking for applied AI engineers to help bring Codex agents from impressive demos to dependable tools. This role is about improving agent performance on real software engineering tasks and closing the gap between research capability and real-world usefulness.

You’ll work closely with research, infrastructure, and product to ensure agents are not just powerful, but useful, steerable, and reliable in practice. The job is not only to improve model behavior in isolation, but to turn those improvements into measurable gains in solve rate, usefulness, and economic value for users.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and iterate on agent behaviors across real-world coding tasks and long-horizon workflows.
  • Work closely with research to develop and run evals to measure agent performance, regressions, failure modes, and edge cases.
  • Improve performance through prompting, tool-use strategies, context construction, and model-facing experimentation.
  • Analyze failures in production and systematically improve robustness and reliability.
  • Build feedback loops and data systems that get better real-task data into evaluation and research.
  • Work with product teams to shape user-facing agent experiences and the interfaces the agent depends on.
  • Help define what “good” looks like for agents completing complex tasks end-to-end.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

  • Have experience building or shipping machine learning or LLM-powered products.
  • Are strong in Python and comfortable with modern ML tooling.
  • Have worked on model evaluation, fine-tuning, or prompt design.
  • Think in terms of systems and user outcomes, not just model metrics.
  • Enjoy debugging messy, real-world failures and turning them into improvements.
  • Want to work in the layer that turns research and model potential into systems that actually work for users.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with agent frameworks or tool-using LLM systems.
  • Research experiencewith code generation models or developer tooling.
  • Experience working with large, messy datasets or production logs.

job.description:
Intelligent machines powered by Artificial Intelligence computers that can learn, reason and interact with people are no longer science fiction. Today, a self-driving car powered by AI can meander through a country road at night and find its way. An AI-powered robot can learn motor skills through trial and error. Do you agree with us that this truly is an extraordinary time and that the era of AI has begun? We are proud that NVIDIA is playing a meaningful role in this development, where our hardware and software platforms power a large eco-system of partners who are working to deliver products, all over the world. In the space of self-driving cars, Nvidia provides the DRIVE AGX hardware platform which runs our DRIVE software.

We are looking for a Senior ML Localization Engineer for Autonomous Vehicles to join us. While reliance on maps has been significantly reduced, available maps continue to help tremendously with reliable autonomous driving, including L3/L4 applications, and route planning. In this role, you will help build robust solutions for localizing on various maps, including ubiquitous navigation maps and our crowd sourced maps, in our driving stack. You will develop both classical and machine learned algorithms to perform localization and determine map correctness. You will work closely with Perception and World Model teams to determine the best tradeoff for using maps in the driving stack. You will contribute to next-generation systems that encode maps into foundation models for better understanding of the overall context.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design and build robust and accurate classical and ML solutions for map enhanced autonomous driving with ASIL safety requirements in mind.
  • Develop algorithms to assess map correctness, detect inconsistencies between maps and onboard observations, and estimate confidence in map information.
  • Collaborate with Perception and World Model teams to determine when and how to use map information, accounting for map availability, accuracy, and freshness.
  • Explore ways to incorporate map context into foundation models for autonomous driving.
  • Make sure our algorithms work well on large amounts of real and synthetic data, in a diverse range of environments and conditions.
  • Write safe, highly efficient real-time code in C++, making use of algorithmic parallelism offered by GPGPU programming in CUDA.
  • Productize all software for real-world deployment to consumer cars, following automotive quality and safety standards (MISRA, ISO26262).

job.description:
Join the team bringing autonomy to the built world

At Bedrock, we're moving AI out of the lab and onto real job sites. Our team includes veterans who helped launch Waymo, scaled Segment to a $3.2B acquisition, and grew Uber Freight to $5B in revenue. We retrofit the heavy equipment contractors already own, starting with excavators, so experienced crews can safely take on more projects and deliver more of the critical infrastructure our society needs.

In August 2026, Bedrock-equipped excavators began doing fully autonomous, paid work on live commercial job sites. We've more than doubled our customer base since 2025, and our machines now work with contractors across the South, Midwest, and Mid-Atlantic

In October 2026, we raised a $600M Series C co-led by CapitalG and Emergence Capital, bringing our total funding to nearly $1B. We're using it to put more autonomous machines to work, build the field and operations teams behind every deployment, and expand into new machine types and job-site tasks.

This is where algorithms meet steel-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world-class engineers to solve physical-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us.

The Mission We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer with a focus on behavior learning, specifically data-driven behavior policies and robust data infrastructure. In this role, you'll be responsible for developing and scaling state-of-the-art learning architectures, while also building the data systems that make these models reliable, scalable, and reproducible in production.

What You’ll Do

  • Build metrics to evaluate model performance in open loop, simulation, and in the real world
  • Collaborate with simulation, systems, and infrastructure teams to integrate ML models into real-world autonomous systems
  • Deploy and debug these models in real-world environments, addressing practical issues such as latency, hardware constraints, and system integration

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of practical experience applying Machine Learning with Deep Learning frameworks, such as PyTorch/Tensorflow/JAX to solve real-world problems
  • 3+ years of professional experience building, deploying, and maintaining Machine Learning models in production environments
  • Familiarity with recent literature and methods in learned behavior policies
  • Practical experience in behavior cloning and/or reinforcement learning
  • Bonus: Experience with diffusion policies, Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, or related technologies

job.name: LLM / GenAI Engineer
job.description:
About The Role The role sits on a team building production LLM systems — RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, fine-tuning infrastructure, and evaluation frameworks — not demos that fall apart under real traffic. The work spans model selection, prompt architecture, retrieval optimization, and the observability needed to keep GenAI features reliable at scale.

This role matters because the difference between a prototype and a production AI system is engineering discipline: systematic evaluation, cost control, latency budgets, and failure handling. The team ships GenAI capabilities that customers use daily, and this engineer will own meaningful pieces of that stack end-to-end.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build production RAG pipelines — chunking strategies, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and context window optimization — using LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom architectures
  • Develop agentic workflows with tool use, function calling, and multi-step orchestration, including guardrails and fallback strategies for failure modes
  • Build systematic LLM evaluation infrastructure: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge pipelines, regression test suites, and automated quality gates in CI/CD
  • Run parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA) and instruction tuning on domain-specific datasets; manage training runs on GPU infrastructure
  • Optimize inference performance and cost — quantization, batching, caching, model routing across OpenAI, Anthropic, and open-weight models (Llama, Mistral, Qwen)
  • Instrument LLM systems for observability: token-level tracing, latency/quality dashboards, and drift detection on retrieval and generation quality
  • Collaborate with product and applied science teams to translate ambiguous requirements into shippable AI features with measurable success criteria

What We Are Looking For

  • 3–6 years of software engineering experience, including at least 1–2 years building and shipping LLM/GenAI systems in production
  • Deep Python skills; comfort with async programming, REST API design, and building services that handle real traffic
  • Hands-on experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, Qdrant) and embedding models in production retrieval systems
  • Practical knowledge of prompt engineering, structured output, and context management — plus the judgment to know when fine-tuning is actually the right answer
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and containerized deployment (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • BS/MS in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience building AI systems
  • Bonus: experience with vLLM or other self-hosted inference stacks, MLflow/W&B for experiment tracking, contribution to open-source LLM tooling, or multi-tenant AI platform experience

Key job responsibilities

As a Machine Learning Engineer with the FAI team, you will support the development of RL Gyms, assess their usefulness for the frontier model advancement and build techniques to advance the state of the art with LLMs. You will support the foundational model development in an applied research role. Your work will directly impact our customers in the form of products and services that make use of GenAI technology. You will leverage Amazon’s heterogeneous data sources and large-scale computing resources to accelerate advances in LLMs.

About The Team The FAI team supports the growth and progress of RL Gyms and assess the value of RL gyms for the frontier model advancement. The team has a mission to push boundaries in GenAI with LLMs, in order to provide the best-possible experience for our customers.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
  • 3+ years of computer science fundamentals (object-oriented design, data structures, algorithm design, problem solving and complexity analysis) experience
  • Experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
  • Master's degree in computer science or equivalent
  • Experience using managed ML/AI solutions

job.description:
Optum Tech is a global leader in health care innovation. Our teams develop cutting-edge solutions that help people live healthier lives and help make the health system work better for everyone. From advanced data analytics and AI to cybersecurity, we use innovative approaches to solve some of health care's most complex challenges. Your contributions here have the potential to change lives. Ready to build the next breakthrough? Join us in making healthcare work better for everyone through people-led, responsible AI while Caring. Connecting. Growing together. The Optum Health Technology team is seeking a Senior AI/ML Engineer with a solid data science background to build and scale cutting-edge AI-powered solutions that transform value-based care delivery. In this role, you will lead the design, development, statistical analysis, and enterprise deployment of machine learning models, generative AI architectures, predictive analytics, and intelligent automations that directly improve patient health outcomes and operational efficiency. You will collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, data architects, product managers, and clinical leaders to translate complex clinical data into actionable intelligence, streamline healthcare workflows, empower clinical decision-making, and deliver scalable value across the care continuum.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely \* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges. For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered solutions to address complex healthcare challenges with an emphasis on the responsible and ethical use of AI
  • Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA), feature engineering, statistical modeling, and hypothesis testing on large-scale clinical and healthcare datasets
  • Leverage enterprise-approved AI tools and frameworks to streamline engineering workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and drive continuous process improvement
  • Evaluate emerging AI/ML trends, foundational models, statistical techniques, and technical tools to inform architectural solution design and strategic innovation
  • Build, optimize, and maintain production-grade machine learning pipelines and predictive models for data preprocessing, model training, evaluation, and monitoring
  • Architect scalable microservices and APIs to integrate machine learning models and data science capabilities seamlessly into enterprise applications and clinical workflows
  • Collaborate with cross-functional technical, data, and clinical teams to translate high-level business objectives into robust, secure, and performant solutions
  • Implement MLOps best practices to ensure continuous integration, automated model evaluation, governance, model tracking, and reliable deployment at enterprise scale

job.name: Forward Deployed AI Engineer, Travel Intelligence
job.description:
About The Role Hopper powers travel for some of the world’s largest banks, airlines and travel companies, and our Research team builds travel-specialized models. As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer you take that work into a partner’s environment and make it theirs: building the evaluation with their team, preparing their data, training and evaluating the model, and putting it into production where it delivers measurable results. You work in a small forward-deployed team as the person who leads model training on site, across servicing, loyalty, commerce and more, and you are the bridge between our partners and Research.

What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like

  • Work with a partner’s data and business teams to turn their real tasks into a frozen, held-out benchmark across their priority use cases
  • Define what success means for each task, covering task completion, policy adherence, cost and response time, and build the automated graders with human spot checks
  • Establish baselines so results can be compared fairly
  • Prepare training data inside the partner’s environment through extraction, redaction, deduplication, labelling and train/test splits, using only the data the agreed tasks need
  • Run post-training in partnership with Research, applying modern fine-tuning methods to partner use cases
  • Run training on the partner’s cloud and GPUs, or in an environment they approve, under their security and access rules
  • Design experiments that show partners clearly what drives the results
  • Take models from evaluation into production based on evidence, then monitor quality, latency and cost once they are live
  • Use production results to keep improving the model
  • Present results, method and trade-offs to partner data and technology leaders, and defend them
  • Work closely with Research, feeding back what you learn in the field
  • Turn each deployment into reusable tooling so the next partner goes faster
  • Uphold strict data handling, privacy and security standards in every partner environment, and support partner model-risk, security and compliance reviews with clear documentation of data, training and evaluation

job.name: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
job.description:
About AGF Management Limited: Founded in 1957, AGF Management Limited (AGF) is an independent and globally diverse asset management firm. Our companies deliver excellence in investing in the public and private markets through three business lines: AGF Investments, AGF Capital Partners and AGF Private Wealth.

AGF brings a disciplined approach, focused on incorporating sound, responsible and sustainable corporate practices. The firm’s collective investment expertise, driven by its fundamental, quantitative and alternative investing capabilities, extends globally to a wide range of clients, from financial advisors and their clients to high-net worth and institutional investors including pension plans, corporate plans, sovereign wealth funds, endowments and foundations.

Headquartered in Toronto, Canada, AGF has investment operations and client servicing teams on the ground in North America and Europe. AGF serves more than 820,000 investors. AGF trades on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the symbol AGF.B.

About the Team: AGF is building an enterprise-wide Artificial Intelligence capability to improve client outcomes, investment performance, operational effectiveness, and employee productivity. Through its AI Centre of Expertise (AI CoE), AGF is establishing the governance, technology, talent, and operating model needed to responsibly scale AI across the organization.

As part of this strategy, AGF is creating a team of Forward Deployed AI Engineers who will work at the intersection of business strategy, technology, and AI innovation to identify, build, and deploy solutions that create measurable business value. Initial priorities will focus on Investment Management and Distribution, with expansion across all business functions over time.

About the Role: The Forward Deployed AI Engineer is a hands-on technical expert responsible for partnering directly with business stakeholders to identify opportunities, design solutions, and build production-grade AI applications that solve real business problems.

This role combines the technical depth of an experienced AI engineer with the business acumen of a consultant. You will work closely with portfolio managers, investment professionals, distribution teams, operations leaders, and other subject matter experts to understand their challenges and rapidly deliver AI-enabled solutions that drive growth, increase productivity, improve decision-making, and enhance client outcomes.

Unlike traditional software development roles, Forward Deployed AI Engineers spend significant time engaging with business teams, understanding workflows, and translating business opportunities into working solutions. You will own the delivery lifecycle from discovery and design through implementation, deployment, adoption, and ongoing support.

job.name: Planning Specialist
job.description:
Planning Specialist is responsible for balancing the demand & supply at all the warehouses across India. He is responsible for ensuring that the right amount of stock is available at the right time. He is responsible for the end – to – end Supply chain planning of VISIT materials (800+ SKUs). He must ensure continuous development and implementation of the S&OP process for the VISIT materials and update the demand at a monthly level. He is responsible for the replenishment to the regional warehouses basis the monthly forecast from sales and ensure the replenishment is done with sufficient safety stock. He must ensure the updating of VISIT material forecast in APO DP ,track the arrivals and deployment of the same.

All the responsibilities we'll trust you with: Supply planning and inventory Ensuring the monthly demand and 12-months rolling forecast is aligned with sales at the month end planning meeting Review, identify and communicate the supply constraints against the forecast with sales and balance the supply and demand in the planning horizon to meet the requirement Collate the final aligned 12-months rolling sales forecast from the sales team and update the same in APO DP at the end of each month Prepare and execute the replenishment plan for each warehouse against the month forecast against set inventory norms for finished goods and POSM Create and execute the local stock deployment plan based on inventory levels and warehouse space Monitoring & analyzing the Low Shelf-life inventory for FG and sharing the visibility with the business on the same. Projections on SLOB.

Integrated Business Planning (IBP) Process Process execution for the IBP process Execution of the demand plan on a monthly level with a mid term outlook Perform the demand planning step to align the sales and supply chain parameters. Run the monthly planning meetings for Demand and Supply Planning Execute the S&OP IBP process for Red Bull India and give feedback on the variations. Dashboard commenting and responsible for the IBP India score. Maintenance and calculations of monthly target inventory levels based on the lead time variations and business objectives.

S&OP Planning Process for VISIT Managing and deploying S&OP process for VISIT materials with all the stakeholders, focus on the monthly stock arrival & deployment Monitor and review the realization of the plans together with the stakeholders (Planning – Logistics - Sales – Customer Service - Finance) and incorporate changes into the plan if necessary Ensure to update the consensus demand for VISIT items in APO DP and periodically review the purchase requisition generated by the system Plan and execute the monthly meeting for the VISIT material execution with a focus on stock levels and deployment

job.name: Sr Software Engineer, iOS
job.description:
The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary: What You Need To Know About The Role- As a Senior iOS Software Engineer, you will lead the architecture and quality of the PayPal POS iOS app, including payment-critical flows such as Tap to Pay on iPhone, Key In and reader connectivity. You will guide the team through taking over ownership of the app from our Sweden colleagues and set the bar for how we build, test and release.

Meet our team

job.name: Ecommerce & Marketplace Growth Manager
job.description:
About the Company

Litverse and Homeverse are growing e-commerce brands in the lighting and home décor categories, selling through leading online marketplaces and digital channels. We are focused on expanding our marketplace presence, strengthening our D2C business and building scalable, profitable e-commerce operations.

We are looking for a hands-on E-commerce & Marketplace Growth Manager to take ownership of the online business across both brands.

Location: New Delhi

Experience: 3–6 Years

Industry: Lighting & Home Décor

About the Role

Litverse is looking for a hands-on, result-oriented E-commerce Manager to take ownership of our online business, drive marketplace growth, expand into quick commerce and ensure overall business profitability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and grow sales across Amazon, Flipkart and our Shopify website.
  • Lead onboarding and business operations on Blinkit and Swiggy Instamart.
  • Independently manage Amazon PPC, Flipkart Ads and Shopify advertising campaigns, optimizing budgets, ROAS and profitability.
  • Handle product listings, catalogue management, keyword research, SEO and listing optimization.
  • Manage inventory planning, stock levels, replenishment and order fulfilment.
  • Maintain SKU-level sales, cost and profitability analysis, marketplace settlements, reconciliations and financial records.
  • Monitor returns, cancellations, courier operations and marketplace account health.
  • Identify growth opportunities and ensure applicable BIS compliance for lighting and electrical products.

Requirements

  • 3–6 years of hands-on e-commerce and marketplace management experience.
  • Strong knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, Flipkart Seller Hub and Shopify.
  • Proven experience in marketplace advertising and performance optimization.
  • Good understanding of inventory management, financial analysis and SKU-level profitability.
  • Experience of Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart and BIS compliance preferred.
  • Experience in Solar Lighting, electricals, home décor or consumer durables will be an advantage.

We are looking for someone who can independently manage, scale and drive the profitability of our entire e-commerce business.

Interested Candidates can share their CV at abhimanyugulati12@gmail.com

About Accenture Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. What would you do? The primary responsibility of the role is to proactively manage the delivery of Group Management and Statutory Reporting information in line with the agreed service level agreements by acting as a P&L owner. job.description:
Introduction A career in IBM Consulting embraces long-term relationships and close collaboration with clients across the globe. In this role, you will work for IBM BPO, part of Consulting that, accelerates digital transformation using agile methodologies, process mining, and AI-powered workflows.

You'll work with visionaries across multiple industries to improve the hybrid cloud and AI journey for the most innovative and valuable companies in the world. Your ability to accelerate impact and make meaningful change for your clients is enabled by our strategic partner ecosystem and our robust technology platforms across the IBM portfolio, including IBM Software and Red Hat.

Curiosity and a constant quest for knowledge serve as the foundation to success in IBM Consulting. In your role, you'll be supported by mentors and coaches who will encourage you to challenge the norm, investigate ideas outside of your role, and come up with creative solutions resulting in groundbreaking impact for a wide network of clients. Our culture of evolution and empathy centers on long-term career growth and learning opportunities in an environment that embraces your unique skills and experience.

Your Role And Responsibilities As a Process Innovation Professional specializing in Lead to Cash, you will leverage your expertise to lead organizations through complex transactions across multiple departments. The office was established with an initial concentration of finance, operations, and technology personnel, followed by the expansion of additional functions and capabilities. KKR’s creation of a Gurugram office builds upon the firm's momentum in India and bolsters its existing presence in Mumbai.

By doing so, we produce accurate financial information for decision making, ensure compliance with financial regulations and policies, and provide leadership for operational improvements, cost savings and strategic investments that align with the Firm’s culture and long-term goals.

job.name: Operations & Logistics Manager
job.description:
About The Role Airports are no longer just transport nodes – they are dynamic, multi-layered ecosystems shaping the entire traveller journey. At Uber, we see a significant opportunity to redefine how mobility integrates into that ecosystem. At Uber, we see a meaningful opportunity to positively shape the travel experience for riders around the world. The India & South Asia (InSA) Airports & Places team is responsible for building and scaling Uber’s business across airports and other strategic hubs.This role is focused on delivering exceptional rider and driver experiences across travel hubs, while acting as a true strategic partner to airport operators, railway stations and other key ecosystem stakeholders. It goes beyond operational excellence — it is about resetting how we partner with airports: evolving from transactional contract management to long-term, strategic collaboration.

We are seeking an Operations Manager who will act as a strategic ops partner to India’s leading airport operators, drive marketplace performance, lead airport expansion, and unlock innovation opportunities across the ecosystem.

This is a high-impact role offering end-to-end business ownership – spanning Marketplace, Product, Launch, Operations, Expansion, Analytics and Revenue Growth.

What The Candidate Will Do

  • Own and deepen daily operating relationships with airport operators
  • Identify and co-build innovative mobility solutions across the full traveller journey
  • Strategic planning, GTM, launch and management of new airports
  • Drive airport marketplace performance through pricing, incentives, supply positioning and category mix optimisation
  • Ensure seamless, scalable pickup operations with strong reliability, minimal wait times and operational discipline
  • Work with global Tech teams to launch and scale airport-specific Product innovations (e.g., PIN expansion, zoning models, new category rollouts)
  • Use data-driven insights to unlock growth, efficiency and incremental revenue opportunities
  • Build scalable playbooks and operating frameworks deployable across multiple airports
  • Partner cross-functionally across BD, Policy, Comms, Product, RiderOps and Legal to deliver measurable results

What The Candidate Will Need

  • 3+ years of experience in operations, consulting, strategy, business intelligence or related fields
  • Demonstrated stakeholder or partner management experience
  • Strong commercial acumen and comfort in negotiation environments
  • Advanced Excel/data management skills; SQL strongly preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA preferred
  • Strong leadership and cross-functional influence capabilities
  • Structured problem-solving ability and intellectual curiosity
  • High ownership mindset with bias toward action
  • Ability to operate in ambiguity and scale processes across regions

job.name: Senior Analyst, Enterprise D&D Planning
job.description:
At Aristocrat, we believe in creating the world's greatest gaming and entertainment experiences through innovation, and meticulous investment. Our success is driven by our focus on delivering value to players, customers, and shareholders. We are looking for a highly organized and analytically strong finance professional to join our Development & Design Finance group as a Senior Analyst, Enterprise D&D Planning. This role is pivotal in bringing greater structure, consistency, and coordination to our annual planning, rolling forecasts, and headcount planning activities.

For individuals eager to improve processes, promote alignment across teams, and ease complex planning cycles, this position offers extensive interaction with Finance, People & Culture, Group Finance, RCOE, and D&D leadership.

What You'll Do

As Senior Analyst, Enterprise D&D Planning, you will support the core planning and forecasting operating rhythm for D&D. You will assist in structuring timelines, templates, inputs, assumptions, and follow-ups so finance partners and business leaders can plan with greater accuracy, consistency, and accountability.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Support the planning and forecasting calendar across D&D, including annual plan, rolling forecast, monthly updates, and key submission achievements.
  • Assemble and synchronize inputs across Finance, Studios, Product, Technology, People & Culture, Group Finance, and RCOE to support alignment and timely delivery of planning assumptions.
  • Keep transparent trackers for forecast submissions, open items, risks, delayed inputs, approvals, and follow-up actions.
  • Help prepare planning outputs that are consistent, comparable, and ready for D&D Finance and leadership review.
  • Develop, sustain, and enhance headcount planning templates across D&D, incorporating role-level, location, cost center, hiring, attrition, and transfer inputs.
  • Help establish a more structured operating rhythm for planning across D&D, reducing last-minute churn and improving transparency.
  • Partner closely with People & Culture and Finance teams to align headcount assumptions, open roles, hiring timing, compensation inputs, and workforce changes.
  • Create repeatable processes and controls that improve data quality, reduce rework, and make headcount planning easier to manage across cycles.
  • Support clear variance explanations for headcount, compensation, and related cost movements across plan, forecast, and actuals.
  • Find opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve planning and forecasting processes across D&D.
  • Maintain planning documentation, process maps, templates, and operating guides to support consistency and knowledge transfer.
  • Build trusted relationships by being responsive, organized, and clear on ownership and next steps.
  • Support alignment across collaborators by bringing structure, clarity, and follow-through to complex, multi-participant planning cycles.

About Analog Devices Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.

Software Engineer Automotive cabin electronics (ACE) software team’s charter is to develop/lead technology domains with highly differentiated sensing, signal processing and network solutions for automotive infotainment in general and digital signal processors (DSPs) and in-vehicle connectivity (GMSL, A2B, Ethernet – E2B).

Position Summary and Job Responsibilities: This position will be responsible for developing production ready software following a defined software development process. Products that will be developed are audio/sensor connectivity with proprietary ADI networks like E2B, etc. Position will consist of developing automotive SW solutions – embedded, written in C/C++ and PC/host based supporting tools, written in C#. The person will be responsible for end-to-end software development by taking proof-of-concept technology to production.

  • Develop production ready embedded solutions and ROM based firmware for automotive products
  • Develop middleware software stacks for Ethernet based protocols & ADI proprietary bus protocols like E2B.
  • Also work on cyber security stacks including MACSEC and MKA – Design, development & compliance.
  • Understanding challenges in customers’ SDV and zonal architectures and translating into SW requirements
  • Analyze customer and internal requirements and specifications and translate these into software requirements and designs.
  • Analyze existing embedded software to add features, optimize, fix defects, and/or port to different platforms.
  • Test software designs and code at the unit level (developer tests) to ensure that all requirements are met, and the highest software quality is achieved.
  • Develop automated embedded software tests.
  • Identify product requirement or performance issues. Work with external teams as necessary to resolve issues in a timely manner.

Supervisory Responsibilities: This position does not have any direct or indirect reports, but the candidate is expected to be self-driven.

job.name: Software Engineer - IOS
job.description:
Company Overview Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

What you'll do

Docusign's Mobile Engineering team is looking for a motivated Software Engineer (P2) to help build and refine our native iOS application. Docusign is redefining how the world handles agreements, moving beyond e-signatures to a platform that makes agreements smarter, faster, and more connected across the entire agreement lifecycle. Our team's charter is twofold: to support the complex, high-volume use cases of our enterprise customers while maintaining the world-class usability and polish that consumers expect from top App Store applications. As a P2 engineer, you will focus on building user-facing application features, fixing bugs, and improving app performance. You will write clean Swift code, write unit tests, and work alongside senior engineers to grow your technical skills in a collaborative Agile environment.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to Senior Engineering Manager.

*Responsibility*

  • Design and build engaging, native user experiences for the Docusign iOS app using Swift
  • Write clean, maintainable code and unit tests to ensure high performance and application stability
  • Work closely with Product Managers, UI/UX Designers, QA, and backend engineers to turn feature requirements into working mobile software
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues and performance bottlenecks reported by users or automated tools
  • Actively participate in team sprint planning, daily standups, and code reviews to give and receive constructive feedback
  • Stay updated with new Apple features, tools, and iOS updates to help continuous team improvement

Job Designation

Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job.
