An extraordinarily talented group of individuals work together every day to drive TNS' success, from both professional and personal perspectives. Come join the excellence!

Overview The Field Support area is responsible for providing on-site technical or non technical product support and service to customers.

Responsibilities The Financial Markets Global IP Desk will contribute to the success of the team supporting the stability and availability of the TNS Financial Markets infrastructure and services by raising service incident tickets and assigning them to an appropriate engineer.

This position is part of the Global IP Desk with a close relationship to the Technical Support Group which serves as second level escalation on all IP related Network Control Center issues. Primary responsibilities will be to resolve any issues including complex IP network routing, hardware, and protocol issues on the TNS global core and Financial Markets network. This will also include opening tickets with Vendor Help desks (Cisco and Juniper TAC) and escalating problems for engineering support when necessary. The technical support engineer will also be responsible for maintaining and updating assigned tickets providing peace of mind.

The role being within the Financial Markets industry, liaising with TNS customer’s technical representatives requires solid technical understanding in relation to network, systems infrastructure and datacenters, as well as understanding of Financial Markets and Financial Exchanges.

  • Provide support of global large scale TCP/IP, VPN and MPLS networks to include OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, RIP, IS-IS protocols
  • Hands-on configuration and troubleshooting of Cisco, Arista and Juniper routers and switches
  • Vendor management, to include extensive interface with Cisco and Juniper TAC
  • Second-level network and protocol troubleshooting and debugging
  • Coordination, scheduling and support of network maintenance and change management activities . Any change in network is scheduled as per the Change Management Policy, including second sighted to avoid any errors for that change during its implementation.

  • Operation Readiness, final checks for project acceptance into the NOC for handover support.
  • Incident management, ensure all clients and network incidents are restored with minimal service impact.

job.name: Head of Business Technology Intelligence
job.description:
If you’re looking for further opportunities to develop your career, take the next step in fulfilling your potential right here at HSBC.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 58 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role Head of Business Technology Intelligence .

The Opportunity Data and Analytics Professionals at HSBC have responsibility for executing our HSBC Data Strategy. Their responsibilities are threefold:

  • Recognising data as an asset to HSBC by managing Data Risk and ensuring we are compliant with our Data standards and policies;
  • Using analytics and data science to unlock the value of our data; and
  • Implementing and maintaining our Data Technologies. Data and Analytics Professionals are geographically dispersed and aligned to the Global Businesses / Global Functions or regions.

What You Will Do As an influential and visionary servant leader, you’ll lead and empower delivery teams to execute the Group Business and Technology Data Strategy and roadmap. You’ll provide direct and indirect leadership, fostering innovation across the organisation through agile ways of working and effective agile leadership.

Leading by example, you’ll enable teams to deliver high-quality technology, data products and services that meet customer and business requirements. You’ll help create an environment where people can succeed, collaborate effectively and deliver measurable value at pace.

The Head of Data Group Chief Information Office is accountable for the strategic design, implementation, governance, and ongoing management of the end-to-end enterprise data model across Group Chief Information Office. The role ensures that data is structured, governed, trusted, and managed as a strategic asset, enabling effective decision-making, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and technology transformation.

The role leads the development and execution of the organisation's data architecture, data quality, lineage, metadata, and data management capabilities, establishing robust controls and standards across the technology estate while driving adoption and accountability throughout the organisation.

job.name: Senior AI Scientist
job.description:
We're looking for a *Senior AI Scientist This role is Office Based, Hyderabad Office Role Overview* We are looking for a Senior AI Scientist to drive the research, development, and deployment of advanced Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions across the organization. The role will focus on solving complex business and product problems using modern AI techniques, including Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), NLP, recommendation systems, deep learning, reinforcement learning, and agentic AI.

The ideal candidate combines strong scientific thinking with hands-on engineering capabilities and can take AI ideas from research and experimentation through production deployment and continuous optimization.

In This Role You Will

  • Design and develop LLM, Generative AI, RAG, NLP, recommendation, personalization, and agentic AI solutions.
  • Research and evaluate state-of-the-art AI/ML techniques and determine their applicability to business problems.
  • Develop and fine-tune foundation models, domain-specific models, embedding models, and task-specific models.
  • Design training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and inference pipelines for AI models.
  • Apply techniques such as transformer architectures, LLM fine-tuning, RAG, embeddings, vector search, deep learning, reinforcement learning, contextual bandits, and information retrieval.
  • Develop experimentation frameworks and establish metrics for model quality, relevance, accuracy, robustness, latency, and cost.
  • Investigate model behavior through experimentation, error analysis, ablation studies, and statistical analysis.
  • Build prototypes and proof-of-concepts and transition successful approaches into production systems.
  • Collaborate with Software Engineering, Product, Data Engineering, and Platform teams to productionize AI solutions.
  • Optimize models and AI systems for accuracy, scalability, latency, memory, and inference cost.
  • Design and implement model evaluation frameworks, including automated, human, and LLM-based evaluation.
  • Stay current with advances in AI research and translate relevant research into practical solutions.
  • Publish internal research, technical documentation, patents, or external research papers where appropriate.

You've Got What It Takes If You Have

  • Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in AI/ML, Data Science, or a closely related field.
  • Strong understanding of machine learning and deep learning fundamentals.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Python and modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Experience developing and deploying machine learning models at scale.

job.name: SDE-3
job.description:
Job Description – Senior Software Development Engineer (SDE-3), ERP L3 Support

Position Details

  • Designation: Senior Software Development Engineer (SDE-3)
  • Department: ERP Technical Support – L3
  • Experience: 8–10+ Years
  • Employment Type: Full-Time
  • Reporting To: Team Lead
  • Location: Kolkata

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced and technically strong Senior Software Development Engineer (SDE-3) to join our ERP L3 Support team. The candidate will be responsible for handling complex production issues, performing in-depth code-level analysis, identifying root causes, implementing permanent fixes, and ensuring the stability and performance of the ERP application.

The role requires strong hands-on experience in C#, ASP.NET, Oracle/PostgreSQL databases, enterprise application architecture, debugging, and production issue resolution. The candidate will also contribute to code reviews, technical mentoring, process improvements, and collaboration with Product, QA, DevOps, and Implementation teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced Debugging & Technical Investigation – Primary Focus
  • Independently investigate complex and critical production issues across large-scale ERP applications.
  • Perform deep code-level debugging to identify the exact point of failure and underlying cause.
  • Analyse application execution flow, call stacks, exception traces, logs, database transactions, and API requests/responses.
  • Debug issues involving complex business logic, multi-layer application architecture, and database interactions.
  • Troubleshoot intermittent, environment-specific, customer-specific, and version-specific issues.
  • Identify the difference between symptoms, contributing factors, and the actual root cause.
  • Reproduce production issues in controlled environments wherever possible.
  • Investigate issues that cannot be reproduced locally by analysing production logs, data patterns, code paths, and execution behaviour.
  • Identify hidden dependencies and side effects that may impact other ERP modules or business processes.
  • Problem Solving & Permanent Solution

About The Company Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. Netspend's financial products and services span prepaid, debit, cross-border payments, and loyalty solutions for consumers and enterprise partners.

Netspend provides prepaid and debit account solutions that connect customers with secure, convenient access to global payment networks so they can manage their money and make everyday purchases. With a nationwide U.S. retail network, customers can purchase and reload Netspend products at 130,000 reload points and over 100,000 distributing locations.

Since our founding in 1999 by industry pioneers, Netspend products have processed billions of dollars in transaction volume and served millions of customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide.

Role Overview As a Senior Network Engineer, you will be responsible for the architecture, deployment, and optimization of our global, high-availability network infrastructure across data centers and AWS cloud environments. Your role involves expert-level knowledge in managing complex enterprise routing and switching, designing and maintaining enterprise Wireless Infrastructure (Cisco Meraki), configuring enterprise-grade firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto), and integrating hybrid cloud solutions. You will bridge the gap between high-level business goals and technical execution, ensuring our network is cost-optimized, secure by design, and resilient.

job.name: Network Engineer – AWS & Cisco Migration IRC303755
job.description:
Description Network Engineer – AWS & Cisco Migration

Requirements Role Summary We are seeking a highly skilled Network Engineer with deep expertise in Cisco networking technologies and AWS cloud networking to lead and execute the migration of on‑premises and Cisco‑based network infrastructure into AWS. This role will be responsible for designing, building, securing, and operating hybrid and cloud‑native network architectures while modernizing legacy Cisco environments.

The ideal candidate has hands‑on experience with Cisco firewalls, routing/switching, VPNs, and BGP, combined with strong practical knowledge of AWS VPC design, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, and cloud security controls.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional experience as a Network Engineer, with strong Cisco networking background.
  • 3+ years of hands‑on experience designing and supporting AWS networking.
  • Deep expertise in Cisco routing and switching, including BGP and OSPF.
  • Strong experience with Cisco firewalls (ASA, FTD, ASAv/FTDv) and VPN technologies.
  • Solid understanding of AWS VPCs, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Route 53, and Elastic Load Balancing.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex network issues in production environments.
  • Experience migrating large‑scale enterprise networks from Cisco to AWS.
  • Hands‑on experience with Terraform (preferred) or CloudFormation.
  • Familiarity with container networking (EKS, Kubernetes CNI).
  • AWS and/or Cisco certifications such as: – AWS Advanced Networking – Specialty – CCNP Enterprise or CCNP Security

Job responsibilities

Cisco to AWS Migration

  • Lead network migration initiatives from Cisco on‑premises and datacenter environments to AWS.
  • Assess existing Cisco architectures (ASA/FTD, routers, switches) and define migration strategies to AWS‑native or virtualized equivalents (ASAv/FTDv, Transit Gateway, AWS Network Firewall).
  • Migrate and validate ACLs, NAT rules, VPNs (Site‑to‑Site and Client VPN), and routing policies in AWS.

AWS Networking & Hybrid Connectivity

  • Design and implement AWS VPC architectures, including CIDR planning, subnets, routing tables, gateways (IGW/NAT), and security boundaries.
  • Build and operate hybrid connectivity using Site‑to‑Site VPN and AWS Direct Connect with BGP and high availability.
  • Implement Transit Gateway architectures for large‑scale, multi‑account environments.

Network Security & Compliance

  • Deploy and manage Cisco firewalls (ASA, FTD, ASAv/FTDv) and/or AWS‑native security services.
  • Implement network security best practices using security groups, NACLs, and logging (VPC Flow Logs).
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC, PCI, HIPAA where applicable) through secure network design and documentation.

Automation, Operations & Troubleshooting

Job Title: Senior Software Engineer Job Description This Senior Software Engineer role focuses on supporting and enhancing an existing Battery Management Systems (BMS) product line while leading development of the next-generation platform. You will join a small multidisciplinary engineering team at a foundational stage, directly influencing system architecture, capabilities, and engineering practices that shape future products. The position spans the full product development V-model, from concept through production, and requires strong electronics fundamentals, hands-on product experience, and the ability to work effectively across engineering disciplines with limited direction.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and support Battery Management System (BMS) software from requirements and architecture through integration, verification, and production release.

  • Provide technical direction and oversight for software activities performed by external engineering partners.
  • Work across the full product development V-model, including requirements definition, design, implementation, integration, and verification.
  • Develop and debug embedded software that interfaces directly with electronics, sensors, communications buses, and control hardware.
  • Ensure robust requirements traceability, software architecture, configuration management, and structured verification throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Independently take ambiguous technical objectives, define the required work, and drive tasks to completion with minimal direction.
  • Solve problems that cross software, hardware, systems, and test boundaries rather than focusing only on isolated software tasks.
  • Communicate technical decisions, risks, and trade-offs clearly across engineering disciplines and stakeholders.

This role focuses on evaluating MMIS procurement alternatives through Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), Cost Benefit Analysis (CBA), and Analysis of Alternatives (AoA), helping inform critical RFP decisions.

  • Conduct post-project lessons-learned reviews to support knowledge transfer and customer satisfaction.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • 10+ years of IT Sourcing Consulting experience.
  • Experience and familiarity with CMS's Analysis of Alternatives (AoA) template and MMIS RFP Cost Benefit Analysis.
  • Medicaid Enterprise Systems (MES) / Medicaid Management Information Systems (MMIS) consulting experience.
  • CMS Advanced Planning Document (APD) support experience.
  • Medicaid consulting expertise in gathering industry information and developing Total Cost of Ownership and Cost Benefit Analysis for MMIS RFP alternatives.

job.name: Lead UI/UX Designer
job.description:
As the UX Lead for our ServiceNow platform, you will drive consistency across our UX and UI, document and own the standards that get us there, and build the design system and practice that make great experiences repeatable

rather than accidental. This is a hands on leadership role. You will set the design direction and build it, in UI Builder and in React.

This is a pivotal moment for experience on our platform. We are raising our ambition from enterprise tolerable to consumer grade, moving beyond a traditional ITSM mindset to design solutions our users genuinely want to use.You will own the success and adoption of what we ship, not just the design behind it.

You will establish a formal UX practice on the platform from the ground up and lead the designers and developers

who join it. Strong stakeholder management and communication are central to the role. You will be the advocate for experience who aligns product, engineering, and business around a shared bar for quality, and holds us to it.

What you will do

UX Standards and Consistency

  • Own and document the UX and UI standards for the platform, and drive their adoption across every team building on ServiceNow.
  • Build and own a design system and component library so that consistency is built in, not policed after the fact.
  • Establish design patterns, guidelines, and reusable components that raise the floor on every solution we ship.
  • Define what “good” looks like on the platform and hold teams to it through design reviews and clear standards.

Consumer Grade Experience and Adoption

  • Move the platform beyond a traditional ITSM mindset and design solutions where the experience is consumer grade.
  • Own the success and adoption of the solutions we ship. Define what adoption looks like, measure it, and use

it to drive design decisions.

  • Partner with product and business teams to make sure we are solving the real user problem, not just delivering the requested feature.
  • Bring an outside-in view of quality, benchmarked against the consumer products our users actually compare us to.

Hands On Design and Build

  • Design and build experiences directly in UI Builder and the Now Experience Framework.
  • Write front-end code in React to build components, prototypes, and production experiences where native tooling is not enough.
  • Move fluidly between design and implementation so that what gets shipped matches what was designed.
  • Set front-end engineering standards for the UX work on the platform.

User Research and Accessibility

  • Stand up a user research practice. Talk to real users, run usability testing, and bring evidence to design decisions rather than opinion.
  • Own accessibility on the platform. Make sure what we build meets WCAG standards and works for everyone, and build accessibility into the design system rather than retrofitting it.
  • Turn research and accessibility from checkboxes into a genuine part of how the team works.

Mobile Experience

CGI est à la recherche d’un(e) scientifique en intelligence artificielle pour contribuer à des initiatives menées au sein de la fonction Données et analytique d’une grande institution financière.

Vous participerez à la conception et au déploiement de solutions en apprentissage automatique et en IA générative afin d’améliorer l’expérience client et employé, d’automatiser certaines activités et d’accroître l’efficacité opérationnelle. Les projets pourront notamment porter sur les assistants conversationnels, les architectures RAG et les systèmes agentiques.

Concevoir, entraîner, évaluer et optimiser des modèles d’apprentissage automatique répondant à des besoins d’affaires.

Développer des solutions d’IA générative faisant appel aux LLM, aux architectures RAG et aux systèmes agentiques ou multiagents.

Participer à la création de chatbots, d’assistants intelligents et d’outils d’automatisation.

Collaborer avec les partenaires d’affaires pour cerner les occasions où l’IA peut accélérer les processus et améliorer l’efficacité opérationnelle.

Développer les composantes nécessaires à l’entraînement, à l’évaluation, au déploiement et à l’évolution des solutions.

Évaluer la performance, la robustesse et la fiabilité des modèles.

Contribuer à l’adoption de pratiques responsables en matière d’IA, de gouvernance et de gestion des risques.

Travailler avec les scientifiques de données et les équipes d’affaires afin d’identifier et de prioriser les cas d’usage à valeur ajoutée.

Diplôme universitaire en informatique, en intelligence artificielle, en mathématiques, en statistique, en recherche opérationnelle ou dans un domaine connexe.

Environ 3 à 5 ans d’expérience pertinente en apprentissage automatique ou en intelligence artificielle.

Expérience en apprentissage automatique et en apprentissage profond.

Expérience en IA générative, avec les LLM et les approches RAG.

Expérience dans des environnements infonuagiques et capacité à développer, valider et déployer des modèles en production.

Connaissance d’outils tels qu’AWS, Snowflake, Git, GitHub Copilot ou Jenkins.

Capacité à concilier expertise technique et compréhension des besoins d’affaires.

Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais.

job.name: AI Engineer
job.description:
Job Title: Applied AI Engineer

Location: Montreal, QC (Hybrid)

Experience: 3 to 5 years of software engineering, including 1 to 3 years building with generative AI

Role summary:

Build AI agents and LLM applications that run inside the firm's enterprise systems, taking them from first prototype to a service other teams can rely on. You will work alongside senior platform engineers and learn how large regulated systems fit together: how requests are authenticated, how services talk to each other, and how code gets safely to production. Strong engineering fundamentals matter more here than the number of AI frameworks you have used.

What you will do:

  • Build agents and LLM workflows using tool calling, RAG and MCP, connected to enterprise systems through their APIs.
  • Turn prototypes into services that hold up: clean APIs, tests, logging, error handling and documentation others can run.
  • Work within the firm's authentication and entitlement controls when your code calls other systems.
  • Package and deploy your work in containers on Kubernetes through the team's CI/CD pipelines.
  • Write evaluations for prompts and agents, so changes are measured before they ship.
  • Work with business partners to scope use cases and explain trade-offs in plain terms.
  • Apply responsible AI, security and data protection controls to everything you build.

Must have:

  • 3 to 5 years of software engineering with strong Python.
  • Solid fundamentals: data structures, async and concurrency, and networking basics (HTTP, DNS, TLS).
  • Built and consumed REST APIs; understand authentication basics such as OAuth 2.0, tokens and API keys, and why services should not share credentials.
  • Git, code review, unit and integration testing, and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins or similar).
  • Docker, and a working understanding of how applications run on Kubernetes.
  • SQL and at least one NoSQL store.
  • 1 to 3 years building with LLMs: prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector databases and tool calling.
  • Can read and debug code in a larger codebase you did not write, using logs and traces to find problems.

Nice to have:

At Aviva Canada , we put people first, our employees, our customers, and our communities. We’re proud of a culture built on care, inclusion, and collaboration, where your voice matters and your growth is supported. job.name: Data Scientist
job.description:
Our mission is to Profoundly change the standard of care by creating a tomorrow where clinicians can confidently ablate tissue with precision; a tomorrow where patients have access to safe and effective treatment options, so they can quickly return to their daily lives. Changing the standard of care is part of our fabric. We are a group of energetic, problem-solvers focused on innovation, and looking to change the world. We are changing the paradigm for treating diseases such as prostate cancer by using real-time MR Imaging, thermal ultrasound and close-loop temperature feedback control, to gently ablate the diseased tissue with minimal side effects.

If you share our values and want to work in a collaborative results focused culture and want to make a Profound impact in healthcare and your career, here is your chance.

General Accountability

The Data Scientist researches, develops, improves, and evaluates the core technologies and features used in Profound Medical’s products through simulations and machine learning.

The Data Scientist Is Primarily Responsible For

  • Researching and executing simulations related to ultrasound propagation and heating in tissues, and magnetic resonance thermometry which are the technologies at the core of the Company’s product.
  • Developing and improving Profound’s products using machine learning and deep learning methods, leveraging treatment and imaging data.

The Data Scientist also stays abreast of the state of the art in these fields, researches what competitors are developing, and participates in the growth of the intellectual property portfolio. They work as a liaison with external research partners.

Duties and Responsibilities

Primary Duties Are As Follows

  • Invent, develop, improve, analyze and validate treatment algorithms at the core of the company’s product, with the aim to maximize speed and efficiency while maintaining safety;
  • Develop and execute ultrasound and MR simulations under various mechanical and physiological conditions to assist in the design of ultrasound transducers, or clinical workflows.
  • Evaluate and research improvements to Profound Medical’s core technologies (real-time MR thermometry, high-intensity therapeutic ultrasound) and identify its strengths and weaknesses against its competitors’ technology;
  • Develop, train, and evaluate computer vision models to improve treatment performance and safety using machine learning and artificial intelligence techniques.
  • Develop and implement data analytics tools to assess treatment and test outcomes, predict technical failures, or track sites performance.
  • Establish a liaison with external research partners, contribute to their research as needed, and transfer knowledge back to Profound Medical.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer
job.description:
About the Company

Our client is building the first unified, end-to-end care delivery platform for chronic neurodegenerative conditions.

Millions of families currently navigate severe cognitive disorders through a broken, fragmented healthcare system, bouncing between specialist shortages, primary care delays, complex social benefits, and immense out-of-pocket costs. Unpaid family caregivers contribute billions of hours of uncoordinated, exhausting labor, often relying on nothing more than handwritten notes to track clinical decline and manage daily care.

Most patients receive an accurate diagnosis years after their first symptoms appear, missing the critical window where early disease-modifying therapies can meaningfully alter their trajectory.

They are building the modern clinical infrastructure this space has always lacked: an integrated care model combining specialized clinical care, dedicated care navigation, and purpose-built software. They collaborate directly with health systems, outpatient specialty clinics, and leading academic medical institutions. Our client is a venture-backed, Series A health-tech company supported by premier global investors and accelerators.

Why Now

A rare convergence of regulatory, diagnostic, and clinical breakthroughs has fundamentally changed the landscape:

Dedicated Alternative Payment Models: Federal payers have recently introduced national, longitudinal value-based payment frameworks designed explicitly to fund coordinated, non-billable support, including continuous care navigation, 24/7 clinical access, individualized care plans, and caregiver respite.

Decentralized Biomarker Diagnostics: Novel blood-based biomarker assays have achieved regulatory clearance, shifting diagnosis away from specialized academic centers and directly into high-volume community clinics and primary care practices.

Actionable Treatment Pathways: The approval of disease-modifying therapies, alongside a rapidly growing clinical trial pipeline targeting disease progression, has created an urgent demand for coordinated specialty care that traditional provider networks simply do not have the clinician bandwidth to meet.

Solving this imbalance between surging demand and a severe specialist deficit requires software-driven clinical leverage. That is the core mission.

The Role

job.name: Core Engineering Intern
job.description:
About Etched Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across prefill and decode. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, we're redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.

Job Summary Core Engineering is our special projects team. This team identifies critical gaps across Etched and builds solutions 0 to 1, often in days, with immediate feedback loops. You might build internal tools to unblock a hardware team, prototype systems for manufacturing execution, or design, evaluate, and deploy agentic systems for our most challenging R&D problems.

This role is for engineers who thrive on ambiguity, move fast without sacrificing quality, and get energy from solving whatever problem matters most right now. It is a whiteboard for future founders – if you're interested in shipping 0-1 production-level code every week, this role is for you.

This role requires exceptional full-stack engineering capabilities, deep product sense, personal accountability, and a knack for building from the ground up. At Etched, we're developing our processes for scale, and we're looking for engineers to deploy to our toughest challenges. The problems we solve are time-sensitive and business-critical. This role will not be a 9-5, and the ideal candidate is excited about that. This is not a shadowing program. You will own a real project, scoped to land in production and shape how Etched executes.

You May Be a Good Fit If You

  • Have a track record of solving hard problems across stacks and domains — you enjoy being dropped into unfamiliar territory and figuring it out
  • Have something you built that you can walk us through in depth. Depth in one thing beats a list of ten
  • Are comfortable with Python and TypeScript: you can read it, modify it, debug it, and direct AI to write it well. We don't care whether you write code from scratch, but we do care whether you ship things that work
  • Have product sense and its necessary prerequisites, from AI tooling proficiency to design taste
  • Bias towards action and comfort with incomplete information

Strong Candidates May Also Have

  • Data engineering, infrastructure or DevOps experience, and deploying operational systems in enterprise environments
  • Experience wielding frontier models on frontier problems: an eval-driven mindset — you measure whether AI systems work, identify where they fall short, and know how to hillclimb
  • High agency and comfort with ambiguity — you find the real problem to solve
  • Prior startup experience, especially during hyper growth

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every qualification

OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

Job Summary The Associate Implementation Engineer works directly with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning both the product configuration and the underlying data migration that make each implementation successful. This role confirms requirements, configures and tests the platform, migrates and validates customer data, and trains users, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go-live.

Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and strong data and database expertise, the Associate Implementation Engineer understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows. This role blends hands-on technical delivery, including database schema management, ETL configuration, and scripting, with a consultative, customer-first approach, and partners across teams to ensure a smooth, high-quality implementation that maximizes the value customers realize from OpenGov.

job.name: Sr. Software Engineer-LIMS Job
job.description:
Job Title: Sr. Software Engineer-LIMS *Experience* 3 - 5 Years

*About The Role* Connect laboratory instruments to WinLIMS. This means understanding instrument outputs (files, serial, network), building the parsing and mapping logic, and configuring WinLIMS import and review. You'll work across lab chemists, ESI IT and WinLIMS administrators to bring 32 instruments live in waves.

*Key Responsibilities* Run instrument discovery: output method, file format, sample-ID method and software version for each instrument.

Configure vendor software exports (for example OpenLab, Syngistix, tiamo) and edge capture using LIVA mini PCs and Moxa serial-to-Ethernet units.

Build and maintain connector definitions and parsers; map results to WinLIMS tests, units and sample types.

Configure WinLIMS import definitions, intermediate and final sample types, and the chemist review workflow.

Write test scripts, execute interface tests with known samples, and document validation evidence.

Support go-live, hypercare, and handover documentation for the global rollout.

*Technical Skills* WinLIMS or comparable LIMS configuration (sample types, tests, import definitions, XML/XSL imports)

Laboratory instruments and techniques: HPLC/IC, ICP-OES/MS, titration, TOC, CVS

Data formats and parsing: CSV, XML/XSL, fixed-format text; Python or similar scripting

Serial (RS-232) and TCP/IP basics, Windows file shares, Moxa NPort setup

SQL, Linux and Docker basics, test documentation

*Experience* 3 - 5 Years

job.name: Full-Stack Software Engineer (Frontend, Backend & Cloud) – Applied & Agentic AI Systems
job.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Job Description We are looking for a highly skilled, deeply hands-on Full-Stack Software Engineer who will cover frontend UI, backend architecture, cloud deployment, and DevOps engineering all under one hat. Since our team already includes dedicated AI Engineers and Data Engineers, your primary mission is to be the foundational software engineering anchor: building the robust, scalable, and secure user interfaces, infrastructure, integrations, and server-side logic that allows our AI solutions to thrive in a production environment.

Description Of The Area At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. As part of our strategic initiatives, we are enabling high-value AI solutions spanning advanced agentic frameworks, Generative AI applications, and classical Machine Learning. The Applied AI Engineering Team is tasked with building these innovative AI applications end-to-end to solve complex business challenges in healthcare.

In the 2026 tech landscape, the lines between traditional disciplines have blurred. We operate in small agile teams (e.g., ~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before (through agentic SDLC).

Job Responsibilities Frontend Architecture & Generative UI: Develop highly scalable, reusable UI components using expert-level TypeScript and modern frameworks (React/Next.js or Angular 16+). Shift from static layouts to flexible, dynamic interfaces that gracefully handle unpredictable data and real-time LLM streams.

Core Backend Engineering & API Design: Design and build highly scalable, reusable backend services and APIs (using Python) that serve as the backbone for multi-agent workflows and GenAI applications. Build, host, and secure Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and standard APIs to standardize data exchange.

Cloud Architecture & DevOps Excellence: Design, implement, and manage secure and scalable cloud infrastructure (primarily AWS) tailored for diverse AI workloads. Apply Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) practices using Terraform. Build, maintain, and optimize fully automated CI/CD pipelines and manage application containerization (Docker).

Agentic SDLC & Engineering Excellence: Leverage AI coding assistants and autonomous agents (e.g., Claude Code, Ona) daily to accelerate full-stack development cycles. Conduct rigorous code reviews for both human-written and AI-generated code.

job.description:
Summary Position Summary Cyber Join Deloitte’s Cyber Engineering team as a Cyber Client Cyber Engineer - AI and help clients build secure, scalable, artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled cybersecurity solutions. In this forward-deployed engineering role, you will work with client teams to design, build, integrate, test, and deploy full-stack applications using agentic AI and automation. You will apply Python, web development, large language model (LLM) and agent orchestration, and enterprise integration skills from discovery through operational handover. You will use reference architectures and responsible AI practices to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to stakeholders.

Work you'll do As a Cyber Client Cyber Engineer - AI on the Cyber Engineering team, you will be responsible for:

  • Partner with client business, cybersecurity, and technology stakeholders to identify automation opportunities, assess data and integration readiness, and prioritize use cases by value, risk, and delivery effort.
  • Design and build Python-based AI agents, automation, backend application programming interfaces (APIs), and web interfaces for cybersecurity and enterprise workflows.
  • Develop agent orchestration, prompts, tool integrations, and workflow controls; connect model services, enterprise applications, configuration management databases (CMDBs), vulnerability scanners, and asset inventories.
  • Apply secure development and responsible AI controls with architecture, application security, and AI governance stakeholders; use Claude Code and GitLab Duo for appropriate engineering and software development life cycle (SDLC) activities and support Microsoft Copilot solutions.
  • Define acceptance criteria; test frontend and backend components, AI outputs, source data, workflows, integrations, security controls, and recovery paths; and deploy applications through controlled engineering pipelines.
  • Produce solution designs, test evidence, user guidance, and operational runbooks; transfer knowledge to client teams or the automation Center of Excellence (CoE); and contribute reusable assets.

The team Deloitte Cyber helps clients navigate the evolving threat landscape, operate with resilience, and proactively manage their security posture. Deloitte’s Cyber Engineering team builds technology that underpins the next generation of cybersecurity services.

job.name: Engineering Manager
job.description:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.

Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon.

Itron Resiliency Solutions is a global, diverse team of builders and innovators who tackle previously impossible challenges for our customers. If you have a desire to challenge yourself, solve impactful problems, and work with a passionate and talented team, this is the place.

Position Summary

We're hiring a hands-on Engineering Manager in Bengaluru to lead a team that owns production software end to end — from what customers need, to how it's built, to how it runs. This is not a coordination role: you will still design systems, review code and get into incidents, while growing the people around you.

Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. Y ou'll help shape how this team works, who joins it, and what it ships. Y ou'll report to the Director of Engineering and work closely with Product, Program Management, Customer Support and business stakeholders.

What You'll Own In Your First Year

  • A team and its outcomes. Lead a team of engineers (growing as we hire) and own what it delivers — measured by what changed for customers, not by tickets closed.
  • Hiring. Help build the team: define what good looks like, interview, and close candidates.
  • Quality as a first-class priority. Set the bar for testing, release and on-call so the team ships often without breaking customers.
  • Technical direction. Make and document the architecture tradeoffs for your area, and stay close enough to the code to know when a design is wrong.
  • People growth. Run 1:1s, give direct feedback, and create stretch paths so strong engineers grow faster than a standard promotion cycle.
  • Own: Own it end to end with Speed, quality, depth and long term vision.

What You Must Bring

  • You have led engineers. At least 2 years directly managing a team — hiring, feedback,

performance conversations, growing people.

  • Tech-lead: A tech-lead role for at least 4 years.
  • You are still hands-on. Y ou've designed and built production systems in the recent

past, and you can review a pull request or a design doc and find the real problem in it.

Own Every Moment at NetApp At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.

Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.

Job Summary The Oracle CPQ Developer is responsible for configuring, developing, testing, and supporting Oracle CPQ Cloud solutions for product configuration, pricing, quoting, and order management processes. The role collaborates with business stakeholders, sales teams, and technical teams to deliver scalable and efficient Quote-to-Cash solutions.

  • Configure Oracle CPQ product models, attributes, constraints, and validation rules
  • Support enhancements and bug fixes in Oracle CPQ applications
  • Create and maintain Commerce rules such as validation, hide/show, filter, and constraint rules
  • Develop and maintain BML scripts for pricing calculations, discount logic, commerce actions and defaulting & validation rules

Job Requirements

  • Must have strong experience in Oracle CPQ Cloud configuration and development
  • Working knowledge of BML (Big Machines Language)
  • Experience configuring product models, attributes, rules, constraints, and validations
  • Knowledge of pricing rules, discounting logic, and Commerce processes
  • Experience with Commerce layouts, actions, and approvals

Education

  • Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science, Information Technology or related field
  • 4 years of overall IT experience with 2-4 years of hands-on experience in Oracle CPQ Cloud
  • Oracle CPQ Cloud Certification is a plus

At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in-office and/or in-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.

Equal Opportunity Employer: NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification.

Why You'll Thrive at NetApp At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.

Responsive & Progressive Web applications (PWAs) using bootstrap, tailwind css 7 48 months of experience with any major platforms: Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions 8 12 months of experience in leverage modern AI-aided development tools (such as GitLab Duo or GitHub Copilot or Claude or Google CLI) for code generation, refactoring, and test writing 9 Bachelor's degree in computer science or a comparable field. Lead Front- End Engineer
job.description:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.

Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

Accenture Federal Services is looking for a Lead Front-End Engineer to build secure, scalable, and accessible web applications that support high-volume users and business-critical workflows. The ideal candidate has deep front-end expertise, strong full-stack fundamentals, and a track record of delivering high-quality software in production environments. In this role, you will be a hands-on engineer who combines technical excellence, product thinking, and strong execution to deliver secure, performant, and customer-focused web experiences, at scale.

The Work:

  • Build intuitive user experiences that reduce friction, errors, and support burden.
  • Integrate frontend applications with backend services and APIs.
  • Optimize application performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Implement secure authentication, authorization, and session management.
  • Develop and maintain automated testing strategies to improve release quality and reduce regressions.
  • Own features end-to-end, from design and development through deployment and production support.
  • Collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams to deliver high-impact customer experiences.

Here’s What You Need:

  • Expertise in modern JavaScript/TypeScript and frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.
  • Experience building secure, responsive, and accessible web applications.
  • Strong understanding of API integration, state management, performance optimization, and secure session handling.
  • Experience working as a Team Lead or Manager
  • Hands-on experience with automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end).
  • Proven ability to improve user experiences by reducing friction, errors, and support needs.
  • Experience delivering features end-to-end with strong operational and release discipline.
  • Previous experience at an industry-leading technology company.

job.name: SDC Front End Engineer--Analyst----Raleigh, NC or Dallas, TX
job.description:
Location: Raleigh, and Dallas

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

EY is the only professional services firm with a separate business unit (“FSO”) that is dedicated to the financial services marketplace. Our FSO teams have been at the forefront of every event that has reshaped and redefined the financial services industry. If you have a passion for rallying together to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic FSO team!

We help our clients transform. Together we are changing the way they interact with their Customers, Employees and Partners alike. We are modernizing their applications, creating new ones and driving business efficiency across their ever-changing platform and channel infrastructures. Everything we do centers around this simple story.

The opportunity As an FSO Technology Service Delivery Manager, you’ll be based in our Service Delivery Center, which is made up of high-performing US-based colleagues who work closely with our experienced advisory professionals. We deliver Technology project-based work and managed services to our clients. Here, you’ll work as part of a project team and will be responsible for the design, build/configuration, testing, analysis, delivery and support of Technology solutions. This position is fast-paced and ever-changing, which means you’ll need to be a flexible self-starter and be able to manage changing priorities and learning new and rapidly changing technology solutions.

We are looking for Frontend Engineers who will collaborate with clients to transform their business through disruptive innovation and transformational design solutions. The team supports clients in modernizing customer-facing systems, processes, and products to deliver intuitive, responsive, accessible, and high-performing digital experiences. The team leverages Angular, React, TypeScript, API integration, cloud technologies, and modern UI engineering practices to enable scalable end-to-end solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities The goal is to help our clients solve business problems through frontend engineering solutions. You will assist engagement teams with analyzing business and user experience requirements; designing, developing, integrating, testing, deploying, and supporting responsive web applications; and delivering high-quality systems with a focus on usability, accessibility, reliability, performance, and excellent customer experience. You will demonstrate in-depth technical capabilities and professional knowledge.

job.name: Senior Web Developer (UI, Training Content & Adoption Tools)
job.description:
About Peraton Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Program Overview The program is an IDIQ contract for an AWS-based cloud hosting system. Currently, Peraton is supporting the Cloud Security, IoT, and AIML use cases for the environment in a hybrid work environment with Federal employees. Peraton also support the following applications as part of the environment: Dremio, Tableau, Globus, Posit/RStudio, Atlassian, ThingLogix, Alteryx and CloudCheckr.

About The Role Peraton is seeking a Senior Web Developer (UI, Training Content & Adoption Tools) with instructional technology experience to support platform UI development and lead the development of web-based training content and adoption tools for a federal data integration program. You will build accessible online learning resources and the training metrics dashboard that tracks adoption across government partner offices. This is a fully remote position.

The Department of the Interior (DOI), U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS), and NOAA's National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS) have identified a critical gap in the federal government's ability to conduct comprehensive Endangered Species Act (ESA) research. While FWS operates an authoritative web-based platform for managing data for terrestrial and freshwater species, it does not currently include NMFS marine and anadromous species data forcing agencies to rely on separate, manual processes. This program closes that gap by integrating marine and anadromous species data into the existing FWS platform, creating a single, unified experience for all ESA-listed species . Work Location: Remote

job.name: Senior or Staff Frontend Engineer
job.description:
Job Title: Senior / Staff Frontend Engineer (Remote, US) Role Overview We are partnering with a well-established, global technology-enabled services company that is modernizing how it builds software. Their engineering organization is delivering new customer-facing web and mobile experiences, a unified design system, and AI-powered capabilities across its products, with Engineering, Product, and Design working together end to end.

This is a high-leverage opportunity for a frontend engineer who already works this way. You will spend more time on architecture, technical direction, and production ownership than on writing every line of code yourself. Frontend Engineers here are software engineers first, held to the same bar for design, testing, performance, security, and production quality as everyone else, with added depth in the browser, component architecture, accessibility, and design systems. The team builds in Angular and TypeScript, and strong React or comparable frontend experience is directly relevant. This search covers two levels: Senior (own a frontend domain) and Staff (set frontend architecture strategy across products).

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the full frontend lifecycle (architecture, implementation, testing, review, and production) while directing implementation and delegating meaningful build work to AI agents
  • Senior: Own a frontend domain end to end, including its architecture, quality, evolution, production behavior, and the shared capabilities other teams depend on
  • Senior: Set technical direction within the frontend platform, design patterns that solve real product needs, and establish clear boundaries
  • Staff: Set frontend architecture strategy across products, defining where shared patterns and platforms create leverage and where teams need flexibility
  • Staff: Lead the design system as an engineering platform, setting its technical direction, contribution and release model, and adoption strategy
  • Solve difficult frontend problems in production, leading diagnosis when behavior, performance, or reliability breaks down and staying accountable for what ships, regardless of who or what wrote the code
  • Own frontend quality and production health, defining how accessibility, performance, reliability, security, and testing are designed into frontend systems
  • Staff: Create the APIs, tooling, guardrails, documentation, and defaults that make excellent frontend engineering easier for every engineer
  • Set AI-native engineering practices for frontend teams, defining how agentic work is specified, validated, tested, and reviewed, while keeping review and production judgment human
  • Partner with Product, Design, QA, and full-stack engineers to bring frontend architecture, browser behavior, accessibility, and platform constraints into decisions early
  • Raise the engineering bar through mentoring, reviewing consequential changes, and growing engineers into broader ownership

Read the full description

job.name: Senior Backend Engineer
job.description:
Hiring for BRAHMA AI — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

BRAHMA AI builds an enterprise AI content platform for media, entertainment and brand content teams. Its BRAHMA AI Core (BAIC) platform grew out of the CLEAR media asset management system and helps organisations ingest, manage, search and localise large libraries of video and media, while BRAHMA AI Studio adds generative AI for content creation. The engineering team in Bengaluru is modernising the core platform and adding AI capabilities across it, and this hire strengthens that work.

About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineer (Backend) at BRAHMA AI in Bengaluru, you'll design and build the services behind the BAIC platform: microservices in Go, Python and .NET, the data stores and search that power media workflows, and the React micro-frontends on top of them. This is a full-time, on-site role working directly with BRAHMA AI.

What you'll do

  • Design, build and maintain scalable backend microservices for the BAIC platform in Go, Python and .NET.
  • Model and optimise data in PostgreSQL and MongoDB for media metadata, workflows and assets.
  • Build search over large media libraries with Elasticsearch or OpenSearch.
  • Build and improve React micro-frontends that sit on top of your services.
  • Deploy to AWS and Azure and keep CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps fast and reliable.
  • Pay down technical debt, modernise legacy platform services, review code and contribute to architecture and documentation.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering.
  • Strong production backend development in at least one of Go, Python or .NET (C#/ASP.NET). Strength in one is enough; willingness to work across the others is expected.
  • Hands-on React experience, ideally with microservices and micro-frontend architectures.
  • Working knowledge of PostgreSQL/SQL and MongoDB, and of a search engine such as Elasticsearch or OpenSearch.
  • Has deployed and run services on AWS or Azure, with CI/CD in Jenkins, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience building an enterprise SaaS or media-tech product, in an agile team.

Nice to have

  • Experience with media asset management, OTT, video or content platforms.
  • Exposure to integrating AI/ML models into product workflows.
  • Experience modernising legacy services into cloud-native microservices.

Originally posted on: 5 Nov 2026

Job Title: Manager – Data Operations Summary: We are looking for a skilled and experienced Manager – Data Operations to manage the day-to-day operation of enterprise data pipelines and platforms supporting corporate finance transformation.

This role combines hands-on operational oversight, service management, and team leadership to ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data delivery. The ideal candidate will work closely with data engineering, platform, governance, and business teams to support finance processes across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.

job.name: Monitoring Engineer - L1
job.description:
Make an impact with NTT DATA Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

Your day at NTT DATA As a Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L1) at NTT DATA, you will be the first point of contact for our clients, ensuring their IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You will proactively identify, investigate, and resolve technical incidents and problems, focusing on first-line support for standard and low-complexity incidents and service requests. Your aim? To ensure zero missed service level agreement conditions.

Every day, you will monitor client infrastructure and solutions, identifying problems and errors before or as they occur. You will dive deep into first-line incidents assigned to you, pinpointing the root causes, and providing telephonic, ITSM ticket or chat support to our clients when they need it most. Maintenance activities, such as patching and configuration changes, will be part of your routine, ensuring the smooth operation of client systems.

You will work across two or more technology domains, such as Cloud, Security, Networking, Applications, or Collaboration. Your day may include updating existing knowledge articles or creating new ones, seeking opportunities for work optimization, and supporting project work as needed. Additionally, you will contribute to disaster recovery functions and tests, ensuring our clients' DATA is safe and sound.

Shift changes are made seamless with your careful handovers, ensuring service continuity. You will report and escalate incidents when necessary and strive for efficient, comprehensive resolutions of incidents and requests. With each interaction, you will aim to provide a positive client experience, placing their needs at the forefront of all you do.

job.name: Senior Linux Administrator
job.description:
About Our Company Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year-end 2024. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.

Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

Job Description In this role the person will be the responsible for Linux administration, cloud infrastructure, and automation. The role will be responsible for supporting highly available Linux environments while driving automation, security, reliability, and operational efficiency across on-premises and cloud platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Automating the administration & end-to-end life-cycle management of RHEL servers by including provisioning, installation, software packaging, patching, planned & unplanned maintenance, service configuration and integration with our monitoring platform.

Development & continuous enhancement of tools, utilities, reports & frameworks to assist production support, operational processes, re-engineering efforts etc.

Work closely with Cloud Engineering to enable development of end-to-end automated platforms

  • Develop new automations in Ansible or new Lambdas (self-healing & INC-minimization). Contribute towards API gateway-related deliverables & proactively move towards server-less infra. Contribute towards developing a holistic Front-end for our Core Infrastructure services, which would initially mean for operational & visibility for our team, but would simultaneously provide few frequently needed info by App-teams. Move towards AI/ML driven data-visualization & self-healing, using Python

Required Qualifications Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent academic qualification.

3-6 years of System Administration experience in supporting, engineering, developing & optimizing automation solutions on RHEL based On-Premises or post-premise, currently working as L2/L3 team-member in a Service Delivery model.

Candidate should have exposure to Basic ITIL concepts viz. Incident/Change/Problem/Request management.

Mandatory: 3+ years of expertise with RHEL Linux System Administration.

job.description:
Location - Gurugram, India (Hybrid)

This is a hybrid role based out of our Gurugram, India office, 3 days in the office, 2 days remote (from home).

About Us Sauce Labs is the world’s largest full-lifecycle, test automation platform, and the company behind Selenium. Trusted by 80% of the world’s top ten largest financial institutions and over 300,000 enterprise users, Sauce Labs provides the only AI platform capable of turning business intent into autonomous testing and quality assurance. With a proprietary dataset of 8.7 billion test runs, Sauce Labs empowers the Fortune 2000 to bridge the gap between AI-driven code generation and enterprise-grade software quality. Learn more at http://saucelabs.com.

Release Assurance at the Speed of AI | Meet the new Sauce Labs The Role

We are looking for a Web Developer to join our team at Sauce Labs! In this role, you’ll bring your expertise in headless CMS’s and the necessary coding languages to build, support, and optimize our website. You will play a critical role in maintaining the performance, scalability, and functionality of our website, ensuring it meets the evolving needs of our business and users. This role requires a developer who is collaborative, detail-oriented, and proactive in solving technical challenges.

Responsibilities

  • Key owner of back-end and front-end development, optimization, and infrastructure of the saucelabs.com website.
  • Collaborate closely with Demand Gen and Marketing Operations to develop an optimized back-end in our CMS to allow for flexible landing page building experience for editors.
  • Lead projects end-to-end — maintaining timelines, stakeholder expectations, ticket triaging, and regularly troubleshooting and optimizing the website.
  • Troubleshoot any bugs reported by Sauce Labs team and triage efficiently.
  • Build and maintain comprehensive testing strategies to ensure code quality, reliability, and performance.
  • Assess and audit existing CMS to simplify our implementation and recommend a more streamlined set-up (which could be the same CMS or migrating to a new one).

Required Skills

  • 3-7 years of development experience using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • 3+ years of development experience in React/Typescript, frameworks (Next.js, Gatsby), headless CMS (Contentful or Sanity), backend technologies (Node.js, Express), and server rendered & statically generated sites.
  • Knowledge of website analytics tools like Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager.
  • Experience working on SEO-driven projects, localization, performance optimization & experimentation.

Nice to Haves

  • Worked on conversion rate optimization standard methodologies, using A/B testing to achieve results.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines for automated deployment workflows.

job.description:
Job Description Title: IoT Software Developer - Device Engineering Team-Husky(India) Guindy, Chennai

Id: 20963

Type: FullTime

Location: Chennai, India

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

IoT Software Developer Do you want to work on software applications that connect industrial machines, edge devices, and cloud platforms?

Our mission is to advance the standard of care, improve patient outcomes, and reduce healthcare costs by giving surgeons enhanced visualization of microscopic tissue structures in the operating room.

job.name: GenAI Developer
job.description:
Iris's Fortune 100 direct client is looking for GenAI Developer . Please find below Job description and share me your updated resume at Saurav.upadhyay@irissoftware.com .

Position: GenAI Developer

Location: Toronto Ontario

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop scalable Generative AI solutions that combine traditional Python-based engineering with Large Language Models (LLMs) to solve business problems effectively.
  • Build and maintain robust Python applications, APIs, and data processing pipelines to support AI-driven workflows and integrations.
  • Develop hybrid AI architectures that blend business rules, deterministic logic, and LLM capabilities for reliable and production-ready outcomes.
  • Integrate and optimize LLM frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar platforms for enterprise use cases.

  • Deploy, monitor, and support AI applications on AWS cloud environments, ensuring scalability, security, and performance.
  • Evaluate AI model outputs, identify limitations, and implement safeguards, validation mechanisms, and fallback logic to enhance reliability.
  • Stay current with emerging GenAI technologies, frameworks, and best practices while continuously improving existing AI platforms and development standards.

About Iris Software Inc.

With 4,000+ associates and offices in India, U.S.A. and Canada, Iris Software delivers technology services and solutions that help clients complete fast, far-reaching digital transformations and achieve their business goals. A strategic partner to Fortune 500 and other top companies in financial services and many other industries, Iris provides a value-driven approach - a unique blend of highly-skilled specialists, software engineering expertise, cutting-edge technology, and flexible engagement models. High customer satisfaction has translated into long-standing relationships and preferred-partner status with many of our clients, who rely on our 30+ years of technical and domain expertise to future-proof their enterprises. Associates of Iris work on mission-critical applications supported by a workplace culture that has won numerous awards in the last few years, including Certified Great Place to Work in India; Top 25 GPW in IT & IT-BPM; Ambition Box Best Place to Work, #3 in IT/ITES; and Top Workplace NJ-USA.

We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title Software Development Engineering - Sr Professional II

About Your Role Payfare now a part of Fiserv is a global financial technology company powering digital banking and instant payout solutions for gig economy workers, partnering with major platforms such as Lyft, DoorDash and Uber. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will work with a highly skilled cross-functional team to enhance our core banking platform, which is built on a microservices architecture and has proven capabilities for processing high volumes of payments. You will build highly scalable solutions that help the next generation of workers get paid instantly, earn cashback rewards and access no-fee banking.

What You’ll Do

Experience You’ll Need To Have

  • 5+ years of experience in software development.
  • Significant experience with at least one dynamically typed, object-oriented programming language like Python.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservice architecture and RESTful API development.
  • Experience with cloud computing and container-based distributed systems like Docker or equivalent product.

About The Role BMO Technology & Operations is building production AI capability for Capital Markets and Commercial Banking. As an Senior AI Engineer, you will design, build and run AI solutions that solve real business problems, from intelligent document processing and workflow automation to agentic systems that work alongside our people. You will start with the business problem and stay with it until the solution is working in production and delivering measurable value.

What you'll do

  • Partner with business, product and operations teams to identify high-value AI use cases and shape them into deliverable solutions.
  • Design, build and deploy solutions using large language models, retrieval-augmented generation and agent orchestration frameworks.
  • Engineer data pipelines, prompts, evaluation harnesses and guardrails so solutions are accurate, explainable and safe.
  • Integrate AI capabilities into existing platforms and workflows through APIs and event-driven services.
  • Monitor model and solution performance in production and iterate based on user feedback and outcome metrics.
  • Work within BMO model risk, data governance, privacy and information security standards.
  • At the senior level, lead technical design for a product area, mentor engineers and set engineering patterns for reuse across teams.

What you bring

  • 6 years of software engineering experience, including hands-on delivery of machine learning or generative AI solutions into production.
  • Strong Python skills and experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred), containers and CI/CD.
  • Practical experience with LLM APIs, vector stores, retrieval patterns, and agent frameworks.
  • A product mindset and the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Understanding responsible AI practices, including evaluation, bias, transparency, and human oversight.

Nice to have

  • Experience in financial services, Capital Markets or Commercial Lending.
  • Experience working in a forward-deployed or client-embedded engineering model.
