Vendelux is building the category-defining platform for event marketing intelligence.

Events are one of the largest and most impactful marketing channels, yet historically one of the least measurable. Vendelux brings transparency and performance to this space — helping companies discover, evaluate, and optimize their event strategy with data.

Our platform powers thousands of event decisions by delivering proprietary, AI-driven insights across hundreds of thousands of events globally. At the core of our platform is a robust ecosystem of event organizer partnerships — where organizers share first-party data, enabling richer insights for customers while receiving benchmarking and audience intelligence in return. From identifying the highest ROI conferences to enabling targeted meeting programs, Vendelux helps companies turn events into a predictable and scalable growth engine.

In addition, Vendelux Meetings extends our platform by turning insights into pipeline — using AI to identify high-value attendees and proactively book 1:1 meetings between our customers and their ideal prospects at events. This enables go-to-market teams to drive measurable ROI and maximize every event interaction.

Founded in 2021, Vendelux is a Series B SaaS company backed by top-tier investors including Tribeca Ventures, FirstMark and Hubspot Ventures. We partner with many of the fastest-growing companies in the world, and our team includes leaders from Bain, ZoomInfo, Shutterstock, FanDuel, Compass, Airbnb, Jet.com. and beyond.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Data-driven marketers have plenty of tools to optimize their digital ad spend and verify that their ads showed where they were supposed to. We build the same kinds of tools, but for data-driven event marketers, who’ve previously been limited to scanning conference badges at their booth.

We're growing, and looking for Staff Software Engineers to ship critical features and drive key infrastructure changes.

This is a full-time role based in NYC, reporting directly to our Head of Engineering. It's hybrid, 3–4 days a week in our NYC office depending on your location.

As a Staff Engineer at Vendelux, you will help shape the technical strategy for our products and systems.

job.name: LLM / GenAI Engineer
job.description:
About The Role The role sits at the intersection of applied ML and platform engineering: building LLM-powered systems that hold up under real production load - latency budgets, cost constraints, eval-driven iteration, and users who do not wait for the model to be right.

This team ships GenAI features that customers actually use: retrieval pipelines grounded in enterprise data, agentic workflows with tool calling, and fine-tuned models tuned for domain-specific accuracy. The work is hands-on and full-stack - prompt code to GPU infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build production RAG pipelines using LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom architectures, including chunking strategies, hybrid retrieval, and reranking
  • Implement and scale vector search infrastructure (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, or Elasticsearch) for semantic retrieval over large document corpora
  • Develop agentic workflows with multi-step tool calling, function orchestration, and guardrails for safety and reliability
  • Fine-tune open-weight and proprietary models using LoRA/QLoRA and instruction-tuning pipelines on domain-specific datasets
  • Build systematic LLM evaluation frameworks: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge pipelines, regression suites wired into CI/CD
  • Optimize inference performance and cost - quantization, batching, caching, and model routing across OpenAI, Anthropic, and self-hosted endpoints
  • Deploy and monitor LLM services in production using observability tooling for latency, token cost, hallucination rates, and drift

What We Are Looking For

  • 3–6 years of software or ML engineering experience, with at least 1–2 years building LLM/GenAI systems in production
  • Strong Python engineering skills; comfort with async programming, REST/streaming APIs, and production code quality standards
  • Hands-on experience with at least one LLM orchestration framework (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent) and one vector database
  • Practical understanding of transformer architectures, embedding models, and retrieval-augmented generation patterns
  • Experience deploying and operating services on AWS, GCP, or Azure, including containerized workloads (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • MS in Computer Science, related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Bonus: experience with vLLM/TGI inference optimization, RLHF or preference tuning, Spark/PySpark data pipelines, or contributions to open-source LLM tooling

job.name: Machine Learning Engineer – GPU Performance & Low-Latency Inference
job.description:
We’re partnering with a leading global trading firm to hire a Machine Learning Engineer to make ML models run as fast as possible. You’ll work close to the hardware, squeezing latency out of real-time inference and speeding up training, in an environment where microseconds matter.

What you’ll do

  • Build and optimize low-latency inference pipelines that deliver real-time predictions in production
  • Profile and optimize ML workloads at the device level: memory, compute, kernels and compilers
  • Write and tune custom GPU code (CUDA, Triton or equivalent) where libraries fall short
  • Apply and validate low-precision techniques (FP8/INT8, quantization), knowing which optimizations stay bit-exact,
  • Optimize batching, KV caching and serving paths for latency-critical workloads.
  • Extend the internals of PyTorch and inference frameworks to raise performance on specific workloads

What you’ll bring

  • 3+ years in machine learning, focused on inference or GPU performance
  • Hands-on experience optimizing ML at the GPU level: CUDA, Triton, C++, TensorRT or similar
  • Experience with profiling tools (Nsight, torch.profiler) and reasoning about memory bandwidth, latency and throughput
  • A strong grasp of modern ML architectures, attention in particular, and how they map onto hardware
  • Production-quality Python (C++ a strong plus), with testing discipline and ownership of the systems you ship
  • A habit of measuring before optimizing, and the judgment to know when to build versus buy

Nice to have

  • Experience building real-time, low-latency prediction systems in high-performance environments
  • Experience with numerics: mixed precision, quantization and correctness at scale
  • Contributions to open-source projects such as PyTorch, vLLM, Triton or FlashAttention

No trading experience is required. What matters is deep, hands-on performance engineering and a drive to make things faster.

job.name: Research Scientist / Engineer – Reinforcement Learning Infrastructure
job.description:
You'll build the systems that make reinforcement learning work at frontier scale — coupling policy optimization with large fleets of inference workers, agentic environments, and the reward and verification systems that turn model behavior into learning signal. RL is how Luma's models go from capable to useful.

RL at scale is a full-loop systems problem: training, rollout generation, environment execution, and reward computation running concurrently across thousands of GPUs, all needing to stay fast, stable, and correct together. It fits someone who has lived this — post-trained LLMs with RL, built environments and verifiers, and debugged asynchronous rollout pipelines at scale. If you haven't operated RL at real scale, this will be deep water.

What You'll Own

  • Design, build, and scale distributed RL post-training systems, orchestrating trainer, rollout, environment, and reward workloads across thousands of GPUs.
  • Build high-throughput rollout generation, integrating inference engines (vLLM, SGLang), weight synchronization, and asynchronous/off-policy schemes.
  • Design RL environments for agentic, multi-step tasks — sandboxed code execution, tool use, computer use, multimodal interaction — reproducible and scalable to millions of episodes.
  • Build reward infrastructure: verifiable/programmatic rewards, reward-model serving, LLM-as-judge pipelines, and defenses against reward hacking.
  • Develop the evaluation, monitoring, and debugging tooling that keeps large RL runs stable.
  • Advance training efficiency and stability, and turn new post-training ideas into production runs with researchers.

First 90 Days One way the first 90 could unfold.

  • Days 1–30 — Immerse & Diagnose: Learn the current RL stack and where throughput, stability, or correctness break.
  • Days 30–60 — Ship & Validate: Improve a piece of the loop (rollout throughput, reward infra, or an environment) and prove it on a real run.
  • Days 60–90 — Scale & Systemize: Harden the full loop across thousands of GPUs and asynchronous architectures.

What You Bring

  • Hands-on experience post-training LLMs with RL (PPO/GRPO-family, RLHF, RLVR) at meaningful scale.
  • Extensive distributed PyTorch training and parallelism (FSDP, Tensor/Pipeline/Expert Parallel) for foundation models.
  • Experience building RL environments, reward functions, verifiers, or evaluation harnesses for LLM agents, including sandboxed execution and multi-turn tool use.
  • Deep familiarity with RL post-training frameworks (veRL, OpenRLHF, TRL, Ray orchestration) and rollout inference engines (vLLM, SGLang).
  • Strong understanding of GPU clusters, networking, and communication libraries (NCCL, MPI) under mixed training and inference workloads.

Nice to Have

You’ll own the infrastructure that turns a research idea into a trained, tested model, and you’ll be measured on how fast and how cheaply that happens.

What you’ll do

  • Build and scale distributed training pipelines for large models and complex, high-volume datasets
  • Design the parallelism strategy, data loading and checkpointing for multi-node GPU training
  • Automate the research loop with quantitative researchers: experiment orchestration, hyperparameter tuning and model retraining
  • Work with HPC specialists to raise training throughput and GPU utilization, and to cut compute cost
  • Extend the internals of PyTorch and other open-source ML tools when off-the-shelf isn’t fast enough
  • Evaluate third-party tools and decide when to build versus buy

What you’ll bring

  • 3+ years in machine learning, focused on training systems
  • Hands-on experience scaling training across many GPUs and nodes with PyTorch, JAX or TensorFlow (e.g. FSDP, DeepSpeed, Megatron, DDP)
  • A strong grasp of ML fundamentals, including transformer and attention internals, beyond high-level APIs
  • Production-quality Python, with testing discipline and ownership of the systems you ship
  • A habit of measuring before optimizing: profiling, benchmarking and finding the real bottleneck
  • Clear communication, so you can explain your technical decisions to researchers and adapt when the evidence says to

Nice to have

  • Experience with HPC schedulers (Slurm) and cloud or orchestration platforms (Kubernetes, Ray)
  • Contributions to open-source ML or distributed-systems projects
  • Familiarity with NCCL, collective communication or interconnect tuning

No trading experience is required. What matters is depth in large-scale training systems and the ability to move fast among very smart people.

job.name: Sr Software Development Engineer , AWS IoT Fleet Management
job.description:
Description AWS IoT is building the infrastructure to deliver AI from the cloud to the physical world. Our Physical AI team is developing services that provision, deploy, monitor, and secure AI software across every processor inside autonomous machines — including robots, vehicles, drones, agricultural equipment, and industrial workcells — operating in environments with limited or no cloud connectivity.

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to define and drive the architecture of our edge-first fleet management platform for Physical AI. You will own the end-to-end system design spanning cloud control planes, edge gateways, and device-tier processors — reasoning deeply about state, consistency, partition tolerance, failure domains, recovery, and reconciliation across tiers that are routinely disconnected from each other. You will design APIs, platform abstractions, and SDKs that enable customers to manage heterogeneous machine fleets as coherent units, and architect secure software and model distribution pipelines with hardware attestation, cryptographic signing, and device-bound authorization.

This role demands the ability to start from ambiguity and deliver production architecture. You will take large, loosely defined initiatives and decompose them into parallel workstreams that L4 and L5 engineers can execute against. You will write high-quality architecture and design documents that set the technical bar for the team, lead cross-team technical discussions, and drive alignment on decisions that affect adjacent services and organizations. You will own operational excellence for device fleets at scale — not just service availability, but the health, versioning, and security posture of tens of thousands of physical processors in the field.

This is an opportunity to be a technical leader on a foundational new AWS platform — shaping how intelligence is delivered, protected, and maintained across the physical world at scale.

Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

job.name: Design System/UX Engineer
job.description:
At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive.

TTEC Digital seeks a Design System/UX Engineer to join our team. This role is a full-time and fully remote opportunity!

The work: We’re an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools — automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation — for the world’s biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that’s been obsessed with customer experience since 1982.

This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don’t just move a metric — you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds.

Who we hire — the DNA:

  • Self-starters and do-ers with grit — hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals.
  • Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly — new tools, new models, new priorities — without drama.
  • Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread.
  • AI-native. You work with AI on all levels — you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity.
  • Distributed-systems literate. High-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands.
  • Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them.
  • You consider yourself exceptional — and you like winning. So do we.
  • No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well-rounded, smart people who move fast

What You Will Do: The role:

  • Own the design system in code and the UX of the wedge — the Agent UI shell, slide-out / pill, Control UI, and the per-module panels
  • UX here ships as code, not Figma hand-offs. This is not a look-pretty job: the UI renders live voice, desktop, and AI event streams in real time, and you have to understand the technology underneath — events, WebSocket state, latency, plugin loading — so what you design flows and works, not just looks good
  • Startup environment: 1-week sprints, Friday demos, fail fast, move forward.

What you'll own:

job.name: Salesforce Developer
job.description:
Hiring for PULS Group — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About Company

PULS is a German manufacturer of DIN-rail power supplies for industrial automation, with plants in Germany, the Czech Republic, China and Chennai. Its global IT team, spread across the same four countries, runs Salesforce as a core business platform connected to sales, service and SAP S/4HANA. PULS is hiring a hands-on developer in Chennai to build and extend that platform for business units worldwide.

Job Roles & Responsibilities

  • Build and enhance Salesforce solutions in Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL and Flow for global PULS business units.

  • Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce and SAP S/4HANA through SAP CPI, using REST/SOAP APIs and Platform Events.

  • Resolve incidents and problems raised by business stakeholders across countries.
  • Follow the team's development standards, code reviews, Git workflows and CI/CD deployments.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development, writing Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL and Flow.

  • Has designed and shipped at least one integration between Salesforce and an external system using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events or middleware.
  • Has deployed through Git-based version control and a CI/CD pipeline with Salesforce DX or similar deployment tools.
  • Has turned business-user requirements into maintainable solutions and troubleshot complex production issues.
  • Communicates clearly in English with stakeholders in several countries.
  • A plus: Platform Developer I/II certification, full-cycle implementations, SAP integration, Service Cloud, manufacturing or electronics industry experience, and work with implementation partners.

What We Offer

job.name: Sr Software Engineer, iOS

The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary: What You Need To Know About The Role- As a Senior iOS Software Engineer, you will lead the architecture and quality of the PayPal POS iOS app, including payment-critical flows such as Tap to Pay on iPhone, Key In and reader connectivity. job.name: Applied AI Security Intern (Agent Safety and Testing)
job.description:
OneSpotAI builds security infrastructure for AI. As companies hand more work to AI agents, we make sure those agents stay safe, controlled, and trustworthy. Our clients are in healthcare, finance, and logistics.

The Role

You will work on one question: what can go wrong with an AI agent, and how do we stop it? You will run experiments to expose weak spots, build the fixes, and set up checks that confirm the fixes last. This is hands-on engineering with real impact on our product.

Your Day to Day

  • Run experiments that expose unsafe agent behavior, including tool misuse, excess permissions, and data leaks
  • Investigate what caused each issue
  • Build the fix, whether that is a guardrail, an access rule, or a detection check
  • Create repeatable tests that catch the issue if it ever returns
  • Share findings in plain, practical write-ups

What We Look For

  • Python skills you have used to build real projects
  • Familiarity with LLM apps, agents, RAG, or MCP
  • Interest in security, red teaming, or vulnerability research
  • Work we can look at: GitHub, CTF writeups, blogs, or side projects

Perks

  • Remote, with flexible hours
  • Stipend at the top of the market for this role
  • Close collaboration with the core team
  • Ownership of your work from start to finish

job.description:
ReOrbit is looking for a Satellite Security Architect to join our team.

As our Satellite Security Architect, you will define the trust, identity, security, and cryptographic foundations of our end to end space based computing platform, built to operate autonomously, at global scale, and securely for the quantum era.

You will work closely with SW and HW engineers, system architects and security stakeholders to create practical security designs and architecture that meet the long term security objectives of our space platform.

It's an exciting chance to join a dynamic start up, with the opportunity to make a real impact, to reach our goal of pushing the boundaries of space data transfer.

Responsibilities

  • Design the security architecture for a distributed satellite mesh
  • Define PKI, identity, and trust models for intermittently connected systems
  • Lead our post-quantum cryptography (PQC) strategy
  • Define hardware root-of-trust, secure provisioning, and key management architecture for satellite systems
  • Integrate with 3rd party software stacks relying on our hardware
  • Design security architecture for a containerized, cloud-based ground segment
  • Ensure crypto agility and long-term resilience
  • Define and enforce trust boundaries in the design

Skills And Requirements

  • Strong experience in security architecture and distributed systems
  • Deep knowledge of PKI, key management, secure protocols and authentication systems
  • Strong understanding of modern cryptography and emerging post quantum cryptography standards
  • Experience in cloud, edge, telecom or IoT environments
  • Satellite, aerospace, Delay-Tolerant Networking (DTN), or mission-critical distributed systems experience is a bonus
  • Experience with HSMs, secure elements, or hardware roots of trust is a bonus
  • Experience with 5G / NTN / D2D security is a bonus

What does ReOrbit do? ReOrbit builds the foundation for the next generation of space applications by transforming satellites into truly intelligent, interconnected platforms, defined by software. Our satellite design philosophy revolves around the idea that satellites must network, communicate with each other and thus improve mission efficiency. How can this be achieved? Thanks to a flexible software-first architecture, where all these aspects are dealt with upfront in the mission concept, as integrated functionalities.

ReOrbit’s top-notch team of software engineers and system architects develop in-house software, procure hardware from the best-in-class suppliers, and seamlessly integrate the components to create flexible and secure satellites. Today, we are a rapidly growing company building a very strong multidisciplinary team to support our activities. We are headquartered in Helsinki, Finland with a subsidiaries in Bristol, UK, Bariloche, Argentina and Bengaluru, India.

  • Develop Python-based tools and automation for log analysis, failure classification, regression isolation, automated bisection, and reporting.
  • Apply Agentic AI workflows to correlate diagnostic evidence, identify patterns, summarize failures, recommend investigation paths, and improve triage efficiency.

job.name: SDE II , AWS IoT Fleet Management
job.description:
Description AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

AWS IoT is building the infrastructure to deliver AI from the cloud to the physical world. Our Physical AI team is developing services that provision, deploy, monitor, and secure AI software across every processor inside autonomous machines including robots, vehicles, drones, agricultural equipment, and industrial workcells operating in environments with limited or no cloud connectivity.

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II to own and drive the design and delivery of core subsystems in our edge-first fleet management platform for Physical AI. You will design and build systems that operate reliably without cloud connectivity handling offline provisioning state reconciliation on reconnect staged fleet-wide rollouts atomic rollback across multi-processor machines and secure over-the-air (OTA) delivery of AI models and software to heterogeneous processor topologies. Your systems must be correct when disconnected consistent when reconnected and resilient when partially connected. You will also develop cloud-side services that orchestrate, monitor, and coordinate with fleets of edge devices ensuring seamless interaction between cloud control planes and disconnected or intermittently connected hardware. You will write high-performance code working across the hardware-software boundary to debug issues that span operating systems, runtimes, networks, and physical devices. You will independently own substantial subsystems end to end from writing the design document through implementation testing and production operation.

You will also mentor junior engineers raise the bar on design quality and help shape the technical direction of the platform. This is an opportunity to build foundational infrastructure for a new category of AWS services delivering intelligence to the physical world at scale.

Key job responsibilities

Job Roles & Responsibilities

We are looking for a Platform Developer with a strong background in Java backend development and scalable distributed systems, to build and evolve the core platform layer that powers CLEAR AI, our AI-driven applications and next-generation user experiences.

You will work at the intersection of backend engineering, AI systems, and front-end technologies, creating reliable, high-performance APIs and data services that enable smooth collaboration between our AI and UI teams.

  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and cloud-native deployments (Kubernetes, AWS).

job.description:
Job Summary: As a Full Stack & CI/CD Consultant within the S&C GN Customer Service Analytics & Contact Center AI practice, you will be responsible for designing, building, and deploying scalable web applications and automated delivery pipelines that power enterprise Contact Center AI platform implementations. Your typical day will involve developing frontend and backend application components, configuring CI/CD pipelines, integrating CCaaS platform connectors, and advising clients on deployment architecture, release strategy, and data pipeline design across all phases of delivery.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Design and build scalable full stack applications using React/Angular/Vue/Next.js, Node.js/Python/Java/FastAPI, REST/GraphQL APIs, and SQL/NoSQL databases supporting Contact Center AI platform workflows and operational dashboards.
  • Design, implement, and manage CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/Jenkins with zero-downtime releases, automated rollback, canary/blue-green deployments, GitOps branching, and embedded SAST/DAST security controls.
  • Configure and maintain CCaaS platform integrations across Genesys, Avaya, Amazon Connect, NICE, and Five9 for real-time streaming and batch data ingestion.
  • Build and manage data ingestion pipelines covering transcription, enrichment, scoring, normalization, PII detection and redaction, and compliance-aligned data retention workflows.
  • Deploy and manage containerized application components using Kubernetes across AWS/Azure/GCP and on-premises environments with full-stack observability including metrics, log aggregation, anomaly detection, and incident alerting.
  • Lead client-facing infrastructure and data discovery workshops; advise on deployment model selection, CI/CD strategy, and connector architecture prior to onboarding.
  • Identify and mitigate implementation risks; develop phased delivery roadmaps aligned to client go-live timelines.
  • Mentor analysts and junior developers; review technical deliverables across frontend, backend, and DevOps workstreams.
  • Present architecture and delivery decisions to senior client stakeholders; maintain documentation for knowledge transfer and team continuity.

job.description:
How to Apply

A cover letter is required for consideration for this position and should be attached as the first page of your resume. The cover letter should specifically address your interest in the position and outline skills and experience that directly relate to this position. Cover letters of two-page length are recommended. For ease of use in our hiring system, please provide these all-in pdfs with at least your last name in the filename.

Job Summary The Survey Research Center (SRC) of the Institute for Social Research (ISR) at the University of Michigan seeks an established leader in survey research to serve as Director of Survey Research Operations (SRO).

Survey Research Operations (SRO) is the data collection operations unit within SRC responsible for conducting and overseeing the management of high-quality data collection for major national population studies (Panel Study of Income Dynamics, the Monitoring the Future Study, the Health and Retirement Study), as well as a broad portfolio of studies in the social sciences and related disciplines that employ surveys using cutting-edge methods and survey technologies, including the recently launched National Survey Panel. The unit currently employs 170 university-based and more than 700 field-based staff across the nation. SRO actively manages over 100 projects with a combined annual research volume totaling $40 million. SRO also partners with the Michigan Program in Survey and Data Science (MPSDS) in training graduate students in survey sampling, design, and data collection.

The position reports directly to the Director of the Survey Research Center.

The Survey Research Center (SRC) at the Institute for Social Research (ISR) at the University of Michigan seeks to create a community of respect and authentic collaboration by recruiting and retaining individuals who represent a variety of voices as a reflection of our commitment to serve the people of Michigan, to maintain the excellence of the university, and to ground our research in varied disciplines, perspectives, and ways of knowing and learning.

Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.

Must have skills : SAP BTP Application Development

Good to have skills : NA

Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary AI Powered Tech Talent

Build AI native enterprise applications on SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP) by combining strong platform engineering (admin + solution design + full stack build) with agentic AI application patterns (LLMs + tools + retrieval + evaluation). This role is about building, deploying, and operating cloud applications on SAP BTP, and evolving them into intelligent systems through rapid prototyping and production hardening.

Core Responsibilities

  • Cloud Application Engineering on SAP BTP

Build, deploy, and manage applications in a cloud-based environment on SAP BTP, covering platform fundamentals, administration touchpoints, solution design, and both frontend and backend development.

  • Full Stack Delivery (Frontend + Backend) with SAP BTP Patterns

Develop backend services and APIs (including CRUD + business logic + validations) using Node.js-based service patterns, and expose services for frontend consumption.

Build responsive UI components using SAPUI5 (XML views, controllers, MVC approach) and integrate with backend APIs for data display and write-back flows.

  • Data Modeling & Persistence Foundations

Design database artifacts and data models (tables/views/entities/relationships) and connect applications to SAP HANA-based persistence patterns used in BTP app development scenarios.

  • Platform Setup & Deployment Engineering

Configure subaccounts/service instances/roles and set up development spaces configure connectivity artifacts (e.g., destinations) for integrating external APIs and databases as part of application delivery.

Package and deploy applications using multi-target application (MTA) style deployment artifacts where applicable.

  • AI Native Application Patterns (Agentic + LLM Integrated) (Build expectation)

Implement LLM-integrated features as part of BTP applications (e.g., assistant in the workflow ), including: tool calling, orchestration, memory/state handling, and safe action boundaries.

Build retrieval-grounded experiences (RAG-style) over enterprise content and APIs where the solution requires grounded responses, with clear fallback behaviors.

Create evaluation loops (offline test sets + online monitoring) so AI behavior changes are measurable and regressions are caught early.

  • Engineering Excellence (Quality, DevOps, Collaboration)

Overview: TekWissen is a global workforce management provider headquartered in Ann Arbor, Michigan that offers strategic talent solutions to our clients world-wide. The below Client runs through fifteen executive departments which carry out the day-to-day administration of the federal government. Popular departments like Agriculture and Rural Development, Civil Rights, Environment, Health and Human Services, Natural Resources, Secretary of State. This Client has opportunities in a number of career pathways, including, but not limited to, business and administrative support, education and human services, IT and computers, medical and healthcare, natural resources, law enforcement and public safety, skilled trades and more. With positions in over 18 state departments, your perfect career fit is waiting for you at the client. This client is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

**Job Title: Software Solutions Architect

Location: Dimondale, MI 48821

Duration: 6 Months

Job Type: Temporary Assignment

Work Type: Hybrid Shift Timings: 08:00 AM To 05:00 PM Responsibilities Job Description:**

  • Design, develop, and maintain full stack applications utilizing Java (Spring Boot) on the back end and modern JavaScript frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue on the front end.
  • Lead the development of scalable, secure, and high-performance solutions using Java-based technologies.
  • Collaborate closely with product owners, architects, and cross-functional teams to deliver comprehensive full-stack solutions aligned with business goals.
  • Design, develop, and consume RESTful APIs, and integrate with various third-party services and platforms.
  • Build responsive, user-friendly UI components using modern front-end frameworks, ensuring a seamless user experience across devices.
  • Actively contribute to DevOps practices, including continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD), containerization using Docker/Kubernetes, and automated testing.
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and collaborate effectively within an agile development environment.
  • Analyze, design, document, implement, and test software solutions based on detailed user stories managed through Jira.
  • Ensure accurate and timely time tracking for billing and reporting purposes.
  • Work alongside product owners to understand and define complex business processes
  • and translate them into effective technical solutions.
  • Identify common issues and recurring patterns across applications to design reusable, scalable solutions that reduce redundancy and improve maintainability.
  • Provide knowledge transfer and mentorship to team members, ensuring continuity and shared understanding of developed solutions.

job.name: Senior Engineer, Software Testing
job.description:
The Impact You'll Make Danfoss is looking for an experienced person having solid experience in Senior Embedded Systems Software Testing using LabVIEW and Test Stand, in accordance with Software Testing Life Cycle.

This person will be responsible to guide and coach the team as well as independently write test cases and develop scripts based on defined software requirements.

What You’ll Be Doing Responsibilities for this position include, but are not limited to, the following.

  • Writing Software testcase specification and management
  • Scripting the test cases per test case specification
  • Testing, test executing and reporting
  • Leading and coaching the team

What We're Looking For B.E/B. Tech/M.Tech/Master (Electronics/Telecommunications/Computers Science)OR equivalent

+ Certified LabVIEW Developer (CLD) is must
+ Certified LabVIEW Architect(CLA) is preferred

Experience & Attributes

  • 5 or more years of experience in Embedded software testing using LabVIEW and NI Test Stand
  • Creating Test strategies
  • Excellent communication skills, spoken and written English

Must Have Specialized Knowledge

  • LabVIEW, LabVIEW Realtime and FPGA
  • NI TestStand
  • Understands CAN Communication & Protocols like UDS, KWP2000, CANopen and J1939
  • Test Specification Management & Tools like Polarion or Equivalent
  • Change Management & Tools like JIRA/VSTS
  • Version control & Tools like SVN/GIT/Clearcase
  • Understands Traceability management & Tools like Reqtify or equivalent
  • Understands Software Architecture & Design
  • Software Test Life Cycle
  • SDLC, Agile Scrum

What You'll Get From Us

  • We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.
  • You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.
  • We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.
  • You’ll receive benefits like 13th salary, annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

Ready to Make a Difference? If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

job.name: Implementation Engineer III
job.description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

Job Summary The Implementation Engineer III is a senior technical delivery leader who partners with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning the most complex product configurations and the underlying data migrations across a portfolio of implementations. This role leads requirements validation, configuration and data reviews, platform configuration and testing, data migration and reconciliation, and user enablement, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go-live while setting the technical quality bar for the team.

Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and advanced data and database expertise, the Implementation Engineer III understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows, and translates them into scalable, maintainable solutions. This role blends hands-on technical delivery, including data transformation and migration (ETL), and scripting, with a consultative, customer-first approach. It also mentors less-experienced engineers, reviews their configuration and data work, and drives the process and quality improvements that raise the standard of implementation delivery across the organization.

Responsibilities

Read the full description

job.name: Quality Engineering & SIT Delivery Lead
job.description:
Who We Are VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

About This Role We are seeking an experienced Quality Engineering & SIT Delivery Lead to own successful end-to-end System Integration Testing (SIT) delivery for CCS releases in Pune.

In this role, you will oversee scope and risk assessment, capacity planning, test preparation and execution, defect governance, Future Usage Testing (FUT), launch assurance and release readiness. You will work closely with VOIS CIT management, onshore Test Management and programme stakeholders to align scope, risks, timelines, resource requirements and launch decisions.

You will also use delivery and defect insights to improve test effectiveness, automation adoption and productivity while reducing customer journey testing (CJT) issues and production defect leakage. The role includes direct leadership and development of 8–10 team members , alongside workforce and performance governance.

What You’ll Do

job.name: Multibody Dynamics Testing Engineer
job.description:
In this Operations role, you will directly contribute to release qualification of SIMULIA products and be responsible for quality control activities pertaining to software release. You will perform duties using our proprietary and customized toolset, work with a global teams and contribute to qualifying software deliveries adhering to our Master Release Schedule.

This position can be based in Pune, India.

Role Description & Responsibilities

  • Perform test execution, correctness failure review and ensure existing functionality is working as expected as software undergoes change.
  • Verify and validate forward compatibility of application
  • Debug and Analyze QA test failures and work closely with development team to resolve them in a timely manner.
  • Provide concise, articulated, verbal and/or written communication of findings to mentors, management and/or co-workers as necessary.
  • Identify sensitive, noisy automated test failures and resolve them.
  • Identify bottlenecks, opportunities to improve and develop scripts to optimize QC workflow.
  • Strong knowledge about Vehicle Dynamics, Engineering Mechanics, Theory of Machines, Dynamics of Machinery
  • Knowledge of any finite element analysis software will be additional advantage

Qualifications

  • ME/MTech/MS/PG in Mechanical engineering or related field with 0-1 years of experience.
  • Strong domain knowledge of Multibody Dynamics (MBD) is essential.
  • Experience or exposure in Catia, Solidworks or on similar tools will be additional advantage.
  • Good understanding of scripting and programming concepts is required to enable the candidate to understand AI-related technologies,

adapt to new tools, and effectively leverage AI solutions as needed.

What's In It For You

  • Strong learnability so that candidate learns DS QA processes, Gen7 products and platform topics.
  • Possesses excellent communication skills in English, both verbally and in writing.
  • Knowledge of software development life cycle.
  • Self-motivated, passionate and possesses critical thinking skills
  • Possesses strong organizational skills and is detail oriented
  • Test Automation: Design, develop and maintain automated test suites and associated test artifacts
  • Debug, investigate, troubleshoot and resolve issues in test environment
  • Collaborate with quality engineering and software development teams to build highly reliable tests.
  • Provide clear weekly status to management including progress, impediments and ideas
  • Contribute towards process and tools initiatives to improve our software test automation solutions
  • Use AI technology to optimize and improve the Test Automation
  • Work in a culture of collaboration and innovation
  • Ensure knowledge sharing within the team
  • Able to work well in a team environment and communicate effectively with co-workers, both local and remote.
  • Working with a Multinational culture company.

job.name: Integration Test Automation Engineer (SAP Ecosystem)
job.description:
Dear Aspirant! We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant international team.

We are looking for: Integration Test Automation Engineer (SAP Ecosystems) The Test Manager is responsible for the overall planning, coordination, governance and reporting of testing activities within the SHERPA X environment. The role ensures effective validation of SAP S/4HANA and connected applications across functional, integration, end-to-end and non-functional testing, while driving risk-based testing, automation and the effective use of AI-supported testing capabilities. The Test Manager works closely with business, E2E process teams, development teams, the Testing Factory, Release Management and technical specialists to ensure transparency of quality, risks and release readiness.

You’ll make an impact by:

  • Define and manage the overall test strategy, scope and planning for SHERPA X releases.
  • Lead and coordinate functional, integration, end-to-end, regression and non-functional testing across the SHERPA X landscape.
  • Drive cross-system integration testing across SAP S/4HANA, APIs, EDI, middleware, interfaces and connected applications.
  • Coordinate testing across Business, E2E Process Teams, Development Teams, Testing Factory, Release Management and technical specialists.
  • Manage test execution, defects, risks, quality gates and test evidence, ensuring transparency of overall quality status.
  • Ensure release readiness and provide clear quality and risk assessments as input for Go/No-Go decisions.
  • Drive risk-based regression testing and test automation, focusing on business-critical processes and high-risk scenarios.
  • Coordinate performance and non-functional testing with Performance Architects and Engineers, including load, endurance, performance regression, API/interface and batch testing.
  • Ensure relevant performance requirements and KPIs are defined and validated, including response time, throughput, stability and error rates.
  • Drive the adoption of AI-supported testing, including test-case generation and optimization, risk-based test selection, defect analysis and test-data support.
  • Provide transparent test KPIs, quality status, risks and management reporting to support release decisions.
  • Continuously improve testing through shift-left, automation, AI, standardization and lessons learned.

You’re excited to build on your existing expertise, including :

job.name: Risk Analytics - Audit Analytics - Manager
job.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

Audit Analytics - Manager At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

About Global Delivery Services Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

The Opportunity As a Manager – Audit Analytics, you will lead the design and delivery of data analytics solutions across Internal Audit, risk and controls engagements. You will partner with audit, business, technology and data stakeholders to translate risk and control objectives into scalable analytical solutions while providing technical oversight and driving high-quality delivery across teams.

The role provides an opportunity to drive Internal Audit transformation through data analytics, automation, Continuous Controls Monitoring (CCM), AI/GenAI and modern data technologies. You will also contribute to business development through solutioning, proposals and RFPs, effort estimation, solution architecture and commercial discussions.

Your Key Responsibilities

job.name: Senior AI / Machine Learning Trainer
job.description:
We are looking for an experienced AI/ML professional to deliver an intensive, hands-on Machine Learning and AI bootcamp for a corporate client in Kolkata.

The ideal candidate should have strong industry experience in building and deploying Machine Learning solutions, along with the ability to deliver practical training, conduct hands-on labs and mentor participants throughout an end-to-end capstone project.

Key Required Skills

1. Python & Data Science

  • Python, NumPy, Pandas and data manipulation
  • Statistics, probability and hypothesis testing
  • Data visualisation and exploratory data analysis
  • Feature engineering and data preparation

2. Machine Learning

  • Regression and classification algorithms
  • Decision Trees, Random Forest, XGBoost
  • Clustering, KNN and Naive Bayes
  • Hyperparameter tuning and cross-validation
  • Time Series Forecasting (ARIMA, SARIMA, etc.)
  • NLP, sentiment analysis and recommendation systems
  • Model evaluation and SHAP explainability

3. MLOps & Model Deployment

  • Scikit-learn pipelines and MLflow
  • FastAPI and Docker
  • GitHub Actions and CI/CD
  • Model monitoring and drift detection
  • Model deployment and productionisation

4. Generative AI & Agentic AI

  • LLMs and Prompt Engineering
  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  • AI Agents and Agentic AI workflows
  • GitHub Copilot and AI-assisted development

5. Google Cloud & Vertex AI

  • Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Vertex AI and Gemini
  • Vertex AI Search and RAG Engine
  • Agent Builder
  • Model deployment, monitoring and ML pipelines on GCP

Trainer Expectations

  • Strong hands-on industry experience in AI/ML engineering and Data Science.
  • Previous experience delivering corporate or technical training.
  • Ability to conduct practical coding sessions and guided labs.
  • Experience mentoring teams on real-world ML projects and capstone development.
  • Good communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to cover the curriculum progressively, from foundational concepts to advanced ML and production deployment.

job.name: Supply Chain AI Solutions Architect
job.description:
Cognizant is looking to hire a Supply Chain AI Solutions Architect who will be part of the SCM AI practice within our Product Delivery Team (EPS). The role spans three areas: presales solutioning, running customer pilots in Supply Chain AI, and solutions architecture for new SC/AI offerings. You will work closely with Sales/BD, Functional SCM, and senior architecture reviewers to turn incoming requests into credible technical responses, then carry validated solutions through pilot delivery. As part of our global team, you’ll be empowered to make a real impact - on your career, your community, and the world around you.

The Global Business Process Expert (BPX) is accountable for designing, standardizing, and evolving the end-to-end Order-to-Cash (O2C) event-driven operating model. This role plays a critical part in a multi-year transformation to shift from traditional order entry to a proactive, exception-based customer service model enabled by automation, advanced workflows, and AI-driven insights.

The Global BPE partners closely with the Global Process Owner to define new ways of working that fundamentally change how work is performed, introducing event orchestration, touchless order processing, and real-time intervention capabilities. This includes designing global standards, governance frameworks, and scalable process models that drive consistency across regions while improving service reliability, speed, and cost efficiency.

To ensure these standards remain relevant and effective, the Global BPX actively incorporates feedback from Regional BPXs into the evolution of global standards. This role combines process design, transformation execution, and technology enablement, ensuring that future-state processes are not only well-defined but also practical, scalable, and aligned to business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities Global Process Design & Transformation

  • Design and document future-state O2C processes, emphasizing event-driven orchestration and exception-based execution.
  • Embed new ways of working that shift teams from transactional processing to proactive event management.
  • Set global standards for touchless order processing, intelligent exception handling, and consistent customer outcomes.

Event & Exception Framework

  • Develop and maintain a global event taxonomy (e.g., order failures, credit blocks, supply and delivery risks).
  • Define event triggers, thresholds, prioritization logic, and escalation paths to enable timely intervention.
  • Create standardized response playbooks to ensure consistent issue handling and resolution across regions.

Technology & Digital Enablement

  • Partner with IT and transformation teams to enable processes through ERP, CRM, and workflow platforms (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Dynamics 365).
  • Support the implementation of case management, automated workflows, and real-time alerting to manage exceptions at scale.
  • Contribute to AI and analytics use cases that improve visibility, predict risk, and enable proactive issue resolution.

Governance & Global Alignment

More than 1,400 global enterprises across manufacturing, public sector, higher education and other industries use our platform to manage sourcing, contracts, invoicing, payments and supplier relationships in one place.

Jaggaer One connects Source-to-Contract, Procure-to-Pay and Supplier Intelligence, with embedded AI (JAI) that helps teams move faster, stay compliant and make better decisions. Our platform supports a supplier community of more than 13 million and manages $2.9 trillion in annual spend.

We’re looking for Someone who takes ownership of outcomes, not just tasks. This role needs a self-starter who drives cost initiatives to closure with minimal hand-holding - flags issues before they’re asked to, follows up without being chased, and treats savings targets as something they’re personally accountable for.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end validation of cost optimization opportunities (rightsizing, idle resource clean-up, storage optimization) - not just flagging them, but following through to closure.
  • Act as the technical liaison with engineering/tech teams when recommendations are challenged or denied, bringing data-backed validation and alternative options rather than escalating every pushback upward.
  • Independently prepare and distribute regular cloud cost and usage reports, proactively surfacing anomalies or trends rather than waiting to be asked.
  • Drive daily follow-up on open optimization opportunities - ownership means nothing sits stale in a tracker; you chase it until it’s implemented.
  • Execute optimizations directly: rightsizing, terminating idle resources, scheduling non-prod resources, applying storage lifecycle policies.
  • Maintain FinOps hygiene - tagging governance, anomaly detection, budget adherence — as an ongoing discipline, not a periodic task.
  • Keep a clear, self-maintained progress tracker on savings initiatives and proactively update leadership without being chased for status.
  • Monitor usage trends across cloud providers (including GCP, if multi-cloud) to catch new/unexpected usage early rather than after it hits the bill.
  • Support RI/Savings Plan lifecycle management — tracking expirations, recommending renewals or exchanges, and coordinating sign-off with relevant stakeholders (e.g., DBA, engineering).

job.description:
Who We Are VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

About This Role We are seeking a Credit Vetting Analyst to conduct credit and identity verification checks for new and existing business customers across SME, SOHO, LSME and Corporate segments. The role supports Vodafone’s credit risk framework through customer due diligence, credit assessment, credit limit management and fraud prevention.

The role also supports compliance with Credit and Collections policies, Know Your Customer (KYC) requirements, audit obligations and regulatory standards, helping protect Vodafone from bad debt and fraud exposure

What You Will Do Complete credit assessments for new business account applications and assess customer creditworthiness using available assessment data.

Review and validate company information and legal entity details.

Conduct credit reference agency checks using approved credit bureau tools.

Recommend appropriate risk classifications and escalate high-risk applications to Credit Risk Management for approval.

Review existing customer accounts where credit limits have been exceeded.

Review and validate company registration, director and business ownership information, proof of identity and proof of address documentation where required.

Verify directors and authorised signatories against approved identification sources and ensure KYC documentation is complete before account activation.

Review requests for new or increased credit limits and support quarterly reviews of existing customer limits.

Ensure credit limits remain aligned with customer risk profiles and exposure levels, with final credit limit setting approved by the Credit Risk Manager.

Maintain complete audit trails and supporting evidence and assist with internal and external audit activities.

job.name: CFMC Lead (Water)
job.description:
Responsibilities Budgeting & Financial Planning Protocols:

  • Develop comprehensive capex and opex plans and detailed financial models for all upcoming and ongoing projects, ensuring alignment with strategic business objectives.
  • Validate financial assumptions related to cost, timelines, and revenue impact, and ensure adherence to financial performance benchmarks such as Payback Period, Internal Rate of Return (IRR), and Return on Capital Employed (ROCE).
  • Incorporate risk buffers and scenario analysis to strengthen planning accuracy and decision-making confidence.

Fund Utilization & Reporting Mechanisms

  • Monitor short- and long-term cash flow forecasts to ensure optimal fund availability and rational deployment across projects in coordination with the Treasury team.
  • Oversee vendor billing processes, Letter of Credit (LC) utilization, and advance payments to maintain financial discipline and prevent working capital inefficiencies.
  • Implement robust fund tracking and reporting systems to enhance transparency and accountability.

Financial & Operational Reporting

  • Consolidate project-level financial and operational data into structured, periodic reports for senior management and stakeholders.
  • Automate recurring reporting processes where possible to improve efficiency and ensure real-time visibility into Capex performance.

Cost Governance & Financial Controls

  • Lead financial governance through regular variance analysis, highlighting deviations from budget and ensuring timely interventions.
  • Prepare and present quarterly reports on key financial performance indicators (KPIs), enabling leadership visibility and proactive risk management.
  • Establish and monitor internal financial controls, and initiate corrective measures in cases of overspending, budget breaches, or unapproved expenditures.

Value Engineering

  • Provide analytical and financial support during contract negotiations to ensure that final deals align with the organization’s cost optimization objectives and financial targets.
  • Review and refine Capex BOQs and budget estimates in coordination with project and finance teams; support financial negotiations and commercial discussions by providing cost analysis and recommendations for optimization.
  • Review vendor quotations for commercial feasibility, benchmark costs against industry standards, and offer value engineering insights to enhance deal value.
  • Leverage financial modeling to influence strategic procurement and vendor selection decisions.

Project Returns & Closure Reports

  • Track actual financial performance of projects both during execution and post-commissioning to ensure delivery against projected returns.
  • Prepare comprehensive project closure reports in alignment with Detailed Project Report (DPR) expectations, capturing key financial metrics, learnings, and deviations.
  • Escalate material variances or performance issues to leadership for timely review and corrective planning.

job.name: Business Analyst
job.description:
Company Description

Turnpoint Advisors is an operator-led advisory firm that helps Indian consumer brands accelerate growth and navigate business turnarounds. The firm partners with founders, promoters and boards of FMCG, D2C and consumer-product companies on critical P&L decisions, including brand and portfolio strategy, go-to-market, distribution, sales-force effectiveness, pricing and revenue growth management. Founded by Sudhir Langer, a consumer-goods CEO with over 20 years of leadership experience at Colgate-Palmolive, Reckitt, Tata Consumer Products and Raymond Consumer Care, Turnpoint's advice is grounded in real-world operating experience. The firm combines rapid diagnostics, focused strategy design and hands-on execution support alongside client teams. Turnpoint Advisors is based in Kolkata and works with consumer brands across India.

Role Description

This is a full-time, on-site Business Analyst role on a contract basis, based in Kolkata. The Business Analyst will support client engagements by gathering and analyzing data on brand performance, pricing, distribution and sales-force effectiveness. The role involves translating business challenges into clear problem statements, mapping current business processes, and identifying opportunities for growth and efficiency. The individual will prepare reports, dashboards and presentations to communicate insights to Turnpoint leadership and client stakeholders, and will work closely with client teams to validate findings, support strategic planning and track impact during execution.

Qualifications

  • MBA from a reputed institute.
  • 2+ years of work experience, preferably in consulting, FMCG or consumer brands.
  • Willingness to work full-time, on-site in Kolkata.

Skills

  • Strong analytical skills: interpreting complex data, spotting trends and turning them into actionable insights.
  • Business analysis and structured problem solving: translating client needs into clear problem statements and solution approaches.
  • Business process mapping and improvement.
  • Advanced Excel / spreadsheets and data visualization; PowerPoint storytelling.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with senior stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced advisory environment.
  • Attention to detail and a collaborative, professional approach to client work.

Description & Requirements Bloomberg AIM (Asset and Investment Manager) is a buy-side trading platform used by some of the biggest asset managers in capital markets. Our platform is a one-stop shop that enables everything from idea generation to trade execution and post-trade operations. It’s a large scale system – built by more than 400 engineers – used to manage trillions of dollars each day by 930 global firms across over 80 countries. We’re the market leading platform, and Bloomberg continues to invest in our growth as a product and engineering team – that’s where you come in!

Our Team In the Compliance team, we tackle problems associated with large distributed systems such as latency and scaling, balanced with the need for reliability and accuracy required for a business-critical system. Over the next 2-3 years, we have multiple projects focused on keeping our clients ahead of the competition as well as organically rebuilding the platform in order to serve the growing number of tier-1 clients with a global footprint that transact in volumes we currently cannot support. Solving problems on this scale is hard and we’re always looking for fresh ideas and new technologies to leverage.

What’s in it for you? The Compliance team builds systems which ensure that every transaction happening across the entire AIM platform is checked against 10s of thousands of rules. These rules ensure that no market regulation is violated, no illicit/manipulative activity is performed, and no activity that would put the client at financial risk takes place. We additionally provide the necessary tools to define and manage rules as well as deal with violations and provide trading supervisory overrides where applicable. Because our systems are in the critical path of real-time trading, throughput, latency and correctness are of paramount importance.

The impact of the Compliance product spans further than just AIM as it is also being used by the Sell-Side OMS (TOMS), various execution platforms and portfolio optimizers. The team is a core team under Compliance providing a solution for Creation, Business intelligence, Audit, Reporting, and Automation of Compliance Rules. Our team works closely with our business counterparts and quality engineering teams in an Agile environment. Our development processes include daily scrum, sprint planning, Github, developing unit/regression tests, conducting code reviews and automated coverage tests and CI/CD pipeline.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with a strong background in system design, architecture, and the development of high-quality, modular, stable, and scalable software. Just as importantly, we value engineers who bring energy and enthusiasm - driving discussions, sharing fresh ideas, and championing best practices within their teams.

job.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Job Description We are looking for a highly skilled, deeply hands-on Full-Stack Software Engineer who will cover frontend UI, backend architecture, cloud deployment, and DevOps engineering all under one hat. Since our team already includes dedicated AI Engineers and Data Engineers, your primary mission is to be the foundational software engineering anchor: building the robust, scalable, and secure user interfaces, infrastructure, integrations, and server-side logic that allows our AI solutions to thrive in a production environment.

Description Of The Area At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. As part of our strategic initiatives, we are enabling high-value AI solutions spanning advanced agentic frameworks, Generative AI applications, and classical Machine Learning. The Applied AI Engineering Team is tasked with building these innovative AI applications end-to-end to solve complex business challenges in healthcare.

In the 2026 tech landscape, the lines between traditional disciplines have blurred. We operate in small agile teams (e.g., ~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before (through agentic SDLC).

Job Responsibilities Frontend Architecture & Generative UI: Develop highly scalable, reusable UI components using expert-level TypeScript and modern frameworks (React/Next.js or Angular 16+). Shift from static layouts to flexible, dynamic interfaces that gracefully handle unpredictable data and real-time LLM streams.

Core Backend Engineering & API Design: Design and build highly scalable, reusable backend services and APIs (using Python) that serve as the backbone for multi-agent workflows and GenAI applications. Build, host, and secure Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and standard APIs to standardize data exchange.

Cloud Architecture & DevOps Excellence: Design, implement, and manage secure and scalable cloud infrastructure (primarily AWS) tailored for diverse AI workloads. Apply Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) practices using Terraform. Build, maintain, and optimize fully automated CI/CD pipelines and manage application containerization (Docker).

Agentic SDLC & Engineering Excellence: Leverage AI coding assistants and autonomous agents (e.g., Claude Code, Ona) daily to accelerate full-stack development cycles. Conduct rigorous code reviews for both human-written and AI-generated code.
