job.name: AI Inference Engineer
job.description:
Hiring for FlexAI — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

FlexAI is building a high-performance, cloud-agnostic AI compute platform for training and inference. Its Token Factory serves 20+ open models through one OpenAI-compatible API, from serverless to dedicated endpoints and private cloud, running across NVIDIA, AMD and emerging AI accelerators. The company is led by the team that deployed the Aurora supercomputer and managed 50,000+ GPUs at Intel, is headquartered in Paris, and is growing its Bengaluru engineering centre as inference demand scales.

About the Role

As an AI Inference Engineer you'll design, build and optimise the serving stack that runs large language and multimodal models in production on heterogeneous hardware. It's a hands-on role at the intersection of model architecture, hardware and production serving: you'll own critical parts of an inference runtime built on vLLM, SGLang and PyTorch, help set direction on performance, and work with engineering, research and product to deliver fast, reliable and cost-efficient tokens to customers.

What you'll do

  • Own the serving stack for LLMs and multimodal models: engine configuration, tensor/expert/data parallelism and deployment across NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.
  • Bring new open-weight models to production quickly and correctly: chat templates, tool-calling and reasoning parsers, structured outputs, quantized checkpoints.
  • Profile and optimise throughput, time to first token, inter-token latency and cost per token, from kernels to the request path.
  • Apply and evaluate FP8/FP4 quantization, speculative decoding, KV-cache reuse and offloading, prefix caching and prefill/decode disaggregation.
  • Maintain and contribute patches to vLLM and SGLang, and upstream fixes where it makes sense.
  • Run inference on Kubernetes across clusters and clouds with autoscaling, zero-downtime rollouts and graceful failure handling.
  • Build observability, benchmarking, load-testing, evaluation and model-release tooling that catches silent quality regressions before customers do.

What you bring

  • 2+ years building performance-critical systems software in Python and C++.
  • Hands-on experience serving LLMs in production with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM or similar engines.
  • A deep understanding of transformer inference: attention and the KV cache, batching and scheduling, and when a workload is memory-bandwidth bound versus compute bound.
  • Experience profiling GPU workloads (Nsight, rocprof, PyTorch profiler) and turning findings into measured improvements.
  • Familiarity with distributed inference: tensor and expert parallelism, NCCL/RCCL, high-speed interconnects.
  • Comfort with Kubernetes, containers and running production services.
  • A habit of measuring before and after every change, and of verifying correctness, not only speed.

Nice to have

job.name: Senior, Forward Deployed Engineer, Tech Transfer Strategy (2 year-fixed term contract)
job.description:
This is a 2 years fixed term contract About The Role GSK’s Enterprise AI team builds AI solutions that prove value fast and scale to production. The Forward Deployed Engineer is the engineer GSK sends in to find out whether an AI idea will work — embedded with business unit teams, proving ideas through PoCs, PoVs, and MVPs at a days-to-weeks cadence, then handing the proven solution off to the Sr. Solutions Engineer for scale-up. The pattern is proven by AI-native companies — Anthropic, Palantir, OpenAI — and this role brings that model to GSK.

This senior engineer role embeds directly with business unit teams — product owners, engineering leads, and the wider BU — to understand the problem and execute. Most prototyping work is AI-augmented: AI coding assistants and multi-agent workflows handle the bulk of routine coding, freeing the FDE to focus on framing, judgement, and validation. The role works directly inside the customer’s business and emerges with working software and a defensible value hypothesis — not slideware. The FDE does not carry use cases through to long-term operations — clean handoff to the Sr. Solutions Engineer is part of the role.

CMC (Chemistry, Manufacturing and Controls) is the GSK function that turns a validated molecule into a reliably manufactured, quality-assured medicine; its mission is to get safe, effective, consistently manufactured medicines to patients, faster. To support GSK's ambition to double new product introductions, the CMC Acceleration program is composed of three engines: the Development Engine, which fosters molecule and process development (R&D); the Tech Transfer Engine, which expedites the path from R&D to market (GSC); and the Data & Automation Engine (across CMC), which provides the foundational knowledge system feedback loop and agentification of the full CMC process.

This role will build and scale the low-code and pro-code agent platform applied to tech transfer strategy. It will also use predictive modelling to assess process fitness for a receiving site, quantify site impact, facilitate PPQ and PAI readiness. The core area of NPI strategy will be thoroughly tackled optimizing scenario planning and data exchange with Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMO). You bring deep, hands-on AI/engineering expertise and the judgement to turn ambiguous tech transfer problems into shipped, production-grade systems, while mentoring the engineers around you.

Key Responsibilities PoC (Proof of Concept) / PoV (Proof of Value) / MVP (Minimum Viable Product) Delivery

  • Take ownership of high-priority BU (Business Unit) use cases from problem framing through to a working prototype, at days-to-weeks cadence, and form a defensible view on whether each should progress.
  • Ship first production versions directly for use cases where the path is clear — before the Senior Solutions Engineer takes them forward to scale.

job.name: API Test Engineer - Capital Markets
job.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced API Tester with 5–8 years of software testing experience and strong expertise in the Capital Markets domain. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in API testing, REST/SOAP services, backend validation, and financial trading workflows , ensuring the reliability, accuracy, and performance of capital markets applications.

Key Responsibilities

1. Analyze business and technical requirements to develop API test scenarios, test cases, and test scripts.
2. Perform functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end API testing.
3. Test RESTful and SOAP APIs using tools such as Postman, Swagger, and SoapUI.
4. Validate API request/response payloads, HTTP status codes, headers, authentication, and error handling.
5. Perform backend database validation using SQL queries.
6. Validate end-to-end Capital Markets workflows, including order management, trade execution, clearing, settlement, and reconciliation.
7. Test integrations between trading platforms, brokerage systems, and financial applications.
8. Identify, document, track, and report defects using Jira or similar defect management tools.
9. Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and QA teams to resolve API-related issues.
10. Ensure data accuracy, system reliability, and compliance with business requirements.

Mandatory Technical Skills

1. 5–8 years of experience in Software Testing, with strong hands-on API testing experience.
2. Strong knowledge of REST APIs, SOAP APIs, JSON, and XML.
3. Hands-on experience with Postman, Swagger, SoapUI, or similar API testing tools.
4. Good understanding of HTTP methods, status codes, authentication, and authorization.
5. Strong SQL skills for backend data validation.
6. Experience in Functional, Integration, Regression, and End-to-End Testing.
7. Good understanding of API automation frameworks is an added advantage.
8. Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar test management tools.

Mandatory Domain Experience – Capital Markets

1. Strong hands-on experience in Capital Markets, Investment Banking, or Brokerage platforms.
2. Understanding of trading lifecycle, including order placement, execution, trade confirmation, clearing, and settlement.
3. Knowledge of financial instruments such as Equities, Derivatives, Bonds, or Fixed Income.
4. Exposure to Order Management Systems (OMS), Trading Platforms, and Market Data integrations.
5. Understanding of financial transaction processing and reconciliation.

Good to Have

1. Experience with FIX Protocol and FIX message validation.
2. Exposure to performance testing tools such as JMeter.
3. Knowledge of microservices architecture and event-driven systems.
4. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and API automation using Rest Assured or similar frameworks.

Last Mile builds global solutions that enable Amazon to attract an elastic supply of drivers, companies, and assets needed to deliver Amazon's and other shippers' volumes at the lowest cost and with the best customer delivery experience. Last Mile Science team owns the core decision models in the space of jurisdiction planning, delivery channel and modes network design, capacity planning for on the road and at delivery stations, routing inputs estimation and optimization. Our research has direct impact on customer experience, driver and station associate experience, Delivery Service Partner (DSP)’s success and the sustainable growth of Amazon. Optimizing the last mile delivery requires deep understanding of transportation, supply chain management, pricing strategies and forecasting. Only through innovative and strategic thinking, we will make the right capital investments in technology, assets and infrastructures that allows for long-term success. Our team members have an opportunity to be on the forefront of supply chain thought leadership by working on some of the most difficult problems in the industry with some of the best product managers, scientists, and software engineers in the industry.

Key job responsibilities

Candidates will be responsible for developing solutions to better manage and optimize delivery capacity in the last mile network. The successful candidate should have solid research experience in one or more technical areas of Operations Research or Machine Learning. These positions will focus on identifying and analyzing opportunities to improve existing algorithms and also on optimizing the system policies across the management of external delivery service providers and internal planning strategies. They require superior logical thinkers who are able to quickly approach large ambiguous problems, turn high-level business requirements into mathematical models, identify the right solution approach, and contribute to the software development for production systems. To support their proposals, candidates should be able to independently mine and analyze data, and be able to use any necessary programming and statistical analysis software to do so. Successful candidates must thrive in fast-paced environments, which encourage collaborative and creative problem solving, be able to measure and estimate risks, constructively critique peer research, and align research focuses with the Amazon's strategic needs. As a senior scientist, you will also help coach/mentor junior scientists in the team.

job.description:
Hiring for PULS Group — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About PULS Group

PULS Group is a global leader in DIN rail power supplies, Field Power Supplies, and industrial power technology. The India team is scaling local capability for manufacturing, analytics, supply-chain visibility, and cross-functional business support while staying connected to PULS global operating standards. The role is based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu.

Job Roles & Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain reliable data pipelines from SAP S/4HANA into Snowflake, ensuring clean, consistent, business-ready data for the global controlling and analytics team.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • 3–5 years of data engineering, analytics engineering, or BI engineering experience; no freshers/newcomers for this role.

Role Impact

This role will help PULS replace and localize data-engineering capability that previously sat in Munich. The hire will turn SAP and business data into trusted Snowflake data products and Power BI outputs, enabling controllers and global business teams to make faster, more confident decisions.

What We Offer

job.description:
Quantitative Analyst — Front Office Analytics

About Calypso (a Nasdaq Product) Nasdaq Calypso delivers mission-critical risk, regulatory, and trading technology to the world's largest financial institutions. The platform powers trading and trade processing across every major asset class — FX, rates, equities, credit, commodities, and digital assets — serving hundreds of banks, broker-dealers, asset managers, and central counterparties globally.

Our Quantitative Analytics team sits within a global organization of 10,000+ colleagues with offices across North America, EMEA, and APAC. We combine the engineering depth of a leading fintech with the scale, stability, and client reach of a publicly listed market infrastructure leader.

This role is based in Mumbai and operates on a hybrid working model (typically 3 days in office, 2 days remote).

Role Overview

We are hiring a Quantitative Analyst to join our Front Office Analytics team. You will design, implement, and productionize pricing and risk models used directly by our clients' trading desks.

This is a hands-on quant role: you will own models end-to-end, from mathematical derivation through C++/Python implementation, performance optimization, testing, documentation, and client support. Our library covers all major asset classes, so you'll have exposure well beyond any single desk.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and maintain pricing, risk, and XVA models across rates, FX, credit, equity, and/or commodities
  • Translate mathematical specifications into high-performance, well-tested production code
  • Work directly with clients' quants and traders to calibrate, validate, and extend models to new products and markets
  • Partner with Engineering on performance (vectorization, GPU/parallel compute, AAD/adjoint sensitivities)
  • Give to our AI/ML initiatives for model acceleration, calibration, and anomaly detection
  • Write clear technical documentation and defend methodology in model validation reviews

Required Skills & Requirements

  • 5+ years as a quantitative analyst in derivatives analytics (any asset class considered)
  • Strong development skills in C++ (modern C++17/20) and/or Python; comfort with Git, CI/CD, and code review culture

Job Description Implements and optimizes components within existing distributed systems under the guidance of senior engineers. Applies foundational scalability principles, conducts performance and load testing, and configures retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts to improve resilience to network variability. Delivers scoped features, develops fault-injection tests, and assists with data replication and synchronization.

Builds telemetry and alerts, maintains operational runbooks, and participates in on-call rotations with support. Uses automation and infrastructure-as-code scripts to troubleshoot issues. Follows established change management, security, and compliance procedures, including encryption, access controls, and remediation plans, and escalates complex issues appropriately.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: –Assist in the implementation of components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling under the guidance of senior engineers.

–Optimize code segments and/or systems for large-scale data processing with oversight from senior engineers.

–Implement scalability requirements for assigned components.

–Learn about the use of data plane platforms for large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.

–Execute performance and load testing, with guidance.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: –Collaborate with the team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by learning about redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.

–Learn about recovery oriented computing principles and assist in applying them to component designs.

–Configure and test retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability, with guidance

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: –Implement testing and alarming configurations to detect issues/failures.

–Support efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures, under guidance.

–Help build dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: –Implement functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.

–Implement test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness, under guidance.

–Help implement basic data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: –Assist in diagnosing and debugging issues in system components to support ongoing operation, under supervision.

–Follow protocols to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.

job.description:
Job Purpose and Impact

  • The Full Stack Developer – Corporate Risk Reporting role focuses on the risk visualization layer of the Corporate Risk Reporting (CRR) platform. The role is responsible for building application capabilities that enable fast, flexible, and intuitive consumption of enterprise risk data for internal risk management users.
  • Within the CRR architecture, core risk logic is implemented in PostgreSQL, with curated risk results published into OpenSearch to support high-performance reporting, fuzzy filtering, and interactive exploration. This role remains hands-on in building solutions using .NET-based backend services and React-based frontend applications, while also leading and coaching junior full stack developers to deliver cohesive, high-quality visualization capabilities.
  • The position plays a key role in translating complex risk datasets into scalable and user-friendly reporting experiences, while setting technical direction and standards for the CRR visualization layer.

Key Accountabilities

RISK VISUALIZATION DELIVERY: Designs and implements user-facing risk reporting capabilities that enable efficient visualization and exploration of enterprise risk data, including positions, P&L, FX exposures, and entering adjustments.

FRONTEND EXPERIENCE DELIVERY: Development of high-performance and intuitive user interfaces using React and AgGrid, optimized for large datasets and advanced interaction patterns such as drilldowns, pivots, filtering, and navigation.

BACKEND SERVICES AND APIs: Develops .NET-based backend services that mediate access to OpenSearch, support aggregation and query orchestration, and enable consistent data consumption patterns.

OPENSEARCH CONSUMPTION: Implements effective OpenSearch query, indexing and consumption patterns to support fast retrieval, fuzzy filtering, and flexible exploration of risk data published from PostgreSQL.

ENGINEERING QUALITY: Enforces engineering standards for the visualization layer, including code quality, testing practices, and CI/CD adoption, ensuring maintainable and reliable solutions.

PERFORMANCE AND USABILITY: Owns performance and usability outcomes for the visualization layer, actively identifying and addressing bottlenecks across frontend, backend, and OpenSearch interactions.

COLLABORATION: Works closely with the CRR Development Lead and Senior Business Analyst to align visualization capabilities with platform architecture and business risk requirements.

CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT: Continuously evaluates and improves visualization patterns, technical approaches, and team practices to enhance the effectiveness and scalability of CRR risk reporting.

Qualifications Minimum requirement of 3 years of relevant work experience, typically reflecting 5+ years in delivering full-stack applications in data-intensive or analytics-driven environments.

About the Role:

Aditya Birla Science and Technology Co. Pvt. Ltd. (ABSTC) seeks a technically strong Senior Scientist for the Metals & Mining, Copper Domain. The role requires hands-on experience in metal deformation processes and expertise in FEA-based simulation of metal deformation process. Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Act as the primary technical interface for customers in the wire and cable industry to understand their process issues, quality concerns, and performance gaps. Willing to work on field and stay in a plant (Non-negotiable)
  • Design and optimize wire drawing passes. Evaluate material performance during drawing operation through benchmark study (Non-negotiable)
  • Effectively use and apply simulation tools using FEA (e.g., ANSYS or Abaqus or DEFORM) to predict stress–strain behaviour, temperature rise, and die wear. (Non-negotiable)
  • Work with manufacturing teams on-site to improve yield, reduce break rates, and enhance line speeds through research & data-driven process optimization. (Non-negotiable)
  • Translate customer problems into technical requirements for new die designs, drawing schedules, or process modifications.
  • Define and monitor KPIs for drawing performance (e.g., breaks/km, die life, energy per ton) and lead continuous improvement initiatives (Lean/Six Sigma).
  • Material characterization: Good to have analytical knowledge to perform fracture mechanics and microstructural analysis.
  • Prepare technical reports, project charters, risk assessments, and business cases for leadership review. Author and publish technical manuscripts, conference papers, and internal whitepapers to build organizational and industry thought leadership.
  • Contributes to scientific and technical ideation and scoping of new projects to resolve technical issues of stakeholders.

Skills & Experience:

  • 1–3 years of field experience in the metals industry (Aluminium or Copper or Steel) manufacturing or wire drawing processes.
  • Effective communication skills for project and team management.
  • Good to have field experience preferably in wire and cable

Qualification:

M. Tech in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering or Materials Science or related field from premier institute with good academic and professional work experience.

Key Competencies:

  • Wire drawing process knowledge and experience.
  • Metal Deformation modelling
  • Material Characterization

We seek a knowledgeable and research-focused Security Engineer to join a new Advanced Threat Protection team within Auth0 Customer Identity. This role does two things at once: it researches how attackers will use AI against identity systems, and it researches and builds how we use AI to defend our products, our infrastructure, and — most importantly — our customers' tenants.

This role is a key member of the Security team embedded within the Customer Identity product unit and works across multiple functions to get ahead of emerging AI threats, supporting the growth of our global Customer Identity business.

We are an engineering-focused team that seeks to stay on the cutting edge of security technology and the threat landscape. In this role you won't just assess our current AI security offering — you'll research what we should be protecting customers from one to two years ahead, turn that research into concrete protections, and help put AI-assisted defenses into the hands of the teams and customers who protect their tenants.

In this role you will work as part of a globally distributed team of talented engineers who share a passion for security and enjoy solving complex problems at scale. This role works closely with and alongside the members of the broader Okta Security team in support of Okta's company-wide security strategy and Okta’s Secure Identity Commitment.

This is a level-agnostic description; scope, autonomy, and leadership expectations scale with level (Senior through Staff).

job.name: AI Product Engineer
job.description:
Join our Team We are seeking a hands-on AI Engineer to build and support enterprise People Data, analytics, and AI solutions.

The role involves working with business and technology teams to understand requirements, develop prototypes, and turn successful ideas into secure, scalable solutions. The candidate should be comfortable coding, solving technical problems, and supporting applications through deployment and production.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate business requirements into practical technical solutions.
  • Develop and maintain data pipelines, APIs, AI applications, and integrations.
  • Build prototypes and evolve successful concepts into production-ready solutions.
  • Develop GenAI capabilities such as RAG applications, intelligent assistants, and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Integrate AI solutions with Snowflake, cloud services, enterprise APIs, and vector databases.
  • Support the modernization and migration of legacy data workloads.
  • Implement data quality, security, privacy, access control, monitoring, and responsible AI requirements.
  • Test, troubleshoot, document, deploy, and support solutions in production.
  • Collaborate with engineers, business teams, security, and architecture stakeholders.

Technical Skills Python and Software Engineering

  • Strong Python programming skills.
  • Experience developing APIs, backend services, data pipelines, or AI applications.
  • Understanding of modular development, testing, logging, exception handling, secure coding, and CI/CD.
  • Ability to troubleshoot application and production issues.

AI and GenAI

  • Experience building LLM-powered applications.
  • Knowledge of RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and AI orchestration frameworks.
  • Understanding of AI evaluation, hallucination mitigation, model monitoring, and responsible AI.
  • Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise data and applications.

Snowflake and Data Engineering

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake, SQL, data modelling, and ETL/ELT pipelines.
  • Familiarity with Snowflake features such as Streams, Tasks, Snowpipe, RBAC, and data masking.
  • Experience with query optimisation, data reconciliation, and performance monitoring.
  • Knowledge of PySpark and at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Required Competencies

  • Relevant experience in AI engineering, software engineering, or data engineering.
  • Strong coding, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work through ambiguity and learn new technologies quickly.
  • Good understanding of secure and scalable application development.
  • Clear communication and effective collaboration with technical and business teams.
  • Experience working with enterprise security, privacy, and governance requirements.

Our teams ensure the performance, security, and scalability that clients and industries depend on every day. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. job.name: Senior Software Engineer
job.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Title of Job: Sr . Software Engineer

We are looking for a Senior Software engineer who is passionate about writing the tools to integrate and support to build large-scale, high-demand software in a fast-paced agile environment. You will share our passion for test-driven development, continuous integration and automation to produce frequent high-quality releases.

Our engineering team is fast, innovative and flexible; with a weekly release cycle and individual ownership. We expect great things from our engineers and reward them with stimulating new projects, emerging technologies and the chance to be part of a company that is changing the cloud computing landscape forever.

You will get an opportunity to work in scaling our infrastructure to the next generation. Our scale is already huge in running tens of thousands of tests for every commit automatically. This comes with challenges in speed by reducing compute time from days to a few minutes.

Responsibilities:

  • You will be part of the team that builds, maintains, and improves our highly-automated build, release and testing infrastructure.
  • Scripting, tools-building, and automation are paramount to Okta Engineering; everybody automates. You will be creating and coding tools for internal use to support continuous delivery.
  • Team up with Development, QA and Ops to continuously innovate and enhance our build and automation infrastructure
  • Collaborate with peers and stake-holders to create new tools/process/technology. We use the latest technology from AWS and you can experiment, recommend, and implement new technologies in our build and CI system.
  • Work with internal customers to roll-out projects and process, monitor adoption, collect feedback, and fine-tune the project to respond to internal customers’ needs.

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience with one or more programming languages including Python, Go, Java, Javascript
  • Good understanding of application development, micro services architecture and successful elements of a multi-service ecosystem
  • Ability to coordinate cross-functional work towards task completion.
  • Understanding of Agile methodologies is a plus.
  • Past experience working on AWS or K8S
  • Good understanding of virtualization, dynamic provisioning, Docker, AWS and Linux
  • Experience in Kubernetes is a plus
  • B.S. Computer Science or equivalent.

Okta is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

job.description:
Overview Microsoft’s AI infrastructure is evolving rapidly to support the next generation of large-scale AI training and inference. The AI Frameworks (AIFx) Networking & Systems Tools (NeST) organisation develops foundational system software that enables Microsoft’s Maia accelerator platforms across pre-silicon development, hardware bring-up, cloud integration and production cloud infrastructure that enables AI accelerators to operate reliably and efficiently at cloud scale.

Within NeST, the India Development Centre is building end-to-end engineering competency across the Maia system software stack. Our work spans the boundary between distributed cloud systems and low-level accelerator software, including control-plane services, host and device management software, accelerator virtualisation, Kubernetes-based infrastructure, Developer/Debugger Infrastructure tools, hardware lifecycle management, reliability, telemetry and diagnostics.

We are looking for a Software Engineer 2 to design and build scalable AKS/Kubernetes infrastructure for GPU and AI accelerator platforms. You will work on cluster lifecycle, node and resource management, deployment, availability, observability and automation needed to operate accelerator infrastructure reliably at cloud scale.

job.name: Senior Platform Engineer
job.description:
ABOUT US: LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.

LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.

OUR PEOPLE: People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our culture of connecting, creating opportunity and delivering excellence shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.

We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 70 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers.

ROLE SUMMARY: This is an exciting opportunity to join a high impact engineering team responsible for developing and evolving the LOCP platform, a strategic technology enabling the migration of flagship real time systems onto an advanced, cutting-edge container platform designed for ultra-low latency, high throughput, and resilience.

You will be working at the forefront of platform engineering, contributing to the design, implementation, and evolution of enterprise scale infrastructure and platform capabilities that operate at extraordinary scale.

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it’s your career and ‘It’s yours to build’ which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.

The opportunity : Senior Consultant-TMT-Business Consulting Risk-CNS - Risk - Process & Controls - Gurgaon

TMT : Industry convergence offers TMT (Technology, Media & Entertainment, and Telecommunications) organizations the chance to evolve and transform, but it also presents challenges around competitiveness and delivering agile corporate strategies for growth. Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now.

We help TMT companies create compelling employee and customer experiences, retaining skills and talent while achieving enterprise-wide operational excellence. We help them protect their data, brand and reputation. We also enable the pursuit of M&A strategies that systematically create value, reduce risk and transform TMT companies into powerhouses that will lead the technology revolution of the future – building a better working world for all.

CNS - Risk - Process & Controls : EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.

We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :

Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls

job.name: Competitive Intelligence - Oncology - Gurgaon-DM
job.description:
Company Description WNS, part of Capgemini, is an Agentic AI-powered leader in intelligent operations and transformation, serving more than 700 clients across 10 industries, including Banking and Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, Shipping and Logistics, and Travel and Hospitality. We bring together deep domain excellence – WNS’ core differentiator – with AI-powered platforms and analytics to help businesses innovate, scale, adapt and build resilience in a world defined by disruption.Our purpose is clear: to enable lasting business value by designing intelligent, human-led solutions that deliver sustainable outcomes and a differentiated impact. With three global headquarters across four continents, operations in 13 countries, 65 delivery centers and more than 66,000 employees, WNS combines scale, expertise and execution to create meaningful, measurable impact.

Job Description Total Exp - 4-9 Years. To support Global Pharma Franchise (Immuno-Inflammation Derma CVM) Commercial strategy team for various requirements of Competitive Intelligence

  • Have good understanding of Pharmaceutical business from commercial and clinical development perspective; knowledge of global pharmaceutical environment and challenges enabling to provide CI support for early, near to launch and launched medicines
  • Hand-on experience on secondary data sources and propriety databases such as Pharma Projects, TrialTrove, Cortellis, PharmaTell, Decision Resources, etc.
  • To manage multiple CI projects under tight timelines interfacing with global clientele and prioritize requests based on the criticality and business need as agreed with the stakeholders
  • Gain business context about the internal assets, competitor dynamics and monitor competitor activity for a range of KITs/KIQs specific to the medicine/TA
  • Deliver in depth, comprehensive, regular CI reports and support ad hoc queries in the areas of indication based pipeline landscapes, competitor company/ asset profile, competitor launch timelines and key event timelines, newsletters etc.
  • To engage with various internal and external stakeholders such as Forecasting/Market intelligence/Pricing & Market access/ Market research / Medical teams and able to stick the various intelligence and report the same
  • Responsible for continuous process improvement in developing content for various CI deliverables across indications/therapy areas
  • Interact as a “partner” with onshore stakeholders, not waiting to be asked to give an opinion and pushing back with respect to scenarios, iterations, analysis, and recommendations
  • Demonstrate excellence as an individual contributor with minimal support from peers/team lead, together with the ability to mentor a team of CI offshore analysts, driving high productivity/ efficiency, and creating appropriate performance reviews and capability development plans
  • Strong written and oral communication/presentation skills.

Qualifications M.Pharm / PhD

job.name: Software Engineer
job.description:
Job Description – ROS 2 Robotics Developer

Company: Brightbots Private Limited

Position: Robotics Software Engineer – ROS 2, LiDAR & Autonomous Navigation

Experience: 2–3 Years

Location: Gurgaon, Haryana

Employment: Full-Time, On-Site

Industry: Robotics, Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMR), Solar Automation

About Brightbots

Brightbots develops robotic cleaning and automation solutions for large-scale solar power plants. We are developing an autonomous tracked rover/crawler capable of navigating solar farms, transporting robotic cleaners between solar panel rows, and performing precise docking and alignment operations.

We are looking for a hands-on ROS 2 Developer to support the development, integration, testing and deployment of our autonomous crawler using LiDAR, cameras, IMU, RTK-GNSS and other sensors.

Key Responsibilities

1. ROS 2 Development

  • Develop and integrate robotics software using ROS 2 (Humble/Jazzy).
  • Implement ROS 2 nodes, topics, services, actions and launch files.
  • Integrate motor controllers, sensors and embedded control systems.
  • Develop communication interfaces between ROS 2 and STM32/ESP32 controllers.

2. LiDAR & Sensor Integration

  • Integrate 2D/3D LiDAR for obstacle detection, mapping and navigation.
  • Work with cameras, IMU, wheel encoders and RTK-GNSS.
  • Implement sensor fusion for reliable outdoor localization.
  • Support point-cloud processing and obstacle avoidance.

3. Autonomous Navigation

  • Configure and customize ROS 2 Nav2 navigation stack.
  • Implement waypoint navigation between solar panel rows.
  • Develop path planning and obstacle avoidance algorithms.
  • Support outdoor navigation in uneven terrain, dust and variable lighting.
  • Develop autonomous stopping and recovery procedures.

4. Precision Docking & Alignment

  • Develop algorithms for positioning the crawler at solar panel row ends.
  • Use LiDAR, cameras and markers for precise alignment.
  • Support telescopic bridge positioning and cleaner transfer operations.
  • Implement safety interlocks during docking and robot transfer.

5. Testing & Deployment

  • Test algorithms using Gazebo/RViz and actual hardware.
  • Conduct field trials at solar power plants.
  • Debug navigation, localization and sensor issues.
  • Optimize software for industrial deployment.

Required Technical Skills

  • 2–3 years of practical experience in robotics software development.
  • Working knowledge of ROS 2.
  • Proficiency in Python and C++.
  • Experience integrating LiDAR with ROS.
  • Familiarity with SLAM, localization and navigation.
  • Knowledge of ROS 2 Nav2, TF2, URDF and RViz.
  • Understanding of differential-drive or tracked mobile robots.
  • Experience with Linux/Ubuntu and Git.
  • Ability to debug software directly on robotic hardware.

Preferred Skills

job.name: Deep Learning Research Engineer – Medical Imaging
job.description:
Key Responsibilities Job Description – Deep Learning Research Engineer – Medical Imaging

  • Develop deep learning models for 2D/3D image segmentation, including tumor, lesion, and organ segmentation.
  • Preprocess medical images, including DICOM/NIfTI handling, resizing/resampling, normalization, cropping, and augmentation.
  • Explore, implement, and benchmark deep learning and foundation models for oncology-related medical image segmentation, classification, and lesion detection.
  • Perform transfer learning, fine-tuning, feature extraction, and controlled ablation experiments.
  • Train, fine-tune, and evaluate models using Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, MONAI, and nnU-Net.
  • Evaluate models using appropriate metrics, including Dice/IoU for segmentation and accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, ROC-AUC, and calibration for classification.

Experience

  • 4–7 years of hands-on experience in developing and fine-tuning AI/ML models.
  • Practical exposure to NLP, computer vision, or predictive analytics projects.
  • Demonstrated experience in implementing AI solutions using open-source or cloud frameworks

Technical Competencies Understanding Of Foundational Deep Learning Models And Architectures, Including

  • Image segmentation: U-Net, U-Net++, Attention U-Net, 3D U-Net, nnU-Net, and DeepLab.
  • Vision Transformers: ViT, DeiT, Swin Transformer, and Swin-UNETR.
  • Foundation and self-supervised models: SAM/MedSAM and DINOv2 for transfer learning or feature extraction.
  • CNN–Transformer hybrid architectures: TransUNet, UNETR, Swin-UNETR, and hybrid CNN/Transformer encoders.
  • Detection and instance segmentation: Mask R-CNN, especially for lesion detection or digital pathology.
  • Classification: CNN-based classifiers, ResNet/EfficientNet-style backbones, ViT/Swin-based classifiers, and transfer-learning approaches.

Educational Qualification Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Medical Imaging, or a related field.

+ Strong Python programming skills.
+ Hands-on experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow; PyTorch is preferred.
+ Understanding of CNNs, transfer learning, data augmentation, and standard training/evaluation workflows.
+ Foundational deep learning concepts: Strong understanding of neural network fundamentals, including weights and biases, activation functions, forward propagation, loss functions, backpropagation, gradient-based optimization, weight updates, and model training and evaluation.

Skills: cnn,lesion detection,medical imaging,nifti,swin-unetr,image segmentation,swin transformer,deep learning,dicom,monai,pytorch / tensorflow,u-net / nnu-net

As our customers rapidly adopt large language models and generative AI for their business, we're building the next-generation AI platform to accelerate their development. You'll work alongside teams of talented engineers, collaborate with applied scientists, and solve problems that span the full AI lifecycle — from efficient resource scheduling across heterogeneous hardware to fault-tolerant distributed training and reinforcement learning. Design and improve the automation, reliability, and performance of generative AI training compute infrastructure, including resource scheduling and fault-tolerant distributed training across heterogeneous hardware.

Partner with applied scientists and software engineers to evaluate new technologies and deliver infrastructure changes that improve the end-to-end AI development workflow.

A day in the life

You'll spend your days close to the customer — identifying their pain points and building the tools that solve them. You'll dig into how resources are being used, find opportunities to make them more efficient and secure, then implement those optimizations end to end. You'll also define and instrument the metrics that matter, such as GPU efficiency, so the team can measure what's working and continuously improve. It's a role for someone who enjoys moving between understanding a problem, engineering a solution, and proving its impact with data.

job.name: Machine Learning Engineer - ECH, Vice President
job.description:
Join us as a Machine Learning Engineer - ECH

  • In this role, you’ll be driving and embedding the deployment, automation, maintenance and monitoring of machine learning models and algorithms
  • Day-to-day, you’ll make sure that models and algorithms work effectively in a production environment while promoting data literacy education with business stakeholders
  • If you see opportunities where others see challenges, you’ll find that this solutions-driven role will be your chance to solve new problems and enjoy excellent career development
  • We're offering this role at vice president level

What you’ll do

Your daily responsibilities will include you collaborating with colleagues to design and develop advanced machine learning products which power our group for our customers. You’ll also codify and automate complex machine learning model productions, including pipeline optimisation.

We’ll expect you to transform advanced data science prototypes and apply machine learning algorithms and tools. You’ll also plan, manage, and deliver larger or complex projects, involving a variety of colleagues and teams across our business.

You’ll Also Be Responsible For

  • Understanding the complex requirements and needs of business stakeholders, developing good relationships and how machine learning solutions can support our business strategy
  • Working with colleagues to productionise machine learning models, including pipeline design and development and testing and deployment, so the original intent is carried over to production
  • Creating frameworks to ensure robust monitoring of machine learning models within a production environment, making sure they deliver quality and performance
  • Understanding and addressing any shortfalls, for instance, through retraining
  • Leading direct reports and wider teams in an Agile way within multi-disciplinary data and analytics teams to achieve agreed project and Scrum outcomes

The skills you’ll need

To be successful in this role, you’ll need to have a good academic background in a STEM discipline, such as Mathematics, Physics, Engineering or Computer Science. You’ll also have the ability to use data to solve business problems, from hypotheses through to resolution.

We’ll look to you to have experience with machine learning on large datasets, as well as experience building, testing, supporting, and deploying advanced machine learning models into a production environment using modern CI/CD tools, including git, TeamCity and CodeDeploy.

You’ll Also Need

job.name: Data Analyst
job.description:
Company Description TCS (Tata Consultancy Services) is a global IT services, consulting, and business solutions organization known for delivering technology-driven transformation to clients across industries. The company offers a broad portfolio of services, including analytics, digital solutions, and cloud technologies, enabling organizations to make data-informed decisions. TCS invests in professional development and learning to help team members build long-term, sustainable careers in technology and analytics. The Gurugram location provides opportunities to work on impactful projects with global clients in a collaborative, inclusive environment.
Role Description This full-time, on-site Data Analyst role is based in Gurugram. The Data Analyst will collect, clean, and validate data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy and reliability for reporting and analysis. The role involves performing data analysis, building dashboards and reports, and developing data models to support business insights and decision-making. The Data Analyst will collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into analytical solutions and communicate findings in a clear and actionable manner. The role also includes documenting methodologies, maintaining data quality standards, and continuously improving analytical processes.
Qualifications

  • Strong Analytical Skills and Data Analytics capabilities to interpret complex datasets and derive insights.
  • Solid understanding of Statistics to support hypothesis testing, forecasting, and data-driven decision-making.
  • Experience with Data Modeling to design and optimize data structures for reporting and analysis.
  • Effective Communication skills to present findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in tools such as SQL, Excel, and at least one analytics or BI platform (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).
  • Familiarity with a programming language for data analysis (e.g., Python or R) is preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced setting.

job.name: Quantitative Analyst-Market Making
job.description:
Quantitative Researcher / Analyst – Market Making

Location: Noida, India (On-site)

Company: Met Traders Ltd

Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role

We are looking for talented Quantitative Researchers and Analysts to join our growing quantitative trading team in Noida.

You will work closely with our London-based traders and quantitative developers to research, develop, and optimise systematic market-making strategies across global derivatives markets.

This is a hands-on, research-focused role with direct exposure to live trading operations, where your analysis and strategies will have a measurable impact on trading performance.

Key Responsibilities

Research and develop quantitative market-making strategies, including pricing, spread optimisation, inventory management, and hedging.

Analyse high-frequency market data to identify trading opportunities, market microstructure patterns, and execution inefficiencies.

Build backtesting and simulation frameworks to evaluate trading strategies.

Develop statistical models for fair-value estimation, volatility, liquidity, and short-term price movements.

Monitor and analyse live strategy performance, identifying opportunities to improve profitability and risk-adjusted returns.

Collaborate with traders and developers to deploy research into live production trading systems.

Investigate execution quality, adverse selection, transaction costs, and other factors affecting market-making profitability.

Requirements

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.

Strong Python programming skills, particularly NumPy, pandas, and statistical analysis libraries.

Solid understanding of probability, statistics, time-series analysis, and quantitative modelling.

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with an aptitude for working with large datasets.

An interest in financial markets, algorithmic trading, and market microstructure.

Ability to independently investigate complex quantitative problems and communicate findings clearly.

Desirable Skills

Previous experience in quantitative research, algorithmic trading, market making, or high-frequency trading.

Knowledge of derivatives, particularly futures and options.

Understanding of order-book dynamics, bid-ask spreads, liquidity provision, and inventory risk.

Experience with C++ or C#.

Familiarity with statistical arbitrage, mean reversion, and short-horizon predictive modelling.

Experience handling tick-level market data and building event-driven backtesting systems.

What We Offer

Direct involvement in developing and improving live market-making strategies.

Close collaboration with experienced traders and quantitative researchers in London.

Exposure to global derivatives markets and sophisticated electronic trading infrastructure.

Opportunities to take ownership of research projects from initial concept through to live deployment.

job.name: AI Data Engineer III
job.description:
Overview This role reports into Director/Sr. Manager within Technology GRC and is the technical builder behind the function's agentic AI transformation. The AI Data Engineer III designs, builds, and operates the data pipelines, AI agents, and automations that deliver GRC services — with primary focus on the Data Governance capabilities (e.g., data quality, data lineage and data catalog), all operating under a human-in-the-loop model supervised by the responsible GRC leader.

The role bridges GRC domain requirements and engineering execution: building the data foundations (ingestion, modeling, quality) that agentic workflows depend on, and prototyping control automations, evidence collectors, and governance tooling that reduce manual effort and enable the team to scale without proportional headcount growth.

Responsibilities GRC Tool & Automation Engineering

  • Build and integrate agentic AI solutions and automations within the enterprise GRC platform to standardize workflows, automate evidence collection, and improve reporting.
  • Develop control automations, evidence collectors, and governance tooling, reducing dependence on the broader engineering backlog.

Risk Register Automation

  • Engineer AI-assisted workflows to populate, maintain, and reconcile the enterprise Risk Register across technology domains.
  • Automate linkage between risk entries, controls, and remediation tracking.

Policy Governance Automation

  • Build AI-assisted tooling for policy drafting, framework crosswalks, annual review cadence, and exception workflows.

Agent Design, Safety & Operations (Human-in-the-Loop)

  • Design agentic workflows using RAG, function/tool calling, and Model Context Protocol (MCP), with appropriate guardrails for accuracy, confidentiality, and IP boundaries.
  • Implement human-in-the-loop checkpoints and monitoring so GRC leaders can supervise and validate agent outputs.
  • Apply AI risk controls aligned to OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and MITRE ATLAS.

Agent Evaluation, Observability & Guardrails

  • Build evaluation harnesses and observability for deployed agents - measuring grounding, accuracy, and consistency while minimizing hallucinations across GRC use cases.
  • Implement guardrails, deployment gates, and immutable audit trails/logging so non-compliant or low-confidence outputs are caught before use.
  • Maintain model documentation (model cards, data provenance) to support AI governance and regulatory defensibility.

Qualifications

Job Description: About Us At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.

We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.

Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Global Business Services Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.

Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.

In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.

Process Overview The GenAI & Digital Assets Platform Team develops and operates secure, scalable, and compliant technology platforms that support innovation across the organization. The team is responsible for enterprise capabilities spanning GenAI application development, AI agents, model orchestration, governance, observability, security controls, tokenization, digital custody, distributed ledger integration, and digital settlement.

The team follows a product-led and engineering-driven approach, partnering with business and technology stakeholders to mature reusable platform capabilities and deliver solutions using Agile and DevSecOps practices.

job.name: Senior Platform Software Engineer
job.description:
Job Description Owns moderately complex components within platform services or SDKs; leads team-level improvements to integration frameworks and developer tooling. Performs deep debugging across a bounded set of distributed services, driving fixes that protect downstream consumers and upgrade paths. Analyzes usage, performance, and error budgets for specific platform surfaces; implements targeted resilience and capacity optimizations. Authors and curates team-scoped documentation, samples, and adoption guidance.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities Platform Software Development:

  • Own a bounded platform component (service module, SDK area) and evolve its contracts for multi-tenant use.
  • Perform deep debugging across a limited-service graph; drive compatibility-safe remediation plans.
  • Implement targeted resilience/capacity patterns and document adoption guidance for team consumers.

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization:

  • Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently.
  • Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle.
  • Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code.
  • Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements.
  • Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. Develops fixes for identified issues.
  • Implements software testing (e.g., functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process.
  • Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding.
  • Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration.
  • Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design:

  • Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture.
  • Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices.

Description About the Role & Team We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Architect to help our enterprise customers radically accelerate and modernize their software delivery lifecycle. In this elite, high-impact role, you will embed directly with customer engineering teams to prove the value of AI-led engineering through hands-on architecture, agentic workflows, and measurable delivery outcomes.

You will help customers transition from traditional, ticket-bound Scrum cycles toward intent-driven, increasingly autonomous delivery models where AI tools, agents, and human governance seamlessly turn business intent into production-ready software.

Requirements Candidate Profile: Qualifications & Experience Must-Have Attributes Experience: 12+ years of proven experience across software engineering, architecture, product/platform engineering, or solution architecture, backed by a strong track record of product-side delivery.

SDLC Mastery: Deep, foundational understanding of enterprise software architecture, DevSecOps pipelines, Agile/Scrum frameworks, and the broader product lifecycle.

Hands-on AI Fluency: Direct, practical fluency with AI development tools, IDE-based AI assistants, agentic workflows, and AI-enabled software delivery. You must possess the ability to build, evaluate, and deeply explain working AI solutions.

Modern AI Tech Stack: Experience leveraging tools and frameworks such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, MCP (Model Context Protocol), RAG, and vector databases.

Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi-agent orchestration, AI Observability

Good-to-Have Skills Customer-Facing Excellence: Prior experience in high-touch, customer-facing technical roles (e.g., Forward-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, Field Engineer, or Pre-Sales Engineering Leader).

AI Governance & Security: A strong grasp of AI governance models, human-in-the-loop controls, responsible AI frameworks, observability, and production readiness for AI-enabled enterprise systems.

Job responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Identify AI Opportunities: Work directly with customer engineering, product, architecture, and executive teams to diagnose SDLC bottlenecks and map out high-value areas for AI-led acceleration.

job.name: Large Language Model Architect
job.description:
Project Role : Large Language Model Architect

Project Role Description : Architect large language models (LLM) that can process and generate natural language. Design neural network parameters, trained on large quantities of unlabeled text data.

Must have skills : Large Language Models (LLMs)

Good to have skills : NA

Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary:

As a Large Language Model Architect, a typical day involves designing and structuring advanced language models capable of understanding and generating human-like text. This role requires envisioning the architecture of neural networks that can efficiently process vast amounts of unstructured text data. The professional spends time analyzing model performance, refining parameters, and ensuring the models meet the desired objectives. Collaboration with various teams to align the model design with project goals and troubleshooting challenges that arise during development are integral parts of the daily routine. Continuous innovation and adaptation to emerging research in natural language processing are also key aspects of the role.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
  • Responsible for team decisions.
  • Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
  • Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
  • Lead the development and implementation of scalable language model architectures.
  • Mentor junior team members to enhance their technical skills and project contributions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional efforts to integrate language models into broader applications.
  • Monitor and evaluate model outputs to ensure quality and relevance in real-world scenarios.

Professional & Technical Skills:

  • Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Large Language Models (LLMs).
  • Experience in designing and tuning neural network architectures for natural language processing tasks.
  • Strong knowledge of training models on large-scale unlabeled text datasets.
  • Ability to optimize model parameters to improve performance and efficiency.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art techniques in language model development and deployment.
  • Capability to troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to model behavior and integration.

Additional Information:

  • The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Large Language Models (LLMs).
  • This position is based at our Pune office.
  • A 15 years full time education is required.

job.name: Data Scientist II
job.description:
Do you want to help solve the world's most pressing challenges? Feeding the world's growing population and slowing climate change are two of the world's greatest challenges. AGCO is a part of the solution! Join us to make your contribution.

AGCO is looking to hire candidates for the position of Data Scientist Your Impact

  • Data Management and Analysis: Extract, clean, and analyze large datasets from diverse sources, including telemetry data, test fleet data, and test bench data, to support engineering and AI applications in the agricultural machinery domain.
  • Insight Generation: Identify patterns, trends, and correlations in data to derive actionable insights that inform product development, parts design, specifications, and operational decisions.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams to drive data-driven decision-making and foster innovative solutions that enhance engineering efficiency, improve product quality, and enable the development of new, data-driven solutions for product usage.
  • Model Development and Refinement: Continuously develop, evaluate, and refine analytical models and methods to ensure their accuracy, scalability, and relevance to business needs.
  • Machine Learning Applications: Develop machine learning models to predict maintenance needs, optimize machine settings, analyze customer usage patterns, and enhance overall product performance.

Your Experience And Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience working with structured data, including cleaning, manipulating, and data mining. Experience with unstructured data is a plus.
  • Proven experience with at least two of the following: statistical models, machine learning, deep learning (preferably time series or large language models for NLP, topic modeling, or conversational AI). Familiarity with model setup, fine-tuning, evaluation, and deployment.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, PySpark, and common frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch). Familiarity with R is a plus.
  • Experience with cloud-based tools like Apache Spark, Databricks, AWS Glue, and Amazon SageMaker.
  • Strong data visualization skills and experience with BI tools (e.g., Dash, Tableau, Shiny).

Your Benefits

  • GLOBAL DIVERSITY – Diversity means many things to us, different brands, cultures, nationalities, genders, generations – even variety in our roles. You make us unique!
  • ENTERPRISING SPIRIT- Every role adds value. We're committed to helping you develop and grow to realize your potential.
  • POSITIVE IMPACT – Make it personal and help us feed the world.
  • INNOVATIVE TECHNOLOGIES - You can combine your love for technology with manufacturing excellence – and work alongside teams of people worldwide who share your enthusiasm.
  • MAKE THE MOST OF YOU – Benefits include health care and wellness plans and flexible and virtual work options.

Who is Mastercard?

The team builds scalable, API-driven platforms that identify, enrich, and manage subscription payments, helping reduce disputes, improve transparency, and enhance customer experience.

Engineers work on high-impact, cloud-native solutions integrated with Mastercard’s global infrastructure, delivering real-time insights and actions for millions of users.

  • Create repeatable processes to support development of modeling and reporting
  • Effectively use tools to manipulate large-scale databases, synthesizing data insights. Provide 1st level insights/conclusions/assessments and present findings via Excel and PowerPoint.

job.name: Senior Full Stack Engineer (React, Python, AI)
job.description:
Hiring for ClearRoute — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

ClearRoute is a global platform engineering consultancy, headquartered in London with engineering hubs in Pune and Bengaluru. It helps large enterprises bring digital products to market faster, cheaper and more safely, across cloud platforms, quality engineering and developer experience, and it puts AI at the centre of how software gets delivered. ClearRoute is growing its India engineering team for enterprise client engagements and is hiring two senior full-stack engineers who can build AI-enabled applications end to end.

About the Role

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer you'll build, deploy and optimise scalable, high-performance web applications that handle large volumes of data and integrate AI-driven components. You'll work closely with backend engineers, cloud specialists and AI teams to ship intelligent, production-ready applications at scale. This is a full-time role, hybrid from Pune or Bengaluru.

What you'll do

  • Design, build and maintain scalable front-end applications in React and modern TypeScript/JavaScript, backed by Python services
  • Build front ends that stay fast and responsive under high data throughput
  • Integrate applications with AI-powered services: LLM APIs, RAG pipelines, LLM workflows and agentic AI systems
  • Build automation and orchestration services, particularly on Microsoft Azure
  • Deploy applications to the cloud (Azure preferred, AWS welcome) using Docker and cloud-native pipelines
  • Support CI/CD and make deployments reliable and repeatable
  • Improve front-end performance and observability, using measurements to guide decisions

What you bring

  • 6–8 years of software engineering experience, with recent years as a senior full-stack engineer
  • Expert, hands-on React (modern patterns, hooks, state management, performance optimisation) and Python in production
  • Has integrated LLM APIs, RAG or agentic workflows into a real application, not just used AI coding assistants
  • Has deployed applications to a cloud platform, ideally Microsoft Azure
  • Has integrated front ends with APIs, microservices and distributed systems
  • Has worked on applications that handle large datasets or high traffic
  • Familiar with Docker and container-based deployment
  • Strong understanding of front-end performance, observability and optimisation

Nice to have

  • Hands-on Azure automation and orchestration services
  • CI/CD pipeline ownership
  • Consulting or client-facing delivery experience
  • A proactive, ownership-driven way of working rather than ticket-led delivery

Originally posted on: 28 Oct 2026

job.name: Sr. Associate I, Software Engineering (Senior Backend Developer)
job.description:
Summary of Position: The Senior Backend Developer designs, develops, and supports backend capabilities for rules-based decisioning, workflow execution, event processing, and enterprise integrations within the ISS digital product portfolio. The role requires deep hands-on Java engineering experience and the ability to work effectively in an existing, production, regulated environment.

This role owns implementation across assigned backend workstreams while partnering with Enterprise Architecture and technical leadership on architecture decisions. The developer must be able to understand an established codebase, data model, integration landscape, and controlled release process, then deliver reliable enhancements with minimal supervision.

Key Requirements: Rules, workflow, and backend development

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain Java and Spring Boot services for rules authoring, versioning, scheduling, execution, notification, and related backend capabilities.
  • Implement decision and process logic using Drools, DMN, BPMN, or comparable rules and workflow technologies.
  • Design explainable and auditable execution behavior for multi-condition rules, temporal reasoning, and complex decision paths.
  • Develop secure, production-grade REST APIs with effective validation, error handling, and authorization.
  • Design and optimize data models across DynamoDB and PostgreSQL/Amazon RDS, including integrity and uniqueness patterns appropriate to each technology.

AWS, integrations, and operational resilience

  • Build and operate event-driven, serverless services using AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, and API Gateway.
  • Implement reliable asynchronous processing with idempotency, retries, dead-letter handling, concurrency management, and eventual-consistency considerations.
  • Integrate with enterprise systems, service platforms, integration middleware, and data services under real-world conditions such as timeouts, partial failures, and rate limits.
  • Define and maintain AWS resources through Terraform and Terragrunt.
  • Build logging, monitoring, alerting, and diagnostic capabilities that support production operations and root-cause analysis.

Quality, regulated delivery, and collaboration

  • Contribute to technical design reviews and Architecture Decision Records, working with Enterprise Architecture when decisions affect shared platforms or enterprise standards.
  • Build and maintain unit, component, integration, and end-to-end automated tests and meet applicable code-quality and application-security controls.
  • Support CI/CD, controlled deployments, validation evidence, and release plans across development, test, validation, and production environments.
  • Perform code reviews, mentor developers, document technical decisions, and help improve engineering practices.
  • Participate in production support, incident investigation, defect resolution, and continuous improvement.

Read the full description

Proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture.

Experience with REST APIs, JSON/XML, and API integrations.

Knowledge of SQL, PL/SQL, and database performance tuning.

Experience With Messaging Systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ) Preferred. Nice To Have :
