job.name: Software Dev Engineer II, Amazon Now (Tez)
job.description:
Description We're the India Grocery and Everyday Essentials team, building ground-up supply chain systems in India for Amazon's worldwide quick commerce business. We're developing the systems that power this fast-growing space, including demand forecasting, buying, and inter-store transfers, built ground-up on multiple backend services. Our systems span the entire quick commerce journey, from inventory availability and placement to enabling the ordering and delivery promise.

For this greenfield initiative, you'll work alongside a talented, collaborative team of Sr. SDEs, Sr. FEEs, and PEs. It's a great opportunity to learn, grow, and build industry-leading supply chain systems from scratch.

Key job responsibilities

You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices.

You work with your team to invent, design, and build software that is stable and performant.

You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when each is appropriate (and when it is not). Your solutions are pragmatic.

You consider the legacy of the code you produce and write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand.

You limit short-term workarounds. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time (or at least minimize incidental complexity).

You create flexible software without over-engineering. You make appropriate trade-offs, re-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies.

You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., system hardware, database, memory/CPU).

You work on project ideas with customers, stakeholders, and peers.

About The Team We're a fast-paced, focused team of passionate and ambitious Amazonians who strive to build industry-leading products while collaborating closely and having fun. Made up of multiple Sr. SDEs, we're working on first-of-their-kind Amazon initiatives that will scale beyond India and grocery. The team follows a flexible, collaborative culture with ample mentoring and guidance from PEs. We value high ownership, bias for action, and insist on the highest standards, following a build-fast, iterate-fast methodology. It's a great fit for passionate engineers who are equally interested in contributing to the business and product roadmap.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
  • 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
  • Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

job.name: Sr. Associate II, Software Engineering (Senior Backend Developer)
job.description:
Summary of Position: The Senior Backend Developer designs, develops, and supports secure, scalable backend services for the ISS digital product portfolio. The role requires strong hands-on engineering skills and experience delivering reliable enterprise solutions on AWS.

This role works within established enterprise architecture, security, and engineering guardrails. The developer partners with Product, Enterprise Architecture, DevOps, Quality Engineering, and other technical teams to translate requirements into maintainable production solutions and contribute to technical design decisions.

Key Requirements: Backend engineering and solution delivery

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain backend microservices, APIs, and integrations using Python 3.
  • Build scalable, secure, event-driven, and serverless solutions using AWS services.
  • Apply Hexagonal Architecture, Ports and Adapters, or comparable domain-centered patterns to keep business logic independent from frameworks, databases, cloud services, and external APIs.
  • Design domain models, application services, inbound interfaces, and outbound adapters that support maintainability and testability.
  • Implement business rules, workflow orchestration, audit-friendly processing, and reliable asynchronous execution.
  • Design and optimize data models for DynamoDB and PostgreSQL/Amazon RDS.

Cloud integration, security, and reliability

  • Design REST APIs and integrations with enterprise platforms and external services, including resilient handling of timeouts, retries, partial failures, and rate limits.
  • Implement queue-based processing with idempotency, retry policies, concurrency controls, and dead-letter handling.
  • Implement authentication and authorization patterns using OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, Okta, Active Directory, and AWS authorization capabilities.
  • Build observability through structured logging, metrics, alerts, tracing, and production diagnostics.
  • Contribute to application security, vulnerability remediation, data protection, and regulated delivery requirements.

Engineering practices and collaboration

  • Participate in technical design reviews and collaborate with Enterprise Architecture on decisions that affect shared platforms or enterprise standards.
  • Drive high-quality code reviews, automated testing, documentation, and engineering standards across assigned workstreams.
  • Define and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and Terragrunt and support CI/CD and deployment automation.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement sustainable corrective actions.
  • Mentor developers, share technical knowledge, and contribute to continuous improvement of backend engineering practices.

Description Amazon built world-class finance and accounting machinery to run its own business at scale. Finance as a Service (FaaS) is turning that machinery into a product: end-to-end back-office finance and accounting, delivered to sellers and partners as a service. Customers get Amazon-grade accuracy, controllership, and compliance without building it themselves. We run accounts payable, accounts receivable, record-to-report, and tax operations for a growing roster customers today.

The systems that power FaaS today are highly specialized, built to run Amazon's own books and in many ways add odds what other businesses really want and need. FaaS as a product will benefit from an operations stack built with multi-tenancy, data isolation, multi-auditor control support built into its foundation from the start. FaaS must scale from large multinationals down to small local business, and its technology must be similarly geared. Scaling FaaS into a durable business requires a deliberate long-term strategy, and this includes the technology that powers it.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer - Fullstack
job.description:
The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary: What You Need To Know About The Role- PayPal Marketing Technology team is dedicated to creating a best-in-class platform. As a Senior Software Engineer on our Marketing Technology Platform, you will be at the forefront of building and scaling Java/Spring, Node.js, React, and Python based services that move millions of customer profile attributes and events from PayPal source systems to downstream marketing and SaaS platforms.

job.name: Solution Architect
job.description:
Position Title: Solution Architect

Position Type: Regular - Full-Time

Requisition ID: 44959

Role Purpose

The HR Solution Architect operates at the intersection of HR strategy, process and experience design, enterprise data, and technology architecture. The role is the discipline-keeper for how HR ideas become solutions, ensuring that decisions begin with a clearly defined business problem and are evaluated through a consistent, evidence-based solutioning approach.

This role evaluates the full range of pathways, including process redesign, native SaaS capability, AI agents and automation, enterprise data platforms, API integration, custom applications, and hybrid approaches. It is platform-agnostic and vendor-neutral, with accountability for recommending solutions that are valuable, scalable, secure, responsible, human-centered, and aligned with enterprise standards.

The HR Solution Architect is a bridge role, not a platform administrator and not a pure enterprise architect. The role translates business needs into end-to-end workflows and architecture choices, builds the case for the recommended approach, and guides the solution through architecture, data, security, privacy, legal, and delivery governance. The role must communicate with equal credibility in an HR leadership discussion and a technical architecture review.

Guiding principle: Start with the business problem and the work to be redesigned, not the technology. Core Responsibilities

Problem-First Solution Design

Lead structured discovery, blueprinting, and solution design engagements that define the business problem, intended outcomes, user needs, process constraints, data needs, and value measures before identifying technology options.

Evaluate process redesign, native SaaS capability, AI or agentic solutions, enterprise data platforms, custom applications, integrations, and hybrid approaches using a consistent framework for fit, value, risk, complexity, security, data readiness, and change impact.

Create clear solution recommendations, decision records, target-state designs, and business cases that explain why the selected path is preferred and what trade-offs were considered.

Dynamic Work and Experience Design

Analyze HR services and workflows end to end before recommending technology.

Map employee, candidate, manager, HR, and shared-service experiences across process steps, handoffs, channels, decisions, controls, and data flows.

Distinguish work that requires human judgment, empathy, accountability, or exception handling from work suited to automation or AI-led execution.

Design human-in-the-loop controls and escalation paths, especially where outcomes may materially affect employees or candidates.

AI Solutioning, Experimentation, and Orchestration

Assess AI opportunities across HR with practical rigor and responsible experimentation.

Read the full description

The Global Data & CMDB Compliance Architect is the technical authority for Configuration Management Database design, Common Service Data Model (CSDM) adoption, data governance and Discovery across the Securitas ServiceNow environment. You will lead the CMDB redesign and ensure that data sovereignty, CI ownership and compliance standards are enforced at a global level.

This is a hands-on architecture role — not a reporting or analyst role. You will build, govern and continuously improve the data foundation that every other ServiceNow capability depends on.

Responsibilities

  • Represent Pinkerton’s core values of integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
  • CMDB Design & CSDM Adoption

+ Own the end-to-end redesign of the Securitas CMDB — consolidating EU and NA configurations into a single CSDM-aligned data model
+ Drive the adoption of the Common Service Data Model across all ServiceNow modules, ensuring consistent CI taxonomy, service mapping and dependency modelling.
+ Define and enforce CI ownership standards — including ownership assignment, lifecycle management and the elimination of orphaned or unowned configuration items.
+ Establish data quality KPIs and run regular CMDB health audits, reporting status to the platform governance board.

Data Governance & Compliance

  • Define and maintain global data standards for all configuration data, including naming conventions, classification schemas and data retention policies.
  • Develop and enforce a data sovereignty and compliance strategy that addresses EU GDPR requirements, regional data residency obligations and Securitas internal audit standards.
  • Work directly with the Information Security team to ensure CMDB data supports security incident response, vulnerability management and compliance reporting.
  • Own the governance process for all configuration data changes — ensuring no unauthorized production changes reach the CMDB.

Discovery & Third-Party Integrations

job.description:
The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

You will own these solutions end to end: from architecture and model selection through cloud deployment, evaluation, observability, cost efficiency, and secure operation at scale on Google Cloud Platform. Beyond individual delivery, you will raise the bar for the team — defining engineering standards, reviewing designs, mentoring engineers, and partnering with platform, security, and model risk stakeholders so that GenAI capability lands in production safely and stays reliable.

  • GenAI Solution Architecture: Architect and build production-grade LLM-powered applications, multi-agent systems, and workflow automations that assist model validators and quantitative modelers (e.g., independent validation agents, code-generation agents, monitoring agents). Own the technical design end to end, including model selection, prompting and orchestration strategy, retrieval design, tool integration, and evaluation criteria.
  • Agentic & Retrieval Systems: Design agent architectures with clear tool boundaries, guardrails, and fallback behaviour. Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines over internal data, including chunking strategy, embedding selection, index design, hybrid search, and grounding/citation quality. Define how agents are evaluated for correctness, hallucination, and safety before release.
  • Cloud Platform & Deployment Architecture: Design and operate highly available, multi-service AI workloads on Google Cloud Platform. Take ownership of the cloud architecture for AI applications — compute and serving patterns (Cloud Run, GKE), networking (VPC, private service access, egress controls), identity (IAM service accounts, least privilege), secrets (Secret Manager), storage and data services (GCS, BigQuery), and managed AI services (Vertex AI, Vertex Vector Search). Make deliberate trade-offs on scalability, latency, resilience, and cost.
  • AI-Ops & LLMOps at Scale: Establish and mature AI-Ops/LLMOps pipelines covering the full lifecycle of Generative AI tools: automated deployment, model and prompt versioning, artifact and evaluation tracking, regression testing of prompts and agents, and continuous monitoring for quality, drift, latency, token cost, and hallucination mitigation. Build the reusable platform components that let other engineers ship GenAI safely without rebuilding foundations.
  • CI/CD & Infrastructure as Code: Own CI/CD and infrastructure automation for AI services using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Cloud Build, Kubernetes manifests) and GitOps practices. Deliver reproducible, auditable, environment-parity deployments with automated testing, progressive rollout, and clean rollback paths.

Working closely with IT, Index Research, Operations, Product, Marketing, and Legal, you will coordinate across Frankfurt and New York, as well as with external consultants, to ingest and normalize complex market and reference data (e.g., exchange pricing, corporate actions, constituents), enforce data contracts and SLAs/SLOs for timeliness and accuracy, and ship high‑quality, resilient data foundations that ensure the accuracy and performance of our benchmarks.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data engineers.
  • Set coding standards, review code, and ensure best engineering practices.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, performance reviews, and career development.
  • Plan and prioritize work, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.

Data Pipeline Development

  • Design, build, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines for batch and real-time data using Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Pipelines, and Azure Synapse Notebooks for Spark-based transformations.
  • Integrate data from various sources into our Azure Synapse Analytics data warehouse and ADLS Gen2 data lake.
  • Implement scalable, efficient data ingestion and transformation workflows.
  • Ensure pipelines are reliable, maintainable, and monitored.

Data Platform Engineering

  • Work with other teams to implement and optimize data architecture.
  • Manage Azure cloud-based data platforms, including Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, Azure Function Apps, Azure Key Vault, and ADLS Gen2.
  • Design and maintain data models following Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) on ADLS Gen2; participate in schema design, modelling, and metadata management.
  • Optimize storage, compute, and overall data system performance.

Quality, Governance & Security

job.name: Data Architect
job.description:
Job Description - Data Architect Azure Databricks | Insurance and Benefits Management Experience 15+ years

Role Level Senior / Lead Data Architect

Primary Platform Microsoft Azure and Azure Databricks

Domain Insurance and Benefits Management

Role Summary

Seeking a senior Data Architect with 15+ years of experience designing scalable, secure and governed enterprise data platforms. The role requires deep expertise in Microsoft Azure, Azure Databricks, Lakehouse architecture, data modelling, data integration, governance and AI-ready data platforms, supported by strong Insurance and Benefits Management domain experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define conceptual, logical and physical data architectures for enterprise-scale cloud data platforms.
  • Design Azure Databricks Lakehouse solutions using Bronze, Silver and Gold data layers, Delta Lake and Databricks SQL.
  • Define canonical, dimensional, semantic and master-data models for analytics, reporting and AI workloads.
  • Architect scalable ETL/ELT, batch, API, file-based and event-driven integration patterns.
  • Establish data governance using Unity Catalog, including RBAC, lineage, auditing, classification and access controls.
  • Define data-quality, validation, reconciliation, exception-management and observability standards.
  • Architect secure data solutions covering encryption, masking, row/column security, privacy and regulated-data controls.
  • Design AI-ready data patterns for RAG, embeddings, vector search, semantic retrieval, MLflow and governed model consumption.
  • Drive performance, scalability, resilience, retention and disaster-recovery architecture.
  • Lead architecture reviews, technical decisions, engineering standards and mentoring across distributed teams.

Mandatory Technical Skills

Microsoft Azure; Azure Databricks; Databricks SQL; Lakehouse and medallion architecture; Delta Lake; Apache Spark and PySpark; Unity Catalog; conceptual, logical, physical and dimensional modelling; enterprise ontology and semantic-layer design; master-data management and identity resolution; ETL/ELT and distributed processing; data-quality and reconciliation frameworks; Databricks Genie; MLflow and Databricks Model Serving; RAG, embeddings and vector search; Azure AI Document Intelligence; REST APIs and managed file transfer; EDI integration concepts; Terraform; CI/CD and DevSecOps; security, encryption, masking, privacy, monitoring and observability.

Experience And Qualifications

job.name: SDE II, Ship With Amazon, Ship With Amazon
job.description:
Description Amazon’s global fulfillment network enables any merchant to ship items that are ordered on Amazon to any place on earth. There is a complex network of ways in which items move between vendor locations, Amazon warehouses, and customer locations as well as several intermediate locations through which packages travel before reaching the customer. With a scale of millions of packages, each with different attributes and delivery requirements, what results is a highly dense graph of nodes.

We have built a highly respected software engineering team which is focused on solving complex problems in worldwide transportation using workflows, optimization algorithms, and machine learning systems. These are large-scale distributed systems handling millions of packages being shipped through the Amazon logistics network.

job.name: Product Engineer - Geospatial Data Science
job.description:
Overview Esri is the world leader in geographic information systems (GIS) and developer of ArcGIS, the leading mapping and analytics software used in 75 percent of Fortune 500 companies. At the Esri R&D Center-New Delhi, we are applying cutting-edge AI and deep learning techniques to revolutionize geospatial analysis and derive insight from imagery and location data. We are passionate about applying data science and artificial intelligence to solve some of the world’s biggest challenges.

Our team develops tools, APIs, and AI models for geospatial analysts and data scientists, enabling them to leverage the latest research in spatial data science, AI, and geospatial deep learning. Our product engineers provide a strong technical voice in the product development process and use the best tools available to build highly reliable, sustained, and evolutionary software.

As a Product Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality and usability of our geospatial AI tools, models, and libraries. You will design and implement test plans, write test code, and validate software, SDKs, and AI models to help deliver robust, high-quality products to our customers. This will also include performing, documenting, and teaching a wide variety of technical tasks, developing best practices, creating tutorials and documentation, and gathering requirements. If you are passionate about geospatial AI, have a deep understanding of the product and customer needs, and communicate effectively via writing and presentations, this is the place to be!

Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement test plans and test cases, write test code, verify code changes, bug fixes for the relevant and related products to maintain product quality
  • Review and analyse test results; report status on software quality and stability; test and certify software, SDK, and AI model quality
  • Troubleshoot and triage customer issues, analyse user feedback to identify areas for improvement
  • Collaborate with data scientists and engineers on the testing, documentation and release of tools, APIs and pretrained models for geospatial AI
  • Develop samples, tutorials, documentation, blog posts and presentation of product features
  • Develop pre-trained geospatial AI models for imagery, 3D datasets and text

Job Overview We are seeking an Engineer II, Oracle Fusion Developer, to join our Corporate Systems team and support the delivery, integration, and ongoing operation of Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials. In this hands-on engineering role, you will design, develop, test, deploy, and support scalable solutions across General Ledger and related financial processes. You will collaborate with Finance, Accounting, functional consultants, senior engineers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions that meet quality, control, and delivery expectations.

Responsibilities

  • Oracle Fusion Development: Configure, develop, test, deploy, and support Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials solutions, with emphasis on General Ledger, chart of accounts, ledger structures, journal processing, allocations, and financial reporting.
  • Integrations: Develop and maintain integrations between legacy ERP subledgers, enterprise applications, and Oracle Fusion using Oracle Integration Cloud, REST/SOAP services, FBDI, and file-based interfaces.
  • Data Conversion and Reconciliation: Build and execute data conversion, mapping, validation, reconciliation, and error-handling processes that support accurate and complete financial data.
  • Reporting and Data Access: Develop and support financial reports, extracts, and data solutions using SQL, BI Publisher, OTBI, and related Oracle Fusion reporting capabilities.
  • Production Support: Monitor interfaces and scheduled processes, troubleshoot incidents, perform root-cause analysis, implement corrective actions, and improve application reliability and performance.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, strengthen controls, reduce operational risk, and improve the scalability of future Oracle Fusion subledger adoption.

job.name: Data Management Analyst
job.description:
About This Role We are seeking a motivated Data Management Analyst to join Commercial Banking AI & Data, CB and CIB Strategy & Planning, Analytics & Data Management & Product.

The role will support CB and CIB data initiatives across lending, reference data, trades and positions, with responsibilities spanning business and data analysis, product development, Data APIs, data quality, governance, controls, and delivery. The analyst will partner with business, product, technology, operations, and governance teams to deliver reliable and well-controlled data solutions and contribute to Marketplace product enablement and enhancements.

In this role, you will

  • Gather, analyze, and translate business and data requirements into user stories, process flows, data mappings, business rules and acceptance criteria.
  • Develop an understanding of CB/CIB products, lending, reference data, trade lifecycle, positions and front-to-back data flows.
  • Perform data analysis, profiling, validation and reconciliation, supporting root-cause analysis and remediation of data quality and production issues.
  • Contribute to Marketplace product development and feature enhancements, including feature definition, requirements, backlog refinement, prioritization, testing/UAT, implementation and post-production validation.
  • Partner with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and technology teams to define feature scope and translate business/data needs into scalable product capabilities.
  • Support Data API enablement for business teams, including API requirements, data attributes, mappings, business rules, validation, onboarding, and data consumption.
  • Assess new data sources for suitability, completeness, quality, and business use, while maintaining data definitions, metadata, lineage, and mappings.
  • Support data quality, data governance, and control execution, including control testing, evidence management, exceptions, and remediation tracking.
  • Support RCSA, RCSA Navigator and ITV/audit activities, including risk/control documentation, control execution evidence, findings, and remediation actions.
  • Coordinate across business, product, technology, operations, risk and governance teams, tracking risks, dependencies, issues, and action items.
  • Support Agile/Scrum delivery, including ceremonies, backlog refinement, user stories, testing, releases and post-production validation.
  • Identify opportunities for new product features, process improvements and automation across Marketplace, Data APIs, data quality, governance, and controls, including appropriate use of AI/LLM capabilities.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of data management, business analysis, analytics, or project management experience, or equivalent demonstrated

job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION - LEAD BI / DW / ETL ENGINEER Azure Databricks | Data Warehousing | ETL/ELT | Power BI | Lakehouse Experience 10-12 years

Role Level Lead Engineer / Technical Lead

Primary Focus BI, DW, ETL and Databricks

Domain Insurance and Benefits Management

Role Summary

Seeking a hands-on Lead Engineer with 10-12 years of experience across Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing and ETL/ELT, including strong Azure Databricks expertise. The role will lead delivery of governed Lakehouse and warehouse solutions, scalable data pipelines, dimensional and semantic models, certified metrics and Power BI reporting for Insurance and Benefits Management use cases.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end design and delivery of BI, enterprise data warehouse, data-mart and Azure Databricks Lakehouse solutions.
  • Design Bronze, Silver and Gold layers using Delta Lake, dimensional models, star/snowflake schemas, facts, dimensions and slowly changing dimensions.
  • Develop and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Databricks, Spark, PySpark, Spark SQL, Python, SQL and Azure Data Factory.
  • Implement batch, incremental and streaming ingestion from databases, APIs, files, HRIS, benefits platforms, CRM and external feeds.
  • Deliver curated datasets, semantic models, certified KPIs and reporting structures for Power BI, Databricks SQL and Genie.
  • Define source-to-target mappings, transformation rules, data-quality checks, reconciliation, lineage and audit controls.
  • Apply Unity Catalog governance, RBAC/ABAC, masking, access policies, employer isolation and secure data-sharing patterns.
  • Optimize Spark workloads, Delta tables, SQL queries, data models, Power BI datasets, refresh performance, compute and storage cost.
  • Establish engineering standards, reusable frameworks, automated testing, CI/CD, release controls, monitoring and production runbooks.
  • Lead technical reviews, estimates, sprint delivery, defect resolution, stakeholder communication and mentoring of distributed engineering teams.

Mandatory Technical Skills

Azure Databricks; Apache Spark; PySpark; Spark SQL; Python; advanced SQL and T-SQL; Delta Lake; medallion architecture; data warehousing, ODS and data marts; dimensional modelling; star and snowflake schemas; SCD Types 1 and 2; ETL/ELT; Azure Data Factory; Auto Loader and Lakeflow; Databricks Workflows and SQL; Photon; Unity Catalog; ADLS Gen2; Power BI data modelling, DAX, Power Query, semantic models, gateways and refresh; SSIS, Informatica or equivalent ETL exposure; data profiling, quality, reconciliation and lineage; REST APIs; Git; Azure DevOps; CI/CD; Terraform awareness; monitoring, security and performance optimization.

Preferred Education Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • ETL Job Implementation: Exposure to implementing Business Objects Data Services ETL jobs within a Business Objects Enterprise landscape, utilizing knowledge of Business Objects Data Services to support complex ETL data flows.

job.description:
Job Description

Summary of Position

We are seeking a Senior Oracle Integration Cloud Developer with 10+ years of experience across Oracle Fusion Cloud, OIC integrations, Oracle APEX application development, Oracle Visual Builder Cloud Service (VBCS), and PL/SQL to lead design, development, and support of enterprise Oracle solutions.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead design and development of OIC integrations connecting Oracle Fusion Financials, Supply chain with third party/downstream systems.
  • Architect and build scheduled and app-driven integrations, including FBDI automation with call-back functionality.

•Design, develop, and maintain custom web applications using Oracle APEX (pages, regions, dynamic actions, interactive reports/grids, forms, processes).

•Develop and optimize PL/SQL packages, procedures, functions, and triggers supporting both OIC integrations and APEX applications.

  • Design integrations using REST/SOAP web services (XML, XSD, WSDL, JSON) and XSLT transformations.

•Implement OAuth-based security for integrations, including secure connections, credential management, and token-based authentication.

•Develop and invoke OCI Functions within OIC integrations to extend processing logic and support serverless custom operations.

  • Design and build custom web and mobile front-end applications using Oracle Visual Builder Cloud Service (VBCS), integrated with OIC and Fusion/PaaS back-ends.
  • Develop and maintain OTBI and BI Publisher (XML Publisher) reports.
  • Own OIC lifecycle management — packages, lookups, versioning, cloning, and cross-instance/DR migration.
  • Lead gap analysis, solution design, and technical documentation for implementations and upgrades.
  • Design and build failure notification/alerting frameworks for integrations.
  • Prepare technical specification documents and lead KT sessions for teams.
  • Mentor junior developers and enforce coding/design standards.

•The time spent on each responsibility reflects an estimate and is subject to change dependent on business needs.

Qualifications Expected for Position

  • 10+ years of overall Oracle development experience, including strong hands-on work in OIC, Oracle APEX, and PL/SQL.
  • Strong experience with Oracle Fusion Financials (GL, AP).

•Oracle APEX application development experience is mandatory /region design, dynamic actions, interactive reports/grids, session state and security.

  • Proven expertise in FBDI automation and callback-based integration patterns.
  • Strong PL/SQL development — packages, procedures, functions, performance tuning.
  • Proficiency in REST/SOAP web services, XML, XSD, WSDL, JSON, and XSLT.
  • Strong knowledge of OAuth and other security protocols for securing integrations and web services.
  • Experience using OCI Functions as part of OIC integration flows.
  • Hands-on experience with Oracle Visual Builder Cloud Service (VBCS) for building custom UI applications.

About TechPros Network

TechPros Network (Techpros IT Solutions Pvt Ltd) is a managed services and technology partner for growing businesses, delivering digital marketing, demand generation, contact center, BPO, AI and workflow automation, web and e-commerce engineering, cloud and cybersecurity services. Learn more at techprosnetwork.com.

We are looking for an experienced Mobile Application Developer who has built and shipped apps for both Android and iPhone (iOS). Apply through LinkedIn with your resume and links to apps you have published on the Play Store and App Store.

job.name: AWS Infra and Platform Security - Manager
job.description:
Summary Position Summary Cyber Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights that help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape and secure their technology and digital transformation.

Position Summary Level: Manager

Work you’ll do:

  • Design core AWS platform security architecture, including areas such as:
  • Network (VPC) segmentation, IAM, and organization/account design (AWS Organizations, Control Tower/Landing Zone)
  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation), policy as code (Checkov, OPA) and script-based environment automation
  • Compute, containers and serverless (EC2, ECS, EKS, Fargate, Lambda)
  • Storage and data protection (S3, EBS), plus backup and disaster recovery design
  • Logging and monitoring (CloudTrail, CloudWatch, Security Hub, GuardDuty, AWS Config)
  • Define the cloud security posture strategy for multi-account AWS estates, including CSPM/CNAPP selection and implementation (e.g., Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Orca, Lacework, Sysdig, Microsoft Defender for Cloud), operating model and KPIs.
  • Establish a policy-as-code and secure-by-design programme: golden patterns, landing zone guardrails (SCPs, preventive and detective controls) and automated IaC scanning.
  • Lead the design of AI/GenAI security frameworks (Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker security, AI-SPM, AI governance) and address LLM threats such as prompt injection and data leakage using OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS.
  • Design and develop enterprise cyber security strategy and architecture by evaluating business strategies and conducting security vulnerability and risk analysis.
  • Provide product best-fit analysis for end-to-end security across layered security, zoning, integration, API, endpoint, data security, compliance and regulations.
  • Design authentication and authorization solutions (MFA, SSO, identity management) and application-specific security frameworks aligned with the organization’s strategy, policies and compliance requirements.
  • Develop Enterprise Security Governance frameworks and security policies, standards and controls using SABSA/TOGAF; perform assessments against NIST, SANS, CIS, etc.
  • Lead, mentor and manage project teams, including staffing, delivery quality and stakeholder management.
  • Support pre-sales: RFP responses, effort estimation, client workshops and thought leadership, and ensure overall design assurance.

Role Purpose

The Microsoft 365 Senior Consultant delivers and steers complex Microsoft 365 engagements across collaboration, productivity, security, and governance. The role provides expert consulting to IT and business stakeholders, supports roll-outs and service evolution aligned with the Microsoft 365 roadmap, and resolves complex technical issues. Within the matrix organization, the role works under global functional leadership while coordinating local administrative topics through the Chennai hub line management.

Matrix Reporting Model

This Role Operates Under a Global Matrix Organization

  • Functional reporting to the Global Microsoft 365 team and product leadership for scope, priorities, technical direction, and delivery outcomes.
  • Local line management to the Group Leader ITO Applications (Chennai) for organizational, administrative, and people-related matters (e.g., leave approvals, time tracking, local HR processes).

Key Responsibilities

  • Consulting, Governance & Adoption

Advise and implement best practices for Microsoft 365 adoption, governance, and security.

Stay up to date with the Microsoft 365 roadmap and support roll-out of updates and new capabilities.

Conduct workshops and training sessions for IT and business units; develop reusable guidance materials.

  • Delivery & Technical Leadership

Lead or steer delivery workstreams for Microsoft 365 improvements and initiatives under global prioritization.

Provide technical leadership and mentoring to consultants; review and improve solution quality and documentation.

Promote automation and operational excellence (e.g., PowerShell scripting, standard operating procedures).

  • Operations & Problem Solving

Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across Microsoft 365 services (e.g., SharePoint Online, Teams, Power Platform, Entra ID, etc).

Support ITSM-aligned operations (incident/problem/change), ensuring changes and releases are executed safely and documented.

Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Microsoft 365 Consultant or similar role (typically 5+ years).
  • Deep knowledge of Microsoft 365 services including SharePoint Online, Teams, Entra ID/Azure AD and related services.
  • Power Platform experience (Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI) is a must.
  • Strong understanding of identity and access management, compliance, and security within Microsoft 365.
  • Familiarity with scripting and automation using PowerShell.
  • Microsoft certifications (e.g., MS-100, MS-101, or equivalent) are desirable.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-facing skills in English; ability to manage multiple priorities.

About Us WHY LINEDATA ?

Join us in shaping the fintech of tomorrow.

With more than 1,350 colleagues across 20 locations worldwide, you'll help build cutting-edge platforms and tailored services that power the daily operations of 700 leading financial institutions. As a global, multicultural company with over 45 nationalities represented and just as many languages spoken, we thrive on diverse perspectives and collaboration. Together, we tackle future-focused topics like Al and the digitalization of finance, delivering smart solutions for our customers.

Whether you're just beginning your career or are an experienced professional, Linedata offers exposure to large-scale client projects, internal mobility and opportunities to develop your skills alongside leading experts.

THE ROLE

Candidate to actively work on L1, L2 related issues on Windows platform.

He would be responsible for managing client infrastructure and needs to resolve client queries within stipulated timeframe.

Candidate would be a part of 24\*7 rotation support and would be responsible for answering Customer queries over the emails/calls.

Responsibilities

  • Handling Windows server 2008, 2012 and 2016 on day-day basis.
  • Handling of Microsoft Exchange Server (2003, 2007, 2010, 2013, 2016 and O365) with Active Directory 2008, 2012 R2
  • Administration of Microsoft Exchange server (2003, 2007, 2010, 2013, 2016 and O365)
  • Migration mailboxes from Exchange 2010\Exchange 2013 to Exchange 2016\O365 platform
  • Routing/Mail Flow and Set up Installation and Configuration concepts
  • Troubleshoot Mail flow, DAG, Database dismount, Log Shipping issues, etc.
  • Troubleshoot issues both at the client (Microsoft outlook/ActiveSync) and server side
  • Troubleshoot issues related to infrastructure setups - DNS, DHCP, GPO
  • Troubleshoot Backup related issues on Unitrends, Veeam, Symantec Backups Exac, etc.
  • Provide timely response to all incidents, outages and performance alerts. Categorize issues for escalation to appropriate technical teams

job.name: Java Full Stack Developer with AWS
Software Engineer (UI Developer)
job.description:
Job Description Summary We are looking for a Software Engineer to help build and maintain reusable user interface components for GE HealthCare’s Ethos Design System (EDS).

In this role, you will turn designs into accessible, tested and well-documented components used by product teams across the organization. You will work with senior engineers, UX designers, product owners and quality engineers to deliver consistent user experiences for clinical and operational applications.

You should be comfortable building modern web interfaces and interested in developing deeper skills in Web Components, design systems and accessibility. You will own assigned components and features with guidance from senior team members.

GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

Job Description About EDS

EDS is the unified digital platform that powers GE HealthCare’s global software portfolio. It brings together reusable UI components, design patterns and accessibility standards to connect user experience and engineering.

By encouraging teams to reduce, reuse and recycle, EDS helps product teams eliminate redundant work and build consistent, accessible applications. These foundational components support clinical and operational applications and allow teams to focus on patient safety.

The opportunity

We are looking for a Software Engineer to build and maintain reusable components for the Ethos Design System. As EDS grows across GE HealthCare’s product portfolio, you will help make its components easy for teams to discover, integrate and use.

You will work with senior engineers, architects, UX designers, product owners, Lead System Designers, DevOps and quality engineers. You will own assigned components and features from implementation through testing, documentation and maintenance, with support and guidance from senior team members.

Key responsibilities

Component engineering and API design

  • Develop and maintain reusable, encapsulated UI components using Lit and Web Components.
  • Write clean JavaScript and TypeScript, semantic HTML, and scoped CSS using SASS.
  • Implement component APIs, including properties, events and slots, following established design system patterns.
  • Investigate defects and contribute to component performance, reliability and maintainability.
  • Participate in code reviews and apply feedback from other engineers.

Cross-framework integration

job.name: CMS-Senior-Incident Orchestrator
job.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

The opportunity The Incident Orchestrator is responsible for coordinating, driving, and governing the execution of security incidents identified by the SOC. The role ensures that incidents are triaged correctly, escalated appropriately, and resolved within defined SLAs, acting as the central coordination point between SOC analysts, threat detection teams, IT responders, and incident response leadership.

The role operates in accordance with the enterprise Incident Response Plan and Policy, supporting structured, repeatable, and auditable incident handling

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end to end coordination of security incidents from initial escalation through containment, remediation, and closure.
  • Act as the single point of coordination between L1/L2 SOC analysts, threat detection teams, IT teams, and incident response stakeholders
  • Ensure incidents are classified, prioritized, and handled in line with the approved Incident Response Policy and severity model
  • Validate escalated alerts and incidents to confirm true positives and business impact before response actions are initiated
  • Drive containment and mitigation actions by coordinating with relevant resolver groups (endpoint, network, identity, cloud, etc.)
  • Manage incident bridges / war rooms during major incidents, ensuring clear ownership and timely updates.
  • Ensure all incident activities are accurately documented in the designated incident management / ticketing platform
  • Prepare and deliver incident status updates, timelines, and summaries for SOC leadership and stakeholders.
  • Support post incident reviews (PIRs) by compiling evidence, timelines, and response effectiveness inputs.
  • Ensure SOC incident handling follows defined playbooks, runbooks, and SOPs.
  • Identify process gaps, recurring issues, and response inefficiencies, and recommend improvements to SOC and IR leadership
  • Act as an escalation point for complex or ambiguous incidents that require senior operational judgment.
  • Review and improve incident response processes and playbooks.
  • Participate and/or lead incident response calls.
  • Participate in post-incident reviews to assess the effectiveness of the response and identify areas for improvement.
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to lower-level incident responders.

job.description:
BOLD is seeking for Devops professional to own the production ML environments and MLOps infrastructure within infrastructure and data science teams. Handle day-to-day support, ad-hoc requests, and cross-team projects. Architect scalable MLOps pipelines using AWS services like SageMaker, EMR, and OpenSearch.

Job Description ABOUT THIS TEAM Infrastructure team provides various services including automation, observability, cloud/server/network architectures, CICD, infrastructure as code, database administration, incident management, vendor management, security and compliance, and acquiring new skills. These services help to improve efficiency, reduce errors, and ensure fast and reliable application releases while maintaining security and compliance. Techops help teams monitor applications and infrastructure, create resilient infrastructure, identify and resolve IT service issues, manage vendors, and ensure cloud security and compliance. The team also focuses on continuous learning and implementing new technologies to provide better value to the organization.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Design and maintain end-to-end MLOps pipelines for data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Productionize ML/GenAI services, collaborating with data scientists on model serving and workflow optimization.
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability to reduce MTTR and ensure production reliability.
  • Manage data/feature stores and search infrastructure for scalable ML inference.
  • Automate CI/CD for ML models and infrastructure with governance and security compliance.
  • Handle security patching, cost optimization, and 24x7 on-call rotations for critical services.
  • Coordinate cross-functionally with development, QA, ops, and data teams to innovate build/deployment processes.

  • 4.5+ years (Sr Engineer)/7+ years (Module Lead) in AWS MLOps with hands-on SageMaker (Pipelines, Model Registry, Studio), EMR, OpenSearch (kNN/vector search).
  • Python/Bash scripting for CI/CD, provisioning, monitoring of FastAPI/Spring Boot web services; and Linux servers (Solr/OpenSearch).
  • AWS services (S3, DynamoDB, Lambda, Step Functions) with cost control, reporting; databases (MySQL, MongoDB).
  • Strong Linux and networking fundamentals;
  • Hands-on expertise in ML tools (MLFlow, Airflow, Metaflow, ONNX).

job.name: PAM Architect/SME
job.description:
Details: This role involves Privileged Access Management (PAM) Architect will be responsible for designing the PAM architecture strategy. This role will also require helping design the PAM platform with all its tools.

Job Role Includes:

  • Develop a comprehensive PAM architecture strategy that aligns with organizational objectives and regulatory requirements.
  • Lead the design contribute to the development and deployment of PAM solutions, focusing on workload access controls and secrets management.
  • Contribute to the implementation and management of secrets management solutions ensuring secure storage, access and rotation of privileged credentials.

Leverage PAM tools such as CyberArk, HashiCorp Vault, and Microsoft Entra ID to enhance security measures and streamline access management processes.

  • Design PAM policies, standards, and procedures to ensure consistent and secure management of privileged accounts. Ensure PAM practices comply with organizational policies and regulatory requirements
  • Assess the effectiveness of PAM controls, making data-driven decisions to reduce risk and enhance security posture.
  • Collaborate with technology and business partners to identify and mitigate risks associated with privileged access.
  • Stay current with emerging trends and technologies in PAM and cybersecurity and driving enhancements to existing solutions.

Job Requirements

Details: Skills Required:

  • 7-10 years of experience in Privileged Access Management using PAM Solutions like CyberArk/StrongDM etc as an Architect/SME.
  • Strong industry experience in architecting and designing PAM solutions and deployment across the enterprise.
  • Deep technical understanding of PAM capabilities, controls and security technologies in areas related to identity and access management to address privilege-based risk.
  • Familiarity with regulatory requirements related to PAM, such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, or GDPR.
  • Expertise with build vs. buy solution options.
  • Good understanding of security concepts and technologies in the wider Identity and Access Management space: Logical Access Controls, LDAP and RBAC, Authentication solutions, PKI concepts and SIEM solutions
  • Proficient in Privileged Access Management (PAM) concepts and standard processes, covering privileged account discovery & vaulting, session management, DevOps secret management, and endpoint privilege management
